Abāza n’izindi mbaho mirongwibiri z’ urundi ruhande rw’iryo hema, ruhera i burārūko,
na zo azicurira ibitereko vyazo mirongwine mw ifeza: ibitereko bibiri‐bibiri vyo kuja musi y’urubaho rumwe‐rumwe.
Kand’ abāza imbaho zitandatu z’ahahera inyuma kur’ iryo hema, aharābana n’i burengerazuba.
Abāza n’imbaho zibiri zo ku mfuruka z’iryo hema ahahera inyuma nyene.
Hasi zari zibiri‐zibiri, arikw ahahera hejuru zari zimatanye, aho ikigombo ca mbere kigera; uko ni ko yazikoze zompi ku mfuruka zompi z’ahahera inyuma.
Nukw izo mbaho zose na zose zari munani, n’ibitereko vyazo vy’ ifeza cumi na bitandatu: ibitereko bibiri‐bibiri bija musi y’urubaho rumwe‐rumwe.
Abāza ibiti vy’intumba mu giti citwa umushita: ibiti bitanu vyo kuja ku mbaho zo ku ruhande rumwe rw’iryo hema,
n’ibindi bitanu vyo kuja ku zo ku rundi ruhande rwaryo, n’ibindi bitanu vyo kuja ku z’ahahera inyuma kuri ryo, ahahera i burengerazuba.
Igiti co hagati y’ibindi, kiri hagati kur’ izo mbaho, akigira umwishikira.
Kand’ izo mbaho azomekakw izahabu, maz’ azicurira ibigombo vy’ izahabu vyo gusobekamwo vya biti; n’ivyo biti na vyo avyomekakw izahabu.

Ajisha igihuzu co gukingīra, akijisha mu nyuzi z’amasufe no mu z’amashigisha no mu zisa n’ agahama, no mu zera derere nziza zihinzwe neza; kandi cari kijishwekw ibishushanyo vy’abekerubi, bijishwe n’abahinga bavyo.
Akibāzira inkingi zine mu giti c’umushita, azomekakw izahabu, azitērakw imisumari yacuzwe mw izahabu; avugutira ifeza, ayikūramw’ ibitereko bine vyo kuzinegamwo.
Kand’ ajisha igihuzu co gukinga ku muryango w’ ihema, mu nyuzi z’amasufe no mu z’amashigisha no mu zisa n’agahama, no mu zera derere nziza zihinzwe neza, cari kijererenzwekw amabara n’abahinga.
Abāza inkingi zitanu zaco, azitērakw imisumari; ku mitwe yazo azomekakw izahabu, bo n’ imitambikwa yazo; ibitereko vyazo ukw ari bitanu vyari bicuzwe mu miringa.

Besaleli abāza isandugu mu giti citwa umushita: uburebure bgayo bg’umurambararo bgar’ amatambge abiri n’igice y’ukuboko uciriye mu nkokora, ubgaguke bgayo bgar’ itambge rimwe n’igice, uburebure bg’igihagararo bgar’ itambge rimwe n’igice nyene.
Ayomekakw izahabu iramuye imbere n’inyuma, ayikīkūzak’ umuguno w’izahabu impande zose.
Avugutira izahabu, ayikūramw’ ibigombo bine vyo kuyitērako, abitēra ku maguru yayo ukw ar’ ane, ibigombo bibiri biba ku ruhande rumwe, bindi bibiri biba ku rundi.
Abāza iminiho mu mushita, ayomekakw izahabu;
araheza yinjiza iyo miniho yo kurerura iyo sandugu mur’ ivyo bigombo vyo ku mpande zayo.
Acura n’umutemere wo guhongerako mw izahabu iramuye; uburebure bgawo bg’ umurambararo bgar’ amatambge abiri n’igihimba y’ukuboko uciriye mu nkokora, ubgaguke bgawo bgar’ itambge rimwe n’igihimba.
Akora abakerubi babiri mw izahabu, mu mitwe yompi y’uwo mutemere wo guhongerako, abakoze mu buryo bgo gucura.
Umukerubi umwe amukora mu mutwe umwe, uwundi amukora mu wundi; abo bakerubi abashamika kur’ uwo mutemere wo guhongerako mu mitwe yawo yompi, baba kimwe na wo.
Abo bakerubi bari bashanje amababa hejuru, ayo mababa yabo yar’ akingiye uwo mutemere wo guhongerako, bārarābana; bari bashize amaso kur’ uwo mutemere.

Maz’ abāza ameza mu giti citwa umushita: uburebure bgayo bg’umurambararo bgar’ amatambge abiri y’ukuboko uciriye mu nkokora, ubgaguke bgayo bgar’ itambge rimwe, uburebure bg’ igihagararo bgar’ itambge rimwe n’igihimba.
Ayomekakw izahabu iramuye, ayakīkūza umuguno w’izahabu impande zose.
Ayabāzira ibizingiti vyo kugumya amaguru bikīkūje impande zose, ubgaguke bgavyo bungana n’urushi, abikīkūzak’ umuguno w’izahabu impande zose.
Avugutira izahabu, ayikūramw’ ibigombo bine vy’ayo meza, abitēra ku nkokora ukw ari zine zo ku maguru yayo ukw ar’ ane.
Ivyo bigombo vyari hafi ya vya bizingiti, vyar’ ivyo kwinjizamw’ iminiho yo kurerura ayo meza.
Abāza iminiho mu mushita yo kurerura ameza, ayomekakw izahabu.
Acura ibintu vyo kur’ ayo meza, amasahani yayo, n’udukombe twayo, n’imibehe n’amakarabo vyayo vyo gusukisha ibiturire ku gicaniro; abicura mw izahabu iramuye.

Akora ico guterekakw amatara mw izahabu iramuye; ico gitereko cose, hamwe n’intebe yaco n’umutumba waco, cār’ igicurano; ibikombe vyaco, bigizwe bga mapfundo apfundikiyekw amashurwe, vyari bicuriwe kuri co, vyari kimwe na co.
Cari gifise amashami atandatu mu mbavu zaco: mu ruhande rumwe rw’ico gitereko hār’ amashami atatu, mu rundi ruhande rwaco hāri yandi atatu.

Ishami rimwe ryari rifise ibikombe bitatu bisa n’amashurwe y’igiti citwa shakedi, igikombe cose cari kigizwe bga pfundo ripfundikiyekw ishurwe; n’irindi shami n’uko: amashami yose ukw ar’ atandatu ashamitse kur’ ico gitereko ni ko yar’ ameze.
Kand’ umutumba w’ico gitereko warikw ibikombe bine, bisa n’ayo mashurwe ya shakedi nyene; vyari bigizwe bga mapfundo apfundikiyekw amashurwe;
aho amashami ashamikiye kur’ ico gitereko hose ukw ar’atandatu, hār’ ipfundo ahahera musi aho amashami ahūrira, bicuriwe kuri co, vyari kimwe.
Amapfundo yaco n’amashami yaco vyari bicuriwe kuri co, vyari kimwe na co: cose hamwe cār’ igicurano gicuzwe mw izahabu iramuye.
Araheza agicurira amatara ndwi, n’imakasi zaco zo gutunganya urutambi, n’ udusahani two gushirwak’ umunyota warwo, abicuze mw izahabu iramuye.
Ico gitereko, bo n’ibintu vyaco vyose, yabikoze mw izahabu iramuye, inganya kuriba n’italanto imwe.

Abāza igicaniro co kwoserezakw imibavu mu giti citwa umushita; uburebure bgaco bgar’ itambge rimwe ry’ukuboko uciriye mu nkokora, ubgaguke bgar’ itambge rimwe nyene: cangana impande zose; uburebure bgaco bg’igihagararo bgar’ amatambge abiri; amahembe yaco yar’ abāziwe kuri co, yari kimwe na co.
Acomekakw izahabu iramuye, hejuru kuri co, no mu mbavu zaco impande zose, no ku mahembe yaco; agikīkūzak’ umuguno w’izahabu impande zose.
Musi y’uwo muguno waco, ahahera mu mbavu zaco zompi, agicurira ibigombo bibiri‐bibiri vy’ izahabu; abitēra mu mpande zaco zompi, biba ivyo kwinjizamw’ iminiho yo kukirerura.
Abāza iminiho mu giti c’umushita, ayomekakw izahabu.
Atunganya amavuta yera yo kurobanuza abahabga ibango, n’ imibavu iroranye y’ibintu bimoga, abikora nk’umuhinga yabimogoreye.

Abāza igicaniro co kwoserezakw ibimazi mu giti c’ umushita; uburebure bgaco bgar’ amatambge atanu y’ukuboko uciriye mu nkokora, ubgaguke bgaco bgar’ atanu nyene, cangana impande zose; uburebure bgaco bg’ igihagararo bgar’ amatambge atatu.
Agiha amahembe ku nkokora zaco ukw ari zine, ayo mahembe yaco yabāziwe kuri co, aba kimwe na co; araheza acomekakw imiringa.
Acura ibintu vyose vy’ ico gicaniro: inzavya, n’ibintu vyo kuyoza umunyota, n’imibehe, n’ivyo kwōkōza inyama, n’ivyo kurahuza: ivyo bintu vyaco vyose yabicuze mu miringa.
Ico gicaniro agicurira ikintu c’insobane kimeze bga rusenga, agicuze mu miringa, agishira musi y’ igikugīrwa gikīkūje ico gicaniro, gihēra hasi, kigarukira ahacāgatije ico gicaniro nyene.
Avugutira imiringa, ayikūramw’ ibigombo bine vyo gutera ku nkokora zine za ca kintu c’insobane cācuzwe mu miringa, biba ivyo kwinjizamw’ iminiho.
Abāza iminiho mu giti c’umushita, ayomekakw imiringa.
Yinjiza iyo miniho mur’ ivyo bigombo biri mu mbavu z’ico gicaniro, yo kukirerura; yakibāje mu mbaho, akigira igisamāre.
Maz’ acura ikigārigāri mu miringa, co gukaraba, acura n’ intebe yaco mu miringa nyene, abicuze mu vyīrore vy’imiringa vy’abagore bākoranira ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro gukora ibikorwa.

Maz’ akora urugo; ku ruhande ruhera i bumanuko, impuzu zo kubamba ngo zibe urugo zari zijishwe mu nyuzi zera derere nziza zihinzwe neza, uburebure bgazo bg’amakika bgar’ amatambge ijana y’ukuboko uciriye mu nkokora.

Ibirimbi vyo kuzimanikako vyari mirongwibiri, n’ ibitereko vyavyo vyo kubinegamwo vyari mirongwibiri nyene, bicuzwe mu miringa: imisumari yo kuri vyo yar’ icuzwe mw ifeza, bo n’ imitambikwa yo kuri vyo.

No ku ruhande ruhera i burārūko na rwo uburebure bg’amakika bg’izo mpuzu bgar’ amatambge ijana nyene, n’ibirimbi vyazo vyari mirongwibiri, n’ibitereko vyavyo vyari mirongwibiri nyene bicuzwe mu miringa; imisumari yo kuri vyo yar’ icuzwe mw ifeza, bo n’imitambikwa yo kuri vyo.

Ku ruhande rw’i burengerazuba, impuzu zo kubamba zar’ iz’ amatambge mirongwitanu; ibirimbi vyazo vyari cumi, n’ibitereko vyavyo vyari cumi nyene; imisumari yo kuri vyo yar’ icuzwe mw ifeza, bo n’ imitambikwa yo kuri vyo.
No ku ruhande rw’i burasirazuba, amatambge yazo yari mirongwitanu nyene.
Ku ruhande rumwe ruhera kw irembo impuzu zo kubamba zar’ iz’ amatambge cumi n’atanu; ibirimbi vyazo vyari bitatu, n’ibitereko vyavyo vyari bitatu nyene.

No ku rundi ruhande rwaryo vyari kuno; hepfo y’ irembo ry’urwo rugo no haruguru, impuzu zo kubamba zar’ iz’ amatambge cumi‐cumi n’atanu; ibirimbi vyazo vyari bitatu‐bitatu, n’ibitereko vyavyo vyari bitatu‐bitatu nyene.
Impuzu zose zo kubamba impande zose ngo zibe urugo, zari zijishwe mu nyuzi zera derere nziza zihinzwe neza.

Ibitereko vyo kunegamw’ ibirimbi vyari bicuzwe mu miringa; imisumari yo kur’ ivyo birimbi, bo n’imitambikwa yo kuri vyo, vyari bicuzwe mw ifeza; ku mitwe yavyo vyari vyometswekw ifeza; ibirimbi vyose vy’urwo rugo vyarikw imitambikwa icuzwe mw ifeza.

Igihuzu co gukinga mw irembo ry’urwo rugo cari kijererenzwekw amabara n’abahinga, cari kijishwe mu nyuzi z’amasufe no mu z’amashigisha no mu zisa n’agahama, no mu zera derere nziza zihinzwe neza; uburebure bgaco bg’amakika bgar’ amatambge mirongwibiri, uburebure bg’igihagararo bgar’ amatambge atanu: bgari cabugerwe n’ubg’ izindi mpuzu zo kubamba ngo zibe urugo.

Ibirimbi vyaco vyari bine, n’ibitereko vyavyo vyari bine nyene, vyacuzwe mu miringa; imisumari yo kuri vyo yar’ icuzwe mw ifeza, kandi vyari vyometswekw ifeza ku mitwe yavyo, bifise n’imitambikwa yacuzwe mw ifeza nyene.
Imambo zose z’iryo hema, n’iz’ urugo rurikīkūje impande zose, zari zicuzwe mu miringa.
Iki ni co gitigiri c’ivyakoze iryo hema, ari ryo hema ry’Ibishinga intahe, nk’uko Mose yageze ko biharūrwa, Abalewi baba ari bo babiharūra, baharūzwa na Itamari, mwene Aroni umuherezi.
Kandi Besaleli mwene Uri, Uri mwene Huri, wo mu muryango wa Yuda, ni we yakoze ivyo Uhoraho yabariye Mose vyose.

Yar’ afatanije na Oholiyabu mwene Ahisamaki, wo mu muryango wa Dani, umuntu azi guca amagarwe ku tubuyenge, w’umukozi w’umuhanga, umuhinga wo kujererenga amabara y’inyuzi z’ amasufe n’iz’ amashigisha n’izisa n’agahama n’izera derere.

Amazahabu yose yakoreshejwe mu gucura ivy’ iryo hema vyose, ari yo mazahabu y’amashikanwa, yanganya kuriba n’ italanto mirongwibiri n’icenda na shekeli amajana ndwi na mirongwitatu, yagezwe kuri shekeli ir’ Ahēra.
Amafeza yatanzwe n’ abaharūwe bo mw ikoraniro yanganya kuriba n’italanto ijana na shekeli igihumbi n’amajana ndwi na mirongwirindwi na zitanu, yagezwe kuri shekeli ir’ Ahēra;

yatanzwe n’abantu ibihumbi amajana atandatu na bitatu n’ amajana atanu na mirongwitanu, umuntu wese yarēngāna agashirwa mu gitigiri c’abāharūwe, amaze imyaka mirongwibiri cank’ isāga, yatanga beka imwe, ari yo kigabane ca shekeli yagezwe kuri shekeli ir’ Ahēra.

Izo talanto z’ifeza, ukw ar’ ijana, zar’ izo gutekwa zikavugutirwa, ngo zivemw’ ibitereko vyo kurokezamw’ inkingi z’iryo hema, n’iza ca gihuzu co gukingīra Ahēra cane: za talanto ukw ar’ ijana zāvuyemw’ ibitereko ijana nyene, igitereko cose cāvuye mw italanto imwe.
Na za shekeli z’ifeza ukw ar’ igihumbi n’amajana ndwi na mirongwirindwi na zitanu, yazicuzemw’ imisumari yo ku birimbi, aziyagiriza no ku mitwe yavyo, azicuramwo n’imitambikwa yo kuri vyo.
Kand’ imiringa y’amashikanwa yanganya kuriba n’italanto mirongwirindwi na shekeli ibihumbi bibiri n’amajana ane.

Na yo ayicuramw’ ibitereko vyo kurokezamw’ inkingi za ca gihuzu co gukinga ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro, ayicuramwo na ca gicaniro c’imiringa, na ca kintu c’insobane caco c’imiringa nyene, bo n’ibintu vy’ico gicaniro vyose,

n’ibitereko vyo kunegamw’ ibirimbi vy’urugo impande zose, bo n’ibitereko vyo kunegamw’ ibirimbi bitambagije mw irembo ryarwo, n’imambo zose z’iryo hema, bo n’iz’ urwo rugo rwaryo rurikīkūje impande zose.
Za nyuzi z’amasufe n’iz’ amashigisha n’izisa n’agahama bazijishamw’ imyambaro ijishitse neza yo kwambara mu gukora Ahēra, ni yo myambaro yejejwe yo kwambara Aroni, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yabariye Mose.
Besaleli ajishisha umwambaro witwa efodi intahe z’izahabu, n’ inyuzi z’amasufe, n’iz’ amashigisha, n’izisa n’agahama, n’izera derere nziza zihinzwe neza.
Bacura amazahabu kugeza abaye uduhuhwa, badukebaguramw’intahe zo kujererenga mur’ izo nyuzi z’amasufe n’iz’amashigisha n’izisa n’agahama n’izera derere nziza, abahinga bavyo baba ari bo babikora.
Bakora ibizāna vy’uwo mwambaro, babitēra kuri wo; babitēra ku nzāno zawo zompi.

Umusipi ujishwe n’abahinga, ujishiwe kuri wo, wo kuwukenyeza, uba kimwe na wo, wajishwe nka wo; bawujishishije intahe z’izahabu n’inyuzi z’amasufe n’iz’ amashigisha n’izisa n’agahama n’ izera derere nziza zihinzwe neza, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yabariye Mose.
Batunganya utubuyenge twitwa shohamu, baturumya mu tugenegene tw’izahabu, batwandikakw amazina y’abana ba Isirayeli mu buryo bgo guca amagarwe, nk’ abaca amagarwe ku kabuyenge ko kudoma ikimenyetso.
Besaleli adutēra ahahera ku bitugu ku bizāna vya efodi, kugira ngo tubere Abisirayeli utubuyenge two kwibukwako, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yabariye Mose.

Ajishisha umupfuko wo kwambara mu gikiriza, abahinga bavyo baba ari bo babikora, nk’uko efodi yajishwe; bawujisha mu ntahe z’izahabu no mu nyuzi z’ amasufe n’iz’ amashigisha n’izisa n’agahama, n’izera derere nziza zihinzwe neza.
Bawukora bawukubiranije, uringaniye impande zose; uburebure bgawo bgar’ itambge rimwe ry’intoke, n’ubgaguke bgawo bgar’ itambge rimwe nyene: war’ ukubiranije.
Bawudombagizak’ utubuyenge mu mirongo ine: umurongo wa mbere war’ umurongo w’utwitwa odemu na pitida na bareketi;
mu wa kabiri har’ utwitwa nofekina na safiro na yahalomu;
mu wa gatatu har’ utwitwa leshemu na shevo na akilama;
mu wa kane har’ utwitwa tarushishi na shohamu na yasipi; twagenda turumikwa mu tugenegene tw’izahabu.

Utwo tubuyenge twanganya igitigiri n’amazina y’abana ba Isirayeli; twar’ icumi na tubiri, nk’ukw amazina yabo ar’ icumi n’abiri; twari tumeze nk’ utubuyenge two kudoma ibimenyetso, twagenda twandikwakw izina mu buryo bgo guca amagarwe, twar’ utw’ iyo miryango ukw ar’ icumi n’ibiri.
Kur’ uwo mupfuko wo kwambara mu gikiriza bashirakw imigufu icuzwe mw izahabu iramuye, ikozwe nk’ imigozi itsivye.
Bacura utugenegene tubiri mw izahabu, n’impeta zibiri z’izahabu nyene; izo mpeta zompi bazitera ku mitwe yawo yompi yo haruguru.
Baraheza barumya iyo migufu yompi y’izahabu itsivye kur’ izo mpeta zompi zo ku mitwe y’uwo mupfuko wo ku gikiriza.
Iyindi mitwe yompi y’ivyo bitsibo vy’ imigufu vyompi bayirumya kur’ utwo tugenegene twompi, bayitēra kuri vya bizāna vya efodi vyo ku bitugu, ku ruhande rw’imbere.
Bacura izindi mpeta zibiri mw izahabu, bazitēra ku mitwe yompi yo hepfo y’uwo mupfuko wo ku gikiriza, ku mubuga wawo, ku ruhande rw’imbere ruhera kuri efodi.
Bacura n’izindi mpeta zibiri mw izahabu, bazitēra ahahera imbere aho vya bizāna bibiri vya efodi vyo ku bitugu bitērewe, haruguru ya wa musipi wajishwe n’abahinga, wo gukenyeza efodi.

Uwo mupfuko wo kwambara ku gikiriza bawufatanisha impeta zawo n’impeta zo kuri efodi akagozi ko mu nyuzi z’amasufe, kugira ng’ ugume kuri wa musipi wa efodi wajishwe n’abahinga, uwo mupfuko ngo woye gukūrwa kuri efodi, babigenjeje nk’uk’ Uhoraho yabariye Mose.
Kand’ umwinjiro wo kwambarirwako efodi Besaleli awujisha mu nyuzi z’amasufe gusa;
asatura urwano muri wo hagati, nk’urw’ ikanzo y’icuma, arutērakw akandi kajishano kameze nk’ umusōzo karukīkūje, kugira ngo ntiruze rucike.
Ku mubuga w’uwo mwambaro bawutērak’ udusa n’amakomamanga dukozwe mu nyuzi z’amasufe n’iz’ amashigisha n’izisa n’agahama, n’izera derere zihinzwe neza.
Bacura imidende mw izahabu iramuye, bayitēra hagati y’ayo makomamanga ku mubuga w’uwo mwambaro impande zose, babirobekeranije,
iyo midende bayirobekeranya n’ayo makomamanga, bikīkūza umubuga w’uwo mwinjiro impande zose, uba uwo kwambarwa mu guhereza, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yabariye Mose.
Kandi bajishira Aroni n’ abana biwe amakanzo mu nyuzi zera derere nziza,
bajisha n’ igitambara co kuzingīra mu mutwe mu nyuzi zera derere nziza, n’udukofero dushajije na two nyene mu nyuzi zera derere nziza, bo n’amabutura mu nyuzi zera derere nziza zihinzwe neza,
n’ umukanda mu nyuzi zera derere nziza zihinzwe neza, no mu z’ amasufe n’iz’ amashigisha n’izisa n’agahama, wajererenzwekw amabara n’abahinga bavyo, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yabariye Mose.
Maze bacura akabāte, ni co gitsibo cera, mw izahabu iramuye, bakandikakw amajambo mu buryo bgo guca amagarwe ku kabuyenge ko kudoma ikimenyetso, ngo YEREJWE UHORAHO.
Bagapfundikakw akagozi ko mu nyuzi z’amasufe, ko kugafatisha hejuru kuri ca gitambara co kuzingīra mu mutwe, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yabariye Mose.
Uko ni ko barangije gukora ivy’ iryo hema vyose, ari ryo hema ry’ibonaniro; Abisirayeli bākoze vyose, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yabariye Mose: uko ni ko bābikoze.
Bazanira Mose iryo hema ry’imbere, n’ihema ryo hejuru, n’ibintu vyaryo vyose, n’uturinda twaryo, n’imbaho zaryo, n’ ibiti vy’intumba vyaryo, n’inkingi zaryo, n’ibitereko vyo kuzirokezamwo,
n’ico kurenza hejuru yaryo cakozwe mu nsāto z’amapfizi y’intama zazizwe mu gahama, n’ikindi co kurenza hejuru yaco cakozwe mu nsāto z’ ibikōko vyitwa tahashi, n’igihuzu co gukingīra Ahēra cane;
n’ isandugu y’Ibishinga intahe, n’ iminiho yayo, n’umutemere wo guhongerako;
n’ameza, n’ ibintu vyayo vyose, n’imitsima y’ibiterekerwa;
n’igiterekwakw amatara c’izahabu iramuye, n’ amatara yaco nyene, ari yo matara yo gushirwa kuri co, n’ibintu vyaco vyose, n’amavuta y’ayo matara;
n’igicaniro cacuzwe mw izahabu, n’amavuta yo kurobanuza abahabga ibango n’imibavu itāmirana, n’igihuzu co gukinga ku muryango w’ihema;
n’igicaniro cacuzwe mu miringa, n’ikintu caco c’insobane cacuzwe mu miringa nyene, n’iminiho yaco, n’ibintu vyaco vyose; n’ ikigārigāri, n’intebe yaco;

n’ impuzu zo kubamba ngo zibe urugo, n’ibirimbi vyarwo, n’ibitereko vyo kubinegamwo, n’impuzu yo gukinga mw irembo ry’ urwo rugo, n’imigozi yarwo, n’ imambo zarwo, n’ibintu vyose vyo gukoresha mur’ iryo hema, ari ryo hema ry’ibonaniro;
n’ imyambaro ijishitse neza yo kwambara mu gukora Ahēra, ni yo myambaro yejejwe yo kwambara Aroni umuherezi, n’imyambaro y’ abana biwe, yo kwambara mu gukora igikorwa c’ubuherezi.
Nk’uk’ Uhoraho yari yarabibariye Mose, Abisirayeli ni ko bābikoze vyose.
Mose yitegereza ivyo bākoze vyose, asanga barabiroranije; nk’uk’ Uhoraho yari yaravuze, ni ko bābikoze: Mose arabahezagira.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
ati Ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa mbere uz’ ushinge iryo hema, ari ryo hema ry’ibonaniro.
Uheze ushiremwo ya sandugu y’ Ibishinga intahe, uyikingirize ca gihuzu.
Maze winjizemwo ya meza, uyaterekekw ibintu vyayo, ubiroranye; winjize na ca gitereko c’amatara, ugishirekw amatara yaco;
na ca gicaniro c’izahabu co kwoserezakw imibavu uz’ ugitereke hino ya ya sandugu y’Ibishinga intahe, ukinge ca gihuzu ku muryango w’iryo hema.
Uheze ushire ca gicaniro co kwoserezakw ibimazi imbere y’ umuryango w’iryo hema, ari ryo hema ry’ibonaniro.
Maz’ utereke ca kigārigāri co gukaraba hagati y’ihema ry’ibonaniro n’ico gicaniro, ugisukemw’ amazi.
Uheze ushireh’ urugo rukikuza impande zose, umanike n’impuzu yo gukinga mw irembo ryarwo.
Uheze wābire ya mavuta yo kurobanuza abahabga ibango, uyarobanuze iryo hema n’ibirimwo vyose, uryezanye n’ibintu vyaryo vyose: nuko rizoba ribaye iryera.
Uyarobanuze n’igicaniro co kwoserezakw ibimazi, n’ibintu vyaco vyose, uceze: nuko kizoba kibaye icera cane.
Uyarobanuze n’ikigārigāri bo n’intebe yaco, uceze.
Uheze uzane Aroni n’abana biwe ku muryango w’iryo hema ry’ibonaniro, ubuhagire.
Wambike Aroni ya myambaro yejejwe, umurobanuze ayo mavuta, umweze, kugira ngw ankorere igikorwa c’ubuherezi.
Uheze uzane n’abana biwe, ubambike ya makanzo.

Ubarobanuze amavuta, nk’uk’ uyarobanuje se, kugira ngo bankorere igikorwa c’ubuherezi: ukwo kurobanurwa kwabo kuzoba kubahaye ubuherezi bg’intahava ukw ibihe vy’urunganwe rwabo bizogenda bikurikirana.
Nuko Mose abigenza artyo: uk’ Uhoraho yamubariye kwose, ni ko yabikoze.
Nuko mu kwezi kwa mbere kwo mu mwaka ugira kabiri, ku musi wakwo wa mbere, iryo hema ry’ imbere rirashingwa.
Mose ararishinga, ashirah’ ibitereko vyaryo, ashingamw’ imbaho zaryo, azisobekamw’ ibiti vyazo vy’ intumba, ashinga inkingi zaryo.
Araheza arirenzako rya hema ryo hejuru, iryo hema na ryo arirenzakw ikindi hejuru, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yari yaramubariye.
Yābīra vya Bishinga intahe, abishira muri ya sandugu, ayisobekakw iminiho yayo, arumika wa mutemere wo guhongerako kur’ iyo sandugu hejuru:
yinjiza iyo sandugu mw ihema, amanika ca gihuzu co gukingīra Ahēra cane, gikingīra iyo sandugu y’Ibishinga intahe, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yari yaramubariye.
Ashira ya meza mur’ iryo hema ry’ibonaniro, ayaherereza ku ruhande rw’i burārūko rw’iryo hema, hino y’ico gihuzu.
Ayaterekako ya mitsima imbere y’Uhoraho, nk’uk Uhoraho yari yaramubariye.
Ashira na ca giterekwakw amatara mur’ iryo hema ry’ibonaniro, aharābana n’ ayo meza, ku ruhande rw’i bumanuko rw’iryo hema.
Agishirakw amatara imbere y’ Uhoraho, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yari yaramubariye.
Ashira na ca gicaniro c’izahabu mur’ iryo hema ry’ibonaniro, hino ya ca gihuzu,
acoserezakw imibavu y’ibintu bimoga, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yari yaramubariye.
Akinga ca gihuzu ku muryango w’iryo hema.
Ashira ca gicaniro co kwoserezakw ibimazi imbere y’umuryango w’iryo hema, ari ryo hema ry’ibonaniro, agitangirakw ikimazi, aracosa, agitangirako n’ishikanwa ry’ ifu, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yari yaramubariye.
Atereka ca kigārigāri hagati y’ihema ry’ibonaniro n’ico gicaniro, agisukamw’ amazi yo gukaraba,
Mose ubgiwe na Aroni n’abana biwe barayakaraba, bayoga n’ibirenge;
iyo bagiye kwinjira mw ihema ry’ ibonaniro, n’iyo bagiye kwēgēra ico gicaniro, bārakaraba, bakoga ibirenge, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yari yarabariye Mose.
Araheza ashirah’ urugo rukīkūza iryo hema n’igicaniro impande zose, ashiraho n’impuzu yo gukinga mw irembo ryarwo. Uko ni ko Mose yarangije ico gikorwa.
Maze ca gicu gipfuka ihema ry’ibonaniro, ubgiza bg’Uhoraho bguzura mw ihema ry’imbere.
Mose ntiyashobora kwinjira mur’ iryo hema ry’ibonaniro, kukw ico gicu cari kuri ryo, n’ubgiza bg’Uhoraho bguzuye mur’ iryo hema ry’imbere.
Kandi mu rugendo rwabo rwose, iy’ ico gicu kivuye kur’ iryo hema kigasubira hejuru, Abisirayeli bāca bafata inzira;
arikw iy’ ico gicu kidasubiye hejuru, ntibāgenda, gushitsa ku musi gisubiye hejuru.
Kukw ico gicu c’Uhoraho ku murango caba kur’ iryo hema, mw ijoro kikākamw’ umuriro, imbere y’ab’ inzu ya Isirayeli bose, mu rugendo rwabo rwose.
Uhoraho ari mw ihema ry’ibonaniro ahamagara Mose, aramubarira,
ati Barira Abisirayeli, uti Ni haramuka hagize ūmuha ikimazi, muze mukūre ivyo bimazi mu vyo mutunze, ari mu masho canke mu mikuku.
Ikimazi c’umuntu co kwoswa, ni cāba ar’ ico mu busho, az’ atange imasa itagira agasembga: ayitangire ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro, kugira ngo yemerwe imbere yanje.
Maz’ arambike ikiganza mu ruhanga rw’ico kimazi co kwoswa, ni ho kizokwemerwa kumubera impongano.
Aheze akererere iyo masa imbere yanje, bene Aroni abaherezi bazane amaraso yayo, bayahereze, bayamijagire impande zose ku gicaniro co ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Aheze abāge ico kimazi co kwoswa, akijanjagure, agishire mu bikenye vyaco.
Bene Aroni abaherezi bashire umuriro kur’ ico gicaniro, bawurundekw inkwi:
bene Aroni abaherezi bagereke ivyo bikenye n’umutwe n’ibinure ku nkwi ziri ku muriro kur’ ico gicaniro;
arikw amara yayo n’ibikenye vyayo vy’amaguru abanze abironge mu mazi; maz’ umuherezi avyosereze vyose ku gicaniro, bibe ikimazi coshejwe, ikimazi gitōngōwe n’umuriro, umubabge ummotera neza.
Kand’ ikimazi ciwe co kwoswa ni caba ar’ ico mu mukuku, ar’ intama cank’ impene, az’ atange isuguru itagira agasembga.
Az’ agikererere i ruhande y’igicaniro, ahahera i burārūko, imbere yanje; bene Aroni abaherezi bamijagire amaraso yaco ku gicaniro impande zose.
Ayijanjagure, ayishire mu bikenye vyayo, ashireko n’ umutwe wayo n’ibinure vyayo; umuherezi aheze abigereke ku nkwi ziri ku muriro kur’ ico gicaniro:

arikw amara n’ibikenye vy’amaguru abanze abironge mu mazi; maz’ umuherezi abihereze vyose, avyosereze kur’ ico gicaniro. Kizoba ar’ ikimazi coshejwe, ikimazi gitōngōwe n’umuriro, umubabge ummotera neza.
Kand’ ikimazi ciwe co kwoswa azompa ni caba ar’ inyoni, az’ atange intunguru cank’ ivyana vy’ inuma.
Umuherezi az’ akizane ku gicaniro, akinuse umutwe, awosereze ku gicaniro; amaraso yaco amiminukire ku gicaniro ku ruhande rwaco rumwe;
agikūrekw agatorero kaco n’amoya yaco, abiterere hambavu y’igicaniro ahahera i burasirazuba, ku gikuburiro c’umunyota.

Aheze afate amababa yaco agitānye, ariko ntacahukanye: maz’ uwo muherezi acosereze ku gicaniro, akigeretse ku nkwi ziri ku muriro. Kizoba ar’ ikimazi coshejwe, ikimazi gitōngōwe n’umuriro, umubabge ummotera neza.
Ni hagira umuntu azonshikanira ishikanwa ry’ifu, az’ ashikane īgogōretse; ayisukekw amavuta ya elayo, ayishireko n’ imibavu.

Aheze ayizanire bene Aroni abaherezi; akamate urushi rumwe kur’ iyo fu n’ayo mavuta, akūraneko n’iyo mibavu yose; umuherezi aheze avyosereze ku gicaniro, bibe icibutso c’iryo shikanwa, bibe ishikanwa ritōngōrwa n’umuriro, umubabge ummotera neza.
Ibisigaye kur’ iryo shikanwa ry’ifu bize bibe ivya Aroni n’abana biwe: kizoba ar’ ikintu cera cane mu mashikanwa atōngōrwa n’umuriro nshikanirwa, jewe Uhoraho.

Kandi ni mwashikana ishikanwa ry’ivyokejwe mu ziko vyakozwe mw ifu, bize bibe udutsima tutambiwe twacumbge mw ifu igogōretse, twacumbanywe n’amavuta ya elayo, cank’ udutsima tutambiwe nyene, tubēhūye, twasutswekw amavuta ya elayo.
Kand’ ishikanwa ryanyu ni ryaba iry’ ivyakaranzwe ku cuma vyakozwe mw ifu, bize bibe ivyakozwe mw īgogōretse, ata mwambiro, vyacumbanywe n’amavuta ya elayo.
Mubicemw’ utumanyu, mudusukekw amavuta ya elayo: iryo rizoba ribaye ishikanwa ryo mw ifu.
Kand’ ishikanwa ryanyu ni ryaba iry’ ivyakaranganywe n’amavuta, vyakozwe mw ifu, bize bibe ivyakozwe mw īgogōretse, vyacumbanywe n’amavuta ya elayo.
Muze munzanire ishikanwa ry’ivyakozwe mw ifu, ryakozwe mur’ ubgo buryo; rishīrwe umuherezi, na we arizane ku gicaniro.
Umuherezi aheze akamate kur’ iryo shikanwa ry’ ivyakozwe mw ifu, ikizoba icibutso caryo, acosereze ku gicaniro, kibe ishikanwa ritōngōrwa n’umuriro, umubabge ummotera neza.
Ibisigaye kur’ iryo shikanwa ry’ivyakozwe mw ifu bize bibe ivya Aroni n’abana biwe: kizoba ar’ umugabane wera cane mu mashikanwa atōngōrwa n’umuriro nshikanirwa jewe Uhoraho.
Ntihaze hagire ishikanwa ryakozwe mw ifu munshikanira ryacumbanywe n’umwambiro: kuko mudakwiye kugira umwambiro cank’ ubūki mwosa ngo bibe ishikanwa ritōngōrwa n’umuriro munshikaniye.
Ivyo mushobora kubinshikanira nk’ishikanwa ry’umushuzo, ariko ntibize bishirwe ku gicaniro kuba nk’umubabge umota neza.

Kand’ ishikanwa ryose ry’ivyakozwe mw ifu muzoshikana muze mubirunge umunyu; ntimuze mugire ishikanwa ry’ivyakozwe mw ifu mushikana ritarimw’ umunyu, kand’ ari wo kimenyetso c’isezerano ryanje, Imana yanyu: ivyo muzotanga vyose muze mubitangane n’umunyu.
Kandi ni mwanshikanira ishikanwa ry’ivyakozwe mw ifu ivuye mu vy’umushuzo, rize ribe iry’ igihonde c’impeke mbisi, zivuye mu mishi ikigenywa, zikaranze.
Mugisukekw amavuta ya elayo, mukigerekeko n’imibavu: iryo rizoba ishikanwa ry’ivyakozwe mw ifu.

Umuherezi aheze akūre kuri ryo ikizoba icibutso caryo, acōse, ni co gace k’ico gihonde c’impeke, n’ak’ ayo mavuta yazo, bo n’iyo mibavu yazo yose; iryo rizoba ishikanwa nshikaniwe jewe Uhoraho ritōngōrwa n’umuriro.
Kand’ ishikanwa ry’umuntu ni ryaba ar’ ikimazi c’ishimwe akūye mu busho, ar’ imasa cank’ inyana, az’ agitange kitagira agasembga imbere yanje.
Aheze arambike ikiganza mu ruhanga rw’iryo shikanwa ryiwe ry’ikimazi, agikererere ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro: bene Aroni abaherezi baheze bamijagire amaraso yaco ku gicaniro impande zose.
Maz’ ico kimazi ciwe c’ishimwe agikūrekw ishikanwa anshikanira ryo gutōngōrwa n’umuriro, ribe urubambanda rwōrōshe amara, n’ibinure vyose bihometse ku mara,
n’amafyigo yompi, n’ ibinure bihometse kuri yo, ahahereranye n’umurya, n’agashami gatoya k’igitigu, agakūrane n’ amafyigo.
Bene Aroni baheze bavyosereze ku gicaniro, babigeretse ku kimazi coswa kiri ku nkwi ziri ku muriro: ivyo bizoba ikimazi gitōngōrwa n’umuriro, umubabge ummotera neza.
Kand’ ishikanwa ryiwe ry’ ikimazi c’ishimwe anshikaniye, ni caba ar’ ico akūye mu mukuku, ar’ isuguru cank’ ishashi, az’ agitange kitagira agasembga.
Ni yatanga umwana w’intama kw ishikanwa ryiwe, az’ awuzane imbere yanje.
Aheze arambike ikiganza mu ruhanga rw’iryo shikanwa ryiwe ry’ikimazi, agikererere imbere y’ihema ry’ibonaniro: bene Aroni baheze bamijagire amaraso yaco ku gicaniro impande zose.

Maz’ ico kimazi ciwe c’ishimwe agikūrekw ishikanwa anshikanira ryo gutōngōrwa n’umuriro, ribe ibinure vy’uwo mwana w’intama; umurizo wawo uko wagahometsekw ibinure, az’ awucire mu nguge udasonōye, n’urubambanda rwōrōshe amara, n’ibinure vyose bihometse ku mara,
n’amafyigo yompi, n’ ibinure bihometse kuri yo, ahahereranye n’umurya, n’agashami gatoya k’igitigu, agakūrane n’ amafyigo.
Umuherezi aheze avyosereze ku gicaniro: ivyo bizoba bibaye imfungurwa nshikaniwe jewe Uhoraho, zitōngōrwa n’umuriro.
Kandi ni yatanga impene kw ishikanwa ryiwe, az’ ayizane imbere yanje.
Aheze arambike ikiganza mu ruhanga rwayo, ayikererere imbere y’ihema ry’ibonaniro: bene Aroni baheze bamijagire amaraso yayo ku gicaniro impande zose.
Maz’ ayikūrekw ishikanwa ryiwe anshikanira ryo gutōngōrwa n’umuriro, ribe urubambanda rwōrōshe amara, n’ibinure vyose bihometse ku mara,
n’amafyigo yompi, n’ibinure bihometse kuri yo, ahahereranye n’ umurya, n’agashami gatoya k’ igitigu, agakūrane n’amafyigo.
Umuherezi aheze avyosereze ku gicaniro: ivyo bizoba bibaye imfungurwa, ari ryo shikanwa ritōngōrwa n’umuriro, ngo ribe umubabge umota neza; ibinure vyose bizoba ivyanje.
Bize bibabere icagezwe c’intahava ukw ibihe vy’urunganwe rwanyu bizogenda bikurikirana, yuko mu ngo zanyu zose mutazokwigera mugeza mu kanwa ibinure cank’ ubuseri.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
ati Barira Abisirayeli, uti Ni hagira umuntu akora icaha atabigize ibigirankana mu vyo jewe Uhoraho nabuzanije, hakagira ico akora muri vyo;
namb’ ar’ umuherezi yarobanujwe amavuta aramutse akoze icaha, agacumuza ubgo bgoko, az’ atangire ico caha ciwe yakoze imasa y’umukangara itagira agasembga: ayinzanire kw ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha.
Azane iyo masa ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro imbere yanje, arambike ikiganza mu ruhanga rwayo, ayikererere imbere yanje.
Uwo muherezi yarobanujwe amavuta, aheze yābīre ku maraso y’iyo masa, ayazane mw ihema ry’ibonaniro:
ajōbeke urutoke rwiwe mur’ ayo maraso, ayacucagire ibihetangabo ndwi imbere yanje, hino ya ca gihuzu gikingiriye Ahēra cane.

Kur’ ayo maraso nyene ayasīge ku mahembe y’igicaniro co kwoserezakw imibavu itamirana, kiri mw ihema ry’ibonaniro imbere yanje; ayandi maraso yose y’iyo masa ayavyagize hasi hambavu y’igicaniro co kwoserezakw ibimazi, kiri ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Kand’ iyo masa y’ikimazi gitangiwe ivyaha, az’ ayikūremw’ ibinure vyayo vyose: urubambanda rwōrōshe amara, n’ibinure vyose bihometse ku mara,
n’amafyigo yompi, n’ibinure bihometse kuri yo, ahahereranye n’umurya, n’agashami gatoya k’igitigu, agakūrane n’amafyigo,
babikūre nk’uko nyene bahora babikūra ku masa y’ikimazi c’ishimwe; uyo muherezi avyosereze ku gicaniro co kwoserezakw ibimazi.
Kand’ urusato rw’iyo masa, n’inyama zayo zose, hamwe n’umutwe wayo, n’ibikenye vy’amaguru, n’amara yayo, n’amayezi yayo,
ivy’ iyo masa vyose iyo biva bikagera, abijane inyuma y’aho mushagaje, ahantu hadahumanye, aho basēsa umunyota, abigereke ku nkwi, abiturire; ah’ umunyota usēswa abe ari ho bituririrwa.
Kand’ ikoraniro ryose ry’ Abisirayeli ni ryaramuka ricumuye, ritabigize ibigirankana, ntibabimenye, bakoze mu vyo jewe Uhoraho nabuzanije, bakikwegera gutsindwa n’urubanza;
igicumuro bacumuye ni camenyekana, iryo shengero rize ritange imasa y’umukangara kw ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha, bayizane imbere y’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Abakuru b’iryo koraniro baheze barambike ibiganza mu ruhanga rw’iyo masa imbere yanje: baheze bayikererere ngaho nyene imbere yanje.
Maz’ umuherezi yarobanujwe amavuta az’ azane ku maraso y’iyo masa mw ihema ry’ibonaniro,
ajōbeke urutoke rwiwe mur’ ayo maraso, ayacucagire ibihetangabo ndwi imbere yanje, hino ya ca gihuzu.

Kur’ ayo maraso nyene ayasīge ku mahembe y’igicaniro kir’ imbere yanje mw ihema ry’ibonaniro; ayandi maraso yose ayavyagize hasi hambavu y’igicaniro co kwoserezakw ibimazi, kiri ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Az’ ayikūremw’ ibinure vyayo vyose, avyosereze ku gicaniro.
Ukw az’ abe ari kw agira iyo masa: nk’uko yagize ya masa yindi y’ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha, az’ abe ari kw agira n’iyo. Nuk’ umuherezi azoba abahongeye, na bo bazoharirwa.
Aheze ajane ivy’ iyo masa inyuma y’aho mushagaje, abiturire nk’uko yaturiye ivy’ imasa ya mbere: ico kizoba ar’ ikimazi gitangiwe ivyaha vy’ ishengero.
Umukuru ni yakora icaha, akagira ico akora mu vyo jewe Uhoraho Imana yiwe nabuzanije vyose, atabigize ibigirankana, akikwegera gutsindwa n’urubanza;
icaha yakoze amaze kukimenyeshwa, az’ azane isuguru y’impene itagira agasembga kw ikimazi ciwe.
Arambike ikiganza mu ruhanga rwayo, ayikererere imbere yanje aho bahora bakererera ikimazi co kwosa: kizoba ar’ ikimazi gitangiwe ivyaha.
Umuherezi aheze yābirize urutoke ku maraso y’ico kimazi gitangiwe ivyaha, ayasīge ku mahembe y’igicaniro co kwoserezakw ibimazi, ayandi maraso yaco ayavyagize hasi hambavu y’ico gicaniro.
Ibinure vyaco vyose avyosereze ku gicaniro, nk’uko bōsa ibinure vy’ikimazi c’ishimwe. Nuk’ umuherezi azoba amuhongeye kur’ ico caha ciwe, na we azoharirwa.
Ni hagira umuntu mu banyagihugu akora icaha atabigize ibigirankana, mu vyo jewe Uhoraho nabuzanije, akikwegera gutsindwa n’urubanza;
icaha yakoze amaze kukimenyeshwa, az’ azane impene kw ikimazi ciwe, y’ishashi itagira agasembga, yo gutangirwa icaha ciwe yakoze.
Arambike ikiganza mu ruhanga rw’ico kimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha, agikererere aho bakererera ikimazi co kwosa.
Umuherezi aheze yābirize urutoke ku maraso yaco, ayasīge ku mahembe y’igicaniro co kwoserezakw ibimazi, ayandi maraso yaco yose ayavyagize hasi hambavu y’igicaniro.
Ibinure vyaco vyose az’ abikūre, nk’uko bakūra ivy’ ikimazi c’ishimwe: uwo muherezi aheze avyosereze ku gicaniro, bibe umubabge ummotera neza. Nuk’ umuherezi azoba amuhongeye, na we azoharirwa.
Kandi ni yaramuka azanye umwana w’intama kw ishikanwa ry’ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha, az’ azane ishashi itagira agasembga.
Arambike ikiganza mu ruhanga rw’ico kimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha, agikererere aho bakererera ikimazi co kwosa, kibe ikimazi gitangiwe ivyaha.
Umuherezi aheze yābirize urutoke ku maraso y’ico kimazi, ayasīge ku mahembe y’igicaniro co kwoserezakw ibimazi, ayandi maraso yaco yose ayavyagize hasi hambavu y’igicaniro.

Ibinure vyaco vyose az’ abikūre, nk’uko bakūra ivy’ umwana w’intama w’ikimazi c’ ishimwe; uwo muherezi aheze avyosereze ku gicaniro, abigeretse ku bimazi nshikaniwe jewe Uhoraho, bigatōngōrwa n’umuriro. Nuk’ umuherezi azoba amuhongeye kur’ ico caha ciwe yakoze, na we azoharirwa.
Ni babarahiza mw ikoraniro, umuntu akavyumva, agaheza agakora icaha co guhora ico yabonye n’ico azi, azogībgako n’ibigabitanyo vyiwe.

Canke ni hagira umuntu akora ku kintu kizira ic’ ari co cose, namb’ ar’ umuvyimba w’igikōko kizira, cank’ umuvyimba w’igitunzwe kizira, cank’ umuvyimba w’icikwega hasi kizira nyene, ariko ntabimenye, agahumana, kizoba kimubereye icaha.
Canke ni yaramuka akoze ku gihumanya giherereye ku muntu, ic’ ari co cose, ntabimenye, ni yabimenya, kizoba kimubereye icaha.

Canke ni hagira umuntu atantamukana indahiro y’ico agira akore, ari kibi, ari ciza, atavyiyumviriye, ic’ ari co cose umuntu yotantamukanira indahiro, hanyuma ni yabimenya, ico kintu kizoba kimubereye icaha.
Nuk’ umuntu ni yaramuka atsinzwe na kimwe mur’ ivyo bidōnzwe, aze yature icaha yakoze,
anzanire ikimazi ciwe c’impongano y’icaha yakoze, c’inyana y’intama canke y’impene, ayikūye mu mukuku, ngw ibe ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha; umuherezi azoba amuhongeye ku caha ciwe.

Kandi ni yaba atoshobora kuronka umwana w’intama, anzanire ikimazi ciwe c’impongano y’icaha yakoze, c’intunguru zibiri cank’ ivyana vy’inuma bibiri: kimwe kize kibe ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha, ikindi kibe ikimazi co kwoswa.
Abizanire umuherezi, na we atangurire ku kimazi gitangirwa ivyaha, akinuse umutwe, arik’ umutumba waco ntawusature ngw awahukanye.
Yābīre ku maraso y’ico kimazi gitangirwa ivyaha, ayacucagire ku gicaniro ku ruhande rwaco rumwe; ayandi maraso ayamiminurire hasi hambavu y’igicaniro: ico kizoba ar’ ikimazi gitangiwe ivyaha.
Ica kabiri agitange kw ikimazi co kwoswa nk’uko bishinzwe. Nuk’ uwo muherezi azoba amuhongeye ku caha yakoze, na we azoharirwa.

Ariko ni yaba atoshobora kuronka n’izo ntunguru zibiri cank’ ivyana vy’inuma bibiri, az’ azane ishikanwa ry’icaha yakoze, ry’ikigiracumi c’ingero yitwa efa y’ifu igogōretse: ariko ntaz’ ayisukekw amavuta, canke ngw ayishirekw imibavu, kukw ar’ ikimazi gitangiwe ivyaha.

Aheze ayizanire umuherezi, na we ayikamatek’ urushi rumwe rwo kuba icibutso cayo, ayosereze ku gicaniro, ayishize ku bimazi nshikaniwe jewe Uhoraho, bigatōngōrwa n’ umuriro: kizoba ar’ ikimazi gitangiwe ivyaha.
Nuk’ uwo muherezi azoba amuhongeye ku caha yakoze ic’ ari co cose muri vya bindi bidōnzwe, na we azoharirwa: ifu isigaye iz’ ibe iy’ umuherezi, nk’uko bisanzwe biba kw ishikanwa rindi ry’amafu.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,

ati Ni hagira umuntu ampomvya ku bintu vyera ngerewe, agakora icaha kitar’ ic’ ibigirankana; az’ anzanire ikimazi ciwe c’impongano c’impfizi y’intama itagira agasembga, ikūwe mu mukuku, iz’ ibe iyimaze igiciro uzocira, ca shekeli z’ifeza zagezwe kuri shekeli ir’ ahēra, ibe ikimazi c’impongano.

Kand’ az’ arihe ico kintu yafuditseko co mu vyera, akigerekeko n’ikingana n’ikigira gatanu caco, abishīre umuherezi: uwo muherezi az’ amuhongere iyo mpfizi y’intama y’ikimazi c’impongano, na we azoharirwa.
Kandi ni hagira umuntu akora icaha, agakora na kimwe mu vyo nabuzanije; naho yoba agikoze atabizi, aba atsinzwe, kand’ azogībgako n’ibigabitanyo vyiwe.

Az’ azanire umuherezi impfizi y’intama itagira agasembga, ikūwe mu mukuku, iz’ ibe iyimaze igiciro uzocira, ibe ikimazi c’ impongano. Uwo muherezi az’ amuhongere kur’ ico kintu yacumuye atabigize ibigirankana, atabizi, na we azoharirwa.
Ico kizoba ar’ ikimazi c’impongano: n’ukuri koko, azoba yaratsinzwe imbere yanje.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
ati Ni hagira umuntu akora icaha, akancumurako, jewe Uhoraho, akagunga mugenzi we mu vyo yamubikije, canke ku ngwati yamugwatirije, canke mu vyo yambuye, cank’ akanyaga mugenzi we ku gahahazo,
cank’ akabona icazimiye, akakigunga, akakirahira ibinyoma; ni hagira ikintu na kimwe mur’ ivyo vyose umuntu azokora, agakora icaha ubgo buryo;
iy’ akoze ico caha, akumva kw atsinzwe, az’ arihe ico yambuye, cank’ ico yaronkeshejwe n’agahahazo, cank’ ico yabikijwe, cank’ icari cazimiye yatoye,
cank’ ikindi kintu cose yarahiye ibinyoma; az’ akirihe uko kingana, kand’ akigerekeko n’ikingana n’ikigira gatanu caco: akirihe ina co ku musi nyene azotangakw ikimazi c’impongano.
Anzanire ico kimazi ciwe c’impongano c’impfizi y’intama itagira agasembga, ikūwe mu mukuku, iz’ ibe iyimaze igiciro uzocira gikwiranye n’ikimazi c’impongano; agishire umuherezi.
Umuherezi aheze amuhongerere imbere yanje, na we azoharirwa ico yakoze cose camutsindishije.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
ati Barira Aroni n’abana biwe, ut’ Iki ni co cagezwe ku vy’ikimazi coswa: kize gihore kiba ku nkwi zaco ku gicaniro, kirāreho buce: umuriro wo ku gicaniro uze wame waka.

Maz’ umuherezi yambare wa mwambaro wiwe wera derere, na rya butura ryiwe ryera derere aryambike ubgambure bgiwe; aheze ayore umunyota w’ ikimazi coshejwe, ic’ umuriro watōngōreye ku gicaniro, awufashe i ruhande y’igicaniro.
Maze yambure iyo myambaro yiwe, yambare iyindi, aheze aje gusēsa uyo munyota inyuma y’aho mushagaje, ahantu hadahumanye.
Nuk’ umuriro wo ku gicaniro uze wame waka, ntuzime; umuherezi aze yame awucana, awurundekw inkwi uko bukeye, aheze azigerekekw ivy’ ikimazi co kwoswa, acoserezekw ibinure vy’ibimazi vy’ishimwe.
Umuriro uze wame waka ku gicaniro udahengeshanya, ntuz’ uzime.
Iki ni co cagezwe ku vy’ ishikanwa ry’amafu: bene Aroni baze barihereze bar’ aho nyene imbere yanje, imbere y’igicaniro.

Umuherezi aheze akamate urushi rumwe kur’ iyo fu igogōretse y’iryo shikanwa, no ku mavuta yo kuri yo, n’imibavu yose igeretse kur’ iryo shikanwa ry’ifu, avyosereze ku gicaniro kuba umubabge umota neza, bimbere icibutso caryo.
Ibisigaye kuri vyo Aroni n’abana biwe babirye, babirye bitambiwe, babirīre ahantu hēra, mu rugo rw’ihema ry’ibonaniro abe ari ho babirīra.
Ntibaze babicumbane n’umwambiro. Ndabibahaye, bibe umugabane wabo ku mashikanwa nshikanirwa atōngōrwa n’umuriro; n’ivyera cane, nk’ukw ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha kimeze, bo n’ic’ impongano.

Izinamuhungu wese wo muri bene Aroni yemererwa kubiryako; bibaye umwanya wabo w’intahava, ukw ibihe vy’urunganwe rwanyu bizogenda bikurikirana, wo ku mashikanwa nshikanirwa atōngōrwa n’umuriro; ūzobikorako wese azoba abaye uwera, abe inyegu yavyo.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,

at’ Iri ni ryo shikanwa rya Aroni n’abana biwe, bakwiye kuzokwama banshikanira, uhereye ku musi Aroni azorobanuzwa amavuta: ikigiracumi c’ingero yitwa efa y’ifu igogōretse, ngo kize kibe ishikanwa ry’ifu ry’ubudasība; igice cayo kize gishikanwe mu gitondo, ikindi ku mugoroba.
Baze bayivangire n’amavuta ya elayo ku cuma gikaranga; ni yamara guhwana, bayizane; baze batange iryo shikanwa ry’ivyakozwe mw ifu ar’ utumanyagu dukaranze, ngo ribe umubabge ummotera neza.
Umuherezi wo mu bana biwe azorobanuzwa amavuta, amusubiriye mu gishingo, aze yame anshikanira iryo shikanwa, bibe icagezwe c’intahava: ryose rize rishe ritōngōke.
Ishikanwa ry’ivyakozwe mw ifu umuherezi azotanga, rize rishe ryose, ritōngōke: ntirize riribge na mba.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,

ati Barira Aroni n’abana biwe, ut’ Iki ni co cagezwe ku vy’ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha: aho bakererera ikimazi co kwoswa, az’ abe ari ho bakererera ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha, imbere yanje: n’icera cane.
Umuherezi ahereje ico kimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha az’ abe ari we akirya: kize kirīwe ahantu hēra, ni ho mu rugo rw’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Ūzokora ku nyama zaco wese azoba abaye uwera, abe inyegu yaco, kandi ni hagira umwambaro wose utarukirwako n’amaraso yaco, uwo mwambaro yatarukiyeko baze bawumesurire aho hantu hēra.
Kandi ni catekwa mu nkono y’ imbumbano, baze bayimene; na ho ni catekwa mu nkono y’umuringa, baze bayikūbe, bayunyuguze n’amazi.
Izinamuhungu wese wo mu baherezi yemererwa kukiryako: kizoba ar’ icera cane.
Kand’ ikimazi cose gitangirwa ivyaha, amaraso yaco akajanwa mw ihema ry’ibonaniro, agahongerwa ahēra, ntikize kiribge na mba: ariko kize giturirwe.
Iki ni co cagezwe co ku kimazi c’impongano: kizoba ar’ icera cane.
Aho bakererera ikimazi co kwoswa, az’ abe ari ho bakererera ikimazi c’impongano; amaraso yaco baze bayamijagire ku gicaniro impande zose.
Kandi batange ibinure vyaco vyose, ari vyo murizo uko wagahometsekw ibinure, n’urubambanda rwōrōshe amara,
n’amafyigo yompi, n’ ibinure bihometse kuri yo, ahahereranye n’umurya, n’agashami gatoya k’igitigu, bagakūrane n’ amafyigo.
Umuherezi aheze avyosereze ku gicaniro, kibe ikimazi nshikaniwe gitōngōrwa n’ umuriro. Ico ni co kimazi c’ impongano.
Izinamuhungu wese wo mu baherezi yemererwa kukiryako: kize kirīrwe ahantu hēra: n’icera cane.
Nk’uko bigenzwa ku kimazi gitangirwa ivyaha, ni ko bigenzwa no ku kimazi c’impongano: icagezwe cavyo ni kimwe: umuherezi ahereje iyo mpongano, ni we kizoba iciwe.
Kand’ umuherezi ahereje ikimazi c’umuntu uw’ ari we wese co kwoswa, uwo muherezi nyene az’ abe ari we atwara urusato rw’ico kimazi coshejwe atanze.
Ishikanwa ryose ry’ivyakozwe mw ifu vyokejwe mu ziko, n’ibindi vyose vyakozwe mw ifu bikaranganywe n’amavuta, bo n’ivyataraguwe ku cuma gikaranga, bizoba ivy’ umuherezi abihereje.
Ishikanwa ryose ry’ifu, ar’ ivanze amavuta cank’ itavanze, rizoba irya bene Aroni bose, barigabangane.
Iki ni co cagezwe co ku kimazi c’ishimwe umuntu azonshikanira.

Ni yagitanga kubgo gukenguruka, ico kimazi co gukenguruka az’ agitangane n’udutsima tutambiwe twacumbanywe n’amavuta ya elayo, bo n’utundi dutsima tubēhūye, tutambiwe nyene, twasutswekw amavuta, n’utundi nyene twacumbanywe n’amavuta, twacumbge mw ifu igogōretse ivangishijwe amavuta ngw ihwane.
Iryo shikanwa ryiwe, n’ico kimazi ciwe c’ishimwe yatanze kubgo gukenguruka, az’ abitangane n’utundi dutsima twambiwe.
Kandi kur’ iryo shikanwa ryiwe ry’udutsima tw’ uburyo bgose, az’atangeko kamwe‐kamwe kw ishikanwa angereye jewe Uhoraho; rize ribe umuturi w’umuherezi amija amaraso y’ico kimazi c’ishimwe.
Kand’ inyama z’ico kimazi ciwe c’ishimwe yatanze kubgo gukenguruka, zize ziribge ku musi agitanzeko nyene: ntihaze hagire izo asigaza ngo zirāre.
Arikw ico kimazi ashikanye, ni caba ico gushitsa isezerano, cank’ ico ashikanye kukw avyigombeye, kize kiribge ku musi agitanzeko; izizorāra kuri co zize ziribge bukeye bgaho.
Arikw inyama z’ico kimazi ni zashika ku musi ugira gatatu, zize ziturirwe.

Ariko ni haramuka hagize inyama z’ico kimazi ciwe c’ishimwe ziribga ku musi ugira gatatu, ntikizoba kicemerwa, uwagitanze ntikizoba kikimuharūrwako: kizoba kibaye ikizira, ūkiriyeko azogībgako n’ukugabitanya kwiwe.
Ni hagira inyama zikora ku kintu gihumanya ntizize ziribge, ariko ziturirwe. Umuntu wese adahumanye ni we yemererwa kurya ku nyama z’ico kimazi.
Arik’ ūzorya ku nyama z’ico kimazi c’ishimwe, agihumanye, kand’ ar’ icanje jewe Uhoraho, uwo muntu az’ acibge mu bgoko bgabo.

Kand’ umuntu wese azokora ku kintu gihumanya ic’ ari co cose, ar’ igiherereye ku muntu, cank’ ar’ igitunzwe gihumanya, cank’ ar’ ikindi cose c’ikizira gihumanya, agaheza akarya ku nyama z’ikimazi c’ishimwe, kand’ ar’ icanje jewe Uhoraho, uwo muntu az’ acibge mu bgoko bgabo.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
ati Barira Abisirayeli, uti Ntimuze mwigere murya ku binure, ar’ ivy’ inka, canke vy’intama, canke vy’ impene.
Arikw ibinure vy’ iyipfiriye, cank’ ivy’ ikirangara, vyoshobora gukoreshwa igikorwa kindi cose: ariko ntimuze mubiryeko na gatoya.
Kuk’ ūzorya wese ku binure vy’ibitunzwe, kand’ ari vyo abantu batangakw ibimazi banshikanira vyo gutongorwa n’umuriro, umuntu azoramuka abiriyeko az’ acibge mu bgoko bgabo.
Ntimuze mwigere mugeza ubuseri mu kanwa mu ngo zanyu zose, ar’ ubg’ ibiguruka, cank’ ubg’ ibitunzwe, cank’ ubg’ ibikōko.
Umuntu wese azobugeza mu kanwa, ubg’ ari bgo bgose, uwo muntu az’ acibge mu bgoko bgabo.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
ati Barira Abisirayeli, ut’ Ūzompa ikimazi c’ishimwe, az’ anshikanire ishikanwa arikūye kur’ ico kimazi ciwe c’ishimwe nyene.
Ubgiwe yizanire mu minwe yiwe ishikanwa anshikaniye ryo gutōngōrwa n’ umuriro; az’ azane ibinure bo n’inkoro, kugira ngw iyo nkoro ibe ishikanwa rizungurijwe imbere yanje.
Maz’ ivyo binure umuherezi az’ avyosereze ku gicaniro; arikw inkoro ibe umwanya wa Aroni n’abana biwe.
Kand’ igikenye c’ukuguru kw’i buryo muze mugihe umuherezi, kibe umwanya wiwe, mugikūye ku kimazi mutanze c’ishimwe.
Uwo muri bene Aroni azohereza amaraso n’ibinure vy’ikimazi c’ishimwe, az’ abe ari we ahabga igikenye c’ukuguru kw’i buryo kuba umwanya wiwe.

Kuko ya nkoro ishikanishwa kuzunguzwa, na ca gikenye c’ukuguru kigerewe abaherezi, mbishinguye ku bimazi vy’Abisirayeli vy’ishimwe, mbihaye Aroni umuherezi, n’abana biwe, kuba umuturi bazohora bashingura mu Bisirayeli ibihe vyose.
Uwo ni wo mwanya wa Aroni n’abana biwe bashinguriwe ku bimazi bishikaniwe Uhoraho bigatōngōrwa n’umuriro, bāgerewe uhereye umusi barobanuriwe kuba abaherezi bo gukorera Uhoraho;
Uhoraho yashinze yukw Abisirayeli bazohora babaha uwo mwanya, uhereye ku musi barobanuriweko; uzoba umuturi wabo ukw ibihe vy’urunganwe rwabo bizogenda bikurikirana.

Ico ni co cagezwe co ku kimazi co kwoswa, n’ico kw ishikanwa ry’ amafu, n’ico ku kimazi gitangirwa ivyaha, n’ico ku kimazi c’impongano, n’ico ku vyo kwinjiza abaherezi mw ibango, n’ico ku bimazi vy’ishimwe,
ivyo Uhoraho yageze Mose ari ku musozi Sinayi, ku musi yageze Abisirayeli kumuzanira amashikanwa, aho nyene mu bugaragwa bg’i Sinayi.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
ati Jana Aroni n’abana biwe, na ya myambaro na ya mavuta yo kurobanuza abahabga ibango, na ya masa y’ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha, na za mpfizi z’intama zompi, na ya ndumane irimw’ imitsima itambiwe;
uheze ukoranirize ikoraniro ryose ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Nuko Mose agenza nk’uk’ Uhoraho yamubariye; iryo koraniro rikoranira ku muryango w’ihema ry’ ibonaniro.
Mose abarira iryo koraniro, at’ Ibi ni vyo Uhoraho yageze ko bikorwa.
Mose araheza azana Aroni n’abana biwe, arabuhagira.
Yambika Aroni ya kanzo, amukenyeza wa mukanda, amwambika na wa mwinjiro, amushirako na efodi, amukenyeza na wa musipi wa efodi ujishwe n’ abahinga, awuyifatishiriza kuri we;
amwambika na wa mupfuko mu gikiriza, mur’ uwo mupfuko ashiramwo Urimu na Tumimu.
Amwambika na ca gitambara mu mutwe; imbere kur’ ico gitambara agishirako ka kabāte k’izahabu, ari co gitsibo cera; nk’uk’ Uhoraho yari yaramubariye.
Mose araheza yābīra ya mavuta yo kurobanuza, ayarobanuza rya hema bo n’ibirimwo vyose, aravyeza.
Ayacucagira ku gicaniro ibihetangabo ndwi, arayakirobanuza bo n’ibintu vyaco vyose, bo n’ikigārigāri co gukaraba n’intebe yaco, ngw avyeze.
Maz’ ayo mavuta yo kurobanuza abahabga ibango ayasuka ku mutwe wa Aroni, aramurobanura, aramweza.
Mose araheza azana bene Aroni, abambika amakanzo, abakenyeza imikanda, abapfundika n’udukofero; nk’uk’ Uhoraho yari yaramubariye.
Araheza azana ya masa y’ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha, Aroni n’abana biwe bayirambika ibiganza mu ruhanga.
Mose arayikerera, yābīra amaraso yayo, ayasīgisha urutoke ku mahembe y’igicaniro impande zose, aragihumanura, araheza avyagiza ayo maraso hasi hambavu y’igicaniro, acezesha kugitangira impongano.
Yābīra urubambanda rwose rwōrōshe amara, n’agashami gatoya k’igitigu, n’amafyigo yompi, n’ibinure vyo kuri yo, avyosereza ku gicaniro.
Arikw ivy’ iyo masa, urusato rwayo n’inyama zayo n’amayezi yayo abituririra inyuma y’aho bashagaje, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yari yaramubariye.
Araheza azana impfizi y’ intama y’ikimazi co kwoswa; Aroni n’abana biwe bayirambika ibiganza mu ruhanga.
Mose arayikerera, amijagira amaraso yayo ku gicaniro impande zose.
Arayijanjagura, ayishira mu bikenye vyayo; yōsa umutwe wayo, n’ibindi bice vyayo, n’ ibinure vyayo.

Amara yayo n’ibikenye vyayo vy’amaguru arabironga; nukw ivy’ iyo mpfizi y’intama vyose iyo biva bikagera Mose avyosereza ku gicaniro, kuba ikimazi coshejwe, umubabge umota neza, ikimazi gishikaniwe Uhoraho gitōngōwe n’umuriro; nk’uk’ Uhoraho yari yaramubariye.
Araheza azana ya mpfizi y’intama yindi, ari yo yo kubinjiza mw ibango, Aroni n’abana biwe bayirambika ibiganza mu ruhanga.
Maze Mose arayikerera, yābīra ku maraso yayo, ayakoza ku gutwi kw’i buryo kwa Aroni ahahera hejuru, no ku rukumu rwiwe rw’i buryo, no kw ino ryiwe rinini ry’i buryo.

Atakw azana bene Aroni, na bo nyene akoza amaraso ku matwi yabo y’i buryo ahahera hejuru, no ku bikumu vyabo vy’i buryo, no ku mano yabo manini y’i buryo: ayandi maraso ayamijagira ku gicaniro impande zose.

Maze yābīra ibinure vyayo, n’umurizo wayo uko wagahometsekw ibinure, n’urubambanda rwose rwōrōshe amara, n’agashami gatoya k’igitigu, n’amafyigo yompi, n’ibinure vyo kuri yo, n’igikenye c’ukuguru kwayo kw’i buryo.

Kandi muri ya ndumane irimw’ imitsima itambiwe iteretse imbere y’Uhoraho, akūramw’ umutsima umwe, n’agatsima kamwe kācumbanywe n’amavuta ya elayo, n’akandi kamwe kabēhūye, ayishira kur’ ivyo binure no kur’ ico gikenye c’ ukuguru kw’i buryo.
Ivyo vyose abishira ku mashi ya Aroni no ku y’abana biwe, ngo babizunguze kuba ishikanwa rizungurijwe imbere y’Uhoraho.

Mose araheza abikūra ku mashi yabo, avyosereza ku gicaniro, abigeretse kuri ca kimazi coshejwe; biba ivyo kubinjiza mw ibango, vy’umubabge umota neza, ikimazi gishikaniwe Uhoraho kigatōngōrwa n’umuriro.
Maze Mose yābīra inkoro, arayizunguza ngw ibe ishikanwa rizungurijwe imbere y’Uhoraho: uwo war’ umwanya wa Mose wo kur’ iyo mpfizi y’intama yo kubinjiza mw ibango, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yari yaramubariye.

Maze Mose yābīra kuri ya mavuta yo kurobanuza abahabga ibango, no ku maraso yari ku gicaniro, abicucagira kuri Aroni no ku myambaro yiwe, no ku bana biwe no ku myambaro yabo; yeza Aroni n’imyambaro yiwe, n’abana biwe n’imyambaro yabo.

Maze Mose abarira Aroni n’abana biwe, ati Muteke za nyama ku muryango w’ihema ry’ ibonaniro; abe ari ho muzirīra, hamwe na ya mitsima iri mu ndumane yo kubinjiza mw ibango; nk’uko navuze, nti Aroni n’abana biwe babe ari bo babirya.
Ibisigara kur’ izo nyama no kur’ iyo mitsima mubiturire.
Ntimuze mutirimuke ngo muve ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro kumara imisi ndwi, gushitsa ah’ imisi yanyu yo gushikirizwa iryo bango izoshirira: kuko muzomara imisi ndwi murishikirizwa.
Uko bikozwe uyu musi, ni k’Uhoraho yageze ko bizokorwa mu kubatangira impongano.
Ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro abe ari ho mumara imisi ndwi ku murango no mw ijoro, mwitondera ivyo Uhoraho yabajeje, kugira ngo ntimupfe: kuk’ uko ari ko nabariwe.
Nuko Aroni n’abana biwe babikora vyose, uk’ Uhoraho yari yarabariye Mose.
Maze ku musi ugira umunani, Mose ahamagara Aroni n’ abana biwe n’abakuru bo mu Bisirayeli;
abarira Aroni, ati Jana ishuri y’umukangara y’ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha, n’ impfizi y’intama y’ikimazi co kwoswa, bitagira agasembga, ubitange ur’ imbere y’Uhoraho.
Kandi barira Abisirayeli, uti Ni mujane isuguru y’impene kw ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha, bo n’imasa n’umwana w’intama, vyompi bimaze umwaka, kandi bitagira agasembga, kw ikimazi co kwoswa;
n’impfizi y’inka n’impfizi y’intama kw ikimazi c’ishimwe, vyo gukererera imbere y’Uhoraho; bo n’ishikanwa ry’ifu ivanze n’ amavuta ya elayo; kuk’ uyu musi Uhoraho agira abiyereke.
Nuko bazana ivyo Mose yageze imbere y’ihema ry’ibonaniro; ikoraniro ryose ryīgira hafi, rihagarara imbere yo Uhoraho.
Mose aravuga, at’ Ibi ni vyo Uhoraho yageze ko mukora, maz’ ubgiza bg’ Uhoraho burababonekera.
Maze Mose abarira Aroni, at’ Egera igicaniro, witangire ikimazi c’ ivyaha, n’ico kwoswa, wihongere, uhongere n’abantu; utange n’ibimazi vy’abantu, ubahongere, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yageze.
Nuko Aroni yegera igicaniro, akerera iyo shuri yitangiriye kw ikimazi c’ivyaha.
Abana biwe bamuhēreza amaraso, ayajōbekamw’ urutoke, ayasīga ku mahembe y’igicaniro, ayandi ayavyagiza hasi hambavu y’igicaniro:
arikw ibinure, n’amafyigo, n’agashami gatoya k’igitigu vy’ico kimazi gitangiwe ivyaha, avyosereza ku gicaniro, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yari yarageze Mose.
Maz’ inyama zaco n’urusāto abituririra inyuma y’aho bashagaje.
Araheza akerera ikimazi co kwoswa; abana biwe bamuhēreza amaraso, ayamijagira ku gicaniro impande zose.
Maze bamuhēreza ivy’ ico kimazi, bamuha ibice vyaco kimwe‐kimwe bo n’ umutwe waco, avyosereza ku gicaniro.
Aronga amara yaco, n’ibikenye vy’amaguru, aravyosa, abigeretse ku vy’ico kimazi coshejwe kiri ku gicaniro.
Maz’ azana ibimazi abantu batanze; yābīra impene y’ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha vy’abantu, arayikerera, ayitanga kubg’ ivyaha, nk’uko yatanze ca kimazi ca mbere.
Azana n’ikimazi co kwoswa, agitanga nk’uko vyagezwe.
Azana n’ishikanwa ry’ ifu, ayikamatak’ urushi rumwe, ayosereza ku gicaniro, ayongeye ku kimazi coshejwe co mu gitondo.
Kand’ akerera ya mpfizi y’inka na ya mpfizi y’intama kw ikimazi c’ishimwe gitangiwe abantu; abana biwe bamuhēreza amaraso, ayamijagira ku gicaniro impande zose;
bamuhēreza ibinure vy’iyo mpfizi, n’ivy’ iyo mpfizi y’intama, n’umurizo uko wagahometsekw ibinure, n’urubambanda, n’amafyigo, n’udushami dutoya tw’ibitigu;
bafasha ivyo binure ku nkoro z’ivyo bimazi; araheza yosereza ivyo binure ku gicaniro,
izo nkoro, bo n’ibikenye vy’amaguru y’i buryo, Aroni arabizunguza, kuba ishikanwa rizungurijwe imbere y’ Uhoraho, nk’uko Mose yageze.
Maze Aroni aterura amaboko, atumbereye abantu, arabahezagira; araheza arururuka, ava aho yatangiye ca kimazi catangiwe ivyaha, na ca kimazi coshejwe, na ca kimazi c’ishimwe.
Maze Mose na Aroni binjira mw ihema ry’ ibonaniro, baraheza barasohoka, bahezagira abantu; maz’ ubgiza bg’Uhoraho bubonekera abantu bose.
Umuriro uvuye imbere y’Uhoraho uraheza uraza, utōngōrera ku gicaniro ca kimazi coshejwe bo na vya binure: abo bantu bose babibonye, basēsereza impundu, barūnama bashika hasi.
Nadabu na Abihu, bene Aroni, bābīra ivyotero vyabo, bashiramw’ umuriro, bashirakw imibavu, bayosereza Uhoraho ku muriro urahuwe ahandi, uwo atabageze.
Haza umuriro uvuye imbere y’Uhoraho, urabīca, bagwa aho imbere yiwe.
Mose abarira Aroni, at’ Ivyo ni vyo Uhoraho yavuze, ng’ Ukwera kwiwe kuzogaragarira mu bamwegera, kandi ngw Azoherwa icubahiro imbere y’abantu bose. Aroni arūmirwa.
Mose ahamagara Mishayeli na Elisafani, bene Uziyeli se wabo wa Aroni, arababarira, ati Ni mwīgire hano, muterure ab’i wanyu, mubakūre imbere y’ahēra, mubajane inyuma y’aho dushagaje.
Nuko bīgira hafi, babaterura mu makanzo yabo, uko bakayambaye, babajana inyuma y’aho bashagaje, nk’uko Mose agize.

Mose abarira Aroni n’abana biwe Eleyazari na Itamari, ati Ntimuhamburure imishatsi yanyu, canke ngo mutantamure impuzu zanyu, kugira ngo ntimupfe, kand’ Uhoraho ntarakire ikoraniro ryose; ariko bene wanyu, ab’ inzu yose ya Isirayeli, abe ari bo baborogeshwa n’ umuriro Uhoraho arekuye.
Kandi ntimutirimuke ngo muve ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro, kugira ngo ntimupfe: kukw amavuta y’Uhoraho mwarobanujwe akiri kuri mwebge; nuko babigenza nk’uko Mose avuze.
Uhoraho abarira Aroni,

ati Ntuze wigere unywa kuri vino canke ku kiboreza na kimwe, mwe n’abana bawe, igihe mugira mwinjire mw ihema ry’ibonaniro, kugira ngo ntimupfe: ico kibabere icagezwe c’intahava ukw ibihe vy’urunganwe rwanyu bizogenda bikurikirana,
kugira ngo mubone uko mutandukanya ivyera n’ibitar’ ivyera, n’ibihumanya n’ ibidahumanya,
kandi kugira ngo mwigishe Abisirayeli ivyagezwe vyose narungikanye Mose.

Mose abarira Aroni n’abana biwe basigaye, Eleyazari na Itamari, ati Ni mujane ivyasigaye kuri rya shikanwa ry’ifu ryo mu mashikanwa yashikaniwe Uhoraho agatōngōrwa n’umuriro, mubirīre i ruhande y’igicaniro bitarimw’ umwambiro: kukw ar’ ivyera cane.
Nuko mubirīre ahantu hēra, kukw ar’ umuturi wawe n’uw’ abana bawe, wo ku mashikanwa ashikaniwe Uhoraho agatōngōrwa n’umuriro; kuk’ ukw ari ko nabariwe.

Na ya nkoro yashikanishijwe kuzunguzwa, na ca gikenye c’ukuguru cagerewe abaherezi, mubirīre ahantu hadahumanye, mwe n’abahungu bawe n’abakobga bawe; kukw ari vyo wagerewe ngo bibe umuturi wawe, n’uw’ abahungu bawe, wo ku bimazi vy’ishimwe Abisirayeli bashikanye.

Igikenye c’ukuguru kigerewe abaherezi bo n’inkoro yo kuzunguzwa, baze bahore babizanana n’ishikanwa ry’ibinure ryo gutōngōrwa n’umuriro, ngo babizunguze, bibe ishikanwa rizungurijwe imbere y’Uhoraho: ivyo bizoba ivyawe n’ivy’ abana bawe, bibe umuturi wanyu w’intahava, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yageze.
Mose abariritsa ca kimazi c’impene catangiwe ivyaha, asanga catongotse. Arakira bene Aroni basigaye, Eleyazari na Itamari, arababaza,

ati Mwabujijwe n’iki kurya ca kimazi catangiwe ivyaha, ngo muteko mukirīre ahantu hēra, kand’ ar’ icera cane, ar’ ico Uhoraho yabahaye ngo gitume mwishirakw ibigabitanyo vy’ikoraniro, ngo murihongerere imbere yiwe?
Ehe rāba amaraso yaco kw atari yazanywe ahēra, nta cari kubabuza kukirya, ngo mukirīre ahantu hēra, nk’uko nageze.

Aroni yishura Mose, at’ Ereg’ uyu musi batanze ikimazi cabo gitangiwe ivyaha, bo n’ikimazi cabo co kwoswa, bakabitangira imbere y’Uhoraho; kand’ ehe rāba ayo nabonye: mbega non’ uyu musi iyo ndya ico kimazi catangiwe ivyaha, ivyo vyari kuba ari vyiza imbere y’Uhoraho?
Mose avyumvise, arashirwa.
Uhoraho abarira Mose na Aroni,
ati Mubarire Abisirayeli, muti Mu bikōko vyose, ibi ni vyo mwemererwa kurya mu bigenda vyose vyo mw isi:
igifise inzāra cose ziri n’umwanya hagati, kikagira inzāra kubiri, kigatako kikūza, ico ni co mwemererwa kurya mu bigenda.
Ariko mu vyūza no mu bifise inzāra ziri n’umwanya hagati, ivyo mutemerewe kurya n’ibi: ingamiya, kuko naho yūza ariko ntigira inzāra ziri n’umwanya hagati, iyo n’ igihumanya kuri mwebge.
N’ inkezi, kuko naho yūza ariko ntigira inzāra ziri n’umwanya hagati, na yo n’igihumanya kuri mwebge.
N’urukwavu, kuko naho rwūza ariko ntirugira inzāra ziri n’umwanya hagati, na rwo n’igihumanya kuri mwebge.
N’ ingurube, kuko nah’ ifise inzāra ziri n’umwanya hagati, ikagira inzāra kubiri, ariko ntiyūza, na yo n’igihumanya kuri mwebge.
Inyama zavyo ntimuze muzirye, n’imivyimba yavyo ntimuze muyikoreko: n’ibihumanya kuri mwebge.
Ibi ni vyo mwemererwa kurya mu biba mu mazi vyose: ibiba mu mazi, mu biyaga no mu nzūzi, bifise amababa n’ibigaragamba, ivyo ni vyo mwemererwa kurya.
Ibidafise amababa n’ ibigaragamba vyo mu biyaga no mu nzūzi, ibigendera mu mazi vyose, ibifise ubugingo vyose biba mu mazi, n’umuziro kuri mwebge.
Bize bihore biba umuziro kuri mwebge; ntimuze mwigere murya ku nyama zavyo, kand’ imivyimba yavyo muze muyigire umuziro.
Ico mu mazi cose kitagira amababa n’ibigaragamba kize kibe umuziro kuri mwebge.
Ibi az’ abe ari vyo mugira umuziro mu bisīga; ntibize vyigere biribga, n’ibizira: inkukuma, n’itarangabo, na oziniya;
n’ ikinyamwanira, n’inkōna, ukw amoko yavyo ari;
n’icitwa igikōna cose, ukw amoko yavyo ari;
n’imbuni, na tamasi, na shakafu, n’agaca, ukw amoko yavyo ari;
n’igihuna, na shalaki, n’inyanana;
na tinishemeti, n’ inkongori, n’ikinyakabaka;
na sarumfune, n’agasōza, ukw amoko yavyo ari, na samunsure, n’ agahungarema.
Udukōko twose tw’amababa tunyonyera, tugendesha amaguru ane, n’umuziro kuri mwebge.
Arikw ivyo mwemererwa kurya muri two n’ibi: udufise amaguru maremare akonye ahahera hejuru y’ibirenge, yo kugenda dutarukisha hasi.
Utwo mwemererwa kurya muri two n’uruzige, nk’ukw amoko yazo ari, n’utundi tumeze nka rwo twitwa solamu na harugoli na hagabu, nk’ukw amoko yatwo ari.
Arik’ utundi twose tw’amababa tunyonyera, tugendesha amaguru ane, n’umuziro kuri mwebge.
Kand’ ibi ni vyo vyobahumanya: uwokora ku muvyimba wavyo yoba ahumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba;
kandi n’uwogira ico aterura co ku muvyimba wavyo, az’ amesure impuzu ziwe, akomeze kuba ūhumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba.
Ikigenda gifise inzāra ziri n’imyanya hagati cose, arikw inzāra zitari kubiri rwose, kigatako nticūze, n’igihumanya kuri mwebge; uwogikorako wese yoba ahumanye.
Ikigendesha amajanja cose co mu bigenza amaguru ane vyose, n’igihumanya kuri mwebge; uwokora ku muvyimba wavyo yoba ahumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba.
Kandi n’ uwogira ico aterura co ku muvyimba wavyo, az’ amesure impuzu ziwe, akomeze kuba ūhumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba: ivyo n’ ibihumanya kuri mwebge.
Ibi ni vyo bihumanya kuri mwebge mu binyonyera bigenda hasi: igikara, n’imbeba, bo n’imburu nk’ukw amoko yazo ari;
n’ icūgu, n’ikivumbura, n’umuserebanyi, n’agacamano, n’uruvu.
Ivyo vyose n’ibihumanya kuri mwebge mu binyonyera vyose; uwokora ku gipfuye muri vyo yoba ahumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba.

Kand’ ikintu cose cokorokerwako n’umuvyimba w’ico muri vyo coba gihumanye; kandi naho coba ikintu cose cabājwe mu giti, cank’ umwambaro, cank’ urusato, cank’ igunira, cank’ ikindi kintu iyo kiva kikagera gikoreshwa mu buryo ubg’ ari bgo bgose, gikwiye kwinikwa mu mazi, kibe igihumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba; aho ni ho kizoba gihumanutse.
Kand’ ikibumbano cose cokorokerwamwo na kimwe muri vyo, ivyoba muri co vyose vyoba bihumanye, na co ubgaco mwoba mukwiye kukimena.
Ibirībga vyose vyosukwakw amazi yo muri co, vyoba bihumanye: kand’ ico kunywa cose coba mu kintu ben’ ico cose coba gihumanye.
Ikintu cose cokorokerwako n’icavuye ku muvyimba wavyo coba gihumanye; ar’ iziko cank’ amashiga, coba gikwiye kumenagurwa; ivyo n’ ibihumanya, kandi bizoba ibihumanya kuri mwebge.
Mugabo icokorokera mw isōko canke mu rwobo rwimbiwe kubīkamw’ amazi, akadengēramwo, yo ntiyoba ahumanye; arik’ uwokora ku muvyimba wavyo wakorokeyemwo yoba ahumanye.
Kandi ni hagira ico ku muvyimba wavyo cogwa mu mbuto zo kubibga iz’ ari zo zose, zo ntizoba zihumanye.
Ariko namb’ izo mbuto zīnitswe mu mazi, icavuye ku muvyimba wavyo kikazigwamwo, zizoba igihumanya kuri mwebge.
Kand’ igikōko cose cank’ igitunzwe mu vyo mwemererwa kurya, hagize igipfuye, uwokora ku muvyimba waco yoba ahumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba.

Kandi horamuka har’ ūriye ku muvyimba waco, az’ amesure impuzu ziwe, akomeze kuba ūhumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba; n’uwoterura umuvyimba waco, na we az’ amesure impuzu ziwe, akomeze kuba ūhumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba.
Kand’ ikinyonyera cose kinyonyera hasi n’ikizira: ntikize cigere kiribga.
Igikwega inda hasi cose, n’akagendesha amaguru ane kose, n’akagendesha ubuguru bginshi, mber’ utunyonyera twose tunyonyera hasi, ntimuze mwigere muturya, kukw ar’ ibizira.
Ntimuze mwiyandurishe ak’ ari ko kose ko mu tunyonyera, ntimuze muvyihumanishe ngo bibanduze.
Kuko nd’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu: ni mwiyeze rero, mube abera, kuko nanje nd’ uwera; kandi ntimuze mwiyandurishe akanyonyera k’uburyo bgose kagendera hasi.
Kukw ari jewe Uhoraho nabadūganye mbakūye mu gihugu ca Egiputa, ngo mbe Imana yanyu: nuko rero mube abera, kuko nanje nd’ uwera.
Ivyo ni vyo vyagezwe vyo ku bikōko no ku bitunzwe, no ku bisīga, no ku bifise ubugingo vyose bigendera mu mazi, no ku turiho twose tunyonyera hasi;
vyo gutandukanya igihumanya n’ikidahumanya, n’icoribga mu bigenda n’ikitoribga.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
ati Barira Abisirayeli, ut’ Umugore ni yasama inda, akavyara umwana w’umuhungu, az’ amare imisi ndwi ahumanye: nk’uko bimubera iy’ari mu muhango w’imiziro yiwe, ni kw azoba ahumanye.
Ku musi ugira umunani uwo mwana az’ akebge.

Nyina az’ amare imisi mirongwitatu n’itatu abone guhumanurwa, avuye mu maraso yiwe; ntaz’ akore ku kintu cera na kimwe, canke ngw ashike ahantu hēra, gushitsa ah’ imisi y’uguhumanurwa kwiwe izoshirira.

Na ho ni yavyara umwana w’umukobga, az’ amare amayinga abiri ahumanye, nk’uko bimubera iy’ ari mu miziro yiwe; az’ aheze amare imisi mirongwitandatu n’ itandatu abone guhumanurwa, avuye mu maraso yiwe.

Imisi y’uguhumanurwa kwiwe ni yaramuka ishize, yo ku muhungu canke ku mukobga, az’ azane umwagazi w’intama utarengeje umwaka kw ikimazi co kwoswa, n’icana c’inuma cank’ intunguru, kw ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha, abizanire umuherezi ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro:

na we aheze abitangire aho nyene imbere yanje jewe Uhoraho, amuhongere; uwo mugore ni ho azoba ahumanuwe isōko y’amaraso yiwe. Ico ni co cagezwe c’umugore avyaye, namba yoba avyaye umuhungu cank’ umukobga.

Kandi ni yaba atoshobora kuronka umwagazi w’intama, az’ azane intunguru zibiri cank’ ivyana vy’inuma bibiri; imwe y’ikimazi co kwoswa, iyindi y’ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha: nuk’ umuherezi amuhongere, na we azoba ahumanutse.
Uhoraho abarira Mose na Aroni,

at’ Umuntu ni yagira igishundu, cank’ akagira ibintu bitongangiye, cank’ akagira ikibibi, ku mubiri wiwe inyuma ku rukoba, ico kintu kigahinduka indwara y’imibembe aho nyene ku rukoba rwiwe, baze bamuzanire Aroni umuherezi, cank’ umwe wo muri bene Aroni abaherezi.

Nuk’ uwo muherezi asuzume iyo ndwara iri ku mubiri wiwe inyuma ku rukoba; maz’ ubgoya bg’aho hantu harwaye, ni yasanga bgahindutse bukēra, iyo ndwara igasa n’aho yinjiye imbere mu rukoba, iyo ndwara izoba ar’ iy’ imibembe: nuk’ uwo muherezi amusuzumye, avuge kw ahumanye.
Na ho ni yasanga ico kibibi co ku mubiri wiwe cera, kandi kidasa n’aho cinjiye imbere mu rukoba, n’ ubgoya bgaho butāhindutse ngo bgere, nuk’ uwo muherezi yugarane uwo murwayi kumara imisi ndwi.
Ku musi ugira indwi uwo muherezi amusuzume; ni yasanga iyo ndwara itayegayeze, ngo yunguruze inyuma ku rukoba, uwo muherezi asubire amwugarane kumara iyindi misi ndwi.

Ku musi ugira indwi, yongere amusuzume; nuko ni yabona iyo ndwara irikw irazimangana, itunguruje inyuma ku rukoba, avuge kw adahumanye: kizoba car’ igisekera; uwo muntu agende amesure impuzu ziwe, abe uwejejwe.
Arikw amaze guheza kwiyereka umuherezi, akezwa, ico gisekera kikunguruza inyuma ku rukoba, aze yongere kwiyereka umuherezi.
Uwo muherezi amusuzume, maze ni yabona ico gisekera cunguruje koko aho nyene inyuma ku rukoba, avuge kw ahumanye: izoba ar’ imibembe.
Umuntu ni yafatwa n’indwara y’imibembe, az’ azanirwe umuherezi;
uwo muherezi amusuzume; maze ni haboneka ahashundashe, inyuma ku rukoba, hagatako hakēra, bigatuma ubgoya bgaho bgera, inyama zaho zikajējēta;
izoba ar’ imibembe yamaze igihe kirekire mu rukoba rw’umubiri wiwe: uwo muherezi avuge kw ahumanye, ntarinde kumwugarana, kukw ahumanye.
Arikw imibembe ni yasēsa ku mubiri, ikarangiza umubiri wose w’uwafashwe n’iyo ndwara, uhereye ku mutwe ugashitsa ku birenge, ah’ umuherezi ageza amaso hose;
uwo muherezi amusuzume: maze ni yabona iyo mibembe imukwiye umubiri wose, az’ avuge yuk’ uyo yafashwe n’iyo ndwara adahumanye: umubiri wiwe ko wahindutse ukēra hose, ntahumanye.
Ariko ni yaramuka agize ahamyotse, hakaba inyama zijega, azoba ahumanye.
Umuherezi az’ ahasuzume, avuge kw ahumanye: izo nyama zijega n’uguhumana: n’imibembe.
Na ho ahar’ izo nyama zijega, ni hasubira guhinduka, hakēra, asubire ku muherezi,
na we amusuzume; maze ni yasanga aho hārwaye hahindutse, hakēra, uwo muherezi avuge ko yahumanutse: azoba atagihumanye.
Umuntu ni yagira inkovu y’ahahora igihute inyuma ku rukoba,
maze muri nya nkovu hagashundaha hakabenjuka, canke hakaza ikibibi, hagatukura; haze herekwe umuherezi,

na we ahasuzume, maze ni yasanga ico kintu gisa n’icinjiye imbere mu rukoba, ubgoya bgaho bgahindutse, bukēra, uwo muherezi az’ avuge kw ahumanye: izoba ar’ indwara y’imibembe, yaziye mu nkovu y’igihute.
Arik’ umuherezi ni yahasuzuma, agasanga hatar’ ubgoya bgera, kandi kitinjiye imbere mu rukoba, ariko kiriko kirazimangana, uwo muherezi az’ amwugarane kumara imisi ndwi.
Maze ni yasanga cunguruje inyuma ku rukoba, avuge kw ahumanye: izoba ar’ imibembe.
Arikw ico kibibi ni kitayegayega ngo cunguruze, kizoba ar’ inkovu ya ca gihute; umuherezi az’ avuge ko yeze.
Cank’ umuntu ni yagira ubushe ku mubiri wiwe, inyuma ku rukoba, inkovu yabgo igahinduka ikibibi, hagatukura canke hakabenjuka;

umuherezi az’ ahasuzume; ni yasanga ubgoya bgo mur’ ico kibibi buhindutse, bukēra, kigasa n’icinjiye imbere mu rukoba, izoba ar’ imibembe yaziye muri bga bushe: nuk’ uwo muherezi avuge kw ahumanye; izoba ar’ indwara y’imibembe.
Arik’ umuherezi ni yahasuzuma, agasanga ubgoya bgo mur’ ico kibibi butera, kandi kitinjiye imbere mu rukoba, ariko kiriko kirazimangana, uwo muherezi amwugarane kumara imisi ndwi.
Ku musi ugira indwi, uwo muherezi amusuzume; maze ni yasanga cunguruje inyuma ku rukoba, avuge kw ahumanye: izoba ar’ indwara y’imibembe.

Arikw ico kibibi ni kitayegayega ngo cunguruze inyuma ku rukoba, kandi kikaba kiriko kirazimangana, hazoba haje igishundu kiziye muri bga bushe: uwo muherezi avuge ko yeze; izoba ar’ inkovu y’ubgo bushe.
Kand’ umugabo cank’ umugore ni yafatwa n’indwara mu mutwe canke mu bganwa,

umuherezi az’ asuzume iyo ndwara; ni yabona isa n’iyinjiye musi y’ urukoba, umushatsi waho ugacēkūka, ukaba intaragande; avuge kw ahumanye: kizoba ar’ igiturika c’imibembe ifatiye mu mutwe canke mu bganwa.

Arik’ umuherezi ni yasuzuma iyo ndwara y’igiturika, agasanga isa n’ah’ itinjiye imbere mu rukoba, kandi hatar’ umushatsi wirabura, uwo muherezi yugarane uwafashwe n’ iyo ndwara y’igiturika kumara imisi ndwi.
Ku musi ugira indwi umuherezi az’ asuzume iyo ndwara; maze ni yasanga ico giturika kitunguruje, hatar’ umushatsi ucēkūtse, kandi kidasa n’aho cinjiye imbere mu rukoba,
baheze bamumwe, arikw ah’ ico giturika kiri ntibahamwe; uwo muherezi asubire yugarane uwafashwe n’ico giturika iyindi misi ndwi.

Ku musi ugira indwi uwo muherezi asuzume ico giturika: maze ni yasanga kitunguruje inyuma ku rukoba, kandi kidasa n’aho cinjiye imbere mu rukoba, uwo muherezi avuge kw adahumanye: uwo muntu agende amesure impuzu ziwe, abe uwejejwe.
Arikw amaze guheza kwitwa uweze, ico giturika kikunguruza inyuma ku rukoba,
umuherezi aheze amusuzume; maze ni yasanga ico giturika cunguruje inyuma ku rukoba, ntiyirirwe aserangura umushatsi k’ucēkūtse: uyo azoba ahumanye.
Na ho ku ruhande rwiwe ni yasanga ico giturika kitayegayeze, n’umushatsi wahameze wirabura; ico giturika kizoba gikize, uwo muntu azoba yeze: umuherezi avuge ko yeze.
Kandi ni hagira umugabo cank’ umugore agira ibibibi ku mubiri wiwe inyuma ku rukoba, ivyo bibibi bikēra;
umuherezi az’ abisuzume: maze ni yasanga ivyo bibibi vyo ku mubiri wiwe vyeragurika gusa, bizoba ar’ amabara yadutse inyuma ku rukoba: uyo muntu azoba adahumanye.
Kand’ umugabo ni yavunguka umushatsi, buzoba ar’ ubuhanza, ariko ntazoba ahumanye.
Kandi ni yavunguka umushatsi wo mu gitwariro, azoba ar’ ubuhanza yatobotse mu gitwariro, ariko ntazoba ahumanye.
Ariko ni haturika ibintu vy’indwara bitukura mu buhanza bgo mu gakomokomo canke mu bgo mu gitwariro; izoba ar’ imibembe yaje mur’ ubgo buhanza bgo mu gakomokomo canke mu bgo mu gitwariro.
Nuk’ umuherezi az’ amusuzume: maze ni yasanga ico gishundu arwaye gitukura aho nyene mu buhanza bgo mu gakomokomo canke mu bgo mu gitwariro, igasa n’imibembe ir’ inyuma ku rukoba;
uwo muntu azoba ar’ umunyamibembe, azoba ahumanye; umuherezi ntaz’ abure kuvuga kw ahumanye; iyo ndwara izoba yamufatiye mu mutwe.
Kand’ umunyamibembe iy’ arwaye iyo ndwara, agende yambaye impuzu zitantamutse, ahamburuye umushatsi wiwe, yipfutse ku munwa, agende arasemerera, ati Ndahumanye, ndahumanye!
Imisi yose akirwaye iyo ndwara azoba ahumanye; mber’ azoba ar’ igihumane, abe ukwiwe: az’ abe hirya y’aho mushagaje.
Kandi ni hagira umwambaro urikw indwara yo mu buryo bg’ imibembe, n’iyo woba wajishwe mu bgoya bg’intama, canke mu nyuzi zera derere;
iyo ndwara igafata kur’ ico kijishano uko kijishwe kwose, ari mu nyuzi zera derere canke mu z’ubgoya bg’ intama; cank’ igafata ku rusāto, canke ku kintu cose cakozwe mu rusāto;

iyo ndwara ikagomba gusa n’akatsi gatoto canke n’agahama, aho nyene ku mwambaro uk’ ujishwe kwose, canke ku rusāto, canke ku kintu cose cakozwe mu rusāto; iyo ndwara izoba ar’ iyo mu buryo bg’ imibembe: ivyo vyerekwe umuherezi.
Na we asuzume iyo ndwara, yugarane ico iriko kumara imisi ndwi.

Ku musi ugira indwi asubire asuzume iyo ndwara; maze ni yasanga iyo ndwara yunguruje kur’ uwo mwambaro uk’ ujishwe kwose, canke kur’ urwo rusāto, ico rwoba rukora cose; iyo ndwara izoba ar’ imibembe igenda irarya: ico kintu kizoba gihumanye.

Aheze aturire uwo mwambaro, iyo ndwara namba yoba ifashe kur’ ico kijishano uko kijishwe kwose, ari mu nyuzi z’ubgoya bg’intama canke mu zera derere, canke namba yoba ifashe ku kintu cose cakozwe mu rusāto, kukw ar’ imibembe igenda irarya; ico kintu kize giturirwe.
Arik’ uwo muherezi ni yasuzuma, akabona iyo ndwara itunguruje kur’ uwo mwambaro uk’ ujishwe kwose, canke ku kintu cose cakozwe mu rusāto;
avuge ko bamesura ico iyo ndwara yafashe, aheze acugarane kumara iyindi misi ndwi.

Maz’ ico kintu indwara yafashe, uwo muherezi az’ agisuzume, kimaze kumesurwa; nuko ni yasanga ah’ iyo ndwara yafashe hadahinduye ibara, kand’ iyo ndwara itunguruje, na ho nyene kizoba gihumanye; kize giturirwe: izoba ar’ iyo ndwara igenda irarya, naho coba kibaye inkūte imbere cank’ inyuma.

Maz’ ico kintu indwara yafashe, uwo muherezi ni yagisuzuma, agasanga iyo ndwara irikw irazimangana, kimaze kumesurwa, aho hantu aheze ahatabure, ahakūre kur’ uwo mwambaro uk’ ujishwe kwose, canke kur’ urwo rusāto.
Maz’ iyo ndwara ni yasubira kwubuka kur’ uwo mwambaro uk’ ujishwe kwose, canke ku kintu cose cakozwe mu rusāto, izoba igitwarije; ico kintu kirimw’ iyo ndwara kize giturirwe.
Na ho iyo ndwara ni yaba yavuye mur’ uwo mwambaro uk’ ujishwe kwose, canke mu kintu ic’ ari co cose cakozwe mu rusāto, cari caramesuwe, kize gisubire kumesurwa ubugira kabiri, kibe gihumanutse.

Ico ni co cagezwe c’indwara yo mu buryo bg’imibembe ifashe umwambaro, ar’ uwajishwe mu bgoya bg’intama canke mu nyuzi zera derere, igafata kur’ ico kijishano uko kijishwe kwose, canke ku kintu cose cakozwe mu rusāto, ngo babone kuvuga ko gihumanye canke ko kidahumanye.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
at’ Iki abe ari co kiba icagezwe co ku munyamibembe, ku musi wo guhumanurwa kwiwe: az’ ashīrwe umuherezi.
Na we aheze agende inyuma y’aho mushagaje, asuzume uwo munyamibembe; maze ni yasanga iyo ndwara y’imibembe ikize,
avuge ko bazanira uyo agira ahumanurwe inyoni zibiri zibona, zitar’ izo mu zizira, n’ingegene y’igiti c’isederi, n’utunyuzi dusa n’agahama, n’ utubabi twa ezobu;
umuherezi avuge ko bakererera imwe mur’ izo nyoni hejuru y’ikintu c’ikibumbano, kirimw’ amazi yavomwe mu mbizi.
Aheze yābīre imwe ikidora, na ya ngegene y’isederi, na twa tunyuzi dusa n’agahama, na ezobu, abijobekane na ya nyoni ikidora mu maraso ya ya nyoni yakererewe hejuru y’amazi yavomwe mu mbizi.
Aheze ayacucagire ibihetangabo ndwi kur’ uwo nyene guhumanurwa ngw avekw imibembe, avuge kw ahumanutse, arekurire iyo nyoni idora mu gahinga.
Nyene guhumanurwa aheze amesure impuzu ziwe, yimoshe ahamera umushatsi hose, yiyuhagire, azoba ahumanutse, abone kugaruka aho mushagaje; arikw amare imisi ndwi abe hanze inyuma y’ihema ryiwe.
Ku musi ugira indwi yimoshe umushatsi wose wo ku mutwe, n’ubganwa n’ibigohe, amwe n’ uwundi wose; aheze amesure impuzu ziwe, yiyuhagire, abe ahumanutse.

Ku musi ugira umunani aze yābīre abana b’ intama babiri b’amasuguru, batagira agasembga, n’inyana y’intama itarengeje umwaka itagira agasembga, bo n’ibice bitatu vy’icumi vy’ingero y’ifu igogōretse vyo kuba ishikanwa ry’ifu ivanze n’ amavuta ya elayo, n’ingero imwe yitwa logi y’amavuta ya elayo.
Umuherezi amuhumanura ashire uwo muntu nyene guhumanurwa hamwe n’ivyo bintu, imbere yanje ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Uwo muherezi yābīre imwe mur’ ayo masuguru y’intama, ayitangekw ikimazi c’impongano, ayitangane na ya ngero yitwa logi y’amavuta, abizunguze, bibe ishikanwa rizungurijwe imbere yanje;

akererere iyo suguru y’intama aho bakererera ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha bo n’ikimazi co kwoswa, ahantu hēra: nk’ukw ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha ar’ umuturi w’umuherezi, ni ko n’ ikimazi c’impongano kiri: n’icera cane.
Uwo muherezi yābīre ku maraso y’ico kimazi c’impongano, ayakoze ku gutwi kw’i buryo kw’uyo arikw arahumanurwa, ahahera hejuru, no ku rukumu rwiwe rw’i buryo, no kw ino ryiwe rinini ry’i buryo.
Uwo muherezi aheze yābīre ku mavuta ari muri logi, ayasuke ku rushi rwiwe rw’i bumoso,
akoze urutoke rwiwe rwo ku kuryo mur’ ayo mavuta ari ku rushi rwiwe rw’i bumoso, ayacucagirishe urwo rutoke rwiwe imbere yanje ibihetangabo ndwi;

amavuta asigaye ku rushi rwiwe, uwo muherezi ayakoze ku gutwi kw’i buryo kw’uyo arikw arahumanurwa, ahahera hejuru, no ku rukumu rwiwe rw’i buryo, no kw ino ryiwe rinini ry’i buryo, aharoye ya maraso y’ikimazi c’impongano.
Ayandi mavuta asigaye ku rushi rwiwe, uwo muherezi ayasīge mu mutwe w’uwo arikw arahumanurwa; uwo muherezi aheze amuhongerere imbere yanje:
atange ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha, ahongere uwo arikw arahumanurwa ubuhumane bgiwe; hanyuma akerere ikimazi co kwoswa.
Uwo muherezi atangire ku gicaniro ico kimazi co kwoswa bo na rya shikanwa ry’ifu; uko ni kw azoba amuhongeye, na we azoba yejejwe.

Kandi ni yaba ar’ umworo, ntashobore kuronka ibingana birtyo, aze yābīre umwana w’intama w’isuguru, kuba ikimazi c’impongano co kuzunguzwa, ngw acīhongere, bo n’ikigiracumi c’ingero y’ifu igogōretse ivanze n’amavuta ya elayo, co kuba ishikanwa ry’ifu, na logi imwe y’amavuta ya elayo;
bo n’intunguru zibiri cank’ ivyana vy’inuma bibiri, ivy’ azoshobora kuronka; kimwe kibe ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha, ikindi kibe ikimazi co kwoswa.
Ku musi ugira umunani, az’ abishīre umuherezi ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro imbere yanje, bibe ivyo kumuhumanura.
Umuherezi yābīre uwo mwana w’intama w’ikimazi c’impongano, na ya ngero yitwa logi y’amavuta, abizunguze, bibe ishikanwa rizungurijwe imbere yanje.

Akerere uwo mwana w’intama w’ ikimazi c’impongano, aheze yābīre ku maraso y’ico kimazi, ayakoze ku gutwi kw’i buryo kw’uyo arikw arahumanurwa, ahahera hejuru, no ku rukumu rwiwe rw’i buryo, no kw ino ryiwe rinini ry’i buryo.
Uwo muherezi aheze asuke kur’ ayo mavuta, ayasuke ku rushi rwiwe rw’i bumoso;
ayacucagirishe urutoke rwiwe rwo ku kuryo imbere yanje ibihetangabo ndwi;

aheze yābīre kur’ ayo mavuta ari ku rushi rwiwe, ayakoze ku gutwi kw’i buryo kw’ uyo arikw arahumanurwa, ahahera hejuru, no ku rukumu rwiwe rw’i buryo, no kw ino ryiwe rinini ry’i buryo, aho hantu nyene hari ya maraso y’ikimazi c’impongano.
Ayandi mavuta asigaye ku rushi rwiwe, uwo muherezi ayasīge mu mutwe w’uwo arikw arahumanurwa, kugira ngo bimubere impongano imbere yanje.
Kand’ atange imwe muri za ntunguru canke kimwe muri vya vyana vy’inuma, ivy’ uwo ashoboye kuronka;
