atange ku vy’uwo ashoboye kuronka, kimwe kibe ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha, ikindi kibe ico kwoswa, hamwe n’ishikanwa ry’ifu: uwo arikw arahumanurwa, umuherezi amuhongerere imbere yanje.
Ico ni co cagezwe c’uwafashwe n’ indwara y’imibembe, ntashobore kuronka ivyo kumuhumanura.
Uhoraho abarira Mose na Aroni,
ati Ni mwamara gushika mu gihugu c’i Kanani, ico mbahaye kuba ishamvu yanyu, ngatera inzu yo mu gihugu c’ ishamvu yanyu indwara yo mu buryo bg’imibembe;
nyen’ iyo nzu az’ agende abarire umuherezi, at’ Inzu yanje umengo isa n’aho yatewe n’indwara.
Uwo muherezi avuge ko basohora ibintu vyose muri yo, atarinjira gusuzuma iyo ndwara, kugira ngw ivyo mur’ iyo nzu vyose vyoye guhinduka ibihumanye; hanyuma uwo muherezi aze yinjire kurāba iyo nzu;
nukw asuzume iyo ndwara: maze ni yabona iyo ndwara yateye amarabaga ku bisika agomba gusa n’akatsi gatoto canke n’agahama, ikaboneka nk’ah’ umengo yinjiye imbere mu gisika;
uwo muherezi aheze yisohokere, ave mur’ iyo nzu: ashitse ku muryango, yugare iyo nzu kumara imisi ndwi.
Ku musi ugira indwi, uwo muherezi agaruke, ayisuzume; maze ni yasanga iyo ndwara yunguruje ku bisika vy’iyo nzu,
avuge ko basambura amabuye afashweko n’iyo ndwara, bayaterere ahantu hahumanye, inyuma y’igisagara.
Atekw avuge ko bahomōra iyo nzu imbere hose, kand’ ivyo bihome bahomōye babisēse ha hantu hahumanye, inyuma y’igisagara.
Baheze bazane ayandi mabuye, bayasanishe aho basambuye ya yandi, bazane n’iyindi ngwa, bahome iyo nzu.
Na h’iyo ndwara ni yagaruka, igasubira gusēsa ku nzu, bamaze gusambura amabuye no kuyihomōra, bagasubira kuyihoma;
uwo muherezi aze yinjire, ayisuzume; maze ni yasanga iyo ndwara yunguruje ku nzu, izoba ar’ imibembe igenda irarya: iyo nzu izoba ihumanye.
Maze bayisambure, amabuye yayo, n’ibiti vyayo, n’ibihomōtse kuri yo vyose, babikūre mu gisagara, babijane ahantu hahumanye.
Ikindi, ūzokwinjira mur’ iyo nzu igihe icugawe, azoba ahumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba.
Kand’ uwoyirāramwo az’ amesure impuzu ziwe; n’uwoyirīramwo na we amesure impuzu ziwe.
Na ho umuherezi ni yinjira, akayisuzuma, agasanga iyo ndwara itunguruje ku nzu, imaze guhomwa; uwo muherezi avuge kw ihumanutse, kukw iyo ndwara ikize.
Yābīre ivyo guhumanura iyo nzu, inyoni zibiri, n’ ingegene y’igiti c’isederi, n’utunyuzi dusa n’agahama, n’utubabi twa ezobu.
Aheze akererere imwe mur’ izo nyoni hejuru y’ ikintu c’ikibumbano, kirimw’ amazi yavomwe mu mbizi:

yābīre iyo ngegene y’isederi, n’iyo ezobu, n’utwo tunyuzi dusa n’agahama, n’iyo nyoni ikidora, abijōbeke mu maraso y’iyo nyoni yakerewe no mur’ ayo mazi yavomwe mu mbizi, acucagire kur’ iyo nzu ibihetangabo ndwi.
Ahumanuze iyo nzu amaraso y’iyo nyoni, n’ayo mazi yavomwe mu mbizi, n’iyo nyoni ikidora, n’iyo ngegene y’isederi, n’iyo ezobu, n’utwo tunyuzi dusa n’agahama.
Aheze agende arekurire iyo nyoni idora mu gahinga, inyuma y’igisagara; uko ni kw azoba ahongeye iyo nzu: nukw izoba yejejwe.
Ivyo ni vyo vyagezwe vy’ uburyo bgose bg’indwara y’imibembe: ar’ igiturika,
ar’ indwara yo mu buryo bg’imibembe ifashe umwambaro cank’ inzu,
ar’ igishundu, ar’ ibintu bitongangiye, ar’ ikibibi,
kugira ngo vyigishe umuntu kw ikintu gihumanye, canke ko kidahumanye: ivyo ni vyo vyagezwe vyo ku mibembe.
Uhoraho abarira Mose na Aroni,
ati Mubarire Abisirayeli, mut’ Umugabo wese ni yagira igisokoro mu mubiri wiwe, azoba ahumanye kubg’ ico gisokoro ciwe.
Uku ni kwo kuzoba guhumana kwiwe gutewe n’ico gisokoro ciwe: ni yaba agenda arajejeta cank’ azibiye, aba ahumanye.
Uburiri bgose umunyagisokoro aryamyeko buzoba buhumanye, n’ikintu cose yicayeko kizoba gihumanye.
Kand’ umuntu wese azokora ku buriri bgiwe az’ amesure impuzu ziwe, yiyuhagire, akomeze kuba ūhumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba.
Ūzokwicara ku kintu na kimwe umunyagisokoro yicayeko, az’ amesure impuzu ziwe, yiyuhagire, akomeze kuba ūhumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba.
Ūzokora ku mubiri w’umunyagisokoro, az’ amesure impuzu ziwe, yiyuhagire, akomeze kuba ūhumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba.
Kand’ umunyagisokoro ni yacira amate, agakorokera k’ūdahumanye, uyo az’ amesure impuzu ziwe, yiyuhagire, akomeze kuba ūhumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba.
Icicaro cose c’ikigenderwako umunyagisokoro azokwicarako kizoba gihumanye.
Ūzokora ku kintu na kimwe cari musi yiwe, azoba ahumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba; kand’ ūzoterura ivyo, az’ amesure impuzu ziwe, yiyuhagire, akomeze kuba ūhumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba.
Kand’ umunyagisokoro ni yakora ku muntu adakaravye, uwo az’ amesure impuzu ziwe, yiyuhagire, akomeze kuba ūhumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba.
Ikintu c’ikibumbano umunyagisokoro azokorako, kize kimenwe; na ho ni caba ikibazano, kize cunyugurishwe amazi.
Kand’ umunyagisokoro ni yagera guhumanurwa igisokoro ciwe, az’ aharūre imisi ndwi yo guhumanurwa, amesure impuzu ziwe; yiyuhagire mu mazi yavomwe mu mbizi, abone guhumanuka.
Ku musi ugira umunani, yijanire intunguru zibiri cank’ ivyana vy’inuma bibiri, abizane imbere yanje ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro, abihe umuherezi;
uwo muherezi abitange kw ibimazi, kimwe co gutangirwa ivyaha, ikindi co kwoswa; nuk’ uwo muherezi amuhongerere imbere yanje, kubg’ igisokoro ciwe.
Kand’ intanga z’umugabo ni zamuvamwo, aze yiyuhagire umubiri wose, akomeze kuba ūhumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba.
Kand’ umwambaro wose cank’ urusato rwose kirikw izo ntanga, kize kimesurwe, kize gikomeze kiba igihumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba.
Kand’ uwo mugabo ni yaramuka aryamanye n’umugore, bompi biyuhagire, bakomeze kuba abahumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba.
Kand’ izinamukobga ni yaja mu mihango yiwe, az’ amare imisi ndwi mu miziro yiwe: ūzomukorako wese azoba ahumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba.
Ikintu cose azoryamako akiri mu miziro yiwe kizoba gihumanye, n’ico azokwicarako cose kizoba gihumanye.
Kand’ umuntu wese azokora ku buriri bgiwe az’ amesure impuzu ziwe, yiyuhagire, akomeze kuba ūhumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba.
Ūzokora ku kintu na kimwe yicayeko, az’ amesure impuzu ziwe, yiyuhagire, akomeze kuba ūhumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba.
Uhereye ku buriri bgiwe, canke ku kintu cose yicayeko, ūzogikorako azoba ahumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba.
Kandi ni hagira umugabo aryamana na we, imiziro yiwe ikamwanduza, uwo mugabo azoba ahumanye kumara imisi ndwi: uburiri bgose azoryamako buzoba buhumanye.

Umukobga cank’ umugore ni yamara imisi myinshi ari mu mihango yiwe mu gihe kitari co, canke ni yarenza imisi yiwe, imisi yose azomara mu miziro, az’ abe nk’uko yahora ari mu miziro yiwe; azoba ahumanye.

Uburiri bgose azoryamako mu misi yose yo guhumana kwiwe, buze bumubere nk’ubgo yaryamyeko mu misi y’imiziro yiwe; n’ikintu cose azokwicarako kizoba gihumanye nk’icari gisanzwe gihumanywa n’ iy’ ari mu miziro.
Ūkoze kuri vyo wese azoba ahumanye; az’ amesure impuzu ziwe, yiyuhagire, akomeze kuba ūhumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba.
Ariko ni yaramuka ageze guhumanurwa ubgo buhumane bgamuvuyemwo, az’ aharūre imisi ndwi, hanyuma abone guhumanuka.
Ku musi ugira umunani, yijanire intunguru zibiri cank’ ivyana vy’inuma bibiri, abishīre umuherezi ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro;
uwo muherezi abitange kw ibimazi, kimwe co gutangirwa ivyaha, ikindi co kwoswa; nuk’ uwo muherezi amuhongerere imbere yanje, kubg’ ubuhumane bgiwe.
Uko ni ko muzotandukanya Abisirayeli n’ubuhumane bgabo, kugira ngo boye gupfa bahōwe ubuhumane bgabo bgo kwanduza ihema ryanje riri hagati muri bo.
Ivyo ni vyo vyagezwe vy’ umunyagisokoro, n’ivy’ ūvubgamwo n’intanga ziwe, bikamuhumanya;
n’ivy’ umukobga cank’ umugore arwaye ubutinyanka, n’ ivy’ ūvubgamwo n’ibimuhumanya wese, ar’ umugabo ar’ umugore, n’ivy’ umugabo arāranye n’umugore ahumanye.
Uhoraho abarira Mose hanyuma yo gupfa kwa ba bana ba Aroni bompi, hamwe bīgira hafi imbere y’Uhoraho, bakagwaho;

Uhoraho abarira Mose, ati Barira Aroni mukurwawe, yoye kwama yinjira, igihe yigombeye cose, ngw aje Ahēra, hirya ya ca gihuzu gikinze, imbere ya wa mutemere wo guhongerako urumitse kuri ya sandugu hejuru, kugira ngo ntapfe; kuko nzoserukira kur’ uwo mutemere wo guhongerako ndi muri ca gicu.
Aroni uku abe ari kw azogenza, mu kwinjira Ahēra: aze yābīre imasa y’umukangara y’ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha, n’impfizi y’ intama y’ikimazi co kwoswa.

Yambare ya kanzo yejejwe yera derere, na rya butura ryiwe ryera derere aryambike ubgambure bgiwe; akenyeze wa mukanda wera derere, yambare na ca gitambara cera derere mu mutwe; iyo ni yo myambaro yejejwe: nukw abanze kwiyuhagira, aheze ayambare.
Maze yake ikoraniro ry’Abisirayeli amasuguru abiri y’impene kuba ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha, n’impfizi y’intama kuba ikimazi co kwoswa.
Aroni aheze yīgize hafi ya masa y’ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha, yo kwitangirira, yo kwitangirakw impongano bo n’urugo rwiwe.
Maz’ azane za mpene zompi, azihagarike imbere yanje ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Aroni aheze apfindire izo mpene zompi: ubupfindo bumwe bgerekane iyanje, ubundi bgerekane iyo gusendwa.
Maze yīgize hafi iyo mpene yerekanywe n’ubupfindo kw ar’ iyanje, ayigerere kuba ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha.
Arikw imwe yerekanywe kw ar’ iyo gusendwa, ihagarikwe imbere yanje ikidora, kugira ngo yaturirwekw ivyaha, irungikwe kuba iyo gusenderwa mu bugaragwa.
Aroni aheze yīgize hafi ya masa y’ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha yo kwitangirira, yo kwitangirakw impongano bo n’urugo rwiwe, akerere iyo masa y’ikimazi c’ivyaha yitangiriye.
Yābire icotero, acuzuze amakara y’umuriro akūye ku gicaniro aho nyene imbere yanje, agende yujuje amashi imibavu iseye igogōye, y’ ibintu bimoga, avyinjize hirya ya ca gihuzu;
iyo mibavu ayishire kur’ uwo muriro aho nyene imbere yanje, kugira ng’ umwotsi w’iyo mibavu utwīkīre wa mutemere wo guhongerako, uri hejuru ya vya Bishinga intahe, kugira ngo ntapfe.
Kandi yābīre ku maraso ya ya masa, ayacucagize urutoke kur’ uwo mutemere wo guhongerako ku ruhande rw’i burasirazuba, atekw ayacucagize urutoke nyene imbere y’iyo ntebe ibihetangabo ndwi.

Aheze akerere ya mpene y’ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha vy’abantu, yinjirane amaraso yayo hirya ya ca gihuzu, ayagenze nk’uko yagenjeje amaraso ya ya masa, ayacucagire kuri wa mutemere wo guhongerako, bo n’imbere yawo.

Uko ni kw azoba atangiriye Ahēra impongano, kubg’ ubuhumane bg’Abisirayeli, no kubg’ ibicumuro vyabo, n’ivyaha vyabo vyose; kand’ abe ari kw agirira n’ihema ry’ibonaniro, riri hagati yabo, mu buhumane bgabo.

Ntihaze hagire umuntu n’umwe agera mw ihema ry’ibonaniro, igihe Aroni yinjira Ahēra kuhatangira impongano, gushitsa ah’ azoba asohokeye, amaze kwitangira impongano ubgiwe bo n’ urugo rwiwe, no kuyitangira ishengero ryose ry’Abisirayeli.
Nukw asohotse, aheze aje ku gicaniro aho nyene imbere yanje, agitangirire impongano, yābīre ku maraso ya ya masa no ku ya ya mpene, ayasīge ku mahembe y’ico gicaniro impande zose.
Aheze agicucagirekw ayo maraso n’urutoke rwiwe ibihetangabo ndwi, agihumanure, aceze kugira ngo kivek’ ubuhumane bg’Abisirayeli.
Ni yaheza gutangira Ahēra impongano, bo n’ihema ry’ibonaniro, n’igicaniro, aheze yīgize hafi ya mpene ikidora.

Uwo Aroni aheze arambike ibiganza vyiwe vyompi mu ruhanga rw’iyo mpene idora, ayaturirekw ibigabitanyo vy’Abisirayeli vyose, n’ ibicumuro vyabo vyose, n’ivyaha vyabo vyose; abiremeke mu ruhanga rw’iyo mpene, ayihe umuntu yari yibangikanije, ayijane mu bugaragwa.
Iyo mpene igende yikoreye ibigabitanyo vyabo vyose, ibijane ahataba abantu; uwo muntu ayishiburire mu bugaragwa.
Aroni yinjire mw ihema ry’ ibonaniro, yambure ya myambaro yera derere, iyo yari yambaye igihe yinjira Ahēra, ayisigeyo.
Aheze yiyuhagirire ahantu hēra, yambare imyambaro yahorana, asohoke, yitangire ikimazi ciwe ubgiwe co kwoswa, atangire n’abantu icabo, yihongere ubgiwe, ahongere n’abantu.
Kand’ ibinure vya ca kimazi catangiwe ivyaha avyosereze ku gicaniro.
Uwagiye gushibura ya mpene yasenzwe, amesure impuzu ziwe, yiyuhagire, abone kugaruka aho mushagaje.

Kand’ ivya ya masa y’ikimazi catangiwe ivyaha, n’ivya ya mpene y’ikimazi catangiwe ivyaha nyene, bimwe amaraso yavyo yinjijwe Ahēra kuba impongano, babiterure, babijane inyuma y’aho mushagaje, baturire insāto zavyo, n’inyama zavyo, n’amayezi yavyo;
kand’ uwabituriye amesure impuzu ziwe, yiyuhagire, abone kugaruka aho mushagaje.

Ibi bize bibabere icagezwe c’intahava: mu kwezi kw’indwi, ku musi wakwo w’icumi, muze mwame mwibabaza; ntihaze hagire ūgira igikorwa awukorako, naho yoba imvukira, cank’ umunyamahanga aba muri mwebge.
Kuko kur’ uwo musi ari ho muzotangirwa impongano, kugira ngo muhumanurwe: nuko muzoba muhumanuwe ivyaha vyanyu vyose imbere yanje, jewe Uhoraho.
Uwo musi uze wame ubabera isabato yo kuruhuka bihebuje, muze mwame muwibabazako: ico n’icagezwe c’intahava.
Kand’ umuherezi azorobanuzwa amavuta, akarobanurirwa ubuherezi mu gishingo ca se, az’ abe ari we abatangira impongano, yambaye ya myambaro yera derere, ari yo myambaro yejejwe;
az’ atange impongano y’Ahēra cane, n’iy’ ihema ry’ibonaniro, n’iy’ igicaniro, atange n’iy’ abaherezi, n’iy’ ikoraniro ry’abantu bose.
Ico kize kibabere icagezwe c’intahava, yukw azokwama atangira Abisirayeli impongano kubg’ ivyaha vyabo vyose, rimwe gusa uk’umwaka utashe. Nuko Aroni agenza nk’ uk’ Uhoraho yabariye Mose.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
ati Barira Aroni n’abana biwe n’Abisirayeli bose, ut’ Ibi ni vyo ashinze:
Umuntu wese wo mu nzu ya Isirayeli azobāgira inka cank’ umwana w’intama cank’ impene aho mushagaje, cank’ inyuma yaho,

atakizanye ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro, ngw akinshikanire kw ishikanwa, imbere y’ihema ryanje, uwo muntu azogībgako n’ayo maraso: mber’ azoba avishije amaraso: uwo muntu az’ acibge mu bgoko bgabo.
Ivyo n’ukugira ngw Abisirayeli baze bazane ibimazi vyabo, ivyo bahora batangira mu gahinga, babinzanire ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro, babihe umuherezi, babinshikanire kw ibimazi vy’ishimwe.
Uwo muherezi aheze amije amaraso ku gicaniro canje kiri ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro, yose ibinure ngo bibe umubabge ummotera neza.

Ntibaze bapfe basubiye gukererera ibisigo vy’amapfizi y’impene ibimazi vyabo, ari vyo bahurumbira nk’ ibimaka. Ico kize kibabere icagezwe c’intahava ukw ibihe vy’urunganwe rwabo bizogenda bikurikirana.
Kand’ ubabarire, ut’ Umuntu wese wo mu nzu ya Isirayeli, canke wo mu banyamahanga baba muri bo, azotanga ikimazi co kwoswa cank’ ikimazi kindi,
atakizanye ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro kukinshikanira, uwo muntu az’ acibge mu bgoko bgabo.
Kand’ umuntu wese wo mu nzu ya Isirayeli, canke wo mu banyamahanga baba muri bo, azokwigera ageza ubuseri mu kanwa, nzohoza igitsūre canje kur’ uwo muntu yariye ubuseri, ndamurandure mu bgoko bgabo.
Kuk’ ubugingo bg’umubiri buba mu maraso, nanje nshinze kw aba ku gicaniro kubganyu, ngw abe impongano y’ubugingo bganyu: kukw amaraso ar’ impongano, kubg’ ubugingo buri muri yo.
Ni co catumye nihanikiriza Abisirayeli, nti Ntihaze hagire umuntu azokwigera ageza mu kanwa icitwa amaraso, ar’ uwo muri mwebge, cank’ umunyamahanga aba muri mwebge.

Kand’ umuntu wese wo mu Bisirayeli, canke wo mu banyamahanga baba muri bo, azogira ico afata ari guhīga, ar’ igikōko, ar’ igisīga, cank’ inyoni, mu vyemerwa kuribga, amaraso yaco az’ ayareke amiminukire hasi, ayarenzekw ivu.

Kuk’ ubugingo bg’icaremwe cose ar’ amaraso yaco; ni co catumye nihanikiriza Abisirayeli, nti Ntimuze mwigere mugeza mu kanwa icitwa amaraso y’icaremwe ic’ ari co cose, kuk’ ubugingo bg’icaremwe cose ar’ amaraso yaco: ūzoyageza mu kanwa wese az’ acibge.
Kand’ umuntu wese azorya icipfiriye cank’ ikirangara, ar’ imvukira cank’ umunyamahanga, az’ amesure impuzu ziwe, yiyuhagire, akomeze kuba ūhumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba: ni h’azoba ahumanutse.
Ariko n’atazimesura, ntiyiyuhagire, azogibgako n’ibigabitanyo vyiwe.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
ati Barira Abisirayeli, uti Ni we Uhoraho, Imana yanyu.
Uti Ntimuze mukore nk’ivyo abo mu gihugu ca Egiputa bakora, abo mwahora mubamwo; kandi ntimuze mukore nk’ivyo abo mu gihugu c’i Kanani bakora, iy’ abajanye kuba: ntimuze mukurikire amabgirizwa yabo.
Ut’ Ivyagezwe vyiwe az’ abe ari vyo mwumvira, n’amabgirizwa yiwe az’ abe ari yo mwitondera, mubigenderemwo: uti Ni we Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Uti Nuko muze mwitondere amabgirizwa yiwe, n’ivyagezwe vyiwe; umuntu azokora ivyo, ni vyo bizomubeshaho: nd’ Uhoraho.
Ntihaze hagire uwo muri mwebge yēgēra uwo mu nzu yo hafi, ngw amwambike ubusa: nd’ Uhoraho.
Ntihaze hagire uwambika ubusa nyina, ni kwo kwambika ubusa se: uwo ni nyina, ntaz’ amwambike ubusa.
Ntihaze hagire uwambika ubusa muka se; kukw ar’ ubgambure bga se.
Ntihaze hagire uwambika ubusa mushiki we, ar’ uwo basangiye se canke nyina, ar’ uwo bavukana cank’ ar’ umuzanano: ntihaze hagire ūmwambika ubusa.
Ntihaze hagire uwambika ubusa umwuzukuru wo ku muhungu wiwe canke wo ku mukobga, kuk’ ubgambure bgabo ari bgo bgiwe.
Ntihaze hagire uwambika ubusa umukobga wa muka se, basangiye se: uwo ni mushikiwe, ntaz’ amwambike ubusa.
Ntihaze hagire uwambika ubusa inasenge, kukw avukana na se.
Ntihaze hagire uwambika ubusa nyinabo, kukw avukana na nyina.
Ntihaze hagire uwambika ubusa se wabo, ngo yegere umugore wiwe, kukw ari nka nyina.
Ntihaze hagire uwambika ubusa umukazana wiwe: uwo n’umugore w’ umuhungu wiwe, ntihaze hagire ūmwambika ubusa.
Ntihaze hagire uwambika ubusa muramu we: kuk’ ubgambure bgiwe ar’ ubg’ uwo bavukana.

Ntihaze hagire uwambika ubusa umugore n’umukobga wiwe, canke ngo yābīre umwuzukuru wo ku muhungu w’uwo mugore, cank’ uwo ku mukobga wiwe, ngw amwambike ubusa: kukw ar’ abo mu nda yiwe; ico n’icaha gikomeye.
Ntihaze hagire ūharika umugore uwo bavukana, ngw abe umukēba wiwe, ngw amwambike ubusa uwo bavukana akiriho.
Ntihaze hagire uwegera umugore ngw amwambike ubusa, akiri mu muhango wiwe.
Ntihaze hagire ūsambana na muka mugenzi we, ngo yiyanduze kubgiwe.
Kandi ntihaze hagire ūtanga uwo mu bana biwe ngo yoserezwe Moleki kw ikimazi, ngw atukishe izina ryanje, Imana yiwe: nd’ Uhoraho.
Ntihaze hagire umugabo yenda uwundi mugabo bga mugore: n’ikizira.

Ntihaze hagire ūryamana n’igitungano ic’ ari co cose, ngw aciyandurishe; kandi ntihaze hagire umugore cank’ umukobga ahagarara imbere y’igitungano ngw aryamane na co: ivyo vyoba ar’ukuvanga ibidahwanye.
Ntimuze mugire ico mwiyandurisha na kimwe mur’ ivyo vyose; kukw ivyo vyose ari vyo vyanduje amahanga ngira nze nirukane imbere yanyu,
bikanduza n’igihugu cabo; ni co gituma ngira ngihōre ibigabitanyo vyaco, ico gihugu kikahava kidahwa abakibamwo.
Nuko rero mweho muze mwitondere amabgirizwa yanje n’ivyagezwe vyanje, ntimuze mugire ikizira na kimwe co mur’ ivyo mukora, naho yoba imvukira, cank’ umunyamahanga aba muri mwebge.
Kukw ivyo bizira vyose ben’ ico gihugu babatanguriye kuhaba ari vyo bakoze, bikanduza ico gihugu.
Ntimuze mubikore, ngw ico gihugu kibadahwe namwe, ni mwacanduza, nk’uko cadashwe rya hanga ryabatanguriye kuhaba.
Kuk’ umuntu wese azogira ico akora na kimwe mur’ ivyo vyose bizira, abazobikora bose bazorandurwa bakūrwe mu bgoko bgabo.
Ni co gituma mukwiye kwitondera ivyo mbihanikirije, kugira ngo ntimuze mugire n’umwe mur’ iyo migenzo izira mukora, yakorwa n’ababatanguriye kuhaba, ngo muyiyandurishe: nd’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
ati Barira ikoraniro ry’Abisirayeli ryose, uti Mube abera, kuk’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu na we ar’ uwera.
Umuntu wese muri mwebge aze yubahe nyina na se, kandi muze mwitondere amasabato yanje: ni jewe Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ntimuze muhindukirire ibigirwamana, canke ngo mwironderere ibigirwamana mu bivugutiwe mu nkero: ni jewe Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ni mwanshikanira ikimazi c’ishimwe, muze mugishikane uburyo butuma mwemerwa.
Umusi mugitanzeko abe ari wo kirīrwako nyene, bo na bukeye bgaho; ariko ni hagira ikizoshitsa ku musi ugira gatatu, kize giturirwe.
Kandi ni caribgako na gatoya ku musi ugira gatatu, kizoba ar’ ikizira: ntikizokwemerwa;
kand’ ūkiriyeko wese azogībgako n’ibigabitanyo vyiwe, kukw aba atukishije icera canje: uwo muntu az’ acibge mu bgoko bgabo.
Kandi ni mwimbura ivyimburwa vyo mu gihugu canyu, ntimuze muherengeteze rwose kwimbura ivyo ku mibari y’imirima yanyu, kandi ntimuze muhumbe uduhumbga twose iyo muriko murashwābūra.
Ntimuze muhumbe mu mirima y’imizabibu yanyu, canke ngo mutore izahungurukiyeyo: muze mubisigarize aboro n’abanyamahanga: ni jewe Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ntimuze mwibe, ntimuze mugunge, canke ngo mubeshane.
Ntimuze murahire ibinyoma izina ryanje, bigatuma mutukisha izina ryanje, Imana yanyu: ni jewe Uhoraho.
Ntihaze hagire ūhahaza mugenzi we, canke ngw amwambure; ntihaze hagire ūrārana ingero umucangero yakoreye.
Ntihaze hagire ūvuma igipfamatwi, canke ngo hagire ūshira imbere y’impumyi ikintu comutsitaza: ariko mugende mutinya jewe Imana yanyu: ni jewe Uhoraho.
Ntimuze mucishe urubanza aho rutari; ntimuze muce urwa nkunzi mubitewe no kugirira impuhwe umworo, canke no gutinya ūhambaye; ariko muze mucire bagenzi banyu imanza ziroranye.
Ntihaze hagire ūgendagendeshwa no guteranya abantu, kandi ntihaze hagire uwitangakw icabona c’ ibinyoma co kwicisha mugenzi we: ni jewe Uhoraho.
Ntihaze hagire uwamanira akazīka uw’i wabo mu mutima wiwe; ariko ntaz’ abure kumuhanūra, kugira ngo ntibimukwegere icaha kubg’ uwo.
Ntihaze hagire uwihōra, cank’ ūbīkira inzigo abo mu bgoko bgabo; ariko mukunde bagenzi banyu nk’uko mwikunda: ni jewe Uhoraho.

Muze mwitondere ivyagezwe vyanje. Ntihaze hagire ūbangurira ivy’ atunze ivyo bidahwanije ubgoko; canke ngo hagire ūsukiranya imbuto z’imiryango ibiri mu ndimiro yiwe; canke ngo hagire uwambara impuzu ijishwe mu nyuzi z’ubgoko bubiri.
Umuntu ni yasambana n’ umuguranokazi ataribgacungurwe ngw aronke umwidegemvyo, kandi yar’ asabge n’uwundi; baze bahanwe, ariko ntibaze babice, kuk’ uwo atari n’umwidegemvyo.
Uwo mugabo azane ikimazi ciwe c’impongano, akinzanire ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro; ico kimazi kibe impfizi y’intama.
Umuherezi aheze amuhongere iyo mpfizi y’intama y’ikimazi c’impongano c’icaha ciwe yakoze, ayitangire imbere yanje; na we azoharirwa ico caha yakoze.
Kandi ni mwinjira ca gihugu, mugatera ibiti vy’ubgoko bgose vyama ibiribga, muze mubanze mwite ivyamye kuri vyo nk’ibizira; bize bimare imyaka itatu kuri mwebge ar’ ibizira; ntibize birībgeko.
Ariko mu mwaka ugira kane, ivyamye kuri vyo vyose bizoba ivyera vyo kunshimisha, jewe Uhoraho.
Maze mu mwaka ugira gatanu abe ari ho mutangura kurya ku vyamye kuri vyo, kugira ngo birushirize kubāmira: ni jewe Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ntimuze mugire ikintu murya kikirimw’ amaraso yaco: ntimuze mutere amabara, canke ngo mupfumuze.
Ntimuze mukebēre umushatsi wo mu misaya, canke ngo mucācūre imitwe y’ubganwa bganyu.
Ntimuze mwikebagure ku mibiri kubg’ ūpfuye; kandi ntimuze mwicishe imanzi n’imwe: ni jewe Uhoraho.
Ntihaze hagire uwononesha umukobga wiwe kumutanga kuba maraya, kugira ngw igihugu coye kwisuka mu busambanyi, kikuzura ubushakanyi.
Muze mwitondere amasabato yanje, mwubahe Ahēra hanje: ni jewe Uhoraho.
Ntimuze muhindukirire abahamagara imizimu cank’ abamenyi: ntimuze muje kubabaza, bagahava babahumanya: ni jewe Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Umuntu wese muri mwebge az’ avire hasi ūmaze kuyenzura imvi, yubahe umutāma, antinye, jewe Imana yiwe: ni jewe Uhoraho.
Umunyamahanga ni yaza mu gihugu canyu, akabana namwe, ntimuze mumugirire nabi.
Umunyamahanga aba muri mwebge muze mumugirire nk’imvukira, mumukunde nk’ uko mwikunda: kuko namwe mwar’ abanyamahanga mu gihugu ca Egiputa: ni jewe Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ntimuze mugoreke imanza, mu gusuzuma ivyo kugeresha metero, cank’ ikilo, cank’ ingero.
Arikw iminzane y’ukuri, n’ibilo vy’ukuri, n’ingero yitwa efa y’ukuri, n’ ingero yitwa hini y’ukuri, bize bibe ari vyo mukoresha: ni jewe Uhoraho Imana yanyu, nabakūye mu gihugu ca Egiputa.
Nuko muze mwitondere amabgirizwa yanje yose, n’ivyagezwe vyanje vyose, mubishitse: ni jewe Uhoraho.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,

ati Barira Abisirayeli, uti Ni hagira umuntu uw’ari we wese, ar’ uwo muri mwebge Abisirayeli canke w’umunyamahanga aba muri mwebge, azoshikanira Moleki uwo mu bana biwe, ntaz’ abure kwicwa; abo mur’ ico gihugu baze bamwicishe amabuye.
Nanje nzohoza igitsūre kur’ uwo muntu, ndamurandure mu bgoko bgabo, ndamuhōye gushikanira Moleki uwo mu bana biwe, akanduza Ahēra hanje, agatukisha izina ryanje ryera.
Arikw abantu bo mur’ ico gihugu ni birengagiza uwo muntu yashikaniye Moleki uwo mu bana biwe, ntibamwice;
jewe ubganje nzohoza igitsūre kur’ uwo muntu, no ku muryango wiwe, ndabarandurane mu bgoko bgabo n’abābīgānye mur’ ubgo bumaka bgo guhurumbira Moleki.
Umuntu yirukira abahamagara imizimu n’abamenyi, akaja kubaraguza, akabahurumbira nk’ ikimaka; nzohoza igitsūre canje kuri we, ndamurandure mu bgoko bgabo.
Nuko mwiyeze, mube abera, kuko nd’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Kandi muze mwitondere amabgirizwa yanje, muyashitse: jewe Uhoraho ni jewe mbeza.
Umuntu wese azovuma se canke nyina ntaz’ abure kwicwa: kw azoba avumye se canke nyina, amaraso yiwe ni we azokora.
Umuntu ni yasambana n’ umugore w’uwundi, agasambana na muka mugenzi we, uwo musambanyi n’uwo musambanyikazi ntibaze babure kwicwa.
Ūryamanye na muka se aba yambitse se ubusa: bompi ntibaze babure kwicwa: amaraso yabo ni bo azokora.
Umuntu ni yaryamana n’umukazana wiwe, bompi ntibaze babure kwicwa: bazoba bavanze ibidahwanye: amaraso yabo ni bo azokora.
Umugabo yenze uwundi mugabo bga mugore, bompi bazoba bakoze ikizira: ntibaze babure kwicwa: amaraso yabo ni bo azokora.
Umuntu ni yābīra umukobga na nyina, kizoba icaha gikomeye: az’ atabge mu muriro, ubgiwe na bo; kugira ngo ntihaze hagire icaha gikomeye kiba muri mwebge.
Umuntu ni yaryamana n’igitungano, ntaz’ abure kwicwa; na nya gitungano na co mucice.
Kand’ umugore cank’ umukobga ni yegera igitungano, akaryamana na co, muze mumwicane na co: ntibize bibure kwicwa: amaraso yavyo ni vyo azokora.

Umuntu ni yenda mushiki we, basangiye se canke nyina, bakarābana ubgambure, kizoba ar’ igihemu giteye isoni: baze barandurirwe mu maso y’ab’ ubgoko bgabo: uyo, kw azoba yambitse ubusa mushiki we, azogībgako n’ukugabitanya kwiwe.
Umuntu ni yaryamana n’umugore akiri mu muhango wiwe, akamwambika ubusa, azoba yambitse ubusa isōko yiwe, na wa mugore azoba atwikuruye iyo sōko y’amaraso yiwe: bompi baze barandurwe mu bgoko bgabo.
Kandi ntihaze hagire uwambika ubusa nyinabo canke inasenge: ūzokora artyo azoba yambitse ubusa bene wabo: bazogībgako n’ukugabitanya kwabo.
Umuntu ni yaryamana na muka se wabo, azoba yambitse ubusa se wabo: bazogībgako n’icaha cabo: bazopfa ar’ imponnyi.
Umuntu ni yacikiza muka mwene nyina, bizoba ar’ ukwiyanduza: azoba yambitse ubusa mwene nyina; bazoba imponnyi.
Nuko rero muze mwitondere amabgirizwa yanje yose n’ivyagezwe vyanje vyose, muvyumvire: kugira ngw igihugu mbajanyemwo ngo muhabe, ntikize kihave kibadahwa.
Ntimuze mugendere mu migenzo y’ihanga ngira nze nirukane imbere yanyu: kukw ivyo vyose ari vyo bākora, bigatuma mbanka urunuka.
Ariko mwebge narababgiye, nti Ni mwebge muzokwegukira igihugu cabo, kandi nzokibaha, kibe icanyu, ico gihugu gitemba amata n’ubūki: ni jewe Uhoraho Imana yanyu, nabatandukanije n’ayandi mahanga.

Ni co gituma mukwiye gutandukanya ibihumanya n’ibidahumanya mu bitungano no mu bikōko, n’ibihumanya n’ibidahumanya mu bisīga no mu nyoni: ntimuze mwiyandurishe igitungano cank’ igikōko, cank’ igisīga cank’ inyoni, cank’ icikwega hasi ic’ ari co cose, ari vyo nasobanuye mu bindi ngo mumenye ko bihumanya.
Kandi muze mumbere abera, kuko jewe Uhoraho nd’ uwera, kandi nabatandukanije n’ayandi mahanga ngo mube abanje.
Umugabo cank’ umugore bahamagara imizimu, canke bakaba abamenyi, ntibaze babure kwicwa: baze babicishe amabuye; amaraso yabo ni bo azokora.
Uhoraho abarira Mose, ati Barira abaherezi bene Aroni, uti Ntihaze hagire umuherezi yiyandurisha ūpfuye wo mu bgoko bgabo;
shit’ uwo mu muryango wo hafi, nyina, canke se, cank’ umuhungu wiwe, cank’ umukobga wiwe, canke mukuru we, canke murumuna we,
canke mushiki we akir’ imvyiruke, akimuzeyeko vyose, kukw atararongorwa: uwo we biremerwa ko yomwanduza.
Kw ar’ umukuru mw ihanga ryabo, ntaze yiyanduze ngo yiyonone.
Abaherezi ntibaze bimoshe inkomvorera, canke ngo bacācūre imitwe y’ubganwa bgabo, canke ngo bikebagure ku mibiri.

Baze bambere abera, jewe Imana yabo, ntibatukishe izina ryanje, Imana yabo; kukw ari bo bampēreza ibimazi, jewe Uhoraho, bitōngōrwa n’umuriro, ari zo mfungurwa zanje, Imana yabo: ni co gituma bakwiye kuba abera.
Ntihaze hagire uwābira maraya muri bo, cank’ uwamaze kwononekara, kandi ntihagire uwābīra uwirukanywe n’umugabo wiwe: kuk’ umuherezi ar’ uwera kuri jewe, Imana yiwe.
Ni co gituma mukwiye kumwita uwera, kukw ari we ampēreza imfungurwa, jewe Imana yanyu: az’ ababere uwera, kuko jewe Uhoraho, mbeza, nd’ uwera.
Kand’ umukobga w’umuherezi wese ni yiyononesha gusambana, azoba yambitse ibara se: az’ atabge mu muriro.

Umuherezi abaye mukuru muri bagenzi biwe, yasutswe amavuta mu mutwe yo kumurobanura, akaba yashikirijwe ibango ngo yambare ya myambaro, ntaz’ ahamburure umushatsi wiwe, canke ngo yitantamurirekw impuzu ziwe agandaye;
ntaze yinjirire ku muvyimba n’umwe, canke ngw awiyandurishe, n’iyo woba uwa se cank’ uwa nyina;
canke ngo binamusohokane ngw ave Ahēra, canke ngw ahumanye Ahēra hanje Imana yiwe; kukw ibango yaheshejwe no kurobanuzwa amavuta yanje Imana yiwe riri kuri we: ni jewe Uhoraho.
Kand’ uwo azokwābīra az’ abe inkumi yirongoreye.
Arik’ umupfakazi, cank’ uwirukanywe, cank’ uwamaze kwononekara, canke maraya, ntaz’ agire uwo yābīra muri bo, atar’ inkumi yirongoreye yo mu bgoko bgabo,
kugira ngo ntaz’ atume uruvyaro rwiwe ruhinduka uruhumanye mu bgoko bgabo: kukw ari jewe Uhoraho ndamweza.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
ati Barira Aroni, ut’ Umuntu wese azoba afise agasembga wo mu ruvyaro rwawe, ukw ibihe vy’ urunganwe rwanyu bizogenda bikurikirana, ntaze yēgēre ngw ampēreze imfungurwa, jewe Imana yiwe.
Umuntu wese afise agasembga ntaz’ anyīgire hafi: ar’ impumyi, ar’ ūcumbagira, ar’ ūfise izuru rihomberanye, ar’ ūfise urugingo rurutana n’urundi,
ar’ ūvunitse ikirenge cank’ igikonjo,
ar’ ūfise inyonzo, ar’ uwabaye impfunya, ar’ ūfise agasembga ku jisho, ar’ ūfise amahere cank’ urukemba, ar’ ūmenetse amavya;

ntihaze hagire umuntu n’umwe wo mu ruvyaro rwa Aroni azokwigera yīgira hafi afise agasembga, ngw ahēreze ibimazi vyanje, jewe Uhoraho, bitōngōrwa n’umuriro: kw azoba arikw agasembga, ntaze yigire hafi ngw ahēreze imfungurwa zanje, jewe Imana yiwe.
Ashobora kurya ku mfungurwa zanje, Imana yiwe, ari ku zera cane, canke ku zera zindi.
Mugabo ntaze yēgēre ca gihuzu gikingīra Ahēra cane, canke ngo yēgēre igicaniro, kukw azoba afise agasembga, kugira ngo yoye guhumanya ahēra hanje ah’ ari ho hose: kukw ari jewe Uhoraho ndabeza.
Nukw ivyo vyose Mose abibarira Aroni n’abana biwe n’Abisirayeli bose.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
ati Barira Aroni n’abana biwe baze bitonde mu kwēgēra ivyejejwe Abisirayeli banshikanira, boye gutukisha izina ryanje ryera: nd’ Uhoraho.

Ubabarire yuk’ umuntu wese wo mu ruvyaro rwabo azokwēgēra ivyejejwe Abisirayeli banshikaniye, ahumanye, uk’ urunganwe rwabo ruzogenda rukurikirana, uwo muntu az’ arandurwe, akūrwe imbere yanje: nd’ Uhoraho.

Umuntu wese wo mu ruvyaro rwa Aroni yabaye umunyamibembe cank’ afise igisokoro, ntaz’ arye ku vyera gushitsa ahumanutse. Kand’ ūzokora ku kintu ic’ ari co cose cahumanijwe no gukora ku muvyimba, canke ku mugabo intanga zavuyemwo;
cank’ ūzokora ku kanyonyera ak’ ari ko kose, ar’ akomuhumanya, canke ku muntu, ar’ uwomuhumanisha ubuhumane ubg’ ari bgo bgose;
ūzokora ku bimeze birtyo azoba ahumanye arinde ashitsa ku mugoroba; ntaz’ arye kur’ ivyo vyejejwe, shit’ abanje kwiyuhagira.
Izuba ni ryamara kurenga azoba ahumanutse; ni h’azobona kurya ku vyejejwe, kukw ivyo ari vyo vyar’ indya ziwe.
Icipfiriye cank’ ikirangara, ntaz’ agire ico arya muri vyo ngw acihumanishe: nd’ Uhoraho.
Ni co gituma bakwiye kwitondera ibgirizwa ryanje, boye kwikwēgera icaha kubgaryo, rikabicisha, kuko bazoba bahumanije ivyejejwe: kukw ari jewe Uhoraho ndabeza.
Ntihaze hagire ūtar’ uwo mu baherezi arya ku kintu cejejwe; umushitsi arāriye umuherezi, cank’ umucangero, ntaz’ arye ku kintu cejejwe.
Umuherezi ni yaramuka yaraguze umuntu, akaba uwo yiguriye amahera yiwe, uyo we azobiryako; n’abavukiye mu rugo rwiwe na bo bazorya ku vyo kurya vyiwe.
Umukobga w’ umuherezi ni yābīrwa n’ūtar’ uwo mu baherezi ntaz’ arye ku vyejejwe vyashikanywe.

Arik’ umukobga w’umuherezi apfakaye canke yirukanywe, atagira umwana, akaba igisubiramuhira mu rugo kwa se, akamera nk’uko yahoze mu bgana bgiwe, we azorya ku vyo kurya vya se: arik’ ūtar’ uwo mu baherezi ntaz’ abiryeko.
Umuntu ni yaramuka ariye ku kintu cejejwe atabizi, az’ akirihe, asubize umuherezi ikingana n’ico kintu cejejwe yariye, akigerekeko n’ikingana n’ikigira gatanu caco.
Kand’ abaherezi ntibaze bahumanye ivyejejwe Abisirayeli banshikaniye,
bigatuma babacumuza, bikabazanira gutsindwa, iyo hagize abarya ku vyejejwe vyabo: kukw ari jewe Uhoraho ndabeza.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,

ati Barira Aroni n’abana biwe, n’Abisirayeli bose, yuk’ umuntu wese wo mu b’inzu ya Isirayeli, canke wo mu banyamahanga baba muri bo, azoha jewe Uhoraho ikimazi co kwoswa, ar’ ico gushitsa isezerano ryiwe, ar’ ico atanze avyigombeye,
az’ atange ishuri cank’ isuguru y’intama cank’ iy’ impene, kugira ngw abone kwemerwa.
Arikw igifise agasembga cose ntimuze mugitange, kuko kitazokwemerwa ko mushikanye.

Umuntu wese azotanga ikimazi c’ishimwe, akakimpa jewe Uhoraho ngw ashitse isezerano ryiwe, canke kikaba ico atanze avyigombeye, ar’ ico akūye mu busho canke mu mukuku, kize kibe ciza kugira ngo cemerwe: ntihaze hagire agasembga kibonekako.

Ntihaze hagire impumyi, cank’ ikivunitse, cank’ icakomerekejwe, cank’ igifise igisebe, cank’ ikirwaye umwirye, cank’ ubushita, muzonshikanira muri ben’ ivyo, canke ngo mugitange kw ishikanwa munshikaniye jewe Uhoraho, ngo gitōngōrwe n’umuriro ku gicaniro.

Ishuri cank’ umwana w’intama, hagize igifise urugingo rutareha n’izindi, umuntu aremererwa kugitanga kw ishikanwa ashikanye avyigombeye; ariko nticokwemerwa kuba ishikanwa ryo gushitsa isezerano yasezeranye.
Igifise amavya yahomberanye canke yamenetse canke yajanjaguritse canke yashahuwe, ntimuze mukinshikanire, jewe Uhoraho; ntimuze mugenze murtyo mu gihugu canyu.
N’iyo coba kizanywe n’umunyamahanga, ntimuze mwemere ikimeze girtyo na kimwe, ngo mukinshikanire kw imfungurwa, jewe Imana yanyu; ntikizokwemerwa ko mushikanye, kuko gitosekaye, kikabakw agasembga.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,

at’ Ishuri ni yavuka, cank’ umwagazi w’intama canke w’impene, iz’ imarane na nyina imisi ndwi; uhereye umusi ugira umunani yoshobora kwemerwa kuba ikimazi nshikanirwa jewe Uhoraho, gitōngōrwa n’umuriro.
Kand’ inka cank’ intama, ntimuze muzibāgane n’izazo ku musi umwe.
Kandi ni mwampa ikimazi co gukenguruka, mugitange uburyo butuma mwemerwa.
Kize kiribge kur’ uwo musi nyene mugitanzeko; ntihaze hagire ico musigaza ngo kirāre: ni jewe Uhoraho.
Nuko muze mwitondere ivyagezwe vyanje, mubishitse: ni jewe Uhoraho.
Ntimuze mutukishe izina ryanje ryera, ariko nze name mboneka nd’Uwera hagati mu Bisirayeli: ni jewe Uhoraho ndabeza,
nabakūye mu gihugu ca Egiputa, ngo mbe Imana yanyu: ni jewe Uhoraho.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
ati Barira Abisirayeli, ut’ Iyi ni yo misi mikuru yiwe ishinzwe mukwiye kuzotāngāza kw ar’ iyo gukorana kwera; imisi mikuru yiwe ishinzwe n’iyi:

mu misi itandatu abe ari ho ibikorwa bikorerwa, arik’ ūgira indwi n’ isabato yo kuruhuka bihebuje, n’ikoraniro ryera; ntimuze mugire igikorwa na kimwe muwukorako; n’isabato yanje Uhoraho, yo kwitonderwa mu ngo zanyu zose.
Iyi ni yo misi mikuru yanje Uhoraho ishinzwe yo gukorana kwera, mukwiye kuzotāngāza igihe cayo kigeze:
mu kwezi kwa mbere, ku musi wakwo w’icumi na kane ku mugoroba, haze hame haba Pasika yanje Uhoraho.
Ku musi w’icumi na gatanu w’ukwo kwezi nyene, ni ho hazoba umusi mukuru wo kunyubaha w’imitsima itambiwe: muze mumare imisi ndwi ari yo murya.
Ku musi w’intangamarāra wayo muze mukoranywe no kuba ikoraniro ryera: ntihaze hagire igikorwa kiruhisha muwukorako.
Mur’ iyo misi ukw ar’ indwi, uko bukeye muze munshikanire ibimazi bitōngōrwa n’umuriro: umusi ugira indwi uz’ ube uwo gukorana kwera, ntihaze hagire igikorwa kiruhisha muwukorako.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
ati Barira Abisirayeli, uti Ni mwashika mu gihugu nzobaha, mukimbura ivyimburo vyaho, muze mwame mushīra umuherezi umukama wo ku vyimburwa vyanyu vy’umushuzo:
na we awuzungurize imbere yanje, kugira ng’ ubabere ishikanwa ryemerwa: ku musi ukurikira isabato abe ari wo umuherezi awuzunguzako.
Ku musi muwujungujeko muze munshikanire n’isuguru y’intama itaramara umwaka kw ikimazi co kwoswa.

Kand’ ishikanwa ry’ ivyakozwe mw ifu ritanganwa na co rize ribe ibigiracumi bibiri vy’ingero y’ifu igogōretse, ivanze n’amavuta ya elayo; ribe ishikanwa nshikaniwe jewe Uhoraho ritōngōrwa n’umuriro, umubabge umota neza. Kand’ ishikanwa ry’ibiturire ritanganwa na co nyene rize ribe ikigirakane c’ingero yitwa hini ya vino.

Kandi ntimuze mugire umutsima w’iyo fu murya, cank’ impeke muhekenya, ar’ izikaranze canke mbisi, uwo musi utarashika, ngo muzane iryo shikanwa ryanje Imana yanyu: iryo rize ribabere ibgirizwa ry’intahava mu ngo zanyu zose, no ku runganwe rwanyu, uko ruzogenda rukurikirana.
Kandi muze muharūre imisi, muhereye kur’ uwo musi nyene ukurikira isabato, ari wo musi mwazaniyeko umukama w’ishikanwa ryo kuzunguzwa, habe amasabato ndwi yiramvuriye.
Muharūre, murumye imisi mirongwitanu, irume ku musi ukurikira isabato igira indwi; muheze munshikanire ishikanwa, jewe Uhoraho, ry’ivyakozwe mw ifu y’ ivyakurikiyeko.

Mu ngo zanyu muze mukūremw’ imitsima ibiri yo kuba ishikanwa ryo kuzunguzwa; ibe ivy’ ibigiracumi bibiri vy’ingero yitwa efa y’ifu; iyo fu ibe igogōretse, icumbanywe n’ umwambiro, ngw ibe ishikanwa ryo ku vyimburwa vy’umushuzo mpabga jewe Uhoraho.

Kandi hamwe n’iyo mitsima mushikane abana b’intama ndwi batagira agasembga, batarengeje umwaka, bo n’imasa y’umukangara, n’impfizi z’intama zibiri; bibe ikimazi coswa nshikaniwe jewe Uhoraho, bizananwe n’ishikanwa ry’ivyakozwe mw ifu, n’iry’ ibiturire, bibe ikimazi gitōngōrwa n’umuriro, umubabge ummotera neza.
Mutange n’isuguru y’impene kw ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha, n’amasuguru abiri y’intama atarengeje umwaka, kw ikimazi c’ishimwe.
Umuherezi abizunguzanye na ya mitsima yo ku vyimburwa vy’umushuzo, bo na ba bana b’intama bompi, bibe ishikanwa rizungurijwe imbere yanje: bibe ivyera kuri jewe, bihabge umuherezi.

Kur’ uwo musi nyene muze mutāngāze kw ar’ umusi mukuru: muze muwugire uwo gukorana kwera; ntihaze hagire igikorwa kiruhisha muwukorako: iryo rize ribabere ibgirizwa ry’ intahava mu ngo zanyu zose no ku runganwe rwanyu, uko ruzogenda rukurikirana.

Kandi ni mwimbura ivyimburwa vyo mu gihugu canyu, ntimuze muherengeteze rwose gushwābūra ivyo ku mibari y’imirima yanyu, kandi ntimuze muhumbe uduhumbga tw’ivyo mwimbuye: muze mubisigarize aboro n’abanyamahanga: nd’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
ati Barira Abisirayeli, uti Mu kwezi kw’indwi, umusi wakwo wa mbere uz’ ubabere umusi wo kuruhuka bihebuje, ube uwo kubibutsa, muwutāngāze mu kuvuza inzamba, ube uwo gukorana kwera.
Ntihaze hagire igikorwa kiruhisha muwukorako, kandi muze muwunshikanirekw ikimazi gitōngōrwa n’umuriro.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
at’ Umusi ugira icumi w’ukwo kwezi nye ne kw’indwi ni wo musi w’impongano: uz’ ubabere uwo gukorana kwera, muze mwame mwibabaza, kandi muze muwunshikanirekw ikimazi gitōngōrwa n’umuriro.
Ntimuze mugire igikorwa na kimwe mukora kur’ uwo musi, kukw ar’ umusi w’ impongano, aho muzotangirwa impongano imbere yanje, jewe Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Kandi ni hagira umuntu atazokwibabaza kur’ uwo musi, az’ acibge mu bgoko bgabo.
Kandi ni hagira ūzogira igikorwa na kimwe akora kur’ uwo musi, uwo muntu nzomurandura mu bgoko bgabo.
Ntimuze mugire igikorwa na kimwe mukora: iryo rize ribabere ibgirizwa ry’intahava mu ngo zanyu zose, no ku runganwe rwanyu, uko ruzogenda rukurikirana.
Uwo musi uz’ ubabere isabato yo kuruhuka bihebuje, muze muwibabazeko; muze mwitondere iyo sabato yanyu, muhereye ku mugoroba w’umusi ugira icenda w’ukwo kwezi, mushitse ku mugoroba wundi.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
ati Barira Abisirayeli, uti Ku musi ugira icumi na gatanu w’ukwo kwezi kw’indwi nyene, ni ho hazoba umusi mukuru wo kunyubaha w’insago: iz’ ibe imisi mikuru gushitsa indwi.
Ku musi w’intangamarāra muze mukoranywe no kuba ikoraniro ryera: ntihaze hagire igikorwa kiruhisha muwukorako.

Mur’ iyo misi ukw ar’ indwi, uko bukeye muze munshikanire ibimazi bitōngōrwa n’umuriro; umusi ugira umunani muze muwugire uwo gukorana kwera: muze muwunshikanirekw ikimazi gitōngōrwa n’umuriro: rize ribe ikoraniro ry’agahebūza; ntihaze hagire igikorwa kiruhisha muwukorako.

Iyo ni yo misi mikuru yanje jewe Uhoraho; mukwiye kuyitāngāza kw ar’ iyo gukorana kwera, no kuyinshikanirakw ibimazi vyo gutōngōrwa n’umuriro, vy’ivyo kwoswa, n’amashikanwa y’ivyakozwe mw ifu, n’ibimazi bindi, n’amashikanwa y’ibiturire, ibintu vyose ku musi wavyo, uko vyashinzwe;

kand’ ivyo ntibikwiye kubabuza kwitondera amasabato yanje, canke gushikana amashikanwa yanyu, canke gushikana ayo gushitsa amasezerano yose mwasezeranye, canke kunshikanira ivyo mutanze vyose muvyigombeye.

Nuko muhereye kur’ uwo musi ugira icumi na gatanu w’ ukwo kwezi kw’indwi, mumaze kwimbura ivyimburwa vyo mu gihugu, muze mugire imisi mikuru ndwi yo kunyubaha: ku musi w’intangamarāra wayo hazoba kuruhuka kwo kwitonderwa, no ku musi ugira umunani haze habe kuruhuka kwo kwitonderwa nyene.

Kandi kur’ uwo musi w’intangamarāra muze mwābīre ku vyiza‐vyiza vyamye ku biti, n’amashami y’ibigazi, n’amashami y’ibiti bitwaye intunda, n’ibiti vyameze i ruhande y’inzūzi; mumare imisi ndwi munezererewe imbere yanje, Uhoraho Imana yanyu.

Uk’ umwaka utashe, muze muhore mugira iyo misi mikuru ndwi yo kunyubaha: iryo rize ribabere ibgirizwa ry’intahava ukw ibihe vy’urunganwe rwanyu bizogenda bikurikirana: muze mugire iyo misi mikuru mu kwezi kw’indwi.
Muze mumare iyo misi ndwi muri mu nsago; Abisirayeli b’imvukira bose baze bayimare bari mu nsago;
kugira ngw ab’ urunganwe rwanyu, uko ruzogenda rukurikirana, bamenye yuko nabesheje Abisirayeli mu nsago, hamwe nabakūra mu gihugu ca Egiputa; nd’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Nuko Mose amenyesha Abisirayeli imisi mikuru y’Uhoraho ishinzwe iy’ ari yo.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
ati Barira Abisirayeli bakuzanire amavuta y’umwisengesure avuye muri elayo zisekuwe, ya ya matara, kugira ngo haze hame har’ itara ryaka.

Inyuma ya ca gihuzu gikingiriye vya Bishinga intahe, mw ihema ry’ibonaniro, az’ abe ari ho Aroni azokwama aritunganiriza, kugira ngo rize ryame ryaka imbere yanje, rihēre ku mugoroba rishitse mu gitondo ubudasība: iryo rize ribabere ibgirizwa ry’intahava ukw ibihe vy’urunganwe rwanyu bizogenda bikurikirana.
Aze yame atunganiriza ayo matara kur’ ico gitereko c’izahabu iramuye, kugira ngo yame yakira imbere yanje ubudasiba.
Kandi wābīre ifu igogōretse, uyicumbemw’ imitsima cumi n’ ibiri: mu bigiracumi bibiri vy’ ingero yitwa efa havemw’ umutsima umwe‐umwe.
Uyigire ibirundo bibiri kuri ya meza y’izahabu iramuye ar’ imbere yanje, mu kirundo kimwe habemw’ itandatu, mu kindi kuno.
Ku kirundo kimwe ugerekekw imibavu itunganye, ku kindi kuno, ibe icibutso kur’ iyo mitsima, ishikanwa nshikaniwe ryo gutōngōrwa n’umuriro.
Ukw isabato itashe, Aroni az’ ayitereke imbere yanje na ntaryo kubg’ Abisirayeli, bibe isezerano ritazoshira.
Kand’ iyo mitsima iz’ ibe iya Aroni n’abana biwe; baze bahore bayirīra ahantu hera, kukw ar’ umugabane wiwe wera cane w’intahava agerewe mu mashikanwa atōngōrwa n’umuriro nshikanirwa, jewe Uhoraho.
Umuhungu w’Umwisirayelikazi yavyaranye n’Umunyegiputa arasohoka, aja mu Bisirayeli; atonganira mu nsago n’umuntu w’ Umwisirayeli.
Uwo muhungu w’Umwisirayelikazi arogota kuri rya Zina, ararituka: bamuzanira Mose. Nyina yitwa Shelomiti, mwene Diburi, wo mu muryango wa Dani.
Baramwugarana kugeza igihe baja kubgirwa ivyo Uhoraho aribushinge.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
ati Jana uwatukanye inyuma y’aho mushagaje, abamwumvise bose aho yatukana bashire ibiganza vyabo ku mutwe wiwe: ikoraniro ryose rimwicishe amabuye.
Nawe ubarire Abisirayeli, yuk’ umuntu wese azontuka, jewe Imana yiwe, azogībgako n’icaha ciwe.
Kand’ ūzorogota kw izina ryanje, jewe Uhoraho, ntaz’ abure kwicwa: ikoraniro ryose rize rimwicishe amabuye: yaba umunyamahanga ari muri mwebge cank’ imvukira azorogota kw izina ryanje, aze yicwe.
Ūzokubita umuntu akamutsindaho, na we ntaz’ abure kwicwa;
ūzokubita igitunzwe, akacica, az’ akirihe: igifise ubugingo kirihwe ikindi.
Umuntu ni yatera agasembga uwundi, bamugirire nk’uko yamugiriye.
Imvune ihōrwe iyindi, n’ijisho rihōrwe irindi, n’iryinyo rihōrwe irindi: ukw azoba yateye uwundi agasembga, abe ari kw asubirizwa mu nkōko.
Ūzokwica igitunzwe akirihe; ūzokwica umuntu na we yicwe.
Muze mugire icagezwe kimwe ku munyamahanga ar’i wanyu no ku mvukira: kuko jewe nd’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Nuko Mose abarira Abisirayeli, bajana uwatukanye inyuma y’aho bashagaje, bamwicisha amabuye. Abisirayeli bakora nk’uk’ Uhoraho yabariye Mose.
Uhoraho abaririra Mose ku musozi Sinayi,
ati Barira Abisirayeli, yuko ni bashika mu gihugu nzobaha, ico gihugu kize kigire ikiruhuko nk’isabato co kunyubaha jewe Uhoraho.
Muze murime mu ndimiro zanyu imyaka itandatu, kandi mur’ iyo myaka itandatu abe ari yo mutūtūriramw’ imizabibu yanyu, mwamure inzabibu zayo.
Arik’ umwaka ugira indwi uz’ ubere igihugu nk’isabato yo kuruhuka bihebuje, nk’isabato yo kunyubaha jewe Uhoraho: ntimuze muwurimemwo mu ndimiro zanyu, ntimuze muwutūtūriremw’ imizabibu yanyu.
Ivyimeza bikurikiye ivyo mwimbuye ntimuze muvyimburire mu bigega, canke ngo mwimbure inzabibu zo ku mizabibu yanyu idatūtūriye: uwo mwaka uz’ ubere igihugu uwo kuruhuka bihebuje.

Mugabo, ivyo mu gihugu vyapfuye kwimeza mur’ ico gihe c’isabato yaco ni vyo bizoba ivyo kurya vyanyu, mwe n’abagurano banyu, n’abaguranokazi banyu, n’ abakozi banyu b’abacangero, n’ abanyamahanga baba muri mwebge;
kandi n’ibiragirano vyanyu n’ibikōko vyo mu gihugu canyu, ivyimeza vyaco vyose bizobibera ivyo kurya.
Iyo myaka yabaye nk’isabato, muharūre ayo masabato murumye ndwi, muyirumye imyaka ndwi ibihetangabo ndwi; ico gihe muzosanga harimw’ amasabato ndwi y’imyaka, ni yo myaka mirongwine n’icenda.
Maze ku musi ugira icumi w’ukwezi kw’indwi muze muvugishe inzamba y’ijwi rirenga; ku musi w’impongano az’ abe ari ho muvugisha inzamba mu gihugu canyu cose.

Muze murobanure uwo mwaka ugira mirongwitanu, mutāngāze mu gihugu cose ko habaye umwidegemvyo w’ abantu bose bo muri co: uwo mwaka uz’ ubabere uwa yubile; umuntu wese muri mwebge aheze agaruke mw itongo ryiwe, kand’ umuntu wese agaruke mu b’i wabo.
Uwo mwaka ugira mirongwitanu uze wame ubabera uwa yubile; ntimuze muwurimemwo, canke ngo mwimburire mu bigega ivyimejeje muri wo, canke ngo mwimbure inzabibu zo ku mizabibu itātūtūriye.
Kukw ar’ umwaka wa yubile; uze wame ubabera uwejejwe; muzotungwa n’ivyimeza vyo muri wo, vyimejeje mu ndimiro.
Mur’ uwo mwaka wa yubile umuntu wese muri mwebge az’ agaruke mw itongo ryiwe.
Kandi ni hagira ūgurira ikintu mugenzi we, cank’ akagira ico amuguzeko na we, ntimuze mugungane.
Ukw imyaka ingana, ikurikiye uwa yubile, az’ abe ari k’ūje kugura na mugenzi we atanga ibiguzi; na we az’ amucire nk’ukw imyaka y’ivyimburo ingana.
Uk’ umuntu azobona imyaka igisigaye ari myinshi, az’ abe ari kw adūza igiciro, kand’ ukw azobona ari mike, az’ abe ari kw akimanura; kukw agura arīmbūye igitigiri c’ivyimburo kigisigaye.
Nuko ntimuze mugungane, ariko muntinye, jewe Imana yanyu, kuko nd’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ni co gituma mukwiye kwumvira amabgirizwa yanje, no kwitondera ivyagezwe vyanje, mukavyumvira; ni ho muzoba mu gihugu amahoro.
Kand’ ico gihugu kizokwimbuka, muzokwama mu gahimbo, mube muri co amahoro.
Ariko ni mwavuga, muti Tuzotungwa n’iki mur’ uwo mwaka ugira indwi, ko tutazorima, ntitwimbure?
Mu mwaka ugira gatandatu nzobarungikira umugisha utuma haba uburumbuke bg’indya zizobatunga imyaka itatu.
Mu mwaka ugira umunani ni ho muzorima, kandi muzoba murya ibigugu vyahitikiranijwe; mbere muzoba murya ivyahitikiranijwe gushitsa mu mwaka ugira icenda, mu gihe c’iyimbura.
Amatongo ntaz’ agurwe herandaheze, kukw igihugu ar’ icanje, namwe kuri jewe mukaba akavantara n’ abatsi b’indāro.
Kandi mu gihugu cose c’ishamvu yanyu, uwahoze ari nyen’ itongo muze mwemere aricungure.
Uw’i wanyu ni yahinduka umugorwa, akagura kw itongo ryiwe, mwene wabo azoba ar’ uwo hafi az’ aze, acungure iryo tongo mwene wabo yaguze.
Arik’ umuntu ni yabura uwo kuricungura, akaba yarasubiye gutunga, akabona ibikwiranye na ryo vyo kuricungura,
az’ aharūre imyaka ryaguriwemwo, asubize uwariguze ibigisigaye ku giciro caryo, abone ukw asubira gushikīra itongo ryiwe.
Ariko n’atashobora kuricungura ubgiwe, iryo ryaguzwe rigumane uwariguze gushitsa ku mwaka wa yubile; maze rizokomōrwa n’uwo mwaka wa yubile, abone ukw asubira gushikīra itongo ryiwe.
Umuntu ni yagura inzu yiwe iri mu gisagara gikikijwe n’uruzitiro rw’amabuye, biremerwa kw ayicungura ata mwaka wose urashira; afise uburyo bgo kuyicungura ata mwaka wose urashira.

Ariko n’atayicungura uwo mwaka wose utarashira, iyo nzu iri mu gisagara gikikijwe n’uruzitiro izoba yegukiwe n’uwayiguze herandaheze, ukw ibihe vy’urunganwe rwabo bizogenda bikurikirana: ntizokomōrwa n’umwaka wa yubile.
Arikw inzu zo mu mihana idakikijwe n’uruzitiro rw’ amabuye, zize zibe kimwe n’ amatongo yo mu misozi, biremerwa ko zicungurwa: zizokomōrwa n’umwaka wa yubile.
Arikw ibisagara vy’Abalewi vyo si ko bimeze: inzu zo mu bisagara vy’amashamvu yabo, Abalewi biremerwa ko bazicungura aho baboneye uburyo.
Umwe mu Balewi n’adacungura inzu, iyo nzu yaguzwe yo mu gisagara c’ishamvu yabo iz’ ikomōrwe n’umwaka wa yubile: kukw amazu yo mu bisagara vy’Abalewi ar’ ishamvu yabo mu Bisirayeli.
Arikw ah’Abalewi baragira inyuma y’ ibisagara vyabo ntihaze hagurwe, kukw ar’ ishamvu yabo y’intahava.
Kand’ uw’i wanyu ni yahinduka umugorwa, mukabona afūtānye, mukwiye kumusanasana; mumufashe nk’uko mwofasha akavantara n’umugerērwa.
Ntihaze hagire ūmwaka inyungu cank’ ibirenze ku vyo yatwaye, arikw agende antinya jewe Imana yiwe; kugira ng’ uw’i wanyu abone ingen’ abana namwe.
Ntaz’ amuguranire amahera kuzohabga ay’inyungu, canke ngw amugurane ivyo kurya kugira ngw aguranurwe ibirenze.
Nd’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, nabakūye mu gihugu ca Egiputa ngo mbahe igihugu c’i Kanani, mbe Imana yanyu.
Kand’ uw’i wanyu ni yagorerwa mu maso yanyu, akagira uwo yibunzako ngw amugure, uwo ntaz’ amukoreshe nk’umugurano:
az’ abane na we nk’umukozi aca ingero canke nk’ umugerērwa; az’ amukorere gushitsa ku mwaka wa yubile.
Ni ho azobona kumuvako, bo n’abana biwe, asubire mu b’i wabo bgite, mw ishamvu ya ba sekuruza;
kukw ar’ abagurano banje nakūye mu gihugu ca Egiputa: ntibaze bagurwe ngo babe abagurano b’abandi.
Ntimuze mubatwaze igitugu, ariko mugende muntinya, jewe Imana yanyu.
Arikw abagurano banyu n’abaguranokazi muzogira, muze mubakūre mu mahanga abakikije, abe ari ho mubagura.
Kandi mu bagerērwa bababamwo, bo muremererwa kubaguramwo, bo no mu ruvyaro rwabo bavyariye mu gihugu canyu, abo bakazoba inyegu mwegukiye,
mukazobaraga n’abana banyu muzosiga, bakabegukira; mur’ abo ni ho mwemererwa gukūramw’ abagurano b’intahava; ariko muri bene wanyu b’Abisirayeli ntihaze habe gutwazanya igitugu.

Kand’ umunyamahanga cank’ umugerērwa ari muri mwebge ni yahinduka umutunzi, uw’i wanyu agahinduka umugorwa i ruhande yiwe, akibunza kur’ uwo munyamahanga canke kur’ uwo mugerērwa ari muri mwebge, canke ku wo mu b’i wabo wa ben’ uwo, ngw amugure,
amaze kugurwa ashobora gucungurwa: umwe muri bene wabo yomucungura,
canke se wabo, canke mwene se wabo, canke mwene wabo wo hafi uw’ ari we wese yomucungura; canke na we ubgiwe ahindutse umutunzi yokwicungura.

Aharūre imyaka hamwe n’uwo yamuguze, uhereye ku mwaka yamuguriyemwo gushitsa ku mwaka wa yubile: igiciro co kwicungura kize gihwane n’igitigiri c’iyo myaka; igihe yamaranye na we amukorera kize kirīmbūrwe nk’igihe umucangero agererwa yokoze.
Ni yaba imyaka izoba igisigaye ari myinshi, ukw izoba ingana abe ari kw ariha igiciro c’ivyo yaguzwe co kwicungura.
Ni yaba imyaka yo gushitsa kuri yubile izoba isigaye ari mike, ayirīmbūre hamwe na we ico imaze: ukw iyo myaka izoba ingana abe ari kw ariha igiciro co kwicungura.
Az’ abane na we nk’umucangero akorera ingero uk’ umwaka utashe; ntaz’ amutwaze igitugu mu maso yanyu.
Kandi ni hatagira ikimucungura mur’ ivyo, azomuvako mu mwaka wa yubile, bo n’abana biwe.
Kukw Abisirayeli ar’ abagurano banje niharije; n’abagurano banje nakūye mu gihugu ca Egiputa: ni jewe Uhoraho Imana yanyu.

Ntimuze mwironderere ibigirwamana, canke ngo mushinge igishushanyo, ar’ ikibāzano, ar’ inkingi y’ibuye, kandi ntimuze mugire ikibuye mushira mu gihugu canyu gikorogoshoyekw ibishushanyo co kwunamira: kuko nd’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Muze mwitondere amasabato yanje, mwubahe Ahēra hanje: ni jewe Uhoraho.
Ni mwahora mugendera mu mabgirizwa yanje, mukitondera ivyagezwe vyanje, mukavyumvira;
nuko nanje nzogenda mbarekurira imvura mu bihe vyayo, n’ igihugu kizogenda cimbuka ivyimburo vyaco, n’ibiti vyo mu ndimiro bizokwama bitengengere.
Igihe canyu c’isekura kizorinda gishitsa mw iyimbura ry’inzabibu, iryo yimbura na ryo ririnde rishitsa mw ibiba: muzokwama mu gahimbo, mwībēre mu gihugu canyu ata nkomanzi.
Kandi nzoha ico gihugu kugira impore, muzokwiryamira ata kibateye akōba: kandi nzohaherengeteza ibikōko vy’inkazi, kandi nta nkota izogera mu gihugu canyu.
Muzokinagiza abansi banyu, bahindikiranywe n’inkota imbere yanyu.
Batanu muri mwebge bazokinagiza ijana, n’ijana muri mwebge bazokinagiza ibihumbi cumi, abansi banyu bazohindikiranywa n’ inkota imbere yanyu.
Nzokwama mbashizek’ umutima, mbarōndōre, mbagwize, nkomeze isezerano ryanje namwe.
Muzorya ibigugu vyahitikiranye, kandi muzodaha ibihitira kugira ngo mubone aho mwimburira ivyeze.
Nzoshira ihema ryanje hagati muri mwebge, kandi sinzokwigera ndabazinukwa.
Nzogendera hagati muri mwebge, mbe Imana yanyu, namwe mube abantu banje.
Ni jewe Uhoraho Imana yanyu, nabakūye mu gihugu ca Egiputa, kugira ngo ntimube abagurano babo; navunnye ibiti vy’ingōgo vyababoshe, mbaha kugenda mwemye.
Ariko ni mutanyumvira, ntimwitondere ivyo vyagezwe vyose,
kandi ni mwagaya amabgirizwa yanje, mukazinukwa ivyo nashinze, bigatuma mutitondera ivyagezwe vyanje vyose, mukica isezerano ryanje;

nanje uko nzobagira n’uku: nzobagomorera ibibaca ivutu; kugenda mukōnyēra bo no kurwara inyonko bizotuma muhwera mu kajisho, imitima yanyu ihondobēre: muzorimira ubusa, kukw abansi banyu ari bo bazobirya.
Kandi nzohoza igitsūre canje kuri mwebge, muzoneshwa n’abansi banyu: ababanka ni bo bazobaganza; kandi muzohunga ata kibirukanye.
Ivyo ni bitātuma munyumvira, nanje nzokwongera kubahanira ivyaha vyanyu ibihetangabo ndwi.
Nzocobogoza ubushobozi bganyu mwihaya, mpindure ijuru ryo hejuru yanyu nk’icuma, n’isi yanyu nk’umuringa.
Amaboko yanyu azopfa ubusa, n’igihugu canyu ntikizoruha cera, kandi n’ibiti vyo muri co ngo bigire ico vyama.
Kandi ni mwashishikara kugenda munyuranya nanje, ntimunyumvire, nanje nzokwongera kubateza ivyago ibihetangabo ndwi bihwanye n’ivyaha vyanyu.
Kandi nzobatērēra ibikōko vyo mw ishamba, bitware abana banyu, biyigize amasho yanyu n’imikuku yanyu, bibatūvye, inzira zanyu zisibe.
Ivyo ni bitātuma mwihana ngo mumpindukirire, ariko mugashishikara kugenda munyuranya nanje,
nuko nanje nzogenda nnyuranya namwe, nzobakubita ibihetangabo ndwi jewe ubganje, mbahōra ivyaha vyanyu.
Kandi nzobatērēra inkota, ibahōre kuva mw isezerano ryanje; na ho ni mwirundaniriza mu bisagara vyanyu, nzobatērēra ikīza; kandi muzotangwa mu maboko y’abansi.
Ni navuna inkoni mwegamiye, ari yo vyo kurya vyanyu, abagore cumi bazoderenganiriza mu ziko rimwe, botsa udutsima, bazosigara babagaburira udutsima twa mugerwa: murye ututabahāgije.
Ivyo vyose ni bitātuma munyumvira, ariko mukagenda munyuranya nanje;
nuko nanje nzogenda nnyuranya namwe ndi n’uburake, kandi nzobahanira ivyaha vyanyu ibihetangabo ndwi.
Muzorya abahungu banyu n’ abakobga banyu.
Kandi nzokomvomvora ibitabo vyanyu vyo ku mpinga z’imisozi, nsiture ibishushanyo vyanyu vy’izuba, nshiburire imivyimba yanyu ku mirambararo y’ibigirwamana vyanyu; kandi nzobazinukwa mu mutima wanje.
Nzohindura ibisagara vyanyu imisaka, ahēra hanyu ntume hatamārirwa, kandi sinzomoterwa n’ugutamirana kw’ibimoga vyanyu munyosereza.
Nzotuma igihugu canyu gitamārirwa, bijoreze abansi banyu bakibamwo.
Namwe nzobashwiragiriza mu mahanga, nsokōre inkota, mbirukane; igihugu canyu kizosigara gitamāriwe, n’ibisagara vyanyu bicike imisaka.
Ico gihe igihugu kizobona uko gishumbushwa ya masabato yaco, ico gihe cose kikir’ amatongo, namwe mukiri mu gihugu c’ abansi banyu; aho ni ho igihugu kizoruhuka, gishumbushwe ya masabato yaco.
Igihe cose kikir’ amatongo kizoruhuka ukuruhuka kitigeze kuruhuka ku masabato yanyu mukikibamwo.
Amasigarira yo muri mwebge nzotuma barandukira imitima mu gihugu c’abansi babo: bazokangwa n’ ukwumva akababi gakakaje, bahunge nk’ūhunga inkota; bazotemba ata kibirukanye.
Bazogwanako nk’abahunga inkota, ata kibirukanye; mbere ntimuzoshobora guhagarara abansi banyu imbere.
Muzohonera mu mahanga, igihugu c’abansi banyu kizobaherengeteza.
Amasigarira yo muri mwebge bazogenda bashirira umunywera mu gihugu c’abansi banyu kubg’ ibigabitanyo vyabo; kandi n’ibigabitanyo vya ba sekuruza bizotuma bagenda bashira umunywera nka bo.
Ariko ni bātura ibigabitanyo vyabo n’ibigabitanyo vya ba sekuruza, ari vyo bihemu vyabo, bakemera yuko kunyuranya nanje kwabo

ari kwo kwatumye nanje nnyuranya na bo, nkabahindira mu gihugu c’abansi babo; kandi ni bicisha bugufi ico gihe mu mitima yabo imeze nk’imibiri itakebge, bakarīmbūka, bakemera yukw ibihano bāhanwe ar’ ivyazanywe n’ibigabitanyo vyabo;
ni ho nanje nzokwibuka isezerano ryanje nasezeraniye Yakobo, n’ iryo nasezeraniye Isaka, n’iryo nasezeraniye Aburahamu na ryo nzoryibuka; kandi n’igihugu na co nzocibuka.

Mber’ ico gihugu bazoba barakivuyemwo, gishumbushwe ya masabato yaco, gisigare ar’ imisaka batakikibamwo; na bo bazoba barīmbūtse, bemeye yukw ibihano bāhanwe ar’ ivyazanywe n’ibigabitanyo vyabo, kuko banse ivyagezwe vyanje, bakazinukwa amabgirizwa yanje.

Ariko naho bizomera birtyo, sinzobaheba, igihe bazoba bari mu gihugu c’abansi babo, kandi sinzobazinukwa, ngo ndabahenebereze rwose, mve mw isezerano ryanje nabasezeraniye: kuko nd’ Uhoraho Imana yabo.
Ariko kubgabo nzokwibuka isezerano nasezeraniye ba sekuruza, abo nakūye mu gihugu ca Egiputa amahanga arorēra, kugira ngo mbe Imana yabo: ni jewe Uhoraho.
Ayo ni yo mabgirizwa n’ ivyashinzwe n’ivyagezwe, ivyo Uhoraho yashize hagati yiwe n’ Abisirayeli, abigereye ku musozi Sinayi, abitumye Mose.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
ati Barira Abisirayeli, ut’ Umuntu ni yashitsa isezerano yansezeraniye jewe Uhoraho, riherereye ku citwa izinamuntu, uwo yasezeranywe az’ acunguzwe igiciro uzocira.
Umuhungu cank’ umugabo, uhereye k’ūmaze imyaka mirongwibiri gushitsa k’ūshikanye mirongwitandatu, uzoba ukwiye kumucira shekeli z’ifeza mirongwitanu, zagezwe kuri shekeli ir’ Ahēra.
Ni yaba umukobga cank’ umugore, uzoba ukwiye kumucira shekeli mirongwitatu.
Kand’ uhereye k’ūmaze imyaka itanu gushitsa k’ūshikanye mirongwibiri, ni yaba umuhungu uzoba ukwiye kumucira shekeli mirongwibiri, ni yaba umukobga, umucire icumi.
Kand’ uhereye k’ūmaze ukwezi kumwe gushitsa k’ūshikanye imyaka itanu, ni yaba umuhungu uzoba ukwiye kumucira shekeli z’ifeza zitanu, ni yaba umukobga, umucire zitatu.
Kand’ uhereye k’ūrengeje imyaka mirongwitandatu, ni yaba umugabo uzoba ukwiye kumucira shekeli z’ifeza cumi na zitanu, ni yaba umugore umucire icumi.
Arik’ uwasezeranye ni yaba umworo, ntashobore ico waciriye, baze bamujane imbere y’umuherezi, uwo muherezi amucire ico akwiye: amucire igiciro gihwanye n’ico uwasezeranye ashobora gutanga.
Ni caba ar’ igitunzwe co mu vyo basanzwe bampakw ibimazi, ic’ ari co cose co muri ben’ ivyo umuntu azonshikanira jewe Uhoraho, ico kizoba icera.
Ntaz’ akiguze ico bidahuje, canke ngw agikābe ikindi, ari ciza ngw agikābe ikibi, cank’ ari kibi ngw agikābe iciza: na ho ni yagikāba ikindi, icākābge bo n’ico yagikāvye, vyompi bizoba ivyera.
Kandi ni caba ar’ igitunzwe co mu bisanzwe bizira, co mu vyo batāhora bampakw ibimazi, az’ akijane imbere y’umuherezi;
uwo muherezi agicire igiciro kimaze, gihwanye n’ukw ari ciza cank’ ari kibi; igiciro uwo muherezi azogicira, kize kibe ico.
Arik’ uwagitanze, ni yagomba kucicungurira, akigerekeko n’ikingana n’ikigira gatanu caco, nk’ uko caciriwe.
Umuntu ni yarobanura inzu yiwe, akayimpa ngw ibe iyera, umuherezi az’ ayicire igiciro imaze, gihwanye n’ukw ari nziza cank’ ari mbi; igiciro uwo muherezi azoyicira, kize kigume uko.
Arik’ uwayirobanuye akayitanga, ni yagomba kuyicungurira, ayigerekeko n’ikingana n’ikigira gatanu cayo, nk’uko yaciriwe, ibone kuba iyiwe.

Umuntu ni yarobanura igice co kw itongo ryo mw ishamvu yiwe, akakimpa, mu kuhacira uz’ urīmbūre imbuto yohabibga ukw ingana: ni haba hokwirwa n’ ingero yitwa homeru ya sayiri, uhacire shekeli z’ifeza mirongwitanu.
Nuko ni yahēra mu mwaka wa yubile, akarobanura iyo ndimiro yiwe, haze hagume ico giciro waciriye.
Na ho ni yarobanura iyo ndimiro yiwe inyuma ya yubile, umuherezi az’ acire uyo amahera, arīmbūye imyaka igisigaye gushitsa ku mwaka wa yubile wundi, amanure igiciro ku vyo waciriye.
Arik’ uwarobanuye iyo ndimiro, ni yagomba kuyicungurira, agerekeko n’ikingana n’ikigira gatanu cayo, nk’uko wayiciriye, ibone kuba iyiwe bgite.
Na ho n’atāgomba kuyicungura, arikw akayigurira uwundi, nta kundi kuzoyicungura hanyuma:
arikw iyo ndimiro ni yakomōrwa n’umwaka wa yubile, izoba icitse iyera yanje, nk’iyatanzwe kuba inyegu yanje; izokwegukira umuherezi.
Kand’ umuntu ni yarobanura indimiro, akayimpa, ar’ iyo yaguze, itar’ iyo mw itongo ryo mw ishamvu yiwe;
umuherezi az’ acire uyo igiciro gihwanye n’ico waciriye kuzoshitsa ku mwaka wa yubile: az’ atange kur’ uwo musi igiciro waciriye, kibe ikintu canje cera.
Maze mu mwaka wa yubile, iyo ndimiro iz’ isubizwe uwayiguzweko, nyen’ ishamvu iryo tongo ririmwo.
Kand’ igiciro cose uzohora ucira, kize kibe shekeli zagezwe kuri shekeli ir’ Ahēra: shekeli imwe ikwiye kubamw’ ingero yitwa gera mirongwibiri.
Arikw ic’ uburiza co mu bitunzwe, ntihaze hagire umuntu akirobanura ngw agitange, kuko na kare ivy’ uburiza vyari bisanzwe ar’ ivyanje; ar’ inka cank’ intama, n’iyanje.
Na ho ni caba ico mu bitunzwe bizira, uwo muntu az’ agicungure nk’uko waciriye, akigerekeko n’ikingana n’ikigira gatanu caco; ariko ni kitacungurwa, kize kigurwe nk’uko waciriye.

Mugabo, ishikanwa ry’ikintu gitanzwe kuba inyegu yanje, ico umuntu azonshikanira akinyeguriye, mu vyo afise ivy’ ari vyo vyose, yaba umuntu, yaba igitunzwe, cank’ indimiro yo mw ishamvu yiwe, ntihaze hagire ben’ ico kigurwa canke ngo gicungurwe: ben’ iryo shikanwa ry’ikintu catanzwe kw inyegu n’icera cane kuri jewe Uhoraho.
Uwo abantu baciriyekw iteka barunduye, ntaz’ acungurwe; aze yicwe ata kabuza.
Mu vyeze mu gihugu, vyaba ivyo mu ndimiro, cank’ ivyamye ku biti, ikigiracumi c’ivyo vyose n’icanje, jewe Uhoraho: n’icera canje.
Maz’ umuntu ni yagomba gucungura ikigiracumi ciwe mur’ ivyo, ico agicunguje akigerekekw ikingana n’ikigiragatanu caco.
Kandi mu masho no mu mikuku, uko zigenda ziharūzwa inkoni, ikigiracumi co mur’ izo zose kize kibe icera canje, jewe Uhoraho.
Umuntu ntaze yibaze kw ari nziza canke kw ari mbi, canke ngw ayikābe iyindi: na ho ni yayikāba iyindi, iyakābge bo n’iyo yayikāvye, zompi zizoba izera: īgira icumi ntiz’ icungurwe.
Ivyo ni vyo vyagezwe Uhoraho yagereye Mose ku musozi Sinayi, ngw abishikirize Abisirayeli.
Ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa kabiri kw’umwaka ugira kabiri bavuye mu gihugu ca Egiputa, Uhoraho abaririra Mose mw ihema ry’ibonaniro, bari mu bugaragwa bg’i Sinayi,
ati Muharūre igitigiri c’ishengero ryose ry’Abisirayeli, nk’ukw imiryango yabo iri, nk’ukw amazu ya ba sekuruza ari, muharūre amazina y’abagabo bose umwe‐umwe,
muhēreye ku bamaze imyaka mirongwibiri no kuja hejuru, abo mu Bisirayeli bose bashobora kurwana mu ntambara, mwe na Aroni mubaharūre, nk’ukw imice yabo iri.
Kandi muze mufatanye n’umuntu umwe‐umwe wo mu miryango yose, asanzwe ar’ umukuru mu nzu ya ba sekuruza.
Aya ni yo mazina y’abo bantu bazofatanya namwe: mu ba Reyubeni ni Esisuri mwene Shedeyuri;
mu ba Simeyoni ni Shelumiyeli mwene Surishadayi;
mu ba Yuda ni Nahashoni mwene Aminadabu;
mu ba Isakari ni Netaneli mwene Suwari;
mu ba Zebuloni ni Eliyabu mwene Heloni;
muri bene Yosefu, uwo mu ba Efurayimu ni Elishama mwene Amihudi, uwo mu ba Manase ni Gamaliyeli mwene Pedasuri;
mu ba Benyamini ni Abidani mwene Gideyoni;
mu ba Dani ni Ahiyeseri mwene Amishadayi;
mu ba Asheri ni Pagiyeli mwene Okirani;
mu ba Gadi ni Eliyasafu mwene Duweli;
mu ba Nafutali ni Ahira mwene Enani.
Abo ni bo bātowe mw ikoraniro, b’abakuru mu miryango ya ba sekuruza, ni bo bāgaba ibihumbi vy’Abisirayeli.
Nuko Mose na Aroni bajana abo bantu bavuzwe amazina,

bakoranya ikoraniro ryose ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa kabiri; abantu bariyandikisha nk’ukw amavuka yabo ari, nk’ukw imiryango yabo iri, nk’ukw amazu ya ba sekuruza ari, baharūra amazina yabo umwe‐umwe, uhereye ku bamaze imyaka mirongwibiri no kuja hejuru,
nk’uk’ Uhoraho yabariye Mose; nukw abaharūrira mu bugaragwa bg’i Sinayi.

Baharūra amavuka ya ba Reyubeni imfura ya Isirayeli, nk’ukw imiryango yabo iri, nk’ukw amazu ya ba sekuruza ari, amazina y’abagabo bose umwe‐umwe, uhereye ku bamaze imyaka mirongwibiri no kuja hejuru, abashobora kurwana mu ntambara bose:
abāharūwe bo mu muryango wa Reyubeni baba ibihumbi mirongwine na bitandatu n’amajana atanu.

Baharūra amavuka ya ba Simeyoni, nk’ukw imiryango yabo iri, nk’ukw amazu ya ba sekuruza ari, amazina yabo bose, uhereye ku bamaze imyaka mirongwibiri no kuja hejuru, abashobora kurwana mu ntambara bose:
abāharūwe bo mu muryango wa Simeyoni baba ibihumbi mirongwitanu n’ icenda n’amajana atatu.
Baharūra amavuka ya ba Gadi, nk’ukw imiryango yabo iri, nk’ukw amazu ya ba sekuruza ari, amazina yabo bose, uhereye ku bamaze imyaka mirongwibiri no kuja hejuru, abashobora kurwana mu ntambara bose:
abāharūwe bo mu muryango wa Gadi baba ibihumbi mirongwine na bitanu n’amajana atandatu na mirongwitanu.
Baharūra amavuka ya ba Yuda, nk’ukw imiryango yabo iri, nk’ukw amazu ya ba sekuruza ari, amazina yabo bose, uhereye ku bamaze imyaka mirongwibiri no kuja hejuru, abashobora kurwana mu ntambara bose:
abāharūwe bo mu muryango wa Yuda baba ibihumbi mirongwirindwi n’amajana atandatu.

Baharūra amavuka ya ba Isakari, nk’ukw imiryango yabo iri, nk’ukw amazu ya ba sekuruza ari, amazina yabo bose, uhereye ku bamaze imyaka mirongwibiri no kuja hejuru, abashobora kurwana mu ntambara bose:
abāharūwe bo mu muryango wa Isakari baba ibihumbi mirongwitanu na bine n’amajana ane.

Baharūra amavuka ya ba Zebuloni, nk’ukw imiryango yabo iri, nk’ukw amazu ya ba sekuruza ari, amazina yabo bose, uhereye ku bamaze imyaka mirongwibiri no kuja hejuru, abashobora kurwana mu ntambara bose:
abāharūwe bo mu muryango wa Zebuloni baba ibihumbi mirongwitanu n’ indwi n’amajana ane.

Mu ba Yosefu, baharūra amavuka ya ba Efurayimu, nk’ukw imiryango yabo iri, nk’ukw amazu ya ba sekuruza ari, amazina yabo bose, uhereye ku bamaze imyaka mirongwibiri no kuja hejuru, abashobora kurwana mu ntambara bose:
abāharūwe bo mu muryango wa Efurayimu baba ibihumbi mirongwine n’amajana atanu.

Baharūra amavuka ya ba Manase, nk’ukw imiryango yabo iri, nk’ukw amazu ya ba sekuruza ari, amazina yabo bose, uhereye ku bamaze imyaka mirongwibiri no kuja hejuru, abashobora kurwana mu ntambara bose:
abāharūwe bo mu muryango wa Manase baba ibihumbi mirongwitatu na bibiri n’amajana abiri.

Baharūra amavuka ya ba Benyamini, nk’ukw imiryango yabo iri, nk’ukw amazu ya ba sekuruza ari, amazina yabo bose, uhereye ku bamaze imyaka mirongwibiri no kuja hejuru, abashobora kurwana mu ntambara bose:
abāharūwe bo mu muryango wa Benyamini baba ibihumbi mirongwitatu na bitanu n’amajana ane.
Baharūra amavuka ya ba Dani, nk’ukw imiryango yabo iri, nk’ukw amazu ya ba sekuruza ari, amazina yabo bose, uhereye ku bamaze imyaka mirongwibiri no kuja hejuru, abashobora kurwana mu ntambara bose:
abāharūwe bo mu muryango wa Dani baba ibihumbi mirongwitandatu na bibiri n’amajana ndwi.

Baharūra amavuka ya ba Asheri, nk’ukw imiryango yabo iri, nk’ukw amazu ya ba sekuruza ari, amazina yabo bose, uhereye ku bamaze imyaka mirongwibiri no kuja hejuru, abashobora kurwana mu ntambara bose:
abāharūwe bo mu muryango wa Asheri baba ibihumbi mirongwine na kimwe n’amajana atanu.

Baharūra amavuka ya ba Nafutali, nk’ukw imiryango yabo iri, nk’ukw amazu ya ba sekuruza ari, amazina yabo bose, uhereye ku bamaze imyaka mirongwibiri no kuja hejuru, abashobora kurwana mu ntambara bose:
abāharūwe bo mu muryango wa Nafutali baba ibihumbi mirongwitanu na bitatu n’amajana ane.
Abo ni bo bāharūwe na Mose na Aroni bafatanije na ba bakuru b’Abisirayeli ukw ar’ icumi na babiri, umwe‐umwe wo mu nzu ya ba sekuruza.
Nukw abāharūwe bose bo mu Bisirayeli, nk’ukw amazu ya ba sekuruza ari, uhereye ku bamaze imyaka mirongwibiri no kuja hejuru, abashobora kurwana mu ntambara bose bo mu Bisirayeli;
abāharūwe bose na bose baba ibihumbi amajana atandatu na bitatu, n’amajana atanu na mirongwitanu.
Arikw Abalewi, nk’uk’ umuryango wa ba sekuruza usanzwe uri, ntibāharūranywe na bo,
kuk’ Uhoraho yabariye Mose,
at’ Umuryango wa Lewi wo ntuz’ uwuharūre, canke ng’ urīmbūre igitigiri cabo mu Bisirayeli bandi.

Arikw Abalewi uz’ ubagire abo kuzezwa iryo hema ry’Ibishinga intahe, n’ibintu vyose vy’imbombovu vyo muri ryo, n’ivyaryo vyose: abe ari bo barirerura, n’ibintu vyose vyo muri ryo; abe ari bo bakora ibikorwa vyo muri ryo, bashinge amahema yabo impande zose z’iryo hema.

Kandi mu kurishingūra rigeze kugenda, Abalewi abe ari bo barishingūra, kand’ iyo hageze gushinga, Abalewi abe ari bo barishinga: kandi ni hagira uwundi wese atar’ uwo muri bo yovyēgēra akavyitamwo, aze yicwe.
Abisirayeli baze bashinge amahema yabo, nk’ukw imice yabo iri, umuntu wese aherēre ah’ ab’i wabo bashagaje, ku ruhande rw’ibendera y’i wabo.

Arikw Abalewi bo baze bashinge ayabo impande zose z’iryo hema ry’Ibishinga intahe, kugira ng’ uburake bganje bgoye kuziriringira iryo koraniro ry’Abisirayeli; Abalewi baze bitondere ivyo bājejwe vy’iryo hema.
Nukw Abisirayeli babigenza kuno, bakora vyose nk’uk’ Uhoraho yabariye Mose.
Uhoraho abarira Mose na Aroni,
at’ Abisirayeli baze bame bashinga amahema yabo, umuntu wese ku ruhande rw’ibendera y’i wabo, bateko baje ku kabendera karanga inzu ya ba sekuruza: basagaze bakīkūje ihema ry’ibonaniro impande zose.
I burasirazuba haze hasagaze ab’ ibendera y’igugu rya Yuda, nk’ukw imice yabo iri; umukuru w’Abayuda ni Nahashoni mwene Aminadabu.
Ingabo zāharūwe zabo zar’ ibihumbi mirongwirindwi na bine n’amajana atandatu.
Ab’ umuryango wa Isakari abe ari bo bahererana na bo; kand’ umukuru w’Abisakari ni Netaneli mwene Suwari:
ingabo zāharūwe zabo zar’ ibihumbi mirongwitanu na bine n’amajana ane.
Bakurikirwe n’umuryango wa Zebuloni; umukuru w’Abazebuloni ni Eliyabu mwene Heloni;
ingabo zāharūwe zabo zar’ ibihumbi mirongwitanu n’indwi n’amajana ane.
Bose na bose abāharūwe mw igugu rya Yuda bar’ ingabo ibihumbi ijana na mirongumunani na bitandatu n’amajana ane, nk’ukw imice yabo yakurikirana. Abo baze babe ari bo babanza guhaguruka.
Ku ruhande rw’i bumanuko haze habe igugu rya Reyubeni, n’ibendera yaryo, nk’ukw imice yabo iri; umukuru w’Abareyubeni ni Elisuri mwene Shedeyuri.
Ingabo zāharūwe zabo zar’ ibihumbi mirongwine na bitandatu n’amajana atanu.
Ab’ umuryango wa Simeyoni abe ari bo bahererana na bo; kand’ umukuru w’Abasimeyoni ni Shelumiyeli mwene Surishadayi:
ingabo zāharūwe zabo zar’ ibihumbi mirongwitanu n’icenda n’amajana atatu.
Bakurikirwe n’umuryango wa Gadi; umukuru w’Abagadi ni Eliyasafu mwene Ruweli:
ingabo zāharūwe zabo zar’ ibihumbi mirongwine na bitanu n’amajana atandatu na mirongwitanu.
Bose na bose abāharūwe mw igugu rya Reyubeni bar’ ingabo ibihumbi ijana na mirongwitanu na kimwe n’amajana ane na mirongwitanu, nk’ukw imice yabo yakurikirana. Abo baze babe aba kabiri mu kugenda.

Hanyuma haze hagende ihema ry’ibonaniro, rijane n’igugu ry’Abalewi, rigendere hagati y’ayandi magugu: uko bakurikirana mu gusagaza, abe ari ko bagenda, umuce wose mu gihimba cawo, ukw’ amabendera yayo akurikirana.
Ku ruhande rw’i burengerazuba haze habe igugu rya Efurayimu, n’ibendera yabo, nk’ukw imice yabo iri; umukuru w’Abefurayimu ni Elishama mwene Amihudi.
Ingabo zāharūwe zabo zar’ ibihumbi mirongwine n’amajana atanu.
Ab’ umuryango wa Manase abe ari bo bahererana na bo; kand’ umukuru w’Abamanase ni Gamaliyeli mwene Pedasuri:
ingabo zāharūwe zabo zar’ ibihumbi mirongwitatu na bibiri n’amajana abiri.
Bakurikirwe n’umuryango wa Benyamini; umukuru w’Ababenyamini ni Abidani mwene Gideyoni:
ingabo zāharūwe zabo zar’ ibihumbi mirongwitatu na bitanu n’amajana ane.
Bose na bose abāharūwe mw igugu rya Efurayimu bar’ ingabo ibihumbi ijana n’umunani n’ijana rimwe, nk’ukw imice yabo yakurikirana. Abo baze babe aba gatatu mu kugenda.
Ku ruhande rw’i burārūko haze habe igugu rya Dani, n’ibendera yabo, nk’ukw imice yabo iri; umukuru w’Abadani ni Ahiyezeri mwene Amishadayi.
Ingabo zāharūwe zabo zar’ ibihumbi mirongwitandatu na bibiri n’amajana ndwi.
Ab’ umuryango wa Asheri abe ari bo bahererana na bo; kand’ umukuru w’Abasheri ni Pagiyeli mwene Okirani:
ingabo zāharūwe zabo zar’ ibihumbi mirongwine na kimwe n’amajana atanu.
Bakurikirwe n’umuryango wa Nafutali; umukuru w’Abanafutali ni Ahira mwene Enani:
ingabo zāharūwe zabo zar’ ibihumbi mirongwitanu na bitatu n’amajana ane.
Bose na bose abāharūwe mw igugu rya Dani bar’ ingabo ibihumbi ijana na mirongwitanu n’indwi n’amajana atandatu. Abo baze babe ababaherukira mu kugenda, bakurikire amabendera yabo.

Abo ni bo bāharūwe mu Bisirayeli, nk’ukw amazu ya ba sekuruza ari: abāharūwe bose na bose bo mur’ ayo magugu, nk’ukw imice yabo yari, bar’ ibihumbi amajana atandatu na bitatu n’amajana atanu na mirongwitanu.
Arikw Abalewi ntibāharūranwa n’Abisirayeli, biba nk’uk’ Uhoraho yabariye Mose.

Abisirayeli bakora kuno; basagaza baherereye ku mabendera yabo; ngo hagere kugenda bakagenda, umuntu wese agakomeza mu bo mu muryango wabo no mu bo mu nzu ya ba sekuruza, bakurikiye ivyo Uhoraho yabariye Mose vyose.
Uru ni rwo ruvyaro Aroni na Mose bari bafise igihe Uhoraho yavuganira na Mose ku musozi Sinayi.
Aya ni yo mazina ya bene Aroni: imfura yiwe ni Nadabu, agakurikirwa na Abihu na Eleyazari na Itamari.
Ayo ni yo mazina ya bene Aroni, abaherezi bāsutswekw amavuta yo kubarobanura, bagashikirizwa ibango ry’ ubuherezi.

Mugabo Nadabu na Abihu bāpfiriye imbere y’Uhoraho, igihe bāmwosereza imibavu ku muriro urahuwe ahandi, bari mu bugaragwa bg’i Sinayi; bapfa ar’ incike. Ariko Eleyazari na Itamari bāshishikara ibango ry’ ubuherezi imbere ya se Aroni.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
at’ Igiza hafi umuryango wa Lewi, ubashire imbere ya Aroni umuherezi, kugira ngo bamutumikire:
bamutumikire mu vyo yagezweko, no mu vy’ ishengero ryose ryagezweko, imbere y’ihema ry’ ibonaniro; bakore n’ibikorwa vy’ iryo hema.
Bazezwe ibintu vyose vyo mw ihema ry’ibonaniro, batumikire n’ishengero ry’Abisirayeli mu vyo ryagezweko, bakore n’ibikorwa vy’iryo hema.
Nukw Abalewi ubashikirize Aroni n’ abana biwe, arabahawe arabeguriwe, barobanuwe mu Bisirayeli.
Ushireho Aroni n’abana biwe, abe ari bo bazezwa igikorwa c’ubuherezi bgabo: kand’ uwundi wese atar’ uwo muri bo yovyēgēra akavyitamwo, aze yicwe.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
ati Rāba jewe nisobanuriye Abalewi mu Bisirayeli bandi, ngo babe mu gishingo c’abana bose b’ubuzibūra bg’Abisirayeli: Abalewi bose bazoba abanje niharije.

Kukw abana bose b’imfura ar’ abanje: ku musi nicirakw abana bose b’imfura bo mu gihugu ca Egiputa, ni ho nirobanuriye imfura zose zo mu Bisirayeli nkazēza, iz’ abantu bo n’uburiza bg’ibitunzwe: bizoba ivyanje; nd’ Uhoraho.
Uhoraho abaririra Mose mu bugaragwa bg’i Sinayi,
ati Harūra Abalewi, nk’ukw amazu ya ba sekuruza ari, nk’ukw imiryango yabo iri: uharūre izinamuhungu wese, uhereye ku bamaze ukwezi kumwe ukaja hejuru.
Nuko Mose arabaharūra, nk’ukw ijambo ry’Uhoraho ryavuze: agira nk’uko yabariwe.
Aba ni bo bana ba Lewi, ukw amazina yabo akurikirana: Gerushoni na Kohati na Merari.
Aya ni yo mazina ya bene Gerushoni, nk’ukw imiryango yabo iri: Libuni na Shimeyi.
Aba ni bo bene Kohati, nk’ukw imiryango yabo iri: Amuramu na Isihari na Heburoni na Uziyeli.
Aba ni bo bene Merari, nk’ukw imiryango yabo iri: Mahili na Mushi. Iyo ni yo miryango y’Abalewi, nk’ ukw amazu ya ba sekuruza ari.
Abākomōtse kuri Gerushoni n’umuryango w’Abalibuni n’uw’ Abashimeyi: iyo ni yo miryango ya ba Gerushoni.
Abāharūwe bo muri bo, nk’ukw igitigiri c’izinamuhungu wese cari kiri, uhereye ku bamaze ukwezi kumwe no kuja hejuru, bār’ ibihumbi ndwi n’amajana atanu.
Ab’ imiryango ya ba Gerushoni bāsagaza inyuma ya rya hema ahahera i burengerazuba.
Umukuru w’ inzu ya ba sekuruza b’aba Gerushoni yari Eliyasafu mwene Layeli.
Ivy’ ihema ry’ibonaniro aba Gerushoni bāzēzwa vyar’ ihema ry’imbere, n’ihema ryo hejuru, n’ico kurenza hejuru yaryo, n’ igihuzu cakinga ku muryango w’iryo hema ry’ibonaniro nyene,
n’impuzu zo kubamba ngo zibe urugo, n’igihuzu cakinga mw irembo ry’urwo rugo rukīkūza ihema n’igicaniro, n’imigozi, n’ ibikorwa vyavyo vyose.
Abākomōtse kuri Kohati n’ umuryango w’Abamuramu n’uw’ Abisihari n’uw’ Abaheburoni n’uw’ Abuziyeli: iyo ni yo miryango y’aba Kohati.
Nk’ukw igitigiri c’izinamuhungu wese cari kiri, uhereye ku bamaze ukwezi kumwe no kuja hejuru, bar’ ibihumbi munani n’amajana atandatu: ni bo bāzēzwa ivy’ Ahēra.
Ab’ imiryango y’aba Kohati bāsagaza ku ruhande rw’iryo hema ahahera i bumanuko.
Umukuru w’inzu ya ba sekuruza b’aba Kohati yari Elisafani mwene Uziyeli.
Ivyo bāzēzwa yar’ isandugu n’ameza n’ico guterekwakw amatara, n’ibicaniro vyompi, n’ibintu vy’Ahēra vyo gukoresha, n’igihuzu co gukingīra Ahēra, n’ibikorwa vyavyo vyose.
Eleyazari mwene Aroni umuherezi ni we yagizwe mukuru kuri ba bakuru b’Abalewi, ngw abgirize abājējwe ivy’ Ahēra.
Abākomōtse kuri Merari n’umuryango w’Abamahili n’uw’ Abamushi: iyo ni yo miryango y’aba Merari.
Abāharūwe bo muri bo, nk’ukw igitigiri c’izinamuhungu wese cari kiri, uhereye ku bamaze ukwezi kumwe no kuja hejuru, bār’ ibihumbi bitandatu n’amajana abiri.
Umukuru w’inzu ya ba sekuruza b’aba Merari yari Suriyeli mwene Abihayili; abo ni bo bāsagaza ku ruhande rw’iryo hema ahahera i burārūko.
Aba Merari, ivyo bāshingiwe kuzēzwa zar’ imbaho z’iryo hema, n’ibiti vyo gusobeka muri zo, n’inkingi zaryo, n’ibitereko vyo kuzinegamwo, n’ibintu vyaryo vyose, n’ibikoreshwa vyaryo vyose;
n’ibirimbi vy’ urugo rwo kurikīkūza, n’ibitereko vyavyo vyo kubinegamwo, n’ imambo zavyo n’imigozi yavyo.

Abāshinga amahema yabo imbere y’iryo hema ahahera i burasirazuba, yari Mose bo na Aroni n’abana biwe; ni bo bāzēzwa igikorwa c’Ahēra, n’ibindi bākora kubg’ Abisirayeli; kand’ uwundi wese atar’ uwo muri bo yovyēgēra akavyitamwo, yar’ akwiye kwicwa.

Abāharūwe bo mu Balewi, abo Mose na Aroni bāharūye, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yabibabariye, bār’ ibihumbi mirongwibiri na bibiri, nk’ukw imiryango yabo iri, izinamuhungu wese, uhereye ku bamaze ukwezi kumwe ukaja hejuru.
Uhoraho abarira Mose, ati Harūra izinamuhungu wese mu bana b’imfura b’Abisirayeli, uhereye ku bamaze ukwezi kumwe ukaja hejuru, ubaharūre nk’ukw amazina yabo ari.

Unshingūrire Abalewi, ubashire mu gishingo c’imfura zose z’Abisirayeli: nd’Uhoraho; kand’ unshingūrire n’amasho n’imikuku vy’Abalewi, ubishire mu gishingo c’ivy’ uburiza bgose bg’amasho n’imikuku vy’Abisirayeli.
Nuko Mose aharūra imfura zose zo mu Bisirayeli, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yamubariye.

Abahungu b’imfura bose bāharūwe, uhereye ku bamaze ukwezi kumwe no kuja hejuru, nk’ukw igitigiri c’amazina yabo kiri, abāharūwe bār’ ibihumbi mirongwibiri na bibiri n’amajana abiri na mirongwirindwi na batatu.
Uhoraho abarira Mose,
ati Shingūra Abalewi, ubashire mu gishingo c’imfura zose z’Abisirayeli, n’amasho n’imikuku vy’ Abalewi ubishire mu gishingo c’ivyabo; Abalewi babe abanje niharije: nd’Uhoraho.
Kand’ abana b’imfura b’Abisirayeli basigaye, ukw ar’ amajana abiri na mirongwirindwi na batatu, basāgutse ku gitigiri c’Abalewi,
uz’ ubāke shekeli zitanu kw incungu, umuntu umwe‐umwe ku mutwe wiwe; shekeli uzokwāka zize zibe izigezwe kuri shekeli ir’ Ahēra: shekeli imwe irimwo gera mirongwibiri.
Ayo mahera acunguye abasāgutse uyahe Aroni n’abana biwe.
Nuko Mose yāka amahera y’incungu abo bāsāgutse ku bācunguwe n’Abalewi:
amahera yātse abo bana b’ imfura b’Abisirayeli aba shekeli igihumbi n’amajana atatu na mirongwitandatu na zitanu, zigezwe kuri shekeli ir’ Ahēra.
Ayo mahera y’incungu Mose ayaha Aroni n’abana biwe, nk’ukw ijambo ry’Uhoraho ryavuze, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yageze Mose.
Uhoraho abarira Mose na Aroni,
