Abatware b’i Sukoti baramwishura, bat’ Aho Zeba na Salumuna murabafise, bari mu maboko yanyu, ngo duhēmbūre ingabo zawe?
Gideyoni arabishura, ati Nuko rero, Uhoraho ni yamara kugabura Zeba na Salumuna mu maboko yanje, nzoza mbashishaguze amahwa yo mw ishamba n’imibambangwe!
Avayo, aja i Peniyeli, n’abaho ababgira nk’uko, na bo bamwishura nk’ukw ab’i Sukoti bamwishuye.
Nukw abgira ab’i Peniyeli, ati Ni nagaruka amahoro nzohomvagura uyu munara.

Kandi Zeba na Salumuna bar’ i Karikori, hamwe n’ingabo zabo zishika nko ku bihumbi cumi na bitanu, ari zo zari zisigaye gusa mu ngabo zose z’ab’i burasirazuba, kuko mu rugamba hāri hāgūye ingabo ibihumbi ijana na mirongwibiri zizi kurwanisha inkota.
Maze Gideyoni adūgana inzira ica mu bībēra mu mahema hirya y’i Noba n’i Yogi‐beha ku ruhande rw’i burasirazuba, asanga izo ngabo zījajaye, arazitera.
Zeba na Salumuna barahunga, abōma inyuma, afata mpiri abo bami b’i Midiyani ukw ari babiri, aca igikuba ingabo zabo zose.
Nuko Gideyoni mwene Yowasi agarukira ku mudūgo w’i Heresi, aratabāruka.
Ahūra n’umusore wo mu b’i Sukoti, aramufata, aramudedaguza, na we aca amwandikira amazina y’abaganwa n’abakuru b’i Sukoti, bashika ku bantu mirongwirindwi n’indwi.
Ashitse i Sukoti abarira abaho, ati Ni murābe Zeba na Salumuna ngaba, aho mwari mukingaya, ngo Mbega Zeba na Salumuna aho murabafise, bari mu maboko yanyu, ngo duhēmbūre ingabo zawe zishonje?
Nukw afata abakuru bo mur’ ico gisagara, aca amahwa yo mw ishamba n’imibambangwe, abishishaguza abo bantu b’i Sukoti.
Maz’ ahomvagura na wa munara w’i Peniyeli, yica abantu bo mur’ ico gisagara.
Maz’ abaza Zeba na Salumuna, ati Mbeg’ abantu mwiciye i Tabora bāsa bate? Baramwishura, bati Bāsa n’uko kwawe: umuntu wese yasa n’umwana w’ umwami.
Arababgira, ati Barya bār’ abo tuvukana, mbere bāri bene mama. Iyaba mwarabaretse, mbarahiye uguhoraho kw’Uhoraho, sinabica!
Maz’ abarira imfura yiwe Yeteri, ati Va hasi ubice. Arik’ uyo muhungu ntiyubahuka gusokōra inkota, kuko yar’ akiri muto.
Nuko Zeba na Salumuna baravuga, bati Haguruka, abe ari wewe utwiyicira: urukāmvye rumara umugabo. Gideyoni aca ava hasi, yica Zeba na Salumuna, yambura ingamiya zabo ibihete vyari mu mazosi yazo.
Maz’ Abisirayeli babarira Gideyoni, bati N’utuganze, wewe ubgawe, n’umwana wawe az’ atuganze, n’umwuzukuru wawe, kuko wadukijije, ukadukūra mu maboko y’Abamidiyani.
Gideyoni arabishura, at’ Eka sinemeye kubaganza, n’umwana wanje ntazobaganza; arik’ Uhoraho ni we azobaganza.
Maz’ arababarira, ati Mugabo, har’ ico mbasaba: umuntu wese n’ampe impeta zo ku matwi yanyaze. (Abo bansi bari bambaye impeta z’izahabu ku matwi, kuko bār’ Abishimayeli.)
Baramwishura, bati Turaziguha cane. Nuko basasa impuzu hasi, umuntu wese atererakw impeta zo ku matwi yanyaze.

Kandi kuriba kw’izo mpeta z’izahabu kwari shekeli igihumbi n’amajana ndwi, udashizemw’ ibihete n’utugenegene n’impuzu z’inyambarabami, ivy’ abo bami b’i Midiyani bambara, udashizemwo n’imigufu yari ku mazosi y’ingamiya zabo.
Maz’ izo zahabu Gideyoni azikoramw’ icitwa efodi, ayishira mu gisagara c’i wabo Ofura; maz’ Abisirayeli bose bahondoganirayo, bayihurumbira nk’ibimaka; ihindukira Gideyoni n’abiwe umutego.
Nukw Abamidiyani bamarwa igabo n’Abisirayeli: ntibāsubira kuvyutsa umutwe ukundi; mu gihe ca Gideyoni igihugu gihabga impore kumara imyaka mirongwine.
Nuko Yerubayali mwene Yowasi, ari we Gideyoni, ni kwo gutaha, yībēra i muhira;
kand’ abahungu yivyariye bāri mirongwirindwi, kuko yar’ afise abagore benshi.
Kandi yar’ afise incoreke i Shekemu, na yo ayivyarak’ umwana w’umuhungu amwita Abimeleki.
Nuko Gideyoni mwene Yowasi apfa yīsāziye neza, bamuhamba mu mva yahambgemwo se Yowasi, ku musozi Ofura w’Ababiyezeri.
Maze Gideyoni apfuye, Abisirayeli baca bahindukirira za Bayali, bazihurumbira nk’ibimaka, kandi Bayali‐beriti bayigira imana yabo.
Maze ntibaba bacibuka Uhoraho Imana yabo, yabakijije akabakūra mu maboko y’abansi babo bose bāri babakikije.
Kandi ntibagirira neza ab’ inzu ya Yerubayali, ari we Gideyoni, ngo bamwishure ineza yose yari yarabagiriye.
Maze Abimeleki mwene Yerubayali aja i Shekemu kwa ba inarume, avugana na bo n’abo mu nzu ya sekuru avyara nyina, arababarira,

at’ Enda ni mumbarize ab’i Shekemu bose, mut’ Icobamerera neza n’iki? N’uko mwotwarwa na bene Yerubayali bose ukw ari mirongwirindwi, canke n’uko mwotwarwa n’umwe? Kandi muribuka yuko nd’ akavata kanyu n’akara kanyu.
Ba inarume baragenda bīgānira ayo majambo yose ab’i Shekemu bose; na bo imitima yabo baca bayishira kuri Abimeleki, bati Na kare yari mwishwa wacu.
Bamuha intete z’ifeza mirongwirindwi bakūye mu ngoro ya Bayali‐beriti; Abimeleki azihēra abantu b’imburakimazi kandi b’inshirukanya, bāgendana na we.
Aja i wabo i Ofura, yica bene se, ari bo bene Yerubayali, abakererera kw ibuye rimwe; ariko Yotamu umuhererezi wa Yerubayali, ararokoka, kuko yaciye yinyegeza.
Maz’ abantu bose b’i Shekemu bakoranira hamwe n’ab’ inzu ya Milo bose, baja kwimikira Abimeleki musi y’igiti c’umweloni cari mu gitabo i Shekemu.
Maze Yotamu avyumvise, aragenda ahagarara ku mpinga y’ umusozi Gerizimu, asemerera n’ ijwi rirenga, aravuga, ati Yemwe bantu b’i Shekemu, ni munyumvirize, kugira ngw Imana namwe ibumvirize.
Kera ibiti vyari bigiye kwiyimikamw’ umwami wo kubiganza. Bibarira igiti c’umwelayo, biti Ba ari wewe utuganza.
Umwelayo uravyishura, uti Mbeg’ aho noheba amavuta yanje, kand’ ari yo atuma nubahwa n’Imana n’abantu, ngo nje kwirirwa ndahungabana hejuru y’ibiti?
Maz’ ibiti bibarira umusukoni, biti N’uze weho utuganze.
Umusukoni uravyishura, uti Mbeg’ aho noheba uburyohe bganje n’insukoni zanje nziza, ngo nje kwirirwa ndahungabana hejuru y’ibiti?
Maz’ ibiti bibarira umuzabibu, biti N’uze weho utuganze.
Umuzabibu uravyishura, uti Mbeg’ aho noheba vino yanje inezereza Imana n’abantu, ngo nje kwirirwa ndahungabana hejuru y’ibiti?
Maz’ ibiti vyose bibarira umubambangwe, biti N’uze weho utuganze.

Umubambangwe wishura ivyo biti, ut’ Asangwa mugomba kunyimika vy’ukuri ngo mbe umwami wanyu, ni muze mwikinge mu gitutu canje; na ho bitabaye ivy’ ukuri, umuriro uzokwaduka mu mubambangwe, uyigize amasederi y’i Lebanoni.
Yotamu yungamwo, ati Mbeg’ aho mwakoze ivy’ ukuri n’ibibereye, kwimika Abimeleki? Aho mwagiriye neza Yerubayali n’ab’ inzu yiwe, mwamwishuye ivyo yar’ akwiye?
Data ko yabarwanira ahevye amagara yiwe, akabakiza akabakūra mu maboko y’Abamidiyani;

none mwebge ko mwakūriye hasi inzu yiwe, mukica abana biwe mirongwirindwi, mukabakererera kuri rya buye, mukaba mwimitse Abimeleki umwana w’umuja wiwe, kukw ari mwene wanyu, kugira ngw abe umwami w’ab’i Shekemu!
None rero, asangwa mwakoreye Yerubayali n’inzu yiwe ivy’ ukuri n’ibibereye, enda ni munezererwe Abimeleki, na we abanezererwe!
Na ho bitabaye birtyo, umuriro n’uve kuri Abimeleki, uyigize abantu b’i Shekemu n’ab’ inzu ya Milo; kand’ umuriro n’uve mu b’i Shekemu no mu b’inzu ya Milo, uyigize Abimeleki.
Maze Yotamu aca yiruka arahunga, aja i Beri, abayo, kuko yatinya Abimeleki mwene se.
Nuko Abimeleki amara imyaka itatu, ari we aganza Abisirayeli.
Maz’ Imana irungika impwemu mbi yo guteranya Abimeleki n’ abantu b’i Shekemu; nukw ab’i Shekemu baryaruka Abimeleki;
kugira ngw asubirizwe mu nkōko agatikizo yatikije bene Yerubayali mirongwirindwi, kandi ngw amaraso yabo akore Abimeleki nyene kubica, akore n’abantu b’i Shekemu bāfatanije na we aho yica bene se.
Maz’ ab’i Shekemu bashirah’ abantu bo kumuryamira ku mpinga z’imisozi, kandi bahāmburira abahita benshi bāca mur’ iyo nzira. Abimeleki arabibūrirwa.
Maze Gayali mwene Ebedi yimukana n’abo bavukana, baja i Shekemu; abantu b’i Shekemu baca baramwizigira.
Bukeye baja mu ndimiro, bimbura inzabibu zabo, barazigana, bagira umusi mukuru, binjira mu ngoro y’ikigirwamana cabo, bararya baranywa, bavuma Abimeleki.

Gayali mwene Ebedi aravuga, ati Abimeleki n’iki, kand’ ab’i Shekemu duhūriye hehe na we, vyotuma tumusaba? Mbeg’ uyo mwene Yerubayali, bo na Zebuli amutwarira, kera ntibāri bashumbiye Abanyahamori, ari we Sēshekemu nyene? None n’iki cotuma tumusaba?
Icompa nkaba ari jewe mbaganza! Nokūraho Abimeleki! Nobarira Abimeleki, nti Gwiza ingabo zawe, uheze uze, uransanga!
Zebuli umutware w’ico gisagara, yumvise amagambo ya Gayali mwene Ebedi, uburake bgiwe buraziriringa.
Atuma intumwa kwa Abimeleki mu mpisho, muti Gayali mwene Ebedi bo n’ ab’i wabo baje i Shekemu, kandi bariko barakugomeshereza igisagara.
Muti None rero, enda n’uhenge mw ijoro, mwe n’abantu muri kumwe, muze muryame mu mirima;
muheze muhenge kare mu gatondo izuba rirashe, muvyuke mutere igisagara. Muti Maze Gayali n’abo bari kumwe ni baza kukurwanya, uzoshobora kubagirira uk’ ugomba.
Nuko Abimeleki ahenga mw ijoro, ahagurukana n’abantu bose bari kumwe na we, baja kuryamira i Shekemu, bīcīyemw’ imice ine.
Maze Gayali mwene Ebedi arasohoka, aragenda ahagarara kw irembo ry’igisagara; maze Abimeleki n’abo bari kumwe, bavyuka aho babunze mu gico.
Nuko Gayali ababonye, abarira Zebuli, at’ Ehe bariya bantu bamanuka ku mpinga y’umusozi! Zebuli aramwishura, at’ Ereg’ ubonye ibitutu vy’imisozi, uvyita abantu!
Maze Gayali yongera kuvuga, at’ Ehe rāba, ngabariya n’abandi, bamanutse ku gahanamo, kandi n’ uwundi muce uzananye inzira yo ku giti c’umweloni w’abapfumu!
Maze Zebuli aca aramubgira, ati Kwa kwihaya kwawe kuri hehe, aho wavuga, uti Abimeleki n’iki tukamusaba? Bariya si ba bantu wakēngēra? None seruka urwane na bo!
Nuko Gayali arōngōra ingabo z’i Shekemu, aja kurwana na Abimeleki.
Abimeleki aramukinagiza, na we aratemēsha; benshi bagenda bahindikirana bakomeretse, kugeza no kw ishikiro ry’irembo ry’igisagara.
Nuko Abimeleki arāra i Aruma, maze Zebuli yirukana Gayali n’ ab’i wabo kugira ngo ntibasubire kuba i Shekemu.
Bukeye bgaho abantu baragenda baja mu mirima; Abimeleki barabimubarira.
Aca ajana ingabo ziwe, azicamw’ imice itatu, baryama mu mirima; maz’ abonye abantu ko bavuye mu gisagara, baca babakūrira hasi, barabarwanya.
Maze Abimeleki n’umuce wari kumwe na we birukira kw ishikiro ry’irembo, bahagararaho; iyindi mice ibiri yirukira abagiye mu mirima bose, barabarwanya.
Abimeleki yiriza uwo musi wose arwanya ico gisagara, aragitsinda, ageseza abari muri co, aragisangangura, akimēmēramw’ umunyu.
Maz’ abantu bose bo ku munara w’i Shekemu bumvise ivyo, baja kwinyegeza mu cumba co mu kuzimu musi y’ingoro y’ikigirwamana Beriti.
Abimeleki abarirwa yukw abantu bose bo ku munara w’i Shekemu bakoraniye hamwe.
Nuko Abimeleki adūga umusozi Salumoni bo n’abantu bose bari kumwe; ahitana incabiti, yicira inkwi, araziterura, azita ku rutugu; abgira abari kumwe na we, ati Nyaruka mugire uko ngize.
Nukw abantu bose bicira inkwi, bakurikira Abimeleki, bazirunda kuri ca cumba, bakibaturirako. Nukw abantu bose bo mu munara w’i Shekemu na bo barapfa, bose na bose abagabo n’abagore bari nk’igihumbi.
Maze Abimeleki aja i Tebesi, asagaza inyuma yaho, arahatera, arahatsinda.
Ariko mur’ ico gisagara hār’ umunara ukomeye; ni ho abantu bose bo mur’ ico gisagara birukiye, abagabo n’abagore, bariyugarana, būrira mur’ uwo munara, baja hejuru kuri wo.
Abimeleki araza azibiriza uwo munara, yēgēra urugi rwawo ngw aruturire.
Maz’ umugore umwe mur’ abo atera Abimeleki ingasire mu ruhanga, ararusāvya.
Aca ahamagara umuhungu w’umusore amutwaje ibirwanishwa, ati Sokōra inkota yawe, umpohoshe, boye kuzovuga, ngo Yishwe n’umugore. Nuk’ uwo muhungu aramusogota, arapfa.
Maz’ Abisirayeli babonye Abimeleki apfuye, barataha, umuntu wese aja i we.
Uko ni kw Imana yashubirije Abimeleki mu nkōko, ku vyo yagiriye se, aho yamwicira abana mirongwirindwi;
kand’ Imana yatumye ibibi vyose ab’i Shekemu bākoze bibasubira ku mutwe, wa muvumo wa Yotamu mwene Yerubayali ubashikako.
Hanyuma ya Abimeleki haza Tola mwene Puwa, Puwa wa Dodo, wo mu muryango wa Isakari, arahaguruka akiza Abisirayeli. Yaba i Shamiri mu mugamba w’Abefurayimu.
Amara imyaka mirongwibiri n’itatu ar’ umucamanza mu Bisirayeli; apfuye, bamuhamba i Shamiri nyene.
Hanyuma yiwe hahaguruka Yayiri w’Umugileyadi; amara imyaka mirongwibiri n’ibiri ar’ umucamanza mu Bisirayeli.

Kandi yar’ afise abahungu mirongwitatu, bagendera ku ndogoba mirongwitatu nyene, kandi bari bafise ibisagara mirongwitatu vyitwa Havoti‐yayiri, kandi ni ko bicitwa na bugingo n’ubu; biri mu gihugu c’i Gileyadi.
Yayiri apfuye, bamuhamba i Kamoni.

Maz’ Abisirayeli bongera gukora ivyo Uhoraho abona kw ari bibi, basaba za Bayali na za Ashitaroti, n’imana z’i Siriya n’iz’ i Sidoni n’iz’ i Mowabu n’iz’ Abamoni n’iz’ Abafilisitiya; bata Uhoraho, ntibaba bakimusaba.
Uburake bg’ Uhoraho buziriringira Abisirayeli, abagabura mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya no mu y’ Abamoni.
Mur’ uwo mwaka bacuranguza Abisirayeli, barabahahaza; bamara imyaka cumi n’umunani bagirira nabi Abisirayeli bose bo hakurya ya Yorodani mu gihugu c’Abamori i Gileyadi.
Hanyuma Abamoni bajabuka Yorodani baja gutera n’Abayuda na bo n’Ababenyamini n’ab’ umuryango w’Abefurayimu, bituma Abisirayeli babura epfo na ruguru.
Maz’ Abisirayeli batakambira Uhoraho, bati Twagucumuyeko, kuko twakuvuyeko ari wewe Imana yacu, tugasaba za Bayali.
Uhoraho yishura Abisirayeli, ati Mbega si jewe nagenda mbakiza Abanyegiputa n’Abamori n’Abamoni n’Abafilisitiya?
Kandi hamwe Abasidoni n’Abamaleki n’Abamayoni bābahahaza, mukantakambira, nagenda mbarokora nkabakūra mu maboko yabo.
Yamara, ko mwamvuyeko, mukaja gusaba izindi mana, ni co gituma ntongera kubakiza.
Ni mugende mutakambire za mana mwitoranirije, abe ari zo zibakiza mu gihe c’amagorwa yanyu.
Abisirayeli bishura Uhoraho, bati Twaracumuye koko, none n’utugire uk’ ugomba: mugabo, wemere kudukiza iri rimwe gusa.
Baraheza bakūraho izo mana z’inyamahanga, basubira gusaba Uhoraho, na we aca agira ikigumbagumba mu mutima kubgo kubona imibabaro y’Abisirayeli.
Maz’ Abamoni bakoranira hamwe, basagaza i Gileyadi, Abisirayeli na bo barakorana, basagaza i Misipa.
Abantu baravugana, ari bo bakuru b’i Gileyadi, bati Ni nde yotangura gusomboroza Abamoni? Uwoboneka azohabga ubukuru mu b’i Gileyadi bose.
Maze hāri Yefuta w’Umugileyadi, kandi yar’ umuhizi w’inkomezi; yari yavutse kuri maraya, yamuvyaweko na Gileyadi.
Ariko muka Gileyadi bari baravyaranye abandi bahungu; abo bamaze gukura, bāri bārirukanye Yefuta, bati Nta co uteze mu vya data, kuko wavutse ku mugore w’ icangazi.
Maze Yefuta aca ahunga bene se, aragenda aba mu gihugu c’i Tobu; abantu b’ imburakimazi bakoranira kuri we, bakagenda bambura abantu.
Igihe kiragera, Abamoni ni kwo gutera Abisirayeli.
Maze babateye, abakuru b’i Gileyadi baragenda ngo bakūre Yefuta mu gihugu c’i Tobu;
baramubarira, bati N’uze ube umugabisha wacu, tubone kurwanya Abamoni.
Yefuta yishura abakuru b’i Gileyadi, ati Mbega si mwebge mwanyanse, mukanyirukana mu rugo rwa data? None muhenga mugowe mukaza iyo ndi?
Maz’ abakuru b’i Gileyadi baramwishura, bati Noneh’ igitumye tuza iy’ uri n’ukugira ng’ ujane natwe, urwanye Abamoni; uzoheza ube umukuru wacu, uganze ababa i Gileyadi bose.
Yefuta arababaza, ati None ni mwansubiza i wacu kurwana n’Abamoni, Uhoraho akampa kubatsinda, nzoheza mbe umukuru wanyu koko?
Abo bakuru b’i Gileyadi baramwishura, bat’ Uhoraho abaye icabona hagati yacu, yuko tuzoshitsa ivyo uvuze.
Nuko Yefuta ajana n’abo bakuru b’i Gileyadi, abantu bamugira umugabisha wabo n’umukuru wo kubaganza; Yefuta asubira muri ya majambo yiwe yose imbere y’Uhoraho i Misipa.
Maze Yefuta atuma intumwa ku mwami w’Abamoni, muti Ngo Mupfa iki, gitumye umukūriye hasi, ukaza gutera igihugu ciwe?

Umwami w’Abamoni yishura intumwa za Yefuta, uti N’ukw Abisirayeli, bamaze kuva muri Egiputa, banyaze igihugu ciwe uhereye ku ruzi Arunoni ugashitsa kuri Yaboki no kuri Yorodani. Uti None rero, n’umusubize ivyo bihugu ku neza.
Yefuta yongera gutuma intumwa ku mwami w’Abamoni,
ziramubgira, ziti Yefuta ngw Abisirayeli si bo bānyaze igihugu c’i Mowabu cank’ igihugu c’Abamoni,
ut’ Arikw Abisirayeli, igihe bādūga bava muri Egiputa, bāciye mu bugaragwa bashika ku Kiyaga Gitukura; hanyuma bashika i Kadeshi.

Ut’ Abisirayeli baraheza batuma intumwa ku mwami wa Edomu kumwinginga ngw abareke bahite mu gihugu ciwe, arik’ umwami wa Edomu ntiyabakundira. Uti Batuma no ku mwami w’i Mowabu nk’uko nyene, na we nyene aranka. Uti Nukw Abisirayeli baguma i Kadeshi.

Uti Hanyuma baca mu bugaragwa, bagendana urubibe rw’igihugu ca Edomu n’ic’ i Mowabu, bashika ku ruhande rw’i burasirazuba rw’igihugu c’i Mowabu, basagaza hakurya ya Arunoni; ut’ Ariko ntibārenze urubibe rw’i Mowabu, uti Kuko Arunoni ari rwo rwar’ urubibe rwaho.
Uti Maz’ Abisirayeli batuma intumwa kuri Sihoni umwami w’Abamori yaba i Heshiboni, uti Kumwinginga ngw abareke bahite mu gihugu ciwe, baje mu cabo.
Ut’ Ariko Sihoni ntiyabashirwako ngw abareke bahite mu gihugu ciwe; ut’ Arikw akoranya ingabo ziwe zose, abategera i Yahasi, arabarwanya.
Uti Maz’ Uhoraho Imana y’ Abisirayeli agabura Sihoni n’ ingabo ziwe zose mu maboko y’Abisirayeli, barabatsinda. Uti Nukw Abisirayeli bashikīra igihugu cose c’Abamori bāba mur’ ico gihugu.
Bashikīra igihugu cose c’Abamori, uhereye kuri Arunoni ugashitsa kuri Yaboki, uhereye no mu bugaragwa ugashitsa kuri Yorodani.
Uti Non’ Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli, ko yasohoye Abamori ngo babise abantu biwe b’Abisirayeli, uti None ni wewe wohabāka?
Uti Non’ igihugu imana yawe Kemoshi yoguha, ntiwocegukira? Uti Na bo n’uko, igihugu Uhoraho Imana yabo yasohoyemwo bene co bose ngo bababise, bāracegukiye.
Uti Mbeg’ uraruta Balaki mwene Sipori umwami w’i Mowabu? Uti Har’ aho yigeze aja impaka n’Abisirayeli? Uti Har’ aho yarwanye na bo?

Ut’ Abisirayeli ko bamaze imyaka amajana atatu baba i Heshiboni no mu dusagara tuhakūkira, n’i Aroweri no mu dusagara tuhakūkira, no mu bisagara vyose vyo kuri Arunoni; uti None n’iki cababujije kubisubirana mur’ ico gihe cose?
Uti We nta co agukoreye, ni wewe umugiriye nabi k’uje kumutera. Ut’ Uhoraho Umucamanza uyu musi ni yerekane Abisirayeli n’Abamoni abatsinze ab’ ari bo.
Arik’ umwami w’Abamoni ntiyaruha yumva amajambo Yefuta yamutumyeko.
Maze Mpwemu w’Uhoraho aza kuri Yefuta, na we anyuranganya i Gileyadi no mu bg’aba Manase, aca i Misipe h’i Gileyadi, avay’ aragenda ngw aje mu Bamoni.
Maze Yefuta asezeranira Uhoraho isezerano, ati Ni wagabura Abamoni mu maboko yanje,
ngatabaruka amahoro mvuye kurwana na bo, ūzobanza gusohoka mu nzu yanje kunsanganira, azoba uwawe, Uhoraho, nanje nzomutanga kw ikimazi c’ukwoswa.
Nuko Yefuta ajabuka mu Bamoni, arabatera; Uhoraho abagabura mu maboko yiwe.
Arabatikiza uhereye i Aroweri ugashitsa i Miniti, atsinda ibisagara mirongwibiri, arinda ashitsa i Abeli‐keramimu; kaba agatikizo gakomeye. Uko ni kw Abamoni bāmazwe igabo n’Abisirayeli.

Maze Yefuta aratabaruka, aja i Misipa; ashitse i we, umwana wiwe w’umwigeme asohoka kumusanganira afise udushāko tw’ ingoma, arikw aratamba, atārīka. Kand’ uwo mwana wiwe yar’ ikinege: nta muhungu nta mwigeme wundi yar’ afise, atar’ uyo gusa.
Amubonye, yitantamurirakw impuzu ziwe, ati Mbonye ibara, mwana wanje! Urambabaje, ungiriye nabi! Kuko navyīkūriye mu kanwa, nkabibarira Uhoraho, none sinshobora kwivuguruza.
Aramwishura, ati Data, ko vyakwīvīriye mu kanwa ukabibarira Uhoraho, n’ungenze nk’uko wavuze; kazima Uhoraho yaguhaye kwīhōra abansi bawe b’Abamoni.
Kand’ abarira se, ati Mugabo har’ ico ngusaba: ube urandetse amezi abiri, ngende ku misozi, twe na bagenzi banje, ndirire ubukumi bganje.
Se aramwishura, ati Genda. Aramusezera ngw aje kumara amezi abiri. Ajana na bagenzi be, aririra ubukumi bgiwe mu misozi.
Maz’ amezi abiri ashize, agaruka kwa se, na we amugenza nk’ukw isezerano yasezeranye riri; kandi ntiyari yarīgeze kumenya icitwa umugabo. Bica biba umugenzo mu Bisirayeli, uk’ umwaka utashe:
abigeme b’Abisirayeli bama bagenda kwibuka uwo mukobga wa Yefuta w’Umugileyadi, bamuririra imisi ine mu mwaka mu mwaka.
Maz’ Abefurayimu barakorakorana, baja i burārūko, babaza Yefuta, bati N’iki catumye uja kurwana n’Abamoni, ntudutabaze? Tuzoguturirira mu nzu!
Yefuta arabishura, ati Twe n’abantu banje twari tugishāmiranye n’Abamoni, maze ngo ndabatabaze ntimwāza kudutabara ngo muturwanire.
Maze mbonye ko mwanse kudutabara nca nīrya uko ndi, ndajabuka ndwana n’ Abamoni, Uhoraho abagabura mu maboko yanje. None n’iki gitumye uyu musi muza kurwana nanje?

Maze Yefuta akoranya ingabo zose z’i Gileyadi, barwana n’Abefurayimu; Abagileyadi banesha Abefurayimu, barabica, kuko bavuze, bati Mur’ incīke z’ Abefurayimu, mwa Bagileyadi mwe, mwacitse ku Befurayimu no ku Bamanase!
Abagileyadi bazibira ivyambu vya Yorodani ngo batege Abefurayimu; maz’ ūcitse wo mu Befurayimu yahashika, ati Ndeka njabuke, Abagileyadi bakamubaza, bat’ Ur’ Umwefurayimu? Yavuga, at’ Oya!

bagaca bamubarira, bati None rero vuga Shiboleti. Na we akavuga, ati Siboleti; kukw adashobora kurishitsa neza; bagaca bamufata, bakamwicira aho nyene ku cambu ca Yorodani. Ico gihe hapfa Abefurayimu ibihumbi mirongwine na bibiri.
Nuko Yefuta amara imyaka itandatu ar’ umucamanza w’Abisirayeli. Maze Yefuta uwo Mugileyadi araheza arapfa, bamuhamba mu gisagara c’i wabo c’i Gileyadi.
Yefuta akurikirwa na Ibusani w’i Betelehemu, aba umucamanza w’Abisirayeli.

Yar’ afise abahungu mirongwitatu n’abakobga mirongwitatu; abo bakobga abashingira mu yindi miryango, asabira abahungu biwe abageni mirongwitatu nyene bavuye mu yindi miryango. Amara imyaka ndwi acira imanza Abisirayeli.
Ibusani araheza arapfa, bamuhamba i Betelehemu.
Akurikirwa na Eloni wo mu Bazebuloni, aba umucamanza w’ Abisirayeli; amara imyaka cumi abacira imanza.
Eloni uwo, wo mu Bazebuloni, araheza arapfa, bamuhamba i Ayaloni mu gihugu c’Abazebuloni.
Akurikirwa na Abudoni mwene Hileli w’Umunyapiratoni, na we acira imanza Abisirayeli.
Kandi yar’ afise abahungu mirongwine n’abuzukuru mirongwitatu, bāgendera ku ndogoba mirongwirindwi; amara imyaka munani acira imanza Abisirayeli.
Abudoni mwene Hileli w’ Umunyapiratoni araheza arapfa, bamuhamba i Piratoni nyene mu gihugu c’Abefurayimu, ku musozi Amaleki.
Maz’ Abisirayeli bongera gukora ivyo Uhoraho abona kw ari bibi; Uhoraho abatanga mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya kumara imyaka mirongwine.
Kandi hār’ umuntu w’i Sora wo mu muryango w’Abadani, yitwa Manowa. Umugore wiwe yar’ ingumba itigeze kuvyara.
Umumarayika w’Uhoraho yiyereka uwo mugore, aramubarira, ati Rāba ur’ ingumba, ntiwigeze kuvyara; arik’ uzosama inda, uvyare umwana w’umuhungu.
None rero, uz’ uzire akaziri ntunywe vino cank’ ikiboreza na kimwe, kandi ntuz’ urye ikintu na kimwe gihumanya;

kukw ehe rāba, ugiye gusama inda, uvyare umwana w’umuhungu; kandi ntihaze hagire urupfuhe rumugera ku mutwe; kuk’ uwo mwana azoba Umunaziri ku Mana uhereye akiva mu nda; kandi ni we azotangura kurokora Abisirayeli, abakūre mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya.

Uwo mugore aragenda, abibarira umugabo wiwe, at’ Umuntu w’Imana yaje aho ndi; kandi mu maso hiwe hāsa n’ah’ umumarayika w’Imana, kandi hateye ubgoba cane. Ariko sinamubajije iy’ avuye, na we ntiyambgiye izina ryiwe.

Ariko yambariye ngo nzosama inda, mvyare umuhungu; kandi ngo none nze nzire akaziri sinze nnywe vino cank’ ikiboreza na kimwe canke ngo ndye ikintu na kimwe gihumanya, ngo kuk’ uwo mwana azoba Umunaziri ku Mana uhereye akiva mu nda ngo gushitsa ku musi azopfirako.
Maze Manowa yinginga Uhoraho, ati Bgirukiro, ndakwinginze, wa muntu wawe wadutumako ni yongere agaruke kuri twebge, atubarire uko tuzogenza uwo mwana azovuka.
Nukw Imana yemerera Manowa; maz’ uwo mumarayika w’Imana asubira kugaruka aho wa mugore ari, amusanga aho yari yicaye mu murima; ariko Manowa umugabo wiwe ntiyari kumwe na we.
Nuk’ uwo mugore aca aranyaruka, arirukanga, abibgira umugabo wiwe, ati Wa muntu yaza bga bundi yongeye kunyiyereka.
Maze Manowa ava hasi, akurikira umugore wiwe; ashikiriye uwo muntu aramubaza, ati Mbega ni wewe wavuganye n’uyu mugore? Na we ati Ni jewe.
Manowa aramubaza, at’ Ivyo wavuze ni vyashika, uwo mwana tuzomurera dute? Azokora iki?
Uwo mumarayika w’Uhoraho yishura Manowa, at’ Ivyo nabariye uyu mugore vyose, az’ avyirinde:
ntaz’ arye ku kintu na kimwe kivuye ku muzabibu, ntaz’ anywe vino cank’ ikiboreza na kimwe, canke ngw arye ikintu na kimwe gihumanya; ivyo namubariye vyose az’ avyitondere.
Maze Manowa abarira uwo mumarayika w’Uhoraho, ati Ndakwinginze, banza uhagarare, tukubāgire agasuguru.

Uwo mumarayika w’Uhoraho aramwishura, ati Nah’ umpagaritse nta co ndiburye ku vyo kurya vyawe; ariko namb’ ugomba kubāga ikimazi co kwosa, ugishikanire Uhoraho. Ariko Manowa ntiyaribgamenye kw ar’ umumarayika w’Uhoraho.
Maze Manowa abaza uwo mumarayika w’Uhoraho, ati Witwa nde, kugira ngw ivyo wavuze ni vyashika tuze tugushemagize?
Uwo mumarayika w’Uhoraho aramwishura, at’ Umbariza iki izina ryanje, kw ar’ izina ritangaje?
Nuko Manowa yābīra iyo suguru y’impene n’ishikanwa ry’ifu, abishikanirira Uhoraho hejuru ku gitandara; haca haba igitangaza, Manowa n’umugore wiwe babirorēra:
umuriro wo ku gicaniro ukiriko urarabagiza uja hejuru, wa mumarayika w’Uhoraho adūga mur’ uwo muriro wo ku gicaniro, Manowa n’umugore wiwe babirorēra; baca barapfukama, barūnama.
Kuva ubgo, uwo mumarayika w’Uhoraho ntiyongeye kwiyereka Manowa cank’ umugore wiwe ukundi. Nuko Manowa amenya kw ar’ umumarayika w’Uhoraho.
Maze Manowa abarira umugore wiwe, ati Nta kabuza turapfuye, kuko tubonye Imana!

Arik’ umugore wiwe aramwishura, at’ Iyaba Uhoraho yagomba kutwica, ntaba yātwākīriye ikimazi cacu coshejwe bo n’ishikanwa ryacu ry’ifu, kandi ntaba yātweretse ivyo vyose, canke ngw atubarire amajambo ameze nk’ayo.
Hanyuma uwo mugore avyara umwana w’umuhungu, amwita Samusoni; uwo mwana arakura, Uhoraho amuha umugisha.
Maze Mpwemu w’Uhoraho atangura kumucānīra ar’ i Mahane‐dani, hagati y’i Sora n’i Eshitayoli.
Samusoni aramanuka aja i Timuna; abonay’ umwigeme wo mu Bafilisitiyakazi.
Maz’ aradūga, abarira se na nyina, ati Nabonye umwigeme i Timuna w’Umufilisitiyakazi: none ni mumunsabire.

Se na nyina baramwishura, bati Mbega nta mwigeme n’umwe ari mu b’i wanyu canke mu b’iki gihugu, igitumye uja gusaba umugeni mu Bafilisitiya batākebge? Ariko Samusoni yishura se, ati Nsabira uyo, kukw ari we nagomwe.
Ariko se na nyina ntibāri bāzi ko bivuye k’Uhoraho; kuko yarondera inyanduruko ku Bafilisitiya. Kand’ ico gihe Abafilisitiya ni bo bāganza Abisirayeli.
Hanyuma Samusoni amanukana na se na nyina, baja i Timuna; ashitse mu mizabibu yaho, ahūra n’umugunza w’intambge, iramutontomera.
Maze Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho amuzako akābushungwe, arayitabagura nk’uwotabagura umwagazi w’impene, kandi yar’ imbokoboko. Ariko ntiyabgira se canke nyina ico akoze.
Araheza aramanuka, ayāga n’uwo mwigeme, yumva amuhimbaye.
Bukeye asubiyeyo kurongora, akebereza ha handi kurāba wa muvyimba w’intambge; asanga ikirangara, inzuki zakiremeyemwo ziri n’ubūki.
Arabuhakura, abushira mu minwe, agenda araburya; ashikiriye se na nyina, abubahako, na bo baraburya; ariko ntiyababgira kw abukūye mu kirangara c’intambge.
Se amanutse i wabo w’uwo mwigeme, Samusoni arondeza amazimano y’ubukwe, kukw abasore ari wo war’ umugenzo wabo.
Bamubonye, bamuzanira abagenzi mirongwitatu ngo babe baragumanye na we.

Maze Samusoni arababgira, ati Hinge mbasōkōze igisōkōranyo; ni mwashobora kugipfīndūra, mukakinsobanurira, iyi misi ndwi yo kuba mu nkinga itarashira, nzoheza mbahe imikenyero yera mirongwitatu n’ impuzu zo gukūranya mirongwitatu nyene;
ariko ni cabananira, ni mwebge muzompa imikenyero yera mirongwitatu n’impuzu zo gukūranya mirongwitatu nyene. Baramwishura, bati Dusōkōze, twumve igisōkōranyo cawe.
Arababgira, ati Mu muryi hāvuyemw’ ivyo kurya, Mu munyenkomezi hāvuyemw’ ibisōsa. Bamara imisi itatu bananiwe kugisobanura.
Maze ku musi ugira kane babarira muka Samusoni, bati Genda uhendahende umugabo wawe, udusobanurize ico gisōkōranyo, ntiduhave tuza tukaguturirana n’urugo rwa so. Mbega mwaduhamagariye kunyaga utwacu?

Nuko muka Samusoni amuririra imbere, aramubarira, at’ Ereg’ uranyanka gusa, ntunkunda; ko wasōkōje ab’i wacu igisōkōranyo, ntukimbarire. Aramwishura, at’ Erega na data na mama sinakibabariye, none nokibarira wewe?
Arangiza iyo misi ndwi bari mu nkinga amuririra imbere; maze ku musi ugira indwi arakimubarira, kuko yamujigirije: na we aca abarira ab’i wabo ico gisōkōranyo.

Maze kur’ uwo musi ugira indwi nyene, izuba ritararenga, abo mu gisagara baramubarira, bati N’iki corusha ubūki gusōsa? canke n’iki corusha intambge inkomezi? Na we arabishura, at’ Iyaba mutarimishije inka yanje, Ntimuba mupfīndūye igisōkōranyo canje!

Maze Mpwemu w’Uhoraho amuzako akābushungwe, aramanuka aja i Ashikeloni, yicayo abantu mirongwitatu, abakoba imyambaro yabo, aha bamwe bāpfīndūye ca gisōkōranyo imyambaro yo gukūranya. Araheza arīvumbura, adūga kwa se asuguriwe.
Ariko muka Samusoni bamuha umwe wo muri ba bandi bagenzi ba Samusoni, uwo yari yātoye kuba mukuru.

Maz’ igihe gihise, hageze mw igenya ry’ingano, Samusoni asubira iy’ umugore ari, ajanye agasuguru k’impene. Aravuga, ati Hinge nje iy’ umugore wanje ari, haruguru; ariko sebukwe ntiyamukundira kujayo.
Aramubgira, at’ Erega nagira ngo waramwanse rwose; ni co catumye ndamuha umwe muri bagenzi bawe. Mbega murumuna we si we anamurusha ubgiza? Enda mujane mu gishingo ciwe.
Samusoni arababgira, at’ Ubu ho nta kizombako ku vy’Abafilisitiya, ni naramuka ndabagiriye nabi.
Nuko Samusoni aragenda afata imbgebge amajana atatu, ahambira ivyatsi vyo gukongerezak’ umuriro; araheza izo mbgebge azitumberanya imirizo, agenda abohera ivyo vyatsi ku mirizo ibiri‐ibiri.
Amaze kudomeka ivyo vyatsi, azirekurira mu mirima y’ingano z’Abafilisitiya; uwo muriro ugenda uratōngōra kuva ku mikama itēkeye no ku ngano zigihagaze gushitsa no ku mirima y’imyelayo.

Maz’ Abafilisitiya barabaza, bati Ni nde yakoze ivyo? Bati Ni Samusoni, umukwe wa wa Munyatimuna, kuko yamwātse umugore wiwe akamushingira uwundi. Nukw Abafilisitiya baca baradūga, uwo mugore bamuturirana na se.
Maze Samusoni arababarira, ati Ko mukoze murtyo, sinzogenda ntabīhōye! Ariko ni naheza kubīhōra nzorekeraho.
Aca arabahindikiranya, arabatikiza bikomeye; araheza aramanuka, aja kuba mu gihoro co mu gitandara c’ahitwa Etamu.
Maz’ Abafilisitiya baradūga, basagaza mu Buyuda, baragandagaza, barinda bashika i Lehi.
Ab’i Buyuda barababaza, bati N’iki kibazanye kudutera? Barabishura, bati Tuzanywe no gufata Samusoni ngo tumubohe, tumugirire nk’ivyo yatugiriye.

Maz’ abantu b’i Buyuda ibihumbi bitatu baca baramanuka, basanga Samusoni muri ca gihoro co mu gitandara c’ahitwa Etamu; baramubaza, bati Mbega ntuzi yukw Abafilisitiya ari bo batuganza? Non’ ivyo udukoreye n’ibiki? Arabishura, at’ Erega kwar’ ukubasubiriza mu nkōko ivyo bāngiriye.
Baramwishura, bat’ Ikituzanye n’ukugufata ngo tukubohe, tugutange mu maboko y’ Abafilisitiya. Samusoni arabishura, ati Ni mundahire ko mutanyica mwebge ubganyu.
Baramwishura, bat’ Oya, turakuboha gusa, tubagushikirize, ariko twebge ubgacu ntitukwica. Nuko bamubohesha imigozi misha ibiri, bamukūra mur’ ico gitandara baramudūgana.

Ashitse i Lehi, Abafilisitiya bamusanganiza urwamo. Maze Mpwemu w’Uhoraho amuzako akābushūngwe, imigozi yar’ imuboshe amaboko ihinduka nk’ubugwēgwe bufashwe n’umuriro; ivyari bimuboshe ku bikonjo biravutagurika.
Abona urwāsaya rw’indogoba rutarūma, atuma ukuboko araruraha, arwicisha abantu igihumbi.
Maze Samusoni aravuga, at’ Urwāsaya rw’indogoba ndarurundishije ibirundo n’ ibirundo, Urwāsaya rw’indogoba ndarwicishije abantu igihumbi!
Ahejeje kuvuga artyo, ashibura rwa rwāsaya yar’ afise mu minwe; aho hantu haca hitwa Ramati‐lehi.
Agwa umwūmwa, atakambira Uhoraho, ati Jewe umusavyi wawe ko wampaye uku kunesha gukomeye, none nicwe n’inyota, ngwe mu maboko y’ abatākebge?
Maz’ ikinogo car’ i Lehi Imana iragisatura, amazi aradudubiza; nukw amaze kunywa, udutege turagaruka, arahēmbūka. Ni co catumye bacita Eni‐hakore: kiracar’ i Lehi na bugingo n’ubu.
Nukw amara imyaka mirongwibiri acira imanza Abisirayeli, mu gihe c’Abafilisitiya.
Maze Samusoni aja i Gaza, abonayo maraya, yinjira i we.
Babarira ab’i Gaza, bati Samusoni ashitse hano. Baramuryamira, barāra bamutegeye kw irembo ry’igisagara, bakēsha ijoro ryose banumye, bati Tubanze turorēre buce, duheze tumwice.

Ariko Samusoni ariryamira gushitsa mu gicugu; hageze mu gicugu aravyuka, afata inzugi z’ irembo ry’igisagara, n’ibikingi vyompi vy’irembo, abishingūra vyose hamwe n’igihindizo cavyo, abita ku bitugu, abidūgana ku mpinga y’umusozi urābana n’i Heburoni.
Hanyuma y’ivyo agomwa umugore yitwa Delila, yaba ku mwonga Soreki.

Maz’ abaganwa b’ Abafilisitiya baja iy’ uwo mugore ari, baramubarira, bati Genda umuhendahende, umenye ah’ inkomezi ziwe nyinshi ziva, n’uburyo twomushobora, kugira ngo tubone kumuboha, tumumare amanyama; nawe tuzoguha amafeza, umuntu wese igihumbi n’ ijana.
Nuko Delila abarira Samusoni, ati Ndakwinginze, mbarira ah’ inkomezi zawe nyinshi ziva, n’icoshobora kukuboha, ugashira amanyama.
Samusoni aramwishura, at’ Abombohesha imvuto ndwi zikiri mbisi zitarūma, noca mpinduka goyigoyi, nkamera nk’abandi.
Maz’ abo baganwa b’Abafilisitiya bazanira uwo mugore imvuto ndwi zikiri mbisi zitarūma, arazimubohesha.

Kand’ uwo mugore yar’ afise abantu babunze mu cumba c’imbere mu nzu; nukw aramubarira, ati Ngaho Samusoni, Abafilisitiya baragushikiriye! Arikw acagagura izo mvuto, nk’uk’ ubugwēgwe bucika bgumvise umuriro. Nukw inkomezi ziwe ntizamenyekana aho ziva.
Maze Delila abarira Samusoni, at’ Ereg’ urampenze, umbariye ibinyoma! Enda se, ndakwinginze, mbarira icoshobora kukuboha.
Aramwishura, ati Bombohesha imigozi misha itigeze gukoreshwa, noca mpinduka goyigoyi, nkamera nk’abandi.

Nuko Delila yābīra imigozi misha, arayimubohesha, aramubarira, ati Ngaho Samusoni, Abafilisitiya baragushikiriye! Kand’ abāmubundiye bāri mu cumba c’imbere mu nzu. Maze Samusoni aca acagagura iyo migozi imuboshe amaboko, nk’ūcagagura inyuzi.

Delila abarira Samusoni, ati Na non’ uracampenda, umbarira ibinyoma gusa! Ntabara umbarire icoshobora kukuboha. Aramwishura, at’ Ibitsibo ndwi vy’ umushatsi wanje wobijishira ku kijisha impuzu, vyoshoboka.
Nukw arabijisha, abigumisha urumambo, maz’ aramubarira, ati Ngaho Samusoni, Abafilisitiya baragushikiriye! Aca arakanguka, ashikura urwo rumambo rw’inshingiro hamwe n’ikijishirwakw impuzu.
Delila aramubarira, ati Wokagize ng’ Urankunda, kand’ ufise ivyo unkinga! Eh’ umpenze aka gatatu kose, wanka kumbarira ah’ inkomezi zawe nyinshi ziva.
Maz’ akomeje kumuzigiriza imisi yose, amukubakuba, abona kw atakimucanan’ uwāka.

Nukw amumenera impuri rwose, aramubarira, ati Nta rupfuhe rwigeze kugera ku mutwe wanje, kuko nabaye Umunaziri w’Imana uhereye nkiva mu nda ya mama; nomobga, inkomezi zanje zoca zimvako, ngahinduka goyigoyi, nkamera nk’abandi bose.

Nuko Delila abonye kw amumeneye impuri rwose, atuma guhamagaza ba baganwa b’Abafilisitiya, uti Ni mudūge iri rimwe gusa, uti Kuko yamumeneye impuri. Nukw abo baganwa b’Abafilisitiya baza iy’ ari, bāzanye ya mafeza.
Maze Delila amusinziriza ku bibero vyiwe; araheza ahamagara umuntu, amumwa vya bitsibo ndwi vy’umushatsi. Atangura guhinduka goyigoyi, inkomezi ziwe zimuvako.
Maz’ aramubarira, ati Ngaho Samusoni, Abafilisitiya baragushikiriye! Aca arakanguka, agira ngw arabakira nk’uko yahora, abīkunkumure. Ariko ntiyar’ azi yuk’ Uhoraho yamuretse.
Maz’ Abafilisitiya baramufata, bamunogora amaso, bamumanukana i Gaza, bamufatisha iminyororo y’imiringa, bamugira umusyi mu nzu y’imbohe.
Ariko naho bamumoye, umushatsi wiwe utangura gusubira kumera.
Hanyuma abaganwa b’Abafilisitiya bakoranira gutanga ibimazi vyinshi babiha Dagoni imana yabo no kunezerwa, kuko bāvuga, bat’ Imana yacu yagabuye umwansi wacu Samusoni mu maboko yacu.
Nukw abantu bamubonye batāzīra iyo mana yabo, bat’ Imana yacu yagabuye umwansi wacu mu maboko yacu, ari we yar’ umuranduzi w’igihugu cacu, yishe benshi muri twebge.

Maze bacuzuye umunezero, baravuga, bati Ni muhamagare Samusoni, tube turamwitwengera. Nuko baja guhamagara Samusoni, bamukūra mu nzu y’imbohe; ashitse imbere yabo baramwitwengera. Bamuhagarika hagati y’inkingi;
maze Samusoni abarira umuhungu yar’ amufashe ukuboko, ati Njana numve ah’ inkingi ziri ziteze iyi nzu, mbe ndazegamiye.
Kand’ iyo nzu yari yuzuye abagabo n’abagore, n’abaganwa bose b’Abafilisitiya ni ho bāri bari; kandi no hejuru ku nzu hār’ abagabo n’abagore nk’ibihumbi bitatu, bāriko bararorēra bamwitwengera.
Maze Samusoni atakambira Uhoraho, at’ Ewe Mwami Uhoraho, ndakwinginze nyibuka, umpe se inkomezi iri rimwe gusa, Mana, nsubirize Abafilisitiya mu nkōko aka kanya gusa, mpōre amaso yanje yompi.
Nuko Samusoni afata izo nkingi zompi zo hagati ziteze inzu, arazegamira, ukuboko kw’i buryo gufata imwe, ukw’ i bumoso iyindi.

Maz’ aravuga, ati Reka mpfane n’Abafilisitiya. Araheza arīkōngānya n’inkomezi ziwe zose, arazishika, inzu ihomvokera kuri ba baganwa no ku bantu bose bari muri yo. Nukw abo yishe mu gupfa kwiwe bāruta abo yishe akiriho.

Maz’ ab’i wabo n’abo kwa se bose baramanuka, bajana ikiziga ciwe, barakidūgana, bamuhamba hagati y’i Sora n’i Eshitayoli, ahantu aho se Manowa yahambge. Kandi Samusoni yar’ amaze imyaka mirongwibiri acira imanza Abisirayeli.
Kandi hār’ umuntu wo mu mugamba w’Abefurayimu yitwa Mika.
Abarira nyina, ati Za shekeli z’ifeza igihumbi n’ijana wari wibge, nkumva uvumana, ni jewe nazitwaye, ndazifise. Nyina aravuga, at’ Uragahezagirwa n’ Uhoraho, mwana wanje!

Nukw asubiza nyina izo shekeli z’ ifeza igihumbi n’ijana; nyina aravuga, at’ Izi feza ndazēguriye Uhoraho ngo zibe izera, kugira ng’ uzironderemw’ igishushanyo kibājwe n’igishushanyo kivugutiye mu nkero, mwana wanje: none rero ndaziguhaye.
Nukw amaze gusubiza nyina izo feza, nyina ahitanamw’ amajana abiri, aziha umucuzi, azikūramw’ igishushanyo kibājwe n’igishushanyo kivugutiye mu nkero; babishira mu nzu ya Mika.
Uwo mugabo Mika yar’ afise akanyabugoro k’ibigirwamana; arondeza umwambaro witwa efodi na terafimu, yirobanurira umwe mu bahungu biwe ngw amubere umuherezi.
Mur’ iyo misi Abisirayeli nta mwami bāribgagire: umuntu wese yakora ico yigombeye.
Kandi hārih’ umusore w’i Betelehemu h’i Buyuda wo mu muryango wa Yuda w’Umulewi, yari yaje ngaho.
Yari yaravuye mur’ ico gisagara c’i Betelehemu h’i Buyuda, aja kurondera ah’ aba; akirikw arāngāra mu mugamba w’Abefurayimu aserukira ku rugo rwa Mika.
Mika aramubaza, at’ Uva hehe? Aramwishura, ati Nd’ Umulewi w’i Betelehemu h’i Buyuda: ngenda ndondera aho mba.
Mika aramwishura, at’ Igumire ngaha i wanje, umbere umuvyeyi umbere n’umuherezi, nanje nzoguhemba shekeli cumi mu mwaka, n’impuzu n’ivyo kurya. Nuk’ uwo Mulewi aca arinjira,
yemera kubana na we; uwo musore amuhindukira nk’ umwe mu bana biwe.
Nuko Mika arobanura uwo Mulewi, ahinduka umuherezi wiwe, yībēra mu rugo rwiwe.
Maze Mika aravuga, ati Noneho mmenye yuk’ Uhoraho azongirira neza, kuko mfise Umulewi k’umuherezi.

Mur’ ico gihe Abisirayeli nta mwami bāribgagire. Kand’ ico gihe umuryango w’Abadani warik’ urironderera ishamvu yo kubamwo, kuko kugeza ico gihe ata shamvu bāribgaronke mu miryango yindi y’Abisirayeli.

Nukw Abadani batora mu muryango wabo wose abantu batanu barīndūka, bava i Sora n’i Eshitayoli, babatuma kuja gutata igihugu no kugisuzuma; barababarira, bati Ni mugende musuzume ico gihugu uko kimeze. Nuko baragenda, bīhēreza umugamba w’Abefurayimu, bashika ku rugo rwa Mika, ngw abe ari ho barāra.
Bacegereje kwa Mika, bamenya ijwi rya wa musore w’Umulewi, bakeberezayo, baramubaza, bati Ni nde yakuzanye ino? Ukora iki hano, kand’ uhatungiwe n’iki?
Abadōndera uko Mika amutunze kwose, at’ Arampemba, nanje nd’ umuherezi wiwe.
Baramubarira, bat’ Enda se tubarize Imana, tumenye ko tuzogira amahirwe mu rugendo rwacu.
Uwo muherezi arabishura, ati Ni mugende uburarame: Uhoraho arabaragira mu rugendo rwanyu.

Nukw abo bantu ukw ari batanu baragenda, bashika i Layishi, bitegereza abantu baho, babona ingene bīrāye nk’ukw ab’ i Sidoni basanzwe bamera, bitekerereje ata co bīnona, ata co babuze mur’ ico gihugu, bifitiye ubutunzi; babona n’ingene baba kure y’ab’i Sidoni, n’ingene batifatanya n’umuntu wundi n’umwe.
Nukw abo batasi bahindukiye mu b’i wabo i Sora n’i Eshitayoli, barababaza, bati Muzanye inkuru ki?
Barabishura, bati Ni mukūre hasi tuje kubatera, kuko twitegereje igihugu, kandi ni ciza cane. None mwopfa kwiyicarira ngaho? Ntimutebagane kuja kwinjira ico gihugu ngo mucegukire.
Nuko ni mwagenda, muzosanga abantu bīrāye; ico gihugu kirāgutse, kand’ Imana yakigabuye mu maboko yanyu. N’ahantu hadakennye ikintu na kimwe kiba mw isi.
Nukw abantu bo mu muryango wa Dani bashika ku majana atandatu barahaguruka, bava i Sora n’i Eshitayoli, bitwaje ibirwanishwa;
baradūga, basagaza kuri Kiriyati‐yeyarimu i Buyuda. Ni co catumye aho hantu bahīta Mahane‐dani na bugingo n’ubu; hār’ ahahera i burengerazuba bg’i Kiriyati‐yeyarimu.
Bavudukayo baca mu mugamba w’ Abefurayimu, baca kwa Mika.

Maze ba bandi ukw ari batanu bāri baragiye gutata igihugu c’i Layishi, babgira bagenzi babo, bati Harya murazi ko mur’ uru rugo harimwo efodi na terafimu n’igishushanyo kibājwe n’igishushanyo kivugutiye mu nkero? None rero ni mwiyumvire ico mwokora.
Bakeberezaho, bashika mu nzu ya wa musore w’ Umulewi mu rugo rwa Mika, baramuramutsa;
ba bandi ukw ar’ amajana atandatu bo mu Badani bari bahagaze kw irembo, bitwaje ibirwanishwa vyabo.

Nuko bano ukw ari batanu bāri baratase ico gihugu, ni kwo kudūga bakinjira mu nzu, bagasahura ico gishushanyo kibājwe na efodi na terafimu na ca gishushanyo kivugutiye mu nkero; arik’ uwo muherezi yar’ ahagaze kw irembo hamwe n’abo bantu ukw ar’ amajana atandatu bitwaje ibirwanishwa.
Nukw abo bamaze kwinjira mu nzu ya Mika, no gusahura ico gishushanyo kibājwe na efodi na terafimu na ca gishushanyo kivugutiye mu nkero, uwo muherezi arababaza, ati Mbeg’ ivyo mugira n’ibiki?

Baramwishura, bat’ Ihorere ni winumire: uz’ ujane natwe, utubere umuvyeyi n’umuherezi. Mbeg’ ugira ngw iciza n’uko woba umuherezi w’urugo rumwe kuruta uko woba umuherezi w’inzu yose, ari wo muryango umwe wo mu miryango y’Abisirayeli?
Nuk’ uwo muherezi agira akanyamuneza mu mutima, ajana efodi na terafimu na ca gishushanyo kibājwe, agenda acagatiwe n’abo bantu.
Nuko barakebānuka, baragenda, bimiriza abana n’ivyo bashoreye n’intēkera zabo.
Bagenze nk’ikirēre bavuye kwa Mika, abo mu mihana ihereranye na Mika baratabara, baseseka ku Badani;
babatera akāmo; Abadani barakebuka, babaza Mika, bati Mbega n’ibiki, k’uzananye n’ ingabo?
Arabishura, ati Ko munsahuye imana zanje nironkeye, n’umuherezi wanje, mukīgīra mugasiga munyogeje, none murambaza, muti N’ibiki?
Abadani baramwishura, bati Ntusubire kudusemerera inyuma, bamwe muri twebge bohava bashangashirwa, bakabagwako, bakakwicana n’abo mu rugo rwawe!
Nukw Abadani baca bīgīra; maze Mika abonye kw atobashobora, arahindukira asubira i we.
Nukw Abadani ni kwo gutwara ivyo Mika yari yarironkeye, bo n’umuherezi yar’ afise, bashika i Layishi, mu bantu bitekerereje ata co bīnona, babīcisha inkota, baturira n’igisagara cabo.

Kandi ntihāgira gitabara, kuko hāri kure y’i Sidoni, kand’ abaho ntibāri bīfatanije n’umuntu wundi n’ umwe. Aho hantu hāri mu kiyaya gihereranye n’i Beti‐rehobu. Maz’ Abadani basanura ico gisagara, bakibamwo.
Bacita Dani, bacitiranije na sekuruza wabo Dani mwene Isirayeli; arik’ ubga mbere ico gisagara citwa Layishi.

Maz’ Abadani bīshingira ca gishushanyo kibājwe; kandi Yonatani mwene Gerushomu, Gerushomu wa Mose, ni we yabaye umuherezi w’umuryango w’Abadani, bo n’uruvyaro rwiwe, gushitsa igihe abo mu gihugu bajanywe kw inyagano.
Nukw ico gishushanyo kibājwe bāshinze, ico Mika yari yarironkeye, kiguma ngaho kumara igihe cose inzu y’ Imana yamaze i Shilo.
Maz’ ico gihe, Abisirayeli bataragira umwami, hār’ Umulewi yari yaracīkiye mu mugamba w’Abefurayimu wo hirya, yari yābiriye umugore ava i Betelehemu h’i Buyuda.
Bukeye umugore wiwe amucumurako, arasambana, arāhukana, aja kwa se i Betelehemu h’i Buyuda; amaray’ igihe nk’amezi ane.

Bukeye umugabo wiwe arīkora, aramukurikira, kugira ngw amuhōyahōye, amugarukane; ajana n’ umuntu wiwe n’indogoba zibiri; ashitse i wabo w’uwo mugore, se wa nya mugore amubonye, aza kumusanganira anezerewe.
Maze sebukwe, se wa nya mugore, aramusīvya, amarana na we imisi itatu, barya, banywa, ari ho barāra.
Ku musi ugira kane bavyutse kare, arīkora ngw agende. Se wa nya mugore abarira uwo mukwe wiwe, ati Banza wābīre utw’ utamira, uhēmbūre umutima, mubone kugenda.
Nuko bompi baca baricara, bararya, baranywa, kugeza se wa nya mugore amubariye, at’ Enda se subira urāre hano, ube urījandajandira.
Arik’ uwo mugabo arahaguruka ngw agende; sebukwe aramwinginga, arongera ararāra.
Ku musi ugira gatanu azinduka kare ngw agende. Se wa nya mugore aravuga, at’ Enda banza wihēmbūre! Ba muraguma hano gushitsa umusi ukuze. Nuko bompi bararya.

Uwo mugabo araheza ava hasi ngw agende, bo n’umugore wiwe n’umuntu wiwe; maze sebukwe, se w’uwo mugore, aramubarira, at’ Ehe burije, ndabinginze murāre hano iri joro; rāba bgāhinnye: kīnja hano wījandajandire! Ejo uz’ uhenge mu gatwenzi, wifatire inzira, utahe.
Arik’ uwo mugabo ntiyemera kurāra; arīkora, aragenda, ashika aharābana n’i Yebusi, ari ho Yerusalemu; kandi yar’ afise indogoba zibiri zirikw amatandiko, n’umugore wiwe bari kumwe.
Kandi bāshitse hafi y’i Yebusi buriko buragoroba. Wa muntu abgira shebuja, at’ Enda ngo dukevye, twāke indāro muri kirya gisagara c’Abayebusi.
Ariko shebuja aramubarira, ati Ntitwokevya ngo tuje mu gisagara c’abanyamahanga kitar’ ic’ Abisirayeli; ariko ngo tujabuke dufate i Gibeya.
Yongera abarira uwo muntu wiwe, at’ Enda tuje mu gisagara kimwe muri biriya, twāke indāro i Gibeya cank’ i Rama.
Nuko bararamiriza, izuba ricokera bashitse hafi y’i Gibeya h’Ababenyamini.
Bakeberezayo, baja kwāka indāro i Gibeya. Ashitseyo, apfa kwicara mu kibuga co mur’ ico gisagara, kukw ata wemeye kubaha indāro.
Maze haza umutāma avuye mu murima gukora buhwibiriye; kand’ uwo muntu yahora mu mugamba w’Abefurayimu, acīkira i Gibeya, arikw abo mur’ ico gisagara bār’ Ababenyamini.
Yunamuye amaso, abona umuntu w’ingenzi ari ngaho mu kibuga co mur’ ico gisagara. Uwo mutāma aramubaza, at’ Uva hehe, ukaja he?
Aramwishura, ati Tuvuye i Betelehemu h’i Buyuda, tuja mu mugamba w’Abefurayimu wo hirya, iyo naturutse; nari nagiye i Betelehemu h’i Buyuda, none ndatashe; kandi mbuze umuntu yompa indāro,
naho nari nīfitiye ivyarire vy’indogoba zacu n’ivyo kurya vyazo, bo n’ivyo kurya vya twe n’uyu mugore n’uyu muhungu turi kumwe: nta co tubuze na mba.
Uwo mutāma aramwishura, ati Ruhuka, gira amahoro: ivy’ ugomba vyose ndabikugirira; mugabo ntimushobora kurāra ku musozi.
Nukw abajana i we, agaburira izo ndogoba; nuko bamaze kwoga ibirenge, bararya baranywa.

Bakiriko barījandajandira, haza abanyagisagara b’abanyangeso mbi, bakikiza iyo nzu impande zose, bakubitagura ku rugi, babarira uwo mutāma nyen’ urugo, bati Sohora uwo mugabo yinjiye i wawe, tumwonone.
Uwo mugabo nyen’ urugo arasohoka, arababarira, ati Sigaho bagenzi banje, ndabinginze, ntimukore icaha kingana girtyo; kuk’ uyu mugabo aje mu nzu yanje: ntimukore ikizira kingana girtyo!
Rāba harih’ umwigeme wanje w’inkumi n’umugore w’uyo mugabo: hinge ndababasohorere, abe ari bo mwonona, mubagenze uko mugomba kwose; arik’ uwo mugabo mwoye kumukorakw ikizira kingana girtyo.
Arikw abo bagabo banka kumwumvira; nuk’ uwo mushitsi afata umugore wiwe, aramubahereza; barārana na we baramwonona bakēsha ijoro; umutwenzi utambitse, baramurekura.
Nuko mu mutwenzi nya mugore araza, ahenukira imbere y’umuryango w’inzu y’uwo mutāma, ah’ umugabo wiwe ari, burinda buca ari ngaho.
Maz’ umugabo wiwe mu gatondo aravyuka, yugurura urugi rw’inzu, arasohoka agira ngw agende. Asanga uwo mugore wiwe arambaraye imbere y’umuryango w’inzu, ibiganza vyiwe biri mu rwinjiriro.
Aramubarira, ati Vyuka, tugende; ariko ntiyakakaza. Nukw aramuterura, amurambika ku ndogoba; uwo mugabo ni kwo guca yitahira.
Ashitse i we, ahitana imbugita, afata umuvyimba w’uyo mugore wiwe, awuhimbaguramw’ ibihimba cumi na bibiri, acīra mu ngingo mu ngingo, abirungika mu bihugu vyose vy’Abisirayeli.

Maz’ ababibonye bose baravuga, bat’ Ikintu kimeze girtyo nticīgeze gukorwa canke kuboneka, uhereye ku musi Abisirayeli bādūgiye bava mu gihugu ca Egiputa kugeza uyu musi! Nuko ni muvyiyumvire, mubije inama, mugire ico muvuga!
Maz’ Abisirayeli bose baragenda, bava mu gihugu cose uhereye i Dani ugashitsa i Beri‐sheba, hamwe n’abo mu gihugu c’i Gileyadi, bakoranira i Misipa imbere y’Uhoraho, bahūje inama nk’umuntu umwe.
Maz’ abakuru bo mu bantu bose b’imiryango yose y’Abisirayeli bava hasi mw ikoraniro ry’abantu b’Imana, ryakoranye ar’ ingabo ibihumbi amajana ane zizi kurwanisha inkota.
(Kand’ Ababenyamini bari bumvise kw Abisirayeli badūze i Misipa.) Maz’ Abisirayeli barabaza, bati Tubarire ukw ico caha cakozwe.
Wa Mulewi, umugabo wa wa mugore yishwe, arabishura, ati Nashitse i Gibeya h’i Bubenyamini, mpāka indāro ndi kumwe n’umugore wanje.
Maz’ abagabo b’i Gibeya bahenga mw ijoro barantera, bakikiza inzu narimwo; jewe bāgomba kunyica, kand’ umugore wanje baramwonona, arapfa.
Ndaheza ndamufata, mmuhimbaguramw’ ibihimba, mbirungika mu gihugu cose c’ishamvu y’Abisirayeli, kuko bākoze igiteye isoni c’ubuyobe mu Bisirayeli.
None rero yemwe Bisirayeli mwese, ni murondere inama y’ivyo, mubijekw ingingo!
Maz’ abantu bose bavira hasi icarimwe, bati Nta muntu n’umwe muri twebge azosubira i muhira canke ngw atahe i we;
arikw ico dukwiye kugirira i Gibeya n’ ukuhatera, nk’uk’ ubupfindo buzotwereka.

Kandi tuzogenda dutora abantu, mw ijana tuhakūra cumi, mu gihumbi tuhakūra ijana, mu bihumbi cumi tuhakūra igihumbi, duhetūre mu miryango yose y’Abisirayeli, kugira ngo baje gukoranya ivyo kurya vy’ingabo zigiye kuja i Gibeya h’i Bubenyamini kubahōra ubuyobe bgose bākoreye mu Bisirayeli.
Nukw ingabo zose z’Abisirayeli zikoranira kurwanya ico gisagara, bahūje umutima nk’umuntu umwe.
Maz’ ab’ imiryango y’Abisirayeli batuma intumwa mu muryango w’Ababenyamini iy’ uva ukagera, zo kubabaza, ut’ Ubgo buyobe bgabaye muri mwebge bgavuye ku ki?
Uti None ni mubahe abo bantu b’abagesera b’i Gibeya, babice, bakūre ikibi mu Bisirayeli. Arikw Ababenyamini banka kwumvira ab’i wabo b’Abisirayeli.
Maz’ Ababenyamini bava mu bisagara vyabo bakoranira i Gibeya, kugira ngo barwane n’Abisirayeli.
Uwo musi hakorana Ababenyamini bavuye mur’ ivyo bisagara ingabo zizi kurwanisha inkota ibihumbi mirongwibiri na bitandatu, udashizemw’ abasanzwe baba i Gibeya, ingabo z’intorwa amajana ndwi.
Kandi mur’ izo ngabo zose hārimw’ abantu b’intorwa amajana ndwi b’amabamfu, kand’ umwe‐umwe muri bo yashobora guteresha ibuye umugozi ntāhushe, n’iyo koba agashatsi kamwe.
Abandi Bisirayeli, udashizemw’ Ababenyamini, bākoranye ar’ ibihumbi mirongwine bazi kurwanisha inkota: abo bose bar’ ingabo.

Maz’ Abisirayeli barahaguruka baja i Beteli, ngo basiguze Imana; barayibaza, bati Muri twebge ni ba nde bazotangura kuja gutera Ababenyamini? Uhoraho arabishura, at’ Abayuda ni bo bazotangura kugenda.
Nuko bukeye Abisirayeli barahaguruka, basagaza inyuma y’i Gibeya.
Ingabo zabo zitera Ababenyamini, zitonda urugamba i Gibeya ngo zibarwanye.
Maz’ Ababenyamini barasokoroka bava i Gibeya, batikiza Abisirayeli kur’ uwo musi, bahasiga imihindigiti ibihumbi mirongwibiri na bibiri.
Arikw izo ngabo z’Abisirayeli zirīyūngūnganya, basubira gutonda urugamba hamwe bari barutonze ubga mbere.

Maz’ Abisirayeli baradūga, baja kuririra imbere y’Uhoraho gushitsa ku mugorōba; babaza Uhoraho, bati Mbega dusubire kuja kurwana n’ab’ i wacu b’Ababenyamini? Uhoraho arabishura, at’ Ego me dūga mubatere.
Nuko ku musi ugira kabiri Abisirayeli bongera kwēgereza Ababenyamini.
Maz’ Ababenyamini bongera gusokoroka bava i Gibeya kur’ uwo musi wa kabiri nyene, basubira gutikiza Abisirayeli, bahasiga imihindigiti ibihumbi cumi n’umunani, bose ar’ abāri bazi kurwanisha inkota.

Maz’ ingabo zose z’Abisirayeli n’abantu bose baradūga, baja i Beteli, bicara ngaho imbere y’ Uhoraho barira, bīrirwa bīsonzesheje kugeza ku mugorōba, batangira ngah’ imbere y’Uhoraho ibimazi vyo kwoswa n’ibimazi vy’ ishimwe.
Maz’ Abisirayeli basiguza Uhoraho, (kukw ico gihe isandugu y’isezerano ry’Imana ari ho yar’ iri;

na Finehasi mwene Eleyazari umwuzukuru wa Aroni ni we yahagarara imbere yayo); babaza Uhoraho, bati Mbega dusubire kuja kurwana n’ab’i wacu b’Ababenyamini, canke dusigeho? Uhoraho arabishura, ati Dūga, kukw ejo nzobagabura mu maboko yanyu.
Nukw Abisirayeli barekura abaca ibico ngo batangatange i Gibeya impande zose.
Maze ku musi ugira gatatu Abisirayeli baja gutera Ababenyamini, batonda urugamba i Gibeya nk’ubga mbere.

Ababenyamini baraza barabarwanya, na bo barabahenda, babavana hafi y’ico gisagara; maz’ Ababenyamini batangura kubica ingenda nk’ubga mbere, babatsinda mu mabarabara, mu rija i Beteli no mu rija i Gibeya, no mu misozi; mu Bisirayeli hapfa abantu nka mirongwitatu.
Maz’ Ababenyamini barihaya, bati Turabanesheje nk’ubga mbere; arikw Abisirayeli bati Ngo twiruke, tubahende, bave hafi y’igisagara bashike mu mabarabara.
Uko ni kw Abisirayeli bose bāvuye aho bāri bari, baja gutonda urugamba i Bayali‐tamari; maz’ abāri baciye ibico baravyuka, bava aho bāri babunze i Mare‐geba:
nukw abo bantu, ukw ar’ ibihumbi cumi b’intorwa bo mu Bisirayeli bose, baraza batera i Gibeya; haba intambara ikomeye; arikw Ababenyamini ntibāri bazi kw ivyago bibashikiriye.
Maz’ Uhoraho atuma Ababenyamini baneshwa imbere y’Abisirayeli; kur’ uwo musi Abisirayeli batikiza mu Babenyamini abantu ibihumbi mirongwibiri na bitanu n’ijana, bose ar’abāri bazi kurwanisha inkota.
Nukw Ababenyamini babona ko baneshejwe. Uko ni kw Abisirayeli bāhenze Ababenyamini, kuko bāri bizigiye abo bari bashize mu bico inyuma y’i Gibeya;
abo bāri mu bico ni kwo kwiruka akābushūngwe, bagatera i Gibeya, bagasāgiriza ico gisagara, bakaranduza abari muri co bose inkota.
Ikimenyetso Abisirayeli bāri bāhānye n’abāri mu bico n’uko ni bāturira igisagara, umwotsi mwinshi ugapfūndūka,
Abisirayeli ni ho bazoca babahindukirana. Kand’ Ababenyamini bāri bamaze gutangura kwica mu Bisirayeli abantu nka mirongwitatu, bihaya, bati N’ukuri turabanesheje nko muri ya ntambara ya mbere.
Arik’ umwotsi utanguye kudūga utwaje uva mu gisagara, Ababenyamini ni kwo gukebuka, bakabona igisagara cose gipfūndūka umwotsi udūga intumbgejuru.
Abisirayeli ni kwo kubahindukirana, Ababenyamini bakagwa igihūmura, kuko babonye yukw ivyago bibashikiriye.
Nuko baha ibitugu Abisirayeli, bajana inzira ija mu bugaragwa; arikw ingabo zibōma inyuma, kand’ izivuye mu gisagara zibīteramwo hagati, zigenda zirabica.
Baca Ababenyamini hirya no hino, barabakinagiza, bagize ngo baratēnyēnya barabasiribanga, kurinda bashika aharābana n’i Gibeya, ku ruhande ruhera i burasirazuba.
Mu Babenyamini hapfa abantu ibihumbi cumi n’ umunani, bose n’abahizi.

Uko ni ko bākebeje, bagahunga bajanye inzira ija mu bugaragwa, kugira ngo bashike ku gitandara c’i Rimona; abo bishe ingenda mu mabarabara bār’ ibihumbi bitanu, bakomeza kubōma inyuma gushitsa i Gidomu, batsinday’ abandi ibihumbi bibiri.
Nukw abāpfuye kur’ uwo musi mu Babenyamini bose na bose bār’ ibihumbi mirongwibiri na bitanu bazi kurwanisha inkota; abo bose bār’ abahizi.
Mugabo, abantu amajana atandatu bākebeje, bagahunga bajanye inzira ija mu bugaragwa, bāruhiye gushika kuri ca gitandara c’i Rimona; bagumayo kumara amezi ane.

Maz’ Abisirayeli barahindukira, bongera kurwanya abandi bo mu Babenyamini, babicisha inkota uhereye ku bantu no ku bigenda bindi no ku vyo barengutseko vyose; kand’ ibisagara vyose bārengukako barabiturira.
Kand’ Abisirayeli bāri bararahiriye i Misipa, bati Nta muntu n’umwe muri twebge azoshingira umwana wiwe Umubenyamini.
Nukw abantu baja i Beteli, bicara imbere y’Imana gushitsa ku mugoroba, baboroga, barira,
bat’ Ewe Uhoraho, Mana y’Abisirayeli, n’iki cateye ibi mu Bisirayeli, bigatuma habura umuryango umwe muri twebge?
Bukeye abantu bakoroka kare, bahubaka igicaniro, bahatangira ibimazi vyo kwoswa n’ivy’ ishimwe.

Maz’ Abisirayeli barabazanya, bati Ni ba nde bo mu miryango y’Abisirayeli boba batādūze ngo baje mw ikoraniro ry’ Uhoraho? Kuko bāri bararahiye indahiro ikomeye k’umuntu atazodūga gushengerera Uhoraho i Misipa atazobura gupfa.
Nukw Abisirayeli baricuza kubg’ Ababenyamini bene wabo, baravuga, bat’ Uyu musi umuryango umwe uraranduwe mu Bisirayeli.
None twobigenza dute ngo turonderere amasigarira yabo abagore, kandi twaramaze kugira Uhoraho indahiro ko tutazobashingira abakobga bacu?

Ni kwo kubazanya, bati Harya har’ abo mu miryango y’Abisirayeli boba batādūze gushengerera Uhoraho i Misipa? Basanga kw ata muntu n’umwe yavuye i Yabeshi‐gileyadi ngw aze aho bashagaje mw ikoraniro ryabo,
kukw igihe abantu bāharūrwa ntihābonetse n’umwe wo mu baba i Yabeshi‐gileyadi.
Nukw iryo koraniro ritumay’ abantu ibihumbi cumi na bibiri b’abahizi barusha abandi; barababarira, bati Ni mugende muririkishe inkota ababa i Yabeshi‐gileyadi, mubīcane n’abagore n’ abana.
Uku abe ari ko muzobigenza: muze mugeseze umugabo wese iyo bava bakagera, n’ umugore wese, eka n’uwigeze kuryamana n’umugabo.
Nuko mu baba i Yabeshi‐gileyadi babonay’ abakobga b’inkumi amajana ane batīgeze kumenya icitwa umugabo; babazana aho bashagaje i Shilo, mu gihugu c’i Kanani.
Maz’ iryo koraniro ryose rituma impore ku Babenyamini bāri kuri ca gitandara c’i Rimona.
Buno Ababenyamini baca barahūngūka, babashingira ba bigeme bārokoye mu bagore b’i Yabeshi‐gileyadi, ariko ntibābakwira.
Nukw abantu barīcuza kubg’ Ababenyamini, kuk’ Uhoraho yari yaciye igihengeri mu miryango y’Abisirayeli.
Maz’ abakuru b’iryo koraniro barabazanya, bati Twobigenza dute ngo turonderere abasigaye abagore? None kw abagore batikiye mu Babenyamini!
Bat’ Amasigarira y’Ababenyamini ntakwiye kubura ishingiro, ngo hagire umuryango uzimangana mu Bisirayeli.
Yamara twebge ntidushobora kubashingira abakobga bacu! Icabiteye n’ukw Abisirayeli bari bararahiye, ng’ Ūzoshingira Umubenyamini arakavumwa!

Maze baravuga, bat’ Erega hariho wa musi mukuru w’Uhoraho bagira uk’ umwaka utashe i Shilo, hamwe i burārūko bg’ i Beteli, ku ruhande ruhera i burasirazuba rw’inzira iva i Beteli ija i Shekemu, i bumanuko bg’i Lebona.
Nuko babarira Ababenyamini, bati Ni mugende muryame mu mizabibu,

murereke: maz’ abakobga b’i Shilo ni basokoroka baja kuvyina, muce musokoroka aho mubunze mu mizabibu, umuntu wese acakire umwigeme mur’ abo bigeme b’i Shilo, amugire umugore wiwe; muheze mwitahire mu gihugu c’i Bubenyamini.

Maze ba se canke basāza babo ni baza kutwitwarako, tuzobabgira, tuti Ni mubaduhe ku neza, kukw abagore twābasahuriye muri ya ntambara batābakwiye. Tuti Kandi kw atari mwebge mwababīhēreye, nta co muriko.
Nukw Ababenyamini babigenza kuno, binyagira abageni mu baje kuvyina bahwanye n’igitigiri cabo, barabashorera; baraheza barīgīra, basubira mw ishamvu yabo, bongera kwubaka ibisagara, babibamwo.
Ico gihe nyene Abisirayeli na bo bavayo, umuntu wese asubira mu muryango w’i wabo no mu nzu y’i wabo; bitahira mu mashamvu yabo.
Kandi mur’ iyo misi Abisirayeli nta mwami bāribgagire: umuntu wese yakora ico yigombeye.
Mu misi y’abacamanza ikigoyi cateye mu gihugu. Nuk’ umugabo w’i Betelehemu h’i Buyuda asuhukira mu gihugu c’i Mowabu, bo n’umugore wiwe n’abahungu biwe bompi.

Uwo mugabo yitwa Elimeleki, umugore wiwe yitwa Nawomi, abahungu biwe bompi umwe yitwa Mahaloni, uwundi yitwa Kiliyoni, bār’ Abanyefurata b’i Betelehemu h’i Buyuda. Bashika mu gihugu c’i Mowabu, babayo.
Elimeleki, umugabo wa Nawomi, arapfa; asigarana n’abahungu biwe bompi.
Bābīra Abanyamowabukazi; umwe yitwa Orupa, uwundi yitwa Rusi: bamaray’ imyaka nk’ icumi.
Maze Mahaloni na Kiliyoni bompi barapfa; uwo mugore abura abana biwe bompi n’umugabo wiwe.
Bukeye avana hasi n’abakazana biwe, kugira ngw ave mu gihugu c’i Mowabu asubire i wabo: kuko yari yumvise ari mu gihugu c’i Mowabu yuk’ Uhoraho yagendeye abantu biwe, akabaha ivyo kurya.
Ava aho hantu yar’ ari, bo n’abakazana biwe bompi, bajana inzira isubira mu gihugu c’i Buyuda.
Nawomi abgira abakazana biwe bompi, ati Ni mugende, musubire mu mazu ya ba nyoko: Uhoraho abagirire neza, nk’uko mwagiriye neza abahisi, bo nanje.
Uhoraho abahe mwempi gusubira kwubaka ingo mugire abagabo. Arabagūmbīra, baraturikisha, bararira.
Baramwishura, bat’ Oya, ariko turasubiranayo nawe mw ihanga ryanyu.
Nawomi arabishura, ati Bakobga banje, ni mwisubirire inyuma: n’iki gitumye mugomba kujana nanje? Har’ abandi bana ngifise mu nda, ngo baze babe abagabo banyu?
Ni mwisubirire inyuma, bakobga banje, mwīgīre; kuko ndenze gucūrwa. Iyo mba mvuzeho, nti Ndi n’ivyizigiro; ndeke naho noronka umugabo iri joro nyene nkazovyara abahungu;

mbeg’ ivyo vyotuma mubarīndīra gushitsa aho bazokurira? Ivyo vyotuma mureka kurondera abagabo? Vyoye kuba birtyo, bakobga banje, kuko muntera akagongwe, kuk’ ukuboko kw’Uhoraho kwaramvuriye kundwanya.
Barongera baraturikīsha, bararira: Orupa agūmbīra inabukwe, ariko Rusi we amugumakw akaramata.
Nawomi aravuga, ati Rāba, mugenzawe asubiye mu b’i wabo no ku mana yabo: nawe subirayo, ukurikire mugenzawe.

Rusi aramwishura, ati Reka kunyinginga kuguheba, no gusubira inyuma ngo noye kugukurikira; kukw ah’ uzoja ari ho nzoja, kand’ ah’ uzorāra ari ho nzorāra; ihanga ryanyu ni ryo rizoba ihanga ryacu, Imana yawe ni yo izoba Imana yanje;
ah’ uzogwa ni ho nzogwa, bahampambe: Uhoraho arakabimpanira, kandi birushirije, ni nagira ikizontandukanya nawe, atar’ urupfu.
Nawomi abonye yukw amaramaje kujana na we aca arahora.
Nuko bompi barajana kurinda bashika i Betelehemu. Nuko rero bashitse i Betelehemu abo mu gisagara bose barashwabāduka, abagore barabazanya, bati Mbeg’ uyo yoba Nawomi?
Arabishura, ati Ntimube mukinyita Nawomi, ariko munyite Mara; kuko Rugira Vyose ivyo yangiriye vyambereye umururāzi.
Navuye ino nninahaye, Uhoraho angarukanye i wacu nd’ imbokoboko: munyitira iki Nawomi, Uhoraho ko yantuntuje, kandi Rugira Vyose akaba yanteye ivyago?
Uko ni ko Nawomi yagarukanye na Rusi Umunyamowabukazi umukazana wiwe, bavuye mu gihugu c’i Mowabu: bashika i Betelehemu mw itangura ry’igenya rya sayiri.
Kandi Nawomi yar’ afise mwene wabo w’umugabo wiwe, umuntu akomeye w’umutunzi, wo mu muryango wa Elimeleki, yitwa Bowazi.
Rusi wa Munyamowabukazi abarira Nawomi, ati Ndekura ngende mu bibuba mpūmbe uduhūmbga, nkurikire uwongirira ubuntu. Aramwishura, ati Genda, mukobga wanje.
Aragenda, ahūmba mu kibuba akurikiye abagenyi: kand’ umurima yarengutseko war’ uwo mw itongo rya Bowazi, wo mu muryango wa Elimeleki.
Bowazi araza, avuye i Betelehemu, abgira abagenyi, at’ Uhoraho abane namwe. Na bo baramwishura, bat’ Uhoraho aguhe umugisha.
Maze Bowazi abaza umuntu wiwe agenyesha, at’ Uyu mukobga n’uwa nde?
Ūgenyesha aramwishura, ati Ni wa Munyamowabukazi yagarukanye na Nawomi avuye mu gihugu c’i Mowabu:
kandi yansavye, ati Ndakwinginze nyemerera guhūmba nkurikire abagenyi hagati y’ imikama: nukw araza, kandi yahereye mu gatondo gushitsa n’ubu, atar’ akanya gatoya yaruhutse.
Maze Bowazi abgira Rusi, at’ Urumva, mukobga wanje? Ntuz’ ugire uwundi murima uzohūmbamwo, kandi ntuve hano, arik’ ugume hano hafi y’abigeme b’i wanje.
Shira amaso ku murima bagenya, ubakurikire: mbeg’ abahungu simbihanikirije ko batazogukoma? Kand’ iy’ ugize inyota wame ugenda ku mibindi unywe ku yo abahungu bavomye.
Yicisha bugufi, arūnama ashika hasi, aramubaza, ati N’iki gitumye ungirira ubuntu, ukambabara, kandi nd’ umunyamahanga?
Bowazi aramwishura, ati Bānyigāniye neza ivyo wakoreye nyokobukwe vyose, uhereye ah’ umugabo wawe yapfiriye: kandi ko wasize so na nyoko n’igihugu wavukiyemwo, ukaza mw ihanga utār’ uzi.
Uhoraho akwishure ivyo wakoze, uhabge impēra ishitse n’ Uhoraho, Imana y’Abisirayeli, wahungiye musi y’amababa yayo.
Aramwishura, ati Ni ngirirwe akagongwe imbere yawe, mugenzi, kuk’ ummaze umubabaro, ukabarira incoreke yawe neza, naho ntahwanye n’umwe wo mu ncoreke zawe.
Igihe co kurya kigeze, Bowazi aramubgira, ati Ngwino urye agatsima, ukoze intore yawe mu nkarisha ya vino. Yicarana n’abagenyi bamuhēreza impeke zikaranze, arazirya, arahāga, arasigaza.
Avuye hasi guhūmba, Bowazi abarira imikangara yiwe, ati N’ ahūmbe no hagati y’imikama, ntimumukabukire.
Kandi mumusokōrere zimwe mu mikama, muzisige, azihūmbe, ntimumuhambarire.
Nukw ahūmba mur’ ico kibuba ashitsa ni kera; akubita izo yahūmvye, izo sayiri zishika ingero yitwa efa.
Arazīkorera, aja mu gisagara: inabukwe abona izo yahūmvye, Rusi amugobororera utwo yashigaje amaze guhāga, aratumuha.

Inabukwe aramubaza, ati Wahūmvye kwa nde uyu musi? Wakoze hehe? Uwakubabaye aragahezagirwa! Asobanurira inabukwe nyen’ umurima yakozemwo uw’ ari we, aramubgira, ati Nyen’ umurima nakozemw’ uyu musi yitwa Bowazi.

Nawomi abgira umukazana wiwe, at’ Uhoraho atāsizeho kugirira neza abakiriho n’abāpfuye, arakamuhezagira! Nawomi arongera aramubgira, at’ Uwo mugabo n’uwo mu muryango wacu wo hafi, n’umwe wo mu bacunguzi bacu.
Rusi wa Munyamowabukazi aramubarira, ati Mbere yambgiye, ati Wame ugumana n’abahungu b’i wanje, gushitsa aho bazohereza kugenya i wanje hose.
Nawomi abarira Rusi umukazana wiwe, ati Mukobga wanje, ni vyiza k’ujana n’abigeme bamukorera, boye kugusanga mu murima w’uwundi.
Nukw aguma hafi y’abigeme bakorera Bowazi, agahūmba akageza aho bahereje kugenya sayiri bo n’ingano; abana na inabukwe.
Nawomi inabukwe aramubaza, ati Mukobga wanje, sinokurangira urugo, kugira ng’ umererwe neza?
None ntihariho Bowazi wo mu muryango wacu, umwe wabana n’abigeme biwe? Umve iri joro aragosōreza sayiri kuri ya mbuga.
Nuko wiyuhagire, wīsīge, wambare imyambaro yawe, umanuke uje ku mbuga: ariko ntumwiyereke atararangiza kurya no kunywa.
Nuko rero, ni yaryama, witegereze aho aja kuryama, nawe ujeyo, worosore ibirenge vyiwe, uryame; na we arakubgira ico uja gukora.
Aramwishura, at’ Ic’ umbgiye cose ndagikora.
Aramanuka aja ku mbuga, abikora vyose nk’uko inabukwe yamubariye.
Bowazi amaze kurya no kunywa, ahimvye mu mutima wiwe, aja kuryama i ruhande y’ ikirundo c’umuhure: na we aza asōbōka, yorosora ibirenge vyiwe, araryama.
Maze mu gicugu uwo mugabo arīkanga, arihindukiza: asanga har’ umugore aryamye hepfo y’ibirenge vyiwe.
Aramubaza, at’ Uri nde? Aramwishura, ati Nd’ incoreke yawe Rusi; worose umuja wawe umwambaro wawe, kuk’ ur’ umucunguzi wacu.
Aramwishura, at’ Uragahezagirwa n’Uhoraho, mukobga wanje; ineza werekanye none iruta iyo werekanye ubga mbere, kuk’ utārondeye imisore, ar’ aboro cank’ abatunzi.
None rero, mukobga wanje, nta co utinya; ndakugirira ivyo uvuze vyose: kukw abashingantahe bose b’i wacu bazi yuk’ ur’ umugore aroranye.
N’ukuri koko nd’ umucunguzi wanyu, ariko harih’ uwundi andusha kuba umucunguzi wo hafi.

Rāra hano iri joro, kandi mu gitondo ni yakugirira ivy’ umucunguzi bizoba vyiza, az’ abikugirire; ariko ni yanka kubikugirira, ndahiye uguhoraho kw’Uhoraho yuk’ ubganje nzokugirira ivy’ umucunguzi: ryama buce.
Aryama hepfo y’ibirenge vyiwe, ageza mu rubungubungu: avyuka hataragera igihe umuntu yohwihwisha uwundi. Kuko yagira ngo Vyoye kumenyekana yuk’ uyo mugore yaje ku mbuga.
Aramubgira, ati Zana umutamana wawe uwutege; amugerera ingero zitandatu za sayiri, arazimukorera, aja mu gisagara.
Ashitse kwa inabukwe, aramubaza, ati Ni wewe ga mukobga wanje? Na we amwīgānira vyose ivyo uwo mugabo yamugiriye.
At’ Izi ngero za sayiri ukw ari zitandatu ni we yazimpaye: kuko yambgiye, ati Ntiwosubira kwa nyokobukwe ata co ufise.
Nawomi aramubarira, at’ Iyicarire mukobga wanje, ushitse ah’ uribumenyere amaherezo yavyo; kuk’ uyo mugabo ataja kuruhuka, gushitsa ah’ abirangiriza uyu musi.
Nuko Bowazi aradūga, aja kw irembo ry’igisagara, yicarayo: maze wa mucunguzi Bowazi yavuze arahaca; aramuhamagara, ati Yewe naka! Ngo wicare hano. Aragenda, aricara.
Azana abantu cumi bo mu bashingantahe b’ico gisagara, arababgira, ati Ni mwicare hano. Baricara.
Abgira wa mucunguzi, ati Nawomi, umwe yagaruka avuye mu gihugu c’i Mowabu, agomba kugura itongo ryar’ irya mwene wacu Elimeleki:

nagomvye kubikumenyesha, no kukubgira kurigurira imbere y’aba bicaye hano, n’imbere y’ abashingantahe b’i wacu. Ni wagomba kuritora, uritore, n’utabigomba mbarira, mbimenye: kukw ata wundi yoritora atari wewe, canke jewe ngukurikiye. Aramwishura, ati Ndaritora.
Maze Bowazi aramubarira, ati Ni wagura iryo tongo na Nawomi, ukwiye kurigurana na Rusi Umunyamowabukazi, umugore w’umuhisi, ng’ uhonore umuhisi, ribe ishamvu y’izina ryiwe.
Wa mucunguzi aramwishura, at’ Ubganje sinshobora kuritora, ngw iyanje shamvu ndayidabanganye: subira mu gishingo canje co kuritora, kuko jeho ntashobora kuritora.
Kera uyu ni wo war’ umugenzo w’Abisirayeli wo gucungura no kunyuranya, kugira ngo vyose bishingwe: umuntu yakūra inkweto yiwe, akayiha uwundi. Uko ni kw’Abisirayeli bātanga icabona ca ben’ ivyo.
Nuko wa mucunguzi abarira Bowazi, ati N’uryīgurire. Maz’ akūra inkweto yiwe.
Bowazi abarira abashingantahe n’ abantu bose, ati Mbatanzekw ivyabona uyu musi, yuko nguze ivyar’ ivya Elimeleki vyose, n’ivyar’ ivya Kiliyoni na Mahaloni, mbiguze na Nawomi.

Kandi na Rusi Umunyamowabukazi, yari muka Mahaloni, ndamuguze ngw abe umugore wanje, ngo mponore umuhisi, ishamvu ntive kw izina ryiwe, izina ry’umuhisi ryoye kuzimangana muri bene wabo, no ku marembo y’igisagara cabo: mbatanzekw ivyabona uyu musi.

Nukw abantu bose bāri kw irembo n’abashingantahe baramwishura, bati Tur’ ivyabona vy’ ivyo. Uwo mugore aje mu nzu yawe, Uhoraho amuhwanye na Rakeli na Leya, ari bo bompi bāshinze inzu ya Isirayeli: nawe uragasagamba muri Efurata, ube rurangiranwa i Betelehemu:
kand’ inzu yawe n’ihwane n’ iya Peresi, uwo Tamari yavyariye Yuda, bizanywe n’uruvyaro Uhoraho azoguha kur’ ico gitamba.
Nuko Bowazi yābīra Rusi, aba umugore wiwe; abana na we, Uhoraho amuha gusama inda, avyara umuhungu.
Abagore babgira Nawomi, bat’ Uhoraho ashemezwe, atākuretse uyu musi ng’ube ūtagira umucunguzi; izina ryiwe ni ribe rurangiranwa mu Bisirayeli.
Kand’ azosubiza intege mu bugingo bgawe, kand’ azogutunga ugeze mu zabukuru: kuk’ umukazana wawe agukunda, akakurutira abahungu ndwi wovyaye, ari we amuvyaye.
Nawomi ajana uwo mwana, amushira mu gikiriza, aba umurezi wiwe.
Abagore b’ababanyi biwe bamwita izina, bati Nawomi avyariwe umuhungu. Bamwita Obedi, ni we se wa Isayi, se wa Dawidi.
Uru ni rwo ruvyaro rwa Peresi: Peresi yavyaye Hesironi;
Hesironi yavyaye Ramu; Ramu yavyaye Aminadabu;
Aminadabu yavyaye Nahashoni; Nahashoni yavyaye Salumoni;
Salumoni yavyaye Bowazi; Bowazi yavyaye Obedi;
Obedi yavyaye Isayi; Isayi yavyaye Dawidi.
Hār’ umuntu w’i Ramatayimu‐sofimu, mu mugamba w’Abefurayimu, yitwa Elukana; yari mwene Yerohamu, Yerohamu wa Elihu, Elihu wa Tohu, Tohu wa Sufu, w’Umwefurayimu.
Yar’ afise abagore babiri, umwe yitwa Hana, uwundi Penina; Penina ni we yavyara, ariko Hana yar’ ingumba.

Uwo muntu yama ava mu gisagara c’i wabo uk’ umwaka utashe, akadūga i Shilo gusenga no gushikanira Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo ibimazi. Kandi bene Eli bompi, Hofuni na Finehasi, bār’ abaherezi b’Uhoraho aho hantu.
Umusi Elukana yatangakw ikimazi, yahakw imitigiri Penina umugore wiwe, n’abahungu biwe n’abakobga biwe;
ariko Hana yamuha umutigiri ungana n’iyabo kabiri, kuko yamukunda; arik’ Uhoraho yari yaramuzivye inda.
Kandi mukēba we yama amushinyagurira, akamutera intuntu, kuk’ Uhoraho yamuzivye inda.
Uko ni ko vyāgenda, uk’ umwaka utashe: uko Hana yadūga aja mu ngoro y’Uhoraho, ni ko mukēba we yamushinyagurira. Ni co cātuma arira, akanka kurya.
Maz’ umugabo wiwe Elukana aramubaza, at’ Urizwa n’iki ga Hana? N’iki kikubuza kurya? Ubabajwe n’iki? Mbega sinkurutira abahungu cumi wovyaye?
Maze barangije kurya no kunywa aho bāri bari i Shilo, Hana ava hasi. Kandi Eli umuherezi yari yicaye ku ntebe yiwe ku gishimaryango mu rusengero rw’Uhoraho.
Maze Hana asenga Uhoraho afise intuntu, arira cane,

asezerana isezerano, at’ Ewe Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, ni warāba umubabaro wanje incoreke yawe, ukanyibuka, ntunyibagire jewe incoreke yawe, ukantabaza umwana w’umuhungu, nanje nzomuguha, Uhoraho, abe uwawe kuzorinda apfa, kandi nta rupfuhe ruzomugera ku mutwe.
Nukw akomeje artyo gusengera imbere y’Uhoraho, Eli yitegereza umunwa wiwe;
kuko Hana yavugira mu mutima, akubita umunwa gusa, arikw ijwi ryiwe ritumvikana; ni co catumye Eli yiyumvira kw aborewe.
Nuko Eli aramubaza, at’ Uzogeza hehe kwama uborewe? Genda uhebe iyo vino yawe!
Ariko Hana aramwishura, at’ Oyaye mwami wanje, nd’ umuntu yabonye amahano! Nta vino nanyoye cank’ ikindi kiboreza, ariko nariko ndasuka amajojwa yanje imbere y’Uhoraho.
Ntugire ngo nd’ umuntu w’ umunyangeso mbi, kukw aka kanya kose namye mvugana umubabaro n’amaganya bindengeye.
Maze Eli aramwishura, ati Nuko ni wīgīre amahoro; Imana ya Isirayeli iguhe ico wayisavye.
Na we aramwishura, ati N’ umpangaze, jewe incoreke yawe. Maz’ uwo mugore arīgīra; araheza ararya, ntiyasubira kwiraburanirwa ukundi.
Bukeye barazinduka, baja imbere y’Uhoraho barasenga; bahejeje barataha, basubira i wabo i Rama. Maze Elukana arārira Hana umugore wiwe, Uhoraho aramwibuka.
Igihe kiragera, Hana asama inda, avyara umwana w’umuhungu, amwita Samweli, ati Kuko namusavye Uhoraho.
Maz’ uwo mugabo Elukana akora abo mu rugo rwiwe bose aradūga, aja gushikanira Uhoraho ikimazi c’uwo mwaka no gushitsa amasezerano yiwe.
Ariko Hana ntiyadūgayo, abarira umugabo wiwe, at’ Umwana ni yamara gucūka ni ho nzodūga, ndamujane, ashikirizwe Uhoraho, agumey’ igihe cose.

Maze Elukana umugabo wiwe aramwishura, ati N’ukore ico ushimye: wigumire aho gushitsa ah’uzomucūkiriza; arik’ Uhoraho n’ashitse ijambo ryiwe. Nuk’ uwo mugore yigumira ngaho, yonsa umwana wiwe, gushitsa aho yamucūkirije.
Amaze kumucūtsa aramudūgana, ajana n’imasa imaze imyaka itatu, n’ingero yitwa efa y’ifu, n’umukuza w’urusato wa vino; nukw amujana i Shilo mu ngoro y’Uhoraho; kand’ uwo mwana yar’ akiri mutoya.
Babāga nya masa, bazanira Eli uwo mwana.
Maze Hana aravuga, ati Mwami wanje, indahiro ni wewe nyene, erega ni jewe wa mugore nari mpagaze i ruhande yawe, mwami wanje, nsaba Uhoraho.
Uyu mwana ni we nasaba, kand’ Uhoraho yampaye ico namusavye.
Ni co gitumye ndamugize inkūka y’Uhoraho; azorinda apfa ar’ inkūka y’Uhoraho. Nuko basengera Uhoraho aho hantu.
Maze Hana arasenga, at’ Umutima wanje uvugiriza Uhoraho impundu, Ihembe ryanje rivyuwe n’ Uhoraho; Akanwa kanje kāsamiye abansi banje, Kuko nnejerejwe n’agakiza kiwe.
Nta wera nk’Uhoraho, Kukw ata yindi mana, atari we: Kandi nta gitandara kimeze nk’Imana yacu.
Ntimukongere kuvuga ivy’ ubgibone murtyo, Ivy’ amanyama ntibigaturuke mu kanwa kanyu; Kuk’ Uhoraho ar’ Imana izi vyose, Ni yo igera ibikorwa vy’abantu nko ku munzane.
Imiheto y’abahizi iravunitse, Abāri badendebukiwe bakenyeye inkomezi.
Abāhoran’ agahimbo basigaye baca ingero, Arikw abāhora bashonje ntibagicumukura. Mber’ uwahora ar’ ingumba avyaye indwi, Uwavyaye benshi arahondobereye.
Uhoraho ni we atuma umuntu apfa, kandi ni we atuma abaho, Ni we amumanura i kuzimu, kandi ni we amukūrayo.
Uhoraho ni we amukenesha kandi ni we amukenura, Ni we amucisha bugufi kandi ni we amushira hejuru.

Ni we akūra umugorwa mu mukungugu, Agashira hejuru umukene, amukūye mu mwavu, Kugira ngw abicarikane n’ abahambaye, Baragwe intebe z’icubahiro: Kukw inkingi z’isi ar’ iz’ Uhoraho, Kandi ni zo yayiteretseko.
Azozigama ibirenge vy’abagororotsi biwe, Arikw abanyavyaha bazohonera mu muzimagiza, Kukw inkomezi z’umuntu atari zo zimuha kunesha.
Abarwanya Uhoraho bazovunagurika, Azoturagara ari mw ijuru, abakankamire. Uhoraho azocira imanza abo ku mpera z’isi; Kand’ azoha inkomezi umwami wiwe, Ashire hejuru ihembe ry’uwo yimikishije amavuta.
Maze Elukana asubira i we i Rama. Arik’ uwo mwana akorera Uhoraho imbere ya Eli umuherezi.
Kandi bene Eli bār’ abanyangeso mbi; bāpfa uko bagize ivy’ Uhoraho,
n’ivy’imituri abaherezi bāgenewe ku bimazi vy’abantu. Iy’ umuntu atanze ikimazi, inyama zigitētswe, umusuku w’ umuherezi yaraza, afise icuma mu ntoke cārura inyama c’ingobe zitatu;
akagita mw isafuriya, canke mw ibinika, canke mu nkono, canke mu kazīhebe; maz’ iz’ ico cuma cājabura zose, umuherezi yarazītwarira. Uko ni ko bāgirira Abisirayeli bose uko bagiye i Shilo.
Mbere batarosa ibinure, umusuku w’umuherezi yaraza, akabarira ūtanze ikimazi, ati N’umpe inyama zo gutarira umuherezi, kukw atagomba k’umuha izitētse, atar’ imbisi.
Uwo muntu yamwishura, ati Hinge babanze bose ibinure, uheze ubone gutwara iz’ ugomba; na we akamubarira, at’ Oya, urazimpa ubu nyene: utazimpaye ndazitwara wanse ukunze!
Uko ni kw icaha c’abo basore cabaye igikomeye imbere y’Uhoraho, kuko bākēngēra ikimazi ciwe.
Ariko Samweli akorera Uhoraho, kandi yar’ akir’ umwana, yari yambaye efodi yera derere.
Kandi nyina yama amubarīrira agahuzu, akakamushīra uk’ umwaka utashe, uko yajana n’umugabo wiwe gutanga ikimazi c’umwaka;
Eli na we agahezagira Elukana n’umugore wiwe, at’ Uragahabga uruvyaro n’Uhoraho kur’ uyu mugore, abasubirize mu bukandu bg’ uwo yahaye Uhoraho kw’ inkūka; bagaheza bagasubira i wabo.
Maz’ Uhoraho agendera Hana, asama inda, aja imbere avyara abana b’abahungu batatu n’abakobga babiri. Arik’ uwo mwana Samweli akurira imbere y’Uhoraho.
Nuko Eli yar’ ageze mu zabukuru; kandi yama yumva ivyo abo bahungu biwe bagirira Abisirayeli bose, kandi ko basambana n’abagore bākora ibikorwa vyo ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Arababaza, ati N’iki gituma mukora ben’ ivyo? Ko nama numva abantu bose bambarira ingeso zanyu mbi.
Eka bana banje, ivyo numva bavuga kuri mwebge si vyiza, kandi muracumuza abantu b’Uhoraho.
Umuntu ni yacumura ku wundi, Imana ishobora kubuzuza; arik’ uwocumura k’ Uhoraho, ni nde yomuvugira? Yamara bīrengagiza ivyo se ababariye, kuk’ Uhoraho yari yagabiye kubica.
Arik’ uwo mwana Samweli akomeza gukura, no gushimwa n’Uhoraho n’abantu.
Bukeye haza umuntu w’Imana kuri Eli, aramubarira, at’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ngo Mbega ntiyiyeretse inzu ya sogokuruza, bakiri muri Egiputa mu buja kwa Farawo?

Ngo Ntiyamutoranije mu miryango yose y’Abisirayeli, ngw abe umuherezi wiwe, aje ku gicaniro ciwe, yose imibavu, yambare efodi imbere yiwe? Ngo Kandi ntiyahaye inzu ya sogokuruza ibimazi vyose Abisirayeli batanga vyo gutongorwa n’umuriro?

Ngo N’iki gituma mutimamukira ibimazi vyiwe n’amashikanwa yiwe, ivyo yashinze ko bamuzanira mu ngoro yiwe, ng’ Ukūbaha abahungu bawe kubamurutisha, mukīgaburira ibinoboye vyo mu bimazi vyose abantu biwe b’Abisirayeli bamushikanira, mukīvyibuhira?

Ni co gitumye Uhoraho, Imana y’Abisirayeli, avuga, ngo N’ukuri yari yaravuze yukw ab’ inzu yawe n’ab’ inzu ya sogokuruza bazokwama bamugendako bar’ imbere yiwe ibihe vyose; ariko noneh’ Uhoraho agize ngo Biragahera; ngo Kukw abamwubaha ari bo azokwubaha, arikw abamukēngēra bazokēngērwa.
Ngw Ehe rāba, imisi igiye kuza, akūreh’ inkomezi zawe, n’iz’ ab’ inzu ya sogokuruza, hoye kugira uwo mu nzu yawe azoba agishika mu zabukuru.
Ngo Maze mu magorwa yawe uzotimamukira ivyiza azoba ahaye abandi Bisirayeli; ngo Kandi nta n’umwe wo mu nzu yawe azoba agishika mu zabukuru kugeza ibihe vyose.

Ngo Kandi ni hagira umuntu wo kuri wewe azosigara atamukūye ku gicaniro ciwe, na ho nyene bizoba ar’ ugusigara akobotse amaso, atuntuye mu mutima; ngo Kand’ ab’ uruvyaro rw’inzu yawe bose bazogenda bapfa bakenyutse.
Ngo Kand’ ikizoba ku bahungu bawe bompi, Hofuni na Finehasi, kizokubera ikimenyamenya c’ivyo: bompi bazopfira umusi umwe.

Maze ngw Azokwihagurukiriza umuherezi w’umwizigirwa, umuntu azokora nk’ivyari mu mutima wiwe no mu vyiyumviro vyiwe; ngo Kand’ azomwubakira inzu izokwamaho; na we azogendanira uwo yimikishije amavuta ibihe vyose.

Ngo Kand’ uko bizogenda n’uku: ng’ Umuntu wese w’agasigarira ko mu nzu yawe azoza amwikubite imbere, amusabe agafeza n’agatsima, amubgire, ati Ndakwinginze, umpe agakorwa kamwe ko mu vy’ubuherezi, kugira ngo mbone utwo kuntunga.
Uwo mwana Samweli yakorera Uhoraho imbere ya Eli. Kandi mur’ iyo misi ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryari risigaye ar’ imbonekarimwe, nta kwerekwa na we kwari kukiriho cane.
Ico gihe Eli yar’ atanguye guhuma, asigaye ahwihwisha gusa. Umusi ur’ izina yiryamiye ku buriri bgiwe,
itara ry’Imana ritarazima, Samweli na we aryamye mu rusengero rw’Uhoraho, ah’ isandugu y’ Imana iba,
Uhoraho ahamagara Samweli; na we ati Sabge!
Araheza arirukanga, aja iyo Eli ari, aramubarira, ati Ndaje nditavye. Eli at’ Eka singuhamagaye: subira kuryama. Nukw aragenda araryama.
Uhoraho yongera guhamagara, ati Samweli! Nuko Samweli aravyuka, aja iyo Eli ari, ati Ndaje nditavye. Na we at’ Eka singuhamagaye, mwananje: subira kuryama.
Maze Samweli ntiyaribgamenye Uhoraho, canke ngw ahishurirwe ijambo ryiwe.
Nuk’ Uhoraho yongera guhamagara Samweli ubugira gatatu. Aravyuka, aja iyo Eli ari, ati Ndaje nditavye. Maze Eli aca amenya kw ar’ Uhoraho ahamagaye uwo mwana;
ni kwo kubarira Samweli, ati Genda, subira kuryama; maze ni yongera kuguhamagara, uheze umwitabe, ut’ Uhoraho, n’ uvuge, kuk’ umusavyi wawe nteze amatwi. Nuko Samweli asubira kuryama aho yar’ ari.
Maz’ Uhoraho araza ahagarara ngaho, aramuhamagara nk’ubga mbere, ati Samweli we! Ewe Samweli! Na we ati N’uvuge, kuk’ umusavyi wawe nteze amatwi.
