Uhoraho abarira Samweli, ati Rāba nzokora ikintu mu Bisirayeli, ūzocumva wese imīnzerere izomuvuga mu matwi.
Uwo musi nzoshitsa kuri Eli ivyo navuze ku nzu yiwe vyose, iyo biva bikagera.
Kuko mmaze kumubgira yuko ngiye guha inzu yiwe igihano kitazobavako, mbahōye ukugabitanya yirengagije, kukw abahungu biwe bihamagariye umuvumo, na we ntabateshe.
Ni co catumye ndahira ab’ inzu ya Eli, yukw ibigabitanyo vyabo bitazotangirwa impongano, n’iyo coba ikimazi cank’ ishikanwa, gushitsa ibihe vyose.
Nuko Samweli araryama, ageza mu gitondo; aravyuka, yugurura inzugi z’inzu y’Uhoraho; arikw atinya kubarira Eli ivyo yeretswe.
Maze Eli aramuhamagara, ati Mwana wanje Samweli! Na we ati Sabge!
Aramubaza, ati Bga bundi yakubariye iki? Ntugire ico umpisha. Ni wagira ico umpisha mu vyo yakubariye vyose, Imana ibiguhanire, mbere birushirije.
Nuko Samweli amudōndera vyose, ntiyagira ico amuhisha. Maze Eli aravuga, ati N’Uhoraho: n’akore ico ashima.
Nuko Samweli arakura, Uhoraho abana na we; ntiyakunda ko hagira ijambo na rimwe rya Samweli rikorokera hasi.
Nukw Abisirayeli bose, uhereye i Dani ugashitsa i Beri‐sheba, bamenya ko Samweli yegukiye kuba ūvugishwa n’Uhoraho.
Nuk’ Uhoraho asubira kwiyerekanira i Shilo, kukw i Shilo nyene ari ho Uhoraho yihishuririra Samweli mw ijambo ryiwe. Kand’ ijambo rya Samweli rishika ku Bisirayeli bose.
Bukeye Abisirayeli batera Abafilisitiya, basagaza ahabangikanye n’i Ebenezeri; Abafilisitiya na bo basagaza kuri Afeka.
Abafilisitiya batonda urugamba ngo barwanye Abisirayeli: bamaze kurumana, Abisirayeli baneshwa n’ Abafilisitiya, Abafilisitiya babicamw’ abantu nk’ibihumbi bine mur’ urwo rugamba.

Maz’ ingabo zishitse mu nsago, abakuru bo mu Bisirayeli barabazanya, bati N’iki gitumye Uhoraho yemera ko tuneshwa uyu musi n’Abafilisitiya? Enda ni muze tuje kuzana isandugu y’isezerano ry’Uhoraho tuyikūre i Shilo, tuyizane hano, kugira ngo ni yashika muri twebge idutabare ububasha bg’abansi bacu.

Nukw abantu batuma i Shilo, bakūray’ isandugu y’isezerano ry’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo yama avyagiye ku bakerubi, barayizana. Kandi bene Eli bompi, Hofuni na Finehasi, bazanana n’iyo sandugu y’isezerano ry’Imana.
Nukw iyo sandugu y’isezerano ry’Uhoraho ishitse aho bashagaje, Abisirayeli bose baca biha akamo icarimwe, isi irāsīra.
Maz’ Abafilisitiya bumvise urwo rwamo, barabazanya, bat’ Urwo rwamo rwinshi ruri mu nsago z’Abaheburayo n’urw’ iki? Hanyuma bamenya kw ar’ isandugu y’Uhoraho ishitse mur’ izo nsago.
Maz’ Abafilisitiya baratinya, bat’ Imana irashitse mu nsago zabo! Bat’ Erega turapfuye! Nta ho twaribgabone nk’ivyo!
Eka turapfuye! Ni nde yodukiza akadukūra mu maboko y’izo mana zihambaye? Izo ni za mana zāzaniye Abanyegiputa ivyago bitari bimwe mu bugaragwa.
Ni mushikame, murwane magabo, yemwe Bafilisitiya, mwoye kuba abaja b’Abaheburayo, nk’uko bo ar’ abacu: nuko murwane magabo!
Nukw Abafilisitiya bashirako bararwana, maz’ Abisirayeli baraneshwa, umuntu wese ahungira i we; haba agatikizo gakomeye: mu Bisirayeli hapfa ingabo ibihumbi mirongwitatu.
Kand’ isandugu y’ Imana ifatwa mpiri; na bene Eli bompi, Hofuni na Finehasi baricwa.
Maz’ umuntu wo mu ba Benyamini ava mu rugamba, agenda yiruka, ashika i Shilo uwo musi, yitantamuriyekw impuzu ziwe, yiyoreye ivu mu mutwe.

Kand’ aho yaza, Eli yari yicaye ku ntebe yiwe i ruhande y’inzira, ategereye agakuru, kuko yar’ ahagaritswe umutima n’isandugu y’Imana. Nuk’ uwo muntu ashitse mu gisagara, avuga inkuru z’ivyabaye; abo mu gisagara bose bacura umuborogo.
Maze Eli yumvise ijwi ry’amaborogo, arabaza, at’ Urwo rwamo n’urw’ iki? Nuk’ uwo muntu aza yirukanga, abibikira Eli.
Kandi Eli yar’ amaze imyaka mirongwicenda n’umunani; amaso yiwe yar’ ahumye, ntiyar’ akibona.
Nuk’ uwo muntu abarira Eli, ati Ni jewe mvuye mu rugamba, nje mpunga mvuye mu ntambara uyu musi. Aramubaza, ati Vyagenze bite ga mwana wanje?
Iyo mbitsi iramwishura, it’ Abisirayeli batsinzwe n’ Abafilisitiya, habaye agatikizo gakomeye mu bantu; ba bahungu bawe bompi Hofuni na Finehasi bapfuye; kand’ isandugu y’Imana yafashwe mpiri.

Nukw amaze kuvuga ivy’ isandugu y’Imana, Eli ahanuka ku ntebe yiwe, agwa agaramye ku gikingi c’irembo, akenyura izosi, arahwera; kuko yar’ umutāma, kandi yari yiremereye. Yar’ amaze imyaka mirongwine ar’ umucamanza w’Abisirayeli.

Umukazana wiwe, muka Finehasi, yar’ afise inda, ari hafi yo kuvyara. Nuko yumvise izo nkuru yukw isandugu y’Imana yafashwe mpiri, kandi ko sebukwe n’ umugabo wiwe bapfuye, aca apfukama, aravyara, kukw ibise vyaciye bimufata.
Maz’ ari hafi yo gucīkāna, abagore bāri bamuhagaze i ruhande baramubarira, bati Rema, kuk’ uvyaye umuhungu! Ariko nta co yabishura, canke ngw anabibabare.
Yita uwo mwana Ikabodi; at’ Icubahiro kirashize mu Bisirayeli. Icatumye avuga artyo n’ukw isandugu y’ Imana yafashwe mpiri, kandi n’ uko sebukwe n’umugabo wiwe bāpfuye.
Aravuga, at’ Icubahiro kirashize mu Bisirayeli, kukw isandugu y’Imana ifashwe mpiri.
Abafilisitiya bafashe mpiri isandugu y’Imana, bayikūra i Ebenezeri bayijana i Ashidodi.
Baraheza bayinjiza mu ngoro ya Dagoni, bayitereka i ruhande ya Dagoni nyene.
Bukeye mu mavyuka ya kare Abanyashidodi basanga Dagoni yatemvye yubamye imbere y’isandugu y’Uhoraho; barayegura, bayisubiza ahantu hayo.

Bukeye bgaho, mu mavyuka ya kare nyene, basanga Dagoni yongeye gutemba yubamye imbere y’isandugu y’Uhoraho, kand’ umutwe n’ibikonjo vyayo vyahimbaguritse vyayivuyeko, bitembagara mu rwinjiriro; hari hasigaye umutumba wayo gusa.
Ni co gituma abaherezi ba Dagoni n’uwinjira mu ngoro yayo wese, bitonda kudakandagira mu rwinjiriro rw’ ingoro ya Dagoni yo muri Ashidodi gushitsa n’ubu.
Maz’ ukuboko kw’Uhoraho gushikamira Abanyashidodi n’abāhakūkira, arabageseza, abatērēra ibihute.
Abanyashidodi babonye bibaye birtyo baravugana, bat’ Isandugu y’Imana y’Abisirayeli ntikagume muri twebge, kuk’ ukuboko kwayo kudushikamiye, twe na Dagoni imana yacu.

Ni kwo gutuma ku baganwa b’Abafilisitiya bose, bakoraniraho barababaza, bati Mbeg’ isandugu y’Imana y’ Abisirayeli tuyigenze dute? Barabishura, bati Ni bayijane i Gati. Nuko bajanay’ iyo sandugu y’ Imana y’Abisirayeli.
Bamaze kuyishikanayo, ukuboko kw’Uhoraho kurwanya ico gisagara, kubaca ivutu; atērēra ibihute abo mur’ ico gisagara, abato n’abakuru, bisēsa ku mibiri yabo.
Nukw iyo sandugu y’Imana bayirungika i Ekuroni. Igiserukayo, Abanyekuroni bavuza induru, bati Batuzaniye ya sandugu y’Imana y’Abisirayeli ngw itumarane n’ abacu!

Ni kwo gutuma ku baganwa bose b’Abafilisitiya, bakoraniraho, barababgira, bati Ni murungike iyi sandugu y’Imana y’Abisirayeli, isubire aho yahora, ireke kutumarana n’abacu; kuko mur’ ico gisagara cose urupfu rwari rwabaciye ivutu, kand’ ukuboko kw’Imana kwari kubashikamiye cane.
Abatāpfuye batērērwa ibihute; induru z’ico gisagara zishika mw ijuru.
Kand’ iyo sandugu y’Uhoraho yar’ imaze amezi ndwi mu gihugu c’Abafilisitiya.
Bukeye Abafilisitiya bahamagara abaherezi n’abapfumu, barababaza, bat’ Iyi sandugu y’Uhoraho tuyigenze dute? Tuyirungikane n’iki, mu ko tuyisubiza ahantu hayo?

Barabishura, bati Ni mwarungika iyo sandugu y’Imana y’Abisirayeli, ntimuze muyirungike yonyene, ariko muyisubizanyeyo n’impongano muhongeye Imana: ni ho muzobona gukira, mumenye n’icatumye ukuboko kwayo kutabatenzukira.

Barababaza, bati Mbega tuyihongere impongano ki? Bati Muyihongere ibisa n’ibihute bitanu mucuze mw izahabu, n’ ibisa n’imbeba bitanu mucuze mw izahabu nyene, nk’ukw igitigiri c’abaganwa b’Abafilisitiya kingana; kukw icago cabashitseko mwese ari kimwe n’icashitse ku baganwa banyu.

Ni co gituma mukwiye kwicurishiriza ibishushanyo vy’ivyo bihute vyanyu, n’ibishushanyo vy’izo mbeba zabateye, zikonona igihugu; muteko mwubahe Imana y’Abisirayeli: kumbure yotenzura ukuboko kwayo, ikagukūra kuri mwebge no ku mana zanyu no ku gihugu canyu.
Har’ icotuma mukomantaza imitima nk’ukw Abanyegiputa na Farawo bagize? Mbeg’ imaze kwerekana ububasha muri bo, ntibāhavuye bakarekura abo bantu, bakīgīra?
None rero ni murondere umukogote musha, bo n’ inka zibiri z’imvyeyi, zitigeze gukoreshwa igikorwa na kimwe; muheze muziboherek’ uwo mukogote, muzāke izazo muzisubize i muhira.
Maze mwābīre ya sandugu y’Uhoraho, muyigereke kur’ uwo mukogote; kand’ ivyo bishushanyo vy’izahabu murungitse vyo kumuhongera, mubishire mu gasandugu i ruhande yayo; muheze muyirungike, igende.

Maze muyishinge ijisho: ni yajana inzira ija i Beti‐shemeshi mu gihugu cayo, izoba ar’ Imana yaduterereye ivyo vyago bikomeye; ariko bitabaye birtyo tuzomenya kw atar’ ukuboko kwayo kwatwishe, bizoba ar’ ivyago vy’ivyaduka vyapfuye kutuzako gusa.
Nukw abo bantu babigenza bartyo; bābīra inka zibiri z’imvyeyi, baziboherak’ umukogote, izazo bazugaririra i muhira;
baraheza bashira iyo sandugu y’Uhoraho kur’ uwo mukogote, bashirako na ka gasandugu karimw’ izo mbeba zacuzwe mw izahabu na vya bishushanyo vy’ibihute vyabo.

Izo nka zigenda zitumbereye i Beti‐shemeshi, zijana inzira y’iroro, zigenda zirābira inzira yose, ntizakebereza i buryo cank’ i bumoso; abaganwa b’Abafilisitiya baraziherekeza, bazishikana ku rubibe rw’i Beti‐shemeshi.
Kand’ ab’i Beti‐shemeshi bāriko baragenya ingano mu kiyaya; bunamuye amaso babona isandugu iserutse: bayibonye baranezerwa.

Nuk’ uwo mukogote uraza, ushikira mu murima wa Yosuwa w’i Beti‐shemeshi, uhagararaho. Kand’ aho hantu hār’ ikibuye kinini. Baraheza basatagura uwo mukogote mw inkwi, bazitangirakw izo nka kw ikimazi co kwosereza Uhoraho.

Abalewi bāri bawukūyekw isandugu y’Uhoraho na ka gasandugu kari kumwe na yo, karimwo vya bintu vy’izahabu, babiteretse kuri ca kibuye kinini. Nuk’ uwo musi ab’i Beti‐shemeshi bashikanira Uhoraho ibimazi vyoshejwe n’ibindi bimazi.
Maze ba baganwa batanu b’Abafilisitiya babibonye, basubira i Ekuroni kur’ uwo musi nyene.

Ibihute vyacuzwe mw izahabu Abafilisitiya bashikaniye Uhoraho kw impongano vyar’ ibi: kimwe car’ ic’i Ashidodi, ikindi car’ ic’i Gaza, ikindi car’ ic’i Ashikeloni, ikindi car’ ic’i Gati, ikindi car’ ic’i Ekuroni;

bo n’imbeba zacuzwe mw izahabu nyene, zingana n’ibisagara vyose vy’Abafilisitiya biganzwa n’abo baganwa batanu, uhereye ku bisagara vyubakiwe inzitiro no ku dusagara tutubakiwe. Ca kibuye kinini bāterekakw isandugu y’Uhoraho, kiri mu murima wa Yosuwa w’i Beti‐shemeshi, ni co kibishingira intahe.
Hanyuma Uhoraho yica abantu b’i Beti‐shemeshi mirongwirindwi, kuko barungurutse mw isandugu yiwe; maz’ abantu barizwa n’uk’ Uhoraho yabiciye abantu benshi.
Abo bantu b’i Beti‐shemeshi baravuga, bati Ni nde yoshobora guhagarara imbere y’Uhoraho, iyi Mana yera? Mbega none yodūga hehe, kugira ngw ituvemwo?
Batuma intumwa ku baba i Kiriyati‐yeyarimu, mut’ Abafilisitiya bagarukanye isandugu y’Uhoraho; muti None ni mumanuke, muyidūgane ije i wanyu.
Nukw ab’i Kiriyati‐yeyarimu baraza, bajana isandugu y’ Uhoraho, bayidūgana umusozi, bayishira kwa Abinadabu; maze barobanura umuhungu wiwe Eleyazari, kugira ngw abe ari we ayizezwa.
Kuva ku musi iyo sandugu yashikiye i Kiriyati‐yeyarimu hashira igihe kirekire, nk’imyaka mirongwibiri; ab’ inzu y’Abisirayeli bose barondera Uhoraho batuntuye.

Maze Samweli abarira ab’ inzu y’Abisirayeli bose, ati Ni mwaba mugarutse k’Uhoraho n’ imitima yanyu yose, ni mukūreh’ ibigirwamana vy’abanyamahanga na Ashitaroti biri muri mwebge, muherereze imitima yanyu k’Uhoraho, abe ari we musaba wenyene, na we azobarokora, abakūre mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya.
Nukw Abisirayeli baca bakūraho za Bayali na Ashitaroti, basaba Uhoraho wenyene.
Bukeye Samweli aravuga, at’ Abisirayeli bose ni mubakoranirize i Misipa, nanje nzobasengera k’ Uhoraho.
Nuko bakoranira i Misipa, bavoma amazi, bayavyagiza imbere y’Uhoraho; uwo musi barisonzesha, baravuga, bati Twaracumuye k’Uhoraho. Maze Samweli acīrira Abisirayeli imanza aho nyene i Misipa.
Abafilisitiya bumvise kw Abisirayeli bakoraniye i Misipa, abaganwa babo baca badūga kubatera. Abisirayeli bavyumvise, bagira ubgoba kubg’ Abafilisitiya.
Abisirayeli babarira Samweli, bati Ntuhengeshanye kudutakambira k’Uhoraho Imana yacu, kugira ngw adukize, ntidukorokere mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya.
Nuko Samweli yābīra umwagazi w’intama uconka, awushikanira Uhoraho kw ikimazi co kwoswa kidasonōye; maze Samweli atakambira Uhoraho kubg’ Abisirayeli; Uhoraho aramwumvira.

Samweli akirikw arosa ico kimazi, Abafilisitiya bēgereza Abisirayeli ngo bashireko, barwane. Arik’ Uhoraho kuri nya musi nyene aturikira hejuru y’ Abafilisitiya guturagara guhāmbāye, abaca umuhongo; Abisirayeli ni kwo kubanesha.
Ingabo z’ Abisirayeli ziva i Misipa, bakinagiza Abafilisitiya babica ingenda kurinda bashika musi y’i Beti‐kari.
Maze Samweli yābīra ibuye, arishinga hagati y’i Misipa n’i Sheni, aryita Ebenezeri, ati Kugeza n’ubu Uhoraho aradutabaye.
Uko ni kw Abafilisitiya bātsinzwe, ntibasubira kurenga urubibe rw’Abisirayeli; mbere mu gihe ca Samweli cose ukuboko kw’Uhoraho kwama gushikamiye Abafilisitiya.

Kand’ ibisagara vy’ Abisirayeli vyari vyaranyazwe n’ Abafilisitiya barabisubizwa, uhereye i Ekuroni ugashitsa i Gati, mber’ Abisirayeli bakūra igihugu cabo mu bubasha bg’Abafilisitiya. Ariko hagati y’Abisirayeli n’Abamori ho hār’ impore.
Imisi yose Samweli yamaze, yar’ umucamanza w’Abisirayeli.
Kand’ uk’ umwaka utashe yama agīshanya imbu kuja i Beteli n’i Gilugali n’i Misipa, acīra Abisirayeli imanza mur’ iyo myanya yose;
agaheza agasubira i Rama, kukw ari ho urugo rwiwe rwari ruri, na ho nyene akahacīrira Abisirayeli imanza. Kandi yari yarahubakiye Uhoraho igicaniro.
Maze Samweli ageze mu zabukuru, abahungu biwe abagira abacamanza b’Abisirayeli;
imfura yiwe yitwa Yoweli, uw’ ubuheta yitwa Abiya. Baba abacamanza b’i Beri‐sheba.
Yamar’ abo bahungu biwe ntibāri n’ingeso nk’ iziwe, ariko bākebereje gukurikira inyungu mbi, bakarya ingurire, bakagoreka imanza.
Nukw abakuru b’Abisirayeli bose barakorana, baja i Rama kwa Samweli,
baramubarira, bat’ Ehe rāba urashaje, kand’ abahungu bawe ntibafise ingeso nk’izawe; none rer’ utwimikire umwami wo kuducīra imanza nk’ayandi mahanga yose.
Arikw iryo jambo ribabaza Samweli, ko bavuze ngo n’abahe umwami wo kubacīra imanza; araheza asenga Uhoraho.
Uhoraho abarira Samweli, ati Ni wemerere abo bantu ico bakwātse cose, kukw atari wewe banse, ariko ni jewe banse ngo simbe Umwami wabo.
Bakugiriye nk’uko bāngiriye muri vyose, uhereye umusi nabadūganye mbakūye muri Egiputa ukageza n’ubu; kuko bāntaye, bagasaba izindi mana.
None rero n’upfe kubemerera, arik’ ubihanikirize cane, ubamenyeshe ingeso z’umwami azobaganza uko zizobamerera.
Nuko Samweli asigurira abantu bamusavye umwami ivyo Uhoraho yamubariye vyose.
Aravuga, at’ Umve ubugene umwami agiye kubaganza azobagirira: azofata abahungu banyu abashinge gukora ivy’ imikogote yiwe n’ivy’ amafarasi yiwe, no kwiruka imbere y’imikogote yiwe;
abandi azobashinga kuba abagabisha b’ingabo, bamwe igihumbi abandi mirongwitanu; abandi azobagira abarimyi n’abimbuzi biwe, n’abo gucura ibirwanishwa vyiwe vy’intambara n’ivyuma vy’imikogote yiwe.
Kand’ azofata abakobga banyu, abashinge kuba abasyi b’imbazi n’abatētsi n’abacumvyi.
Kand’ azofata imirima yanyu n’imizabibu yanyu n’imyelayo yanyu, ibiruta ibindi kuba vyiza, abihe abantu biwe.
Kand’ azobatoza ibigiracumi vy’impeke zanyu n’inzabibu kw amarari, abihe abīshikira biwe n’abantu biwe.
Kand’ azobanyaga abagurano banyu b’abahungu n’abakobga, yikubitire intorwa mu nka zanyu no mu ndogoba, abikoreshe ibikorwa vyiwe.
Kand’ azobatwara ikigiracumi c’imikuku yanyu, namwe azobagaba ukw agomba.
Maz’ umusi muzobibona muzoborōzwa n’uwo mwami mwitoreye; arik’ uwo musi nta co Uhoraho azobishura.
Arikw abantu banka kwumva ivyo Samweli ababariye, baravuga, bati Nta co biriko, turagomba umwami wo kutuganza,
kugira ngo natwe tumere nk’ayandi mahanga yose, tugire umwami wo kuducīra imanza no kutuja imbere no kuturwanira mu ntambara.
Samweli yumvise ivyo abantu bavuze vyose, abishikiriza Uhoraho.
Uhoraho aramwishura, ati N’ubemerere, ubimikire umwami. Maze Samweli abarira Abisirayeli, ati Mwese ni mwītāhire mu bisagara vy’i wanyu.
Hār’ umuntu w’Umubenyamini yitwa Kishi; yari mwene Abiyeli, Abiyeli wa Serori, Serori wa Bekorati, Bekorati wa Afiya w’ Umubenyamini; yar’ umuntu w’umutunzi.
Kandi yar’ afise umuhungu mwiza w’umusore yitwa Sauli. Nta n’umwe mu Bisirayeli yamurusha ubgiza, kandi yasumba abantu bose, bamugera ku bitugu gusa.
Bukeye indogoba za Kishi se wiwe ziratakara. Kishi abarira Sauli umuhungu wiwe, ati Hitana umwe mu banyarugo, muje kurondera izo ndogoba.
Nuko baca mu mugamba w’Abefurayimu no mu ntāra y’i Shalisha, ntibāzibona. Maze baca mu ntāra y’i Shalimu barazibura, baca no mu ntāra y’ Ababenyamini, na ho nyene ntibāzibona.
Hanyuma bashitse mu ntāra y’i Sufi, Sauli abarira uno muntu bari kumwe, at’ Ingo dutahe, data ntahave ahagarikira umutima twebge kuruta indogoba.
Na we aramwishura, at’ Erega mur’ iki gisagara harih’ umuntu w’Imana, kandi n’umunyacubahiro; ivyo avuga vyose bihora bishika; enda se tujeyo, kumbure yoturangira inzira tujana.
Maze Sauli abaza uwo muntu wiwe, ati Mbega none, ni twajayo tumugemura iki? Kw impamba yashize mu masaho yacu, tukaba ata ngemu tugira yo guha uwo muntu w’Imana. Mbega har’ ico dufise?
Uwo muntu yishura Sauli, at’ Ehe ndafise ikigirakane ca shekeli y’ifeza; ndagiha uwo muntu w’ Imana kugira ngw aturangire inzira.
(Kera mu Bisirayeli, umuntu iyo yagira ic’ aja gusiguza Imana, yavuga, ati Hogi tuje kwa kamenyi; kuk’ uwitwa ūvugishwa n’Imana ubu, kera yitwa kamenyi.)
Nuko Sauli abgira uwo muntu wiwe, ati Ni vyiza; ngwino tugende. Nuko baja ku gisagara ah’ uwo muntu w’Imana yaba.
Bakidūga umusozi ngo bashike ku gisagara, bahūra n’abigeme bavuyeyo baja kuvoma; barababaza, bati Mbega kamenyi ni ho ari?
Barabishura, bat’ Ego me; nguyo ah’ imbere yanyu; ariko munyaruke: ni ho agishika mu gisagara, azanywe n’ukw abantu bagira batange ibimazi ku mpinga y’umusozi.

Ni mwashika mu gisagara muca mumubona ataradūga ku mpinga y’umusozi kurīrayo; kukw abantu badashobora kurya ataraza, kukw ari we ahezagira ibimazi, maz’ abātowe bakabona kurya. Nuko rero ni mudūge: muca mumubona aka kanya.
Nuko baradūga ngo baje mu gisagara; bagishikayo baca bahūra na Samweli avayo ngw adūge ku mpinga y’umusozi.
Kand’ umusi Sauli ashikayo, Uhoraho yari yarāye abihishuriye Samweli,

at’ Ejo nka magingo aya nzokurungikira umuntu avuye mu gihugu c’Ababenyamini; uz’ umwimikishe amavuta, abe umwami w’abantu banje Abisirayeli. Ni we azokiza abantu banje, abakūre mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya; kuko nitegereje abantu banje, kand’ ugutaka kwabo kwanshitseko.
Nuko Samweli agikubita ijisho Sauli, Uhoraho aramubarira, at’ Ehe nguyo wa muntu nakubarira! Uyo ni we azoganza abantu banje.
Nuko Sauli yēgēra Samweli aho nyene mw irembo ry’igisagara, aramubarira, ati Ntabara undangire inzu ya kamenyi ah’ itumbereye.
Samweli aramwishura, at’ Erega ni jewe nyene kamenyi; none hogi tuje ku mpinga y’umusozi, kuk’ uyu musi muribusangire nanje; maz’ ejo mu gitondo nzokurekura, ngusobanurire ibiri mu mutima wawe vyose.
Kandi ku vya za ndogoba zawe, zimaze gatatu zizimiye, ntiziguhagarike umutima: zārabonetse. Mbeg’ ivy’ igikundiro vyose vyo mu Bisirayeli bibīkiwe nde? Si wewe nyene, n’inzu yose ya so?

Maze Sauli aramwishura, ati Mbega sind’ Umubenyamini, ari wo muryango mutoya hanyuma y’iyindi yo mu Bisirayeli? Kand’ inzu yacu si yo ntoya hanyuma y’ayandi mazu yose yo mu Babenyamini? None n’iki gitumye umbarira ben’ ivyo?
Maze Samweli ajana Sauli n’ umuntu wiwe, abinjiza mu nzu yo kuzimaniramwo, abaha ivyicaro vy’icubahiro mu bātowe, bāri nka mirongwitatu.
Maze Samweli abarira umusuku, ati Zana wa mutigiri nakubarira.

Nuk’ uwo musuku azana igikenye c’ukuguru n’inkenyūre zaco, agitereka imbere ya Sauli. Maze Samweli aravuga, at’ Ehe ngibi ivyo wateguriwe; shirak’ ufungure, kukw ari wewe wabiteguriwe gushitsa iki gihe cāshinzwe, kugira ng’ usangire n’ abandi bāhamagawe. Nuk’ uwo musi Sauli asangira na Samweli.
Bavuye aho ku mpinga y’umusozi, baramanuka bashika mu gisagara, Samweli aja kugānirira na Sauli hejuru ku nzu.
Bukeye barazinduka; hakiri mu gaturuturu Samweli ahamagara Sauli iy’ ari hejuru ku nzu, ati Vyuka, ndaguherekeze. Nuko Sauli aravyuka, arengana irembo na Samweli.
Bakimanuka, bashitse ah’ igisagara kigarukira, Samweli abarira Sauli, ati Barira uwo muntu wawe atambuke imbere; nawe uhagarare gatoya, nkumenyeshe ijambo ry’ Imana.
Maze Samweli yābīra agakuza k’amavuta ya elayo, ayamusuka ku mutwe, aramugūmbīra, aravuga, ati Mbeg’ Uhoraho si we akwimitse ng’ ube ari wewe ugaba ishamvu yiwe?

Uyu musi ni twamara gutandukana, uja gusanga abantu babiri hafi y’ imva ya Rakeli ku rubibe rw’Ababenyamini i Selusa; kandi barakubarira, bat’ Indogoba wari wagiye kurondera zarabonetse, bati Kandi so asigaye ahagarikiye umutima wewe kuruta izo ndogoba, avuga ngw ivy’ umwana wiwe yobigenza ate?

Maz’ uvuye aho, ugiye nk’akarēre, ugashika ku giti c’umweloni c’i Tabora, uja guhūra n’abantu batatu badūga gushengerera Imana i Beteli, umwe ateruye abagazi b’impene batatu, uwundi atwaye amarobe atatu y’imitsima, uwundi atwaye umukuza wa vino.
Barakuramutsa, baguhe n’amarobe abiri, nawe uyākīre.

Hanyuma urashika ku musozi w’ Imana, ahar’ iboma y’Abafilisitiya; ni washika mur’ ico gisagara, uja guhūra n’agakama k’abavugishwa n’Imana bamanuka bavuye ahēra ho ku mpinga y’umusozi, bafise amakembe n’udushāko tw’ingoma n’imyironge n’inanga bigenda biravugira imbere yabo; uja gusanga bariko baravugishwa n’Imana.
Maze Mpwemu w’Uhoraho aca akuzako akābushūngwe, nawe akuvugishe hamwe na bo, uce uhinduka ukundi, ube umuntu musha.
Kand’ ivyo bimenyamenya ni vyagushikako, ugenze uk’ ubona bikwiye, kukw Imana iri kumwe nawe.

Kand’ uz’ unyitangire imbere, umanuke i Gilugali; nanje nyene nzomanuka ngusangeyo, nje kwosa ibimazi no gutanga ivy’ ishimwe. Uz’ undorēre imisi ndwi kugeza igihe nzogusangayo nkakwereka uk’ ukwiye kugenza.
Akirora irya avuye aho Samweli ari, Imana imuha umutima musha: maze kur’ uwo musi nyene vya bimenyamenya vyose birashika.
Nuko bashitse kuri wa musozi, abavugishwa n’Imana b’agakama bahūra na we; maze Mpwemu w’Uhoraho amuzako akābushūngwe, avugishwa hamwe na bo.
Maz’ abāri basanzwe bamuzi bose, babonye arikw aravugishwa hamwe n’abandi, barabazanya, bati Mbega mwene Kishi yabaye iki? None Sauli na we yari mu bavugishwa n’Imana?
Umwe wo mu baba aho hantu arabaza, ati Mbeg’ abo ni bene nde? Ni co catumye bihinduka akagani, ngo Mbega Sauli na we yari mu bavugishwa n’Imana?
Maz’ arangije kuvugishwa aja ha hantu hēra ku mpinga y’umusozi.
Se wabo wa Sauli abaza Sauli na wa muntu wiwe, ati Mbega mwagiye hehe? Aramwishura, ati Twagiye kurondera za ndogoba; maze tubonye tuzibuze tuja kwa Samweli.
Se wabo wa Sauli aramwishura, at’ Enda se mbarira ivyo Samweli yababgiye.
Sauli yishura se wabo, ati Yatubariye neza kw indogoba zabonetse. Ariko ku vy’ubgami Samweli yamubariye, ntiyagira ico amukerukiriza.
Bukeye Samweli akoraniriza abantu i Misipa imbere y’Uhoraho,

abarira Abisirayeli, at’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli agize, ngo Yadūganye Abisirayeli abakūye muri Egiputa, ngw Arabarokora abakūra mu maboko y’ Abanyegiputa no mu maboko y’ abami bose bābahahaza;

arik’ uyu musi muranse Imana yanyu, kand’ ari yo nyene ubgayo ihora ibakiza mu vyago vyanyu vyose no mu magorwa; mwarayibgiye ngo n’ibahe umwami. Nuko rero, ni muze muhagarare imbere y’Uhoraho, umuryango wose uk’ uri, n’ inzu yose ukw iri.
Nuko Samweli ahamagaza imiryango yose y’Abisirayeli, ubupfindo bufata umuryango w’Ababenyamini.

Ahamagaza umuryango w’Ababenyamini, inzu imwe‐imwe ukwayo, inzu ya ba Matiri irafatwa; araheza ahamagaza ab’ inzu ya ba Matiri, umuntu umwe‐umwe; hafatwa Sauli mwene Kishi; ariko bamurondeye baramubura.
Nuko bongera gusiguza Uhoraho, bati Mbeg’ uwo muntu yoba ataraza? Uhoraho arabishura, at’ Ereg’ arinyegeje mu bintu vy’intēkera.
Bagenda biruka, baramuzana; ahagaze mu bantu, abasumba bose uko bangana: bamugera ku bitugu gusa.
Maze Samweli abarira abantu bose, ati Mbega murabona uw’ Uhoraho yatoranije, kw ata wuhwanye na we mu bantu bose? Abantu bose bashira akamo hejuru, bat’ Umwami n’ahangame.
Maze Samweli amenyesha abantu imiganzirize y’ubgami ukw izobamerera, avyandika mu gitabo, akibīka imbere y’Uhoraho. Samweli araheza asēzera abantu bose, barataha.
Sauli na we arītāhira, aja i muhira i Gibeya, acagatiwe n’abantu b’abahizi, abo Imana yakoze mu mitima.
Arikw abantu b’abagesera bamwe baravuga, bati Mbeg’ uwo muntu yodutabara ate? Baramukēngēra, ntibāruha bamuzanira n’ imishikīro. Arikw apfa kwinumira.
Maze Nahashi umwami w’ Abamoni aradūga, asagaza inyuma y’i Yabeshi‐gileyadi. Ab’i Yabeshi bose baramubarira, bati Duhe isezerano ryo kuduhāngaza, natwe tuzogusaba.
Nahashi umwami w’Abamoni arabishura, ati Mu ko nemera kuribaha, mwese mbanza kubanogora amaso y’i buryo, mbe nsīze Abisirayeli bose iceyi.
Abakuru b’i Yabeshi baramwishura, bati N’utwihanganire imisi ndwi, kugira ngo dutume intabaza zinyuranganye igihugu cose c’Abisirayeli; maze ni hābura uwodutabara, tuzokwisaba.
Nukw intabaza zishitse i Gibeya ho kwa Sauli, zibarira abantu uko bibaye; abantu bose baraturikisha, bararira.
Ako kanya Sauli araza yimirije inka zivuye kurima, arabaza, ati Habaye iki kw abantu barira? Bamubarira inkuru ab’i Yabeshi bazanye.
Sauli yumvise ivyo, Mpwemu w’Imana amuzako akābushūngwe, uburake bgiwe buca buraziriringa;

afata inka zibiri, azihimbaguramw’ ibihimba, abiha intabaza ngo zibinyuranganye mu gihugu cose c’Abisirayeli, mut’ Ūtazotabarana na Sauli na Samweli, uko ni kw inka ziwe zizogirirwa. Ubgoba buvuye k’Uhoraho burabafata, baca baza icarimwe gutabara nk’ umuntu umwe.
Sauli abaharūrira i Bezeki, Abisirayeli bār’ ibihumbi amajana atatu, Abayuda bar’ ibihumbi mirongwitatu.
Maze babarira za ntabaza, bati Mubarire ab’i Yabeshi‐gileyadi, mut’ Ejo ku gasase bazobatabara. Nukw izo ntabaza zije, zibibgira ab’i Yabeshi, baranezerwa.
Ab’i Yabeshi ni kwo kubarira Abamoni, bat’ Ejo tuzoza kubīsaba, namwe mutugire uko mugomba.

Bukeye Sauli agabanya abantu mw imice itatu, basēseka hagati mu nsago z’Abamoni mu gahuru, baririka Abamoni gushitsa ku musase munini; maz’ abācitse kw icumu aho bashwiragiriye nta na babiri wobonye bari hamwe.
Maz’ abantu babarira Samweli, bati Mbega ni ba nde bavuze, ngw Aho Sauli ni we yotuganza? Ni muzane abo bantu, tubice.
Ariko Sauli aravuga, ati Nta muntu yokwicwa uyu musi, kuk’ uyu musi Uhoraho ahaye Abisirayeli intsinzi.
Maze Samweli abarira abantu, ati Ni muze tuje i Gilugali, dusubire dukomeze ivy’ ubgami.
Nukw abantu bose baja i Gilugali, bimikira Sauli imbere y’Uhoraho aho nyene i Gilugali, bahatangira ibimazi vy’ishimwe imbere y’Uhoraho: nuko Sauli n’Abisirayeli bose bahagirira akanyamuneza kenshi.
Maze Samweli abarira Abisirayeli bose, at’ Ehe rāba, nabakoreye ivyo mwansavye vyose, mbimikiye umwami wo kubaganza.
Eh’ umwami azobarōngōra nguyo; jeho ndashaje, mmeze imvi; kandi rāba abahungu banje muri kumwe: nanje murazi ko nabarōngōye uhereye mu buto bganje ugashitsa n’ubu.

Ehe ndi hano: ni munyagirize imbere y’Uhoraho n’imbere y’uwo yimikishije amavuta. Mbega har’ uwo nanyaze inka? Canke har’ uwo nanyaze indogoba? Har’ uwo nagunze? Har’ uwo natwaje igitugu? Canke har’ uwo nātse impongano ikampuma amaso? Vuga ndabarihe.
Baramwishura, bat’ Eka ntiwatugunze, kandi ntiwadutwaje igitugu, canke ng’ ugire ico unyaga umuntu n’umwe.
Arababgira, at’ Uhoraho ni we cabona, bo n’uwo yimikishije amavuta, kw ata co mwambonanye. Baravuga, bati Ni we cabona.
Maze Samweli abarira abantu, at’ Uhoraho yatoranije Mose na Aroni, akadūgana ba sogokuruza abakūye mu gihugu ca Egiputa, ni we cabona.
Nuko none ni muhagarare, mbāgiririze imbere y’ Uhoraho, mbereke n’ivyo yabagiriye vyose mu bugororotsi, mwe na ba sogokuruza.
Yakobo yagiye muri Egiputa, Abanyegiputa babagirira nabi; maze ba sogokuruza batakambira Uhoraho, na we atuma Mose na Aroni, babakūra muri Egiputa, babagerēra mur’ iki gihugu.
Ariko bibagira Uhoraho Imana yabo, abagabura mu maboko ya Sisera umugabisha w’ingabo za Hasori, no mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya no mu maboko y’umwami w’i Mowabu; barabarwanya.
Maze batakambira Uhoraho, bati Twaracumuye, kuko twaguhevye, ewe Uhoraho, tugasaba za Bayali na Ashitaroti; bati Non’ uturokore, udukūre mu maboko y’abansi bacu, abe ari wewe dusaba.
Maz’ Uhoraho arungika Yerubayali na Bedani na Yefuta nanje Samweli, arabarokora, abakūra mu maboko y’abansi banyu impande zose, mwībēra amahoro.
Maze mubona Nahashi umwami w’Abamoni abateye; kandi nah’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu ari we yar’ umwami wanyu, murambarira, muti Nta co biriko: mut’ Umwami ni we azotuganza.
None rero, nguyo umwami mwitoranirije kandi mwasavye; Uhoraho abahaye umwami wo kubaganza.
Mugabo, ni mwubaha Uhoraho, mukamusaba, mukamwumvira, ntimugararize ngo muce mu vyagezwe vyiwe, kandi mwe n’umwami wanyu abaganza, ni mwagendanira Uhoraho Imana yanyu, bizoba vyiza.
Ariko ni mutumvira Uhoraho, mugaca mu vyagezwe vyiwe, ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho kuzobarwanya, nk’uko kwarwanije ba sogokuruza.
Nuko none hagarara murābe ikintu gihambaye Uhoraho agira akorere imbere yanyu.

Mbeg’ ubu si mw igenya ry’ingano? None ngira nsabe Uhoraho arungike imvura irimw’ imituragaro; muca mumenya kandi mubone kw ibigabitanyo vyanyu ari vyinshi, ivyo mwagabitanije imbere y’Uhoraho, ko mwisabiye umwami.
Nuko Samweli asaba Uhoraho; maz’ uwo musi nyene Uhoraho arekura imvura irimw’ imituragaro; abantu bose baca bagirira Uhoraho na Samweli ubgoba bginshi.
Nukw abantu bose babarira Samweli, bati Dusengere k’Uhoraho Imana yawe, twebge abasavyi bawe, twoye gupfa, kuko twageretse ku vyaha vyacu vyose iki caha co kwisabira umwami.
Maze Samweli yishura abantu, ati Nta co mutinya: ivyo bibi vyose mwarabikoze koko; ariko noneho ntimukikame ngo mureke gukurikira Uhoraho; ariko musabishe Uhoraho imitima yanyu yose.
Ntimukikame ngo mukurikire ivy’ impfagusa bidashobora kugira ikimazi canke gukiza, kukw ar’ ubusa gusa.
Uhoraho ntazoheba abantu biwe, kubg’ izina ryiwe rikuru, kuko vyahimbaye Uhoraho kubagira abantu biwe yiharije.
Kandi nanje, ntibikanzeko ko noreka kubasengera, ngacumura k’Uhoraho, ariko nzokwama mbarangira inzira nziza itunganye.
Ariko gusa, ni mwubahe Uhoraho, mumukorere mushize igikonyo, bivuye mu mutima; murābe ivyo yabakoreye ingen’ ar’ ibihambaye.
Ariko ni mwashishikara kugabitanya, muzorandurwa, mwe n’umwami wanyu.
Sauli yīmye amaze imyaka mirongwitatu; amara imyaka ibiri ari ku ngoma aganza Abisirayeli.

Sauli yitoraniriza abantu mu Bisirayeli ibihumbi bitatu; muri bo, ibihumbi bibiri bāba kuri we i Mikimashi no ku musozi w’i Beteli; abandi igihumbi bāba kuri Yonatani i Gibeya h’i Bubenyamini; abasigaye arabacūra, umuntu wese yītāhira i we.
Bukeye Yonatani atera abo mu nsago z’ Abafilisitiya i Geba, arabatsinda; abandi Bafilisitiya baravyumva. Maze Sauli avugisha inzamba mu gihugu cose, kugira ngw Abaheburayo bavyumve.
Abisirayeli bose bumva bavuga ko Sauli yatsinze Abafilisitiya bo mur’ izo nsago, kandi kw ari bo nyene bāsomboroje Abafilisitiya. Nukw abantu bakōndōrera kuri Sauli i Gilugali.

Nukw Abafilisitiya barakorakorana ngo barwanye Abisirayeli; bāri bafise imikogote y’intambara ibihumbi mirongwitatu, n’abagendera ku mafarasi ibihumbi bitandatu, n’ingabo nyinshi nk’umusenyi wo kw isēsero ry’ikiyaga; baradūga, basagaza i Mikimashi ku ruhande rw’i Beti‐aveni ruhera i burasirazuba.
Maz’ Abisirayeli babonye ko babuze epfo na ruguru, kuko bāri mu karindiro, baja kwinyegeza mu masenga no mu bisaka no mu bitandara no mu bihuma no mu vyobo vyimbiwe kubīka amazi.
Mbere bamwe bo mu Baheburayo bāri bajabutse Yorodani, baja mu gihugu c’i Gadi n’i Gileyadi; ariko Sauli we yar’ akir’ i Gilugali; kand’ abāri bakiri kuri we bāri bakūtse imitima.
Nuko Sauli amaray’ imisi ndwi, arorereye Samweli, nk’uko yari yamuhaye indagano; arikw abantu bāri bāgiye biyonjorora bamuta, Samweli ataraza i Gilugali.
Sauli ni kwo kuvuga, ati Ni munzanire hano ikimazi co kwosa n’ibimazi vy’ishimwe. Nuko yosa ico kimazi.
Agiheza kucosa, Samweli arashika; maze Sauli arasohoka aja kumusanganira ngw amuramutse.

Maze Samweli aramubaza, at’ Ivyo wakoze n’ ibiki? Sauli aramwishura, at’ Erega nabonye abantu biyonjoroye bāntaye, kandi nawe nyene utaje muri ya ndagano, Abafilisitiya na bo bariko barakorakorana i Mikimashi;
nuko nca niyumvira, nt’ Abafilisitiya bahava bamanuka ubu nyene i Gilugali bantere, kandi nanje ntaringinga Uhoraho ngw ampangaze; ni kwo gupfa guhāngāra, nosa ikimazi.
Maze Samweli abgira Sauli, ati Wakoze ic’ ubupfu; iyo wumvira icagezwe Uhoraho Imana yawe yakugeze, Uhoraho na we yokomeje ubgami bgawe ibihe vyose mu Bisirayeli.

Ariko noneh’ ubgami bgawe ntibuzohangama; Uhoraho aramaze kwironderera umuntu ameze nk’uk’ umutima wiwe ugomba; kandi ni we Uhoraho yashinze ngw az’ abe segaba w’abantu biwe, kuk’ utumviye ic’ Uhoraho yakugeze.
Nuko Samweli ava hasi, ava i Gilugali, aja i Gibeya h’i Bubenyamini. Maze Sauli aharūra abantu bari kumwe na we, baba nk’amajana atandatu.
Nuko Sauli na Yonatani umuhungu wiwe n’abari kumwe na bo baguma i Geba h’i Bubenyamini; arikw Abafilisitiya bāri bashagaje i Mikimashi.
Bukeye abanyazi b’Abafilisitiya bava aho bashagaje, bīcīyemw’ imice itatu: umuce umwe ujana inzira ija i Ofura, mu gihugu c’i Shuwali;
uwundi ujana inzira ija i Beti‐horoni; uwundi ujana inzira igendana urubibe rurāba ku mwonga w’i Seboyimu ahahera mu bugaragwa.
Ico gihe nta mucuzi yar’ akiboneka mu gihugu cose c’Abisirayeli; kukw Abafilisitiya bari bavuze, bati Hinge tubuze Abaheburayo kwicurishiriza inkota n’ amacumu.
Nukw Abisirayeli bose bāhora bamanuka mu Bafilisitiya, umuntu wese ngw anagūzeyo isuka yiwe cank’ imbāzo cank’ incabiti cank’ umuhoro;
kand’ impembo bācira isuka cank’ imbāzo ryar’ ihera ryitwa pimu, iyo bācira kunagūra incabiti canke gukwikira ikimīto, car’ ikigira gatatu ca shekeli.
Ni co gituma umusi intambara yarumanako, mu bantu bāri kumwe na Sauli na Yonatani ata n’umwe yar’ afise inkota cank’ icumu, ukūye Sauli na Yonatani umuhungu wiwe: ni bo bāri babifise.
Maz’ abo mu nsago z’Abafilisitiya barunguruza, bategera hejuru ku kavōvo k’i Mikimashi.
Umusi ur’ izina, Yonatani mwene Sauli abarira umuhungu yamutwaza ibirwanishwa, ati Ngwino tujabuke tuje ku nsago z’Abafilisitiya hakurya. Ariko ntiyabibarira se.
Kandi Sauli yar’ ashagaje ah’ i Gibeya hagarukira, musi y’igiti c’umukomamanga c’i Miguroni, ari kumwe n’abantu nk’amajana atandatu,
harimwo na Ahiya mwene Ahitubu, Ahitubu mukuru wa Ikabodi mwene Finehasi, Finehasi yari mwene Eli, umuherezi w’Uhoraho i Shilo; kandi Ahiya yambara efodi. Arikw abantu ntibamenya ko Yonatani yagiye.
Kandi mur’ ako kavōvo, aho Yonatani yagomba guca ngw ashikīre za nsago z’Abafilisitiya, mu ruhande rumwe hār’ igitandara gisongoye, mu rundi ikindi; kimwe citwa Bosesi, ikindi citwa Sene.
Igitandara kimwe cari gihagaze ahahera i burārūko, aharābana n’i Mikimashi, ikindi ahahera i bumanuko, aharābana n’i Geba.

Yonatani ni kwo kubarira uwo muhungu yamutwaza ibirwanishwa, ati Ngwino tujabuke tuje ku nsago za ziriya ntakebga; kumbure Uhoraho har’ ico yodukorera, kukw ata cobuza Uhoraho gukiza, atumye benshi canke bake.
Ūmutwaje ibirwanishwa aramwishura, ati Kora ico wiyumvira cose: hogiyo, turajana ah’ ugomba kuja hose.
Yonatani aramwishura, ati Nuko rero tujabuke, duseruke ah’ abo bagabo batubona;
maze ni batubarira, bati Ni mugume aho, turaje; duhagarare, twoye kudūga ngo tuje iyo bari.
Ariko ni batubarira, bati Ni muze ino; duce tudūga, kuk’ Uhoraho azoba abagabuye mu maboko yacu: kand’ ico ni co kija kutubera ikimenyamenya.
Nuko bompi baseruka ah’ abo mu nsago z’Abafilisitiya bababona; maz’ Abafilisitiya baravuga, bat’ Ehe rāba Abaheburayo barasokorotse mu myobo bāri binyegejemwo!

Abo mur’ izo nsago bahamagara Yonatani n’ūmutwaje ibirwanishwa, bati Ni mudūge ino, ico tubereka! Nuko Yonatani abarira ūmutwaje ibirwanishwa, ati Nkurikira, kuk’ Uhoraho abagabuye mu maboko y’Abisirayeli.
Nuko Yonatani aharāmba yāvūra, n’ūmutwaje ibirwanishwa ar’ inyuma yiwe. Ba Bafilisitiya Yonatani arabahindikiranya, bagwa imbere yiwe, n’ūmutwaje ibirwanishwa agenda arabahohosha inyuma yiwe.
Mur’ ukwo kugeseza kwa mbere kwa Yonatani n’ūmutwaje ibirwanishwa, bishe abantu nka mirongwibiri, babatsinda ahantu hangana n’ikivutu umuntu yorima mu gihimba c’umusi.
Maze haba gucika ivutu aho bashagaje n’inyuma yaho, mbere no mu ngabo zose; abo mu nsago na ba banyazi na bo bagwa mu gatengo; isi na yo iratigita, haba gucika ivutu gutewe n’Imana.
Inderetsi za Sauli zar’ i Gibeya h’i Bubenyamini bagize bartya, babona izo ngabo zishwiragiye, ziruka hirya no hino.
Maze Sauli abarira abantu bari kumwe na we, ati Ni muharūrane, murābe ko har’ uwacu yoba yatuvuyemwo. Baharūye, basanga Yonatani n’uwamutwaza ibirwanishwa batariho.
Maze Sauli abarira Ahiya, ati Zana hano isandugu y’Imana; kuko mur’ iyo misi isandugu y’Imana yajana n’ Abisirayeli.
Maze Sauli akirikw aravugana n’umuherezi, urwamo rwari mu nsago z’Abafilisitiya rurarushiriza; nuko Sauli abarira uwo muherezi, at’ Isigireho.
Nuko Sauli n’abantu bari kumwe na we bose barakorana baja mu ntambara, basanga basubiranyemwo, bariko barazibagurana inkota, bacitse umuhongo rwose.
Maz’ Abaheburayo bari basanzwe bafatanije n’Abafilisitiya ubga mbere, bakaba bāradūganye na bo aho bāja gusagaza, na bo barahinduka, bifatanya n’Abisirayeli bari kumwe na Sauli na Yonatani.
Kand’ Abisirayeli bose bari binyegeje mu mugamba w’Abefurayimu, bumvise kw Abafilisitiya bahunze, na bo nyene babōma inyuma babarwanya.
Uko ni k’Uhoraho yarokoye Abisirayeli uwo musi; kand’ urugamba rurinda rurenga i Beti‐aveni.

Maz’ uwo musi Abisirayeli bacika intege; kuko Sauli yari yarahije abantu, akavuga, ati Haravumwe umuntu aza kugira ico atamira butaragoroba, ntaraheza kwihōra abansi banje. Nuko nta muntu n’umwe muri bo yagize ico atamira.
Maz’ abantu bose baja mu kibira; kandi hasi har’ ubūki.
Nuko bashitse mur’ ico kibira, basanga ubgo būki buriko burashonga; ariko ntihagira umuntu n’umwe akoza intoke ku munwa, kuko bātinya kurenga indahiro.
Ariko Yonatani we, igihe se yarahiza abantu, ntiyumva, ni kwo gutuma inkoni yitwaje, akayikoza ku mutsāma w’ ubūki, agashira mu kanwa, akajisho kakagaruka.
Maz’ umwe mur’ abo bantu aramubarira, at’ Erega so yari yihanikirije abantu, arabarahiza, ngo Haravumwe umuntu aza kugira ico atamira uyu musi. Kand’ abantu bari badendebukiwe.
Maze Yonatani aramwishura, ati Data yagiriye abantu nabi! Ehe rāba ingen’ akajisho kagarutse, aho ntamiriye kur’ ubu būki.
Uyu musi iyaba abantu baretswe bakarya ku vyo basahuye abansi babo, vyari kugenda neza; ariko noneho mu Bafilisitiya ntihapfuye benshi cane.
Nuk’ uwo musi bica Abafilisitiya, uhereye i Mikimashi ugashitsa i Ayaloni; arikw abantu bari badendebukiwe cane.
Hanyuma bagurukira ku myiri banyaze, bafata intama n’inka n’inyana, bazitsinda hasi barazizibagura, bazirya zikirimw’ amaraso.
Baca babibarira Sauli, bat’ Ereg’ abantu baracumuye k’Uhoraho, kuko bariko bararya inyama amaraso akirimwo. Arababgira, ati Murahemutse; ni muntembagarize hano ibuye rinini.

Maze Sauli aravuga, ati Ni mugende mukwiragire mu bantu, mubabgire, umuntu wese anzanire inka yanyaze cank’ intama, ayikererere hano. Muheze muzirye, mureke gucumura k’Uhoraho, mukazirya amaraso akirimwo. Nuko mur’ iryo joro umuntu wese muri bo azana inka yanyaze, bazikerereraho.
Maze Sauli yubakira Uhoraho igicaniro; kand’ ico gicaniro ni co ca mbere yubakiye Uhoraho.

Maze Sauli aravuga, at’ Enda ni muze tumanuke, dukurikire Abafilisitiya iri joro, turāre turabanyaga gushitsa mu macaca, ntihagire umuntu n’umwe dusiga. Baramwishura, bati Kora uk’ ugomba kwose. Arik’ umuherezi ati Ni mwīgire hano twēgēre Imana.
Nuko Sauli asiguza Imana, ati Mbega mmanuke nkurikire Abafilisitiya? Urabagabura mu maboko y’Abisirayeli? Arik’ uwo musi ntiyamwishura.
Maze Sauli aravuga, ati Ni mwīgire hano, mwese abakuru b’abantu, musuzume murābe icaha cakozwe uyu musi ic’ ari co.
Ndahiye uguhoraho kw’Uhoraho, yama arokora Abisirayeli, naho yoba umwana wanje Yonatani, arapfa nta kabuza! Ariko mu bantu bose ntihagira n’umwe agira ico amwishura.
Maz’ abarira Abisirayeli bose, ati Ni muherēre ku ruhande rumwe, nanje na Yonatani umwana wanje turaherēra ku rundi. Nukw abantu bishura Sauli, bati Kora uk’ ugomba.

Maze Sauli aravuga, at’ Ewe Uhoraho, Mana y’Abisirayeli, (n’ iki gitumye utishura umusavyi wawe uyu musi? Namb’ ico caha kiri muri jewe canke muri Yonatani umwana wanje, Uhoraho Mana y’Abisirayeli, rekura Urimu, arikw asangwa kiri mu bantu bawe Abisirayeli), rekura Tumimu. Nuk’ ubupfindo bufata Yonatani na Sauli, arikw abantu barēra.
Maze Sauli aravuga, ati Ni mudupfindire twe na Yonatani umwana wanje. Nuko Yonatani arafatwa.
Sauli araheza abgira Yonatani, ati Mbarira ico wakoze. Yonatani aramwishura, ati Nakojeje inkoni nari nitwaje mu mutsāma w’ubūki, ndumviriza; none rero ndemeye gupfa.
Sauli aramwishura, ati Ni wagenda udapfuye ga Yonatani, Imana ibimpanire, mbere birushirije.

Arikw abantu babarira Sauli, bati None Yonatani yopfa, kand’ ari we yahaye Abisirayeli ugutsinda kungana gurtyo? Biragahera! Turahiye uguhoraho kw’Uhoraho yukw ata n’agashatsi na kamwe ko ku mutwe wiwe kazohara ngo gakorokere hasi; kuko ku vyabaye uyu musi yafatanije n’Imana. Uko ni kw abantu bākijije Yonatani ngo ntāpfe.
Maze Sauli arīgīra, areka gukurikira Abafilisitiya; Abafilisitiya na bo basubira i wabo.
Sauli amaze kuja ku ngoma ngw aganze Abisirayeli, arwanya abansi biwe bose impande zose, Abanyamowabu n’Abamoni n’ Abanyedomu, n’abami b’i Zoba, n’Abafilisitiya; yagenda anesha aho yatumbera hose.
Akora ivy’ ubuhizi, anesha Abamaleki, arokora Abisirayeli, abakūra mu maboko y’ababanyaga.
Abahungu ba Sauli bāri Yonatani na Ishivi na Malikishuwa, kand’ abakobga biwe bompi, umukuru yari Merabu, umutoyi yari Mikali.
Muka Sauli yitwa Ahinowamu mwene Ahimasi; kand’ umugabisha w’ingabo ziwe yari Abuneri mwene Neri, se wabo wa Sauli;
Kishi ni we yari se wa Sauli, kandi Neri se wa Abuneri yari mwene Abiyeli.
Imisi yose Sauli yabayeho hābaye indwano zigoye hagati yabo n’Abafilisitiya; kandi Sauli, iy’ abonye umuntu wese w’amagara kandi w’umuhizi yaca amujana i we.
Maze Samweli abarira Sauli, ati Ni jewe Uhoraho yatumye kukwimikisha amavuta, ng’ ube umwami w’abantu biwe b’ Abisirayeli. None rero ni wumve amajambo y’Uhoraho.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize: ngw Amaramaje guhana Abamaleki, abahoye ivyo bagiriye Abisirayeli, ingene bābabujije inzira igihe bādūga bava muri Egiputa.

None rero genda, utere Abamaleki, ubarandure rwose n’ivyo bafise vyose; ntuz’ ugire uwo uziguriza, arik’ uz’ ugeseze abagabo n’abagore n’abana, mbere n’abonka, bo n’inka n’intama n’ingamiya n’indogoba.
Nuko Sauli ahamagaza ingabo, aziharūrira i Telayimu, zār’ ingabo ibihumbi amajana abiri, bo n’iz’ i Buyuda ibihumbi cumi.
Bukeye Sauli aja ku gisagara c’Abamaleki, aryama mu mwonga waho.

Ariko Sauli abarira Abanyakeni, ati Hogi ni mugende, muve mu Bamaleki, noye kubarandurana na bo, kuko mwagiriye Abisirayeli bose neza, igihe bādūga bava muri Egiputa. Nukw Abanyakeni bava mu Bamaleki.
Maze Sauli ageseza Abamaleki uhereye i Havila ugashitsa i Shura, aharābana na Egiputa.
Afata mpiri umwami wabo Agagi, aranduza abantu bose inkota.

Ariko Sauli n’ingabo ziwe baziguriza Agagi, bo n’ibirusha ibindi ubgiza mu ntama no mu nka no mu mashūri anuze no mu myagazi y’intama, mber’ ivyiza‐vyiza vyose, banka kubigeseza rwose; arikw ibigayitse vyose n’ ibitagira ico bimaze aba ari vyo bageseza rwose.
Maz’ ijambo ry’Uhoraho riza kuri Samweli,
riti Ndicujije icatumye nimika Sauli; kuko yamvuyeko, akanka gukora ivyo namubariye. Maze Samweli araraka, akēsha ijoro atakambira Uhoraho.
Bukeye akoroka kare ngw aje gusanganira Sauli; baramubarira, bati Sauli yari yagiye i Karumeli, ahīshingira icibutso; hanyuma arahindukira, akomeza inzira amanuka i Gilugali.
Maze Samweli ashikīra Sauli; Sauli aramubarira, at’ Uragahezagirwa n’Uhoraho! Ico Uhoraho yambariye nāgishikije.
Samweli aramubaza, ati Non’ urwo rwānāga rw’intama runza mu matwi, bo n’ukwabagirana kw’inka numva, n’ivy’ iki?

Sauli aramwishura, ati N’izo bākūye mu Bamaleki, kukw abantu bazigurije izirusha izindi ubgiza mu ntama no mu nka, ngo n’izo gushikanira Uhoraho Imana yawe kw ibimazi; na vyo ibindi vyose twarabigesheje rwose.
Maze Samweli yishura Sauli, ati Hagarara! Hinge nkubarire nanje ivyo Uhoraho yarāye ambariye iri joro. Aramwishura, at’ Ego, vuga.
Samweli aramubgira, ati Naho wari warīkēngereye, mbega ntiwagizwe uwo kuganza imiryango y’ Abisirayeli? Uhoraho ntiyakwimikishije amavuta ng’ube umwami w’Abisirayeli?
Kand’ akagutuma ku rubanza, akakubgira, ati Genda ugeseze rwose ba banyavyaha b’Abamaleki, ubarwanye gushitsa baherengeteye?
None se n’iki cakubujije kwumvira Uhoraho, ukagurukira ku minyago, ugakora ivyo Uhoraho abona kw ari bibi?
Maze Sauli yishura Samweli, at’ Ereg’ Uhoraho nāmwumviye: kand’ urwo rubanza Uhoraho yantumyeko nārumaze; nazanye Agagi umwami w’Abamaleki, kand’ Abamaleki ubgabo narabagesheje rwose.
Arikw abantu ni bo bākūye intama n’inka mu zo bānyaze, izarusha izindi kuba nziza mu zāgira zigesezwe, ngo zize zibe izo gushikanira Uhoraho Imana yawe kw ibimazi ngaha i Gilugali.
Samweli aramwishura, ati Mbeg’ Uhoraho ahimbarwa n’ibimazi vyoswa n’ ibindi bimazi gusumba ūmwumviye? Erega kwumvira gusumba ibimazi, no kuyoboka gusumba ibinure vy’impfizi z’intama.
Kuk’ ubugarariji ari co kimwe n’icaha c’ubupfumu, kandi kuba ntagondwa ni kimwe no gusenga ibishushanyo n’ibigirwamana. Ko wanse ijambo ry’Uhoraho, na we yanse k’uba ku ngoma.
Maze Sauli yishura Samweli, ati Naracumuye, kuko ntumviye icagezwe c’Uhoraho n’amajambo yawe, ngatinya abantu nkabumvira.
None rero ndakwinginze, mparira icaha canje; uze dusubiraneyo, kugira ngo nsenge Uhoraho.
Samweli yishura Sauli, at’ Eka sinsubiranayo nawe; ko wanse ijambo ry’Uhoraho, na we yanse k’uba umwami w’Abisirayeli.
Nuko Samweli agihindukira ngw agende, Sauli ashingīra umutwe w’impuzu yiwe, iratabuka.
Maze Samweli aramubarira, at’ Uhoraho na we uyu musi agutabuyekw ingoma y’Abisirayeli, ayihaye mugenzawe akuruta.
Ereg’ Inyenkomezi y’Abisirayeli ntibesha, kandi ntiyīrīmbūra, kukw atar’ umuntu ngw ize yīrīmbūre.
Na we aramwishura, ati Naracumuye; yamara none ndakwinginze, untere itēka imbere y’abakuru bo mu bantu banje n’imbere y’Abisirayeli, dusubiraneyo kugira ngo nsenge Uhoraho Imana yawe.
Nuko Samweli arahindukira, akurikira Sauli; Sauli asenga Uhoraho.
Maze Samweli aravuga, ati Ni munzanire hano Agagi umwami w’Abamaleki. Nuko Agagi aza ah’ ari araramanga; aravuga, ati N’ukuri ibamba ry’urupfu rirashize.
Maze Samweli aramubgira, ati Nk’ukw inkota yawe yagira abagore imbura, ni ko na nyoko abaye imbura mu bandi bagore. Nuko Samweli amuhimbagurira imbere y’Uhoraho i Gilugali.
Maze Samweli aja i Rama, Sauli na we aradūga, ataha i muhira i we i Gibeya.
Guhēra ico gihe Samweli ntiyongera kubonana na Sauli kurinda apfa, atar’ ukwama amuririra; kand’ Uhoraho aricuza ico yimikiye Sauli ngw abe umwami w’Abisirayeli.

Maz’ Uhoraho abaza Samweli, at’ Uzogeza hehe kuririra Sauli, kandi namaze kwanka kw aba umwami w’Abisirayeli? Uzuza ihembe ryawe amavuta, uheze uze ngutume kuri Isayi w’i Betelehemu, kuko nironkeye umwami mu bahungu biwe.
Samweli arasiguza, ati Nogenda nte? Erega Sauli ni yavyumva azonyica. Uhoraho aramwishura, ati Hitana inka y’ishashi, ugende, uvuge, uti Nje gushikanira Uhoraho ikimazi.
Uheze uhamagare Isayi aze kur’ ico kimazi; nanje nzokwereka uk’ uzogenza; uz’ undobanurize amavuta uwo nzokurangira.
Nuko Samweli agenza nk’uk’ Uhoraho yamubgiye, aja i Betelehemu. Ashitseyo, abakuru b’igisagara baza kumusanganira, bahinda agashitsi. Baramubaza, bati Mbeg’ ugenzwa n’amahoro?
At’ Ego me n’amahoro; nzanywe no gushikanira Uhoraho ikimazi. Nuko ni mwiyeze, muze tujane kur’ ico kimazi. Kandi yeza Isayi n’abahungu biwe, abahamagara kuza kur’ ico kimazi.
Nuko bashitseyo, abonye Eliyabu, aribgira, ati Nta gukekeranya, uwo Uhoraho agira yimikishe amavuta nguyu imbere yiwe.

Arik’ Uhoraho abarira Samweli, ati Nta co urāba ishusho yiwe, cank’ ikirēho ciwe, kuko ntāmushimye; erega jewe sindāba nk’ukw abantu barāba: kukw abantu barāba ku rukoba gusa, ariko jewe Uhoraho ndāba mu mutima.
Maze Isayi ahamagara Abinadabu, amwereka Samweli. Samweli aravuga, ati N’uyu nyene Uhoraho si we yatoranije.
Isayi arongera amwereka Shama; na ho nyene Samweli aravuga, at’ Eka n’uyu na we Uhoraho si we yatoranije.
Nuko Isayi yerekana indwi mu bahungu biwe ngo Samweli abarābe. Samweli abarira Isayi, at’ Aba si bo Uhoraho yatoranije.

Maze Samweli abaza Isayi, ati Mbeg’ abana bawe bose n’abo? Aramwishura, ati Hasigaye umuhererezi, ariko rer’ ari ku ntama. Nuko Samweli aramubarira, ati Tuma ūja kumuhamagara, kuko tutaribgicare ngo turye ataraza.
Nukw atuma ūja kumuzana. Kandi yar’ umuhungu w’inzobe, w’amaso meza, w’umunyakaranga. Maz’ Uhoraho aravuga, ati Va hasi, umusukekw amavuta, kuko wa wundi ar’ uyo.
Nuko Samweli aca yābīra rya hembe ry’amavuta, ayamusukako bakuru be bamukikije. Kuva uwo musi Mpwemu w’Uhoraho yama aza kuri Dawidi akābushūngwe. Nuko Samweli arahaguruka, asubira i Rama.
Mpwemu w’Uhoraho amaze kuva kuri Sauli, impwemu mbi irungitswe n’Uhoraho yama igenda imufata bga gikange.
Maz’ abantu ba Sauli baramubarira, bat’ Ereg’ impwemu mbi irungitswe n’ Uhoraho ni yo igukanga!

Enda se databuja, n’udutume twebge abasavyi bawe duhagaze hano, tuje kukuronderera umuntu w’ umuhinga azi gucuraranga inanga; maz’ iyo mpwemu mbi irungitswe n’Imana iy’ igufashe, az’ agucurarangire, ukire.
Nuko Sauli yishura abo bantu biwe, ati Nuko ni mundonderere umuntu azi gucuraranga neza, mumunzanire.

Umuhungu umwe w’umusore aramwishura, ati Nabonye umuhungu wa Isayi w’i Betelehemu, n’umucuraranzi w’umuhinga, n’ umuhizi w’inkomezi kand’ arazi kurwana, aritonda mu vyo avuga, n’umuntu w’igikundiro, kand’ Uhoraho ari kumwe na we.
Nuko Sauli atuma intumwa kuri Isayi, uti Murungikire umuhungu wawe Dawidi, umwe aragira intama.
Nuko Isayi yābīra indogoba, ayishirakw imitsima n’umukuza w’urusāto wuzuye vino, n’umwagazi w’impene, abirungikana umuhungu wiwe Dawidi ngw abishikanire Sauli.
Nuko Dawidi ashitse kwa Sauli arenguka imbere yiwe; Sauli aramukunda cane, amugira ūmutwaza ibirwanishwa.
Maze Sauli atuma kuri Isayi, ut’ Aragusavye Dawidi ngw amugendanire, kukw amushimye.
Hanyuma uko ya mpwemu mbi yarungitswe n’Imana yafata Sauli, Dawidi yahitana inanga, agacuraranga; maze Sauli akoroherwa agakira, iyo mpwemu mbi ikamuvako.
Maz’ Abafilisitiya bakoranya ingabo zabo ngo batere; bazikoraniriza i Sokoho h’i Buyuda, basagaza ahitwa Efesi‐damimu, hagati y’i Sokoho n’i Azeka.
Sauli n’Abisirayeli na bo barakorakorana, basagaza ku mwonga Ela, batonda urugamba ngo barwanye Abafilisitiya.
Abafilisitiya batonda ku musozi wo hakurya, Abisirayeli ku wo hakuno, umwonga ugaca hagati yabo.
Bukeye mu nsago z’Abafilisitiya havamw’ umuhizi yitwa Goliyati w’i Gati; uburebure bgiwe bgar’ amatambge atandatu y’ukuboko uciriye mu nkokora n’itambge rimwe ry’intoke.
Kandi yari yambaye inkofero y’umuringa mu mutwe, n’umwinjiro ukozwe mu miringa, urivye shekeli ibihumbi bitanu;
ku maguru yari yambaye ibikingira imirundi bikozwe mu miringa; kandi yar’ afise agakobero k’umuringa nyene gatendera inyuma mu butīkorwa.
Uruti rw’icumu ryiwe rwāngana n’umwaro ujishirwakw impuzu, icumu ubgaryo ryar’ iryo mu vyuma, ryari ririvye shekeli amajana atandatu; kand’ uwamutwaza inkinzo yaja imbere yiwe.
Arahagarara, atera akamo ingabo z’Abisirayeli, ati N’iki cabazanye gutonda urugamba? Mbega sind’ Umufilisitiya, namwe mukaba abaja ba Sauli? Enda ni mwitorere umuntu, amanuke aze duhwane!
Ni yashobora kundwanya akanyica, tuzoba abaja banyu; nanje ni nashobora kumutsinda nkamwica, ni mwebge muzoba abaja bacu, mudukorere.
Uwo Mufilisitiya arongera aravuga, at’ Uyu musi ndagaye ingabo z’Abisirayeli! Enda ni muzane umuntu, twimarize twempi!
Maze Sauli n’Abisirayeli bose bumvise ayo magambo y’Umufilisitiya, barīhebūra, bagira ubgoba bginshi.
Kandi Dawidi yar’ umwana wa wa Munyefurata w’i Betelehemu h’i Buyuda yitwa Isayi; Isayi yar’ afise abahungu munani; kand’ igihe Sauli yīma Isayi yar’ ashitse mu zabukuru.
Kand’ abahungu batatu bakuru ba Isayi bāri bāratabaranye na Sauli; amazina y’abo bahungu biwe batatu bātabaye, uw’ imfura ni Eliyabu, uwa kabiri ni Abinadabu, uwa gatatu ni Shama.
Dawidi ni we yar’ umuhererezi; kand’ abo bakuru be batatu bāri bāratabaranye na Sauli.
Kandi Dawidi yaja agīshanya imbu, hamwe akaba kwa Sauli, ahandi akaja kuragira intama za se i Betelehemu.
Nuk’ uwo Mufilisitiya, uko bukeye uko bgije, akāma aseruka ahibonekeza, abasomboroza, kumara imisi mirongwine.
Bukeye Isayi abarira umuhungu wiwe Dawidi, ati Genda ugemurire bakuru bawe ingero imwe kur’ izi ngano zikaranze, n’iyi mitsima cumi, ubandanye aho bashagaje, ubibashīre.
Kand’ ugemurire umugabisha w’umuce barimwo, aya masoro ukw ar’ icumi y’umukānyūre w’amavuta; uheze urābe bakuru bawe uko bameze, unzanire agakuru k’imvāho.
Kandi Sauli n’abo bakuru ba Dawidi n’ingabo zose z’Abisirayeli bāri kuri wa mwonga Ela bashāmiranye n’Abafilisitiya.

Nuko Dawidi akoroka kare, asigarana intama ūzimurābira, ahitana ivyo bintu aragenda, nk’uko Isayi yamubariye, ashikira aho barāza imikogote y’intambara, ahūra ingabo zigiye gutonda urugamba zīrahira ubutōre.
Nukw Abisirayeli batonda urugamba, n’Abafilisitiya n’uko, urugamba ruhanganye n’ urundi.
Maze Dawidi abītsa ivyo yar’ agemuye ūsigarana ibintu vy’intēkera, ariruka aja mu ngabo, aramutsa bakuru be.
Akirikw arayāga na bo, wa muhizi w’Umufilisitiya w’i Gati yitwa Goliyati asokoroka mu ngabo z’Abafilisitiya, atangura kwiyamāmura nk’ uko yahora. Dawidi aravyumva.
Abisirayeli bose bamubonye, bacika ivutu baramuhunga.

Abisirayeli baravuga, bati Ntimubona uriya mugabo adūze? Adūganywe no gucōkōra Abisirayeli, nta kindi. Umuntu yomwica, umwami azomugororera vyinshi, kand’ azomushingira umwana wiwe, akūre n’inzu ya se kw ikori mu Bisirayeli.

Maze Dawidi abaza abantu bahagaze i ruhande yiwe, at’ Uwokwica uwo Mufilisitiya, agakūra igitutsi ku Bisirayeli, bomugororera iki? Mbeg’ uwo Mufilisitiya w’intakebga n’iki, ah’ acōkōra ingabo z’Imana nzima?
Abantu bamwishura nk’ivyo bari bahejeje kuvuga, bat’ Uwomwica, uko ni ko yogororerwa.

Maze Eliyabu mukuru we, imfura ya se, yumvise Dawidi avugana n’abo bantu, uburake bgiwe buraziriringa, aramubaza, ati Wazanywe n’iki? Mbega bga butama wabusigaranye nde mu bugaragwa? Ndazi amanyama yawe, n’ ubugāba bgo mu mutima wawe: ereg’ icakuzanye n’ukugira ng’ urābe intambara.
Dawidi aramwishura, ati None nkoze iki? Ntikwar’ ukubaza gusa?
Arahindukira, arāba uwundi, na we amubaza nk’ivyo, abantu basubira kumwishura nk’ivya mbere.
Bumvise amajambo Dawidi avuga, bayashengerana kwa Sauli; araheza aramuhamagaza.
Dawidi ashitse, abarira Sauli, ati Ntihagire uwo arandura umutima; jewe umusavyi wawe ndagiye kurwana n’uwo Mufilisitiya.
Sauli yishura Dawidi, ati Ntiwoshobora kuja kurwanya uwo Mufilisitiya, kuk’ ukir’ umwana, ariko we yamenyereye kurwana uhereye mu buto bgiwe.
Dawidi yishura Sauli, ati Jewe umusavyi wawe iyo ndagiye intama za data, hakaza intambge cank’ idubu kigasahura umwana w’intama mu mukuku,
twāca tugerekerana nkagikubita, nkakiyāka mu kanwa; cāmvumbukana nkagisūmira urusakanwa, nkagikubita nkacica.
Non’ umusavyi wawe ko namaze kwica intambge n’idubu, n’uwo Mufilisitiya w’intakebga azopfa nka kimwe muri vyo, kuko yacōkōye ingabo z’Imana nzima.
Dawidi atakw aravuga, at’ Uhoraho yagiye andokora mu nzāra z’intambge no mu z’idubu, arandokora no mu maboko y’uwo Mufilisitiya. Nuko Sauli abarira Dawidi, ati Nuko genda; Uhoraho abane nawe.
Maze Sauli yambika Dawidi imyambaro yiwe, amwambika n’inkofero y’umuringa mu mutwe, n’umwinjiro w’ ivyuma.

Dawidi araheza ahagatira inkota yiwe hejuru y’iyo myambaro, agerageza gutambuka ngw arābe, kukw atabimenyereye. Maz’ abarira Sauli, at’ Ibi sinshobora kubijana, kuko ntābimenyereye. Nuko Dawidi aravyiyambura.

Araheza ahitana inkoni yiwe, ashitse ku kagezi, atoramw’ amabuye y’imburungu atanu, ayarokeza mw isaho yiwe y’ubgungere; kandi yar’ afise umugozi mu ntoke wo guteresha ibuye; nukw aja guhūra na wa Mufilisitiya.
Wa Mufilisitiya na we aza guhūra na Dawidi, ūmutwaje inkinzo amutamaje imbere.
Nuko wa Mufilisitiya abonye Dawidi, aramwitegereza, aramukēngēra, kuko yar’ akir’ umwana w’umusore, kandi yar’ inzobe w’umunyakarānga.
Wa Mufilisitiya abaza Dawidi, ati Mbeg’ ugira ngo nd’ imbga, k’uje kundwanya ufise inkoni? Araheza avuma Dawidi mu mazina y’imana ziwe.
Uwo Mufilisitiya abarira Dawidi, ati Ngwino nkubāgire ibisīga vyo mu kirēre n’ibikōko vyo mw ishamba!
Dawidi yishura uwo Mufilisitiya, at’ Uje kundwanya ufise inkota n’icumu n’agakobero, ariko jewe nje kukurwanya mw izina ry’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, Imana y’ingabo z’Abisirayeli wacōkōye.

Uyu musi Uhoraho arakugabuye mu maboko yanje; ngira nkwice, nguce izosi; kand’ imivyimba y’ingabo z’Abafilisitiya ngira ndayigaburire ibisīga vyo mu kirēre n’ibikōko vyo mw ishamba, kugira ngw isi yose imenye ko mu Bisirayeli har’ Imana;
kand’ iri koraniro ryose rimenye yuk’ Uhoraho adakirisha inkota cank’ icumu, kukw intambara ar’ iy’ Uhoraho, kandi ni we agira abagabure mu maboko yacu.
Nuko wa Mufilisitiya atanguye kuza ngw ahūre na Dawidi, Dawidi arabandanya ariruka atumbereye ingabo z’Abafilisitiya, ngw ahūre n’uwo Mufilisitiya nyene.
Maze Dawidi atuma ukuboko mw isaho yiwe, akūray’ ibuye, ariteresha wa mugozi, arinega uwo Mufilisitiya mu ruhanga, rimwiteramwo, aca yikubita hasi yubamye.
Uko ni ko Dawidi yagangahuje uwo Mufilisitiya ibuye yateresheje umugozi, akamwica; kandi nta nkota Dawidi yari yitwaje.
Maze Dawidi arirukanga, amuhagarara hejuru, asūmira inkota yiwe, ayimusokōra mu rwubati, aramuhohosha, amuca izosi. Maz’ Abafilisitiya babonye umuhizi wabo apfuye, baca baratemesha.

Maz’ ingabo z’Abisirayeli n’iz’ Abayuda zikūra hasi, zishira urwamo hejuru, zikinagiza Abafilisitiya zibashitsa i Gati no ku marembo y’i Ekuroni: Abafilisitiya bagenda barahindikirana bakomeretse ku nzira ija i Sharayimu, kurinda bashika i Gati n’i Ekuroni.
Abisirayeli baraheza bava inyuma y’ Abafilisitiya, baragaruka basahura insago zabo.
Maze Dawidi afata umutwe wa wa Mufilisitiya, awujana i Yerusalemu; arikw ibirwanishwa vyo asiga abibītse mw ihema ryiwe.

Igihe Sauli yabona Dawidi agiye kurwana na wa Mufilisitiya, yabajije Abuneri umugabisha w’ ingabo ziwe, ati Harya ga Abuneri, urya muhungu ni mwene nde? Na we aramwishura, ati Mugenzi, indahiro ni wewe nyene nkamumenya!
Umwami aramwishura, ati Baza se w’uwo muhungu uw’ ari we.
Hanyuma Dawidi atabarutse, avuye kwica wa Mufilisitiya, Abuneri aramujana, amushikiriza Sauli, afise umutwe wa wa Mufilisitiya mu ntoke.
Sauli aramubaza, ati Harya uri mwene nde, ga wa muhungu? Dawidi aramwishura, ati Nd’ umwana w’umusavyi wawe Isayi w’i Betelehemu.
Nuko Dawidi amaze kugānīra na Sauli, umutima wa Yonatani uca ufatana n’uwa Dawidi akaramata, Yonatani amukunda nk’uko yikunda.
Maz’ uwo musi Sauli aca agumya Dawidi, ntiyamukundira gusubira kwa se ukundi.
Bukeye Yonatani asezerana isezerano na Dawidi, kuko yar’ amukunze nk’uko yikunda.
Yonatani yikiza umutamana wiwe yari yambaye, awuha Dawidi, amuha n’ivyo yambara mu ntambara, mbere n’inkota yiwe n’ umuheto n’umukanda.
Nuko Dawidi yama agenda aho Sauli yamutuma hose, akabigiramw’ ikiganza ciza, bituma Sauli amuha kugaba ingabo ziwe; abantu bose barabishima, mbere n’abagendanyi ba Sauli na bo.

Maze mw itabaruka ryabo, Dawidi agarutse avuye kwica wa Mufilisitiya, abagore bava mu bisagara vyose vy’Abisirayeli, bavyina batamba, baza gusanganira umwami Sauli, bafise udushāko tw’ingoma n’utundi tuvuga nk’ inanga, bavuza impundu.
Mur’ ukwo kuvyina, abagore bāgenda baritabiriza, bati Sauli yishe ibihumbi, Dawidi we yica ibihumbi indiri.
Sauli aca arashangashirwa, iryo jambo riramubabaza; aravuga, ati Dawidi bamuharūyekw ibihumbi indiri, nanje jeho bamparūyek’ uduhumbi gusa. None har’ ikindi agishigaje, atar’ ingoma?
Kuva uyo musi Sauli yama arāba Dawidi ijisho ribi.

Bukeye impwemu mbi irungitswe n’Imana iza kuri Sauli akābushūngwe, ashirakw ariyamiriza ari mu ngoro, Dawidi akavuza inanga nk’uko yar’ asanzwe akora imisi yose; kandi Sauli yar’ afise icumu mu ntoke.
Araheza ararirekura, ati Hinge ndarisākize Dawidi, rirume ku nzu. Ariko Dawidi amuzibukira kabiri.
Maze Sauli atinya Dawidi, kuk’ Uhoraho yari kumwe na we, ariko we akaba yamuvuyeko.
Ni co catumye amwigizayo, akamugira umugabisha w’ingabo igihumbi, akāma atabarana na zo amaja n’amaza.
Kandi Dawidi yagira ikiganza ciza mu vyo yakora vyose, kand’ Uhoraho yari kumwe na we.
Maze Sauli abonye ukuntu agira ikiganza ciza, aramutinya.
Arikw Abisirayeli n’Abayuda bose bākunda Dawidi, kuko yatabarana na bo amaja n’amaza.

Bukeye Sauli abarira Dawidi, ati Nguyo umukobga wanje mukuru Merabu, nzomuguha; ariko rero, uz’ ube umuhizi wo kundwanira, urwane intambara z’Uhoraho. Kuko Sauli yavuga, ati Yoye kuzongwako, arikw az’ agwe ku Bafilisitiya.
Ariko Dawidi abarira Sauli, ati Mbega jewe, n’inda n’ indēsho, n’umuryango wacu, n’ inzu ya data ukw iri mu Bisirayeli, noba umukwe w’umwami?
Arikw igihe Merabu uwo mukobga wa Sauli yar’ akwiye gushingirwa Dawidi, bamuha Aduriyeli Umumeholati, aramurongora.
Hanyuma Mikali umukobga wa Sauli agomwa Dawidi; babibgira Sauli, arabishima.
Aravuga, ati Nzomumuha, amubere umutego, agwe ku Bafilisitiya. Ni co catumye Sauli abarira Dawidi ubugira kabiri, at’ Uyu musi ubaye umukwe wanje.
Nuko Sauli abarira abantu biwe, ati Ni muje kuyāga na Dawidi mu mpisho, mumubarire, mut’ Umve, umwami aragushima, kandi n’ abantu biwe bose baragukunda; muti None rer’ ukwiye kuba umukwe w’umwami.
Nukw abo bantu ba Sauli babarira Dawidi ayo majambo; Dawidi arabishura, ati Mugira ngo biroroshe kuba umukwe w’umwami, nanje nd’ umworo w’inkēngērwa?
Hanyuma abo bantu ba Sauli baramubarira, bati Dawidi yavuze artya n’artya.

Maze Sauli arababarira, ati Muze mubarire Dawidi, muti Ntagomba inkwano; mut’ Ico agomba n’ubugabo ijana uzoshāhura Abafilisitiya, kugira ngo yīhōre abansi biwe. Ariko Sauli yagira ngw akororere Dawidi mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya.
Nukw abo bantu biwe bamaze kubarira Dawidi ayo majambo, Dawidi aca ashima kuba umukwe w’umwami.

Igihe gishinzwe kitaragera, Dawidi ahagurukana n’ingabo ziwe, yica mu Bafilisitiya abagabo amajana abiri; nuko Dawidi atabarukana ubugabo bgabo, babushikiriza umwami ukw igitigiri cabgo kingana, kugira ngo Dawidi abone kuba umukwe w’umwami. Nuko Sauli amushingira umukobga wiwe Mikali.
Kandi Sauli amenya yuk’ Uhoraho ari kumwe na Dawidi, arabitahura. Kandi Mikali umukobga wa Sauli yakunda Dawidi.
Nuko Sauli arushiriza gutinya Dawidi, amugendanira akazīka imisi yose.
Bukeye abaganwa b’Abafilisitiya baza gutera; kand’ uko bātera kwose, Dawidi yagira ibakwe kurusha abandi bantu bose ba Sauli, bituma izina ryiwe riba rurangiranwa.
Bukeye Sauli abarira Yonatani umuhungu wiwe bo n’ abantu biwe bose ngo bice Dawidi. Ariko Yonatani mwene Sauli yakunda Dawidi cane.
Nukw abūrira Dawidi, ati Data Sauli agomba kukwica; none rero wirinde: ejo uz’ ube ur’ ahantu hiherereye, wihishe.
Nanje nzogenda mpagararane na data ku musozi ah’ uzoba uri nyene, mvugane na we ivyawe; ni nagira ico numva cose nzokikubarira.
Bukeye Yonatani avugana na se Sauli, amushimira Dawidi; aramubarira, ati Mugenzi, ntuz’ ugirire nabi Dawidi umusavyi wawe, kukw ata kibi yakugiriye; mber’ ivyo yagukoreye vyabaye vyiza cane,

kuko yahevye amagara yiwe, akica wa Mufilisitiya, Uhoraho akarokora Abisirayeli uburyo bukomeye. Nawe ubibonye uranezerwa. None n’iki kigutera kugira nabi, ukavisha amaraso y’ūtācumuye, ngo wice Dawidi umuhōye ubusa?
Nuko Sauli yumvira Yonatani, aramurahira, ati Ndahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho akaba agipfuye!
Yonatani arahava ahamagara Dawidi, amwīgānira ivyo vyose. Nuko Yonatani arengukana Dawidi imbere ya Sauli, aguma ngaho nk’uko yahora.
Bukeye hasubira kuba intambara; Dawidi aratabara, arwana n’Abafilisitiya, abatikiza agatikizo gakomeye; abasigaye barahunga.
Bukeye ya mpwemu mbi irungitswe n’Uhoraho iza kuri Sauli, avyagiye mu ngoro yiwe, afise icumu mu minwe; Dawidi amuvugiriza inanga.
Sauli agerageza gusākiza Dawidi icumu, ngo rirume ku nzu; Dawidi ararizibukira, amuva imbere, rinega ku nzu. Nuko mur’ iryo joro nyene Dawidi arahunga, aramukira.
Maze Sauli atuma abantu ngo baje kwa Dawidi, bamuryamire, kugira ngo ni bgāca bamwice. Maze Mikali, muka Dawidi, aramubarira, at’ Iri joro n’utanyaga amagara, ejo bazokwica.
Nuko Mikali acisha Dawidi mw idirisha, aramwururutsa, na we aca aratemesha, arahunga.
Mikali araheza ahitana terafimu, ayirambika ku buriri, ayishirakw ikijishano c’ ubushenza bg’impene mu mutwe, ayorosakw impuzu.
Nukw izo ntumwa Sauli yarungitse gufata Dawidi, Mikali arazibgira, at’ Ararwaye.
Hanyuma Sauli yongera gutuma izo ntumwa ngo barābe Dawidi, ati Mumuterurane n’uburiri mumudūgane, mumunzanire, ndamwice.
Nukw izo ntumwa zinjiye zisanga terafimu ari yo iri ku buriri, na ca kijishano c’ubushenza bg’impene kiri mu mutwe wayo.
Sauli abimenye, abaza Mikali, ati N’iki caguteye kumpenda urtyo, ukareka umwansi wanje, agacika? Mikali yishura Sauli, ati Yambgiye, ati Ndeka ngende, sinkwice.
Nuko Dawidi ni kwo guhunga agacika, akaja i Rama kwa Samweli, amwīgānira ivyo Sauli yamugiriye vyose. Hanyuma ahagurukana na Samweli, baja i Nayoti, bagumayo.
Maze babgira Sauli, bat’ Erega Dawidi ar’ i Nayoti i Rama.

Nuko Sauli atuma abantu gufata Dawidi: bashitseyo, basanga abavugishwa n’Imana b’agakama bariko baravugishwa, na Samweli ahagaze ngaho nk’umukuru wabo; maze Mpwemu w’Imana aza kur’ izo ntumwa za Sauli, na zo zica ziravugishwa.
Babibgiye Sauli, atuma izindi ntumwa, na zo zishitse ziravugishwa. Arongera atuma izindi ubugira gatatu, na zo n’uko ziravugishwa.
Araheza arisidukira, aja i Rama, ashikira kw iriba rinini ry’i Seku, arabaza, ati Samweli na Dawidi bari hehe? Umuntu aramwishura, ati Bar’ i Nayoti i Rama.
Aca agenda i Nayoti i Rama; maze Mpwemu w’Imana amuzako na we, agenda aravugishwa kurinda ashika i Nayoti i Rama nyene.
Ashitseyo yīkiza impuzu ziwe, avugishirizwa imbere ya Samweli arambaraye hasi yambaye ubusa, yiriza umusi akēsha ijoro. Ni co catumye bavuga, bati Mbega Sauli na we yari mu bavugishwa n’Imana?
Nuko Dawidi arahunga, ava i Nayoti i Rama, araza abaza Yonatani, ati Mbega nzira iki? Nacumuye mu ki? Ikibi nagiriye so n’igiki, gituma arondera kunyica?
Na we aramwishura, ati Biragahera, ntuzopfa! Erega data nta co akora atambariye, ari gito ari kinini; none har’ icotuma abimpisha? Ek’ ivyo si ko biri.

Dawidi aramwishura, at’ Erega so azi neza ko ngutonnyeko; ni co catumye yiyumvira, ati Yonatani ntābimenye ngo bimubabaze. Ariko vy’ukuri, ndahiye uguhoraho kw’Uhoraho, nawe nyene ndakurahiye, har’ agatambuko kamwe gusa hagati yanje n’urupfu.
Maze Yonatani yishura Dawidi, at’ Ico ugomba cose nzokigukorera.
Dawidi aramwishura, at’ Ejo ukwezi kuzoboneka, kandi nta cari gikwiye kumbuza gusangira n’umwami; ariko ndekura ngende ninyegeze ku musozi, gushitsa ku musi ugira gatatu ku mugoroba;

maze so ni yaramuka andāvye akambura, uz’ uheze uvuge, uti Dawidi yaranyinginze ngo ndamurekure anyanyase, akubite i wabo i Betelehemu, ngo Kukw igihe co gutangira umuryango wose ikimazi c’umwaka kigeze.
Maze ni yavuga, ati Nuko ni vyiza; umusavyi wawe nzoba nd’ amahoro; ariko ni yaraka, uzoca umenya ko yamaramaje ivyo kuzongirira nabi.
Nuko rer’ ungirire neza, jewe umusavyi wawe, kuko wansezeraniye isezerano imbere y’Uhoraho. Ariko namba har’ igicumuro mfise, n’unyiyicire ubgawe: n’iki cotuma urinda kunshīra so?
Yonatani aramwishura, ati Biragahera! None nomenya ko data afise inama yo kukugirira nabi, sinoca ndabikubgira?
Maze Dawidi abaza Yonatani, ati None so ni yakwishura nabi, nzobibgirwa n’iki?
Yonatani aramubarira, ati Hogi dusohoke tuje ku gahinga.

Nuko Yonatani abarira Dawidi, at’ Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli ni we cabona; ejo nk’aya mango, canke hirya y’ejo, nzoba nāmaze gucaca data; maze ni nasanga akuvuga neza, nzoca ngutumako, ndabikumenyeshe.
Ariko data ni yaramuka agomba kukugirira nabi, simbikumenyeshe, ngo nkurungike wīgīre uburarame, Uhoraho abimpanire, kandi birushirije. Kand’ Uhoraho az’ abane nawe nk’uko yabana na data.
Namba nzoba nkibayeho, uz’ ungirire imbabazi nk’iz’ Uhoraho;
na ho ni napfa, na ho nyene ntuz’ ukūre imbabazi zawe ku nzu yanje gushitsa ibihe vyose, eka mbere gushitsa ah’ Uhoraho azoba ahejeje kurandura abansi bawe bose kw isi.
Nuko Yonatani asezerana isezerano n’inzu ya Dawidi, ati Ni waricamwo, Uhoraho azoriguhōra atumye abansi bawe.
Nuko Yonatani yongera kurahiza Dawidi kubg’ urukundo yamukunda, kuko yamukunda nk’uko yikunda.
Maze Yonatani aramubarira, at’ Ejo k’ukwezi kuzoboneka, bazokurāba bakubure, kukw icicaro cawe kizoba kirimw’ ubusa.
Maze ku musi ugira gatatu, uz’ uce umanuka vuba, usubire ha handi wari winyegeje ku musi wa vya bindi, ugume hambavu ya ca gihongo c’amabuye.
Nanje nzorasa imyampi itatu i ruhande yaco, nk’aho ndi n’ico ngenekereje;

nce ntuma umwana, ndamubarire, nti Genda utore irya myampi. Maze ni nabarira nya mwana, nt’ Eh’ imyampi iri hino yawe, n’uyābīre; uz’ uheze uze, kukw azoba ar’ amahoro, ata co kwinona, nkurahiye uguhoraho kw’Uhoraho.
Ariko ni nabarira nya muhungu, nt’ Eh’ imyampi iri hirya yawe; uz’ uheze uhunge, kuk’ Uhoraho azoba aguhungishije.
Kand’ iri jambo tuvuganye twe nawe, Uhoraho abe hagati yacu ibihe vyose.
Nuko Dawidi yinyegeza ku musozi; bukeye ukwezi kubonetse, umwami aravyagira ngw afungure.
Kandi yar’ avyagiye ku ntebe yiwe, nk’uko yahora, ari yo ntebe yegamiye inzu; Yonatani yar’ amutumbereye, Abuneri yicaye i ruhande ya Sauli; arikw icicaro ca Dawidi carimw’ ubusa.
Yamara Sauli kur’ uwo musi ntiyagira ico avuga, kuko yiyumviriye, ati Sinzi ico yabaye; ngira ngw arahumanye, eka nta kundi arahumanye.

Ku musi ugira kabiri, ukwezi gusībiye kubonetse, na ho nyene icicaro ca Dawidi carimw’ ubusa. Maze Sauli abaza umuhungu wiwe Yonatani, at’ Ejo n’iki cabujije mwene Isayi kuza gusangira natwe, kugeza n’uyu musi akaba ataje?
Yonatani aramwishura, ati Dawidi yaranyinginze ngo ndamurekure akubite i wabo i Betelehemu;

yarambgiye ngo ndamutabare ndamurekure, ngo Kukw i wabo mur’ ico gisagara bazotanga ikimazi, ngo Kandi mukuru we yamutumyeko; ngo Kandi ni naba ndamugiriye neza, ngo Ndamurekure, aje kubonana na bakuru be. Ico ni co camubujije kuza ku meza yawe, mwami.

Maz’ uburake bga Sauli buziriringira Yonatani, aramubarira, ati Wa mwana w’umugore w’intumva kandi w’inshirukanya! Mbeg’ ugira ngo sindabizi ko watoranije mwene Isayi ngo wīmāramāze, wambike na nyoko ibara?
Erega mwene Isayi agihumeka, nta guhangama kwawe, nta n’ugutsindaza kw’ingoma yawe. Nuko tuma bamunzanire; n’ukuri azopfa nta kabuza!
Maze Yonatani yishura se Sauli, ati Non’ apfa azize iki? Yakoze iki?
Sauli amutera icumu ngw amwice; bituma Yonatani amenya ko se yamaramaje kwica Dawidi.
Maze Yonatani aca ava ku meza afise ishavu ryinshi; kur’ uwo musi ugira kabiri w’ukwezi ntiyagira ico atamira na mba, kuko yababajwe n’ivya Dawidi, kandi n’uko se amutētereje.
Bukeye mu gitondo Yonatani aja kuri wa musozi mu gihe yaraganye na Dawidi, ari kumwe n’ umwana mutoya.
Maz’ abarira uwo mwana, at’ Irukanga utore imyampi ngira ndase. Umwana aciruka, Yonatani arekura umwampi, uramurēngāna.
Nya mwana ashitse aho Yonatani arashe umwampi, Yonatani amutera akamo, ati Mbega nta wo ubona hiyo yawe?
Yongera kumutera akamo, ati Bandanya unyaruke, ntuhagarare. Nuko nya mwana wa Yonatani atora imyampi, agaruka aho shebuja ari.
Arik’ uwo mwana ntiyagira ico amenya; Yonatani na Dawidi bonyene ni bo bāri babizi.
Maze Yonatani aha uwo mwana umuheto wiwe n’imyampi, aramubarira, ati Hogi bijane mu gisagara.
Nuk’ uwo mwana amaze kugenda, Dawidi asokoroka aho yar’ ari i ruhande ya ca gihongo, akubita inkoro hasi, amwunamira gatatu; maze baragūmbīrana, bararira, ariko Dawidi we ararushiriza.

Maze Yonatani abarira Dawidi, ati Genda amahoro, ko twarahiye mw izina ry’Uhoraho, tukavuga, tut’ Uhoraho azoba hagati yacu no hagati y’ uruvyaro rwacu gushitsa ibihe vyose. Nuko Dawidi arahaguruka aragenda; Yonatani na we asubira mu gisagara.
Maze Dawidi aja i Nobu kwa Ahimeleki umuherezi; Ahimeleki aza kumusanganira ahinda agashitsi; aramubaza, ati Vyagenze bite, k’uri wenyene ata waguherekeje?

Dawidi yishura Ahimeleki umuherezi, at’ Umwami yantumye ku rubanza, arambarira ngo ntihagire umuntu n’umwe amenya ivy’ urwo rubanza yantumyeko, cank’ ico yangeze. Kand’ imikangara yanje nayirangiye ko tuzohūrira ahanaka.
Mbega nta kazimano? Ntabaza udutsima dutanu, cank’ ico wobona cose.
Uwo muherezi yishura Dawidi, ati Nta mitsima isanzwe mfise, atar’ iyejejwe; n’imiburiburi iyaba iyo mikangara idaherūkanye n’ abagore.

Dawidi yishura uwo muherezi, ati Vy’ukuri haciye imisi itatu dutandukanye n’abagore; kandi twavuye i muhira ibintu vy’iyo mikangara vyejejwe, nah’ ar’ urugendo nk’izindi. Non’ uyu musi ibintu vyabo ntibiheza bikarushiriza kuba ivyera?
Nuk’ uwo muherezi amuha imitsima yejejwe, kukw ata yindi yariho atar’ iy’ ibiterekērwa, iyo bāhora bakūra imbere y’Uhoraho, bagasubizah’ iyigishūshe ku musi bayikūyeho.
Kur’ uwo musi nyene hār’ umuntu umwe wo mu basavyi ba Sauli yari yashībijwe ngw agume imbere y’Uhoraho, yitwa Dowegi w’Umunyedomu, yar’ umubgiriza w’abungere ba Sauli.
Dawidi abaza Ahimeleki, ati Mbega nta cumu wogira hano cank’ inkota? Nta nkota nazanye cank’ ikindi kirwanishwa, kuk’ urubanza rw’umwami rwar’ urwo kwihuta.

Uwo muherezi aramwishura, ati Ya nkota ya Goliyati wa Mufilisitiya watsinda mu mwonga Ela, ehe ngiyi iri hano, izingiriwekw impuzu inyuma ya efodi; ni wagomba kuyijana, uyijane, kukw ata yindi iri hano atar’ iyo. Dawidi aramwishura, ati Nta yiruta iyo; yimpe.
Uwo musi Dawidi arahaguruka ahunga Sauli, aja kwa Akishi umwami w’i Gati.
Abantu ba Akishi baramubarira, bat’ Uyu si Dawidi umwami wa ca gihugu? Si we bāvyinira bitabiriza, bati Sauli yishe ibihumbi, Dawidi we yica ibihumbi indiri?
Ayo magambo atuma Dawidi ahagarika umutima, agirira Akishi umwami w’i Gati ubgoba bginshi.
Araheza yigira ukundi imbere yabo, yisarishiriza muri bo, aharamba inzugi z’irembo, akarekura urukonda rugashororokera mu bganwa.
Akishi abarira abo bantu biwe, at’ Aho ntimubona k’uyo muntu yasaze? Icatumye mumunzanira n’iki?
Mbega har’ abasazi nari nkennye mu ko munzanira uru rugabo kunsarira imbere? Urugabo nk’uru rwongīra mu nzu?
Nuko Dawidi avayo, arahunga, aja mw isenga ry’i Adulamu. Bukeye bakuru be na bene wabo bose bavyumvise, baramanuka bamusangayo.
Kand’ umuntu wese yari mu magorwa, n’ūrin’umwenda, n’ūgendana imyidogo bakoranira kuri we, aba umukuru wabo; nukw abo bantu bāri kumwe na we bāri nk’amajana ane.
Bukeye Dawidi aja i Misipa h’i Mowabu, asaba umwami w’i Mowabu, ati Ndakwinginze, wemerere data na mama bimukire ino, babe i wawe gushitsa aho nzomenyera ico Imana izongirira.
Nukw abashikiriza umwami w’i Mowabu; baba i we igihe cose Dawidi yamaze mw isenga.
Bukeye ūvugishwa n’Imana Gadi abarira Dawidi, ati Reka gukomeza kuba mur’ iryo senga; rivemwo, uje mu ntāra y’i Buyuda. Nuko Dawidi avayo, aja mu kibira c’i Hereti.

Bukeye Sauli yumva ko Dawidi n’abo bari kumwe har’ abababonye; kandi yar’ avyāgiye musi y’igiti c’umwesheli ku gatwe k’ umusozi i Gibeya; yar’ afise icumu mu minwe, kand’ abagendanyi biwe bose bari bahagaze bamukikije.

Sauli abaza abo bagendanyi biwe bamuhagaze irya n’ino, ati Yemwe mwa Babenyamini! Aho mwene Isayi uwo azoha umuntu wese muri mwebge amatongo n’imizabibu? Kandi mwese azobagira abagaba ibihumbi n’abagaba amajana,

ngo bitume mwese mungarariza? Kw ata n’umwe yarushe ammenyesha k’umwana wanje yasezeranye na mwene Isayi, ntihagire n’ūmbabara n’umwe, cank’ ūmmenyesha k’umwana wanje yangararishirije umuntu akamugira umwansi wanje, nk’uko bimeze n’ubu!
Maze Dowegi w’Umunyedomu, yar’ ahagararanye n’abo bagendanyi ba Sauli, yishura umwami, ati Narabonye mwene Isayi uwo aza i Nobu kwa Ahimeleki mwene Ahitubu;
na we amusiguriza Uhoraho, kand’ amuha impamba, amuha na ya nkota yar’ iya Goliyati Umufilisitiya.
Umwami avyumvise, atuma guhamagaza Ahimeleki umuherezi, mwene Ahitubu, n’ab’ inzu ya se bose, ari bo baherezi b’i Nobu; bose bītaba umwami.
Bashitse, Sauli aravuga, ati Wewe mwana wa Ahitubu! Na we ati Sabge mugenzi.
Sauli aramubaza, ati N’iki catumye mungīra inama, mwe na mwene Isayi, ukamuha ivyo kurya n’inkota, ukamusiguriza Imana, ngw ankūrire hasi, abe umwansi wanje, nk’uko bimeze ubu?
Ahimeleki yishura umwami, ati Mbega none mu basavyi bawe bose har’ uwoba umwizigirwa nka Dawidi umukwe w’ umwami, ari we aganza abagushibamira, akaba umunyacubahiro mu rugo rwawe?

Ugira ngo ni bgo bga mbere kumusiguriza Imana? Ntibikabeho ko nokora nk’ivyo! Mugenzi, ntunshirekw ikintu nk’ico, jewe umusavyi wawe, canke ku b’inzu ya data iyo bava bakagera; kukw ata kintu na kimwe nari nzi mur’ ivyo vyose.
Umwami aramwishura, ati Nta kabuza, ntugenda udapfuye, mwe n’ab’ inzu ya so bose.

Umwami araheza abarira abashibamyi bamukikije, ati Ni mukūre hasi, mwice abo baherezi b’Uhoraho, kuko bāfatanye agatoke na Dawidi, kandi bāri bazi ko yahunze, ntibabimbarire. Arikw abo bantu b’umwami ntibemera gukoza amaboko kur’ abo baherezi b’ Uhoraho.
Maz’ umwami abarira Dowegi, ati Kūra hasi weho, wice abo baherezi. Nuko Dowegi Umunyedomu akūra hasi, arabica; uwo musi yica abantu mirongumunani na batanu bambara efodi yera derere.
Maz’ i Nobu, igisagara c’abaherezi, akigeseza n’ inkota, abagabo n’abagore, abana n’abonka, bo n’inka n’indogoba n’intama, vyose abimarira ku nkota.
Arik’ umwe mu bahungu ba Ahimeleki mwene Ahitubu, yitwa Abiyatari, aracīka, ahungira iyo Dawidi ari.
Abikira Dawidi ko Sauli yagesheje abaherezi b’ Uhoraho.
Dawidi abarira Abiyatari, ati Wa musi, aho nabona Dowegi Umunyedomu, namenye kw atazobura kubibarira Sauli: abo mu nzu ya so bose ni jewe bazize.
N’ugume aho ndi, ntutinye; kuk’ ūmpīga ari we aguhīga: ariko ni wagumana nanje nta co uzoba.
Bukeye babarira Dawidi, bat’ Ereg’ Abafilisitiya barateye i Keyila, bariko barasahura ivyandagaye ku mbuga.
Nuko Dawidi asiguza Uhoraho, ati Mbega nje kurwanya abo Bafilisitiya? Uhoraho yishura Dawidi, ati Genda ubarwanye, utabare ab’i Keyila.
Arikw ingabo za Dawidi ziramubaza, ziti Ko twari dusanzwe dufise ubgoba tukir’ ino i Buyuda, ni twaja i Keyila kurwana n’ingabo z’Abafilisitiya bizocura iki?
Nuko Dawidi yongera gusiguza Uhoraho. Uhoraho aramwishura, ati Haguruka umanuke uje i Keyila, kuko nzogabura Abafilisitiya mu maboko yawe.
Nuko Dawidi ahagurukana n’ingabo ziwe, baja i Keyila, barwana n’Abafilisitiya, banyaga inka zabo, babatikiza agatikizo gakomeye. Uko ni ko Dawidi yatabaye ababa i Keyila.
Kand’ igihe Abiyatari mwene Ahimeleki yahungira iyo Dawidi ari, yamanukanye efodi i Keyila.
Bukeye babarira Sauli yuko Dawidi yagiye i Keyila; Sauli aravuga, at’ Imana imugabuye mu maboko yanje, yitaye mu mutego, ko yagiye mu gisagara cugazwa inzugi n’ibihindizo.
Nuko Sauli ahamagaza ingabo zose ngo zitabare, zije gutera i Keyila, zūgarize Dawidi n’ingabo ziwe.
Dawidi amenye ko Sauli yamugīriye inama mbi, abarira Abiyatari umuherezi, ati Zana hano efodi.
Nuko Dawidi arasenga, at’ Uhoraho, Mana y’Abisirayeli, jewe umusavyi wawe numvise inkuru y’imvāho yuko Sauli agomba gutera i Keyila, ngw arandure iki gisagara agihōra jewe.

Mbeg’ abantu b’i Keyila bazontanga mu maboko yiwe? Kandi Sauli azomanuka koko, nk’uko jewe umusavyi wawe navyumvise? Ewe Uhoraho, Mana y’Abisirayeli, ndakwinginze barira umusavyi wawe. Uhoraho aramwishura, at’ Azomanuka.
Maze Dawidi arongera arabaza, ati Non’ abantu b’i Keyila bazontanga twe n’ingabo zanje mu maboko ya Sauli? Uhoraho aramwishura, ati Bazogutanga.
Nuko Dawidi ahagurukana n’ingabo ziwe, zari nk’ amajana atandatu, bava i Keyila, bagenda bayerēra hirya no hino. Hanyuma babarira Sauli ko Dawidi yahunze akava i Keyila; aca asigaho ntiyaja gutera.
Nuko Dawidi aba mu masenga yo mu bugaragwa, aguma mu mugamba wo mu bugaragwa bg’i Zifu. Sauli akāma amurondera uko bukeye, arikw Imana ntiyamugabura mu maboko yiwe.
Maze Dawidi abonye ko Sauli amurondera ngw amwice, yigumira i Horeshi mu bugaragwa bg’i Zifu.
Bukeye Yonatani mwene Sauli arahaguruka, aja iyo Dawidi ari i Horeshi, amuremēsha mu vy’ Imana.
Aramubarira, ati Reka gutinya, kuk’ ukuboko kwa data Sauli kutazogushikīra; kand’ uzoba umwami w’Abisirayeli, nanje nzoba uwa kabiri kuri wewe; kandi data Sauli na we arabizi.
Bompi baraheza basezeranira isezerano imbere y’Uhoraho; maze Dawidi yigumira i Horeshi, Yonatani asubira i we.
Bukeye Abanyezifu baja i Gibeya kwa Sauli, baramubarira, bati Mbeg’ aho ntuzi ko Dawidi yinyegeje i wacu, mu masenga y’i Horeshi, ku musozi Hakila, ahahera i bumanuko bg’ubugaragwa?
None rero mugenzi, n’umanuke nk’uk’ ugomba; kandi ni twebge tuzomugabura mu maboko yawe, mugenzi.
Sauli arabishura, ati Muragahezagirwa n’Uhoraho kuko mwambabaye!
