None rero ni mugende, murushirize guhwēbūtsa, mumenye mwitegereze ah’ ikiryamo ciwe kiri, kandi n’uwoba yaramubonye uw’ ari we, kuko bambariye kw ar’ ubgenge cane.

Nuko murābe mwitegereze utunyegero twiwe twose aho yihisha; muheze mungarukanire inkuru y’imvāho, nanje nzoheza njane namwe: kandi namb’ ari mur’ ico gihugu, nzomusesangura mu masinzi yose y’ Abayuda.
Nuko bava hasi, baja i Zifu, bitangiye imbere ya Sauli. Ariko Dawidi n’ingabo ziwe bāri mu bugaragwa bg’i Mayoni, mu kiyaya Araba, ahahera i bumanuko bg’ubugaragwa.

Nuko Sauli n’ingabo ziwe baja kumurondera, ariko Dawidi arabūrirwa; araheza aramanuka, aja ku gitandara co mu bugaragwa bg’i Mayoni, yigumirayo. Sauli avyumvise, akurikira Dawidi mur’ ubgo bugaragwa bg’i Mayoni nyene.

Ashitseyo, ajana uruhande rumwe rw’umusozi, Dawidi n’ingabo ziwe bajana urundi. Dawidi akirikw aranyaragasa ngw ahunge Sauli, Sauli na we n’ingabo ziwe bakirīko baratangatanga irya n’ino Dawidi n’ingabo ziwe ngo babafate,
haza intabaza kuri Sauli, iramubarira, iti Ngwino tebuka, kukw Abafilisitiya bateye igihugu.
Nuko Sauli arahindukira, areka gukurikira Dawidi, aja kurwanya Abafilisitiya: ni co catumye aho hantu bahita Sela‐hamalekoti.
Nuko Dawidi avayo, aradūga, aja kuba mu masenga y’i Eni‐gedi.
Bukeye Sauli atabarutse, avuye kwirukana Abafilisitiya, baramubarira, bat’ Erega Dawidi ari mu bugaragwa bg’i Eni‐gedi.
Nuko Sauli ahitana ingabo ibihumbi bitatu zitoranijwe mu Bisirayeli bose, baja kurondera Dawidi n’ingabo ziwe mu bitandara ah’ impene z’inyeshamba ziba.
Nukw araza, ashika ku birāro vy’intama vyar’ i ruhande y’inzira, kandi hār’ isenga. Maze Sauli aryinjiramwo kwihagarika. Kandi Dawidi n’ingabo ziwe bari bicaye hirya mur’ iryo senga.

Maz’ izo ngabo za Dawidi ziramubarira, zit’ Uyu ni wa musi Uhoraho yakubgira kw azogabura umwansi wawe mu maboko yawe, ng’ uz’ umugire uk’ ugomba. Dawidi ava hasi, acacura umutwe w’impuzu ya Sauli buhoro‐buhoro.
Hanyuma Dawidi yumva umutima umuseka, kukw acacuye umutwe w’impuzu ya Sauli.

Maz’ abarira ingabo ziwe, at’ Uhoraho arakabishira kure yanje, sinkagire ikintu nk’ico ngirira umwami wanje, kand’ ari we Uhoraho yimikishije amavuta! Sinkamukozek’ ukuboko, kuko yimikishijwe amavuta n’Uhoraho.
Uko ni ko Dawidi yatesheje ingabo ziwe, ntiyabakundira kugurukira kuri Sauli. Nuko Sauli arahaguruka, ava mur’ iryo senga, arīgīra.
Hanyuma Dawidi na we ava hasi, ava mur’ iryo senga nyene, ahamagara Sauli, at’ Urazirikanye, mugenzi! Sauli akebutse, Dawidi akubita inkoro hasi, aramwūnamira.
Nuko Dawidi aramubaza, ati N’iki gituma uja ku vyo abantu bakubarira, ngo Dawidi agomba kukugirira nabi?

Aho ntubonye k’Uhoraho yar’ akugabuye mu maboko yanje uyu musi, mur’ iri senga? Mbere harih’ abāmbgiye kukwica, ariko ndakwirekera, nti Sinokoza ukuboko kuri databuja, nti Kukw ari we Uhoraho yimikishije amavuta.

Kandi ga muvyeyi, ehe rāba nguyu umutwe w’impuzu yawe mu ntoke zanje! Ko nacacuye umutwe w’impuzu yawe sinkwice, none rero n’umenye kand’ ushirwe kw ata kibi cank’ ubugarariji ngufiseko; kandi sinagucumuyeko, nah’ umpīga ng’ unyice.
Uhoraho n’aducire urubanza twe nawe, Uhoraho n’abe ari we azokumpōra; arik’ ukuboko kwanje ntikuzogukorako.
Aba kera baciye umugani, ngw Ibibi biva mu babi; ariko rer’ ukuboko kwanje ntikuzogukorako.
None ga mwami w’Abisirayeli, uteye iki? Uhīga iki? Ereg’ uteye imbga ipfuye, uhīga imbaragasa!
None rer’ Uhoraho n’abe umucamanza, aducīre urubanza twe nawe, n’avyitegereze, ambūrane, ankūre mu maboko yawe.
Nuko Dawidi amaze kubarira Sauli ayo majambo, Sauli aravuga, at’ Ah’ iryo jwi n’iryawe, ga mwana wanje Dawidi? Maze Sauli araturikisha ararira.
Abarira Dawidi, at’ Undushije kugororoka, kuk’ ungiriye neza, nanje jeho nakugiriye nabi.
Kand’ uyu musi werekanye k’ungiriye neza, kuk’ Uhoraho yari yangabuye mu maboko yawe, ntunyice.
Mbeg’ umuntu yobona umwansi wiwe, agaheza agapfa kumureka akīgīra? Uragahabga ingororano nziza n’Uhoraho, ku vy’ unkoreye uyu musi.
Kandi rero ndazi k’utazobura kuba umwami, kandi kw ari wewe uzotuma ingoma y’Abisirayeli ihangama.
None rero ndahira Uhoraho k’utazorandura uruvyaro rwanje, kandi k’utazozimiriza izina ryanje mu nzu ya data.
Nuko Dawidi aramurahira. Sauli araheza yisubirira i we, Dawidi n’ingabo ziwe baradūga baja mw isenga.
Maze Samweli apfuye, Abisirayeli bose bakoranira hamwe, baramuririra; bamuhamba i we i Rama. Hanyuma Dawidi ava hasi, aramanuka aja mu bugaragwa bg’i Parani.
Hār’ umuntu w’i Mayoni, itunga ryiwe ryar’ i Karumeli; yar’ umutunzi cane, yar’ afise intama ibihumbi bitatu n’impene igihumbi; ico gihe yarikw arakemuriza ubgoya bg’intama ziwe i Karumeli.

Uwo muntu yitwa Nabali, umugore wiwe yitwa Abigayili; uwo mugore yar’ umunyabgenge, kandi yar’ umunyakaranga, arik’ umugabo wiwe yar’ umuntu w’ikigoryi kandi w’imico mibi; yar’ uwo mu muryango wa Kalebu.
Maze Dawidi ari mu bugaragwa yumva ko Nabali arikw arakemuza intama ziwe.
Nuko Dawidi atuma abahungu b’imisore cumi, ati Ni mudūge muje i Karumeli, muje kwa Nabali, mumundamukirize;
mubgire uwo mutungwa, mut’ Amahoro abe kuri wewe no mu rugo rwawe no mu vy’ufise vyose.
Muti Yumvise k’ufise abantu bariko barakemura; muti Kand’ abungere bawe bābāna na bo, nta co bābagiriye nabi, nta co bājimije igihe cose bābaye i Karumeli.

Muti Baza imikangara yawe barabikubarira; muti Ngo Kandi natwe abantu biwe utugirire ubuntu, kuko tuje ku musi mwiza; muti Non’ aragusavye, ngw ico uzoba ufise cose, abe ari co uduha, twebge abasavyi bawe, n’umwana wawe Dawidi.
Abo bahungu bo kwa Dawidi bashitse, babarira Nabali ivyo Dawidi yabatumye vyose, baraheza bītega ico abishura.
Nabali yishura abo bantu ba Dawidi, ati Dawidi n’iki? Kandi mwene Isayi n’iki? Erega mur’ iyi misi harih’ abashumba benshi bātaye ba shebuja.
None ntore imitsima yanje n’amazi yanje n’inyama nabāgiye abakemuzi banje, mbihe abantu ntazi iyo bava?
Nukw iyo mikangara ya Dawidi barahindukira, basubirayo; bashitse bamwīgānira ivyo vyose.

Nuko Dawidi abarira abantu biwe, at’ Umuntu wese n’ahagatire inkota yiwe. Nuk’ umuntu wese ahagatira inkota, na Dawidi na we ahagatira iyiwe; nukw abantu nk’ amajana ane badūgana na Dawidi, abagiye imbere; arikw abandi amajana abiri basigara ku bintu.
Maz’ umwe mu mikangara ya Nabali abarira Abigayili muka Nabali, at’ Erega Dawidi yatumye intumwa ziva mu bugaragwa ngo zize kuramutsa databuja; na we araheza arabarandamukira.
Arikw abo bantu bāhora batugirira neza cane, nta kintu na kimwe bātugiriye nabi, ntitwāgize ico tuzimiza igihe cose twābanye na bo, turi mw irāro;
bātubereye uruzitiro rudukingira mw ijoro no ku murango igihe cose twāmaranye na bo turagiye intama.
None rer’ ubimenye, wiyumvire ico wokora, kuko hagiye kuba ivyago kuri databuja no ku rugo rwiwe rwose, kand’ ar’ umuntu w’umugesera, ata woshobora kugira ico amubgira.

Maze Abigayili arakwakwanya, akora imitsima amajana abiri, n’imikuza ibiri ya vino, n’inyama zihiye z’amapfizi atanu y’intama, n’ingero zitanu z’ingano zikaranze, n’imisoko ijana y’inzabibu zumye, n’uturobe amajana abiri tubumbabumbge mu nsukoni, abiremēka indogoba.
Abarira abantu biwe, ati Ni munyītangire imbere, mugende, nanje ndaje ndabakurikiye. Ariko ntiyabibgira Nabali umugabo wiwe.
Nukw akimanuka ari ku ndogoba yiwe, ajanye inzira ikingiriwe n’ umusozi, Dawidi n’abantu biwe bāriko baramanuka batumberanye na we; agize artya ahūra na bo.

Kandi Dawidi yari yāvuze, ati N’ivy’ ukuri vyabaye ivy’ ubusa kuzigama ivy’ urwo rugabo rwari rufise vyose mu bugaragwa, ntihazimire na kimwe mu vyo yar’ afise vyose! Namugiriye ivyiza, anyishuye ibibi.
Ni bgāca hakir’ izinamuhungu n’umwe nja gusiga mu bantu biwe, Imana ibimpanire, jewe Dawidi, mbere birushirije!
Nuko Abigayili abonye Dawidi, ava ku ndogoba yiwe vuba, akubita inkoro hasi, aramwūnamira;
yitembagaza imbere y’ ibirenge vyiwe, aramubarira, ati Mwami wanje, ico caha abe ari jewe kijako; ndakwinginze, jewe umuja wawe zirikana ico nkubarira, utegēre amajambo yanje.

Ndakwinginze, mwami wanje, woye kwiyumvira kur’ uwo muntu w’umugesera Nabali. Izina ni ryo muntu: Nabali ni ko yitwa, kand’ ubujuju ni ko kameremere kiwe. Ariko jewe umuja wawe sinigeze mbona imikangara yawe watumye, mwami wanje.
None rero mugenzi, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yamaho, nawe ukaba uriho, Uhoraho ni we agutesheje ngo ntuvishe amaraso, ntiwīhōre ubgawe; abansi bawe, n’abarondera kukugirira nabi, barakamera nka Nabali, mugenzi!
None rero mwami wanje, nyakīrira iri shikanwa ngushikaniye, jewe umuja wawe, urigaburire imikangara yawe ikugendanira, mugenzi.

Ndakwinginze, mpangaza jewe umuja wawe, umparire igicumuro canje: Uhoraho ntazobura guha inzu yawe kurama, kuk’ urwana intambara z’Uhoraho, mugenzi, kandi nta kibi kizokubonekako imisi yose uzoba uriho.

Kandi nah’ abantu bagukūriye hasi ngo baguhīge, bakwice, ubugingo bgawe buzokwama butēkeye mu mutēkero w’abariho ufiswe n’ Uhoraho Imana yawe, mugenzi: kand’ ubugingo bg’abansi bawe azobushibura nk’ibuye ritewe n’ umugozi.
Nuko mugenzi, Uhoraho ni yamara kugushitsakw ivyiza vyose yakuvuzeko, akaguhindura segaba w’Abisirayeli,
ntuzohava wicuza canke ngo wītek’ umwikomo ko wavishije amaraso ata nyanduruko, canke ko wīhōye ubgawe, mugenzi; maze mugenzi, Uhoraho ni yamara kukugirira neza, uz’ uheze unyibuke, jewe umuja wawe.
Maze Dawidi yishura Abigayili, at’ Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli ashemagizwe, yakurungitse uyu musi kunsanganira;
hahezagirwe n’ubgenge bgawe, nawe ubgawe uragahezagirwa, untesheje uyu musi ngo simvishe amaraso, sinīhōre ubganje.
Ndahiye uguhoraho kw’Uhoraho Imana y’ Abisirayeli, yambujije kukugirira nabi, nta kabuza bgari guca hadasigaye izinamuhungu n’umwe mu bo kwa Nabali, iy’ utanyaruka kunsanganira.
Nuko Dawidi amwākīrira ivyo amuzaniye; aramubarira, ati Ni wīdūgire, usubire i muhira amahoro; nukw ivyo uvuze ndavyumvise, ndakwemereye.

Nuko Abigayili asubirayo, asanga Nabali yarondeje amazimano mu nzu yiwe, nk’amazimano y’umwami, asigaye adayangwa kuko yaborewe cane; ni co catumye atagira ico amubarira, ari gito ari kinini, gushitsa bukeye.
Nuko bukeye, vino imuvuyeko, umugore wiwe amwīgānira ivyo; umutima wa Nabali uca udegera, acika nk’igiti.
Hahise imisi nk’ icumi, Uhoraho akubita Nabali, arapfa.

Bukeye Dawidi yumvise ko Nabali yapfuye, aravuga, at’ Uhoraho ashemagizwe, yambūranye, akankūrakw ibitētērwa Nabali yari yanteye, agatako jewe umusavyi wiwe akambuza gukora icaha; kand’ inabi ya Nabali Uhoraho akayimusubiza ku mutwe. Hanyuma Dawidi atuma kuri Abigayili kumuresha ngw amucūre.
Abantu ba Dawidi bashitse i Karumeli kwa Abigayili, baramubarira, bati Dawidi akudutumyeko ngw agucūre ube umugore wiwe.
Ava hasi arūnama, yicisha bugufi, aravuga, at’ Ehe nd’ incoreke yawe, umuja wo kwoza ibirenge vy’abantu ba databuja.
Nuko Abigayili agira n’ingoga arahaguruka, aja ku ndogoba, ari kumwe n’abigeme batanu bamucorekeye; akurikira izo ntumwa za Dawidi, aba umugore wiwe.
Kandi Dawidi arongora na Ahinowamu w’i Yezireli, bompi baba abagore biwe.
Kandi Mikali, wa mukobga wa Sauli yari muka Dawidi, Sauli yari yaramuhaye Paliti mwene Layishi w’i Galimu.
Bukeye Abanyezifu baja i Gibeya kwa Sauli, baramubarira, bati Mbeg’ aho ntuzi ko Dawidi yinyegeje ku musozi Hakila, aharābana n’ubugaragwa?
Nuko Sauli arahaguruka, amanuka mu bugaragwa bg’i Zifu, ari kumwe n’ingabo ibihumbi bitatu zitoranijwe mu Bisirayeli, agiye kurondera Dawidi mur’ ubgo bugaragwa bg’i Zifu.
Sauli asagaza i ruhande y’inzira ku musozi Hakila, aharābana n’ubugaragwa. Kandi Dawidi yaba mu bugaragwa; maz’ abonye ko Sauli aje kumurondera mur’ ubgo bugaragwa,
aca atuma inderetsi; maz’ amenye ko Sauli aje koko,

aca ava hasi, aja ha handi Sauli yar’ ashagaje. Nuko Dawidi abona ikiryamo ca Sauli aho kiri, n’ica Abuneri mwene Neri, umugabisha w’ingabo ziwe; kand’ ikiryamo ca Sauli cari hagati y’aho bārāza imikogote y’intambara, ingabo na zo zari zimushagaje irya n’ino.
Maze Dawidi abaza Ahimeleki Umuheti na Abishayi umwana wa Seruwiya, murumuna wa Yowabu, ati Ni nde yomanukana nanje aho Sauli ashagaje? Abishayi aramwishura, ati Jewe turajana.

Nuko Dawidi na Abishayi bahenga mw ijoro baragenda, bashika mur’ izo ngabo, basanga Sauli yībīkiriye hagati y’aho bārāza imikogote y’intambara, icumu ryiwe rishinze haruguru y’umutwe wiwe, Abuneri n’ingabo baryamye bamukikije.
Maze Abishayi abarira Dawidi, at’ Uyu musi Imana igabuye umwansi wawe mu maboko yawe; none rero reka ndamuzibure icumu rimwe gusa, rishinge hasi, sinsubīra ubga kabiri.
Ariko Dawidi yishura Abishayi, ati Ntumwice: har’ uwoshobora kubangurira ukuboko uwo Uhoraho yimikishije amavuta, ntābizire?
Arongera aravuga, ati Ndahiye uguhoraho kw’Uhoraho, Uhoraho ubgiwe ni we azomwiyicira; cank’ umusi wiwe wo gupfa uzoshika; cank’ azomanuka aje mu ntambara, ayigwemwo.
Uhoraho arakabishira kure yanje, ko nobangurira ukuboko uwo Uhoraho yimikishije amavuta; ariko ni wābīre iryo cumu riri ku mutwe wiwe, n’uwo mukuza w’amazi, uze tugende.

Nuko Dawidi ajana iryo cumu n’umukuza w’amazi vyari ku mutwe wa Sauli, barīgīra, ata wubakubise ijisho canke ngw abimenye, haba n’uwokwikangura; bose bari basinziriye, kuk’ Uhoraho yari yabasinzirije ubutikoma.
Maze Dawidi afata hakurya, ahagarara ku gatwe k’umusozi witereye, har’ akarēre katari gato hagati yabo;
atera akamo ingabo bo na Abuneri mwene Neri, ati Abuneri we, mbega k’udakakaza! Abuneri aramwishura, at’ Uri nde, wewe uhamagara umwami?
Dawidi abarira Abuneri, ati Mbega ntur’ umuntu w’umugabo? Har’ ūhwanye nawe mu Bisirayeli? None se k’utāteramiye umwami shobuja? Hari haje umuntu aho muri, aje kwica umwami, kand’ ari we shobuja.

Eka ivyo wakoze si vyiza! Mbarahiye uguhoraho kw’Uhoraho, mwari mukwiye gupfa, kuko mutāteramiye shobuja, uwo Uhoraho yimikishije amavuta! Noneho ni musuzume icumu ry’ umwami n’umukuza w’amazi vyari haruguru y’umutwe w’umwami kw ari ho bikiri.
Maze Sauli amenya ijwi rya Dawidi; aramubaza, at’ Ah’ iryo jwi n’iryawe, ga mwana wanje Dawidi? Dawidi aramwishura, ati N’iryanje, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma.
Ati Mbega mugenzi, umpīgira iki, jewe umusavyi wawe? Nakoze iki? Ndikw igicumuro ki?

None rero ndakwinginze, mugenzi, zirikana amajambo yanje jewe umusavyi wawe, mwami; asangw’ ar’ Uhoraho yakungomoreye, ni yemere ndamuhe ikimazi; na ho ni baba ar’ abantu, barakavumwa imbere y’Uhoraho, kuk’ ubu banciye, ngo singire umugabane mw ishamvu y’Uhoraho, bakavuga ngo ni ngende gusaba izindi mana.
None rero ntiwemere kw amaraso yanje azosēswa kure y’ah’ Uhoraho aba; erega mwami w’ Abisirayeli, wazanywe no guhīga imbaragasa, nk’ūhīga inkware mu misozi.
Sauli aramwishura, ati Nakoze icaha; garuka mwananje Dawidi; sinzosubira kukugirira nabi, kukw amagara yanje yabaye agakomeye kuri wewe uyu musi; erega narabaye ikijuju, nakoze nabi cane.
Dawidi aramwishura, ati Ngiri icumu ryawe, mwami! Umwe wo mu basore n’aze aryābīre.
Uhoraho azokwishura umuntu wese ukugororoka kwiwe n’ukuyoboka kwiwe; ereg’ uyu musi Uhoraho yari yakumpaye, ndaheza nanka kubangura ukuboko ku wimikishijwe amavuta n’Uhoraho.
Kandi nk’ukw amagara yawe yabaye agakomeye kuri jewe uyu musi, az’ abe ari kw ayanje aba agakomeye k’Uhoraho, ankize amagorwa yose.
Maze Sauli abarira Dawidi, at’ Uragahezagirwa, mwananje Dawidi! Uzokora ivy’ ubuhizi, kand’ uzotsinda nta kabuza. Nuko Dawidi arīgīra, Sauli na we asubira i we.

Maze Dawidi yiyumvira mu mutima, at’ Umusi munaka, Sauli azoteba anyice; nta cosumba ko nohungira mu gihugu c’ Abafilisitiya, Sauli akampebūra, ntasubire kundondera mu gihugu cose c’Abisirayeli; uko ni ko noba ndamukize.
Nuko Dawidi arahaguruka, bo na za ngabo amajana atandatu zari kuri we, barajabuka baja kwa Akishi mwene Mayoki, umwami w’i Gati.

Nuko Dawidi n’izo ngabo ziwe baba i Gati kwa Akishi, umuntu wese n’abo mu rugo rwiwe; Dawidi na we yari kumwe n’abagore biwe bompi, Ahinowamu w’i Yezireli, na Abigayili w’i Karumeli, yahora ari muka Nabali.
Maze babariye Sauli ko Dawidi yahungiye i Gati, ntiyasubira kumurondera ukundi.
Maze Dawidi abarira Akishi, ati Ni naba ngutonnyeko, ntabaza ikibanza mu gisagara kimwe co mu vyo mu gihugu, abe ari ho nja kuba; har’ icotuma jewe umusavyi wawe ndinda kubana nawe ku murwa wawe?
Nuk’ uwo musi Akishi amugabira i Sikulagi; ni co catumye i Sikulagi haba ah’ abami b’Abayuda bīzīziye na bugingo n’ubu.
Igihe Dawidi yamaze mu gihugu c’Abafilisitiya n’ umwaka n’amezi ane.
Bukeye Dawidi n’ingabo ziwe baradūga, batera Abageshuri n’ Abagiruzi n’Abamaleki; abo ni bo bār’ inyamo z’ico gihugu uhereye kera, kurinda ushika i Shura n’ igihugu ca Egiputa.
Nuko Dawidi ageseza ico gihugu, ntiyagira umugabo cank’ umugore asiga atishe; anyaga intama n’inka n’ indogoba n’ingamiya, asahura n’ impuzu; maze yatabāruka akaja kwa Akishi.
Akishi ngw amubaze, at’ Uyu musi wateye hehe? Dawidi akamwishura, ati Nateye i bumanuko mu Buyuda; cank’ ati Nateye i bumanuko mu ba Yerameyeli; cank’ ati Nateye i bumanuko mu Banyakeni.

Ariko Dawidi ntiyagira umugabo cank’ umugore asiga atishe, kugira ngo ntabajane i Gati, ati Boye kuturega, ngo Dawidi yakoze artya n’ artya. Uko ni ko yahora agenza igihe cose yamaze aba mu gihugu c’Abafilisitiya.
Nuko Akishi aca yizigira Dawidi, akavuga, ati Yatumye Abisirayeli bagenzi biwe bamuzinukwa rwose; noneh’ abaye umuntu wanje gushitsa ibihe vyose.
Mur’ iyo misi Abafilisitiya bakoranya ingabo zabo ngo baje gutera Abisirayeli. Akishi abarira Dawidi, at’ Umenye neza ko mwe n’abantu bawe muzotabarana nanje mu rugamba.
Dawidi aramwishura, ati Ni ko; kandi ni ho uzomenyera ico ndimwo, jewe umusavyi wawe. Akishi aramwishura, ati Nuko nanje nzokugira uwo kuzigama agatwe kanje na ntaryo.
Samweli yar’ amaze gupfa; Abisirayeli bose bari baramuririye, bamuhamba i Rama mu gisagara yabamwo. Kandi Sauli yari yarahoneje abahamagara imizimu n’ abamenyi mu gihugu.
Nukw Abafilisitiya barakorakorana, baraza basagaza i Shunemu; Sauli na we akoranya Abisirayeli bose, basagaza i Gilibowa.
Sauli abonye ingabo z’Abafilisitiya, aratinya, aranduka umutima.
Arikw asiguje Uhoraho, ntiyagira ico amwishura, ari mu nzozi, ari mu buryo bga Urimu, haba no mu bavugishwa na we.
Maze Sauli abarira abantu biwe, ati Ni mumbarize umupfumukazi azi guhamagara imizimu, nje kumubaza. Abantu biwe baramwishura, bati Harih’ umupfumukazi abizi i Endori.

Nuko Sauli ariyoberanya, yambara izindi mpuzu, ajana n’abantu babiri, baja kur’ uwo mupfumukazi mw ijoro. Maze Sauli aramubarira, ati Ntabara umpamagarize umuzimu ubumenyi bgawe, unzūrire uwo ngira nkubarire.
Uwo mupfumukazi aramwishura, ati Mbega ntuzi ivyo Sauli yakoze, ingene yahoneje abahamagara imizimu n’abamenyi mu gihugu? N’iki gitumye ugomba kunta mu mutego, kugira ng’ unyicishe?
Sauli amurahira Uhoraho, ati Nkurahiye uguhoraho kw’Uhoraho hakagira ico uzoba kubg’ ibi.
Uwo mupfumukazi aramubaza, at’ Ugomba ko nkuzūrira nde? Na we ati Nzūrira Samweli.
Uwo mupfumukazi abonye Samweli, atura ubuku n’ijwi rirenga, abaza Sauli, at’ Umbesheye iki? Erega ni wewe Sauli!
Umwami aramwishura, ati Hūmura! Mbarira ico ubonye. Nya mupfumukazi aramwishura, ati Mbonye igisa n’imana kidūga kiva i kuzimu.
Sauli aramubaza, ati Gisa gite? Na we ati Hariko haradūga umutāma, kandi yambaye igikwemu. Maze Sauli aca amenya kw ari Samweli, akubita inkoro hasi, aramwūnamira.

Nuko Samweli abaza Sauli, ati N’iki gitumye uza kunkoma, ukanzūra? Sauli aramwishura, ati N’uko ndi mu magorwa, kukw Abafilisitiya baje kuntera, kand’ Imana ikaba yarantaye, ata co ikinyishura, ari mu bo ivugisha canke mu nzozi. Ni co kinteye kuguhamagara, ng’ummenyeshe ico nkwiye gukora.
Samweli aramwishura, at’ Ubimbarije iki, k’ Uhoraho yakuretse, agahinduka umwansi wawe?
Uhoraho yakugiriye nk’uko yari yarabivugiye muri jewe. Akunyaze ingoma, ayiha mugenzawe Dawidi;
kuk’ utumviye Uhoraho, ntushitse uburake bgiwe bukaze ku Bamaleki; ni co kimuteye kukugenza artyo uyu musi.
Mbere mwe n’Abisirayeli Uhoraho azobagabura mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya; kand’ ejo mwe n’abahungu bawe muzoba mur’ aho ndi; Uhoraho agira agabure ingabo z’ Abisirayeli mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya.
Buno Sauli yikubita hasi, ararambarara, kukw aranduwe umutima n’ivyo Samweli amubariye; kandi na kare yar’ asanzwe adafise intege, kuko yari yiriwe ubusa kand’ akaburāra.
Maze nya mupfumukazi aza aho Sauli ari, abona ko yihebūye, aramubarira, ati Rāba jewe umuja wawe nakwumviye, mpeba amagara, nemera ivyo umbariye.
None rero ndakwinginze, nawe unyumvire, jewe umuja wawe, unyemerere ngire utwo nkuronderera, ufūngure, kugira ng’ usubiremw’ intege ubashe kugenda.
Aranka, at’ Eka singomba kurya. Arikw abantu biwe bo na nya mupfumukazi baramugōbēra, arabemerera, ava hasi, yicara ku buriri.
Kandi nya mupfumukazi yar’ afise imasa inuze mu ruhongore; aranyanyasa arayikerera, ahitana ifu, arayicumba ayironderamw’ umutsima utambiwe;
abihereza Sauli n’ abantu biwe, barafūngura. Maz’ iryo joro nyene barahaguruka, baragenda.
Nukw Abafilisitiya bakoraniriza ingabo zabo zose i Afeka, Abisirayeli na bo basagaza hafi y’iriba ry’i Yezireli.
Maz’ abaganwa b’Abafilisitiya bagenda bajanye ingabo zabo, hamwe ijana‐ijana, ahandi igihumbi‐igihumbi; kandi Dawidi n’ingabo ziwe bazanana na Akishi babakurikiye.

Maz’ abagabisha b’Abafilisitiya barabaza, bati Mbeg’ abo Baheburayo bakora iki hano? Akishi yishura abo bagabisha b’Abafilisitiya, at’ Uyu si Dawidi, yar’ umuntu wa Sauli umwami w’Abisirayeli, akaba yamaranye nanje imisi, na ko n’imyaka? Kand’ uhereye igihe yacīkiye, akaza i wanje, nta kibi namubonyeko gushitsa n’ubu.

Arikw abo bagabisha b’Abafilisitiya baramurakira, baramubarira, bati Subizay’ uwo mugabo, asubire ha hantu hiwe wamuhaye; nta co ajana natwe mu ntambara, ntahave aduhindukira umurwanizi mu rugamba. Mbeg’ uru rugabo, icosubira kurwuzuza na shebuja n’iki? S’imitwe y’aba bantu?
Mbeg’ uyu si Dawidi wa wundi bāvyinira bitabiriza, bati Sauli yishe ibihumbi, Dawidi we yica ibihumbi indiri?

Nuko Akishi ahamagaza Dawidi, aramubarira, ati Ndahiye uguhoraho kw’Uhoraho, warabaye umwizigirwa, kandi kubganje nta cokubujije ko wotabaranye nanje mu rugamba, tugatabarukana; kuk’ uhereye igihe waziye i wanje, nta kibi nakubonyeko gushitsa n’ubu; ariko rer’ abaganwa ntibagushima.
None rero ni wītāhire, ugende amahoro, woye gutera ishavu abaganwa b’Abafilisitiya.
Dawidi abaza Akishi, ati None se nakoze iki? Uhereye igihe natanguriye kuba umusavyi wawe ukageza n’ubu, wambonyekw iki combuza kugenda gutera abansi bawe ga mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma?
Akishi aramwishura, ati Kubganje ndazi ko war’ untunganiye nk’umumarayika w’ Imana; arikw abagabisha b’Abafilisitiya baravuze, ngo Ntuzojana na bo mu ntambara.
Nuko non’ uzindukane n’abantu ba shobuja mwāzananye, muhenge kare mu macāca, mugende.
Nuko Dawidi azindukana kare mu gatondo n’ingabo ziwe, baragenda, basubira mu gihugu c’Abafilisitiya. Arikw Abafilisitiya baradūga, batera i Yezireli.
Nuko Dawidi n’ingabo ziwe bashika i Sikulagi ku musi ugira gatatu, basanga Abamaleki bateye igihugu c’i bumanuko n’i Sikulagi, basanga i Sikulagi bāhanesheje, bāhaturiye,
bānyaze abagore n’abāri mur’ ico gisagara bose, abato n’abakuru; ntibāri bagize uwo bica, atar’ ukubajana ar’ inyagano, bakīgīra.
Nuko Dawidi n’abantu biwe bashitse kur’ ico gisagara, ni kwo gusanga bāgituriye, kand’ abagore n’abana babo b’abahungu n’abakobga bājanywe ar’ inyagano.
Maze Dawidi n’abantu bari kumwe na we baraturikisha, bararira, gushitsa aho batakibasha kurira.
Kand’ abagore ba Dawidi bompi, Ahinowamu w’i Yezireli, na Abigayili yahora ari muka Nabali w’i Karumeli, na bo bāri bājanywe ar’ inyagano.
Maze Dawidi agira intuntu nyinshi, kukw abantu bāvuga nk’abagomba kumutera amabuye; bose bāri n’akabonge kubg’ abana babo b’abahungu n’abakobga; ariko Dawidi arīremēsha, yisunze Uhoraho Imana yiwe.
Maze Dawidi abarira Abiyatari umuherezi mwene Ahimeleki, ati N’unzanire efodi hano. Nuko Abiyatari azanira Dawidi efodi.
Dawidi araheza asiguza Uhoraho, ati Mbega ni nakurikira ico gitero nzogihamvya? Aramwishura, ati N’ubakurikire, kuk’ utazobura kubahamvya, ukabāka vyose.
Nuko Dawidi aragenda, bo na za ngabo zari kumwe na we ukw ar’ amajana atandatu; bashitse ku mugezi Besori, abāri basigaye inyuma bagumaho.
Ariko Dawidi araramiriza, bo n’abantu amajana ane; abandi amajana abiri barasigara, kuko bari barushe, bananirwa kujabuka umugezi Besori.
Hanyuma baseruka ku Munyegiputa mu gahinga, bamuzanira Dawidi; bamutamika agatsima, bamuramiza n’utuzi,
bamuha n’ikimanyu c’irobe ribumbabumbge mu nsukoni, n’udusoko tubiri tw’inzabibu zumye; ariye, aca arahēmbūka, kuko yar’ amaze imisi itatu n’amajoro atatu ata co arya, ata co anywa.
Dawidi aramubaza, at’ Ur’ umuntu wa nde? Kand’ ur’ uwa hehe? Na we aramwishura, ati Nd’ umuhungu wo muri Egiputa, umugurano w’ Umwamaleki; kandi hashize imisi itatu databuja antaye, kuko nari ndwaye.
Twari twateye i bumanuko mu Bakeriti, dutera n’i Buyuda, n’i bumanuko mu bga Kalebu, duturira n’i Sikulagi.
Dawidi aramubaza, ati None wonjana ukanshikana mur’ ico gitero? Aramwishura, ati Ndahira Imana k’utazonyica, canke k’utazontanga mu maboko ya databuja, mpeze ndakujane ah’ ico gitero kiri.
Nukw amumanukanye, basanga bagandagaje, bariko bararya, binywera, batārīka, bahimbawe n’inyagano nyinshi banyaze mu gihugu c’Abafilisitiya no mu c’Abayuda.
Dawidi aca ashirakw arabica, uhereye bugihwībīra ugashitsa ku mugoroba wa bukeye; ntiharokoka n’umwe, atar’ abahungu b’imisore amajana ane, bāsimbiye ku ngamiya bagahunga.
Dawidi yigarukanira ivyo Abamaleki bari banyaze vyose, arokora n’abagore biwe bompi.
Ntihāgira ico babura, ari gito ari kinini, ar’ abana b’abahungu cank’ ab’ abakobga, ar’ ico mu nyagano canke mu vyari vyasahuwe; Dawidi abigarukana vyose.
Dawidi anyaga intama n’inka zose, bazishorera imbere y’izabo, baravuga, bat’ Uyu ni wo munyago wa Dawidi.
Maze Dawidi ashika kuri ba bantu amajana abiri bāri barushe, bananirwa kumukurikira, bakabasiga ku mugezi Besori; baza gusanganira Dawidi n’abari kumwe na we. Dawidi abashikiriye arabaramutsa.

Maz’ abantu bose b’abanyakibi b’abagesera mu bāri bājanye na Dawidi baravuga, bati Ntitubaha ku vyari vyaranyazwe twigarukaniye, kuko batājanye natwe; shit’ umuntu wese turamuha umugore wiwe n’abana, babajane bagende.
Ariko Dawidi arababarira, ati Bagenzi banje, ntimwogenza murtyo ivyo Uhoraho yaduhaye, n’ukuntu yatuzigamye, akagabura mu maboko yacu ico gitero cari caduteye.
Har’ uwokwemera iyo nama yanyu? Uwagiye mu ntambara n’uwasigaye ku bintu bararinganiza umutigiri: baragabangana banganye.
Nuk’ uhereye uwo musi abigira icagezwe n’ibgirizwa mu Bisirayeli na bugingo n’ ubu.
Maze Dawidi ashitse i Sikulagi, arungikira abakunzi biwe b’ abashingantahe b’i Buyuda ku minyago, ati Ngivyo ivyo mbagabiye bivuye ku minyago y’abansi b’ Uhoraho.
Abirungikira ab’i Beteli, n’ab’i Ramoti h’i bumanuko, n’ab’i Yatira;
n’ab’i Aroweri, n’ab’i Sifumoti, n’ab’i Eshitemowa;
n’ab’i Rakala, n’abo mu bisagara vya ba Yerameyeli, n’abo mu bisagara vy’Abanyakeni;
n’ab’i Horuma, n’ab’i Korashani, n’ab’i Ataki;
n’ ab’i Heburoni, n’ab’ ahandi hose aho Dawidi n’abantu biwe bāhora bayerērera.
Nukw Abafilisitiya batera Abisirayeli, Abisirayeli barabahunga, bahindikirana ku musozi Gilibowa.
Abafilisitiya bakinagiza Sauli n’abahungu biwe, bica Yonatani na Abinadabu na Milikishuwa abahungu biwe.
Urubgamba rusugereza Sauli, abanyamiheto bamushingiriza imyampi, bamurandura umutima.

Maze Sauli abarira ūmutwaje ibirwanishwa, ati Sokōra inkota, uyinsogote, zirya ntakebga zoye kunshikīra ngo zinsogote, zinshinyagurire. Arik’ ūmutwaje ibirwanishwa aranka, kuko yari yagize ubgoba bginshi. Sauli ni kwo gufata iyiwe nkota, ayīsukako.
Uno yamutwaza ibirwanishwa abonye ko Sauli apfuye, na we yīsuka kuri rwiwe, bagwa hamwe.
Uko ni ko Sauli yapfuye, n’abahungu biwe batatu, n’uwamutwaza ibirwanishwa, bo n’ingabo ziwe zose, bapfa kur’ uwo musi nyene.

Maz’ ingabo z’Abisirayeli zo hakurya y’umwonga n’izo hakurya ya Yorodani, babonye kw Abisirayeli bahunze, kandi ko Sauli n’ abahungu biwe bapfuye, bata ibisagara vyabo, barahunga; Abafilisitiya baraza, baravyinjira.
Bukeye bgaho, Abafilisitiya baje gukoba imivyimba, basanga Sauli n’abahungu biwe batatu barambaraye ku musozi Gilibowa bapfuye.
Bamuca izosi, bamukoba ibirwanishwa, batuma intumwa mu gihugu c’Abafilisitiya iyo kiva kikagera, ngo bakwize inkuru mu nsengero z’ibigirwamana vyabo no mu bantu.
Ibirwanishwa vyiwe babishira mu rusengero rwa Ashitaroti, umuvyimba wiwe bawēnētsa ku ruzitiro rw’amabuye rw’igisagara c’i Beti‐shani.
Maz’ ab’i Yabeshi‐gileyadi bumvise ivy’ Abafilisitiya bagiriye Sauli,
abahizi bose barahaguruka, bagenda ijoro ryose, bamanura umuvyimba wa Sauli ku ruzitiro rw’i Beti‐shani, bo n’iy’ abahungu biwe; bashitse i Yabeshi bayituririraho.
Maze bābīra amagufa yabo, bayahamba musi y’igiti c’umwesheli i Yabeshi nyene, baca barisonzesha kumara imisi ndwi.
Sauli amaze gutanga, Dawidi na we atabarutse avuye kugeseza Abamaleki, amaze kabiri i Sikulagi,
ku musi ugira gatatu haza umuntu avuye aho Sauli yar’ ashagaje, yitantamuriyekw impuzu ziwe, yiyoreye ivu mu mutwe; ashitse imbere ya Dawidi akubita inkoro hasi, aramwunamira.
Dawidi aramubaza, at’ Uva hehe? Aramwishura, ati Ni jewe ndokotse mva ah’ Abisirayeli bāri bashagaje.
Dawidi aramubaza, ati Vyagenze bite? Ntabara umbarire. Aramwishura, at’ Abantu barahunze bava mu rugamba, kandi benshi baruguyemwo, barapfa; na Sauli na Yonatani umuhungu wiwe na bo bārapfuye.
Maze Dawidi abaza uwo muhungu amubikiye, ati Mbega wabimenye ute ko Sauli na Yonatani umuhungu wiwe bāpfuye?
Nya muhungu amubikiye aramwishura, ati Nariko ndihitira, nshitse ku musozi Gilibowa, ngize ntya mbona Sauli yishimikije icumu, kandi mbona asugerejwe n’imikogote n’abagendera ku mafarasi.
Maze Sauli akebutse inyuma arambona, arampamagara, ndamwitaba, nti Sabge!
Arambaza, at’ Uri nde? Ndamwishura, nti Nd’ Umwamaleki.
Arambarira, at’ Igira hino, untabare umpohoshe, ati Kuko nsigaye nd’ intēre, naho nkibona.
Nuko ndamwēgēra, ndamuhohosha, kuko nabona neza kw atagikira, ni yaramuka atemvye. Ndaheza ndamukoba igitsibo cari mu mutwe, n’umuringa wari ku kuboko; none ndabikuzaniye hano, mugenzi.
Maze Dawidi afata impuzu ziwe, azītantamurirako, n’abantu bose bari kumwe na we bagira kuno;
baraboroga, bararira, birirwa ata co batamiye gushitsa ku mugoroba, kubga Sauli n’ umuhungu wiwe Yonatani, no kubg’ abantu b’Uhoraho, n’inzu ya Isirayeli, kuko bicishijwe inkota.
Dawidi abaza uno muhungu amubikiye, at’ Ur’ uwa hehe? Ati Nd’ umwana w’Umwamaleki yaje ino ar’ inyambukīra.
Dawidi aramubaza, ati N’iki caguteye kwubahuka, ntutinye kubangura ukuboko, ukica uwo Uhoraho yimikishije amavuta?
Dawidi araheza ahamagara umwe mu basore, aramubarira, ati Ngwino umwice. Aca aramucumita, arapfa.
Dawidi aramubarira, at’ Amaraso yawe abe ari wewe aja ku mutwe, kukw akanwa kawe ari ko kakubereye icagirizi, nk’uko wivugiye ko wishe uwo Uhoraho yimikishije amavuta.
Maze Dawidi acura intimba ya Sauli n’umuhungu wiwe Yonatani;
avyita Agacurantimba k’Umuheto, avuga ko bavyigisha Abayuda; vyanditswe mu gitabo ca Yashari.
At’ Ewe Isirayeli, icubahiro cawe gitsinzwe ku mpinga z’imisozi yawe! Ewe kuntu abahizi bāguye!
Ntimukabikerutse i Gati, Ntimukabitāngāze mu nzira z’i Ashikeloni, Abakobga b’Abafilisitiya boye kunezerwa, Abakobga b’abantu b’intakebga boye gutera impundu.

Yemwe misozi y’i Gilibowa, Ntihagatonde ikime kuri mwebge, canke ngo hagwe imvura, Ntihakamere imirima ngo baronkek’ umushuzo w’amashikanwa! Kuko kuri mwebge ari ho inkinzo y’umuhizi yashiburiwe, Ni yo nkinzo ya Sauli, itazosīgwa amavuta ukundi.
Umuheto wa Yonatani ntiwatabaruka Utanyoye amaraso y’abishwe, Udasākije mu binure vy’ abahizi; Kand’ inkota ya Sauli ntiyatabaruka ubusa.
Ewe kuntu Sauli na Yonatani bākundwa, kand’ ar’ abanyagikundiro! Nta cabatandukanije mu kubaho kwabo canke mu gupfa kwabo. Bārusha inkukuma kunyaruka, Bārusha n’intambge gukomera.
Yemwe bakobga b’Abisirayeli, ni muririre Sauli, Yahora abambika impuzu zisa n’agahama, mugashaza, Yashariza impuzu zanyu n’ utugenegene tw’izahabu.
Ewe kuntu abahizi bāguye mu ntambara hagati! Yonatani arambaraye ku mpinga y’umusozi wawe, aho yatsinzwe.
Unteye akabonge, ncuti yanje Yonatani! Ewe kuntu nagukunda! Urukundo wankunda rwar’ igitangaza, Rwaruta urukundo rw’abagore.
Ewe kuntu abahizi bāguye, Ibirwanishwa vyabo bikononekara!
Hanyuma y’ivyo, Dawidi asiguza Uhoraho, ati Mbega ndūge, nimukire mu gisagara kimwe mu vy’i Buyuda? Uhoraho aramwishura, at’ Ego me dūga. Dawidi ati Nje hehe? Aramwishura, ati Ja i Heburoni.
Nuko Dawidi adūganayo n’abagore biwe bompi, Ahinowamu w’i Yezireli, na Abigayili yahora ari muka Nabali w’i Karumeli.
Adūgana n’abantu biwe, umuntu wese n’abo mu rugo rwiwe; bimukira mu bisagara vy’i Heburoni.
Bukeye abantu b’i Buyuda baraza, bahimikira Dawidi bamusutsekw amavuta, ngw abe umwami w’ umuryango w’Abayuda. Bukeye babarira Dawidi, bat’ Ab’i Yabeshi‐gileyadi ni bo bāhamvye Sauli.
Nuko Dawidi atuma intumwa ku b’i Yabeshi‐gileyadi, muti Muragahezagirwa n’Uhoraho, kubg’ ico kigongwe mwagiriye Sauli shobuja, mukamufuba!
Nuko rer’ Uhoraho abagirire ikigongwe ababere umwizigirwa; nanje nyene nzobishura ico kigongwe mwāgize, kuko mwāgenjeje murtyo.
None rero, mwigumye, mube abagabo: kuko Sauli shobuja yāpfuye, kand’ ab’ umuryango w’Abayuda banyimikishije amavuta ngo mbe umwami wabo.
Kandi Abuneri mwene Neri, umugabisha w’ingabo za Sauli, yari yarajanye Ishibosheti mwene Sauli, aramujabutsa amujana i Mahanayimu.
Aramwimika ngw abe umwami w’i Gileyadi n’ uw’ Abashuri n’uw’ i Yezireli n’ uw’ Abefurayimu n’uw’ Ababenyamini n’uw’ Abisirayeli bose.
Kandi Ishibosheti mwene Sauli, igihe yima ngw abe umwami w’ Abisirayeli, yar’ amaze imyaka mirongwine; amara imyaka ibiri ari ku ngoma. Arikw ab’ umuryango w’Abayuda bo, bākondoreye inyuma ya Dawidi.
Kandi Dawidi igihe yamaze i Heburoni ar’ umwami w’umuryango w’ Abayuda, n’imyaka ndwi n’amezi atandatu.
Bukeye Abuneri mwene Neri, n’abantu ba Ishibosheti mwene Sauli, bava i Mahanayimu baja i Gibeyoni.
Yowabu umwana wa Seruwiya na we, n’abantu ba Dawidi, baragenda bahūrira na bo ku kidengeri c’i Gibeyoni; nuko baricara, bamwe hakurya y’ ico kidengeri, abandi hakuno.
Abuneri abarira Yowabu, at’ Abasore ni bave hasi, bakinishe inkota twirorērere. Yowabu at’ Ego me ni bave hasi.

Nuko bava hasi, baraza barahūra, baringanije igitigiri: abo ku ruhande rw’Ababenyamini na Ishibosheti mwene Sauli bar’ icumi na babiri, kand’ abo ku ruhande rwa Dawidi na bo bar’ icumi na babiri nyene.
Bose barasūmirana, umuntu wese asūmira agakanu ka mugenzi we, bazibagurana inkota mu mbavu; bacurikirana hamwe. Ni co catumye aho hantu bahīta Helukati‐hasurimu: ni hafi y’i Gibeyoni.
Uwo musi haca haba intambara ihambaye cane; Abuneri n’Abisirayeli baraneshwa, bahunga abantu ba Dawidi.
Kand’ abana ba Seruwiya ukw ari batatu, Yowabu na Abishayi na Asaheli, ni ho bāri; kandi Asaheli yar’ impayamaguru nk’ingeregere yo mw ishamba.
Maze Asaheli yōma kuri Abuneri, adakebereje i buryo cank’ i bumoso ngw amuve inyuma.
Maze Abuneri akebutse inyuma, aramubaza, ati Mbega ni wewe ga Asaheli? Na we aramwishura, ati Ni jewe.
Abuneri aramubarira, ati Kebereza i buryo cank’ i bumoso, ugire uwo mu misore ufata, abe ari we wambura ibirwanishwa vyiwe. Ariko Asaheli yanka gukevya ngw amuve inyuma.
Abuneri asubira kubarira Asaheli, ati Ca hiyo, ureke kunkurikira; mbeg’ urinde kuntera kukwica? Nkwishe noshobora nte guhūza amaso na Yowabu mukurwawe?

Ariko na ho nyene yanka gukebereza i ruhande, bituma Abuneri amuzibura umuhunda w’icumu ku nda, riseruka inyuma, Asaheli yikubita hasi, agwa aho nyene. Maz’ abantu bashitse aho Asaheli aguye, baca bahagararaho.
Ariko Yowabu na Abishayi bakurikira Abuneri; izuba rirenga bafashe ku musozi Ama, urābana n’i Giya ku nzira ija mu bugaragwa bg’i Gibeyoni.
Maz’ Ababenyamini biyegeraniriza kuri Abuneri, bīrema akarwi kamwe, batonda ku mpinga y’umusozi.

Maze Abuneri atera akamo Yowabu, aramubaza, ati Mbeg’ inkota izokwama iririka na ntaryo? Ntuzi yukw amaherezo hazovamw’ intuntu? None mbeg’ uzogeza ryari kutabogoza abantu ngo bave inyuma ya bene wabo?
Yowabu aramwishura, ati Ndahiye uguhoraho kw’Imana, iy’ utagira ico uvuga, bgari kurinda buca abantu batarareka gukurikirana bene wabo.
Nuko Yowabu aca avuza inzamba, abantu bose barahagarara, ntibakomeza gukurikirana Abisirayeli canke kubarwanya ukundi.
Nuko Abuneri n’ingabo ziwe bakesha iryo joro bajanye ikiyaya Araba; bajabuka Yorodani, bajana i Bitironi hose, bararuha bashika i Mahanayimu.
Yowabu na we arahindukira, areka gukurikirana Abuneri; amaze gukoranya ingabo zose za Dawidi, asanga habuzemw’ abantu cumi n’icenda bo na Asaheli.
Arikw ingabo za Dawidi zari zishe abantu amajana atatu na mirongwitandatu mu Babenyamini no mu ngabo za Abuneri.
Nuko baterura Asaheli, baramujana bamuhamba i Betelehemu mu mva ya se. Yowabu n’ingabo ziwe baraheza bagenda ijoro ryose; buca bashitse i Heburoni.
Nuko haba intambara kumara igihe kirekire hagati y’ab’ inzu ya Sauli n’ab’ iya Dawidi; Dawidi agenda arushiriza kuba agahambaye, arikw ab’ inzu ya Sauli bo bagenda bashira inkomezi.
Abana b’abahungu Dawidi yavyariye i Heburoni, uw’ imfura ni Amunoni, uwo yavyaye kuri Ahinowamu w’i Yezireli;
uwa kabiri ni Kileyabu, uwo yavyaye kuri Abigayili, yahora ari muka Nabali w’i Karumeli; uwa gatatu ni Abusalomu, uwo yavyaye kuri Mayaka, umukobga wa Talumayi umwami w’i Geshuri;
uwa kane ni Adoniya, uwo yavyaye kuri Hagita; uwa gatanu ni Shefatiya, uwo yavyaye kuri Abitali;
uwa gatandatu ni Itureyamu, uwo yavyaye ku wundi mugore wiwe yitwa Egila. Abo ni bo Dawidi yavyariye i Heburoni.
Ico gihe c’intambara y’ab’ inzu ya Sauli n’ab’ iya Dawidi, Abuneri yari yīgize agakomeye mu rugo rwa Sauli.
Kandi Sauli yar’ afise incoreke yari yaragize umugore, yitwa Risipa, umukobga wa Aya; bukeye Ishibosheti abaza Abuneri, ati N’iki catumye winjirana muka data?

Ayo majambo ya Ishibosheti ashavuza Abuneri cane; aramwishura, ati Mbeg’ ugira ngo nd’imbga y’i Buyuda? Ko nagiriye neza ab’ inzu ya so Sauli na bene wabo n’abakunzi biwe, nawe sinkugabure mu maboko ya Dawidi; non’ ugapfa kunyagiriza icaha ku mugore gusa?
Imana iz’ ibimpanire, jewe Abuneri, mbere birushirije, ni ntagirira Dawidi nk’uk’ Uhoraho yamurahiye,
ngakūra ingoma mu nzu ya Sauli, nkayegurira Dawidi, ngatuma ingoma yiwe ihangama mu Bisirayeli no mu Bayuda, uhereye i Dani ugashitsa i Beri‐sheba.
Maze Ishibosheti ntiyaronka irindi na rimwe yishura Abuneri, kuko yamutinya.
Bukeye Abuneri atuma intumwa kuri Dawidi, muti Nyene kirya gihugu ni nde? Muti N’ usezerane isezerano na we, muti Kand’ azofatanya nawe kukurehereza Abisirayeli bose.
Dawidi arishura, ati Ni vyiza; mut’ Azosezerana nawe; muti Mugabo hariho kimwe akugombako, mut’ Utazanye Mikali mwene Sauli, ah’ uzozira ngo mubonane, muti Ntuzomukubita ijisho.
Maze Dawidi atuma intumwa kuri Ishibosheti mwene Sauli, muti Muhe umugore wiwe Mikali, uwo yakoye ubugabo ijana yashahuye Abafilisitiya.
Nuko Ishibosheti aratuma, bamukūra kwa Palutiyeli mwene Layishi umugabo wiwe.
Maz’ uwo mugabo wiwe aramuherekeza, agenda ararira inzira yose, arinda amushikana i Bahurimu. Ashitseyo, Abuneri aramubarira, ati Hogi subira inyuma; nukw aca asubira inyuma.
Bukeye Abuneri aja inama n’ abakuru bo mu Bisirayeli, aravuga, ati Mumaze igihe kitari gito mugomba ko Dawidi yoba umwami wanyu;
none rero ni mubirāngūre; kuk’ Uhoraho yavuze ivya Dawidi, ng’ Umusavyi wiwe Dawidi ni we azokiza abantu biwe Abisirayeli, abakūre mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya no mu y’abansi babo bose.
Abuneri abibarira n’ Ababenyamini na bo. Bukeye aja i Heburoni, kugira ngo yīgānire Dawidi ivyo Abisirayeli n’ab’ umuryango w’Ababenyamini bose bamaramaje gukora vyose.
Nukw ashitse i Heburoni kwa Dawidi, ari kumwe n’abantu mirongwibiri, Dawidi amurondereza amazimano bo n’abari kumwe na we.

Maze Abuneri abarira Dawidi, ati Hinge ngende, ngagamure Abisirayeli bose baze ah’ uri, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma, kugira ngo basezerane nawe, ubone kubaganza bose nk’uk’ ugomba. Nuko Dawidi arekura Abuneri, agenda amahoro.
Maze Yowabu n’abantu ba Dawidi baragaruka bavuye gutera, bazanye iminyago myinshi; ariko Abuneri ntiyar’ akiri kumwe na Dawidi i Heburoni, kuko yar’ amaze kumurekura, yīgīriye amahoro.
Nuko Yowabu n’ingabo ziwe zose bagishika bartya, babarira Yowabu, bati Abuneri mwene Neri yamanye n’umwami, non’ umwami yamurekuye, yīgīriye amahoro.
Maze Yowabu aragenda abaza umwami, ati Wakoze ibiki? Abuneri ngo yamanye nawe, uraheza uramureka arīgīra?
Aho ntuzi yuko Abuneri mwene Neri yazanywe no kuguhenda, ngw amenye ingen’ utabara n’ ingen’ utabaruka, amenye n’ivy’ ukora vyose?
Nuko Yowabu, amaze kwikebanura Dawidi, akurikiza intumwa Abuneri; zimugarurira kw iriba ry’i Sira; ariko Dawidi ntiyabimenya.
Nuko Abuneri ashitse i Heburoni, Yowabu amwihererana hagati y’ amarembo, nk’ūgira abonane na we ata wumva; araheza amucumita ku nda, agwaho, amuhōye amaraso ya murumuna we Asaheli.
Hanyuma Dawidi avyumvise, aravuga, ati Twe n’igihugu canje turacuna imbere y’Uhoraho kur’ ayo maraso ya Abuneri mwene Neri gushitsa ibihe vyose;

arikw arasubira ku mutwe wa Yowabu no ku b’inzu ya se bose; mu nzu ya Yowabu ntihakabure umunyagisokoro, cank’ umunyamibembe, cank’ ūgendera ku kibando, cank’ uwicwa n’inkota, cank’ ūtagira ico ashira ku munwa.
Uko ni ko Yowabu na Abishayi murumuna we bishe Abuneri, kuko yari yatsinze murumuna wabo mu ntambara y’i Gibeyoni.
Dawidi araheza abarira Yowabu n’abari kumwe na we bose, ati Ni mwitantamurirekw impuzu zanyu, mukenyere amagunira, muririre i ruhande ya Abuneri. Maz’ umwami Dawidi akurikira ikigagara ciwe.
Nuko Abuneri bamuhamba i Heburoni, umwami araturikisha aririra ku mva ya Abuneri; abantu bose bararira.
Umwami acurira intimba Abuneri, ati Mbega Abuneri yar’ akwiye gupfa nk’ukw imburabgenge ipfa?
Amaboko yawe kw atar’ aboshwe, Cank’ ibirenge vyawe ngo bibe mu minyororo! Upfuye nk’umuntu aguye mu maboko y’inkozi z’ibibi! Nukw abantu bose bongera kumuririra.
Hanyuma abantu bose baza kwinginga Dawidi ngw afūngure hakiri ku murango; ariko Dawidi ararahira, aravuga, ati Ni nagira ico ntamira izuba ritararenga, Imana iz’ ibimpanire, mbere birushirije!
Abantu bose babibonye birabanezera; mber’ ivy’ umwami yakora vyose vyagenda binezera abantu bose.
Nuk’ uwo musi abantu bose n’Abisirayeli bose bamenya ko bitāvuye ku mwami kwica Abuneri mwene Neri.
Maz’ umwami abarira abantu biwe, at’ Aho ntimuzi yuk’ uyu musi hapfuye uwo mu nda y’ingoma kandi w’agahambaye?

Kandi nanje naho nd’umwami yimikishijwe amavuta, arik’ ubu nsigaye ncitse urudendevu. Kand’ abo bagabo, abahungu ba Seruwiya, n’abantu badashoboka, barannaniye. Uhoraho n’asubirize umunyakibi mu nkōko nk’ukw ibibi vyiwe bingana.
Bukeye Ishibosheti mwene Sauli yumvise ko Abuneri yaguye i Heburoni, arajonjogora, Abisirayeli bose bahagarika imitima.

Kandi mwene Sauli uwo yar’ afise abagabisha babiri b’ imice y’ingabo, umwe yitwa Bayana, uwundi Rekabu, bari bene Rimoni w’i Beroti, wo mu muryango wa Benyamini. (Kukw i Beroti hāharūrwa ku Babenyamini;
kand’ ab’ i Beroti bari barahungiye i Gitayimu, bagumayo kugeza na bugingo n’ubu.)

Kandi Yonatani mwene Sauli yar’ afise umwana yamugaye ibirenge. Igihe imbitsi yaza ivuye i Yezireli kubika Sauli na Yonatani, uwo mwana yar’ amaze imyaka itanu avutse; maz’ umurezi wiwe aramuhitana, arahunga; akinyaragasa ahunga, aramukorokana, yikubita hasi, aca amugara. Nya mwana yitwa Mefibosheti.
Bukeye bene Rimona w’i Beroti, Rekabu na Bayana, baraza, bashika kwa Ishibosheti, igihe yar’ avyukiriye mu mashōka.
Kand’ incoreke ikumīra yari yamye aragosora ingano, iterwa n’itiro, irasinzira; nuko Rekabu na Bayana mwene nyina babona akaryo ko kwinjira.
Bīteye mu ngoro, barenga mw iteka basanga aryamye ku kirwa, baramucumita, baramwica, bamuca izosi; baraheza bajana umutwe wiwe, bagenda ijoro ryose bajanye ikiyaya Araba.

Maz’ uwo mutwe wa Ishibosheti bawushīra umwami Dawidi i Heburoni, baramubarira, bati Nguyu umutwe wa Ishibosheti umwana w’ umwansi wawe Sauli, yahora aguhīga; Uhoraho ashubirije Sauli mu nkōko, n’abana biwe, abaguhōye, mwami wacu nyen’ ingoma.
Maze Dawidi yishura Rekabu na mwene nyina Bayana, bene Rimona w’i Beroti, ati Ndahiye uguhoraho kw’Uhoraho, yagiye andokora mu vyago vyose;
igihe umuntu yaje kumbarira, at’ Erega Sauli yapfuye, agira ngw anzaniye inkuru nziza, naciye ndamufata, ndamwicira aho nyene i Sikulagi; iyo ni yo ngero namugereye ku nkuru yiwe.
None mbega, abantu b’inkozi z’ibibi basanze umuntu w’umugororotsi mu nzu yiwe yiryamiye ku buriri bakamwica, sindushiriza kubahōra amaraso yiwe, nkabarandura nkabakūra mw isi?

Maze Dawidi abarira imisore yamugendanira, barabīca, babaca ibikonjo n’ibirenge, babamanika i ruhande y’ikidengeri c’i Heburoni. Arik’ umutwe wa Ishibosheti barawābīra, bawuhamba mu mva ya Abuneri i Heburoni nyene.
Bukeye imiryango yose y’ Abisirayeli ija i Heburoni kwa Dawidi, baramubarira, bat’ Ehe rāba, tur’ akara kamwe n’amaraso amwe.

Kandi mu bihe vya kera, hamwe Sauli yar’ umwami wacu, ni wewe wajana Abisirayeli gutabara, mugatabarukana. Kand’ Uhoraho yarakubgiye kw ari wewe uzoragira abantu biwe b’ Abisirayeli, kandi k’uzoba segaba wabo.

Uko ni kw abashingantahe bose b’Abisirayeli bāshengereye umwami i Heburoni; nuk’ umwami Dawidi asezeranira na bo isezerano imbere y’Uhoraho i Heburoni nyene; bamwimikisha amavuta ngw abe umwami w’Abisirayeli.
Kandi Dawidi yimye amaze imyaka mirongwitatu avutse; amara imyaka mirongwine ku ngoma.
Yamaze imyaka ndwi n’amezi atandatu i Heburoni, aganza Abayuda; i Yerusalemu na ho ahamara imyaka mirongwitatu n’itatu, aganza bose Abisirayeli n’Abayuda.

Igihe umwami Dawidi yaja i Yerusalemu n’ingabo ziwe gutera Abayebusi, ari bo bamye ar’ inyamo z’ico gihugu, Abayebusi baramubarira, bati Ntuzopfa ushitse ngaha, kuko naho boba impumyi n’ibimuga bokwiyamiriza! Kuko bari bibgiye, bati Dawidi ntiyoshobora gushika ino.
Ariko Dawidi atsinda iboma ry’i Siyoni, ari ho hāciye hahinduka umurwa wiwe.

Uwo musi Dawidi aravuga, at’ Ūgomba gutera Abayebusi, n’ adūgane umugende w’amazi, abone gutera ivyo bimuga n’impumyi umutima wanje wanka. Ni co catumye bavuga, ngo Nta mpumyi cank’ ibimuga bizoshobora kwinjira mu ngoro.
Nuko Dawidi aba mur’ iryo boma, aryita umurwa wa Dawidi. Yubaka impande zose, uhereye inyuma y’uruzitiro rw’i Milo ugashitsa imbere yaho.
Nuko Dawidi arushiriza kuba agahambaye, kuk’ Uhoraho Imana Nyen’ ingabo yari kumwe na we.
Bukeye Hiramu umwami w’i Tiro atuma intumwa kuri Dawidi, arungika n’ibiti vy’amasederi n’ ababāji n’abubatsi, bubakira Dawidi ingoro.
Nuko Dawidi aca atahura yuk’ Uhoraho ari we yamuteretse ngw abe umwami w’ Abisirayeli, kandi kw ashize hejuru ubgami bgiwe kubg’ abantu biwe b’Abisirayeli.
Maze Dawidi yābīrira i Yerusalemu abandi bamikazi, ahagirira n’izindi ncoreke zimeze bga bagore, amaze kwimukirayo avuye i Heburoni, yongera kuvyara abandi bana b’abahungu n’abakobga.
Aya ni yo mazina y’abo yavyariye i Yerusalemu: Shamuwa na Shobabu na Natani na Salomo,
na Ibuhari na Elishuwa na Nefegi na Yafiya,
na Elishama na Eliyada na Elifeleti.
Maz’ Abafilisitiya bumvise ko Dawidi yimikishijwe amavuta ngw abe umwami w’Abisirayeli, Abafilisitiya bose baradūga baja kumuhīga. Dawidi avyumvise aramanuka aja mw isenga.
Kand’ abo Bafilisitiya bari baje, basagaza ku mwonga Refayimu.
Maze Dawidi asiguza Uhoraho, ati Ndūge nje gutera Abafilisitiya? Urabagabura mu maboko yanje? Uhoraho aramwishura, ati Dūga ubatere, kuko ntazobura kugabura abo Bafilisitiya mu maboko yawe.
Nuko Dawidi aja i Bayali‐perasimu, abanesherezayo; aravuga, at’ Uhoraho yahomvoye abansi banje imbere yanje nk’ukw amazi ahomvora urugomero; ni co catumye yita aho hantu Bayali‐perasimu.
Abafilisitiya batayo ibigirwamana vyabo; Dawidi n’ ingabo ziwe barabijana.
Bukeye Abafilisitiya basubira kudūga ubugira kabiri, basagaza ku mwonga Refayimu nyene.
Maze Dawidi asiguje Uhoraho, aramwishura, ati Ntudūge ngo mubīsanganize, arik’ ugende inkerera‐mucamo, mubaturuke inyuma, aharābana n’ibiti vyitwa imibaka.
Maze ni wumva imirindi y’ingabo ihindira hejuru kur’ iyo mibaka, uce uhaguruka vuba, kuko jewe Uhoraho nzoba nkwitangiye imbere gutera izo ngabo z’Abafilisitiya.
Nuko Dawidi abigenza artyo, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yamubariye; akinagiza Abafilisitiya uhereye i Geba ugashitsa i Gezeri.
Bukeye Dawidi yongera gukoranya ingabo zose zatoranijwe mu Bisirayeli; bār’ ibihumbi mirongwitatu.
Dawidi ahagurukana n’abo bantu bose bari kumwe na we, baja i Bayali‐yuda gukūray’ isandugu y’Imana yitirirwa rya Zina, ari ryo zina ry’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo yama avyagiye ku bakerubi.
Nuko bashira iyo sandugu y’Imana ku mukogote musha, bayikūra kwa Abinadabu yaba kur’ uwo musozi; Uza na Ahiyo bene Abinadabu bayobora inka zikwega uyo mukogote musha.
Uko ni ko bākūye iyo sandugu y’ Imana kwa Abinadabu kur’ uwo musozi, Ahiyo ari we ayigiye imbere.
Dawidi n’umuryango wose w’Abisirayeli bagenda biyereka biginagura, bar’ imbere y’Uhoraho, bavuza inanga n’amakembe n’ udushako tw’ingoma n’imiduri n’ivyitwa matowazi.
Maze bashitse ku mbuga ya Nakoni, Uza atuma ukuboko ngw asame isandugu y’Imana, kukw inka zari zitirimutse.
Maz’ uburake bg’Uhoraho buziriringira Uza, aca amutsinda aho nyene, amuhōye ico gicumuro, agwa ngah’ i ruhande y’isandugu y’ Imana.
Bibabaza Dawidi k’ Uhoraho yahwikiye Uza; aho hantu haca hitwa Peresi‐uza, kugeza na bugingo n’ubu.
Uwo musi Dawidi aca aterwa ubgoba n’Uhoraho; aravuga, ati Mbeg’ isandugu y’Uhoraho vyoshoboka bite kw iza i wanje?
Nukw iyo sandugu y’Uhoraho Dawidi ntiyakunda kuyijana i we ku murwa wiwe, arikw ayikebereza kwa Obed‐edomu w’Umunyegati;
imara amezi atatu mu nzu yiwe, kand’ Uhoraho aha umugisha Obed‐edomu n’abo mu rugo rwiwe bose.

Bukeye babarira umwami Dawidi, bat’ Uhoraho yahaye umugisha urugo rwa Obed‐edomu n’ivy’ afise vyose, kubga ya sandugu yiwe. Nuko Dawidi arahaguruka aja gukūra iyo sandugu y’ Imana kwa Obed‐edomu, ayitahana ku murwa wiwe anezerewe.
Kand’ uko vyagenze n’uku: abareruye isandugu y’Uhoraho batambutse intambuko zitandatu, atanga impfizi kw ikimazi, bo n’ ishuri y’igishishe.
Maze Dawidi yiyerekera imbere y’Uhoraho yiginagura; kandi yar’ akenyeye efodi yera derere.
Nuko Dawidi n’umuryango wose w’Abisirayeli badūgana isandugu y’Uhoraho basēsereza impundu, bavuza inzamba.
Maz’ isandugu y’Uhoraho igitamaje ku murwa wa Dawidi, Mikali umukobga wa Sauli arungurukira mw idirisha, abona umwami Dawidi yitera hejuru, yiyerekera imbere y’Uhoraho; amugayira mu mutima.
Nuko binjiza iyo sandugu y’Uhoraho, bayishira aho yagerewe hagati mw ihema Dawidi yari yarayishingiye. Dawidi araheza atangira imbere y’Uhoraho ibimazi vyoswa n’ivy’ ishimwe.
Nuko Dawidi amaze kwosa ikimazi no gutanga ibimazi vy’ishimwe, ahezagira abantu mw izina ry’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo.

Maz’ agaburira abantu bose bo mur’ iryo shengero ryose ry’Abisirayeli, abagabo n’abagore, umwe‐umwe amuha umutsima n’inkekera y’inyama n’akarobe kabumbabumbge mu nzabibu zumye. Maz’ abantu bose barataha, umuntu wese asubira i we.

Dawidi na we asubira i we ngw ahezagire abo mu rugo rwiwe. Maze Mikali umukobga wa Sauli asohoka gusanganira Dawidi, aramubarira, at’ Ereg’ uyu musi umwami w’Abisirayeli yar’ agahore! Urabona ukuntu wikijije impuzu imbere y’ubukobga bushumbiye abantu bawe, nk’umuntu yabaye vyenywe azīkiza ata dusoni!
Dawidi yishura Mikali, at’ Uhoraho ni we nariko ndiyereka, kandi ni we yantoranije kuruta so n’ab’ inzu yiwe bose, akangira segaba w’abantu biwe b’Abisirayeli. Ni co kizotuma niyereka Uhoraho.
Mbere nzorushiriza kwigira inkēngērwa, mbe ūgayitse mu maso yawe; arikw abo bakobga abo uvuze, bo bazonyubaha.
Maze Mikali umukobga wa Sauli ntiyabona akana arinda apfa.
Nuk’ umwami amaze kwinjira ingoro yiwe, Uhoraho amuhaye impore hagati y’abansi biwe bose bamukikije,
abarira ūvugishwa n’Imana Natani, at’ Ehe jewe mba mu nzu yubakishijwe amasederi, na yo isandugu y’Imana iba mw ihema gusa.
Natani yishura umwami, ati Genda ukore nk’uko wumva ugomba kwose, kuk’ Uhoraho ari kumwe nawe.
Arikw iryo joro nyene ijambo ry’Uhoraho riza kuri Natani,
riti Genda ubgire umusavyi wanje Dawidi, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, uti Mbeg’ uzomwubakira inzu yo kubamwo?
Ut’ Erega ntiyigeze kuba mu nzu uhereye igihe yadūganiye Abisirayeli abakūye muri Egiputa gushitsa n’ubu. Uti Yahora aba mw ihema nk’ urusago.

Uti Mbeg’ ahantu hose yagiye agendana n’Abisirayeli bose, uti Har’ aho yigeze kubarira umucamanza w’Abisirayeli uw’ ari we wese, uwo yashizeho kuragira abantu biwe, akamubaza, ati N’iki cababujije kumwubakira inzu y’amasederi?
Nuko rero, ukw abe ari k’ubarira umusavyi wanje Dawidi, ut’ Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, uku ni kw agize, uti Yagukūye mu bgungere, inyuma y’intama, ng’ ube segaba w’abantu biwe b’Abisirayeli;
uti Kandi yagendana nawe aho waja hose, ut’ Arandura abansi bawe bose imbere yawe; uti Kand’ azoguha izina rya rurangiranwa, nk’ukw abandi bahambaye bo mw isi bayafise.
Uti Kand’ abantu biwe b’ Abisirayeli azobagenera ahantu, ahababadike, bahībēre ar’ ahabo bgite, batazohimuka ukundi; uti Kand’ abantu b’ibirara ntibazosubira kubagirira nabi nk’ubga mbere,
nko mu bihe yaha abacamanza kuganza abantu biwe b’Abisirayeli; uti Kand’ azoguha impore hagati y’abansi bawe bose. Uti Mber’ Uhoraho arakubariye yukw azokugira igisata.
Uti Kand’ imisi yawe ni yashika, ugahamvya ba sogokuruza, ut’ Azokwimika umwana wawe wivyariye, agusubirire mu gishingo, uti Kand’ azokomeza ingoma yiwe.
Ut’ Uwo ni we azomwubakira ingoro, ibe iy’ izina ryiwe, uti Kand’ azokomeza intebe yiwe y’ubgami gushitsa ibihe vyose.
Ut’ Azomubera se, na we amubere umwana; uti Na ho ni yacumura, azomuhanisha inkoni nk’iyo abantu bahanisha, amuhe imiramu nk’iy’ abana b’abantu;
ut’ Arikw imbabazi ziwe ntazozimukūrako nk’uko yazikūye kuri Sauli, uwo yasohoye agashiraho wewe.
Uti Kand’ inzu yawe n’ubgami bgawe bizohora bihamye imbere yiwe, uti N’ingoma yawe izokwama ihangamye na ntaryo.
Maz’ ayo majambo yose n’ ukwo kwerekwa kwose, Natani abidondera Dawidi.
Maz’ umwami Dawidi arinjira, yicara imbere y’Uhoraho, aravuga, ati Mwami Uhoraho, mbega jewe n’inda n’indesho, n’inzu yanje, nar’ iki, kubona wagiye unzigama gushitsa n’ubu?

Kand’ ivyo kuri wewe vyari vyoroshe, Mwami Uhoraho; ariko non’ ugeretsek’ uvuga n’ivy’ inzu yanje jewe umusavyi wawe, vy’igihe kirekire kir’ imbere, unyereka n’uruvyaro ruzokwaruka hanyuma, Mwami Uhoraho.
Non’ ikindi jewe Dawidi nokubgira n’iki? kuk’ uzi umusavyi wawe, Mwami Uhoraho.
Ivyo vyose bikomeye wabikoze kubg’ ijambo ryawe, nk’uko wavyigombeye mu mutima wawe, kugira ng’ ubimmenyeshe, jewe umusavyi wawe.
Ni co gituma ur’ ūhambaye, Uhoraho Mana, kukw ata wuhwanye nawe, kand’ ata yindi Mana iriho twigeze kwumva atari wewe.

Har’ irindi hanga na rimwe mw isi rihwanye n’abantu bawe b’Abisirayeli, abo wewe Mana wisidukiye ugacungura, ukabagira abawe, kugira ngo wironkere izina rya rurangiranwa, ugakora ibikomeye kubgabo, n’ ibiteye ubgoba kubg’ igihugu cawe, ukirukana amahanga n’ imana zayo imbere y’abantu bawe, abo wacunguye ukabakūra muri Egiputa?
Ni wewe wahaye abantu bawe b’Abisirayeli gutsindaza, ngo baze bahore ar’ abawe ibihe vyose; kandi nawe, Uhoraho, wababereye Imana.
Nuko none, Uhoraho Mana, ijambo uvuze kuri jewe umusavyi wawe no ku nzu yanje urikomeze ibihe vyose, kand’ ushitse ivy’ uvuze.
Maz’ izina ryawe baze barishemagize ibihe bidashira, bat’ Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo ni yo Mana y’Abisirayeli; kandi n’inzu yanje, jewe umusavyi wawe Dawidi, izokwama itsindaje imbere yawe;
kuk’ umpishuriye, jewe umusavyi wawe, k’uzonyubakira inzu, ewe Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, Mana y’ Abisirayeli; ni co gitumye umusavyi wawe ntinyuka kugusenga ntya.
Kandi none, Mwami Uhoraho, ni wewe Mana, n’amajambo yawe n’ay’ ukuri, kand’ unsezeraniye iryo jambo ryiza, jewe umusavyi wawe.

None rero, emera guha umugisha inzu y’umusavyi wawe, kugira ngw ihore ihamye imbere yawe ibihe vyose, kukw ari wewe ubivuze, Mwami Uhoraho; kand’ umugisha utangwa nawe uz’ uhore ku nzu y’umusavyi wawe ibihe vyose.
Hanyuma y’ivyo Dawidi anesha Abafilisitiya, abamara igabo, atsinda igisagara cabo gikuru, arakibanyaga.

Maz’ anesha Abanyamowabu, abarambika hasi mu mirongo, abageresha umugozi: agera imirongo ibiri, iba iyo kwicwa, uwa gatatu wose uba uwo guhangazwa. Nukw Abanyamowabu baca baba abatwarwa ba Dawidi, bakāma bamuzanira amarari.
Bukeye Dawidi anesha n’ umwami w’i Zoba, Hadadezeri mwene Rehobu, igihe Hadadezeri yaja gusubira kugandura igihugu yaganza co ku ruzi Efurate.

Dawidi amunyaga ingabo zigendera ku mafarasi igihumbi n’amajana ndwi, n’izigendesha amaguru ibihumbi mirongwibiri; maz’ amafarasi akwega imikogote ayacagagura ibitsi, arikw asigaza ayakwiranye n’imikogote ijana.
Maz’ Abasiriya b’i Damasiko baje gutabara Hadadezeri umwami w’i Zoba, Dawidi abicamw’ ingabo ibihumbi mirongwibiri na bibiri.
Araheza akwiragiza amaboma mu gihugu c’i Siriya gikūkira i Damasiko; nukw Abasiriya baba abatwarwa ba Dawidi, bakāma bamuzanira amarari. Nuk’ Uhoraho yahora aha Dawidi intsinzi aho yaja hose.
Kandi Dawidi yari yaranyaze abantu ba Hadadezeri inkinzo z’izahabu bari bafise, azijana i Yerusalemu.
Kand’ umwami Dawidi yari yarasahuye imiringa myinshi cane mu bisagara vya Hadadezeri, ic’ i Beta n’ic’ i Berotayi.
Bukeye Toyu umwami w’i Hamati yumvise ko Dawidi yanesheje ingabo zose za Hadadezeri,

atuma umuhungu wiwe Yoramu ku mwami Dawidi kumuramutsa no kumushima, ko yarwanye na Hadadezeri akamunesha; kuko Hadadezeri yahora arwanya Toyu. Kandi Yoramu yar’ azanye ibintu vy’amafeza n’ivy’ amazahabu n’ ivy’ imiringa.
Na vyo nyene umwami Dawidi abirobanurira Uhoraho, hamwe n’amafeza n’ amazahabu yari yaramurobanuriye, ayasahuye mu mahanga yari yaranesheje,
i Siriya n’i Mowabu no mu Bamoni no mu Bafilisitiya no mu Bamaleki, bo na ya masahu yari yarasahuye umwami w’i Zoba, Hadadezeri mwene Rehobu.
Nuko Dawidi yironkera izina rya rurangiranwa. Maz’ atabarutse avuye kunesha Abasiriya, atsinda Abanyedomu ibihumbi cumi n’umunani mu Kiyaya c’ Umunyu.
Nukw ashira amaboma mu gihugu c’Abanyedomu, ayakwiragiza muri Edomu hose. Abanyedomu bose baca baba abatwarwa ba Dawidi. Nuk’ Uhoraho yahora aha Dawidi intsinzi aho yaja hose.
Nuko Dawidi yaganza Abisirayeli bose, agacira abantu biwe bose imanza ziroranye.
Kandi Yowabu umwana wa Seruwiya ni we yar’ umugabisha w’ingabo, Yehoshafati mwene Ahiludi ni we yar’ umwanditsi w’ivyaja biraba;
Sadoki mwene Ahitubu na Ahimeleki mwene Abiyatari ni bo bār’ abaherezi; Seraya ni we yar’ umukarani;
Benaya mwene Yehoyada ni we yagabisha Abakereti n’Abapeleti; kandi bene Dawidi bār’ abakuru b’igihugu.
Bukeye Dawidi arabaza, ati Mbega har’ agasigarira mu nzu ya Sauli koba kakiriho, kugira ngo ndamugirire neza kubga Yonatani?
Maze hār’ umunyarugo wa Sauli yitwa Ziba; nuko baramuhamagara ngo yitabe Dawidi. Umwami aramubaza, ati Ni wewe Ziba? Na we at’ Ego me, ni jewe Ziba umusavyi wawe.
Umwami aramubaza, ati Mbega mu nzu ya Sauli nta woba akiriho ngo ndamugirire neza kubg’ Imana? Ziba yishura umwami, ati Haracarih’ umwana wa Yonatani amugaye ibirenge.
Umwami aramubaza, at’ Aba hehe? Ziba yishura umwami, at’ Aba kwa Makiri mwene Amiyeli i Lo‐debari.
Maz’ umwami Dawidi aratuma, baramuzana bamukūye kwa Makiri mwene Amiyeli i Lo‐debari.
Nuko Mefibosheti mwene Yonatani umwuzukuru wa Sauli arenguka imbere ya Dawidi; akubita inkoro hasi, aramwunamira. Maze Dawidi aravuga, ati Mefibosheti! Aritaba, ati Sabge!
Dawidi aramubarira, ati Mpore nta co utinya, kuko ntazobura kukugirira neza kubga so Yonatani, kandi nzogusubiza amatongo yose ya sogokuru Sauli, kand’ uzohora urīra ku meza yanje na ntaryo.
Arasubira aramwunamira, ati Mbega jewe umusavyi wawe, n’ inda n’indesho, nar’ iki k’undoreshako n’ijisho, kandi nd’ imbga ipfuye?
Umwami araheza ahamagaza Ziba, yar’ umunyarugo wa Sauli, at’ Ivyar’ ivya Sauli vyose n’ivyar’ ivy’ abo mu nzu yiwe bose, mbigabiye mwene shobuja.

Nawe uz’ uhore umurimira, mwe n’ abahungu bawe n’abantu bawe, mumushikirize imyimbu, kugira ngo mwene shobuja az’ ahore abona ibimutunga. Ariko Mefibosheti mwene shobuja ubgiwe azohora arīra ku meza yanje na ntaryo. Kandi Ziba yar’ afise abahungu cumi na batanu n’abantu atunze mirongwibiri.
Maze Ziba yishura umwami, at’ Ivy’ umbariye vyose, jewe umusavyi wawe, ni ko nzobigenza, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma. Nuko Mefibosheti yama arīra ku meza y’ umwami nk’uwo mu bana b’ umwami.
Kandi Mefibosheti yar’ afise akana k’agahungu kitwa Mika. Nukw abo mu rugo rwa Ziba bose baba abantu ba Mefibosheti.
Nuko Mefibosheti aba i Yerusalemu, kuko yama arīra ku meza y’umwami; kandi yari yaramugaye ibirenge vyompi.
Hanyuma y’ivyo umwami w’Abamoni aratanga; maz’ umuhungu wiwe Hanuni asubira ku ngoma yiwe.

Dawidi avyumvise aravuga, ati Nzogirira neza Hanuni mwene Nahashi, nk’uko se yangiriye neza. Nuko Dawidi arungika abantu bo kumugarukirako kuko yabuze se. Abo bantu ba Dawidi baragenda, bashika mu gihugu c’Abamoni.

Arikw abaganwa b’Abamoni babarira umwami wabo Hanuni, bati Mbeg’ ugira ngo Dawidi icamuteye kurungika abo kukugarukirako n’uko yari yubashe so? Ntuzi kw abo bantu yabarungitse gukenguza iki gisagara no kugitata, ngw abone kukigeseza?
Nuko Hanuni afata abo bantu ba Dawidi, abamwa ubganwa bg’umusaya umwe, akeba impuzu zabo ahereye hagati ku kibuno, araheza arabarungika.
Dawidi abibariwe, atuma abo guhūra na bo, kukw abo bagabo bāri batēterewe cane. Umwami abatumako, uti Ni mugume i Yeriko kugeza musubiye kumera ubganwa, muheze muze mubone kugaruka.

Maz’ Abamoni babonye ko bateye Dawidi akayigo, batuma ku Basiriya b’i Beti‐rehobu n’ab’i Zoba, babaha impēra ngo babahe ingabo ibihumbi mirongwibiri, bahēra n’umwami w’i Mayaka, azana ingabo igihumbi, n’iz’ i Tobu ibihumbi cumi na bibiri.
Maze Dawidi avyumvise, arekura Yowabu n’ingabo zose z’abahizi.
Nukw Abamoni basokoroka mu gisagara, batonda urugamba mw ishikiro kw irembo; Abasiriya b’i Zoba n’ab’i Rehobu, n’ingabo z’i Tobu n’iz’ i Mayaka, na bo baja ukwabo mu gahinga.
Maze Yowabu abonye ko batonze urugamba, rumwe imbere urundi inyuma yiwe, atora bamwe bo mu ntōre zose z’Abisirayeli, abatondesha urugamba ruhangana n’Abasiriya.
Izindi ngabo zose aziha murumuna we Abishayi ngw azigabishe, na we azitondesha urugamba ruhangana n’Abamoni.
Maze Yowabu aramubarira, at’ Abasiriya ni baramuka bagomba kunnanira, uraza untabare; kandi nawe Abamoni ni baramuka bagomba kukunanira, nanje ndaza kugutabara.
Nuko shira ubgoba, turwane kigabo, turwanire ubgoko bgacu n’ibisagara vy’Imana yacu; na we Uhoraho arakora ico ashima.
Nuko Yowabu n’ingabo ziri kumwe na we begereza Abasiriya ngo barumaneko; baca bariruka baramuhunga.
Maz’ Abamoni babonye Abasiriya bahunze, na bo bahunga Abishayi, bīsuka mu gisagara. Nuko Yowabu araheza areka Abamoni, asubira i Yerusalemu.
Bukeye Abasiriya babonye ko baneshejwe n’Abisirayeli, barakorakorana.
Maze Hadadezeri atuma no ku Basiriya bo hakurya y’uruzi Efurate, baza i Helamu, Shobaki umugabisha w’ingabo za Hadadezeri abagiye imbere.
Maze Dawidi abibariwe, na we akorakoranya Abisirayeli bose, bajabuka Yorodani baja i Helamu. Maz’ Abasiriya batonda urugamba bahangana na Dawidi, barwana na we.

Maz’ Abasiriya bahunga Abisirayeli; Dawidi yica mu Basiriya abagendera mu mikogote amajana ndwi y’intambara, n’abagendera ku mafarasi ibihumbi mirongwine, kandi yica Shobaki umugabisha w’ingabo zabo, agwaho.
Maz’ abami bose baganzwa na Hadadezeri, babonye ko baneshejwe n’Abisirayeli, barabīsaba, bemera kuganzwa na bo. Nukw Abasiriya batinya gusubira gutabara Abamoni ukundi.

Nuk’ umwaka utashe, ku gacikamvura, mu gihe abami bākunda kuja mu ntambara, Dawidi agomora Yowabu n’abantu biwe n’Abisirayeli bose, bageseza Abamoni, baziguza n’i Raba. Ariko Dawidi ubgiwe yisigarira i Yerusalemu.
Maz’ umusi ur’ izina ku mugoroba, Dawidi amaze kwibambura ku kirwa, agendagenda hejuru ku ngoro yiwe; maz’ akiri hano hejuru, aja abona umugore arikw ariyuhagira, kandi yari mwiza ateye igomwe.
Nuko Dawidi atuma kubaza uwo mugore uw’ ari we. Baramubarira, bati Si Batisheba mwene Eliyamu, muka Uriya Umuheti?
Nuko Dawidi atuma intumwa zo kumuzana, aca arenguka i we, bararyamana, kuko yari yihumanuye avuye mu miziro; hanyuma asubira i muhira.
Nya mugore asamye inda, atuma kuri Dawidi, ut’ Afise inda.
Maze Dawidi atuma kuri Yowabu, uti Murungikire wa Muheti Uriya. Nuko Yowabu aca arungika Uriya kwa Dawidi.
Uriya amushikiriye, Dawidi amubaza inkuru za Yowabu n’iz’ ingabo, n’uko bigenda mu ntambara.
Maze Dawidi aramubarira, ati Manuka uje i wawe, woge ibirenge. Nuko Uriya asohoka mu ngoro y’umwami, bamukurikiza ingaburo agaburiwe n’umwami.
Ariko Uriya yīrārira hamwe n’abanyarugo ba shebuja bose, mw irebe ry’ingoro y’umwami, ntiyamanuka ngw aje i we.
Maze babariye Dawidi, bat’ Erega Uriya ntiyatashe i muhira; Dawidi aca abaza Uriya, ati Mbega ntiwar’ uvuye ku rugendo? None k’utāgiye kurāra i wawe?

Uriya yishura Dawidi, at’ Isandugu y’Imana n’Abisirayeli n’Abayuda ko barāra mu nsago, kandi databuja Yowabu n’ abantu bawe, mugenzi, bakaba bashagaje mu gahinga; none jewe ngende i wanje, nīrīre, nīnywere, ndārane n’umugore wanje? Ndakurahiye, eka ni wewe ndahiro nyene, sinorikora!
Maze Dawidi aramubarira, ati Sībira hano n’uyu musi, ejo nzokurekura ugende. Nuko Uriya asībira i Yerusalemu uwo musi na bukeye.
Maze Dawidi aramurengukisha ngw aze kurya no kunywa ar’ imbere yiwe, aramuboreza; hageze mw ijoro, Uriya aja kuryama ku gisegure ciwe hamwe na ba banyarugo ba shebuja, ariko ntiyamanuka ngw aje i we.
Bukeye mu gitondo Dawidi yandikira Yowabu icete, akirungikana Uriya nyene.
Yandika mur’ ico cete, ati Muherereze Uriya imbere ah’ urugamba rukaze, muheze mwīgire inyuma mumute, kugira ngo bamutere apfe.
Nuko rero Yowabu, igihe asubiye gutera ico gisagara, aherereza Uriya ahantu azi ko har’ abahizi.
Maz’ abantu bo muri nya gisagara barasokoroka, barwanya Yowabu; abantu bamwe bo mu ngabo za Dawidi barapfa, hapfamwo na Uriya wa Muheti.
Maze Yowabu atuma kumenyesha Dawidi ivy’ intambara uko bimeze;
abarira intumwa, ati Ni wamara kudondera umwami inkuru zose z’uko bimeze mu ntambara,
umwami ni yaramuka aratse, akakubaza, ati N’iki cabateye kurwana mwegereje igisagara murtyo? ati Mbega ntimwari muzi ko batoretse kubarasa bahagaze ku ruzitiro?

Akanakubaza, ati None ni nde yishe Abimeleki mwene Yerubayali? ati S’umugore yamuteye ingasire, yihagarariye ku ruzitiro, akagwa aho nyene i Tebesi? ati N’iki cabateye kwegereza uruzitiro murtyo? Uz’ uheze umubarire, ut’ Erega na wa muntu wawe w’Umuheti Uriya, na we yarapfuye.
Nukw iyo ntumwa iragenda; ishitse, idondera Dawidi ivyo Yowabu yamutumye vyose.
Iramubarira, it’ Abantu baho bāradutwariranije, badushikana no mu gahinga, ariko turaruha tubīgiza inyuma kurinda tubashikanye kw irembo ryabo.
Kand’ abanyamiheto bari bahagaze ku ruzitiro baturasa, twebge abantu bawe; hapfa bamwe bo mu bantu bawe, mwami, kandi hapfuye na wa muntu wawe w’Umuheti, Uriya.

Maze Dawidi yishura iyo ntumwa, at’ Uz’ ubarire Yowabu, ut’ Ivyo ntibikubabaze, uti Kukw inkota mu kwica ipfa uwo ihubiyeko; uti None rero shimika, uvyure akanyarigabo mu kurwanya ico gisagara, ukineshe. Ukw abe ari k’umurindisha.
Maze muka Uriya yumvise k’ umugabo wiwe yapfuye, aramuririra.
Hanyuma agandutse, Dawidi atuma kumuzana i we, aramucūra; bavyarana umwana w’umuhungu; arikw ivyo Dawidi yakoze vyababaje Uhoraho.
Bukeye Uhoraho atuma Natani kuri Dawidi; araza, aramubarira, ati Hār’ abantu babiri bāba mu gisagara kimwe, umwe w’umutunzi, uwundi w’umworo.
Kand’ uwo mutunzi yar’ afise amasinzi y’intama n’inka.

Ariko nya mworo nta co yar’ afise, atar’ akāgazi k’intama kamwe yari yaraguze, akakarera, kagakura kari kumwe na we n’abana biwe, kakarya ku two kurya twiwe, kakanywera mu gikombe ciwe, kakāma karyama mu gikiriza ciwe, kakamumerera nk’umukobga yivyariye.
Bukeye haza umushitsi kwa nya mutunzi, na we yanka gukora mu ntama ziwe canke mu nka, ngw azimane uwo mushitsi amugendeye, arikw ahitana wa mwana w’intama wa nya mworo, ayibāgira umushitsi wiwe.
Maz’ uburake bga Dawidi buca buziriringira uwo muntu; abarira Natani, ati Ndahiye uguhoraho kw’Uhoraho, uwakoze ivyo yar’ akwiye gupfa;
non’ az’ amurihe uwo mwana w’intama kane, kuko yakoze ikintu nk’ico, akaba imburakigongwe.

Maze Natani abarira Dawidi, at’ Ereg’ uwo muntu ni wewe nyene. Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli avuze, ati Ni jewe nakwimikishije amavuta ng’ube umwami w’Abisirayeli, ndagukiza, ngukūra mu maboko ya Sauli;
nkwinjiza ingoro ya shobuja, nguha n’abagore biwe ngo bagusegure; kandi nkugabira umuryango wa Isirayeli n’ uwa Yuda; kand’ iyo biba vyarabaye bike, mba narakwongeye n’ibindi.
N’iki catumye ukēngēra ijambo ryanje jewe Uhoraho, ugakora ivyo mbona kw ari bibi, ukicisha inkota Uriya Umuheti, ugacūra umugore wiwe ukamugira rwawe, na we Uriya ukamwicisha inkota y’Abamoni?
None rero, inkota nta ho izova mu rugo rwawe, kuko wankēngereye, ugacūra muka Uriya Umuheti, ukamugira umugore wawe.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Nzokuvyurira ivyago vyanduruka mu rugo rwawe; nzokunyaga abagore bawe ubona, mbahe umubanyi wawe, aryamane na bo ku murango.
Wewe wabikoreye mu mpisho, ariko jeho nzobikora icese imbere y’Abisirayeli, ku murango nyene.
Maze Dawidi yishura Natani, ati Nacumuye k’Uhoraho. Natani aramwishura, ati Noneho Uhoraho yagukūyekw icaha cawe, ntugipfuye.
Ariko kuko wahaye abansi b’Uhoraho urwitwazo rukomeye rwo kumurogotako kubg’ ico wakoze, wa mwana wavyara ntakabuza azopfa.
Natani araheza yitahira i we. Hanyuma Uhoraho atēza indwara wa mwana muka Uriya yavyarana na Dawidi, agera kure.
Ni co catumye Dawidi yinginga Imana kubg’ uwo mwana, akisonzesha, akinjira mu nzu agakesha ijoro arambaraye hasi.
Abantu bakuru bo mu rugo rwiwe babibonye bamuhagarara i ruhande, ngo bamuvyure ave hasi, aranka, yanka no kuja aho bari ngw afūngure.

Maze ku musi ugira indwi uwo mwana arapfa; abantu ba Dawidi batinya kumubgira k’umwana acīkānye; bati Mbega ko twamuhanūye umwana akiriho, akanka kutwumvira, none biracura iki, ni twamubgira k’umwana acīkānye? Ubgo ntaca yiyahura?
Maze Dawidi abonye kw abantu biwe bongorerana, amenyera aho k’ umwana apfuye; abaza abo bantu biwe, ati Mbeg’ umwana aracīkānye? Bat’ Aracīkānye.

Maze Dawidi aca arahaguruka, ava aho yar’ arambaraye hasi, ariyuhagira arirtyorora, yambara iyindi myambaro, araheza aja mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho, arasenga; hanyuma ataha i we; maze yatse ivyo kurya barabimuzanira, arafūngura.
Maz’ abantu biwe baramubaza, bati Mbeg’ ukoze ibiki? Umwana akiriho ko wisonzesheje ukamuririra, ariko non’ amaze guhwera, uca urahaguruka, urafūngura!
Arabishura, ati Nka ko, umwana akiriho narisonzesheje ndarira, nti Sinzi, kumbure Uhoraho yongirira imbabazi, umwana agakira.
None se kw amaze gupfa, noba ncisonzeshereza iki? Mbega noshobora kumugarura? Nzoja iy’ ari, ariko we ntakigaruka aho ndi.
Maze Dawidi yirura umugore wiwe Batisheba, yinjira iy’ ari, aramurārira; hanyuma avyara umwana w’umuhungu, amwita Salomo. Uhoraho aramukunda,
atuma ūvugishwa na we Natani kumwita Yedidiya; agenza artyo nk’uk’ Uhoraho yamubariye.
Kandi Yowabu yar’ akirwanya i Raba h’Abamoni; atsinda iboma ryazigama ivomo ryaho.
Araheza atuma intumwa kuri Dawidi, uti Yarwanije i Raba, kandi yafashe igisagara kirimw’ ivomo ryaho;
uti None rero koranya izindi ngabo zisigaye, uze gusagaza imbere y’igisagara, abe ari wewe ugitsinda, uti Yoye kuba ari we agitsinda, bakazohava bakimwitirira.
Nuko Dawidi akoranya ingabo zose, arahaguruka aja i Raba, araharwanya, arahatsinda.

Akūra Milikomu igitsibo mu mutwe, kuriba kwaco kwar’ italanto y’izahabu, kandi cari gihunzwek’ utubuyenge tw’igiciro kinini; nuko bacambika Dawidi mu mutwe. Maze mur’ ico gisagara akūramw’ amasahu menshi cane.

Asokorora abantu bāri muri co, abashikiriza imisumeno n’ivyuma vy’ibisaganga n’amacabiti; abakoresha no ku matanure y’amatafari, arabacumukuza. Uko ni ko yagirira ibisagara vyose vy’Abamoni. Nuko Dawidi n’ingabo ziwe zose basubira i Yerusalemu.
Hanyuma y’ivyo ivyābaye n’ibi: Abusalomu mwene Dawidi yar’ afise mushiki we mwiza w’umunyakaranga, yitwa Tamari. Bukeye Amunoni mwene Dawidi nyene aramugomwa.
Amunoni atuntuzwa no kwifuza mushiki we Tamari, biranamurwaza; kuko yar’ inkumi igumije ibanga, Amunoni akamubura uburyo.
Ariko Amunoni yar’ afise umugenzi bakundana yitwa Yonadabu mwene Shimeya, Shimeya mukuru wa Dawidi; kandi Yonadabu uwo yar’ umuntu w’incabgenge.
Aramubaza, ati Mbega mwana w’umwami, k’ugenda ushira umunywera imisi yose, ntiwombgira icabiguteye? Amunoni aramwishura, ati Nagomwe Tamari mushiki wa Abusalomu mwene data.

Yonadabu aramubgira, ati Genda wiryamire ku buriri bgawe, wirwaze; maze so ni yaza kurāba uko umeze, umubarire, uti Ndasavye mundungikire mushikanje Tamari, aze ampēreze utwo ntamira; uti Kand’ abironderere imbere yanje aho mbona, uti Maz’ ubgiwe abimpēreje, ni ho nobirya.

Nuko Amunoni araryama, arirwaza; maz’ umwami aje kurāba ukw ameze, Amunoni aramubgira, ati Ndasavye mundungikire mushikanje Tamari, andonderere udukāte tubiri aho mbona, maz’ abe ari we atumpēreza; ni ho norya.
Maze Dawidi atuma i muhira kuri Tamari, uti Genda kwa musazāwe Amunoni, umuronderere utwo kurya.
Nuko Tamari aja kwa Amunoni musaza we, asanga aryamye; yābīra igikandu, akibumbabumbamw’ udukāte Amunoni abona, aradukaranga.
Yābīra ico yakaranzeko, aratumusukira, ariko yanka kurya. Maze Amunoni aravuga, ati Bose ni bataramuke. Nuko barataramuka bose.
Maze Amunoni abarira Tamari, ati Nzanira mu mpete utwo warondeye, unyīhēre mbone kurya. Nuko Tamari yābīra utwo dukāte yarondeye, adushīra musaza we Amunoni haruguru mu mpete.
Atumuhēreje ngw arye, Amunoni aramucakira, aramubgira, at’ Enda mushikanje, n’uze turyamane.
Na we aramwishura, at’ Oyaye, mwana wa data, reka kunyambika ibara, kuko ben’ ivyo bidakwiye gukorwa mu Bisirayeli; reka gukora ikizira nk’ico.
Mbega nanje noheza ngakwirwa hehe n’ibitētērwa? Kandi nawe woba ugotse mu Bisirayeli. Enda se n’ubivugane n’umwami, kukw atokunyima.
Ariko yanka kwumva ivyo amubgiye; maze kuko yamurusha inkomezi amufata ku kagōbēro, aryamana na we.
Maze Amunoni aca amwanka urunuka; urwanko yamwanse rwaruse urukundo yamukunda. Aramubgira, ati Hoji va hasi ugende.
Na we aramwishura, at’ Oyaye si ko, kuko kunyirukana ari bibi kuruta ivyo umaze kungirira. Ariko yanka kwemera.
Maz’ ahamagara umuntu wiwe amusukurira, ati Sohora uyu mukobga amve i ruhande, umwugaranire hanze.
Kandi yari yambaye umwambaro muremure w’amaboko, kukw abakobga b’umwami bakir’ abigeme ari ko bambara. Nuk’ uwo musuku wiwe aramusohora, aramwugarana.
Maze Tamari yiyorera umunyota mu mutwe, yitantamurirako wa mwambaro wiwe w’amaboko, yiremēka ukuboko, agenda ararira ingenda, aboroga.

Maze Abusalomu musaza we amubonye, aramubaza, at’ Aho ntiwamanye na musazāwe Amunoni? Enda ni wiyihorerere, mwana wa mama; erega kw ari musazāwe, reka kubishirak’ umutima. Nuko Tamari aguma kwa musaza we Abusalomu yifumbereje.
Maz’ umwami Dawidi yumvise ivyo vyose, araraka cane.
Kandi Abusalomu ntiyaba akigira ico avugana na Amunoni, ari kibi ari ciza, kuko Abusalomu yar’ agiriye Amunoni urwanko, kuko yononye mushiki we Tamari.
Hashize imyaka ibiri yiramvuriye, Abusalomu arārika abamukemurira intama i Bayali‐hasori, hāri hahereranye n’i Bgefurayimu; maz’ atumira abana b’umwami bose.
Aragenda abarira umwami, ati Jewe umusavyi wawe ndafise abankemurira intama; none ndakwinginze mugenzi, mwe n’abantu bawe muze tujane.
Umwami yishura Abusalomu, at’ Oyaye mwananje, ntitwojana twese, ngo tuje kukurusha. Abusalomu aramugōbēra, ariko yanka kugenda, mugabo aramuhezagira.
Maze Abusalomu aramubarira, ati None rero k’utaje, urungike mukurwanje Amunoni, aze tujane. Umwami aramubaza, at’ Ugombera iki ko mujana?
Ariko Abusalomu aramuzigitīra, umwami araruha aremera ko Amunoni n’ abandi bana biwe bose bajana na we.

Nuko Abusalomu arahava abarira abasuku biwe, ati Muje muritegereza Amunoni: ni mwabona amaze guhimba vino, nkababarira, nti Ni muzibagure Amunoni; nuko muce mumwica, ntimutinye: none si jewe nzoba ndabibabariye? Nuko mugumye imitima, mube abahizi.
Nukw abo basuku ba Abusalomu bagira Amunoni nk’uko Abusalomu yababariye. Maz’ abana b’umwami bose baca barabatagurika, umuntu wese asimbira ku nyumbu yiwe, barahunga.
Bakiri mu nzira, imbitsi ibikira Dawidi ko Abusalomu yishe abana b’umwami bose, ngo Ntihasigaye n’umwe.
Maz’ umwami arabaduka, yitantamurirakw impuzu ziwe, arambarara mw ivu; n’ abantu biwe bose bamuhagaze i ruhande na bo bitantamurirakw impuzu zabo.

Maze Yonadabu mwene Shimeya, Shimeya mukuru wa Dawidi, aramubarira, ati Mugenzi, erega ntugire ngo bishe abana bawe bose; Amunoni wenyene ni we yapfuye; kukw ivyo Abusalomu yabigabiye guhēra umusi Amunoni yonona mushiki we Tamari.
Nuko none mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma, izo nkuru ureke kuzemera ngo wiyumvire kw abana bawe bose bapfuye, kuko hapfuye Amunoni wenyene.
Kandi Abusalomu yari yahunze. Maz’ umuhungu yar’ ashibamye, yunamuye amaso, abona haje abantu benshi, baturutse mu nzira iva i Horonayimu ikikamanye umusozi.
Maze Yonadabu abarira umwami, at’ Eh’ abana bawe baraje; nk’uko jewe umusavyi wawe nabivuze, ni ko bibaye.
Akirangiza kuvuga, abana b’ umwami barashika, maze baraturikisha bararira; n’umwami na we nyene n’abantu biwe bose bararira baraboroga.
Ariko Abusalomu we yari yahunze, aja ku mwami w’i Geshuri, Talumayi mwene Amihuri. Kandi Dawidi yamana akabonge k’umwana wiwe imisi yose.
Abusalomu amara imyaka itatu i Geshuri iyo yahungiye.
Hanyuma umwami Dawidi amugirira inkumbu nyinshi, kuko yar’ amaze gushira umubabaro w’urupfu rwa Amunoni.
Bukeye Yowabu umwana wa Seruwiya amenya k’ umwami afitiye inkumbu Abusalomu.

Nuko Yowabu atuma i Tekowa guhamagaza umugore w’ umunyabgenge; aramubarira, ati Ntabara wīgire nk’ūgandaye, wambare nk’ūri ku kigandaro, ntiwīsīge amavuta, arik’ use n’umugore amaze imisi myinshi agandariye uwapfuye.
Uheze uje i bgami, ubarire umwami urtya n’urtya. Nuko Yowabu amutegekera ivyo aja kuvuga.
Uwo mugore w’i Tekowa ashikiriye umwami, akubita inkoro hasi, aramwunamira, aramubarira, ati Ntabara, mugenzi.
Umwami aramubaza, at’ Ubaye iki? Aramwishura, ati Yō! Erega nd’ umupfakazi, umugabo wanje yarapfuye.
Kandi jewe incoreke yawe nari mfise abana b’ abahungu babiri; bukeye basindira ku gahinga, batagira ūbabanguranya; nuk’ umwe akubita uwundi, agwa bukumbi.

Non’ abaryango bose bankūriye hasi, jewe incoreke yawe, ngo ni ntange uwishe mugenzi we, kugira ngo bamuhōre uwo yishe; bakagomba kwica n’uwotoye umwandu; uko ni ko bagira bazimye agakara nari nsigaranye, ngo ntibasigarize umugabo wanje izina cank’ imbuto kw isi.
Umwami abgira uwo mugore, ati Genda, ni witahire; ivyawe ndabitunganya.
Uwo mugore w’i Tekowa yishura umwami, at’ Abe ari jewe bizosubira ku mutwe, n’inzu ya data, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma, ntibize bikujeko cank’ ingoma yawe, mugenzi.
Umwami aramwishura, ati Ni hagira ūkuvuga, umunzanire, ntazoba agisubira kugukakaza.

Aramwishura, ati Ndakwinginze mugenzi, undahire Uhoraho Imana yawe, kugira ng’ ūhōra uwishwe ntaz’ aze kwica, bakamarīra n’agahungu nari nsigaranye. Umwami aramwishura, ati Ndahiye uguhoraho kw’Uhoraho, yukw ata n’agashatsi na kamwe ko ku mutwe w’umwana wawe kazohara ngo gakorokere hasi.
Maz’ uno mugore aramubarira, ati Mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma, zirikana ico nkubarira, jewe incoreke yawe. Na we ati Nuko mbarira.
Uwo mugore aramubgira, ati None n’iki caguteye kugira imigabo yo kugirira abantu b’Imana nka ben’ ivyo nyene? Ko vyakwiviriye mu kanwa ga mugenzi, usa n’ūtsinzwe, kuk’ utāgarukanye ca gicibga cawe.
Erega twese tuzopfa, tumeze nk’amazi asēseka ntayorwe. Mbere n’Imana ntiyiciraho, arikw irondera uburyo kugira ng’ uwaciwe ntaz’ arinde apfa akir’ igicibga.

None rero mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma, igitumye nza kukubgira iryo jambo n’ukw abantu banteye ubgoba; incoreke yawe nkavuga nti Hinge nje kwivuganira n’umwami; nti Kumbure umwami yokwemera gukora ico incoreke yiwe imusavye;
nt’ Umwami aranyumvira, ankize jewe incoreke yiwe, ankūre mu maboko ya wa muntu agomba kundandurana n’umwana wanje, adukūre mw ishamvu y’Imana.

Kandi jewe incoreke yawe ngatako nkiyumvira, nt’ Ijambo ry’umwami wanje nyen’ ingoma rizondemesha; nti Kuk’ umwami ameze nk’umumarayika w’Imana ku vyo gutandukanya ibibi n’ ivyiza. Nuk’ Uhoraho Imana yawe az’ ahorane nawe.
Maz’ umwami yishura uwo mugore, ati Ntabara umbarire ico ngira nkubaze cose, ntumpishe. Uwo mugore aramwishura, ati Mbaza mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma.

Umwami aramubaza, at’ Ubg’ ivyo vyose ntiwabibgirijwe na Yowabu? Uwo mugore aramwishura, ati Mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma, indahiro ni wewe nyene hakagira uwoshobora gucisha i ruhande ico umubajije cose; ni koko umusavyi wawe Yowabu ni we yangeze, jewe incoreke yawe, antegekera ayo majambo yose;
icamuteye kugenza artyo kwar’ ukugira ngw ivyabaye abihindure ukundi. Kandi ga mugenzi, ufise ubgenge nk’ubg’ umumarayika w’ Imana, umenya ibiri mw isi vyose.
Maz’ umwami abarira Yowabu, ati Nuko ndavyemeye; uragenda ugarukane uyo muhungu Abusalomu.
