Maze Yowabu akubita inkoro hasi, yunamira umwami, aramuhezagira; aravuga, ati Jewe umusavyi wawe uyu musi mmenye ko ngutonnyeko, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma, kuk’ ukoze ico nagusavye.
Nuko Yowabu arahaguruka, aja i Geshuri, agarukana Abusalomu i Yerusalemu.
Maz’ umwami aravuga, ati N’asubire mu rugo rwiwe; ariko ntazonkubita ijisho. Nuko Abusalomu asubira mu rugo rwiwe, ariko nta ho yabonana n’umwami.
Kandi mu banyakaranga bo mu Bisirayeli bose nta wavugangwa nka Abusalomu; uhereye mu bgōro bg’ikirenge ugashitsa mu gitwariro nta gasembga yagira.
Uk’ umwaka utashe yimosha umushatsi kuko wamuremēra, ni co catuma awimosha. Kand’ iy’ awimosheje yarawugera, ukariba shekeli amajana abiri, yagezwe kuri shekeli y’umwami.
Kandi Abusalomu yari yaravyaye abahungu batatu n’umukobga yitwa Tamari; yar’ umukobga mwiza w’umunyakaranga.
Nuko Abusalomu amara imyaka ibiri yiramvuriye i Yerusalemu, atararengukishwa i bgami.
Bukeye Abusalomu atuma guhamagaza Yowabu, kugira ngw az’ amutume ku mwami; yanka kumwitaba. Yongera kumutumak’ ubugira kabiri, na ho nyene yanka kumwitaba.
Ni kwo kubarira abantu biwe, ati Wa murima wa Yowabu wa sayiri, ubangikanye n’uwanje, mugende muwuturire. Nukw abantu ba Abusalomu baragenda barawuturira.
Maze Yowabu aca arahaguruka aja kwa Abusalomu, aramubaza, ati N’iki catumye abantu bawe banturirira umurima?

Abusalomu yishura Yowabu, ati N’uko nagutumyeko ng’uze hano ngutume ku mwami, ukanka; kwar’ ukugira ng’umumbarize icanzanye nkava i Geshuri; ut’ Iciza kwar’ uko yopfumye agumayo: none rero ndagomba kurenguka imbere y’umwami; kandi namba har’ ibigabitanyo mfise, apfume anyica.
Nuko Yowabu aja i bgami, arabimubarira; maz’ umwami ahamagaza Abusalomu, ararenguka, akubita inkoro hasi imbere y’ umwami; umwami aramugumbira.
Hanyuma y’ivyo, Abusalomu yironderera umukogote n’amafarasi, n’abantu mirongwitanu bo kumwiruka imbere.

Kandi yama akoroka hakiri kare, akagenda agahagarara kw ishikiro ry’ikirimba; maz’ umuntu wese afise urubanza agomba gucirwa n’umwami, Abusalomu akamuhamagara, akamubaza, at’ Uva mu kihe gisagara? Na we at’ Umusavyi wawe nd’ uwo mu muryango munaka wo mu Bisirayeli.
Abusalomu akamubarira, at’ Ereg’ urubanza rwawe rwari rwiza kandi rwari ruboneye; ariko nta muntu umwami yashizeho wo kwumviriza ivyawe.
Kandi Abusalomu agatakw akavuga, ati Yemwe, iyaba naragizwe umucamanza w’iki gihugu, umuntu wese yogize imbūrano cank’ aje kwitwara, akanshikīra, nomuciriye urubanza rwiza!
Kand’ iyo hagize ūmwunamira ngw amuramutse, yarāmvura ukuboko akamufata akamugumbira.
Uko ni ko Abusalomu yagenza Abisirayeli bose baza kwitwara ku mwami; nukw atwara imitima y’ Abisirayeli.
Hashize imyaka ine, Abusalomu abarira umwami, ati Ndasavye unyemerere nje i Heburoni, gushitsa isezerano nasezeraniye Uhoraho.
Kuko nasezeranye isezerano, jewe umusavyi wawe, igihe naba i Geshuri muri Siriya, nt’ Uhoraho ni yaramuka anshubije i Yerusalemu, nzomusaba.
Umwami aramwishura, ati Nuko genda amahoro. Nukw arahaguruka aja i Heburoni.
Bukeye Abusalomu atuma abantu ngo bagende mu mpisho, bakwiragire mu miryango yose y’Abisirayeli, ngo bavuge, bati Ni mwumva ijwi ry’inzamba, muce muvuga, muti Abusalomu agiye ku ngoma i Heburoni.
Kand’ igihe Abusalomu yava i Yerusalemu, yajanye n’abantu amajana abiri yahamagaye, bagenda ata kindi biyumvira, ata co bazi.

Maz’ igihe Abusalomu yarikw aratanga ibimazi, atuma guhamagaza Ahitofeli w’i Gilo, umujanama wa Dawidi; ava mu gisagara c’i wabo i Gilo. Nukw inama y’ubugarariji irakomera, kukw abantu bāgenda bagwirirana kuri Abusalomu.
Bukeye haza intumwa kuri Dawidi, iravuga, it’ Imitima y’Abisirayeli yaroye kuri Abusalomu.

Maze Dawidi abarira abantu biwe bose bari kumwe na we i Yerusalemu, ati Ni muve hasi duhunge; kuko tudahunze ata n’umwe muri twebge yomukira; ni mwihute tugende, ntace aduhamvya akadukorera ibara, umurwa akawuririkisha inkota.
Maz’ abantu b’umwami baramwishura, bati Mwami wacu nyen’ ingoma, abasavyi bawe twiteguye gukora ic’ ugomba cose.
Nuk’ umwami avanayo n’abo mu rugo rwiwe bose bamukondoreye inyuma; arikw asigay’ icumi bo mu ncoreke ziwe yagize abagore, ngo bazigame urugo.
Uko ni k’umwami yavuyeyo, abantu bose bamukondoreye inyuma; bashitse ku nzu y’imperēra batebaganiraho.
Nukw abantu biwe bose bamuca imbere; kand’ Abakereti n’Abapeleti bose, n’Abanyegati bose ukw ar’ amajana atandatu bāri bavuye i Gati bamukurikiye, na bo baca imbere yiwe.
Maz’ umwami abaza Itayi Umunyegati, ati Mbega wewe n’ iki gitumye ugomba kujana natwe? Subirayo, wisabire uwo mwami, kuk’ ur’ umunyamahanga, wavuye i wanyu wāngājwe.

Mbega ko waje ejo bundi, non’ uyu musi noshobora nte kukwemerera kuyererana natwe hirya no hino, ko ngiye kuja ahampaye uburyo hose? Subira inyuma, ujane na bagenzi bawe, Uhoraho akugirire imbabazi, akubere umwizigirwa.
Itayi yishura umwami, ati Ndahiye uguhoraho kw’Uhoraho, nawe nyene mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma, ni wewe ndahiro yanje, ah’ uzoba, mugenzi, ni ho nzoba, jewe umusavyi wawe, ar’ ugupfa ar’ ugukira.
Dawidi yishura Itayi, ati Nuko genda, ujabuke. Nuko Itayi Umunyegati arajabuka, bo n’ingabo ziwe zose n’abana bose bari kumwe na we.
Igihugu cose kirarira kiraboroga abantu bose bakiriko barajabuka; umwami na we aca arajabuka uwo mugezi Kidironi. Nukw abantu bose ni kwo kujabuka; bagenda batumbereye inzira ija mu bugaragwa.
Kandi hari haje Abiyatari, na Sadoki na we ni ho yar’ ari, n’Abalewi bose bareruye isandugu y’isezerano ry’Imana; batereka hasi iyo sandugu y’Imana, kugeza ah’ abantu bose barangirije kuva ku murwa.
Maz’ umwami abarira Sadoki, ati Subiza isandugu y’Imana ku murwa; Uhoraho ni yangirira ubuntu azongarukanayo, anyereke iyo sandugu yiwe n’ah’ aba.
Na ho ni yambarira ngo sindamuhimbaye; ehe ndi hano: n’angire ukw agomba.
Umwami arongera abarira Sadoki umuherezi, at’ Urumva, ni musubire ku murwa amahoro, mwe n’abahungu banyu bompi, Ahimasi umuhungu wawe na Yonatani mwene Abiyatari.
Ehe nzororērera ku majabukiro afata mu bugaragwa, gushitsa aho muzommenyeshereza inkuru z’uko bimeze.
Nuko Sadoki na Abiyatari barerura iyo sandugu y’Imana, bayisubiza i Yerusalemu, bagumayo.
Maze Dawidi atangura kudūga umusozi Elayono, adūga ararira ingenda, yitwikiriye mu mutwe, atambaye inkweto; kand’ abantu bose bari kumwe na we bitwikira mu mitwe, badūga bararira ingenda.
Maz’ umuntu abarira Dawidi, ati Ahitofeli ari mu bagarariji bafatanije na Abusalomu. Maze Dawidi arasenga, at’ Uhoraho, ndakwinginze, hindura ubusa inama za Ahitofeli.
Maze Dawidi ashitse ku mpinga y’uwo musozi, aho bama basengera Imana, Hushayi Umwaruki aza guhūra na we, yitantamuriyekw impuzu yiwe, yisutse ivu ku mutwe.
Dawidi aramubarira, ati Ni twajana uzongora;

ariko ni wasubira ku murwa, ukabgira Abusalomu, uti Mugenzi, mbaye umusavyi wawe; uti Nk’ uko nahora nsaba so mu gihe gishize, ni ko nawe nzogusaba. Uko ni k’uzoshobora kugenda unyicira inama za Ahitofeli.
Kandi ntuzi yuk’ uzoba uri kumwe na Sadoki na Abiyatari abaherezi? Nuko ni wagira ikintu cose wumva i bgami, uz’ uze ukibarire abo baherezi Sadoki na Abiyatari.
Kandi bafiseyo n’ abahungu babo bompi, Ahimasi wa Sadoki na Yonatani wa Abiyatari; abo ni bo muzoja murantumako, ngo mummenyeshe ivyo muzokwumva vyose.
Nuko Hushayi, uwo mukunzi wa Dawidi, aja ku murwa i Yerusalemu, ahashika igihe Abusalomu na we ashitseyo.

Maze Dawidi, aminutse impinga gatoya, ahūra na Ziba, umuntu wa Mefibosheti, azanye indogoba zibiri zirikw amatandiko, zīremētse amarobe y’ imitsima amajana abiri, n’imisoko ijana y’inzabibu zumye, n’amatunda ahishirije ijana, n’umukuza wa vino.

Umwami abaza Ziba, at’ Ibi n’ivy’ iki? Ziba aramwishura, at’ Indogoba n’izo kugira ngw abo mu rugo rwawe bazigendereko, mugenzi; imitsima n’ amatunda na vyo n’induhuro y’ imikangara, vino na yo n’iyo guhēmbūra abazogwira isari mu bugaragwa.
Umwami aramubaza, ati Mbega mwene shobuja we ari hehe? Ziba aramwishura, at’ Erega yigumiye i Yerusalemu, kuko yavuze ng’ uyu musi ab’ inzu ya Isirayeli baramusubiza ku ngoma ya se.
Maz’ umwami abarira Ziba, at’ Ehe rāba, ivyar’ ivya Mefibosheti vyose ndabikugabiye. Ziba aramwishura, ati Ndagukūriye ubgatsi, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma; urakāma untonesha.
Maz’ umwami Dawidi ashitse i Bahurimu, hasokoroka umuntu wo mu muryango wa Sauli yitwa Shimeyi mwene Gera, agenda aramutuka inzira yose.
Agenda aratera umwami Dawidi amabuye, n’abantu biwe bose; kand’ abantu bose n’abahizi bose bari bamuhagatiye i buryo n’i bumoso.
Uku ni ko Shimeyi yagenda aramutuka, ati Genda, urakagenda, wa mwicanyi we, wa mugesera we!

Uhoraho agushubije ku mutwe amaraso yose y’ab’ inzu ya Sauli, uwo wishize mu gishingo ciwe, ukīyimika; non’ Uhoraho agabiye Abusalomu umuhungu wawe ubgo bgami; awa! Ubuyobe bgawe buragukoze, kuk’ ur’ umwicanyi!
Maze Abishayi umwana wa Seruwiya abaza umwami, at’ Ariko n’iki gituma tureka uwo muvyimba w’imbga akagenda aragutuka ga mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma? Hinge njabuke ndamuce izosi.
Umwami aramwishura, ati Dusangiye iki ga yemwe bana ba Seruwiya? Ni yaba antutse Uhoraho ari we yamubariye, ati Tuka Dawidi; har’ uwoshobora kumubuza, at’ Ivyo ubitewe n’iki?

Mbere Dawidi abarira Abishayi n’abantu biwe bose, ati K’umwana wanje nīkūriye mu nda arondera agatwe kanje, mbeg’ urya Mubenyamini we ntarushiriza? Nuko mureke antuke, kuk’ Uhoraho ari we yabimubariye.
Kumbure Uhoraho azorāba ayo mbonye, ampe ivyiza mu gishingo c’iyo mivumo mvumwe uyu musi.
Nuko Dawidi n’abantu biwe bakomeza inzira, Shimeyi na we agenda akikamanye umusozi abangikanye na we, amutuka ingenda, amutera amabuye asūra umukungugu.
Nuk’ umwami n’ abantu bose bari kumwe na we bashika i Ayefimu; aruhukirayo.
Nuko Abusalomu n’Abisirayeli bose bashika i Yerusalemu, na Ahitofeli ari kumwe na we.
Maze Hushayi Umwaruki, umukunzi wa Dawidi, ashikiriye Abusalomu, aramubarira, at’ Uragahora ku ngoma, uragahora ku ngoma!
Maze Abusalomu abaza Hushayi, at’ Urwo ni rwo rukundo ukunze wa mukunzi wawe? Mbega k’utajanye na we?
Hushayi yishura Abusalomu, at’ Ekaye; arik’ ūtoranijwe n’ Uhoraho n’iri hanga bo n’ingabo zose z’Abisirayeli, nzoba uwiwe, ni we nzogendanira.
Kare ho nosavye nde? Sinosavye umwana wiwe? Nk’uko nahora nsaba so ni ko nawe nzogusaba.
Maze Abusalomu abarira Ahitofeli, ati Tugīre inama: tubigenze dute?
Ahitofeli yishura Abusalomu, ati Genda winjirane baka so b’incoreke, abo yasigaranye urugo; ni ho Abisirayeli bose bazomenya ko wacancabuye na so, abari kumwe nawe bose bagaca barema.
Nuko bashingira Abusalomu ihema hejuru ku ngoro; Abusalomu araheza yinjirana izo ncoreke za se, Abisirayeli bose babona.
Kandi mur’ ico gihe, inama Ahitofeli yazana bāzemera nk’izo bagīriwe n’Imana. Uko ni ko vyamera ku nama za Ahitofeli, uhereye kuri Dawidi ugashitsa kuri Abusalomu.
Hanyuma Ahitofeli abarira Abusalomu, ati Hinge ntoranye ingabo ibihumbi cumi na bibiri, mpaguruke nkurikire Dawidi mur’ iri joro nyene;
ndamusēsekeko akirushe, acihebuye, ndamuce ivutu; maz’ abantu bari kumwe na we bose baza guca bahunga, mpeze nice umwami wenyene.
Maze nzokugarukanira abantu bose; ushikiriye uwo urondera, bose uzoba ubagarukanye; ni ho abantu bose bazoca bagira umutekano.
Iyo nama Abusalomu arayishima cane, n’abakuru b’Abisirayeli na bo n’uko.
Maze Abusalomu aravuga, ati Mpamagarira Hushayi Umwaruki na we, twumve ico avuga.
Maze Hushayi arengutse kwa Abusalomu, Abusalomu aramubarira, ati Ahitofeli yatubgiye uku n’uku; none dukore uko yavuze? Ni waba utabishimye, zana inama yawe.
Hushayi yishura Abusalomu, at’ Ubu ho inama Ahitofeli yazanye si yo.
Kand’ at’ Urazi so n’ingabo ziwe kw ar’ abahizi, kandi baramaze kuraka nk’idubu isahuriwe abana mu gahinga. Bitayeko, so n’umuntu amenyereye ivy’ intambara, ntiyopfa kurāra mu ngabo.
Erega nk’ubu aramaze kwinyegeza mu rwobo cank’ ahandi; maze ni hagira abapfa bagitanguye kurwana, ūzovyumva wese azovuga, ati Habaye agatikizo mu bari kuri Abusalomu.
Bizotuma umuntu wese acika ivutu, naho yoba yar’ intōre afise umutima nk’uw’ intambge; kukw Abisirayeli bose basanzwe bazi so kw ar’ umuhizi, kandi n’abari kumwe na we kw ar’ abantu b’ intōre.
Ariko jewe inama yanje, koranya Abisirayeli bose, uhereye i Dani ugashitsa i Beri‐sheba, bangane n’umusenyi wo mw isēsero ry’ikiyaga, kandi nawe ubgawe uz’ ujane na bo mu ntambara.
Tuzomusēsekako ah’ azoba ari hose, tumutondeko nk’ ikime, nk’uko gitonda kw isi; nuk’ uhereye kuri we n’ingabo zose zizoba ziri kumwe na we, ntituzosiga n’uwa kirazira.
Na ho ni yaramuka ahungiye mu gisagara, Abisirayeli bose bazozana imigozi, dukwege ico gisagara tugicurangurize mu ruzi, gushitsa hatakiboneka n’akabuye na kamwe.

Nuko Abusalomu n’ abantu bose b’Abisirayeli baravuga, bat’ Inama ya Hushayi Umwaruki iruse inama ya Ahitofeli. Icabiteye n’uk’ Uhoraho yari yaragabiye gusambura izo nama nziza za Ahitofeli, kugira ngw ateze Abusalomu ivyago.
Maze Hushayi abarira Sadoki na Abiyatari abaherezi, at’ Inama Ahitofeli yagīriye Abusalomu n’ abakuru b’Abisirayeli n’iyi n’iyi; ariko jeho iyo nabagīriye, nababariye ntya na ntya.
None rero ni mutume kuri Dawidi vuba, mut’ Iri joro nturāre ku majabukiro afata mu bugaragwa, ariko ntihagire ikikubuza kujabuka; muti Kugira ngo ntibakumirane n’abantu bose muri kumwe, mugenzi.
Kandi Yonatani na Ahimasi bāri babaye barīkinga i Eni‐rogeli, umuguranokazi akāma aja kubacira agace, na bo bakaja kubibgira umwami Dawidi; kuko batātinyuka gushika ku murwa icese.
Arik’ umwana w’umuhungu arababona, aragenda abibarira Abusalomu; na bo baragenda bihuta bompi, bashika i Bahurimu ku muntu yar’ afise icobo cimbge mu rugo rwiwe co kubīka amazi, bururukirayo.
Maz’ umugore ahitana ikinyambuga, agisasa hejuru ku munwa w’ico cobo, agisanzakw impeke, ntihagira ūbica n’ikanda.
Maz’ abantu ba Abusalomu bashikīra nya mugore mu rugo, baramubaza, bati Ahimasi na Yonatani bari hehe? Nya mugore arabishura, ati Bafashe hakurya. Nuko babarondeye, barababura, basubira i Yerusalemu.
Bamaze kugenda, ba bandi barūrira basokoroka mur’ ico cobo, baragenda babibarira umwami Dawidi; baramubarira, bati Ni muhaguruke mujabuke n’ingoga, kuko Ahitofeli yabagīriye inama izi n’izi.
Nuko Dawidi ahagurukana n’abantu bose bari kumwe na we, bajabuka Yorodani; bgakeye hadasigaye n’ umwe muri bo atājabutse Yorodani.

Ariko Ahitofeli abonye ko batemeye inama yiwe, ashira amatandiko ku ndogoba yiwe, afata inzira ataha i muhira mu gisagara c’i wabo; araheza aroranya ivyo mu rugo rwiwe, aca yiha umugozi. Nukw arapfa, bamuhamba mu mva ya se.
Maze Dawidi ashika i Mahanayimu; Abusalomu na we ajabuka Yorodani, ari kumwe n’ Abisirayeli bose.

Kandi Abusalomu yari yagize Amasa umugabisha w’ingabo mu gishingo ca Yowabu. Kandi Amasa uwo yari mwene Yitura, umuntu w’Umwishimayeli; uyo Yitura yari yaratahiye Abigayili mwene Nahashi, Abigayili mwene nyina wa Seruwiya, Seruwiya nyina wa Yowabu.
Maze Abusalomu n’Abisirayeli basagaza mu gihugu c’i Gileyadi.
Nuko Dawidi ashitse i Mahanayimu, Shobi mwene Nahashi w’i Raba mu Bamoni, na Makiri mwene Amiyeli w’i Lo‐debari, na Baruzilayi Umunyagileyadi w’i Rogelimu,
bamuzanira amariri, n’amabakule, n’inzavya z’ibibumbano; n’ingano, na sayiri, n’ifu, n’impeke zikaranze, n’ibiharage, n’inkore,
n’ubūki, n’urubu, n’ intama, n’umukānyūre w’amavuta y’inka, babigemurira Dawidi n’ abo bari kumwe; kuko bari biyumviriye, bat’ Abantu barashonje kandi bararushe, bafise inyota aho bari mu bugaragwa.
Maze Dawidi aharūra ingabo zari kumwe na we, ashirah’ abagaba igihumbi‐igihumbi n’abagaba ijana‐ijana.

Dawidi araheza agabanya ingabo mu mice itatu, umuce umwe awuha Yowabu, uwundi awuha Abishayi umwana wa Seruwiya, murumuna wa Yowabu, uwundi awuha Itayi Umunyegati. Maz’ umwami abarira ingabo, ati Nanje ubganje turatabarana.

Ingabo ziramuhakanira, bat’ Eka ntiwojana natwe; kuko naho tworamuka duhunze, ntibobibabara, canke hapfuye kimwe ca kabiri cacu, na ho nyene ntibibishirak’ umutima; ariko wewe urengeye abantu ibihumbi cumi bo muri twebge. Icoba ciza n’uko wokwitegura kudutabara uvuye mu gisagara.
Umwami arabishura, at’ Ico mushima ni co nemera. Nuk’ umwami ahagarara kw irembo ry’ igisagara, ingabo zose zirarēngāna, uko zār’ ijana‐ijana n’igihumbi‐igihumbi.
Maz’ umwami agera Yowabu na Abishayi na Itayi, arababarira, ati Muze mundindire uwo muhungu Abusalomu, mumubungabunge. Kand’ ingabo zose zarumva, ah’ umwami yagera abo bagabisha bose ivya Abusalomu.
Nukw izo ngabo zija gutegera Abisirayeli mu gahinga; urugamba rurumanira mu kibira c’i Bgefurayimu.
Abisirayeli baneshwa n’abantu ba Dawidi; uwo musi haba agatikizo gakomeye, hapfa ibihumbi mirongwibiri,
kukw intambara yar’ ikwiye hose mur’ ico gihugu. Uwo musi ikibira kimira abantu benshi kuruta abishwe n’inkota.

Maze Abusalomu ahubirana n’ abantu ba Dawidi, kandi yari ku nyumbu yiwe; maz’ iyo nyumbu imucāna musi y’igiti c’umweloni c’inganzamarumpu c’amashami y’ inzitane, umutwe wiwe ufatwa n’ ayo mashami, asigara yenena mu kirēre; inyumbu yagenderako na yo irakomeza iragenda.
Maz’ umuntu arabibona, abibgira Yowabu, at’ Erega nabonye Abusalomu yenena ku giti c’umweloni.
Yowabu abaza uwo muntu amubariye, ati Non’ uramubona uraheza ntiwamutsinda aho nyene ng’ umutūre hasi? Ko mba nkugororeye intete cumi z’ifeza bo n’ umukanda.

Uwo muntu yishura Yowabu, ati Naho nari guhabga amafeza igihumbi mu ntoke, sinari gukoza ukuboko ku mwana w’umwami; kukw ah’ umwami yabīhanikiriza mwe na Abishayi na Itayi, ati Mwirinde ntihaze hagire ūkora kur’ uwo muhungu Abusalomu, natwe twavyumva.
Non’ iyaba nārikoze nkayoba, umwami ntiyari kubura kuvyumva, nawe ukabintāna.
Yowabu aramwishura, ati Nta co nirirwa ndasyogoranya nawe. Araheza ajana amakobero atatu, ayamutobekeranya mu mutima, ar’ aho nyene mu mweloni akibona.
Maz’ imisore cumi yatwaza Yowabu ibirwanishwa, ica Abusalomu irya n’ino, iramuhohosha, arapfa.
Yowabu araheza avuza inzamba, ingabo zirahindukira, zireka gukurikira Abisirayeli, kuko Yowabu azibujije.
Nuko bajana ikiziga ciwe, bagishiburira mu rwobo runini rwar’ aho mu kibira, bakirundakw ikirundo c’amabuye kinini cane; nukw Abisirayeli bose baratemesha, umuntu wese ahungira i we.

Kandi Abusalomu akiriho yari yarābiriye inkingi y’ibuye, ayishinga mu mwonga w’umwami, kuko yari yaravuze, ati Nta mwana w’umuhungu ngira, ngo baze bamunyibukireko, izina ryanje ntirizimangane; ni kwo kwitiranya iyo nkingi izina ryiwe. Nuko yitwa inkingi y’ icibutso ca Abusalomu na bugingo n’ubu.
Maze Ahimasi mwene Sadoki aravuga, ati Ndeka niruke mbarire umwami inkuru z’ingen’ Uhoraho yashubirije abansi biwe mu nkōko.
Yowabu aramwishura, at’ Eka nta nkuru ujana uyu musi: uzoba urazijana ikindi gihe; arik’ uyu musi nta zo uja kuvuga, kuk’ umwana w’umwami yapfuye.
Yowabu araheza abarira Umunyekushi, ati Genda ubarire umwami ivyo wabonye. Nuk’ uwo Munyekushi yunamira Yowabu, aca arijura aragenda.

Maze Ahimasi mwene Sadoki arongera abarira Yowabu, at’ Eka naho vyabaye birtyo, ndakwinginze undekure nanje mpfe kugenda, nkurikire uwo Munyekushi. Yowabu aramwishura, ati Wirukanwa n’iki ga mwana wanje, kw ata mpēra y’izo nkuru uja guhabga?
Uwundi ati Naho bimeze birtyo, mpfuye kwiruka. Yowabu ati Nuko ni wiruke. Nuko Ahimasi ariruka, ajana inzira ica mu kiyaya, aja gutanga wa Munyekushi.
Kandi Dawidi yar’ avyagiye hagati y’amarembo abiri; maz’ inderetsi yūrira hejuru kw irembo ahahereranye n’uruzitiro rw’amabuye; atereje amaso, abona umuntu yiruka ari wenyene.
Iyo nderetsi ishira ijwi hejuru, ibibgira umwami. Umwami aravuga, ati Ni yaba ari wenyene, har’ inkuru aje kuvuga. Nukw akomeza kubandanya aza.
Maz’ iyo nderetsi ibona uwundi muntu yiruka. Ihamagara umushibamyi, it’ Eh’ uwundi muntu yiruka ari wenyene. Umwami aravuga, ati Na we nyene azanye inkuru.
Iyo nderetsi iravuga, it’ Umenga uw’ imbere yiruka nka Ahimasi mwene Sadoki. Umwami aravuga, ati N’umuntu ameze neza; azoba azanye inkuru nziza.

Maze Ahimasi ashira ijwi hejuru, abarira umwami, ati Vyose vyagenze neza. Araheza akubita inkoro hasi imbere y’umwami, aramubarira, at’ Uhoraho Imana yawe ahimbazwe, yaguhaye abantu bari bakubanguriye amaboko, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma.
Umwami aramubaza, ati Wa muhungu Abusalomu ar’ amahoro? Ahimasi aramwishura, at’ Aho Yowabu yantuma, jewe umusavyi wawe, nabonye agahōgo kenshi, ariko sinamenye ivy’ ari vyo.
Umwami aramubarira, ati Rēngāna uhagarare hano. Nukw ararēngāna, arahagarara.
Wa Munyekushi aca ashika ubgo nyene, aravuga, ati Nkuzaniye inkuru, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma. Uyu musi Uhoraho yashubirije mu nkōko abāri baguhagurukiye bose.

Umwami abaza uwo Munyekushi, ati Wa muhungu Abusalomu ar’ amahoro? Uwo Munyekushi aramwishura, at’ Abansi bawe n’ aboguhagurukira kukugirira nabi bose, barakaba nk’uk’ uwo muhungu yabaye, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma!

Umwami avyumvise, inkonko irakoroka, yūrira mu cumba cubatswe hejuru kw irembo, arira; akirikw aragenda aravuga, ati Yō! Mwananje Abusalomu! Es’ umwananje! Ewe mwananje Abusalomu! Iyo mpfuma ari jewe mpfa mu gishingo cawe, ewe Abusalomu mwana wanje, mwana wanje we!
Hanyuma babarira Yowabu, bat’ Ereg’ umwami arikw araririra Abusalomu, amuborogera.
Uwo musi umunezero w’ uko banesheje uhinduka umubabaro mu bantu bose; kuko bari bumvise ng’ Umwami atuntujwe n’umwana wiwe.
Maz’ uwo musi ingabo zigenda zomba mu kugaruka mu gisagara, nk’ukw abahunze mu ntambara bagenda bomba bafise isoni.
Kand’ umwami yari yitwikiriye mu maso, avuza induru, ati Yō! Mwananje Abusalomu! Ewe Abusalomu, mwana wanje, mwana wanje we!

Maze Yowabu yinjira mu nzu ah’ umwami ari, aramubarira, at’ Uyu musi utētereje abantu bawe bose, kand’ ari bo bakijije amagara yawe uyu musi nyene, n’ay’ abahungu bawe n’abakobga bawe, n’ay’ abamikazi bawe n’abagore bawe b’incoreke,

kuk’ ukunze abakwanse, ukanka abagukunda; ereg’ uyu musi werekanye yukw abagabisha n’abasavyi ari nk’ ubusa kuri wewe; ubu ndamenye yuko Abusalomu iyaba akiriho, tukaba ari twebge twapfuye twese uyu musi, ni vyo uba washimye.

Nuko none n’uhaguruke, usohoke, ucūrire amajambo abasavyi bawe yo kubahūmuriza; ntanze Uhoraho kw indahiro, n’utāsohoka, nta muntu n’umwe aza gusigara kuri wewe mur’ iri joro. Kand’ ivyo bizokubera nabi kuruta ivyago wakabonye vyose, uhereye mu buto bgawe gushitsa n’ ubu.

Nuk’ umwami aca arahaguruka, aja kuvyagira ku kirimba. Maze babarira abantu bose, bat’ Ereg’ umwami avyagiye ku kirimba. Nukw abantu bose baza kumushengerera. Kand’ Abisirayeli bose bari barashwiragiye, umuntu wese aja i we.
Abantu bose bo mu miryango yose y’Abisirayeli baritonganya, bat’ Umwami ni we yahora aturokora, adukūra mu maboko y’abansi bacu, no mu y’Abafilisitiya; none rero yarahunze Abusalomu, ava mu gihugu.
Kandi Abusalomu na we, uwo twari twimikishije amavuta ngw atuganze, yaguye mu ntambara. None rero ko mutavuga ivyo kugarukana umwami?

Bukeye umwami Dawidi atuma kuri Sadoki na Abiyatari abaherezi, uti Ni mubaze abakuru b’ Abayuda, muti N’iki gituma ari mwebge mugiye guherukira abandi kugarukana umwami i we? Muti Kukw inama y’Abisirayeli bose yo kumugarukana i we yamaze kumushikīra.
Muti Kw ari mwebge musangiye umuryango, mukaba akara kamwe n’amaraso amwe, none n’iki gituma ari mwebge mugiye guherukira abandi kumugarukana?
Uti Kandi mumubarize na Amasa, muti Mbega nawe ntimur’ akara kamwe n’amaraso amwe? Mut’ Imana ize ibimuhanire, kandi birushirije, n’atākugira umugabisha w’ingabo ziwe na ntaryo mu gishingo ca Yowabu.
Nuk’ umwami agonda imitima y’Abayuda bose nk’ uw’ umuntu umwe; baca bamutumako ngw agaruke bo n’abantu biwe bose.
Nuk’ umwami asubirayo, ashika kuri Yorodani; maz’ Abayuda baja i Gilugali ngo basanganire umwami, bamujabutse Yorodani.
Maze Shimeyi mwene Gera Umubenyamini w’i Bahurimu, na we arabandanya, amanukana n’abo Bayuda gusanganira umwami Dawidi,

kandi yari kumwe n’ abantu igihumbi b’Ababenyamini nyene. Kandi Ziba, umwe nyene yamye ar’ umusavyi wa Sauli n’ inzu yiwe, arindimuka kuri Yorodani ari kumwe n’abahungu biwe ukw ar’ icumi na batanu n’abantu biwe ukw ari mirongwibiri, umwami abarorēra,
bajabuka icambu kugira ngo bajabutse abo mu rugo rw’umwami, bamukorere n’ivyo agomba. Maz’ umwami agira ngw ajabuke Yorodani, Shimeyi mwene Gera yikubita hasi imbere yiwe.
Abarira umwami, ati Mugenzi, ntumparūrekw ibigabitanyo, canke ngo wibuke ivy’ ubuyobe nakoze, jewe umusavyi wawe, wa musi wava i Yerusalemu, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma, ng’ unabishirek’ umutima;
kuko jewe umusavyi wawe ndazi ko nacumuye; ni co gitumye uyu musi mbaye uw’intangamarāra mu muryango wa Yosefu wose kumanuka kugusanganira, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma.
Ariko Abishayi umwana wa Seruwiya aravuga, ati None Shimeyi ntakwiye gupfa, ko yatutse uwo Uhoraho yimikishije amavuta?
Dawidi aravuga, ati Dusangiye iki ga yemwe bana ba Seruwiya, uyu musi ko mumbereye abarwanizi? Har’ uwokwicwa uyu musi mu Bisirayeli? Non’ ubu na ho simmaze kumenya ko nd’ umwami w’Abisirayeli?
Umwami abarira Shimeyi, at’ Eka ntupfa. Araheza arabimurahira.

Na Mefibosheti umwuzukuru wa Sauli aramanuka, aza gusanganira umwami; uhereye umusi umwami yagīriye, ugashitsa umusi yagarukiye i we amahoro, ntiyongeye kwiyoga ibirenge, canke ngw aringanize ubganwa, canke ngw amesure impuzu.
Nukw avuye i Yerusalemu gusanganira umwami, umwami aramubaza, ati Mbega n’iki cākubujije kujana nanje ga Mefibosheti?

Aramwishura, at’ Ereg’ umuntu wanje yarampenze, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma; kuko jewe umusavyi wawe namubgiye ngw anshirire amatandiko ku ndogoba kugira ngo ndayigendereko njane nawe, mugenzi, kuko jewe umusavyi wawe nd’ikimuga.
Hanyuma aza kukumbesherako, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma; ariko rero mugenzi, umeze nk’umumarayika w’ Imana; nuko n’ukore ico ugomba;
kukw abo mu rugo rwa data twese imbere yawe twār’ abo gupfa gusa; uraheza jewe umusavyi wawe unshira mu barīra ku meza yawe. None har’ ikindi novuga ngo ngutakambire ga mugenzi?
Umwami aramwishura, ati N’iki gituma ushishikara kuzana amajambo y’ivyawe? Namaze kubiheza: mwe na Ziba ni mugende mugabure iryo tongo.
Mefibosheti yishura umwami, ati Ni yagomba n’atware ryose; kizima ugarutse amahoro mu rugo rwawe, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma.
Na Baruzilayi Umunyagileyadi ava i Rogelimu aramanuka, ngw aje kujabukana n’umwami Yorodani, ngw amugeze hakurya.
Baruzilayi uwo yar’ umutāma ashaje cane, yar’ amaze imyaka mirongumunani, kandi ni we yagemuriye umwami aho yar’ i Mahanayimu, kuko yar’ umuntu w’umutunzi cane.
Maz’ umwami abarira Baruzilayi, ati Ngwino tujabukane, nanje nzokumarira vyose dushitse i wanje i Yerusalemu.
Ariko Baruzilayi yishura umwami, ati Mbeg’ ugira ngo nshigaje imyaka ingana iki, yotuma ndūgana nawe i Yerusalemu ga mugenzi?

Ubu ko mmaze imyaka mirongumunani y’amavuka, ndacamenya ibiryoshe n’ibibishe? Jewe umusavyi wawe ubona nkiryoherwa n’ivyo ndya n’ivyo nnywa? Ndacashobora kwumva amajwi y’abaririmvyi, ar’abagabo ar’abagore? Non’ icotuma jewe umusavyi wawe nja kukugora n’iki, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma?
Ereg’ icari kinzanye kwar’ ukukujabutsa Yorodani gusa, nkakwigiza imbere, mugenzi; non’ ico ni co cotuma urinda kumpa ingororano ingana irtyo ga mwami?

Ntunga nisubirire mu gisagara c’i wacu, jewe umusavyi wawe, abe ari ho nzogwa, ah’ imva ya data na mama iri. Ariko nguyo Kimuhamu umusavyi wawe; abe ari we ajabukana nawe, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma; uz’ umukoreshe ico ugomba.
Umwami aramwishura, ati Nuko Kimuhamu n’ahogi tujabukane, kandi nzomugirira uk’ ugomba; kand’ ic’ uzongombako cose nzokigukorera.
Nukw abantu bose bajabuka Yorodani; n’umwami na we arajabuka. Maz’ umwami agumbira Baruzilayi, aramuhezagira; aca yisubirira i we.
Uko ni k’umwami yajabutse ashikira i Gilugali, na Kimuhamu ajabukana na we, n’Abayuda bose n’igice ca kabiri c’Abisirayeli bamuherekeje.

Bukeye Abisirayeli bose bashengerera umwami Dawidi, baramubaza, bati Mugenzi, n’iki gitumye bene wacu b’Abayuda bakuzana nk’abakutwiba, bakakujabutsa Yorodani bo n’abo mu rugo rwawe n’ingabo zawe zose?
Abayuda bose baca bishura Abisirayeli, bati N’uk’ umwami ari twebge dufitaniye akamwe ko hafi. Non’ ivyo ni vyo bibaratsa? Har’ ico yatugaburiye tukabacura? Canke yoba yatugabiye?

Abisirayeli bishura Abayuda, bat’ Umwami tumufiseko hanini ibihetangabo cumi; kubg’ ivyo Dawidi n’uwacu kuruta mwebge. None n’iki catumye mudukēngēra, kand’ ari twebge twabatanze kugira inama yo kugarukana umwami wacu? Arikw Abayuda mu magambo yabo bāri bakarātiye kuruta Abisirayeli.

Hār’ umuntu w’umugesera yitwa Sheba, mwene Bikuri Umubenyamini; aca avuza inzamba, aravuga, ati Dawidi nta co tumwegako, nta mugabane dufise kuri mwene Isayi: yemwe Bisirayeli, hogi twitahire, umuntu wese aje i muhira!
Nukw Abisirayeli bose bata Dawidi, bakondorera inyuma ya Sheba mwene Bikuri; arikw Abayuda bo bigumira ku mwami wabo, baramuherekeza kuva kuri Yorodani gushitsa i Yerusalemu.

Nuk’ umwami Dawidi ashitse i we i Yerusalemu, ajana za ncoreke ziwe yagize abagore ukw ar’ icumi, abo yari yasigaranye urugo; abashira mu nzu, abaha ababarinda; abatungiraho, ariko ntiyasubira kubarārira. Nuko baguma ngaho barindwa, barinda bapfa bameze nk’abapfakazi.
Maz’ umwami abarira Amasa, ati Nkoraniriza Abayuda hano mu misi itatu itarenze, kandi nawe uz’ ubeho.
Nuko Amasa aja guhamagara Abayuda; arikw arenza imisi umwami yamubariye.

Dawidi araheza abarira Abishayi, ati Sheba mwene Bikuri agiye kutugirira nabi kuruta Abusalomu; abe ari wewe ujana ingabo zanje, umukurikirane, kugira ngo ntiyegukire ibisagara vyubakiwe inzitiro z’amabuye, akaba atujanye.
Nukw ingabo za Yowabu n’ Abakereti n’Abapeleti n’abahizi bose bakurikira Abishayi; bava i Yerusalemu baja guhīga Sheba mwene Bikuri.

Bashitse ku gitandara kinini c’i Gibeyoni, Amasa aza kubasanganira; kandi Yowabu yari yambaye imyambaro y’intambara, ayikenyeje umukanda urikw inkota iri mu rwubati, yenena kw itako ryiwe; yīgīye imbere, iruvamw’ irakoroka.
Yowabu abarira Amasa, ati N’amahoro ga ncuti? Yowabu araheza afatisha Amasa ukuboko kw’i buryo ku rusakanwa nk’ ūgira amusome.

Ariko Amasa ntiyagira ico yibaza ku nkota Yowabu yar’ afise mu ntoke; nuko Yowabu ayimuzibura ku nda, amara yiwe asēseka hasi, ntiyarinda kugereka ubga kabiri; nukw arapfa. Maze Yowabu na Abishayi murumuna we bakomeza guhīga Sheba mwene Bikuri.
Umwe mu ngabo za Yowabu ahagarara hejuru ya Amasa, aravuga, at’ Ūkunda Yowabu, kand’ ūherereye ku ruhande rwa Dawidi, n’ akurikire Yowabu.

Kandi Amasa yari hagati mu nzira arambaraye mu maraso yiwe, arikw arasāmba; maz’ uwo muntu abonye kw abantu bose bahashika bakarundana, aterura Amasa, amukūra mu nzira, amurambika hirya mu murima, amworosa impuzu; kuko yabonye k’uwamushikako wese yaca ahagarara.
Nukw amaze gukūrwa mu nzira, abantu bose baca bakomeza inzira bakurikira Yowabu, baja guhīga Sheba mwene Bikuri.
Sheba anyuragira mu miryango yose y’Abisirayeli, ashika i Abeli h’i Beti‐mayaka; maz’ Ababeriti bose barakorakorana, bamukurikirayo.

Maz’ ingabo zose zari kuri Yowabu ziraza, zimusāgiririza i Abeli nyene h’i Beti‐mayaka, barunda ikirundo kur’ ico gisagara co kwūririrako, cegamiye uruzitiro rwaco; basita urwo ruzitiro kugira ngo baruhomvore.
Maz’ umugore w’umunyabgenge wo mur’ ico gisagara ashira ijwi hejuru, aravuga, ati Ni mwumvirize, yemwe ni mwumvirize! Ndabinginze, mumbaririre Yowabu, mut’ Igira hino, ico akubarira.
Nuko yigira hafi y’ah’ ari; nya mugore aramubaza, ati Ni wewe Yowabu? Na we at’ Ego me ni jewe. Aramubarira, ati Ni wumve amajambo yanje, jewe incoreke yawe; na we at’ Ego me ndumva.
Aravuga, ati Kera bākunda kuvuga, bati Ni bagīshe inama i Abeli; kandi rero vyaca bihera.
Jewe nd’umwe mu bakunda ivy’ amahoro kandi b’abizigirwa mu Bisirayeli; ariko wewe urondera kugeseza igisagara, ari co muvyeyi mu Bisirayeli. N’iki gituma ugomba kuyongobeza ishamvu y’Uhoraho?
Yowabu aramwishura, ati Biragahera! Biragahera ko hogira ico noyongobeza canke nogeseza!

Si ko biri; ariko harih’ umuntu wo mu mugamba w’Abefurayimu yitwa Sheba mwene Bikuri, yagararije umwami Dawidi; mube ari we mutanga wenyene, mbone kubavira ku gisagara. Nya mugore yishura Yowabu, ati Nuko rero, umutwe wiwe turawurenza uruzitiro tuwugushiburire.

Maz’ uwo mugore aja mu bantu bose ajanye inama y’ubgenge; na bo baragenda baca izosi Sheba mwene Bikuri, bashiburira Yowabu umutwe wiwe. Na we araheza avuza inzamba, abantu bose bava ku gisagara, baratandukana, umuntu wese ataha i we. Yowabu na we atabarukira i Yerusalemu i bgami.
Kandi Yowabu yar’ umugabisha w’ingabo zose z’Abisirayeli; Benaya mwene Yehoyada ni we yagabisha Abakereti n’Abapeleti;
Adoramu na we yagaba ivy’ ikori; Yehoshafati mwene Ahiludi ni we yar’ umwanditsi w’ivyaja biraba;
Shewa yar’ umukarani; Sadoki na Abiyatari ni bo bār’ abaherezi;
Ira w’Umuyayiri na we yar’ umujenama mukuru wa Dawidi.
Ku ngoma ya Dawidi hatera inzara, imara imyaka itatu ikurikiranye; maze Dawidi aja kubisiguza Uhoraho. Uhoraho arishura, ati Vyātewe n’ubgicanyi bga Sauli n’inzu yiwe, kuko yishe ab’i Gibeyoni.

Maz’ umwami ahamagaza ab’i Gibeyoni, arabibabgira. (Kand’ ab’i Gibeyoni ntibār’ abo mu Bisirayeli, ariko bār’ abandurutse ku masigarira y’ Abamori; kandi nah’ Abisirayeli bari barasezeranye na bo kubareka, ariko Sauli yari yagomvye kubahonnya, abitewe n’ishaka yagirira Abisirayeli n’Abayuda.)
Nuko Dawidi abaza ab’i Gibeyoni, ati Nobakorera iki? Notanga impongano ki, kugira ngo mubone gusabira ishamvu y’Uhoraho umugisha?
Ab’i Gibeyoni baramwishura, bat’ Ico tugomba kuri Sauli n’ab’ inzu yiwe s’ifeza cank’ izahabu, kandi mu Bisirayeli nta muntu n’umwe tugomba kwica. Na we aravuga, at’ Ico muvuga ni co mbakorera.
Babgira umwami, bat’ Umuntu yaturanduye, akaturonderera inama yo kutugeseza, kugira ngo ntitugire uburagamo mu gihugu cose c’ Abisirayeli,
ni muduhe abantu ndwi mu bahungu biwe, tubamanike imbere y’Uhoraho i Gibeya, ahāri kwa Sauli uwo Uhoraho yatoranije. Umwami arabishura, ati Nzobabaha.
Arik’ umwami Dawidi arēngāna Mefibosheti mwene Yonatani umwuzukuru wa Sauli, kubg’ indahiro bārahiriye imbere y’ Uhoraho, bo na Yonatani nyene, mwene Sauli.

Nuk’ umwami afata abahungu babiri ba Risipa umukobga wa Aya, yavyaranye na Sauli, Arumoni na Mefibosheti, bo n’abahungu batanu ba Merabu umukobga wa Sauli, yavyaranye na Aduriyeli mwene Baruzilayi Umumeholati;
abagabura mu maboko y’ab’i Gibeyoni; babamanika ku musozi imbere y’ Uhoraho; bose ukw ar indwi bagwa hamwe, bicwa mw ishuza ry’ igenya, batanguye kugenya sayiri.

Maze Risipa umukobga wa Aya ahitana amagunira, ayīsasira ku gitandara, ahēra mw ishuza ry’ igenya, ashitsa ku mutasuro, imvura iguye kur’ iyo mivyimba; ku murango ntiyakundira ibisīga vyo mu kirēre ko biyigwako, canke mw ijoro kw ibikōko vyo mw ishamba biyēgēra.
Maze babarira Dawidi ivyo Risipa yakoze, umukobga wa Aya, incoreke Sauli yari yaragize umugore.

Dawidi araheza aragenda yaka abantu b’i Yabeshi‐gileyadi amagufa ya Sauli n’aya Yonatani umuhungu wiwe, ayo bāri bārīvye mu kibuga c’i Beti‐shani, ah’ Abafilisitiya bari barayamanitse, kuri wa musi bātsinda Sauli i Gilibowa.
Akūray’ ayo magufa yabo, maze bakoranya n’amagufa ya ba bandi bamanitswe.

Nuko bahamba ayo magufa ya Sauli na Yonatani umuhungu wiwe i Sela mu gihugu c’Ababenyamini, mu mva ya Kishi se wa Sauli; nuko bashitsa ivy’ umwami yababariye vyose. Hanyuma y’ivyo Imana ibona guhangaza ico gihugu.
Bukeye Abafilisitiya bongera gutera Abisirayeli. Dawidi amanukana n’ingabo ziwe, arwanya Abafilisitiya; arateba araruha.
Maze Ishubi‐benobu, umwe wo mu bana b’Abarefa, yagomba kwica Dawidi; kand’ icumu ryiwe ryar’ iry’ umuringa ririvye shekeli amajana atatu, yari yambaye n’inkota nsha.

Ariko Abishayi umwana wa Seruwiya aramutabara, asogota uwo Mufilisitiya, aramwica. Maz’ abantu ba Dawidi baramurahira, bati Ntuzosubira na mba kujana natwe mu ntambara, ntuz’ uhave uzimya itara ry’Abisirayeli.
Hanyuma y’ivyo hongera kuba intambara yo kurwana n’Abafilisitiya i Goba. Sibekayi Umuhushati yica Safu, umwe wo mu Barefa.

Maze hasubira kuba iyindi ntambara yo kurwana n’ Abafilisitiya aho nyene i Goba. Eluhanani mwene Yare‐oregimu w’i Betelehemu yica Goliyati Umunyegati, uruti rw’icumu ryiwe rwangana n’umwaro ujishirwakw impuzu.

Bukeye hongera kuba intambara i Gati, kandi hariy’ umuntu muremure w’ikigambati, yar’ afise indegeya ku ntoke no ku mano: intoke n’amano vyose na vyose vyari mirongwibiri na bine; kandi na we yar’ umwe wo mu Barefa.
Maz’ acokoye Abisirayeli, Yonatani mwene Shimeyi, umuhungwabo wa Dawidi, aramwica.
Abo bose ukw ari bane bar’ abo mu Barefa b’i Gati; bicwa na Dawidi n’abantu biwe.
Dawidi yabariye Uhoraho amajambo yo mur’ iyi ndirimbo, umusi Uhoraho yamurokoye, akamukūra mu maboko y’ abansi biwe bose, no mu ya Sauli.
Aravuga, at’ Uhoraho n’igitandara canje, n’ubuhungiro bganje, n’umurokozi wanje,
N’Imana igitandara canje; ni we nzohungirako. Ni we nkinzo yanje, n’ihembe ry’agakiza kanje, n’ umunara wanje wo guhungiramwo, n’ubgugamo bganje; Ni wewe Mukiza wanje, unkiza umuryano w’abantu.
Ndambaza Uhoraho abereye gushimwa: Ni ho nzokizwa abansi banje.
Imipfunda y’urupfu yaranyizingiriyeko, Isūri zo kurandura zanteye ubgoba.
Ingoyi z’i kuzimu zantaye hagati, Imitego y’urupfu yantanze imbere.
Mu mubabaro wanje nambaje Uhoraho, Mbere natakambiye Imana yanje; Yumva ijwi ryanje iri mu ngoro yayo, Ivyo natakamvye biyishika mu matwi.
Maz’ isi iratigita, ihinda agashitsi, Amatanguriro y’ijuru aranyiganyiga, Atigitishwa n’uburake bgayo.
Umwotsi upfunduka mu mazuru yayo, Umuriro uva mu kanwa kayo, urayigiza, Amakara afatishwa na wo.
Yandaza ijuru, na yo nyene iramanuka, Umwiza w’umuzitanya wari musi y’ibirenge vyayo.
Iguruka ivyagiye ku mukerubi, Mbere yabonetse igendera ku mababa y’umuyaga.
Umwiza iwugira ihema riyisāgiriye; Isāgīrwa n’ibicu bibungenze amazi, ibicu bitwaye intunda vyo mw ijuru.
Ubgiza bukayangana bur’ imbere yayo Butuma amakara yaka.
Uhoraho aturagara ari mw ijuru, Ūsumba vyose avugisha ijwi ryiwe.
Arasa imyampi yiwe, ashwiragiza abansi banje, Arekura imiravyo, abaca umuhongo.
Maz’ agataka ko musi y’ikiyaga karaboneka, Amatanguriro y’isi aratwikururwa, Bitewe n’uguhana kw’Uhoraho, N’ugufūha kw’impwemu ziva mu mazuru yiwe.
Atuma ukuboko ari hejuru, aramfata, Andoba mu mazi menshi.
Ankiza umwansi wanje akomeye, N’abanyanka, kuko bandusha inkomezi.
Bari bantanze imbere ku musi w’amagorwa yanje, Arik’ Uhoraho ni we yambereye ubgishimikizo.
Abinkūramwo, anshira ahantu hāgutse: Yandokoye kuko namuhimbaye.
Uhoraho yangereye ibikwiranye n’ukugororoka kwanje, Nk’ukw amaboko yanje atanduye, ni ko yangiriye.
Kuko nitondeye inzira z’ Uhoraho, Kandi sinakoze icaha co kureka Imana yanje:
Kukw amateka yayo yose yar’ imbere yanje, Kandi sinatirimutse ngo mve mu vyagezwe vyayo.
Narayitunganira, Nirinze ukugabitanya kwanje.
Ni co catumye Uhoraho anyishura ibikwiranye n’ukugororoka kwanje, Ibikwiranye n’ukutandura kwanje mu nyonga ziwe.
Ku munyembabazi uzokwiyerekana ur’ umunyembabazi; K’ūtunganye uzokwiyerekana ur’ ūtunganye;
K’ūtanduye uzokwiyerekana ur’ ūtanduye; Ku ntabarirwa uzokwiyerekana ur’ ūdadika.
Abacishijwe bugufi uzobakiza, Arikw igitsure cawe kiri ku bībone, kugira ng’ ubasubize hasi.
Kukw ari wewe tara ryanje, Uhoraho; Uhoraho ni we yākira umwiza wanje.
Kukw ari wewe unshoboza gutera umuce w’ingabo, Kand’ ar’ Imana yanje inshoboza gusimba uruzitiro rw’ amabuye.
Imana yo, inzira yayo iratunganye rwose, Ijambo ry’Uhoraho ryaravugutiwe: Ni we nkinzo ikīngīra abamuhungirako bose.
Ni nde Mana, atar’ Uhoraho? Ni nde Gitandara, atar’ Imana yacu?
Imana ni yo buhungiro bganje bukomeye; Irōngōra umugororotsi mu nzira yayo.
Ni yo ihindura ibirenge vyanje nk’ivy’ impongokazi, Impagarika ku dutwe tw’ imisozi yanje.
Yigisha intoke zanje kurasana, Bituma amaboko yanje afora umuheto w’umuringa.
Kandi wampaye inkinzo, ni yo gakiza kawe, Ukwicisha bugufi kwawe kwanshize hejuru.
Intambuko zanje wazāguriye inzira, Ibirenge vyanje ntivyanyereye.
Nakinagije abansi banje, ndabarandura, Sinatabaruka badaheze.
Narabatobekeranije, ntibābasha kuvyuka; Mbere bāguye musi y’ibirenge vyanje.
Wankenyeje inkomezi ngo ndwane, Abarwanizi banje wabamaze igabo.
Watumye ababisha banje bampa ibitugu, Kugira ngo ndandure abanyanka.
Bārēraguje, babura ūbakiza; Batakambiye Uhoraho, ntiyabishura.
Maze ndabasya, bacika nk’ umukungugu wo kw isi, Ndabasiribanga nk’umwavu wo ku nzira, ndabashwiragiza.
Wankijije indwano z’abantu banje, Waranzigamye ngo nganze amahanga; Ihanga ntigeze kumenya ryaransavye.
Abanyamahanga baje banyunamira bampema; Bumvise inkuru yanje baca baranyoboka.
Abanyamahanga barakabiranye, Bava mu binyegero vyabo bahinda agashitsi.
Uhoraho yamaho; Igitandara canje gihimbazwe; Imana, Igitandara c’agakiza kanje, ishirwe hejuru:
Ni yo Mana impōra, Ikangandūrira amahanga nkayaganza.
Inkūra mu babisha banje: Mber’ unshira hejuru y’abampagurukira, Unkiza n’umuntu w’ikirara.
Ni co gituma, Uhoraho, nzogushimira mu mahanga, Ndirimbe ishimwe ry’izina ryawe.
Umwami yimitse amugabira agakiza gakomeye, Agirira imbabazi umwami yimikishije amavuta, Ni Dawidi n’uruvyaro rwiwe ibihe bidashira.
Aya ni yo majambo ya Dawidi aheruka: At’ Uku ni ko Dawidi mwene Isayi avuga, Ni k’uwashizwe hejuru avuga, Uwo Imana ya Yakobo yimikishije amavuta, Umuririmvyi w’umuhinga w’ Abisirayeli;
Ati Mpwemu w’Uhoraho yavugiye muri jewe, Ijambo ryiwe ryari ku rurimi rwanje.
Imana y’Abisirayeli yaravuze, Igitandara c’Abisirayeli yarambgiye, It’ Ūganza abantu mu bugororotsi, Agatwara yubaha Imana,
Abarasira nk’umutwenzi iy’ utambitse, Nk’izuba iyo rirashe mu gatondo hatagira agacu, Ubgatsi bukamera hasi, imvura yāguye.
Non’ inzu yanje si kw imeze ku Mana? Kuko yasezeranye nanje isezerano ritazovaho, Ritunganye muri vyose, kandi rikomeye; Non’ agakiza kanje kose n’ ivyo nifuza vyose Ntizotuma bimera bikaba ibironge?
Arikw abantu bose b’abagesera bazoba nk’amahwa abantu bakinjura, Kukw ata wuyafatisha intoke;
Arik’ uwoyakorako Akwiye kugira icuma n’uruti rw’icumu; Umuriro uzoyatongorera aho nyene.
Aya ni yo mazina y’abahizi Dawidi yar’ afise: Yoshebu‐bashebeti w’i Takemoni, ni we yar’ umukuru wa bamwe batatu; ni we yarāgūriye icumu abantu amajana munani, bahindikiranirah’ umusi umwe.
Uwa kabiri kuri we muri ba bahizi batatu ni Eleyazari mwene Dodayi Umwahohi. Yari kumwe na Dawidi igihe bahangāra Abafilisitiya bari bakoraniye kubarwanya. Maz’ Abisirayeli bahunze,

arahaguruka yica Abafilisitiya, ukuboko kwiwe kurateba kugwa ikinyānya, kwumira ku nkota. Uwo musi Uhoraho atanga intsinzi ikomeye; abantu baraheza bagaruka kuri Eleyazari, bazanywe no gukoba imivyimba gusa.
Akurikirwa na Shama mwene Ageye Umuharari. Abafilisitiya bari bakoraniye i Lehi, ahār’ umurima w’inkore; nukw ingabo zihunga Abafilisitiya.
Ariko we yihagararira muri wa murima, arawurwanira, yica Abafilisitiya; nuk’ Uhoraho atanga intsinzi ikomeye.

Umusi ur’ izina batatu bo muri bamwe mirongwitatu b’abahizi baramanuka, baja iyo Dawidi ari muri rya senga ry’i Adulamu; hāri mu gihe c’iyimbura, kand’ igitero c’Abafilisitiya cari gishagaje ku mwonga Refayimu.
Ico gihe Dawidi yari mw isenga, kandi har’ insago z’Abafilisitiya i Betelehemu.
Dawidi yumva akumbuye amazi yaho; aravuga, at’ Icompa nkabona uwompa ku mazi y’iriba ryo kw irembo ry’i Betelehemu, nkayanywa!
Maze ba bahizi batatu baca mu ngabo z’ Abafilisitiya, bavoma amazi mur’ iryo riba ryo kw irembo ry’i Betelehemu, barayazana, bayaha Dawidi; ariko yanka kuyanywa, ayavyagiza imbere y’Uhoraho.
Aravuga, at’ Ewe Uhoraho, biragahera ko nokora ntyo! Ndābe nnywe amaraso y’abantu bahevye amagara yabo? Ni co catumye yanka kuyanywa. Ivyo ni vyo vyakozwe na ba bandi batatu b’ abahizi.

Kandi Abishayi murumuna wa Yowabu umwana wa Seruwiya ni we yar’ umukuru wa bamwe mirongwitatu. Yarāgūriye icumu abantu amajana atatu, arabahindikiranya, aronka izina rya rurangiranwa mur’ abo mirongwitatu.
Yaravugangwa mur’ abo mirongwitatu nyene, bituma agirwa umukuru wabo. Ariko rero ntiyashikīra ba bandi batatu ba mbere.

Kandi na Benaya mwene Yehoyada, umuntu w’umuhizi w’i Kabuseli, na we yari yarakoze ivy’ ubutōre; ni we yishe bene Ariyeli w’i Mowabu bompi; kandi yaramanutse yicira intambge mw isenga, ku musi shelegi yar’ iguye.
Yishe n’Umunyegiputa mwiza w’akaranga; uwo Munyegiputa yar’ afise icumu mu minwe, ariko we amanuka iy’ ari atwaye ubuhiri; amushikura iryo cumu, ararimwicisha.
Ivyo ni vyo Benaya mwene Yehoyada yakoze, aronka izina rya rurangiranwa muri ba bahizi mirongwitatu.
Yaravugangwa mur’ abo mirongwitatu nyene, ariko ntiyashikīra ba bandi batatu ba mbere. Maze Dawidi amugira umukuru w’abashibamyi biwe.
Asaheli murumuna wa Yowabu yar’ umwe muri bamwe mirongwitatu, hamwe na Eluhanani mwene Dodo w’i Betelehemu,
na Shama w’i Harodi, na Elika w’i Harodi nyene;
na Helezi w’i Paluti, na Ira mwene Ikeshi w’i Tekowa;
na Abiyezeri w’i Anatoti, na Mebunayi w’i Hushati;
na Salumoni w’i Ahohi, na Maharayi w’i Netofati;
na Helebu mwene Bayana w’i Netofati nyene, na Itayi mwene Ribayi w’i Gibeya h’Ababenyamini;
na Benaya w’i Piratoni, na Hidayi wo ku migezi y’i Gashi;
na Abi‐aluboni w’i Arubati, na Azimaveti w’i Bahurimu;
na Eliyaba w’i Shaliboni, na bene Yasheni, na Yonatani;
na Shama w’i Harari, na Ahiyamu mwene Sharari w’i Harari nyene;
na Elifeleti mwene Ahasubayi w’i Mayaka, na Eliyamu mwene Ahitofeli w’i Giloni;
na Hesiro w’i Karumeli, na Parayi w’i Arubi;
na Igali mwene Natani w’i Zoba, na Bani w’Umugadi;
na Seleki w’Umwamoni, na Naharayi w’i Beroti, ari we yatwaza Yowabu umwana wa Seruwiya ibirwanishwa;
na Ira w’i Ituri, na Garebu w’i Ituri nyene;
na Uriya Umuheti; bose na bose bari mirongwitatu n’indwi.
Maz’ uburake bg’Uhoraho bgongera kuziriringira Abisirayeli; asunika Dawidi ngw abakwegere, ati Genda uharūre Abisirayeli n’Abayuda.
Umwami abarira Yowabu umugabisha w’ingabo ziwe yari kuri we, ati Nyuragira mu miryango yose y’ Abisirayeli, uhereye i Dani ugashitsa i Beri‐sheba, muharūre abantu, kugira ngo mmenye igitigiri cabo.

Yowabu yishura umwami, at’ Uhoraho Imana yawe n’igwiririkanye abantu, barute uko bari basanzwe bangana ibihetangabo ijana, nawe uz’ uvyibonere mugenzi; ariko mbega n’iki kiguteye gushira umutima ku kintu nk’ico ga mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma?
Arikw ijambo ry’umwami rinesha irya Yowabu n’iry’ abagabisha b’ingabo. Nuko Yowabu n’abo bagabisha bava imbere y’umwami, baja guharūra Abisirayeli.
Bajabuka Yorodani, bahēra i Aroweri, no ku gisagara kiri hagati mu kiyaya, bagenda berekeye i Gadi kurinda bashika i Yazeri.
Maze baja i Gileyadi no mu gihugu c’i Tahatimu‐hodishi, baja n’i Dani‐yani, barazenguka baja i Sidoni,
baca kw iboma ry’i Tiro no mu bisagara vyose vy’Abahiwi n’ivy’ Abanyakanani, bagarukira i Beri‐sheba i bumanuko bg’i Buyuda.
Nuko barangije kugendura igihugu cose basubira i Yerusalemu, bamaze amezi cenda n’imisi mirongwibiri.
Maze Yowabu ashikiriza umwami igitigiri c’abantu bāharūye: mu Bisirayeli hārimw’ abantu b’abahizi bazi kurwanisha inkota, ibihumbi amajana munani; mu Bayuda na ho hārimw’ ibihumbi amajana atanu.

Ariko Dawidi amaze guharūra abantu, yumva umutima umukubita. Abarira Uhoraho, ati Nācumuye cane ku vyo nakoze; ariko none, Uhoraho, ndakwinginze, kūrah’ ibigabitanyo vyanje, jewe umusavyi wawe, kuko nakoze ivy’ ubujuju rwose.
Bukeye mu gatondo, Dawidi avyukurutse, ijambo ry’Uhoraho riza kuri Gadi, uwavugishwa na we, ari we kamenyi wa Dawidi,
riti Genda ubarire Dawidi, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ut’ Agushize imbere ibihano bitatu; uti Hitamwo kimwe muri vyo; ut’ Abe ari co aguhanisha.

Nuko Gadi aja kwa Dawidi arabimubgira; aravuga, ati Ngo Mbega hatere inzara mu gihugu cawe, imare imyaka itatu, canke ng’ Uhīgwe n’abansi kumara amezi atatu, canke ngo Hatere ikīza mu gihugu cawe, kimare imisi itatu? Ni wiyumvire rero, uvuge ico nja kwishura Iyantumye.
Dawidi yishura Gadi, ati Ndagowe rwose: ni dupfume dukorokera mu maboko y’Uhoraho, kukw imbabazi ziwe ari nyinshi; ariko noye gukorokera mu maboko y’abantu.
Nuk’ Uhoraho atērēra Abisirayeli ikīza, gihēra mu gitondo gishitsa igihe cāshinzwe; uhereye i Dani ugashika i Beri‐sheba, hapfa abagabo ibihumbi mirongwirindwi.

Maz’ umumarayika akibangurira ukuboko i Yerusalemu ngw ahageseze, Uhoraho arīgarura abuza ivyo vyago, abarira uwo mumarayika yageseza abantu, ati Birahaye: garukana ukuboko kwawe. Kand’ uwo mumarayika w’Uhoraho yar’ ahagaze i ruhande y’imbuga ya Arawuna Umuyebusi.

Dawidi abonye uwo mumarayika yageseza abantu, abarira Uhoraho, at’ Erega ni jewe nacumuye, ni jewe nakoze nabi; arikw izi ntama zo zakoze iki? Ndakwinginze, ukuboko kwawe abe ari jewe kurwanya, bo n’inzu ya data.
Uwo musi nyene Gadi aja kuri Dawidi, aramubarira, ati Dūga wubakire Uhoraho igicaniro ku mbuga ya Arawuna Umuyebusi.
Nuko Dawidi yumvise irya Gadi aradūga, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yavuze.
Maze Arawuna agize ngw ararāba, abona umwami n’ abantu baza iy’ ari; Arawuna arenga irembo, akubita inkoro hasi imbere y’umwami, aramwunamira.

Arawuna aramubaza, ati Mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma, uzanywe n’iki i wanje jewe umusavyi wawe? Dawidi aramwishura, ati Nzanywe no kugura iyo mbuga yawe, ngo nubakire Uhoraho igicaniro, kugira ngw ikīza kive mu bantu.
Arawuna yishura Dawidi, ati Mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma, twara ivy’ ugomba vyose, ubitange: eh’ inka ngizo z’ikimazi co kwosa, n’ibisekuzo zikoresha n’ ingōgo zazo mubigire inkwi:
ivyo vyose jewe Arawuna ndabiguhaye, mugenzi. Arawuna arongera abarira umwami, at’ Uhoraho Imana yawe ikwākīrire.

Arik’ umwami yishura Arawuna, ati Na mba: turabigura, nguhe ikiguzi cavyo; sinokwosereza Uhoraho Imana yanje ibimazi ata co binkeheje. Nuko Dawidi agura iyo mbuga n’inka, atanga amashekeli y’ifeza mirongwitanu.
Maze Dawidi ahubakira Uhoraho igicaniro, ahosereza ibimazi, atanga n’ibimazi vy’ishimwe. Nuk’ Uhoraho abona guhangaza ico gihugu, ikīza kirabogozwa mu Bisirayeli.
Umwami Dawidi yar’ ashaje, ageze mu zabukuru; bāri basigaye bamupfuka impuzu ntabe agisusurukirwa.
Bituma abīshikira biwe bamubarira, bati Mwami wacu nyen’ ingoma, ni bakuronderere umwigeme w’inkumi, yamane nawe, akubungabunge, agupfumbatire, kugira ng’ ususurukirwe, mugenzi.
Nuko barondera umwigeme mwiza mu gihugu cose c’Abisirayeli; baronka Abishagi w’i Shunemu, bamuzanira umwami.
Uwo mwigeme yari mwiza w’umunyakaranga; nukw aba uwo kubungabunga umwami, akāma amukorera; ariko ntibāmenyana mu buryo bg’umugabo n’umugore.
Hanyuma Adoniya umwana wa Hagita arishira hejuru, aravuga, ati Ni jewe nzoba umwami. Yironderera imikogote n’abagendera ku mafarasi, n’abantu mirongwitanu bo kumwiruka imbere.
Kandi se nta ho yigeze amukankamira, ngw amubaze at’ Ivyo ukora ubiterwa n’iki? Kandi Adoniya yar’ umuntu mwiza w’ umunyakaranga, mu nda kwa se ni we yavutse inyuma ya Abusalomu.
Nukw aja inama na Yowabu umwana wa Seruwiya, na Abiyatari umuherezi, baramukurikira ngo bamushigikire.
Ariko Sadoki umuherezi na Benaya mwene Yehoyada na Natani uwavugishwa n’Imana na Shimeyi na Reyi na ba bahizi ba Dawidi, ntibāfatanya na Adoniya.

Bukeye Adoniya abāgira intama n’inka n’amashūri y’ibitegetera ku gitandara c’i Zoheleti hahereranye n’i Eni‐rogeli; atumira abana b’umwami bose, ari bo barumuna biwe, n’Abayuda bose bagendanira umwami.
Ariko Natani uwavugishwa n’Imana, na Benaya, na ba bahizi, na Salomo mwene se, bo ntiyabatumira.
Maze Natani abaza Batisheba nyina wa Salomo, at’ Ubgo ntiwumvise ko Adoniya umwana wa Hagita yiyimitse, kandi databuja Dawidi ata co azi?
None rero, enda ndakugīre inama, kugira ng’ ubone gukiza agatwe kawe n’ak’ umwana wawe Salomo.

Genda ushikīre umwami Dawidi, umubaze, uti Mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma, uti Mbega ntiwandahiye jewe incoreke yawe, yuko Salomo umwana wanje ari we azokwima ni watanga, akagusubirira ku ngoma? Uti None n’iki gitumye Adoniya ari we yimye?
Maz’ ukirik’ urabonana n’ umwami, nanje nza kuza ngukurikiye, nemeze ivyo uvuze.
Nuko Batisheba arinjira, aja i kare iy’ umwami ari; kand’ umwami yar’ ashaje cane, Abishagi w’i Shunemu ni we yamukorera.
Maze Batisheba akubita inkoro hasi, yunamira umwami. Umwami aramubaza, at’ Ugomba iki?
Aramwishura, at’ Urazirikanye, jewe incoreke yawe wandahiye Uhoraho Imana yawe, yuko Salomo umwana wanje ari we azokwima ni watanga, akagusubirira ku ngoma.
Ariko none, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma, Adoniya ni we yimye, kandi ntiwabimenye.
Yabāze inka n’ amashūri y’ibitegetera n’intama vy’isinzi, atumira abana bawe bose mugenzi, na Abiyatari umuherezi na Yowabu umugabisha w’ ingabo; arik’ umusavyi wawe Salomo ntiyamutumiye.
None rer’ amaso y’Abisirayeli bose bayahanze wewe, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma, kugira ng’ ubamenyeshe ūzosubira ku ngoma yawe ni watanga.
Arik’ utagize ico ukora ga mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma, ni wahamvya ba sogokuruza, twe n’umwana wanje Salomo bazotwita abagarariji.
Akirikw arabonana n’umwami, Natani ūvugishwa n’Imana arinjira.
Babarira umwami, bat’ Ūvugishwa n’Imana Natani nguyu hano. Arengutse imbere y’umwami, akubita inkoro hasi, aramwunamira.
Natani abaza umwami, ati Mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma, mbega ni wewe wavuze yuko Adoniya ari we azokwima ni watanga, akagusubirira ku ngoma?

Uyu musi ko yamanutse, akabāga inka n’amashūri y’ibitegetera n’intama vy’isinzi, agatumira abana bawe bose mugenzi, n’abagabisha b’ ingabo, na Abiyatari umuherezi; none bakaba bariko bararya, banywa, bar’ imbere yiwe, bavuga ng’ Umwami Adoniya n’ahangame!
Ariko jewe umusavyi wawe, na Sadoki umuherezi, na Benaya mwene Yehoyada, n’umusavyi wawe Salomo, tweho ntiyadutumiye.
None ga mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma, ivyo ni wewe wabigeze, kandi twebge abasavyi bawe ata ho wigeze kutubarira ūzogusubirira ku ngoma ni watanga ga mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma?
Maz’ umwami Dawidi aramubarira, ati Mpamagarira Batisheba. Nukw arengutse, ahagarara imbere y’umwami.
Umwami ararahira, ati Ndahiye uguhoraho kw’Uhoraho, yagiye andokora mu vyago vyose,
uko nakurahiye Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli, yuko Salomo umwana wawe ari we azokwima ni natanga, akansubirira ku ngoma, ni ko ngira ndabishitse uyu musi.
Maze Batisheba akubita inkoro hasi, yunamira umwami Dawidi, aravuga, at’ Uragahora ku ngoma, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma.
Maz’ umwami Dawidi aravuga, ati Ni mumpamagarire Sadoki umuherezi n’ūvugishwa n’ Imana Natani na Benaya mwene Yehoyada. Nuko bararenguka.
Umwami arababarira, ati Ni mujane ingabo zanje, kandi mushire umwana wanje Salomo ku nyumbu yanje bgite, ayigendereko, mumumanukane i Gihoni;
maze Sadoki umuherezi n’ ūvugishwa n’Imana Natani baheze bamwimikishirizey’ amavuta, abe umwami w’Abisirayeli; maze muce muvuza inzamba, mut’ Umwami Salomo n’ahangame!
Muheze mudūge mumugendaniye, aze avyagire ku ntebe yanje y’ubgami; kukw ari we azoba umwami mu gishingo canje, kand’ ari we nyene nageze kw azoba segaba w’Abisirayeli n’Abayuda.
Maze Benaya mwene Yehoyada yishura umwami, ati Ni bibe birtyo: Uhoraho Imana yawe n’ ibishitse, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma.
Nk’uk’ Uhoraho yabanye nawe, mwami wanje, abe ari kw azobana na Salomo, atume ingoma yiwe isumburuka iyawe, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma.
Nuko Sadoki umuherezi n’ ūvugishwa n’Imana Natani na Benaya mwene Yehoyada n’Abakereti n’Abapeleti bamanukana Salomo, bamushize ku nyumbu y’ umwami Dawidi, bamujana i Gihoni.
Umuherezi Sadoki araheza akūra ihembe ry’amavuta mw Ihema, ayimikisha Salomo; maze bavuza inzamba; abantu bose baravuga, bat’ Umwami Salomo n’ahangame!
Maz’ abantu bose bamukondorera inyuma, baradūga, bavuza imyironge, basēsereza impundu nyinshi, urwamo rwabo rutuma imisozi yāsīra.
Maze Adoniya n’abatumire biwe bose bari kumwe na we baravyumva, bakiriko baraheza kurya. Yowabu yumvise ijwi ry’inzamba aravuga, at’ Urwo rwamo rwinshi ruri mu gisagara n’urw’ iki?
Akibivuga, haza Yonatani mwene Abiyatari umuherezi; Adoniya aramubarira, ati Shika, kuk’ ur’ umuntu ameze neza, ntiwobura kuzana inkuru nziza.
Yonatani yishura Adoniya, at’ Eka si ko, ariko segaba umwami Dawidi yimitse Salomo ngw abe umwami.
Kand’ umwami yarungitse Sadoki umuherezi n’ūvugishwa n’ Imana Natani na Benaya mwene Yehoyada, bo n’Abakereti n’Abapeleti, bajana na we bamushize ku nyumbu y’umwami;
kandi Sadoki umuherezi n’ūvugishwa n’Imana Natani bamwimikishirije amavuta i Gihoni; ubu baravuyeyo, baradūze basēsereza impundu, igisagara cose n’urwamo rusa. Iyo ni yo ntūrēka mwumvise.
Mbere Salomo yavyagiye ku ntebe y’ubgami.
Bitayekw abantu b’umwami baje guhezagira segaba umwami Dawidi, bat’ Imana yawe itume izina rya Salomo risumburuka iryawe, n’ingoma yiwe isumburuka iyawe. Umwami na we yaciye yunama ku kirwa ciwe;
mbere yavuze, at’ Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli ahimbazwe, ampaye uwo kuvyagira ku ntebe yanje nkibona.
Maz’ abatumire ba Adoniya bose baranduka imitima, bava hasi, umuntu wese afata inzira yiwe.
Maze Adoniya atinya Salomo, aca ava hasi, aragenda yumira ku mahembe y’igicaniro.
Nuko babarira Salomo, bati Adoniya yakugiriye ubgoba mugenzi; kuko yagiye kwumira ku mahembe y’igicaniro, at’ Umwami Salomo andahire uyu musi kw atanyicisha inkota, jewe umusavyi wiwe.
Maze Salomo aravuga, ati Ni yaboneka kw ameze neza, nta n’agashatsi na kamwe kiwe kazohara ngo gakorokere hasi; ariko ni hagira ikibi kimubonekako, azopfa.
Nuk’ umwami Salomo atuma abamukūra ku gicaniro. Nukw araza yikubita imbere y’ umwami Salomo. Salomo aramubarira, ati Ni witahire.
Igihe ca Dawidi co gutanga kigira gishike, abarira umwana wiwe Salomo ivyo azokora,
ati Ngiye kujana inzira ab’ isi bose bajana; nuko shikama, ube umugabo nya mugabo.

Uze wumvire ivyo Uhoraho Imana yawe yageze, ugendere mu nzira ziwe, witondere ivyo yashinze, n’amabgirizwa yiwe, n’amateka yiwe, n’ivyo yihanikirije, nk’uko vyanditswe mu vyagezwe vya Mose, kugira ng’ ugire ikiganza ciza mu vy’uzokora vyose n’ah’ uzoja hose;

ng’ Uhoraho az’ ashitse ijambo yamvuzeko, kw abana banje ni bitonda mu ngeso zabo, bakagendera imbere yiwe mu vy’ukuri, uhereye mu vyiyumviro vyabo no mu mitima yabo, yavuze ngo ntihazobura mu banje uwo kuja ku ngoma y’Abisirayeli.

Ikindi, urazi ivyo Yowabu umwana wa Seruwiya yangiriye, n’ivyo yagiriye ba bagabisha bompi b’ingabo z’Abisirayeli, Abuneri mwene Neri na Amasa mwene Yeteri, abo yishe, amaraso yaviriye mu ntambara akayahōra mu gihe c’impore, akīyandurisha amaraso y’abatācumuye, akamutarukira ku mukanda no ku nkweto.
Ubgenge bgawe buze bukurōngōre mu vyo uzomugirira, ariko ntuze wemere kw azomanukana imvi ziwe ngw aje mu mva amahoro.
Ariko bene Baruzilayi Umugileyadi uz’ ubagirire neza, ubashire mu barīra ku meza yawe; kuko na bo bangiriye neza igihe nari narahunze mukurwawe Abusalomu.

Mugabo harih’ uwundi ngaho, ni Shimeyi mwene Gera, Umubenyamini w’i Bahurimu, yantutse ibitutsi bibi, umusi naja i Mahanayimu; ariko hanyuma amanuka kuri Yorodani kunsanganira, ndamurahira Uhoraho yuko ntazomwicisha inkota.
Ariko rero wewe ntuz’ ugende utamuhannye; kuk’ ur’ umunyabgenge, uzomenya uk’ ukwiye kumugenza; uz’ utume amanuka mu mva imvi ziwe zirikw ibitenga vy’amaraso.
Nuko Dawidi ahamvya ba sekuruza, bamuhamba ku murwa i we.
Kand’ imyaka Dawidi yamaze ku ngoma aganza Abisirayeli yari mirongwine, kuko yamaze imyaka ndwi aganziriza i Heburoni, akamara n’ iyindi mirongwitatu n’itatu i Yerusalemu.
Nuko Salomo asubira ku ngoma ya se Dawidi, ubgami bgiwe burahangama.
Maze Adoniya umwana wa Hagita ashikīra Batisheba nyina wa Salomo. Batisheba aramubaza, at’ Ugenzwa n’ amahoro? Na we at’ Ego me n’ amahoro.
Kand’ ati Ndagusavye ijambo. Na we at’ Ego me vuga.

Aramubarira, at’ Urazi yukw ingoma yar’ iyanje, kukw Abisirayeli bose bari bampanze amaso, ngo ni jewe nzoba umwami. Ariko hanyuma ingoma irahinduka, iba iya murumunanje, kuk’ Uhoraho ari we yayimuhaye.
None rero, har’ ico ngusaba: kandi ntukinyime. Aramwishura, ati Kivuge.
Aramubarira, ati Ndakwinginze, nsabira umwami Salomo, kukw adashobora kukwima, ampe Abishagi w’i Shunemu, ndamucūre.
Batisheba aramwishura, ati Nuko, ndakuvugira ku mwami.

Nuko Batisheba aragenda ashikīra umwami Salomo, kugira ngw avugire Adoniya. Umwami aca ahaguruka ngw amusanganire, aramwunamira; araheza asubira kuvyagira ku ntebe y’ubgami, avuga ko bazanira umugabekazi intebe; nuk’ umugabekazi yicara i buryo bgiwe.
Aravuga, ati Har’ ico ngusaba gitoya, ntukinyime. Umwami aramwishura, ati Kimbarire nyina wanje, sindakikwima.
Aramubgira, ati Adoniya mukurwawe n’ahabge Abishagi w’i Shunemu, amucūre.

Arik’ umwami Salomo yishura nyina, ati N’iki gitumye usabira Adoniya Abishagi w’i Shunemu? Erega n’umusabire n’ingoma, kukw ari mukurwanje! Mber’ uyisabire na Abiyatari umuherezi na Yowabu umwana wa Seruwiya!
Maz’ umwami Salomo arahira Uhoraho, at’ Ijambo Adoniya avuze, ni ritamucisha umutwe, Imana iz’ ibimpanire, kandi birushirije!
Nuko rero ndahiye uguhoraho kw’Uhoraho yanshize ku ngoma ya data Dawidi, akantereka, akampindura inzu nk’uko yasezeranye, n’ukuri uyu musi Adoniya akagenda batamwishe!
Nuk’ umwami Salomo arungika Benaya mwene Yehoyada, amutsindaho, arapfa.

Maz’ umwami abarira Abiyatari umuherezi, ati Hoji genda, subira i Anatoti mw ishamvu yawe; war’ ukwiye gupfa, arik’ ubu sinkwica, kuko wagenda ureruye isandugu y’Uhoraho Imana imbere ya data Dawidi, kandi kuko wababarana na we mu vyamubabaje vyose.
Uko ni ko Salomo yirukanye Abiyatari mu buherezi bg’Uhoraho, ngw ashitse ijambo Uhoraho yari yaravuze ku nzu ya Eli i Shilo.
Nukw inkuru zishika kuri Yowabu; kandi Yowabu yari yarafatanije na Adoniya, nah’ atāfatanije na Abusalomu. Nukw aca ahungira mw Ihema ry’ Uhoraho, yumira ku mahembe y’igicaniro.
Maze babgira umwami Salomo, bati Yowabu yahungiye mw Ihema ry’Uhoraho, ubu ari ku gicaniro. Nuko Salomo arungika Benaya mwene Yehoyada, aramubarira, ati Genda umwice.
Nuko Benaya aragenda, aja mw Ihema ry’Uhoraho, aramubarira, at’ Umwami agize ngo Sohoka. Na we at’ Ekaye, ndagwa ngaha. Nuko Benaya aragenda, abarira umwami ivyo Yowabu yavuze n’ingene yamwishuye.
Umwami aramubarira, ati Genda ubigenze uko yavuze, umutsindeho, umuhambe, kugira ng’ ukūre kuri jewe no ku nzu ya data amaraso yavishije adafise inyanduruko.

Uhoraho aza kuba amushubije ku mutwe amaraso ya ba bantu babiri yatsindaho, akabicisha inkota, data Dawidi atabizi, kand’ ar’ abantu bamurusha kugororoka no gutungana, ni bo Abuneri mwene Neri, umugabisha w’ingabo z’Abisirayeli, na Amasa mwene Yeteri, umugabisha w’ingabo z’Abayuda.
Uko ni kw amaraso yabo azosubira ku mutwe wa Yowabu no ku mitwe y’uruvyaro rwiwe ibihe vyose; ariko kuri Dawidi n’uruvyaro rwiwe n’inzu yiwe n’ingoma yiwe hazoba amahoro ava k’Uhoraho ibihe vyose.
Nuko Benaya mwene Yehoyada aradūga, amutsindaho, aramwica; bamuhamba mu rugo rwiwe bgite rwari mu bugaragwa.
Maz’ umwami ashira Benaya mwene Yehoyada mu gishingo ca Yowabu ngw abe umugabisha w’ingabo, ashira na Sadoki umuherezi mu gishingo ca Abiyatari.
Maz’ umwami atumiza Shimeyi, aramubarira, ati Ni wiyubakire inzu i Yerusalemu, uyibemwo, ntuz’ uyivemwo ng’ ugire ahandi uja na hamwe.
Umusi wayivuyemwo, ukajabuka umugezi Kidironi, umenye neza k’ utazobura gupfa; amaraso yawe azoba ari wewe aja ku mutwe.
Shimeyi yishura umwami, at’ Ivyo umbgiye ni vyiza; uk’ uvuze, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma, ni ko nzobigenza, jewe umusavyi wawe. Nuko Shimeyi aba i Yerusalemu igihe kirekire.
Hahise imyaka itatu, abagurano babiri ba Shimeyi baracika, baja kwa Akishi mwene Mayaka umwami w’i Gati. Bukeye babarira Shimeyi, bati Ba bagurano bawe bar’ i Gati.
Shimeyi arahaguruka, ashira amatandiko ku ndogoba yiwe, aja i Gati kwa Akishi kurondera abagurano biwe; nukw aragenda abakūra i Gati.
Maze Salomo abarirwa ko Shimeyi yavuye i Yerusalemu akaja i Gati, akagaruka.

Nuk’ umwami atumiza Shimeyi, aramubaza, ati Mbega sinakwatse indahiro y’Uhoraho, nkakwihanikiriza rwose, nt’ Umenye neza yuk’ umusi uzovayo, ukagira ah’ ucarukira na hamwe, k’utazobura gupfa? Ukanyishura yukw ivyo mvuze ari vyiza, k’ uvyumvise?
None n’iki cakubujije kwitondera indahiro y’ Uhoraho n’icagezwe naguhaye?
Umwami atakw abarira Shimeyi, at’ Urazi mu mutima wawe ibibi vyose wakoreye data Dawidi, ni co gituma ivyo bibi vyawe Uhoraho agira abigusubize ku mutwe.
Ariko jewe umwami Salomo nzohabga umugisha, kand’ ingoma ya Dawidi izohangama imbere y’ Uhoraho ibihe vyose.
Nuk’ umwami agera Benaya mwene Yehoyada kumwica; na we arasohoka, amutsindaho, arapfa. Uko ni ko Salomo yahangamye ku ngoma.

Maze Salomo asabira Farawo umwami wa Egiputa, arongora umukobga wiwe, amujana mu gisagara ca Dawidi, gushitsa amaze kwubaka ingoro yiwe bgite n’ ingoro y’Uhoraho, n’uruzitiro rwo kuzitirira i Yerusalemu impande zose.
Kand’ ico gihe abantu bātangira ibimazi ku mpinga z’ imisozi; kuko gushitsa ico gihe ata ngoro bāribgubakire izina ry’ Uhoraho.
Kandi Salomo yakunda Uhoraho, akagendera mu mabgirizwa ya se Dawidi, mugabo yatangira ibimazi ku mpinga z’ imisozi, akahosereza imibavu.
Bukeye umwami Salomo aja i Gibeyoni gutangiray’ ibimazi, kukw ari ho hari hakuru ku zindi mpinga z’imisozi; nuko yosereza ku gicaniro caho ibimazi igihumbi.
Kandi Salomo akir’ i Gibeyoni, Uhoraho amwiyerekera mu nzozi mw ijoro. Nukw Imana iramubarira, iti Nsaba ico ugomba, ndakiguhe.

Salomo arishura, ati Wagiriye neza cane data, umusavyi wawe Dawidi, kuko yagendera imbere yawe mu vy’ukuri no mu vy’ukugororoka, agutunganiye mu mutima wiwe, kand’ ukaba waramugereye kuzomugirira neza cane nk’uku, ukamuha umwana wo kumusubirira ku ngoma, nk’uko bir’ uyu musi.
Nuko none, Uhoraho Mana yanje, jewe umusavyi wawe wanyimitse mu gishingo ca data Dawidi, naho nkir’ umwana muto gusa; sinzi iyo bija n’iyo biva.
Kandi jewe umusavyi wawe ndi hagati mu bantu bawe watoranije, ihanga rihambaye, ritoharūrika canke ngo rimenywe ubginshi bgaryo.
None rero, jewe umusavyi wawe, n’umpe umutima w’ubgenge, nshobore gucira abantu bawe imanza, mmenye gutandukanya ikibi n’iciza. None ni nde yoshobora gucira imanza iri hanga ryawe rihambaye?
Maze binezereza Uhoraho yuko Salomo asavye ivyo.
Nukw Imana iramubarira, it’ Ivyo kw ari vyo usavye, ukaba udasavye kuramba, canke ng’ usabe ubutunzi, canke ng’ usabe kw abansi bawe bapfa; arik’ ukaba wisabiye ubgenge bgo guca imanza neza;
nuko nkugiriye nk’uk’ usavye: ehe nguhaye umutima w’ubgenge wo gutahura, ata we muhwanye mu bākwitangiye imbere canke mu bazoguherukira.
Kandi nguhaye n’ico utansavye: nguhaye ubutunzi n’icubahiro, bitume ata mwami n’umwe azohwana nawe igihe cose ukiriho.
Kandi ni wagendera mu nzira zanje, ukitondera amabgirizwa yanje n’ivyagezwe vyanje, nk’uko so Dawidi yagenjeje, nzoguha kuramba.

Maze Salomo aribambura, amenya kw ar’ inzozi. Maz’ aja i Yerusalemu, ahagarara imbere y’isandugu y’isezerano ry’Uhoraho, ahosereza ibimazi, ahatangira n’ibimazi vy’ishimwe, atumirira abantu biwe bose amazimano.
Bukeye ba maraya babiri baza ku mwami, bahagarara imbere yiwe.
Umwe muri bo aravuga, at’ Urazirikanye mugenzi; jewe n’uyu mugore tubana mu nzu imwe; bukeye mvyara umwana turi kumwe mu nzu.
Mmaze imisi itatu mvyaye, uyu mugore na we aravyara; kandi twari twenyene, ata muntu wundi yari kumwe natwe mu nzu, atari twebge twempi gusa.
Hanyuma umwana w’uyu mugore ahenga mw ijoro arapfa, nyina yamuryamyeko.
Na we aca avyuka mu gicugu, ankūra umwana i ruhande nsinziriye, jewe umusavyi wawe, amuryamika mu gikiriza ciwe, wa wundi yapfuye amuryamika mu gikiriza canje.
Ngo mvyuke kwonsa umwana bugira buce, nsanga yapfuye; ariko bukeye ndamwitegereje, nsanga si we w’iwanje navyaye.

Uwundi mugore aramwishura, ati Na mba! Ūkomeye ni we w’ iwanje, na we uwapfuye ni rwawe. Uno na we at’ Eka na mba! Uwapfuye ni we mwana wawe, ūgikomeye ni we w’iwanje. Uko ni ko bābūraniye imbere y’umwami.
Nuk’ umwami aravuga, ati Mbega k’umwe avuga, ng’ Ūkomeye ni we w’iwanje, ngo Na we uwapfuye ni we w’iwawe; uwundi akavuga, ati Na mba! Uwapfuye ni we w’iwawe, ūgikomeye ni we w’iwanje!
Umwami arongera aravuga, ati Ni munzanire inkota. Bayizana imbere y’ umwami.
Maz’ umwami aravuga, at’ Uwo mwana akomeye ni mumucemwo kubiri, igihimba kimwe mugihe umwe, ikindi mugihe uwundi.

Nuko wa mugore nyina w’umwana akomeye, kuko mu mutima yar’ afise ikibabarwe c’umwana wiwe, abarira umwami, at’ Ewe mugenzi! Uyo mwana akomeye pfuma umumuha, ntumwice na gatoya. Ariko wa wundi ati Ni mumucemwo kubiri, tumubure twempi.
Maz’ umwami araheza aravuga, at’ Uwo mwana akomeye ntimumwice na gatoya, mumuhe urya, kukw ari we nyina.
Nukw Abisirayeli bose bumvise uk’ umwami yaciye urwo rubanza, baca baramutinya, kuko bābonye k’ubgenge buva ku Mana buri muri we bgo guca imanza.
Umwami Salomo yar’ umwami w’Abisirayeli bose.
Kand’ aba ni bo baganwa biwe: Azariya mwene Sadoki umuherezi;
Elihorefu na Ahiya bene Shisha bar’ abakarani; Yehoshafati mwene Ahiludi ni we yar’ umwanditsi w’ ivyaja biraba;
Benaya mwene Yehoyada yar’ umugabisha w’ ingabo; Sadoki na Abiyatari ni bo bar’ abaherezi;
Azariya mwene Natani yar’ umukuru w’ abamenyekana; Zabudi mwene Natani nyene yar’ umuherezi kandi yar’ umukunzi w’umwami;
Ahishari yar’ umubgiriza wo mu rugo; Adoniramu mwene Abuda ni we yagaba ivy’ abanyabikebere.

Kand’ umwami Salomo yar’ afise abamenyekana cumi na babiri bakwiragiye mu Bgisirayeli hose, kugira ngo bame bamutoreza ivyo kumutunga bo n’abo mu rugo rwiwe; umuntu wese yar’ afise ukwezi kumwe mu mwaka kwo kubitoza.
Aya ni yo mazina yabo: mwene Huri yatoza ivyo mu mugamba w’Abefurayimu;
na mwene Dekeri yatoza ivy’ i Makasi n’i Shalibimo n’i Beti‐shemeshi n’i Eloni‐beti‐hanani;
na mwene Hesedi yatoza ivy’ i Aruboti, akaganza n’i Sokoho n’intāra yose y’i Heferi;
na mwene Abinadabu yatoza ivyo mu misozi yose ihagaze y’i Dori, kandi yar’ afise umukobga wa Salomo yitwa Tafati;

na Bayana mwene Ahiludi yatoza ivy’ i Tanaki n’i Megido, n’i Beti‐sheyani hose hahereranye n’i Zaretani hepfo y’i Yezireli, uhereye i Beti‐sheyani nyene ugaca i Abeli‐mehola ukarinda ushika hirya y’i Yokumeyamu;

na mwene Geberi yatoza ivy’ i Ramoti‐gileyadi, akaganza n’ibisagara vya Yayiri mwene Manase vyar’ i Gileyadi nyene, bo n’intāra y’i Arugobu i Bashani yarimw’ ibisagara mirongwitandatu bikomeye, bizitijwe inzitiro z’amabuye, vyugazwa ibihindizo vy’imiringa;
na Ahinadabu mwene Ido yatoza ivy’ i Mahanayimu;
na Ahimasi yatoza ivy’ Abanafutali, yari yarongoye Basemati umukobga wa Salomo;
na Bayana mwene Hushayi yatoza ivy’ Abasheri n’ivy’ i Beyaloti;
na Yehoshafati mwene Paruwa yatoza ivy’ Abisakari;
na Shimeyi mwene Ela yatoza ivy’ Ababenyamini;
na Gebera mwene Uri yatoza ivyo mu gihugu c’i Gileyadi, mu ntāra yar’ iya Sihoni umwami w’Abamori na Ogi umwami w’i Bashani; hār’ umumenyekana umwe gusa yatoza ivyo mur’ ico gihugu.
Kand’ Abayuda n’Abisirayeli bār’ isinzi, bangana n’umusenyi wo mw isēsero ry’ikiyaga; kandi bārarya, bāranywa, bakanezerwa.

Kandi Salomo yaganza ibihugu vyose vy’abami, uhereye kuri rwa ruzi Efurate, ugashitsa ku gihugu c’Abafilisitiya ukagarukira ku rubibe rwa Egiputa, bakāma bamuzanira amashikanwa, bakamusaba, igihe cose yabaye ku ngoma.
Ivyāgaburwa kwa Salomo ku musi ku musi vyar’ ibi: ingero zitwa koro mirongwitatu z’ifu igogōretse, n’ingero mirongwitandatu z’ayandi mafu;
n’ibimasa cumi vyagaburiwe neza, n’ ibindi mirongwibiri vyirishiriza, n’intama ijana, ukūyemw’ impongo n’ingeregere n’amafumberi, bo n’inkoko zagaburiwe neza.
Kuko yaganza igihugu cose co hakuno ya rwa ruzi Efurate, uhereye i Tifusa ugashitsa i Gaza, akaganza n’abami bose bo hakuno yarwo, kandi yabana amahoro n’ ibihugu vyose bimukikije;
nukw Abayuda n’Abisirayeli bībēra amahoro, umuntu wese mu mizabibu yiwe no mu misukoni yiwe, uhereye i Dani ugashitsa i Beri‐sheba, igihe cose Salomo yari ku ngoma.
Kandi Salomo yar’ afise impongore ibihumbi bine z’amafarasi yakwega imikogote yiwe, n’abantu bagendera ku mafarasi ibihumbi cumi na bibiri.
Nukw abo bamenyekana bama batoza ivyo gutunga umwami Salomo n’abaza kurīra ku meza yiwe bose, umuntu wese uk’ ukwezi kwiwe gutashe; nta kintu na kimwe bāhaza ngo kibure.
Kandi bama bazana na sayiri n’ivyarire vy’amafarasi akwega imikogote n’ayandi yo kwirukako, nk’uko vyashinzwe, bakabizana aho bikwiye kuja.
Nukw Imana iha Salomo ubgenge n’ubuhanga bginshi cane, n’ umutima wagutse, nk’ukw isēsero ry’umusenyi wo ku kiyaga ryagutse.
Ubgenge bga Salomo bgāruta ubg’ abanyabgenge bose b’i burasirazuba n’ubg’ Abanyegiputa bgose.
Yarusha abandi bantu bose ubgenge, yarusha na Etani Umwezerahi, na Hemani na Kalukoli na Darada, bene Maholi; mbere yaravugangwa mu mahanga yose amukikije.
Yigeneye imigani ibihumbi bitatu, n’indirimbo igihumbi na zitanu.
Yar’ azi kudondora ivy’ ibiti, uhereye kw isederi y’i Lebanoni ugashitsa kuri ezobu imera ku mazu; yar’ azi no kudondora ivy’ ibikōko n’ ibisīga n’ivyikwega hasi n’amafi.
Nukw abantu bakava mu mahanga yose bazanywe no kwumva ubgenge bga Salomo, barungitswe n’abami bose bo mw isi bumvise ivy’ ubgenge bgiwe.
Hiramu umwami w’i Tiro yumvise ko bimikishije Salomo amavuta ngw asubire ku ngoma ya se, amutumakw intumwa, kuk’ uhereye kera Hiramu yakundana na Dawidi.
Nuko Salomo atuma kwishura Hiramu,

ut’ Urazi ko se Dawidi atābonye uburyo bgo kwubaka ingoro y’izina ry’ Uhoraho Imana yiwe, kubg’ intambara z’abansi biwe zari zimuturutse irya n’ino, uti Gushitsa ah’ Uhoraho yabashiriye musi y’ibirenge vyiwe.
Ut’ Ariko we, Uhoraho Imana yiwe amuhaye impore impande zose; uti Nta murwanizi nta n’agakakaza.
Uti Non’ afise imigabo yo kwubaka ingoro y’izina ry’Uhoraho Imana yiwe, uti Nk’uk’ Uhoraho yabariye se wiwe Dawidi, at’ Umwana wawe nzosubiza ku ngoma yawe ni we azonyubakira ingoro y’izina ryanje.

Uti None rer’ umubaririre abamwicirira ibiti vy’ amasederi i Lebanoni, uti Kand’ abantu biwe bazofatanya n’abawe; uti Kand’ azoguha ingero z’abakozi bawe uk’ uzozicīra kwose; uti Kuk’ uzi yukw ata n’umwe mu b’i wabo azi kwicira ibiti nk’Abasidoni.
Nuko Hiramu yumvise amajambo ya Salomo aranezerwa cane, aravuga, at’ Uyu musi Uhoraho ashemagizwe, kuko yahaye Dawidi umwana w’incabgenge wo kuganza iryo hanga rihambaye.
Nuko Hiramu atuma kuri Salomo, uti Yumvise ivyo umutumyeko; uti Nukw azogukorera ivyo wamusavye vyose ku vy’ibiti vy’amasederi no ku vy’ akajwari.

Ut’ Abantu biwe bazobikūra i Lebanoni, babimanukane babishikane ku kiyaga; uti Bishitseyo azobitekera imbambo, abicīshe mu kiyaga, ut’ Abishikane ah’ uzomurangira, babitekururireho, uti Nawe abe ari ho uzovyākīrira. Uti Nawe ni watanga ivyo kugaburira abo mu rugo rwiwe, uzoba uhaye.
Nuko Hiramu aha Salomo ibiti vy’amasederi n’ivy’ akajwari, nk’uko yagomba kwose.

Salomo na we agaha Hiramu ingano ingero zitwa koro ibihumbi mirongwibiri zo kugaburira abo mu rugo rwiwe, n’amavuta akūwe muri elayo zisekuwe ingero mirongwibiri. Uko ni ko Salomo yaha Hiramu uk’ umwaka utashe.
Nuk’ Uhoraho aha Salomo ubgenge nk’uko yamusezeraniye, na we abana amahoro na Hiramu, basezerana isezerano ryo gufatanya.
Maz’ umwami Salomo atoza abantu bo kuba abanyabikebere mu Bisirayeli hose; abo yatoje baba ibihumbi mirongwitatu.
Akāma abarungika i Lebanoni, bagahāna imbu, ibihumbi icumi‐icumi mu kwezi, bakamara ukwezi kumwe i Lebanoni, abiri bakayamara i muhira. Adoniramu ni we yagaba ivy’ abo banyabikebere.
Kandi Salomo yari yarashizeh’ abantu ibihumbi mirongwirindwi bāshinzwe ivyo kwikorera, n’abandi ibihumbi mirongumunani bāshinzwe kubāza amabuye ku misozi;
udashizemw’ abakoresha biwe bakuru bākoresha ivyo bikorwa, ibihumbi bitatu n’amajana atatu, bāgaba abo bakozi.
Nuk’ umwami agera ko bimba amabuye manini‐manini y’igiciro kinini, kugira ngw itanguriro ry’iyo ngoro ryubakishwe amabuye abājwe.
Maz’ abubatsi ba Salomo n’aba Hiramu n’Abagebali barayabāza, batunganya ibiti n’amabuye, kugira ngo bavyubakishe iyo ngoro.

Maz’ imyaka amajana ane na mirongumunani ishize, uhereye igihe Abisirayeli baviriye mu gihugu ca Egiputa, Salomo atangura kwubaka ingoro y’Uhoraho, hāri mu mwaka ugira kane ari ku ngoma, mu kwezi kwa Zivu, ari kwo kwezi kwa kabiri.

Iyo ngoro umwami Salomo yubakiye Uhoraho, uburebure bgayo bgar’ amatambge mirongwitandatu y’ ukuboko uciriye mu nkokora, ubgaguke bgayo bgar’ amatambge mirongwibiri, uburebure bgayo bg’igihagararo bgar’ amatambge mirongwitatu.
Urubaraza ruherereye imbere y’Ahēra h’iyo ngoro, uburebure bgarwo bg’ amakika bgar’ amatambge mirongwibiri, nk’uk’ ubgaguke bg’iyo ngoro bgangana; ubgaguke bgarwo bgar’ amatambge cumi.
Iyo ngoro ayishiramw’ amadirisha y’ inshingo zikomeye.
Mu mbavu z’iyo ngoro ahōmeka utwumba tugerekeranye, dukikuje iyo ngoro yose uhereye Ahēra n’Ahēra Cane; uko ni ko yubatse utwumba tuyikikuje.

Utwumba two hasi, ubgaguke bgatwo bgar’ amatambge atanu; utwo hagati ubgaguke bgatwo bgar’ atandatu; utwa gatatu, ubgaguke bgatwo bgar’ indwi; ku gisika c’iyo ngoro ahahera inyuma, yagenda asiga ahaniguye impande zose, kugira ngw imbaho z’utwo twumba ntizinjire mu gisika c’iyo ngoro.
Mw iyubaka ry’iyo ngoro bayubakishije amabuye yatunganirijwe aho bayimvye; nta nyundo cank’ incabiti cank’ ikindi kintu cose c’icuma cumvikana mur’ iryo yubakwa ryayo.
Umuryango w’utwumba two hasi wari ku ruhande rw’i buryo rw’iyo ngoro; abāja mu twumba two hagati bāca ku curirizo cihotaguye mu gushikayo, bahavuye bagashika mu twa gatatu.
Uko ni ko yubatse iyo ngoro, arayuzuza; ayimanikisha ibishōro n’imbaho vy’amasederi.

Twa twumba yometse kur’ iyo ngoro impande zose, kamwe‐kamwe uburebure bgako bg’igihagararo bgar’ amatambge atanu y’ukuboko uciriye mu nkokora; twari twubatswe ku myaro y’amasederi ifashe kur’ iyo ngoro.
Bukeye ijambo ry’Uhoraho riza kuri Salomo,

riti Ku vy’ iyi ngoro urik’ urubaka, ni wagendera mu vyo nashinze, ugashitsa amabgirizwa yanje, ukitondera ivyagezwe vyanje vyose, ukaba ari vyo ugenderamwo, nanje nzokomeza ijambo ryanje kuri wewe, iryo navuganye na so Dawidi.
Kandi nzoba mu Bisirayeli, sinzoheba abantu banje.
Uko ni ko Salomo yubatse iyo ngoro, arayuzuza.
Imbere ku bisika vy’iyo ngoro ahōmeka imbaho z’amasederi; uhereye hasi ugashitsa ku myaro y’urusenge, imbere hose ahōmeka imbaho; kandi hasi ahasasa imbaho z’akajwari.

Haruguru imbere mur’ iyo ngoro ahōmeka imbaho z’ amasederi kumara amatambge mirongwibiri, uhereye hasi ugashitsa ku myaro; aho hantu imbere haruguru arahakīngīra kugira ngo habe ahantu hiherereye, habe Ahēra Cane.
Ingoro isigaye hino y’Ahēra Cane yar’ amatambge mirongwine; ni yo yitwa Ahēra.
Hose imbere mur’ iyo ngoro hāri hōmetse imbaho z’ amasederi zisharijwekw ibishushanyo vy’uturende n’amashurwe asambuye; hose zar’ imbaho z’ amasederi, nta buye ryaboneka.
Nukw atunganya Ahēra Cane aho nyene imbere haruguru mur’ iyo ngoro, kugira ngw ahatereke isandugu y’isezerano ry’Uhoraho.

Kand’ Ahēra Cane, amakika yaho yar’ amatambge mirongwibiri, n’ubgaguke bgaho bgari mirongwibiri, n’uburebure bg’igihagararo na bgo bgari mirongwibiri nyene. Hose ahōmekakw izahabu iramuye, abāza n’igicaniro mw isederi, na co acomekakw izahabu, agitereka imbere y’Ahēra Cane.
Nuko ku ngoro imbere hose ahōmekakw izahabu iramuye, araheza atambika iminyororo y’izahabu imbere y’Ahēra Cane.
Nuko ku ngoro hose yahōmetse izahabu kugeza ingoro yose ihwanye; na ca gicaniro c’imbere y’ Ahēra Cane na co yacometsekw izahabu hose.
Abāza mu biti vy’imyelayo ibishushanyo vy’abakerubi bibiri vyo gushira Ahēra Cane, uburebure bgavyo bgar’ amatambge cumi y’ukuboko uciriye mu nkokora.
Uburebure bg’ibaba rimwe ry’umukerubi bgar’ amatambge atanu, n’irindi baba n’uko: uhereye kw isonga ry’ibaba rimwe ukageza ku ry’irindi yar’ amatambge cumi.
Igishushanyo c’ umukerubi ca kabiri uburebure bgaco bgar’ amatambge cumi nyene; abo bakerubi bompi bārangana cabugerwe, kandi n’ishusho yabo yar’ imwe.
Uburebure bg’umukerubi umwe bgar’ amatambge cumi, n’ubg’ uwundi kuno nyene.

Nukw atereka abo bakerubi aho nyene haruguru mur’ iyo ngoro; amababa yabo yar’ ashānje, ibaba ry’umwe ryaruma ku nzu ku ruhande rumwe, iry’ uwundi ku rundi ruhande, yandi abiri agasomanira hagati mu nzu.
Kand’ abo bakerubi abomekakw izahabu.
Ku nzu hose imbere mur’ iyo ngoro ahabāzira ibishushanyo vy’ abakerubi n’ivy’ ibigazi n’ivy’ amashurwe asambuye, imbere haruguru no hino.
No hasi mur’ iyo ngoro ahōmeka izahabu, imbere haruguru no hino.
Umuryango uja Ahēra Cane awushirakw inzugi z’imbaho z’ imyelayo; uwo muryango, hakora ikibambāsi co hejuru n’ibishimaryango, watwaye umwanya w’ikigiragatanu c’umukingo waho.

Kand’ abāza inzugi zibiri mu mbaho z’imyelayo, mu kuzibāza azishushanyakw ibishushanyo vy’ abakerubi n’ivy’ ibigazi n’ivy’ amashurwe asambuye, azomekakw izahabu, ayiyagiriza no kur’ ivyo bishushanyo vy’abakerubi no ku vy’ibigazi.
Akora ibishimaryango vy’ urwinjiriro rw’urusengero mu biti vy’imyelayo, uwo muryango utwara umwanya w’ikigirakane c’urwo ruhande;
akora n’inzugi zaho zibiri mu mbaho z’akajwari; urugi rumwe iyo buguruye, imbaho zarwo zompi zarīzinga, n’iz’ urwa kabiri zīzinga kuno nyene.
Kandi mu kuzibāza azishushanyakw ibishushanyo vy’abakerubi n’ivy’ ibigazi n’ivy’ amashurwe asambuye, azomekakw izahabu ayikuyengeza no kur’ ivyo bishushanyo.
Urugo rw’inyubakwa arwubakisha amabuye abājwe imirongo itatu igerekeranye, n’uwundi murongo w’ibiti bibājwe vy’amasederi.
Igihe bātanguriye kwubaka itanguriro ry’iyo ngoro y’Uhoraho hāri mu mwaka ugira kane Salomo ari ku ngoma, mu kwezi kwa Zivu.
Mu mwaka ugira icumi na rimwe, mu kwezi kwa Bulu, ari kwo kwezi kw’umunani, barangiza iyo ngoro n’ivyayo vyose, nk’ukw icitegererezo cayo cose cari kimeze. Nuko yamaze imyaka ndwi ayubaka.
