Nuko baramukīnjūrira, ajana inzira ishika kw irembo ry’amafarasi rija mu rugo rw’umwami; bamwiciraho.
Maze Yehoyada ashinga isezerano hagati yiwe n’abantu bose n’umwami, ngo babe abantu b’ Uhoraho.
Abantu bose baca bagenda ku ngoro ya Bayali, barayisangangura, bamenagura n’ibicaniro vyayo n’ibishushanyo vyayo, kandi Matani umuherezi wa Bayali bamwicira imbere y’ibicaniro.

Maze Yehoyada ashirah’ abateramyi bo guteramira ingoro y’Uhoraho, bakarābga n’abaherezi n’Abalewi, abo Dawidi yashinze ko baba mu ngoro y’Uhoraho, ngo bosereze Uhoraho ibimazi, nk’uko vyanditswe mu vyagezwe vya Mose, bavyose banezerewe baririmba, nk’uko Dawidi yabishinze nyene.
Ashiraho n’abashibamyi bo ku birimba vy’urugo rw’ ingoro y’Uhoraho, kugira ngo ntihaze hagire umuntu ahumanye ku kintu na kimwe abicamwo.

Ajana ba bagabisha bagaba amajana, n’abaganwa, n’abagaba abantu, n’abantu bose bo mu gihugu; basohokana umwami mu ngoro y’Uhoraho, baramumanukana, bajana inzira ica mu kirimba co haruguru, bamushikana mu ngoro i bgami; baraheza bamushira ku ntebe y’ubgami.
Maz’ abantu bose bo mu gihugu baranezerwa, haba umutēkāno ku murwa. Uko ni ko bicishije Ataliya inkota.
Yowasi yar’ amaze imyaka ndwi igihe yaja ku ngoma; ayimarakw imyaka mirongwine i Yerusalemu. Nyina yitwa Sibiya w’i Beri‐sheba.
Yowasi akora ivyo Uhoraho abona kw ari vyiza igihe cose Yehoyada umuherezi yabayeho.
Yehoyada amuronkera abamikazi babiri, bavyarana abana b’abahungu n’abakobga.
Hanyuma y’ivyo Yowasi agira imigabo yo gusanisha ingoro y’ Uhoraho.

Akoranya abaherezi n’Abalewi, arababarira, ati Ni mugende muje mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda, mukoranye amahera mu Bisirayeli bose yo kuzogenda asanisha ingoro y’Imana yanyu uk’ umwaka utashe; kandi mubigirire umwete wo kubinyarutsa. Arikw abo Balewi ntibābinyarutsa.

Bukeye umwami ahamagaza umuherezi mukuru Yehoyada, aramubaza, ati N’iki cakubujije kubgira Abalewi gutoza Abayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu ikori, iryo Mose umusavyi w’Uhoraho yashingiye ikoraniro ry’Abisirayeli, ngo baritange kubg’ ihema ry’ibonaniro?
Kukw abahungu ba Ataliya, wa mugore mubi, bāri bārahubaguye ingoro y’Imana, kand’ ibintu vyose vyāri vyāragizwe inyegu, vyāri mur’ iyo ngoro y’Uhoraho, babiha za Bayali.
Maz’ umwami agera ko babāza isandugu, ngo bayitereke hanze, ku kirimba c’urugo rw’ingoro y’ Uhoraho.
Babitāngāza mu Buyuda hose n’i Yerusalemu ngo bazanire Uhoraho ikori, iryo Mose umusavyi w’Imana yashingiye Abisirayeli, igihe bāri mu bugaragwa.
Maz’ abaganwa bose n’abantu bose birabanezereza, bararizana, umuntu wese aterera mur’ iyo sandugu, gushitsa barangije.

Maz’ Abalewi, iyo babonye ko mur’ iyo sandugu harimw’ amahera menshi, bāca bayizanira ababgiriza b’umwami, maz’ umukarani w’umwami n’umubgiriza n’umuherezi mukuru bakaza, bakayacurānura, iyo sandugu bakayijana, bakayisubiza aho yar’ iri. Uko ni ko bābigenza uko bukeye, bagakoranya amahera menshi cane.

Maz’ umwami na Yehoyada bakayaha abāshinzwe gukoresha ibikorwa vyo kur’ iyo ngoro y’Uhoraho; na bo bakarārika abubatsi b’amabuye n’ababāji ngo basane iyo ngoro, bakarārika n’abacuzi b’ivyuma n’ imiringa vyo kuyisana nyene.
Nukw abo bakozi barakora, baja imbere mu gikorwa co gusana iyo ngoro y’Imana, basubira kuyihagarika nk’uko yahora, barayikomeza.

Bamaze kuyuzuza, bashikiriza umwami na Yehoyada amahera asigaye, na bo bayacurishamwo ivyo gukoresha mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho: ibikoreshwa vy’ubuherezi, n’ivyo gukoresha mu kwosa ibimazi, n’udukombe, n’ibintu vy’ amazahabu n’ivy’ ifeza. Nuko bama bosa ibimazi ubudasība mu ngoro y’Uhoraho igihe cose Yehoyada yamaze akiriho.
Ariko Yehoyada aramvye igihe kirekire ashika mu zabukuru, araheza arapfa; yapfuye amaze imyaka ijana na mirongwitatu.
Bamuhamba ku murwa wa Dawidi hamwe n’abami, kuko yakoze neza mu Bisirayeli, no ku Mana, no mu vy’ingoro yayo.
Hanyuma Yehoyada amaze gupfa, abaganwa b’i Buyuda baraza, bakubita inkoro hasi imbere y’umwami. Maz’ umwami yumviriza ivyabo.
Maze baca baheba ingoro y’Uhoraho Imana ya ba sekuruza, basaba Ashera n’ ibindi bishushanyo. Uburake bg’ Uhoraho buraheza buza ku Bayuda no ku b’i Yerusalemu kubg’ ico gicumuro cabo.
Yamar’ akagenda abarungikira abavugishwa na we bo kubagarukana kuri we, bakāma babāgiriza, ariko bo bakanka kwumva.

Maze Mpwemu w’Imana aza kuri Zekariya mwene Yehoyada umuherezi; ahagarara ahataramutse imbere y’abantu, arababarira, at’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho Imana agize, ngo N’iki kibateye gucumura ku vyagezwe vyiwe, bikababuza kuroranirwa? Ko mwahevye Uhoraho na we arabahevye.
Bamugīra inama, bamwicisha amabuye bivuye ku cagezwe c’umwami, bamutsinda mu nyubakwa yo ku ngoro y’Uhoraho.
Uko ni k’umwami Yowasi atibutse ineza Yehoyada se w’uwo Zekariya yamugiriye, akamwicira uwo mwana wiwe nyene. Akirikw arapfa, yaravuze, at’ Uhoraho n’arābe ibi, abihōre.

Maz’ uwo mwaka ushize, ingabo z’Abasiriya ziradūga, zitera Yowasi. Bashika i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu, bageseza abaganwa bose bo mu gihugu, barabamara, barungikira umwami w’i Damasiko iminyago yose babanyaze.

Kand’ izo ngabo z’Abasiriya zaje ar’ igitero gito, arik’ Uhoraho agabura ingabo nyinshi cane z’Abayuda mu maboko yabo, kuko bari bamuhevye, ari we Uhoraho Imana ya ba sekuruza. Nukw Abasiriya bashitsa kuri Yowasi itēka yaciriwe.

Hanyuma bahindukiye bamuvuyeko, basize arwaye asinzikaye, abantu bo mu banyarugo biwe bgite baramugarariza, bamutsinda ku kirwa ciwe, arapfa, kubg’ amaraso ya mwene Yehoyada umuherezi yavishije; baraheza bamuhamba ku murwa wa Dawidi, ariko ntibamuhamba mu mva z’ abandi bami.
Abāmugararije n’aba: Zabadi umwana wa Shimeyati Umwamonikazi, na Yehozabadi umwana wa Shimuriti Umunyamowabukazi.
Nukw ivy’ abahungu biwe, n’imbūri nyinshi yabūriwe, n’ ingene yasanishije ingoro y’Imana, biranditswe mu bidōnda inkuru vyo mu gitabo c’abami. Maz’ umuhungu wiwe Amaziya asubira ku ngoma yiwe.
Amaziya yar’ amaze imyaka mirongwibiri n’itanu igihe yaja ku ngoma, amara imyaka mirongwibiri n’icenda i Yerusalemu ari ku ngoma; nyina yitwa Yehoyadina w’i Yerusalemu nyene.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona kw ari vyiza, ariko ntiyabigirana umutima utunganye rwose.
Amaze kubona kw ahangamye ku ngoma, yica ba banyarugo bāri barishe umwami se wiwe.

Arikw abana babo ntiyabica, abigenza nk’uko vyanditswe mu gitabo c’ivyagezwe vya Mose, ivyashinzwe n’Uhoraho ngw Abavyeyi ntibaze bicwe bazize abana babo, kand’ abana ntibaze bicwe bazize abavyeyi: ngw Arik’ umuntu wese az’ azire iciwe caha.

Maze Amaziya akoranya Abayuda, abakurikiranya ukw amazu ya ba sekuruza ari, ngo bagabge n’abagaba ibihumbi n’abagaba amajana; abakoranya ar’ Abayuda bose n’Ababenyamini; arabaharūra uhereye ku bamaze imyaka mirongwibiri no kuja hejuru, asanga ar’ ingabo ibihumbi amajana atatu, abantu b’intōre bashobora gutabara mu ntambara, bazi uburyo bgo gutwara amacumu n’ inkinzo.
Arārika n’ingabo ibihumbi ijana mu Bisirayeli, abantu b’abahizi, abagerera italanto z’ ifeza ijana.
Hanyuma haza umuntu w’Imana kuri we, aramubarira, ati Mwami, izo ngabo z’Abisirayeli ntuzijane, kuk’ Uhoraho atari kumwe n’Abisirayeli, ari bo bano bantu bose b’Abefurayimu.
Ariko namba wiyumvira yuko mur’ ubgo buryo ari ho uzoronka intsinzi mu ntambara, Imana izotuma uneshwa n’abansi; ifise ububasha bgo kugutabara n’ubgo gutuma uneshwa.
Amaziya yishura uwo muntu w’Imana, at’ Arikw italanto ijana nahaye ingabo z’Abisirayeli, zo twozigira dute? Uwo muntu w’Imana aramwishura, at’ Uhoraho ashobora kuguha ibisumba ivyo kure.
Nuko Amaziya asobanura izo ngabo zaje kuri we zivuye i Bgefurayimu, ngo zisubire i wabo; ivyo bibatera kurakira Abayuda uburake bginshi, basubira i wabo bajanye umwikomo mwinshi.
Maze Amaziya agumya umutima, ajana ingabo ziwe baja mu Kiyaya c’Umunyu, bica mu Baseyiri abantu ibihumbi cumi.
Abandi ibihumbi cumi nyene Abayuda babafata mpiri, babajana ku gitandara c’imanga, babatembagarizayo, baravunagurika bose.
Ariko za ngabo Amaziya yashubijeyo ngo ntibajane na we, batera ibisagara vy’i Buyuda, bavudutse i Samariya kurinda bashika i Beti‐horoni, bavyicamw’ abantu ibihumbi bitatu, banyaga iminyago myinshi.
Hanyuma Amaziya atabarutse, avuye kwica Abanyedomu, azana ibigirwamana vy’abo Baseyiri; arabishinga ngo bibe imana ziwe, arabipfukamira, avyosereza imibavu.
Ni co catumye uburake bg’Uhoraho buziriringira Amaziya, amutumak’ umuntu yavugisha; uno muntu aramubaza, ati N’iki gituma urondera imana zitākijije bene zo ngo zibakūre mu maboko yawe?

Akirikw aramubarira, umwami aramubaza, ati Har’ aho twākwātiye ng’ uje mu bashingantahe banje? Ziba, ntuhave ukubitwa! Nuk’ uwo muvugishwa arahora, arikw aravuga, ati Nzi yukw Imana yagabiye kukwica, ko wakoze ivyo, kandi wanse kwumva inama yanje.
Bukeye Amaziya umwami w’ Abayuda aja inama, atuma kuri Yehowasi mwene Yehowahazi, Yehowahazi mwene Yehu, umwami w’Abisirayeli, muti N’uze muhangane.

Yehowasi umwami w’ Abisirayeli atuma kwishura Amaziya umwami w’i Buyuda, mut’ Igitovu c’i Lebanoni catumye kw isederi y’i Lebanoni nyene, ut’ Umukobga wawe n’umushingire umuhungu waco. Bukeye igikōko caba i Lebanoni kihahise gikandagira ca gitovu.
Nka ko uravuga, ngo Waratsinze Abanyedomu, uraheza wishira hejuru mu mutima wawe, urihayagiza; none rero n’ugume i muhira; n’iki gituma ugomba kwikwegera akaziri, mugapfa mwe n’Abayuda?
Ariko Amaziya ntiyaruha amwumvira; kukw ivyo vyari bivuye ku Mana, kugira ngw ibagabure mu maboko y’abansi babo, kuko bagiye kurondera ibigirwamana vy’Abanyedomu.
Nuko Yehowasi umwami w’Abisirayeli ni kwo kudūga, bahanganira na Amaziya umwami w’i Buyuda i Beti‐shemeshi h’i Buyuda nyene, bararumana.
Maz’ Abayuda baneshwa n’Abisirayeli, umuntu wese ahungira i we.

Maze Yehowasi umwami w’Abisirayeli afata mpiri Amaziya umwami w’i Buyuda, mwene Yowasi, Yowasi mwene Ahaziya, amufatira i Beti‐shemeshi nyene; aca aja i Yerusalemu, asangangura uruzitiro rwaho rw’amabuye, uhereye kw irembo ry’Abefurayimu ugashitsa kw irembo ryo ku mfuruka, hose har’ amatambge amajana ane y’ukuboko uciriye mu nkokora.

Asahura amazahabu n’amafeza yose, n’ibintu vyose vy’imbombovu bāsanze mu ngoro y’Imana bijejwe Obed‐edomu, n’ivyo bāsanze mu bubīko bgo mu ngoro y’umwami, afata n’ abantu abajana bari mu bugombe, araheza asubira i Samariya.
Yehowasi mwene Yehowahazi umwami w’Abisirayeli amaze gutanga, Amaziya mwene Yowasi umwami w’i Buyuda amara iyindi myaka cumi n’itanu.
Ibindi vyose vyadonzwe kuri Amaziya, uhereye ku ca mbere ugashitsa ku c’imperēra, none ntivyanditswe mu gitabo c’abami b’i Buyuda n’i Bgisirayeli?
Kuva igihe Amaziya arekeye gukurikira Uhoraho baciye bamuvyukiriza umugararizo i Yerusalemu, araheza ahungira i Lakishi; barungika abamukurikirana i Lakishi, bamutsindayo.
Umuvyimba wiwe bawuremēka amafarasi, barawuzana bamuhamba hamwe na ba sekuruza ku murwa w’i Buyuda.
Nukw abantu bose b’Abayuda bahitana Uziya baramwimika, bamusubiza ku ngoma ya se Amaziya; Uziya yar’ amaze imyaka cumi n’itandatu.
Ni we yasanasannye i Eloti, ahagarura i Buyuda, umwami Amaziya amaze guhamvya ba sekuruza.
Nuko Uziya yar’ amaze imyaka cumi n’itandatu igihe yaja ku ngoma, araheza ayimarakw imyaka mirongwitanu n’ibiri i Yerusalemu. Nyina yitwa Yekiliya w’i Yerusalemu nyene.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona kw ari vyiza, nk’ivyo se Amaziya yakora vyose.
Ashira umutima ku kurondera Imana mu gihe cose ca Zekariya, umuntu yamwigishije kwubaha Imana; kand’ uko yakomeje kurondera Uhoraho, Imana yamuhaye umugisha.
Bukeye aragenda atera Abafilisitiya, asangangura uruzitiro rw’i Gati n’urw’ i Yabune n’urw’ i Ashidodi; yubaka ibisagara mu ntāra y’i Ashidodi n’ahandi mu gihugu c’Abafilisitiya nyene.
Nukw Imana iramufasha, arwanya n’abo Bafilisitiya bo n’Abarabo bāba i Guribayali, bo n’ab’i Mayoni.
Kand’ Abamoni bazanira Uziya ingorore; nukw izina ryiwe rirāmāmara, rishika n’ahafata muri Egiputa; kuko yagiye arushiriza kugira ububasha.
Kandi Uziya yubaka iminara i Yerusalemu kw irembo ryo ku mfuruka y’uruzitiro rwaho rw’ amabuye, no kw irembo rija ku mwonga, no ku yindi mfuruka y’ uruzitiro nyene; iyo minara arayigumya.

Kandi yubaka iminara no mu bugaragwa, yimbisha n’ivyobo vyinshi vyo kubīka amazi, kuko yar’ afise amasho menshi mu gihugu gishashe no mu biyaya; yar’ afise n’abarimyi n’abazi gutunganya imizabibu mu misozi no mu matongo amera cane, kuko yar’ umurimyi.

Kandi Uziya yar’ afise ingabo z’abarwanyi, bāja kurwana bīcīye ibitero, nk’ukw ibitigiri vyabo vyashinzwe, uko bāharūwe na Yeyeli umukarani na Mayaseya umwanditsi, bāgabga na Hananiya, umwe mu bagabisha b’umwami.
Igitigiri cose c’abakuru b’ amazu ya ba sekuruza, abantu b’ abahizi, bar’ ibihumbi bibiri n’ amajana atandatu.
Kand’ abo bāgaba ingabo zigishijwe kurwana, ibihumbi amajana atatu n’ ibihumbi ndwi n’amajana atanu, bārwanana ubuhizi bginshi, barwanira umwami ngo ntāneshwe n’abansi.
Uziya aronderera izo ngabo zose inkinzo n’amacumu, n’inkofero z’ivyuma, n’amakoti y’ivyuma, n’imiheto, n’amabuye atereshwa umugozi.

Kand’ i Yerusalemu ahakoreshereza ibintu vy’intambara vyigenewe n’ abahinga, bifise imishibuka irasa imyampi ikavundereza amabuye manini‐manini, vyo gushirwa ku minara no hejuru ku mfuruka z’ uruzitiro. Izina ryiwe riba rurangiranwa, rirāmāmara, kuko yafashijwe bitangaje, gushitsa aho yabereye agahambaye.

Arikw amaze kuba agahambaye, yishira hejuru mu mutima wiwe, bituma akora ivyo kugabitanya, acumura k’Uhoraho Imana yiwe; kuko yinjiye mu rusengero rw’Uhoraho ngo yosereze imibavu ku gicaniro ihora yoserezwako.
Maze Azariya umuherezi aca arinjira amukurikiye, ari kumwe n’abandi baherezi b’Uhoraho mirongumunani, abantu b’abahizi;

babuza umwami Uziya, baramubarira, bat’ Ewe Uziya, s’igikorwa cawe kwosereza Uhoraho imibavu, n’ic’ abaherezi bo mu ba Aroni bārobanuriwe kwama bayosa. Enda va aha hantu hēra, kuk’ ucumuye, kand’ ivyo nta cubahiro bizoguhesha kivuye k’ Uhoraho Imana.

Maze Uziya aca araraka; kandi yar’ afise icotero mu ntoke, agira ngo yose imibavu. Akirakiye abo baherezi, imibembe isēsa mu ruhanga rwiwe, akir’ aho nyene imbere y’ abaherezi mu ngoro y’Uhoraho, i ruhande y’igicaniro coserezwakw imibavu.

Maze Azariya umuherezi mukuru n’abandi baherezi bose bagize ngo baramurāba, babona imibembe ishēshe mu ruhanga rwiwe; bakwakwanya kumusunika ngw ahave, na we nyene ubgiwe yihuta gusohoka, kuk’ Uhoraho amuteje indwara.

Nuk’ umwami Uziya arinda atanga akir’ umunyamibembe, aba mu nzu ya wenyene kubg’ imibembe yiwe, kukw atemerewe kuza mu ngoro y’Uhoraho; maze Yotamu umwana wiwe ni we yagaba ivyo mu rugo i bgami, agacira abantu bo mu gihugu imanza.
Nukw ibindi vyose vyadonzwe kuri Uziya, uhereye ku ca mbere ugashitsa ku c’imperēra, vyanditswe n’uwavugishwa n’Imana Yesaya mwene Amosi.
Nuko Uziya ahamvya ba sekuruza, bamuhamba hamwe na bo; mugabo bamushira ukwiwe mw itongo rihambgamw’ abami, kuko bāvuga kw ar’ umunyamibembe. Maz’ uwo muhungu wiwe Yotamu asubira ku ngoma yiwe.
Yotamu yar’ amaze imyaka mirongwibiri n’itanu aho yima; amara imyaka cumi n’ itandatu i Yerusalemu ari ku ngoma. Nyina yitwa Yerusha, umukobga wa Sadoki.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona kw ari vyiza, nk’ ivyo se Uziya yakoze vyose. Mugabo we ntiyinjiye mu rusengero rw’Uhoraho. Arikw abantu bākomeje kwihumanya.
Ni we yubatse ikirimba co haruguru ku ngoro y’Uhoraho, yubaka n’ibindi vyinshi ku ruzitiro rw’i Ofeli.
Kandi yubaka n’ibisagara mu mugamba w’i Buyuda, n’amaboma n’iminara mu bibira.

Arwana n’umwami w’Abamoni; abo Bamoni arabanesha. Nuko mur’ uwo mwaka Abamoni bamugororera italanto z’ifeza ijana, n’ingero zitwa koro ibihumbi cumi z’ingano, n’ingero ibihumbi cumi nyene za sayiri. No mu mwaka wa kabiri n’uwa gatatu bāmuzaniye nk’ivyo nyene.
Nuko Yotamu aba ūhambaye, kuko yagenda atunganya ingeso ziwe imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yiwe.
Nukw ibindi vyose vyadōnzwe kuri Yotamu, n’intambara zose yarwanye, n’ivy’ ingeso ziwe, vyanditswe mu gitabo c’abami b’ Abisirayeli n’ab’ Abayuda.
Yar’ amaze imyaka mirongwibiri n’ itanu aho yaja ku ngoma; ayimarakw imyaka cumi n’itandatu i Yerusalemu.
Maze Yotamu ahamvya ba sekuruza, bamuhamba ku murwa wa Dawidi; maz’ umuhungu wiwe Ahazi asubira ku ngoma yiwe.
Ahazi yar’ amaze imyaka mirongwibiri igihe yima, amara imyaka cumi n’itandatu i Yerusalemu ari ku ngoma. Mugabo ntiyakora ivyo Uhoraho abona kw ari vyiza, nk’uko sekuruza Dawidi yakora;
ariko yagendera mu ngeso z’abami b’Abisirayeli, agakoresha ibishushanyo vya za Bayali bivugutiwe mu nkero.

Ikigeretseko, yosereza imibavu mu mwonga wa mwene Hinomu, atanga n’abana biwe kw ibimazi ngo boserezwe mu muriro, nk’ ukw ibizira vy’ubuyobe vy’abanyamahanga vyari bimeze, abo Uhoraho yari yarirukanye imbere y’Abisirayeli.
Yatanga ibimazi akosereza imibavu mu bitabo no ku mpinga z’imisozi no musi y’ igiti cose gitotahaye.

Kubg’ ivyo Uhoraho Imana yiwe amugabura mu maboko y’umwami w’i Siriya. Abasiriya baramunesha, bafata mpiri benshi cane mu bantu biwe, babajana i Damasiko ar’ inyagano. Arongera agaburwa mu maboko y’umwami w’Abisirayeli, na we aramunesha, yica benshi cane.
Kuk’ uwo mwami Peka mwene Remaliya yishe mu Bayuda ingabo ibihumbi ijana na mirongwibiri ku musi umwe, bose ar’ abantu b’abahizi; inyanduruko n’uko bāri baretse Uhoraho Imana ya ba sekuruza.
Kandi Zikuri, umuntu w’umuhizi wo mu Befurayimu, yica Mayaseya umwana w’umwami, na Azurikamu umubgiriza wo mu ngoro i bgami, na Elukana uwa kabiri ku mwami.
Nukw Abisirayeli bajana mu b’i wabo abantu ibihumbi amajana abiri ar’ inyagano, b’abagore n’ abahungu n’abakobga, babasahura n’amasahu menshi cane, babijana i Samariya.

Ariko hāriy’ ūvugishwa n’Uhoraho yitwa Odedi; aragenda aja gusanganira izo ngabo zihindukiye i Samariya, arababarira, at’ Ereg’ icātumye Uhoraho Imana ya ba sogokuruza agabura Abayuda mu maboko yanyu n’uko yar’ abarakiye, ariko mwebge mwabicanye ishavu ryinshi rishika mw ijuru.
None mugabiye kugandura Abayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu ngo mubagire abagurano n’abaguranokazi; aho mwebge nta bicumuro mufise vyanyu ubganyu mwācumuye k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu?
Enda rero ni munyumve, ni musubizey’ aba bantu b’i wanyu mwanyaze; kuk’ uburake bg’inkazi bg’Uhoraho buri kuri mwebge.
Maz’ abaganwa bamwe b’Abefurayimu, Azariya mwene Yohanani, na Berekiya mwene Meshilemoti, na Yehizikiya mwene Shalumu, na Amasa mwene Hadulayi, barahaguruka, babuza abo batabārutse mu ntambara,

barababarira, bat’ Abo bantu b’inyagano ntimubazane ngaha; kukw ico mugomba gukora kizoducumuza k’ Uhoraho, congereze ivyaha vyacu n’ibicumuro vyacu; kuko na none twācumuye bikomeye, kandi twebge Abisirayeli dufitiwe uburake bg’inkazi.
Nukw izo ngabo zica zisiga abo bantu b’inyagano bo n’amasahu basahuye imbere y’ abo baganwa, n’imbere y’abāhakoraniye bose.

Maz’ abo bantu bavuzwe amazina barahaguruka, bābīra abo bantu b’inyagano; abāri bambaye ubusa bose bo muri bo babambika ivyo bakūye mu masahu, babaha impuzu n’ inkweto, barabagaburira, babaha n’ivyo kunywa, babasiga amavuta; abananiwe bose muri bo babashira ku ndogoba, babashikana mu b’i wabo i Yeriko, igisagara c’ibigazi; baraheza basubira i Samariya.
Ico gihe umwami Ahazi atuma ku mwami w’i Ashuri ngw amutabare,
kukw Abanyedomu bāri bongeye gutera i Buyuda, bakahanesha, bakajana abaho ar’ inyagano.

Kandi n’Abafilisitiya na bo bāri bateye ibisagara vyo mu kiyaya, n’ivy’ i Buyuda bg’i bumanuko, bafata i Beti‐shemeshi, n’i Ayaloni, n’i Gederoti, n’i Sokoho, n’ibisagara bihakūkira, n’i Timuna n’ibisagara bihakūkira, n’i Gimuzo na ho nyene n’ibisagara bihakūkira; baca barahinjira.
Uhoraho yari yacishije Abayuda bugufi, abahōye Ahazi umwami wabo, kuko yakoze ivy’ isoni nke mu Buyuda, agacumura k’Uhoraho bitangaje.
Nuko Tigulati‐pileseri umwami w’i Ashuri aza kuri we; ariko mu gishingo co kumuremesha amurandura umutima.
Kuko Ahazi yābiriye ibintu bimwe vyo mu ngoro y’Uhoraho, no mu ngoro yiwe ubgiwe, no mu mazu y’ abaganwa, akabishikanira umwami w’i Ashuri; ariko ntivyagira ico bimumarira.
Maz’ uwo mwami Ahazi nyene, igihe aburaniwe arushiriza kuja imbere gucumura k’ Uhoraho,
kuko yahaye ibimazi imana z’i Damasiko zamunesheje, akavuga, at’ Izo mana z’abami b’i Siriya ko zabafashije, hinge nanje ndazihe ibimazi zintabare. Ariko zāmukwegeye akaziri, bo n’Abisirayeli bose.
Nuko Ahazi akoranya ibintu vyose vy’imbombovu vyo mu ngoro y’Imana, arabijanjagura, yugara inzugi z’iyo ngoro y’Uhoraho; yiyubakira ibicaniro ahantu hose h’i Yerusalemu.
No mu gisagara cose c’i Buyuda atabamw’ ibitabo vy’aho kwosereza imibavu izindi mana, atera umwikomo Uhoraho Imana ya ba sekuruza.
Ibindi vyose vyadonzwe kuri we, n’ivy’ ingeso ziwe zose, uhereye ku vya mbere ugashitsa ku vy’ imperēra, vyanditswe mu gitabo c’abami b’Abayuda n’ab’ Abisirayeli.
Nuko Ahazi ahamvya ba sekuruza, bamuhamba ku murwa w’i Yerusalemu, kuko batāmuhamvye mu mva z’abami b’i Buyuda; maz’ umuhungu wiwe Hezekiya asubira ku ngoma yiwe.
Hezekiya yar’ amaze imyaka mirongwibiri n’itanu igihe yima, amara imyaka mirongwibiri n’icenda i Yerusalemu ari ku ngoma. Nyina yitwa Abiya, umukobga wa Zekariya.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona kw ari vyiza, nk’ ivyo sekuruza Dawidi yakoze vyose.
Mu mwaka wa mbere agiye ku ngoma, mu kwezi kwa mbere, yugurura inzugi z’ingoro y’Uhoraho, arazisana.
Ahamagaza abaherezi n’Abalewi, abakoraniriza mu karusha gahera i burasirazuba,
arababarira, ati Ni muntege amatwi, yemwe Balewi; enda ni mwiyeze, mweze n’ingoro y’Uhoraho Imana ya ba sogokuruza banyu, mukūre ibihumanya Ahēra Cane.
Kuko ba sogokuruza bacu bācumuye, bagakora ivyo Uhoraho Imana yacu abona kw ari bibi, bakamuta, bakarora irya, bagakūra amaso ahantu Uhoraho aba, bakahatera ibitugu.
Ikindi, bugaye inzugi zo ku rubaraza, amatara barayazimya, kandi ntibosereza imibavu Imana y’Abisirayeli, canke ngo bosereze ibimazi Ahantu hēra;
ni co catumye uburake bg’Uhoraho buza ku Bayuda no ku b’i Yerusalemu, akabatanga ngo babe akūmiza n’akajoreza, n’abo kuvuzwakw agahwa, nk’uko namwe muvyibonera n’amaso yanyu.
Ereg’ ivyo ni vyo vyatumye ba sogokuruza bacu bicwa n’inkota, kand’ abahungu bacu n’abakobga bacu n’abagore bacu bakaba bārabaye inyagano.
None ngabiye mu mutima wanje gusezerana isezerano n’Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli, kugira ng’ uburake bgiwe bg’inkazi butuveko.
None rero bana banje, mureke kuvyanjanjwako, kukw ari mwebge Uhoraho yatoranije ngo mumuhagarare imbere, mumusukurire, mube abasuku biwe, mwose imibavu.

Maz’ Abalewi bava hasi, Mahati mwene Amasayi, na Yoweli mwene Azariya, bo mu ba Kohati; n’abo mu ba Merari, Kishi mwene Abudi, na Azariya mwene Yehaleleli; n’abo mu ba Gerushoni, Yowa mwene Zima, na Edeni mwene Yowa.
Abo mu ba Elisafani ni Shimuri na Yeweli; abo mu ba Asafu ni Zekariya na Mataniya;
abo mu ba Hemani ni Yehuweli na Shimeyi; abo mu ba Yedutuni ni Shemaya na Uziyeli.
Bakoranya bagenzi babo, bariyeza; baraheza barinjira ngo bahumanure iyo ngoro y’Uhoraho, nk’uk’ umwami yageze, kandi nk’uk’ Uhoraho yabgirije.

Abaherezi baja haruguru mur’ iyo ngoro y’Uhoraho kugira ngo bahahumanure, ibihumanya vyose basanze mur’ urwo rusengero rwiwe babisohora mu rugo rw’iyo ngoro yiwe. Abalewi baraheza baravyābīra, babijana hirya ku mugezi Kidironi.

Kandi bāri bahēreye ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa mbere mu gutangura ivy’ ukweza; ku musi ugira umunani w’ukwo kwezi bashika ku rubaraza rw’Uhoraho; nuko bamara imisi munani beza iyo ngoro y’Uhoraho; maze ku musi ugira icumi na gatandatu w’ ukwo kwezi kwa mbere bararangiza.

Baraheza baja i bgami, bashika i kare ah’ umwami Hezekiya ari, baramubarira, bati Tumaze guhumanura ingoro yose y’ Uhoraho, n’igicaniro co kwoserezakw ibimazi bo n’ibintu vyaco vyose, n’ameza y’imitsima y’ibiterekērwa n’ibintu vyayo vyose.
Kandi n’ibintu vyose umwami Ahazi yataye mu gucumura kwiwe igihe yari ku ngoma, twabitunganije, turavyeza; none bir’ imbere y’igicaniro c’Uhoraho.
Bukeye umwami Hezekiya akoroka kare, akoranya abaganwa bo kur’ uwo murwa, aradūga aja ku ngoro y’Uhoraho.

Bazana amamasa ndwi, n’amapfizi y’intama ndwi, n’imyagazi y’intama ndwi, n’amapfizi y’impene ndwi nyene, kw ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha, ngo babitangire ubgami n’urusengero n’Abayuda. Abarira abaherezi bene Aroni kubitangira ku gicaniro c’Uhoraho.

Nuko bakerera ayo mamasa, abaherezi batega amaraso, bayamija ku gicaniro; bakerera n’ayo mapfizi y’intama, bamija amaraso yayo kur’ ico gicaniro, bakerera n’iyo myagazi y’intama, bamija n’amaraso yayo kur’ ico gicaniro nyene.
Maze ya mapfizi y’ impene bayīgiza hafi imbere y’ umwami n’ikoraniro, ngw abe ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha; baraheza bayarambikakw ibiganza.

Abaherezi barayakerera, batanga amaraso yayo ku gicaniro kw ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha, ngo bahongerere Abayuda bose; kuk’ umwami yavuze kw ikimazi co kwoswa n’ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha bitangirwa Abayuda bose.

Kand’ ashira Abalewi mu ngoro y’Uhoraho bafise ivyo kuvuza vyitwa matowazi n’amakembe n’inanga, nk’uko vyashinzwe na Dawidi na Gadi kamenyi w’ umwami na Natani yavugishwa n’ Imana, kukw ico cagezwe cari kivuye k’Uhoraho agitumye abo yavugisha.
Nukw abo Balewi bahagarara ngaho bafise ivyo kuvuza vyashinzwe na Dawidi, n’ abaherezi na bo bafise inzumbete.

Maze Hezekiya avuga kw ikimazi co kwoswa bacosereza ku gicaniro. Nukw ico kimazi bagitanguye kucosa, abaririmba indirimbo y’Uhoraho na bo bashirako, bo n’abavuza inzumbete n’ibindi vyo kuvuza vyashinzwe na Dawidi umwami w’Abisirayeli.
Maz’ ikoraniro ryose rirasenga, abaririmvyi bakaririmba, abavuza inzumbete bakavuza; vyose biba birtyo gushitsa ah’ ikimazi coshejwe kirangiriye.
Nukw ivy’ ico kimazi birangiye, umwami n’abari kumwe na we barūnama, barasenga.
Kand’ umwami Hezekiya n’abaganwa babarira Abalewi kuririmbira Uhoraho ishimwe mu ndirimbo za Dawidi n’iza Asafu kamenyi; nuko baririmba ishimwe banezerewe, bunamika amaso, barasenga.

Maze Hezekiya arababarira, ati None ko mwirobanuriye Uhoraho, mwīgire hafi, muzane ibimazi n’amashikanwa yo gukenguruka mu ngoro y’Uhoraho. Nukw iryo koraniro rizana ibimazi n’amashikanwa yo gukenguruka; n’abāri bafise imitima ikunze bose bazana ibimazi vyo kwosa.
Igitigiri c’ibimazi vyo kwoswa ikoraniro ryazanye car’ amapfizi mirongwirindwi n’amapfizi y’intama ijana n’imyagazi y’intama amajana abiri; ivyo vyose vyar’ ivyo kuba ikimazi co kwosereza Uhoraho.
Kand’ ibimazi vyejejwe vyar’ amapfizi amajana atandatu n’intama ibihumbi bitatu.

Arikw abaherezi baba bake, ntibāshobora kubāga ibimazi vyose vyo kwoswa; ni co catumye bagenzi babo b’ Abalewi babafasha, gushitsa ah’ igikorwa kirangiriye, no gushitsa ah’ abandi baherezi bāri bamaze kwiyeza, kukw Abalewi bārusha abaherezi kugororoka mu mitima yabo bigatuma bakunda kwiyeza.

Kand’ ivyo bimazi vyo kwoswa vyari vyinshi cane, hamwe n’ibinure vy’ibimazi vy’ishimwe, n’ amashikanwa y’ibiturire yagendana n’ikimazi cose co kwoswa. Uko ni kw ibikorwa vyo mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho vyatunganijwe.
Nuko Hezekiya agira akanyamuneza, bo n’abantu bose, kubg’ ivyo Imana yateguriye abantu, kuko vyakozwe giturumbuka.

Bukeye Hezekiya atuma ku Bisirayeli no ku Bayuda bose, yandikira n’ivyete Abefurayimu n’Abamanase, ngo baze kugira umusi mukuru w’ivya Pasika y’Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli, mu ngoro y’Uhoraho i Yerusalemu.
Kuk’ umwami n’abaganwa biwe n’ikoraniro ryose ry’ i Yerusalemu bari bagiye inama yo kugira umusi mukuru w’ivya Pasika mu kwezi kwa kabiri.
Ntivyābashobokeye mu gihe gikwiye, kukw igitigiri c’abaherezi biyejeje cāri gito, kand’ abantu batākoraniye i Yerusalemu.
Nuk’ umwami n’iryo koraniro ryose barabishima;

bashinga ko bitāngāzwa mu Bgisirayeli hose, uhereye i Berisheba ugashitsa i Dani, ngo baze i Yerusalemu ku musi mukuru wa Pasika y’Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli; kuko batāri bakiza ari benshi nk’uko vyari vyarashinzwe.

Nukw intumwa zijana ivyete bivuye ku mwami n’abaganwa biwe, zibikwiza mu Bgisirayeli hose no mu Buyuda, zivuga nk’uk’ umwami yashinze, ziti Yemwe Bisirayeli, ni mugaruke k’Uhoraho Imana ya Aburahamu na Isaka na Isirayeli, kugira ngo na we agaruke kuri mwebge abasigaye barokotse abami b’i Ashuri.
Ngo Kandi ntimuse na ba sogokuruza banyu, cank’ abandi b’i wanyu bāgenda bacumura k’Uhoraho Imana ya ba sekuruza, bigatuma ibatanga bakagesezwa, nk’uko namwe mubibona.

Ngo None rero mweho ntimugamike amazosi nka ba sogokuruza banyu, ariko muyoboke Uhoraho, muze muze mu rusengero rwiwe yejeje gushitsa ibihe vyose, mube abasavyi b’Uhoraho Imana yanyu, kugira ng’ uburake bgiwe bg’inkazi bubaveko.

Ngo Kuko ni mwahindukirira Uhoraho, ab’ i wanyu n’abana banyu bazotera akagongwe abābajanye ar’ inyagano, babarekure bagaruke mur’ iki gihugu; ngo Kuk’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu ar’ umunyabuntu kandi n’umunyembabazi, ntazobakūrakw inyonga ziwe ni mwamugarukako.
Nukw izo ntumwa ziragenda, zihetura ibisagara vyose vyo mu gihugu c’Abefurayimu n’ic’ Abamanase, zirinda zishika no mu c’ Abazebuloni; ariko barazitwenga cane, barazishinyagurira.
Mugabo bamwe bo mu Basheri no mu Bamanase no mu Bazebuloni barīhanūra, baja i Yerusalemu.
Kandi n’i Buyuda ukuboko kw’ Imana kubaha guhūza umutima, bumvira ico cagezwe c’umwami n’ abaganwa kivuye kw ijambo ry’ Uhoraho.
Nuko mu kwezi kwa kabiri hakoranira abantu benshi i Yerusalemu, kugira umusi mukuru w’ imitsima itambiwe, ar’ ikoraniro rinini cane.
Bakūra hasi, bakūrah’ ibicaniro vyar’ i Yerusalemu, n’ibicaniro vyose vyo kwoserezakw imibavu, babita mu mugezi Kidironi.
Maze ku musi ugira icumi na kane wo mur’ ukwo kwezi kwa kabiri, babāga ivya Pasika; maz’ abaherezi n’Abalewi baramāramāra, baraheza barīyeza, bazana ibimazi vyo kwoswa mu ngoro y’Uhoraho.
Bahagarara mu myanya yabo basanganywe, nk’uko vyashinzwe na Mose umuntu w’Imana; abo baherezi bamija amaraso, Abalewi ari bo bayabahēreje;
kuko mur’ iryo koraniro hāri benshi batiyejeje, bituma Abalewi ari bo bagerwa kubāgira umwagazi wa Pasika umuntu wese ahumanye, kugira ngo babēreze Uhoraho.

Kukw abantu benshi cane batāri biyejeje, cane‐cane bār’ abo mu Befurayimu no mu Bamanase no mu Bisakari no mu Bazebuloni, bagapfa kurya ivya Pasika uburyo butemewe n’ivyanditswe. Kandi Hezekiya yari yābasengeye,
at’ Uhoraho, ari we munyabuntu, n’aharire umuntu wese ashize umutima ku kurondera Imana, ari we Uhoraho Imana ya ba sekuruza, nah’ atejejwe nk’ukw ivyagezwe vy’urusengero rwera biri.
Nuk’ Uhoraho yumvira Hezekiya, atunga abantu.

Nukw Abisirayeli bāri bakoraniye i Yerusalemu bamara imisi ndwi bari mu misi mikuru y’imitsima itambiwe bafise umunezero mwinshi; kand’ Abalewi n’abaherezi bāhimbaza Uhoraho uko bukeye, bamuririmbira n’amajwi arenga.

Hezekiya aremēsha imitima y’Abalewi bose bāgira umwete wo gukorera Uhoraho. Nukw abantu bamara iyo misi ndwi barya ivy’ iyo misi mikuru, batanga ibimazi vy’ishimwe, bakengurukira Uhoraho Imana ya ba sekuruza.
Maz’ ikoraniro ryose baja inama yo kwongera kumara iyindi misi mikuru ndwi; nuko bayimara banezerewe.

Kuko Hezekiya umwami w’Abayuda yari yahaye iryo koraniro amamasa igihumbi n’intama ibihumbi ndwi vyo gutanga kw ibimazi, abaganwa na bo bariha amamasa igihumbi nyene, n’intama ibihumbi cumi; nukw abaherezi benshi bariyeza.
Nukw iryo koraniro ryose ry’Abayuda riranezerwa, bo n’abaherezi n’ Abalewi, n’ikoraniro ryose ryavuye i Bgisirayeli, n’abari baravuye mu gihugu c’i Bgisirayeli bakaza kuba i Buyuda.
Nukw i Yerusalemu haba akanyamuneza kenshi, kuk’ uhereye ku ngoma ya Salomo mwene Dawidi umwami w’Abisirayeli, hatāri harīgeze kuba ibihwanye n’ivyo i Yerusalemu.
Maz’ abaherezi, ari bo Balewi, barahaguruka, bahezagira abantu; ijwi ryabo ryumvikana ku Mana, ugusenga kwabo gushika ahēra hayo ah’ iba, ari ho mw ijuru.

Nukw ivyo vyose bishize, Abisirayeli bose bāri bakoraniye aho, baca baja mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda, bamenagura amabuye bāshinze, batemagura inkingi bāshingiye Ashera, basibanganya ibitabo vyo ku mpinga z’imisozi, basangangura n’ibicaniro vy’i Buyuda n’i Bubenyamini, bo n’i Bgefurayimu no mu bg’Abamanase, gushitsa aho babiherengetereje vyose. Abisirayeli bose barahindukira, basubira mu bisagara vyabo, umuntu wese mw ishamvu yiwe.

Maze Hezekiya ashinga imbu z’abaherezi n’Abalewi, nk’uko zari zisanzwe, nk’uk’ umuntu wese muri bo yar’ asanzwe akora, ar’ abo gutanga ibimazi vyoswa, ar’ abo gutanga ibimazi vy’ishimwe, ar’ abo guhēreza, ar’ abo gushima, ar’ abo guhimbaza, bahagaze ku birimba vy’urugo rw’Uhoraho.

Umwami agera n’umugabane w’ivyo azotanga ku vyo atunze, ku vy’ ibimazi vyo kwoswa bizotangwa mu gitondo no ku mugoroba, n’ibimazi vyo kwoswa ku masabato, n’ivyo mu mboneko z’ukwezi, n’ivy’ imisi mikuru yashinzwe, nk’uko vyanditswe mu vyagezwe vy’Uhoraho.
Kand’ agera kw abantu bose baba i Yerusalemu batanga ivyashinzwe guhabga abaherezi n’Abalewi, kugira ngo babone kwitwaririka ivyagezwe vy’Uhoraho.

Nukw ico cagezwe kimaze gutāngāzwa, Abisirayeli bazana vyinshi cane vy’ umushuzo w’ingano na vino n’ amavuta ya elayo n’ubūki n’ ivyeze vyose vyo mu mirima; kandi n’ikigiracumi ca vyose babizana ari vyinshi cane.
Kand’ Abisirayeli n’Abayuda, bāba mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda, na bo bazana ikigiracumi c’inka n’intama, n’ ikigiracumi c’ibintu vyejejwe bigashikanirwa Uhoraho Imana yabo, ivyo bintu babigira ibirundo.
Mu kwezi kwa gatatu ni ho batanguye kurunda ivyo birundo, babirangiza mu kwezi kw’indwi.
Maze Hezekiya n’abaganwa baje, bakabona ivyo birundo, baciye bashima Uhoraho n’abantu biwe b’Abisirayeli.
Maze Hezekiya abaza abaherezi n’Abalewi ivy’ ivyo birundo.

Azariya umuherezi mukuru, umuntu wo mu nzu ya Sadoki, aramwishura, at’ Uhereye igihe abantu batanguriye kuzana amashikanwa mu ngoro y’Uhoraho, twagiye tubona ivyo kurya, tugahāga, tugasigaza vyinshi; kuk’ Uhoraho yahaye abantu biwe umugisha, kand’ ibisāgutse ni vyo ibi bingana birtyo.
Maze Hezekiya araheza ababarira ko batunganya ivyumba vyo mu ngoro y’Uhoraho; nuko barabitunganya;
babishiramw’ ayo mashikanwa n’ivyo bigiracumi, n’ivyo bintu vyagizwe inyegu, babikoze nk’uko bizigiwe; umukuru yabijejwe yari Konaniya Umulewi, agakurikirwa na murumuna we Shimeyi.

Yehiyeli na Azaziya na Nahati, na Asaheli na Yerimoti na Yozabadi, na Eliyeli na Isimakiya na Mahati na Benaya, ni bo bār’ ababgiriza bāgabga na Konaniya na murumuna we Shimeyi, nk’uk’ umwami Hezekiya yabishinze, bo na Azariya umubgiriza w’ingoro y’Imana.

Kandi Kore, mwene Imuna Umulewi, umukumirizi w’irembo ry’i burasirazuba, ni we yar’ ajejwe amashikanwa bashikaniye Imana bavyigombeye, agatanga imigabane ku mashikanwa y’Uhoraho no ku bintu vyera cane.

Mu bisagara vy’abaherezi yar’ afise abizigirwa yagaba, ni bo aba: Edeni na Minyamini na Yeshuwa na Shemaya na Amariya na Shekaniya; yabagaba mu gikorwa cabo co guha imigabane bagenzi babo, uhereye ku bakuru n’abatoya, ukw imbu zabo zagenda zikurikirana;

mugabo ntibayiha abaramukiwe gukora mu ngoro y’Uhoraho ku rubu rwabo, nk’ukw ibikorwa bāgerewe biri uko bukeye, ari bo nyene banditswe mu gitabo kidondora amavuka y’izinamuhungu wese, uhereye ku bamaze imyaka itatu no kuja hejuru.
Abaherezi bāgenda bandikwa ukw amazu ya ba sekuruza ari; Abalewi uhereye ku bamaze imyaka mirongwibiri no kuja hejuru, bakandikwa ukw ibikorwa vyabo n’imbu zabo biri.
Kandi handikwa n’ababo bose, uhereye ku bagore babo n’abahungu n’abakobga, bose iyo bava bakagera; kuko bāgenda bayoboka mu gukora ivyera.

Kandi kubg’ abaherezi bo mu ba Aroni bāba mu matongo aho bafise amaragiro inyuma y’ibisagara vyabo, mu gisagara cose hār’ abantu bazwi amazina bāshiriweho guha umugabane umuntu wese w’izinamuhungu mur’ abo baherezi n’ abanditswe bose mu Balewi mu gitabo kidondora amavuka yabo.
Uko ni ko Hezekiya yakoze mu Buyuda hose; yagenda akora ivyiza n’ibiroranye n’ivy’ ukuri imbere y’Uhoraho Imana yiwe.
Mu vyo yakora vyose arondera Imana yiwe, uhereye ku bikorwa vyo mu ngoro y’Imana, no ku vyagezwe no ku mabgirizwa, yabikora abishizek’ umutima wiwe wose, bikamubera ko.

Hanyuma y’ivyo vyose, no hanyuma y’ukwo kuyoboka kwa Hezekiya, Senakeribu umwami w’i Ashuri araza, atera i Buyuda, asagaza inyuma y’ibisagara vyubakiwe inzitiro z’amabuye, agira ngw azovyihesha umuheto.
Maze Hezekiya abonye ko Senakeribu aje agabiye gutera i Yerusalemu,
aja inama n’abaganwa biwe n’abashingantahe biwe, kugira ngo bazibire amariba ar’ inyuma y’igisagara; bemera gufatanya na we.
Nuko hakorana abantu benshi, bazibira amariba yose, n’ umugezi waca mur’ iyo ntāra; kuko bāvuga, bati Mbeg’ abami b’i Ashuri bokwama baza basanga amazi ari menshi?

Nuko Hezekiya agumya umutima, asanura uruzitiro aho rwari rwarasenyutse hose, arwubakakw iminara, yubaka n’urundi ruzitiro inyuma yarwo, akomeza n’i Milo mu gisagara ca Dawidi; arondeza ibirwanishwa n’inkinzo vyinshi cane.
Ashirah’ abagabisha b’ingabo bamenyereye ivy’ intambara kuganza abantu, abakoraniriza hamwe ku nama kw irembo ry’ igisagara, ababarira amajambo yo kubaremēsha,
ati Ni mushikame, mushire amanga, ntimutinye, ntimurandurwe imitima n’umwami w’i Ashuri bo na rirya sinzi ry’ ingabo riri kumwe na we; kuk’ Uwo turi kumwe ahambaye kuruta abari kumwe na we.

Mu ruhande rwiwe haherereye inkomezi z’ab’ umubiri, ariko mu ruhande rwacu haherereye Uhoraho Imana yacu, ngw adutabare, aturwanire mu ntambara zacu. Maz’ abantu baremēshwa n’ayo majambo ya Hezekiya umwami w’i Buyuda.
Hanyuma y’ivyo Senakeribu umwami w’i Ashuri, akir’ inyuma y’i Lakishi, bo n’ingabo ziwe zose, atuma intumwa i Yerusalemu kuri Hezekiya umwami w’i Buyuda, no ku Bayuda bose bar’ i Yerusalemu;
ziravuga, zit’ Uku ni ko Senakeribu umwami w’i Ashuri agize, ngo Mbega mwizigiye iki, gituma murorēra kw’i Yerusalemu harinda kwugarizwa?
Ngw Aho Hezekiya s’ukubahenda, kugira ngw abicishe inzara n’inyota? Kw ababarira ng’ Uhoraho Imana yacu izodukiza, ngo ntidukorokere mu maboko y’umwami w’i Ashuri!
Ngo None Hezekiya uwo si we yakūyeh’ ibitabo vyayo n’ ibicaniro vyayo, akabarira Abayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu, ati Muze musengere imbere y’iki gicaniro conyene, abe ari ho mwosereza imibavu?
Ngo Mbega ntimuzi bo na ba sekuru uko bāgiriye amahanga yose yo mw isi? Ngo Non’ imana z’ayo mahanga yo mur’ ivyo bihugu zarashoboye na gatoya gukiza igihugu cazo ngo ntigikorokere mu maboko yiwe?
Ngo None mu mana zose z’ amahanga ba sekuru baranduye rwose, n’iyihe yashoboye gukiza abantu bayo ngo ntibakorokere mu maboko yiwe, bitume n’ iyanyu na yo yoshobora kubamukiza?

Ngo None Hezekiya ntabahende, canke ngw abasuke mu buryo ben’ ubgo; ngo Ntimumwemerere; ngo Kukw ata mana n’imwe y’ihanga na rimwe canke y’igihugu ic’ ari co cose yashoboye gukiza abantu bayo ngo ntibakorokere mu maboko yiwe canke mu maboko ya ba sekuru; ngo Kugira ngw iyanyu na yo ishobore kubamukiza.
Maz’ izo ntumwa ziwe ziyongeranya gutuka Uhoraho Imana, na Hezekiya umusavyi wayo.

Kandi Senakeribu yandika icete co kurogota k’Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli no kumuvuga nabi, ngo Nk’ukw imana z’amahanga yo mu bihugu zitākijije abantu bazo, ngo ntibakorokere mu maboko yiwe, ngo Ni ko n’Imana ya Hezekiya itazokiza abantu bayo ngo ntibamukorokere mu maboko.

Mber’ izo ntumwa zivuga n’ ijwi rirenga mu rurimi rw’Ikiyuda, babibarira abantu b’i Yerusalemu bāri hejuru ku ruzitiro rw’amabuye, ngo babatere ubgoba, babarandure imitima, kugira ngo babone kunesha ico gisagara.
Bavuga Imana y’i Yerusalemu nk’ah’ ari co kimwe n’imana z’ amahanga y’isi zakozwe n’intoke z’abantu.
Ivyo bituma umwami Hezekiya, n’uwavugishwa n’Imana Yesaya mwene Amosi, basenga, batakambira Iyo mw ijuru.

Nuk’ Uhoraho arungika umumarayika, atikiza abahizi bose n’abakuru n’ abagabisha b’ingabo z’umwami w’i Ashuri, aho bari bashagaje. Nuk’ uwo mwami asubira mu gihugu ciwe amāramāye. Maz’ ashitse mu ngoro y’ikigirwamana ciwe, abo yivyariye bahamwicishiriza inkota.
Uko ni k’Uhoraho yakijije Hezekiya n’ababa i Yerusalemu, abakūye mu maboko ya Senakeribu umwami w’i Ashuri, no mu maboko y’abandi bansi bose; nukw abaha impore impande zose.
Maze benshi bashikanira Uhoraho amashikanwa i Yerusalemu, kandi na Hezekiya umwami w’i Buyuda bamuzanira ibintu vy’igiciro kinini, bituma ashirwa hejuru imbere y’amahanga yose, uhereye ico gihe.
Mur’ iyo misi Hezekiya ararwara agera hafi yo gupfa. Asenga Uhoraho, na we aramwishura, amuha n’ikimenyamenya.
Ariko Hezekiya, ubuntu yagiriwe ntiyabumwishura, kuko yaciye yishira hejuru mu mutima; kubg’ ivyo uburake bg’Uhoraho buza kuri we no ku Bayuda no kuri Yerusalemu.
Ariko Hezekiya yicisha bugufi, yihana ubgo bgibone bgo mu mutima wiwe, ubgiwe n’ababa i Yerusalemu, bituma uburake bg’Uhoraho butabashikīra ku ngoma ya Hezekiya.

Kandi Hezekiya yari n’itunga ryinshi n’icubahiro cinshi; yironderera ububīko bg’amafeza n’ ubg’ amazahabu n’ubg’ utubuyenge tw’igiciro kinini n’ubg’ imibavu n’ubg’ inkinzo n’ubg’ ibintu vyiza‐vyiza vy’uburyo bgose.
Kandi yubaka n’amazu y’ibigega y’aho kwimburira ingano na vino n’amavuta ya elayo; n’ impongore z’ibitayega vyiwe vy’ uburyo bgose, n’impongore z’ imikuku.
Kandi yironkera n’ ibisagara, n’amasinzi y’imikuku n’amasho, kukw Imana yamuhaye ibintu vy’isinzi.
Kandi Hezekiya uwo agomera isōko yo haruguru y’amazi y’i Gihoni, akwega umūzi wayo, ayamanukana ku ruhande rw’igisagara ca Dawidi ruhera i burengerazuba. Nuko Hezekiya ivyo yakora vyose bimubera ko.
Ariko ku vy’intumwa abaganwa b’i Babuloni bamutumyeko, ngo bamubaze igitangaza cabayeho mu gihugu ciwe, Imana iramureka ngw imugerageze, kugira ngw imenye ivyari mu mutima wiwe vyose.
Nukw ibindi vyose vyadonzwe kuri Hezekiya, n’ivyiza yakoze, vyanditswe mu vyo uwavugishwa n’Imana Yesaya mwene Amosi yeretswe, no mu gitabo c’abami b’Abayuda n’ab’ Abisirayeli.

Maze Hezekiya ahamvya ba sekuruza, bamuhamba ahadūga haja mu mva z’abuzukuruza ba Dawidi; aho yatanga, Abayuda bose n’ab’i Yerusalemu baza kumuha icubahiro. Maz’ umuhungu wiwe Manase asubira ku ngoma yiwe.
Manase yagiye ku ngoma amaze imyaka cumi n’ibiri; ayimarakw imyaka mirongwitanu n’itanu ar’ i Yerusalemu.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona kw ari bibi, aja mu bizira vy’ubuyobe vy’ abanyamahanga, abo Uhoraho yari yarirukanyei mbere y’Abisirayeli.

Yongera gutabisha ibitabo ku mpinga z’imisozi, ivyo se Hezekiya yari yarasibanganije, yubakira za Bayali ibicaniro, abāza igishushanyo ca Ashera, asenga ingabo zose zo kw ijuru, ari zo nyenyeri, arazisaba.
Yubaka n’ ibicaniro mu ngoro y’Uhoraho, ari ho Uhoraho yari yaravuze, at’ I Yerusalemu ni ho izina ryanje rizoba ibihe vyose.
Kandi yubakira izo ngabo zose zo kw ijuru ibicaniro mu ntangaro no mu nyubakwa vyo ku ngoro y’Uhoraho.

Atanga abana biwe kw ibimazi ngo boswe mu muriro mu mwonga wa mwene Hinomu, agapfumuza, agatera amabara, agakoresha uburozi, akaja kuraguza abahamagara imizimu, n’abamenyi; yakora ibibi vyinshi imbere y’Uhoraho, bimutera umwikomo.

Ca gishushanyo c’ikigirwamana yabāje agishinga mu ngoro y’Imana, ari yo ngoro Imana yari yarabariye Dawidi na Salomo umuhungu wiwe, iti Mur’ iyi ngoro, bo n’i Yerusalemu, ni ho natoranije mu miryango yose y’Abisirayeli ko nzohashira izina ryanje ngo rihabe ibihe vyose.
Kand’ iti Sinzosubira gukūra Abisirayeli ngo bave mu gihugu nashinze ko kizoba ica ba sekuruza, ni bitondera ivyo nabageze vyose, ari vyo vyagezwe n’ amabgirizwa n’imigenzo nageze mbitumye Mose.
Nuko Manase azimiza Abayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu, bituma bakora nabi gusumvya amahanga Uhoraho yageshereje imbere y’Abisirayeli.
Maz’ Uhoraho abūrira Manase n’abantu biwe, ariko ntibābibabara.
Ni co catumye Uhoraho abatēza abagabisha b’ingabo z’umwami w’i Ashuri, bagafata Manase, bakamubohesha ivyuma, bakamushira mu minyororo, bakamujana i Babuloni.
Maz’ abonye kw ashitse mu magorwa, yinginga Uhoraho Imana yiwe, yicisha bugufi ashika hasi imbere y’Imana ya ba sekuruza.
Maz’ ayisenze, iramwemerera, yumva ukwinginga kwiwe, imusubiza i Yerusalemu mu bgami bgiwe. Nuko Manase aca amenya yuk’ Uhoraho ari we Mana.

Hanyuma y’ivyo yubaka uruzitiro rw’amabuye, ruciye inyuma y’igisagara ca Dawidi, ruca ku ruhande rw’i Gihoni ruhera i burengerazuba mu mwonga, rukarinda rushika kw irembo ryitwa iry’ Amafi; arukīkūza i Ofeli, ararukuza, arugira rurerure cane; kand’ ashira abagabisha b’ingabo mu bisagara vyose vy’i Buyuda bizitiriwe inzitiro.
Kand’ akūrah’ ibigirwamana vy’amahanga, akūra na ca gishushanyo mu ngoro y’Uhoraho, n’ibicaniro vyose yari yarubatse ku musozi urikw ingoro y’Uhoraho n’i Yerusalemu, abishiburira inyuma y’igisagara.
Maz’ asana igicaniro c’Uhoraho, agitangirakw ibimazi vy’ishimwe n’ivyo gukenguruka, kand’ agera kw Abayuda basaba Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli.
Mugabo abantu bakomeza gutangira ibimazi mu bitabo vyo ku mpinga z’imisozi, ariko bakabiha Uhoraho Imana yabo wenyene gusa.

Nukw ibindi vyose vyadonzwe kuri Manase, n’ivy’ isengesho yasenze Imana yiwe, n’amajambo ba kamenyi bāmubariye mw izina ry’Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli, vyanditswe mu bitabo bidonda ivy’ abami b’Abayuda.

Kandi n’ivy’ isengesho ryiwe, n’ ingene yemerewe, n’ivy’ ivyaha vyiwe vyose n’ugucumura kwiwe, n’ivy’ ahantu hose yatavye ibitabo, akahashinga inkingi za Ashera n’ibishushanyo bibājwe, ataricisha bugufi, ivyo vyanditswe mu majambo ya Hozayi.
Nuko Manase ahamvya ba sekuruza, ahambga mu rugo rwiwe; maz’ umuhungu wiwe Amoni asubira ku ngoma yiwe.
Amoni yagiye ku ngoma amaze imyaka mirongwibiri n’ibiri, ayimarakw imyaka ibiri ar’i Yerusalemu.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona kw ari bibi, nk’uko se Manase yakora; aha ibimazi ibishushanyo vyose bibājwe, ivyo se Manase yakoresheje, arabisaba.
Ntiyicisha bugufi imbere y’ Uhoraho, nk’uko se Manase yicishije bugufi, ariko Amoni uwo agenda arushiriza gucumura.
Bukeye abanyarugo biwe baramugarariza, bamutsinda mu ngoro yiwe.
Maz’ abantu bo mu gihugu bica abo bantu bose bāgararije umwami Amoni, baraheza bimika Yosiya umuhungu wiwe, bamusubiza ku ngoma yiwe.
Yosiya yagiye ku ngoma amaze imyaka munani; ayimarakw imyaka mirongwitatu n’ umwe ar’i Yerusalemu.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona kw ari vyiza, agendera mu ngeso nziza za sekuruza Dawidi, ntiyatambamira i buryo cank’ i bumoso.

Mu mwaka ugira umunani ari ku ngoma, akir’ umwana, yatanguye kurondera Imana ya sekuruza Dawidi; maze mu mwaka ugira icumi na kabiri atangura gutunganya i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu, ahakūra ibitabo vyo ku mpinga z’imisozi, n’inkingi bāshingiye Ashera, n’ibishushanyo bibājwe bo n’ivyavugutiwe mu nkero;

basangangura ibicaniro vya za Bayali abahagarikiye, asitaguza n’ inkingi zashingiwe izuba zari zibihanamiye hejuru; amenagura n’inkingi zashingiwe Ashera, n’ ibishushanyo bibājwe n’ivyavugutiwe mu nkero, abigira ishingwe, arimēmēra ku mva z’abābiha ibimazi.
Aturirira amagufa y’ abaherezi ku bicaniro vyabo; nukw atunganya i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu.
Kandi ni ko yagenjeje no mu bisagara vyabaye amatongo impande zose, ivy’ Abamanase n’ ivy’ Abefurayimu n’ivy’ Abasimeyoni, no kurinda ashitsa no mu vy’i Bunafutali.

Asangangura ibicaniro, ajonjanga inkingi zāshingiwe Ashera, n’ibishushanyo bibājwe, abigira ifu; asitagura n’ inkingi zose zāshingiwe izuba mu gihugu cose c’i Bgisirayeli; araheza arahindukira, asubira i Yerusalemu.

Maze mu mwaka ugira icumi n’umunani ari ku ngoma, ahejeje gutunganya igihugu n’urusengero, arungika Shafani mwene Asaliya, na Mayaseya umukuru w’umurwa, na Yowa mwene Yowahazi umwanditsi w’ivyaja biraba, ngo baje gusanisha ingoro y’Uhoraho Imana yiwe.

Bashikīra Hilukiya umuherezi mukuru, bamushikiriza amahera yazanywe mu ngoro y’ Imana, ayo Abalewi b’abakumirizi bari barakoranije mu Bamanase no mu Befurayimu no mu masigarira yose y’Abisirayeli, no mu Bayuda bose no mu Babenyamini no mu baba i Yerusalemu;
bayaha abāshinzwe gukoresha ibikorwa vyo ku ngoro y’Uhoraho, na bo bayahemba abakozi bakora iyo ngoro, kugira ngo bayisanure bayikomeze;
bayaha ababāji n’ abubatsi kugira ngo bagure amabuye abājwe n’ibiti vy’imyaro n’ ivy’ ibishoro vyo gusanura inyubako abami b’i Buyuda bononye.

Nukw abo bantu bakora ico gikorwa ar’ abizigirwa; abābarāba n’aba: Yahati na Obadiya, Abalewi bo mu ba Merari, na Zekariya na Meshulamu bo mu ba Kohati, ni bo bābakoresha; kand’ abandi Balewi bose b’abahinga bazi ivyo kuvuza,
ni bo bāgenda barāba ivy’ abikorezi, bagakoresha n’ abandi bose bakora igikorwa ic’ ari co cose; kand’ Abalewi bamwe bār’ abakarani n’abashingantahe n’abakumirizi.
Maze bariko barasohora amahera yazanywe mu ngoro y’Uhoraho, Hilukiya umuherezi arenguka ku gitabo c’ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho, ivyo Mose yazanye.
Hilukiya abarira Shafani umukarani, ati Ntoye igitabo c’ivyagezwe mu ngoro y’Uhoraho. Hilukiya araheza agiha Shafani.
Shafani ajana ico gitabo, agishīra umwami, amudondera uko vyagenze, at’ Ivyo abasavyi bawe bāgezweko vyose, bābikoze;
kandi bābiriye amahera yari mu ngoro y’Uhoraho, bayashikirije abakoresha ibikorwa n’abakozi.
Uwo mukarani Shafani yongera kubarira umwami, ati Kand’ umuherezi Hilukiya andungikanye igitabo. Nuko Shafani agisomera umwami.
Maz’ umwami yumvise amajambo yo mu vyagezwe, yitantamurirakw impuzu ziwe.
Umwami araheza atuma Hilukiya na Ahikamu mwene Shafani na Abudoni mwene Mika n’uwo mukarani Shafani nyene na Asaya umumenyekana wiwe,

ati Ni mugende munsigurize Uhoraho, twe n’amasigarira yo mu Bisirayeli no mu Bayuda, ivy’ amajambo yo mur’ ico gitabo batoye; kuk’ uburake bg’Uhoraho budusutsweko ari bginshi, kubga ba sogokuruza batumviye ijambo ry’Uhoraho, ngo bakore ivyanditswe mur’ iki gitabo vyose.

Nuko Hilukiya n’abo bandi umwami yatumye, baragenda, baja k’ūvugishwa n’Imana Hulida muka Shalumu, Shalumu mwene Tokihati, umwuzukuru wa Hasira, yajejwe ububīko bg’imyambaro, bamusiguza ivyo. Kand’ uwo mugore yaba i Yerusalemu mu gice caho ca kabiri.
Arabishura, at’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli agize, ngo Murabarira uwo muntu yamubatumyeko,
mut’ Uhoraho agize ngw Azotēza ivyago aha hantu, bo n’abahaba, ngo Ni yo mivumo yose yanditswe mur’ ico gitabo bagusomeye, wewe nyene umwami w’i Buyuda;
muti Kuko bāmuvuyeko, bakosereza imibavu izindi mana, muti Bakamutēza umwikomo ibikorwa vyose vy’intoke zabo; muti Ni co kizotuma uburake bgiwe busukwa aha hantu, ntihagire ikibuzimya.
Ati Kandi mubarire uwo mwami w’i Buyuda yabatumye gusiguza Uhoraho, mut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho Imana y’ Abisirayeli agize, ngo Ku vy’ ayo majambo wumvise,

ngo Kuko watsinzwe mu mutima wawe, ukicisha bugufi imbere yiwe, ari yo Mana, igihe wumva amajambo yavuze ku vy’ aha hantu bo n’ abahaba, ng’ Ukicisha bugufi imbere yiwe, ukītantamurirakw impuzu zawe, ukaririra imbere yiwe, ngo Na we arakwumvise; ni k’Uhoraho agize.

Ngo Nukw azoguha guhambga hamwe na ba sogokuruza, ushike mu mva yawe amahoro; ngo Kand’ amaso yawe ntazobona ivyo vyago vyose azotēza aha hantu n’abahaba. Nuko baraza, bagarukanira umwami ayo majambo.
Maz’ umwami atuma gukoraniriza hamwe abakuru bose b’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu.

Umwami araheza aradūga, aja ku ngoro y’Uhoraho, bo n’abashingantahe b’i Buyuda bose n’ ababa i Yerusalemu, bo n’abaherezi n’Abalewi n’abantu bose, abahambaye n’aboroshe; abasomera amajambo yose yo mur’ ico gitabo c’isezerano bātoye mu ngoro y’Uhoraho.

Maz’ umwami ahagarara ahantu yamenyereye, asezeranira imbere y’Uhoraho kw azomukurikira, no kuzokwitondera ivyagezwe vyiwe n’amabgirizwa yiwe n’ivyo yashinze, no kuzovyitonderesha umutima wiwe wose n’ubugingo bgiwe bgose, no kuzoshitsa amajambo y’iryo sezerano yanditswe mur’ ico gitabo.
Araheza yemeza iryo sezerano ababa i Yerusalemu n’Ababenyamini bose. Nukw ab’i Yerusalemu bashitsa iryo sezerano ry’ Imana, ari yo Mana ya ba sekuruza.

Maze Yosiya akūra ibizira vyose vy’ubuyobe mu ntāra zose z’Abisirayeli, yemeza abari mu gihugu c’i Bgisirayeli bose gusaba Uhoraho Imana ya ba sekuruza. Igihe cose yamaze akiriho nta ho bāretse gukurikira Uhoraho, Imana ya ba sekuruza.
Bukeye Yosiya agira umusi mukuru wa Pasika y’Uhoraho i Yerusalemu. Babāga imyagazi ya Pasika ku musi ugira icumi na kane wo mu kwezi kwa mbere.
Ashira abaherezi mu mbu zabo, abatera umwete wo gukora igikorwa co mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho.

Kand’ abarira Abalewi berejwe Uhoraho, ari bo bigisha Abisirayeli bose, ati Ni mushire isandugu yera mu ngoro Salomo mwene Dawidi umwami w’Abisirayeli yubatse; ntimuzosubira kurinda kuyirerura ku bitugu vyanyu ukundi. None rero ni mukorere Uhoraho Imana yanyu, bo n’abantu biwe b’Abisirayeli.
Mwitegure kuja mu mbu zanyu, nk’ukw amazu ya ba sogokuruza ari, nk’uko vyanditswe na Dawidi umwami w’Abisirayeli na Salomo umuhungu wiwe.

Muheze muze muhagarare ahantu hēra, mwiciyemw’ imitigiri ingana n’imigabane y’amazu ya ba sekuruza ya bagenzi banyu batar’ Abalewi, kugira ng’ umugabane wose ugire umutigiri uwākīrira wo mu mazu ya ba sogokuruza, mwebge Abalewi.
Muheze mubabāgire ivya Pasika, mwiyeze, abo bagenzi banyu mubibategurire, nk’ukw ijambo ry’Uhoraho riri, iryo yatumye Mose.

Maze Yosiya aha abantu bose bari ngaho imyagazi y’intama n’iy’ impene yo mu mikuku, yo kuba ibimazi vya Pasika; igitigiri c’iyo myagazi car’ ibihumbi mirongwitatu; abaha n’amapfizi ibihumbi bitatu; ivyo vyose ni vyo umwami yatanze kw itunga ryiwe.

Kand’ abaganwa biwe na bo nyene nk’uko bavyigombeye baha abantu ibimazi vyo gutanga, babiha n’abaherezi n’Abalewi. Hilukiya na Zekariya na Yehiyeli, abakuru baganza ivy’ ingoro y’Imana, baha abaherezi ivyo gutanga kw ibimazi vya Pasika, imyagazi ibihumbi bibiri n’amajana atandatu, n’amapfizi amajana atatu.

Kandi n’ abakuru b’Abalewi, Konaniya na barumuna biwe Shemaya na Netaneli, bo na Hashabiya na Yeyeli na Yozabadi, baha Abalewi ivyo gutanga kw ibimazi vya Pasika, imyagazi ibihumbi bitanu n’amapfizi amajana atanu.
Uko ni ko biteguye ivy’ ico gikorwa; abaherezi bahagarara mu myanya yabo, n’Abalewi bahagarara nk’ukw imbu zabo zikurikirana, nk’uk’ umwami yabishinze.
Nuko bakerera imyagazi ya Pasika, abaherezi bamija amaraso bayahawe n’abo Balewi, Abalewi na bo baraheza barabāga.

Bakūrah’ imitigiri yo kuba ibimazi vyo kwoswa, bayiha abantu nk’ukw amazu ya ba sekuruza ari, kugira ngo na bo bayīhēre Uhoraho kw ibimazi, nk’ uko vyanditswe mu gitabo ca Mose. N’ayo mapfizi na yo bayagenza bartyo.
Baraheza batara inyama z’ivyo bimazi vya Pasika, nk’uko vyashinzwe; bateka n’iz’ ibimazi vyera mu nkono no mu masafuriya no mu tuzīhebe; zihiye bakazijana vuba bakaziha abantu bose.

Hanyuma bakitegura ivyabo ubgabo bo n’ivy’ abaherezi, kukw abo baherezi bo mu ba Aroni batātirimuka kubgo kwosa ibimazi n’ibinure, bukarinda bgira; ni co catumye Abalewi bitegura ivyabo ubgabo, bakitegura n’ivy’ abo baherezi bo mu ba Aroni.

N’abaririmvyi bo mu ba Asafu bāri mu myanya yabo nk’uko vyari vyarashinzwe na Dawidi na Asafu na Hemani na Yedutuni kamenyi w’umwami; abakumirizi na bo bāri ku birimba vyose; na bo nyene ntibārinda kuva ku gikorwa cabo, kuko bagenzi babo b’Abalewi bābitegurira ivyabo na bo.
Uko ni kw igikorwa cose c’ Uhoraho cātunganijwe kur’ uwo musi, co kugira umusi mukuru wa Pasika no kwosereza ibimazi ku gicaniro c’Uhoraho, nk’uk’ umwami Yosiya yabishinze.
Ico gihe nyene Abisirayeli bāri ngaho baja mu vy’uwo musi mukuru wa Pasika, baja no mu vy’iyindi misi mikuru ndwi y’imitsima itambiwe.

Ntihīgeze kuba umusi wa Pasika uhwanye n’uyo mu Bisirayeli, uhereye mu gihe c’uwavugishwa n’Imana Samweli; kandi nta wundi mu bami b’Abisirayeli yagize umusi mukuru wa Pasika uhwanye n’uwo Yosiya yagize, bo n’abaherezi n’Abalewi n’Abayuda bose n’ Abisirayeli bāri ngaho, n’ababa i Yerusalemu.
Iyo Pasika yabaye mu mwaka ugira icumi n’ umunani Yosiya ari ku ngoma.
Hanyuma y’ivyo vyose, Yosiya amaze gutunganya urusengero, Neko umwami wa Egiputa aradūga aja gutera Karikemeshi ku ruzi Efurate; maze Yosiya aja kumutega ngw amurwanye.

Ariko Neko amutumakw intumwa, uti Mupfa iki na we, ga Mwami w’ Abayuda? Ut’ Ubu si wewe ateye, ut’ Arikw ateye inzu bahamana; uti Mber’ Imana imubariye kwihuta; uti Reka gukorakoza Imana iri kumwe na we, uti Ntihave ikwica.
Yamara Yosiya ntiyemera guhindukira ngw amureke, arikw ariyoberanya kugira ngw amurwanye, ntiyumvira amajambo ya Neko avuye ku Mana; barumanira mu kiyaya c’i Megido.
Maz’ abarashi barasa umwami Yosiya; abarira abantu biwe, ati Ni munkūre hano, kuko nkomeretse bibi.
Nukw abantu biwe bamukūra mu mukogote yarimwo, bamushira mu wa kabiri yar’ afise, bamujana i Yerusalemu; nukw aratanga, bamuhamba mu mva za ba sekuruza. Abayuda bose n’ ab’ i Yerusalemu baramuririra.
Na Yeremiya aborogera Yosiya, n’abaririmvyi bose b’abagabo n’abagore iyo bacura intimba bavuga Yosiya kugeza n’ubu; babigira umugenzo mu Bisirayeli; kandi vyanditswe mu majambo y’agacurantimba.
Ibindi vyose vyadonzwe kuri Yosiya, n’ivyiza yakoze yitondera ivyanditswe mu vyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho,
n’ibikorwa vyiwe vyose uhereye ku ca mbere ukageza ku c’imperēra, vyanditswe mu gitabo c’abami b’Abisirayeli n’ab’ Abayuda.
Maz’ abantu bo mur’ ico gihugu bahitana Yehowahazi umuhungu wa Yosiya, bamwimika mu gishingo ca se i Yerusalemu.
Yehowahazi yagiye ku ngoma amaze imyaka mirongwibiri n’itatu; ayimarakw amezi atatu ar’ i Yerusalemu.
Bukeye umwami wa Egiputa amukūra ku ngoma i Yerusalemu; igihugu ciwe agicira iciru c’italanto ijana z’ifeza n’italanto imwe y’izahabu.
Uwo mwami wa Egiputa yimika Eliyakimu mukuru we, amugira umwami w’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu, ahindura izina ryiwe, amwita Yehoyakimu. Neko araheza afata Yehowahazi, amujana muri Egiputa.
Kandi Yehoyakimu yagiye ku ngoma amaze imyaka mirongwibiri n’itanu; ayimarakw imyaka cumi n’umwe ar’i Yerusalemu; akora ivyo Uhoraho Imana yiwe abona kw ari bibi.
Hanyuma Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni araza aramutera, amuta mu minyororo, amujana i Babuloni.
Nebukadineza atakw ajana n’ ibintu vyo mu ngoro y’Uhoraho i Babuloni, abishira mu rusengero rwiwe i Babuloni nyene.

Ibindi vyose vyadonzwe kuri Yehoyakimu, n’ivy’ ibizira vy’ubuyobe yakoze, n’ibindi bibi vyose yagenda abonekako, vyanditswe mu gitabo c’abami b’Abisirayeli n’ab’ Abayuda. Maz’ umuhungu wiwe Yehoyakina asubira ku ngoma yiwe.
Yehoyakina yagiye ku ngoma amaze imyaka cumi n’umunani; ayimarakw amezi atatu n’imisi cumi i Yerusalemu; na we akora ivyo Uhoraho abona kw ari bibi.
Ku gacikamvura umwami Nebukadineza aratuma ngo bamuzane i Babuloni, bo n’ibintu vyiza‐vyiza vyo mu ngoro y’Uhoraho; yimika mukuru we Zedekiya ngw abe umwami w’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu.
Zedekiya yagiye ku ngoma amaze imyaka mirongwibiri n’ umwe; ayimarakw imyaka cumi n’umwe i Yerusalemu;
na we akora ivyo Uhoraho Imana yiwe abona kw ari bibi; ntiyicisha bugufi imbere y’uwavugishwa n’ Imana Yeremiya, iy’ amubariye ibiva mu kanwa k’Uhoraho.
Na we agarariza umwami Nebukadineza, kandi yari yaramurahije Imana; nukw agamika izosi, yikomantaza umutima, ntiyahindukirira Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli.

Mbere n’abaherezi bakuru‐bakuru bose bo n’abantu bāgize ivy’ ubuhemu bginshi, bakaja mu vy’ibizira vyose vy’ubuyobe vy’abanyamahanga, bakanduza ingoro y’Uhoraho, iyo Uhoraho ubgiwe yari yarejeje i Yerusalemu.
Uhoraho, Imana ya ba sekuruza, akabatumakw intumwa ziwe, akāma azindurwa uko bukeye no kubatuma, kuko yatewe akagongwe n’abantu biwe bo n’ aho hantu yaba.
Ariko bagashinyagurira izo ntumwa z’Imana, bagakēngēra amajambo yayo, bagatwenga abo yavugisha, gushitsa ah’uburake bg’Uhoraho bgabaye ku bantu biwe, butagishobora kugarurwa.

Nci co catumye abatēza umwami w’Abakaludaya, akicisha imisore yabo inkota, akabatsinda mu rusengero rwabo, ntagirire akagongwe umusore cank’ umwigeme, umutāma cank’ umusāza bukokori; bose akabagabura mu maboko yiwe.

Kand’ ibintu vyose vyo mu ngoro y’Imana, ibito‐bito n’ibinini‐binini, bo n’ivy’ ubutunzi vyo mur’ iyo ngoro nyene y’Uhoraho, n’ivy’ ubutunzi vy’umwami n’ivy’ abaganwa biwe, ivyo vyose abijana i Babuloni.
Maze baturira n’ ingoro y’Imana, basangangura n’ uruzitiro rw’amabuye rw’i Yerusalemu, baturira n’ingoro zaho zose, bīca n’ivyiza‐vyiza vyaho vyose.
Abācitse bagakira inkota, uwo mwami abajana i Babuloni, abagira abaja biwe n’ab’ abahungu biwe, gushitsa igihe Abaperesi bashikiriye ingoma,

kwar’ ukugira ngw ijambo Uhoraho yavugiye mu kanwa ka Yeremiya rishike, igihugu gishumbushwe amasabato yaco; igihe cose camaze kikir’ amatongo, cariko kiziririza amasabato yaco, gushitsa kimaze imyaka mirongwirindwi.

Hanyuma mu mwaka wa mbere Kuro umwami w’i Buperesi agiye ku ngoma, Uhoraho akangura umutima wiwe kugira ngw ijambo yavugiye mu kanwa ka Yeremiya ribone gushika. Nuko Kuro uwo mwami w’i Buperesi ashinga ko babitangaza mu gihugu ciwe cose, aranavyandika,

ngo Kuro, umwami w’i Buperesi aravuze, at’ Uhoraho Imana Nyen’ ijuru yangabiye ibihugu vyose vyo mw isi. Kandi yangeze ngo ndamwubakire ingoro i Yerusalemu mu Buyuda. Non’ umuntu wese muri mwebge wo mu bantu biwe bose, Uhoraho Imana yiwe n’ibane na we, adūge ajeyo.

Mu mwaka wa mbere Kuro umwami w’i Buperesi agiye ku ngoma, Uhoraho akangura umutima wiwe kugira ngw ijambo yavugiye mu kanwa ka Yeremiya ribone gushika. Nuko Kuro uwo mwami w’i Buperesi ashinga ko babitangaza mu gihugu ciwe cose, aranavyandika,
ngo Kuro, umwami w’i Buperesi aravuze, at’ Uhoraho Imana Nyen’ ijuru yangabiye ibihugu vyose vyo mw isi. Kandi yangeze ngo ndamwubakire ingoro i Yerusalemu mu Buyuda.
Non’ umuntu wese muri mwebge wo mu bantu biwe bose, Imana yiwe n’ibane na we, adūge i Yerusalemu mu Buyuda, yubake ingoro y’Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli, ari yo Mana iba i Yerusalemu.

Kand’ ahantu hose hasigaye umuntu w’inyambukīra, abantu baho ni bamufashishe ifeza n’ izahabu n’ibintu n’ibitungano, bamuhe n’amashikanwa bashikanye kubg’ iyo ngoro y’Imana y’i Yerusalemu bivuye ku mitima ikunze.

Nuko, abakuru b’amazu ya ba sekuruza b’Abayuda n’ab’ Ababenyamini, bo n’abaherezi n’ Abalewi n’abandi bose Imana yateye umwete, bava hasi kugira ngo baje gusubira kwubaka ingoro y’Uhoraho i Yerusalemu.
Ababanyi babo bose babaha intererano z’ibintu vy’amafeza n’amazahabu n’ibindi, bo n’ibitungano n’ibintu vy’igiciro kinini, ukūyemw’ ivyo bashikanye vyose bivuye ku mitima ikunze.
Kandi n’umwami Kuro asohora ibintu vy’imbombovu vyakoreshwa mu ngoro y’Uhoraho, ivyo Nebukadineza yari yaranyaze i Yerusalemu, akabishira mu kinyabugoro c’imana ziwe;
izo mbombovu Kuro umwami w’i Buperesi mu kuzisohora atuma Mitiredati umuzezwabintu wiwe, na we aziharūrira imbere ya Sheshibazari umuganwa wo mu Bayuda.
Kand’ igitigiri cavyo ngiki: amasahani y’izahabu mirongwitatu, n’ay’ ifeza igihumbi, n’ imbugita mirongwibiri n’icenda,
n’amabakure y’izahabu mirongwitatu, n’amabakure y’ifeza y’uburyo bga kabiri amajana ane n’icumi, n’ibikoreshwa bindi igihumbi.
Ibintu vy’imbombovu vy’izahabu n’ivy’ ifeza, vyose na vyose vyar’ ibihumbi bitanu n’ amajana ane. Ivyo vyose Sheshibazari yabijanye igihe abantu b’inyagano bāva i Babuloni bagasubira i Yerusalemu.

Aba ni bo bo mur’ ico gihugu Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni yari yarajanye i Babuloni nyene ar’ inyagano, bakava mu kinyago bagasubira i Yerusalemu n’i Buyuda, umuntu wese agasubira mu gisagara c’i wabo;
ni bo bāzananye na Zerubabeli na Yosuwa na Nehemiya, na Seraya na Reyelaya na Moridekayi, na Bilishani na Misipari na Bigivayi, na Rehumu na Bayana. Igitigiri c’abagabo bo mu Bisirayeli ngiki:
abo mu ba Paroshi n’ibihumbi bibiri n’ijana na mirongwirindwi na babiri.
Abo mu ba Shefatiya n’amajana atatu na mirongwirindwi na babiri.
Abo mu ba Ara n’amajana ndwi na mirongwirindwi na batanu.
Abo mu ba Pahati‐mowabu, bandurutse kuri Yosuwa na Yowabu, n’ibihumbi bibiri n’amajana munani n’ icumi na babiri.
Abo mu ba Elamu n’igihumbi n’amajana abiri na mirongwitanu na bane.
Abo mu ba Zatu n’amajana cenda na mirongwine na batanu.
Abo mu ba Zakayi n’amajana ndwi na mirongwitandatu.
Abo mu ba Bani n’amajana atandatu na mirongwine na babiri.
Abo mu ba Bebayi n’amajana atandatu na mirongwibiri na batatu.
Abo mu ba Azigadi n’igihumbi n’amajana abiri na mirongwibiri na babiri.
Abo mu ba Adonikamu n’amajana atandatu na mirongwitandatu na batandatu.
Abo mu ba Bigivayi n’ibihumbi bibiri na mirongwitanu na batandatu.
Abo mu ba Adini n’amajana ane na mirongwitanu na bane.
Abo mu ba Ateri, bo mu muryango wa Hezekiya, ni mirongwicenda n’ umunani.
Abo mu ba Besayi n’amajana atatu na mirongwibiri na batatu.
Abo mu ba Yora n’ijana n’icumi na babiri.
Abo mu ba Hashumu n’amajana abiri na mirongwibiri na batatu.
Ab’i Gibari ni mirongwicenda na batanu.
Ab’i Betelehemu n’ijana na mirongwibiri na batatu.
Abagabo b’i Netofa ni mirongwitanu na batandatu.
Abagabo b’i Anatoti n’ijana na mirongwibiri n’umunani.
Ab’i Azimaveti ni mirongwine na babiri.
Ab’i Kiriyatarimu n’i Kefira n’i Beroti n’amajana ndwi na mirongwine na batatu.
Ab’i Rama n’i Geba n’amajana atandatu na mirongwibiri n’umwe.
Abagabo b’i Mikimasi n’ijana na mirongwibiri na babiri.
Abagabo b’i Beteli n’i Hayi n’ amajana abiri na mirongwibiri na batatu.
Ab’i Nebo ni mirongwitanu na babiri.
Ab’i Magibishi n’ijana na mirongwitanu na batandatu.
Ab’i Elamu handi n’igihumbi n’amajana abiri na mirongwitanu na bane.
Ab’i Harimu n’amajana atatu na mirongwibiri.
Ab’i Lodi n’i Hadidi n’i Ono n’amajana ndwi na mirongwibiri na batanu.
Ab’i Yeriko n’amajana atatu na mirongwine na batanu.
Ab’i Sena n’ibihumbi bitatu n’amajana atandatu na mirongwitatu.
Abaherezi n’aba: abo mu ba Yedaya, bo mu nzu ya Yosuwa, n’amajana cenda na mirongwirindwi na batatu.
Abo mu ba Imeri n’igihumbi na mirongwitanu na babiri.
Abo mu ba Pashuri n’igihumbi n’amajana abiri na mirongwine n’indwi.
Abo mu ba Harimu n’igihumbi n’icumi n’indwi.
Abalewi n’aba: abo mu ba Yosuwa na Kadimiyeli, ari bo bandurutse kuri Hodaviya, ni mirongwirindwi na bane.
Abaririmvyi bo mu ba Asafu n’ijana na mirongwibiri n’umunani.
Mu bashibamyi, abo mu ba Shalumu, no mu ba Ateri, no mu ba Talimoni, no mu ba Akubu, no mu ba Hatita, no mu ba Shobayi, bose na bose n’ijana na mirongwitatu n’icenda.
Abahawe ibango ry’ibikorwa vy’urusengero n’aba: abo mu ba Siha, no mu ba Hasufa, no mu ba Tabayoti,
no mu ba Kerosi, no mu ba Siyaha, no mu ba Padoni,
no mu ba Lebana, no mu ba Hagaba, no mu ba Akubu,
no mu ba Hagabu, no mu ba Shamulayi, no mu ba Hanani,
no mu ba Gideli, no mu ba Gahari, no mu ba Reyaya,
no mu ba Resini, no mu ba Nekoda, no mu ba Gazamu,
no mu ba Uza, no mu ba Paseya, no mu ba Besayi,
no mu ba Asina, no mu ba Mehunimu, no mu ba Nefisimu,
no mu ba Bakibuki, no mu ba Hakufa, no mu ba Harihuri,
no mu ba Basiluti, no mu ba Mehida, no mu ba Harisha,
no mu ba Barikosi, no mu ba Sisera, no mu ba Tema,
no mu ba Nesiya, no mu ba Hatifa.
Abuzukuruza b’abasavyi ba Salomo n’aba: abo mu ba Sotayi, no mu ba Hasofereti, no mu ba Peruda,
no mu ba Yahala, no mu ba Darikoni, no mu ba Gideli,
no mu ba Shefatiya, no mu ba Hatili, no mu ba Pokereti‐hasebayimu, no mu ba Ami.
Abahawe ibango ry’ibikorwa vy’urusengero bose, bo n’abuzukuruza b’abasavyi ba Salomo, bose na bose bar’ amajana atatu na mirongwicenda na babiri.

Kand’ aba ni bo bādūze bava i Telimela n’i Teliharisha n’i Kerubu n’i Adani n’i Imeri, ariko vyarabananira kwerekana amazu ya ba sekuruza bandurutseko cank’ abo bakomotseko yukw ar’ Abisirayeli vy’ukuri.
Abo mu ba Delaya no mu ba Tobiya no mu ba Nekoda n’amajana atandatu na mirongwitanu na babiri.
Abo mu baherezi n’aba: abo mu ba Habaya, no mu ba Hakosi, no mu ba Baruzilayi, umwe yābiriye umugeni mu bakobga ba Baruzilayi w’Umunyagileyadi, agaca yitiranwa na sebukwe,
abo bārondeye amazina yabo mu gitabo kidondora ba sekuruza, ntibayabona, ni co gituma biyumviriwe nk’abahumanye, bagakūrwa mu buherezi.
Umucamateka arababuza ngo ntibarye ku vyera cane, kugeza igihe hazobonekera umuherezi afise Urimu na Tumimu.
Nukw iryo shengero ryose iyo riva rikagera, bose na bose bar’ ibihumbi mirongwine na bibiri n’amajana atatu na mirongwitandatu;
udashizemw’ abagurano n’abaguranokazi babo, igitigiri cabo bar’ ibihumbi ndwi n’amajana atatu na mirongwitatu n’indwi; kandi bari bafise abaririmvyi b’abagabo n’abagore amajana abiri.
Amafarasi yabo yar’ amajana ndwi na mirongwitatu n’atandatu; n’inyumbu zabo zar’ amajana abiri na mirongwine na zitanu;
n’ingamiya zabo zar’ amajana ane na mirongwitatu na zitanu, n’indogoba zabo ibihumbi bitandatu n’amajana ndwi na mirongwibiri.
Bamwe mu bakuru b’amazu ya ba sekuruza, bāshitse ku kibanza c’ingoro y’ Uhoraho i Yerusalemu, batanga amashikanwa y’iyo ngoro y’Imana bivuye ku mitima, ngo bayihagarike ahantu hayo.

Batanga uko bashoboye, bashira mu bubiko bg’ivyo kwubakisha amahera y’izahabu yitwa dariki ibihumbi mirongwitandatu na kimwe, n’ ifeza, ingero yitwa mina ibihumbi bitanu, n’imyambaro ijana y’abaherezi.

Nukw abaherezi n’ Abalewi n’abantu bamwe baba i Yerusalemu no hafi yaho; abaririmvyi n’abashibamyi n’abahawe ibango ry’ibikorwa vy’urusengero bibera mu bisagara vyabo, n’abandi Bisirayeli bose mu bisagara vyabo.
Maz’ ukwezi kugira indwi kubonetse, kand’ Abisirayeli bamaze kwibera mu bisagara vyabo, abantu bakoranira i Yerusalemu icarimwe.

Maze Yosuwa mwene Yehozadaki ahagararana na bagenzi biwe b’abaherezi na Zerubabeli mwene Sheyalitiyeli na bagenzi biwe, bubaka igicaniro c’ Imana y’Abisirayeli co kwoserezakw ibimazi, nk’uko vyanditswe mu vyagezwe vya Mose umuntu w’Imana.
Ico gicaniro bacubaka aho cahora, kuko bari batewe ubgoba n’abantu bo mur’ ivyo bihugu; bacoserezak’ Uhoraho ibimazi vyo mu gitondo n’ivyo ku mugoroba.
Bagira imisi mikuru y’insago, nk’uko vyanditswe, batanga ibimazi vyo kwoswa vyo ku musi n’ umusi, nk’ukw igitigiri cavyo kiri, uko vyari vyarashinzwe ngo babikurikiranye uko bukeye;

hanyuma bakomeza gutanga ibimazi vyo kwoswa vy’intasība, n’ivyo mu mboneko z’amezi, n’ivy’ imisi mikuru yose yerejwe Uhoraho, n’ ivyo umuntu wese yagomba gushikanira Uhoraho ishikanwa bivuye ku mutima ukunze.
Guhēra ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kw’indwi ni ho batanguye kwosereza Uhoraho ibimazi, arikw itanguriro ry’urusengero rwiwe ntiryaribgashirweho.

Kandi bagerera abubatsi n’ababaji amahera, ab’i Sidoni n’ab’i Tiro babagerera ivyo kurya n’ibinyobga n’ amavuta, kugira ngo bazane ibiti vy’amasederi, babikūre i Lebanoni babizane ku kiyaga babishikane i Yopa, bakurikiye ibgirizwa ryashinzwe na Kuro Umwami w’i Buperesi.

Nuko mu mwaka ugira kabiri uhereye aho bashikiye ku kibanza c’ingoro y’Imana i Yerusalemu, mu kwezi kwa kabiri, ni ho Zerubabeli mwene Sheyalitiyeli na Yosuwa mwene Yehozadaki batanguriye gukora, bafatanije n’abandi bagenzi babo b’abaherezi n’ Abalewi, n’abavuye mu kinyago bose bakaza i Yerusalemu; bashirah’ Abalewi, uhereye ku bamaze imyaka mirongwibiri no kuja hejuru, kugira ngo bahagarikire igikorwa c’ingoro y’Uhoraho.

Maze Yosuwa arīnega hamwe n’abahungu biwe na bagenzi biwe, na Kadimiyeli n’abahungu biwe, ari bo bandurutse kuri Yuda, baja gukoresha abakozi bakora igikorwa c’ingoro y’Imana, bafatanije na bene Henadadi n’ abahungu babo n’Abalewi bagenzi babo.

Abubatsi bamaze kwubaka itanguriro ry’urusengero rw’Uhoraho, bashirah’ abaherezi, bambaye impuzu z’ubuherezi nyene, bafise inzumbete, n’Abalewi bo mu ba Asafu, bafise ivyo kuvuza vyitwa matowazi, ngo bahimbaze Uhoraho nk’uko vyagezwe na Dawidi umwami w’Abisirayeli.

Bakaririmba bahāniranwa, bahimbaza Uhoraho bamushima, bat’ Erega ni mwiza, kukw imbabazi agirira Abisirayeli zamah’ ibihe bidashira. Maz’ abantu bose bashira amajwi hejuru, barasemerera batazira Uhoraho, kukw itanguriro ry’ingoro y’Uhoraho rimaze gushirwaho.

Ariko benshi mu baherezi n’Abalewi n’abakuru b’ amazu ya ba sekuruza, mber’ abatāma bose bari barabonye ingoro ya mbere, babonye itanguriro ry’iya kabiri rishinzwe imbere yabo, bararira cane baraboroga; arikw abandi benshi bavuza urwamo rw’akanyamuneza;
kand’ abantu ntibashobora gutandukanya urwamo rw’umunezero n’ urwamo rw’amarira; kukw abantu bayogora n’amajwi arenga, urwamo rwabo rukagera kure.
Maz’ abansi b’Abayuda n’ab’ Ababenyamini bumvise yukw abāvuye mu kinyago bubakira Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli urusengero,

baca bēgēra Zerubabeli n’abakuru b’amazu ya ba sekuruza, barababgira, bat’ Enda dufatanye namwe kwubaka, kuko dusenga Imana yanyu nk’uko namwe muyisenga; kandi twamye tuyishikanira ibimazi uhereye ku ngoma ya Esarihadoni, umwami w’i Ashuri yatudūganye akatuzana ino.

Ariko Zerubabeli na Yosuwa n’abandi bakuru b’amazu ya ba sekuruza b’Abisirayeli barabishura, bati Nta ho duhuriye namwe, vyotuma dufatanya kwubaka ingoro y’Imana yacu, ariko ni twebge twenyene tuzokwubakira Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli iyo ngoro, nk’uko Kuro umwami w’i Buperesi yabitugeze.
Maz’ abantu bo mur’ ico gihugu badendebura amaboko y’Abayuda, bama bababurabuza mu kwubaka.

Baha impēra abo kwigenera inama zo kubabuza gushitsa ivyo bagabiye; bikomeza birtyo igihe cose Kuro umwami w’i Buperesi yamaze ku ngoma, barinda bashitsa no ku ngoma ya Dariyo umwami w’i Buperesi nyene.
Mbere ku ngoma ya Ahasuwerusi, ari ho agishika ku ngoma nyene, bandika ivyo kurega ababa i Buyuda n’ab’ i Yerusalemu.
Kandi no ku ngoma ya Aritazeruzi, Bishilamu na Mitiredati na Tabeyeli na bagenzi babo bandi bandikiye Aritazeruzi umwami w’i Buperesi; ico cete canditswe mu nyuguti z’Abasiriya no mu rurimi rwabo.
Rehumu umujanama na Shimushayi umukarani bandikira uwo mwami Aritazeruzi icete, barega ab’i Yerusalemu mur’ ubu buryo:

mbere Rehumu uwo mujanama na Shimushayi umukarani bafatanya kucandika na bagenzi babo bandi b’Abadinayi n’Abafarisatiki n’Abataripeli n’ Abafarisiti n’Abarikevi, n’Abanyababuloni n’Abashushanki n’ Abadehayi n’Abelamiti,
n’ ayandi mahanga yose Osinapari umunyacubahiro ahambaye yajabukanye hakuno akabagerēra mu gisagara c’i Samariya, no mu kindi gihugu co hakuno y’ uruzi.
Aya majambo n’amwe n’ayo mur’ ico cete bāmwandikiye, ngo Ku mwami Aritazeruzi, twebge abasavyi bawe bo hakuno y’uruzi turagize bgakeye.
Urazirikanye, Abayuda bāvuye iyo, bakaza bakadusanga i Yerusalemu, ubu bariko barasubira kwubaka ico gisagara kibi c’ikigarariji; bariko baruzuza uruzitiro, basana n’ amatanguriro.
None nyaguhora ku ngoma, umenye yukw iki gisagara ni cubakwa, inzitiro zaco zikuzura, ntibazotanga ikori, cank’ ikibuguro, cank’ ingorore; nukw iherezo ryavyo abami bazokehanirwa.
None rero kuko dutunzwe n’agasōsa kava i bgami, tukoya kuzohava tubona umwami akēngērwa, ni co catumye tugutumako, tukabikumenyesha,

kugira ngo barondere mu gitabo kidonda ivyagenda biba ku ngoma za ba sogokuruza. Nuko uzobisanga mur’ ico gitabo, kand’ uzomenya yukw ico gisagara ar’igisagara cama kigarariza, kikazana ubuhombe ku bami no ku bihugu vyabo, kikāma gitera umugararizo uhereye no mu bihe vya kera; mbere ni vyo vyatumye ico gisagara nyene gisangangurwa.
None rero nyaguhora ku ngoma, turakubūriye yukw ico gisagara ni cubakwa, inzitiro zaco zikuzura, ata mugabane uzoba ukironka hakuno y’uruzi.
Maz’ umwami arungikira inyishu uwo mujanama Rehumu na Shimushayi umukarani na bagenzi babo baba i Samariya no mu bindi bihugu vyo hakurya y’ uruzi, ati N’amahoro. None rero
ca cete mwaturungikira barakinsomeye, ndagitahura neza.
Nuko nshinga yuko babiserangura; maze basanga ico gisagara mu bihe vya kera caragarariza abami koko, ubugarariji n’ubugāba vyaraboneka muri co.
Kandi ngo Hābamw’ abami bakomeye cane bāganza i Yerusalemu n’ igihugu cose co hakurya y’uruzi, ngo bagatorezwa ikori n’ikibuguro n’ingorore.
Nuko rero ni mushinge icagezwe bareke kwubaka, ico gisagara coye kwubakwa, gushitsa aho jewe nyene nzoryīkūrira mu kanwa.
Kandi mwame mugavye ntimureburure mur’ ivyo, kugira ngw ikibi ntikigwire, abami bagakehanirwa.
Nukw ico cete c’umwami Aritazeruzi kimaze gusomerwa uwo mujanama Rehumu na Shimushayi umukarani na bagenzi babo, baca baja i Yerusalemu, ah’ Abayuda bari, bababuza kwubaka ku bubasha no ku kagōbēro.
Nukw igikorwa c’ingoro y’ Imana ir’i Yerusalemu barakireka, gushitsa mu mwaka ugira kabiri Dariyo umwami w’i Buperesi ari ku ngoma.
Maz’ abavugishwa n’Imana Hagayi na Zekariya mwene Ido bavugishwa mw izina ry’Imana y’Abisirayeli, babarira Abayuda bar’ i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu.
Bukeye Zerubabeli mwene Sheyalitiyeli na Yosuwa mwene Yehozadaki bakūra hasi, batangura gusubira kwubaka ingoro y’Imana ir’i Yerusalemu, bari kumwe n’ abo bavugishwa n’Imana babafasha.

Mur’ iyo misi nyene Tatenayi icēgēra c’umwami co hakuno y’uruzi, na Shetari‐bozenayi na bagenzi babo, baza aho bari, barababaza, bati Ni nde yabahaye ibgirizwa ryo kwubaka iyi nzu, ngo mwuzuze n’uru ruzitiro?
Kandi barababaza, bat’ Abantu bubaka iyi nzu ni ba nde?
Arikw abakuru b’Abayuda, inyonga z’Imana yabo ziguma kuri bo, ntibābabuza kwubaka gushitsa batumye kuri Dariyo, icete c’inyishu kikagaruka.
Aya majambo n’amwe n’ayo mu cete canditswe na Tatenayi, icēgēra c’umwami co hakuno y’ uruzi, na Shetari‐bozenayi, na bagenzi babo b’Abafarisaki baba hakuno y’uruzi, bakakirungikira umwami Dariyo.
Nuko bamurungikira icete canditswe girtya, ngo Ku mwami Dariyo, n’ amahoro neza.

Urazirikanye ga mugenzi, twagiye mu gihugu c’i Buyuda ku nzu y’Imana nkuru yubakishwa amabuye manini‐manini, kand’ itambitswekw ibiti ku nsika zayo; ico gikorwa kirakomeza kuja imbere, bafise amaboko yabakundiye.
None twabajije abo bakuru, tuti Ni nde yabahaye ibgirizwa ryo kwubaka iyi nzu, ngo mwuzuze n’uru ruzitiro?
Kandi twababajije amazina yabo, kugira ngo tuyakumenyeshe, twandika n’amazina y’abakuru babagaba.

Nuko baratwishura, bati Tur’ abasavyi b’Imana Nyen’ ijuru n’isi, kandi turiko turasubira kwubaka ingoro yari yarubatswe kera, ubu hashize imyaka myinshi, iyo umwami ahambaye w’Abisirayeli yari yarubatse akayuzuza.
Bat’ Ariko hanyuma ba sogokuruza baratsa Imana Nyen’ ijuru, ibatanga mu maboko ya Nebukadineza w’Umukaludaya, umwami w’i Babuloni, ni we yasanganguye iyo ngoro, ajana abantu i Babuloni ar’ inyagano.
Bat’ Ariko mu mwaka wa mbere Kuro umwami w’i Babuloni ari ku ngoma, uwo mwami Kuro nyene yashinze ibgirizwa yukw iyi ngoro y’Imana yubakwa.

Bati Mbere n’ibikoreshwa vy’izahabu n’ifeza vyahora mur’ iyo ngoro y’Imana, ivyo Nebukadineza yari yarasahuye muri yo, ari rwo rusengero rwahora hano i Yerusalemu, akabijana mu rusengero rw’i Babuloni, bat’ Umwami Kuro abikūra mur’ urwo rusengero rw’i Babuloni nyene, bishikirizwa umuntu yitwa Sheshibazari, uwo yari yaragize icēgēra ciwe.
Bat’ Aramubgira, at’ Abīra ivyo bintu ubijane ku kibanza c’urusengero rw’i Yerusalemu, iyo nzu y’Imana isubire yubakwe mu kibanza cayo.
Nuko bukeye uwo Sheshibazari araza, yubaka itanguriro ry’iyo nzu y’Imana i Yerusalemu nyene. Nuko rer’ uhereye ico gihe ugashitsa n’ubu iracubakwa, kandi ntiruzura.

None rero nyaguhora ku ngoma, ni wabishima, barondere mu nzu y’ububīko bgawe aho nyene i Babuloni, barābe yuk’ umwami Kuro yoba yarashinze ibgirizwa koko ryo kwubaka iyo nzu y’Imana i Yerusalemu; uheze mugenzi, udutumeko utumenyeshe ic’ ugomba mur’ ivyo.
Maz’ umwami Dariyo avuga ko barondera mu nzu ibīkwamw’ ibitabo vy’ivyabaye, ahabīkwa ibintu vy’igiciro i Babuloni;
babona umuzingo w’igitabo mu rugo rw’i bgami ahitwa Akimeta, mu gihugu c’i Bumedi; uwo muzingo wari wanditswemw’ ibi, ngw Icibutso:

mu mwaka wa mbere umwami Kuro ari ku ngoma, uwo mwami Kuro nyene yashinze ibgirizwa ry’ivy’ inzu y’Imana i Yerusalemu, kugira ngw isubire yubakwe, ibe ahantu batangira ibimazi; kand’ amatanguriro yayo bayubake bayakomeze; uburebure bgayo bg’igihagararo bube amatambge mirongwitandatu y’ ukuboko uciriye mu nkokora, amakika na yo abe amatambge mirongwitandatu nyene.
Mu kwubaka bakurikiranye imirongo itatu y’amabuye manini‐manini n’umurongo w’ibiti bikiri bishasha; kand’ ibizotangwa kuri yo bize bikūrwe mu ngoro y’umwami.

Kandi n’ibintu vy’imbombovu vyākūwe mur’ iyo nzu y’Imana vy’izahabu n’ifeza, ivyo Nebukadineza yari yaranyaze mu rusengero rw’i Yerusalemu, akabizana i Babuloni, ni bisubizweyo bijanwe mu rusengero rw’i Yerusalemu, ikintu cose gisubire mu kibanza cahoramwo, bishirwe mur’ iyo nzu y’Imana.
None rero, Tatenayi, wewe cēgēra canje co hakurya y’uruzi, nawe Shetari‐bozenayi na bagenzi banyu b’Abafarisaki bo hakurya y’uruzi, ntimuje mur’ ivyo, s’ivyanyu;
mureke igikorwa c’ iyo nzu y’Imana kije imbere, mureke n’icēgēra canje kigaba Abayuda n’abakuru babo bubake iyo nzu y’Imana mu kibanza cayo.

Kandi nshinze ibgirizwa ry’ ivyo mukwiye gukorera abakuru b’Abayuda mu vyo kwubakisha iyo nzu y’Imana: mugire umwete cane wo guha abo bantu ivyo bazotanga, kugira ngo hoye kuzogira ikibabuza gukora, muvyabiriye ku bintu vyanje, mbere kw ikori ry’ abo hakurya y’uruzi.

Kandi n’ ivyo bazokena nk’amamasa y’ imikangara n’amapfizi y’intama n’ imyagazi y’intama nyene vyo gutangakw ibimazi vyo kwosereza Imana Nyen’ ijuru, n’ingano n’ umunyu na vino n’amavuta, ivyo abaherezi b’i Yerusalemu bazokwāka, baze bame babihabga uko bukeye, ntibasībe,
kugira ngo baze bahore baha Imana Nyen’ ijuru ibimazi vy’umubabge umota neza, kandi bansabire kuramba, jewe umwami n’abahungu banje.
Kandi nshinze itēka, k’umuntu wese azohindura iri bgirizwa, bazositura inkingi mu nzu yiwe, bayishinge bayimumanikeko, kand’ inzu yiwe bayihindure ikirundo c’isakamburira bamuhoye ivyo.

Kand’ Imana yatumye izina ryayo rihaba, iragatsinda umwami wese n’ihanga ryose, abazorenga ibgirizwa ryanje, bakaramvura amaboko yabo, ngo basambure iyo nzu y’Imana i Yerusalemu. Jewe Dariyo nshinze iryo bgirizwa; rize rikorwe rishimikiwe.
Hanyuma Tatenayi icēgēra c’ umwami co hakuno y’uruzi na Shetari‐bozenayi na bagenzi babo bumvise ijambo ry’umwami Dariyo, bagira umwete wo kubishitsa nk’uko yabatumyeko.
