Nukw abakuru b’Abayuda bagira ikiganza ciza mu kwubaka, bafashijwe n’ukuvugishwa kwa Hagayi uwavugishwa n’Imana na Zekariya mwene Ido. Barayubaka iruzura, nk’ukw ibgirizwa ry’Imana y’ Abisirayeli ryashinze, kandi no kubg’ icagezwe ca Kuro na Dariyo, na Aritazeruzi umwami w’i Buperesi.
Iyo ngoro yuzura ku musi ugira gatatu w’ukwezi kwa Adari, kwo mu mwaka ugira gatandatu umwami Dariyo ari ku ngoma.
Maz’ Abisirayeli n’abaherezi n’Abalewi, n’abandi bavuye mu kinyago, bagira umusi mukuru wo gushikiriza Imana iyo ngoro yayo banezerewe.

Ico gihe co kuyishikiriza Imana, bātanze amamasa ijana n’amapfizi y’intama amajana abiri n’imyagazi y’intama amajana ane, kandi batangirira Abisirayeli bose amasuguru y’ impene cumi n’abiri, nk’ukw igitigiri c’imiryango y’Abisirayeli kingana, kw ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha.
Bashirah’ abaherezi ukw imigabane yabo ikurikirana, n’Abalewi baja ku mbu zabo, ngo bakorere Imana i Yerusalemu, nk’uko vyanditswe mu gitabo ca Mose.
Maz’ abavuye mu kinyago barya ivya Pasika ku musi w’icumi na kane w’ukwezi kwa mbere,
kukw abaherezi n’Abalewi bari biyereje hamwe, bose bari batunganye; nuko babāga imyagazi ya Pasika kubg’ abavuye mu kinyago bose no kubg’ abaherezi bagenzi babo, no kubgabo na bo nyene.

Nukw Abisirayeli bari bagarutse bavuye mu kinyago barya ivya Pasika, bo n’abantu bose bari bitandukanije n’ivy’ ubuhumane bgo mu bapagani bo mur’ ico gihugu, bagafatanya n’Abisirayeli gusenga Uhoraho Imana y’ Abisirayeli,

bagira imisi mikuru ndwi y’imitsima itambiwe banezerewe, kuk’ Uhoraho yabanejereje, kand’ agahindurira umutima w’umwami w’i Ashuri kuri bo, ngw abunganire mu gukora igikorwa c’ingoro y’Imana, ari yo Mana y’Abisirayeli.
Hanyuma y’ivyo, ku ngoma ya Aritazeruzi umwami w’i Buperesi, haza Ezira mwene Seraya, Seraya wa Azariya, Azariya wa Hilukiya,
Hilukiya wa Shalumu, Shalumu wa Sadoki, Sadoki wa Ahitubu,
Ahitubu wa Amariya, Amariya wa Azariya, Azariya wa Merayoti,
Merayoti wa Zerahiya, Zerahiya wa Uzi, Uzi wa Buki,
Buki wa Abishuwa, Abishuwa wa Finehasi, Finehasi wa Eleyazari, Eleyazari wa Aroni umuherezi mukuru;

uwo Ezira aradūga ava i Babuloni; kandi yar’ umunyabgenge w’ivyanditswe kandi w’umuhanga mu vy’ivyagezwe vya Mose vyatanzwe n’ Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli. Umwami amuha ivyo yamusavye vyose, abiheshwa n’ikiganza c’ Uhoraho Imana yiwe cari kuri we.

Nuko bamwe mu Bisirayeli badūgana n’abaherezi bamwe n’ Abalewi n’abaririmvyi b’abashibamyi n’abahawe ibango ry’ibikorwa vy’urusengero; abo baja i Yerusalemu mu mwaka ugira indwi Aritazeruzi ari ku ngoma.
Nuko Ezira ashika i Yerusalemu mu kwezi kwa gatanu kwo mu mwaka ugira indwi nyene uwo mwami ari ku ngoma.
Yari yahagurutse ava i Babuloni ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa mbere, maz’ ashika i Yerusalemu ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa gatanu, abihawe n’ikiganza ciza c’Imana cari kuri we;
kuko Ezira yari yarīnāmūye mu mutima kwitwaririka ivyagezwe vy’Uhoraho ngw abishitse, kandi ngo yigishe mu Bisirayeli amabgirizwa n’amatēka.
Aya majambo n’amwe n’ayo mu cete umwami Aritazeruzi yahaye Ezira umuherezi ari we mwanditsi, mbere yar’ umwanditsi azi amajambo y’ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho n’ivyo yashingiye Abisirayeli:
ngo Jewe Aritazeruzi umwami aganza abami, ndakwandikiye Ezira umuherezi, umunyabgenge azi ivyagezwe vy’Imana Nyen’ ijuru: n’amahoro neza?
None nshinze ibgirizwa ryo kurekura abo mu bantu b’ Abisirayeli bose baba mu bihugu vyanje bīgombera ubgabo kujana nawe i Yerusalemu, bo n’abaherezi babo n’Abalewi.
Kuko jewe umwami n’abajanama banje ukw ar’ indwi, tugutumye ng’ uje kubaza ivy’ i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu, nk’ukw ivyagezwe vy’Imana yawe bimeze, ivy’ ufise mu maboko yawe;
kandi ng’ ugende ujanye amafeza n’amazahabu, ayo jewe umwami n’abajanama banje twashikaniye Imana y’Abisirayeli iba i Yerusalemu,
bo n’amafeza yose n’amazahabu uzosanga mu gihugu c’i Babuloni cose, hamwe n’amashikanwa y’abantu n’ay’ abaherezi, ayo bāshikaniye ingoro y’Imana yabo ir’ i Yerusalemu bivuye ku mitima;

ni co gituma ayo mahera ukwiye kugira umwete cane wo kuzoyagura amamasa n’ amapfizi y’intama bo n’imyagazi, hamwe n’amashikanwa y’amafu n’ay’ ibiturire agendana na vyo, ukazobitangira ku gicaniro c’ingoro y’Imana yanyu i Yerusalemu.
Kand’ ibizosāguka kur’ ayo mafeza n’amazahabu, mwe na bagenzi banyu muze mubikoreshe uko mubona bikwiye, mukurikiye ivyo Imana yanyu igomba;
kand’ ibintu vy’imbombovu uhawe vyo gukoresha mu ngoro y’Imana yawe, uz’ ubishikirize iyo Mana y’i Yerusalemu.
Kand’ ibintu vyose ingoro y’ Imana yawe izokenera, ivyo uzoba ukwiye gutanga, uz’ uhore ubikūra mu nzu ibīkwamw’ ibintu vyanje.

Kandi jewe umwami Aritazeruzi, mbariye abazezwabintu banje bose bo hakurya y’ uruzi, ku vya Ezira umuherezi, umwanditsi w’ivyagezwe vy’Imana Nyen’ ijuru, yukw ivy’ azobāka vyose bizohora bitanganwa umwete,
bikagarukira kw italanto z’ ifeza ijana, n’ingero zitwa koro z’ingano ijana, n’imibindi ya vino ijana, n’imibindi y’amavuta ijana nyene, n’umunyu utarinze kugerwa.
Ic’ Imana Nyen’ ijuru izokwaka cose kize gihore kigirirwa ingoro yayo bidatevye, kugira ng’ uburake bgayo ntibube ku gihugu canje n’abahungu banje.

Kandi turabamenyesha ivy’ abaherezi n’Abalewi, n’abaririmvyi n’abashibamyi, n’abahawe ibango ry’ibikorwa vy’urusengero, n’abakozi bo mur’ iyo ngoro y’ Imana bose uko bangana, ko bitemewe ko bākwa ikori cank’ ikibuguro cank’ ingorore.

Kandi nawe Ezira, nk’uk’ ubgenge bg’ Imana buri muri wewe, uz’ utore abashingantahe n’abacamanza bo gucīra imanza abantu bose bo hakurya y’uruzi, abazi ivyagezwe vy’Imana yawe bose; n’ūtabizi muze muhore mubimwigisha.
Maz’ ūtazokwumvira ivyagezwe vy’Imana yawe n’ivyagezwe vyanje umwami, baze bagire umwete wo kumucīra urubanza, ar’ urwo kwicwa, cank’ urwo gucibga, cank’ urwo kunyagwa ivyiwe, cank’ urwo kubohwa.
Uhoraho Imana ya ba sogokuruza aragahezagirwa, yashize mu mutima w’umwami imigabo imeze irtyo, yo gushariza ingoro y’Uhoraho ir’ i Yerusalemu.

Kandi ni we yerekanye imbabazi ziwe kuri jewe imbere y’ umwami n’abajanama biwe, n’ imbere y’abaganwa biwe bose bahambaye. Nuko ndemeshwa n’ikiganza c’Uhoraho Imana yanje cari kuri jewe; nca nkoranya abakuru bo mu Bisirayeli ngo tudūgane.
Aba ni bo bakuru b’amazu ya ba sekuruza twādūganye tuva i Babuloni, ku ngoma y’umwami Aritazeruzi, kand’ uku ni kwo ba sekuruza badōndōrwa.
Mu ba Finehasi ni Gerushomu; mu ba Itamari ni Daniyeli; mu ba Dawidi ni Hatushi,
wo muri bene Shekaniya; mu ba Paroshi ni Zekariya, kandi yandikanywe n’ abagabo ijana na mirongwitanu banditswe mu gitabo kidōndōra ba sekuruza.
Mu ba Pahati‐mowabu ni Elihowenayi mwene Zerahiya, kand’ uwo yandikanywe n’abagabo amajana abiri.
Mu ba Shekaniya ni mwene Yahaziyeli, kand’ uwo yandikanywe n’ abagabo amajana atatu.
Mu ba Adini ni Ebedi mwene Yonatani; uwo yandikanywe n’abagabo mirongwitanu.
Mu ba Elamu ni Yeshaya mwene Ataliya, na we yandikanywe n’abagabo mirongwirindwi.
Mu ba Shefatiya ni Zebadiya mwene Mikayeli, na we yandikanywe n’abagabo mirongumunani.
Mu ba Yowabu ni Obadiya mwene Yehiyeli, na we yandikanywe n’abagabo amajana abiri n’icumi n’umunani.
Mu ba Shelomiti ni mwene Yosifiya, na we yandikanywe n’abagabo ijana na mirongwitandatu.
Mu ba Bebayi ni Zekariya mwene Bebayi nyene, na we yandikanywe n’abagabo mirongwibiri n’ umunani.
Mu ba Azigadi ni Yohanani mwene Hakatani, na we yandikanywe n’abagabo ijana n’ icumi.
Mu ba Adonikamu, ari bo baje hanyuma, aya ni yo mazina yabo: Elifeleti na Yeweli na Shemaya, na bo bandikanywe n’ abagabo mirongwitandatu.
Kandi mu ba Bigivayi ni Utayi na Zabudi, na bo bandikanywe n’ abagabo mirongwirindwi.
Nuko mbakoraniriza ku ruzi rusēsera muri Ahava, tuhaca insago, tuhamara imisi itatu. Nitegereje abo bantu n’abaherezi, nsanga nta n’umwe wo mu Balewi ari muri bo.
Maze ntuma kuri Eliyezeri na Ariyeli na Shemaya na Elinatani na Yaribu na Elinatani wundi na Natani na Zekariya na Meshulamu, ari bo bantu b’abashingantahe, bo na Yoyaribu na Elinatani b’abigisha.

Ndaheza ndabatuma kuri Ido w’umushingantahe w’ahītwa i Kasifiya, mbabgira ubutumwa bazomubgira bo na bagenzi biwe babawe ibango ry’ibikorwa vy’ urusengero, aho bāba i Kasifiya nyene, ngo baturungikire abo guhēreza mu ngoro y’Imana yacu.

Maze kubg’ ikiganza ciza c’ Imana yacu cari kuri twebge batuzanira umuntu w’umunyabgenge wo mu bandurutse kuri Mahili, Mahili wa Lewi, Lewi wa Isirayeli; batuzanira na Sherebiya n’abahungu biwe na bagenzi biwe ukw ar’ icumi n’umunani,
na Hashabiya hamwe na Yeshaya wo mu bandurutse kuri Merari, na bagenzi biwe n’abahungu babo ukw ari mirongwibiri,

bo n’abo mu bahawe ibango ry’ibikorwa vy’urusengero, abandurutse ku bo Dawidi n’abāmutwarira bāri bāratanze ngo bakorere Abalewi, abanyebango amajana abiri na mirongwibiri, bose badōndwa amazina yabo.
Maze ntāngāriza aho nyene kur’ urwo ruzi Ahava ivyo kwisonzesha, kugira ngo twicishe bugufi imbere y’Imana yacu, ngo tuyisabe iduhe kugira urugendo rwiza, twebge n’abana bacu n’ ibintu vyacu vyose.

Kuko vyanteye isoni gusaba umwami umuce w’ingabo n’abagendera ku mafarasi, ngo baze badutabare kwivuna abansi bodutegera mu nzira; kuko twari twabgiye umwami, tut’ Ikiganza c’Imana yacu kiri ku bayitwaririka bose, ngw ibagirire neza; arik’ ububasha bgayo n’uburake birwanya abayireka bose.
Nuko turisonzesha, dusaba Imana tuyinginga, iraheza yemera kutwumvira.
Maze ntora icumi na babiri mu bakuru b’abaherezi, ari bo Sherebiya na Hashabiya, n’abandi cumi muri bagenzi babo.

Maz’ amafeza n’amazahabu n’ ibintu vy’imbombovu mbigera ku munzane babona, ari vyo vyatanzwekw amashikanwa y’ingoro y’ Imana yacu, ivy’ umwami n’ abajanama biwe n’abaganwa biwe n’Abisirayeli bāriho bose bāshikanye.
Nuko ndabigera, ndaheza ndabibazēza, ar’ italanto z’ ifeza amajana atandatu na mirongwitanu, n’ibintu vy’imbombovu bicuzwe mu mafeza italanto ijana, n’italanto z’izahabu ijana nyene;
n’ibikombe vy’izahabu mirongwibiri biciye amahera yitwa dariki igihumbi, n’ibikoreshwa bibiri vy’imiringa myiza isenwe y’ igiciro kinini nk’ic’ izahabu.
Ndababgira, nti Mwebge mur’ aberejwe Uhoraho, n’ibintu vy’ imbombovu na vyo nyene n’ ivyera, kand’ ayo mafeza n’amazahabu ni yo mashikanwa bashikaniye Uhoraho Imana ya ba sogokuruza bivuye ku mitima.
Muvyitwaririke mubizigame, kugeza aho muzobigerera ku munzane imbere y’abakuru b’abaherezi n’Abalewi n’abakuru b’ amazu ya ba sogokuruza b’Abisirayeli, mu vyumba vyo mu ngoro y’Uhoraho i Yerusalemu.
Nukw abaherezi n’Abalewi bākīra ayo mafeza n’amazahabu n’ibindi bintu uk’ urugero rwavyo rwangana, ngo babijane i Yerusalemu mu ngoro y’Imana yacu.

Maze ku musi ugira icumi na kabiri w’ukwezi kwa mbere turahaguruka tuva kur’ urwo ruzi Ahava, ngo tuje i Yerusalemu; ikiganza c’Imana yacu kiba kuri twebge, iradukiza ngo ntitugwe mu maboko y’abansi n’abaturyamiye mu mayira.
Dushitse i Yerusalemu turuhuka imisi itatu.

Maze ku musi ugira kane bagera ku munzane ayo mafeza n’ amazahabu n’ibindi bintu, babigerera mu ngoro y’Imana yacu, babishikiriza Meremoti mwene Uriya umuherezi, ari kumwe na Eleyazari mwene Finehasi, kandi bari bafatanije na Yozabadi mwene Yosuwa na Nowadiya mwene Binuwi, b’Abalewi.
Vyose barabiharūra ukw igitigiri cavyo n’ukuriba kwavyo vyangana. Ico gihe nyene ukuriba kwavyo kwose kurandikwa.

Maz’ abāgarutse bavuye mu kinyago bosereza Imana y’Abisirayeli ibimazi; batanga amamasa cumi n’abiri kw ikimazi c’Abisirayeli bose, n’amapfizi y’ intama mirongwicenda n’atandatu, n’imyagazi y’intama mirongwirindwi n’indwi; batanga n’amasuguru y’impene cumi n’abiri kw ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha; ivyo vyose vyabaye ikimazi coserezwa Uhoraho.
Maz’ amajambo y’ umwami bayashikiriza ivyēgēra vyiwe n’abaganza hakuno y’uruzi, na bo batanga ivyo gufasha abantu bo n’ingoro y’Imana.

Nukw ivyo vyose birangiye, abakuru baraza barambarira, bat’ Abisirayeli n’abaherezi n’ Abalewi ntibitandukanije n’abantu bo mur’ ibi bihugu, ariko bakora ivy’ ubuyobe, ivy’ Abanyakanani n’ivy’ Abaheti n’ivy’ Abaferizi n’ivy’ Abayebusi n’ivy’ Abamoni n’ivy’ Abanyamowabu n’ivy’ Abanyegiputa n’ivy’ Abamori;

kuk’ ubgabo bābiriye abageni bo muri bo, bakabashingira n’abahungu babo, bigatuma uruvyaro rwera rusukirana n’urw’ abantu bo mur’ ibi bihugu; mber’ abakuru n’abashingantahe ni bo babaye aba mbere mur’ ico gicumuro.
Maze numvise ivyo nitantamurirakw imvune bo n’umutamana, nishikura umushatsi nishikura n’ ubganwa, nicara numiwe.
Maz’ aho ndi hakoranira abahindishwa agashitsi bose n’amajambo y’ Imana y’Abisirayeli, kubg’ igicumuro c’abavuye mu kinyago; nkomeza kwicara numiwe, gushitsa ku gihe co gutanga ikimazi ca ni kera.
Ikimazi ca ni kera kimaze gushikanwa, mva hasi aho nari nicaye ntēterewe, imvune yanje n’ umutamana wanje ar’ ibitabagurike; nca nkubita amavi hasi, nayira amaboko Uhoraho Imana yanje;

ndavuga, nt’ Ewe Mana yanje, isoni ziriko zirammwa, mu maso hanje hāhīndānye, bimbuza kukwunamurirakw amaso, Mana yanje, kukw ibigabitanyo vyacu bigwiriye, bikaba umurengera, ivyo twakoze biradutsinze, vyarundanye bigera mw ijuru.

Uhereye mu bihe vya ba sogokuruza twamye dukora ibidutsinda vyinshi cane, gushitsa na bugingo n’ubu; kand’ ibigabitanyo vyacu ni vyo vyatumye twe n’abami bacu n’ abaherezi bacu tugaburwa mu maboko y’abami bo mu bindi bihugu, tukagenda twicwa n’ inkota, tukajanwa tur’ imbohe, tukanyagwa utwacu, tukaba ibimāramāre nk’uko bimeze uyu musi.

Ariko noneho mur’ aka kanya gatoya Uhoraho Imana yacu atweretse ikigongwe ciwe, adusigariza amasigarira, adushimangiye nk’umusumari Ahēra hiwe, kugira ngw akeshe amaso yacu, aduhēmbūre buhoro mu bugurano bgacu.

Kuko na none tur’ abagurano; arikw Imana yacu ntiyaduhebeye mu bugurano bgacu, arikw itugirira ikigongwe, yerekana imbabazi kuri twebge imbere y’abami b’i Buperesi, iraduhēmbūra, kugira ngo dusubire twubake ingoro y’Imana yacu, kandi ngo dusane ahasenyutse hayo, ngw iduhe n’uruzitiro rudukikije i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu.
None ga Mana yacu, ivyo ko vyabaye birtyo, twovuga iki kandi? Ko twaretse ivyagezwe vyawe,

ivyo washingiye mu basavyi bawe wavugisha, ukavuga, ut’ Igihugu mugiyemwo ngo mucegukire n’igihugu candujwe n’ibizira vy’amahanga yo mur’ ivyo bihugu, n’ivy’ ubuyobe bakora, bacujuje ubuhumane bgabo hose iyo kiva kikagera;

kand’ uti Ntimuze mushingirane na bo, ntimuze mwigere mubendeza ivy’ amahoro cank’ ivyiza, kugira ngo mubone kugira inkomezi, murye ivyiza vyo mu gihugu, muzokiraga n’abana banyu kibe inyegu yabo ibihe vyose.

None rero kw ivyo vyose bidushitseko, tukaba dutsinzwe n’ivyo twakoze vyinshi, tuzize ingeso zacu mbi, nawe Mana yacu ukaba utaduhannye igihano cari gikwiranye n’ibigabitanyo vyacu, kuk’ udushigarije amasigarira angana artya,
mbega twongeye kurenga ivyagezwe vyawe, dushingirana n’abanyamahanga bakora ivyo bintu vy’ ubuyobe? Ntuca uturakira kugeza uturanduye, ntihagire amasigarira canke n’uwa kirazira?

Uhoraho Mana y’Abisirayeli, ni wewe ugororoka; kuko twebge dusigaye tur’ amasigarira, nk’uko bimeze uyu musi; rāba tur’ imbere yawe dutsinzwe n’urubanza; ivyo ni vyo bituma tudashobora guhagarara imbere yawe.
Nuko Ezira agisenga yātura, kand’ arira, yikubise hasi imbere y’ingoro y’Imana, ikoraniro rinini cane ry’Abisirayeli, abagabo n’abagore n’abana, bakoranira ah’ ari; kand’ abantu bararira cane.

Maze Shekaniya mwene Yehiyeli, umwe wo mu bandurutse kuri Elamu, abgira Ezira, ati Twacumuye ku Mana yacu, ko twābiriye abanyamahangakazi bo mu mahanga yo mur’ ibi bihugu; yamara naho bimeze birtyo haracar’ ivyizigiro vy’ukw Abisirayeli bokira.

Nuko rero none dusezerane isezerano n’Imana yacu yuko twirukana abo bagore bose n’ abana bāvyaye, dukurikiye inama yawe mugenzi, n’iy’ abubaha icagezwe c’Imana yacu; kandi bigenzwe nk’ukw ivyagezwe bigera.
Va hasi, kukw ar’ ivyawe, kandi turi kumwe nawe; shira ubgoba, ubikore.
Nuko Ezira aca ava hasi, arahiza abakuru b’ abaherezi n’Abalewi n’Abisirayeli bose, yuko bazobigenza nk’uko bagiye inama. Nuko bararahira.

Maze Ezira arahaguruka ava imbere y’ingoro y’Imana, aja mu cumba ca Yehohanani mwene Eliyashibu; arikw ashitseyo ntiyagira ic’ atamira, nta n’amazi yasomye, kuko yari yababajwe n’ igicumuro c’abāvuye mu kinyago.
Hanyuma batāngāza i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu ngw abavuye mu kinyago bose bakoranire i Yerusalemu;
kandi ngo mu misi itatu, ūtazoba yaje nk’ukw abakuru n’ abashingantahe bahuje inama, azonyagwa ivyiwe vyose, kandi na we ubgiwe agacibga mw ikoraniro ry’ abavuye mu kinyago.

Nuko mur’ iyo misi itatu Abayuda n’Ababenyamini bose bari bamaze gukoranira i Yerusalemu; hāri ku musi ugira mirongwibiri w’ukwezi kw’icenda; abantu bose bagandagaza ku kibuga imbere y’ ingoro y’Imana, bahindishwa agashitsi n’ivyo, kandi n’uko hāri n’ imvura nyinshi.
Maze Ezira umuherezi arahaguruka, arababarira, ati Mwaracumuye, mwābīra abagore b’abanyamahangakazi, mwongerereza Abisirayeli icaha.
None ni mwaturire Uhoraho Imana ya ba sogokuruza ivyo, mukore ivy’ igomba, mwitandukanye n’amahanga yo mu bihugu n’abagore b’abanyamahangakazi.
Nukw ikoraniro ryose bamwishura n’ijwi rirenga, bat’ Ic’ utugezeko ni co twemeye gukora.
Arikw abantu ni benshi, kandi n’igihe c’imvura nyinshi, ntitwoshobora guhagarara hanze. Kand’ ico gikorwa s’ic’ umusi umwe cank’ ibiri, kuko twacumuye cane mur’ ivyo.

None rer’ abakuru bacu ni basigarire iri koraniro ryose; maz’ abo mu bisagara vyacu bose bābiriye abanyamahangakazi, baze bame baza mu bihe bishinzwe, bāzanywe n’abakuru b’ibisagara vyose n’abacamanza bavyo, bashitse igihe uburake bg’Imana yacu bg’inkazi buzotuvirako, ubgo yatugiriye kubg’ ivyo bintu.
Ariko Yonatani mwene Asaheli na Yahazeya mwene Tikuva ni bo bāvuye hasi bahakana iyo nama; kandi bafatanya na Meshulamu na Shabetayi Umulewi.

Nukw abavuye mu kinyago babigenza bartyo. Maze Ezira umuherezi na bamwe bo mu bakuru b’amazu ya ba sekuruza, baratorwa, nk’ukw amazu yabo ari, bose bahamagarwa mu mazina yabo; nuko ku musi wa mbere w’ ukwezi kw’icumi baricara barabisuzuma.
Ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa mbere bari barangije ivy’ abantu bose bari barābiriye abagore b’abanyamahangakazi.
Abo mu bana b’abaherezi bābiriye abagore b’abanyamahangakazi ni Mayaseya na Eliyezeri na Yaribu na Gedaliya muri bene Yosuwa, Yosuwa mwene Yehozadaki, na bagenzi biwe.
Abo bararahira bakorana mu ntoke yuko birukana abagore babo; kandi batanga impfizi y’ intama kw iciru, kuko batsinzwe n’urubanza.
Muri bene Imeri, ni Hanani na Zebadiya.
Muri bene Harimu, ni Mayaseya na Eliya na Shemaya na Yehiyeli na Uziya.
Muri bene Pashuri, ni Eliyowenayi na Mayaseya na Ishimayeli na Netaneli na Yozabadi na Elasa.
Mu Balewi, ni Yozabadi na Shimeyi na Kelaya (ari we Kelita), na Petahiya na Yuda na Eliyezeri.
Mu baririmvyi, ni Eliyashibu; mu bashibamyi, ni Shalumu na Telemu na Uri.
Mu Bisirayeli bandi, abo mu ba Paroshi, ni Ramiya na Iziya na Malikiya na Miyamini na Eleyazari na Malakiya na Benaya.
Mu ba Elamu, ni Mataniya na Zekariya na Yehiyeli na Abudi na Yeremoti na Eliya.
Mu ba Zatu, ni Eliyowenayi na Eliyashibu na Mataniya na Yeremoti na Zabadi na Aziza.
Mu ba Bebayi, ni Yehohanani na Hananiya na Zabayi na Atilayi.
Mu ba Bani, ni Meshulamu na Maluki na Adaya na Yashubu na Sheyeli na Yeremoti.
Mu ba Pahati‐mowabu, ni Adina na Kelali na Benaya na Mayaseya na Mataniya na Besaleli na Binuwi na Manase.
Mu ba Harimu, ni Eliyezeri na Ishiya na Malikiya na Shemaya na Simeyoni,
na Benyamini na Maluki na Shemariya.
Mu ba Hashumu, ni Matenayi na Matata na Zabadi na Elifeleti na Yeremayi na Manase na Shimeyi.
Mu ba Bani, ni Mayadayi na Amuramu na Uweli,
na Benaya na Bedeya na Keluhi,
na Vaniya na Meremoti na Eliyashibu,
na Mataniya na Matenayi na Yahasu,
na Bani na Binuwi na Shimeyi,
na Shelemiya na Natani na Adaya,
na Makinadebayi na Shashayi na Sharayi,
na Azareli na Shelemiya na Shemariya,
na Shalumu na Amariya na Yosefu.
Mu ba Nebo, ni Yeyeri na Matitiya na Zabadi na Zebina na Ido na Yoweli na Benaya.
Abo bose bāri bābiriye abagore b’abanyamahangakazi, mbere bamwe muri bo bāri bamaze kuvyarana abana.
Amajambo ya Nehemiya mwene Hakaliya. Mu kwezi kwa Kisilevu, mu mwaka ugira mirongwibiri, nari nsanzwe ndi ku murwa i Shushani.

Maze Hanani, umwe wo muri bene wacu, araza azananye n’abantu bamwe bavuye i Buyuda. Mbabaza inkuru z’amasigarira y’ Abayuda, abāri barasigaye batajanywe ar’ inyagano, mbabaza n’ inkuru z’i Yerusalemu.
Barambgira, bat’ Abāri barasigaye mur’ ico gihugu batājanywe ar’ inyagano bari n’amarushwa menshi n’ibitētērwa, kand’ inzitiro z’ amabuye z’i Yerusalemu zarasenyutse, n’amarembo yaho yarahiye.
Nuko mmaze kwumva izo nkuru nca nicara ngaho ndarira, mmara imisi mbabaye nisonzesha, nsengera imbere y’Imana Nyen’ ijuru.
Ndavuga, nti Ndakwinginze, ewe Uhoraho, Mana Nyen’ ijuru, Mana nkuru uteye ubgoba, ukagumya isezerano n’ imbabazi ugirira abagukunda bakitondera ivyagezwe vyawe.

None tega ugutwi kwawe wumvirize, tereza n’inyonga zawe witegereze, kugira ngo wumve ugusenga kwanje, jewe umusavyi wawe nsengera imbere yawe mur’ iyi misi ku murango no mw ijoro, nkwingingira abasavyi bawe b’ Abisirayeli, nātura ivyaha twebge Abisirayeli twagucumuyeko; mbere twe n’inzu ya data twaracumuye.
Eka twaragucumuyeko bikomeye, ntitwitondeye ivyagezwe vyawe n’ivyo washinze n’amabgirizwa yawe, ivyo wageze umusavyi wawe Mose.
Ni wibuke ijambo wabariye umusavyi wawe Mose, uti Ni mwandyaruka nzobashwiragiriza mu mahanga;

ut’ Ariko ni mwampindukirira, mukitondera ivyagezwe vyanje mukabishitsa, nah’ abirukanywe bo muri mwebge bazoba bar’ iy’ ijuru riherera, uti Sinobura kubakūrayo nkabēgeranya, nkabazana ha hantu nitoranirije ngw izina ryanje rihabe.
None rero, abo ni bo basavyi bawe, kandi n’abantu bawe wacunguje ububasha bgawe bginshi bo n’ukuboko kwawe kw’ inkomezi.

Bgirukiro, ndakwinginze, tega ugutwi wumve ugusenga kwanje, jewe umusavyi wawe, wumve n’ugusenga kw’ abasavyi bawe bakunda kwubaha izina ryawe, untabare jewe umusavyi wawe, umpe kugira amahirwe uyu musi, no guhangazwa n’uwo muntu nsavye. Kuko nari nsanzwe nd’ umukevyi mpereza umwami igiturire.

Nuko mu mwaka ugira mirongwibiri umwami Aritazeruzi ari ku ngoma, mu kwezi kwa Nisani, umusi ur’ izina vino yar’ iteretse imbere y’umwami, maze ndayābira, ndayimuhēreza. Kandi sinaribgagire umubabaro nd’ imbere yiwe.
Nuk’ umwami arambaza, ati Mbega k’ubabaye, wiraburaniwe mu maso, kand’ utarwaye? Ivyo ntibiterwa n’ikindi, atar’ umubabaro wo mu mutima. Ndaheza ngira ubgoba bginshi;
ndamwishura, nti Mwami nyaguhora ku ngoma, mbega nobura kwiraburanirwa, igisagara ca ba sogokuruza, aho bāhambge, carabaye amatongo kand’ amarembo yaco yarahiye?
Nuk’ umwami arambaza, ati Non’ ugomba iki? Nca nsenga Imana Nyen’ ijuru.
Maze nishura umwami, nti Ni wabishima ga mugenzi, nkagira ubutoni imbere yawe, ico ngusaba n’ukugira ng’ undungike i Buyuda, mu gisagara kirimw’ imva za ba sogokuruza, nsubire ndacubake.

Kand’ umwami yar’ avyagiye ngaho ari kumwe n’umwamikazi wiwe; nukw arambaza, at’ Urugendo rwawe ruzoba urw’ imisi ingahe kand’ uzogaruka ryari? Nuk’ umwami yemera kundekura, nanje nca ndamubgira igihe.
Ndaheza ndamubarira, nti Ni wabishima ga mugenzi, mpabge ivyete nshīra ivyēgēra vyawe vyo hakurya y’ uruzi, kugira ngo bemere kumpa inzira nshike i Buyuda,

bo n’ icete nshira Asafu, umurinzi arinda icibare cawe, kugira ngw ampe ibiti vyo kubāza ibikingi vy’amarembo y’igihome c’abashibamyi co ku ngoro, bo n’ivy’ uruzitiro rw’igisagara n’ivy’ inzu nzobamwo. Nuk’ umwami arabinyemerera, abitewe n’ikiganza ciza c’Imana cari kuri jewe.
Maze ngenda njanye n’abagabisha b’ingabo bo n’abagendera ku mafarasi umwami yampaye, nshikīra ivyēgēra vyiwe vyo hakurya y’uruzi, mbahēreza ivyete umwami yandungikanye.
Buno Sanibalati Umuhoroni bo na Tobiya Umwamoni w’umugurano bavyumvise, bibamerera nabi cane yuko haje umuntu ababaye Abisirayeli.
Nuko nshitse i Yerusalemu mmaray’ imisi itatu.
Ndaheza mpenga mw ijoro mvyukana n’ abantu bake, kandi sinagize umuntu n’umwe mbgira ivyo Imana yashize mu mutima wanje ngo ndabikorere Yerusalemu; kandi nta mafarasi twajanye atar’ iyo nagenderako.

Nukw iryo joro nca mw irembo rija ku mwonga, nkomeza inzira y’isōko y’ikiyoka, nshika no kw irembo bācishamw’ umwavu, ngenda nitegereza inzitiro z’amabuye z’i Yerusalemu ukuntu zāsenyutse, n’amarembo yaho ingene yahiye.
Maze nkomeza inzira nshika kw irembo rija kw iriba, nshika no ku kidengeri c’umwami, ariko ntihaboneka inzira ifarasi nagenderako icamwo.
Nukw iryo joro nyene nsubira kudūgana akagezi, nkomeza kugenda nitegereza inzitiro, ndaheza ndakevya nsubira guca muri rya rembo rija ku mwonga; nuko ndataha.
Arikw abakuru ntibari bazi iyo nagiye cank’ ico nakoze, kandi nta co naribgabarire Abayuda, ar’ abaherezi cank’ abanyacubahiro cank’ abakuru cank’ abandi bose bazokorana nanje ico gikorwa.

Maze ndababarira, nti Mbega ntimubona ayo twabonye, ingen’ i Yerusalemu hahindutse imisaka, n’amarembo yaho akaba yarahīye! Enda ni muze dusubire twubake uruzitiro rwaho, kugira ngo twoye kwama tur’ agatwengo.

Ndaheza mbiganira ingen’ ikiganza ciza c’Imana yanje cabaye kuri jewe, mbiganira n’amajambo umwami yambgiye; na bo baravuga, bati Ni tuve hasi twubake. Nuko bariyungunganya, bashirako bakora ico gikorwa ciza.

Ariko Sanibalati Umuhoroni, na Tobiya Umwamoni w’umugurano, na Geshemu Umwarabo, bavyumvise baradushinyagurira, batubarirana agakengerwe, bat’ Ivyo mukora n’ibiki? Mbega s’ uko mugomba kugarariza umwami?
Nanje ndabishura, nt’ Imana yo mw ijuru ni yo izotuma bikunda, ni co gituma twebge abasavyi bayo dushirako tukubaka; ariko mweho nta mugabane, nta bubasha, nta n’icibutso mufise i Yerusalemu.

Bukeye Eliyashibu, umuherezi mukuru, hamwe na bagenzi biwe b’abaherezi, bashirako bubaka irembo ry’intama; bararihezagira, bashiraho n’inzugi zaryo; bakomeza kwubaka barinda bashitsa ku munara wa Hameya, na wo barawuhezagira; bavudukaho bashitsa no ku munara wa Hananeli.
Maz’ ab’ i Yeriko bahēra aho Eliyashibu yagarukiye, barubaka; bakurikirwa na Zakuri mwene Imuri.
Irembo ryitwa iry’ Amafi ryubakwa na bene Hasenaya, barishiramw’ imitambikwa yaryo, baterako n’inzugi zaryo n’ivyuma vyo kuzigumya n’ibihindizo vyazo.
Bakurikirwa na Meremoti mwene Uriya, Uriya wa Hakosi, mu kuhasana; na we akurikirwa na Meshulamu mwene Berekiya, Berekiya wa Meshezabeli; na we akurikirwa na Sadoki mwene Bayana.
Bakurikirwa n’ab’i Tekowa, arikw abapfasoni bo muri bo ntibarushe bemera gukora igikorwa ca Segaba.
Irembo rya kera ryasanwe na Yoyada mwene Paseya na Meshulamu mwene Besodeya; barishiramw’ imitambikwa yaryo, baterako n’inzugi zaryo n’ivyuma vyo kuzigumya n’ibihindizo vyazo.
Bakurikirwa na Melatiya w’i Gibeya na Yadoni w’i Meronoti, hamwe n’ab’i Gibeya n’ab’i Misipa bo mu baganzwa n’icēgēra c’ umwami co hakuno y’uruzi.

Bakurikirwa na Uziyeli mwene Harihaya, umwe wo mu bacuzi b’izahabu; na we akurikirwa na Hananiya, umwe wo mu bahinga bazi kwinjiza imibavu; nuko basana inzitiro z’i Yerusalemu bashitsa no ku ruzitiro rw’intimba nini.
Bakurikirwa na Refaya mwene Huri, umukuru aganza igice kimwe c’intāra y’i Yerusalemu;
akurikirwa na Yedaya mwene Harumafu, asana aherekeye inzu yiwe; na we akurikirwa na Hatushi mwene Hashabuneya.
Malakiya mwene Harimu, na Hashubu mwene Pahati‐mowabu, basana ikindi gice, bo n’umunara wo ku matanure.
Akurikirwa na Shalumu mwene Haloheshi, umukuru aganza ikindi gice c’i Yerusalemu nyene, na we arasana, bo n’abakobga biwe.

Irembo rija ku mwonga ryasanwe na Hanuni bo n’abantu b’i Zanowa; bararyubaka, baterako n’inzugi zaryo n’ivyuma vyo kuzigumya n’ibihindizo vyazo, basana uruzitiro rw’amatambge igihumbi y’ukuboko uciriye mu nkokora, bageza kw irembo ricishwamw’ umwavu.
Iryo rembo ricishwamw’ umwavu ryasanwe na Malakiya mwene Rekabu, umukuru aganza intāra y’i Beti‐hakeremu; araryubaka, aterakw inzugi zaryo n’ ivyuma vyo kuzigumya n’ibihindizo vyazo.

Irembo rija kw iriba risanwa na Shalumu mwene Koli‐hoze, umukuru aganza intāra y’i Misipa, araryubaka ararisakara, ariterakw inzugi zaryo, n’ivyuma vyo kuzigumya n’ibihindizo vyazo, yubaka n’uruzitiro rwo ku kidengeri Shela co ku ndimiro y’umwami, kurinda ashitsa ahagenda hadondagirwa hamanuka hava ku gisagara ca Dawidi.
Hakurikira Nehemiya mwene Azibuki, umukuru aganza igice c’intāra y’i Beti‐suri, agenda arasana ashitsa aharābana n’imva za Dawidi, no ku kidengeri cāgomewe, arinda ashitsa no ku nzu y’abahizi.
Akurikirwa n’Abalewi, Rehumu mwene Bani, na we akurikirwa na Hashabiya, umukuru aganza igice c’ intāra y’i Keyila, asana akorera intāra yiwe.
Hakurikira bagenzi babo bava mu kindi gice c’ intāra y’i Keyila nyene, umukuru ni Bavayi mwene Henadadi.
Hakurikira umukuru w’i Misipa, ni we Ezeri mwene Yeshuwa, asana igihimba kirābana n’ahadondagirwa hadūga ku nzu y’ ibirwanishwa iri ku mfuruka y’ uruzitiro.
Akurikirwa na Baruki mwene Zabayi, asana ikindi gihimba afise umwete, ahereye kur’ iyo mfuruka nyene, arinda ashitsa ku muryango w’inzu ya Eliyashibu umuherezi mukuru.
Akurikirwa na Meremoti mwene Uriya, Uriya wa Hakosi, asana ikindi gihimba, ahereye ku muryango w’iyo nzu ya Eliyashibu akageza ah’ iyo nzu nyene igarukira.
Akurikirwa n’abaherezi bo mur’ iyo ntāra.
Na bo bakurikirwa na Benyamini na Hashubu, basana aharābana n’ inzu yabo; bakurikirwa na Azariya mwene Mayaseya, Mayaseya wa Ananiya, asana ahabangikanye n’inzu yiwe.
Akurikirwa na Binuwi mwene Henadadi, asana ikindi gihimba ahereye kur’ iyo nzu ya Azariya ashitsa ah’ uruzitiro rwiheteye, ku mfuruka.
Akurikirwa na Palali mwene Uzayi, asana aharābana n’ahihese, ahahera ku munara wometswe ku ngoro y’umwami yo haruguru, ahahereranye n’urugo rw’abateramyi. Na we akurikirwa na Pedaya mwene Paroshi,
bo n’abahawe ibango ry’ibikorwa vy’urusengero bāba muri Ofeli; basana ahahereranye n’irembo ry’amazi ryerekeye i burasirazuba, bo n’ umunara wometseko.
Hakurikirakw abantu b’i Tekowa, basana ikindi gihimba kirābana n’ uwo munara munini wometseko nyene, bashitsa ku ruzitiro rw’i Ofeli.
Haruguru y’irembo ry’amafarasi hasanwa n’abaherezi, umuherezi wese asana ahahereranye n’inzu yiwe.
Hakurikirako Sadoki mwene Imeri, asana ahahereranye n’inzu yiwe; hakurikira Shemaya mwene Shekaniya, umushibamyi w’irembo rihera i burasirazuba.
Akurikirwa na Hananiya mwene Shelemiya, na Hanuni umuhungu agira gatandatu wo muri bene Salafu, basana ikindi gihimba; hakurikira Meshulamu mwene Berekiya, asana ahahereranye n’icumba ciwe.

Hakurikira Malikiya, umwe wo mu bacuzi b’izahabu, arasana ashitsa ku nzu y’abahawe ibango ry’ibikorwa vy’urusengero, no ku nzu y’abadandaza, aharābana n’ irembo ryitwa Hamifukadi, kugeza ahadūga haja ku mfuruka.
Kandi hagati y’ahadūga haja ku mfuruka n’irembo ry’intama hasanwa n’abacuzi b’izahabu hamwe n’abadandaza.
Bukeye Sanibalati yumvise ko twubaka urwo ruzitiro rw’ amabuye, araraka arashangashirwa; aca aratunegura twebge Abayuda,

avugira imbere ya bagenzi biwe n’imbere y’ingabo z’i Samariya, ati Barya bagoyigoyi b’Abayuda bakora ibiki? Mbega bagomba kwizitirira? Canke bazotanga ibimazi? Mbega bagomba kwubaka ngo buzuze ku musi umwe? None bozīkurura amabuye bayakūra mu bishingwe kandi yarahiye?
Kandi na Tobiya w’Umwamoni yar’ ahagararanye na we, aravuga, ati Ni mubareke bubake! N’imbgebge yosimbira kur’ urwo ruzitiro rw’ amabuye rwoca rusenyuka!
Maze ndasenga, nti Mana yacu, ni wumve ingene dukengerewe; ibitutsi vyabo abe ari bo bisubira ku mitwe; ubatange bajanwe mu mahanga ar’ inyagano.
Ntutwikire igicumuro cabo, ntusibanganye icaha cabo ngo kive imbere yawe, kukw ijambo ryabo ar’ akavunamutima ku bubatsi.
Nuko dushimikira kwubaka uruzitiro, rwose turaruhwanya, gushitsa rutimbanye; kukw abantu bari bashize umutima kur’ ico gikorwa.
Bukeye Sanibalati na Tobiya n’Abarabo n’Abamoni n’Abanyashidodi bumvise yukw igikorwa co gusana uruzitiro rw’i Yerusalemu kija imbere, kandi yukw ibihengeri bitanguye kuzibirwa, bararaka cane,
bahiga imihigo bose yuko bazoja gutera i Yerusalemu no kutuburabuza.
Ariko twebge dusenga Imana yacu, dushiraho n’abarinzi bo kuharinda ku murango no mw ijoro, ngo tubabuze gutera.
Maz’ Abayuda baravuga, bat’ Abikorezi bacitse intege kuko har’ ibishingwe vyinshi; ntitugishoboye kwubaka uruzitiro.
Kand’ abarwanizi bacu na bo baravuga, bati Nta co bazomenya canke ngo bagire ico babona, kugeza aho tuzobūbīrira tukabīca, igikorwa cabo kigaca kiburangana.
Kand’ Abayuda bāba hafi yabo bama baza kutubūrira bava hirya no hino, mbere bātubūriye ibihetangabo cumi baja baragaruka aho turi.
Ni co catumye nshira abantu inyuma y’uruzitiro, mbashira mu myonga n’ahītārūye, ukw imiryango yabo iri, bitwaje inkota n’amacumu n’imiheto.

Mbitegereje, mva hasi mbarira abakuru n’abaganza n’abandi bose, nti Ntimubatinye. Mwibuke Umwami Imana, ahambaye ateye ubgoba, murwanire bene wanyu, n’abahungu banyu n’abakobga banyu n’abagore banyu n’ingo zanyu.
Nukw abansi bacu bumva ko vyamenyekanye muri twebge; Imana ihindura ubusa imigabo yabo, natwe twese dusubira ku ruzitiro, umuntu wese ku gikorwa ciwe.

Uhereye ico gihe mu bantu banje, igihimba cakoze ico gikorwa, ikindi gihimba bahagarara bitwaje amacumu n’inkinzo n’ imiheto, bambaye n’amakoti y’ ivyuma; kand’ abaganza bāri bahagaze inyuma y’Abayuda bose.
Nukw abubaka uruzitiro n’abikorezi n’ababakorera, umuntu wese yakoresha ukuboko kumwe, ukundi gufashe ikirwanishwa ciwe.
N’abubatsi, umuntu wese yakora yambaye inkota kw itako, akubaka artyo. Kand’ uwo kuvuza inzamba yama ar’ i ruhande yanje.
Ndaheza mbgira abakuru n’abaganza n’ abandi bose, nt’ Igikorwa cacu ni kinini kigera kure, kandi turasanzaye hose ku ruzitiro, umuntu wese ari kure y’uwundi;
none rero ni mwumva inzamba ivuze, muce mukoranira aho turi ah’ izoba ivugiye hose. Imana yacu ntizobura kuturwanira.
Uko ni ko twākora ico gikorwa; umuce umwe wo muri twebge bitwaza amacumu uhereye mu mutwenzi ugashitsa inyenyeri zibonetse.
Ico gihe nyene mbarira abantu, nt’ Umuntu wese n’aze arāre i Yerusalemu azananye n’umuntu wiwe, kugira ngo duterame mw ijoro, ku murango dukore.
Nuko nanje na bagenzi banje n’abantu banje n’abarinzi bāri kuri jewe, twese twama turāra twambaye, mbere n’ūgiye kuvoma wese yama agenda yitwaje ikirwanishwa ciwe.
Bukeye haba ugutaka gukomeye, abantu n’abagore babo bidodombera bene wabo b’Abayuda,
bati Twe n’abahungu bacu n’abakobga bacu turi benshi; ni muduhe ibidutunga turye kugira ngo tubeho.
Abandi baravuga, bat’ Amatongo yacu n’inzabibu zacu n’amazu yacu tubitangakw ingwati kugira ngo turonke ibidutunga bizodutsindira ikigoyi.
Kandi n’abandi baravuga, bati Twagwatirije amatongo n’inzabibu zacu kugira ngo batugurāne amahera y’ikori ry’umwami.

Yamara rero, imibiri yacu n’ imwe n’iya bene wacu, kand’ abana bacu ni bamwe n’ababo; kand’ ehe rāba abahungu bacu n’abakobga bacu turiko turabata mu buja. Mbere bamwe bo mu bakobga bacu baramaze kubushikamwo, kandi twabuze uko tugira, kukw amatongo yacu n’inzabibu zacu bimaze kujanwa n’abandi.
Numvise ayo majambo n’amaganya yabo nca ndaraka rwose.
Mmaze kuvyiyumvirako nca ntonganya abakuru n’abaganza, ndababgira, nti Mbega bene wanyu ko mubāka inyungu ku ngurāne! Ndaheza mpamagara ikoraniro rinini ngo ndababūranye.

Ndababgira, nti Twebge uko dushoboye twaracunguye Abayuda bagenzi bacu bāri baraguzwe n’abanyamahanga; ariko mweho bagenzi banyu murabagura, na bo bakīshora ngo tubagure! Baca barihorera babura iryo bavuga.
Ndongera ndavuga, nt’ Ivyo mukora si vyiza. Mbeg’ ibikwiye s’uko mugenda mwubaha Imana yacu, ntimwitukishe mu bansi bacu b’abanyamahanga?
Na jewe nyene, twe na bene wacu n’ abantu banje, har’ abamaze kutugurānakw amahera n’impeke; non’ enda tubibahebere.

Mber’ uyu musi mubasubize amatongo yabo, n’imirima yabo y’imizabibu n’imyelayo, n’amazu yabo; mubasubize na ca gice c’ijana c’amahera n’ic’ impeke n’ica vino n’ic’ amavuta ya elayo, ivyo mwābātse kw inyungu.
Na bo baravuga, bati Turabibasubiza, kandi nta co tuzobāka kw inyungu; tuzobigenza nk’uk’ uvuze. Ndaheza mpamagaza abaherezi, ndahiriza abo bantu imbere yabo ko bazobikora nk’uko basezeranye.

Maze nkunkumura umutamana wanje, nt’ Umuntu wese atazoshitsa iri jambo, Imana iz’ imukunkumure mu nzu yiwe no mu vyiwe; az’ abe ari kw akunkumurwa, asigare agaragara. Nukw ikoraniro ryose riremera, riti Amen; baraheza bahimbaza Uhoraho. Nukw abantu bagumya iryo sezerano.

Kand’ uhereye umusi umwami Aritazeruzi yangize icēgēra ciwe mu gihugu c’i Buyuda, kuva ku mwaka ugira mirongwibiri kugeza ku mwaka ugira mirongwitatu n’ibiri ari ku ngoma, ukw ar’ imyaka cumi n’ibiri, ari jewe ari bene wacu, nta ho twigeze dutungwa n’amarari yagerewe icēgēra c’umwami.

Arikw abanyitangiye imbere mu gutwarira umwami, bāraruhije abantu, kuko bāgenda babatoza ivyo kurya na vino, hamwe na shekeli z’ifeza mirongwine; mbere n’abasavyi babo bagatwaza abantu amanyama. Ariko jewe sinigeze ngenza ntyo, kuko nubaha Imana.
Ariko nagize umwete wo gukora, nubaka urwo ruzitiro; nta tongo na rimwe twaguze, kandi n’abantu banje bose bāma bakoranira kur’ ico gikorwa.
Kand’ abantu ijana na mirongwitanu b’Abayuda n’ababaganza bāma baza kurya i wanje, udashizemw’ abaza bavuye mu mahanga adukikije.

Ku musi ku musi twābāga inka imwe n’intama zitandatu z’intorwa, bo n’inkoko, kand’ ukw imisi cumi ishize twama tubaha vino z’ubgoko bgose; ariko naho vyangana birtyo nta ho nigeze ntoza amarari yagerewe icēgēra c’umwami, kukw abantu bāri bacumukujwe n’intwaro mbi.
Ndaheza ndasenga, nti Mana yanje, ivyo nagiriye aba bantu uz’ ubinzirikaneko, ubinyishure ivyiza.
Bukeye babgira Sanibalati na Tobiya na Geshemu Umwarabo n’abandi bansi bacu, yuko nujuje uruzitiro kandi kw ata kirengero kigisigaye, naho ntaribgatere inzugi ku marembo.
Nuko Sanibalati na Geshemu baca bantumako ngo ngende duhūrire mu mihana yo mu kiyaya c’i Ono. Arikw ico bāgomba kwar’ ukungirira nabi.
Maze mbatumakw intumwa, mut’ Arikw arakora igikorwa gihambaye, ntashobora kuza; muti Ntiyota igikorwa ngo gihagarare, ngw amanuke abasange iyo.
Bantumako bartyo ibihetangabo bine, nanje ngenda mbishura kwa kundi nyene.
Ubugira gatanu Sanibalati asubira kuntumak’ umuntu wiwe kuno nyene, amurungikana n’ icete kitazinze,

canditswemwo ngo Mu mahanga humvikana impuha, kandi na Geshemu aravyemeza, yuko wewe n’Abayuda muri n’imigabo yo kugarariza, kandi kw ari yo nyanduruko yatumye mwubaka uruzitiro, kandi nawe ng’ ugomba kwiyimika.
Bitayeko ngo Washizeho ba kamenyi bo kukwāmāmaza i Yerusalemu, ngo Mu Bayuda har’ umwami. Izo nkuru ntibobura kuzibgira umwami: none rero n’ uze tubivugane.
Ndaheza ntuma kumwishura, ut’ Ivyo uvuga nta ho vyigeze bibaho, ut’ Ariko ni wewe wavyigeneye gusa.
Kuko bose bāgomba kudutera ubgoba, bati Bazohava bacika intege, igikorwa gihere aho. Ariko none Mana, undemeshe.

Bukeye ninjira mu nzu ya Shemaya mwene Delaya, Delaya wa Mehetabeli, kand’ uyo yari yiyugaranye; arambarira, at’ Ingo tuje kubonanira mu ngoro y’ Imana, mu rusengero hagati, twugare inzugi, kuko haza kuza abantu bo kukwica: mbere mur’ iri joro nta kabuza barakwica.
Nanje ndamwishura, nti Mbeg’ umuntu nkanje nohunga? Kand’ umuntu nkanje yokwinjira mu rusengero ngo yikize? Eka sinjayo!
Maze mvyitegereje mmenya kw atar’ Imana yabimutumye, ariko yaje kubimbgira kuko Tobiya na Sanibalati bāri bāmuhēreye.
Bāmuhēreye ngw antere ubgoba, mpeze nemere inama yiwe, mbe ncumuye, na bo ngo baronke urwitwazo rwo kwanda inkuru mbi no kunyambika ibara.
Ndaheza ndasenga, nt’ Ewe Mana yanje, uze wibuke Tobiya na Sanibalati kubg’ ivyo bakoze, hamwe na Nowadiya wa mumenyikazi, n’abandi ba kamenyi bashatse kuntera ubgoba.
Ku musi ugira mirongwibiri na gatanu w’ukwezi kwa Eluli ni ho twarangije uruzitiro, tumaze imisi mirongwitanu n’ibiri turwubaka.
Maz’ abansi bacu bose bavyumvise, bo n’abanyamahanga bose bo ku mpande zacu zose, bagira ubgoba, baratētērwa, kuko bamenye kw ar’ Imana yacu yadushoboje kurangiza igikorwa kingana girtyo.
Kandi mur’ iyo misi abakuru b’i Buyuda na Tobiya bandikiranira ivyete vyinshi.
Kandi benshi bo mu Bayuda bari bafitaniye amasezerano na we, kuko yar’ umukwe wa Shekaniya mwene Ara, kand’ umuhungu wiwe Yohanani yar’ afise umukobga wa Meshulamu mwene Berekiya.
Kandi bama bambgira ivyiza kuri we, bakongera bakamubgira amajambo yanje; Tobiya na we akandungikira ivyete vyo kuntera ubgoba.
Barangije kwubaka uruzitiro nca nterakw inzugi hose, ntora abashibamyi ndabashiraho, nongera nshirah’ abaririmvyi n’ Abalewi.
Ndaheza nzeza igisagara c’i Yerusalemu mwene wacu Hanani, bo na Hananiya umukuru w’iboma y’abashibamyi, kukw ar’ umuntu yizigirwa, yubaha Imana kurusha benshi;

ndababgira, nt’ Amarembo y’i Yerusalemu ntaze yugururwe hataraba ku gasase, kandi ngo bayugarire, inzugi bazishirekw ibihindizo, izuba ritararenga; nti Maze mushireh’ abashibamyi bo mu baba i Yerusalemu, umuntu wese mu gishingo ciwe, aharābana n’inzu yiwe.
Kand’ ico gisagara cari kinini kikagera kure, arikw abantu bakibamwo bari bakiri bake, kand’ amazu ntiyaribgubakwe.

Imana yanje impa ivyiyumviro vyo gukoranya abakuru n’abaganza n’abantu bose ngo mbandikishe ivy’ akārōnda kabo. Ndondeye mbona igitabo kidonda ivy’ akārōnda k’abābanje kudūga, mbona ko handitswemw’ ibi:
Aba ni bo bantu bo mu gihugu cacu bādūze bava mu kinyago mu bo Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni yajanye ar’ inyagano, bakagaruka i Yerusalemu n’i Buyuda, umuntu wese agasubira mu gisagara c’i wabo;

bāzananye na Zerubabeli na Yosuwa, na Nehemiya na Azariya, na Rayamiya na Nahamani, na Moridekayi na Bilishani, na Misipereti na Bigivayi, na Nehumu na Bayana. Igitigiri c’abagabo bo mu Bisirayeli ngiki:
abo mu ba Paroshi n’ ibihumbi bibiri n’ijana na mirongwirindwi na babiri.
Abo mu ba Shefatiya n’amajana atatu na mirongwirindwi na babiri.
Abo mu ba Ara n’amajana atandatu na mirongwitanu na babiri.
Abo mu ba Pahati‐mowabu, bandurutse kuri Yosuwa na Yowabu, n’ibihumbi bibiri n’amajana munani n’icumi n’umunani.
Abo mu ba Elamu n’igihumbi n’amajana abiri na mirongwitanu na bane.
Abo mu ba Zatu n’amajana munani na mirongwine na batanu.
Abo mu ba Zakayi n’amajana ndwi na mirongwitandatu.
Abo mu ba Binuwi n’ amajana atandatu na mirongwine n’umunani.
Abo mu ba Bebayi n’amajana atandatu na mirongwibiri n’umunani.
Abo mu ba Azigadi n’ibihumbi bibiri n’ amajana atatu na mirongwibiri na babiri.
Abo mu ba Adonikamu n’amajana atandatu na mirongwitandatu n’indwi.
Abo mu ba Bigivayi n’ibihumbi bibiri na mirongwitandatu n’indwi.
Abo mu ba Adini n’amajana atandatu na mirongwitanu na batanu.
Abo mu ba Ateri, bo mu muryango wa Hezekiya, ni mirongwicenda n’umunani.
Abo mu ba Hashumu n’amajana atatu na mirongwibiri n’ umunani.
Abo mu ba Besayi n’amajana atatu na mirongwibiri na bane.
Abo mu ba Harifu n’ijana n’icumi na babiri.
Ab’i Gibeyoni ni mirongwicenda na batanu.
Abagabo b’i Betelehemu n’i Netofa n’ijana na mirongumunani n’umunani.
Abagabo b’i Anatoti n’ijana na mirongwibiri n’umunani.
Abagabo b’i Beti‐azimaveti ni mirongwine na babiri.
Abagabo b’i Kiriyati‐yeyarimu n’i Kefira n’i Beroti n’amajana ndwi na mirongwine na batatu.
Abagabo b’i Rama n’i Geba n’amajana atandatu na mirongwibiri n’umwe.
Abagabo b’i Mikimasi n’ijana na mirongwibiri na babiri.
Abagabo b’i Beteli n’i Hayi n’ijana na mirongwibiri na batatu.
Abagabo b’i Nebo handi ni mirongwitanu na babiri.
Ab’i Elamu handi n’igihumbi n’amajana abiri na mirongwitanu na bane.
Ab’i Harimu n’ amajana atatu na mirongwibiri.
Ab’i Yeriko n’amajana atatu na mirongwine na batanu.
Ab’i Lodi n’i Hadidi n’i Ono n’amajana ndwi na mirongwibiri n’umwe.
Ab’i Sena n’ibihumbi bitatu n’amajana cenda na mirongwitatu.
Abaherezi n’aba: abo mu ba Yedaya, bo mu nzu ya Yosuwa, n’amajana cenda na mirongwirindwi na batatu.
Abo mu ba Imeri n’igihumbi na mirongwitanu na babiri.
Abo mu ba Pashuri n’igihumbi n’amajana abiri na mirongwine n’indwi.
Abo mu ba Harimu n’igihumbi n’icumi n’indwi.
Abalewi n’aba: abo mu ba Yosuwa na Kadimiyeli, ari bo bandurutse kuri Hodeva, ni mirongwirindwi na bane.
Abaririmvyi bo mu ba Asafu n’ijana na mirongwine n’umunani.
Abashibamyi n’aba: abo mu ba Shalumu, no mu ba Ateri, no mu ba Talimoni, no mu ba Akubu, no mu ba Hatita, no mu ba Shobayi, bose na bose n’ijana na mirongwitatu n’umunani.
Abahawe ibango ry’ibikorwa vy’urusengero n’aba: abo mu ba Siha, no mu ba Hasufa, no mu ba Tabayoti,
no mu ba Kerosi, no mu ba Siya, no mu ba Padoni,
no mu ba Lebana, no mu ba Hagaba, no mu ba Salimayi,
no mu ba Hanani, no mu ba Gedeli, no mu ba Gahari,
no mu ba Reyaya, no mu ba Resini, no mu ba Nekoda,
no mu ba Gazamu, no mu ba Uza, no mu ba Paseya,
no mu ba Besayi, no mu ba Mehunimu, no mu ba Nefushesimu,
no mu ba Bakibuki, no mu ba Hakufa, no mu ba Harihuri,
no mu ba Basiliti, no mu ba Mehida, no mu ba Harisha,
no mu ba Barikosi, no mu ba Sisera, no mu ba Tema,
no mu ba Nesiya, no mu ba Hatifa.
Abuzukuruza b’abasavyi ba Salomo n’aba: abo mu ba Sotayi, no mu ba Sofereti, no mu ba Perida,
no mu ba Yahala, no mu ba Darikoni, no mu ba Gideli,
no mu ba Shefatiya, no mu ba Hatili, no mu ba Pokereti‐hasebayimu, no mu ba Amoni.
Abahawe iryo bango bose, bo n’abuzukuruza b’abasavyi ba Salomo, bose na bose bār’ amajana atatu na mirongwicenda na babiri.

Kand’ aba ni bo bādūze bava i Telimela n’i Teliharisha n’i Kerubu n’i Adoni n’i Imeri, ariko vyarabananira kwerekana amazu ya ba sekuruza bandurutseko cank’ abo bākomōtseko yukw ar’ Abisirayeli vy’ukuri.
Abo mu ba Delaya no mu ba Tobiya no mu ba Nekoda n’amajana atandatu na mirongwine na babiri.
Abo mu baherezi ni bo aba: abo mu ba Habaya, no mu ba Hakosi, no mu ba Baruzilayi, umwe yābiriye umugeni mu bakobga ba Baruzilayi w’Umunyagileyadi, agaca yitiranwa na sebukwe,
abo bārondeye amazina yabo mu gitabo kidōndōra ba sekuruza, ntibayabona, ni co gituma biyumviriwe nk’ abahumanye, bagakūrwa mu buherezi.
Umucamatēka arababuza ngo ntibarye ku vyera cane, kugeza igihe hazobonekera umuherezi afise Urimu na Tumimu.
Nukw iryo shengero ryose iyo riva rikagera, bose na bose bār’ ibihumbi mirongwine na bibiri n’amajana atatu na mirongwitandatu;

udashizemw’ abagurano n’abaguranokazi babo, igitigiri cabo bār’ ibihumbi ndwi n’ amajana atatu na mirongwitatu n’ indwi; kandi bāri bafise abaririmvyi b’abagabo n’abagore amajana abiri na mirongwine na batanu.
Amafarasi yabo yār’ amajana ndwi na mirongwitatu n’atandatu; n’inyumbu zabo zār’ amajana abiri na mirongwine na zitanu;
n’ingamiya zabo zār’ amajana ane na mirongwitatu na zitanu, n’indogoba zabo ibihumbi bitandatu n’amajana ndwi na mirongwibiri.

Bamwe mu bakuru b’amazu ya ba sekuruza batanze imfashanyo yo gufasha ico gikorwa, n’icēgēra c’umwami na we atanga amahera y’izahabu yitwa dariki igihumbi, n’ibikombe mirongwitanu, n’ imyambaro amajana atanu na mirongwitatu y’abaherezi, babishira mu bubīko.
Bamwe mu bakuru b’amazu ya ba sekuruza bashira mu bubiko burimw’ ibikoreshwa, dariki z’izahabu ibihumbi mirongwibiri, n’ifeza irivye ingero yitwa mina ibihumbi bibiri n’amajana abiri.
Ivyo abandi bantu batanze bishika kuri dariki z’izahabu ibihumbi mirongwibiri nyene, n’ibihumbi bibiri vya mina z’ifeza, bo n’imyambaro y’abaherezi mirongwitandatu n’ indwi.

Nukw abaherezi n’Abalewi n’ abashibamyi n’abaririmvyi n’abantu bamwe, n’abahawe ibango ry’ibikorwa vy’urusengero, n’abandi Bisirayeli bose, bībēra mu bisagara vyabo; mber’ ukwezi kw’indwi kwabonetse Abisirayeli bamaze kwībēra mu bisagara vyabo.

Maz’ abantu bose iyo bava bakagera bakoranira icarimwe ku kibuga kir’ imbere y’irembo ry’ amazi, basaba Ezira, umunyabgenge w’ivyanditswe, ngw azane igitabo c’ivyagezwe vya Mose, bimwe Uhoraho yaha Abisirayeli.
Nuko Ezira umuherezi azana ico gitabo c’ivyagezwe, agishira imbere y’ishengero ry’abagabo n’abagore n’abandi bose bafise ubgenge bgo kwumva. Hari ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kw’indwi.

Ezira agisoma ahagaze yerekeye ico kibuga kir’ imbere y’irembo ry’amazi, agisomera abagabo n’abagore n’ abandi bashoboye kwumva, uhereye mu mutwenzi ugashitsa mu mashōka, kand’ abantu bose bari bateze amatwi bumviriza ivy’ ico gitabo c’ivyagezwe.

Ezira, uwo munyabgenge w’ivyanditswe, yar’ ahagaze ku mutara w’ibiti, bubakiye ico gikorwa nyene, yar’ ahagararanye na Matitiya na Shema na Anaya na Uriya na Hilukiya na Mayaseya; abo ni bo bār’ i buryo bgiwe; i bumoso bgiwe hāri Pedaya na Mishayeli na Malikiya na Hashumu na Hashibadana na Zekariya na Meshulamu.
Nuko Ezira azingurura igitabo abantu bose babona, kuko yar’ ahagaze ahisumbuye; maz’ akikizingurura abantu bose bava hasi.
Ezira araheza ahimbaza Uhoraho Imana isumba vyose, abantu bose bashira amaboko hejuru, bati Amen, Amen. Baraheza barunama bashika hasi imbere y’Uhoraho, bubika amaso kw isi.

Yosuwa na Bani na Sherebiya, na Yamini na Akubu, na Shabetayi na Hodiya na Mayaseya, na Kelita na Azariya na Yozabadi, na Hanani na Pelaya n’ Abalewi, abo ni bo basobanurira abantu ivy’ ivyagezwe, abantu bakaguma aho bari;
babasomera mu gitabo c’ ivyagezwe vy’Imana mu buryo bgumvikana, barabibasobanurira kugira ngo batahure ivyo basomewe.

Nehemiya icēgēra c’umwami, na Ezira umuherezi, umunyabgenge w’ivyanditswe, n’Abalewi ari bo bigisha abantu, baraheza bababgira bose, bat’ Uyu musi n’ uwo Uhoraho Imana yanyu yejeje, nta co mubabara kandi reka kurira; kukw abantu bose bariko bararira, aho bumviye amajambo y’ ivyagezwe.

Maze Nehemiya arababgira, ati Ni mutahe muje kurya inyama zinuze, munywe n’ibisosa, n’abatagira ico bafise mubarungikire, kuk’ uyu musi werejwe Uhoraho; ntimubabare, kuk’ umunezero w’Uhoraho ari zo nkomezi zanyu.
Abalewi na bo bahoza abantu bose, bati Ni mwihorere, kuk’ uyu musi ar’ uwera, ntimubabare.
Nukw abantu bose baraheza baja kurya no kunywa no kugemuranira no kunezeranwa akanyamuneza kenshi, kuko bari batahuye amajambo basobanuriwe.
Ku musi ugira kabiri abakuru b’amyazu ya ba sekuruza bo mu bantu bose, n’abaherezi n’Abalewi, bakoranira kuri Ezira umunyabgenge w’ivyanditswe, kugira ngo bashire ayo majambo y’ivyagezwe ku mitima.
Baraheza basanga ko mur’ ivyo vyagezwe Uhoraho yahaye Mose handitswe ko mu kwezi kw’indwi Abisirayeli bazokwama bagira imisi mikuru yo kurāra mu nsāgo,

kandi ko bazotāngāza ayo majambo mu bisagara vyose no muri Yerusalemu, ngo Ni mugende ku misozi muce amashami y’ibiti vya elayo n’ay’ ibijābija vya elayo nyene, n’ay’ imihadasi n’ay’ ibigazi, n’ay’ ibindi biti vyose bizitanye, kugira ngo muce insāgo nk’uko vyanditswe.

Nukw abantu bava hasi baragenda barondera amashami, bīcīra insāgo, hejuru ku nzu zabo, no mu ngo zabo, no mu ntangaro y’ingoro y’Imana, no ku kibuga co kw irembo ry’amazi no ku co kw irembo ry’Abefurayimu.

Kand’ ikoraniro ryose ry’abāgarutse bavuye mu kinyago bīcīra insāgo bazirāramwo. Uhereye mu gihe ca Yosuwa mwene Nuni ukageza kur’ uwo musi Abisirayeli ntibaribgigere bagira nk’uko; nuko haba umunezero mwinshi cane.

Kandi Ezira abasomera igitabo c’ivyagezwe vy’Imana umusi n’ umusi, uhereye ku musi wa mbere ukageza ku wuheruka. Bāmaze imisi indwi bagira imisi mikuru; ku musi ugira umunani haba ikoraniro ry’agahebuza nk’ukw ivyagezwe bivuga.
Maze ku musi ugira mirongwibiri na kane wo mur’ ukwo kwezi, Abisirayeli barakorana, barisonzesha bambaye amagunira, bīrengeje imikungugu ku mitwe.
Ab’ uruvyaro rwa Isirayeli bītandukanya n’abanyamahanga bose, barahagarara bātura ivyaha vyabo n’ibicumuro vya ba sekuruza.
Bahagarara aho bari, bamara igice ca kane c’umurango basoma igitabo c’ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho Imana yabo, ikindi gice ca kane nyene bakimara bātura ivyaha vyabo, basenga Uhoraho Imana yabo.
Maze Yosuwa na Bani na Kadimiyeli na Shebaniya na Buni na Sherebiya na Bani wundi na Kenani bahagarara ahataramutse hubakiwe Abalewi, bashira ijwi hejuru batakambira Uhoraho Imana yabo.

Nukw abo Balewi, Yosuwa na Kadimiyeli na Bani na Hashabuneya na Sherebiya na Hodiya na Shebaniya na Petahiya baca baravuga, bati Ni muve hasi muhimbaze Uhoraho Imana yanyu, nk’uko vyamye uhereye kera hose ugashitsa ibihe bitazoshira. Baraheza bahimbaza izina ryiwe ry’icubahiro, ari ryo rishizwe hejuru gusumba ah’ ugushima kwose n’uguhimbaza kwose bigarukira.

Ezira araheza aravuga, ati Ni wewe Uhoraho wenyene nta wundi, ni wewe waremye ijuru, mbere n’amajuru asumba ayandi, n’ ingabo zose zo kuri yo; waremye n’isi n’ibiri kuri yo vyose, n’ibiyaga n’ibiri muri vyo vyose, kandi ni wewe ubibeshaho vyose; ingabo zo kw ijuru ziraguhimbaza.
Uhoraho Mana, ni wewe watoye Aburamu, umukūra muri Uri h’i Bukaludaya, umwita izina Aburahamu;

wabonye umutima wiwe kw ar’ uwo kwizigirwa imbere yawe, usezerana na we isezerano ryo kuzoha uruvyaro rwiwe igihugu c’Abanyakanani n’ic’ Abaheti n’ic’ Abamori n’ic’ Abaferizi n’ic’ Abayebusi n’ic’ Abagirugashi; kand’ iryo sezerano wararishikije kuko wama ugororoka.
Wabonye ivyago vya ba sogokuruza bacu bari muri Egiputa, wumva ugutakamba kwabo bari ku Kiyaga Gitukura,

werekanye ibimenyetso n’ibitangaza kuri Farawo no ku basavyi biwe no ku bantu bose bo mu gihugu ciwe, kuko war’ uzi ko bāgenda babīhayagizako. Uko ni ko wironkeye izina rya rurangiranwa, ari ryo ugifise na bugingo n’ubu.
Watandukanije ikiyaga mu maso yabo, na bo bagicamwo nk’ abagenda ku musozi, arikw ababakurikiye babahīga ubakororera i bgina, badobera mu mazi maremare nk’ ibuye.
Ubarōngōza inkingi y’igicu ku murango n’ inkingi y’umuriro mw ijoro, kugira ng’ ubamurikire mu nzira bacamwo.
Uramanuka uhagarara ku musozi Sinayi, uvugana na bo uri mw ijuru, ubaha amateka agororotse n’ivyagezwe vy’ukuri, n’ivyashinzwe bo n’amabgirizwa vy’agahore.
Wabamenyesheje isabato yawe yera, ubashirirah’ amabgirizwa n’ivyashinzwe n’ ivyagezwe, ubitumye umusavyi wawe Mose.
Ubaha umutsima uvuye mw ijuru wo kubamara inzara, ubaha n’amazi adudubiza mu gitandara yo kubamara inyota, ubagera kuja kwinjira igihugu warahiye k’uzokibaha.
Ariko ba sogokuruza bacu babaye intahetwa, bagamika amazosi, ntibumvira amabgirizwa yawe;

banka kuyumvira, canke ngo bibuke ibitangaza wakoze muri bo; ariko bagamika amazosi yabo, baragarariza, bironderera umugabisha ngo basubire mu buja bāhozemwo. Ariko wewe ur’ Imana ikunda guharira, ur’ inyabuntu, wuzuye imbabazi, uteba kuraka, ugira ikigongwe cinshi; nuko rero ntiwabataye.
Mbere naho bicuriye igishushanyo c’ imasa kivugutiwe, bakavuga, bat’ Eh’ imana yanyu yabakuye muri Egiputa! bagakora ivyo kukuratsa bikomeye;

ariko na ho nyene kubg’ imbabazi zawe nyinshi ntiwabataye mu bugaragwa; inkingi y’igicu ntiyabavuye imbere ku murango ibarōngōra mu nzira, cank’ inkingi y’umuriro mw ijoro yo kubamurikira, ngw ibereke inzira bacamwo.
Wabahaye Mpwemu wawe mwiza wo kubaha ubgenge, ntiwabimye manu yawe yo kurya, ubaha n’amazi yo kubamara inyota.
Wabatungiye mu bugaragwa kumara imyaka mirongwine, ntibāgira ico bakena; impuzu zabo ntizabashirirako, ibirenge vyabo ntivyavyimba.
Wabagabiye ibihugu vy’abami ubaha n’amahanga, ubagabanganya imigabane nk’ukw imiryango yabo iri, begukira igihugu ca Sihoni umwami w’i Heshiboni, n’ igihugu ca Ogi umwami w’i Bashani.
Wagwije abana babo bangana n’inyenyeri zo kw ijuru, ubashira mu gihugu wabariye ba sekuruza babo ngo bacinjire bacegukire.

Nukw abo bana babo baraza binjira ico gihugu baracegukira, nawe unesha imvukira zaho ari bo Banyakanani, ubagabura mu maboko yabo, hamwe n’abami babo n’abantu bo mur’ ico gihugu, kugira ngo babagirire uko bashaka.

Batsinda ibisagara bikomeye bifise inzitiro z’amabuye, bashikīra n’intāra zimera cane, binjira n’amazu yuzuye ivyiza vyose, bashikīra n’ ivyobo vyimbiwe kubīka amazi, n’imirima y’imizabibu n’iy’ imyelayo, n’ibindi biti vyama vy’isinzi, bararya barahāga baravyibuha, bidibamira mu vyiza vyose wabahaye.
Ariko ntibakwumviye, barakugarariza, bashiburira ivyagezwe vyawe inyuma yabo, bica abavugishwa nawe bāhora babahanura ngo babasubize kuri wewe, bakora ivyo kukuratsa bikomeye.

Ni co catumye ubagabura mu maboko y’abansi babo babashira mu vyago. Maze babonye bari mu vyago, ngo bagutakambire ukabumva uri mw ijuru, ukarungika ababatabara, bakabakūra mu maboko y’abansi babo kubg’ imbabazi zawe nyinshi.

Yamara ngo babone impore, bagasubira gukorera ibibi imbere yawe, nawe ukongera kubagabura mu maboko y’abansi babo bakabaganza. Mugabo, basubiye kugutakambira ukabumva uri mw ijuru, ukabarokora ibihe n’ibihe kubg’ imbabazi zawe.

Wama ubahanura kugira ngo basubire gukurikira ivyagezwe vyawe, ariko bo bakagira ubgibone, ntibumvire ivyagezwe vyawe, bagacumura ku mabgirizwa yawe, kand’ ari yo abeshah’ umuntu iy’ ayitondeye; bagakūtsa ibitugu, bakagamika amazosi, bakanka kwumva.
Wamaze imyaka myinshi ubihanganira, watumye Mpwemu wawe kubahanura, avugiye mu bavugishwa bawe, ariko banka kwumva; ni co catumye ubagabura mu maboko y’abanyamahanga bo mu bindi bihugu.
Yamara naho bimeze birtyo, imbabazi zawe nyinshi zakubujije kubahonnya rwose, ntiwabata, kuk’ ur’ Imana y’inyabuntu kandi y’imbabazi.

None, Mana yacu, Mana nkuru, uhambaye uteye ubgoba, ni wewe ugumya isezerano n’ikigongwe, turakwinginze amagorwa yose twabonye ntuyite ikintu coroshe, ayatubayeko twe n’abami bacu, n’abakuru bacu, n’abaherezi bacu, n’abavugishwa bacu, na ba sogokuruza bacu, eka n’abantu bawe bose, uhereye igihe c’abami b’i Ashuri ugashitsa na bugingo n’ubu.
Ariko mur’ ivyo vyose vyatubayeko, weho wama uboneka ugororotse, wama ukora ibiroranye, yamara twebge twakoze ibibi.
Abami bacu n’abakuru bacu n’abaherezi bacu na ba sogokuruza bacu ntibitondeye ivyagezwe vyawe, ntibumviye amabgirizwa yawe n’imbūri wababūriye.
Ariko mu kuganza kwabo, no mu vyiza vyinshi wabahaye, no mu gihugu kininiya kimera cane wabagabiye, ntibāgukoreye ngo bahindukire bareke ibikorwa vyabo bibi.
Rāba none twebge tur’ abaja! Rāba twagizwe abaja mu gihugu wahaye ba sogokuruza ngo bakibemwo, bacimburiremwo, barye ivyiza vyaco vyose.
Ereg’ imyimbu myinshi abami waduhaye ngo batuganze kubg’ ivyaha vyacu, ni bo bayimburirwa; badufisek’ ubushobozi bgo kutugirira uko bagomba, ari ku mitumba yacu, ari ku nka zacu; eka turagowe rwose!
Nuko kubg’ ivyo dusezerana isezerano ry’intahava, turaryandika; maz’ abakuru bacu n’Abalewi bacu bo n’abaherezi bacu barishirakw ikimenyetso kidomye mw ishashara.
Abāshizekw ikimenyetso n’ aba: icēgēra c’umwami, ari we Nehemiya mwene Hakaliya, na Zedekiya,
na Seraya na Azariya na Yeremiya,
na Pashuri na Amariya na Malakiya,
na Hatushi na Shebaniya na Maluki,
na Harimu na Meremoti na Obadiya,
na Daniyeli na Ginetoni ni na Baruki,
na Meshulamu na Abiya na Miyamini,
na Mahaziya na Biligayi na Shemaya; abo ni bo baherezi.
Abalewi n’aba: Yosuwa mwene Azaniya, na Binuwi wo muri bene Henadadi, na Kadimiyeli,
na bagenzi babo Shebaniya na Hodiya na Kelita na Pelaya na Hanani,
na Mika na Rehobu na Hashabiya,
na Zakuri na Sherebiya na Shebaniya,
na Hodiya na Bani na Beninu.
Abakuru‐bakuru bo mu bantu n’aba: Paroshi na Pahati‐Mowabu na Elamu na Zatu na Bani,
na Buni na Azigadi na Bebayi,
na Adoniya na Bigivayi na Adini,
na Ateri na Hezekiya na Azuri,
na Hodiya na Hashumu na Bezayi,
na Harifu na Anatoti na Nebayi,
na Magipiyashi na Meshulamu na Heziri,
na Meshezabeli na Sadoki na Yaduwa,
na Pelatiya na Hanani na Anaya,
na Hosheya na Hananiya na Hashubu,
na Haloheshi na Piliha na Shobeka,
na Rehumu na Hashabuna na Mayaseya,
na Ahiya na Hanani na Anani,
na Maluki na Harimu na Bayana.

Kandi n’abandi bantu bose, abaherezi n’Abalewi n’abashibamyi n’abaririmvyi n’abahawe ibango ry’ibikorwa vy’urusengero, n’abandi bose bamaze kwitandukanya n’amahanga yo mu bihugu, kugira ngo bitondere ivyagezwe vy’Imana, hamwe n’abagore babo n’abahungu babo n’abakobga babo, umuntu wese aciye ubgenge ashobora kubitahura;

abo bose bafatanya na bagenzi babo b’ abakuru, bararahira barīsiba ko bazohora bagendera mu vyagezwe vy’Imana vyatanzwe na Mose umusavyi wayo, kandi ko bazokwitondera amabgirizwa yose y’Uhoraho Umwami wacu, bakayashitsa, bo n’ivyo yihanikirije n’ivyo yashinze.
Bati Kand’ abakobga bacu ntituzobashingira abanyamahanga bo mur’ iki gihugu, n’abahungu bacu ntituzobasabira abageni mu bakobga babo.

Kand’ abanyamahanga bo mur’ iki gihugu ni bagira ivyo bashora kw isabato, ar’ ibintu bashoye, ar’ ivyo kurya, ntituzogira ico tugura kw isabato canke ku wundi musi wose wejejwe. Kandi ku mwaka ugira indwi wose, tuzorāza indimiro zose, duheberanire n’imyenda yose.
Kandi dushinze gutanga uk’ umwaka utashe ikigiragatatu ca shekeli, bize bikoreshwe mu ngoro y’Imana yacu,

kugira ngo haze hame haboneka imitsima y’ibiterekerwa, bo n’amashikanwa y’amafu y’intasība, n’ibimazi vyoswa vy’intasība nyene, n’ivy’ amasabato, n’ivy’ imisi mikuru yashinzwe, haboneke n’ibintu vyera, n’ibimazi vyo gutangirwa ivyaha kw impongano y’Abisirayeli, bo n’ivy’ ibikorwa vyose vyo mu ngoro y’Imana yacu.

Kandi twebge abaherezi n’Abalewi n’ abantu dupfinze ubupfindo ngo tumenye ukw amashikanwa y’ inkwi azohora azanwa mu ngoro y’Imana yacu, ukw amazu ya ba sogokuruza akurikirana ku mbu zacu; uk’ umwaka utashe izo nkwi n’izo gukoma icoto ku gicaniro c’Uhoraho Imana yacu, nk’uko vyanditswe mu vyagezwe.
Kand’ uk’ umwaka utashe tuzozana mu ngoro y’Uhoraho ivy’ imishuzo yo mu mirima yacu, n’ivy’ imishuzo y’ivyama vyose vyo ku biti vy’amoko yose,

kandi tuzozana abahungu bacu b’imfura n’ uburiza bg’ivyo dutunze, ubg’ inka zacu n’ubg’ intama zacu, tubizane mu ngoro y’Imana yacu nk’uko vyanditswe mu vyagezwe, tubishikirize abaherezi bakora mu ngoro y’Imana yacu.

Tuzohora tuzana ifu yacu y’umushuzo isewe iheretuwe, n’amashikanwa yacu azunguzwa, n’umushuzo w’ ivyama ku biti vy’ubgoko bgose, n’uwa vino n’amavuta, tubishikirize abaherezi, babishingure mu vyumba vyo ku ngoro y’Imana yacu; n’Abalewi tuzobashikiriza ikigiracumi c’ivyeze vyo mu mirima yacu, kukw Abalewi ari bo bākīra ibigiracumi mu bisagara vyacu vyose aho dufise imirima.

Kand’ umuherezi wo mu ba Aroni azohora ajana n’Abalewi bagiye kwākīra ibigiracumi vyabo; Abalewi na bo bazokūramw’ ikigiracumi co mur’ ivyo bigiracumi nyene, babizane mu ngoro y’ Imana yacu, babishingure mu vyumba vy’ububīko.

Abisirayeli n’Abalewi bazokwama bazana amashikanwa azunguzwa y’ impeke n’aya vino n’ay’ amavuta, bayashingure mu vyumba ah’ imbombovu z’Ahēra zibīkwa, ari ho nyene abaherezi n’abashibamyi n’abaririmvyi barāra. Nta ho tuzohemukira ingoro y’Imana yacu.

Abakuru b’abantu ni bo bāba i Yerusalemu; maz’ abandi bantu bose bapfinda ubupfindo kugira ng’ umuntu umwe‐umwe mur’ icumi na we az’ agerēre i Yerusalemu ku murwa wera, abandi basigaye babe mu bindi bisagara.
Maz’ abantu bahezagira abandi bose bitanze n’ imitima ikunze kuba i Yerusalemu.

Aba ni bo bāgaba intāra bāba i Yerusalemu; ariko mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda umuntu wese yaba kw itongo ryiwe mu gisagara c’i wabo, Abisirayeli bose n’abaherezi, n’Abalewi n’abahawe ibango ry’ibikorwa vy’urusengero, bo n’ abākomotse ku basavyi ba Salomo.

I Yerusalemu hāba bamwe bo mu Bayuda no mu Babenyamini. Mu Bayuda ni Ataya mwene Uziya, Uziya wa Zekariya, Zekariya wa Amariya, Amariya wa Shefatiya, Shefatiya wa Mahalaleli, wo mu bākomotse kuri Peresi;
na Mayaseya mwene Baruki, Baruki wa Kolihoze, Kolihoze wa Hasaya, Hasaya wa Adaya, Adaya wa Yoyaribu, Yoyaribu wa Zekariya Umunyeshiloni.
Abākomotse kuri Peresi bāba i Yerusalemu, bose na bose bār’ abagabo b’abahizi amajana ane na mirongwitandatu n’umunani.
Ababenyamini n’aba: Salu mwene Meshulamu, Meshulamu wa Yohedi, Yohedi wa Pedaya, Pedaya wa Kolaya, Kolaya wa Mayaseya, Mayaseya wa Itiyeli, Itiyeli wa Yeshaya;
hamwe na Gebayi na Salayi, bose na bose bar’ amajana cenda na mirongwibiri n’umunani.
Yoweli mwene Zikuri yar’ umukoresha wabo, na Yuda mwene Hasenuwa yar’ uwa kabiri wo mu baganza ico gisagara.
Mu baherezi n’aba: Yedaya mwene Yoyaribu, na Yakini,
na Seraya mwene Hilukiya, Hilukiya wa Meshulamu, Meshulamu wa Sadoki, Sadoki wa Merayoti, Merayoti wa Ahitubu, umubgiriza w’ingoro y’Imana;

bo na bagenzi babo bakora ibikorwa vyo mur’ iyo ngoro, bose na bose bar’ amajana munani na mirongwibiri na babiri; hari na Adaya mwene Yerohamu, Yerohamu wa Pelaliya, Pelaliya wa Amusi, Amusi wa Zekariya, Zekariya wa Pashuri, Pashuri wa Malakiya,

hamwe na bagenzi biwe, ni bo bār’ abakuru b’amazu ya ba sekuruza, bose na bose bār’ amajana abiri na mirongwine na babiri; hari na Amashisayi mwene Asareli, Asareli wa Ahazayi, Ahazayi wa Meshilemoti, Meshilemoti wa Imeri,
na bagenzi babo, abagabo b’ abahizi, bose na bose bar’ ijana na mirongwibiri n’umunani. Umukoresha wabo ni Sabudiyeli mwene Hagedolimu.
Mu Balewi n’aba: Shemaya mwene Hasubu, Hasubu wa Asirikamu, Asirikamu wa Hashabiya, Hashabiya wa Buni,
na Shabetayi na Yozabadi, ni bo bākoresha ibikorwa vy’ingoro y’Imana vyo hanze, kandi bar’ abakuru bo mu Balewi.

Hari na Mataniya mwene Mika, Mika wa Zabudi, Zabudi wa Asafu, ni we yaterera abaririmba ishimwe mu gihe co gusenga; na Bakibukiya yar’ uwa kabiri muri bagenzi biwe, na Abuda mwene Shamuwa, Shamuwa wa Galali, Galali wa Yedutuni.
Abalewi bo ku murwa wera bose na bose bar’ amajana abiri na mirongumunani na bane.
Abashibamyi, Akubu na Talimoni na bagenzi babo bāshibama ku marembo, bose na bose bar’ ijana na mirongwirindwi na babiri.
Abasigaye bo mu Bisirayeli no mu baherezi no mu Balewi bāba mu bindi bisagara vyose vy’i Buyuda, umuntu wese mw itongo ryiwe.
Arikw abahawe ibango ry’ibikorwa vy’urusengero bāba i Ofeli, kandi Siha na Gishipa ni bo bābaganza.

Kand’ umukoresha w’Abalewi i Yerusalemu, ari we yajejwe ibikorwa vyo mu ngoro y’Imana, ni Uzi mwene Bani, Bani wa Hashabiya, Hashabiya wa Mataniya, Mataniya wa Mika wo mu bākomotse kuri Asafu, ari bo baririmvyi.
Kuko har’ icagezwe cashinzwe n’ umwami kw abaririmvyi bazohora bahabga ibibatunga ku musi n’ umusi.
Petahiya mwene Meshezabeli wo mu bandurutse kuri Zera mwene Yuda ni we yar’ umushikirwa w’amajambo y’abantu bose aza ku mwami.
Kandi ku vy’imihana n’amatongo yayo, bamwe bo mu Bayuda bāba i Kiriyati‐Araba no mu bisagara bihakūkira, n’i Diboni no mu bisagara bihakūkira,
n’i Yeshuwa n’i Molada n’i Beti‐peleti,
n’i Hasari‐shuwali n’i Beri‐sheba no mu bisagara bihakūkira,
bāba n’i Sikulagi, n’i Mekona no mu bisagara bihakūkira,
n’i Eni‐rimoni n’i Zora n’i Yarimuti,

n’i Zanowa n’i Adulamu no mu bisagara bigenda bihakūkira, n’i Lakishi no mu matongo yaho, n’i Azeka no mu bisagara bihakūkira. Uko ni ko bāgerereye uhereye i Beri‐sheba ugashitsa no ku mwonga wa Hinomu.
Ababenyamini bāba i Geba n’i Mikimashi n’i Aya, n’i Beteli no mu bisagara bihakūkira,
no muri Anatoti n’i Nobu n’i Ananiya,
n’i Hasori n’i Rama n’i Gitayimu,
n’i Hadidi n’i Seboyimu n’i Nebalati,
n’i Lodi n’i Ono ari co kiyaya c’ abanyamyuga.
Mu Balewi, imitigiri imwe y’abāhora i Buyuda yagiye kuba i Bubenyamini.
Aba ni bo baherezi n’Abalewi bādūganye na Zerubabeli mwene Sheyalitiyeli na Yosuwa; ni Seraya na Yeremiya na Ezira,
na Amariya na Maluki na Hatushi,
na Shekaniya na Rehumu na Meremoti,
na Ido na Ginetoyi na Abiya,
na Miyamini na Mahadiya na Biliga,
na Shemaya na Yoyaribu na Yedaya,
na Salu na Amoki na Hilukiya na Yedaya wundi. Abo ni bo bār’ abakuru b’abaherezi na bagenzi babo mu gihe ca Yosuwa.
Kand’ Abalewi ni Yosuwa na Binuwi na Kadimiyeli na Sherebiya na Yuda na Mataniya; Mataniya uwo, bo na bagenzi biwe, ni bo baterera abandi indirimbo z’ ishimwe;
kandi bagenzi babo Bakibukiya na Uno bākūranwa na bo, bahāna imbu.
Yosuwa yavyaye Yoyakimu, Yoyakimu avyara Eliyashibu, Eliyashibu avyara Yoyada,
Yoyada avyara Yonatani, Yonatani avyara Yaduwa.
Abaherezi bo mu gihe ca Yoyakimu b’abakuru b’amazu ya ba sekuruza n’aba: mu ba Seraya ni Meraya; mu ba Yeremiya ni Hananiya;
mu ba Ezira ni Meshulamu; mu ba Amariya ni Yehohanani;
mu ba Maluki ni Yonatani; mu ba Shebaniya ni Yosefu;
mu ba Harimu ni Adina; mu ba Merayoti ni Helikayi;
mu ba Ido ni Zekariya; mu ba Ginetoni ni Meshulamu;
mu ba Abiya ni Zikuri; mu ba Minyamini no mu ba Mohadiya ni Pilitayi;
mu ba Biliga ni Shamuwa; mu ba Shemaya ni Yehonatani;
mu ba Yoyaribu ni Matenayi; mu ba Yedaya ni Uzi;
mu ba Salayi ni Kalayi; mu ba Amoki ni Eberi;
mu ba Hilukiya ni Hashabiya; mu ba Yedaya ni Netaneli.
Mu Balewi, abakuru b’amazu ya ba sekuruza banditswe mu gihe ca Eliyashibu na Yoyada na Yohanani na Yaduwa; abaherezi na bo banditswe ku ngoma ya Dariyo Umuperesi.
Abandurutse kuri Lewi bo mu bakuru b’amazu ya ba sekuruza bari banditswe mu gitabo c’ivyo ku ngoma, kugeza igihe ca Yohanani mwene Eliyashibu.

Kand’ abakuru b’ Abalewi ni Hashabiya na Sherebiya na Yosuwa mwene Kadimiyeli na bagenzi babo, bari bashinzwe guhimbaza Imana no kuyishima, bakurikiye ibgirizwa rya Dawidi umuntu w’Imana, bahāna imbu.
Mataniya na Bakibukiya na Obadiya na Meshulamu na Talimoni na Akubu bar’ abashibamyi barinda amazu y’ububīko yo ku marembo.
Abo ni bo bāriho mu gihe ca Yoyakimu mwene Yosuwa, Yosuwa wa Yehozadaki, no mu gihe ca Nehemiya icēgēra c’umwami, na Ezira umuherezi, ari we munyabgenge w’ivyanditswe.

Igihe bāshikiriza Imana uruzitiro rw’i Yerusalemu, bāhamagaye Abalewi aho bāba hose, ngo baze i Yerusalemu ku musi mukuru wo kurushikiriza Imana banezerewe, ngo bashimishe indirimbo bafise n’ivyo kuvuza vyitwa matowazi bo n’amakembe n’inanga.
Nukw abaririmvyi barakorana bava mu biyaya bikikije i Yerusalemu no mu mihana y’ Abanetofati,
n’i Beti‐gilugali no mu misozi y’i Geba n’i Azimaveti, kukw abaririmvyi bari biyubakiye imigerero impande zose z’i Yerusalemu.
Nukw abaherezi n’Abalewi bariyeza, maze beza abantu n’amarembo n’uruzitiro.

Maze nuriza abakuru b’Abayuda ngo baje hejuru ku ruzitiro, ndabagabanyamw’ imice ibiri minini ngo bagende barōngōye bahimbaza. Umuce umwe ugenda ku ruzitiro werekeye i buryo, kw irembo bacishamw’ umwavu.
Bakurikirwa na Hoshaya n’ igice kimwe c’abakuru b’Abayuda,
na Azariya na Ezira na Meshulamu,
na Yuda na Benyamini na Shemaya na Yeremiya,
n’abahungu b’abaherezi bamwe bafise inzumbete: Zekariya mwene Yonatani, Yonatani wa Shemaya, Shemaya wa Mataniya, Mataniya wa Mikaya, Mikaya wa Zakuri, Zakuri wa Asafu;

na bagenzi biwe Shemaya na Azareli na Milalayi na Gilalayi na Mahayi na Netaneli na Yuda na Hanani, bari bafise ibintu vyo kuvuza vyar’ ivya Dawidi umuntu w’Imana; kandi Ezira umunyabgenge w’ ivyanditswe yar’ abagiye imbere;

baca kw irembo rija kw iriba batumbera imbere yabo, badūgira ahadondagirwa haja mu gisagara ca Dawidi, ah’ uruzitiro rudūgira haruguru y’ingoro yar’ iya Dawidi, bashika kw irembo ry’amazi ryerekeye i burasirazuba.

Uwundi muce w’abagenda bahimbaza ugenda kubasanganira, nanje nari mbakurikiye ndi kumwe n’ikindi gice c’abantu; nuko bagenda hejuru ku ruzitiro, haruguru y’umunara w’amatanure, bashika no ku ruzitiro rw’intimba nini.

Maze baca haruguru y’irembo ry’Abefurayimu no kw irembo rya kera, no kw irembo ryitwa iry’ Amafi, no ku munara wa Hananeli, no ku wa Hameya, bashika kw irembo ry’intama; nuko bahagarara kw irembo ry’abateramyi.
Maz’ iyo mice yompi y’abagenda bahimbaza ija guhagarara mu ngoro y’Imana, nanje nyene twe n’umuce w’abakuru twari kumwe,
bo n’abaherezi Eliyakimu na Mayaseya na Minyamini na Mikaya na Eliyowenayi na Zekariya na Hananiya bafise inzumbete;
na Mayaseya na Shemaya na Eleyazari na Uzi na Yehohanani na Malakiya na Elamu na Ezeri. Maz’ abaririmvyi baririmba ijwi rirenga, Yezirahiya ni we yabarōngōra.
Uwo musi batanga ibimazi vyinshi, baranezerwa kukw Imana yar’ ibateye umunezero mwinshi; kandi n’abagore n’ abana baranezerwa, bituma umunezero ur’i Yerusalemu wumvikana kure.

Kur’ uyo musi batoranya abantu bo kuzezwa ivyumba vy’ ububīko vyo kubīkamw’ amashikanwa azunguzwa, n’ay’ umushuzo, n’ay’ ibigiracumi, kugira ngo bayashingure muri vyo, abe imituri y’abaherezi n’Abalewi, nk’ uko vyashinzwe mu vyagezwe, ukw imirima yo mu bisagara yangana, kukw Abayuda banezerejwe n’ukw abaherezi n’Abalewi bari kw ibango ryabo,
bagatako bakagenda bahāna imbu mu gukorera Imana yabo no mu kwiyeza. Kand’ abaririmvyi n’abashibamyi ni ko bāgenza, bakurikiye icagezwe ca Dawidi n’ic’ umuhungu wiwe Salomo.
Kuko kera mu gihe ca Dawidi na Asafu hārih’ abarōngōzi b’abaririmvyi, hakabaho n’indirimbo zo guhimbaza Imana no kuyishima.

Kandi mu gihe ca Zerubabeli na Nehemiya Abisirayeli bātanga imituri y’abaririmvyi n’iy’ abashibamyi, nk’uko vyashinzwe ku musi n’umusi; bakongera bagaha Abalewi ivyejejwe, Abalewi na bo bakabihakw abo kuri Aroni.
Kur’ uwo musi abantu basomerwa igitabo ca Mose, basanga nta Mwamoni cank’ Umunyamowabu yemererwa gushika mw ikoraniro ry’Imana gushitsa ibihe vyose,
kuko batāsanganije Abisirayeli umutsima n’amazi, kandi kuko bāhēreye Balamu ngw abavume; mugabo, Imana yacu yahinduye uwo muvumo ucika umugisha.
Nukw Abisirayeli bamaze kwumva ivyo vyagezwe, baca bītandukanya n’ ikivange c’abanyamahanga bose bāri muri bo.
Arikw ivyo bitarabaho, Eliyashibu umuherezi, ari we yajejwe ivyumba vyo ku ngoro y’Imana yacu, kandi yar’ incuti ya Tobiya,

yateguriye Tobiya nyene icumba kinini, aho bāhora babīka amashikanwa y’amafu n’imibavu, bakahabīka n’ibintu vy’imbombovu, kandi hābīkwa n’ibigiracumi vy’impeke n’ivya vino n’ivy’ amavuta ya elayo, ari vyo ivyagezwe vyashinze ko bihabga Abalewi n’abaririmvyi n’abashibamyi, hamwe n’amashikanwa azunguzwa yahabga abaherezi.

Ariko mur’ ico gihe cose sinar’ i Yerusalemu, kuko nari nagiye i bgami mu mwaka ugira mirongwitatu na kabiri Aritazeruzi umwami w’i Babuloni ari ku ngoma. Mpamaze imisi, nsaba umwami ngw andekure ngende.
Maze nshitse i Yerusalemu mbona ikibi Eliyashibu yakoze, ko yahaye Tobiya icumba mu nyubakwa yo ku ngoro y’Imana.
Birambabaza cane, ni co catumye nshibagurira hanze ibintu vyose vya Tobiya vyari mur’ ico cumba,
ngera ko bahumanura ico cumba; bamaze kugihumanura nsubizamw’ ibintu vy’imbombovu vy’ingoro y’Imana, hamwe n’amashikanwa y’amafu bo n’imibavu.
Hanyuma nsanga yukw Abalewi batakironka imituri bāgerewe, ivyo vyatumye Abalewi n’ abaririmvyi, abākora ibikorwa vy’ ingoro y’Imana, babita, umuntu wese agasubira mw itongo ryiwe.
Maze nca ntātira abakuru, nti N’iki catumye ingoro y’Imana irekwa? Ndaheza nkoranya abo Balewi n’abaririmvyi, mbasubiza mu myanya yabo.
Maz’ Abayuda bose baca bazana ibigiracumi vy’impeke n’ivya vino n’ivy’ amavuta ya elayo, babishingura mu bubīko.

Nshirah’ abazezwabintu vyo mu bubīko, ni bo b’aba: Shelemiya umuherezi, na Sadoki umunyabgenge w’ivyanditswe, na Pedaya wo mu Balewi; hakurikirako Hanani mwene Zakuri, Zakuri wa Mataniya, kukw abo bari bazwi kw ar’ abizigirwa; kand’ igikorwa cabo kwar’ ukugaburira bagenzi babo.
Ndaheza ndasenga, nti Mana yanje, ibi uz’ ubinzirikaneko, ntuz’ uhanagure ibikorwa vy’ urukundo nakoreye ingoro yawe, Mana yanje, n’ivyo nakoze vyo gufasha ibihakorerwa.

Mur’ iyo misi mbona bamwe bo mu Bayuda bagana vino kw isabato, n’abandi mbona bimburira mu bigega, abandi baremeka indogoba zabo vino n’inzabibu n’ insukoni n’ibintu vy’uburyo bgose, babizana i Yerusalemu ku musi w’isabato. Mbasanga aho badandariza, ndabahambarira kur’ uwo musi nyene baguriyekw ivyo kurya.
Hāri n’abantu bavuye i Tiro baba i Yerusalemu, bama bazana amafi n’ibindi vy’uburyo bgose babigurira Abayuda kw isabato i Yerusalemu.
Ndaheza ntātira abakuru bo mu Bayuda, nti N’iki gituma mukora ibibi bisa birtyo mugahumanya isabato?
Mbega ntimubona kw Imana yacu yaturekuriyekw ivyago, twe n’iki gisagara, kuko ba sogokuruza bacu bākoze bartyo? None namwe murushiriza gukwēgera Abisirayeli uburake, kuko mwama muhumanya isabato.

Isabato itaratangura, hagitangura kutabona neza mu marembo y’i Yerusalemu, mvuga ko bugarira amarembo, ntibaze bayugurure isabato idashize. Ndaheza nshira bamwe bo mu bantu banje kurinda amarembo ngo ntihagire umutwaro n’umwe bayacishamwo ku musi w’isabato.
Maz’ abadandaza n’abagura ibintu vy’ uburyo bgose barāra inyuma y’i Yerusalemu rimwe canke kabiri.
Maze ndabahambarira, ndababaza, nt’ Igituma murāra inyuma y’uruzitiro n’iki? Ni mwasubīra nzobafata. Kuva ico gihe ntibāsubiriye kugaruka kw isabato.

Ndaheza mbgira Abalewi ngo biyeze, babone kuza gushibama ku marembo, kugira ngo batume umusi w’isabato uziririzwa. Ndaheza ndasaba, nti Mana yanje, n’ibi na vyo uz’ ubinzirikaneko, umpangaze nk’ukw imbabazi zawe nyinshi zingana.
Nuko mur’ ico gihe mbona Abayuda bābiriye abagore bo mu Banyashidodi no mu Bamoni no mu Banyamowabu,
kandi ko benshi bo mu bana babo bavuga ikinyashidodi cank’ urundi rurimi rw’ayandi mahanga gusa, ntibashobore kuvuga ikiyuda.

Maze ndabahambarira ndabavuma, mbere bamwe ndanabakubita, mbashikura umushatsi, ndaheza mbarahiza Imana, nti Ntimuze mutirimuke ngo musubire gushingira abakobga banyu abahungu babo, canke ngo musabire abahungu banyu abakobga babo, kandi namwe ntimukabābīrire.

Mbega Salomo umwami w’ Abisirayeli, we ntiyacumujwe n’ abagore nk’uko nyene? Kandi nta mwami yar’ ahwanye na we yaribgaboneke mu mahanga yose, yakundwa rwose n’Imana yiwe, iramwimika imugira umwami w’ Abisirayeli bose; ariko na we nyene yacumujwe n’abagore b’ abanyamahangakazi nk’ukundi uko.
Mbega namwe tubemerere gukora icaha kingana girtyo ngo mwābīre abagore b’abanyamahangakazi, mucumure ku Mana yacu?
Kand’ umwe wo mu bahungu ba Yoyada mwene Eliyashibu, umuherezi mukuru, yar’ umukwe wa Sanibalati w’Umuhoroni; nca ndamwirukana amva i ruhande.
Ndaheza ndasaba, nt’ Ewe Mana yanje, ubibuke kuko bāhumanije ubuherezi bo n’isezerano ry’ ubuherezi nyene n’iry’ Abalewi.
Uko ni ko nabahumanuye, nkabakūramw’ ikintu cose c’ikinyamahanga, ngashingira abaherezi n’Abalewi imbu zabo, umuntu wese ku gikorwa ciwe;
kandi natunganije n’ivyo kuzana amashikanwa y’inkwi mu bihe vyashinzwe, bo n’ay’ imishuzo. Ndaheza ndasaba, nti Mana yanje, uz’ ubinzirikaneko, ubinyishure ivyiza.
Ku ngoma ya Ahasuwerusi, (Ahasuwerusi uyo, ni we yaganza ibihugu ijana na mirongwibiri n’indwi, uhereye i Buhindi ugashitsa Etiyopiya),
ico gihe umwami Ahasuwerusi yar’ ahangamye ku ngoma yiwe ku murwa i Shushani;
mu mwaka ugira gatatu ari ku ngoma atumirira amazimano abaganwa biwe bose n’abamenyekana biwe; abahambaye b’i Buperesi n’i Bumedi, na ba segaba n’abaganwa b’ibihugu bakoranira imbere yiwe.
Amara imisi myinshi yerekana ubutunzi bg’ ubgami bgiwe bg’icubahiro, n’ igitinyiro c’ubugabe bgiwe bg’ agahebuza; ashitsa imisi ijana na mirongumunani.
Nukw iyo misi ishize, umwami atumira abantu bose bari ku murwa i Shushani, abahambaye n’ aboroshe; bamara imisi ndwi mu nyubakwa yo mu rugo rwo ku ngoro y’umwami.

Hāri hakinze impuzu zera n’izisa n’akatsi gatoto n’iz’ amasufe, zimanikishijwe imigozi y’ibitambara vyera vyiza n’iy’ inyambarabami, ifashwe n’impeta z’ifeza ku nkingi z’amabuye yitwa marimari; hāri n’imisegamuro yakozwe mw izahabu n’ifeza, iteretse ku musezero wa marimari nyene y’amabara y’ agahama n’ayera n’ay’ umuhondo n’ayirabura.
Babahēra ivyo kunywa mu mabakure y’izahabu — kand’ ayo mabakure amwe yasa ukwayo ayandi ukwayo — babaha ku biturire vy’i bgami, nk’ukw ikiganza ciza c’umwami cari kiri.
Kandi mur’ ukwo kunywa vyashinzwe ngo ntihagire ūgōbērwa; kuk’ umwami yari yageze abasuku biwe ng’ umuntu wese agire ukw agomba.
Kandi n’umwamikazi Vashiti atumirira abagore amazimano mu ngoro y’umwami Ahasuwerusi nyene.

Nuko ku musi ugira indwi umutima w’umwami umaze gukankamurwa na vino, abarira Mehumani na Bizita na Haribona na Bigita na Abaguta na Zetari na Karukasi, abo ukw ar’ indwi bār’ inkone zihēreza uwo mwami Ahasuwerusi,
ababgira kuzana umwamikazi Vashiti imbere yiwe yambaye igitsibo c’ubgami, kugira ngo yereke amahanga n’abaganwa ubgiza bgiwe, kuko yar’ umunyakaranga.
Arik’ umwamikazi Vashiti yanka kuza ngo yemere ijambo ry’umwami ryatumwe izo nkone: bituma umwami ashangashirwa rwose, uburake bgiwe buraziriringa.
Maz’ umwami aca abaza abanyabgenge bazi uko vyahora bigenda mu bihe vyashize; (kuk’ ukw ari k’umwami yahora agenza ku bazi ivyagezwe n’imanza bose).

Kand’ abār’ akadasohoka ku mwami bāri Karishena na Shetari na Adimata na Tarishishi na Meresi na Marisena na Memukani, abaganwa ndwi b’i Buperesi n’i Bumedi; bār’ abishikira b’umwami, bakaba n’aba mbere mu bgami bgiwe.
Arababaza, at’ Umwamikazi Vashiti tumugire dute mu vy’ivyagezwe, kukw atemeye ijambo natumye inkone, jewe umwami Ahasuwerusi?

Maze Memukani arishura, avugira imbere y’umwami n’abo baganwa, at’ Umwamikazi Vashiti ntacumuye ku mwami wenyene, acumuye no ku baganwa bose, no ku mahanga yose ari mu bihugu vyose vy’umwami Ahasuwerusi;
kukw ivyo umwamikazi yakoze ivyo bizokwamamara mu bagore bose, bibatere gukēngēra abagabo babo, ni vyavugwa yuk’ umwami Ahasuwerusi yageze k’umwamikazi Vashiti azanwa imbere yiwe, akanka.
Mber’ uyu musi abagore bacu b’i Buperesi n’i Bumedi ni bumva ivyo umwamikazi yakoze, na bo bazoca bagira bartyo abaganwa bose b’umwami. Nuko rero hazobah’ agakēngērwe kenshi n’ishavu.

Umwami avyemeye, hoshingwa ibgirizwa ry’umwami, maze rikandikwa mu vyagezwe vy’Abaperesi n’Abamedi, rikoya guhinduka, yuko Vashiti atazokwongera guseruka imbere y’umwami Ahasuwerusi; kandi n’icubahiro ciwe c’ubgamikazi agihe uwundi amurusha kwubaha.
Maz’ iteka umwami aribuce ni ryamara kwamamara mu bihugu vyiwe vyose iyo biva bikagera, abagore bose bazoca bubaha abagabo babo, abahambaye n’aboroshe.
Iyo nama umwami n’abaganwa barayishima; umwami abigenza nk’ukw inama ya Memukani yar’ iri.

Nukw arungika ivyete mu bihugu vyose vy’umwami, igihugu cose ukw inyandiko zaco ziri, n’ ihanga ryose uk’ ururimi rwaryo ruri, ng’umugabo wese yiganze mu rugo rwiwe, kandi ngo bavyamamaze mu ndimi z’abantu biwe uko zingana.
