Hanyuma y’ivyo, uburake bg’ umwami Ahasuwerusi buhwamye, yibuka ivya Vashiti n’ ivyo yakoze, n’ivyashinzwe kubgiwe.
Maz’ abāsukurira umwami baramubgira, bati Mwami, ni bakuronderere abigeme b’ inkumi beza‐beza;

kandi n’ ushireh’ abantu mu bihugu vyawe vyose, mwami, ngo bakoranirize hamwe abigeme bose b’inkumi beza‐beza ku murwa i Shushani, bashirwe mu nzu y’abigeme, babashikirize Hegayi inkone y’umwami, asanzwe arinda abigeme, bahabge ivyo kwisīga ngo bayagayage mu maso.
Maz’ umwigeme uzoshima az’ abe umwamikazi mu gishingo ca Vashiti. Nuk’ umwami ashima iyo nama, abigenza artyo.
Ku murwa i Shushani hār’ Umuyuda yitwa Moridekayi mwene Yayiri, Yayiri wa Shimeyi, Shimeyi wa Kishi, Umubenyamini.
Yari yakūwe i Yerusalemu ar’ inyagano, ajananwa n’abandi banyagano banyaganywe n’umwami w’Abayuda Yekoniya, igihe bānyagwa na Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni.

Moridekayi yari yareze Hadasa, ari we Esiteri, mwene se wabo, kukw atāgira se na nyina, kand’ uwo mwigeme yari mwiza w’umunyakaranga; maze se na nyina bamaze gupfa, Moridekayi aramujana amurera nk’umwana wiwe.

Nukw ibgirizwa ry’umwami n’ icagezwe ciwe bimaze kwamamara, abigeme benshi bagakoranirizwa ku murwa i Shushani, ngo barindwe na Hegayi, Esiteri na we ajanwa i bgami, ahabga Hegayi nyene, yarinda abigeme.

Ashima uwo mwigeme, aramutonesha; agira umwete wo kumuha ivyo kwisīga ngw ayagayage mu maso, amuha n’igisa yagerewe, amuha n’abakobga ndwi, atoranije mu rugo rw’umwami: aramwunguruza bo n’abo bakobga, amushira aharusha ahandi kuba heza mur’ iyo nzu y’abigeme.
Kandi Esiteri nta ho yigeze aserura ubgoko bgabo ubg’ ari bgo, cank’ umuryango wabo: kuko Moridekayi yari yaramwihanije kutabivuga.
Kandi Moridekayi yahora agendagenda uko bukeye inyuma y’urugo rw’inzu y’abigeme, kugira ngw amenye Esiteri uko yaramutse n’ukw ameze.

Nuk’ umwigeme wese yashikwako n’urubu rwiwe rwo kujanwa ku mwami Ahasuwerusi, amaze amezi cumi n’abiri akorerwa ivy’ abigeme, nk’uko vyashinzwe, kukw igihe co kwitunganya kwabo ari ko cari kimeze: bāhabga amavuta arimw’ isenga kumara amezi atandatu, yandi mezi atandatu bagahabga ibitāmirana, n’ ivyo abigeme bāgerewe kwisīga ngo bayagayage mu maso.
Uko ni k’umwigeme wese yabona kuja ku mwami; kand’ iy’ agira aje mu ngoro y’umwami, ico yagomba cose co mu nzu y’abigeme yaragihabga.

Yagenda ku kagoroba, akavayo mu gitondo, akaja mu nzu ya kabiri y’abagore, akarindwa na Shayashigazi inkone y’umwami yarinda incoreke z’ intoni; ntiyongera gusubira ku mwami, shit’ iy’ umwami amushimye, akamuhamagaza amutoboye izina.

Nukw igihe ca Esiteri kirashika co kujanwa ku mwami. (Esiteri uwo yari mwene Abihayili, se wabo wa Moridekayi, Moridekayi umwe nyene yamurera nk’ umwana wiwe.) Ico gihe gishitse co kujanwa ku mwami, ntiyagira ico yaka, atar’ ivyo Hegayi yamugereye, ari we nkone y’umwami yarinda abigeme; kandi Esiteri yashimwa n’abāmubona bose.
Nuko mu kwezi kw’icumi, ni kwo kwitwa Tebeti, mu mwaka ugira indwi umwami Ahasuwerusi ari ku ngoma, Esiteri ajanwa mu ngoro ku mwami Ahasuwerusi.

Nuk’ umwami agomwa Esiteri, amurutisha abamikazi bose, na we arakundwakara, aba intoni mu nyonga ziwe kuruta za nkumi zose; bituma amwambika igitsibo c’ubgami mu mutwe, amugira umwamikazi mu gishingo ca Vashiti.

Maz’ umwami atumirira abaganwa biwe bose n’abamenyekana biwe amazimano akomeye; kand’ ayo mazimano yari kubga Esiteri; ibihugu abiharira ikori, agaba ingabire, nk’ukw ikiganza ciza c’umwami cari kiri.
Nuko bongeye gukoranya inkumi ubugira kabiri, Moridekayi yari yicaye ku kirimba i bgami.

Kandi Esiteri ntiyaribgaserure umuryango wabo cank’ ubgoko bgabo ubg’ ari bgo, nk’uko Moridekayi yari yaramwihanikirije; kuko Esiteri yahora yumvira Moridekayi mu vyo amubarira, nk’uko yamwumvira akimureze.
Mur’ iyo misi, Moridekayi yari yicaye ku kirimba i bgami, babiri bo mu nkone z’umwami, Bigitana na Tereshi, bo mu barinda umuryango, barashungumirwa, barondera ingene bokwica umwami Ahasuwerusi.
Iyo nama imenywa na Moridekayi; abibarira umwamikazi Esiteri; Esiteri na we abibarira umwami atumwe na Moridekayi.
Ivyo babisuzumye, basanze ari ko biri, abo bompi babamanika ku giti; maz’ ivyo vyandikirwa imbere y’umwami mu gitabo kidonda ibigenda biba ku ngoma yiwe.
Maze hanyuma y’ivyo umwami Ahasuwerusi akuza Hamani mwene Hamedata, Umwagagi, amushira hejuru, intebe yiwe ayisumbisha iz’ abaganwa bose basabanye.

Maz’ abagendanyi b’ umwami bose bāri ku kirimba i bgami bunamira Hamani, bakamwikubita imbere, kuk’ umwami yari yābishinze ngo bamuhe ico cubahiro. Ariko Moridekayi ntiyamwunamira, ntiyamwikubita imbere.
Maz’ abagendanyi b’ umwami bāri ku kirimba i bgami, babaza Moridekayi, bati N’iki gituma uca mu cagezwe c’umwami?
Nuko bashishikara kubimubarira uko bukeye, ntiyabumvira; baca babibarira Hamani, ngo barābe ivya Moridekayi uko vyoba, kuko yari yābabariye ngo n’Umuyuda.
Nuko Hamani abonye yuko Moridekayi atamwunamiye canke ngw amwikubite imbere, aca arashangashirwa.

Arikw abona yuko gufata Moridekayi wenyene ata kimazi, kuko bari bamubgiye ubgoko bga Moridekayi ubg’ ari bgo; ni co catumye Hamani arondera uburyo bgo kugeseza Abayuda bose bāri mu bihugu vyose vy’umwami Ahasuwerusi, ari bo bgoko nyene bga Moridekayi.

Maze mu mwaka ugira icumi na kabiri umwami Ahasuwerusi ari ku ngoma, mu kwezi kwa mbere kwitwa Nisani, bapfindira Puri imbere ya Hamani, ari bgo bupfindo, bapfinda umusi uw’ ari wo, n’ukwezi ukw ari kwo, ubupfindo bgerekana ukwezi kw’icumi na kabiri, kwitwa Adari.

Nuko Hamani abarira umwami Ahasuwerusi, ati Harih’ ubgoko busābagiye, bukwiragiye mu mahanga yo mu bihugu vyawe vyose; kand’ ivyagezwe vyabo nta ho bihūriye n’ivy’ ayandi mahanga yose, kandi ntibitondera ivyagezwe vyawe, mwami: ni co gituma, mwami, bitabereye gupfa kubarekera ngaho.
Nuko mwami, ni wavyemera, hoshingwa iteka, bakaryandika ngo barandurwe; nanje nzotanga italanto z’ifeza ibihumbi cumi, ndazihe abajejwe itunga ryawe, bazishire mu bubīko bgawe, mwami.
Nuk’ umwami aca yambura impeta ku rutoke, ayiha Hamani mwene Hamedata Umwagagi, umwansi w’Abayuda.
Umwami abarira Hamani, at’ Izo feza zigumirize, na ho ubgo bgoko ushobora kubugira uk’ ugomba.

Bukeye ku musi w’icumi na gatatu w’ukwezi kwa mbere, bahamagara abakarani b’ umwami, bandika vyose nk’uko Hamani yabishinze, babirungikira ivyēgēra vy’umwami n’abaganza ibihugu vyiwe vyose, n’abaganwa bo mu mahanga yose, igihugu cose ukw inyandiko zaco ziri, n’ihanga ryose uk’ ururimi rwaryo ruri; bavyandika mw izina ry’ umwami Ahasuwerusi, babidomakw ikimenyetso co ku mpeta y’ umwami.

Nuko barungika ivyo vyete babiha intumwa zibijana mu bihugu vy’umwami vyose, ngo bageseze Abayuda bose, abakuru n’abato, n’ibibondo n’ abagore, ngo babice, babahonnye ku musi umwe, ni wo musi w’ icumi na gatatu w’ukwezi kw’ icumi na kabiri kwitwa Adari, kandi banyage n’ivyabo.
Amakopi y’ico cete bayakwiza mu mahanga yose, ngw iryo teka ryamamazwe mu bihugu vyose, kugira ngo bitegurire uwo musi.
Nukw izo ntumwa zigenda zihuta, kubgo kwihanikirizwa n’ umwami; iryo teka ryamamara no ku murwa i Shushani. Maz’ umwami na Hamani biyicarira ngo banywe; arikw abo ku murwa i Shushani barumirwa.
Nuko Moridekayi amenye ibibaye vyose ivy’ ari vyo, yitantamurirakw impuzu ziwe, yambara igunira, yisūrirakw iminyota, arasohoka aja mu gisagara hagati, aborogesha ijwi rirenga ry’ umubabaro.
Arinda ashika n’ inyuma y’ikirimba c’i bgami: kukw ata wemererwa guca mu kirimba c’i bgami yambaye igunira.

Kandi mu gihugu cose, ah’ icagezwe c’umwami n’iteka ryiwe bishitse, hāba amaborogo menshi mu Bayuda, no kwisonzesha, n’ amarira, n’ugutaka; kandi benshi bācura imirambararo bari mu magunira no mu minyota.
Maz’ incoreke za Esiteri n’ inkone ziwe baraza barabimubarira; umwamikazi arababara cane: arungikira Moridekayi imyambaro yo kumwambika, ngo bamwambure igunira: ariko ntiyavyemera.
Nuko Esiteri ahamagaza Hataki, umwe mu nkone z’umwami, uwo umwami yamuhaye ngw amutume, amutuma kuri Moridekayi amwihanikirije, ngw amubaze ibibaye ivy’ ari vyo n’inyanduruko yavyo.
Nuko Hataki arasohoka agenda kuri Moridekayi, aho yar’ ari ahantu hiyaguye ku murwa, mw irasukiro ry’ikirimba c’i bgami.
Moridekayi amudōndera vyose ivyamubayeko, n’igitigiri c’amahera uko kingana Hamani yasezeranye gutanga ngw aje mu bubīko bg’ umwami, ayatanze kugira ngw ageseze Abayuda.

Amuha n’ ikopi y’ivyanditswe vy’iryo teka ryamamajwe i Shushani ryo kubageseza, ngw ayereke Esiteri, abimusobanurire; aheze amwihanikirize ngw aje ku mwami, amwinginge, atakambire ubgoko bgabo kuri we.
Nuko Hataki aragaruka, abarira Esiteri amajambo ya Moridekayi.
Maze Esiteri avugana na Hataki amurungikana amajambo kuri Moridekayi,

at’ Ereg’ abamenyekana b’umwami bose, n’abantu bo mu bihugu vy’umwami, barazi yuk’ umuntu wese, ar’ umugabo cank’ umugore, yosanga umwami mu karusha, adahamagawe, har’ icagezwe kimwe gusa kuri ben’ uwo, n’ukwicwa; shit’ umuntu umwami atunze inkoni y’izahabu y’ubugabe bgiwe: bibaye birtyo, uwo ni we akira. Ariko jeho mmaze imisi mirongwitatu ntararengukishwa n’umwami.
Nuko babgira Moridekayi amajambo ya Esiteri.
Maze Moridekayi na we arabatuma yishura Esiteri, ati Ntugire ngo ni wewe wenyene uzokira mu Bayuda bose, kuk’ uri mu ngoro y’umwami.

Kuko ni wapfa kwiyumya mur’ iki gihe, nta kizobuza Abayuda gutabarwa bakarokoka, ariko bivuye ahandi; ariko weho n’ab’ inzu ya so muzohona. Nta wubizi, kumbure icakwimitse ng’ube umwamikazi n’ ukugira ng’ uz’ useruke mu gihe gisa n’iki!
Maze Esiteri arabatuma yishura Moridekayi,

ati Genda ukoranirize hamwe Abayuda bose bar’ i Shushani, mwisonzeshe kubganje, mumare imisi itatu ku murango no mw ijoro mutagira ico murya canke munywa; nanje twe n’incoreke zanje tuzokwisonzesha durtyo nyene, mpeze mbone gushika ah’ umwami ari, nah’ ar’ uguca mu cagezwe: kandi namba ndamukiwe no gupfa, mpfe!
Nuko Moridekayi aragenda, akora vyose nk’uko Esiteri yamugeze.

Bukeye ku musi ugira gatatu, Esiteri yambara imyambaro yiwe y’ubgamikazi, aragenda ahagarara mu karusha ko ku ngoro y’umwami, aharābana n’iyo ngoro nyene; kand’ umwami yar’ avyagiye ku ntebe yiwe y’ubgami mu ngoro, atumberanye no mw irebe.

Nuk’ umwami abonye umwamikazi Esiteri ahagaze mu karusha, Esiteri agira ubutoni imbere yiwe; umwami atunga Esiteri inkoni y’ izahabu yar’ afise mu minwe. Maze Esiteri aca yīgira hafi, akora ku mutwe w’iyo nkoni.
Nuk’ umwami aramubaza, at’ Uragomba iki ga mwamikazi Esiteri? Urasaba iki? Ndakiguha, n’iyo coba igisate c’igihugu canje.
Esiteri aramwishura, ati Mwami, ni wavyemera, uyu musi wozanana na Hamani ku giturire mbīteguriye.
Nuk’ umwami aravuga, ati Ni munyarukane Hamani, kugira ngo bibe nk’uko Esiteri avuze. Nuk’ umwami na Hamani baja ku giturire Esiteri yiteguye.
Bakiri ku giturire ca vino, umwami abaza Esiteri, at’ Ico usaba n’iki, ukagihabga? Urondera iki? N’iyo coba igisate c’igihugu canje uragihabga.
Esiteri aramwishura, at’ Ico nsaba kandi ndondera n’iki:
namba ngize ubutoni imbere yawe, mwami, ukemera kumpa ico nsaba, no gushitsa ico ndondera, mwokwongera kuza, mwe na Hamani, ku giturire nzobītegurira; kand’ ejo ico uvuze nzogikora, mwami.
Nuk’ uwo musi Hamani asohoka ahimbawe, afise akanyamuneza mu mutima; arikw abonye Moridekayi ku kirimba i bgami, atamuhagurukiye canke ngw amuroresheko n’ijisho, bimutera gushungumirwa cane.
Yamara Hamani ariyumanganya, arataha; atuma guhamagara abagenzi, n’umugore wiwe Zereshi.

Nuko Hamani abīgānira ukw atunze, n’uko bimuhaye icubahiro, n’ abana biwe ingen’ ari benshi, n’ ingen’ umwami yamushize hejuru muri vyose, kandi ko yamukujije kuruta abaganwa b’umwami n’ abamenyekana biwe.
Hamani arongera arababgira, ati Kandi n’umwamikazi Esiteri nta wundi yakundiye kwinjirana n’umwami ku giturire yiteguye atari jewe; mbere n’ubu yantumiye ngo n’ejo nze njane n’umwami.
Arikw ivyo vyose nta co bimmariye, nkibona wa Muyuda Moridekayi yicaye ku kirimba i bgami.

Nuk’ umugore wiwe Zereshi n’abagenzi biwe bose bamugīra inama, bati Ni bashinge igiti c’intambge mirongwitanu z’ukuboko uciriye mu nkokora, maz’ ejo uz’ usabe umwami atange Moridekayi bakimumanikeko; uheze ubone kwinjirana n’umwami ku giturire unezerewe. Nuko Hamani ashima iyo nama; aca ashingisha ico giti.
Iryo joro nyene umwami abura itiro; aca avuga ko bazana igitabo kidonda ibigenda biba ku ngoma yiwe, nuko bagisomera umwami.
Basanga canditswemwo yuko Moridekayi ari we yareze Bigitana na Tereshi, babiri bo mu nkone z’umwami, bo mu bārinda umuryango, yuko bāshaka kwica umwami Ahasuwerusi.
Nuk’ umwami arabaza, ati Mbega Moridekayi uwo, har’ ishimwe cank’ icubahiro yahawe kubg’ ivyo? Maz’ abasuku b’umwami bahēreza baramwishura, bati Nta co yahawe.
Umwami arabaza, ati Ni nde ari mu rugo? Kand’ aho nyene Hamani yar’ ashitse mu ntangaro mu rugo i bgami, azanywe no gusaba umwami ngw amanike Moridekayi ku giti yamwiteguriye.
Abo basuku b’ umwami baramubgira, bati Hamani ni we ahagaze mu rugo. Umwami ati Ni yinjire.
Nuko Hamani arinjira. Umwami aramubaza, ati Mbeg’ umuntu jewe umwami nkunze guha icubahiro yokorerwa iki? Nuko Hamani yibaza mu mutima, ati Har’ uwundi umwami yokunda guha icubahiro kuruta jewe?
Maze Hamani abarira umwami, at’ Umuntu umwami akunze guha icubahiro,
bozana imyambaro y’ubgami iyo umwami ahora yambara, n’ifarasi umwami agenderako, yambitswe igitsibo c’ubgami.

Maz’ iyo myambaro n’iyo farasi bobiha umwe mu baganwa b’umwami asumvya abandi icubahiro, bakayambika uwo muntu umwami akunze guha icubahiro, bakamugendagendesha mu nzira yo mu gisagara ari kur’ iyo farasi, bagasemererera imbere yiwe, bat’ Umuntu umwami akunze guha icubahiro, uku ni kw azohora agirirwa.
Nuk’ umwami abgira Hamani, ati Bandanya wābīre imyambaro n’ifarasi nk’uk’ uvuze, ubikore urtyo kuri Moridekayi Umuyuda, yama yicara ku kirimba i bgami: ntihagire na kimwe uhaza mu vyo uvuze vyose.

Nuko Hamani yābīra ya myambaro na ya farasi, yambika Moridekayi, amugendagendesha mu nzira yo mu gisagara, asemererera imbere yiwe, at’ Umuntu umwami akunze guha icubahiro, uku ni kw azohora agirirwa.
Hanyuma Moridekayi asubira ku kirimba i bgami; ariko Hamani arihuta asubira i we, ababaye kandi yitwikiriye.

Maze yigānira Zereshi umugore wiwe n’abagenzi biwe bose, ivyamubayeko vyose. Nukw abahanuzi biwe na Zereshi umugore wiwe baramubarira, bati Moridekayi uwo, k’utanguye gucurangurizwa imbere yiwe, asangw’ ar’ uwo mu ruvyaro rw’ Abayuda, ntuzomushobora, arik’ uzocurangurizwa imbere yiwe nta kabuza!
Bakivugana na we, haza inkone z’umwami, zihuta kujana Hamani ku giturire Esiteri yari yiteguye.
Nuk’ umwami na Hamani baza gusangira n’umwamikazi Esiteri.

Maze kur’ uwo musi ugira kabiri wo kunywa igiturire ca vino, umwami yongera kubaza Esiteri, at’ Ico usaba n’iki ga mwamikazi Esiteri, ukagihabga? Urondera iki? N’iyo coba igisate c’igihugu canje uragihabga.
Maz’ umwamikazi Esiteri aramwishura, ati Namba ngize ubutoni imbere yawe, mugenzi, ukavyemera, mwami, nsabiye agatwe kanje, nsabiye n’ubgoko bgacu;
kuko twe n’ubgoko bgacu twaguzwe, ngo tugesezwe, twicwe, duhone. Iyo tuba twaraguzwe ngo tuje mu buja gusa, nocereje, kuko naho vyodukomereye cane, sinorinze kugora umwami.
Maz’ umwami Ahasuwerusi abaza umwamikazi Esiteri, ati Ni nde yubahutse kwīgīra inama nk’iyo, kand’ ari hehe?
Esiteri aramwishura, ati N’umubisha kandi n’umwansi, ni we uyu muyobe Hamani! Maze Hamani acikira ivutu imbere y’umwami n’umwamikazi.

Umwami aca ahagurukana uburake, ava ku giturire ca vino, arasohoka aja mu nyubakwa yo ku ngoro; Hamani na we ava hasi ngw asabire agatwe kiwe ku mwamikazi Esiteri; kuko yar’ abonye k’umwami amaramaje kumwica.

Maz’ umwami aragaruka, avuye mu nyubakwa yo ku ngoro, yinjira ha handi hār’ igiturire ca vino: asanga Hamani yikubise ku musegamuro Esiteri yariko. Umwami aravuga, ati Mbeg’ agira ngw afatire n’umwamikazi mu ngoro yanje aho mbona? Iryo jambo rikiva mu kanwa k’umwami, Hamani bamupfuka mu maso.

Maze Haribona, umwe mu nkone zama hafi y’umwami, aravuga, at’ Ushime mbere kwa Hamani hashinze igiti c’intambge mirongwitanu z’ukuboko uciriye mu nkokora, ico Hamani yagereye Moridekayi, kand’ ari we yavuze ijambo ryākijije umwami. Umwami aravuga, ati Mube ari co mumumanikako.
Nuko Hamani bamumanika kur’ ico giti nyene yari yiteguriye Moridekayi. Maz’ uburake bg’umwami burahwama.
Kur’ uwo musi nyene umwami Ahasuwerusi agabira umwamikazi Esiteri urugo rwa Hamani umwansi w’Abayuda. Maze Moridekayi aseruka imbere y’umwami; kuko Esiteri yari yavuze ico bapfana.
Umwami aca yiyambura impeta, iyo yari yatse Hamani, ayiha Moridekayi. Maze Esiteri ashikiriza Moridekayi urwo rugo rwa Hamani.
Hanyuma Esiteri yongera kuvugira imbere y’umwami, yikubita imbere y’inyundo ziwe, amwinginga arira, ngw akūreh’ inama mbi zāgīwe na Hamani Umwagagi, n’imigabo yiwe yari yagabiye kugirira Abayuda.
Maz’ umwami atunga Esiteri ya nkoni y’izahabu. Nuko Esiteri ava hasi, ahagarara imbere y’umwami,

aravuga, ati Mwami, ni wavyemera, kandi namba ngize ubutoni imbere yawe, ukabona kw ar’ ibibereye, kandi nanje nkaguhimbara, hokwandikwa ivyete vyo gukūra bimwe vy’inama mbi Hamani mwene Hamedata Umwagagi yandikishirije guhonnya Abayuda bari mu bihugu vyawe vyose, mwami.
Mbega noshobora nte kwihanganira kurāba ivyago bizoba ku bgoko bgacu? Canke noshobora nte kwihanganira kurorēra umuryango wacu urik’ uragesezwa?
Nuk’ umwami Ahasuwerusi yishura umwamikazi Esiteri na Moridekayi Umuyuda, at’ Ehe nagabiye Esiteri urugo rwa Hamani, na we Hamani bamumanitse ku giti, ahōwe kwimbira icobo Abayuda.

Nuko namwe ni mwandikire Abayuda, uko mugomba, mubandikire mw izina ryanje, mubidomekw ikimenyetso co ku mpeta yanje; kukw icanditswe cose mw izina ry’umwami, kikadomwakw ikimenyetso co ku mpeta yiwe, nta muntu ashobora kugihindura.

Nukw ico gihe abakarani b’ umwami barahamagarwa, hāri ku musi wa mirongwibiri na gatatu w’ukwezi kwa gatatu kwitwa Sivani, bandika ivyo Moridekayi ashinze ku Bayuda vyose, bavyandikira ivyēgēra vy’umwami, n’abaganza ibihugu, n’abaganwa b’ibihugu ijana na mirongwibiri n’indwi, uhereye i Buhindi ugashitsa Etiyopiya, igihugu cose ukw inyandiko zaco ziri, n’ihanga ryose uk’ ururimi rwaryo ruri; bandikira n’Abayuda mu rurimi rwabo ukw inyandiko zabo ziri.

Nuko Moridekayi avyandika mw izina ry’umwami Ahasuwerusi, abidomakw ikimenyetso co ku mpeta y’umwami, arungika intumwa zijana ivyo vyete ziri ku mafarasi atebuka, akoreshwa ibikorwa vy’ umwami, yavutse mu ntorwa z’i bgami.

Mur’ ivyo vyete umwami yemerera Abayuda bari mu bisagara vyose kwirema inteko ngo bīrwanire, bageseze aboza kubatera bose bo mu moko yose yo mur’ ivyo bihugu, babice, babahonnye, hamwe n’abana babo n’abagore babo, banyage n’ivyabo;
kand’ ivyo bize bikorwe ku musi umwe mu bihugu vyose vy’ umwami Ahasuwerusi, ni wo musi w’icumi na gatatu w’ukwezi kw’ icumi na kabiri kwitwa Adari.
Amakopi y’ico cete bayakwiza mu mahanga yose, ngw iryo teka ryamamazwe mu bihugu vyose, kugira ng’ uwo musi uz’ usange Abayuda biteguye kwivuna abansi babo.
Nukw izo ntumwa ziri kuri ya mafarasi atebuka, akoreshwa ibikorwa vy’umwami, zigenda zihuta, zitewe umwete n’ ukwihanikirizwa n’umwami; ico cagezwe camamara no ku murwa i Shushani.

Maze Moridekayi arasohoka, ava imbere y’umwami, yambaye imyambaro y’ubgami y’amasufe n’iyera, n’igitsibo kinini c’izahabu, n’imvune yera nziza y’inyambarabami; nukw abo ku murwa i Shushani basemerera banezerewe.
Abayuda na bo gica kireyuka, baranezerwa, barahimbarwa, bagira icubahiro.

Maze mu gihugu cose no mu gisagara cose, ah’ icagezwe c’umwami n’ivyo yashinze vyashika, Abayuda baranezerwa, bagahimbarwa, bagatumirana, bakagira umusi mukuru. Maz’ abantu benshi bo mu mahanga yo mur’ ico gihugu batora idini y’Abayuda, kukw Abayuda bāri babateye ubgoba.

Nuko mu kwezi kw’icumi na kabiri kwitwa Adari, ku musi wakwo w’icumi na gatatu, ari wo musi nyene icagezwe c’umwami n’iteka ryiwe vyari bishitse ku ntaho, ni wo musi abansi b’Abayuda bāziga ko babahagarara ku gakanu; ariko birahinduka, Abayuda baba ari bo bahagarara ku gakanu abari babafitiye urwanko.

Nukw Abayuda bakoranira mu bisagara vyabo mu bihugu vyose umwami Ahasuwerusi aganza, ngo basomboroze abarondera kubayigiza; kandi nta muntu yashobora kubahagarara imbere, kuko bāri baciye ivutu amahanga yose.
Nukw abaganwa bose bo mu bihugu, n’ivyēgēra vy’umwami, n’ abaganza ibihugu, n’abatwarira umwami, batabara Abayuda, kuko Moridekayi yar’ abaciye ivutu.
Moridekayi uwo yar’ agahambaye mu rugo rw’umwami, kandi yari rurangiranwa mu bihugu vyose: kuk’ uwo mugabo Moridekayi yarushiriza kuba agahambaye.
Nukw Abayuda bicisha inkota abansi babo bose, barabarandura, barabaherengeteza; bagira uko bagomba abari babafitiye urwanko.
Ku murwa i Shushani nyene Abayuda bahica abagabo amajana atanu, barabarandura.
Bica na Parishanidata na Dalifoni na Asipata,
na Porata na Adaliya na Aridata,
na Parimashita na Arisayi na Aridayi na Vayizata,
abo bose ukw ar’ icumi bishe, bāri bene Hamani umwansi w’Abayuda, mwene Hamedata; ariko ntibākojeje ukuboko kwabo kw isahu.
Kur’ uwo musi bamenyesha umwami igitigiri c’abiciwe ku murwa i Shushani.

Nuk’ umwami abgira umwamikazi Esiteri, at’ Abayuda bishe abagabo amajana atanu ku murwa i Shushani, barabarandura, bica na bene Hamani ukw ar’ icumi. Mbega none mu bindi bihugu vyanje bakoze ibingana iki? Har’ ico usaba na none ukagihabga? Har’ ikindi urondera kigakorwa?
Esiteri aramwishura, ati Mwami, ni wavyemera, ejo Abayuda bar’ i Shushani borekurwa, bagakora nk’ ukw icagezwe c’uyu musi kibaye; kand’ imivyimba ya bene Hamani ukw ar’ icumi ikamanikwa ku biti.
Nuk’ umwami agera ko biba birtyo; iteka ryamamara i Shushani; bamanika na ya mivyimba ya bene Hamani ukw ar’ icumi.
Nukw Abayuda bār’ i Shushani bongera kwirema inteko no ku musi w’icumi na kane w’ ukwo kwezi kwitwa Adari, bica abagabo amajana atatu i Shushani; ariko ntibākojeje ukuboko kwabo kw isahu.

Kand’ abandi Bayuda bāri mu bihugu umwami aganza birema inteko, barirwanira, bica mu babisha ibihumbi mirongwirindwi na bitanu; baraheza baruhuka abansi babo. Ariko ntibākojeje ukuboko kwabo kw isahu.
Uko ni ko vyabaye ku musi w’icumi na gatatu w’ukwezi kwitwa Adari; ku musi w’icumi na kane wakwo bararuhuka, bawugira umusi wo gutumiranako no kunezerwa.
Arikw Abayuda bar’ i Shushani birema inteko ku musi wakwo w’icumi na gatatu, no ku w’icumi na kane nyene; maze ku w’icumi na gatanu wakwo bararuhuka, bawugira umusi wo gutumiranako no kunezerwa.
Ni co gituma uwo musi w’icumi na kane w’ukwezi kwitwa Adari, Abayuda bo mu misozi, baba mu bisagara bitagira inzitiro, bawugira umusi wo kunezerwa no gutumiranako, n’ umusi mwiza wo kugemuranirako.
Maze Moridekayi yandika ivyabaye, Abayuda bose bari mu bihugu vyose umwami Ahasuwerusi aganza, abarungikira ivyete, abari hafi n’abari kure,
ashinga ng’ umusi w’icumi na kane n’ uw’ icumi na gatanu w’ukwezi kwitwa Adari, bayigire imisi mikuru, uk’ umwaka utashe;

kuba icibutso c’imisi Abayuda bāruhukiyekw abansi babo, n’ukwezi kwabahindukiye ukw’ umunezero mu gishingo c’umubabaro, bakaronka umusi mwiza mu gishingo c’uwo kugandarako; kand’ ababarira ko bayigira imisi yo gutumiranako no kunezerwa, n’iyo kugemuriranirako no kugabira aboro.
Nukw Abayuda bemera kwama babigenza nk’uko babitanguye, kandi nk’uko Moridekayi yabibandikiye;
kuko Hamani umwansi w’Abayuda bose, mwene Hamedata Umwagagi, yari yagabiye kugeseza Abayuda, kandi yari yapfinze Puri, ari bgo bupfindo, ngw abayigize, abahonnye;
ariko bishitse ku mwami, umwami arungika ivyete bivuga yukw iyo migabo mibi Hamani yari yagabiye ku Bayuda imugaruka ku mutwe, kandi yuk’ ubgiwe n’abahungu biwe bamanikwa ku biti.
Ni co gituma iyo misi bayita Purimu, bayitiriye Puri. Maze kubg’ amajambo yose yo mur’ ico cete, n’ivyo bīboneye ubgabo, n’ivyababayeko,

bituma Abayuda barundura ivy’ iyo misi yompi ko bazoyigira mikuru, uk’ umwaka utashe, mu gihe cayo gishinzwe nk’uko vyari vyanditswe, babicāna amahani ubgabo no ku ruvyaro rwabo, n’abifatanije na bo bose, ngo vyoye kuzoshingūka;

kandi barundura yukw iyo misi ikwiye kwama yibukwa no kugirwa mikuru ukw ibihe vy’urunganwe rwabo bizogenda bikurikirana, mu muryango wose no mu gihugu cose no mu gisagara cose, kandi ngw iyo misi ya Purimu ntize ishingūke mu Bayuda, cank’ icibutso cayo ngo kize kizimangane mu ruvyaro rwabo.
Nuk’ umwamikazi Esiteri mwene Abihayili, na Moridekayi Umuyuda, bandika mu bubasha bgose, bashinga ivy’ ico cete ca kabiri c’ivya Purimu.
Nukw Abayuda bose bo mu bihugu ijana na mirongwibiri n’indwi, ari vyo bihugu vya Ahasuwerusi, barungikirwa ivyo vyete, birimw’ amajambo y’amahoro n’ay’ ukuri,

yo gushinga ivy’ iyo misi ya Purimu mu bihe vyayo vyashinzwe, nk’uko Moridekayi Umuyuda n’umwamikazi Esiteri babigeze, na bo bakavyisezeranira ubgabo no ku ruvyaro rwabo, mu vyo kwisonzesha no mu vyo kuboroga kwabo.
Nukw icagezwe ca Esiteri gishinga ivyo vya Purimu; maze vyandikwa mu gitabo.
Nuk’ umwami Ahasuwerusi atangisha ikori igihugu cose n’abo mu bizinga vyo mu kiyaga.

Kand’ ibikorwa vyose yakoresheje ububasha bgiwe n’ubushobozi bgiwe, bo n’amajambo adondora neza ubukuru bga Moridekayi, uburyo umwami yamushize hejuru, mbega ntivyanditswe mu gitabo c’ivyo ku ngoma z’abami b’i Bumedi n’i Buperesi?

Kuk’ uwo Muyuda Moridekayi, uwar’ amurengeye yar’ umwami Ahasuwerusi gusa, kandi yar’ agahambaye mu Bayuda, yashimwa n’ab’i wabo uko bangana; kandi yama yendeza ubgoko bgabo ivyiza, akavuga ibihesha uruvyaro rwabo amahoro.
Mu gihugu c’i Uzi hār’ umuntu yitwa Yobu; kand’ uwo muntu yar’ umuntu atunganye w’umugororotsi, yubaha Imana, akitandukanya n’ikibi.
Yar’ afise abahungu ndwi n’abakobga batatu.

Itunga ryiwe ryar’ intama ibihumbi ndwi, n’ingamiya ibihumbi bitatu, n’inka igihumbi zirima, n’indogoba zivyara amajana atanu, n’abahinda mu rugo benshi cane; nuk’ uwo muntu yar’ ūhambaye gusumba abantu bose b’i burasirazuba.
Kand’ abahungu biwe bāhora barondera amazimano mu nzu y’ umuntu wese muri bo ku musi ashinze, bagatumira bashiki babo ukw ari batatu ngo baze gusangira na bo.

Nuk’ ukw imisi y’amazimano yabo yahera, Yobu yabatumako ngw abeze, akavyuka kare mu gatondo, agatanga ibimazi vyoswa bihwanye n’igitigiri ca bose: kuko Yobu yavuga, ati Kumbure abahungu banje bācumuye, barogota ku Mana mu mitima yabo. Uko ni ko Yobu yahora agenza ubudasiba.
Umusi ur’ izina abana b’Imana baje bashengereye Uhoraho, kandi na Satani yazananye na bo.
Uhoraho abaza Satani, at’ Uvuye hehe? Satani yishura Uhoraho, ati Mvuye gukwiragira mw isi no kuyigendagendamwo.
Uhoraho abaza Satani, ati Mbega witegereje umusavyi wanje Yobu, yukw ata wuhwanye na we mw isi, ar’ umuntu atunganye w’umugororotsi, anyubaha, akitandukanya n’ikibi?
Maze Satani yishura Uhoraho, ati Mbeg’ ugira ngo Yobu yubahira Imana ubusa?
Ntiwamuzitiriye uruzitiro rumukikije, bo n’inzu yiwe, n’ivy’ atunze vyose? Wahezagiye igikorwa c’amaboko yiwe, kand’ itunga ryiwe ryagwiriye mu gihugu.
Ariko pfa gutuma ukuboko kwawe, wubike ivy’ afise vyose, urābe kw atazokurogotako imbonankubone.
Uhoraho yishura Satani, at’ Eh’ ivy’ afise vyose biri mu kuboko kwawe; ariko we ku mutumba wiwe ntuz’ umukoreko. Nuko Satani aca arasohoka, ava imbere y’Uhoraho.
Maz’ umusi ur’ izina, abahungu n’abakobga ba Yobu bāriko barasangira, banywera vino mu nzu ya mukuru wabo,
haza imbitsi kuri Yobu, it’ Inka zariko zirarima, n’indogoba zarisha i ruhande yazo;
maz’ Abasabeya barazinyaze, barazitwaye: mbere n’abungere babaririkishije inkota; ni jewe jenyene ndokotse wo kuza kubikubikira.
Akibivuga, haza uwundi na we, at’ Umuriro w’Imana watibutse uva mw ijuru, uyigiza intama n’abungere, urabimara; ni jewe jenyene ndokotse wo kuza kubikubikira.
Akibivuga, haza uwundi na we, at’ Abakaludaya bigize imice itatu, banyaze ingamiya, barazitwaye: mbere n’abungere babaririkishije inkota; ni jewe jenyene ndokotse wo kuza kubikubikira.
Akibivuga, haza uwundi na we, at’ Abahungu bawe n’abakobga bawe bāriko barasangira banywera vino mu nzu ya mukuru wabo,
nuko haza umuyaga w’ igihuhuta uturutse mu bugaragwa, uhitana imfuruka zine z’inzu; maz’ isidukira kur’ abo bahungu, barapfa; ni jewe jenyene ndokotse wo kuza kubikubikira.
Maze Yobu ava hasi, yitantamurirak’ umutamana wiwe yimosha inkomvorera, yikubita hasi, arasenga,
ati Navuye mu nda ya mama nambaye ubusa, kandi nzosubira mu nda y’isi ata co nambaye. Uhoraho ni we yagavye, kand’ Uhoraho ni we agaburuje: izina ry’Uhoraho ni rishemagizwe.
Mur’ ivyo vyose Yobu ntiyakoze icaha, canke ngw aherereze amafuti ku Mana.
Uwundi musi abana b’Imana baje bashengereye Uhoraho, na Satani azanana na bo gushengerera Uhoraho.
Uhoraho abaza Satani, at’ Uvuye hehe? Satani yishura Uhoraho, ati Mvuye gukwiragira mw isi no kuyigendagendamwo.

Uhoraho abaza Satani, ati Mbega witegereje umusavyi wanje Yobu, yukw ata wuhwanye na we mw isi, ar’ umuntu atunganye w’umugororotsi, anyubaha, akitandukanya n’ikibi? Erega yakomeje ukugororoka kwiwe gushitsa n’ubu, naho wanteye kumugeseza ata co ndamuhōye.
Maze Satani yishura Uhoraho, at’ Amagara akābga ayandi! Mber’ ivy’ umuntu atunze vyose yobitanga ku magara yiwe.
Ariko pfa gutuma ukuboko kwawe, utere amagufa yiwe n’umubiri wiwe, urābe kw atazokurogotako imbonankubone.
Uhoraho yishura Satani, at’ Eh’ ari mu kuboko kwawe; kimwe gusa, uzigurize ubugingo bgiwe.
Nuko Satani aca arasohoka, ava imbere y’Uhoraho, atēza Yobu ibihute bikomeye uhēreye mu bgōro bg’ikirenge ugashitsa mu gitwariro.
Nuko yābīra urujo rwo kwiyagarisha; araheza yicara ku gikuburiro c’umunyota.
Maz’ umugore wiwe aramubaza, ati Mbega n’ubu uracakomeje kwa kugororoka kwawe? Tuka Imana, upfe uveho.

Arikw aramwishura, at’ Uvuze nk’umwe wo mu bagore b’ibipfapfa. Mbega none twohabga ivyiza bisa mu biganza vy’Imana, tukanka kwākīra n’ibibi na vyo? Mur’ ivyo vyose Yobu ntiyakoresheje icaha akanwa kiwe.

Nukw abakunzi ba Yobu batatu bumvise ivyo vyago vyose vyamuteye, baraza, umuntu wese muri bo ava i we: Elifazi w’i Temani, na Biludadi w’i Shuhi, na Zofari w’i Nayama; baragana indagano kuja kumugarukirako no kumugandaza.
Bunamuye amaso bakiri kure ntibaruha bamumenya, baca baraturika bararira; umuntu wese muri bo yitantamurirak’ umutamana wiwe, basūrira umukungugu hejuru y’ imitwe yabo.
Maze bicarana na we hasi, bamara imisi ndwi ku murango no mw ijoro; ntihāgira ūmubgira ijambo, kubgo kubona umubabaro wiwe kw ari mwinshi cane.
Hanyuma y’ivyo Yobu yanzika kuvuga, avuma umusi wo kuvuka kwiwe.
Nuko Yobu aravuga,
at’ Umusi navukiyeko urakazimangana, Bo na rya joro ryavuzwemwo, ng’ Umwana w’umuhungu atwawe inda!
Uwo musi uragacura umwiza; Imana yoye kuwitegereza ir’ iyo hejuru, Kandi n’umuco woye kuwākira.
Umwiza n’igitūtu c’urupfu biwugire uwavyo, Igicu kiwubarareko: Ivyīrīsha ubgīrakabiri vyose biwutere ubgoba.
Iryo joro, umwiza w’umuzitanya uricakire: Ntirikanezeranwe n’imisi y’ umwaka; Ntirigaharūrwe mu gitigiri c’amezi.
Mber’ iryo joro rirakaba ingumba; Ntirikabonekemwo ijwi ry’ umunezero.
Abazi kuvuma imisi ni barivume, Ni bo bar’ uburyo bgo kuvyutsa Lewiyatani.
Inyenyeri zo mu gahuru karyo ziragacura umwiza: Ryitege umuco, riwubure, Kandi ntirikabone ugutambika kw’umutwenzi:
Kuko ritūgaye inda ya mama, Ngo rihishe amaso yanje umubabaro.
N’iki catumye ntāpfuye nkiri mu nda? N’iki catumye impwemu zanje zitāheze nkiyivamwo?
N’iki catumye ibibero binkikira, Canke ngahabga amabere, nkayonka?
Iyaba ari ko vyagenze, ubu mba ndyamye nkaba amahoro, Mba nsinziriye; ni ho mba nduhutse.
Mba ndi kumwe n’abami n’ abajanama bo mw isi, Biyubakiye ahār’ imisaka;
Canke mba ndi kumwe n’ abaganwa bāri bafise izahabu, Bakuzuza amazu yabo ifeza;
Iyo mba narabaye nk’inda ikorotse igahishwa, simba narabayeho; Canke nk’inzoya zitigeze zibona umuco.
Iyo ni ho abanyakibi barekera kugorana; Iyo ni ho abārushe baruhukira.
Iyo ni ho imbohe zībēra amahoro zose hamwe; Ntiziba zicumva ijwi ry’ūbakoresha abahindagiza.
Uworoshe n’ūhambaye ni ho bari; Umushumba ahafitiye umwidegemvyo kuri shebuja.
N’iki gituma umunyamubabaro ahabga kubona umuco, N’ūfise akabonge mu mutima agahabga ubugingo?
Bifuza urupfu, ntiruze: Barwimba kurusha abimba izahabu zānyegejwe;
Iyo barushe bakabona imva Birabahimbara cane, bakanezerwa.
Mbeg’ umuntu ayobewe inzira, Imana ikamutangatanga, N’iki gituma ahabga kubona umuco?
Kuko kuniha kwanje kumbereye ivyo kurya, Kand’ amaborogo yanje asukwa nk’amazi.
Kukw ico natinya ari co canshitseko, Kand’ icantera ubgoba ari co canjeko.
Simmerewe neza, simfise amahoro, simfise uburuhukiro; Ariko haza ivyago gusa.
Maze Elifazi w’i Temani aramubarira,
ati Mbeg’ uwogerageza kugira ico akubarira, vyokubabaza? Ariko se har’ uwokwama afumbije?
Rāba ingene wahora wigisha benshi, Wakomeza amaboko areganutse.
Amajambo yawe yaramira uwarikw aratemba, Kandi wagumisha amavi aregarega.
Ariko none ni wewe bishitseko, kand’ urihebuye; Biraguteye, uhagarika umutima.
Mbeg’ ivyizigiro vyawe s’uko wubaha Imana? Kand’ inzira zawe zigororotse si zo wishimira?
Ibuka ndakwinginze, ni nde yigeze kugesera atācumuye? Canke har’ ah’ abagororotsi bigeze kurandurwa?
Nk’uko ngenda mbibona, abarima ibigabitanyo, Bakabiba amagorwa, ni vyo bazokwimbura.
Bagesezwa n’impwemu z’ Imana, Bakamarwa n’igihuhuta c’ uburake bgayo.
Kwivuga kw’intambge, n’ijwi ry’intambge y’inkazi birahezwa, N’imikāka y’imigunza y’intambge iravunagurwa.
Intambge nah’ ikomeye yicwa no kubura ico ifata, Kand’ ibibgana vy’intambge birasābagira.
Nuko, har’ ijambo ryanshitseko mu mpisho, Maz’ ugutwi kwanje kwumva utwongoshwa twaryo.
Nciyumvira ivyiyumviro bivuye mw iravūta ryo mw ijoro, Igihe itiro ryinshi ritwaye abantu,
Mfatwa n’ubgoba n’agatengo, Bituma amagufa yanje yose atetemera.
Maz’ impwemu zihita imbere yanje, Ubgoya bgo ku mubiri wanje buramerereza.
Haca haboneka ikintu gihagaze, ariko sinashobora kwihweza uko casa; Hār’ ishusho imbere y’amaso yanje: Habah’ agacerere, maze numva ijwi rivuga,
Ngo Mbeg’ umuntu buntu yorusha Imana kugororoka? Mbeg’ umuntu yorusha Umuremyi wiwe gutungana?
Rāba kw itizigira abasavyi bayo, N’abamarayika bayo kw ibabonakw amafuti,
None ntivyorushiriza ku baba mu nzu z’ibumba, Amatanguriro yazo akaba mu mukungugu, Bahonyoreka nk’inyenzi?
Hagati y’igihe c’igitondo n’ umugoroba baravunagurwa: Bapfa akagīrīre, ntihagire ūbishirak’ umutima.
Mbeg’ umugozi w’ihema ryabo ntiwabakūwemwo? Bapfa, kand’ ata bgenge.
Enda takamba: mbega har’ ūzokwishura? Ni nde wo mu bera wotabaza?
Ereg’ igipfu ni co cicwa n’ umwikomo, N’imburabgenge ni yo yicwa n’ishari.
Ubganje nabonye igipfu kiriko kirashōra imizi, Ubgo nyene mvuma ahantu kiba.
Abana biwe bari kure y’ ubuhungiro; Bahonyorerwa mw irembo, Ata wo kubakiza.
Ivyimburwa vyabo bimarwa n’abashonje, Mbere bajana n’ibimera mu mahwa, Kand’ abafise inyota bifuza ibintu vyabo.
Kukw amarushwa atava mu mukungugu, Kandi n’ivyago bitamera biva mw ivu.
Arik’ umuntu avukira amagorwa, Nk’ukw amasase atabura gutarukira mu kirēre.
Arikw iyaba jewe, mba narambambiye Imana, Iryo mfise mba naryitwaye ku Mana;
Ni yo ikora ibihambaye bidaserangurwa, N’ibitangaza bidaharūrika;
Ni yo irekurira imvura kw isi, Igakwiza amazi mu ndimiro;
Ni yo ishira hejuru abaciye bugufi, N’abari mu mubabaro ibashira mu mahoro.
Yica imigabo y’ingunge, Kugira ngw amaboko yazo ntāgire ingene yoyishitsa.
Itegesha abanyabgenge ubugunge bgabo ubgabo, Kand’ inama z’ibidadi irazisāvya.
Bahūra n’umwiza ari ku murango, Bakabakaba no mu mashōka nko mw ijoro.
Arikw ikiza umugorwa inkota yo mu kanwa kabo, Mber’ imukiza ukuboko kw’ umunyenkomezi.
Uko ni k’umworo agira ivyizigiro, Abagabitanya bakazibga akanwa.
Hahirwa umuntu Imana ihana: Nuko rero ntukagaye igikangiro c’Ūshobora vyose.
Kukw ari yo ikomeretsa, kand’ ikaba ari yo isomōra; Irakubita, kand’ amaboko yayo akaba ari yo atīmbūra.
Izokurokora mu vyago bitandatu, Mbere no mu vyago ndwi nta kibi kizogukorako.
Muri kigoyi izogukiza urupfu, No mu ntambara igukize ubushobozi bg’inkota.
Uzohishwa intega y’ururimi; Kandi ntuzotinya ubugesera buje.
Ubugesera n’amapfa uzobitwenga; Kandi ntuzotinya ibikōko vyo mw isi.
Kuk’ uzosezerana isezerano n’ amabuye yo mu gasozi; Kand’ ibikōko vyo mu gasozi bizokwuzura nawe.
Kand’ uzomenya yukw ihema ryawe rir’ amahoro: Uzogendura urugo rw’imikuku yawe, usange ata kibuze.
Kand’ uzomenya yuk’ uruvyaro rwawe ruzogwira, N’abagukomokako bakaba nk’ ivyatsi vyo ku misozi.
Uzoja mu mva wīsāziye neza, Nk’ikinyankinda bazana igihe kigeze.
Rāba, ivyo ni vyo twagenzuye, dusanga ari ko biri: Nawe n’uvyumve, wīkūriremw’ ivyokugirira ikimazi.
Maze Yobu arishura,
at’ Iyaba umwikomo wanje wāgerwa, N’ivyago vyanje bigashirwa ku munzane!
Kuko vyari kuremēra kurusha umusenyi wo ku kiyaga: Ni co catumye nihutira kuvuga.
Ereg’ imyampi y’Ūshobora vyose yantobekeranije, Ubugingo bganje bganyoye ubumara bgayo: Ibiteye ubgoba vy’Imana bitonze urugamba kundwanya.
Mbeg’ indogoba y’inyeshamba yokwivuga iri n’ubgatsi? Cank’ inka yokwābira iri n’ ico irisha?
Mbeg’ ikitaryoshe coribga kitarimw’ umunyu? Canke se, mu murenda w’irigi harimw’ icanga?
Umutima wanje wanse kubikorako; Bimmereye nk’ivyo kurya biteye iseseme.
Icompa nkaronka ico nsaba, Imana ikampa ico nifuza!
Imana nyene ikemera kumfyonyora, Igatuma ukuboko kwayo igacacura imigozi inziritse!
Aho ho ni ho noba ndonse ikinduhura, Mbere nokwiteraguzwa n’umunezero naho nagize uburibge budatenzura: Kuko ntāhakanye amajambo y’Uwera.
Mbeg’ inkomezi zanje n’inki ndorereye? Kand’ iherezo ryanje n’iriki nihanganira?
Non’ inkomezi zanje ni nk’iz’ amabuye? Canke se umubiri wanje ni nk’umuringa?
Mbega sinsigaye ntafise ikintabara, Ivy’ ugukira kwanje bikajanwa kure yanje?
Ūdendebukiwe bikwiye kw atera akagongwe abakunzi biwe, Naho yoba aretse kwubaha Ūshobora vyose.
Bagenzi banje babaye ba rusukabatungu nko mu mburamazi, Babaye nk’isūri yo mu mburamazi itemba igashira,
Iciwe iyondoyondo n’urubura, Shelegi ikīhishamwo;
Haje agasusuruko, ikazimangana, Ubushuhe bgaza, igakamirikirira ahantu hayo.
Igugu ry’abari ku rugendo ryājana inkōkoro yaho rirakevya; Badūga mu bugaragwa, bagwayo.
Igugu ry’ab’ i Tema ryari ribīteze, Ingenzi z’i Sheba zari zibarorereye;
Bamāramāzwa n’uko bāri bavyizigiye, Bashitseyo baratētērwa.
Noneho rero nta co mumaze; Mubonye ibiteye ubgoba, muratinya.
Mbega har’ aho nigeze kuvuga, nti Ni mugire ico mumpa? Canke nti Ni muntangire impongano mu bintu vyanyu?
Canke nti Ni mundokore munkūre mu maboko y’umwansi? Canke nti Ni muncungure munkūre mu maboko y’ abampahaza?
Ni munyigishe, nanje ni ho ndibuhore: Mummenyeshe ivyo nafuditse ivy’ ari vyo.
Ereg’ amajambo y’ukuri agira ububasha! Arikw ibihāri vyanyu bimaze iki?
Mbega muragomba guhinyura amajambo, Ayo uwihevye avuga amera nk’ibitwawe n’umuyaga?
Erega mwonapfindira impfuvyi, N’umukunzi wanyu mwomugura.
Enda kunda munyitegereze: N’ukuri sinobesha mu maso yanyu.
Ni mwirimbure, ndabinginze, hoye kuba ibifutamye; Mbere ni mwirimbure ukundi gusha, ivyanje n’ibigororotse.
Mbeg’ ururimi rwanje ruri n’ibifutamye? Akanwa kanje ntikazi gutandukanya ikibi?
Mbeg’ umuntu akiri mw isi ntaba ari mu ntambara? N’imisi yiwe si nk’iy’ umucangero?
Nk’uk’ umugurano yifuza igitūtu, N’umucangero akarereka ingero yiwe,
Ni ko nahawe umugabane w’ amezi y’umwunamo, Kandi nashingiwe amajoro y’umuruho.
Iyo ndyamye, ndavuga, Nti Buca ryari ngo mvyuke? Ndāra ndagaragurika bukarinda buca.
Umubiri wanje utwikiriwe n’inyo, utaramyekw ivyomeke vy’umukungugu; Urukoba rwanje ruratarurira, rugasaduka.
Imisi yanje irihuta kuruta ico umujishi w’impuzu ajishisha, Ishira ata vyizigiro.
Ibuka se k’ubugingo bganje ar’ umuyaga gusa: Ijisho ryanje ntirigisubira kubona ivyiza ukundi.
Ijisho ry’uwambona ntirigisubira kundāba; Amaso yawe uzoyanshirako, ariko nzoba ntakiriho.
Nk’ukw igicu cēyūka kigakamangana, Ni ko n’ūmanuka aja mu kuzimu atazosubira kudūga ukundi.
Ntazogaruka mu nzu yiwe ukundi, Kand’ aho yaba ntihazoba hakimwibuka ukundi.
Ni co gitumye ntiyumanganya; Ngira mvuge kubg’ umubabaro w’umutima wanje; Ndiganyira kubg’ akabonge ko mu mushaha wanje.
Mbega nd’ ikiyaga? Canke se nd’ igikōko co mu kiyaga, K’unshinze abarinzi?
Iyo mvuze, nt’ Uburiri bganje buzommara umubabaro, Ikirago canje kizonyorohereza amaganya;
Na ho nyene unkangisha inzozi, Ukanca ivutu mu vyo neretswe;
Bigatuma umutima wanje uhitamwo gupfuma nnigwa, Mpisemw’ urupfu kuruta kugumana aya magufa yanje.
Kubaho kwanje ndakuzinutswe; singomba kuramba: Enda se n’umpumekere, kukw imisi yanje ata co imaze.
Umuntu n’iki, ah’ umukuza, Ukamushirak’ umutima,
Ukamugendera uko bukeye, Ukāma umugerageza na ntaryo?
Uzogeza ryari kutankūrakw ijisho, Ng’ umpumekere, mmire amate?
Namba narakoze icaha, wewe nagutwaye iki ga Ngenzuzi y’abantu? N’iki gituma unshinga nk’ uruti rw’icumu utīmba, Bigatuma nirambirwa?
Kandi n’iki gituma utamparira igicumuro canje, ng’ unkūrek’ ukugabitanya kwanje? Kuko vuba ngiye kuryama mu mukungugu, Nawe uzondonderana umwete, ariko nzoba ntakiriho.
Maze Biludadi w’i Shuhi aramwishura,
at’ Uzogeza ryari kuvuga ben’ ivyo? Kand’ amajambo yo mu kanwa kawe azogeza ryari kuba nk’umuyaga w’igihuhuta?
Mbeg’ Imana iragoreka urubanza? Īshobora vyose irafutamika izibereye?
Namb’ abana bawe bāyicumuyeko, Ibatanze mu maboko y’ibibi vyabo.
Ariko weho, ni waronderana Imana umwete, Ukinginga Īshobora vyose,
Ni watungana ukagororoka, N’ukuri ntiyobura kwikangurira kugutabara, No gutuma ikibanza c’ubugororotsi bgawe kiroranirwa.
Kandi nah’ itangura ryawe ryari ritoya, Arikw amaherezo yawe wokwunguka cane.
Ndakwinginze, baza abo hambere, Shira umutima ku vyo ba sogokuruza bābaririkije:
Kuko tweho tur’ ab’ ejo gusa, ata co tuzi, Kand’ imisi tumara mw isi ni nk’igitūtu gusa.
Mbeg’ abo ntibokwigisha, bakakwīgānira, Bakavuga amajambo bakūye mu mitima yabo?
Mbeg’ umubere wokura ahatagira igitēmēka? Cank’ urukangaga rwomera ahatagira amazi?
Ruyabuze, naho rwoba rukiri rubisi, rudaciwe, Rutanga ibindi vyatsi vyose kwuma.
Ni kw inzira z’abibagira Imana bose zimera; Kand’ ivyizigiro vy’ūtubaha Imana bizoshira:
Ukwishima kwiwe kuzosāba, Ivyizigiro vyiwe bimeze nk’ inzu y’igitangurirwa.
Yokwegamira inzu yiwe, ariko na yo ntiyohagarara: Yoyibangiriza, ntigumeho.
Atotahara ari ku zuba, Amashami yiwe agasārira mu ndimiro yiwe yose.
Imizi yiwe isobekerana mu gihongo, Ayishōra i wabo w’amabuye.
Ni yarandurwa aho yamye, Hazoca hamwihakana, hati Sinigeze kukubona.
Rāba, uwo ni wo munezero ingeso ziwe zimuhaye! Kandi mw ivu yavuyemwo hazoca hamera abandi.
Ereg’ Imana ntizota umuntu atācumuye, Kandi ntizoramira inkozi z’ ibibi.
Akanwa kawe izosubira kukuzuza ibitwengatwenga, N’iminwa yawe izoyuzuza impundu.
Abakwanka bazokwambikwa isoni, Kand’ ihema ry’inkozi z’ibibi ntirizoba rikibaho ukundi.
Maze Yobu arishura,
ati N’ivy’ ukuri nzi kw ari ko biri: Arik’ umuntu yoshobora ate kuba umugororotsi imbere y’Imana?
Igomvye kumubūranya Ntiyobona iryo kuyishura, haba na rimwe mu gihumbi.
N’inyabgenge mu mutima, n’inyabushobozi mu nkomezi: Ni nde yayikomantajek’ umutima, akaroranirwa?
Yimura ibisozi ntibibimenye, Ikavyubikana uburake bgayo.
Itigitisha isi, igatirimuka ahantu hayo, Inkingi zayo zikanyiganyiga.
Ibuza izuba ntirirase, N’inyenyeri ikazitwikira.
Igaranzura amajuru iri yonyene, Ikagendera ku mikuba y’ ikiyaga.
Irema inyenyeri zitwa Arukuturo na Oriyoni na Kilimiya, N’ibirēre vy’i bumanuko.
Ni yo ikora ibihambaye bidaserangurika, Mbere n’ibitangaza bitoharūrika.
Rāba inca i ruhande sindayibone, Ikīrēngānira sindayimenye.
Isūmira ico iteye: ni nde yoyikimiranya? Ni nde yoyibaza, at’ Ivyo ugira n’ibiki?
Imana ntizokūrah’ uburake bgayo: Ingabo za Bgibone zubama musi yayo.
None jewe noshobora nte kuyishura, No kuronka amajambo yo kuyibūranya?
Naho noba mfise urubanza sinoyishura, Noyisaba imbabazi, kukw ari yo Mucamanza wanje.
Naho notakamba, ikitaba, Sinokwizigira ko yokwumviriza ivyanje.
Kukw imvunaguza igihuhuta, Ikanyongeranyakw ibikomere impōye ubusa.
Ntinkundira guhumeka, Arikw inyuzuza umubabaro.
Namba tuvuga inkomezi z’ umunyenkomezi, rāba na yo ni yo! Namba tuvuga ivyo kubūrana, ni nde yoyihamagaza?
Naho noba mfise urubanza, akanwa kanje nyene ni ko kontsindisha: Naho noba ntunganye, konyagiriza ubugorame.
Na none ndatunganye! Sincibabaye; Ngaye ukubaho kwanje.
Vyose ni co kimwe: ni co gituma mvuga, Nt’ Irandurana ūtunganye n’ umunyakibi.
Icago ni caduka kikica abantu, Ipfa kwitwengera ivyago vy’ abatācumuye.
Isi itanzwe mu maboko y’ inkozi z’ibibi; Ikinga mu maso h’abacamanza b’isi; Namb’ atari yo, none yoba nde se?
Imisi yo kubaho kwanje irihuta kurusha impayamaguru: Irahunga, ariko nta ciza ibona.
Iridunya nk’ibitebo vy’inkorogoto bisoza, Nk’inkukuma yirasa gufata ico ihīga.
Iyo mvuze, nti Hinge nirengagize amaganya yanje, Nēyūre mu maso hanje, hace:
Na ho nyene nca ntinya imibabaro yanje yose, Nkamenya yuk’ utazoncira urw’ abatācumuye.
Nzotsindwa: None rero n’iki gituma ntamishwa n’ubusa?
Naho nokwiyuhagiza shelegi, Ngakaraba isabuni;
Na ho nyene womvumbagaza mu muvo, Impuzu zanje zikanzinukwa.
Ereg’ Imana s’umuntu nkanje, ngo ndayishure, Ngo tujane tuje kubūrana.
Nta muhūza ariho hagati yacu Wo kudushirakw amaboko twempi ngo twuzure.
Noneho n’inkūrekw inkoni yayo, Igitinyiro cayo coye kuntera ubgoba.
Ni ho novuga ndayishize ubgoba; Kuko mu mutima wanje uko ndi atari ko mboneka.
Umutima wanje urambiwe n’ukubaho; Ngira nziburure amajojwa yanje, Mvugishwe n’akabonge ko mu mutima wanje.
Mbgire Imana, nti Ntuntsindishe: N’ummenyeshe igituma umbūranya.
Mbeg’ ubona ari vyiza wewe guhahaza, Ugakēngēra igikorwa c’amaboko yawe, Ukākishiriza umuco imigabo y’abanyakibi?
Mbeg’ ufise amaso y’umubiri? Canke se urāba nk’ukw abantu barāba?
Ah’ imisi yawe ingana n’iy’ umuntu? Canke se imyaka yawe ihwanye n’imisi y’umuntu?
Bituma ubaririkiriza ibigabitanyo vyanje, Ugasesangura icaha canje,
Kand’ uzi ko ntarikw igicumuro, Kw ata woshobora kundokora ngw ankūre mu kuboko kwawe?
Intoke zawe ni zo zambumvye, Ziranteranya uko ndi wese: yamara non’ uranyishe.
Ibuka, ndakwinginze, yuko wambumvye nk’ibumba: None se ugira unsubize mu mukungugu?
Mbega ntiwansutse nk’amata, Ukamvuza nk’urubu?
Wanyambitse urukoba n’ inyama, Undandikanisha amagufa n’ imitsi.
Wampaye ubugingo, ungirira imbabazi; Kungendera kwawe ni kwo kwanzigamiye umutima.
Yamara rero wamye uhishije ibindi mu mutima wawe, Kand’ ivyo wagabiye nzi kw ar’ ibi:
Iyo nkoze icaha unshinga ijisho, Kandi ntuzomparira ivyo nagabitanije.
Namba narakoze ibibi, mbonye ibara; Kandi namba nd’ umugororotsi, na ho nyene sinkivyutsa umutwe: Nuzuyemw’ ibitētērwa, nkitegereza umubabaro wanje.
Kandi n’iyo novyutsa umutwe, woca umpīga nk’intambge; Maz’ ukongera kunyiyereka ur’ akūmiza.
Usubira kuzana ivyabona vyawe kunyagiriza ukundi gusha; Ukangwizak’ ubushangashirwe bgawe; Ibintera binyungikanako.
None se n’iki catumye unkūra mu nda ya mama? Mba naracikanye, ntihagire ūnkubita ijisho.
Mba narabaye nk’ūtigeze kubaho, Bakanterurira mu mva nkiva mu nda ya mama.
Mbeg’ imisi yanje si mike? Ntabara undeke, Umpumekere, kugira ngo nduhuke gatoya,
Ntaraja aho ntazogaruka ukundi, Mu gihugu c’umwiza n’ic’ igitūtu c’urupfu,
Igihugu c’umwiza w’umuzitanya, nk’uk’ umuzimagiza nyene umeze, Ic’ igitūtu c’urupfu, ahatagira umutekano, Ah’ umuco umeze nk’umwiza.
Maze Zofari w’i Nayama arishura,
ati Mbeg’ isinzi ry’amajambo ntirikwiye kwishurwa? Ugira ng’umuntu yotsindanishirizwa n’ukw ar’ imvuzi?
Canke kwihayagiza kwawe gukwiye guhoza abantu? Iy’ utukana nta wuriho yotuma ugira n’udusoni?
Kuk’ uvuga, ng’ Uk’ uri kwose uragororotse, Kandi ngo Nawe uratunganye mu nyonga zayo.
Arikw icompa Imana ikavuga, Igateranura akanwa ikakwishura:
Ikakwereka amabanga y’ ubgenge, Uko bumeze kw ar’ igitangaza: Ni ho womenya yukw Imana itakugiriye ibihwanye n’ ibigabitanyo vyawe.
Mbega woshobora kugenzura ibidashikīrwa vy’Imana? Woshobora kumenya Īshobora vyose ukanonosora?
Biri hejuru nk’ijuru; wogira ute? Bir’ i bgina kuruta i kuzimu; womenya iki?
Urugero rwavyo rusumba isi uburebure, Rusumba ikiyaga ubgaguke.
Iyo yiyiziye, igata abantu mu ngoyi, Igakoranya abo kuja mu rubanza, ni nde yoyibuza?
Kukw itayobewe abantu b’ imburakimazi, Ibona n’ibigabitanyo itarinze kuvyitegereza.
Arik’ umuntu we, ubgenge bgiwe n’ubujuju: Mber’ avuka nk’inyana y’ indogoba y’inyeshamba.
Ariko weho, ni watunganya umutima wawe, Ukaya amaboko imbere yayo;
Namba har’ ukugabitanya mu kuboko kwawe ugute kure, Kandi ntukundire ibitagororotse ko biba mu mahema yawe:
N’ukuri ni ho uzokwunamura amaso yawe ata gasembga ufise; Mber’ uzokomera, ntuzotinya.
Kuk’ uzokwibagira umubabaro wawe, Uzowibuka nk’amazi yatemvye;
Kand’ ubugingo bgawe buzokwaka kurusha umurango w’amashōka; Naho hoba umwiza, hazomera nk’umuco wo mu gatondo‐tondo.
Kand’ uzoba amahoro, kuko harih’ ivyizigiro; Mber’ uzokenguza, wiruhukire ata nkomanzi.
Kand’ uzokwiryamira, ntihagire ūgutera ubgoba; Mbere benshi bazogusaba ng’ ubatonere.
Arikw amaso y’abanyakibi azokoboka, Ntibazobona aho guhungira; Kand’ ivyifuzo vyabo n’ugupfa.
Maze Yobu arishura,
ati N’ukuri umenga ni mwebge bantu muriho mwenyene, Kandi yuk’ umenga ubgenge buzojana namwe!
Erega nanje nzi ubgenge, si mwebge gusa, ntimubundusha; Mbega ben’ ivyo har’ ūtabizi?
Mpindutse nk’agatwengo kuri bagenzi banje: Nahora ntabaza Imana, ikantabara, Nd’ umugororotsi, nd’ umuntu atunganye, none mpindutse agatwengo.
Mu mutima w’uwihiririwe habamwo gukēngēra abagowe; Ūnyereye wese aratwengwa.
Ingo z’abambuzi zigira amahirwe, N’abavyogoroza Imana baba amahoro; Inkomezi zabo ni zo bagize imana yabo.
Enda baza ibikōko, bizokwigisha; N’inyoni zo mu kirēre, zizokubarira:
Cank’ uvugane n’isi, izokwigisha; N’amafi yo mu kiyaga azobikudondera.
N’ikihe mur’ ivyo vyose kitomenya yuk’ ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho ari kwo kwabikoze?
Ni we afise mu kuboko kwiwe ubugingo bg’ikintu cose kizima, N’impwemu z’ababaho bose.
Mbeg’ ugutwi si kwo gutondanuza amajambo, Nk’ukw akanwa kumviriza ivyo kurya?
Ubgenge bufiswe n’abatāma, Kand’ ukumenya gufiswe n’ abamaze igihe kirekire.
Arikw iyo yo ni yo ifise ubgenge n’inkomezi; Ni yo ifise inama no kumenya.
Rāba, irasambura, ntihasubire kwubakika; Yugarana umuntu, ntihashobore kwuguruka.
Rāba, yimana amazi, agakama; Vyongeye yayarekura, akūbika isi.
Ni yo ifise inkomezi n’ubgenge bushitse; Ūgunga n’ūgungwa n’abayo.
Ishorera abajanama ar’ inyagano, N’abacamanza ibahindura ibipfu.
Ikenyurura inkindi z’abami, Ikabakenyeza imigozi.
Ishorera abaherezi ar’ inyagano, Icurikiranya abakomeye.
Abār’ imvuzi ibahindura ibiragi, Kand’ abashingantahe ibāka ubgenge bgabo.
Isuka agakēngērwe ku bahambaye, Ikadohora umukanda w’abahizi.
Iserura ibitamenyekana vyo mu mwiza, Kand’ igitūtu c’urupfu igishira ahabona.
Igwiza amahanga, kand’ ikayarandura; Ishwiragiza amahanga, kand’ ikayagarukana.
Abatware b’amoko yo mw isi ibāka ubgenge, Ibayerereza mu bugaragwa ahatagira inzira.
Bakabakabira mu mwiza ahatagira umuco, Kand’ ibadandabagiranya nk’ imborerwa.
Rāba, ijisho ryanje ryabonye ivyo vyose; Ugutwi kwanje kwaravyiyumviye, kurabitahura.
Ivyo muzi nanje ndabizi: Ntimundusha.
N’ukuri ndagomba kwibaririra Īshobora vyose, Kandi ndifuza kwībūranira ku Mana.
Ariko mwebge mur’ abarementanya ibinyoma; Mwese mur’ abavūzi b’imburakimazi.
Icompa mugacereza rwose! Mwobaye mugize ubgenge.
Noneho ni mwumve urubanza rwanje, Kandi mutegere amatwi kubūrana kw’iminwa yanje.
Mbeg’ Imana mwoyibūranira mugoreka amajambo, Kandi muyivugira ibinyoma?
Mbega muyitinya ku kigohe? Non’ Imana mwoyitsa?
Aho vyoba vyiza ibaseranguye ikarāba? Canke mwoyihenda nk’uk’ umuntu ahenda uwundi?
Ntizobura kubahana, Namba murobanura ku cubahiro mu mpisho.
Mbeg’ icubahiro cayo nticobatera ubgoba, Igitinyiro cayo kikabasūmira?
Ya magambo yanyu akomeye ni nk’imigani y’iminyota, Inkinzo zanyu ni nk’inkinzo z’ibibumbano.
Ni muhore, mumpumekere, mbone kuvuga, Bice aho bigomba.
Ar’ ugupfa, mpfe, Ar’ uguheba amagara yanje, ndayahebe.
Ehe rāba, agira anyice: nta co nkirorereye; Yamara nzokwiregura ingeso zanje imbere yayo.
Ivyo na vyo bizombera agakiza, Kuk’ ūtubaha Imana atoseruka imbere yayo.
Enda ni mugire umwete wo kwumva amajambo yanje; Ivyo ngira mvuge bishike mu matwi yanyu.
Rāba mmaze gushinga urubanza rwanje: Ndazi ko nd’ umugororotsi.
Ni nde yompāririza? Abayeho noca mpora ngahwera.
Yamara Bgirukiro, ntunga ku bintu bibiri, Ni ho ntokwihisha mu nyonga zawe:
Geguza ukuboko kwawe kumveko, Kandi ntuntereshe ubgoba igitinyiro cawe ukundi.
Ni ho wompamagara, nkakwitaba, Cank’ unyemerere mvuge, abe ari wewe unyishura.
Ibigabitanyo vyanje n’ivyaha vyanje bingana bite? N’ummenyeshe igicumuro canje n’icaha canje.
N’iki gituma umpisha mu nyonga hawe, Ukangira umwansi wawe?
Mbeg’ ikibabi bubabi gikubebga n’umuyaga, wogitera ubgoba? Wokwiruka inyuma y’ibishingwe vyumye?
Kuk’ unyanditsekw ibintu bimbereye umururazi, Kand’ ukansubizakw ibigabitanyo vyo mu busore bganje.
Kand’ ibirenge vyanje ubishize mu mpatane z’ibiti, Ugenzura imigendere yanje yose; Ushingiye akarimbi ibirenge vyanje:
Naho mmeze nk’igiti kibongeye, Nk’impuzu yariwe n’inyenzi.
Umuntu yavyawe n’umugore Amara imisi mike kand’ adundubiwe n’amagorwa.
Ashurika bga shurwe, maz’ agacibga; Ahita nk’igitūtu, ntiyamaho.
Mbega nawe, ūmeze artyo womukanurira ijisho, K’unshize mu rukinja?
Ni nde yoshobora gukūra ikintu gitunganye mu canduye? Erega nta wuriho n’umwe.
Imisi yiwe ko yashinzwe, igitigiri c’amezi yiwe kikaba gifiswe nawe, Ukaba waramushingiye akarimbi adashobora kurēngāna;
Umukūrekw ijisho, abone kuruhuka, Anezererwe umusi wiwe nk’ umucangero agodotse.
Kuko harih’ ivyizigiro vy’ igiti, iyo giciwe, yuko kizokwongera kunaga, Kand’ ibitontomya vyaco ko bitazobura.
Nah’ umuzi waco usāzira mw ivu, N’igishitsi caco kigahera mu kuzimu,
Arikw iyo cumvise amazi gica kinaga, Kigashamika nk’igiti kikiri gito.
Arik’ umuntu we, arapfa, akīgīra maheriheri, Mber’ impwemu z’umuntu zirahera, non’ aba akiri hehe?
Nk’ukw amazi yo mu kiyaga akeha, N’umugezi ukagabanuka, ugakamuka;
Ni k’umuntu aryama, ntasubire kuvyuka: Gushitsa ah’ ijuru rizoba ritakiriho, ntibazokwigera bikangura, Canke ngo bavyutswe bave mw itiro ryabo.
Icompa ukampisha i kuzimu, Ukandindira ahihishije, gushitsa ah’ uburake bgawe buzoshirira; Ukanshingira igihe, kand’ ukazonyibuka.
Umuntu ni yapfa, mbeg’ azosubira kubaho? Nokwihanganiye imisi y’intambara yanje yose, Nkarorēra igihe canje co kurekurwa.
Wompamagaye nkakwitaba; Wobaye wifuza igikorwa c’ amaboko yawe.
Yamara non’ uharūra intambuko zanje: Mbega ntushinze ijisho icaha canje?
Igicumuro canje gitekewe mw isaho irumanijwe n’ishashara, N’ibigabitanyo vyanje ubiboheye hamwe.
Yamara n’ukuri umusozi uracika, ugaherengetera, N’igitandara kigakūrwa aho cari kiri;
Amazi agenda akorogoshora amabuye; Isūri itembana umukungugu wo kw isi: Ni ko nawe ukūrah’ ivyizigiro vy’umuntu.
Umutsinda buheriheri, akagenda mazimayongo; Uhindura mu maso hiwe ukundi, ukamurungika.
Abana biwe bahabga icubahiro, ntabimenye; Bacishwa bugufi, ntabice n’ ikanda.
Arik’ uburibge bg’umubiri wiwe ubgiwe ni bgo yumva gusa, Umutima wiwe uniha uwo gupfa.
Maze Elifazi w’i Temani arishura,
ati Mbeg’ umunyabgenge yokwishurana amagambo asunitswe n’impwemu, Umuyaga akaba ari wo yuzuza inda?
Mbega yobūranisha amagambo atagira ikimazi, Canke yovuga ibitagira ico bivūra?
N’ukuri, kwubaha Imana ugukūyeho, Kand’ ubuzanije no kuyisenga.
Kukw ibigabitanyo vyawe ari vyo vyigisha akanwa kawe, Nawe wihitiyemw’ ururimi rw’ubugunge.
Akanwa kawe ubgako ni ko kagutsindisha, si jewe; Mber’ iminwa yawe ni yo ikwagiriza.
Mbega ni wewe muntu wa mbere yatanguye kuvuka? Canke se wavyawe imisozi itararemwa?
Mbega wigeze kwumva inama zihishijwe z’Imana? Canke ni wewe wiharije ubgenge?
Ivy’ uzi tutazi natwe n’ibiki? Ico watahuye tutāmenye n’ iki?
Turimw’ abameze imvi n’ abatāma bukokori, Baruta so ubukuru iy’ atibona.
Mbeg’ ukwirura kw’Imana wakwise ubusa, Bo n’amajambo yo kukworohereza?
N’iki gituma umutima wawe ukuzimiza, Amaso yawe agahindurira,
Ugatera umutima wawe kurwanya Imana, Ugatuma akanwa kawe karokomboka amagambo ameze artyo?
Umuntu vyoshoboka bite kw aba uwera? Cank’ uwavyawe n’umugore, kw aba umugororotsi?
Erega n’abera bayo nta ho ibizigira, Mbere n’ijuru na ryo ntiritunganye mu nyonga zayo,
Nanswe umuntu agayitse kand’ abihiye, Agotomera ibigabitanyo nk’ amazi!
Ngira nkubarire, nawe nyumviriza: Kand’ ivyo nabonye ndabikumenyesha.
Vyāvuzwe n’abanyabgenge, Bābikūye kuri ba sekuruza, ntibābihisha;
Kandi ni bo bonyene bāhawe igihugu, Nta n’umunyamahanga yaca muri bo:
Ni vyo ibi, yuk’ umunyakibi ahora aseserewe imisi yiwe yose, Akarinda ashitsa igitigiri c’ imyaka abahahaji bāshingiwe.
Ijwi ry’ibiteye ubgoba ryama mu matwi yiwe; Akiri mu mahoro umunyazi azomunyaga.
Ntiyizigira kw azogaruka ngw ave mur’ uwo muzimagiza, Kandi yumva kw inkota ihora imurorereye.
Ayerēra arondera ivyo kurya, ati Vyoba hehe? Azi k’umusi w’umuzimagiza umwiteze uri hambavu yiwe.
Amagorwa n’umubabaro bimutera ubgoba; Biramutsinda bimeze nk’ umwami yiteguriye kurwana,
Kuko yabanguriye Imana ukuboko kwiwe, Akīnantaza kw Īshobora vyose,
Akayirangirirako afise ubugabo, Yitwaje inkinzo ifise umukondo ukomeye.
Asenyuka mu maso hiwe, Akagira ibinyonyori ku mafyinga.
Kandi yagerereye mu bisagara vyabaye amatongo, No mu nzu z’imisaka abantu batakibamwo, Zisigaje gatoya zigacika ibirundo vy’amasakamburira.
Ntazoba umutunzi, kandi n’ ivyo yar’ atunze ntibizogumaho, Kandi n’ivyo yamuje nta ho bizoregeza ngo bijondajonde hasi.
Nta ho azova mu mwiza; Urubeya rw’umuriro ruzobabura amashami yiwe, Impwemu ziva mu kanwa k’ Imana zizomukūraho.
Yoye kwizigira ivy’ ubusa, yihenda; Kukw ibitagira ikimazi ari vyo ngero yiwe.
Azoyihabga igihe ciwe kitaribgashike, Kand’ ishami ryiwe ntirizotoha.
Azokenyanywa nk’uk’ umuzabibu ukorora inzabibu zawo zikir’ ibitumbge, Nk’uk’ umwelayo uhungurutsekw amashurwe yawo.
Kukw igihari c’abatubaha Imana kizogumbaha, Kand’ umuriro uzoyigiza ingo z’abarya ingurire.
Basama inda z’inabi, bakavyara ibigabitanyo, Mu nda zabo hakuramw’ ubugunge.
Maze Yobu arishura,
ati Numvise vyinshi ben’ ivyo: Mwese mur’ abagandazi bagorana.
Mbeg’ amagambo atwarwa n’umuyaga ntazogira iherezo? Ikigutera kwishura n’iki?
Erega nanje noshoboye kuvuga nkamwe, Iyaba ari mwebge mwari mumeze nkanje, Nanje noshoboye gukoranya amagambo yo kubanegura, Nkabazunguriza umutwe.
Nanje nobaremeshesha akanwa kanje, Kwirura kwo gupfa kubomboranya iminwa yanje kwoborohereza.
Yamara n’iyo ngize ico mvuga, umubabaro wanje ntiworoherwa; Canke niyumanganije, ntugabanuka.
Ariko noneh’ irambutamitse, Yagesheje abanje bose.
Yaransūmiye, bihinduka ibinyagiriza: Kunanuka kwanje kwankūriye hasi, kuranyagiriza imbonankubone.
Yantabaguranye uburake bgayo impōye ubusa; Yandyanirije insya z’amenyo; Īndwanya intungiriye igitsure.
Baranyasamiye n’akanwa kabo, Bankoze kw itama bantuka; Bankoraniyeko.
Imana yangabuye mu batayubaha; Intereye mu maboko y’inkozi z’ibibi.
Nari nibereye mu mahoro, maz’ iramvunagura; Mbere yansūmiye kw izosi, irankenyagura: Kand’ inshinga nk’uruti rw’ icumu.
Abarashi bayo bantanze irya n’ino, Intobekeranije mu mafyigo ata kagongwe; Ishēshe amara yanje hasi.
Yiyongeranya kunca ibihengeri, Insūmiye imeze nk’ikigatanya.
Nibaririyekw amagunira ku mubiri wanje; Ihembe ryanje narishiburiye mu mukungugu.
Amaso yanje akobowe no kurira, Kand’ igitūtu c’urupfu cubikije ku bigohe vyanje;
Nah’ ata muryano wari mu maboko yanje, Kand’ ugusenga kwanje kukaba kwari gutunganye.
Wa si we, ntutwikire amaraso yanje, Gutakamba kwanje ntikugire aho guhengeshanya.
Rāba n’ubu Icabona canje kiri mw ijuru, Ūnyineze ar’ iyo hejuru.
Abakunzi banje barankēngēra, Arikw ijisho ryanje risuka amosozi imbere y’Imana,
Kugira ngo habeh’ uwitsa ivy’ umuntu ku Mana, Nk’uk’ umuntu avugira mugenzi we!
Kukw imyaka mike ni yashira, Nzojana inzira ntazogarukamw’ ukundi.
Ubugingo bganje buraheze, Imisi yanje irashize, Imva iranyiteze.
Ereg’ abacokoranyi barankikije, Ijisho ryanje nta kindi ribona atar’ akavyongo kabo.
Enda se tanga ingwati, unyishinge wewe ubgawe: Uwundi twokorana mu ntoke duhānye isezerano yoba nde?
Kuko wahishije ubgenge imitima yabo: Ni co gituma utazobashira hejuru.
Umuntu ashengerera bagenzi biwe ngo banyagwe, Amaso y’abana biwe azokoboka.
Ariko yangize iciro ry’imigani mu bantu, Mpindutse uwo gucirwa mu maso.
Ijisho ryanje rikabiranijwe n’ intuntu, N’ingingo zanje zose zimeze nk’igitūtu.
Ivyo bizotuma abatunganye bumirwa, N’umuntu atagira igicumuro ngw avuduke arwanye ūtubaha Imana.
Arik’ umugororotsi azokomerera mu nzira yiwe, N’ūfise amaboko yiziguye azokwama yunguka inkomezi.
Ariko mweho ni mushireko muje imbere mwese, Na ho nyene nta munyabgenge n’umwe nobona muri mwebge.
Imisi yanje iraheze, imigabo yanje ipfuye umuhimba, Iyo nari mfise mu mutima wanje.
Ijoro baryita umurango, Bat’ Umuco uraje; kandi hakir’ umwiza.
Ko nziga i kuzimu kw ari ho i wanje, Nkaba nshashe uburiri bganje mu mwiza,
Nkaba mbariye rwa rwobo, nti Ni wewe data, Nkabarira n’inyo, nti Ni wewe mama, kand’ ukaba na mushikanje;
Non’ ivyizigiro vyanje biri hehe? Kand’ ivyo vyizigiro vyanje ni nde azoruha abibona?
Bizomanuka bishike ku bihindizo vy’i kuzimu, Igihe nzoronka uburuhukiro mu mukungugu.
Maze Biludadi w’i Shuhi arishura,
ati Muzogeza ryari kurondera amajambo? Ni mwiyumvire, hanyuma tubone kuvuga.
N’iki gituma tugereranywa n’ibikōko, Tugahinduka nk’abatagira ubgenge mu maso yanyu?
Wewe witabagurana uburake bgawe, Mbeg’ isi yohebga kubgawe? Cank’ igitandara cokūrwaho kubgawe?
N’ukuri urumuri rw’umunyakibi ruzozima, Kand’ urubeya rw’umuriro wiwe ntiruzokwaka.
Umuco uzocura umwiza mu nzu yiwe, N’itara rimanitse hejuru yiwe rizozima.
Intambuko ziwe z’inkomezi zizopfunywa, Imigabo yiwe ubgiwe ni yo izomutsinda hasi.
Ereg’ ivyiwe birenge ni vyo bimutsinda mu ruriba, Agaca ku gitsiburira.
Ikigāmo kizomufata igitsintsiri, Umutego uzomucakira.
Impururu yo kumufata ihishijwe mw ivu, Umushibuka umutegeye mu nzira.
Azoterwa ubgoba n’ibimukanga irya n’ino, Bizomukinagiza vyōmye ku bitsintsiri vyiwe.
Inkomezi ziwe zizomarwa n’ inzara, Kand’ ivyago bizoba bibunze i ruhande yiwe.
Ingingo z’umubiri wiwe zizotsontsomerwa, Mber’ imfura y’urupfu izozitsontsomera.
Azorandurwa mu rugo rwiwe yishimira, Azokwegerwa imbere y’ umwami w’ibiteye ubgoba.
Abatar’ abiwe bazokwinjira urugo rwiwe; Amazuku azosukwa ahantu yahora aba.
Imizi yiwe izokwumira hasi, N’ishami ryiwe rizokabiranira hejuru.
Kwibukwa kwiwe kuzozimangana mw isi, Kand’ izina ryiwe ntirizokwongera kuvugwa mu nzira.
Azokwirukanwa ave mu muco, aje mu mwiza; Mber’ azocibga mw isi.
Ntazogira umuhungu cank’ umwuzukuru mu bgoko bgiwe, Cank’ ūzosigara aho yahora.
Abazoza inyuma yiwe bazotangarira umusi wiwe, Nk’ukw abāmwitangiye imbere bātewe n’ubgoba.
N’ukuri aho ni ho i wabo w’ūgabitanya, Kand’ aho ni ho hantu h’ ūtazi Imana.
Maze Yobu arishura,
ati Muzogeza hehe kubabaza umutima wanje, Mukamvunaguza amagambo yanyu?
Ubu n’ubugira icumi munshinyagurira; Nta n’agasoni mugira ko kungirira nabi.
Namba naracumuye koko, Igicumuro canje ni jewe kiriko.
Namba mugomba kunyiratako, No kunyagiririsha ivyago vyanje mubindemēka,
Mumenye yukw ar’ Imana yubitse urubanza rwanje, Ikanta hagati mu mutego.
Rāba, ntakishwa n’umuryano, ariko sinumvirwa; Ndatabaza, sincirwe urubereye.
Inzira yanje yarayishibije ngo sinshobore kuhaca; Kandi yakwiragije umwiza mu nzira zanje.
Yanyaze icubahiro canje, Inyambura n’igitsibo co mu mutwe wanje.
Yansanganguye impande zose, ndapfuye; Kand’ ivyizigiro vyanje yabiranduye nk’igiti.
Yandometseko n’uburake bgayo, Imparūra mu barwanizi bayo.
Ingabo zayo zaziye icarimwe, zitegura inzira yo kuntera, Zisagaza irya n’ino y’urugo rwanje.
Yantandukanije n’abo tuvukana, Kandi n’abo twari tuzinanyi baranyihakanye.
Ab’i wacu bantaye, N’abakunzi banje pfampfe banyibagiye.
Ababa mu rugo rwanje, n’ incoreke zanje, bangize nk’ umushitsi: Mbaye nk’umunyamahanga mu maso yabo.
Mpamagara umushumba wanje, ntaruha anyitaba, Naho nomukomera ibobo.
Umugore wanje azinutswe ubgaku bganje, Nteye ishishi bene mama.
Mbere n’abana bato barankēngēra; Iyo mvuye hasi bamvuga nabi.
Abajanama banje baranzinutswe bose, N’abo nakunda bahindukiye kundwanya.
Amagufa yanje amatanye n’ urukoba n’inyama: Nshigaje gatoya ngapfa.
Mungirire akagongwe, mungirire akagongwe, yemwe bakunzi banje, Kuk’ ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho kwankozeko.
N’iki kibatera kundendereza nk’ukw Imana ingize? Uk’umubiri wanje wabaye ntikubahāgije?
Icompa amajambo yanje akaba yanditswe! Icompa akaba yanditswe mu gitabo!
Icompa akaba akorogoshowe mu gitandara N’ikaramu y’icuma, n’icuma c’isāsu, akazohoraho!
Ariko jewe ubganje nzi yuk’ Umucunguzi wanje ariho, Kandi ko kw iherezo azohagarara kw isi:
Kand’ urukoba rwanje ni rwamara kubora, Nzobona Imana mfise umubiri.
Nzoyībonera ubganje, Amaso yanje azoyitegereza, nta wundi nzorāba. Umushaha wanje udendebuwe n’inkumbu.
Ko muvuga muti Ngo tumutemvye: Mut’ Inyanduruko y’ivyiwe imubonetseko!
Ni mutinye inkota: Kuk’ uburake bgihamagarira inkota, Kandi mumenye yuk’ urubanza ruzocibga.
Maze Zofari w’i Nayama arishura,
at’ Ivyiyumviro vyanje binteye kwishura, Kuko bindundumiye.
Numvise ibikangisho binteye isoni, Kand’ umutima wanje w’ ubgenge uranyishuye.
Mbega ntuzi yuko kuva kera, Uhereye igihe umuntu yashizwe mw isi,
Ukwihaya kw’abanyakibi kumara igihe gito, No kunezerwa kw’abatubaha Imana ar’ ukw’ akanya isase?
Nah’ ubgibone bgiwe bgoshika kw ijuru, Umutwe wiwe ugashika mu bicu,
Azoshira buheriheri nk’ umwanda umuvuyemwo: Abāhora bamubona bazovuga, bati Mbeg’ ari hehe?
Azoguruka nk’inzozi, ntabe akiboneka, Mber’ azokamangana nk’ibiravūswe mw ijoro.
Ijisho ryahora rimurāba ntirizosubira kumubona ukundi, N’ahantu yaba ngo hongere kumubona.
Abana biwe bazoja gusaba aboro, Kandi bazoriha ivyo yagunze.
Inkomezi z’ubusore bgiwe zuzuye mu magufa yiwe, Zizoryamana na we mu mukungugu.
Nah’ ivyaha bimuryohera mu kanwa, Akabinyegeza mu nkingi z’ ururimi,
Akanka kubiheba, Akabigumya mu kanwa kiwe,
Yamar’ ivyo yariye bizomuhinduka bishitse mu nda, Bizohinduka nk’ubumara bg’ imvuvyi muri we.
Yamize ubutunzi miyonzwa, non’ azobudahwa: Imana izobisevya mu nda yiwe.
Azonunuza ubumara bg’ imvuvyi; Ururimi rw’inzoka ruzomwica.
Ntazokwitegereza inzūzi, Ari zo migezi itemba ubūki n’ urubu.
Inyungu yaronse azozisubiza, ntazozitamirako; Ubutunzi yaronse ntibuzomunezereza.
Kuko yahahaje aboro, akabīrengagiza; Yinjiye urugo atubatse.
Umutima wiwe ntuzi guhurarara, Kandi ntazokiza ikintu na kimwe mu vyamuhimbara.
Nta casigaye atāherengeteje, Ni co gituma ubuhirwe bgiwe butazogumaho.
Igihe ivyiwe bizoba bimucugaye binengesereye, azofutana; Amagorwa yose azomwizingirako.
Igihe agira ahāze inda yiwe, Imana izomusukak’ uburake bgayo bg’inkazi, Izobumucuncuburirako akirikw ararya.
Azogira ngw arahunga ibirwanishwa vy’ivyuma, Arik’ umuheto w’umuringa uzomutobekeranisha umwampi,
Useruke mu mugongo wiwe: Mber’ uwo mubugita ukayangana uzoseruka utobekeranije indurwe yiwe; Ubgoba buzoba bumufashe.
Umwiza wose ni wo azobīkirwa ku butunzi: Umuriro utākijwe n’umuntu uzomutongora, Uherengeteze ibizoba bisigaye mu rugo rwiwe.
Ijuru rizoshira ibigabitanyo vyiwe ahabona, Kand’ isi izomukūrira hasi.
Inyungu yo mu nzu yiwe izojanwa, Ibintu vyiwe bizotwarwa bisendanishijwe ku musi w’ uburake bgayo.
Ivyo ni vyo mugabane umunyakibi ahabga n’Imana, Ni yo ngero yagerewe na yo.
Maze Yobu arishura,
ati Ni mwitwaririke kwumva ivyo mvuga; Uko ni ko mwommara umubabaro.
Ni munyihanganire, mvuge nanje, Maze ni naheza kuvuga mukomeze mutwenge.
Mbeg’ abantu ni bo nganyira? Icotuma nihangana n’iki?
Ni munyitegereze mwumirwe, Mwifate ku munwa.
Iyo mvyibutse ngira ubgoba, Umubiri wanje ugafatwa n’ agatengo.
N’iki gituma abanyakibi babaho, Bakīsāzira, mbere bakarushiriza kugira inkomezi?
Uruvyaro rwabo rwāruka barubona, Abana babo bārukira imbere y’amaso yabo.
Ingo zabo zībēra amahoro ata co zīkanga, Kand’ inkoni y’Imana ntibagerako.
Impfizi zabo nta ho zihangūra kuvyara; Inka zabo zama zivyara, ntiziramburure.
Ibibondo vyabo birōngōra imbere yabo nk’umukuku, Kand’ abana babo bama bavyina.
Baririmbisha udushako tw’ ingoma n’inanga, Bakanezererwa ijwi ry’umwironge.
Imisi yabo bayimara baroraniwe, Maze bakamanuka i kuzimu banihutse.
Yamar’ ari bo bābariye Imana, bati Tuve i ruhande, Kuko tutagomba kumenya inzira zawe.
Bat’ Īshobora vyose n’iki, ngo tuyisabe? Kandi ni twayisenga, bizotumarira iki?
Rāba, umugisha wabo si bo bawizigamiye: Inama y’abanyakibi iba kure yanje.
Mbega har’ aho mubona itara ry’abanyakibi rizima, Ivyago bikabatera, Imana ikabagabanganya imibabaro iri n’uburake,
Bakaba nk’ibishingwe bitwarwa n’umuyaga, Nk’umuguruka utumurwa n’ igihuhuta?
Mbeg’ Imana izohanira abana ibigabitanyo vya se? Eka ni yihanirwe ubgiwe, yibonereko!
Ayiwe maso ni yibonere ivyago vyiwe, Kand’ anywe ku burake bg’ Īshobora vyose!
Ibizoba ku b’inzu yiwe bazomukurikira mbeg’ azobibabara, Kand’ apfuye akenyutse?
Har’ uwokwigisha Imana ubgenge, Kand’ ari yo icira imanza abahambaye?
Umwe apfa, agifise inkomezi zishitse, Acidibamiye mu mahoro,
Ivyansi vyiwe bicuzuye amata, Umusokōro ukiyagagira mu magufa yiwe.
Uwundi apfana intimba mu mutima, Atigeze kubona ivyiza.
Bompi baryamana mu mukungugu, Inyo zikaborosa.
Erega ndazi ivyiyumviro vyanyu, N’imigabo mibi mungīra.
Kuko muvuga, mut’ Inzu y’ ūhambaye iri hehe? N’urugo abanyavyaha bāhoramwo ruri hehe?
Mbega ntimuraruha mubaza abantu b’ingenzi? Ntimwemeye ivyo bashingiye intahe,
Yukw inkozi y’ikibi ihora irokoka ku musi w’ivyago, Kandi kw ikira ku musi w’ uburake?
Ni nde yomwereka ingeso ziwe imbonankubone? Ni nde yomusubiriza mu nkōko ivyo yakoze?
Yamar’ azoterurirwa mu cobo, Bazorinda imva yiwe.
Ibisinde vyo mu mwonga bizomworohera, Abantu bose bazomukurikira, Kand’ abāmwitangiye imbere babaye isinzi.
None rero n’iki gituma munyirurisha ivy’ ubusa? Ibisigaye mu vyo munyishura n’ibinyoma bisa!
Maze Elifazi w’i Temani arishura,
ati Mbeg’ umuntu yoshobora kugirira Imana ikimazi? Ushime n’umunyabgenge nta wundi yokigirira shiti kucīgirira ubgiwe.
Mbeg’ ukugororoka kwawe kurahimbara Īshobora vyose? Canke se gutunganya ingeso zawe har’ ico biyungura?
Mbeg’ ukuyubaha kwawe ugira ngo ni kwo kwatumye iguhana, Ikagushira mu rubanza?
S’ukw ivyaha vyawe bikomeye? Mber’ ibigabitanyo vyawe ntibigira akagero.
Kuko wanyaze bene wanyu ingwati z’ubusa, Ugakoba impuzu z’abatagira ico bambara.
Umuntu arushe ntiwamuhaye amazi yo kunywa, Kand’ umushonji wamwimye ivyo kurya.
Ūhambaye ni we yiganziye igihugu, Ūtinywa mu kigohe akacībēramwo.
Wirukanye abapfakazi bagenda imvumure, N’amaboko y’impfuvyi aravunagurwa.
Ni co gituma imitego igukikije, Ubgoba bga giturumbuka buguhagaritse umutima,
N’umwiza na wo ukagukikiza, ukakubuza kubona, Kand’ amazi menshi akakurengera.
Mbeg’ Imana ntiri hejuru mw ijuru? Kandi rāba inyenyeri ziri hejuru iyo bigwa, ingene zir’ ahītereye kure!
Nawe ukavuga, ngw Imana izi iki? Kand’ uti Yoshobora ite guca imanza iri mu mwiza w’ umuzitanya?
Ut’ Ibicu bitwaye intunda birayitwikiriye, biyibuza kubona; Yigendagendera ahihese hejuru kw ijuru.
Mbeg’ ugomba gukomeza inzira ya kera, Iy’ abanyakibi bājanye?
Bācakiwe igihe cabo kitaragera; Itanguriro ryabo ryatemvye nk’umugezi.
Bakabgira Imana, bati Tuve i ruhande; Bat’ Īshobora vyose yotumarira iki?
Yamara yujuje inzu zabo ivyiza: Inama z’abanyakibi zikaba kure yayo.
Abagororotsi barabibona bakanezerwa, Abatarikw igicumuro barabatwengera mw ijigo,
Bati N’ukuri abāri badukūriye hasi bararanduwe, N’amasigarira yo muri bo atongowe n’umuriro.
Enda rero ni wiyuzuze na yo, ubone kuba amahoro: Uko ni k’uzobona amahirwe.
Ndakwinginze, wemere kwigishwa n’ibiva mu kanwa kayo, Amajambo yayo uyabīke mu mutima wawe.
Ni wagaruka kw Īshobora vyose, Ugashira ukugabitanya kure y’urugo rwawe, uzokomezwa.
Rekurira itunga ryawe mu mukungugu, N’izahabu yavuye muri Ofiru uyirekurire mu mabuye yo mu migezi;
Maz’ Īshobora vyose izokubera itunga, N’ifeza y’igiciro kinini.
Ni ho uzonezererwa Īshobora vyose, Ukunamurira amaso yawe ku Mana.
Uzoyisaba, na yo izokwumva; Kand’ uzoshitsa amasezerano yawe.
Iy’ ugize ico ugabira, kizokubera uko wagomba, Kand’ umuco uzomurika mu nzira zawe.
Ni bagutsinda hasi uzovuga, uti Har’ ikimvyutsa; Kand’ uwicisha bugufi Imana izomukiza.
Mber’ izorokora n’ūrikw igicumuro: N’ukuri uzorokorwa no gutungana kw’amaboko yawe.
Maze Yobu arishura,
ati No gushitsa uyu musi amajojwa yanje aharūrwa nk’umugararizo: Uko nkubitwa kuruta uko nniha.
Iyo mba nari nzi aho noyibona, Kugira ngo nduhe nshike n’ imbere y’intebe yayo!
Noyikūrira ku ntango urubanza rwanje, Akanwa kanje nkakuzuzamw’ amajambo y’imibūrano.
Nkamenya amajambo yonyishura, Ngatahura ico yombarira.
Mbega yontwarisha ituntu ubushobozi bgayo buhambaye? Oyaye, arikw ivyanje yobishira ku mutima.
Aho ni ho umugororotsi yobūranira na yo, Īncira urubanza ikancira urutazokwivuguruzwa gushitsa ibihe bidashira.
Rāba, nja imbere, ariko si ho iri; Nasubira inyuma, nkayibura;
Naja i bubamfu mu gihe ikorera, na ho nyene sinshobore kuyibona; Yihisha ku ruhande rw’i buryo, kugira ngo sindayikubite ijisho.
Yamara yo irazi inzira ncamwo; Ni yamara kumvugutira nzovamwo mmeze nk’izahabu.
Ikirenge canje nacometse mu cayo; Inzira yayo narayikomeje, sinakikama.
Nta ho nasubiye inyuma ngo mve mu vyagezwe yashinze; Nashize umutima ku majambo yo mu kanwa kayo kuruta uko ndawushira ku vyo kurya bintunga.
Yagiye imigabo: none ni nde yoshobora kuyibuza? Kand’ ico umutima wayo ugomvye ni co ikora.
Kukw ari yo izonshitsakw ivyo yangereye: Kand’ ifise ibindi vyinshi bimeze nk’ivyo.
Ni co gituma ndandurwa umutima no kuba imbere yayo; Iyo ndayiyumviriye ndayitinya.
Kukw Imana ari yo idendebuye umutima wanje, Kand’ Īshobora vyose ikaba ari yo inciye ivutu.
Ivyo ni vyo binshābije, s’ umwiza, S’uk’ umwiza w’umuzitanya untwikiriye mu maso.
N’iki gituma Īshobora vyose idashinga ibihe vy’imanza? N’iki gituma abayizi batabona iyo misi?
Har’ abashingūra akarimbi k’ urubibe, Bakanyaga imikuku ku manyama bakayīragirira.
Bakinagiza akadogoba k’ impfuvyi, Batwara agaka k’umupfakazi kw ingwati.
Bashiburira abagorwa hirya y’inzira: Impahazwa zo mu gihugu zikanyegagira hamwe.
Ehe basokororwa no gukora, banuranura utwo kurya, Bameze nk’indogoba z’inyeshamba zo mu bugaragwa: Mu bugaragwa honyene ni ho bakūrira abana utwo kurya.
Basigaye batungwa no kwahira ibibabi mu matongo, Bapfa guhumba uducekwa two mu mizabibu y’abanyakibi.
Ijoro ryose barāra ubutura, ata co bipfutse, Kandi mu mbeho nta co bishirako.
Bacikirwako n’imvura imanutse ku misozi, Bikinga mu gitandara babuze ubgugamo.
Har’ abashikura impfuvyi ibere, Bakāka ingwati aboro,
Bigatuma bagenda gusa, ata co bambaye, Kandi baremēkwa ibinyankinda n’inzara mu nda;
Bagakānyūra amavuta muri elayo mu ngo z’abo banyakibi, Bagakānyana inyota mu māto yabo.
Mu gisagara abantu baraniha, Kand’ imitima y’abakomeretse iratakamba: Yamar’ Imana ntiruha ivyibaza.
Abo n’abo mu bagarariza umuco, Ntibazi inzira zawo, Canke ngo bazigumemwo.
Umwicanyi azinduka mu gahuru, akica impahazwa n’ umukene; No mw ijoro amera nk’igisuma.
Ijisho ry’umusambanyi ritega akagoroba, Akavuga, ati Nta wuribunkubite ijisho: Akipfuka mu maso.
Mu mwiza bimba amazu: Ku murango bakīrirwa biyugaranye; Ntibazi umuco.
Bose agatondo‐tondo kabamerera nk’igitūtu c’urupfu, Kuko bamenyereye ubgoba buterwa na co.
Bahehwa vuba n’amazi; Umugabane wabo uravumwe mu gihugu: Ntibakijana inzira ija mu ruzabibu.
Ikigatwa n’ubushuhe bikamura amazi ya shelegi; Ni ko n’i kuzimu hakamanganya abakoze ivyaha.
Inda yamuvyaye izomwibagira; inyo zizomurya ziryoherwe; Ntazokwongera kwibukwa ukundi: Ukugabitanya kuzovunwa nk’ igiti.
Arya umugore w’ingumba atigeze akana, Kandi nta ho agirira neza umupfakazi.
Imana yongera abanyenkomezi kuramba kubg’ ubushobozi bgayo, Bagasubira kuzunzuka bāri bihebuye.
Ibaha kuba amahoro, bakayadibamamwo; Kand’ inyonga zayo izihanze ku nzira zabo.
Bashirwa hejuru: maze hāshira igihe gito bakaba bīgīriye; Mbere bacishwa bugufi, bagakūrwa mu nzira nk’abandi bose, Bakagenywa nk’uburo.
N’ubu namb’ atari ko biri, ni nde yompinyuza ko nd’ umubeshi, Agahindura ubusa amajambo yanje?
Maze Biludadi w’i Shuhi arishura,
at’ Inganji n’igitinyiro n’ ivyayo; Kand’ itanga amahoro ahantu hayo iyo hejuru.
Mbeg’ ingabo zayo zigira igitigiri? Kandi ni nde umuco wayo utarasira?
None rer’ umuntu yoshobora ate kuba umugororotsi imbere y’Imana? Cank’ uwavyawe n’umugore yoshobora ate kuba ūtunganye?
Rāba n’ukwezi ntigufise gukayangana, N’inyenyeri ntizitunganye mu nyonga zayo:
Nanswe umuntu buntu, kand’ ar’ inyo! N’umwana w’umuntu, kand’ ar’ umusiba!
Maze Yobu arishura,
at’ Ewe kuntu uzi gufasha umunyantegenke! N’ingen’ uzi gukiza uw’ amaboko adendebutse!
N’ukuntu ugīra inama ūdafise ubgenge, Ukerekana rwose ubgenge ubg’ ari bgo!
Ayo magambo ugira ng’ uyabariye nde? Kand’ impwemu ikuvugishije n’iya nde?
Abāpfuye bahindira agashitsi Musi y’amazi n’ibiyabamwo.
I kuzimu hambaye ubusa imbere y’Imana, Mu mahonero nta mwambaro hikinzeko.
Yagaranzuye i burārūko ihashinga ku kirēre, Isi iyenetsa ku busa.
Itekera amazi mu bicu vyayo vyibungenze, Kandi ntibitoborwa n’uburemerezi bgayo.
Itwikira intebe yayo, Ikayirenzakw igicu cayo.
Amazi yayashingiye ingabano, Zishika ah’ umuco n’umwiza bigarukira.
Inkingi z’ijuru ziradegezwa, Zumizwa no gukankamira kwayo.
Izīkuruza ikiyaga ububasha bgayo, N’ubgenge bgayo ibutobekeranisha Bgibone.
Mpwemu wayo yēyūra ijuru, Ukuboko kwayo igusogotesha inzoka y’ubukuba.
Erega n’ivyo n’ubusunwa gusa bg’inzira zayo: Kandi n’ivyo twumva kuri yo ni nk’utwongorerano dutoya! Non’ imyasano y’ububasha bgayo ni nde yoshobora kuyitahura?
Maze Yobu yongera kuvuga amajambo yiwe y’ibirāgurāgu,
ati Ndahiye uguhoraho kw’ Imana, ari yo yandīririye urubanza, Ni yo Īshobora vyose, yagiriye nabi ubugingo bganje,
Ubugingo bganje bukidundega, Impwemu z’Imana zikiri mu mazuru yanje,
N’ukuri iminwa yanje ntizovuga ivy’ ukugabitanya, Cank’ ururimi rwanje ngo ruvuge ivy’ ubugunge.
Ntibikabeho yuko nobemerera ngo muvuze ibiroranye; Kugeza aho nzopfira, sinzokwigera mva ku gutungana kwanje.
Ukugororoka kwanje ndakubangirije, nta ho nzokurekura, Umutima wanje ntuzokwigera unyagiriza no ku vy’umusi n’umwe mu yanje yose.
Umwansi wanje n’amere nk’ umunyakibi, Kand’ ūnkūriye hasi n’amere nk’umugabitanyi.
None se ūtubaha Imana agira ivyizigiro ki, Iy’ Imana imuciye, ikamwaka ubugingo bgiwe?
Mbeg’ Imana yokwumva ugutakamba kwiwe, Ivyago iyo bimuteye?
Canke se yohimbarwa n’ Īshobora vyose, Akāma atabaza Imana ibihe vyose?
Reka ndabigishe ivy’ ububasha bg’Imana; Imigabo y’Īshobora vyose sinoyihisha.
Rāba mwebge mwese ubganyu mwaravyiboneye; None se n’iki gitumye muba abatagira ico bamaze na mba?
Eh’ uyu ni wo mugabane umunyakibi aronka ku Mana, Ni yo ngero y’abahahaza, iyo bagererwa n’Īshobora vyose.
Abana biwe ni bagwira, bazogwirira inkota; N’uruvyaro rwiwe ntibazoronka ivyo kurya bibahāza.
Amasigarira yo mu biwe azomirwa n’urupfu, Kand’ abapfakazi babo ntibazobaririra.
Naho yotekeranya amafeza nk’ umukungugu, Akirundaniriza imyambaro nk’ibumba;
Ashobora kuyirundanya, arik’ umugororotsi ni we azoyambara; Na ya mafeza, abatācumuye ni bo bazoyagabangana.
Yiyubakiye inzu nk’iy’ igitangurirwa, Nk’umutara wubatswe n’ umurinzi w’inyoni.
Yiryamira ar’ umutunzi, bigaciraho; Agize ngw arakanura, agasanga atakiriho.
Ibiteye ubgoba bimwisukako nk’isūri, Ikirura kimuhitana mw ijoro.
Umuyaga uturutse i burasirazuba uramutwara, akagīrako; Uramukubeba akava aho yahora.
Mber’ Imana izomurasa ntimuzigurize, Azokwifuza guhunga ngw ave mu maboko yayo.
Abantu bazomwitamba ku muvyimba bakubite amashi ku yandi, Bazomwimyoza arikw arava i we.
N’ukuri har’ inganzo yimbgamw’ ifeza, N’ahantu bakūra izahabu ngo bazivugutire.
Ubutare bukūrwa mw ivu, N’ibuye barivugutira ngo rivemw’ imiringa.
Abantu badōbēra mu mwiza bakawurangiza, Bagashika kw iherezo ry’ urubibe rwawo Basesangura amabuye yo mu mwiza w’umuzitanya no mu gitūtu c’urupfu.
Bimba urwobo rugera kure y’aho abantu baba; Ingenzi zihahita nta co zībaza kuri bo; Bacundeba muri rwo kure y’abantu, bakenena hirya no hino.
Isi ivamw’ ivyo kurya; Arikw i kuzimu muri yo hazīkururwa nk’aho hazīkuruwe n’umuriro.
Mu mabuye yaho harih’ ahantu h’utubuyenge twitwa safiro, Hakaba n’ifu y’izahabu.
Iyo nzira nta gisiga c’amero kiyizi, N’ijisho ry’ikinyakabaka ntiryigeze kuyibona:
N’ibikōko vyihayagiza nta ho vyayikandagiyemwo, Cank’ intambge y’inkazi ngw iyihitemwo.
Baramvura amaboko yabo ku kibuye c’isare; Bubika imisozi bahereye mu mizi yayo.
Basatagura inzira mu bibuye; Amaso yabo yitegereza ikintu cose c’igiciro kinini.
Bagomera imigezi ntidonye; Kandi n’icari gihishijwe bakizana ahabona.
Arik’ ubgenge bgo, buzoboneka hehe? Cank’ ahantu ugutahura kuba ni hehe?
Abantu ntibazi igiciro cabgo, Ntibuboneka mw isi y’abariho.
I bgina haravuga, hati Ntiburi muri jewe; N’ikiyaga kiravuga, kiti Ntibur’ aho ndi.
Ntiburonkeshwa amazahabu, Kandi n’amafeza ntagerwa ku munzane ngw abe igiciro kibuguze.
N’amazahabu yavuye muri Ofiru nta ho yohūza uburiba na bgo, Cank’ utubuyenge twitwa shohamu tw’igiciro kinini, haba n’utwitwa safiro.
Izahabu n’ibirahuri nta ho vyoshobora kugereranywa na bgo; N’ivyacuzwe mw izahabu nziza ntivyobukāba.
