Ivyitwa fezaruka n’ibirahuri ntivyoruha binavugwa, Mber’ igiciro c’ubgenge kirengeye utubuyenge twitwa marijani.
Ivyitwa pitida vyavuye muri Etiyopiya nta ho vyogereranywa na bgo, Kand’ izahabu iramuye nta ho yohūza uburiba na bgo.
None rer’ ubgenge bganduruka he? Kand’ ahantu ugutahura kuba ni hehe?
Ko buhishijwe amaso y’abariho bose, Bukanyegezwa ibiguruka mu kirēre.
Amahonero n’urupfu biravuga, Biti Twumvise impuha zabgo ku matwi gusa.
Imana ni yo izi inzira yabgo, Ni yo izi ahantu buba.
Kuko yitegereza gushitsa ku mpera z’isi, Ikarāba n’ibiri musi y’ijuru vyose.
Hamwe yagera uburemerezi bg’umuyaga, Ikagera amazi mu rugero,
Hamwe yashingira imvura icagezwe, N’umuravyo w’inkuba ikawugerera inzira;
Ni ho yabgitegerereje, irabuserura; Irabushinga, mber’ irabusuzuma.
Maz’ ibgira abantu, Iti Rāba kwubaha Uhoraho ni bgo bgenge, Kandi kuva mu vyaha ni kwo gutahura.
Maze Yobu yongera kuvuga amajambo yiwe y’ibirāgurāgu,
at’ Icompa nkaba nari mmeze nk’uko nari ndi mu mezi yahise, Nko mu misi Imana yanzigamiramwo;
Igihe itara ryayo ryākira hejuru y’umutwe wanje, Umuco wayo ukancisha mu mwiza;
Nkaba nk’uko nari mmeze igihe nari nshitse ubukombe, Hamwe inama y’Imana yar’ ikiri mu rugo rwanje;
Igihe Īshobora vyose yar’ ikiri kumwe nanje, Abana banje bakinkikije;
Ibirenge vyanje bigitonyanga ivuta, Ubgato bgimbge mu gitandara bukinsendanishiriza amavuta ya elayo!
Uko nasohoka, nkaja kw irembo ry’igisagara, Ngaterekesha intebe yanje ahiyaguye,
Imisore yarambona, ikihisha, Abahūmure na bo bakampagurukira bagahagarara;
Abaganwa bagacereza, Bakifata ku munwa.
Ijwi ry’abapfasoni ryarahora, Ururimi rwabo rukamatana n’uruhekenyero.
Uk’ugutwi kwanyumva kwarampezagira, N’ijisho uko ryambona ryambera igishingantahe:
Kuko narokora impahazwa itakamba, Kandi n’impfuvyi itagira gitabara.
Umugorwa yarampezagira, Kandi nanezereza umutima w’umupfakazi.
Nambara ukugororoka, kukansagira, Kuroranya kwanje kwari kumbereye nk’umutamana n’ igitsibo.
Nar’ amaso y’impumyi, Nar’ ibirenge vy’ūcumbagira.
Nari se w’abakene, Natondanuza urubanza rw’ uwo ntazi.
Navunagura imibangabanga y’ umugabitanyi, Nkamushikura iminyago mu menyo yiwe.
Maze naravuga, nti Nzopfira mu rugo rwanje, Nti Nzogwiza imisi yanje ingane n’umusenyi:
Nt’ Imizi yanje ishōreye mu mazi, N’ikime gitonda kw ishami ryanje bukarinda buca:
Nt’ Ubgiza bganje bgama bgiyubura, N’umuheto wanje uhora ar’ umwerasi mu ntoke zanje.
Abantu bāhora bantega amatwi, bakitega ico mvuga, Bagacereza, ngo bumve inama yanje.
Iyo mmaze kuvuga, nta wagira ico asubiza; Amajambo yanje yabatonyangako.
Kandi bānyitega nk’abiteze imvura, Bakāsama cane, nk’abāsamira imvura y’urushana.
Narabatwenza bihebuye, Kand’ umukēra wo mu maso hanje ntibāwuhindura ngo hijirwe.
Nakunda inzira ija aho bari, nkicara nk’umutware, Naba nk’umwami mu ngabo ziwe, Nkaba nk’ūhoza abagandaye.
Ariko none, abo nduta ubukuru ni bo bampinduye agatwengo, Abo nakēngērera ba se, ntonabēgereje n’imbga ziteramira umukuku w’intama zanje.
Non’ inkomezi z’amaboko yabo zommarira iki? Kw ar’ utugoyigoyi tutazoshika mu bigero.
Bazingamitswe n’ugukena n’ inzara, Baguguna imisozi igadutse y’ ubgeranyange.
Basoroma utuboga tumera mu bisaka, Imizi y’igiti c’umurotemu ni yo bagira utwo kurya.
Bāciwe mu bantu; Bahabga induru nk’ibisuma.
Bituma baba mu bikukumushi vyo mu myonga, Mu masenga yo mu misozi no mu bitandara.
Basigaye bābirira mu bisaka nk’inka; Bīryamira hamwe musi y’ ibisuru.
N’abana b’ibipfapfa, mbere n’abana ba ba nyarucari; Bābaye ibicibga mu gihugu.
Maze noneho mpindutse akavyino kabo, Mbere mbaye iciro ry’imigani yabo.
Baranzinutswe, baranyītāngūye, Ntibashishwa no kuncira amate mu maso.
Kukw Imana yabanguruye urutsi rw’umuheto wanje, incisha bugufi; Ni co gituma batigarura imbere yanje.
I buryo bganje hahaguruka imihimbiri, Basunika ibirenge vyanje, Bitegura inzira zo kuntera ngo bandandure.
Inzira yanje barayonona, Basunikiriza ivyago vyanje, Kandi nta wubabuza.
Banziye nk’abaciye mu kirengero kinini: Bānsūmiye bagigimba hakiriko harahomvoka.
Ibiteye ubgoba birampanze, Bakubeba icubahiro canje nk’ umuyaga; Amahirwe yanje akamanganye nk’igicu.
Maze non’ ubugingo bganje bunshongeyemwo; Imisi y’umubabaro irancakiye.
Mw ijoro amagufa yanje yantobekeranirijwemwo, Uburibge buranguguna ntibumpumekera.
Kubg’ inkomezi nyinshi z’ indwara yanje umwambaro wanje urononekaye, Unyumiyeko nk’uk’ umutamana wanje unduma mu rwano.
Yanshiburiye mu kivurugu c’ ivyondo, Mpindutse nk’umukungugu n’umunyota.
Ndagutakambira, ntunyishura; Nahagarara, ukandāba utw’ ininga.
Wampindukiye inkarwe: Ukuboko kwawe kw’inkomezi kurandendereza.
Unteruza umuyaga, ugatuma njanwa na wo; Unnyukangiye mu kirura.
Kuko nzi yuk’ uzonshitsa mu rupfu, Ukanshitsa no mu nzu y’ ihūriro ry’abakiriho bose.
Yamar’ umuntu iyo arikw aratemba ntiyābābiza amaboko? No mu vyago vyiwe ntiyotabaza?
Mbega sinaririra ūjigirijwe? Umutima wanje ntiwababazwa n’umukene?
Naziga amahirwe, hakaza ivyago; Naziga umuco, hakaza umwiza.
Amara yanje aradobangana, nta ho aruhuka; Imisi y’amagorwa inshitseko.
Ngenda ngandaye ntabona izuba: Mpagarara mw ikoraniro, ngatabaza.
Ndi mwene wabo w’imbgebge, Ndi mugenzi w’igisīga citwa imbuni.
Urukoba rwanje rurirabuye, rumvuyeko, N’amagufa yanje ahiye uburimbi.
Ni co gitumye inanga yanje isigaye ar’ agacurantimba, N’umwironge wanje ugahinduka ijwi ry’abarira.
Nasezeranye isezerano n’ amaso yanje; None noshobora nte gushira ijisho ku mwigeme?
Kuk’ umugabane Imana yompa uvuye mw ijuru woba iki? N’inyegu ivuye iyo hejuru Īshobora vyose yompa yoba inki?
Mbega ntiyoba ubugesera bubīkirwa umugabitanyi, N’ivyago bibīkirwa inkozi z’ ibibi?
Mbega yo yo ntiyitegereza inzira zanje, Igaharūra intambuko zanje zose?
Asangwa naragendeye mu binyoma, Ikirenge canje kikihutishwa no kuja kugunga,
Ni ngerwe ku munzane w’ ukuri, Kugira ngw Imana imenye ukugororoka kwanje!
Asangw’ ibirenge vyanje vyarakebeje mu nzira, Umutima wanje ugakurikira amaso yanje, Kand’ asangwa har’ agasembga na kamwe kometse ku biganza vyanje:
Ndakarima, birye uwundi, Mbere n’imirima yo mu ndimiro yanje irandurwe!
Asangw’ umutima wanje warasutswe n’umugore, Nkabunda ku muryango w’ umubanyi wanje:
Umugore wanje aragasēra uwundi, Kand’ akindweko n’abandi.
Kukw ico coba ar’ ishano ritavugwa, Mbere coba ar’ ikibi co guhanirwa mu bacamanza;
Coba ar’ umuriro utongora gushitsa uhoneje, Ugaturira imirima yanje yose.
Asangwa narīrengagije ivy’ umushumba wanje cank’ ivy’ incoreke yanje, Igihe banyitwarako:
None nzobikika nte, igihe Imana izokwisidukira? Noyishura iki, igihe ije kumbazaguza?
Mbeg’ iyandemeye mu nda ya mama si yo yamuremye na we? Iyatubumbiye mu nda s’ imwe?
Asangwa narīmye abagorwa ico bifuza, Canke naratumye amaso y’ abapfakazi akoboka;
Cank’ asangwa narigunganye ivyo kurya vyanje, Impfuvyi ntibikoreko,
Kand’ uhereye mu buto bganje ari jewe nayireze ndi nka se, N’umupfakazi ari jewe namuhagarikiye, nkiva mu nda ya mama;
Kand’ asangwa har’ uwo nabonye yishwe no kubura ico yambara, Cank’ umukene abuze ico yipfuka,
Asangw’ urukenyerero rwiwe rutampezagiye, Kand’ atāsusurukijwe n’ubgoya bg’intama zanje;
Kand’ asangwa narabanguriye ukuboko impfuvyi, Kubgo kugira aho mpininikiye mu rukinja;
Asangwa vyarabaye birtyo, igitugu canje kiragatandukana n’urubeshi, N’ukuboko kwanje gucike gutandukane n’igufa!
Kukw ivyago vyovuye ku Mana vyantera ubgoba, Narashishwa kubg’ igitinyiro cayo.
Asangwa naragize izahabu ivyizigiro vyanje, Nkabarira izahabu nziza, nti Ni wewe nishimiye;
Kand’ asangwa nanejerejwe n’uk’ ubutunzi bganje ari bginshi, Kandi yuk’ ukuboko kwanje kwaronse vyinshi;
Kand’ asangwa naritegereje izuba igihe ryaka, Cank’ ukwezi kugendera mu bgiza bgakwo,
Umutima wanje ugasukwa na vyo mu mpisho, Nkabiha ukuboko kwanje:
Ivyo na vyo vyoba ar’ ikibi co guhanirwa mu bacamanza, Kuko noba nihakanye Imana iri hejuru.
Asangwa naranejerejwe n’uk’ ūnyanka ageshejwe, Canke nkitereshwa hejuru n’ ukw ivyago bimushitseko,
Kand’ ari jewe nari narazitiye akanwa kanje ngo ntigacumure, Ntikamuvume ngo kamwifurize gupfa;
Kand’ asangw’ abo mu rugo rwanje batavuga, Bati Ni nde yobona umuntu n’umwe atāhāgijwe n’inyama yagabura?
Kandi kw ata mushitsi narāje hanze, Arikw ingenzi nama ndayugururira;
Kand’ asangwa naratwikiriye ibicumuro vyanje nka Adamu, Ngahisha ibigabitanyo vyanje mu gikiriza,
Mbitewe no gutinya ishengero mu kigohe, No gutinya kugawa n’iyindi miryango, Bigatuma nihorera, sindenge n’irembo—
Icompa hakagira ūnyumviriza! Ivyo nireguje ndabitereye igikumu: Īshobora vyose n’ inyishure! Kand’ icompa nkabona ibirego vyanditswe n’umwansi wanje!
N’ukuri novyikorera ku rutugu, Nkavyipfundikako nk’igitsibo.
Noyimenyesha igitigiri c’intambuko zanje, Noyishikīra nk’uk’ umuganwa ashikīra umwami.
Asangwa mu bgatsi bganje hatakishwa no kundega, N’ubusize bgaho bukarira;
Kand’ asangwa narariye ivyeze vyaho ata co nishuye, Cank’ asangwa narishe nabi bene ho:
Asangwa vyarabaye birtyo, amahwa arakamera ahobaye ingano, N’ikigunda ahobaye sayiri. Amajambo ya Yobu agarukiye aho.
Nukw abo bagabo ukw ari batatu bareka kwishura Yobu, kuko yibona kw ar’ umugororotsi ubgiwe.
Maz’ uburake bga Elihu mwene Barakeli w’i Buzi, wo mu muryango wa Ramu, buraziriringa: buziriringira Yobu, kuko yīgize umugororotsi kurusha Imana.
Kand’ uburake bgiwe buziriringira na ba bakunzi batatu ba Yobu, kuko batāronse ico bamwishura, yamara bakamuhinyura.
Ariko Elihu yari yarīndiriye kuvugana na Yobu, kuko bāmuruta ubukuru.
Maze Elihu abonye yukw abo batatu babuze icobava mu kanwa ngo bamwishure, uburake bgiwe buraziriringa.
Nuko Elihu mwene Barakeli w’i Buzi aravuga, ati Jewe ndi muto, namwe murakuze cane: Ni co catumye nizitira, sinubahuke kubaserurira ico niyumvira.
Naravuze, nt’ Abo ha mbere ni bo bakwiye kuvuga, Nt’ Abamaze imyaka myinshi ni bo bakwiye kwigisha ubgenge.
Ariko har’ impwemu mu bantu, Kand’ ibihumetswe n’Īshobora vyose bibaha gutahura.
Abakuze si bo banyabgenge bonyene, N’abatāma si bo bamenya imanza gusa.
Ni co gitumye mvuga, nti Ni muntege amatwi, Nanje mbaserurire ico niyumvira.
Rāba, narīndiriye amajambo yanyu, Niteze ibiroranye vyova mu kanwa kanyu, Mukirondera ico mwovuga.
Mbere nababangiye ugutwi, Ariko nta n’umwe muri mwebge yemeje Yobu, Canke ngw amwishure amajambo yiwe.
Mwiyubare, mwoye kuvuga, muti Ni twebge twaronse ubgenge; Imana ni yo yoshobora kumutsinda, s’umuntu.
Si jewe yaroreshejekw amajambo yiwe; Nanje sinomwishura amajambo nk’ayanyu.
Ehe barumiwe, nta co bacishura: Ntibakigira ijambo bavuga.
Mbega nobuzwa n’ukw ata co bavuga, Kuko bahagaze batakigira ico bishura?
Jewe nanje ngira mvuge ivyanje, Ngira nserure ico niyumvira.
Kukw amajambo anyuzuyemwo, Imbere muri jewe umutima uransunika.
Inda yanje imeze nka vino itagira isaganirizo, Nk’imikuza y’insāto misha igira ngw iturike.
Ngira mvuge, kugira ngo ntenzukirwe; Ngira nteranure akanwa, nishure.
Muntunge, mvuge ntarobanuye abantu ku butoni; Sinogira umuntu n’umwe nohema.
Kuko ntazi guhemana; Mbikoze, Umuremyi wanje yonkūraho bidatevye.
Enda rero Yobu, wumve ivyo mvuga, Kand’ utegere amatwi amajambo yanje yose.
Ehe nteranuye akanwa, Ururimi rwanje ruvugiye mu kanwa kanje.
Amajambo yanje agira aserure ukugororoka kw’umutima wanje, Kand’ ivyo nzi iminwa yanje irabivuga ata buryarya.
Mpwemu w’Imana ni we yandemye, Kand’ uguhumeka kw’Īshobora vyose ni kwo kwampaye ubugingo.
Ni wabishobora unyishure, Amajambo yawe uyatumberanirize imbere yanje, uve hasi uhagarare.
Rāba mpwanye nawe imbere y’Imana, Nanje n’uko nabumbge mw ibumba.
Ehe nta gitinyiro mfise co kugutera ubgoba, Cank’ ijunja ng’ untinye.
N’ukuri wavuze numva, Kandi numvise ivyo amajambo yawe avuga;
Ng’ Uratunganye, ngo Nta gicumuro ugira; Ngo Nta rubanza rugutsinze, ngo Nta n’ukugabitanya ugira:
Ariko ngw Imana ikuronderakw inyanduruko, Ikakwiyumvira nk’umwansi wayo;
Ngw ibirenge vyawe ibishira mu mpatane z’ibiti, Ikitegereza inzira zawe zose.
Reka nkwishure: mur’ ivyo ntugororotse; Kukw Imana irengeye abantu.
N’iki gituma uyihāririza? Kukw ata co yirirwa isobanura mu vyayo.
Kukw Imana, har’ ah’ ivuga mu buryo bumwe, Har’ ah’ ivuga mu bundi, nah’ umuntu atobibabara.
Mu nzozi, mw iravūta ryo mw ijoro, Igihe itiro ryinshi ritwaye abantu, Bisinziriye ku mariri yabo;
Ni ho izibūra amatwi y’abantu, Ikabatēza ubgoba ivyo ibabūrira,
Kugira ngw igaburuze umuntu imigabo yiwe, Imurinde ubgibone.
Umutima wiwe iwukiza rwa rwobo, N’ubugingo bgiwe ngo ntibgicwe n’inkota.
Kandi har’ ah’ ahanwa n’ uburibge ari ku buriri bgiwe, Akagira uburibge budahorerekeza mu magufa yiwe:
Bigatuma umutima wiwe uhura ivyo kurya, Akazinukwa ibiryoshe.
Umubiri wiwe urananuka, ukayongayonga; N’amagufa yiwe atāboneka agasohoka.
Mber’ umutima wiwe ukaba wēgereye rwa rwobo, N’ubugingo bgiwe bukēgēra intumwa z’urupfu.
Namba yoba kumwe n’umumarayika, Ari we mushikirwa umwe mu gihumbi, Wo kumenyesha umuntu ukw akwiye kugenza;
Ni ho amugirira imbabazi, Ati Murekure, yoye kumanuka ngw aje muri rwa rwobo; Mbonye ikimucungura.
Umubiri wiwe uzotonyanga itōto kurusha uw’ umwana; Azokwiyubura, abe nko mu misi yo mu buto bgiwe.
Asenga Imana, na yo ikamuhāngaza, Bituma arāba mu nyonga hayo anezerewe: Kand’ ikagarukanira umuntu ukugororoka kwiwe.
Aririmbira imbere y’abantu, Ati Naracumuye, ngoreka ibiroranye, Ariko nta co vyammariye.
Imana yacunguye umutima wanje ngo ntuje muri rwa rwobo, Kand’ ubugingo bganje buzokwitegereza umuco.
Rāba, ivyo vyose Imana ni yo ibikora, Igenza irtyo umuntu kabiri, mbere n’ubugira gatatu,
Kugira ngw igarukane umutima wiwe ngo ntuje muri rwa rwobo, Abone kumurikirwa n’umuco w’ubugingo.
Enda bishirek’ umutima, Yobu we, untege amatwi: Ucereze, nanje mvuge.
Asangw’ uri n’ico uvuga, unyishure: Vuga, kuko nifuza k’uboneka k’ugororotse.
Namb’ ata kiriho, untege amatwi: Ucereze, nanje ngucishe ubgenge.
Maze Elihu yongera kuvuga,
ati Ni mwumve amajambo yanje, yemwe banyabgenge; Muntege ugutwi, yemwe abafise ubgenge.
Kuk’ ugutwi kurobanura amajambo Nk’ukw akanwa kumviriza ivyo kurya.
Twihitiremw’ igitunganye, Twebge ubgacu twimenyere iciza ic’ ari co.
Kuko Yobu avuga, ngo N’ umugororotsi, Kandi ngw Imana yamurīrīriye urubanza:
Ngo Nah’ ari n’urubanza, abarwa nk’umubeshi; Ng’ Uruguma rwiwe ntirukivūrika, ngo Nah’ atarikw igicumuro.
Mbega ni nde muntu yomera nka Yobu, Agotomera ibirogotano nk’ amazi?
Agenda yifatanije n’abakora ivy’ ukugabitanya, Kand’ akagendana n’abanyakibi.
Kuko yavuze, ati Nta co bimariye umuntu Kunezerezwa n’Imana.
Nuko rero ni munyumvirize, mwebge bantu bazi gutahura: Biragahera kw Imana yokora ivyaha, Īshobora vyose ko yokora ivy’ ukugabitanya.
Kuk’ umuntu izomusubiriza mu nkōko ibihwanye n’ igikorwa ciwe, Izotuma umuntu wese abona ibihwanye n’ingeso ziwe.
Eka n’ivy’ ukuri, Imana nta ho yokora icaha, Īshobora vyose nta ho yogoreka imanza.
Ni nde yayiragije isi? Ni nde yayizigamishije ibiri kuri yo vyose?
Yokwisubizako Mpwemu wayo, Ikagarukana n’uguhumeka kwayo,
Ivyaremwe vyose vyohonera rimwe, Abantu na bo bagasubira mu mukungugu.
None rero namb’ ugize ubgenge, ni wumve ibi: Utegere amatwi amajambo yanje.
Mbeg’ uwanka guca iziroranye yoshobora kuganza? Mbega wotsindisha Īgororotse ari yo Nyenkomezi?
None birabereye kubarira umwami, ngo Nta co umaze? Canke kubarira abaganwa, uti Muri babi?
None ntibirushirije kuba ibitabereye kubibarira Īdatinya abaganwa ku kigohe, Ntikunde umutunzi kumurutisha umworo, Kuko bose ar’ igikorwa c’ intoke zayo?
Bapfa mu kanya isase, no mu gicugu n’uko, Bafatwa n’agatengo bakagenda akagīrīre, N’abahizi bakūrwaho, ata wubakozeko.
Kukw inyonga zayo ziri ku nzira z’umuntu, Kandi yitegereza urugendo rwiwe rwose.
Nta mwiza cank’ igitūtu c’ urupfu Ah’ abakora ivy’ ukugabitanya boshobora kwinyegeza.
Kukw ata gihe Imana yashingiye umuntu Co kurenguka imbere yayo mu manza.
Ivunagura abahizi mu buryo budaserangurika, Igashira abandi mu gishingo cabo.
Kukw izi ibikorwa vyabo, Ibacurikiranya mw ijoro, bagafyonyoka.
Ibakubita nk’abanyakibi nyene, Ibigirira ahibonekeza, abandi barorēra;
Kuko bākikamye, bakayiva inyuma, Bakanka gushira umutima ku nzira zayo.
Bagatuma ugutaka kw’abagorwa kuyishikako, Ikumva ugutaka kw’impahazwa.
Iy’ itanze impore, ni nde yoyitsindisha? Iy’ itwikiriye mu nyonga hayo, ni nde yoshobora kuyibona? Ukw izigama ihanga ryose, ni kw izigama n’umuntu umwe;
Kugira ng’ ūtubaha Imana ntaje ku ngoma, Hoye kugira abatsinda abantu mu mitego.
Mbega har’ uwabariye Imana, Ati Narahanwe, sinzosubira gucumura;
At’ Ico ntabona ukinyigishe: Ati Namba naragabitanije sinzosubīra?
Mbeg’ ingero yayo uyankishwa n’ukw idakoze ico ugomba? Kukw ari wewe ukwiye guhitamwo, si jewe: Nuko vuga ico uzi.
Abantu bazi gutahura, Mbere n’umuntu wese w’ umunyabgenge anyumva, bazombgira,
Bati Yobu avuga ico atazi, Kand’ amagambo yiwe nta bgenge burimwo.
Icompa Yobu akageragezwa, agashitsa kw iherezo, Kubgo kwishura kwiwe nk’ abanyakibi.
Kukw agereka ubugarariji ku caha ciwe, Agakubita amashi ku yandi hagati muri twebge, Agasegenyura amagambo yo kurwanya Imana.
Nuko Elihu akomeza amajambo yiwe,
ati Mbeg’ ugira ngw ivyo uvuga ni ko, Ugira ng’ ukugororoka kwawe kuruta ukw’ Imana?
K’uvuga, ngo Vyokumarira iki? Kandi ng’ Uzoronka inyungu ki, ziruta izo uba warabonye ukoze ivyaha?
Jewe ngira nkwishure, Mwe na bagenzi bawe.
Itegereze mw ijuru urābe; Kand’ urābe iyo hejuru, ingene hagusumba.
Asangwa warakoze icaha, uyitwaye iki? Kand’ ibicumuro vyawe namba vyaragwiriye, uyigize iki?
Asangw’ ur’ umugororotsi, uyihaye iki? Canke se ico ironse mu kuboko kwawe n’iki?
Mugabo ibibi vyawe vyobabaza umuntu ameze nkawe; N’ubugororotsi bgawe uwo bgogirira ikimazi n’umwana w’umuntu gusa.
Batakishwa n’agahahazo kenshi, Batakambishwa no kubabazwa n’amaboko y’abanyenkomezi.
Ariko nta wuvuga, at’ Imana Umuremyi wanje iri hehe, Kand’ ari yo iduha indirimbo mw ijoro,
Ikatwigisha gusumba ibikōko vyo mw isi, Ikaduha ubgenge gusumba ibiguruka mu kirēre?
Nuko barataka, ariko nta wugira ico abishura, Bitewe n’ubgibone bg’abantu babi.
Ereg’ Imana ntiyokwumva amagambo y’ubuhuhuta, Īshobora vyose ntiyonayababara.
None ntirushirije kutumva, iy’ uvuga ngo Ntuyibona, Ng’ Urubanza rwawe rur’ imbere yayo, ng’ Urayirorereye?
Ariko noneho, uburake bgayo ko butātumye ihana, Ntinababare cane ivy’ amanyama,
Ni co catumye Yobu ateranurira akanwa kuvuga amagambo y’ubuhuhuta, Agasegenyura amagambo ata co azi.
Elihu ashishikara kuja imbere,
ati Nyihanganira gato, nkwereke; Kuko ngifise bimwe mvuga ku ruhande rw’Imana.
Ndahēmbēra akenge, naho kava kure, Nature ingen’ Umuremyi wanje agororoka.
N’ukuri ivyo mvuga s’ibinyoma: Ūfise ubgenge bushitse ari kumwe nawe.
Rāba, Imana n’inyabushobozi, kandi ntigira uwo ikēngēra n’umwe: N’inyabushobozi mu nkomezi z’ubgenge.
Ntizigama ubugingo bg’abanyakibi, Impahazwa izicira imanza zibereye.
Nta ho ikūra inyonga zayo ku bagororotsi, Arikw ibicarika hamwe n’ abami ku ntebe zabo Gushitsa ibihe bidashira, bagashirwa hejuru.
Kand’ iyo baboheshejwe iminyororo, Bagashirwa mu ngoyi z’umubabaro;
Ibamenyesha ibikorwa vyabo, N’ibicumuro vyabo, yuko bābikoreshejwe n’ubgibone.
Kand’ izibūra amatwi yabo ngo bumve inyigisho, Ikabīhanikiriza ngo bagaruke bave mu bigabitanyo.
Ni bayumvira, bakayisaba, Bazomara imisi yabo baguwe neza, N’imyaka yabo bahimbawe.
Ariko ni batayumvira, bazotikizwa n’inkota, Bazopfa batāmenye ubgenge.
Kand’ abatubaha Imana mu mitima yabo bāmana umwikomo: Iyo ibaboshe ntibaruha bayitakambira.
Bapfa bakenyutse, Kand’ ubugingo bgabo bugeserana n’abanduye.
Ikirisha impahazwa uguhahazwa kwazo, Kand’ iziburisha amatwi yazo ukubabazwa kwazo.
N’ukuri iba yaragukūye mu magorwa, Ikagushira ahantu hāgutse, hatari mu mbombane; Kand’ ibiterekeranijwe ku meza yawe biba vyuzuye ibinure.
Arik’ urubanza rucirwa abanyavyaha rugushitseko kand’ ugeze: Urubanza rw’ukuri uciriwe ruragushikiriye.
Wirinde, ishavu ryawe ntirihave rigutera kurogota, Kand’ ubginshi bg’incungu ntibugukebanure.
Mbeg’ ugutakamba kwawe har’ ico kwokumarira ngo ntubone ivyago, Cank’ ubushobozi bg’inkomezi zawe?
Ntukifuze ijoro, Igihe amahanga acibga akava ahantu hayo.
Witonde, woye gushira umutima ku vy’ukugabitanya: Kuk’ umenga ari vyo wahisemwo bikakurutira kubabazwa.
Rāba Imana ikora ibihambaye mu bushobozi bgayo: Umwigisha ahwanye na yo ni nde?
Ni nde yayigereye inzira icamwo? Canke ni nde yohangara kuyibarira, ati Wakoze ibitaroranye?
Ibuka gutazira ibikorwa vyayo, Ivyo abantu bahora baririmba.
Abantu bose bahora babirāba, Umuntu akavyitegereza ari kure yavyo.
Rāba Imana irahambaye, natwe ntituyizi; Igitigiri c’imyaka yayo ntigiserangurika.
Kukw idūza udutonyanga tw’ ikiduhu, Ikaduhindura ibicu bikagwisha imvura.
Ijuru rikayijogotereza, Ikagwa ku bantu benshi.
Mbega har’ uwoshobora gutahura ingen’ ibicu bikwiragira, Canke ngw atahure imituragaro iva mw ihema ry’ Imana?
Ikwiragiza imiravyo impande zayo zose; Kand’ itwikira hasi muri nyina w’ikiyaga.
Kukw ivyo ari vyo ikoresha mu gucira amateka amahanga, Ikabizanisha ivyo kurya vy’ umurengera.
Yorosa intoke zayo umuravyo, Ikawubarira kugema ico ishinze.
Imituragaro y’inkuba imenyekanisha ivyayo, Inka na zo zikumva kw ikirura kije.
Ivyo bihindisha agashitsi umutima wanje, Ukamvamwo.
Ni mwumve yemwe, ni mwumvirize ukwivuga kw’ijwi ryayo, N’ukuririkiza kuva mu kanwa kayo.
Igukwiza musi y’ijuru hose, N’imiravyo yayo ikayishitsa ku mpera z’isi.
Hanyuma y’ivyo ijwi ryayo rirahinda, Igaturagarisha ijwi ry’icubahiro cayo: Ntirinda kuziganya imiravyo, ijwi ryayo rica ryumvikana.
Imana ituragarisha ijwi ryayo bitangaje; Ikora ibikomeye tudashobora gutahura.
Kukw ibarira shelegi, iti Gwa kw isi; Ikabarira n’imvura y’umuvuvu, N’iy’ isegenya, iti Ni mukomere.
Yugarana abantu bose, Kugira ngw abo yaremye bose babimenye.
Ico gihe ibikōko binyegera mu bgihisho, Bikaguma mu masenga yavyo.
Mu birēre vy’i bumanuko hava ikirura, N’imbeho ikava i burārūko.
Urubura ruzanwa n’impwemu zihumetswe n’Imana, Maz’ amazi adengereye agafatana.
Mber’ ibicu bitwaye intunda ibiremereza amazi; Ibicu bisanzaza imiravyo yayo.
Bikuba iserere nk’ukw igomba, Kugira ngo bikore ico ibigeze cose, Biri hejuru y’isi ibakw abantu:
Ni yo ibirungika, ari bga nkoni ihanisha igihugu cayo, Cank’ ar’ uguhesha umugisha.
Umve ibi, yewe Yobu: Hagarara, witegereze ibikorwa vy’Imana bitangaje.
Mbeg’ urazi ingen’ Imana ibigera, N’ingen’ ibarira umuravyo w’igicu cayo kuravya?
Cank’ urazi ingen’ ibicu bishigikiwe? Urazi ibikorwa bitangaje vy’ Iyizi ubgenge bgose?
Cank’ imyambaro yawe igituma isusuruka, Igihe isi icereje kubg’ umuyaga uva i bumanuko?
Mbega woshobora kwaganura ijuru ufatanije na yo, Kandi rikomeye nk’icirore cavugutiwe mu nkero?
Enda twigishe ico twoyibarira; Kuko tubuzwa n’umwiza gutunganya amajambo yacu.
Mbega har’ uwoyibarira ko ngomba kugira ico mvuga? None har’ umuntu yokwifuza kumirwa miyonzwa?
Kandi n’ubu abantu ntibashobora guhanga amaso umuco ukayanganira mw ijuru, Iy’ umuyaga uhise wēyūye ibicu.
I burārūko hava ubgiza bukayangana nk’izahabu; Imana yambaye igitinyiro giteye ubgoba.
Īshobora vyose nta ho twoshobora kuyiserangura: ifise ububasha bunyomoje; Kand’ ica imanza zibereye, igira ukugororoka kwinshi: Nta ho idendereza.
Ni co gituma abantu bayubaha; Nta ho ishira umutima ku muntu n’umwe yīgize umunyabgenge.
Maz’ Uhoraho yishurira Yobu mu gashururu,
at’ Uyo ni nde azimanganya inama Mu magambo atarimw’ ubgenge?
Enda kenyera magabo! Kuko ngira nkubaze, nawe uheze unyishure.
Mbega wewe wari hehe, igihe nashirah’ amatanguriro y’ isi? Bivuge, namb’ ufise ubgenge.
Ni nde yatamvye amatambge yayo, namb’ ubizi? Canke ni nde yayigeresheje umugozi?
Ibinogo vy’inkingi zayo vyimbururiwe mu ki? Canke ni nde yashizeh’ ibuye rigumya imfuruka,
Igihe inyenyeri zo mu gaturuturu zāririmbira hamwe, N’abana b’Imana bose bagasēsereza impundu?
Ni nde yugarije ikiyaga inzugi, Igihe cafyiruka nk’ikivuye mu nda?
Igihe nagira ibicu imyambaro yaco, Nkakizingirak’ umwiza w’ umuzitanya nk’impuzu y’ uruyoya,
Nkagishingira akarimbi, Nkagishirirah’ ibihindizo n’ inzugi,
Nkavuga, nti Garukira aha, ntuharēngāne: Nt’ Aha ni ho imipfunda yawe yīshira hejuru izogarukira?
Mbeg’ aho wabereye, har’ aho wigeze kugera ko busambura, Ukarangira umutwenzi ahantu uhēra,
Ngo na wo ufate imikugiro y’isi, Uyikunkumuremw’ abanyakibi?
Isi ica irahinduka, nk’ukw ikibumbano giciye amagarwe kimera; Vyose bikaja ahabona nk’ ivyambaye.
Kand’ abanyakibi bakwa umuco wabo, N’ukuboko kubanguwe kuravunika.
Mbega warashitse mu masōko y’ikiyaga? Canke waragendagenze ahigobetse i bgina bgaco?
Har’ aho weretswe amarembo y’urupfu? Cank’ amarembo y’igitūtu c’ urupfu har’ aho wigeze kuyabona?
Mbega waratahuye ubgaguke bg’isi? Bivuge, namb’ ubizi vyose.
Inzira ija i wabo w’umuco iri hehe? N’umwiza na wo ah’ uba ni hehe,
Kugira ng’ ubisubize aho bihānira imbibe, Kandi ng’ umenye inzira zija ku nzu zavyo?
Ereg’ urabizi, kuko wari waravutse ico gihe, N’igitigiri c’imisi yawe kikaba cinshi!
Har’ aho wigeze gushika mu bubīko bga shelegi? Cank’ urābona ububīko bg’ urubura,
Urwo nabīkiye igihe co kuzana amagorwa, Nkarubīkira umusi w’intambara no kurwana?
Inzira ijana ah’ ibishwarara vy’umuco bitangurira n’ iyihe? Cank’ inzira ijana ah’ umuyaga w’i burasirazuba uturuka, mu k’usāba kw isi?
Ni nde yaciriye isegenya imigende imanukana, Canke yaciriye umuravyo w’ inkuba inzira;
Kugira ngw arekurire imvura mu gihugu kitagiramw’ abantu, N’ubugaragwa butarimw’ umuntu n’umwe;
Ngw ahēmbūre ahantu h’ uruharabuga hagadutse, Ngw ahameze ubgatsi butotahaye.
Mbeg’ imvura iri na se? Canke ni nde yavyaye udutonyanga tw’ikime?
Urubura rwavuye mu nda ya nde? N’urume rw’igikonyozi ruva mw ijuru ni nde yarugīriye ku rwahi?
Amazi aravura, agacika nk’ ibuye, Amazi yo hejuru y’idamba agafatana.
Mbega woshobora guhambira hamwe akarundo k’inyenyeri zitwa Kilimiya, Canke kubohora ingoyi z’ izitwa Oriyoni?
Woshobora kurōngōra za Mazaroti mu gihe cazo? Canke woyobora izitwa Arukuturo n’abana bazo?
Mbeg’ urazi ivyagezwe biganza ijuru? Woshobora gushinga uko riganza isi?
Woshobora gushira ijwi hejuru ngo rishikīre ibicu, Kugira ngw amazi y’isegenya akwitabe?
Woshobora gutuma imiravyo, ikagenda, Cank’ ikakwitaba, iti Sabge?
Ni nde yashize ubgenge mu mutima w’umuntu? Canke mu mushaha wiwe ni nde yahashize ugutahura?
Ni nde yogira ubgenge bgomushoboza guharūra ibicu? Canke ni nde yoshobora gucuranura amazi yo mu mibindi yo mw ijuru,
Igihe umukungugu uhinduka ivyondo, Ibinonko bikamatana hamwe?
Mbega woshobora guhīgira ingore y’intambge? Canke wohāza imigunza y’ intambge,
Igihe ziryamye mu masenga yazo, N’igihe zibunze mw ishamba ziteze ico zifata?
Ni nde aronderera igikōna ivyo kurya, Igihe ivyana vyaco bitakambira Imana, Biyererezwa no kubura ico birya?
Mbeg’ impene z’ibinyeshamba ziba mu bitandara urazi igihe zivyarira? Canke woshobora kuranga igihe impongokazi zivyarira?
Woshobora kurīmbūra amezi zimara? Canke se womenya igihe zivyarira?
Ziritunatuna, zikavyara abana bazo, Ukwērēra kwazo kugashira.
Abana bazo barashisha, bagakurira mu gahinga; Bahwewe bakīgīra ukwabo, ntibazigarukeko.
Ni nde yarekuye indogoba z’ ibinyeshamba ngo zigende aho zigomba? Canke ni nde yazizituye ku biziriko?
Izo nahinduriye ubugaragwa ngo bube inzu yazo, N’igihugu c’umunyu ngo kibe ahantu ziba.
Zitwenga urwamo rwo mu gisagara, Kandi ntizīgera zumva gukankamirwa n’ūziyoboye.
Ku misozi ni ho zigendagenda zirisha, Zikarondera udutohera twose tw’ubgatsi.
Mbeg’ imbogo yokwemera kugukorera? Canke yotahukira ku gicaniro cawe?
Canke woshobora kuyambika umugozi ngw ikurimire ikivi? Canke se yogenda irakubiturura inyuma yawe mu myonga?
Mbega woyizigira kukw inkomezi zayo ari nyinshi? Canke woyisigarana igikorwa cawe?
Woyishimira ko yokwegeranya ivyo wejeje ikabizana i muhira, Ikabirunda ku mbuga yawe?
Igisīga citwa imbuni gikungutana amababa yaco kwiteragura; Ariko mbeg’ amababa yaco n’ amoya yaco bigira neza?
Kuko kirekera amagi yaco hasi, Agashuhira mu mukungugu,
Kikibagira kw ikirenge coshobora kuyafyonyagura, Canke kw igikōko coshobora kuyakandagira.
Kirenga ivyana vyaco, nk’ ibitar’ ivyaco; Naho caruhiye ubusa ntikibibabara;
Kukw Imana yacimye ubgenge, Ntigihe ingabire yo kumenya.
Iyo kivudutse ciruka, Gikēngēra ifarasi n’ūyigenderako.
Mbega ni wewe wahaye ifarasi inkomezi zayo? Canke ni wewe wambitse izosi ryayo umugāra uhungabana?
Ni wewe wayihaye gusimba nk’inzige? Erega gufuha kw’amanyama kwayo guteye ubgoba.
Iy’ iri mu kiyaya irakoba, igahimbarwa n’inkomezi zayo; Ikaja gutega ingabo.
Itwenga ubgoba, ntiranduka umutima, Nta ho ikimirana ngw ihunge inkota.
Umutana ugenda ujegera kuri yo, Bo n’icumu ry’intēga rikayangana n’agakōbero.
Amakare yayo n’uburake bituma itemaguza imisozi, Kand’ iyo yumvise ijwi ry’ inzamba ntinatenyenya.
Uko yumvise inzamba kwose iravuga, iti Ha ha ha ha! Kand’ ihemba intambara ikiri kure, N’uguhinda kw’abagabisha n’ akāyaga.
Mbeg’ ubgenge bgawe ni bgo butuma agaca kaguruka, Iyo gashānje amababa yako aherekeye i bumanuko?
Mbeg’ ibgirizwa ryawe ni ryo rituma ikinyakabaka canikiza hejuru, Canke kikārika icāri caco hejuru kure?
Kiba mu bitandara, kikārikaho, No ku karungerunge kavyo, no mu masenga yavyo.
Kikir’ aho, gituma akajisho kirondera ico cofata; Amaso yaco akakibona kiri kure.
Ivyana vyaco na vyo binunuza amaraso; Kand’ ah’ imivyimba iri hose, ni ho kija.
Uhoraho yongera kubaza Yobu,
ati Mbeg’ umunyempāri yohāririza Īshobora vyose? Ūhāririza Imana, ni yishure!
Maze Yobu yishura Uhoraho,
ati Rāba ndi nta kimazi: nokwishura iki? Nifashe ku munwa.
Mvuze rimwe, ariko singisubīra; Mbere ni kabiri, arikw aho ni ho ngarukiye.
Maz’ Uhoraho yishurira Yobu mu gashururu,
at’ Enda kenyera magabo! Ngira nkubaze, nawe uheze unyishure.
Mbega woshingūra urwo nashinze? Wompenurirakw ibitari vyo kugira ng’ ubone urubanza?
Canke se, unganya amaboko n’Imana? Woshobora guturagarisha ijwi nka yo?
Enda ni wisakare ubgiza n’ ubukuru, Wambare icubahiro n’igitinyiro!
Sendereza uburake bgawe busebereye, Kandi witegereze umwibone wese, umucishe bugufi.
Witegereze umwibone wese, umusubize hasi, Kand’ ufyonyorere abanyakibi aho bari.
Ubashire mu mukungugu bose hamwe, Upfukire mu maso habo ahantu hatabona.
Ni ho nanje nzokwemera Yuk’ ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo kwoshobora kugukiza.
Enda ni witegereze imvubu, iyo naremye nk’uko nakuremye; Irisha ubgatsi nk’inka.
Ehe rāba, inkomezi zayo ziri mu masohoro yayo, N’ububasha bgayo buri mu mitsi yo mu nda.
Izungagiza umurizo wayo udadaye nk’igiti c’isederi; Imitsi yo mu matako yayo irasobekeranye.
Amagufa yayo ameze nk’imiheha y’imiringa; Ingingo zayo zimeze nk’ibihindizo vy’ivyuma.
Mu vyaremwe n’Imana ni yo gakomeye; Iyayiremye ni yo yonyene yoshobora kuyishikiriza inkota.
N’ukuri imisozi iyimereza ivyo kurya, Ah’ ibikōko vyose vyo mw ishamba bikinira.
Yiryamira musi y’ibiti vy’ intunda, Mu bgihisho bgo mu marenga no mu rufunzo.
Ibiti vy’intunda biyikwiza igitūtu; Ibiti bimeze i ruhande y’ umugezi birayikikiza.
Rāba, iy’ uruzi rwigize akagabo ntiruha ihinda agashitsi; Naho Yorodani rwoseberera ikaruhūhira ku munwa, ntibigira ikindi.
Mbega har’ uwoyifata iri maso, Cank’ akayifatisha urusenga ngw ayitobore izuru?
Mbeg’ ingona woshobora kuyirobesha igera? Canke wofatisha ururimi rwayo umugozi?
Woshobora kuyicisha umugozi w’umuhotora mu zuru? Canke wotoboza umubangabanga wayo uruhindu?
Mbega yokwisaba mu majambo menshi, Canke yokubarira ikarambarara?
Mbega yosezerana nawe, Ng’ uyisabishe ikubere umushumba imisi yose?
Woyikinisha nk’ūkinisha inyoni? Mbega woyizirika ngw abanyakigo bagukorera bayikinishe?
Mbeg’ igihari c’abarovyi coyidandaza? Coyikwiragiza mu bahanjuzi?
Mbeg’ urusāto rwayo worushingagirakw imyampi y’ ingobe, Cank’ umutwe wayo kw amacumu yica amafi?
Pfa kuyishirak’ ukuboko gusa! Uze wame wibuka intambara, ntuze wongere.
Eh’ ivyizigiro vyo kuyifata nta vyo: Mbeg’ umuntu ntiyogwishwa igihūmura n’ukw ayirāvye gusa?
Nta wogira ubuhizi bgotuma ahangara kuyikakaza: Nuko rero jewe ni nde yoshobora kumpagarara imbere?
Ni nde yabanje kugira ico ampa ngo ndamwishure? Ibiri musi y’ijuru vyose iyo riva rikagera n’ivyanje.
Ingona sinoreka kuvuga amaguru yayo, Cank’ ububasha bg’inkomezi zayo, cank’ ubgiza bg’umutumba wayo.
Ni nde yoshobora kuyikūrak’ umwambaro w’inyuma? Ni nde yokwishira hagati mu majigo yayo?
Ni nde yoshobora kuyasamika akanwa? Gutera akōba gukikije amenyo yayo.
Ibigaragamba vyayo vy’inkomezi ni vyo igenda yishinzako; Bigerekeranye hamwe nk’ ivyamatanijwe rwose.
Uko kimwe gifatanye n’ikindi Bituma ata muyaga ushobora kubicamwo.
Biramatanye kimwe ku kindi, Biromekanye uburyo bitoshoboka gutandukanywa.
Kwasamura kwayo guca ibibatsi; Amaso yayo asa n’ugutambika kw’umutwenzi.
Mu kanwa kayo havamw’ imuri zaka, Hagatarukamw’ ibisase vy’ umuriro.
Mu mazuru yayo hapfundukamw’ umwotsi, Nk’uw’ inkono ibiragira cank’ uw’ urukangaga rwaka.
Impwemu zayo zidomeka amakara, Kandi mu kanwa kayo havamw’ ibirimi vy’umuriro.
Mw izosi ryayo habamw’ inkomezi; Gutera akōba kwayo kuyihamiriza imbere.
Inyama zo ku mubiri wayo ziramatanye: Ziyimaseko, ntizishobora gutentema.
Umutima wayo ukomeye nk’ ibuye: Mber’ ukomeye nk’urusyo.
Iyo yiburutse abahizi bahinda agashitsi, Ubgoba bukabasarisha.
N’uworamuka ayirwanishije inkota nta co vyomara: N’iyo ryoba icumu cank’ umugenyuzi cank’ umwampi w’ubukera.
Ivyuma ibigereranya n’ivyatsi, N’imiringa nk’ibiti bibongeye.
Umwampi ntushobora gutuma ihunga; Amabuye atewe n’umugozi ayihindukira nk’ibishingwe.
Ubuhiri ibugereranya n’ibishingwe nyene: Itwenga imivuguvugu y’icumu.
Mu nda hayo hameze nk’injo zikarishe; Ah’ iciye mu vyondo ihasiga imikuku nk’ahaciye umusekuzo w’amenyo.
Isebagiza mw idamba nk’ inkono ibiragira, Itagatisha ikiyaga nk’amavuta yo kwīsīga.
Inyuma yayo ihasiga inzira ikayangana; Womenga mw idamba hasheshe uruyenzi.
Nta kindi gihwanye na yo kiri kw isi, Yo yaremwe ar’ inshirabgoba.
Irābana agakēngērwe ibishizwe hejuru vyose; Ni yo mwami w’ibinyabgibone vyose.
Maze Yobu yishura Uhoraho,
ati Nzi yuk’ ushobora vyose, Kandi kw ata gishobora kubuza imigabo yawe.
Uyo ni nde azimanganya inama ata bgenge agira? Erega ni co catumye mvuga ivyo ntatahuye, Nkavuga ibitangaza bindengeye ntazi.
None ndakwinginze ni wumve, nanje mvuge: Ngira nkubaze, nawe umbarire.
Nari narumvishije ivyawe ugutwi, Ariko noneh’ ijisho ryanje rirakwiboneye.
Ni co kinteye kwizinukwa, nkihana Nigaragura mu mukungugu no mu munyota.

Nuk’ Uhoraho amaze kubgira Yobu ayo majambo, Uhoraho abarira Elifazi w’i Temani, at’ Uburake bganje burakuziriringiye, mwe na bagenzi bawe bompi: kuko mutamvuzekw ibiroranye, nk’uk’ umusavyi wanje Yobu yagize.

None rero ni mwijanire amashūri ndwi n’impfizi z’intama ndwi, muje ku musavyi wanje Yobu, mwitangire ibimazi vyoswa; kand’ umusavyi wanje Yobu azobasabira, kukw ari we nzokwemera, kugira ngo noye kubagirira nk’uk’ ubupfu bganyu bumeze; kuko mutamvuzekw ibiroranye, nk’uk’ umusavyi wanje Yobu yagize.
Nuko Elifazi w’i Temani na Biludadi w’i Shuhi na Zofari w’i Nayama baragenda, bagira nk’uk’ Uhoraho yababariye: maz’ Uhoraho yumvira ugusenga kwa Yobu.
Yobu agisengera bagenzi biwe, Uhoraho amukūrak’ uburushwa bgiwe, amushumbusha ibingana n’ivyo yar’ afise ibihetangabo kabiri.

Maz’ abo bavukana bose baraza, na bashiki biwe bose, n’abāri bāzinanyi na we bose ubga mbere, basangirira na we mu nzu yiwe; baje kumugarukirako no kumwirura kubg’ ivyago vyose Uhoraho yari yaramutēje; umuntu wese amuha ihera ryitwa kesita n’impeta y’ izahabu.
Nuk’ Uhoraho aha Yobu umugisha mu gihe c’amaheruka kuruta ica mbere: aronka intama ibihumbi cumi na bine, n’ ingamiya ibihumbi bitandatu, n’ inka zirima ibihumbi bibiri, n’ indogoba zivyara igihumbi.
Kand’ avyara n’abahungu ndwi n’abakobga batatu.
Umukobga wa mbere amwita Yemima; uw’ ubuheta amwita Keziya; uwa gatatu amwita Kereni‐hapuki.
Kandi mu gihugu cose nta bigeme bāri bahwanije akaranga n’ abakobga ba Yobu: nuko se abaraga hamwe na basaza babo.
Hanyuma yaho, Yobu amara imyaka ijana na mirongwine, abona abana biwe n’abuzukuru biwe, gushitsa no ku buzukururuza.
Nuko Yobu apfa yīsāziye, ageze mu zabukuru.
Hahirwa umuntu atagendera mu nama z’ababi, Adahagarara mu nzira y’abanyavyaha, Aticarana n’abacokoranyi.
Arikw ibimuhimbara biri mu vyagezwe vy’Uhoraho, Kand’ ivyagezwe vyiwe ni vyo ashirak’ umutima ku murango no mw ijoro.
Azoba nk’igiti gitewe hafi y’ imigezi y’amazi, Cama igihe caco, Ibibabi vyaco ntivyuma: Ic’ azokora cose kizomubera ko.
Ababi ntibamera bartyo: Ariko baba nk’umuguruka utwarwa n’umuyaga.
Ni co gituma ababi batazoshobora guhagarara ku musi w’amateka, Cank’ abanyavyaha mw ikoraniro ry’abagororotsi.
Kuk’ Uhoraho azi inzira y’ abagororotsi, Arikw inzira y’abanyavyaha ijana mu mahonero.
Abanyamahanga n’iki kibateye umuvurungano? N’amoko yagīriye ingingo iki ivy’ ubusa?
Abami bo mw isi baragomoye, N’abakuru bahūrije ingingo hamwe Kurwanya Uhoraho n’Uwo yarobanuje amavuta;
Bati Ngo ducagagure imvuto bātubohesheje, Dute kure ingoyi bādushizemwo.
Umwe avyagiye mw ijuru azobatwengera mw ijigo: Umwami Imana azobakēngēra.
Maz’ azobabarirana uburake bgiwe, Azobatēza ubgoba uguhambara kwiwe gukomeye,
Ati Ni jewe niyimikiye umwami wanje Kuri Siyoni, umurwa wanje wera.
Ndavuga rya jambo rishinzwe: Uhoraho yarambgiye, at’ Ur’ Ubura bganje, Uyu musi ndakuvyaye.
Nsaba, nzoguha amahanga, az’ abe umwandu wawe, N’impera z’isi zize zibe ishamvu yawe.
Uzobavunaguza inkoni y’icuma, Uzobamenagura nk’ikibumbano.
Noneho rero, mwa bami, ni muce ubgenge, Mwa bacamanza bo mw isi, ni mwemere kugīrwa inama.
Musabe Uhoraho mwubashe, Munezeranwe guhinda agashitsi.
Mugumbire urya Mwana, kugira ngo ntarake, namwe mugahonera mu nzira, Kuk’ uburake bgiwe bgoca buziriringa: Hahirwa abamuhungirako bose.
Uhoraho we, ereg’ abarwanizi banje baragwiriye! Abangararije ni benshi.
Benshi baramvuga, Ngo Nta gakiza afise ku Mana.
Yamara wewe, Uhoraho, ur’ inkinzo inkīngira, Ur’ icubahiro canje, ni wewe ushira hejuru umutwe wanje.
Ijwi ryanje ritakambira Uhoraho, Na we akanyishura ari ku murwa wiwe wera.
Nararyama, ngasinzira, Nkīkangura, kuk’ Uhoraho ari we ampagarikiye.
Sinzotinya abantu ibihumbi vyinshi Vy’abankikije impande zose kugira ngo bantere.
Uhoraho we, haguruka: Mana yanje we, nkiza: Kuko wakubise abansi banje bose mu musaya, Wahongoye amenyo y’ababi.
Agakiza n’ak’ Uhoraho: Umugisha utanga ube ku bantu bawe.
Unyishure uko ngutakambiye, Mana ukugororoka kwanje gukomokako. Wanshize ahagutse, aho nari nshugerejwe: Ngirira imbabazi, wumve ugusenga kwanje.
Mwa bana b’abantu, muzogeza hehe gutitura icubahiro canje? Muzogeza hehe gukunda ibitagira ikimazi no kwitwaririka ivy’ ibinyoma?.
Ariko mumenye yuk’ Uhoraho yirobanuriye umukunzi wiwe, Uhoraho azonyumva uko ndamutakambiye.
Mwiyubare, ntimukore icaha: Mucuragize mu mitima yanyu muri ku mariri, mucereje.
Mutange ibimazi vy’ukugororoka, Muheze mwishimire Uhoraho.
Hariho benshi babaza, bati Ni nde azogira iciza atwereka? Uhoraho, utwakishirize umuco wo mu nyonga hawe.
Ushize akanyamuneza mu mutima wanje, Karuta ako bagira mu gahimbo k’amahonda na vino vyabo.
Nzokwama ndyama nsinzire ata co nicura, Kukw ari wewe wenyene, Uhoraho, umpa kuba amahoro.
Uhoraho, tegera ugutwi amajambo yanje, Ushire umutima ku majojwa yanje.
Bangira ugutwi ijwi ry’ugutakamba kwanje, Mwami wanje, Mana yanje: Kukw ari wewe nsenga.
Uhoraho, mu gitondo uzokwama wumva ijwi ryanje: Mu gitondo nzokwama nerekeza ugusenga kwanje kuri wewe, nderetse.
Kuk’ utar’ Imana y’intambirakibi; Umunyakibi ntazobana nawe.
Abībona ntibazohagarara mu nyonga zawe: Wanka inkozi z’ibibi zose.
Uzohonnya abanyabinyoma: Uhoraho yanka urunuka umwicanyi n’ingunge.
Ariko jeho, ubginshi bg’imbabazi zawe buzonyinjiza mu ngoro yawe, Nzokwikubita hasi nsenge nkwubashe, nerekeye urusengero rwawe rwera.
Uhoraho we, undōngōre mu kugororoka kwawe, kubg’ abandyamiye, Utumbereze inzira yawe imbere y’amaso yanje.
Kukw ata kuri kuri mu kanwa kabo; Imbere muri bo n’imanga, Imihogo yabo n’imva zirangaye, Bahemanisha indimi zabo.
Mana, batsindishe, Iyabo migabo n’ibatemvye, Ubahinde kubg’ ubginshi bg’ ibicumuro vyabo, Kuko bakugararije.
Ni ho abakwishimiye bazonezerwa, Umunezero uzobatera guhora bashira amajwi hejuru, kuk’ ubakīngiye, Kandi n’abakunda izina ryawe bazonezererwa muri wewe.
Kuk’ uzoha umugororotsi umugisha: Uhoraho uzomukikiza imbabazi nk’inkinzo.
Uhoraho we, ntumpanane uburake, Canke ng’ unkubitane ishavu.
Ungirire imbabazi, Uhoraho, kuko nkabiranye: Uhoraho n’unkize, kukw amagufa yanje atetemera.
Umutima wanje na wo uratetemera cane. Nawe, Uhoraho, mbeg’ uzogeza ryari?
Ewe Uhoraho garuka, utabare umutima wanje, Unkize kubg’ imbabazi zawe.
Kuk’ utazokwibukirwa mu rupfu; Ni nde azogushimira i kuzimu?
Kuniha kurandambiye; Ukw ijoro ryije ntotesha uburiri bganje amosozi, Uburiri bganje ndayabucuncuburirako.
Nahwereye mu kajisho kubg’ intuntu, Ryakabiranijwe n’abarwanizi banje bose.
Mva i ruhande, mwa bakora ibizira mwe, Kuk’ Uhoraho yumvise ijwi ry’amarira yanje.
Uhoraho yumvise ukwinginga kwanje; Uhoraho azokwemera ugusenga kwanje.
Abansi banje bose bazomāramāra, batetemere cane, Bazosubizwa inyuma, bace bamāramāra.
Uhoraho, Mana yanje, ni wewe mpungirako: Nkiza abampīga bose, ntabara.
Uriya ntanshishimure nk’ intambge, Ngw antabagure ata wo kuntabara.
Uhoraho, Mana yanje, namba naragenjeje ntyo, Namba har’ ukugabitanya mu maboko yanje,
Namb’ uwo twabana amahoro namwihōye inabi, Namba naranyaze umwansi wanje ndamuhōye ubusa,
Umwansi n’ampīge, anshikīre, Ego n’ahonyangire ubugingo bganje mw ivu, N’ashire icubahiro canje mu mukungugu.
Uhoraho we, hagurukana uburake bgawe, Wisidukire kurwanya ubushangashirwe bg’abarwanizi banje, Ni wikangurire kuntabara: ni wewe washinze urubanza.
Ishengero ry’amahanga ni rigukoranireko, Nawe uvyagire iyo hejuru.
Uhoraho acira amahanga imanza: Uhoraho, uncire urubanza rukwiranye no kugororoka kwanje, n’ukuri kuri muri jewe.
Ububi bg’abanyakibi ni bushire, arikw abagororotsi ubashigikire: Kukw Imana igororoka ari yo isesa imitima n’imishaha.
Inkinzo yanje ifashwe n’ Imana, Ni yo ikiza abafise imitima itunganye.
Imana n’umucamanza agororoka, Mbere n’Imana ishavura imisi yose.
Umuntu n’atihana izokarisha inkota yayo; Umuheto wayo imaze kuwufora, irashize mu ruge.
Kand’ imaze kumwitegurira ivyo kumwica, Imyampi yayo iyidometsek’ umuriro.
Ehe rāba, uwo we aramukwa ukugabitanya, Mber’ inda yasamye n’ukugira nabi, avyara ibinyoma.
Yimvye icobo arakibirikiza, Agwa mu mugazo yagazuye.
Kugira nabi kwiwe kuzomugaruka ku mutwe, Umuryano wiwe uzogwa mu gahanga kiwe.
Nzoshima Uhoraho nk’uko bibereye ukugororoka kwiwe, Nzoririmba ntazira izina ry’ Uhoraho asumba vyose.
Uhoraho, Mwami wacu, Ereg’ izina ryawe ni ryiza mw isi yose! Washize icubahiro cawe hejuru y’amajuru.
Akanwa k’abana bato n’ abonka wagahaye gushimangira inkomezi zawe, Gutsindisha abansi bawe, Kugira ng’ uzibize umwansi n’umuhōzi.
Iyo nitegereje ijuru ryawe, igikorwa c’intoke zawe, N’ukwezi n’inyenyeri, ivyo waremye;
Umuntu n’iki ah’ umwibuka, Cank’ umwana w’umuntu ah’ umugendera?
Hāri hasigaye gato ukamunganya n’Imana, Umwambika ubgiza n’icubahiro nk’igitsibo.
Wamuhaye kuganza ibikorwa vy’amaboko yawe, Wamuhaye gutwara ibintu vyose, ubishira musi y’ibirenge vyiwe:
Intama zose n’inka, N’ibikōko vyo mw ishamba na vyo,
N’ibiguruka mu kirēre, n’ifi zo mu kiyaga, N’ikintu cose gica mu nzira zo mu biyaga.
Uhoraho, Mwami wacu, Ereg’ izina ryawe ni ryiza mw isi yose!
Ndashimisha Uhoraho umutima wanje wose, Nderekana ibikorwa vyawe vyose bitangaza.
Ndakunezererwa, nkiginagura; Ndaririmba ishimwe ry’izina ryawe, wewe Usumba vyose.
Kukw abansi banje basubiye inyuma, Baratsitaye, barandukiye imbere yawe.
Wampagarikiye mu manza zanje no mu miburano yanje, Uvyagiye ku ntebe uca imanza zibereye.
Wakankamiye abanyamahanga, wahoneje ababi, Wasibanganije amazina yabo gushitsa ibihe bitazoshira.
Abansi barayogeye, hasigaye imisaka ibihe vyose, N’ibisagara vyabo warabikomvomvoye, Mbere no kwibukwa kwabo kwarazimanganye.
Arik’ Uhoraho aravyagira ibihe vyose, Yiteguriye imanza intebe yiwe.
Azocira isi imanza zibereye, Azoshikiriza amahanga imanza z’ukuri.
Kand’ Uhoraho azoba ubuhungiro bg’abadenderezwa, Azoba ubuhungiro mu bihe vy’amagorwa.
Kand’ abazi izina ryawe bazokwizigira, Kuko wewe, Uhoraho, udahemukira abakurondera.
Uhoraho aba i Siyoni mumuririmbire ishimwe; Mukwize mu mahanga ibikorwa vyiwe.
Kuk’ ūhōra amaraso abibuka, Ntiyibagira ugutakamba kw’ abaciye bugufi.
Uhoraho, ngirira ikigongwe; Urābe umubabaro mbabazwa n’abanyanka, Ni wewe undūgana, ukankūra mu marembo y’urupfu,
Kugira ngo nerekanire ishimwe ryawe ryose Mu marembo y’umukobga w’i Siyoni; Kandi nzonezererwa agakiza kawe.
Abanyamahanga barokeye mu cobo biyimbiye, Mu mutego bateze, ni ho icabo kirenge gifatiwe.
Uhoraho yimenyekanishije, yarashikije imanza: Ategesha umunyakibi ibikorwa vy’intoke ziwe nk’ umutego..
Abanyakibi bazosubizwa i kuzimu, Mbere n’amahanga yose yibagira Imana.
Kuk’ umukene atazokwama yibagirwa, Kand’ ivyizigiro vy’abaciye bugufi bitazohora birashira.
Haguruka, Uhoraho we, abantu boye kuba ari bo bagira inganji; Amahanga n’acirwekw iteka mu nyonga zawe.
Uhoraho, n’ubatere ubgoba; Amahanga yimenye kw ar’ abantu buntu.
N’iki gitumye uhagarara kure, Uhoraho we? N’iki gitumye wihisha mu bihe vy’amarushwa?
Ubgibone bg’umunyakibi butuma akinagiza umugorwa; N’agwe mu mutego w’imigabo yīgīriye.
Kuk’ umunyakibi yishimagiriza ivyo umutima wiwe wifuza, Kand’ umunyegono yikunkumura Uhoraho, kand’ akamukēngēra.
Umunyakibi kubg’ ubgibone bgiwe aravuga, at’ Eka ntazohōra. Ivyiyumviro vyiwe vyose bihūrira mur’ iri jambo, ngo Nta Mana iriho.
Mu nzira ziwe zose nta co yinona. Amateka yawe ari hejuru cane, arenze ah’ ijisho ryiwe rishika: Abansi biwe bose arabakanira.
Yibgira mu mutima, ati Nta kizonsegenyesha; Kugeza ibihe vyose sinzokwigera mpīndāna.
Akanwa kiwe kuzuye imivumo n’ubugunge n’akadenderezo; Musi y’ururimi rwiwe har’ ukugira nabi n’ukugabitanya.
Yicara mu bibundo vyo mu mihana, Mu biryamo ni ho yicira abatagira igicumuro: Amaso yiwe ayatatisha umurushwa.
Abunda mu kiryamo nk’ukw intambge ibunda mw isenga ryayo, Abundira gucakira umworo: Acakira umworo, akamukwegesha umugozi yamuteze.
Abunda, amase hasi, Abahizi biwe batūra hasi umurushwa.
Yibgira mu mutima, at’ Imana yibagiye: Yipfutse mu nyonga hayo, ntizokwigera ibibona.
Kūra hasi, Uhoraho we; Mana, urāmvure ukuboko kwawe; Ntiwibagire ūciye bugufi.
N’iki gituma umunyakibi akēngēra Imana, Akayibaririra mu mutima, ati Ntuzohōra?
Warabibonye, kuk’ urāba ukugira nabi n’inzigo, kugira ng’ ubishire mu kuboko kwawe; Umurushwa yegamira wewe wenyene; Ni wewe mutabazi w’impfuvyi.
Vunagura ukuboko kw’umunyakibi, Utōte ububi bg’umubi, gushitsa ah’ utazobumusangana.
Uhoraho ni we Mwami ibihe bitazoshira, Abanyamahanga bārandukiye mu gihugu ciwe.
Uhoraho, wumvise ivyo abaciye bugufi bagomba: Uzokomeza imitima yabo, uzohora ubanze ugutwi,
Kugira ng’ucire urubanza impfuvyi n’abadenderezwa, Umuntu wo mw ivu yoye gusubira gutera ubgoba.
Uhoraho ni we mpungirako. Mubaririra iki umutima wanje, Muti Hungira ku musozi wanyu nk’inyoni?
Kukw abanyakibi bariko barafora umuheto, Bashira umwampi mu ruge, Kugira ngo barasire mu mwiza abafise imitima itunganye.
Namb’ amatanguriro asambuwe, Ivyo umugororotsi yakoze vyapfuye iki?
Uhoraho ari mu rusengero rwiwe rwera, Uhoraho, intebe yiwe iri mw ijuru. Acacisha inyonga ziwe abana b’abantu, mu kigohe ciwe harabasuzuma.
Uhoraho asuzuma abagororotsi: Arik’ umunyakibi n’ūkunda umuryano, umutima wiwe urabanka.
Abanyakibi azobarekurirakw amakara yaka n’amazuku; Umuyaga w’indugumba uzoba umugabane mu gikombe cabo.
Kuk’ Uhoraho ar’ umugororotsi, kand’ akunda ivyo kugororoka, Abatunganye bazorāba mu nyonga hiwe.
Uhoraho we, tabara: kukw abakwubaha baheze, Abo kwizigirwa bakennye mu bana b’abantu.
Bose barabeshana, umuntu wese na mugenzi we: Bavugisha iminwa ihemana n’imitima ibiri.
Uhoraho azokūrah’ iminwa yose ihemana, N’ururimi rwihayagiza:
Abāvuze, bati Tuzotsindisha indimi zacu, Iminwa yacu kw ar’ iyacu: ūtuganza ni nde?
Kubgo kunyagwa kw’umugorwa, kubgo kwitsa umutima kw’umukene, Ubu nyene ndahaguruka, ni k’Uhoraho agize, Ndashira uwo bakanira ahatagira inkomanzi.
Amajambo y’Uhoraho n’icuma gihiye: Ameze nk’ifeza iramuriye mu ruganda rwo mw isi, Ivugutiwe ibihetangabo ndwi.
Uhoraho, uzotuzigama, Uzodukiza ab’ iki gihe ibihe bidashira.
Abanyakibi bayerera impande zose, Iyo hashizwe hejuru abantu b’imburakimazi mu bana b’abantu.
Uhoraho, uzogeza hehe kwama unyibagira imisi yose? Uzogeza hehe kumpisha mu nyonga hawe?
Nzogeza hehe kwīgīra inama mu mutima wanje, Mfise umubabaro mu mushaha wanje bukarinda bgira? Umwansi wanje azogeza hehe kumpagarara hejuru?
Vyitegereze, unyishure, ewe Uhoraho, Mana yanje, Kubitisha akagohe amaso yanje, noye gusinzira itiro ry’urupfu.
Umwansi wanje yoye kuvuga ngo Ndamunesheje: Abarwanizi banje boye kunyitambishwa hejuru n’uko nsegenyeshejwe.
Ariko nizigiye imbabazi zawe; Umutima wanje uzonezererwa agakiza kawe.
Ndaririmbira Uhoraho, Kuko yangiriye neza.
Igipfapfa cibgira mu mutima, ngo Nta Mana iriho. Bārononekaye, bākoze ibikorwa vyo kwankwa urunuka, Nta wukora ivyiza.
Uhoraho acishirīza mu bantu, ari mw ijuru, Kugira ngw arābe ko harimw’ abatāhūra, Barondera Imana.
Barazimiye iyo bava bakagera, bose banduye hamwe, Nta wukora ivyiza, eka nta n’umwe.
Mbeg’ inkozi z’ibibi zose nta bgenge zifise? Ko barya abantu banje nk’ uko barya umutsima, Kandi ntibambaza Uhoraho.
Aho nyene bahagiriye ubgoba bginshi; Kukw Imana iri mu bgoko bg’abagororotsi.
Imigabo y’umugorwa murayitētereza, Arik’ Uhoraho n’ubuhungiro bgiwe.
Icompa agakiza k’Abisirayeli kakaba kaje kava i Siyoni! Uhoraho ni yasubizay’ ubgoko bgiwe bgajanywe ar’ inyagano, Ni ho aba Yakobo bazohimbarwa, Abisirayeli bakanezerwa.
Uhoraho, ni nde azosembera mw ihema ryawe? Ni nde azogerēra ku musozi wawe wera?
N’ūgendera mu bitunganye, agakora ivy’ ukugororoka, Akavuga ukuri mu mutima wiwe.
Ūtarementanisha ururimi rwiwe, Ntagirire nabi mugenzi we, Ntakaze inkuru y’umubanyi wiwe.
Mu maso yiwe igihumbu kirakēngēretse, Ariko yubaha abatinya Uhoraho; Ico yarahiye naho comugirira nabi, ntiyirahuruza.
Ntagurānira amahera kuzohabga ay’ inyungu, Ntiyemera ingurire yo gutsindisha ūfise urubanza. Ūgenza artyo nta kizomunyiganyiza.
Mana unzigame: kukw ari wewe mpungiyeko.
Nabariye Uhoraho, nti Ni wewe Mwami wanje, Nta mugisha mfise atari wewe.
Abera bo mw isi Ni bo ntōre nnezererwa bonyene.
Amagorwa y’abakāba Uhoraho iyindi mana azogwira, Ibimazi vyazo vy’amaraso sinzobihereza ngo ndabisuke, Kand’ amazina yazo sinzoyavugisha iminwa yanje.
Uhoraho ni we mugabane w’umwandu wanje n’uw’ igikombe canje, Ni wewe ukomeza umugabane wanje.
Ubupfindo bgankubitiye amabango ahantu heza, Ni koko, mfise umwandu mwiza.
Ndahimbaza Uhoraho, umujanama wanje; Ni koko, umushaha wanje umpanūra mu bihe vy’ ijoro.
Nashize Uhoraho imbere yanje imisi yose; Kukw ar’ i buryo bganje sinzonyiganyizwa.
Ni co gituma umutima wanje uhimbarwa, ubgiza bganje bukanezerwa, Kandi n’umubiri wanje uzoba ahatagira inkomanzi.
Kuk’ utazoreka ubugingo bganje ngo buje i kuzimu, Kandi ntuzokundira Uwera wawe ngw az’ abore.
Uzondangira inzira y’ubugingo: Mu nyonga hawe ni ho har’ akanyamuneza kuzuye; Mu kuboko kwawe kw’i buryo hahora ibihimbaye ibihe bidashira.
Uhoraho we, umviriza ivy’ ukuri vyanje, bangira ugutwi ugutakamba kwanje, Tegera ugutwi ugusenga kwanje, kutava mu minwa iryarya.
Urubanza rwanje ni ruve imbere yawe, Inyonga zawe ni zirābe ibibereye.
Wagerageje umutima wanje, wangendeye mw ijoro; Waransuzumye, ntiwambonamw’ imigabo mibi; Akanwa kanje ntigacumura.
Ku ruhande rw’ibikorwa vy’ abantu, jeho kwitondera ijambo ry’iminwa yawe Ni kwo kwampaye kwirinda inzira z’abantu b’ikirara.
Intambuko zanje zishikamye mu nzira zawe, Ibirenge vyanje ntibinyerera.
Ndakwambaje, kuk’ utobura kunyishura, Mana: Ntegera ugutwi, wumve ivyo mvuga.
Erekana imbabazi zawe zitangaza, wewe ukiza abaguhungirako kubg’ abarwanizi babo, Ubakirishije ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo.
Unzigame nk’imbone y’ijisho, Umpishe mu gitūtu c’amababa yawe,
Umpishe abanyakibi bannyaga, Ni bo babisha banje bankikije.
Bugaye imitima yabo kugira ngw ikigongwe nticinjire, Akanwa kabo bakavugisha ubgibone.
None bakikije intambuko zacu, Baduhanze amaso kugira ngo badutūre hasi.
Bameze nk’intambge ifise amero y’ico yofata; Nk’umugunza w’intambge, utegeye mu bibundo.
Uhoraho we, haguruka, Ubahagarare mu ruhanga, ubatūre hasi. Ukize umutima wanje umunyakibi, uwukirishije inkota yawe;

Uhoraho, uwukize abantu, uwukirishije ukuboko kwawe; Ni bo bantu b’isi, umugabane wabo uri mur’ ubu bugingo. Inda zabo ziragahāga ivyo wababīkiye, Abana babo barakabihāga, Barakabisigariza n’ibibondo vyabo!
Jeho nzorāba mu nyonga hawe ngororoka, Nikanguye nzonyurwa n’ ishusho yawe.
Ndagukunda, Uhoraho we, ni wewe nkomezi zanje.

Uhoraho n’igitandara canje, n’ubuhungiro bganje, n’ umurokozi wanje, N’Imana yanje, n’igitandara canje gikomeye, ni we nzohungirako; Ni we nkinzo yanje, n’ihembe ry’agakiza kanje, n’umunara wanje wo guhungiramwo.
Ndambaza Uhoraho abereye gushimwa: Ni ho nzokizwa abansi banje.
Ingoyi z’urupfu zaranyizingiriyeko, Isūri zo kurandura zanteye ubgoba.
Ingoyi z’i kuzimu zantaye hagati, Imitego y’urupfu yantanze imbere.
Mu mubabaro wanje nambaje Uhoraho, Natakambiye Imana yanje; Yumva ijwi ryanje iri mu ngoro yayo, Ivyo natakambiye imbere yayo biyishika mu matwi.
Maz’ isi iratigita, ihinda agashitsi, Amatanguriro y’imisozi na yo aranyiganyiga, Atigitishwa n’uburake bgayo.
Umwotsi upfunduka mu mazuru yayo, Umuriro uva mu kanwa kayo, urayigiza, Amakara afatishwa na wo.
Yandaza ijuru, na yo nyene iramanuka, Umwiza w’umuzitanya wari musi y’ibirenge vyayo.
Iguruka ivyagiye ku mukerubi, Mber’ igurukishwa vuba n’ amababa y’umuyaga.
Umwiza iwugira ubgihisho, kuba ihema ryayo riyisāgiriye; Isāgīrwa n’umwiza w’ibicu bibungenze amazi, ibicu bitwaye intunda vyo mw ijuru.
Ubgiza bukayangana bur’ imbere yayo butuma ibicu vyayo bitwaye intunda bikinjura, Hakaba urubura n’amakara yaka.
Kand’ Uhoraho aturagarira mw ijuru, Ūsumba vyose avugisha ijwi ryiwe, Hakaba urubura n’amakara yaka.
Arasa imyampi yiwe, ashwiragiza abansi banje, Arekura imiravyo myinshi, abaca umuhongo.
Maz’ agataka ko musi y’amazi karaboneka, Amatanguriro y’isi aratwikururwa, Bitewe n’uguhana kwawe, Uhoraho, N’ugufūha kw’impwemu ziva mu mazuru yawe.
Atuma ukuboko ari hejuru, aramfata, Andoba mu mazi menshi.
Ankiza umwansi wanje akomeye, N’abanyanka, kuko bandusha inkomezi.
Bari bantanze imbere ku musi w’amagorwa yanje, Arik’ Uhoraho ni we yambereye ubgishimikizo.
Ayankūramwo, anshira ahantu hāgutse: Yandokoye kuko namuhimbaye.
Uhoraho yangereye ibikwiranye n’ukugororoka kwanje, Nk’ukw amaboko yanje atanduye, ni ko yangiriye.
Kuko nitondeye inzira z’ Uhoraho, Kandi sinakoze icaha co kureka Imana yanje:
Kukw amateka yayo yose yar’ imbere yanje, Kand’ ivyagezwe vyayo sinabikūye imbere yanje.
Kandi nabana na yo ntungana, Nirinze ukugabitanya kwanje.
Ni co catumye Uhoraho anyishura ibikwiranye n’ukugororoka kwanje, Ibikwiranye n’ukutandura kw’ amaboko yanje mu nyonga ziwe.
Ku munyembabazi uzokwiyerekana ur’ umunyembabazi; K’ūtunganye uzokwiyerekana ur’ ūtunganye;
K’ūtanduye uzokwiyerekana ur’ ūtanduye; Ku ntabarirwa uzokwiyerekana ur’ ūdadika.
Kuk’ uzokiza abacishijwe bugufi, Arikw amaso yibona uzoyasubiza hasi.
Ni wewe uzodomeka itara ryanje, Uhoraho, Imana yanje, ni we yākira umwiza wanje.
Kukw ari wewe unshoboza gutera umuce w’ingabo, Kand’ ar’ Imana yanje inshoboza gusimba uruzitiro rw’ amabuye.
Imana yo, inzira yayo iratunganye rwose, Ijambo ry’Uhoraho ryaravugutiwe: Ni we nkinzo ikīngira abamuhungirako bose.
Ni nde Mana, atar’ Uhoraho? Ni nde Gitandara, atar’ Imana yacu?
Ni yo Mana inkenyeje inkomezi, Igatunganya inzira yanje.
Ni yo ihindura ibirenge vyanje nk’ivy’ impongokazi, Impagarika ku dutwe tw’imisozi yanje.
Yigisha intoke zanje kurasana, Bituma amaboko yanje afora umuheto w’umuringa.
Kandi wampaye inkinzo, ni yo gakiza kawe, Ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo kurandamira, Ukwicisha bugufi kwawe kwanshize hejuru.
Intambuko zanje wazāguriye inzira, Ibirenge vyanje ntivyanyereye.
Nakinagije abansi banje, ndabahamvya, Sinatabaruka badaheze.
Narabatobekeranije, ntibabasha kuvyuka, Kandi bāguye musi y’ibirenge vyanje.
Wankenyeje inkomezi ngo ndwane, Abarwanizi banje wabamaze igabo.
Watumye ababisha banje bampa ibitugu, Kugira ngo ndandure abanyanka.
Baratakamvye, ntihagira ūbakiza; Batakambiye Uhoraho, ntiyabishura.
Maze ndabasya, bacika nk’ umukungugu utumurwa n’ umuyaga, Mbata nk’umwavu ku nzira.
Wankijije indwano z’abantu, Wangize ūganza amahanga, Ihanga ntigeze kumenya ryaransavye.
Bumvise inkuru yanje baca baranyoboka, Abanyamahanga baje banyunamira bampema.
Abanyamahanga barakabiranye, Bava mu binyegero vyabo bahinda agashitsi.
Uhoraho yamaho; Igitandara canje gihimbazwe; Imana y’agakiza kanje ishirwe hejuru:
Ni yo Mana impōra, Ikangandūrira amahanga nkayaganza.
Inkiza ababisha banje: Mber’ unshira hejuru y’abampagurukira, Unkiza n’umuntu w’ikirara.
Ni co gituma, Uhoraho, nzogushimira mu mahanga, Ndirimbe ishimwe ry’izina ryawe.
Umwami yimitse amugabira agakiza gakomeye, Agirira imbabazi umwami yimikishije amavuta, Ni Dawidi n’uruvyaro rwiwe ibihe bidashira.
Ijuru ritāngāza icubahiro c’Imana, Itāzānure ryaryo rimenyekanisha igikorwa c’intoke zayo.
Umurango uvugana n’uwundi murango urudaca, Ijoro rimenyesha irindi joro ubgenge.
Nta majambo cank’ ururimi biriho, Ijwi ryavyo ntiryumvikana.
Umugozi ubigera ushika mw isi yose, Bo n’amajambo yavyo ku mpera y’isi. Muri vyo yashingiye izuba ihema,
Rimeze nk’umukwe asohoka ava mu nzu i we, Rinezerwa nk’umunyenkomezi ryiruka mu nzira yaryo.
Riturumbuka riva ku mpera y’ijuru, Rikajana inzira ishika ku yindi mpera yaryo, Nta kintu gihishwa indugumba yaryo.
Ivyagezwe vy’Uhoraho biratunganye rwose, bihēmbūra ubugingo, Ivyo Uhoraho yashingiye intahe n’ivyo kwizerwa, biha umutungu ubgenge.
Ivyagezwe Uhoraho yigisha biragororotse, binezereza umutima, Ivyo Uhoraho yageze n’ibitanduye, bihwejesha amaso.
Ukwubaha Uhoraho kuratunganye, kwamah’ ibihe bidashira, Amateka y’Uhoraho n’ay’ ukuri, aragororotse rwose.
N’ivyo kwifuzwa kuruta izahabu, naho zoba izahabu, nyinshi zitarimw’ inkamba: Bisōsa kurusha ubūki, n’umutsāma w’ikigigu utonyanga.
Kandi ni vyo bibūrira umusavyi wawe; Kuvyitondera harimw’ impēra nini.
Ni nde ashobora kwimenyakw amafuti? Ntumparūrekw ivyaha vyanyinyegeje.
Kandi wame uzigama umusavyi wawe sinze nkore ivyaha ibigirankana, Ntibize binganze: ni ho nzobona gutungana rwose, Sinzotsindwa n’urubanza rw’ icaha gikomeye.
Amajambo yo mu kanwa kanje, n’ivyiyumviro vyo mu mutima wanje, bize bishimwe mu nyonga zawe, Uhoraho, gitandara canje, mucunguzi wanje.
Uhoraho akwishure ku musi w’amagorwa, Izina ry’Imana ya Yakobo rigushire hejuru;
Ikurungikire ugutabarwa kuva ahēra h’urusengero, Iguhe inkomezi ziva i Siyoni.
Yibuke amashikanwa yawe yose, Yākīre ikimazi cawe coshejwe.
Iguhe ico umutima wawe wifuza, Ishitse inama zawe zose.
Tuzovugishwa impundu n’ agakiza kawe, Kandi kubg’ izina ry’Imana yacu tuzokwerekana amabendera yacu. Uhoraho ashitse ivy’ usaba vyose.
None mmenye yuk’ Uhoraho akiza uwo yarobanuje amavuta, Azomwishura, ari mw ijuru ryiwe ryera, Azomwishurisha ubushobozi bukiza bg’ukuboko kwiwe kw’i buryo.
Bamwe bizigira imikogote, abandi bizigira amafarasi, Ariko tweho tuzokwizigira izina ry’Uhoraho, Imana yacu.
Barunamye, baratemvye; Ariko tweho tuvuye hasi, turēmye.
Uhoraho, kiza umwami: Kand’ utwishure uko tukwambaje.
Uhoraho we! Umwami azonezerezwa n’inkomezi zawe. Ereg’ agakiza kawe azokanezererwa cane!
Wamuhaye ico umutima wiwe wifuza, Ntiwamwimye ico iminwa yiwe yasavye.
Kuk’ umusanganije imigisha y’ivyiza, Wamwambitse igitsibo c’izahabu nziza mu mutwe.
Yagusavye ubugingo, urabumuha, Ni bgo kuramba ibihe bitazoshira.
Ubgiza bgiwe ni bginshi kubg’ agakiza kawe, Icubahiro n’igitinyiro ubimushizeko.
Umugize icitegererezo c’ihirwe ibihe vyose, Umunejereje akaneza mu nyonga zawe.
Kuk’ umwami yizigira Uhoraho, Kubg’ imbabazi z’Ūsumba vyose ntazosegenyeshwa.
Ukuboko kwawe kuzoserangura ababisha bawe bose; Ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo kuzoserangura abakwanka.
Uzobahindura nk’itanure ry’ umuriro mu gihe c’uburake bgawe, Uhoraho azobayongobeza mu burake bgiwe, Umuriro uzobatsontsomera.
Nawe uzohonnya imbuto zabo mw isi, N’uruvyaro rwabo mu bana b’abantu.
Kuko bagabiye kukugirira nabi, Bagīye inama badashobora gushitsa.
Uzotuma bagutera ibitugu, Uzoshira mu ruge rwawe utumbereje mu maso habo.
Uhoraho, ni wishire hejuru mu nkomezi zawe: Ni ho tuzoririmba dushima ububasha bgawe.
Mana yanje, Mana yanje, n’iki kikumpebesheje, Ukaba kure ntuntabare, kure y’amajambo yo kuniha kwanje?
Mana yanje, ntakambira ku murango ntunyishure: Ntakambira no mw ijoro, simpore.
Ariko wewe ur’ uwera, Intebe yawe ikikijwe n’ishimwe rya Isirayeli.
Ba sogokuruza bacu bārakwizigira: Bārakwizigira, nawe ukabakiza.
Bāragutakambira, bagakizwa: Bārakwizigira, ntibamāramāre.
Ariko jeho nd’umusiba, sind’ umuntu: Ndi ruvumwa mu bantu, nkēngērwa na bose.
Abambona bose bantwengera mw ijigo: Bampa ibinoko, banzunguriza imitwe,
Bati Yishize k’Uhoraho, n’ amukize: N’amukize kw amunezererwa.
Ariko ni wewe wankūye mu nda ya mama: Wanyijigije nkiri kw ibere rya mama.
Ni wewe nashiburiweko, uhereye aho navukiye; Ni wewe Mana yanje uhereye aho naviriye mu nda ya mama.
Ntumbe kure, kukw amagorwa ari hafi, Kand’ ata mutabazi.
Impfizi nyinshi zirankikije, Impfizi z’ubukombe z’i Bashani zintaye hagati.
Baranyasamiye n’akanwa kabo, Nk’intambge yaromoye yivuga.
Nsutswe nk’amazi, Amagufa yanje yose aradohotse, Umutima wanje umeze nk’ ishashara, Uyagiye hagati mu mara yanje.
Intege zanje zumye nk’urujo, Ururimi rwanje rufatanye n’ uruhekenyero; Kand’ unshize mu mukungugu w’urupfu.
Kukw imbga zinkikije, Umurwi w’inkozi z’ibibi wantaye hagati; Bantoboye ibiganza n’ibirenge.
Nshobora guharūra amagufa yanje yose; Bandāba bankanuriye amaso.
Bagabura impuzu zanje, Bapfindira umwambaro wanje.
Ariko ntumbe kure, Uhoraho we: Yewe muvunyi wanje, tebuka untabare.
Kiza ubugingo bganje inkota, Ico mfitiye igishika ugikize ububasha bg’imbga.
Nkiza akanwa k’intambge; Waranyishuye, unkūra mu mahembe y’imbogo.
Nzobarira bene Data izina ryawe, Nzogutazirira hagati y’ishengero.
Yemwe abubaha Uhoraho, mumutazire, Yemwe ruvyaro rwa Yakobo mwese, mumuhimbaze, Yemwe ruvyaro rwa Isirayeli mwese, mumutinye.
Kukw atāgaye cank’ atanse urunuka amarushwa y’umurushwa, Kand’ atāmuhishije mu nyonga hiwe: Arikw amutakambiye, yaramwumvise.
Ishimwe ngushimisha mw ikoraniro ryinshi riva kuri wewe: Nzoshitsa amasezerano nagusezeraniye imbere y’abakwubaha.
Abaciye bugufi bazorya bahāge, Abarondera Uhoraho bazomuhimbaza: Imitima yanyu irambe ibihe vyose.
Abo ku mpera zose z’isi bazokwibuka bahindukirire Uhoraho, Amoko yose yo mu mahanga azosengera imbere yawe.
Kuk’ ubgami ar’ ubg’ Uhoraho, Kand’ ari we mugabe w’amahanga.
Abakomeye bo mw isi bose bazorya basenge; Kand’ abamanuka baja mu mukungugu bazokwunama imbere yiwe, N’ūdashobora kwizigamira ubugingo bgiwe ngo ntibupfe.
Uruvyaro ruzomusaba; Abuzukuru bazovuka bazobarirwa ivy’ Umwami Imana.
Bazoza babgire abantu bazovuka Ukugororoka kwiwe, kw ari we yabikoze.
Uhoraho ni we mwungere wanje, sinzokena.
Amvyagiza mu canya c’ubgatsi butotahaye: Andōngōrera i ruhande y’ amazi adasūma:
Aremesha umutima wanje. Anyobora mu nzira zo kugororoka kubg’ izina ryiwe.
Mbere naho noca mu mwonga w’igitūtu c’urupfu Sinzogira ikibi ntinya; kuk’ uri kumwe nanje: Inyobozo yawe n’ubuhiri bgawe ni vyo bimpumuriza.
Untegurira ameza mu maso y’abansi banje; Wansīze amavuta mu mutwe; igikombe canje kirasēsekaye.
N’ukuri ivyiza n’imbabazi bizonyomako imisi yose y’ ukubaho kwanje, Nanje nzoba mu ngoro y’Uhoraho ibihe vyose.
Isi n’iy’ Uhoraho, n’ibiyuzuye, Isi n’abayibamwo.
Kukw ari we yashize amatanguriro yayo ku biyaga, Yayihamangiye ku mazi menshi.
Ni nde azodūga umusozi w’ Uhoraho? Ni nde azohagarara ahēra hiwe?
N’ūfise amaboko akeye n’umutima utanduye, Atigeze kwerekeza umushaha wiwe ku vy’ukubesha, Ntarahire ibinyoma.
Uwo ni we azohabga umugisha n’Uhoraho, N’ukugororoka azoguharūrwako n’Imana y’agakiza kiwe.
Abayirondera ni ben’ uwo muntu, Abarondera mu nyonga hawe, Mana ya Yakobo.
Ni mwīgire birebire, mwa birimba, Musegenye, mwa nzugi z’ ibihe vyose, ngo hāguke, Umwami w’ubgiza ngw ashike.
Uwo Mwami w’ubgiza ni nde? N’Uhoraho afise inkomezi n’ ubutōre, N’Uhoraho afise ubutōre mu ntambara.
Ni mwīgire birebire, mwa birimba, Musegenye, mwa nzugi z’ ibihe vyose, ngo hāguke, Umwami w’ubgiza ngw ashike.
Uwo Mwami w’ubgiza ni nde? Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo Ni we Mwami w’ubgiza.
Uhoraho, ni wewe ncurūrira umutima.
Mana yanje, ni wewe nizigiye, Noye kumāramāra, Abansi banje boye kunyihaya.
Ni koko, abakwiteze nta wuzomāramāra: Abahemuka ata nyanduruko ni bo bazomāramāra.
Uhoraho, nyereka inzira zawe, Nyigisha amarango yawe.
Undōngōre mu kuri kwawe, unyigishe: Kukw ari wewe Mana y’agakiza kanje; Ni wewe nirirwa niteze.
Uhoraho we, ibuka imbabazi zawe no kugira neza kwawe, Kuko vyahozeho, uhereye kera hose.
Ntiwibuke ivyaha vyo mu busore bganje, cank’ ibicumuro vyanje, Nk’ukw imbabazi zawe ziri, abe ari k’unyibuka, Kubgo kugira neza kwawe, Uhoraho.
Uhoraho ni mwiza, aragororotse: Ni co gituma azorangira abanyavyaha inzira.
Abīcisha bugufi azobarōngōra mu vy’ukugororoka, Abīcisha bugufi azobarangira inzira yiwe.
Inzira zose z’Uhoraho n’ imbabazi n’ukuri Ku bitondera isezerano ryiwe n’ibishingantahe vyiwe.
Uhoraho we, kubg’ izina ryawe Umparire ukugabitanya kwanje, kuko gukomeye.
Umuntu yubaha Uhoraho ni nde? Azomurangira inzira akwiye guhitamwo.
Umutima wiwe uzoba amahoro, Uruvyaro rwiwe ruzoragwa isi.
Ibanga ry’Uhoraho rifiswe n’abamwubaha, Azobereka isezerano ryiwe.
Amaso yanje ahora ahanze k’Uhoraho, Kukw azokūra ibirenge vyanje mu mutego.
Umpindukirire, ungirire ikigongwe, Kuko ntagira shinge na rugero, ndagowe.
Imibabaro y’umutima wanje uyiruhure, Nkūra se mu marushwa yanje.
Witegereze umubabaro wanje n’umuruho, Umparire ivyaha vyanje vyose.
Witegereze abansi banje, kukw ari benshi, Kandi banyanka urwanko rw’ inkazi.
Zigama umutima wanje, unkize: Noye kumāramāra, kuko nguhungiyeko.
Ukugororoka n’ugutungana binzigame, Kuko nkwiteze.
Mana, cungura Abisirayeli, Ubakūre mu marushwa yabo yose.
Uhoraho, uncire urubanza, kuk’ ukugororoka kwanje ari kwo ngenderamwo, Kandi nizigira Uhoraho ntakekeranya.
Uhoraho, unsuzume, ungerageze, Sesa umushaha wanje n’umutima wanje.
Kukw imbabazi zawe ziri mu maso yanje, Kandi ngendera mu kuri kwawe.
Sinicarana n’abanyabinyoma, Kandi sinzogendera indyarya.
Nanka ikoraniro ry’inkozi z’ ibibi, Kandi sinzokwicarana n’abanyakibi.
Nzokaraba mu kudacumura, Ni ho nzobona gukikuza igicaniro cawe, Uhoraho;
Kugira ngo numvikanishe ijwi ry’ishimwe, Mvuge ibikorwa bitangaje vyose wakoze.
Uhoraho, nkunda ah’ inzu yawe igerereye, Ahantu ubgiza bgawe buba.
Nturandurane umutima wanje n’abanyavyaha, Cank’ ubugingo bganje n’ abavisha amaraso.
Amaboko yabo arimw’ umugararizo, Ukuboko kwabo kw’i buryo kwuzuye ingurire.
Ariko jeho ukugororoka kwanje ni kwo nzogenderamwo; Uncungure, ungirire ikigongwe.
Ikirenge canje gihagaze aharinganiye; Nzoshemagiriza Uhoraho mu makoraniro.
Uhoraho ni we muco wanje n’agakiza kanje: nzotinya nde? Uhoraho ni we gihome gikīngira ubugingo bganje, ni nde azonca ivutu?
Hamwe inkozi z’ibibi zari zinziye ngo zirye inyama zanje, Ni bo barwanizi banje n’ababisha banje, bāratsitaye, baratemba.
Nah’ ingabo zosagaza ngo zintere, Umutima wanje ntiwotinya; Nah’ intambara yovyuka ikandwanya, No muri yo norema.
Ico nsaba Uhoraho ni kimwe, ni co nzohora nitwaririka: N’ukuba mu ngoro y’Uhoraho imisi yose y’ubugingo bganje, Nkarāba ubgiza bg’Uhoraho, nkihweza urusengero rwiwe.
Kuko ku musi w’amagorwa azonzigama akampisha mw ihema ryiwe, Mu bgigobeko bgo mw ihema ryiwe ni ho azompisha; Azonshira hejuru, ampagarike ku gitandara.
N’ubu, umutwe wanje uzoshirwa hejuru y’abansi banje bankikije; Nanje nzotangira ibimazi vy’ umunezero mw ihema ryiwe, Nzoririmba, ego cane nzoririmbira Uhoraho amatazirano.
Uhoraho we, umve gutaka kw’ijwi ryanje, Utek’ ungirire ikigongwe, unyishure.
Wavuze, uti Ni murondere mu nyonga hanje; umutima wanje urakwishuye, Uti Mu nyonga hawe ndaharondera, Uhoraho.
Ntumpishe mu nyonga hawe, Ntiwirukanishe umusavyi wawe uburake. Ni wewe wahoze ur’ umutabazi wanje, Ntunte, ntumpebe, Mana y’ agakiza kanje.
N’iyo data na mama bonta, Uhoraho azonyitorera.
Ndangira inzira yawe, Uhoraho, Undōngōre mu nzira y’umuharuro, Kubg’ abandyamiye.
Ntumpe abarwanizi banje ngo bangirire uko bagomba, Kukw ivyabona vy’ibinyoma binkūriye hasi, n’abafuhagira inzigo.
Mba narihebūye iyo ntizera ko nzobonera ukugira neza kw’Uhoraho Mw isi y’abakiriho.
Ni witege Uhoraho: Rema, umutima wawe uhūmure: Nuko, ni witege Uhoraho.
Uhoraho, ni wewe ntakambira; Gitandara canje, ntiwice amatwi: Kuko wonyihoza Nohinduka nk’abamanuka baja muri rwa rwobo.
Wumvirize ijwi ry’ukwinginga kwanje uko ngutakambiye, Uko ntaritse amaboko, ndayatumbereje ahēra h’urusengero rwawe.
Ntunkwegane n’abanyakibi N’inkozi z’ibibi; Bavugana ivy’ amahoro na bagenzi babo, Ariko mu mitima yabo har’ imanga.
Ubahe ibikwiranye n’ivyo bākoze, ibikwiranye n’ivyo bāgabitanije, Ubahe ibikwiranye n’ibikorwa vy’amaboko yabo: Ubasubirize mu nkōko nk’ uko bibakwiye.
Kuko batababaye ivyo Uhoraho yakoze, Cank’ ibikorwa vy’amaboko yiwe, Azobasangangura, ntazobubaka.
Uhoraho ahimbazwe, Kuko yumviye ijwi ry’ukwinginga kwanje.
Uhoraho ni we nkomezi zanje n’inkinzo yanje, Umutima wanje uhora umwizigira, ngatabarwa: Ni co gituma umutima wanje unezerwa cane, Kandi nzomutazirisha indirimbo yanje.
Uhoraho n’inkomezi z’abantu biwe, Uwo yarobanuje amavuta amubera ubuhungiro bg’ agakiza.
Kiza abantu bawe, uhe ishamvu yawe umugisha: Kand’ ubaragire, wame ubaramira ibihe bidashira.
Mwaturire Uhoraho, yemwe bana b’Imana, Mwaturire Uhoraho kw afise icubahiro n’inkomezi.
Muhe Uhoraho icubahiro kibereye izina ryiwe: Musenge Uhoraho mushajije n’ukwera.
Ijwi ry’Uhoraho rihindira hejuru y’amazi: Imana y’icubahiro ihindisha inkuba, Ni we Uhoraho ahindishiriza inkuba hejuru y’amazi menshi.
Ijwi ry’Uhoraho rifise inkomezi; Ijwi ry’Uhoraho ryuzuye igitinyiro;
Ijwi ry’Uhoraho risatura ibiti vy’amasederi, Mber’ Uhoraho asatagura amasederi y’i Lebanoni.
Ayakinisha amatavu nk’inyana, I Lebanoni n’i Siriyoni ahakinisha amatavu nk’inyana y’imbogo.
Ijwi ry’Uhoraho rishwaza ibirimi vy’umuriro.
Ijwi ry’Uhoraho rinyiganyiza ubugaragwa, Uhoraho anyiganyiza ubugaragwa bg’i Kadeshi.
Ijwi ry’Uhoraho riramburuza impongokazi, Kandi rigakōkōra ikibira; Kandi mu rusengero rwiwe vyose bikavuga, bit’ Icubahiro kibe icawe.
Uhoraho yar’ avyagiye hejuru ya wa Mwuzure: Ni koko, Uhoraho avyagiye ahangamye ibihe bidashira.
Uhoraho azoha abantu biwe inkomezi, Uhoraho azoha abantu biwe umugisha w’amahoro.
Uhoraho ndaguhimbaza kuko wankūye hasi, Ntukunde kw abansi banje banyitamba hejuru.
Uhoraho, Mana yanje, Naragutakambiye, urankiza.
Uhoraho, wadūganye ubugingo bganje, ubukūra i kuzimu: Wankijije urupfu, ngo noye kumanuka nkaja muri rwa rwobo.
Muririmbire Uhoraho ishimwe, yemwe bakunzi biwe, Mushime izina ryiwe ryera.
Kuk’ uburake bgiwe ar’ ubg’ akanya isase, Arik’ ubuntu bgiwe bgamah’ igihe cose umuntu akiriho. Ukurira kworārira umuntu mw ijoro, Ariko mu gitondo impundu zikavuga.
Nanje, aho nari nguwe neza, naravuze, Nti Sinzokwigera nsegenyeshwa.
Uhoraho, kubg’ urukundo rwawe war’ ushimangiye umusozi wanje; Wapfutse my nyonga hawe, mpagarika umutima.
Uhoraho naragutakambiye, Kandi ninginze Uhoraho:
Nti Mbeg’ amaraso yanje azomara iki, ni namanuka nkaja muri rwa rwobo? Non’ umukungugu uzoguhimbaza? Mbeg’ uzokwatura ukuri kwawe?
Uhoraho we, zirikana ungirire ikigongwe: Uhoraho, mbera umutabazi.
Intimba yanje uyihinduye imvyino, Unkenyuruye amagunira yanje, unkenyeza umunezero,
Kugira ng’umushaha wanje ukuririmbire ishimwe ntucereze. Uhoraho, Mana yanje, nzogushima ibihe bidashira.
Uhoraho, ni wewe mpungirako: sinze nigere mmāramāzwa; Unkize kubg’ ukugororoka kwawe.
Umbangire ugutwi, unyaruke unkize: Umbere igitandara gikomeye, inzu y’igihome yo kunkiza.
Kukw ari wewe gitandara canje n’igihome kinkīngira: Nuko kubg’ izina ryawe unje imbere, undōngōre.
Unkūre mu mutego bantegeye mu mpisho, Kukw ari wewe buhungiro bganje.
Mu kuboko kwawe ni ho nshize ubugingo bganje; Warancunguye Uhoraho, we Mana y’ukuri.
Nanka abashira imitima ku bitagira ikimazi vy’ibinyoma, Ariko jeho nizigira Uhoraho.
Nzokwama nnezerwa mpimbawe n’imbabazi zawe, Kuko wabonye amagorwa yanje; Wamenye imibabaro y’umutima wanje,
Kandi ntiwantanze mu maboko y’umwansi; Washize ibirenge vyanje ahantu hāgutse.
Ngirira ikigongwe Uhoraho we, kuko ngowe: Ijisho ryanje rikabiranijwe n’ intuntu, bo n’ubugingo bganje n’umubiri.
Kukw imisi y’ukubaho kwanje imazwe n’umubabaro, n’imyaka yanje imazwe no kwitsa umutima: Intege zanje ziracitse kubg’ ukugabitanya kwanje, amagufa yanje ashize umunywera.
Mpindutse ruvumwa kubg’ abansi banje bose, Mbere, mpindukiye abo tubana igitutsi gikomeye, n’ abo tuzinanyi mbahindukiye igiteye ubgoba: Abambonye mu nzira barampunga.
Nibagiranye nk’uwapfuye, atacibukwa: Mmeze nk’ikibumbano kimenetse.
Kuko numvise benshi bandementaniriza, Ubgoba kukantera irya n’ino; Hamwe bangīra inama Barondera ingene bonyica.
Ariko jeho, ni wewe nizigiye, Uhoraho, Naravuze, nti Ni wewe Mana yanje.
Ibihe vyanje biri mu kuboko kwawe, Unkize ukuboko kw’abansi banje n’abampama.
Umurikishirize umusavyi wawe mu nyonga hawe, Unkize kubg’ imbabazi zawe.
Uhoraho, sinze nicwe n’isoni, kuko ngutakambiye; Abanyakibi abe ari bo bicwa n’isoni, bajorererwe i kuzimu.
Iminwa ivuga ibinyoma izibge, Ivugana umugororotsi agakēngērwe, N’ubgibone n’akagaye.
Ereg’ ukugira neza kwawe ni kwinshi, ukwo wabīkiye abakwubaha, Ukwo wagiriye abaguhungirako mu maso y’abana b’ abantu!
Mu bgigobeko bgo mu nyonga zawe ni ho uzobahisha inama mbi z’abantu, Uzobahisha mw ihema gutongana kw’indimi.
Uhoraho ahimbazwe, Kuko yanyerekeye imbabazi ziwe zitangaza mu gisagara kizitijwe ibikomeye.
Jeho navuganye ukwihebura, nti Ndarandutse, nkūwe mu nyonga zawe: Ariko weho wumvise ijwi ry’ ukwinginga kwanje hamwe nagutakambira.
Mukunde Uhoraho, yemwe bakunzi biwe mwese: Uhoraho azigama abizigirwa, Ūkora ivy’ ubgibone abimusubiriza mu nkōko kenshi.
Ni mureme, imitima yanyu ishikame, Yemwe abiteze Uhoraho mwese.
Hahirwa uwahariwe ugucumura kwiwe, icaha ciwe kigatwikirwa.
Hahirwa umuntu Uhoraho adaharūrak’ ukugabitanya, Umutima wiwe ntubemw’ ubugunge.
Ngicereje, amagufa yanje atewe gusāza N’ukuniha kwanje umusi ukīra.
Kuk’ ukuboko kwawe kwandemēra ku murango no mw ijoro, Ukubengagira kwanje kugahinduka nk’ukwuma kwo mu ci.
Nakwemereye icaha canje, sinatwikiriye ukugabitanya kwanje; Naravuze, nti Ndāturira Uhoraho ibicumuro vyanje: Nawe umparira ukugabitanya kw’icaha canje.
Ni co gituma ūkwubaha wese akwiye kugusengera mu gihe wobonerwamwo: N’ukuri, iy’ amazi asendanishije yamaze iminyika, ntazomushikako.
Ni wewe bgihisho bganje, uzondinda amagorwa, Uzonkikiza impundu z’uko ndokotse.

Umutima wanje ugirira Imana inyota, Imana nzima: Nzoza ryari ngo nseruke mu nyonga z’Imana?
Amosozi yanje ni yo yambereye ivyo kurya ku murango no mw ijoro, Bakarenza izuba bambaza, bat’ Imana yawe iri hehe?
Ibi ndavyibuka, umutima ukantunturira mu nda, Ingene najana n’ishengero, mbajana mu ngoro y’Imana, Tugendana ijwi ry’akanyamuneza n’ishimwe, tur’ ikoraniro rigize umusi mukuru.
Mutima wanje, n’iki gitumye wicurikīra? N’iki gitumye umpagararamwo? Ni wishimire Imana, kuko na none nzosubira kuyihimbariza Agakiza kava mu nyonga hayo.
Mana yanje, umutima wanje uricurikiriye: Ni co gituma nkwibuka ndi mu gihugu ca Yorodani, No ku misozi ya Herumoni, no ku musozi Mizari.
Idamba rihamagara irindi damba, kubgo kubomborana kw’amasūmo yawe: Imipfunda yawe yose n’imikuba yawe yose birandengeye.
Uhoraho angerera imbabazi ziwe ku murango, No mw ijoro indirimbo yiwe yamana nanje, Ni yo nsengesha Imana y’ ubugingo bganje.
Nzobaza Imana, igitandara canje, nti N’iki gitumye unyibagira? N’iki gituma ngenda ngandaye kubg’ agahahazo k’ abansi banje?
Abansi banje bantuka nk’abanjanjagura amagufa, Bakarenza izuba bambaza, bat’ Imana yawe iri hehe?
Mutima wanje, n’iki gitumye wicurikīra? N’iki gitumye umpagararamwo? Ni wishimire Imana kuko na none nzosubira kuyihimbaza, Ni yo gakiza ko mu maso hanje, n’Imana yanje.
Mana, uncire urubanza, umbūranire n’ihanga ritagira imbabazi: Unkize ingunge n’ūdambikanya.
Kw ari wewe Mana mpungirako, n’iki catumye unta kure? N’iki gituma ngenda ngandaye kubg’ agahahazo k’abansi banje?
N’urungike se umuco wawe n’ukuri kwawe, bindōngōre: Biniane ku murwa wawe wera, No mu mahema yawe.
Maze nzoja ku gicaniro c’ Imana, Ku Mana, ni yo munezero uzana ibinezaneza vyanje; Ngutazirishe inanga, Mana, wewe Mana yanje.
Mutima wanje, n’iki gitumye wicurikīra? N’iki gitumye umpagararamwo? Ni wishimire Imana, kuko na none nzosubira kuyihimbaza, Ni yo gakiza ko mu maso hanje, n’Imana yanje.
Mana, twariyumviye n’amatwi yacu, ba sogokuruza bacu batubariye Ibikorwa wakoze mu gihe cabo, mu gihe ca kera.
Wasohoje amahanga ukuboko kwawe, ariko bo urahabagerēra; Wateye amoko amarushwa, uca ugasāza bano.
Kukw atar’ iyabo nkota yabahaye kwegukira igihugu, Kand’ atar’ ukwabo kuboko kwabakijije: Ariko n’ikiganza cawe c’i buryo n’ukuboko kwawe n’ umuco wo mu nyonga hawe, Kuko wabakunze.
Mana, ni wewe Mwami wanje: Gerera agakiza aba Yakobo.
Ni wewe uzoduha kwirenza abansi bacu: Izina ryawe ni ryo rizoduha gusiribanga abadukūriye hasi.
Kuk’ umuheto wanje atari wo nzokwishimira, Kand’ inkota yanje atari yo izonkiza.
Ariko ni wewe wadukijije abansi bacu, Watētereje abatwanka.
Imana ni yo twirata umusi ukīra, Kandi tuzoshima izina ryawe ibihe bidashira.
Ariko noneho wadushiburiye kure, waduteye gukēngērwa, Kandi ntugitabarana n’ingabo zacu.
Watumye abansi bacu badukimiranya, Abatwanka baratwinyagira.
Wadutanze nk’intama z’imbāgwa, Wadushwiragirije mu mahanga.
Ugura abantu bawe ubusa, Kand’ ibiguzi vyabo ntiwabironsemw’ inyungu.
Uduhindura ruvumwa ku babanyi bacu, Agatwengo no gucokorwa ku badukikije.
Watugize iciro ry’imigani mu mahanga, Abo kuzungurizwa imitwe n’ amoko.
Ubugene nkēngeretse bunyama imbere umusi ukīra, Isoni zo mu maso hanje zirantwikiriye,
Kubg’ ijwi ry’ūtongana, agatukana, Kubg’ umwansi n’umuhōzi.
Ivyo vyose vyadushitseko; ariko ntitwakwibagiye, Kandi ntitwavuye mw isezerano ryawe.
Imitima yacu ntiyasubiye inyuma, Intambuko zacu ntizatirimutse ngo zive mu nzira yawe,
Nawe ng’utuvunagurire ahantu h’imbgebge, Ukadutwikiriza igitūtu c’urupfu.
Namba twaribagiye izina ry’ Imana yacu, Canke tukaya amaboko imbere y’iyindi mana,
Mbeg’ Imana ntizobisuzuma? Kukw izi amabanga yo mu mutima.
Mbere twirirwa twicwa bakuduhōra, Twagereranijwe n’intama z’ imbāgwa.
Ibambure Mwami, n’iki kigusinzirije? Vyukuruka, ntudushiburire kure ibihe bidashira.
N’iki gituma upfuka mu nyonga hawe, Ukibagira amarushwa yacu no guhahazwa kwacu?
Kuk’ ubugingo bgacu bgunamitswe bugashika mu mukungugu, Inda yacu yamatanye n’ivu.
Kūra hasi, udutabare, Uducungure kubg’ imbabazi zawe.
Umutima wanje urabize, usēsekara ivyiza: Ndavuga ivyo nageneye umwami; Ururimi rwanje n’ikaramu y’ umwanditsi w’umuhinga.
Uri n’ubgiza buruta ubg’ abana b’abantu; Igikundiro gisutswe mu minwa yawe: Ni co gitumye Imana iguha umugisha w’ibihe bidashira.
Wa muhizi we, ambara inkota yawe kw itako, Ambara ubgiza bgawe n’icubahiro cawe.
Ugendane icubahiro, ugendera kw ifarasi, utsinde, Urwanire ukuri n’ubugwaneza no kugororoka. Ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo kukwigishe ibitera ubgoba.
Imyampi yawe irasongoye: Amahanga agwa bukumbi imbere yawe; Imyampi yawe iguye mu mitima y’abansi b’umwami.
Ingoma yawe Mana, ihangamye ibihe bidashira, Icumu ry’ubugabe bgawe n’ icumu ry’ūganza atunganye.
Wakunze ukugororoka, wanka ubugarariji: Ni co catumye Imana, ni yo Mana yawe, Ikurobanuza amavuta y’umunezero ikakurutisha bagenzi bawe.
Impuzu zawe zose zitāmirana isenga n’imbazi na kesiya, Mu ngoro zisharijwe n’amahembe y’inzovu, inanga ziraguhimbaye.
Mu ncoreke zawe z’icubahiro harimw’ abakobga b’abami: I buryo bgawe hahagaze umwamikazi yambaye izahabu yavuye muri Ofiru.
Umve mukobga, wiyumvire, ubange ugutwi; Kandi wibagire ubgoko bganyu n’inzu ya so:
Ni co kizotuma umwami agomwa igikundiro cawe, Kukw ari we Mwami wawe, nawe umwunamire.
Kand’ umukobga wo muri Tiro azozana ingorore, Kand’ abatunzi bo mu bantu bazogusaba ng’ ubatonere.
Umukobga w’umwami ar’ i kare afise ubgiza bginshi: Impuzu ziwe zijishishijwe inyuzi z’izahabu.
Ahava azanirwa umwami, yambaye impuzu zisharijwe: Abakobga bagenzi biwe bamukurikiye Bahava bazanwa ah’ uri.
Barazananwa umunezero n’ uguhimbarwa, Binjire mu ngoro y’umwami.
Mu gishingo ca ba sogokuruza bawe kizosubiramw’ abana bawe, Ni bo uzoshiraho kuba abaganwa mu gihugu cose.
Nzokwibukiriza izina ryawe ibihe vyose: Ni co gituma amahanga azogushima ibihe bitazoshira.
