Imana ni yo buhungiro bgacu n’inkomezi zacu, N’umufasha atabura guseruka mu magorwa.
Ni co gituma tutazotinya, nah’ isi yohinduka, Nah’ imisozi yoshingūrwa ikaja mw idamba ry’ibiyaga;
Nah’ amazi yavyo yobomborana, agasuriranya, Nah’ imisozi yotigitishwa no kwitera hejuru kwayo.
Harih’ uruzi, amazi yarwo anezereza umurwa w’Imana, Ni wo hēra har’ amahema y’ Isumba vyose.
Imana iri hagati muri wo, ntuzonyiganyizwa; Imana izowutabara mu mutwenzi w’amacāca.
Abanyamahanga bavugije urwamo, ibihugu vy’abami biravuguswe; Ivuze ijwi ryayo, isi irashonga.
Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo ari kumwe natwe, Imana ya Yakobo n’ubuhungiro bgacu.
Ni muze, murābe ibikorwa vy’Uhoraho, Ingene yarekuriye ubugesera mw isi.
Aca intambara gushitsa ku mpera y’isi, Avunagura imiheto, amacumu arayacagagura, Imikogote ikwegwa n’amafarasi ayiturira mu muriro.
Ni mwisigireho, mumenye kw ari jewe Mana; Nzoshirwa hejuru mu mahanga, nzoshirwa hejuru mw isi.
Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo ari kumwe natwe, Imana ya Yakobo n’ubuhungiro bgacu.
Yemwe mahanga yose, ni mukome amashi; Muvugirize Imana impundu zo kunesha.
Kuk’ Uhoraho asumba vyose ateye ubgoba, N’Umwami ahambaye aganza isi yose.
Aduha guhagarara amahanga ku gakanu, Ashira amoko musi y’ibirenge vyacu.
Adutoraniriza umwandu wacu, Ni wo vyirato vya Yakobo, uwo yakunze.
Imana idūze mu mpundu, Uhoraho adūze mu majwi y’ inzamba.
Muririmbire Imana ishimwe, muririmbe ishimwe: Muririmbire Umwami wacu ishimwe, muririmbe ishimwe.
Kukw Imana ar’ Umwami w’ isi yose, Muririmbishe ishimwe ryayo indirimbo ironkeshejwe ubgenge.
Imana irahangamye mu mahanga; Imana iravyagiye ku ntebe yayo yera.
Abaganwa b’amahanga bashengejwe No guhinduka abantu b’Imana ya Aburahamu. Kukw inkinzo z’abo mw isi ar’ iz’ Imana; Ni yo ishizwe hejuru cane.
Uhoraho arahambaye, abereye gushimirwa cane Ku murwa w’Imana yacu, ku musozi wayo wera.
Umusozi Siyoni, uri mu ruhande rw’i burārūko, Igihagararo cawo ni ciza, ni wo binezaneza vy’isi yose, Ni wo murwa w’Umwami ahambaye.
Imana yimenyekanishije mu ngoro zo kuri wo kw ar’ igihome kirekire gikīngira abantu.
Kand’ abami barakorakoranye, Bawurenganira icarimwe,
Barawurāba, baca baratangara, Bacika ivutu, bahunga vuba.
Agatengo kabafatirayo, N’uburibge, nk’ibise vy’umugore aramutswe.
Usāvya amāto y’i Tarushishi, Uyasābishije umuyaga uturutse i burasirazuba.
Nk’uko twumvise, ni ko twabibonye Ku murwa w’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, ku murwa w’Imana yacu: Imana izowushimangira ibihe vyose.
Mana, twiyumviriye imbabazi zawe Turi mu rusengero rwawe.
Mana, nk’ukw izina ryawe riri, Ni kw ishimwe ryawe riri, gushitsa ku mpera y’isi; Ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo kwuzuye ukugororoka.
Umusozi Siyoni unezerwe, Abakobga ba Yuda bahimbarwe Kubg’ imanza ziroranye zawe.
Mugendagende kuri Siyoni, muwukikuze, Muharūre iminara yaho,
Mwitegereze cane inzitiro zaho z’amabuye, Mwiyumvire ingoro zaho: Kugira ngo muze muvyīgānire ab’ igihe kizoza.
Kukw iyi Mana ar’ Imana yacu ibihe bitazoshira, Ni yo izoturōngōra gushitsa ku rupfu.
Yemwe mahanga mwese, ni mwumve ibi; Yemwe abari mw isi mwese, ni mutege amatwi:
Aboroshe n’abahambaye, Abatunzi n’aboro bose hamwe.
Akanwa kanje kagira kavuge ivy’ ubgenge, Umutima wanje ugira wiyumvire ivy’ ugutahura.
Ndabangira ugutwi umugani, Ubupfindo bganje ndabupfindurisha inanga.
N’iki cotuma ntinya mu misi y’ivyago, Ah’ ukugabitanya kw’abansi banje kunkikije?
Abishimira ubutunzi bgabo, Bakirata ibihinda vy’ivyo batunze,
Nta n’umwe ashobora gucungura mugenzi we na gatoya, Canke guha Imana incungu yiwe:
Kukw incungu y’ubugingo bgabo ar’ iy’ igiciro, N’iyo kurekwa ibihe bidashira.
Nta womucungura ngw az’ abeho ibihe vyose, Yoye kubona rwa rwobo.
Kukw abona kw abanyabgenge bapfa, Igipfu n’ikijuju bikarandukana, Bagasigarana abandi ubutunzi bgabo.
Imva ni zo zizoba imigerēro yabo y’ibihe bidashira: Ni ho bazoba ibihe vyose, Nah’ amashamvu yabo bāri bāyitiriye amazina yabo.
Yamar’ umuntu ntiyamana icubahiro, Ameze nk’ibikōko bipfa gusa.
Ayo ni yo maherezo y’abiyizigira, N’abahimbarwa n’ivyabo ni yo matahiro.
Bacūrirwa i kuzimu nk’umukuku w’intama, Rupfu azobaragira: Abatunganye bukeye bazobaganza; Ubgiza bgabo i kuzimu hazobuhabga ngo habumare, ntibugire aho kuba.
Arikw Imana yo izocungura ubugingo bganje, ibukūre mu kuboko kw’i kuzimu, Kukw ari yo izonyakīra.
Ntuz’ ugire ubgoba umuntu ni yatunga, Icubahiro c’inzu yiwe kikagwira:
Kuko ni yahwera atazogira ico ajana, Icubahiro ciwe ntikizomanuka ngo kimukurikire.
Naho yibarira akiriho kw ahiriwe, Kandi naho bashima umuntu yitungiye;
Azohamvya ba sekuruza Batazobona umuco ukundi.
Umuntu afise icubahiro ntagire n’ubgenge Ameze nk’ibikōko bipfa gusa.
Inyabushobozi, Imana Rurema, Uhoraho aravuze; Ahamagaye isi, uhereye i burasirazuba, ugashitsa aho rirengera.
Kuri Siyoni h’ubgiza buhebuje Ni ho Imana ikayanganiye.
Imana yacu izoza, kandi ntizocereza: Imbere yayo umuriro uzotongora, Izokikizwa irya n’ino n’inkūbi y’umuyaga.
Izohamagara ijuru ryo hejuru N’isi na yo; kugira ngw icire abantu bayo urubanza,
Iti Munkoranirize hano abakunzi banje Bāsezeranye nanje basezeranisha ikimazi.
Ijuru rizoserura ukugororoka kwayo: Kukw Imana ubgayo ari yo mucamanza.
Bantu banje ni mwumve, nanje ndavuga, Wa bgoko bga Isirayeli, ndashinga intahe: Ni jewe ubganje Mana, Imana yawe.
Sinkugayira ibimazi vyawe; Ibimazi vyawe vyoshejwe vyama imbere yanje na ntaryo.
Sinzokwākīra imasa yo mu rugo rwawe, Cank’ amasuguru y’impene zo mu mpongore zawe,
Kukw ibikōko vyose vyo mu kibira ar’ ivyanje, N’inka zo ku misozi y’ibihumbi.
Ndazi inyoni n’ibisīga vyose vyo ku misozi, N’ibikōko vyo ku gahinga n’ ivyanje.
Nogize inzara sinorinze kukubgira, Kukw isi ar’iyanje n’ibiyuzuye.
Mbega nzorya inyama z’amapfizi, Canke nzonywa amaraso y’ impene?
Uz’ ushikanire Imana ikimazi co gukenguruka; Īsumba vyose uyishitsekw amasezerano yawe.
Uz’ unyambaze ku musi w’ amagorwa, Nzogukiza, nawe uzompesha icubahiro.
Arik’ umunyakibi Imana iramubaza, Iti Wiruhiriza iki kubarira abandi amabgirizwa yanje, Ugashira isezerano ryanje mu kanwa kawe?
K’ur’ inyankaguhanwa, Ugashiburira amajambo yanje inyuma yawe!
Iy’ ubonye umusuma, wemeranya na we, Kandi wifatanya n’abasambanyi.
Uhaye ikibi akanwa kawe, Ururimi rwawe rwigenera ubugunge.
Uganama uvuga nabi uwo muvukana, Urementaniriza mwene nyoko bgite.
Ivyo urabikora, nanje ngahora, Ukiyumvira yuko mpwanye nawe rwose: Ariko nzoguhana, mbishire imbere y’amaso yawe, uko bikurikirana.
None rero yemwe abibagira Imana, ni mwiyumvire ibi, Noye kubashishimura, hakabura uwobakiza:
Umuntu wese anshikanira ikimazi c’ishimwe aba ampesheje icubahiro: Kand’ ūtunganya ingeso ziwe Nzomwereka agakiza k’Imana.
Ngirira ikigongwe Mana, kubg’ imbabazi zawe: Kubg’ isinzi ry’imbabazi zawe usibanganye ibicumuro vyanje.
Unyuhagire rwose ukugabitanya kwanje, Unyoze icaha canje.
Kuko nzi ibicumuro vyanje, Icaha canje cama imbere yanje na ntaryo.
Ni wewe, ni wewe ubgawe, nacumuyeko, Nakoze ikibi mu nyonga zawe: Vyabaye birtyo kugira ng’ uboneke k’ugororotse ni wavuga, Kand’ uboneke k’uroranya ni waca urubanza.
Rāba, nabumbanywe ukugabitanya, Mu vyaha ni ho mama yamvyariye.
Rāba, ugomba ukuri hirya mu mutima, Mu bgigobeko bgawo uzommenyesha ubgenge.
Unyezeshe ezobu, ndera: Unyuhagire ndaba derere kurusha uko shelegi yera.
Unyumvishe umunezero n’ uguhimbarwa, Kugira ngw amagufa wavunnye anezerwe.
Hisha inyonga zawe ivyaha vyanje, Usibanganye ibigabitanyo vyanje vyose.
Mana, undememw’ umutima utunganye: Unsubizemw’ umutima uhamye.
Ntunte kure yo mu nyonga zawe, Ntunkūreko Mpwemu wawe Yera.
Unkomōrere umunezero w’ agakiza kawe; Unshigikirishe umutima ushize icīra.
Ni ho nzokwigisha inzira yawe abacumura, Abanyavyaha baguhindukirire.
Unkize umwenda w’amaraso y’umuntu, Mana, we Mana y’agakiza kanje; Ni ho ururimi rwanje ruzorenza ijwi ruririmba ukugororoka kwawe.
Mwami, teranura iminwa yanje, Ni ho akanwa kanje kazokwamamaza ishimwe ryawe.
N’uk’ utanezererwa ibimazi, mba mbigushikaniye: Ntuhimbarwa n’ibimazi vyoshejwe.
Ibimazi Imana ishikanirwa n’umutima umenetse; Umutima umenetse, ujanjaguwe, Mana, ntuzowukēngēra.
Ugirire neza i Siyoni, nk’uko haguhimbara; Wubake inzitiro z’amabuye z’i Yerusalemu.
Ni ho uzonezerwa n’ibimazi bitunganye, ni vyo bimazi vyoshejwe, n’ibimazi vyoshejwe bidasonōye; Ni ho bazoshikanira amamasa ku gicaniro cawe.
Wa muhizi we, n’iki gitumye wirata inzigo? Imbabazi z’Imana zihorah’ ibihe vyose.
Ururimi rwawe rwigenera kugeseza, Rumeze nk’urupfuhe rukarishe, rukora ivy’ ubugunge.
Ukunda ibibi kubirutisha ivyiza, N’ukubesha kukurutisha kuvuga ukuri.
Wa rurimi rw’ingunge we, Ukunda amagambo yose ayongobeza abantu.
Nawe Imana izogucuranguza gushitsa ibihe vyose, Izokuraha, igushikure mw ihema ryawe, Ikurandurane n’imizi igukūre mw isi y’abariho.
Abagororotsi na bo bazobibona biyubare, Bamutwenge,
Bati Rāba, uyu ni we atāhinduye Imana igihome kimukīngira, Ariko yizigira ibihinda vy’ ivyo atunze, Akiha inkomezi mu bubi bgiwe.
Ariko jeho mmeze nk’igiti ca elayo kiremvye co mu rugo rw’Imana: Nizigira imbabazi z’Imana kugeza ibihe bitazoshira.
Nzogushima ibihe vyose, kukw ari wewe wabikoze: Nzokwitega izina ryawe imbere y’abakunzi bawe, kukw ari ryiza.
Igipfu cibgira mu mutima, ngo Nta Mana iriho. Bārononekaye, bākoze ivy’ ukugabitanya vyo kwankwa urunuka, Nta wukora ivyiza.
Imana icishiriza mu bana b’abantu, iri mw ijuru, Kugira ngw irābe ko harimw’ abatāhūra, Barondera Imana.
Bose bāsubiye inyuma; bose banduye hamwe; Nta wukora ivyiza, eka nta n’umwe.
Mbeg’ inkozi z’ibibi zose nta bgenge zifise? Ko barya abantu banje nk’uko barya umutsima, Kandi ntibambaza Imana.
Aho nyene bahacikiye umuhongo, ata kiwubaciye, Kukw Imana yakwiragije amagufa y’uwashagarije kugutera: Warabatetereje, kukw Imana yabahinyuye.
Icompa agakiza k’Abisirayeli kakaba kaje kava i Siyoni! Imana ni yasubizay’ abantu bayo bājanywe ar’ inyagano, Ni ho aba Yakobo bazovuza impundu, Abisirayeli bakanezerwa.
Mana, nkirisha izina ryawe, Ucishe urubanza rwanje inkomezi zawe.
Mana, umviriza ugusenga kwanje; Tegera ugutwi amajambo yo mu kanwa kanje.
Kukw abanyamahanga bāmpagurukiye, N’abantu b’ibirara barondeye ubugingo bganje, Batāshize Imana imbere yabo.
Eh’ Imana n’umufasha wanje, Umwami ni we aramira ubugingo bganje.
Abansi banje azobasubizakw iyo nabi; Ubahonnye kubg’ ukuri kwawe.
Nzogushikanira ikimazi kivuye imbere mu mutima: Uhoraho, nzoshima izina ryawe kukw ari ryiza;
Kuk’ Uhoraho yankijije amagorwa yose, Ijisho ryanje rikībonera abansi banje.
Mana, tegera ugutwi ugusenga kwanje; Ntiwihishe ukwinginga kwanje.
Zirikana unyumve, unyishure: Nembembeshwa n’amajojwa yanje, ndaniha;
Kubg’ ijwi ry’umwansi, Kubg’ agahahazo k’abanyakibi. Kuko bandundakw amagorwa, Bakampīgana inzigo.
Umutima wanje umbabariza cane imbere, Ubgoba bginshi bg’urupfu bunguyeko.
Gutinya n’ukuja mu gatengo binshitseko, Ngwishijwe igihūmura no gucika ivutu.
Ndavuga, nt’ Icompa nkagira amababa nk’inuma! Mba ngurutse, nkaruhuka.
Rāba, mba nyerereye ngashika kure, Nkarāra mu bugaragwa.
Mba mpungiye vuba mu buhungiro, Nkikinga igihuhuta n’inkūbi y’umuyaga.
Mwami, ubayongobeze, uyoberanye indimi zabo: Kuko nabonye umuryano n’ intambara mu gisagara;
Ku murango no mw ijoro bagendagenda hejuru y’inzitiro z’amabuye zaco; Kandi kugabitanya n’inzigo biri hagati muri co;
Ibibi biri hagati muri co: Agahahazo n’ubugunge ntibiva mu nzira zaco.
S’umwansi yantutse, Vyari kumbera ibitwarika; Cank’ uwanyanka si we yanyishimye hejuru, Mba naramwinyegeje.
Ariko ni wewe, urunganwe rwanje, Uwo twagendana, umukunzi wanje pfampfe.
Twashira hamwe twinovorana, Tukagendagendana n’ishengero mu ngoro y’Imana.
Urupfu rubazeko giturumbuka, Bamanuke baje i kuzimu bakibona, Kuko gukora ivyaha kuri mu ngo zabo no mu mitima yabo.
Jeho nzokwambaza Imana, Uhoraho azonkiza.
Ku mugoroba no mu gitondo no mu mashōka nzokwama niganyira, ncura umuniho, Na we azokwumva ijwi ryanje.
Yacunguye ubugingo bganje ngo bube mu mahoro, kugira ngo ntibanyegēre, Kukw abandwanya ari benshi.
Imana izonyumva, ibacishe bugufi, Ni yo ihora ihangamye uhereye kera hose.. Izocisha bugufi abatigeze bahīndāna, Batubaha Imana.
Wa wundi yarāmvuye amaboko ngw arwanye abābana na we amahoro, Yahumanije isezerano ryiwe.
Akanwa kiwe kanyerera nk’ amavuta, Arik’ umutima wiwe warimw’ intambara gusa; Amagambo yiwe yaremba kurusha amavuta ya elayo, Ariko yar’ inkota zisokowe.
Ukorere Uhoraho umutwaro wawe, na we azokuramira: Ntazokwigera akundira umugororotsi kunyiganyizwa.
Ariko wewe Mana, ba bandi uzobamanukana muri rwa rwobo rw’amahonero; Abicanyi n’ingunge ntibazocagatiza imisi y’ubugingo bgabo; Ariko jeho nzokwama nkwizigira.
Mana, ngirira ikigongwe, kukw abantu bashaka kummira; Biriza umusi bandwanya bampahaza.
Abansi banje biriza umusi bashaka kummira, Kukw abandwananya agakēngērwe ari benshi.
Igihe cose ntinye Nzokwizigira.
Imana izompa gushima ijambo ryayo, Imana ni yo nizigiye, sinzotinya; Non’ abantu boshobora kuntwara iki?
Biriza umusi bagoreka amajambo yanje, Ivyiyumviro vyabo vyose n’ ivyo kungirira nabi.
Barakorana, bakinyegeza, Bakagenza ibirenge vyanje, Kuko babundiye ubugingo bganje.
Mbeg’ ukugabitanya kwabo kuzobakiza? Mana, uburake bgawe ubutsindishe hasi amahanga.
Uharūra iminihiro yanje: Ushire amosozi yanje mw icupa ryawe; Mbega ntiyanditswe mu gitabo cawe?
Maz’ abansi banje bazosubizwa inyuma ku musi nzotakambako: Ivyo ndabizi, kukw Imana iri mu ruhande rwanje.
Imana izompa gushima ijambo ryayo; Uhoraho azompa gushima ijambo ryiwe.
Imana ni yo nizigiye, sinzotinya; Non’ abantu boshobora kuntwara iki?
Mana, amasezerano nagusezeraniye ari kuri jewe, Kandi nzogushikanira ibimazi vy’ishimwe.
Kuko wakijije ubugingo bganje urupfu, N’ibirenge vyanje mbega ntiwabikijije gutsitara? Ngo mbone ingene ngendera imbere y’Imana Mu muco w’abakiriho.
Ngirira ikigongwe Mana, ngirira ikigongwe, Kuk’ ubugingo bganje buronka ubuhungiro muri wewe: Mbere no mu gitūtu c’ amababa yawe ni ho ngira mpungire, Gushitsa ah’ ibi vyago birenganira.
Ndatakambira Imana isumba vyose, Ni yo Mana immarira vyose.
Izotuma iri mw ijuru inkize, Ūshaka kummira ni yantuka.. Imana izotuma imbabazi zayo n’ukuri kwayo.
Ubugingo bganje buri hagati y’intambge: Ndyama hagati y’abaka umuriro, Ni bo bana b’abantu, amenyo yabo n’amacumu n’imyampi; Ururimi rwabo n’inkota ikarishe.
Mana, n’ushirwe hejuru y’ amajuru, Icubahiro cawe kibe hejuru y’isi yose.
Bateze ibirenge vyanje umutego; Umutima wanje uricurikiriye. Bimvye icobo imbere yanje: Baba ari bo bakirokeramwo.
Mana, umutima wanje urahamye, umutima wanje urahamye: Ndaririmba, mbere ndaririmba ishimwe.
Ewe bgiza bganje, ni wikangure; kembe n’inanga ni mwikangure: Nanje ubganje nzokwikangura ntange umutwenzi.
Mwami nzogushimira mu moko: Nzokuririmbira ishimwe mu mahanga,
Kukw imbabazi zawe ari nyinshi zishika mw ijuru, Ukuri kwawe gushika no mu bicu.
Mana, n’ushirwe hejuru y’ amajuru, Icubahiro cawe kibe hejuru y’isi yose.
Mbeg’ ugucereza ni kwo mucisha imanza zibereye? Yemwe bana b’abantu, mbega muca imanza zigororotse?
Oyaye, mugabo mukorera ivyo kugabitanya mu mitima yanyu; Umuryano w’amaboko yanyu ni wo rubanza mucira mu gihugu.
Abanyakibi batandukanywa n’ Imana uhereye ku kuva mu nda za ba nyina: Iyo bavutse baca bizimagiza, bakabesha.
Ubumara bgabo bumeze nk’ ubg’ inzoka: Bameze nk’imamba itumva, yiziba amatwi,
Itumva ijwi ry’abagunzi, Naho bayigundisha ubupfumu.
Mana, ubavune amenyo mu kanwa kabo: Uhoraho, uhongagure amajigo y’iyo migunza y’intambge.
Ni bakamangane nk’amazi ashēshwe; Bakigenekereza imyampi ibe nk’ibishishibano.
Babe nk’igifyera kiyaga kigashira; Babe nk’inda ikorotse, itigeze kubona izuba.
Inkono zanyu zitarumva umuriro w’inkwi z’amahwa, Imana izozikūzah’ agashururu, imbisi n’izifashwe zose.
Umugororotsi azonezerwa ni yabona ukwo guhōra: Azokwogesha ibirenge vyiwe amaraso y’ababi.
Bizotuma abantu bavuga, bati N’ukuri har’ impēra y’ abagororotsi: N’ukuri harih’ Imana icira imanza mw isi.
Mana yanje, unkize abansi banje: Unshire hejuru y’abampagurukiye.
Unkize inkozi z’ibibi, Undinde abavisha amaraso.
Kuko rāba, babundiye ubugingo bganje; Abahizi barankoraniye, Atari kubg’ icanje gicumuro cank’ icanje caha, Uhoraho.
Barirukanga bakitegura, batagira ico bampōra. Vyukuruka unsanganire, uvyitegereze:
Wewe nyene, Uhoraho Mana Nyen’ ingabo, Mana y’ Abisirayeli, Vyuka ugīre amahanga yose, Ntugire abanyabicumuro babi ugirira ikigongwe.
Bataha ku mugoroba bagwangwara nk’imbga, Bakagendura igisagara.
Ehe badudubiza amagambo mabi mu kanwa kabo, Inkota ziri mu minwa yabo: Kuko bibgira, bati Ni nde avyumva?
Ariko weho Uhoraho, uzobatwenga; Uzokwegurwa n’agashinyo ku mahanga yose.
Ewe nkomezi zanje, nzokwitega: Kukw Imana ari yo gihome kirekire kinkīngira.
Imana mboneramw’ imbabazi izonsanganira, Imana izompa kwibonera abandyamiye.
Ntubice, abantu banje boye kwibagira: Ubasābagirishe ubushobozi bgawe, ubacishe bugufi, Mwami, nkinzo idukīngira.
Amagambo yo mu minwa yabo ni yo gicumuro c’ akanwa kabo, Ubgibone bgabo bubafate nk’ umutego, Bo n’imivumo n’ibinyoma bavuga.
Ubamarane uburake, ubamare, boye kubah’ ukundi; Kugeza ku mpera y’isi Bamenye yukw Imana ari yo iganza aba Yakobo.
Ba bandi baze batahe ku mugoroba, bagwangware nk’imbga, Bagendure igisagara.
Bahunahuna hose barondera inyama; Ni batāhāga bakesha ijoro.
Ariko jeho nzoririmba inkomezi zawe; Mbere mu gitondo nzoririmba imbabazi zawe n’ijwi rirenga: Kuko wambereye igihome kirekire kinkīngira, N’ubuhungiro ku musi w’ amagorwa yanje.
Ewe nkomezi zanje, ni wewe nzoririmbira ishimwe: Kukw Imana ari yo gihome kirekire kinkīngira, n’Imana mboneramw’ imbabazi.
Mana, uradutaye, uradusambuye: Wararatse; n’udusubizemw’ intege.
Watumye igihugu gihinda agashitsi, uragisatagura: Zibira ubunyenyagu bgaco, kuko kinyiganyiga.
Weretse abantu bawe ibigoye, Watunywesheje vino zidandabagiranya.
Wahaye abakwubaha ibendera, Kugira ngo ryerekanwe kubg’ ukuri.
Kirisha ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo, unyishure, Kugira ngw abo ukunda barokorwe.
Imana yatanze indahiro ku kwera kwayo, iti Nzonezerwa, Nzogabura i Shekemu, kandi nzogaburisha amabango umwonga w’i Sukoti.
Gileyadi n’ahanje, umuryango wa Manase n’uwanje; Uwa Efurayimu ni wo ukīngira umutwe wanje; Uwa Yuda ni wo cumu ry’ ubugabe bganje.
I Mowabu ni ho cogero canje, Abanyedomu nzobashiburirakw inkweto, Filisitiya, umvugirize impundu.
Ni nde azonshikana mu gisagara kizitijwe ibikomeye? Ni nde azonshikana muri Edomu?
Si wewe uzonshikanayo ga Mana yadutaye? Si wewe uzonshikanayo ga Mana itajana n’ingabo zacu?
Udutabare umurwanizi, Kuko gutabara kw’abantu ar’ ukw’ ubusa.
Imana izodukoresha ivy’ ubuhizi, Kukw ari yo izosiribanga abarwanizi bacu.
Mana, umva ugutakamba kwanje; Zirikana ugusenga kwanje.
Uhereye ku mpera y’isi nzoguhamagara, uk’ umutima wanje uzodendebukirwa: Unshire ku gitandara kirekire ntokwishitsako.
Kuko wambereye ubuhungiro, N’igihome kirekire kinkīngira umwansi.
Nzoba mw ihema ryawe ibihe bidashira, Nzohungira mu bgihisho bgo mu mababa yawe.
Kuko wewe Mana, wumvise amasezerano yanje: Umpaye umwandu uhabga abubaha izina ryawe.
Umwami uzomwongera iyindi misi, Imyaka yiwe izomara ibihe n’ibindi.
Azokwama ar’ imbere y’ Imana ibihe bidashira: Itegure imbabazi n’ukuri, kugira ngo bimuzigame.
Ni ho nzoririmbira izina ryawe ishimwe ibihe bidashira, Ngo nshitse amasezerano yanje uko bukeye.
Umutima wanje uhwekereye ku Mana yonyene: Ni yo agakiza kanje kandurukako.
Ni yo gitandara canje yonyene n’agakiza kanje, N’igihome kirekire kinkīngira: sinzosegenyeshwa cane.
Muzogeza hehe gutera umuntu, Ngo mumwice mwese, Nk’igisika gihengamye, nk’ uruzitiro rugira rutembe?
Nta kindi gituma baja inama, atar’ ukugira ngo bamutemvye ngw ave mu bukuru bgiwe; Bahimbarwa n’ibinyoma: Bahezagirisha akanwa, ariko bavumanisha imitima.
Mutima wanje, uhwekere ku Mana yonyene, Kukw ari yo ivyizigiro vyanje vyandurukako.
Ni yo gitandara canje yonyene n’agakiza kanje; N’igihome kirekire kinkīngira, sinzosegenyeshwa.
Imana ni yo irimw’ agakiza kanje n’icubahiro canje: Igitandara c’inkomezi zanje n’ubuhungiro bganje biri mu Mana.
Yemwe bantu, mwame muyizigira ibihe vyose: Musuke ivyo mu mitima yanyu imbere yayo: Imana ni yo itubera ubuhungiro.
N’ukuri abafafara ni nk’impwemu zihumetswe, kand’ abahambaye n’ibinyoma gusa: Ni bashirwa ku munzane, bazoteruka gusa; Bose hamwe bahwahutse kurusha impwemu zihumetswe.
Ntimwishimire agahahazo, Kandi ntimwizigire ubunyazi: Itunga ni ryagwira, ntimuze murishirekw imitima.
Imana yavuze rimwe; Navyumvise kabiri; Ngw Imana ni yo ifise inganji:
Kandi ni wewe Mwami, ufise imbabazi: Kuko wishura umuntu wese ibikwiranye n’ico yakoze.
Mana, ni wewe Mana yanje; nzozinduka nkurondere. Umutima wanje ukugirira inyota, umubiri wanje ukwifuriza Mu gihugu cumye, kiruhijwe, kitagira amazi.
Uko ni ko nagutumberereye ur’ ahēra hawe, Kugira ngo ndābe ubushobozi bgawe n’ubgiza bgawe.
Kukw imbabazi zawe zindutira ubugingo, Iminwa yanje izogushima.
Uko ni ko nzoguhimbaza, nkiriho: Nzotarika amaboko mw izina ryawe.
Umutima wanje uzohāzwa nk’ūriye umusokōro n’ibinure: Akanwa kanje kazogushimisha iminwa inezerewe,
Uko nzokwibuka ndi ku buriri bganje, Nkakwiyumvira mu bihe vy’ amaterama.
Kuko wambereye umufasha, Kandi nzovugiriza impundu mu gitūtu c’amababa yawe.
Umutima wanje ukwōmako: Ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo kurandamira.
Arikw abashaka kunyica ngo banzimirize Bazoja epfo i kuzimu.
Bazoshirwa mu bubasha bg’ inkota, Bazoba umugabane w’imbgebge.
Arik’ umwami azonezererwa Imana, Ūyirahira wese azokwirata: Kukw akanwa k’ababesha kazozibga.
Mana umva ijwi ryanje mu majojwa yanje, Kiza ubugingo bganje gutinya umwansi.
Nnyegeza inama zo mu mpisho z’abakora nabi, N’imivurungano y’inkozi z’ ibibi:
Bakubiriye indimi zabo nk’ inkota, Bagenekereje imyampi yabo, ni yo magambo arura:
Kugira ngo barase ūtunganye bari mu mpisho: Bamurasa giturumbuka ata bgoba.
Biremeshesha imigabo mibi, Baja inama zo gutega imitego mu mpisho; Bakibgira, bati Ni nde azoheza akayibona?
Barondera inama mbi; bakibgira, bat’ Inama twarondera turayinogeje. Kuk’ ubgenge bg’umuntu n’ umutima wiwe vyigobetse.
Arikw Imana izobarasa, Bazokomeretswa n’umwampi giturumbuka.
Uko ni ko bazotsitazwa, urwabo rurimi bgite ruzobarwanya: Abababona bose bazozunguza imitwe.
Kand’ abantu bose bazotinya; Bamenyekanishe igikorwa c’ Imana, Biyumvirishe ubgenge ivyo yakoze.
Umugororotsi azonezererwa Uhoraho, amwizigire; Kand’ abafise imitima itunganye bose bazovuza impundu.
Mana, i Siyoni bagushimisha agahwekere, Kuri wewe bazoshitsa amasezerano.
Wewe wumva ivyo usabga, Abafise umubiri bose bazoza kuri wewe.
Ukugabitanya kwinshi kurannesheje, Arikw ibicumuro vyacu uzobizimanganya.
Hahirwa umuntu utoranya, ukamwiyegereza, Kugira ngw abe mu nyubakwa zawe: Tuzohāzwa n’ivyiza vyo mu ngoro yawe, Vy’ahēra ho mu rusengero rwawe.
Uzotwishurisha ibiteye ubgoba kubg’ ukugororoka, Mana y’agakiza kacu: Ni wewe vyizigiro vy’abo ku mpera zose z’isi, N’ivy’ abari kure ku kiyaga.
Iyo ni yo ishimangirisha imisozi inkomezi zayo, Ikenyeye ubushobozi.
Izibiza kubomborana kw’ibiyaga, kubomborana kw’imipfunda yavyo, N’imivurungano y’amahanga.
Kand’ ababa ku mpera z’isi batinya ibimenyetso vyawe: Uvugisha impundu iy’ igitondo gituruka n’iy’ umugoroba uturuka.
Ugendera isi, ukayirekurira imvura, Uyitungisha cane; Uruzi rw’Imana rwuzuye amazi; Ni wewe wereza abantu impeke, umaze kuhatunganya urtyo.
Uringaniza amaburi yaho, Urekurira imvura mu myanya yo muri yo, Uhorohesha imvura y’akajogotere; Uha ukumera kwaho umugisha.
Wambika umwaka kugira neza kwawe nk’igitsibo, Mu burari bgawe handagaza umugisha,
Wandagara ku miyonga yo mu bugaragwa: Imisozi igakenyera umunezero.
Imikuku yambaye imiyonga, Imyonga yeramw’ impeke zirayitwikira; Isemerezwa n’umunezero ikaririmba.
Yemwe abari mw isi yose, muvugirize Imana impundu:
Muririmbe mwerekana icubahiro c’izina ryayo, Muhimbaze ishimwe ryayo.
Mubgire Imana, mut’ Ereg’ ibikorwa vyawe biteye ubgoba! Ubushobozi bgawe bginshi buzotuma abansi bawe bose bakwunamira baguhema.
Abo mw isi yose bazogusenga, Bakuririmbire: Bazoririmbira izina ryawe.
Ni muze murābe ibikorwa vy’Imana, Iteye ubgoba ku vyo igirira abana b’abantu.
Yahinduye ikiyaga ahūmūtse, Kandi baciye mu ruzi n’ ibirenge: Aho ni ho twayinezererewe.
Iganzisha ubushobozi bgayo ibihe bidashira; Inyonga zayo zitegereza amahanga: Abagarariji ntibishire hejuru.
Yemwe mwa mahanga, ni muhimbaze Imana yacu, Mwumvikanishe ijwi ry’ishimwe ryayo.
Izigama ubugingo bgacu ntibupfe, Kandi ntikundira ibirenge vyacu ko bitirimuka.
Kuko Mana wadukwanguye; Watuvugutiye nk’uko bavugutira ifeza.
Watuzanye mu mutego, Waduhekesheje umutwaro uremereye mu mugongo.
Wahaye abantu kuduhonyangisha ku gakanu amafarasi bagenderako, Twaciye mu muriro no mu mazi; Maz’ udukūramwo, udushira ahantu hatūritse.
Ndinjirana ibimazi vyoshejwe mu ngoro yawe, Ndagushitsakw amasezerano yanje,
Amwe yanteranuriye iminwa, Akanwa kanje kakayavuga, hamwe nari mu mubabaro.
Ndagushikanira ibimazi vyoshejwe vy’amatungo avyibushe, N’umubabge w’amapfizi y’ intama; Ndashikana amamasa bo n’ impene.
Yemwe abubaha Imana mwese, ni muze mwumve, Nanje mvuge ivyo yagiriye ubugingo bganje.
Nayitakambishirije akanwa kanje, Ururimi rwanje rwarayihimbaje.
Iyaba nari nshize umutima wanje ku vyo kugabitanya Umwami Imana ntaba yaranyumviye.
Ariko vy’ukuri Imana iranyumviye, Yabangiye ugutwi ijwi ry’ ugusenga kwanje.
Imana ihimbazwe, Itirukanye ugusenga kwanje, kand’ itānkūyekw imbabazi zayo.
Imana itugirire ikigongwe, iduhe umugisha, Itwakishirize mu nyonga hayo.
Kugira ngw inzira yawe imenyekane mw isi, N’agakiza kawe mu mahanga yose.
Mana, amoko agushime, Amoko yose agushime.
Amahanga anezerwe, aririmbishwe n’akanyamuneza: Kuk’ uzocira amoko imanza ziroranye, Kand’ uzorōngōra amahanga mw isi.
Mana, amoko agushime, Amoko yose agushime.
Isi irimbuka ivyimburo vyayo; Imana, ni yo Mana yacu, izoduha umugisha.
Imana izoduha umugisha; Kand’ abo ku mpera zose z’isi bazoyubaha.
Imana ikūre hasi, abansi bayo basābagire, Kand’ abayanka na bo bahunge bave imbere yayo.
Nk’uk’ umwotsi utumuka, abe ari k’ubatumura: Nk’ukw ishashara iyagira i ruhande y’umuriro Abe ari kw abanyakibi barandukira imbere y’Imana.
Arikw abagororotsi ni banezerwe, bavugirize impundu imbere y’Imana: Mbere banezerwe, bagire akanyamuneza.
Ni muririmbire Imana, muririmbire izina ryayo ishimwe: Muharurire umuharuro Imwe ica mu bugaragwa igendera mu mukogote ukwegwa n’ amafarasi; Izina ryayo ni YA; ni muvugirize impundu imbere yayo.
Imana ir’ ahayo hēra Ni se w’impfuvyi, n’umucamanza ahagarikira abapfakazi.
Imana ishira mu ngo abatagira shinge na rugero, Ibohora imbohe, ikaziha kugubga neza: Arikw abagarariji bakaba mu gihugu cumye.
Mana, hamwe waja imbere y’abantu bawe, Hamwe wagenda mu bugaragwa;.
Isi yahinze agashitsi, Amajuru ashongera imbere y’Imana: Sinayi uriya uhindira agashitsi imbere y’Imana, ni yo Mana y’Abisirayeli.
Mana, warekuriye ishamvu yawe imvura y’ubuntu: Wahashubijemw’ intege hamwe hari harushe.
Abantu bawe bayigerereyemwo: Mana witeguriye umugorwa kubgo kugira neza kwawe.
Umwami Imana yaravuze: Abagore bakwiza inkuru baba ingabo nyinshi.
Abami bari kumwe n’ingabo barahunga, barahunga: Umugore asigaye mu rugo ni we agabanganya iminyago.
Mukiryama mu mpongore z’ intama, amababa y’inuma akayanganakw ifeza, N’amoya yayo akayanganakw izahabu y’umuhondo.
Hamwe Īshobora vyose yashwiragiriza abami mu gihugu, Shelegi yarikw iragwa kuri Tsalumoni.
Umusozi w’i Bashani n’umusozi w’Imana, Umusozi w’i Bashani n’umusozi w’udutwe twinshi.
Mwa misozi miremire, n’iki gituma murābana ishari Umusozi Imana yagomwe ngw iwubeko? Mbere, Uhoraho azowubakw ibihe bidashira.
Imikogote y’Imana n’ibihumbi cumi, ibihumi cumi, Mbere n’ibihumbi n’ibihumbi: Umwami Imana ari hagati yayo; Sinayi ur’ ahēra ho mu rusengero.
Uradūze, uja iyo hejuru, ujanye iminyago, Uhērewe ingabire hagati y’ abantu: Mbere uzihērewe hagati y’ abagarariji na bo, kugira ng’ Uhoraho Imana abane na bo.
Umwami ahimbazwe, atwikorerera umutwaro uko bukeye, Ni we Mana itubera agakiza.
Imana itubera Imana y’agakiza, idukiza kenshi; Kand’ Uhoraho, Umwami, ni we ashobora gukūra mu rupfu.
Arikw Imana izomenagura imitwe y’abansi bayo, N’agahanga kamerak’ umushatsi k’umuntu wese ashishikara kugendera mu bimutsindisha.
Umwami Imana yaravuze, ati Nzobagarukana bave i Bashani, Nzobagarukana bave i bgina mu kiyaga:
Kugira ng’ ushire ikirenge cawe mu maraso, Kandi ngw indimi z’imbga zawe zihabge imitigiri y’ abansi bawe.
Mana, bārāvye ingendo yawe, Ingendo y’Imana yanje, ni yo Mwami wanje, yinjira ahēra.
Abaririmvyi bagiye imbere, abacuraranzi barabakurikira, Hagati y’abigeme bavuza udushako tw’ingoma.
Muhimbarize Imana mu makoraniro, Ni yo Mwami, yemwe abākomotse kw isōko ari yo Isirayeli.
Nguriya umuryango wa Benyamini umuhererezi, ni wo ubagaba, Bo n’abaganwa b’aba Yuda n’ingabo zabo, N’abaganwa b’aba Zebuloni, n’abaganwa b’aba Nafutali.
Imana yawe ikugereye inkomezi, Mana, komeza ivyo wadukoreye;
Kubg’ urusengero rwawe i Yerusalemu Abami bazokuzanira ingorore.
Enda ni wāmire ca gikōko co mu rufunzo, N’amapfizi menshi n’inyana zo mu mahanga, Gushitsa aho bazogukomera amashi, bakugororere amafeza: Sābagiza amahanga ahimbarwa n’intambara.
Abaganwa bazoza bavuye muri Egiputa, Etiyopiya hazokwihutira kurāmvurira Imana amaboko yaho.
Yemwe bihugu vy’abami bo mw isi, muririmbire Imana; Muririmbire Umwami ishimwe;.
Ni we agendera kw ijuru ryo hejuru y’amajuru yose, ryamyeho uhereye kera hose: Rāba avuga ijwi, ijwi rihambaye.
Mwaturire Imana kw ifise ubushobozi, Ubgiza bgayo buri hejuru y’Abisirayeli, Ubushobozi bgayo buri mu bicu.
Mana, urateye ubgoba ur’ ahēra hawe: Imana y’Abisirayeli ni yo iha abantu bayo inkomezi n’ ubushobozi. Imana ihimbazwe.
Nkiza Mana: Kukw amazi ashitse no ku bugingo bganje.
Ndadobeye mw ishayo imira, idafise aho gushinga ikirenge: Nshitse mu mazi amira, ah’ umukuba undengera.
Kurira kwanje kuranduhije; umuhogo urūmye: Amaso yanje yākobotse nkirorereye Imana yanje.
Abanyankira ubusa baruta umushatsi wo ku mutwe wanje mu bginshi: Abagomba kundandura, banyankishwa n’inyanduruko z’ibinyoma, barahambaye: Ni ho narihishijwe ico ntatwaye.
Mana, ni wewe uzi ubupfu bganje: Ivyaha vyanje ntubinyegejwe.
Mwami, Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, abakurorereye ntibaze bamāramāzwe kubganje: Mana y’Abisirayeli, abakurondera ntibaze batēterezwe kubganje.
Kuko nihanganira ibitutsi bakumpōra; Isoni zitwikiriye mu maso hanje.
Mpindutse akavantara ku bo tuvukana, Na murundi kuri bene mama.
Kukw ishaka ry’inzu yawe rindya; Ibitutsi vy’abagutuka vyaguye kuri jewe.
Aho narira, ngahanisha umutima wanje kwisonzesha, Vyampindukiye ibitutsi.
Aho nagize amagunira kuba imyambaro yanje, Nabahindukiye iciro ry’imigani.
Abicara kw irembo baramvuga; Nd’ indirimbo y’ababorewe.
Ariko jeho, amasengesho yanje ari kuri wewe, Uhoraho: Mana, mu gihe co kwemererwamwo, kubg’ isinzi ry’ imbabazi zawe, Unyishurishe ukuri kw’agakiza kawe.
Unshayure mw ishayo, sindobere: Nkizwe abanyanka, nkizwe n’amazi maremare.
Umukuba ntuntware, Mw idamba ntihammire: Rwa rwobo ntirundumanirizek’ umunwa warwo.
Uhoraho unyishure, kukw imbabazi zawe ari nziza: Unkebuke, nk’uko kugira neza kwawe ari kwinshi.
Kandi ntuhishe umusavyi wawe mu nyonga hawe; Kuko ngowe: unyishure vuba.
Wēgēre ubugingo bganje, ubukize: Uncungure kubg’ abansi banje.
Ni wewe uzi ukuntu ntukwa, n’ukuntu ntēterezwa, n’ ukuntu nkēngērwa: Abarwanizi banje bose bar’ imbere yawe.
Ibitutsi vyammenaguye umutima, ndaremerewe cane: Nareretse ko har’ uwongirira akagongwe, nta wabonetse; N’uko har’ abonyirura, ndabura.
Kandi bāmpaye umururazi kuba ivyo kurya vyanje; Ngize inyota bampa inkarisha ngo ndayinywe.
Ameza yabo ahinduke ururiba imbere yabo: Bakiri mu mahoro, ahinduke umutego.
Amaso yabo n’ahumwe, ntibabone; Wame uhindisha agashitsi ikiyunguyungu cabo.
Ubasukek’ ugushangashirwa kwawe, Uburake bgawe bg’inkazi bubahamvye,
I wabo hasigare imisaka, Kandi ntihakagire ūba mu mahema yabo.
Kuko bahama uwo wakubise; Kandi bongeranya umubabaro w’abo wakomerekeje.
Ibigabitanyo vyabo ubibasubirize mu nkōko: Ntibaze binjire mu vy’ukugororoka kwawe.
Basibanganywe mu gitabo c’ ubugingo, Ntibaze bandikanwe n’abagororotsi.
Ariko jeho nd’umugorwa, ndababaye; Mana, agakiza kawe kanshire hejuru.
Nzotazirisha izina ry’Imana indirimbo: Nzoyihimbarisha ishimwe ry’ ivyo yankoreye.
Ivyo bizohimbara Uhoraho kurusha impfizi, Cank’ imasa ifise amahembe n’inzāra.
Abaciye bugufi bazobirāba banezerwe; Yemwe abarondera Imana, imitima yanyu isubizwemw’ ubugingo.
Kuk’ Uhoraho yumva abakene, Ntakēngēra imbohe ziwe.
Ijuru n’isi ni bimushime, N’ibiyaga n’ibibigendamwo vyose.
Kukw Imana izokiza Siyoni, ikubaka ibisagara vya Yuda; Bazohaba, hababere ishamvu.
Kand’ uruvyaro rw’abasavyi bayo ruzoharagwa; Abakunda izina ryayo bazohagerēra.
Mana, tebuka unkize; Uhoraho, tebuka untabare.
Abashaka kunyica Bicwe n’isoni batētērwe: Abanezerezwa n’uko ngiriwe nabi Basubizwe inyuma bakēngērwe.
Abavuga bati Ha ha ha ha! Basubizwe inyuma bamāramāre.
Abakurondera bose bakunezererwe bahimbarwe, Abakunda agakiza kawe baze bame bavuga, Bat’ Imana irahambaye!
Ariko jeho nd’ umugorwa, nd’ umukene: Mana, n’unyaruke uze iyo ndi: Ni wewe mutabazi wanje n’ umurokozi wanje; Uhoraho, ntutebe.
Uhoraho, ni wewe mpungirako: Sinze nigere mmāramāzwa.
Unkize kubg’ ukugororoka kwawe, undokore: Umbangire ugutwi, unkize.
Umbere igitandara co kubamwo, aho nzoshobora kwama mpungira: Wangereye kunkiza, Kukw ari wewe gitandara canje n’igihome kinkīngira.
Mana yanje, ngobotora mu kuboko kw’umunyakibi, Ngobotora mu kuboko kw’ umugabitanyi w’ikirara.
Kukw ari wewe vyizigiro vyanje, Mwami Uhoraho: Ni wewe nizera, uhereye mu buto bganje,
Ni wewe wamye unyishigikiriye uhereye mw ivuka ryanje: Ni wewe wankūye mu nda ya mama: Ishimwe ryanje rizokwama kuri wewe.
Mmeze nk’igitangaza kuri benshi: Ariko ni wewe buhungiro bganje bukomeye.
Akanwa kanje kazokwuzura ishimwe ryawe, N’icubahiro cawe umusi wīre.
Ntunte mu gihe c’ubutāma, Ntumpebe mu gihe intege zanje zishize.
Kukw abansi banje bamvuga, Ababundira ubugingo bganje baja inama:
Bat’ Imana yamuhevye; Mumwirukire, mumufate, kukw atagira uwo kumukiza.
Mana, ntumbe kure: Mana yanje, tebuka untabare.
Abarwanizi b’ubugingo bganje bicwe n’isoni baranduke; Abarondera ingene bongirira nabi bambikwe ibitutsi n’ agakēngērwe.
Ariko jeho nzokwama nizigira ubudasība, Nzokwiyongeranya kugushima.
Akanwa kanje kazovuga inkuru y’ukugororoka kwawe, N’iy’ agakiza kawe umusi wīre: Kuko ntazi igitigiri cavyo.
Nzoza mvuga ibikorwa bihambaye vy’Umwami Uhoraho, Nzovuga ukugororoka kwawe, mber’ ukwawe kwonyene.
Mana, ni wewe wanyigishije, uhereye mu buto bganje, Kugeza n’ubu ndacavuga ibikorwa vyawe bitangaje.
Mana, ntumpebe, kugeza no mu butāma bganje mmeze imvi; Ntarabarira ab’ igihe kizoza amaboko yawe, Ntarabarira abazovuka bose inkomezi zawe.
Mana, ukugororoka kwawe gushika hejuru kure: Ni wewe wakoze ibikomeye, Mana, ni nde ahwanye nawe?
Ni wewe watweretse amagorwa menshi akomeye, Uzokwongera uturabūre, Uzokwongera udukūre i bgina i kuzimu.
Unyongeranirize ubukuru, Uhindukire, unyirure.
Nanje nzogushimisha ikembe; Mana yanje, nzoshima ukuri kwawe: Ni wewe nzoririmbira ishimwe mvugira inanga, Ewe Wera w’Abisirayeli.
Iminwa yanje izonezerwa cane aho nzokuririmbira ishimwe; N’ubugingo bganje wacunguye buzonezerwa.
Kand’ ururimi rwanje ruzovuga ukugororoka kwawe burinde bgīra: Kukw abarondera kungirira nabi bishwe n’isoni batēterewe.
Mana, uhe umwami uguca imanza kwawe, Uhe umwana w’umwami ukuroranya kwawe.
Azocira abantu bawe iziroranye, N’abagorwa bawe abacire iz’ ukuri.
Kuroranya imanza kuzotuma imisozi miremire N’uturambi bizanira abantu amahoro.
Azocira imanza abagorwa bo mu bantu, Akize abana b’abakene, Avunagure umunyagahahazo.
Bazomwubaha izuba rikiriho, Bo n’ukwezi, gushitsa ibihe vyose.
Azomanuka nk’imvura igwa ku vyatsi bitemwe, Nk’imvura y’umuvuvu itosa isi.
Mu misi yiwe abagororotsi bazororanirwa, Kandi hazosēndēra amahoro, gushitsa ah’ ukwezi kuzoviraho.
Azoganza uhereye ku kiyaga ugashitsa ku kiyaga kindi, Kand’ uhereye kuri rwa Ruzi, ugashitsa ku mpera y’isi.
Ababa mu bugaragwa bazomwunamira, Abansi biwe bazorigata umukungugu.
Abami b’i Tarushishi n’abo ku bizinga vyo mu kiyaga bazozana amashikanwa, Abami b’i Sheba n’ab’i Seba bazogorora ingorore.
Mber’ abami bose bazomwikubita imbere, Amahanga yose azomusaba.
Kukw azokiza umukene ah’ azotakambira, N’umugorwa atagira gitabara.
Azogirira akagongwe uworoshe n’umukene, Amagara y’abakene azoyakiza.
Azobacungura, abakize agahahazo n’umuryano; Kand’ amaraso yabo azoba ay’ igiciro mu nyonga ziwe.
Nukw azoramba, kandi bazomukūrira kw izahabu y’i Sheba; Bamusengere urudaca, Bamuhezagire burinde bgīra.
Hazokwera impeke habe agahimbo mu gihugu no ku mpinga z’imisozi; Mw igarura ryavyo bizohungabana nk’ibiti vyo kuri Lebanoni: Abo mu gisagara bazororanirwa batotahare nk’ubgatsi bgo mw isi.
Izina ryiwe rizohorah’ ibihe bidashira, Izina ryiwe rizogira uruvyaro, izuba rikiriho: Abantu bazokwisabira umugisha wo guhwana na we, Amahanga yose azomwita umuhirwe.
Uhoraho Imana, ni yo Mana y’Abisirayeli, ihimbazwe; Ni yo yonyene ikora ibitangaza:
Izina ryayo ry’icubahiro rihimbazwe ibihe bidashira; Kand’ isi yose yuzure icubahiro cayo; Amen, kandi Amen.
Amasengesho ya Dawidi mwene Isayi ararangiye.
N’ukuri Imana igirira neza Abisirayeli, Abafise imitima itanduye.
Ariko jeho, ibirenge vyanje kāri gato bigatirimuka, Intambuko zanje zari zishigaje gatoya zikanyerera.
Kuko nagirira ishari abībone, Aho nabona abanyakibi baguwe neza.
Kuko badasamba mw ipfa ryabo, Arikw amagara yabo arakomera.
Ntibagira amagorwa nk’abandi, Ntibaterwa n’ivyago nk’abandi.
Ni co gituma ubgibone buba nk’urudede mu mazosi yabo, Umuryano ukabambika nk’ impuzu.
Amaso yabo avanywe i mutwe no kuvyibuha, Bafise ibiruta ivyo umutima wokwifuza.
Baracokora, bakavugishwa ivy’ agahahazo n’ukugabitanya kwabo: Bavuga bīshize hejuru.
Bashize akanwa kabo mw ijuru, Ururimi rwabo ruyerera mw isi yose.
Ni co gituma abantu biwe bagaruka, Bakīrāngūza amazi yuzuye mu gikombe,
Bakavuga, bat’ Imana ibibgirwa n’iki? Īsumba vyose har’ ico izi?
Ereg’ abo ni bo banyavyaha: Kandi bama bīdibamiye, ubutunzi bgabo buragwira.
N’ukuri nogereje ubusa umutima wanje, Ukudacumura nagukarabiyemw’ ubusa.
Kuko natewe n’ivyago umusi ukīra, Ngahanwa mu gitondo n’ igitondo uko bukeye.
Iyo mba naravuze, nti Reka mvuge ntyo; Mba narahemukiye abana bawe.
Niyumviriye ingene noshobora kubimenya, Biba ibiruhije mu maso yanje.
Gushitsa aho nagīriye ahēra h’Imana, Nkībaza iherezo rya ba bandi.
N’ukuri ubashira ahanyerera; Ubakororera mu mahonero.
Erega bārahonnye mu kanya gato! Ubgoba bg’uburyo bginshi burabamaze.
Nk’ukw inzozi zimeze, iy’ umuntu yikanguye, Ni ko nawe, Mwami, ni wikangura, uzobakēngēra nk’ibiravūswe.
Ah’ umushaha wanje wababara, Ngatēkerwa n’umubabaro mu mutima,
Nar’ ikijuju, nar’ imburabgenge, Namera nk’igikōko imbere yawe.
Yamara rero namana nawe na ntaryo, Umfashe ukuboko kw’i buryo.
Uzondōngōza inama ungīriye, Kandi hanyuma uz’ unyakīrane icubahiro.
Ni nde mfise mw ijuru, atari wewe? Kandi mw isi nta we ngomba, atari wewe.
Umubiri wanje n’umutima wanje bishira umunywera, Arikw Imana ni yo gitandara umutima wanje uhungirako, kandi ni yo mugabane wanje ibihe vyose.
Kukw abakuja kure bazoranduka; Wahoneje abakuretse bose bagacika ibimaka.
Ariko jeho kwēgēra Imana ni kwo kumbereye amahirwe: Umwami Uhoraho ni we ngize ubuhungiro, Kugira ngo namamaze ibikorwa wakoze vyose.
Mana, n’iki catumye uduca tukaba ruhebga? N’iki gituma uburake bgawe bupfunduka nk’umwotsi, ubgo urakira intama zo mu canya cawe?
Ibuka ikoraniro ryawe waguze kera, Iryo wacunguriye kuba ubgoko bg’ishamvu yawe, Bo n’umusozi Siyoni, aho wagerereye.
Shingūra inyundo zawe, uje mu bitongozi vy’intahava: Abansi bākoreye ahēra ibibi vyose.
Abarwanizi bawe bātontomeye hagati y’aho twakoranira kugusenga: Bāshinze amabendera yabo ngw abe ibimenyetso.
Bameze nk’abantu babanguye incabiti Ngo bace ibiti vy’inzitane.
Non’ ivyabājwe vyaho vyose Barabimenaguza incabiti n’ inyundo.
Bāturiye ahēra hawe: Bāhumanije ubuvyagiro bg’ izina ryawe, barahasangangura rwose.
Bībariye mu mitima yabo, bati Tubageseze rwose; Bāturiye amazu yose yo mu gihugu, yakoranirwamwo gusenga Imana.
Ntitubona ibimenyetso vyacu, Nta wuvugishwa n’Imana akiriho: Kandi nta n’umwe muri twebge azi ah’ ivyo bizogarukira.
Mana, umurwanizi azogeza hehe kudutuka? Mbeg’ umwansi azorogota kw izina ryawe ibihe vyose?
N’iki gituma upfunya ukuboko, ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo? Gukūre mu gikiriza cawe, ubamare.
Arikw Imana yahoze ar’ Umwami wanje uhereye kera, Ivy’ agakiza ibikorera hagati mw isi.
Ni wewe watandukanishije ikiyaga inkomezi zawe, Wameneye mu mazi imitwe y’ibikōko,
Ni wewe wamenaguye imitwe y’ingona, Warayitanze, iba ivyo kurya vy’ivyo mu bugaragwa.
Ni wewe watoboye isōko n’ umugezi, Wakamije inzūzi zitokamye.
Umurango n’uwawe, kand’ ijoro na ryo n’iryawe: Waremye umuco n’izuba.
Ni wewe washizeh’ imbibe zose z’isi, Waremye ici n’agatasi.
Ibuka ibi: yukw abansi bakwinantajeko, Uhoraho; Ihanga ritagira ubgenge ryarogose kw izina ryawe.
Ntugaburire ibikōko ubugingo bg’inuma yawe: Ntiwibagire ubugingo bg’abagorwa bawe gushitsa ibihe vyose.
Zirikana rya sezerano: Kukw ahantu h’umwiza ho mw isi hagwiriye indāro z’umuryāno.
Impahazwa yoye kugaruka itēterewe: Umugorwa n’umukene ni bashime izina ryawe.
Mana, haguruka wībūranire: Ibuka yukw ikijuju cīriza umusi kigutuka.
Ntiwibagire amajwi y’abarwanizi bawe: Urwamo rw’abaguhagurukira rwama rudūga intumbgejuru.
Mana, turagushima; Turagushima kukw izina ryawe riri hafi. Abantu bakwiza ibikorwa bitangaza wakoze.
Igihe nashinze ni cashika, Nzoca imanza ziroranye.
Iy’ isi inyiganyize, bo n’ abayibako bose, Ni jewe ngumije inkingi zayo.
Mbgira abirata, nti Ntimukirate; N’abanyakibi, nti Ntimukavyure ihembe ryanyu.
Ntimukavyure ihembe ryanyu ngo muritunge kw ijuru, Ntimukavuge mushimantaje amazosi.
Kuko gushirwa hejuru kudaturuka i burasirazuba cank’ i burengerazuba, Canke mu bugaragwa bgo ku misozi.
Arikw Imana ni yo mucamanza: Icisha umwe bugufi, igashira uwundi hejuru.
Kuko mu ntoke z’Uhoraho har’ agakarabo, karimwo vino ibira: Kuzuye vino ituriranije, arayisuka: N’ukuri abanyakibi bo mw isi bazokwīrāngūza urukoma rwayo, barunywe.
Ariko jeho nzokwama mvyamamaza ibihe vyose, Nzoririmbira Imana ya Yakobo ishimwe.
Kand’ amahembe yose y’ abanyakibi nzoyakōndōra; Arikw amahembe y’abagororotsi azoshirwa hejuru.
Mu Bayuda Imana ni rurangiranwa: Mu Bisirayeli izina ryayo rirahambaye.
Kand’ i Salemu ni ho hema ryayo, I Siyoni ni ho buvyagiro bgayo.
Ni ho yavunaguriye imyampi yo mu muheto, N’inkinzo n’inkota n’ibirwanishwa vy’intambara.
Ur’ uw’ icubahiro n’ubgiza bginshi, utabarutse mu misozi yuzuye iminyago.
Abarindutse mu mitima baranyazwe, basinzira ubutikoma, Kandi nta bo mu banyenkomezi bashoboye kwivuna.
Mana ya Yakobo, uguhana kwawe Kwatumye imikogote n’amafarasi ayikwega bisinzirira guhwera.
Wewe, ni wewe nyene uteye ubgoba: Ni nde yoshobora guhagarara mu nyonga zawe umaze kuraka?
Wumvikanishije amateka uri mw ijuru: Isi yaratinye, iracereza,
Hamwe Imana yahagurutswa no guca amateka, Ngw ikize abaciye bugufi bose bo mw isi.
N’ukuri uburake bg’abantu buzogushimisha, Uburake buzoba busigaye uzobukenyera.
Musezerane isezerano, murishitse k’Uhoraho Imana yanyu: Uwo Nyene gutinywa, abamukikije bose bamuzanire ingorore.
Ni we amara igabo abaganwa, Agatera ubgoba abami bo mw isi.
Ndatakambira Imana n’ijwi ryanje, Ndatakambira Imana n’ijwi ryanje, na yo irantega ugutwi.
Ku musi w’umubabaro wanje narondeye Umwami Imana: Ukuboko kwanje mw ijoro kwararāmvuwe, ntikwatenzura; Umutima wanje wanka kwirurwa.
Nibuka Imana, ngahagarika umutima: Ndiganyira, umutima wanje ukadendebukirwa.
Ufata ibigohe vy’amaso yanje kugira ngo simpumirize: Mpagaritse umutima bituma ntashobora kuvuga.
Niyumviriye imisi ya kera, Imyaka y’ibihe vya kera.
Nibuka indirimbo yanje yo mw ijoro, Nkibaza mu mutima; Umutima wanje ugasesana umwete,
Uti Mbeg’ Umwami azoduca tube ruhebga? Ntazosubira kuduhangaza ukundi?
Mbeg’ imbabazi ziwe zagīriyeko rwose ruhebga? Isezerano ryiwe ryapfaniranye gushitsa ibihe vyose?
Mbeg’ Imana yibagiye kugira neza? Uburake bgayo butumye yugarana imbabazi zayo?.
Maze ndavuga, nt’ Ivyo n’ indwara iri muri jewe: Mbega ko niyumviriye yuk’ ukuboko kw’i buryo kw’ Īsumba vyose guhinduka!
Nzovuga ibikorwa vy’Uhoraho, Kuko nzokwibuka ibitangaza vyawe vya kera.
Nzokwiyumvira ivyo wakoze vyose, Nshire umutima ku bikomeye wakoze.
Mana, inzira yawe ir’ ahēra; Ni nde mana ihambaye ihwanye n’Imana Rurema?
Ni wewe Mana ikora ibitangaza: Wamenyekanishije inkomezi zawe mu mahanga.
Wacunguje abantu bawe ukuboko kwawe, Ni bo ruvyaro rwa Yakobo na Yosefu.
Mana, amazi yarakubonye, Amazi yarakubonye, aratinya: I bgina hahinda agashitsi.
Ibicu bisuka amazi, Ijuru rirahinda, Imyampi yawe igenda agashwaro.
Imituragaro y’inkuba yawe yari mu gashururu: Imiravyo ibonesha mw isi, Isi ihinda agashitsi, iratigita.
Inzira yawe yari mu kiyaga, Inzira zawe zari mu mazi agaranzutse, Ibirenge vyawe ntivyari n’ akehe.
Warōngōje abantu bawe nk’ ubusho Ukuboko kwa Mose na Aroni.
Bgoko bganje, ni mutegere ugutwi ukwigisha kwanje: Mubangire amatwi amajambo yo mu kanwa kanje.
Ndateranura akanwa kanje, nce imigani, Ndavuga amajambo apfinze ya kera.
Ivyo twumvise tukamenya, Ivyo ba sogokuruza bātubariye,
Ntituzobihisha abuzukuruza babo, Tuzobgira ab’ igihe kizoza ishimwe ry’Uhoraho, N’inkomezi ziwe n’ibikorwa bitangaje yakoze.
Kuko yashimangiye igishingantahe mu ba Yakobo, Yashizeh’ icagezwe mu Bisirayeli, Ico yageze ba sogokuruza, Ngo baze babibarire abana babo:
Kugira ngw ab’ igihe kizoza baze babimenye, ni bo bana bazovuka; Ngo na bo baze bahaguruke, babibarire abana babo.
Kugira ngo bizigire Imana, Kandi ntibibagire ivyo Imana yakoze, Ariko ngo bitondere ivyagezwe vyayo.
Boye kuba nka ba sekuruza, Rwa runganwe rw’ibigāba kandi rw’abagarariji, Urunganwe rw’abatitunganiriza imitima, Imitima yabo itayoboka Imana.
Abefurayimu naho bāri bafise ibirwanishwa batwaye imiheto, Bākimiranye ku musi w’intambara;
Ntibitondeye isezerano ry’ Imana, Banse kugendera mu vyagezwe vyayo;
Bibagiye ivyo yakoze, N’ibikorwa vyayo bitangaje yaberetse.
Yakoreye ibitangaza mu maso ya ba sekuruza Mu gihugu ca Egiputa, mu gahinga k’i Sowani.
Yasatuye ikiyaga, ibacisha hagati yaco; Ihagarika amazi nk’ikirundo.
Kandi ku murango yabarōngōza igicu, Ijoro ryose ikabarōngōza kubonesha kw’umuriro.
Yasaturiye ibitandara mu bugaragwa, Ibanywesha amazi menshi nk’ ayava i bgina.
Kandi mu gitandara yagikūyemw’ amasōko, Itembesha amazi nk’inzūzi.
Yamara ntibāsība kuyicumurako, Bakagarariza Īsumba vyose bari mu gihugu cumye.
Bagerageresha Imana imitima yabo, Bayigerageresha kwaka ivyo kurya vyo kubamara ipfa.
Bacurika Imana, Bati Mbeg’ Imana ishobora gutunganiriza ameza mu bugaragwa?
Rāba, yakubise ca gitandara, amazi aradudubiza, Imigezi iratemba; Mbega yoshobora kuduha n’ umutsima? Yoronkera abantu bayo inyama?
Ni co catumye Uhoraho avyumva, akaraka, Umuriro ukaziriringira aba Yakobo, Uburake bugapfunduka ku Bisirayeli,
Kuko batizeye Imana, Ntibizigire agakiza kayo.
Yamar’ ibarira ibicu vyo hejuru, Yugurura inzugi z’ijuru;
Ibarekurira manu yo kurya, igwa nk’imvura, Ibaha ku mihūre yo mw ijuru.
Bose barya umutsima w’ abahambaye, Ibarungikira ivyo kurya vyo kubahāza rwose.
Ihuhutisha mw ijuru umuyaga uturutse i burasirazuba, Irōngōza ububasha bgayo umuyaga uturutse i bumanuko.
Kand’ ibarekurira inyama zingana n’umukungugu, N’inyoni ziguruka zingana n’umusenyi wo ku kiyaga:
Izigwisha hagati y’aho bashagaje, Zikikiza insago zabo.
Nuko bararya, barahīmba; Yabahaye ivyo bifuje.
Bataribgatandukane n’ukwifuza kwabo, Ivyo kurya vyabo bikiri mu kanwa kabo,
Uburake bg’Imana bubakūrira hasi, Bgica abagabo b’abanyenkomezi bo muri bo, Butsinda hasi imisore yo mu Bisirayeli.
Nah’ ivyo vyababayeko, ntibāsība gucumura, Ntibizera ibikorwa vyayo bitangaje.
Bituma irangiza imisi yabo nk’impwemu zihumetswe, N’imyaka yabo iyirangiza mu kanya isase.
Uko yabica, bābaririza ivyayo, Bakagaruka bakazindukira kurondera Imana.
Bakibuka yukw Imana ari yo gitandara cabo, Kandi yukw Imana isumba vyose ari yo mucunguzi wabo.
Ariko bayihemesha akanwa kabo, Bakayibeshesha indimi zabo,
Kukw imitima yabo itāshikamye ngo babane na yo, Kandi batār’ abizigirwa mw isezerano ryayo.
Ariko yo, kuko yuzuye imbabazi, iharira ukugabitanya kwabo, ntibahonnye, Mbere kenshi iroresha irya uburake bgayo, Ntikangure uburake bgayo bgose:
Kandi yibuka yukw ar’ abantu buntu, N’umuyaga uhita ntugaruke.
Erega ni kenshi bayigaraririza mu bugaragwa, Bayibabariza mu karēre!
Bakihindukiranya, bakagerageza Imana, Bakaratsa Iyera y’Abisirayeli.
Ntibibuka ukuboko kwayo, Cank’ umusi yabacunguyeko, ikabakiza umurwanizi.
Kandi yuko yashize ibimenyetso vyayo muri Egiputa, N’ibitangaza vyayo mu gahinga k’i Sowani:
Igahindura inzūzi zabo amaraso, N’imigezi yabo, ntibashobore kugira ico banywa.
Yabarungitsemw’ amasinzi y’ ibibugu, birabarya; N’ibikere, birabageseza.
Kand’ iha inzikira imirima yabo, N’ivyo bāruhiye ibiha inzige.
Yicisha imizabibu yabo urubura, N’ibiti vyabo vy’imishikima ivyicisha igikonyozi.
Itanga inka zabo ngo zicwe n’urubura, N’imikuku yabo ngw ikubitwe n’inkuba.
Ibatera uburake bgayo bg’ inkazi, Uburake, n’ugushangashirwa, n’ivyago, Igitero c’abamarayika b’abaranduzi.
Iharurira uburake bgayo inzira; Ntiyabakiza urupfu, Arikw irabatanga ngo bicwe n’ikīza;
Yica abana b’imfura bose bo muri Egiputa, Imara ubuzibūra bgo mu mahema ya Hamu.
Arikw abantu bayo bgite ibashorera nk’intama, ibakūrayo, Ibarōngōra mu bugaragwa nk’umukuku.
Ibarōngōra amahoro, bituma badatinya: Arikw ikiyaga kirengera abansi babo.
Kand’ ibajana ku rugabano rw’ahēra hayo, Kur’ uyu musozi, ukuboko kwayo kw’i buryo kwaguze.
Yirukana amahanga imbere yabo, Ibakubitira amabango ahazoba ishamvu yabo, Yinjiza imiryango y’Abisirayeli mu mahema ya bano.
Yamar’ Abisirayeli bagerageza Imana isumba vyose, barayigarariza, Ntibitondera ivyo yashingiye intahe.
Ariko basubira inyuma, bava mw isezerano nka ba sekuruza: Barahusha, nk’umuheto utaye uruvuto.
Kuko bayirakishije ibitabo vyabo bātavye ku mpinga z’imisozi, Bayiteje ifūhe ibishushanyo vyabo vy’ibigirwamana.
Imana ivyumvise, iraraka, Yanka Abisirayeli urunuka.
Bituma iheba umugerēro w’i Shilo, Ni wo hema yashinze hagati y’abantu.
Itanga icubahiro cayo ngo kijanwe kw inyagano, N’ubgiza bgayo ngo buje mu maboko y’umurwanizi.
Kand’ itanga n’abantu bayo ngo bicwe n’inkota, Irakira ishamvu yayo.
Umuriro utongora imisore yabo, Abakobga babo nta ndirimbo y’ubukwe bāri bagifise.
Abaherezi babo bicwa n’ inkota, Abapfakazi babo ntibābaririra.
Maz’ Umwami Imana aribambura, nk’uwar’ asinziriye, Nk’umuhizi asemerezwa cane na vino.
Ikubita abarwanizi bayo, ibasubiza inyuma, Ibahindura ruvumwa rudashira.
Kand’ ihinyura ihema rya Yosefu, Ntiyatoranya umuryango wa Efurayimu;
Arikw itoranya umuryango wa Yuda, Umusozi Siyoni yakunze.
Yubaka urusengero rwayo rwera rusumba impinga z’ imisozi, Ruguma nk’isi yahamangiye gushitsa ibihe vyose.
Kand’ itoranya Dawidi umusavyi wayo, Imukūra mu mpongore z’ intama;
Imukūra mu gushorera intama zonsa, Kugira ngw aragire aba Yakobo abantu bayo, Abisirayeli ishamvu yayo.
Nukw abaragirisha umutima utunganye, Abashoreza ubuhinga bg’amaboko yiwe.
Mana, abanyamahanga bateye ishamvu yawe; Bahumanije urusengero rwawe rwera, Basanganguye Yerusalemu, hasigaye ar’ ibirundo vy’ amasakamburira.
Imivyimba y’abasavyi bawe bayihaye ibisīga vyo mu kirēre ngw ibe indya zavyo, Inyama z’abakunzi bawe bazihaye ibikōko vyo mw isi.
Amaraso yabo bayavishije impande zose z’i Yerusalemu nk’ūsēsa amazi: Ntihabonetse ūbahamba.
Duhindutse ruvumwa ku babanyi bacu, Agatwengo n’agacokoro ku badukikije.
Uhoraho we, uzogeza hehe kuraka ibihe vyose? Mbeg’ ifuhe ryawe rizokwama ryaka nk’umuriro?
Suka uburake bgawe ku mahanga atakuzi, No ku bgami bgose butambaza izina ryawe.
Kuko bātsontsomeye aba Yakobo, Bākomvomvoye ingo zabo.
Ntiwibuke ukugabitanya kwa ba sogokuruza ng’ ukuduhōre: Imbabazi zawe zinyaruke kudusanganira, Kuko ducishijwe bugufi cane.
Dutabare Mana y’agakiza kacu, kubg’ icubahiro c’izina ryawe: Uturokore, utwikire ivyaha vyacu kubg’ izina ryawe.
N’iki gituma abanyamahanga bavuga, ngw Imana yabo iri hehe? Ingen’ uhōra amaraso y’ abasavyi bawe yavuye Ni bimenyekane mu banyamahanga imbere yacu.
Kuniha kw’imbohe ni gushike imbere yawe; Nk’ukw inkomezi z’ukuboko kwawe ziri, kiza abagerewe gupfa.
Kand’ ababanyi bacu, ibitutsi bāgututse Mwami Ubibasubirize mu nkōko ibihetangabo ndwi.
Natwe abantu bawe, intama zo mu cibare cawe, Tuzobigushimira ibihe bidashira: Tuzokwerekana ishimwe ryawe gushitsa ibihe vyose.
Ewe Mwungere w’Abisirayeli, tega ugutwi, Ni wewe urōngōra aba Yosefu nk’umukuku; Ewe uvyagira ku Bakerubi, kayangana.
Kangura inkomezi zawe imbere y’aba Efurayimu n’aba Benyamini n’aba Manase, Uze kudukiza.
Mana utwigarurire, Umurikishe mu nyonga hawe, natwe turakira.
Uhoraho, Mana Nyen’ ingabo, Uzogeza ryari gupfunduka uburake urakira ugusenga kw’abantu bawe?
Wabagaburiye amosozi k’ umutsima, Wabahaye amosozi menshi yo kunywa.
Utumye ababanyi bacu baducuranwa; Abansi bacu batunegura bitwengera.
Mana, Nyen’ ingabo, utwigarurire, Umurikishe mu nyonga hawe, natwe turakira.
Wakūye umuzabibu muri Egiputa: Usohora amahanga, urawutera.
Urawurimirira, Na wo ushikana imizi kure, wuzura igihugu.
Imisozi itwikirwa n’igitūtu cawo, N’ibiti vy’amasederi vy’inganzamarumpu biterwa igitūtu n’amashami yawo.
Ushamika amashami, ashika no ku kiyaga, Amasango yawo ashika no kuri rwa ruzi.
N’iki catumye usambura inzitiro zawo, Ngw abahita bose bawamure?
Ingurube yo mu kibira irawonona, Ibikōko vyo mw ishamba birawona.
Garuka turakwinginze, Mana Nyen’ ingabo: Runguruka uri mw ijuru, ubirābe, ugendere uwo muzabibu,
Zigama ico ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo kwateye, N’ishami wikomereje.
Uwo muzabibu waraturiwe, waratemwe; Bahonejwe n’igitsure co mu nyonga hawe.
Ukuboko kwawe kube ku muntu agushiriye mu buryo, Ku mwana w’umuntu wirereye.
Nuko natwe ntituzosubira inyuma ngo tukuveko; Duhēmbūre, natwe turambaza izina ryawe.
Uhoraho Mana Nyen’ ingabo, utwigarurire, Umurikishe mu nyonga hawe, natwe turakira.
Muririmbishirize Imana ijwi rirenga, ni yo nkomezi zacu; Muvugirize Imana ya Yakobo impundu.
Shirako muririmbe zaburi, muvuze agashako k’ingoma, Mucurarange inanga nziza n’ ikembe.
Muvuze inzamba ukwezi kubonetse, N’iy’ ukwezi gufashe, ku musi wacu mukuru.
Kukw iry’ ari ryo bgirizwa ryashingiwe Abisirayeli, N’icagezwe n’Imana ya Yakobo.
Yagishinze mu ba Yosefu kuba igishingantahe, Aho yisidukira, ikūriye hasi igihugu ca Egiputa: Ni ho numvitiye ijwi ry’Uwo ntari nzi.
Ati Nakūye umutwaro ku rutugu rwawe, Amaboko yawe yabohowe ku gitebo.
Waratakamvye ugowe, ndakurokora: Nakwishuye nihishije mu nkuba: Nakugeragereje ku mazi y’i Meriba.
Bantu banje, ni mwumve, ndabihanikirize, Yemwe bantu ba Isirayeli, icompa mukantega amatwi!
Ntihakabe ikigirwamana c’ abanyamahanga muri mwebge, Kandi ntimukagire ikigirwamana c’abanyamahanga musenga.
Ni jewe Uhoraho, Imana yanyu, Nabakūye mu gihugu ca Egiputa: Asama cane, nanje nduzuza akanwa kanyu.
Arikw abantu banje ntibanyumviye; Abisirayeli baranyikunkumura.
Nanje ndabareka, ngo bakurikire ugukomantara kw’ imitima yabo, Ngo bagendere mu migabo bigeneye.
Icompa abantu banje bakanyumvira, Icompa Abisirayeli bakagendera mu nzira zanje!
Notsinda abansi babo vuba, Nohindurira ukuboko kwanje ku barwanizi babo.
Abansi b’Uhoraho bakamwunamira bamuhema: Ariko ba bandi bakaramba ibihe vyose.
Nobagaburira ingano zisētse neza: Kandi nobahāza ubūki buvuye mu mugina wo mu gitandara.
Imana ihagaze mw ikombe ryayo; Icira abacamanza urubanza,
Iti Muzogeza hehe kugoreka imanza, No gutinya abanyakibi ku kigohe?.
Mucire imanza umugoyigoyi n’impfuvyi; Mucire impahazwa n’umurushwa imanza zigororotse,
Mutabare umugoyigoyi n’ umukene, Mubakūre mu maboko y’abanyakibi.
Abo mbgiye nta co bazi, nta co batahura, Bagendagenda mu mwiza: Amatanguriro yose y’isi aranyiganyiga.
Ni jewe ubganje navuze, nti Mur’ imana, Mwese mur’ abana b’Īsumba vyose.
Ariko muzopfa nk’abantu, Muzotemba nk’umwe wo mu baganwa.
Haguruka Mana, ucire isi urubanza: Kuk’ uzogira amahanga yose ishamvu yawe.
Mana, reka kwihorera, Mana, ntupfe kunuma, ntiwirengagize:
Kukw abansi bawe bateye umuvurungano; Abakwanka bavyukije umutwe.
Banogangiriza inama y’ubugunge abantu bawe, Bagīra inama abo wahishije.
Baravuze, bati Ni muze tubarandure, ntibabe bakiba ihanga, Kugira ngw izina ry’Abisirayeli ntiribe ricibukwa ukundi.
Kuko ba bandi bahūje umutima wo kuja inama, Ni wewe bashiriyeh’ amasezerano:
Ni bo bo mu mahema ya Edomu n’Abishimayeli; Kandi n’Abanyamowabu n’ Abahagiri;
N’Abagebalu n’Abamoni n’ Abamaleki, N’Abafilisitiya n’ababa i Tiro:
N’Abashuri na bo bafatanije na bo; Batabaye aba Loti.
Ubagire nk’uko wagize Abamidiyani, Nk’uko wagize Sisera na Yabini ku ruzi rwitwa Kishoni:
Bāyogereye kuri Endori, Bācitse intabire y’imisozi.
Abapfasoni babo ubagire nka Orebu na Zebu; Abaganwa babo bose ubagire nka Zeba na Salumuna:
Kuko bavuze, bati Twinyagire Umurwa w’Imana.
Mana yanje, ubahindure nk’ umukungugu uvugutwa n’ agashururu, Nk’umuguruka utwarwa n’ umuyaga.
Nk’uk’ umuriro uturira ikibira, Nk’ukw imbeya zawo zifata imisozi:
Abe ari ko ubahīgīsha ikivumbuzi cawe, Ubacishe ivutu ikirura cawe.
Wuzuze mu maso habo isoni, Kugira ngo barondere izina ryawe, Uhoraho;
Bamāramāre, bahagarike imitima gushitsa ibihe bidashira, Bicwe n’isoni, bayogere:
Kugira ngo bamenye yuko wewe, uwitwa uhoraho, Kw ari wewe Usumba vyose, ukaganza isi yose.
Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, ereg’ amahema yawe n’ay’ igikundiro!
Ubugingo bganje buri n’ umuvuro, mbere budendebuwe no kwifuza inyubakwa z’Uhoraho; Umutima wanje n’umubiri wanje bivugiriza impundu Imana nzima.
Akanyoni kironkeye inzu, Intamba yironkeye icari, ah’ ishira ivyana vyayo, Ni ku bicaniro vyawe, Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, Mwami wanje, Mana yanje.
Hahirwa ababa mu ngoro yawe, Bama bagushima ubudasība.
Hahirwa umuntu inkomezi ziwe zihagaze muri wewe, Hahirwa abafise mu mitima amarango aja i Siyoni.
Iyo baciye mu mwonga witwa Marira, bawuhindura ahantu h’amariba, Mber’ imvura y’intasuro iwambika imigisha.
Bagenda bunguka inkomezi, Umuntu wese wo muri bo aseruka imbere y’Imana i Siyoni.
Uhoraho, Mana Nyen’ ingabo, umva ugusenga kwanje: Tega ugutwi, Mana ya Yakobo.
Mana, nkinzo yacu, ehe rāba: Witegereze mu maso y’Uwo warobanuje amavuta.
Kuko kumara umusi umwe mu nyubakwa zawe kuruta kumara iyindi igihumbi ahandi. Nopfuma mpagarara ku gisapfu c’ingoro y’Imana yanje, Hako noba mu mahema y’ abanyakibi.
Kuk’ Uhoraho Imana ar’ izuba, ar’ inkinzo; Uhoraho azotanga ubuntu n’ icubahiro: Ntazogira iciza na kimwe yima abagenda batunganye.
Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, Hahirwa umuntu akwizigira.
Uhoraho, wagiriye igihugu cawe imbabazi; Wagarukanye aba Yakobo bajanywe kw inyagano.
Wahariye ukugabitanya kw’ abantu bawe, Watwikiriye icaha cabo cose.
Wakūyeh’ uburake bgawe bgose, Warigaruye, ureka ubukare bg’uburake bgawe.
Twigarurire, Mana y’agakiza kacu, Kand’ ushire umwikomo wawe utugirira.
Mbeg’ uzoturakira ibihe bidashira? Uzokomeza uburake bgawe ibihe vyose?
Mbega ntuzokwongera kuturabūra, Kugira ngw abantu bawe bakunezererwe?
Twereke imbabazi zawe, Uhoraho we, Uduhe agakiza kawe.
Hinge numve ivyo Imana, Uhoraho, igira ivuge: Kukw izobgira abantu bayo n’abakunzi bayo ivy’ amahoro; Ariko ntibaze basubire mu bupfu.
N’ukuri agakiza kayo kari hafi y’abayubaha, Kugira ng’ubgiza bgayo bube mu gihugu cacu.
Imbabazi n’ukuri birahūye, Ukugororoka n’amahoro biragumbiranye.
Ukuri kubaye ikironge mw isi, Ukugororoka kwarungurutse kuri mw ijuru.
Kand’ Uhoraho azogaba ivyiza: Igihugu cacu kizokwimbuka ivyimburo vyaco.
Ukugororoka kuzomwitangira imbere, Kandi kuzoca mu makanda y’ibirenge vyiwe.
Uhoraho, ntegera ugutwi, unyishure, Kuko nd’ umugorwa, nd’ umukene.
Zigama ubugingo bganje kuko nd’ umukunzi wawe: Ewe Mana yanje, kiza umusavyi wawe akwizigira.
Ngirira ikigongwe Mwami, Kukw ari wewe ntakambira umusi ukīra.
Nezereza ubugingo bg’umusavyi wawe, Kukw ari wewe Mwami, ncurūrira umutima.
Kuko wewe Mwami, uri mwiza, ugabirije guharira, Kandi wuzuye imbabazi ku bakwambaza bose.
Uhoraho we, tegera ugutwi ugusenga kwanje: Umviriza ijwi ryo kwinginga kwanje.
Ku musi w’amarushwa yanje nzokwambaza, Kuk’ uzonyishura.
Nta gihwanye nawe mu bigirwamana, Mwami; Kandi nta bikorwa biriho bihwanye n’ivyawe.
Mwami, amahanga yose waremye azoza, akwikubite imbere, agusenge: Kandi bazohimbaza izina ryawe,
Kuk’ uhambaye, kand’ ukora ibitangaza: Ni wewe Mana wenyene.
Uhoraho, ndangira inzira yawe; nanje nzogendera mu kuri kwawe; Egeranya umutima wanje kugira ngo wubahe izina ryawe.
Mwami, Mana yanje, nzogushimisha umutima wanje wose; Nzohimbaza izina ryawe ibihe bidashira.
Kukw imbabazi umfitiye ari nyinshi; Kandi wakijije ubugingo bganje ngo ntibuje i bgina i kuzimu.
Mana, abibone barampagurukiye, Igitero c’abantu b’ibirara kirondera kunyica, Kandi ntibagushizek’ umutima.
Ariko wewe Mwami, ur’ Imana yuzuye imbabazi, ur’ inyabuntu, Uteba kuraka, ugira ikigongwe cinshi n’ukuri kwinshi.
Hindukira, ungirire ikigongwe; Uhe umusavyi wawe inkomezi zawe, Ukize umwana w’incoreke yawe.
Unyereke ikimenyetso c’ivyiza, Kugira ngw abanyanka bakirābe bamāramāre; Kuko wewe Uhoraho, untabaye, ukammara umubabaro.
Itanguriro yashizeho riri ku misozi yera.
Uhoraho akunda ibirimba vy’ i Siyoni Kubirutisha ingo zose z’aba Yakobo.
Ivy’ icubahiro bikuvugwako, Ewe murwa w’Imana.
Nzovuga i Rahabu n’i Babuloni, ko biri mu bo tuzinanyi: Ehe Filisitiya na Tiro bo na Etiyopiya; Abo ni ho bāvukiye.
Ni koko, bazovuga ivy’ i Siyoni, bat’ Aba n’aba ni ho bāvukiye. Kand’ Īsumba vyose ubgayo izohashimangira.
Uhoraho ni yandika amahanga, azoharūra, At’ Abo ni ho bāvukiye.
Abaririmvyi bo n’abavyinnyi bazovuga, Bat’ Amasōko yanje yose ari muri wewe.
Uhoraho, Mana y’agakiza kanje, Ntakambira imbere yawe ku murango no mw ijoro.
Ugusenga kwanje ni kuje gushika mu nyonga zawe: N’utegere ugutwi ugutakamba kwanje.
Kuk’ umutima wanje wuzuye imibabaro, Kand’ ubugingo bganje bgēgereye i kuzimu.
Mparūranwa n’abamanuka baja muri rwa rwobo; Mmeze nk’ūtagira gitabara:
Naterewe mu bapfuye, Mmeze nk’abishwe, baryamye mu mva, Abo utacibuka ukundi; Kandi batandukanye n’ukuboko kwawe.
Wanshize mu rwobo rwo hasi, Ahantu h’umwiza i bgina.
Uburake bgawe buranshikamiye, Kandi wambabarishije imipfunda yawe yose.
Washize kure yanje abo tuzinanyi; Wangize uwo kwankwa urunuka kuri bo: Ndugaranywe, sinshobora gusohoka.
Ijisho ryanje rirarotse kubg’ umubabaro: Nama ngutakambira uko bukeye, Uhoraho, Nkakwayira amaboko.
Mbeg’ uzokwereka abapfuye ibitangaza? Abahwereye bazozuka bagushime?.
Mbeg’ imbabazi zawe zizovugirwa mu mva? Canke k’ur’ umwizigirwa bizovugirwa mu mahonero?
Ibitangaza vyawe bizomenyekanira mu mwiza? Cank’ ukugororoka kwawe kuzomenyekanira mu gihugu c’abibagiranye?
Ariko, Uhoraho, ni wewe ntakambira, Kandi mu gitondo ugusenga kwanje kuzogusanganira.
Uhoraho we, n’iki gituma uta ubugingo bganje? N’iki gituma umpisha mu nyonga hawe?
Nahereye mu buto bganje mbabazwa, ndi mahwera: Mpagarika umutima uko ntewe n’ubgoba bgawe.
Uburake bgawe bg’inkazi burandengeye; Ubgoba unteye burandanduye.
Vyankikije nk’amazi umusi urīra; Vyanzengukiye vyose icarimwe.
Abakunzi banje n’abagenzi banje wabashize kure yanje, N’abo tuzinanyi baroye mu mwiza.
Nzoririmba imbabazi z’ Uhoraho gushitsa ibihe bidashira; Uk’ urunganwe rugenda rukurikira urundi, nzobamenyesha n’akanwa kanje k’ ur’ umwizigirwa.
Kuko navuze, nt’ Imbabazi zizokomezwa ibihe vyose, No mw ijuru ubgaho, uzohashimangira ukwizigirwa kwawe.
Nasezeranye isezerano n’uwo natoranije, Narahiye Dawidi umusavyi wanje,
Nti Nzoshimangira uruvyaro rwawe gushitsa ibihe bidashira; Ingoma yawe nzoyikomeza, gushitsa ibihe vyose.
Ijuru rizoshima ibitangaza vyawe Uhoraho; Rizoshimira mw ikoraniro ry’ abera k’ur’ uwo kwizigirwa.
Ni nde wo mw ijuru yogereranywa n’Uhoraho? Ni nde wo mu bana b’Imana ahwanye n’Uhoraho?
Ni we Mana iteye ubgoba bginshi mw ikoraniro ry’ abera, N’iyo gutinywa kurusha abayikikije bose.
Uhoraho Mana Nyen’ ingabo, Ni nde munyenkomezi ahwanye nawe, Uhoraho? Kuba umwizigirwa kwawe kuragukikije.
Ni wewe uganza ukwishira hejuru kw’ikiyaga: Iy’ imipfunda yaco ikūye hasi, urayizibiza.
Ni wewe wamenaguye Rahabu, hakamera nk’uwishwe: Abansi bawe wabasābagirishije ukuboko kw’inkomezi zawe.
Ijuru n’iryawe, isi na yo n’ iyawe: Isi n’ibiyuzuye, ni wewe washizeh’ itanguriro ryayo.
I burārūko n’i bumanuko ni wewe waharemye: I Tabora n’i Herumoni hanezererwa izina ryawe.
Ufise ukuboko kw’inkomezi, Ukuboko kwawe kurakomeye, ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo gushizwe hejuru.
Ukugororoka n’imanza zibereye ni vyo ingoma yawe ihagazeko: Imbabazi n’ukuri ni vyo bikwitangira imbere.
Hahirwa ihanga rizi ijwi ry’ impundu: Rigendera mu muco wo mu nyonga hawe, Uhoraho.
Banezererwa izina ryawe umusi ukīra: Kand’ ukugororoka kwawe ni kwo kubashirisha hejuru.
Kuk’ ur’ icubahiro c’inkomezi zabo: Imbabazi zawe ni zo zizoshirisha hejuru ihembe ryacu.
Kukw inkinzo idukīngira ar’ Uhoraho; Umwami wacu n’Uwera w’ Abisirayeli.
Ca gihe wabaririye abakunzi bawe nko mu nzozi, Uti Natabaye umunyenkomezi, Nashize hejuru uwatoranijwe mu bantu.
Nabonye Dawidi umusavyi wanje, Namurobanuje amavuta yanje yera:
Ikiganza canje kizokwama kibana na we, Ukuboko kwanje kuzomuha inkomezi.
Umwansi wiwe ntazomuzako giturumbuka, Kand’ umunyakibi ntazomuhahaza.
Nanje nzojanjagurira abarwanizi biwe imbere yiwe, Ntsinde hasi abamwanka.
Arikw imbabazi zanje no kuba umwizigirwa kwanje bizobana na we; Kand’ izina ryanje rizoshirisha hejuru ihembe ryiwe.
Nzoshira ikiyaga mu ntoke ziwe, N’inzūzi mu kuboko kwiwe kw’i buryo.
Azontakambira, ati Ni wewe Data, Imana yanje, igitandara c’ agakiza kanje.
Kandi nzomugira imfura yanje, Asumbe abami bo mw isi.
Nzomubīkira imbabazi zanje ibihe bidashira, Isezerano ryanje rizohama kuri we.
Kand’ uruvyaro rwiwe nzoruha kuramba gushitsa ibihe bidashira, Bo n’ingoma yiwe nk’imisi y’ ijuru.
Namb’ abana biwe bazoreka ivyagezwe vyanje, Ntibagendere mu vyo nageze;
Namba bazorenga ivyo nashinze, Ntibitondere amabgirizwa yanje,
Ni ho nzohanisha ibicumuro vyabo inkoni, No kugabitanya kwabo imiramu.
Ariko sinzomukūrako rwose imbabazi zanje, Sinzoreka kuba umwizigirwa.
Sinzova mw isezerano ryanje, Sinzohindura ijambo ryavuye mu kanwa kanje.
Igihe kimwe narahiye ukwera kwanje; Sinzobesha Dawidi;
Uruvyaro rwiwe ruzoramba gushitsa ibihe bidashira, Ingoma yiwe izohoraho nk’ izuba imbere yanje.
Izoshimangirwa gushitsa ibihe bidashira nk’ukwezi; Mw ijuru har’ icabona co kubishingira intahe co kwizigirwa.
Ariko none washiburiye kure uwo warobanuje amavuta, uramuheba, Waramurakiye.
Wanse urunuka isezerano ry’ umusavyi wawe, Wahumanishije igitsibo ciwe kugiterera hasi.
Wasanganguye inzitiro ziwe zose; Wakomvomvoye ibihome vyiwe.
Abahita bose baramunyaga: Ahindutse agakēngērwe ku babanyi biwe.
Washize hejuru ukuboko kw’i buryo kw’abarwanizi biwe, Wanezereje abansi biwe bose.
Mber’ usubiza inyuma ubugi bg’inkota yiwe, Kandi ntiwamuhaye guhagarara ashikamye mu ntambara.
Watumye ubgiza bgiwe bushira, Watereye hasi ingoma yiwe.
Wagabanije imisi y’ubusore bgiwe, Wamwambitse isoni.
Uhoraho we, uzogeza hehe kwihisha ibihe vyose? Uburake bgawe buzogeza hehe kwaka nk’umuriro?
Ibuka ingen’ igihe canje ari gito: Ereg’ abana b’abantu bose wabaremeye ubusa!
Ni nde muntu azoramba ntabone urupfu, Agakiza ubugingo bgiwe ukuboko kw’i kuzimu?.
Mwami, imbabazi zawe wahoranye ziri hehe, Izo warahiriye Dawidi mu kwizigirwa kwawe?
Mwami, ibuka ibitutsi batuka abasavyi bawe, Ingene ntwara mu gikiriza ibitutsi vy’amahanga yose ukw ari menshi;
Ivyo abansi bawe bādututse, Uhoraho, Ivyo bātutse intambuko z’ uwo warobanuje amavuta.
Uhoraho ahimbazwe ibihe bitazoshira. Amen, kandi Amen.
Mwami, wamye ur’ uburuhukiro bgacu, Uhereye ibihe vyose.
Imisozi itaravuka, Utararamukwa isi n’ibihugu, Uhereye ibihe bidashira, ugashitsa ibihe bidashira, ni wewe Mana.
Uhindura abantu umukungugu, Uvuze, uti Bana b’abantu, musubireyo.
Kukw imyaka igihumbi mu nyonga zawe Imeze nk’umusi w’ejo wahise, Canke nk’igishingo kimwe c’ijoro.
Ubajana nk’ukw isūri itwara, bahwanye n’itiro; Mu gitondo bamera nk’ivyatsi bikura.
Mu gitondo birakura bigashurika; Ku mugoroba bigatemwa, bikūma.
Kuko tumazwe n’uburake bgawe, Uburake bgawe bgaduhagaritse imitima.
Washize ivyo twagabitanije imbere yawe, N’ivyaha vyacu vyo mu mpisho wabishize mu muco uva mu nyonga hawe.
Kukw imisi yacu yose ishize tukiri mu burake bgawe, Imyaka yacu tuyirangiza nk’ ah’ ar’ akanya ko gusuhuza umutima.
Imisi y’imyaka yacu n’imyaka mirongwirindwi, Canke naho, kubg’ intege nyinshi, yoshika kuri mirongumunani, Yamar’ ivyiratwa vyayo n’ ubutame n’umubabaro, Kukw ishira vuba, natwe tukaba tugurutse.
Ni nde azi inkomezi z’uburake bgawe? Akamenya n’ubushangashirwe bgawe, ingene wewe ukwiye kwubahwa?
Utwigishe guharūra imisi yacu Uburyo butuma dutunga imitima y’ubgenge.
Ewe Uhoraho garuka; uzogeza ryari? Ni wīrīmbūre ku vy’ugirira abasavyi bawe.
Mu gitondo uz’ uduhāze imbabazi zawe; Kugira ngo tuze tunezerwe, duhimbarwe imisi yacu yose.
Utunezereze umunezero ungana n’imisi watubabarijemwo, N’imyaka twabonyemw’ ivyago.
Igikorwa cawe ni ciserure ku basavyi bawe, Bo n’ubgiza bgawe ku bana babo.
Igikundiro c’Uhoraho, Imana yacu, kibe kuri twebge: Kand’ udushimangirire ibikorwa vy’intoke zacu; Mbere, ibikorwa vy’intoke zacu ubishimangire.
Ūba mu bgigobeko bg’Īsumba vyose Azokwama ari mu gitūtu c’ Īshobora vyose.
Ndabgira Uhoraho, nt’ Ur’ ubuhungiro bganje n’igihome kinkīngira, Imana yanje nizigira.
Kukw ari yo izogukiza umutego w’umutezi, N’ikīza gihonnya.
Izokubundikira mu moya yayo, Kand’ uzohungira musi y’ivyubi vyayo; Ukuri kwayo n’inkinzo n’icuma co kwīkīngiriza.
Ntuzotinyishwa n’igiteye ubgoba mw ijoro, Canke n’umwampi urashwe ku murango;
Canke n’ikīza kigendagendera mu mwiza, Canke n’agatikizo kayogeza mu mashōka.
Abantu igihumbi bazohindikirana i ruhande yawe, N’ibihumbi cumi i buryo bgawe, Ariko ntibizogushikako.
Uzobirābisha amaso yawe gusa, Ubone ingero y’abanyakibi.
Wagize Uhoraho ubuhungiro bgawe, Īsumba vyose wayigize uburuhukiro;
Nta kibi kizogira ico kikugira, Kandi nta cago kizokwēgēra ihema ryawe.
Kukw azokuragiza abamarayika biwe, Ngo bakuzigame mu nzira zawe zose.
Bazokuramira mu maboko yabo, Woye gutsitara kw ibuye.
Uzokandagira intambge n’ imamba, Uzosiribanga umugunza w’ intambge n’ikiyoka.
Kuko yankunze akaramata, ni co gituma nzomukiza: Nzomushira hejuru, kuko yamenye izina ryanje.
Azonyambaza, nanje ndamwitabe, Nzobana na we mu marushwa, Ndamukize, mmuhe icubahiro.
Nzomuhāza kuramba, Kandi nzomwereka agakiza kanje.
Ni vyiza gushima Uhoraho, No kuririmbira izina ryawe ishimwe, ewe Usumba vyose:
Kwerekana imbabazi zawe mu gitondo, N’ingen’ ur’ umwizigirwa uko bgīje,
Tuvugira inanga y’imirya cumi n’ikembe, Tukōmānza inanga.
Kuko wewe Uhoraho, wannejereje kubg’ igikorwa cawe wakoze: Nzovugishwa impundu n’ibikorwa vy’intoke zawe.
Ereg’ ibikorwa vyawe birakomeye Uhoraho! Ivyiyumviro vyawe bishika i bgina kure.
Umuntu w’ikijuju ntazi ibi; N’igipfu ntikibitahura:
Iy’ abanyakibi bārutse nk’ ubgatsi, Kand’ inkozi z’ibibi zose iyo zitotahaye, N’ukugira ngo barandurwe gushitsa ibihe vyose.
Ariko wewe, Uhoraho, ushizwe hejuru gushitsa ibihe bitazoshira.
Eh’ abansi bawe, Uhoraho, Eh’ abansi bawe bazohona: Inkozi z’ibibi zose zizosābagira.
Ariko washize hejuru ihembe ryanje nk’iry’ imbogo, Nsīzwe amavuta masha.
Kand’ ijisho ryanje ryiboneye abansi banje, Amatwi yanje yiyumviye ukw inkozi z’ibibi zimpagurukiye zibaye.
Umugororotsi azototahara nk’ ikigazi, Azoshirwa hejuru nk’igiti c’ isederi c’i Lebanoni.
Abatewe mu rugo rw’Uhoraho Bazototaharira mu nyubakwa z’Imana yacu.
No mu busāza bazoba bacāma; Bazogira ubukame bginshi n’itōto:
Kugira ngo vyerekane yuk’ Uhoraho atunganye; Ni we gitandara canje, atarimwo kugabitanya na gukeya.
Uhoraho arahangamye, avogereye mu cubahiro; Uhoraho aravogereye, akenyeje inkomezi. Noneh’ isi na yo irashimangiye, ntinyiganyizwa.
Ingoma yawe yarahamye uhereye kera, Wamyeho uhereye kera hose.
Uhoraho, inzūzi zishize hejuru, Inzūzi zishize hejuru amajwi yazo: Inzūzi zishira hejuru kubomborana kwazo.
Amajwi y’amazi menshi, Imipfunda ihambaye yo mu kiyaga, Uhoraho ar’ iyo hejuru abirusha inkomezi.
Ivyo washingiye intahe n’ivyo kwizigirwa cane; Uhoraho, ukwera kubereye inzu yawe ibihe bitazoshira.
Uhoraho, Mana Nyen’ uguhōra, Mana Nyen’ uguhōra, kayangana.
Ewe mucamanza w’abari mw isi, n’uhaguruke: Abibone ubasubirize mu nkōko.
Ewe Uhoraho, abanyakibi bazogeza hehe, Abanyakibi bazogeza hehe kwitera hejuru?
Bararokomboka, bakavugana amanyama, Inkozi z’ibibi zose zirihaya.
Bamenagura abantu bawe, Uhoraho, Bahahaza ishamvu yawe.
Bica umupfakazi n’inyambukīra, Bica n’impfuvyi.
Bakavuga, bat’ Uhoraho ntaja kubibona, Imana ya Yakobo ntija kubibabara.
Yemwe bijuju vyo mu bantu, ni mwibaze ibi: Mwa bipfu mwe, muzoca ubgenge ryari?
Iyabaditseh’ ugutwi, yobura kwumva? Iyabumvye ijisho, yobura kubona?
Imwe ihana ayandi mahanga, yobura guhana, Kand’ ari yo yigisha abantu ubgenge?
Uhoraho arazi ivyiyumviro vy’abantu Kw ari nk’impwemu zihumetswe gusa.
Ewe Uhoraho, hahirwa umuntu uhana, Ukamwigishisha ivyagezwe vyawe;
Kugira ng’ umuruhure mu misi y’ivyago, Gushitsa ah’ icobo kizokwimbirwa abanyakibi.
Kuk’ Uhoraho atazota abantu biwe, Kand’ atazoheba ishamvu yiwe,
Kuko guca imanza kuzosubira ku kugororoka, Kand’ abafise imitima itunganye bose ni kwo bazokurikira.
Ni nde azokūra hasi ngw antabare kurwanya abanyavyaha? Ni nde azohagarara akantabara ngo turwanye inkozi z’ibibi?
Iy’ Uhoraho ataba umutabazi wanje, Ubugingo bganje buba bgaciye bugerēra ahantu h’ agacerere.
Nkivuga, nt’ Ikirenge canje kiranyereye; Imbabazi zawe, Uhoraho, zarandamiye.
Iy’ amazinda abaye isinzi muri jewe Ivyo umpumuriza binezereza ubugingo bganje.
Mbeg’ abagoreka imanza bazohūza nawe, Kand’ ari bo bagira ivyagezwe urwitwazo rwo kugira nabi?
Bakoranira hamwe gutera ubugingo bg’umugororotsi, Bagatsindisha amaraso adafise igicumuro.
Arik’ Uhoraho yambereye igihome kirekire kinkīngira, Imana yanje n’igitandara c’ ubuhungiro bganje.
Kand’ izobagarukanak’ ukugabitanya kwabo, Izobarandura kubg’ icaha cabo, Uhoraho Imana yacu azobarandura.
Ni muze, turirimbire Uhoraho: Tuvugirize impundu igitandara c’agakiza kacu.
Tuje mu nyonga ziwe tumushima, Tumuvugirize impundu n’ indirimbo.
Kuk’ Uhoraho ar’ Imana ihambaye, N’Umwami ahambaye, asumba ibigirwamana vyose.
I kuzimu hari mu kuboko kwiwe; Kand’ impinga z’imisozi miremire na zo n’iziwe.
Ikiyaga n’iciwe, ni we yakiremye: Intoke ziwe ni zo zabumvye i musozi.
Ni muze tumusenge twunamye, Dupfukamire Uhoraho Umuremyi wacu,
Kukw ari we Mana yacu, Natwe tur’ abantu b’icanya ciwe, tur’ intama zo mu kuboko kwiwe. Uyu musi icompa mukumva ijwi ryiwe!
Ntimukomantaze imitima yanyu, nk’uko mwayikomantarije i Meriba, No kuri wa musi w’i Masa mu bugaragwa,
Hamwe ba sogokuruza banyu bāngerageza, Bakancaca, bakabona igikorwa canje.
Nashavuriye ab’ ico gihe imyaka mirongwine, Ndavuga, nt’ Aba n’abantu bama bazimira mu mitima yabo, Kandi ntibamenya inzira zanje.
Ni co catumye ndahirana uburake, Nti Ntibazoshika mu buruhukiro bganje.
Ni muririmbire Uhoraho indirimbo nsha: Yemwe abari mw isi mwese, muririmbire Uhoraho.
Muririmbire Uhoraho, mushemagize izina ryiwe: Mumenyekanishe agakiza kiwe uko bukeye.
Mwamamaze mu mahanga ubgiza bgiwe, N’ibikorwa bitangaje yakoze muvyamamaze mu moko yose.
Kuk’ Uhoraho ahambaye, abereye gushimwa cane: N’uw’ igitinyiro kuruta ibigirwamana vyose.
Kukw ibigirwamana vyose vy’amahanga ar’ ubusa, Arik’ Uhoraho ni we yaremye amajuru.
Icubahiro n’ububasha bir’ imbere yiwe, Ubushobozi n’igikundiro bir’ ahēra hiwe.
Yemwe miryango y’amahanga, mwaturire Uhoraho, Mwaturire Uhoraho ingen’ afise icubahiro n’inkomezi.
Mwaturire Uhoraho ingen’ izina ryiwe ribereye icubahiro; Muze mu nyubakwa ziwe muzanye ishikanwa.
Musenge Uhoraho mwubashe, mushazishije ukwera: Yemwe abari mw isi mwese, muhindire agashitsi imbere yiwe.
Muvuge mu mahanga, mut’ Uhoraho arahangamye: Isi na yo irashimangiye, ntishobora kunyiganyiga; Azocira amahanga imanza zibereye.
Ijuru ni rinezerwe, isi n’ihimbarwe, Ikiyaga ni kibomborane bo n’ibicuzuye.
Indimiro n’ibizezemwo ni bivuze impundu; Ni ho ibiti vyose vyo mw ishamba bizoririmbishwa n’ akanyamuneza
Imbere y’Uhoraho, kukw agira aze, Agira aze gucira abari mw isi imanza, Azocira abari mw isi imanza zibereye, N’amahanga nk’ukw ar’ umwizigirwa.
Uhoraho arahangamye; isi n’ihimbarwe; Ibizinga vyo mu kiyaga binezerwe uko bingana.
Ibicu n’umwiza biramukikije: Ukugororoka n’imanza zibereye ni vyo ingoma yiwe ihagazeko.
Umuriro umwitangira imbere, Uyigiza abarwanizi biwe impande zose.
Imiravyo yiwe yabonesheje mw isi, Ibihugu birabibona, bihinda agashitsi.
Imisozi iyagira imbere y’ Uhoraho nk’ibishashara, Imbere y’Umwami w’isi yose.
Amajuru atāngāza ukugororoka kwiwe, Amahanga yose yabonye ubgiza bgiwe.
Abasenga ibishushanyo bibājwe, Bakirata ivy’ ubusa, ni bamāramāre: Ibigirwamana vyose biramwunamira.
I Siyoni haravyumvise, haranezerwa, Abakobga b’i Buyuda bahimbarwa N’imanza zawe zibereye, ewe Uhoraho.
Kuko wewe Uhoraho, usumba vyose, ukaba uri hejuru y’isi yose, Ushizwe hejuru cane y’ibigirwamana vyose.
Yemwe abakunda Uhoraho, ni mwanke ibibi; Azigama ubugingo bg’abakunzi biwe, Abarokora mu maboko y’abanyakibi.
Umuco urasira umugororotsi, Bo n’umunezero ku b’imitima itunganye.
Munezererwe Uhoraho, yemwe bagororotsi; Kandi muhimbaze izina ryiwe ryera.
Ni muririmbire Uhoraho indirimbo nsha, Kuko yakoze ibitangaza: Ikiganza ciwe c’i buryo n’ ukuboko kwiwe kwera yabizanishije agakiza.
Uhoraho yamenyekanishije agakiza kiwe: Ukugororoka kwiwe yakugaragaje ahabona mu maso y’amahanga.
Yibutse imbabazi ziwe n’ukugororoka kwiwe, ngw abigirire inzu ya Isirayeli: Abo ku mpera z’isi zose babonye agakiza k’Imana yacu.
Yemwe abari mw isi mwese, muvugirize Uhoraho impundu: Turika muririmbishwe n’ umunezero, mbere muririmbe ishimwe.
Muririmbire Uhoraho ishimwe, muvugira inanga; Muvugira inanga, muririmbe indirimbo.
Muvugishirize impundu imbere y’Umwami Uhoraho, Inzumbete n’ijwi ry’inzamba.
Ikiyaga ni kibomborane bo n’ibicuzuye, N’isi n’abayibamwo bose,
Inzūzi ni zikome amashi, Imisozi n’iririmbishirizwe icarimwe n’umunezero,
Imbere y’Uhoraho, kukw agira aze gucira abari mw isi imanza: Azocira abari mw isi imanza zigororotse, N’amahanga izibereye.
Uhoraho arahangamye; amahanga ahinze agashitsi! Avyagiye ku Bakerubi; isi iranyiganyiga!
Uhoraho arahambaye muri Siyoni, Kand’ ari hejuru kure y’amahanga yose.
Ni batazire izina ryiwe rihambaye riteye ubgoba: Ni we yera.
Inkomezi z’umwami n’ugukunda imanza zibereye; Ni wewe ushinga ibiroranye. Imanza zibereye n’izigororotse ni wewe ubikorera mu ba Yakobo.
Ni mushire hejuru Uhoraho Imana yacu, Mwuname mur’ imbere y’ indava yo musi y’ibirenge vyiwe: Ni we yera.
Mose na Aroni bo mu baherezi biwe, Na Samweli wo mu bambaza izina ryiwe, Bārambaza Uhoraho, akabishura.
Yababaririra mu nkingi y’igicu, Bakitondera ivyo yashingiye intahe n’ibgirizwa yabahaye.
Uhoraho, Mana yacu, wahora ubishura: War’ Imana ibaharira, Naho wabahōra ivyo bakora.
Ni mushire hejuru Uhoraho, Imana yacu, Musengere ku murwa wiwe wera: Kuk’ Uhoraho, Imana yacu, ar’ uwera.
Yemwe abari mw isi yose, muvugirize Uhoraho impundu.
Musabe Uhoraho munezerewe: Muze mu nyonga ziwe muririmba.
Mumenye yuk’ Uhoraho ari we Mana: Ni we yaturemye, natwe tur’ abiwe, Tur’ abantu biwe, tur’ intama zo mu canya ciwe.
Mushike mu birimba vyiwe mushima, No mu nyubakwa ziwe muhimbaza; Mumukengurukire, mushemagize izina ryiwe.
Kuk’ Uhoraho ari mwiza, imbabazi ziwe zihorah’ ibihe bidashira, Kand’ ahora ar’ umwizigirwa no gushitsa ibihe vyose.
Ndaririmba ntazira imbabazi n’imanza zibereye: Uhoraho, ni wewe ngira ndirimbire ishimwe.
Nzokwitondera kugendera mu nzira itunganye: Uzoza aho ndi ryari? Nzokwama ngendana mu nzu yanje umutima utunganye.
Sinzogira ikibi nshira imbere y’amaso yanje: Nanka igikorwa c’ibigoryi; Ntikizomatana nanje.
Umutima ugoramye uzomvako; Sinzogira ikibi mmenya.
Ūbeshera mugenzi we mu mpisho nzomurandura: Ūgamika, akagira umutima wibona, sinzomwihanganira.
Amaso yanje azoba ku bizigirwa bo mu gihugu, kugira ngo tubane: Ūgendera mu nzira itunganye, ni we azonkorera.
Ūgunga ntazoba mu nzu yanje; Ūbesha ntazocimbatara imbere y’amaso yanje.
Uko bukeye nzohonnya abanyakibi bose bo mu gihugu, Kugira ngo ndandure inkozi z’ibibi zose, ndazimare ku murwa w’Uhoraho.
Zirikana wumve ugusenga kwanje Uhoraho we, Ugutakamba kwanje kugushikeko.
Ntumpishe mu nyonga hawe ku musi w’umubabaro wanje, N’umbangire ugutwi; Ku musi ntakambako, unyishure vuba.
Kukw imisi yanje ishira nk’ umwotsi, Amagufa yanje yaka nk’umuriro.
