Umutima wanje ukubiswe nk’ ubgatsi, urakabiranye: Kuko nibagira kurya igisa canje.
Ijwi ry’umuniho wanje ritumye Amagufa yanje amatana n’ inyama zanje.
Mmeze nk’inyanana yo mu bugaragwa, Mpindutse nk’igihuna co mu misaka.
Mba maso, mpindutse Nk’akanyoni kari konyene ku gatwe k’inzu.
Abansi banje barantuka umusi ukīra, Abandandamukiye bahinduye izina ryanje agatukisha.
Kuko ndya umunyota nk’ivyo kurya, Nsukiranya ivyo nnywa n’ amosozi,
Kubg’ ugushangashirwa kwawe n’uburake bgawe Kuko wanteruye, ukanta.
Imisi yanje imeze nk’igitūtu kirehutse: Kandi nkabiranye nk’ubgatsi.
Ariko wewe, Uhoraho, uzohangama ibihe bidashira, Icibutso cawe kizohorah’ ibihe vyose.
Uzohaguruka, ugirire imbabazi i Siyoni: Kukw igihe co kuhagirira ikigongwe gishitse, mber’ igihe cashizweho kirashitse.
Kukw abasavyi bawe bahimbarwa n’amabuye yaho, Umukungugu waho ubateye akagongwe.
Bizotuma amahanga yubaha izina ryawe, Uhoraho, N’abami bose bo mw isi bakubaha icubahiro cawe:
Kuk’ Uhoraho azoba asubiye kwubaka i Siyoni, Kand’ azoba abonekanye icubahiro c’ubgiza bgiwe:
Ashize umutima ku gusenga kw’abatagira shinge na rugero, Ntiyakēngereye ugusenga kwabo.
Ivyo bizokwandikirwa ab’ igihe kizoza; Ubgoko buzoremwa buzoshima Uhoraho.
Kukw azoba arungurutse hasi, ari hejuru, ahēra hiwe; Uhoraho arungurutse isi ari mw ijuru:
Kugira ngo yumve ukuniha kw’imbohe, Abohore abāgerewe gupfa;
Ngw abantu bamenyekanishe izina ry’Uhoraho i Siyoni, N’ishimwe ryiwe i Yerusalemu,
Amahanga n’ibihugu vy’abami Aho bazoshengerera gusaba Uhoraho.
Yaciriye intege zanje mu nzira; Yagabanije imisi yanje.
Ndavuga, nti Mana yanje, ntunkūreho ngicagatije imisi yanje; Imyaka yawe yamah’ ibihe vyose.
Mbere na mbere washizeh’ itanguriro ry’isi, Kand’ amajuru n’igikorwa c’ intoke zawe.
Ivyo bizoshira, ariko weho uzohoraho, Mber’ ivyo vyose bizosāza nk’impuzu, Uzobikūranya nk’impuzu, bikūranwe n’ibindi;
Ariko weho ur’ uko wamye, Imyaka y’ukubaho kwawe ntizogira iherezo.
Abana b’abasavyi bawe bazohora batsindaje, Uruvyaro rwabo ruzocimbatarizwa imbere yawe.
Mutima wanje, himbaza Uhoraho: Namwe ibimbamwo vyose, muhimbaze izina ryiwe ryera.
Mutima wanje, himbaza Uhoraho; Ntiwibagire ivyiza yakugiriye vyose.
Ni we aharira ibigabitanyo vyawe vyose, Agakiza indwara zawe zose,
Agacungura ubugingo bgawe ngo ntibuje mu mahonero, Akakwambika imbabazi no kugirirwa neza nk’igitsibo,
Agahāza ubukambge bgawe ivyiza, Agatuma usubira mu busore busha bumeze nk’ubg’ inkukuma.
Uhoraho akora ivy’ ukugororoka, Agacira imanza impahazwa.
Yamenyesheje Mose inzira ziwe, Ibikorwa vyiwe yabimenyesheje Abisirayeli.
Uhoraho yuzuye imbabazi, n’umunyabuntu, Ateba kuraka, agira ikigongwe cinshi;
Ntazokwama ahana, Ntahorana uburake imisi yose.
Ntiyatugiriye ibihwanye n’ ivyaha vyacu, Ntiyadushubirije mu nkōko ibihwanye n’ibigabitanyo vyacu.
Nk’ukw ijuru ryitanguye isi, Ni kw ikigongwe agirira abamwubaha kingana.
Nk’ukw i burasirazuba hitanguye i burengerazuba, Uko ni ko yashize kure ibicumuro vyacu.
Nk’uko se w’abana abagirira akagongwe, Ni k’Uhoraho akagirira abamwubaha.
Kukw azi iremwa ryacu, Yibuka ko tur’ umukungugu.
Umuntu we, imisi yiwe ni nk’iy’ ivyatsi, Nk’ishurwe ryo ku musozi ni ko yamuza.
Kuk’ umuyaga uricako, rikaba rishize, Ahantu haryo ntiharimenye ukundi.
Arikw imbabazi Uhoraho agirira abamwubaha zahereye kera hose, zikazoshitsa ibihe vyose, Kand’ ukugororoka kwiwe kuzoshitsa no ku buzukururuza babo;
Ni kw agirira abitondera isezerano ryiwe, Bakibuka ivyagezwe vyiwe bakabikora.
Uhoraho yahamangiye intebe yiwe mw ijuru: Ubgami bgiwe buganza vyose.
Muhimbaze Uhoraho, mwebge bamarayika biwe: Mwebge banyenkomezi nyinshi bashikisha ijambo ryiwe Kubangira ugutwi ijwi ry’ ijambo ryiwe.
Muhimbaze Uhoraho, mwebge ngabo ziwe zose, Yemwe basavyi biwe bakora ibimuhimbara.
Muhimbaze Uhoraho, yemwe bikorwa vyiwe vyose, Mumuhimbarize ahantu hose aganza: Mutima wanje, himbaza Uhoraho.
Mutima wanje, himbaza Uhoraho. Uhoraho, Mana yanje, ur’ ūhambaye cane; Wisakaye igitinyiro n’icubahiro.
Wifubika umuco nk’umwambaro; Ugaranzura ijuru nk’ihema.
Ushinga inkingi z’insenge zawe mu mazi; Uhindura ibicu umukogote ugenderamwo; Ugendera ku mababa y’umuyaga.
Uhindura abamarayika bawe imiyaga, Abasavyi bawe ubahindura umuriro waka.
Washizeh’ amatanguriro y’isi, Ngo yoye kuzonyiganyizwa gushitsa ibihe bidashira.
Wayoroshe ikiyaga nk’impuzu, Amazi areremba hejuru y’ imisozi miremire.
Ahungishwa no gukankamira kwawe, Yirukishwa no guhinda kw’ inkuba yawe,
Aca ku misozi, amanukana imyonga, Ashika mu kibanza wayagereye.
Wayakubitiye ibango ngo yoye kurirēngāna, Kugira ngo ntagaruke, akarengera isi.
Urungika amariba mu myonga, Imigezi itemba hagati y’ imisozi;
Ishokwa n’ibikōko vyose vyo mw ishamba, Indogoba z’inyeshamba zishira inyota.
Inyoni n’ibisīga vyo mu kirēre biba kur’ iyo migezi, Bijwiragirira mu mashami.
Imisozi uyirekurirakw imvura ivuye ku nsenge zawe, Isi ihāzwa n’ibivuye mu bikorwa vyawe.
Umereza inka ubgatsi, Umeza imboga zo kugaburira abantu, Kugira ng’ ubakūrire umutsima mw ivu,
Na vino inezereza imitima y’abantu, N’amavuta yo kuyagayagisha mu maso habo, Kandi ng’ umutsima uhe imitima y’abantu amagara.
Ibiti vy’Uhoraho birahāga, Ibiti vy’amasederi vy’i Lebanoni yateye;
Ivyo inyoni n’ibisīga vyārikakw ivyāri: Agasoza gafise inzu yako ku biti vy’akajwari.
Imisozi miremire n’iy’ impene z’inyeshamba, Ibitandara n’ubuhungiro bg’ inkezi.
Washireyeh’ ukwezi kumenyekanisha ibihe: Izuba rirazi iyo rirengera.
Uzana umwiza, hakaba ijoro: Ni ho ibikōko vyose vyo mu kibira bisokoroka bisōbōka.

Izuba ryarasa, zikīgīra, Zikaryama mu masenga yazo.
Abantu bagasohoka, bakaja ku bikorwa vyabo, No mu butame bgabo, bakageza ku mugoroba.
Uhoraho we, ereg’ ibikorwa vyawe n’ivy’ uburyo bginshi! Vyose wabikoresheje ubgenge: Isi yuzuye ubutunzi bgawe.
Ehe kiriya kiyaga kinini cāgutse, Kirimw’ ibikwega inda hasi bitoharūrika, Ibikōko bito‐bito na binini‐binini.
Ni ho amāto agendera: Ni ho ingona iba, wayiremye ngo yikinemwo.
Ivyo vyose biguhanga amaso, Kugira ng’ ubigaburire ivyo kurya vyavyo igihe kigeze.
Bitororokanya ivyo ubihaye: Upfumbaturura igipfunsi cawe, bigahāga ivyiza.
Uhisha mu nyonga hawe, bigahinda agashitsi: Ubikūramw’ impwemu, bigaca bipfa, Bikīsubirira mu mukungugu wavyo.
Urungika impwemu yawe, bikaremwa; Uhindura isi, igasubira itōto.
Icubahiro c’Uhoraho ni cameh’ ibihe bidashira; Uhoraho n’anezererwe ibikorwa vyiwe:
Arāba isi, igahinda agashitsi; Akora ku misozi, igafumba umwotsi.
Nzokwama ndirimbira Uhoraho nkiriho, Nzokwama ndirimbira Imana yanje ishimwe ngihumeka.
Ivyo niyumvira biyiryohere: Nanje nzokwama nnezererwa Uhoraho.
Abanyavyaha ni bahone bashire mw isi: Ababi boye kubah’ ukundi. Mutima wanje, himbaza Uhoraho. Haleluya.
Ni mushime Uhoraho, mwambaze izina ryiwe; Mumenyekanishe ibikorwa vyiwe mu mahanga.
Mumuririmbire, mumuririmbire ishimwe; Muvuge ibikorwa vyiwe vyose bitangaje.
Mwirate izina ryiwe ryera, Imitima y’abarondera Uhoraho inezerwe.
Murondere Uhoraho n’inkomezi ziwe; Murondere mu nyonga hiwe ibihe bidashira.
Mwibuke ibikorwa vyiwe bitangaje yakoze, Ibitangaza vyiwe n’amateka yo mu kanwa kiwe,
Yemwe ruvyaro rwa Aburahamu umusavyi wiwe, Yemwe bana ba Yakobo, abo yatoranije.
Uhoraho ni we Mana yacu; Amateka yiwe ari mw isi yose.
Yama yibuka isezerano ryiwe imisi yose; Ijambo yashinze yama aryibuka uk’ urunganwe rugenda rukurikirana gushitsa ibihe igihumbi,
Ni ryo sezerano yasezeranye na Aburahamu, Indahiro yarahiye Isaka,
Akayongera kuri Yakobo ayitsindagira, ngw ibe icagezwe, Kuri Isirayeli ngw ibe isezerano ry’intahava;
Akavuga, ati Ni wewe nzoha igihugu c’i Kanani, Ngo kibe ishamvu mukubitiwe amabango.
Bāri bakir’ abantu b’imparūrwa, Mbere bāri bake cane, kand’ ar’ inyambukīra muri co,
Bāyerēra, bava mw ihanga baja mu rindi, Bava ku mwami umwe baja mu bundi bgoko.
Ntiyakundira umuntu n’umwe kw abazingirikira, Mbere yahannye abami ababahōra,
Ati Ntimukore ku bo narobanuje amavuta, Ntimugire ico mugira abavugishwa nanje.
Ahamagara amapfa ngw atere mu gihugu; Avuna inkoni yose bishimikije, ni vyo vyo kurya vyabo.
Atuma umuntu wo kubītangira imbere, Ni Yosefu yaguzwe ngw agirwe umuja:
Bababarisha ibirenge vyiwe iminyororo, Bamushira mu vyuma.
Kugeza ah’ iryavuzwe n’ Uhoraho ryashikiye, Ijambo ryiwe ryaramugerageza.
Umwami yaratumye, baramubohora, Segaba w’amahanga yaramurekuye.
Amuhindura umuzezwarugo wiwe, Amugira segaba kw itunga ryiwe ryose.
Ngw agabe abaganwa biwe ukw agomba, Yigishe abakuru biwe ubgenge.
Kandi Isirayeli aja muri Egiputa, Yakobo agerēra mu gihugu ca Hamu.
Kand’ Uhoraho agwiza abantu biwe cane, Abagira abanyenkomezi kurusha abansi babo.
Ahindura imitima ya bano ngo banke abantu biwe, Bagīra icenge abasavyi biwe.
Atuma Mose umusavyi wiwe, Na Aroni yatoranije.
Bashira hagati muri bo ibimenyetso vyiwe, Bakorera ibitangaza mu gihugu ca Hamu.
Arungika umwiza, burakorana, Na bo ntibārenga amajambo yiwe.
Ahindura amazi yabo amaraso, Yica amafi yabo.
Igihugu cabo kinyagaramw’ ibikere, No mu ngoro z’abami babo.
Avuga ijambo, hatera amasinzi y’ibibugu, N’imibu mu gihugu cabo cose.
Abarungikira urubura mu gishingo c’imvura, N’umuriro ururumba mu gihugu cabo.
Akubita imizabibu yabo n’ insukoni zabo, Avunagura ibiti vyo mu gihugu cabo.
Avuga ijambo, inzige ziratera, N’inzikira zidaharūrika.
Zirya ibimera vyose vyo mu gihugu cabo, Zirya ivyeze mu mirima yabo.
Ageseza abana b’imfura bose bo mu gihugu cabo, Amara ubuzibūra bgabo.
Akūramwo Abisirayeli, bafise amafeza n’amazahabu, Nta munyantege nke yari mu miryango yabo yose.
Babonye bagiye, haba umunezero muri Egiputa, Kuko gutera ubgoba kwabo kwari kubafashe.
Agaranzura igicu co kubatwikira, N’umuriro wo kubamurikira mw ijoro.
Barasaba, azana inkware, Abahimvya umutsima wo mw ijuru.
Atobora igitandara, amazi aradudubiza, Atemba ahantu hagadutse nk’ uruzi.
Kuko yibutse ijambo ryiwe ryera, Na Aburahamu umusavyi wiwe.
Akūray’ abantu biwe banezerewe, Abo yatoranije abakūrayo baririmba.
Abaha ibihugu vy’abanyamahanga, Batwara ivyo abanyamahanga bācumukuriye:
Aho vyaba birtyo kwar’ ukugira ngo bitondere ivyagezwe vyiwe, Bagendere mu vyo yashinze. Haleluya!
Haleluya! Ni mushimire Uhoraho yukw ari mwiza: Kukw imbabazi ziwe zamah’ ibihe bidashira.
Ni nde yoshobora kudondora ibikorwa bikomeye Uhoraho yakoze, Canke kwerekana ishimwe ryiwe ryose?
Hahirwa abitondera ibitunganye, Hahirwa uwama akora ivyo kugororoka na ntaryo.
Uhoraho, nyibukana imbabazi ugirira abantu bawe; Ungenderanire agakiza kawe:

Twaracumuye, nka ba sogokuruza, Twaragabitanije, twakoze ivyaha.

Yamara kubg’ izina ryayo irabakiza, Kugira ngw imenyekanishe ubushobozi bgayo bukomeye.
Ikankamira Ikiyaga Gitukura, kirakama: Nukw ibacisha ahār’ i bgina nko mu bugaragwa.
Ibakiza ukuboko kw’umwansi wabo, Irabacungura, ibakūra mu kuboko kw’umurwanizi.
Amazi arengera ababisha babo, Ntihasigara n’umwe.
Maze bizera amajambo yayo; Baririmba ishimwe ryayo.

Ariko bifuriza cane mu bugaragwa, Bageragereza Imana mu karēre.
Ibaha ico basavye, Arikw imitima yabo iyishiramwo kwonda.
Kandi bagiririra Mose ishari aho bari bashagaje, Na Aroni, uwera w’Uhoraho.
Isi irāsama, imira Datani, Iteranira ku bantu ba Abiramu.
Umuriro udomekwa mw ikoraniro ryabo, Ikirimi cawo kiyigiza abanyakibi.
Bacurira imasa i Horebu, Basenga igishushanyo bāvugutiye mu nkero.
Uko ni ko bākāvye icubahiro cabo Igishushanyo c’impfizi irisha ubgatsi.
Bibagira Imana, Umukiza wabo, Yakoreye ibikomeye muri Egiputa;
Yakoreye ibitangaza mu gihugu ca Hamu, N’ibiteye ubgoba ku Kiyaga Gitukura.
Bituma ivuga kw izobahonnya, Kand’ iba yarabahoneje, iyaba Mose uwatoranijwe na yo atāhagaze imbere yayo mu gihengeri, Kugira ngw asubize inyuma uburake bgayo, yoye kubahonnya.
Kandi bāgaya igihugu c’ igikundiro, Ntibizera ijambo ryayo:

Kandi barakiriza Uhoraho ku mazi y’i Meriba, Bituma Mose aterwa ivyago kubgabo:
Kuko bāgararije Mpwemu w’Uhoraho, Bituma Mose avugisha akanwa kiwe ibitabereye.
Kandi ntibāhonnya amahanga, Nk’uk’ Uhoraho yabageze.

Baba abasavyi b’ibigirwamana vyayo, Bibahindukira umutego.

Yahora abakiza kenshi, Ariko bakamugarariza mu migabo yabo, Bagacishwa bugufi kubg’ ukugabitanya kwabo.
Yamara yashira umutima ku mubabaro wabo, Uko yumvise ugutakamba kwabo:
Akabibukira isezerano yabasezeraniye, Akagarukana umutima, nk’ ukw isinzi ry’imbabazi ziwe riri.

Ni mushimire Uhoraho yukw ari mwiza: Kukw imbabazi ziwe zamah’ ibihe bidashira.

Ahindura inzūzi ubugaragwa, N’amasōko ayahindura ahagadutse:

Amaso yanje akobowe no kwifuza ijambo ryawe, Nkibaza nti Mbeg’ uzommara umubabaro ryari?
Kuko mpindutse nk’umukuza w’urusato umanitswe ku mwotsi; Ariko sinibagira ivyo washinze.
Mbeg’ imisi y’ubugingo bg’ umusavyi wawe n’ingahe? Abampama uzobacirakw iteka ryari?
Abībone, badakurikira ivyagezwe vyawe, Banyimbiye ivyobo.
Amabgirizwa yawe yose n’ay’ ukwizigirwa: Bampamisha ibinyoma; n’ untabare.
Bari bashigaje gatoya bakandandura mw isi: Ariko sinareka amateka washinze.
Ungire muzima, nk’ukw imbabazi zawe ziri, Kugira ngo nitondere ivyo akanwa kawe kihanikirije.
Ijambo ryawe ryama rihamye mw ijuru Gushitsa ibihe bidashira, Uhoraho.
Ukwizigirwa kwawe kwamaho gushitsa ibihe vyose; Washinze isi, igumaho.
Imanza zawe ni zo zituma uyu musi vyose biriho: Kuko vyose ar’ abasavyi bawe.
Iyaba ivyagezwe vyawe atari vyo munezero wanje Ico gihe mba nararandukiye mu marushwa yanje.
Sinzokwigera nibagira amateka washinze, Kukw ari yo wangirishije muzima.
Nd’ uwawe, nkiza; Kuko nama ndondera amateka washinze.
Abanyakibi banderekeye kundandura: Ariko jeho nzoshira umutima ku vyo wihanikirije.
Nabonye yuk’ uguhingurwa kwose gufise aho kugarukira; Arikw amabgirizwa yawe arāgutse cane.
Ewe kuntu nkunda ivyagezwe vyawe! Ni vyo ndimbūra bukarinda bgīra.
Amabgirizwa yawe atuma ndusha abansi banje ubgenge; Kuko na ntaryo yamana nanje.
Mfise ubgenge buruta ubg’ abigisha banje bose; Kukw ivyo wihanikirije ari vyo ndimbūra.
Ndusha abatāma ubgenge, Kuko nitondeye amateka washinze.
Nabujije ibirenge vyanje inzira mbi yose, Kugira ngo nitondere ijambo ryawe.
Sinzotirimuka mu manza zawe ziroranye, Kukw ari wewe wanyigishije.
Ewe kuntu amajambo yawe angēngēra mu māgāge! Arusha ubūki gusōsa mu kanwa kanje.
Amateka washinze ni yo andonkesha ubgenge, Ni co gituma nanka inzira z’ibinyoma zose.
Ijambo ryawe n’itara rimurikira ibirenge vyanje, N’umuco umurikira mu nzira yanje.
Nararahiye ndarengwa Yuko nzokwitondera imanza zawe zigororotse.
Ndababazwa cane: Uhoraho, ungire muzima, nk’ukw ijambo ryawe ryavuze.
Uhoraho ndakwinginze, wemere amashikanwa y’akanwa kanje azanywe n’ urukundo, Kand’ unyigishe imanza zawe ziroranye.
Ubugingo bganje buri ku maregerege imisi yose, Ariko sinibagira ivyagezwe vyawe.
Abanyakibi banteze umutego; Ariko sinahushije ngo mve mu mateka washinze.
Ivyo wihanikirije navyākiriye ngo bibe umwandu wanje w’ibihe bidashira, Kukw ari vyo kanyamuneza k’umutima wanje.
Nshize umutima wanje ku gushitsa ivyo washinze Ibihe vyose, gushitsa no kw iherezo.
Nanka ab’ imitima ibiri; Arikw ivyagezwe vyawe ndabikunda.
Ni wewe bgihisho bganje n’inkinzo yanje, Nizigira ijambo ryawe.
Mva i ruhande, mwa nkozi z’ibibi mwe, Kugira ngo nitondere amabgirizwa y’Imana yanje.
Umbere ubgishimikizo, nk’ ukw ijambo ryawe ryavuze, kugira ngo mbeho, Noye kuzotēterezwa n’ivyizigiro vyanje.
Undamire, nzoba ndarusimvye, Nze name ntumbera ivyo washinze.
Wakēngereye abahushagirika bose bakava mu vyo washinze: Kuk’ ubugunge bgabo ata co bubamariye.
Ukūrah’ abanyakibi bose bo mw isi nk’inkamba ku cuma: Ni co gituma nkunda ivyo wihanikirije.
Umubiri wanje uhindishwa agashitsi no kugutinya; Kandi ntinya imanza zawe.
Nakoze ibigororotse n’ibiroranye: Ntundekerane abampahaza.
Wishinge k’uzogirira neza umusavyi wawe: Abībone ntibaze bampahaze.
Amaso yanje akobowe no kwifuza agakiza kawe, N’ijambo ryawe rigororotse.
Ugirire umusavyi wawe ibihwanye n’imbabazi zawe, Kand’ unyigishe ivyo washinze.
Nd’ umusavyi wawe: umpe ubgenge, Kugira ngo mmenye ivyo wihanikirije.
Harageze k’Uhoraho agira ico akora, Kuko bahinduye ubusa ivyagezwe vyiwe.
Ni co gituma nkunda amabgirizwa yawe, Nkayarutisha izahabu, mbere naho yoba izahabu iramuye.
Ni co gituma niyumvira yukw amateka washinze yose atunganye; Kandi nanka inzira yose y’ibinyoma.
Ivyo wihanikirije n’ibitangaza: Ni co gituma umutima wanje uvyitondera.
Guhishurirwa amajambo yawe kuzana umuco, Guha abatungu ubgenge.
Nāsamitse akanwa, ndahuzagizwa, Kuko nifuza amabgirizwa yawe.
Unkebuke, ungirire ikigongwe, Nk’uk’ umenyereye kukigirira abakunda izina ryawe.
Gumiriza intambuko zanje mw ijambo ryawe; Ntihagire ikigabitanyo na kimwe kinganza.
Uncungure, unkūre mu gahahazo k’abantu, Kugira ngo nitondere amateka washinze.
Umurikishirize umusavyi wawe mu nyonga hawe: Unyigishe ivyo washinze.
Amaso yanje asendanisha inzūzi z’amazi, Kuko batitondera ivyagezwe vyawe.
Ur’ umugororotsi, Uhoraho we, Imanza zawe ziragororotse.
Ivyo wihanikirije wabigeresheje ukugororoka N’ukwizigirwa kw’ukuri.
Ishaka ryanje rirandanduye Kukw abarwanizi banje bibagiye amajambo yawe.
Ijambo ryawe n’icuma kiramuye; Ni co gituma umusavyi wawe arikunda.
Nd’ uwo hasi, ndagayitse, Ariko sinibagira amateka washinze.
Ukugororoka kwawe n’ukugororoka kw’ibihe bidashira: Ivyagezwe vyawe n’ukuri.
Amarushwa n’intuntu biranshitseko: Yamara, amabgirizwa yawe ni yo munezero wanje.
Ivyo wihanikirije n’ivyo kugororoka ibihe bidashira: Umpe ubgenge mbone kubaho.
Ntakambishije umutima wose; unyishure Uhoraho we: Nzokwitondera ivyo washinze.
Ndagutakambiye, nkiza, Kugira ngo nitondere ivyo wihanikirije.
Umutwenzi utaratambika naratakamvye: Amajambo yawe ni yo nizigiye.
Abateramyi batarakūranwa mu bishingo vyabo mba ndi maso, Kugira ngo ndimbūre ijambo ryawe.
Ni wumve ijwi ryanje, ukw imbabazi zawe zingana: Ungire muzima, Uhoraho we, nk’ukw imanza zawe zashinze.
Abōmekanye n’ukugabitanya barēgereje, Ariko bari kure y’ivyagezwe vyawe.
Wewe Uhoraho, uri hafi: Amabgirizwa yawe yose n’ ay’ ukuri.
Uhereye kera namenyeshejwe n’ivyo wihanikirije Yuko washizeh’ itanguriro ryavyo kugeza ibihe bidashira.
Shira umutima ku marushwa yanje, undokore; Kuko ntibagira ivyagezwe vyawe.
Umbūranire, uncungure: Ungire muzima, nk’ukw ijambo ryawe ryavuze.
Agakiza kari kure y’abanyakibi, Kuko batarondera ivyo washinze.
Uhoraho, imbabazi zawe zirakomeye, Ungire muzima, nk’ukw imanza zawe zashinze.
Abampīga n’abandwanya ni benshi, Ariko simpuba ngo mve mu vyo wihanikirije.
Nabonye abava mw isezerano, ndashavura: Kuko batitondera ijambo ryawe.
Rāba ingene nkunda amateka washinze: Uhoraho, ungire muzima, nk’ukw imbabazi zawe ziri.
Ijambo ryawe ryose ripoperanirijwe mu kuri; Imanza zawe zigororotse iyo ziva zikagera zamah’ ibihe bidashira.
Abahambaye bampamiye ubusa; Arik’ umutima wanje wubaha amajambo yawe.
Nnezererwa ijambo ryawe Nk’ūronse inyagano nyinshi.
Nanka ibinyoma, mvyanka urunuka: Arikw ivyagezwe vyawe ndabikunda.
Uko bukeye ngushima ibihetangabo ndwi, Ngushimira imanza zawe zigororotse.
Abakunda ivyagezwe vyawe bagira amahoro menshi; Nta kibatsitaza bafise.
Uhoraho, ndishimiye agakiza kawe, Kandi nkora ivyo amabgirizwa yawe avuga.
Umutima wanje witondeye ivyo wihanikirije, Kandi ndabikunda bihebuje.
Nitondeye amateka washinze n’ivyo wihanikirije: Kukw inzira zanje zose zir’ imbere yawe.
Uhoraho, ugutakamba kwanje ni kwīgire hafi imbere yawe; Umpe ubgenge, nk’ukw ijambo ryawe ryavuze.
Ukwinginga kwanje ni gushike imbere yawe; Undokore, nk’ukw ijambo ryawe ryavuze.
Iminwa yanje ivuge ishimwe, Kuk’ unyigisha ivyo washinze.
Ururimi rwanje ni ruririmbe ijambo ryawe, Kukw amabgirizwa yawe yose ar’ ay’ ukugororoka.
Ukuboko kwawe kwame kugabirije kuntabara, Kuko natoranije amateka washinze.
Uhoraho, nifuje agakiza kawe, Kand’ ivyagezwe vyawe ni vyo bimpimbara.
Ubugingo bganje ni bubeho, kugira ngo bugushime: Imanza zawe zintabare.
Narahuvye nk’intama izimiye: rondera umusavyi wawe, Kuko ntibagira amabgirizwa yawe.
Mu magorwa yanje natakambiye Uhoraho, Aranyishura.
Uhoraho, kiza ubugingo bganje iminwa ibesha N’ururimi rw’ingunge.
Wa rurimi rw’ingunge we, Azoguha iki, azoguhetera iki?
N’imyampi isongoye y’abahizi, N’amakara y’igiti c’umurotemu.
Ewe jewe ndagowe, kuko mba i Mesheki nd’ inyambukīra, Nkaba mu mahema y’i Kedari!
Umutima wanje wahereye kera ubana N’uwanka amahoro.
Jeho ngomba amahoro: Arikw iyo ngize ico mvuga, bo bagomba intambara.
Ndunamurira amaso yanje ku misozi: Ugutabarwa kwanje kuzova hehe?
Ugutabarwa kwanje kuva k’ Uhoraho Yaremye ijuru n’isi.
Ntazokundira ibirenge vyawe ko bitirimuka, Ūkuzigama ntazohunyiza.
Mbere, ūzigama Abisirayeli Ntazohunyiza kandi ntazosinzira.
Uhoraho ni we muzigamyi wawe, Uhoraho ni we gitūtu cawe i buryo bgawe.
Izuba ntirizokwica ku murango, Cank’ ukwezi mw ijoro.
Uhoraho azokurinda ikibi cose; Ni we azozigama ubugingo bgawe.
Uhoraho azokuzigama mu maja no mu maza, Uhereye none, ugashitsa ibihe bidashira.
Naranezerewe hamwe bambgira, Bati Tugende tuje ku ngoro y’Uhoraho.
Ibirenge vyacu bihagaze Mu birimba vyawe, ewe Yerusalemu.
Yerusalemu, wubatswe Nk’igisagara c’icomeke:
Ah’ imiryango ikūkira, ni yo miryango y’Uhoraho, Ngo bibe igishingantahe ku Bisirayeli, Kandi bashime izina ry’Uhoraho.
Kukw ari ho batereka intebe z’imanza, Intebe z’ab’ inzu ya Dawidi.
Ni musabire Yerusalemu amahoro; Abagukunda batōtahare.
Amahoro abe imbere mu nzitiro zawe, Itōto ribe mu ngoro zawe.
Kubga bene Data na bagenzi banje Ndavuga, nt’ Amahoro abe muri wewe.
Kubg’ ingoro y’Uhoraho Imana yacu Nzokwendeza ivyiza.
Kuri wewe ni ho nunamurira amaso, Wewe uvyagiye mw ijuru.
Nk’ukw amaso y’abashumba bayahanga ukuboko kwa shebuja, Kandi nk’ukw amaso y’incoreke iyahanga ukuboko kwa inabuja, Ni kw amaso yacu tuyahanga Uhoraho, Imana yacu, Gushitsa ah’ azotugirira ikigongwe.
Utugirire ikigongwe, Uhoraho we, utugirire ikigongwe, Kuko tuduhiwe cane n’agakēngērwe;
Imitima yacu iduhiwe cane N’agacokoro k’abidibamiye, N’agakēngērwe k’abībone.
Iyaba Uhoraho atari we yari mu ruhande rwacu, N’abe ari kw Abisirayeli bavuga none;
Iyaba Uhoraho atari we yari mu ruhande rwacu, Hamwe abantu bādukūrira hasi,
Baba baratuyongobeje tukibona, Hamwe uburake bgabo bgārurumba kuri twebge.
Amazi aba yaraturengeye rwose, Isūri iba yararenze ku bugingo bgacu,
Amazi asūriranya aba yararenze ku bugingo bgacu.
Uhoraho ashemagizwe, Atādutanze ngo tube inyama z’amenyo yabo.
Ubugingo bgacu bukize nk’ ukw inyoni iva mu mutego w’abatezi, Umutego uracitse, natwe tuvamwo turarokoka.
Ugutabarwa kwacu kubonerwa mw izina ry’Uhoraho Yaremye ijuru n’isi.
Abizigiye Uhoraho bameze nk’umusozi Siyoni Udashobora kunyiganyizwa, ariko wama ushimangiye gushitsa ibihe bidashira.
Nk’ukw imisozi ikikije Yerusalemu Ni k’Uhoraho akikije abantu biwe, Uhereye none, ugashitsa ibihe vyose.
Kukw icumu ry’ubugabe ry’ abanyakibi ritazokwama rishinze mu mugabane w’ abagororotsi; Abagororotsi boye kurāmvurira amaboko ibigabitanyo.
Uhoraho, girira neza abanyenda nziza, Bo n’abatunganye mu mitima.
Arikw abizimagiriza mu nzira zabo zigoramye, Uhoraho azobashorerana n’ inkozi z’ibibi. Amahoro abe mu Bisirayeli.
Hamwe Uhoraho yagarukana ab’i Siyoni bāri bārambukanywe ar’ inyagano Twāri tumeze nk’abarota.
Ico gihe akanwa kacu kāri kuzuye ibitwengatwenga, N’indimi zacu zāri zuzuyemw’ indirimbo: Ico gihe mu mahanga bāvuga, Bat’ Uhoraho yabakoreye ibikomeye.
Ni koko, Uhoraho yadukoreye ibikomeye, Natwe turanezerewe.
Uhoraho, abambukanywe ar’ inyagano utugarukane, Tumere nk’imigezi y’i Negebu.
Ababiba barira bazokwimbura banezerewe.
Nah’ umuntu agenda arira, asohoye imbuto, Azogarukana akanyamuneza, azanye imbambo ziwe z’ ivyimburwa.
Uhoraho iy’ atari we yubaka inzu Abayubaka baba baruhira ubusa. Uhoraho iy’ atari we azigama igisagara Umuteramyi abera maso ubusa.
Bibaruhiriza ubusa kuzinduka kare, mugateba cane kuruhuka, Mukarya umutsima w’ubutame: Uwo akunda abimuhēra mw itiro.
Abana ni bo ngabire Uhoraho agaba, Imbuto zo mu nda ni zo mpēra atanga.
Nk’ukw imyampi yo mu ntoke z’umuhizi iri, Ni kw abana bo mu busore bamera.
Hahirwa ūfise umutana buzuyemwo: Abameze bartyo ntibazotētērwa Ni bagira ico bavuganira n’abansi babo mu marembo.
Hahirwa uwubaha Uhoraho wese, Akagendera mu nzira ziwe.
Ibikorwa vy’amaboko yawe bizogutunga, Uzonezerwa, uzohirwa.
Umugore wawe azoba nk’ umuzabibu wama cane, ari haruguru mu nzu yawe; Abana bawe bazoba nk’utugemwe twa elayo, bakikije ameza yawe.
Uko ni k’umuntu yubaha Uhoraho azohirwa.
Uhoraho azoguha umugisha uva i Siyoni, Nawe uzobona ivyiza biza kuri Yerusalemu, imisi yose uzobaho;
Mbere, uzobona abuzukuru bawe. Amahoro abe mu Bisirayeli.
Bāmbabaje kenshi, uhereye mu buto bganje, Abe ari kw Abisirayeli bavuga none:
Bāmbabaje kenshi, uhereye mu buto bganje, Ariko ntibānnesheje.
Abarimyi bārimye ku mugongo wanje: Bāhaciye imikuku miremire.
Uhoraho n’umugororotsi; Yaciye ingoyi abanyakibi bānshizemwo.
Abanka Siyoni bose Ni bamāramāre, basubizwe inyuma.
Babe nk’ivyimejeje ku mazu, Vyuma bitarakura:
Ivy’ umwimbuzi atazokwuzuza n’ikiganza ciwe, Cank’ ūtekera imbambo atazokwuzuza ico yateze.
Abahita ntibaze bababgire, Ng’ Umugisha w’Uhoraho n’ube kuri mwebge; Canke ngo Tubahezagiye mw izina ry’Uhoraho.
Uhoraho, ndagutakambiye nd’ i bgina:
Bgirukiro, ni wumve ijwi ryanje; Amatwi yawe uyabangire kwumva Ijwi ryo kwinginga kwanje.
Uhoraho, wokwama wibuka ibigabitanyo, Bgirukiro, ni nde yohava akazohagarara adatsinzwe?
Ariko guharirwa kubonerwa kuri wewe Kugira ngo wubahwe.
Nditeze Uhoraho, umutima wanje uramwiteze, Kand’ ijambo ryiwe ni ryo nizigiye.
Umutima wanje uriteze Umwami Imana, Urusha ukw abateramyi basūra ko buca: Eka urusha ukw abateramyi basūra ko buca.
Yemwe Bisirayeli, ni mwizigire Uhoraho, Kukw imbabazi zibonerwa k’Uhoraho, Kandi kuri we ni ho habonerwa gucungurwa kwinshi.
Kandi ni we azocungura Abisirayeli, Abakūrekw ivyo bagabitanije vyose.
Uhoraho, umutima wanje ntiwibona, kand’ amaso yanje ntiyishira hejuru; Kandi sinishira mu vyo ntagezwemwo, Canke mu bitangaza bindengeye.
N’ukuri umutima wanje ndawuhwekereje, ndawuhojeje; Nk’uk’ umwana w’umucuko yigwandika kuri nyina, Umutima wanje wigwandika kuri jewe nk’umwana w’ umucuko.
Wa bgoko bg’Abisirayeli, ni wizigire Uhoraho, Uhereye none ugashitsa ibihe bidashira.
Uhoraho, ni wibukire Dawidi amarushwa yiwe yose;
Ingene yarahiye Uhoraho indahiro, Yasezeraniye Inyenkomezi ya Yakobo,
Ati N’ukuri nkazokwinjira mw ihema ari yo nzu yanje, Nkazokwurira ku buriri bganje,
Nkazokundira amaso yanje gusinzira, Cank’ ibigohe vyanje guhunira,
Ntararonkera Uhoraho ikibanza, Ntararonkera Inyenkomezi ya Yakobo aho kuba.
Twavyumviye muri Efurata, Twabibonye mu gahinga k’i Yayari.
Ni twinjire mw ihema ryayo, Dusengere imbere y’indava y’ibirenge vyayo.
Uhoraho, n’uhaguruke, winjire mu buruhukiro bgawe; Wewe ubgawe n’isandugu y’ inkomezi zawe.
Abaherezi bawe bambare ukugororoka; N’abakunzi bawe bavuze impundu.
Kubga Dawidi umusavyi wawe Ntukimiranye uwo warobanuje amavuta.
Uhoraho yarahiye Dawidi indahiro y’ukuri, Ntazokwirahuruza: Ati Nzoshira ku ngoma yawe uwamutse mu bura bgawe.
Abana bawe ni bitondera isezerano ryanje, N’ivyo nzokwihanikiriza nkabigisha, N’abana babo bazokwama bari ku ngoma yawe ibihe bidashira.
Kuk’ Uhoraho yatoranije Siyoni, Yahagomwe ngw ahabe.
At’ Aha ni ho buruhukiro bganje ibihe bidashira: Aha ni ho nzoba; kuko nahagomwe.
Ivyo kurya vyaho nzobihezagira cane, Nzohāza aboro baho umutsima.
Kand’ abaherezi baho nzobambika agakiza: Abakunzi banje baho bazosēsereza impundu.
Ni ho nzotuma ihembe rya Dawidi rimera, Uwo narobanuje amavuta nkamutegurira itara.
Abansi biwe nzobakorera ibara; Ariko we, igitsibo ciwe kizomukayanganako.
Ewe kuntu ari vyiza kand’ ar’ ivy’ igikundiro Kw abavukana babana nyakubana!
Bimeze nk’amavuta ya elayo y’igiciro kinini yasutswe ku mutwe, Agashororokera mu bganwa, Mu bganwa bga Aroni, Agashororokera ku misozo y’impuzu ziwe.
Kandi bimeze nk’ikime co kuri Herumoni, Gitonda ku misozi y’i Siyoni: Kukw ah’ ari ho Uhoraho yagereye umugisha, Ni wo bugingo bg’ibihe bidashira.
Ni mushemagize Uhoraho, yemwe basavyi b’ Uhoraho mwese, Bakesha ijoro bahagaze mu ngoro y’Uhoraho.
Mutarike amaboko yanyu, muyatumbereje ahēra, Mushemagize Uhoraho.
Uhoraho aguhe umugisha uva i Siyoni; Ni we yaremye ijuru n’isi.
Haleluya! Ni mushime izina ry’ Uhoraho; Ni mumushime, yemwe basavyi b’Uhoraho,
Mwebge abahagarara mu ngoro y’Uhoraho, Mu nyubakwa z’ingoro y’ Imana yacu.
Mushimire Uhoraho yukw ari mwiza; Muririmbire izina ryiwe ishimwe, kukw ar’ iry’ igikundiro.
Kuk’ Uhoraho yitoranirije Yakobo, Isirayeli yamutoranirije kuba uwiwe bgite.
Kuko nzi yuk’ Uhoraho ahambaye, Kandi yuk’ Umwami wacu asumba ibigirwamana vyose.
Igihimbaye Uhoraho cose ni co akora, Mw ijuru no mw isi, mu kiyaga n’i bgina hose.
Arandisha ibipfungu bikava ku mpera y’isi; Imvura ayiremera imiravyo; Asokorora umuyaga mu bushinguro bgiwe.
Ni we yakubise abana b’ imfura bo muri Egiputa, arabica, Imfura z’abantu bo n’uburiza bg’ibitungano.
Yarungitse ibimenyetso n’ibitangaza hagati yawe, Egiputa, Kuri Farawo no ku basavyi biwe bose.
Ni we yariritse amahanga menshi, Yica abami bahambaye:
Sihoni, umwami w’Abamori, Na Ogi, umwami w’i Bashani, N’abami b’ibihugu vy’i Kanani bose;
Agaba ibihugu vyabo ngo bibe umwandu, Umwandu w’Abisirayeli abantu biwe.
Izina ryawe, Uhoraho, ryamah’ ibihe bidashira, Ewe Uhoraho, icibutso cawe kizohorah’ ibihe vyose.
Kuk’ Uhoraho azocira urubanza abantu biwe, Kand’ azokwirimbūra ku vyo agirira abasavyi biwe.
Ibigirwamana vy’abanyamahanga n’ifeza n’izahabu, N’ibikorwa n’amaboko y’abantu.
Bifise akanwa, ntibivuga, Bifise amaso, ntibibona,
Bifise amatwi, ntivyumva, Kandi nta mpwemu ziri mu kanwa kavyo.
Ababikora bazohwana na vyo, Mbere n’ūvyizigira wese.
Yemwe ab’ inzu ya Isirayeli, mushemagize Uhoraho: Yemwe ab’ inzu ya Aroni, mushemagize Uhoraho:
Yemwe ab’ inzu ya Lewi, mushemagize Uhoraho: Yemwe abubaha Uhoraho, mumushemagize!
Bashemagirize Uhoraho i Siyoni, Ni we aba i Yerusalemu. Haleluya!
Ni mushimire Uhoraho yukw ari mwiza: Kukw imbabazi ziwe zamah’ ibihe bidashira.
Ni mushime Imana isumba ivyitwa imana, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira.
Ni mushime Umwami w’ abami, Kukw imbabazi ziwe zamah’ ibihe bidashira.
Ni mushime īkora ibitangaza bikomeye yonyene, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira.
Ni mushime iyaremesheje ijuru ubgenge, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira.
Ni mushime iyagaranzuye isi hejuru y’amazi, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira.
Ni mushime iyaremye ibibonesha bikuru, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira.
Yaremye izuba ngo riganze umurango, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira;
Yaremye ukwezi n’inyenyeri ngo biganze ijoro, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira.
Ni mushime iyaririkiye Abanyegiputa abana babo b’ imfura, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira;
Igakūra Abisirayeli hagati yabo, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira;
Ibakūjey’ ikiganza gikomeye n’ukuboko kurāmvuye: Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira.
Ni mushime iyatandukanije Ikiyaga Gitukura, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira;
Igacisha Abisirayeli hagati yaco, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira;
Arikw igakunkumurira Farawo n’ingabo ziwe mu Kiyaga Gitukura, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira.
Ni mushime iyarōngōye abantu bayo mu bugaragwa, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira.
Ni mushime iyariritse abami bahambaye, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira;
Ikica abami bābaye ba rurangiranwa, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira;
Yica Sihoni, umwami w’ Abamori, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira;
Yica na Ogi, umwami w’i Bashani, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira;
Igaba ibihugu vyabo ngo bibe umwandu, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira;
Mbere ngo bibe umwandu w’Abisirayeli, abasavyi bayo, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira.
Yaratwibutse aho twāri mu bufafara, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira;
Idukiza abarwanizi bacu, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira.
Igaburira ibifise imibiri vyose, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira.
Ni mushime Imana yo mw ijuru, Kukw imbabazi zayo zamah’ ibihe bidashira.
Ku nzūzi z’i Babuloni Ni ho twāhora twicara, mbere tugaturika tukarira, Twibutse i Siyoni.
Ku biti vyaho Ni ho twari tumanitse inanga zacu.
Kukw abātwambukanye tur’ inyagano bātugomberakw indirimbo aho hantu, Abātugaraguza agati bātugombakw akanyamuneza, Bati Ni muturirimbire ku ndirimbo z’i Siyoni.
Mbega tworirimba dute indirimbo y’Uhoraho Turi mu mahanga?
Yerusalemu we, ni nakwibagira, N’ukuboko kwanje kw’i buryo ni kwibagire gukora.
N’ururimi rwanje rumatane no mu māgāge Ni ntakwibuka, Ni ntakunda Yerusalemu Ngo ndaharutishe ibinnezereza vy’agahebuza.
Uhoraho, ibuka Abanyedomu Ivyo bagize wa musi w’i Yerusalemu; Ni bo bavuze, bati Ni muhasangangure, ni muhasangangure, Mushitse no kw itanguriro ryaho.
Ewe wa mukobga Babuloni, wa muranduzi we, Hazohirwa ūzogusubiriza mu nkōko Ibihwanye n’ivyo watugiriye!
Hazohirwa ūzofata abana bawe bato Akabahonda ku rutare!
Ndagushimisha umutima wose; Ndakuririmbira ishimwe imbere y’ivyitwa imana.
Ndasenga ntumbereye urusengero rwawe rwera, Nshimira izina ryawe imbabazi zawe n’ukuri kwawe: Kuko washize hejuru ijambo ryawe n’izina ryawe Kubirutisha ibindi vyose.
Umusi nagutakambiyeko waranyishuye, Undemeshesha gusubiza intege mu mutima wanje.
Uhoraho, abami bo mw isi bose bazogushima, Kuko bumvise amajambo yo mu kanwa kawe.
Mbere bazoririmba inzira z’ Uhoraho, Kukw icubahiro c’Uhoraho ar’ agahambaye.
Kuko nah’ Uhoraho ahambaye, ashira umutima ku bafafara, Arikw abībone abamenyera kure.
Naho ngendera hagati y’ amarushwa, uzonzigama; Uzorāmvurira ukuboko kwawe kurwanya uburake bg’ abansi banje, Ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo kuzonkiza.
Ivyanje, Uhoraho ni we azobishitsa: Uhoraho we, imbabazi zawe zamah’ ibihe bidashira; Ntuhebe ibikorwa vy’amaboko yawe.
Uhoraho waransuzumye, urammenya,
Urazi iyicara ryanje n’īva hasi ryanje, Umenyera kure ivyo niyumvira.
Usorongora inzira zanje n’ iryama ryanje, Urazi iminyuro yanje yose.
Kukw ata jambo riza mu rurimi rwanje Wewe Uhoraho utararimenya rwose.
Unkikije inyuma n’imbere, Unshizek’ ukuboko kwawe.
Kumenya ben’ ukwo n’igitangaza ntobasha; Kuransiga, simbasha kugushikīra.
Mbega Mpwemu wawe nomuhungira hehe? Canke nohungira hehe mu nyonga hawe?
Nodūga nkaja mw ijuru, uriyo: Nokwisasira i kuzimu, eh’ uriyo.
Nokwābīra amababa y’umutwenzi, Nkagerēra ku mpera y’ikiyaga;
Aho na ho ukuboko kwawe kwohandōngōrera, Ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo kwohamfatira.
Nokwibgira, nti N’ukuri umwiza ugira unyubikizeko, N’umuco unkikije uhinduke ijoro;
N’umwiza na wo ntugira ico woguhisha, Ariko mw ijoro habona nko ku murango; Umwiza n’umuco kuri wewe ni bimwe.
Kukw ari wewe waremye amafyigo yanje; Wanteranirije mu nda ya mama.
Ndagushimira yuko naremwe uburyo buteye ubgoba butangaje: Ibikorwa vyawe n’ibitangaza; Kand’ ivyo, umutima wanje urabizi neza.
Urukanka rw’umubiri wanje ntiwaruhishwa Hamwe naremerwa mu mpisho, Hamwe naremesherezwa ubgenge i bgina mw isi.
Nkir’ urusoro, inyonga zawe zarambona, Mu gitabo cawe handitswemw’ imisi yanje yose, Yashinzwe hatarabaho n’ umwe.
Erega Mana, ivyiyumviro vyawe n’ivy’ igiciro kuri jewe! Ereg’ igitigiri cavyo ni kinini!
Nobiharūra, vyoruta umusenyi mu bginshi: Nikangura nkiri kumwe nawe.
Mana, icompa ukica abanyakibi: Mva i ruhande, mwa bagwisha inkumbi mwe.
Bakuvugana icīra bacumura, Abansi bawe bavugira ubusa izina ryawe.
Uhoraho, mbega sinanka abakwanka? Kandi sinshavuzwa n’abagukūriye hasi?
Mbanka urwanko rwuzuye: Kuri jewe n’abansi.
Mana, nsuzuma, umenye umutima wanje, N’uncace, umenye ivyiyumviro vyanje,
Urābe yuko harih’ inzira y’ibibi yoba iri muri jewe, Undōngōrere mu nzira y’ ibihe bidashira.
Uhoraho, nkiza abanyakibi: Undinde abantu b’ibirara.
Biyumvira ivy’ inzigo mu mitima yabo, Na ntaryo bandurutsa intambara.
Basongoye indimi zabo nk’ inzoka; Ubumara bg’imvuvyi buri mu binyigishi vyabo.
Uhoraho, nkiza amaboko y’ abanyakibi, Undinde abantu b’ibirara: Bagabiye kuraririza ibirenge vyanje.
Abībone banteze umutego n’ igitsiburira; Banteze ururiba i ruhande y’inzira; Banteze ibigāmo.
Nabgiye Uhoraho, nti Ni wewe Mana yanje: Tega ugutwi ijwi ry’ukwinginga kwanje, Uhoraho we.
Uhoraho, Bgirukiro we, nkomezi z’agakiza kanje, Ni wewe ukīngira umutwe wanje ku musi w’intambara.
Uhoraho we, ntiwemerere umunyakibi ivyo yifuza; Ntiwūngānire imigabo yiwe mibi, ngo boye kwishira hejuru.
Ukugira nabi kwo mu kanwa kw’abantaye hagati Ni kubasubire ku mitwe, kubatwikire.
Amakara yaka abagweko, Batābge mu muriro; Bakororerwe mu vyobo birebire, ngo boye gusubira kuvyuka ukundi.
Sakirimikibi ntazokomezwa mu gihugu: Ibibi bizohama umuntu w’ ikirara kugira ngo bimuhenebereze.
Ndazi yuk’ Uhoraho azohagarikira impahazwa mu mibūrano, N’umukene azomuhagarikira mu manza.
N’ukuri abagororotsi bazoshima izina ryawe: Abatunganye bazoba imbere y’inyonga zawe.
Uhoraho, ndagutakambiye: tebuka, uze aho ndi: Utege ugutwi ijwi ryanje, ni nagutakambira.
Ugusenga kwanje gushirwe imbere yawe nk’imibavu, N’amaboko yanje kuyatarika kube nk’ikimazi co ku mugoroba.
Uhoraho, shira umurinzi imbere y’akanwa kanje: Rinda umuryango w’iminwa yanje.
Ntuhindurire umutima wanje ku kibi na kimwe, Ngo mfatanye ibikorwa vyo kugabitanya N’inkozi z’ibibi: Noye gusangira na zo ibigemanije vyazo.
Umugororotsi ankubise, bizoba ar’ ukungirira neza; Ampannye, bizoba ari nko kunsīga amavuta ya elayo mu mutwe: Umutwe wanje woye kuvyanka. Ariko gusenga kwanje gukomeza kurwanya ivyaha vya ba bandi.
Abacamanza babo bazotembagarizwa mu manga, Ni ho abantu bazokwumviriza amajambo yanje, kukw aryoshe.
Nk’uk’ umuntu arima, agaca isemo, Ni kw amagufa yacu asābagiye ku munwa w’i kuzimu.
Uhoraho Bgirukiro, ni wewe mpanze amaso, Ni wewe nizigiye: ntunte ngo mbe ruhebga.
Undinde umutego banteze, N’ibigāmo vy’inkozi z’ibibi.
Abanyakibi abe ari bo bagwa mu rwabo ruriba, Ariko jeho mbisimbe.
Ndatakambishiriza Uhoraho ijwi ryanje: Ijwi ryanje ndaryingingisha Uhoraho.
Ndajojera amaganya yanje imbere yiwe: Amagorwa yanje ndayaserura imbere yiwe.
Iy’ umutima wanje undendebukiyemwo ni wewe umenya iminyuro yanje. Mu nzira ncamwo bantezemw’ umutego.
Itegereze i buryo bganje, urābe ko har’ umuntu ampa ni rwere: Mbuze ubuhungiro; nta muntu ababaye ubugingo bganje.
Ndagutakambira, Uhoraho we, Nkakubgira, nti Ni wewe buhungiro bganje, N’umugabane wanje mw isi y’abakiriho.
Banga ugutwi ugutakamba kwanje, kuko ncishijwe bugufi cane: Unkize abampama, kuko bandusha inkomezi.
Kūra umutima wanje mw ibohero, kugira ngo nshime izina ryawe; Abagororotsi bazonkikiza, Kuk’ uzoba ungiriye neza.
Uhoraho we, ni wumve ugusenga kwanje; tega ugutwi ukwinginga kwanje! Unyishure, kubgo kuba umwizigirwa kwawe, no kubgo kugororoka kwawe.
Kandi ntushire umusavyi wawe mu rukinja, Kukw ata wo mu bariho azotsindira mu nyonga zawe.
Kuk’ umwansi yahize umutima wanje; Akantsinda hasi akansiribanga; Yatumye ngerēra ahantu h’ umwiza nk’abāpfuye kera.
Ni co gitumye umushaha wanje undendebukiramwo, Umutima wanje ukūmirirwa muri jewe.
Nibutse imisi ya kera; Ndimbūra ivyo wakoze vyose: Ngereranya igikorwa c’amaboko yawe.
Nkwayira amaboko; Umushaha wanje ukugirira inyota nk’iy’ igihugu cūmāniwe.
Uhoraho, n’utebuke unyishure; umutima wanje urashiringitira; Ntumpishe mu nyonga hawe; Simmere nk’abamanuka baja muri rwa rwobo.
Mu gitondo unyumvishe imbabazi zawe, Kukw ari wewe nizigira: Ummenyeshe inzira nkwiye gucamwo, Kukw ari wewe ncurūrira umutima.
Uhoraho, nkiza abansi banje: Ni wewe mpungiyeko ng’ umpishe.
Unyigishe gukora ivyo ugomba, kukw ari wewe Mana yanje: Mpwemu wawe mwiza andōngōre mu nzira irashe.
Uhoraho, ungire muzima, kubg’ izina ryawe: Ukūre umutima wanje mu vyago kubg’ ukugororoka kwawe.
Kand’ urandure abansi banje kubg’ imbabazi zawe. Uhonnye abababaza umushaha wanje bose; Kuko nd’ umusavyi wawe.
Uhoraho, igitandara canje, n’ashemagizwe, Yigisha amaboko yanje kurasana, N’intoke zanje kurwana:
Ni we ndonkeramw’ imbabazi, kandi ni we gihome kinkīngira, Ni we munara wanje muremure, n’umurokozi wanje; Ni we nkinzo yanje n’uwo nizigira; Ni we angandurira abantu banje ngo ndabaganze.
Uhoraho, umuntu n’iki ah’ umumenya? Cank’ umwana w’umuntu ah’ umwiyumvira?
Umuntu ameze nk’impwemu zihumetswe gusa: Imisi yiwe imeze nk’igitūtu gishira.
Andāza ijuru ryawe, Uhoraho we, nawe wimanukire: Ukore ku misozi, ifumbe umwotsi.
Uravye imiravyo, ubashwiragize; Urase imyampi yawe, ubace ivutu.
Rāmvura ukuboko kwawe uri hejuru, Undohōre, undokore mu mazi menshi, Unkize ukuboko kw’abanyamahanga.
Akanwa kabo kavuga ivyo kubesha, N’ukuboko kwabo kw’i buryo n’ukunyabinyoma.
Mana, ndakuririmbira indirimbo nsha: Ndakuririmbira ishimwe ku nanga y’imirya cumi.
Ni wewe uha abami agakiza: Kiza Dawidi umusavyi wawe inkota yica.
Ndokora, unkūre mu maboko y’abanyamahanga, Akanwa kabo kavuga ivyo kubesha, N’ukuboko kwabo kw’i buryo n’ukunyabinyoma.
Abahungu bacu ni babe nk’ibiti vy’ibitontomya mu kwaruka kwabo, N’abakobga bacu bamere nk’ inkingi zihinguwe nk’uko bashariza ingoro;
Ngw ibigega vyacu vyuzure, birimw’ ivyimburwa vy’ imyuga yose; Intama zacu zivyarire ibihumbi n’ibihumbi mu vyanya vyacu;
Ngw inka zacu zidibirize; Ngo hoye kugira abamena, cank’ abasohoka kurwana; Kandi mu mihōra yacu hoye kuvuga induru.
Hahirwa ihanga rimererwa rirtyo: Hahirwa ihanga rifise Uhoraho kw Imana yaryo.
Mana yanje, Mwami wanje, ndagushira hejuru; Nzoshemagiza izina ryawe ibihe bitazoshira.
Nzokwama ngushemagiza uko bukeye, Nzoshima izina ryawe ibihe bitazoshira.
Uhoraho arahambaye, abereye gushimwa cane: Ubukuru bgiwe ntibushobora guserangurika.
Ab’ urunganwe rumwe bazoshimira ab’ urundi ibikorwa vyawe, Babīgānire ivy’ inkomezi wakoze.
Nzovuga ubgiza bg’igitinyiro c’icubahiro cawe, Nzoririmba ibikorwa bitangaje wakoze.
Abantu bazovuga inkomezi z’ ibikorwa vyawe biteye ubgoba: Nanje nzomenyekanisha ubukuru bgawe.
Bazokwibukiriza ukugira neza kwawe kwinshi, Baririmbe ukugororoka kwawe.
Uhoraho n’umunyabuntu, yuzuye imbabazi, Ateba kuraka, agira ikigongwe cinshi.
Uhoraho agirira neza bose, Imbabazi ziwe ziri ku vyo yaremye vyose.
Uhoraho, ivyo waremye vyose bizogushima: Abakunzi bawe bazogushemagiza.
Bazovuga ubgiza bg’ubgami bgawe, Bandagaze ububasha bgawe,
Kugira ngo bamenyeshe abana b’abantu ivy’ inkomezi wakoze, N’ubgiza bg’igitinyiro c’ ubgami bgawe.
Ubgami bgawe n’ubgami bg’ ibihe bidashira, Ubugabe bgawe buzohangama uk’ urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikira urundi.
Uhoraho aramira abatemba bose, Yēmesha abahetamye bose.
Vyose biguhanga amaso, Nawe ukabigaburira ivyo kurya vyavyo igihe kigeze.
Upfumbaturura igipfunsi cawe, Ugahāza ukwifuza kw’ibiriho vyose.
Uhoraho agororoka mu nzira ziwe zose, N’umunyabuntu mu bikorwa vyiwe vyose.
Uhoraho aba hafi y’abamwambaza bose, Y’abamwambaza mu vy’ukuri bose.
Azoshitsa ivyo abamwubaha bagomba; Kand’ azokwumva ugutakamba kwabo, abakize.
Uhoraho azigama abamukunda bose; Arikw abanyakibi bose azobahonnya.
Akanwa kanje kazovuga ishimwe ry’Uhoraho; Abafise imibiri bose ni bashemagize izina ryiwe ryera ibihe bitazoshira.
Haleluya! Mutima wanje, n’ushime Uhoraho.
Nzokwama nshima Uhoraho nkiriho, Nzokwama ndirimbira Imana yanje ishimwe ngihumeka.
Ntimukishimire abahambaye, Cank’ umwana w’umuntu n’ umwe, ata co yoshobora gukiza.
Impwemu ziwe zimuvamwo, akisubirira mw ivu ryiwe; Uwo musi nyene imigabo yiwe igashira.
Hahirwa ūfise Imana ya Yakobo k’umutabazi wiwe, Akizigira Uhoraho Imana yiwe:
Ni we yaremye ijuru n’isi, N’ikiyaga n’ibiri muri vyo vyose; Agumya ukuri gushitsa ibihe bidashira.
Acira imanza impahazwa; Agaburira abashonje ivyo kurya. Uhoraho ni we abohora imbohe;
Uhoraho ni we ahumūra impumyi; Uhoraho ni we yēmesha abahetamye; Uhoraho ni we akunda abagororotsi;
Uhoraho ni we azigama inyambukīra; Ashigikira impfuvyi n’umupfakazi; Arikw inzira y’abanyakibi arayigoreka.
Uhoraho azohora ahangamye uk’ urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikira urundi, Imana yawe, Siyoni, izohora ihangamye ibihe vyose. Haleluya!
Haleluya, Kukw ari vyiza kuririmbira Imana yacu ishimwe; Biraryoshe, kandi gushima kurakwiye!
Uhoraho ni we yubaka Yerusalemu; Akoraniriza hamwe abāri bārasābagijwe bo mu Bisirayeli.
Akiza abafise imitima imenetse, Apfuka inguma zabo.
Aharūra inyenyeri uko zingana, Zose azita amazina yazo.
Umwami wacu arahambaye, n’umunyenkomezi nyinshi; Ubgenge bgiwe n’akaburarugero.
Uhoraho aramira abaciye bugufi: Acisha abanyakibi bugufi, akabashitsa hasi.
Muririmbire Uhoraho mumukengurukira, Muririmbire Imana yacu ishimwe muvugira inanga.
Yorosa ijuru ibicu, Itegura imvura ngw igwe kw isi, Imeza ubgatsi ku misozi.
Igaburira ibitungano ivyo kurya vyavyo, N’ivyana vy’ibikōna vyayagura.
Inkomezi z’ifarasi si zo ziyihimbara, Amaguru y’umuntu si yo inezererwa.
Uhoraho anezererwa abamwubaha, Anezererwa abitega imbabazi ziwe.
Yerusalemu, n’ushime Uhoraho; Siyoni, n’ushime Imana yawe.
Kuko yakomeje imyugariro y’ ibirimba vyawe; Yahezagiye abana bawe baba muri wewe.
Igihugu cawe agiha impore, Aguhāza ingano zisētse neza.
Arungika icagezwe ciwe mw isi; Ijambo ryiwe ryiruka vuba cane.
Atanga shelegi nk’ubgoya bg’ intama; Asanzaza urume rw’igikonyozi nk’umunyota.
Amija urubura rwiwe nk’ imvunguka: Ni nde yobasha kwihanga imbeho yiwe?
Arungika ijambo ryiwe, akabiyagisha; Ahehereza umuyaga wiwe, amazi agasubira gutemba.
Amenyesha aba Yakobo ijambo ryiwe, Amenyesha Abisirayeli ivyo yashinze, bo n’imanza ziwe.
Nta rindi hanga yagiriye artyo: Mbere n’imanza ziwe ntibāzimenye. Haleluya!
Haleluya! Mw ijuru ni mushime Uhoraho: Ni mumushimire ahasumba ijuru.
Yemwe mwa bamarayika biwe mwese, ni mumushime: Yemwe mwa ngabo ziwe zose, ni mumushime.
Yemwe zuba n’ukwezi, ni mumushime; Yemwe nyenyeri zaka zose, ni mumushime.
Yemwe majuru asumba amajuru, ni mumushime, Nawe mazi yo hejuru y’amajuru.
Ni bishime izina ry’Uhoraho, Kuko yageze bikaremwa,
Kandi yabihamangiye gushitsa ibihe bitazoshira; Yashinze icagezwe c’intahava.
Mw isi ni mushime Uhoraho, Yemwe bifi, namwe i bgina hose;
Namwe muriro n’urubura na shelegi n’igipfungu; Nawe muyaga w’igihuhuta, ushitsa ijambo ryiwe;
Namwe bisozi birebire n’uturambi twose; Namwe biti vyama bigatengengera, n’ibiti vy’amasederi vyose;
Namwe bikōko n’ibitungano vyose; Namwe ibikwega inda hasi n’ ibifise amababa;
Namwe bami bo mw isi n’ amahanga yose; Namwe abahambaye n’abacamanza bose bo mw isi;
Namwe misore n’inkumi; Namwe batāma n’abana:
Ni bishime izina ry’Uhoraho, Kukw izina ryiwe ryonyene ari ryo rishizwe hejuru: Ubukuru bgiwe buri hejuru y’isi n’ijuru.
Kandi yashize hejuru ihembe ry’abantu biwe, Ni ryo shimwe ry’abakunzi biwe bose, Ni bo Bisirayeli, ihanga yiyegereje. Haleluya!
Haleluya! Ni muririmbire Uhoraho indirimbo nsha, Muririmbire ishimwe ryiwe mw ikoraniro ry’abakunzi biwe.
Abisirayeli banezererwe Iyabaremye; Abana b’i Siyoni bagirire akaneza Umwami wabo.
Bashimire izina ryiwe mu mvyino: Bamuririmbire ishimwe batamba agashako k’ingoma, bavugira inanga.
Kuk’ Uhoraho ahimbarwa n’ abantu biwe: Azoshariza abaciye bugufi abambike agakiza.
Abakunzi biwe bavugirize impundu mur’ ico cubahiro: Baririmbishwe n’akanyamuneza bari ku mariri yabo.
Ishimwe ryo gushira Imana hejuru ribe mu gahogo kabo, N’inkota ibe mu ntoke zabo,
Yo kwihōresha amahanga, No guhanisha amoko;
Bakabohesha abami bayo iminyororo, N’abaganwa bayo imirinda:
Kugira ngo babashitsekw iteka ryanditswe: Ivyo ni vyo bitera icubahiro abakunzi biwe bose. Haleluya!
Haleluya! Mushimire Imana ahēra hayo, Muyishimire no mw itāzānure ry’ubushobozi bgayo!
Muyishimire ivy’ inkomezi yakoze, Muyishime nk’uko bibereye ubukuru bgayo buhambaye!
Muyishimishe ijwi ry’inzamba, Muyishimishe ikembe n’inanga;
Muyishimishe agashako k’ ingoma n’imvyino, Muyishimishe ibifise imirya n’imyironge;
Muyishimishe kuvuza cane ivyitwa matowazi, Muyishimishe kuvuza matowazi mw ijwi rirēngēra.
Igihumeka cose ni gishime Uhoraho! Haleluya!
Imigani ya Salomo mwene Dawidi, umwami w’Abisirayeli,
Yo kumenya ubgenge bo n’ inyigisho; Gutegēra amajambo y’ugutahura;
Kwigishwa gukora ibiroranye mu bgenge, Mu kugororoka, mu kwitegereza neza no mu gutunganya;
No guha imburabgenge kwiguranura, N’umusore kumuha ukumenya no kugira amakenga:
Kugira ng’ umunyabgenge yumve, yunguke ubgenge, Kandi ng’ umuntu w’umuhanga ashike ku kwemera inama nziza;
No ku gutahura umugani n’ikigereranyo, N’amajambo y’abanyabgenge n’ubupfindo bgabo bapfinda.
Kwubaha Uhoraho ni kwo tanguriro ry’ukumenya: Arikw ibipfu bikēngēra ubgenge n’inyigisho.
Mwana wanje, umva inyigisho ya so, Kandi ntute ibgirizwa rya nyoko:
Kuko bizokubera umugāra w’ubuntu mu mutwe, N’imigufu mw izosi.
Mwana wanje, abanyavyaha ni bakwosha Ntukemere.
Ni bakubgira, bati Ngwino ujane natwe, Turyamire kwica, Dutegere mu mpisho ūtagira igicumuro, ata nyanduruko;
Tubayongobeze nk’i kuzimu, bakibona, Ar’ imirava, nk’abamanuka baja muri rwa rwobo;
Tuzoronka ibintu vyose vy’ igiciro kinini, Tuzokwuzuza amazu yacu isahu;
Enda fadikanya natwe, Twese tugire umupfuko umwe:
Mwana wanje, ntuz’ ugendane na bo mu nzira, Ubuze ikirenge cawe inzira yabo,
Kukw ibirenge vyabo vyirukira gukora ikibi, Kandi bihutira kuvisha amaraso.
Kuk’ umutego utegerwa ubusa Ikiguruka cose iyo kibibona.
Kand’ abo, baryamira kuvisha ayabo maraso, Bategera mu mpisho ubgabo bugingo.
Uko ni kw inzira zimeze z’ umuntu wese w’ikirara ku nyungu: Inyungu ikūrah’ ubugingo bga ba nyene yo.
Bgenge arangururira ijwi mu nzira; Ashirira ijwi hejuru ahiyaguye;
Asemererera ku nama aho bakoranira; Mw ishikiro ku marembo, No mu gisagara, ni hoavugira amajambo yiwe:
Ati Yemwe bijuju, muzogeza ryari gukunda ubujuju? N’abacokoranyi guhimbarwa no gucokora? N’ibipfu kugirira urwanko ubgenge?
Muhindukire kubgo kwihanikiriza kwanje: Rāba, nzosuka impwemu yanje kuri mwebge, Nzobamenyesha amajambo yanje.
Ko nabahamagaye, namwe mukanka; Nkabākura, ntihagire ūbibabara;
Mukagaya inama zanje zose, Mukanka kwihanikiriza kwanje:
Nuko nanje nzobatwengera mw ijigo mu gihe c’ivyago vyanyu; Nzobitamba ku muvyimba, agatengo kabafashe;
Agatengo kanyu kabafashe nk’igihuhuta, Ivyago vyanyu bibazingazinze nk’agashururu, Guhagarika umutima n’ubusinzikare bibashikiriye.
Ni ho bazontakambira, ariko sinzobishura; Bazondondera ubudahumeka, ariko ntibazombona:
Nuko kuko bagiriye urwanko ubgenge, Ntibahitemwo kwubaha Uhoraho;
Bakanka inama zanje, Bagakēngēra ukwihanikiriza kwanje kwose;
Ni co gituma bazorya ku vy’ inzira zabo zāmuje, Bazohāga akazīkira kabo ubgabo.
Gukomantaza imitima kw’ imburabgenge kuzozica, Kand’ ukugubga neza kw’ibipfu kuzobihonnya.
Arik’ ūntega ugutwi wese azoba amahoro, Azokwama atekereje ata kibi atinya.
Mwana wanje, ni wemera amajambo yanje, Ukabīka amabgirizwa yanje muri wewe,
Bigatuma utega ugutwi ubgenge, Ugashira umutima ku gutahura;
Mbere ni wahamagara ubgenge, Ugashira ijwi hejuru uririra ugutahura;
Ni waburondera nk’ifeza, Ukabusesangura nk’ūrondera izahabu zanyegejwe;
Ni ho uzotahura ukwubaha Uhoraho ukw ari kwo, Ukaronka ukumenya Imana.
Kuk’ Uhoraho atanga ubgenge, Mu kanwa kiwe havamw’ ukumenya n’ugutahura.
Abīkira abagororotsi ubgenge buroranye, Ni we nkinzo y’abagenda batunganye.
Kugira ngw arinde inzira z’ imanza ziroranye, Kand’ azigame urugendo rw’ abayoboke biwe.
Ni ho uzotahura ubugororotsi n’imanza ziroranye, N’ibitunganye, mbere n’inzira nziza yose.
Kuk’ ubgenge buzokwinjira mu mutima wawe, Kand’ ukumenya kuzohimbara ubugingo bgawe.
Amakenga azogushibamira, Ugutahura kuzokuzigama,
Ngo bigukize inzira y’ikibi, N’abantu badadika,
Bata inzira zo kugororoka, Ngo bagendere mu nzira z’ umwiza;
Banezererwa gukora ikibi, Bahimbarwa n’ibidadi vy’ikibi;
Inzira zabo ziragoramanze, N’ingendo zabo n’izinguzingu.
Kandi ngo bigukize umugore w’icigenze, Mber’ igukize umunyamahangakazi ahemanisha amagambo yiwe,
Yataye umukunzi wo mu buto bgiwe, Yibagiye isezerano ry’Imana yiwe:
Kukw inzu yiwe ihengamiye mu rupfu, Kand’ inzira ziwe zija mu bāpfuye.
Abaja i we nta ho bagaruka ukundi, Kandi ntibashikīra inzira z’ ubugingo.
Ni ho uzogendera mu nzira y’abagira neza, Ukitondera inzira z’abagororotsi.
Kukw abagororotsi bazokwībēra mu gihugu, Kand’ abatunganye bazokwamayo.
Arikw abanyavyaha bazokomborwa mu gihugu, Kand’ abaguranyi bazorandurwa muri co.
Mwana wanje, ntuze wibagire ukwigisha kwanje, Arik’ umutima wawe witondere amabgirizwa yanje:
Kuko bizokwongerakw imisi myinshi, N’imyaka yo kuramvya ubugingo, n’amahoro.
Ubuntu n’ukuri ntibikuveko, Ubipfundike mw izosi ryawe, uvyandike ku gisate, ni co mutima wawe:
Ni ho uzobona gushimwa, bo n’ubgenge bushitse, Mu maso y’Imana n’abantu.
Wizigize Uhoraho umutima wawe wose, Kandi ntiwishimikize ubgenge bg’iwawe:
Umumenye mu ngendo zawe zose, Na we azogorora inzira zawe.
Ntukiyite umunyabgenge wewe ubgawe; Utinye Uhoraho, uve mu bibi:
Ivyo bizogutera kunonoka mu mubiri, No kugira umusokōro mu magufa yawe.
Wubahishe Uhoraho ibintu vyawe, Bo n’umushuzo w’ivyeze vyawe vyose.
Ni ho ibigega vyawe bizokwuzura vyongerekane, Kandi n’amato yawe azosēsekara imitobe.
Mwana wanje, ntugaye igikāngīro c’Uhoraho, Kandi nturambirwe n’uguhana kwiwe:
Kuk’ uwo Uhoraho akunda ari we ahana, Nk’uko se w’umwana nyene ahana umwana wiwe anezererwa.
Hahirwa umuntu yironkera ubgenge, N’umuntu aronse ugutahura.
Kukw inyungu zabgo ziruta iz’ ifeza, Kand’ ivyo bgunguka biruta izahabu zitarimw’ inkamba.
Burusha igiciro utubuyenge twitwa marijani: Kandi mu bihimbara vyose nta kintu gihwanye na bgo.
Ukuramba kuri mu kuboko kwabgo kw’i buryo, Mu kubamfu kwabgo harimw’ ubutunzi n’icubahiro.
Amayira yabgo n’amayira y’ igikundiro, Kand’ inzira zabgo zose n’iz’ amahoro.
Bubera igiti c’ubugingo ababucakira: Hahirwa umuntu wese abgumirako.
Uhoraho yashirishijeho isi ubgenge; Ugutahura ni kwo yagumishije ijuru.
Ukumenya kwiwe ni kwo kwatumye amasōko y’i kuzimu atoboka, N’ibipfungu bigatonyanga ikime.
Mwana wanje, ivyo ntibikave imbere y’amaso yawe: Ugumye ubgenge buroranye n’amakenga;
Ni ho bizobera umutima wawe ubugingo, N’izosi ryawe ugushaza.
Ni ho uzogenda mu nzira yawe ata nkomanzi, Kandi ntuzotsitara ikirenge cawe.
Ni waryama ntuzogira ubgoba, Mber’ uzoryama, ugire itiro riryoshe.
Ntuzotinya ubgoba bga giturumbuka, Cank’ ukuzingazingwa kw’ abanyavyaha ni kwashika:
Kuk’ Uhoraho azokubera ivyizigiro, Kand’ azorinda ikirenge cawe ngo ntigifatwe.
Ntukanke kugirira ivyiza ababibereye, Ugifise uburyo bgo kubikora.
Ntukabgire mugenzawe, uti Genda, uz’ugaruke, Ejo nzoguha; Kand’ ubifise ngaho.
Ntukīgīre imigabo yo kugirira nabi mugenzawe, Kand’ abana nawe amahoro.
Ntukarwane n’umuntu ata nyanduruko, Iy’ ata kibi yakugiriye.
Ntukagirire ishari umuntu w’ikirara, Ntugatore inzira yiwe n’imwe.
Kukw ikidambidambi n’igisesema k’Uhoraho, Arikw abagororotsi bo, asangiye ibanga na bo.
Umuvumo w’Uhoraho uri mu nzu y’abanyavyaha, Arikw ahezagira ingo z’abagororotsi.
N’ukuri yitamba ku muvyimba abacokoranyi, Arikw agirira ubuntu abicisha bugufi.
Abanyabgenge bazoragwa icubahiro, Arikw isoni ni zo zizoba umugabane w’ibipfu.
Yemwe bana, ni mwumve ukwigisha kwa so, Mushire imitima ku kumenya uburyo bgo gutahura:
Kuko mbahaye inyigisho nziza; Ntimukave mw ibgirizwa ryanje.
Kuko nanje nabereye data umwana nya mwana, Nabungabungwa ndi nk’ikinege mu maso ya mama.
Kandi data yaranyigishije, arambarira, At’ Umutima wawe ugumye amajambo yanje; Witondere amabgirizwa yanje, ubone kubaho:
Wironkere ubgenge, wironkere uburyo bgo gutahura; Ntukibagire, kandi ntugatere ibitugu amajambo y’akanwa kanje:
Ubgenge ntukabute, na bgo buzokuzigama, Bukunde, buzokurinda.
Ikir’ imbere ya vyose n’ubgenge: nuko wironkere ubgenge; Mber’ ivy’ ufise vyose ubihebere ugutahura.
Bushire hejuru, na bgo buzogukuza: Buzoguhesha icubahiro ni wabugūmbīra.
Buzokwambika umugāra w’ ubuntu mu mutwe, Buzoguha igitsibo c’ubgiza.
Mwana wanje, ni wumve, wemere amajambo yanje, Ni ho imyaka y’ukubaho kwawe izoba myinshi.
Nakwigishije inzira y’ubgenge, Nakurōngōye mu nzira z’ ubugororotsi.
Ni wagenda, ibirenge vyawe ntibizokwagirwa, Kandi ni wiruka ntuzotsitara.
Gumya ukwigishwa, ntukurekure; Ukuzigame, kukw ari kwo bugingo bgawe.
Ntukaje mu nzira y’abanyavyaha, Ntukagendere mu nzira y’ abanyakibi.
Yizibukire, ntuyicemwo, Kevya, uyirengāne.
Kuko badasinzira, shiti bakoze ikibi; Kandi n’itiro ryabo riraguruka, iyo batagize uwo bagwisha.
Kuko barya umutsima uva mu bigabitanyo, Banywa vino iva mu muryano.
Arikw inzira y’abagororotsi imeze nk’umuco wo mu gatondotondo, Ugenda urushiriza gukayangana gushitsa hakeye rwose.
Inzira y’abanyavyaha imeze nk’umwiza, Ntibazi ico batsitarako ic’ ari co.
Mwana wanje, shira umutima ku majambo yanje, Tega ugutwi ukuvuga kwanje;
Ntibikave imbere y’amaso yawe, Bizigamire imbere mu mutima wawe.
Kuko bibera ubugingo ababironka, No kunonoka mu mibiri yabo yose.
Rinda umutima wawe kurusha uko worinda ikindi cose, Kukw ari ho ubugingo bududubiriza.
Wīkūrekw akanwa kagoreka, N’iminwa ihushagirika uyishire kure yawe.
Amaso yawe atumbere imbere, N’ibigohe vyawe vyerekeze imbere yawe.
Usēne inzira y’ibirenge vyawe, Kand’ ingendo zawe zose zitungane.
Ntugatambamire i buryo cank’ i bumoso: Ukūre ikirenge cawe mu kibi.
Mwana wanje, shira umutima ku bgenge bganje; Tega ugutwi uburyo bganje bgo gutahura.
Kugira ng’ ugumye amakenga, N’iminwa yawe izigame ukumenya.
Kukw iminwa y’umugore w’ icigenze itonyanga nk’ikigigu c’ubūki, Kand’ akanwa kiwe kanyerera kurusha amavuta ya elayo:
Arikw iherezo ryiwe rirura nk’umururazi, Rikarishe nk’ubūgi bg’inkota.
Ibirenge vyiwe bimanuka mu rupfu; Intambuko ziwe zimushikana i kuzimu;
Bituma atabona inzira isēnnye y’ubugingo, Ingendo ziwe ziradandabagirana, kandi ntazi iy’ aja.
None rero bana banje, munyumve, Ntimukave ku majambo y’ akanwa kanje.
Uz’ umuce kure, Kandi ntiwēgēre umuryango w’inzu yiwe:
Woye kwiha abandi, ngo bonone igikundiro cawe, Na ruburakigongwe ntumumarirekw imyaka yawe:
Abanyamahanga boye guhāga ivyawe, Kand’ ivyakuruhije vyoye kuja mu nzu y’uwundi;
Nawe ukazoboroga kw iherezo ryawe, Ah’ umubiri wawe n’amagara yawe bizoba bishize,
Ukavuga, ut’ Ewe ngo ndanka guhanūrwa, N’umutima wanje ugakēngēra guhanwa;
Sinumvire ijwi ry’abigisha banje, Sintege ugutwi abāmpanūra!
Nari nshigaje gatoya ngahetura ibibi vyose Hagati y’ishengero n’ikoraniro.
Unywe amazi yo mw isōko yawe wiharije, N’amazi atemba yo mw iriba ryawe.
Mbeg’ imigezi yawe yosābagira hose, N’inzuzi z’amazi zosābagira mu nzira?
Ni bibe ivyawe ubgawe, Ntubisangire n’ivyigenze.
Isōko yawe igire umugisha, Kand’ unezererwe umugore wo mu buto bgawe.
Nk’impongokazi y’urukundo n’ingeregere y’igikundiro Amabere yiwe akubumbe ibihe vyose; Kandi wame uhimbarwa n’ urukundo rwiwe.
N’iki cotuma ga mwana wanje, uhimbarwa n’umugore w’icigenze, Ukagwa mu gikiriza c’ūtar’ uwawe?
Kukw ingendo z’umuntu zir’ imbere y’inyonga z’Uhoraho, Kand’ asēna inzira ziwe zose.
Umunyavyaha, ukugabitanya kwiwe bgite ni kwo kuzomufata, Azodunuzwa n’ingoyi z’icaha ciwe.
Azopfa azize kudahaha, Kubg’ ubupfu bgiwe bukomeye azozimira.
Mwana wanje, asangwa warabaye ishinga kuri mugenzawe, Cank’ ukarahira kw ari wewe umwishinze,
Uba utezwe n’amagambo yo mu kanwa kawe, Uba ufashwe n’amagambo yo mu kanwa kawe.
None rero, mwana wanje, kora urtya, wirokore, Kuk’ ushitse mu kuboko kwa mugenzawe; Bandanya, wicishe bugufi, wisabe mugenzawe ushishikaye.
Amaso yawe ntuyahe itiro, N’ibigohe ntubihe guhūnyiza.
Wirokore, nk’ukw ingeregere iva mu kuboko kw’umuhīgi, Kandi nk’ukw inyoni iva mu kuboko kw’umutezi.
Genda ku kimonyo, wa munyabute; Witegereze ingeso zaco, uce ubgenge:
Naho kitagira umucamanza, Cank’ umubgiriza cank’ ūganza,
Ciziganiriza indya zaco zo mu ci, Kikēgeranya ivyo kurya vyaco mw iyimbura.
Uzogeza ryari kwiryamira, ga wa munebge we? Uzovyuka ryari ng’ uve mw itiro?
Ngo Hinge nce agatiro gakeya, mbe ndisinziriye gatoya, Nisegure ukuboko gatoya niboterere:
Uko ni k’ubgoro bgawe buzogushikako nk’umwambuzi, N’ikigoyi kizogushikako nk’ umuntu w’umurwanyi.
Umuntu w’umugarariji, umuntu w’umugabitanyi, Agendana akanwa kagoreka;
Avuniranira akagohe, akeburanisha ibirenge, Yāgana akāra;
Ukugoreka kuri mu mutima wiwe, kandi yama yigenera ibibi; Avyura imitongano.
Ni co gituma ukuranduka kuzomushikako giturumbuka; Azovunagurwa giturumbuka, atagira gitabara.
Har’ ibintu bitandatu Uhoraho yanka, Mbere n’indwi bimusesema:
Amaso y’ubgibone n’ururimi rw’ibinyoma, N’amaboko avisha amaraso y’ aberanda;
N’umutima ugera imigabo mibi, N’ibirenge vyihutira kwirukira ikibi;
N’icabona c’ibinyoma kivuga ivy’ ubuhūmvyi, N’ūvyura imitongano mu bavukana.
Mwana wanje, itondere icagezwe ca so, Kandi ntute ibgirizwa rya nyoko:
Ubihambirire ku mutima wawe ibihe vyose, Ubipfundike mw izosi ryawe.
Bizokuja imbere ugenda, Bizoguteramira usinziriye, Bizoyāga nawe wikanguye.
Kukw icagezwe ar’ itara, kand’ amabgirizwa ar’ umuco; Kand’ uguhana kw’ukwigisha ar’inzira y’ubugingo:
Ngo bikurinde umugore w’ umunyakibi, N’uguhemana kw’ururimi rw’ umugore w’icigenze.
Ntukifuze ubgiza bgiwe mu mutima wawe, Kandi ntagufatishe kubongeka ingohe ziwe.
Kuko kubga maraya umuntu afūtāna gushitsa asigaye ku kamanyu k’agatsima: Kand’ umusambanyikazi ahīga ubugingo bg’igiciro.
Har’ umuntu yoshira umuriro mu gikiriza, Impuzu ziwe ntizishe?
Canke har’ uwogenda ku makara yaka, Ibirenge vyiwe ntibizigire?
Ni ko bimerera uwinjirana umugore wa mugenzi we; Ūmukorako wese ntazobura guhanwa.
Abantu ntibagaya umwivyi, iyo yibishwa No kumara akaruru kiwe ari n’inzara:
Arikw iy’ afashwe ariha ibihetangabo ndwi; Azokwoza urugo rwiwe rwose.
Ūsambana n’umugore aba igipfamutima; Ūgira artyo aba arondera guhonnya ubugingo bgiwe.
Azoba yihamagariye inguma no gutītūka; Kand’ ibara azoba yiyambitse ntirizozimangana.
Kuko gufūha kw’umugabo kurandamura ishavu; Kandi ntazogira akagongwe ku musi wo kwihōra.
Ntazokwemera icīru na kimwe, Kandi ntazonyurwa naho womuhongera vyinshi.
Mwana wanje, witondere amajambo yanje, Ubīke amabgirizwa yanje muri wewe.
Witondere amabgirizwa yanje, ubone kubaho, Rinda ivyagezwe vyanje nk’ imbone y’ijisho.
Bipfundike ku ntoke zawe, Uvyandike ku gisate, ni co mutima wawe.
Ubarire ubgenge, ut’ Uri mushikanje; Kand’ ukumenya ukwite incuti:
Kugira ngo bikurinde umugore w’icigenze, Mbere bikurinde umugore w’icigenze ahemanisha amagambo yiwe.
Nari kw idirisha mu nzu yanje, Ndungurukira mu nshingo zaryo;
Mbona mu mburabgenge, Nitegereza mu basore, Umusore w’igipfamutima,
Aca mu nzira hafi y’inkokora y’inzu y’umugore ameze artyo, Anobanga mu nzira ija ku nzu yiwe;
Hāri mu kagoroba, bugira bgire, Mu kajoro, buhwibiriye.
Maz’ uno mugore aramusanganira, Yambaye nka kumwe kwa maraya, afise umutima w’ uburyarya.
N’inyeruzi, ntahetwa, Ibirenge vyiwe ntibiragama mu nzu;
Hamwe aba mu nzira, ahandi akaba ahiyaguye, Abunda ku mahwane yose y’ inzira.
Afata nya musore aramusoma, Amubarira ata dusoni mu maso,
Ati Nari nsanzwe nkwiye gutanga ikimazi c’ishimwe: Non’ uyu musi nashikije ivyo nasezeranye.
Ni co gitumye nza kugusanganira, Nkuronderana umwete, none ndakubonye.
Nashashe imisego ku buriri bganje, N’impuzu z’amagarwe zajishwe mu nyuzi zo muri Egiputa.
Namotesheje neza uburiri bganje Isenga n’imbazi na mudarasini.
Ngwino turāreko buce, Twinezeranishe urukundo.
Kuk’ umugabo atar’ i muhira, Yamaze urubanza rwa kure.
Yajanye umupfuko w’amahera; Azogaruka ukwezi gufashe.
Amuryesharyeshakw akarimi keza, Amukwegesha guhemana kw’ iminwa yiwe.
Aca amukurikira ubgo nyene, Nk’inka ija kubāgwa, Canke nk’igipfu kijanwa guhanirwa mu munyororo;
Gushitsa ah’ umwampi umutobekeranije mu gitigu; Nk’ukw inyoni yisuka mu mutego, Itazi kw igiye gupfa.
None rero, bana banje, munyumve, Mutege amatwi amajambo y’ akanwa kanje.
Umutima wawe ntugakebereze mu nzira ziwe, Kandi woye kuzimira ng’ ujane inzira ziwe.
Kuko yatsinze hasi abakomerekejwe benshi, Mber’ abakomeye bishwe na we n’isinzi.
Inzu yiwe n’inzira ija i kuzimu, Imanuka irora i wabo w’urupfu.
Mbega Bgenge ntahamagaye? N’ukumenya ntigushize hejuru ijwi ryakwo?
Ku gatwe hejuru, i ruhande y’inzira, Mu mayirabiri, ni ho ahagaze.
I ruhande y’amarembo, mw ishikiro ry’igisagara, Mu bikingi vy’amarembo, ni ho asemererera cane:
Ati Ni mwebge mwa bagabo mpamagaye, Kand’ ijwi ryanje rihamagaye abana b’abantu.
Yemwe mwa mburabgenge, mumenye kwiguranura ic’ ari co, Namwe bijuju, mugire imitima itahura.
Mwumvirize, kuko ngira mvuge ibikomeye; Guteranura iminwa kwanje kuvamw’ ibibereye.
Kukw akanwa kanje kagira kavuge ivy’ ukuri, Kand’ ikibi n’umuziro ku minwa yanje.
Amajambo yose y’akanwa kanje n’ay’ ukugororoka, Kandi muri yo nta kigoramye cank’ ikigoretse.
Yose arumvikana ku muntu atahura, Kand’ aratumbereye ku bāronse ubgenge.
Mwākīre inyigisho zanje, si nk’ifeza, Mwākīre n’ukumenya kurusha izahabu z’indobanurwa.
Kuk’ ubgenge buruta utubuyenge twitwa marijani; Kandi mu bintu bihimbara vyose nta gihwanye na bgo.
Jewe Bgenge, amakenga nayagize inzu yanje, Nserangura ukumenya n’inama nziza.
Kwubaha Uhoraho ni kwo kwanka ikibi: Ubgibone n’amanyama n’inzira y’ikibi N’akanwa k’ibidadi, ndavyanka.
Inama nziza n’iyanje, bo n’ ubgenge bushitse, Ni jewe kumenya, ndi n’inkomezi.
Ni jewe mpa abami kuganza, N’abacamanza gushinga ibiroranye.
Ni jewe mpa abaganza kuganza, N’abaganwa, eka mbere n’abacamanza bose bo mw isi.

Ūrābana ijisho ry’irinyabuntu azohabga umugisha, Kukw aha umugorwa ku vyo kurya vyiwe.
Sohora umucokoranyi, imitongano na yo irasohoka, Mber’ ugurtyozanya n’agatētereza bica bishira.
Ūkunda umutima utanduye, Akagira ubuntu mu minwa yiwe, azoba umutoni w’ umwami.
Inyonga z’Uhoraho zizigama ūfise ubgenge, Arikw amagambo y’igihemu arayatītūra.
Umunyabute aravuga, ati Hanze har’ intambge: Nogwa mu nzira.
Akanwa k’abagore b’ivyigenze n’urusumanyenzi rurerure: Kand’ uwo Uhoraho yazinutswe azorugwamwo.
Ubupfu buba buhambiriwe ku mutima w’umwana, Arikw inkoni y’uguhana izobgirukanira kure yiwe.
Ūnyikiza umugorwa aba amugwirije, Kand’ ūgabira umutunzi, aba amukehereje.
Tega ugutwi, wumvire amajambo y’abanyabgenge, Kand’ ushire umutima ku kumenya kwanje.
N’ic’ umunezero ni wayabīka muri wewe, Agahora rwose mu kanwa kawe.
Ndayakumenyesheje uyu musi, wewe ubgawe, Kugira ngw ivyizigiro vyawe bibe k’Uhoraho.
Mbega sinakwandikiye ivyiza Vyo kukugīra inama n’ivyo kumenya ubgenge,
Nkakumenyesha neza amajambo y’ukuri, Kugira ng’usubirane inyuma amajambo y’ukuri ku bāgutumye?
Ntugasahure umugorwa kubg’ ubugorwa bgiwe, Kandi ntukanyikirize umurushwa mw ikombe.
Kuk’ Uhoraho azobabūranira, Abābanyaze azobanyaga ubugingo.
Ntugacudike n’ikirandamuke, Ntukagendane n’ikigārūke:
Woye gutora inzira ziwe, Ugatega ubugingo bgawe umutego.
Ntukabe mu gitigiri c’abishira mu ndahiro, Canke mu c’abigira ishinga y’imyenda:
Mbega ntuzi yuko ni wabura ico wishura Bazogutwara n’akariri uryamako?
Ntugashingūre akarimbi k’ urubibe rwa kera, Ba sogokuruza bashinze.
Ni wabona umuntu w’umunyamwete mu vyo akora, Ben’ uyo azokorera abami, Ntazokorera ba nyarucari.
Ni wicara gusangira n’ūganza, Ushinge ijisho uyo ar’ imbere yawe.
Asangwa ur’ umuntu w’inda ndende Wigarure, nk’ūhirikiwe imbugita kw izosi.
Ntugire umutima muke mu binoboye vyiwe, Kukw ar’ ivyo kurya vy’ uruhendo.
Ntiwirushe ng’ ube umutunzi, Reka kuvyigengeterereza.
Mbega wogumiza ijisho ku kiriko kirarenga? Kuk’ ubutunzi butobura kumera amababa, Nk’inkukuma iguruka itumbereye mw ijuru.
Ntukarye ivyo kurya vy’ umunyajisho ribi, Ntugire umutima muke mu binoboye vyiwe:
Kuk’ uko yiyumvira mu mutima ari kw ameze: Araguhimiriza, ngo N’urye, n’unywe; Arik’ umutima wiwe udafatanije nawe.
Intore wariye uzoyidahwa, Akayāgo kawe karyoshe kazoba gapfuye ubusa.
Ntugire ico uvuga ikijuju cumva, Kukw azokēngēra ubgenge bgo mu majambo yawe.
Ntugashingūre akarimbi k’ urubibe rwa kera, Kandi ntukarye amatongo y’ impfuvyi;
Kuk’ umucunguzi wazo ar’ Inyenkomezi, Izobūrana urwazo nawe.
Shira umutima ku gutozwa indero nziza, N’amatwi yawe ku majambo y’ubgenge.
Ntureke guhana umwana, Kukw atokwicwa n’uk’ umukubise inkoni.
Uz’ umukubite inkoni, Ni ho uzokiza ubugingo bgiwe ngo ntibuje i kuzimu.
Mwana wanje, umutima wawe ni wagira ubgenge Uwanje mutima bgite uzonezerwa,
Mber’ umushaha wanje uzohimbarwa Iminwa yawe ni yavuga ibiroranye.
Umutima wawe woye kugirira ishari abanyavyaha, Arik’ ugire ishaka ryo kwubaha Uhoraho burinde bgira.
Kuko vy’ukuri har’ ukuziga ibizoba, Kand’ ivyo wizigiye ntibizokūrwaho.
Mwana wanje, wumvirize, ugire ubgenge, Urōngōre umutima wawe mu nzira.
Ntukabe mu gitigiri c’abanohowe na vino, No mu c’abanyameru y’inyama:
Kukw imborerwa n’umunyameru uburuhiro ar’ ugufūtāna, Kand’ itiro rizokwambika umuntu ubucocerwa.
Wumvire so yakuvyaye, Kandi ntugakēngēre nyoko ashitse mu butāmakazi.
Gura ukuri, ntugushōre; Bo n’ubgenge n’indero nziza n’ubukerebutsi.
Se w’umugororotsi azogira akanyamuneza kenshi, N’ūvyaye umwana w’ubgenge azomunezererwa.
So na nyoko ni banezerwe, Nyoko yakuvyaye n’ahimbarwe.
Mwana wanje, mpa umutima wawe, Kand’ amaso yawe ahimbarwe n’inzira zanje.
Kuko maraya ar’ urusumanyenzi rurerure, Kand’ umugore w’icigenze n’urwobo rw’imbōmbāne.
Mber’ abunda nk’umwambuzi, Atuma abanyabihemu bagwira mu bantu.
Ni nde agira ngo Yō! Ni nde agira ngw Agwē! Ni nde afise imitongano? Ni nde afise imyidodombo? Ni nde afise inguma ata nyanduruko? Ni nde afise amaso atukuye?
N’abatavīrīra vino, N’abaja kurondera izituriranije.
Ntukitegereze vino iy’ itukuye, Iy’ ica ibibatsi mu kirahuri, Igashōka neza:
Uburuhiro iryana nk’inzoka, Igakomora nk’imvuvyi.
Amaso yawe ugahava uyarābisha abagore b’ivyīgenze, Umutima wawe ukavuga ibidadi;
Mber’ ugaca umera nk’ūryamye hagati mu kiyaga, Canke nk’ūryamye ku mutwe w’umuringoti wo mu bgato.
Ukavuga, uti Bārankubise, sinababara, Bāranyegaguye, sinavyumva: Nzokwikangura ryari? Na ho nyene nzosubira kuyirondera.
Ntukagirire ishari abanyakibi, Kandi ntukifuze kubana na bo:
Kuk’ umutima wabo wiyumvira guhonnya, Kand’ iminwa yabo ikavuga ivy’ ukugira nabi.
Ubgenge ni bgo bgubaka urugo, Kand’ ubukerebutsi ni bgo burukomeza;
Guca ubgenge ni kwo kwuzuza inzu zo muri rwo Ubutunzi bgose bg’igiciro kinini kandi bg’igikundiro.
Umunyabgenge aba uw’ inkomezi, Mber’ umuntu aciye ubgenge yunguka ubushobozi.
Kuk’ uzoja mu ntambara urōngōwe n’inama y’ubgenge, Kandi mu nama ya benshi habonekamw’ agakiza.
Ubgenge buri hejuru, busiga igipfu: Ntigikūrak’ umunwa iyo kiri mw ikombe.
Uwigerera gukora ibibi Abantu bazomwita Kanyengunge.
Ivyiyumviro vy’igipfu n’ivyaha, Kand’ umucokoranyi n’igisesema ku bandi.
Ni wadendebukirwa ku musi w’ivyago Inkomezi zawe zizoba zari nke.
Urokore abo bashorewe bajanwa kwicwa, N’abagenda bacitse intege bajanwa gutikizwa, ntubure kubatabara.
Ni wavuga, ut’ Erega ntitwari tubizi: Mbeg’ Ūgera imitima ku munzane ntavyiyumvira? Kand’ Ūzigama ubugingo bgawe ntabizi? Mbega ntazokwishura umuntu wese ibikwiranye n’ivyo yakoze?
Mwana wanje, uz’ urye ubūki, kukw ari bgiza, N’ikigigu kikuryohera mu kanwa.
Umenye kw ari k’ubgenge bumerera ubugingo bgawe: Asangwa warabubonye, har’ ukuziga ibizoba, Kand’ ivyo wizigiye ntibizokūrwaho.
Ewe munyakibi, ntukabunde ku rugo rw’umugororotsi, Ntugasangangure umuhana wiwe;
Kuk’ umugororotsi n’iyo yogwa ibihetangabo ndwi, asubira kuvyuka, Arikw abanyakibi bazogwa mu vyago.
Umwansi wawe ni yagwa ntuz’ unezerwe, Umutima wawe woye guhimbarwa ni yatsitara:
Uhoraho yoye guhava abibona, bikaba bibi mu nyonga ziwe, Akaroresha irya uburake yamurakiye.
Ntugashavuzwe n’ivy’ inkozi z’ibibi, Kandi ntukagirire ishari abanyakibi:
Kukw ata kuziga ibizoba kw’umunyakibi; Itara ry’abanyavyaha rizozimwa.
Mwana wanje, utinye Uhoraho, bo n’umwami, Kandi ntukifatanye n’abagarariji:
Kukw ivyago no kugeseza bivuye kur’ abo bompi bizoza giturumbuka, Kandi ni nde yobimenya?
N’aya nyene n’amajambo y’ abanyabgenge. Mu manza si vyiza gutinya abantu ku kigohe.
Ūbarira umutsindwa ng’ Uratsinze, Amoko azomuvuma, amahanga azomwanka urunuka.
Arikw abamuhana bazogirirwa neza, Umugisha n’amahirwe bizobazako.
Uwishuye ibiroranye Biba bibaye nk’indamukanyo nziza.
Tunganya ibikorwa vyawe vyo hanze, Uvyiroranirize mu ndimiro, Hanyuma uz’ ubone kwubaka inzu.
Ntukāgirize mugenzawe ata nyanduruko, Kandi ntugahendanishe iminwa yawe.
Ntukavuge, uti Nzomusubiriza mu nkōko; Nzokwishura uyo muntu ibihwanye n’ivyo yakoze.
Naciye ku ndimiro y’umunebge, No ku ruzabibu rw’umuntu atagira umutima;
Nasanze hose huzuyemw’ amahwa, Hose igisuru kirenze hejuru, Uruzitiro rwaho rw’amabuye rusambūtse.
Ndahitegereje ndiyumvira cane, Ndabirāba, biranyigisha.
Guca agatiro gakeya, kuba urisinziriye gatoya, Kwisegura ukuboko gatoya wiboterere:
Uko ni k’ubgoro bgawe buzogushikako nk’umwambuzi, N’ikigoyi kizogushikako nk’ umuntu w’umurwanyi.
N’iyi nyene n’imigani ya Salomo, iyo abantu ba Hezekiya umwami w’i Buyuda batoranije.
Imana guhisha ikintu, n’ icubahiro cayo, Arikw abami bo, guserangura ikintu, ni co cubahiro cabo.
Nk’ukw ijuru rigera hejuru cane, n’i bgina hakagera kure, Uko ni k’umutima w’abami udaserangurika.
Kūra inkamba mw ifeza, Ni ho hazovamw’ urwavya rutunganye.
Kūra abanyakibi imbere y’ umwami, Ni ho ingoma yiwe izohangama mu bugororotsi.
Ntiwikakishe mu nyonga z’ umwami, Kandi ntukirobeke mu bahambaye:
Ivyoba vyiza n’uko bokubarira, bat’ Igira hino imbere, Hako bagusubiza inyuma imbere y’ūganza, Uwo amaso yawe yiboneye.
Ntukihutire kubūrana, Uburuhiro ntuz’ usange waguye mu rudubi, Mugenzawe amaze kukumāramāza.
Wītātūre na mugenzawe ubgiwe, Kandi ntumenere ibanga uwundi,
Ūvyumvise akagutuka, Ukaba wambaye ibara ritakuvako.
Ijambo rivuzwe mu buryo bubereye Ni nk’amacungwa y’izahabu ari mu tujishano tw’ifeza.
Ukw impeta y’izahabu imeze, bo n’utugenegene two kwambarwa tw’izahabu nziza, Ni k’umunyabgenge azi guhanura amerera ugutwi kwumva.
Nk’ukw imbeho ya shelegi imera mu gihe c’iyimbura, Ni ko n’intumwa yizigirwa imerera abayitumye, Kukw ihēmbūra umutima wa ba shebuja.
Nk’ukw ibicu n’umuyaga bitarimw’ imvura bimeze, Ni k’umuntu ameze yishemagiza ngw aratanga kand’ ar’ ukubesha.
Gushishikara wiyoroheje vyemeza umucamanza, Kand’ ururimi rwiyoroheje rujanjagura igufa.
Ni warenguka ku būki, urye ubukumaze akaruru, Woye kubguzuza inda, bukakudaha.
Ikirenge cawe ntigihore mu nzu kwa mugenzawe, Kugira ngo ntahave akurambirwa, akakwanka.
Umuntu yāgiriza mugenzi we ibinyoma Ni nk’ubuhiri n’inkota n’ umwampi ukarishe.
Kwizigira umuntu w’igihemu mu gihe c’amagorwa, Ni nk’iryinyo ricitse, n’ukuguru gukōndōtse.
Kuvugiriza impundu umuntu atuntuye mu mutima Ni nk’umuntu kwiyambura impuzu mu gihe c’imbeho, n’inkarisha isutswe ku munyu witwa amagadi.
Umwansi wawe ni yasonza umugaburire, Ni yagira inyota umuhe amazi yo kunywa:
Kuk’ uzoba umurunzekw amakara yaka ku mutwe, Kand’ Uhoraho azoguhēra.
Umuyaga uva i burārūko uzana imvura; Ni ko n’ururimi rurementanya ruzana kwiraburanirwa mu maso.
Wopfuma wībēra hanze, Hak’ ubana n’umugore w’ ingāre mu nzu.
Nk’ukw amazi apfutse amerera umutima ufise icākāka, Ni ko n’inkuru nziza zimera, zivuye mu gihugu ca kure.
Umuntu agororotse agapfa kwemerana ivy’ umunyakibi Ameze nk’isōko itobetse, n’ imbizi y’iyōndoyōndo.
Si vyiza kurya ubūki bginshi cane: Kandi kwironderera icubahiro s’icubahiro.
Umuntu atītāngīra mu mutima Ameze nk’igisagara gitewe gisambutse uruzitiro.
Nk’uko shelegi itabereye mu gihe c’umumero, n’ imvura mu gihe c’iyimbura, Ni ko n’ukwubaha igipfu kutabereye.
Nk’ukw akanyoni kayerēra, n’ intamba iguruka, Ni ko n’umuvumo w’ubusa ata we wokora.
Ikimōko n’ic’ ifarasi, n’umujiginya n’uw’ indogoba, Inkoni na yo n’iy’ ibitugu vy’ ibipfu.
Ntiwishure igipfu amagambo ahwanye n’ubupfu bgaco, Kugira ngo nawe ntibikwandukire.
Wishure igipfu amagambo akwiranye n’ubupfu bgaco, Kugira ngo nticirate ko gifise ubgenge.
Ūtumye igipfu Aba yīcīye ibirenge, yihamagariye ubuhombe.
Amaguru y’ikimuga yama aregarega: Ni k’umugani umera mu kanwa k’ibipfu.
Guha igipfu icubahiro Ni nko gushiburira akabuyenge k’igiciro kinini ku gihongo c’amabuye.
Nk’ukw ihwa rihanda mu kiganza c’imborerwa, Ni k’umugani umera mu kanwa k’ibipfu.
Umuhinga yikorera vyose ubgiwe, Arikw igipfu gipfa gucisha ingero uwihitira wese.
Nk’ukw imbga isubira ku vy’ idashwe, Ni kw igipfu gisubira ku bupfu bgaco.
Ni wabona umuntu yirata kw afise ubgenge Umenye kw igipfu copfanirwa ikizigizigi kuruta uyo.
Umunyabute aravuga, ati Mu nzira har’ intambge, Har’ intambge y’ubukombe mw ibarabara.
Nk’uk’ urugi ruhindukira ku mapata yarwo, Ni k’umunebge ahindukira ku buriri bgiwe.
Ikiremare kirokeza ukuboko mu nkōko, Bikagica inkokora kukugarukana ku munwa.
Umunebge yirata kw afise ubgenge Buruta ubg’ abantu ndwi bazi kwishura ibiroranye.
Uwihitira agashingwa n’intonganya z’ibitar’ ivyiwe Ameze nk’ūfata imbga ku matwi.
Nk’uk’ umusazi ashwiragiza ibishirīra N’imyampi vyo kwica,
Uko ni kw ameze, umuntu ahenda mugenzi we, Maz’ akavuga, at’ Erega najandajanda gusa!
Iy’ inkwi zibuze umuriro urazima, Kand’ ahatagira ūneguranira mu vyongorerano imitongano irashira.
Nk’ukw amakara acana igitōngōrero, n’inkwi zicana umuriro, Ni k’umuntu w’amahane acana intonganya.
Amagambo y’ūneguranira mu vyongorerano ni nk’ivyo kurya biryoshe, Bimanuka bija epfo mu nda.
Iminwa ihemana n’umutima mubi Bimeze nk’ikibumbano gikuyengejekw ifeza.
Uwankana atuma iminwa yiwe ihendana, Kand’ abīka uburyarya imbere muri we.
Ni yagira imvugo nziza, ntuz’ umwemere, Kuko mu mutima wiwe harimw’ ibizira ndwi.
Nah’ inzigo yiwe yokwipfukapfukisha ubugunge, Ukugabitanya kwiwe kuzokwerekanirwa imbere y’ ishengero.
Uwimba icobo azokigwamwo, Kand’ ūtembagaza ikibuye kizomugarukako.
Ururimi rubesha rwanka abo rwakomerekeje, Kand’ akanwa gahemana kazana uguhona.
Ntukarāte ivy’ ejo, Kuk’ utazi ivyo umusi uzovyara.
Wopfuma ushimwa n’uwundi, hak’ ushimwa n’akanwa kawe; Wopfuma ushimwa n’akavantara, hak’ ushimwa n’ iminwa yawe.
Ibuye rirarivye, umusenyi uraremereye, Arik’ umwikomo w’igipfu urusha vyompi uburemerezi.
Uburake ni ruburakigongwe, ishavu ritwara nk’umuvo, Ariko ni nde yoshobora kwihanga ishari?
Guhanira ahibonekeza Kuruta urukundo rudaseruka.
Gukubitwa n’umukunzi biba bitewe n’ukuri, Arik’ ugusomagura kw’umwansi buba ar’ uburyarya.
Umutima uhimvye winenaguza ikigigu c’ubūki, Arik’ umutima ushonje ibirura vyose birawuryohera.
Nk’ukw inyoni itaye icāri iyerēra, N’umuntu ni kw ameze, iy’ ataye urugo rwiwe akayerēra.
Ukw amavuta atāmirana n’ ibimota neza binezereza umutima, Ni ko n’uburyohe bg’umukunzi w’umuntu bumeze, buvuye mu nama zo mu mutima.
Ntugahebe umukunzi wawe ubgawe, n’umukunzi wa so, Kandi ntuje kwa mwene wanyu ku musi uboneyekw amagorwa: Umubanyi wo hafi aruta mwene wanyu ari kure.
Mwana wanje, uce ubgenge, unezereze umutima wanje, Kugira ngo ngire ico nishura uwontuka.
Umunyamakenga iy’ abonye ikibi kije, arikinga, Arikw imburabgenge zikomeza inzira zikīgabura.
Twara impuzu y’uwishinze uwo atazi, Wake ingwati uwishinze umugore w’icigenze.
Ūzinduka kare agahezagira mugenzi we n’ijwi rirenga, Abiharūrwako nko kumuvuma.
Amatonyanga adahengeshanya yo ku musi w’imvura nyinshi, N’umugore atongana, vyompi ni kimwe.
Kumutesha ni nko gutesha umuyaga, Kand’ ukuboko kwiwe kw’i buryo kuba gufashe umunyererwe.
Ukw icuma gikarisha ikindi, Ni k’umuntu akarisha mugenzi we.
Ūbungabunga umusukoni wiwe azorya insukoni zawo, Kand’ ūkorera shebuja neza azohabga icubahiro.
Nk’ukw amaso arābana n’ ayandi mu mazi, Ni k’umutima w’umuntu urābana n’uwundi mu muntu.
I kuzimu n’amahonero nta ho bihāga, N’amaso y’abantu nta ho ahāga.
Inkono yo mu ruganda iteka ifeza, n’umuriro uvugutira izahabu, Umuntu na we agezwa no gushimwa.
Igipfu naho wogisekurana n’ impeke mw isekuro, ugisekuje umuhini, Ubupfu bgaco ntibgokivako.
Gira umwete wo kumenya imikuku yawe ukw imeze, No kurāba cane amasho yawe,
Kukw itunga ridahoraho, Canke mbeg’ ingoma ihorah’ ibihe vyose?
Ubgatsi butemwe burakūrwaho, ubundi bukamera, Ivyatsi vyo ku misozi bikegeranywa.
Imyagazi y’intama izokwambika, Kand’ amasuguru azovamw’ ivyo kugura itongo;
Amata y’impene azoguhāzanya n’abo mu rugo rwawe, Kand’ azogutungira abigeme bagukorera.
Abanyakibi bahunga ata wubirukanye, Arikw abagororotsi bagumya umutima nk’intambge.
Iyo havyutse umugararizo mu gihugu abakiganza baba benshi, Arikw abantu b’ubgenge bakerebutse batuma impore ihoraho.
Umuntu w’impabūke guhahaza abagorwa Ni nk’imvura y’isegenya idasigaza indya.
Abataye ivyagezwe bashima abanyakibi, Arikw abitondera ivyagezwe barabarwanya.
Abantu babi ntibatahura ibiroranye, Arikw abarondera Uhoraho batahura vyose.
Umworo agendera mu bugororotsi bgiwe Aruta ikigoramange kijana inzira zibiri, nah’ ar’ umutunzi.
Uwitondera ivyagezwe wese aba ar’umwana w’ubgenge, Arik’ umugenzi w’abakunzi b’ inda atētereza se.
Ūgwirisha itunga ryiwe inyungu ivuye ku vyo yagurānye, akāka n’ibirenzeko, Aba abirundanirije ūgirira akagongwe abagorwa.
Uwica ugutwi ngo ntiyumve ivyagezwe, N’ugusenga kwiwe na kwo kuba igisesema.
Umuntu wese azimiza abagororotsi ngo bajane inzira mbi, Na we nyene azogwa mu rwobo rwiwe ubgiwe: Arikw abatunganye bazoragwa ivyiza.
Umutunzi yibarira kw afise ubgenge, Arik’ umworo ari n’umutima aramuhinyura.
Abagororotsi iyo banesheje haba icubahiro cinshi, Arikw abanyakibi iyo bari hejuru abantu barinyegeza.
