Nuko rero, uku ni k’Umwami Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize: ati Yemwe bantu banje baba i Siyoni, nta co mutinya aba Ashuri, naho bazobakubita inkoni, bakababāngurira ubuhiri, nk’ukw Abanyegiputa bābagiriye.
Kuko hasigaye igihe gito cane ubushangashirwe n’uburake bganje bigashitswa mu guhona kwabo.

Nuk’ Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo azobashongongezakw ikimoko, nka hamwe Abamidiyani bīcirwa ku gitandara ca Orebu: kand’ inkoni yiwe izoba ibānguye hejuru y’ikiyaga, kand’ azoyibāngura nk’uko vyabaye muri Egiputa.
Kandi kur’ uwo musi imitwaro bābaremēka izobava ku bitugu, n’ingōgo bābambika mu mazosi zizovunwa. Baradūze bavuye i Rimoni;
bashitse muri Ayati, baciye i Migironi; i Mikimashi ni ho basize ibintu vyabo vy’intēkera:
baserutse hejuru ku kavōvo, barāye i Geba: ab’ i Rama bafashwe n’agatengo, ab’ i Gibeya ho kwa Sauli barahunze!
Shira ijwi hejuru utakambe, wa mukobga w’i Galimu! Banga ugutwi, Layisha! Ewe Anatoti uragowe!
Ab’ i Madimena bacitse igikuba, ababa i Gebimu bahunganye utwabo!
Kur’ uyu musi wa none barataha i Nobu, babānguriye ukuboko umusozi w’umukobga w’i Siyoni, umurambi w’i Yerusalemu.
Eh’ Umwami Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo azocisha amashami ububasha bgiwe bg’agaterabgoba: ibirebire bisumba ibindi bizokwicirwa, n’ivyishize hejuru bizorambikwa hasi.
Kand’ ibisaka vyo mu kibira azobitemesha icuma, n’i Lebanoni hazotsindwa n’uwo muhizi.
Ku gishitsi ca Isayi hazobaduka agashami, kand’ umunago wanaze mu mizi yiwe uzokwama.
Mpwemu w’Uhoraho azoba kuri we, impwemu y’ubgenge n’iy’ ugutahura, impwemu yo kuja inama n’iy’ ubushobozi, impwemu y’ukumenya Uhoraho n’iy’ ukumwubaha.
Ikizomuhimbara n’ukwubaha Uhoraho; ntazocira urubanza ku bipfa kubonekera amaso yiwe, kandi ntazorushinga ku vyo apfa kwumvisha amatwi;
arikw azocira aboro imanza zibereye, kand’ azoshinga urw’ abaciye bugufi bo mw isi mu kuri: azokubitisha isi inkoni ivuye mu kanwa kiwe, kand’ abanyakibi azobīcisha impwemu ziva mu minwa yiwe.
Ubugororotsi buzomubera umukanda mu rukenyerero, mber’ ukwizigirwa kuzomubera umukanda mu mafyinga.
Ibingira rizobana n’umwagazi w’intama, n’ingwe izoryamana n’umwagazi w’impene, n’inyana n’umugunza w’intambge n’ishūri ishishe bizobana, kand’ umwana mutoya ni we azobishorera.
Inka izorishanya n’igikōko citwa idubu: izazo zizoryama hamwe, kand’ intambge izorisha ubgatsi nk’inka.
Umwana yonka azokinira ku mwobo w’imamba, n’umwana acutse azoshira ukuboko ku mwimba w’imvuvyi.
Hose ku murwa wanje wera ntihazoba hakir’ ibiryana cank’ ivyica; kuko kumenya Uhoraho kuzoba kwuzuye mw isi, nk’ukw amazi abugereye mu kiyaga.
Maze kur’ uwo musi igishitsi ca Isayi kizoba gihagaritswe no kubera amoko ibendera, ico gishitsi ni co amahanga azobariritsa: kand’ uburuhukiro bgiwe buzogira icubahiro.

Kandi kur’ uwo musi Umwami Imana azotuma ukuboko ubugira kabiri, kugarukana amasigarira y’abantu biwe, abazoba bagisigaye, abakūre muri Ashuri no muri Egiputa n’i Patirosi n’i Kushi no muri Elamu n’i Shinari n’i Hamati no mu bizinga vyo mu kiyaga.
Kand’ azoshingira amahanga ibendera, akoranirize hamwe abāri birukanywe bo mu Bisirayeli, akumakumire hamwe Abayuda bagiye isābagire, abakūye ku mfuruka zine z’isi.
Ishari ry’Abefurayimu na ryo rizoshira, n’urwanko rw’Abayuda ruzokūrwaho: Abefurayimu ntibazoba bakigirira Abayuda ishari, kand’ Abayuda ntibazoba bakigirira Abefurayimu urwanko.
Bazohwikira Abafilisitiya b’i burengerazuba, babagwe ku gakanu, bazokwifatanya banyage ab’i burasirazuba; bazorāmvura ukuboko bacakire Abanyedomu n’Abanyamowabu; Abamoni bazobayoboka.
Uhoraho azokamya rwose ikigobe c’ikiyaga ca Egiputa, azozana umuyaga wiwe ururumba, abāngīrire ukuboko rwa Ruzi, arukubite arucemw’ imigezi ndwi, maz’ ajabutse abantu batarinze gukūra inkweto.
Kandi hazoba inzira y’iroro y’amasigarira y’abantu biwe, abazoba bagisigaye, iva muri Ashuri, nk’iyo Abisirayeli bābonye hamwe bādūga bava mu gihugu ca Egiputa.
Kur’ uwo musi uzovuga, ut’ Uhoraho, ndagukengurukiye, kuko naho wandakiye, uburake bgawe burahwamye, nawe uramporahoje.
Ehe rāba, Imana ni yo gakiza kanje; nzokwama nizigira, sintinye: kuk’ UHORAHO YEHOVA ari we nkomezi zanje n’indirimbo yanje, kandi yacitse agakiza kanje.
Ni co gituma muzovomana umunezero mu mariba y’agakiza.
Kandi kur’ uwo musi muzovuga, muti Ni mukengurukire Uhoraho, mwambaze izina ryiwe, mwamamaze ibikorwa vyiwe mu mahanga, mumenyekanishe izina ryiwe ko rishizwe hejuru.
Muririmbire Uhoraho, kuko yakoze ivyiza bihambaye: ivyo ni vyamamare mw isi yose.
Semerera, uvuge cane, yewe uba i Siyoni, kuk’ Uwera w’Abisirayeli, ari hagati muri mwebge, ahambaye.
Imbūri yo kuri Babuloni, iyo Yesaya mwene Amosi yeretswe.
Ni mushinge ibendera ku musozi muremure w’uruharabuga, shira ijwi hejuru mubahamagare, mubākure, kugira ngo bace mu birimba vy’abaganwa.
Nahaye icagezwe abo nirobanuriye, mbere nahamagaye abahizi banje, bo n’abanyirahira bampayagiza, kugira ngo bashitse ivyo uburake bganje bgāgabiye.
Umve ukwo guhinda kw’igugu ku musozi, nk’ukw’ igitero gikomeye! Umve urwo rwamo rw’amahanga y’abami akoraniye hamwe! Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo arikw arakoranya ingabo azitegurira intambara.
Ziva mu gihugu ca kure, ku mpera y’ijuru; Uhoraho azananye n’ibirwanishwa vy’ugushangashirwa kwiwe, guhonnya igihugu cose.
Ni muboroge, kuk’ umusi w’Uhoraho uri hafi; uzoza ar’ umusi wo guhonnya uvuye kw Īshobora vyose.
Ivyo bizotuma amaboko yose adendebuka, n’umutima w’umuntu wese ushonga.
Bazokwiheba; umubabaro n’uburibge bibafate; bazobabara nk’umugore ari ku nda; bazorābana bumirwe; kandi mu maso habo hazohindurira nk’umuriro.
Eh’ umusi w’Uhoraho uraje, ni ruburakigongwe uzananye ishavu n’uburake bg’inkazi; ng’uhindure igihugu imisaka, ugeseze abanyavyaha baho ngo bagishiremwo.
Kukw inyenyeri zo kw ijuru n’uburundo bgazo bitazokwaka, izuba rizocura umwiza rikirasa, n’ukwezi ntikuzobonesha umuco wakwo.
Kandi nzohana ab’ isi kubg’ ibibi vyabo, n’abanyakibi kubg’ ukugabitanya kwabo; nzomara amanyama abibone, n’ ukwishira hejuru kw’abantu b’ agaterabgoba nzogusubiza hasi.
Nzotuvya abantu barushe izahabu nziza‐nziza kuba imparūrwa, mber’ abantu bazoba imparūrwa kurusha izahabu ziramuye zivuye muri Ofiru.
Ni co kizotuma ntigitisha amajuru, kand’ isi na yo izonyiganyiga ive ahayo, kubg’ uburake bganje Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, ku musi w’uburake bganje bg’inkazi.
Maz’ umuntu wese azosubira mu b’i wabo, yiruka nk’ingeregere ihīgwa, canke nk’intama itagira ūyiragiye, umuntu wese ahungire mu gihugu c’i wabo.
Uwo bazobona wese bazomusogota, kand’ ūzofatwa mpiri wese bazomwicisha inkota.
Utuyoya twabo na two bazotubamenagurira imbere; amazu yabo azosahurwa, kand’ abagore babo bazobenda ku kagōbēro.
Rāba nzovyutsa Abamedi ngo babatere; ntibazorāba ifeza, kandi naho zoba izahabu ntibazozibabara.
Imiheto yabo izokenyagura imisore, kandi ntibazogirira akagongwe inda ikiri mu nda, n’ijisho ryabo ntirizobabarira abana bato.
Kandi Babuloni, icubahiro c’amahanga y’abami, ubgiza bg’ubgibone bg’Abakaludaya, hazomera nk’uko vyabaye hamwe Imana yakomvomvora i Sodomu n’i Gomora.
Ntihazokwigera hasubira kweyerwa ngo hubakwe, kand’ uk’ urunganwe rwabo ruzogenda rukurikirana, nta wuzosubira kuhaba. Umwarabo ntazohashinga ihema, kandi n’abungere ntibazohavyagiza imikuku yabo.
Arikw ibikōko vyo mu bugaragwa ni vyo bizohagandagaza: amazu yabo azokwuzura ibihuna; ibisīga vyitwa imbuni na vyo bizohaba, n’ibisigo vy’amapfizi y’impene bizohatēganira.
Amabingira azotontomera mu bihome vyabo, n’imbgebge mu ngoro z’igikundiro. Igihe caho kigira gishike, kand’ imisi ir’ imbere yaho ntizokwongerwako.
Kuk’ Uhoraho azogirira akagongwe aba Yakobo, azosubira gutoranya Abisirayeli, abasubize mu gihugu cabo bgite: kand’ abanyamahanga bazokwifatanya na bo, bamatane n’inzu ya Yakobo.

Amahanga azobajana abasubize i wabo, maz’ ab’ inzu ya Isirayeli bazoyatungira mu gihugu c’Uhoraho, yose bayahindure abaja b’abahungu n’abakobga: kand’ abābajana kw inyagano, na bo bazobajana kw inyagano, kandi bazotwara abābahahaza.
Maze ku musi Uhoraho azokuruhura umubabaro n’amagorwa n’ibikorwa abaguhindagiza bagukoresha,
ni ho uzokwitamba ku muvyimba umwami w’i Babuloni, ut’ Eh’ ukuntu umunyagahahazo aherengeteye, n’amanyama yiwe ukuntu aherengeteye!
Uhoraho avunnye inkoni y’abanyakibi, ni yo nkoni y’abaganza;
bākubita amahanga baratse, bakayashishagura badahumeka, amoko bakayaganzisha amanyama n’akadenderezo ata gitabara.
Isi yose ironse impore, iratekereje; baraturitse bararirimba.
Mber’ ibiti vy’akajwari birakwishima hejuru, n’ivy’ amasederi vy’i Lebanoni biravuga, bit’ Uhereye aho watsindiwe hasi nta wasubiye kudūga kutwicira.
Hasi i kuzimu harashwabadutse kugusanganira; hakanguye abāpfuye kubgawe, ni bo bahambaye bose bo mw isi; havyagurukije abami bose b’amahanga ku ntebe zabo.
Abo bose bazokubaza, bati Mbega nawe uhindutse umunyantege nke nkatwe? Uhwanye natwe?
Icubahiro cawe kimanuwe i kuzimu, bo n’amajwi y’inanga zawe; ugaranzuriwe inyo, kand’ inyo nyene ni zo zikwōrōshe.
Ewe kuntu ukorotse uvuye kw ijuru, wa nyenyeri yo mu rubungubungu we, wa mwana w’umutwenzi! Ewe ingen’ uciwe ugashika hasi, wewe watsinda amahanga!
Wari warībariye mu mutima, uti Nzodūga nje mw ijuru, nkuze ingoma yanje isumbe inyenyeri z’Imana; uti Nzovyagira ku musozi w’ikoraniro mu ruhande rw’ impera y’i burārūko;
uti Nzodūga ndenge ah’ ibicu bigarukira; nzoba nk’ Īsumba vyose.
Yamar’ uzomanurwa, ushike i kuzimu, ushike mu bgigobeko bga rwa rwobo.
Abazokubona bazoguhanga, bakwitegereze, bati Mbeg’ uyu ni we yahindisha isi agashitsi, agashira ubgami bginshi mu gatengo?
Ni we yahindura isi nk’ubugaragwa, agakomvomvora ibisagara vyo muri yo, ntarekure abāfashwe mpiri ngo basubire i wabo?
Abami b’amahanga bose uko bangana basinzirira itiro ry’urupfu mu cubahiro, umwami wese mu ngoro yiwe bgite;
ariko weho bāgushiburiye kure y’imva yawe nk’inda y’urusoro iteye ishishi, uhagatiwe n’abishwe basogōswe n’inkota, bamanuka baja mu mabuye no muri rwa rwobo; weho umeze nk’umuvyimba basiribanga:
ntuzohambanwa na bo kuko wagesheje igihugu cawe, ukica abantu bawe; uruvyaro rw’inkozi z’ibibi nta ho ruzokwigera rwibukwa.
Ni mwitegure gutōtōra abana biwe kubg’ ukugabitanya kwa ba sekuruza; boye kuvyuka ngo bakevye isi, buzuze isi yose ibisagara.
Nzobahagurukira, ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, kandi nzohonnya amazina n’amasigarira, umwana n’umwuzukuru, muri Babuloni, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Kandi nzohahindura i wabo w’ibinyogoto, n’ibidengeri vy’amazi; nzohakubūza imyeyerezo yo kugeseza, ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize.
Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo ararahiye, ati N’ukuri, uko niyumviriye ni ko bizoshika, kand’ uko nagabiye ni ko bizoba:
nzovunagurira Abashuri mu gihugu canje, kandi nzobasiribangira mu misozi yanje miremire: ni ho ingōgo yiwe izobavako, n’imitwaro yabakorera ibave ku bitugu.
Iyo ni yo migabo yagīriwe isi yose, kand’ ukwo ni kwo kuboko kwābānguriwe amahanga yose.
Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo kw ari we yabigabiye, ni nde yobihindura? Kand’ ukuboko kwiwe ko kubānguye, ni nde yogupfunya?
Mu mwaka umwami Ahazi yatanzemwo habayeh’ iyi mbūri.
Yemwe Bufilisitiya bgose, nta co munezerezwa n’ukw inkoni yabakubita ivunitse; kuko mu gishitsi c’inzoka hagiye kuvamw’ imvuvyi, kand’ uruvyaro rwayo ruzoba inzoka iguruka y’ubumara buturira.
Maz’ abana b’ imfura b’aboro bazogaburirwa, n’ abakene baryame amahoro; kand’ igishitsi cawe nzocicisha kigoyi, n’amasigarira yawe azokwicwa.
Wa rembo we, boroga! Nawe gisagara, urire! Bufilisitiya we, iy’ uva ukagera hose, urayaze nk’amavuta, kukw i burārūko havuye umwotsi, kandi nta wusigara yikwega mu ngabo ziwe.
Non’ intumwa z’iryo hanga bazozīshura iki? Bazozīshura, bat’ Uhoraho ni we yashinze Siyoni, kand’ impahazwa zo mu bantu biwe ni ho zizohungira.
Imbūri yo kuri Mowabu: kuko mw ijoro rimwe ahitwa Ari‐Mowabu hageseye, hakomvomvowe; kuko mw ijoro rimwe ahitwa Kiri‐Mowabu hageseye, hakomvomvowe!
Umukobga w’i Diboni aradūze, aja mu bitabo kuririrayo; Abanyamowabu bariko baraborogera i Nebo n’i Medeba: imitwe yabo yose imowe inkomvorera, bo n’ubganwa bgose.
Bagenda mu nzira zabo bacoceye amagunira; hejuru ku nzu zabo no ku nama umuntu wese araboroga, yiyuha iryosozi.
I Heshiboni harataka bo n’i Eleyale; mber’ amajwi yabo ashika n’i Yahazi; ni co gituma ingabo z’i Mowabu ziboroga, imitima yabo ikaja mu gatengo.

Umutima wanje uririra Mowabu; impunzi zaho zahungiye i Sowari n’i Egilati‐shelishiya; ahadūga haja i Luhiti ni ho badūga barira ingenda; no mu nzira ija i Horonayimu ni ho batakira ugutaka kw’ubgihebe.
Kukw amazi y’i Nimurimu azokama, ubgatsi bgaho buzokwuma, ubgatsi butotahaye bubure, ntihazomera ikintu na kimwe kibisi.
Ni co kizotuma ibintu bari barīronkeye n’ ivyo bari barabītse babijana ku mugezi w’ibiti vyitwa arabimu.
Kuk’ ugutaka gukikije ku mbibe z’i Mowabu, amaborogo yaho agashika muri Egulayimu, mber’ ayo maborogo agashika n’i Beri‐elimu.
Kukw amazi y’i Dimoni yuzuye ibitenga vy’amaraso; kandi nzokwongera guteza i Dimoni ibindi vyago, abacitse b’i Mowabu n’amasigarira y’ico gihugu nzobatēza intambge.
Abaganza igihugu, ni murungike ingorore z’imyagazi y’intama muzikūye i Sela, muzicishe mu bugaragwa, muzirungike ku musozi w’umukobga w’i Siyoni.
Kuko nk’ukw inyoni ziyerēra icāri gisambutse, ni kw abakobga b’i Mowabu bazomera ku vyambu vya Arunoni.
Tugīre inama, uduhanure, ku murango w’amaminangohe utubere igitūtu kimeze nk’ijoro: uhishe abirukanywe, kandi n’inyererezi ntuz’ uzigonyorere.
Abirukanywe banje ubemere babe i wawe: kand’ ab’ i Mowabu ubabere ubuhungiro ku babanyaga. Umunyagahahazo ni yahindurwa ubusa, ukunyaga kugashira, kand’ abasiribanga abantu bagaherengetera mu gihugu,
ni ho intebe y’ubgami izoshimangirwa n’imbabazi, kandi hazobah’ ūzoyivyagirako mu kuri, mu nzu ya Dawidi, ar’ umucamanza ashishikara izibereye, akabanguka gukora ivy’ ukugororoka.
Twumvise ubgībone bg’i Mowabu, ko hībona cane: twumvise n’ukwishira hejuru kwaho n’ubgībone bgaho n’agakēngērwe kaho: arik’ ukwīrārīra kwaho n’ukw’ ubusa.
Ivyo ni vyo bizotuma Abanyamowabu baborogera Mowabu, umuntu wese azoboroga: muzorizwa n’amarobe y’inzabibu y’i Kiri‐hareseti mwihebuye rwose.

Kukw imirima y’i Heshiboni iravye, bo n’uruzabibu rw’i Sibuma; abami b’amahanga bāvunaguye amashami yarwo meza‐meza: yar’ ashitse n’i Yazeri, agakakariza mu bugaragwa; amashami yarwo yaragasaye ajabuka n’ikiyaga.

Kubg’ ivyo nzoririra uruzabibu rw’i Sibuma, nk’ukw ab’ i Yezeri baruririra. Nzogutotesha amosozi yanje, yewe Heshiboni, nawe Eleyale: kukw akarūru k’intambara kavugiye ku vyeze vyawe vyo mu ci no ku vyimburwa vyawe.
Akanyamuneza n’ibihimbaro bīkūwe mw itongo rimera cane; nta kuririmba kuzoba mu ruzabibu, cank’ ijwi ry’umunezero; nta mukānyi azokānyira vino mu bgato: akayego k’abakānyi ndakajibije.
Umutima wanje ucurira intimba Mowabu nk’inanga, no mu nda yanje har’ intimba y’i Kiri‐heresi.
Kand’ Abanyamowabu ni barasuka, bakaja kwigorera mu bitabo, bakaja mu bigabiro ngo basenge, nta co bizobamarira.
Iryo jambo ni ryo Uhoraho yari yaravuze kuri Mowabu mu bihe vyashize.

Ariko noneho, Uhoraho avuze, ngw Imyaka itatu itarashira, urīmbūye imyaka nk’iy’ umucangero, icubahiro c’i Mowabu kizokēngērwa bo n’ishengero ryaho ryose rikomeye, kand’ amasigarira azoba ar’ inkehwa rwose, ata co bamaze.
Imbūri yo kuri Damasiko. Rāba Damasiko hakūweho, ntihacitwa umurwa, hazoba ibirundo vy’amasakamburira.
Ibisagara vyo muri Aroweri bicitse imisaka; hazoba ah’ imikuku, ni yo izohagandagaza, nta kizoyikanga.
Ibihome bizoshira muri Efurayimu, n’ubgami bushire i Damasiko, bo n’amasigarira y’i Siriya; bizoba nk’ukw icubahiro c’Abisirayeli cabaye, ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize.
Kur’ uwo musi icubahiro ca Yakobo kizokwonda, n’ukuvyibuha kw’umubiri wiwe kuzoshira, ananuke.
Bizoba nk’uk’ umugenyi yegeranya ingano zeze, agatuma ukuboko agenya imihuruhumbi; mbere bizoba nk’ūrikw arahūmba uduhūmbga mu kiyaya c’i Refayimu.

Ariko hazosigaramw’ uduhūmbga, nk’ uko dusigara ku giti ca elayo bamaze kukinyiganyiza, hosigarayo elayo tubiri canke dutatu mu bushorishori, cabure tune canke dutanu ku mashami y’inyuma y’igiti cāri kiregeje, ni k’Uhoraho, Imana y’Abisirayeli, agize.
Kur’ uwo musi umuntu azotumbera Umuremyi wiwe, kand’ amaso yiwe azoyashira ku Wera w’Abisirayeli.
Kandi ntazotumbera ibicaniro, ivyo yubatse n’amaboko yiwe, ntazoshira amaso ku vyo intoke ziwe zakoze, canke ku nkingi bashingira Ashera n’izo bashingira izuba.
Kur’ uwo musi ibisagara vyiwe bikomeye bizoba nk’imisaka isigaye mw ishamba no ku mpinga z’imisozi, aho bātuze bahunga Abisirayeli: hazosigara ar’ amatongo.
Kuko wibagiye Imana y’agakiza kawe, ntiwibuke igitandara c’inkomezi zawe; ico ni co catumye uteragira interwa zo kwinezereza, ukishingira imizabibu y’ikigirwamana c’akavantara.
Ku musi wabiteyeko warabizitiriye, bukeye utuma ivyo wateye bishurika: arikw ivyimburwa bizobura ku musi w’umubabaro n’akabonge k’ubgihebe.
Ewe wa rwamo rw’amahanga menshi abomborana nk’ukubomborana kw’ikiyaga, n’ugusūma kw’amoko asūma nk’ugusūma kw’ amazi asitanisha!
Amoko azosūma nk’ugusūma kw’amazi menshi: arikw Imana izoyakankamira, na yo azohungira kure, nk’ ibishingwe vyo ku misozi iyo bijanwa n’umuyaga, nk’ifurufumbi y’ umukungugu ir’ imbere y’igihuhuta.
Ku mugoroba haba gucika ivutu, maze bugira buce bakaba batakiriho. Uwo ni wo mugabane w’abatunyaga, kandi ni yo ngero y’abatwambura.
Ewe wa gihugu c’amababa ahinda, kiri hakurya y’inzūzi za Etiyopiya,

gituma intumwa zica mu kiyaga zigenda ku mazi ku bitebo vy’inkorogoto, kiti Ni mugende mwa ntumwa z’impayamaguru, muje mw ihanga ry’ abantu barebare b’imibiri iyagayaga, ubgoko bgamye butera ubgoba uhereye ubga mbere ugashitsa n’ubu; ihanga rikomeye risiribanga vyose, ryo mu gihugu kigabanijwe n’inzūzi.
Yemwe ababa mw isi mwese, yemwe abagandagaje mw isi, ni mwabona ibendera imanitswe ku misozi miremire, muze mwiyubare, kand’ inzamba ni yavuga, muze mwumvirize.
Kuk’ ukw ari k’Uhoraho yambariye, ati Nzokwinumira, nitegereze ndi mu buruhukiro bganje, mmere nk’indugumba irimw’ ibikēke iy’ izuba ryatse, mmere nk’igipfungu c’urume mu ndugumba yo mw iyimbura.
Kukw iyimbura ritaragera, ishurwe rihunguye, uruzabibu rutanguye kubūndūra, udushami tujondajonda azodukereza urukero, n’amashami agasaye azoyaca ayakūreho.
Bazocurikirana hamwe babe ab’ ibisīga vy’amero vyo ku misozi miremire, n’ibikōko vyo mw isi: ivyo bisīga vy’amero bizobamarakw ici, n’ibikōko vyo mw isi bizobamarakw agatāsi.

Ico gihe Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo azoshikanirwa ishikanwa n’ubgo bgoko bg’abantu barebare b’umubiri uyagayaga, ubgoko bgamye butera ubgoba uhereye ubga mbere ugashitsa n’ ubu; ihanga rikomeye risiribanga vyose, ryo mu gihugu kigabanijwe n’inzūzi; iryo shikanwa rizoshikanirwa ahantu h’izina ry’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, ni ho ku musozi Siyoni.
Imbūri yo kuri Egiputa. Rāba Uhoraho areruwe n’ igicu cihuta, aja muri Egiputa; ibigirwamana vyo muri Egiputa bizohindira agashitsi imbere yiwe, umutima wa Egiputa uzoyagira mu nda.
Nzoteranya Abanyegiputa bisubiraniremwo: umuntu wese azorwana n’uwo bavukana, umuntu wese arwane n’umubanyi wiwe, igisagara kirwane n’ikindi, ubgami burwane n’ubundi.
Umutima wa Egiputa uzokamangana, nanje nzokwica imigabo yaho; bazoja gusiguza ibigirwamana n’abavovota n’abahamagara imizimu bo n’abamenyi.
Abanyegiputa nzobagabura mu kuboko kw’umutware w’imburakigongwe, kand’ umwami w’inkazi azobaganza, ni k’Umwami Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize.
Amazi yo mu ruzi yahora asendanisha nk’ikiyaga azobura, kand’ uruzi ruzogeruka, rukame.
Inzūzi zizonuka, kand’ amazi y’imigezi yo muri Egiputa azokeha akamirikire: amarenga n’imibere bizokabirana.
Indimiro zo kuri Nili, zo ku nkombe za Nili, n’ibirimwa vyose vyo kuri Nili bizokwuma, biyoke, ntibibe bikiboneka.
Kandi n’ abarovyi na bo bazorira, abatera igera muri Nili bose baboroge, n’ abarobesha insenga mur’ ayo mazi bahondobere.
Kand’ abakora igikorwa co gukūba inyuzi z’uduti twitwa pishita bazomāramāra, bo n’abajisha imyerupe.
Inkingi za Egiputa zizovunagurika, n’ abacangero bazogira akabonge mu mitima.

Abaganwa b’i Sowani n’ibipfu rwose; inama z’abajanama ba Farawo b’abanyabgenge zihindutse iz’ ubusa: none muhangara mute kubarira Farawo, muti Nd’ umwana w’umunyabgenge, nd’umwana ava mu bami ba kera?
Non’ abanyabgenge bawe bari hehe? Ni bakubarire, bamenye imigabo Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo afitiye Egiputa.
Abaganwa b’i Sowani bacitse ibipfu, n’abaganwa b’i Nofu barasutswe, ni bo bājimije Egiputa, kand’ ari bo buye rigumya imfuruka ry’amoko yaho.
Uhoraho yahasutse impwemu y’iserēre, kandi bājimije Egiputa mu bikorwa vyaho vyose, nk’ukw imborerwa idandabagiranira mu vyo idashwe.
Kandi muri Egiputa nta gikorwa kizohashoboka, ar’ icokorwa n’umutwe cank’ umurizo, ishami ry’ikigazi cank’ umubere.
Kur’ uwo musi Egiputa hazocika bga bagore: hazohinda agashitsi hatinye, kubg’ ugushongongeza ukuboko kw’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, ahashongongereza.
Kand’ igihugu ca Yuda kizohinduka igiteye ubgoba kuri Egiputa: ūzokibarirwa wese azotinya, kubg’ imigabo Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo yagabiye kuri Egiputa.
Kur’ uwo musi mu gihugu ca Egiputa hazobamw’ ibisagara bitanu bivuga urunyakanani, birahira Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo: kimwe muri vyo kizokwitwa Kiri‐haheresi.
Kur’ uwo musi hazoba igicaniro cubakiwe Uhoraho mu gihugu ca Egiputa hagati, kand’ inkingi izoshingirwa Uhoraho ku rubibe rwaco.
Bizoba ikimenyetso n’igishingantahe k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo mu gihugu ca Egiputa: kuko bazotakambira Uhoraho kubg’ ababahahaza, na we azobarungikira umukiza n’umuvunyi, azobakiza.
Kand’ Uhoraho azokwimenyesha Egiputa, n’ Abanyegiputa bazomenya Uhoraho kur’ uwo musi: mbere bazosenga batanga ibimazi bashikana amashikanwa, bazosezeranira Uhoraho isezerano, barishitse.
Kand’ Uhoraho azokubita Egiputa, ahakubite yongere ahakize: bazogaruka k’Uhoraho, na we azobakundira kumwinginga, kand’ azobakiza.
Kur’ uwo musi hazoba inzira y’iroro iva muri Egiputa ija muri Ashuri, kand’ Abashuri bazogendera Egiputa, n’Abanyegiputa bagendere Ashuri; kand’ Abanyegiputa n’Abashuri bazosengera hamwe.
Kur’ uwo musi i Bgisirayeli hazoba aha gatatu kuri Egiputa na Ashuri, ar’ umugisha hagati mw isi:
kuk’ Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo ahahaye umugisha, ati Hahirwe Abanyegiputa abantu banje, n’Abashuri igikorwa c’amaboko yanje, n’Abisirayeli ishamvu yanje.
Umwaka Taritani yatereyemw’ ahitwa Ashidodi, agomowe na Sarigoni umwami w’i Ashuri, akaharwanya akahatsinda,

ico gihe ni ho Uhoraho yavugiye muri Yesaya mwene Amosi, aramubgira, ati Genda ukenyurure igunira ukenyeye mu nda, ukūre n’inkweto mu birenge vyawe. Abigenza artyo, agenda yambaye ubusa, atagira n’inkweto.
Maz’ Uhoraho aravuga, ati Nk’uk’ umusavyi wanje Yesaya amaze imyaka itatu agenda yambaye ubusa atagira n’inkweto, akabera Egiputa na Etiyopiya ikimenyetso n’imbūri;

uko ni k’umwami w’i Ashuri azojana abo muri Egiputa ar’ inyagano, n’abangajwe bo muri Etiyopiya, abato n’abakuru, bazogenda bambaye ubusa batagira n’ inkweto, n’amatako yabo ar’ ubusa, bimāramāze Egiputa.
Kandi bazokwihebura bamāramāre, kubga Etiyopiya bari bizigiye, no kubga Egiputa birātana.

Kur’ uwo musi ababa mur’ iki kiyaya c’ikiyaga bazovuga, bat’ Eh’ ivyo twizigira ingene bibaye, tukahaziga ko twohahungiye, bikadutabara ngo dukire umwami w’i Ashuri! None twebge tweho tuzokwikiza dute?
Imbūri yo ku bugaragwa buri ku kiyaga. Nk’ukw agashururu ko mu gihugu c’i bumanuko gasuriranya, ni ko biza bivuye mu bugaragwa, mu gihugu giteye ubgoba.

Ivyerekanywe bikomeye ndabihishurirwa; abaryarukanyi bariko bararyarukana, abanyazi bariko baranyaga. Yemwe b’i Elamu, ni mudūge mutere, namwe Bamedi, mubate hagati! Ukwitsa umutima kwabo kwose ngira nkurangize.
Ni co gitumye ikiyunguyungu canje cuzuye uburibge, ngafatwa n’ibise nk’ibise vy’umugore ari ku nda; ndaribga bituma ntashobora kwumva, ubgihebe bg’ubgoba butumye ntashobora kubona.
Umutima wanje urahuzagizwa, mpundagajwe n’ubgoba: ijoro nari nifuje ryampindukiye agatengo.
Batunganya ameza, bagashirah’ abashibamyi, bakarya bakanywa. Haguruka, mwa baganwa, musīge inkinzo amavuta!
Kuk’ ukw ari k’Umwami Imana ambariye: ati Genda ushireh’ umushibamyi, az’ avuge ico yabonye.
Ni yabona umuce w’ingabo, ar’ abagendera ku mafarasi bagenda ari babiri‐babiri, cank’ ar’ abagendera ku ndogoba, cank’ ar’ abagendera ku ngamiya, az’ abange amatwi yumvirize cane.
Maz’ avuga nk’intambge, ati Mwami, nama nirirwa mpagaze ku munara wo gushibamako, kandi ngakesha ijoro ku rubu rwanje:

non’ ehe haje umuce w’ingabo zigendera ku mafarasi bagenda ari babiri‐babiri. Arongera aravuga, ati Babuloni harakomvomvowe, harakomvomvowe; n’ibishushanyo bibājwe vyose vy’ibigirwamana vyaho bihindikiraniye hasi bivunaguritse.
Ewe wa muhūre wanje, ewe mpeke zo ku mbuga yanje! Ivyo numvise bivuye k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, Imana y’Abisirayeli, ni vyo mbabariye.
Imbūri yo kuri Duma. Harih’ ūmpamagara ar’ i Seyiri, ati Yewe mushibamyi, ijoro rigeze hehe? Yewe mushibamyi, ijoro rigeze hehe?
Wa mushibamyi aramwishura, ati Bugira buce, kandi bgongere bgire: ni mwagomba kubaza, mubaze; muhindukire muze.
Imbūri yo kuri Arabiya. Yewe wa gugu ry’Abadedani, mw ishamba ryo muri Arabiya ni ho muzorāra.
Uwishwe n’inyota bamuzaniye amazi, ababa mu gihugu c’i Tema basanganije izo mpunzi ivyo kurya.
Kuko bāriko barahunga inkota, inkota zisokōwe, n’imiheto ifoye, n’ivyago vy’intambara.
Kuk’ ukw ari k’Umwami Imana ambariye: at’ Umwaka utarashira, urīmbūye umwaka nk’uw’ umucangero, icubahiro cose c’i Kedari kizoshira;
n’amasigarira yo mu gitigiri c’ abarashi b’abahizi b’Abakedari bazoba imparūrwa; kuk’ Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli ari we abivuze.
Imbūri yo ku kiyaya c’ ukwerekwa. Noneh’ ubaye ute, abantu bawe bose ko būriye ku mazu hejuru?
Wewe wuzuye urwamo, wa murwa w’imivurungano, wa gisagara cihaya, abishwe bo mu bawe kw atar’ abishwe n’inkota, kandi ntibagwe mu rugamba!
Abākuganza bose ko bahungiye hamwe, bagafatanwa imiheto, kand’ abahizi bawe bose bakaba bafatiwe mpiri hamwe, naho bāri bahungiye kure!
Kubg’ ivyo ndavuga, nti Ni murābe irya, munkūrekw amaso, mureke ndire nitunturire; ntimwigore ngo muranyirura umubabaro mfitiye ukunyagwa kw’i Yerusalemu umukobga w’ubgoko bgacu;
kukw ar’ umusi w’ubgihebure n’ugusiribangwa n’ukuzazanirwa, uvuye ku Mwami, Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, mu kiyaya co kwerekwa; hariho gusangangura inzitiro z’amabuye, n’ amaruru ashika ku misozi miremire.
Abelamu bapfukūye imitana, Abaramu baje bagendera ku mafarasi, kand’ ab’i Kiri basokoroye inkinzo.
Maze mu biyaya vyawe vyiza‐vyiza huzuramw’ imikogote, kand’ abagendera ku mafarasi batonda urugamba kw irembo ry’igisagara.
Agukūrakw igitwikirizo, yewe Yuda, ng’ uve i marwi; maz’ uwo musi ujarajara ibirwanishwa vyo mu nzu yitwa iy’ Ikibira.
Mubona ibirengero vy’ibizitiriye umurwa wa Dawidi kw ari vyinshi; mugomera amazi yo mu kidengeri co hepfo.
Muharūra amazu y’i Yerusalemu, amazu muyasambura kugira ngo mukomeze uruzitiro.
Amazi yo mu kidengeri ca kera muyacira urugomero hagati y’inzitiro zompi: ariko ntimwasubiza ijisho ku wari yarakoze ivyo, kandi ntimwashira umutima ku wabiremye kera cane.
Kur’ uwo musi Umwami Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo yahamagariye abantu kwiririra no kwiborogera no kwimosha inkomvorera no gukenyera amagunira:
yamara bashiraho kwinezereza no guhimbarwa, kubāga inka no kubāga intama, kurya inyama no kunywa vino: bati Ngo twīrīre, twinywere, kukw ejo tuzopfa.
Maz’ Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo yihishurira mu matwi yanje, arambgira, ati N’ukuri, ivyo bigabitanyo ntimuzopfa muvyogejwe ngo bibaveko, ni k’Umwami Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize.
Uku ni k’Umwami Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize: ati Genda kuri wa mubgiriza Shebuna, ari we muzezwarugo, umubaze,
ut’ Urakora iki ngaho? uti Kand’ uri kumwe na nde ngaho ko wiyimbiye imva aho nyene? uti Ko wiyimbiye imva ahahera ruguru, ukībāzira ubugaramango mu gitandara!
Uti Rāba, Uhoraho azogushiburana inkomezi ugwe kure, wa munyagakēngērwe we, mber’ azokuzingazinga rwose!
Uti N’ukuri azokugira itu, akuraririze nk’ umupira, ugwe mu gihugu cāgutse; ut’ Aho ni ho uzogwa, kandi ni ho imikogote yawe y’icubahiro izogangarara, wa gatētereza k’inzu ya shobuja.
Nzokunyaga ububgiriza bgawe, kand’ uzosubizwa hasi ukūrwe mu bukuru bgawe.
Kur’ uwo musi nzohamagara umusavyi wanje Eliyakimu mwene Hilukiya,
mmwambike umwambaro wawe, mmukenyeze umukanda wawe, mmushikirize ubutware bgawe; kand’ ababa i Yerusalemu n’ab’ inzu ya Yuda azobabera se.
Kand’ urupfunguzo rw’inzu ya Dawidi nzorushira ku bitugu vyiwe; kand’ azokwugurura ntihagire uwugara, azokwugara ntihagire uwugurura.
Nzomushimangira nk’umusumari ahantu hagumye, azobera inzu ya se intebe y’icubahiro.
Maze bazomusakārakw icubahiro cose c’inzu ya se, bene wabo n’ibiryango‐ryango, akabumbano kose gato, uhereye ku tubumbano tw’utwavya ugashitsa ku tubumbano tw’utubindi.
Kur’ uwo musi, ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, uwo musumari washimangiwe ahantu hagumye uzoshingūka; kand’ uzogazagurwa ukoroke, n’ibiremereye vyari kuri wo bizomenagurika; kuk’ Uhoraho abivuze.
Imbūri yo kuri Tiro. Boroga, yemwe māto y’i Tarushishi: kukw i Tiro hageseye, bigatuma ata mazu akiriho, ata n’aho gutaha; izo nkuru bazibgiwe zivuye mu gihugu c’i Kupuro.
Ni mujorerwe, mwa baba mu kizinga co mu kiyaga, mwa badandaza b’i Sidoni, mwahora muca mu kiyaga,
ku mazi menshi; inyungu zanyu zar’ impeke zivuye kuri Shihori, n’ivyimburwa vyo kuri Nili; mwabaye abadandaza b’amahanga.
Ewe Sidoni māramāra; kukw ikiyaga kivuze, igihome co ku kiyaga kiravuze, kiti Sinaramutswe, sinavyaye, kandi sinonkeje abahungu, sinareze n’abakobga.
Inkuru ni yashika muri Egiputa bazobabazwa cane n’izo nkuru zivuye i Tiro.
Ni mujabuke muje i Tarushishi; muboroge, mwa baba mu kizinga co mu kiyaga.
Mbeg’ iki ni ca gisagara canyu c’umunezero, camyeh’ uhereye imisi ya kera cane, cagendesha amaguru kure kugerērayo?
Ni nde yagabiye kugirira Tiro ivyo, kand’ ar’ igisagara cambika ibitsibo, abadandaza baho bakaba abahambaye, n’abahanjo baho bakaba ar’ abanyacubahiro mw isi?
Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo ni we yabigabiye, kugira ngw akengereze ubgibone bg’ icubahiro cose, kandi ngw agayishe abanyacubahiro bose bo mw isi.
Sendanisha mu gihugu cawe nk’uko Nili rusendanisha, wa mukobga w’i Tarushishi, kukw ata kikikubujije.
Yabānguye ukuboko hejuru y’ikiyaga, anyiganyiza ibihugu vy’abami; Uhoraho agera ivy’ i Kanani ngo bakomvomvore ibihome vyaho.
Aravuga, ati Ntugisubira kunezerwa, wa nkumi y’i Sidoni yononekaye; va hasi ujabuke uje i Kupuro, kandi n’iyo na ho ntuzoharonka uburuhukiro.
Ni murābe igihugu c’Abakaludaya: ubgo bgoko ntibukiriho; Abashuri bahahinduye ah’ ibikōko vyo mu bugaragwa. Bashinga ivyo būririrako, basambura ingoro zaho; bahaca amatongo.
Boroga, mwa māto y’i Tarushishi: kukw igihome canyu gisanganguwe.

Maze kur’ uwo musi i Tiro hazokwibagirana imyaka mirongwirindwi, ihwanye n’imisi umwami umwe yomara ku ngoma; iyo myaka mirongwirindwi ni yashira, ibizoba kuri Tiro bizomera nk’ivyo mu kavyino ka maraya.
Abira inanga ugendagende mu gisagara, wewe maraya wari waribagiranye; ucurarange neza, uvyine utuvyino twinshi kugira ngo wibukwe.
Nukw iyo myaka mirongwirindwi ni yashira Uhoraho azogendera i Tiro, hasubire ku mpēra y’ubumaraya bgaho, hasambane n’ibihugu vy’ abami bose bo mw isi.
Inyungu n’impēra vyaho bizoba ivyera k’Uhoraho; ntibizobīkwa kandi ntibizoshirwa ukwavyo, kukw inyungu zaho zizoba iz’ abahora imbere y’Uhoraho, kugira ngo barye bahāge, baronke n’imyambaro myiza.
Rāba Uhoraho agira ngw ahindure isi umusaka, ayigire amatongo, ayūbike, asanzaze abayibamwo.

Maz’ ibizoba ku bantu buntu bizoba no ku muherezi; ibizoba ku mushumba bizoba no kuri shebuja; ibizoba ku mukobga w’umuja bizoba no kuri inabuja; ibizoba ku muguzi bizoba no k’ūshōra; ibizoba k’ūtiza bizoba no k’ūtira; ibizoba k’uwaka inyungu bizoba no k’uwakwa inyungu.
Isi izohinduka umusaka inyagwe rwose; kuk’ Uhoraho ari we avuze iryo jambo.
Igihugu kiriganyira, kirakabiranye; isi irahondobereye, irakabiranye, abakuru bo mw isi barahondobereye.
Kand’ isi ihumanijwe n’abayibamwo; kuko barenze ivyagezwe, bagaca mw ibgirizwa, bakica isezerano ry’ intahava.
Ni co catumye umuvumo utongora isi, kand’ abayibamwo ni vyo bahōwe: ni co catumye ababa mw isi baturirwa, hagasigara abantu b’imparūrwa.
Umutobe wa vino uriganyira, uruzabibu rurahondobereye, ab’ umutima w’umunezero bose bazokwitsa umutima.
Ibinezereza bivuye ku dushako tw’ingoma birashize, urwamo rw’ abanezerewe ruraheze, ugucuraranga kw’inanga kurashize.
Ntibazonywa vino baririmba, ibiboreza bizobīhira ababinywa.
Igisagara c’umuvurungano kirasanganguwe, inzu yose irasakiwe, kugira ngo ntihagire uwinjira.
Baririra mu nzira kuko babuze vino; ahār’ umunezero burīje mazingi, ibinezereza vyo mu gihugu biragiye.
Mu gisagara hasigaye amatongo, n’ irembo rirasituwe.
Kuk’ ukw ari ko bizomera mw isi hagati mu mahanga; bizomera nk’iyo banyiganyije igiti ca elayo, canke nk’uduhumbga tw’inzabibu iy’ iyimbura rishize.
Abo bazoshira amajwi hejuru basemerere, batārīkishwe n’icubahiro c’Uhoraho bari ku kiyaga.
Nuko ni muhimbarize Uhoraho i burasirazuba, muhimbarize izina ry’ Uhoraho, Imana y’Abisirayeli, mu bizinga vyo mu kiyaga.

Twumvise indirimbo zituruka ku mpera y’isi, zit’ Icubahiro kibe ic’ umugororotsi. Maze nca ndavuga, nti Ndageranywe, ndageranywe! Mbonye ibara! Abaryarukanyi bararyarukanye, mber’ abaryarukanyi bararyarukanye rwose.
Wewe uba mw isi, ibiteye ubgoba n’urusumanyenzi n’umutego bigushitseko.
Nuk’ ūhunga induru y’ibiteye ubgoba azogwa mu rusumanyenzi; uwūrira ngw ave mu rusumanyenzi umutego uzomufata: kukw ingomero zo mw ijuru zigomorowe, kand’ amatanguriro y’isi akanyiganyiga.
Isi iravungaguritse, isi irasataguritse, isi irahuzenze.
Isi izodandabagirana nk’imborerwa, izonyiganyizwa irya n’ino nk’umutara; igicumuro cayo kizoyiremēra, kand’ izotemba, ntiyongere kuvyuka ukundi.
Maze kur’ uwo musi Uhoraho azohana ingabo zo hejuru mw ijuru, n’abami bo hasi mw isi.
Bazokoranirizwa hamwe, nk’ ukw imbohe zikoranirizwa mu kazu k’i bgina, bugaranirwe mw ibohero; kand’ imisi myinshi ni yashira bazohanwa.
Ni ho ukwezi kuzomāramāra, izuba ritētērwe; kuk’ Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo azoba ari ku ngoma ku musozi Siyoni ari ho Yerusalemu, agire icubahiro imbere y’abashingantahe biwe.
Ewe Uhoraho, ni wewe Mana yanje; nzogushira hejuru, ntazire izina ryawe; kuko wakoze ibitangaza, ivyo wagabiye uhereye kera, ur’ uwo kwizigirwa n’uw’ ukuri.
Kuko wahinduye igisagara ibirundo vy’ amasakamburira, igisagara cubakiwe inzitiro wakigize amatongo, ingoro z’abanyamahanga watumye zitakiba igisagara, ntikizokwongera kwubakwa kugeza ibihe vyose.
Ni co kizotuma ubgoko bg’ inkomezi bukwubaha, igisagara c’amahanga y’agaterabgoba kizogutinya.
Kuk’ umugorwa wamubereye igihome, wabereye igihome umukene mu vyago vyiwe, ukababera ubgugamo mu gihuhuta, n’igitūtu mu ndugumba, iy’ inkūbi y’abantu b’ agaterabgoba imeze nk’igihuhuta cisuka ku nzu.
Nk’ukw indugumba yo mu gihugu kigadutse ikūrwaho, ni k’uzozibiza urwamo rw’abanyamahanga; nk’ukw indugumba ikūrwaho n’igitūtu c’igicu, ni k’uzozibiza ivyivugo vy’abantu b’agaterabgoba.
Kandi kur’ uyu musozi Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo azohategurira amahanga yose amazimano y’inyama zinuze, amazimano ya vino y’umukāka, inyama zinuze zuzuye imisokōro, na vino y’umukāka imiminnye neza.
Kur’ uyu musozi ni ho azoherengetereza icitwikiro c’ukugandara catwikiriye amoko yose, n’icitwikiro gitwikiriye amahanga yose.
Urupfu azorumira miyonzwa gushitsa ibihe vyose; kand’ Umwami Uhoraho azohanagura amosozi ku maso ya bose; n’ ubumāramāre bgo ku bantu biwe azobukūra kw isi yose; kuk’ Uhoraho ari we abivuze.
Nuko kur’ uwo musi bizovugwa, ngw Eh’ iyi ni yo Mana yacu; ni yo twari turorereye, na yo iradukiza: uyu ni we Uhoraho; ni we twari turorereye; duhimbarwe, tunezererwe agakiza kiwe.
Kuk’ ukuboko kw’Uhoraho kuri kur’ uyu musozi, ariko Mowabu hazohonyangirwa ahantu haho, nk’ukw ivyatsi bihonyangirwa mu kiziba c’amaganga.
Kandi hazosānza amaboko hagati muri co, nk’uk’ uwoga asānza amaboko ngo yoge: arikw azotsindagira hasi ubgibone bgaho, bo n’ubugunge bg’amaboko yaho.
Kand’ igihome kirekire kigukīngīra c’inzitiro zawe z’amabuye azogisangangura, agitsinde hasi, agishitse mw ivu, mbere no mu mukungugu.
Kur’ uwo musi iyi ndirimbo izoririmbirwa mu gihugu ca Yuda, ngo Dufise igisagara gikomeye; Imana izoshirah’ agakiza kabe inzitiro n’ibihome bidukīngīra.
Ni mwugurure amarembo, kugira ngw ihanga rigororoka rikitondera ivy’ ukuri rishike.
Uzozigama amahoro masa umuntu akwegamikako umutima wiwe, kukw akwizigiye.
Ni mwizigire Uhoraho ibihe vyose: kuk’ UHORAHO YEHOVA ari we gitandara camah’ ibihe bidashira.
Kuko yashubije hasi ababa ahantu ho hejuru mu gisagara cishira hejuru; agitsinda hasi, agitsinda hasi akagishitsa mw ivu, mber’ agishitsa no mu mukungugu.
Ibirenge bizogisiribanga, ni vyo birenge vy’impahazwa, hahonyangwe n’ abakene.
Inzira y’umugororotsi iratunganye: ni wewe usena inzira y’umugororotsi.
Mbere mu nzira y’imanza zawe ziroranye, Uhoraho, ni ho twamye tukwitegeye; izina ryawe n’ukuba rurangiranwa kwawe ni vyo imitima yacu ihahamiye.
Nakwifurishije umutima wanje mw ijoro; mbere nzokurondeza umushaha wanje wose ubudahumeka; kukw iy’ imanza zawe ziroranye ziri mw isi, ababa mw isi biga kugororoka.
Umunyavyaha naho yogirirwa neza nta ho yokwiga kugororoka; mu gihugu c’ubugororotsi azohakorera ibigabitanyo, kandi ntazoruha yitegereza ubgiza bg’Uhoraho.
Uhoraho, umanitse ukuboko, yamara ntibabibona; ariko bazobona umwete ugirira abantu, bamāramāre; mber’ umuriro uzorigata abansi bawe.
Uhoraho, uzoturonsa impore, kukw ivyo dukora vyose ari wewe ubidusohoreza.
Ewe Uhoraho Mana yacu, abandi bami batari wewe bamye batuganza; arikw izina ryawe ryonyene ni ryo twatura.
Bo barapfuye, ntibazokwongera kubaho; barahwereye, ntibazozuka: ni co catumye ubahana, ubarandura, ukazimanganya ukwibukwa kwabo kwose.
Wagwije ihanga, Uhoraho we, wagwije ihanga; urashemagizwa: wunguye imbibe zose z’igihugu.
Uhoraho, aho baboneye amagorwa ni ho bagushengereye; iy’ uguhana kwawe kubashikiriye basuka amajojwa.
Nk’uk’ umugore akuriwe amera, iy’ igihe ciwe co kuvyara gishitse, aribga agatakishwa n’ibise vyiwe, uko ni ko twari tumeze imbere yawe, Uhoraho.
Twari dukuriwe, turaribga, bimera nk’aho twavyaye umuyaga gusa; nta gakiza twazaniye isi, kandi nta bo kuba mw isi bāvutse.
Abapfuye bawe bazoba bazima; imivyimba y’abantu bawe izozuka. Ni mwikangure, muririmbe, yemwe abaryamye mu mukungugu: kukw ikime cawe kimeze nk’igitonda ku vyatsi, kand’ ivu rizogarura abapfuye.
Wa bgoko bganje, ngwino winjire mu nzu yawe, wiyugarane, ube urihishije akanya gato, gushitsa ah’ ubushangashirwe buzoshirira.
Kuk’ Uhoraho arikw arava i we azanywe no guhanira ababa mw isi ukugabitanya kwabo; ivu rizogaragaza ibitenga vy’amaraso yaviriye kuri ryo, kandi ntirizoba rigitwikiriye abishwe bo muri ryo.
Kur’ uwo musi Uhoraho azohanisha inkota yiwe ikarishe nini ikomeye Lewiyatani ca kiyoka kinyaruka, ni co Lewiyatani ca kiyoka cigonyonzora, kand’ azokwica ca gisato c’amahēro co mu kiyaga.
Kur’ uwo musi bazovuga, bati Ni muririmbire uruzabibu rwa vino.
Jewe Uhoraho, ni jewe ndaruzigama; nzohora ndaruvomera akanya kose: nzoruzigama ku murango no mw ijoro, kugira ngo ntihagire ikirwona.
Nta burake mfise. Iyaba imikere n’ amahwa vyari bimpagurukiye kuntera, nobirwanije nkabiyigiriza hamwe:
shiti bokwisunga inkomezi zanje, bakuzura nanje, mbere ni buzure nanje.
Mu misi izoza Yakobo azoshinga imizi, Isirayeli apfundike, ashurike: azokwama, yuzuze isi yose.
Mbega yabakubise nk’uko yakubise abābakubita? Canke bishwe nk’uko hāgeseye abo yishe?
Hamwe wabirukana wabahannye ibitarenze urugero; ku musi w’umuyaga uva i burasirazuba wabavumbuje inkūbi y’umuyaga.

Ivyo ni vyo bizotuma ukugabitanya kwa Yakobo kuzokwozwa, kumuveko; kand’ imbuto zose zizova mu gukūrwakw icaha ciwe n’izi: n’ukw azohindura amabuye yose y’igicaniro nk’ingwa y’amabuye ihondaguwe, kugira ngw inkingi zari zarashingiwe Ashera n’iz’ izuba ntizize zishingwe ukundi.
Kukw igisagara cubakiwe inzitiro gisigaye gitēterewe, ar’ ikibanza gihebge, gitawe, kimeze nk’agahinga; ni ho inyana zizorisha, zikaharyama, zikarya amashami yaho.
Amashami yaho ni yuma azohānyurwa; abagore bazoza bayacane; kukw iryo hanga ar’ iritagira ubgenge; ni co gituma Iyabaremye itazobagirira akagongwe, kand’ Iyababumvye itazobagirira akantu.
Kur’ uwo musi Uhoraho azosekura akūre impeke ziwe, uhereye kuri rwa ruzi Efurate, ugashitsa kuri wa Mugezi wa Egiputa; maze muzonobagurwa umwe‐umwe, mwebge Abisirayeli.
Maze kur’ uwo musi inzamba niniya izovuzwa; kandi hazoza abāriko barahona mu gihugu ca Ashuri, n’abirukanywe mu gihugu ca Egiputa; bazosengera Uhoraho ku musozi wera i Yerusalemu.
Igitsibo c’ubgibone bg’ababorewe b’Abefurayimu kizobona ibara, bo n’ishurwe ry’ ubgiza bg’icubahiro ciwe rikabiranye, riri ku mutwe w’ikiyaya kimera cane c’abatsindwa na vino, na ryo rizobona ibara.
Rāba Uhoraho afise umunyenkomezi w’ubushobozi; ni we azobatūra hasi n’inkomezi, nk’akabushungwe k’urubura, nk’ikirura gitikiza, nk’ugusendanisha kw’amazi y’inkomezi ashēshe.
Igitsibo c’ubgibone bg’ababorewe b’Abefurayimu kizosiribangwa,

kandi n’ishurwe ry’ubgiza bg’icubahiro ciwe rikabiranye, riri ku mutwe w’ikiyaya kimera cane, na ryo rizomera nk’insukoni y’isega, ici ritarasohora: ūyikubise ijisho, akiyishikana mu ntoke akayiyongobeza ako kanya.
Kur’ uwo musi Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo azobera abantu biwe b’amasigarira igitsibo c’icubahiro n’umugāra w’ubgiza:
n’uwicaye aca imanza azomubera umutima uca iziroranye, kand’ azobera inkomezi abasubiza urugamba inyuma y’ amarembo.

Ariko n’Abayuda na bo baradandabagiranywa na vino, bakubishwa iserere n’ibiboreza; umuherezi n’ūvugishwa n’Imana baradandabagiranywa n’ ibiboreza, vino irabamaze, bakubishwa iserere n’ibiboreza; iyo bakiriko barērekwa baradandabagirana, iyo bakiriko baraca imanza barazunguzwa.
Kukw ameza yose yuzuyekw ibirutsi n’ishishi, ata hantu hasigaye.
Uyo azokwigisha nde ubgenge? Kand’ azotahuza ubutumwa nde? Mbega n’abacūtse n’abavuye kw ibere?
Kukw ivyiwe ar’ ibgirizwa ku rindi, ibgirizwa ku rindi, n’umurongo ku wundi, umurongo ku wundi, hamwe tumwe, ahandi utundi.
Noneho rer’ Uhoraho azovuganira n’ubu bgoko mu kanwa katumvikana no mu rurimi rundi;
ari bgo yari yarabariye, at’ Uku ni kwo kuruhuka, mureke ūrushe aruhuke; aha ni ho buruhukiro: ariko banka kwumva.

Ni co gituma kuri bo ijambo ry’Uhoraho rizobabera ibgirizwa ku rindi, ibgirizwa ku rindi, n’umurongo ku wundi, umurongo ku wundi, hamwe tumwe, ahandi utundi; kugira ngo bagende, bagwe bagaramye, bavunagurike, bategwe, bafatwe.
Nuko rero ni mwumve ijambo ry’Uhoraho, mwa bacokoranyi mwe, baganza ubu bgoko bur’ i Yerusalemu!

Ko muvuga, muti Twasezeranye isezerano n’ urupfu, kandi twemeranije n’i kuzimu; mut’ Icago ni casendanisha kigahita mu gihugu, muti Ntikizodushikako; muti Kuko twironkeye ubuhungiro mu binyoma, tukaba tunyegeye musi y’ ubugunge:

ni co gitumye Umwami Uhoraho avuga, ati Rāba, ndashira i Siyoni ibuye ryo kuba itanguriro, ibuye ryagejejwe, ari ryo ryo kugumya imfuruka, riri n’igiciro, rishikamye cane; kand’ uwizera ntazohutagiza.
Kand’ imanza ziroranye ni zo nzogira umugozi ugera, n’ubugororotsi nzobugira karisho: urubura ruzovumbura ubgo buhungiro bg’ibinyoma, kand’ amazi azosendanisha aho hantu ho kwinyegeza.
Maz’ isezerano mwasezeranye n’urupfu rizopfa, kand’ inyemero mwemeranije n’i kuzimu ntizohama; arikw icago ni casendanisha kigahita mu gihugu, ni ho kizobasiribangira hasi.
Uko kizoba gihita kwose kizobafata; kuko kizokwama gihita uko bukeye, ku murango no mw ijoro, kandi gutahura bga butumwa kuzozana gucika ivutu gusa.
Kuk’ uburiri ari bugufi umuntu atoshobora kuburamvyako, kand’ ikirago kikaba akaberere umuntu atoshobora kuciyorosa.

Kuk’ Uhoraho azohaguruka nk’uko yahagurutse ku musozi Perasimu, azoraka nk’uko yarakiye mu kiyaya c’i Gibeyoni; akore igikorwa ciwe, igikorwa ciwe c’igitangaza, ashitse igikorwa ciwe, igikorwa ciwe c’akumiza.
None rero mureke kuba abacokoranyi, kugira ngw imvuto murimwo ntizirushirize gukanasha; kuko numvise yukw ivyo Umwami Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo yagabiye ar’ ugutikiza igihugu cose.
Ni mutege amatwi, mwumve ijwi ryanje; mwumvirize, mwumve amajambo yanje.
Mbeg’ umurimyi avyiririra kuzobiba, yama avyirira na ntaryo? Mbega yama avyirira agakubita imvyirire na ntaryo?
Iy’ amaze kuyikuma ntahava akamija uburo, akabiba izitwa kumino, akabiba ingano mu mirongo, na sayiri akayibiba aho yayitunganirije, akabiba n’izitwa kusemeti ku rubibe rwaho?
Kukw Imana yiwe imwereka neza, ikamwigisha.
Kuk’ uburo budahūzwa imihini ifise ubugi, na kumino ntihūzwa no gutembagazwako ikurudumu y’umukogote; arik’ uburo buhūzwa umuhini, na kumino ihūzwa ikibando.
Mbeg’ impeke z’umutsima mu gusekura barazimenagura? Ereg’ umuntu ntiyokwama arazihūra: mbere naho yozitembagazako ikurudumu y’umukogote wiwe n’amafarasi yiwe, yirinda kutazimenagura.
Ivyo na vyo biva k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, umujanama w’igitangaza, w’ubgenge bg’agahebuza.
Ewe Ariyeli, uzobona ibara, Ariyeli, wa murwa Dawidi yashagajeko! Mukurikiranye umwaka n’uwundi, mugire imisi mikuru mu bihe vyayo;
maze Ariyeli nzoca mpababaza, hazoba kurira no kuboroga; kand’ aho hazombera nka Ariyeli nyene.
Nzogusagazako ngutangatange impande zose, nzogukikiza ibihome ngute hagati, nzoguta hagati nkurundire ikirundo c’ivu kigukikije.
Maz’ uzocishwa bugufi uvugire mw ivu, amajambo yawe azoba asokoroka hasi nk’ayava mu mukungugu; ijwi ryawe rizova mw ivu ryandara nk’iry’ umuzimu, amajambo yawe anywigirire mu mukungugu.
Arikw ingabo z’abansi bawe zizohava zihinduka nk’umukungugu wiseye, n’ingabo z’agaterabgoba zizohinduka nk’umuguruka utumuka: mber’ ivyo bizobabera birtyo giturumbuka mu kanya gato.
Hazoba guterwa n’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, kw’imituragaro, n’ugutigita kw’isi, n’ukwasana gukomeye, n’agashururu, n’ikirura, n’imbeya z’umuriro utongora.
Maz’ ingabo z’amahanga yose arwanya Ariyeli, abaharwananya n’igihome caho bose bakahagora, bazoba nk’inzozi, nk’ivyo umuntu yeretswe mw ijoro nko mu nzozi.

Nuko bizomera nk’umuntu ashonje arota arikw ararya: ngo yikangure agasanga inda iri gusa; canke nk’ūfise inyota arota arikw aranywa: ngo yikangure agasanga akabiranye, agatuwe n’inyota. Uko ni kw ingabo z’amahanga yose arwanya umusozi Siyoni zizomera.
Banza muhagarare, mujorerwe; mwihume amaso, muhume; muborerwe mutanyoye vino; mudandabagirane, bitavuye ku biboreza.
Kuk’ Uhoraho abasutsekw impwemu y’uruhuni, agahuma amaso yanyu, ni yo bavugishwa banyu, agapfuka n’imitwe yanyu, ni yo bamenyi banyu.
Ukwerekwa kwose kwabahindukiye nk’ amajambo yo mu gitabo kimatanishijwe ishashara, iyo bagihaye umuntu azi gusoma, bat’ Enda se soma iki: akabishura, ati Sinshobora, kuko kimatanijwe;
maze bagaha ico gitabo ūtazi gusoma, bat’ Enda se soma iki: akabishura, ati Ko ntazi gusoma.

Umwami Imana aravuga, at’ Aba bantu ko bahora baza hafi yanje, bazanye akanwa kabo gusa, bakanyubahisha iminwa yabo, arikw imitima yabo bakayishira kure yanje, n’ukunyubaha kwabo kukaba ar’ icagezwe bigishijwe n’abantu.
Nuko rero ngira nkore igikorwa c’igitangaza mur’ aba bantu, mbere n’igikorwa gitangaje c’akumiza: ubgenge bg’abanyabgenge babo buzoherengetera, n’ ubuhanga bg’abahanga babo buzokamangana.
Bazobona ibara, abarondera kuzika inama zabo i kuzimu ngo bazihishe Uhoraho, ibikorwa vyabo bikaba mu mwiza, bakavuga, bati Ni nde atubona? kandi bati Ni nde atuzi?
Ewe bupfu buri hano! Mbeg’ umubumvyi mumuhwanya n’ibumba, ngw ikintu cabumbge gihakane uwakibumvye, kiti Ntiyambumvye; cank’ ikintu caremwe kigahakana uwakiremye, kiti Nta bgenge agira?
Mbega ntihasigaye akanya gato cane, Lebanoni hagacika itongo rimera cane, kand’ itongo ryamera cane rikitwa ishamba?
Kur’ uwo musi ibipfamatwi bizokwumva amajambo yo mu gitabo, n’amaso y’impumyi azoca umwiza n’umuzitanya abone.
Kand’ abaciye bugufi na bo bazogwiza umunezero banezererwa Uhoraho, n’abakene bo mu bantu bazohimbarwa n’Uwera w’Abisirayeli.
Kuk’ umuntu w’agaterabgoba atituwe, n’umucokoranyi aheze, kand’ abatambira kugabitanya bose barahonnye,
ni bo bacumuza umuntu mw ijambo, bagatega umutego ūhanūrira mw ishikiro ry’igisagara, bakazibiranya umugororotsi n’amagambo y’ubusa.
None rer’ Uhoraho, ari we yacunguye Aburahamu, uku ni kw avuze ku vy’inzu ya Yakobo, ati Yakobo ntazokwongera gutētērwa, kandi mu maso hiwe ntihazosubira kubgerabgera.

Arik’ ubgiwe n’abana biwe ni babona ivyo amaboko yanje akorera hagati muri bo, bazokwemera izina ryanje ko ryera; mbere bazokwemera Uwera wa Yakobo ko nera, bahindire agashitsi jewe Imana y’ Abisirayeli.
Kandi n’abazimira mu mitima bazoca ubgenge, n’abidodomba bazokwemera kwigishwa.
Abana b’ibigāba bazobona ibara, ni k’Uhoraho agize, bagīsha inama abandi atari jewe, bakifatanya n’abandi atari Mpwemu wanje, kugira ngo bagereke icaha ku kindi;
bakava hasi ngo bamanuke muri Egiputa batabajije irivuye mu kanwa kanje; ngo bisunge inkomezi za Farawo, bironkere ubgugamo mu gitūtu ca Egiputa!
Nuko rero za nkomezi za Farawo zizobatētereza, na bga bgugamo bgo mu gitūtu ca Egiputa buzobambika ibara.
Kukw abaganwa biwe bar’ i Sowani, n’intumwa ziwe zishitse i Hanesi.
Bose bazomāramāra kuko bazosanga ar’ abantu batabasha kubagirira ikimazi, batazobatabara, ata kimazi bafise, atar’ ukubatētereza no kubatukisha.

Imbūri yo ku bikōko vy’i bumanuko. Baca mu gihugu c’ amagorwa n’umubabaro, ah’ intambge y’ingore n’iy’ ingabo zituruka, hakaba n’imamba n’inzoka z’ubumara buturira ziguruka, baremētse indogoba z’imikangara ivy’ ubutunzi bgabo, bashize n’ivy’ itunga ryabo ku mapfupfu y’ ingamiya, kugira ngo baje kubishikanira abantu batazobagirira ikimazi.
Kuko gutabara kwa Egiputa ar’ ubusa, ata co kumaze: ni co gituma mpīta Rahabu yiyicariye gusa.
None rero genda, uvyandike ku gisate imbere yabo, uvyandike no mu gitabo, kugira ngo mu bihe bizoza bibabere igishingantahe c’intahava.
Kukw ar’ ubgoko bg’ibigāba, abana babesha, abana banka kwumva ivyagezwe vy’Uhoraho:
babarira abamenyi, bati Ntimutumenyere, bakabgira n’aberekwa ibizoba, bati Ntimutubarire ivyo mweretswe vy’ukuri, ariko mutubarire ivyoroshe, muvugishwe ivy’ ibinyoma;
muve mu nzira mukikame, mukūre Uwera w’ Abisirayeli imbere yacu.
Ni co gitumye Uwera w’Abisirayeli avuga, ati Ko mukēngereye iryo jambo, mukishimira agahahazo n’ ubugoryi, mukaba ari vyo mwishimikiza,
ni co gituma ukwo kugabitanya kuzobabera nk’uruzitiro rw’amabuye rurerure rwase umugāga, ruminaraye ruri mu gutemba; guhomvoka kwarwo kuzoba giturumbuka mu kanya isase.
Kand’ azorusāvya nk’ukw ikibumbano gisāba, iyo bakijanjanze ata kibabarwe; mu tunywenywe twaco ntihasigare n’akajo korahura umuriro mu ziko, canke kodaha utuzi mw ivomo.
Umwami Uhoraho, Uwera w’Abisirayeli, uku ni ko yari yaravuze, ati Mu guhindukira no mu gutēkāna ni ho muzokirira; mu gutekereza no mu vyizigiro ni ho muzoherwa inkomezi; ariko mwebge ntimwabikunze.
Yamara mwaravuze, mut’ Oya, ariko tuzoguruka ku mafarasi; kandi koko muzoba muhunga; kandi muti Tuzogendera ku y’impayamaguru; ni koko n’abazoba babirukana babakinagiza bazoba ar’ impayamaguru nyene.

Abantu igihumbi bazokwirukanwa n’akāyaga k’umuntu umwe; akāyaga ka batanu kazotuma muhunga: gushitsa aho muzosigara mumeze nk’igiti kirekire gishinze ku mpinga y’umusozi, canke nk’ibendera ishinze ku gasozi.
Ni kubg’ ivyo Uhoraho ashamaje kugira ngw abagirire ubuntu, kandi ni kubg’ ivyo azohaguruka kugira ngw abagirire ikigongwe, kuk’ Uhoraho ar’ Imana ica izibereye; hahirwa abashamaje bamwiteze bose.
Yemwe bantu b’i Siyoni, ababa i Yerusalemu: ntimuzoba mukirira ukundi; ntazobura kubagirira ubuntu ni yumva ijwi ry’ugutakamba kwanyu; acumva azobishura.
Kandi nah’ Umwami Imana azobagaburira ivyo kurya vy’amagorwa n’amazi y’amarushwa, arikw abigisha banyu ntibazoba bacihisha ukundi: amaso yanyu azobībonera;
kandi ni mwakikamira i buryo cank’ i bumoso, amatwi yanyu azokwumva ijambo ribaturutse inyuma rivuga, rit’ Iyi ni yo nzira, mube ari yo mujana.

Kandi muzotitura ifeza yometse ku bishushanyo vyanyu vy’ibibāzano, n’izahabu yometse ku bishushanyo vyanyu vyavugutiwe mu nkero; muzobishibura rwose nk’ikintu gihumanye, mubibarire, muti Vaho, mugende!
Kand’ azorekurira imvura imbuto muzobiba mu ndimiro, kand’ imihure ivuye mu ndimiro izoba inovereye yo gutunga amagara: ico gihe imikuku yanyu izorisha ivyanya binini.
Inka n’indogoba z’imikangara zirima zizorya ivyo kurya birimw’ umunyu, bigosojwe urutaro n’igitemere.
Ku gisozi cose gishizwe hejuru no ku musozi wose muremure hazoba amasōko n’imigezi y’amazi, ku musi wo gutōtōra abantu rwose, ah’ iminara izosidukira.

Kand’ umuco w’ukwezi uzomera nk’uw’ izuba, kand’ umuco w’izuba uzokwongerekanywa ibihetangabo ndwi, ungane n’umuco wo mu misi ndwi, ku musi Uhoraho azopfuka ibikomere vy’abantu biwe, akavūra n’inguma yabakubise.
Eh’ izina ry’Uhoraho riraza rivuye kure, rirurumbamw’ uburake bgiwe, ripfundukamw’ umwotsi w’intunda: iminwa yiwe yuzuye ubushangashirwe, kand’ ururimi rwiwe rumeze nk’umuriro utongora:
impwemu ziwe zimeze nk’umugezi ushēshe ugashika no mw izosi, ngo zigosoze amahanga urutaro rumara umuguruka: kand’ umujiginya uzimiza uzoba mu binyigishi vy’ amahanga.
Nuko muzogira indirimbo nk’iyo baririmba mw ijoro ku musi mukuru wera; muzogira n’umunezero wo mu mutima nk’uw’ umuntu afise umwironge aja ku musozi w’ Uhoraho, ngw ashikīre Igitandara c’Abisirayeli.

Kand’ Uhoraho azotuma ijwi ryiwe ry’icubahiro ryumvikana, azokwerekana ugukubita kw’ukuboko kwiwe mu bushangashirwe bg’uburake, no mu rubeya rw’umuriro utongora, no mu gusegenyuka kw’imvura n’ ikirura n’imināna y’urubura.
Kukw ijwi ry’Uhoraho rizotuma Abashuri bahababuka, abakubitishe urugāge rwiwe.
Kand’ ikibando bāgerewe uko kimashuye kwose, ico Uhoraho abamashuza, hazovuga udushako tw’ingoma n’ inanga; kand’ azorwana na bo mu ntambara adasībiza ukuboko.

Kukw ikirundo c’inkwi citeguwe uhereye kera, mbere citeguriwe umwami; Uhoraho yakigize kirekire kandi kinini; ibigikomanije n’umuriro n’ibigiga vyinshi; impwemu z’Uhoraho zimeze nk’ umugezi w’amazuku ni zo zibidometse.

Bazobona ibara, abamanuka baja muri Egiputa gutabaza, bakishimira amafarasi, bakizigira imikogote ikwegwa n’ amafarasi kukw ari myinshi, bo n’abagendera ku mafarasi kukw ar’ abanyenkomezi nyinshi, ariko ntibashire umutima ku Wera w’Abisirayeli, kandi ntibarondere Uhoraho.
Ariko rero na we azi ubgenge, azozana ivyago kandi ntazokwivuguruza, arikw azohagurukira inzu y’inkozi z’ibibi, bo n’abatabara abakora ivy’ ukugabitanya.

Yamara rero Abanyegiputa s’Imana, n’abantu buntu; n’amafarasi yabo s’impwemu, n’ ay’ umubiri gusa: maz’ Uhoraho ni yabāngura ukuboko kwiwe, ūtabaye azotsitara, kandi n’ūtabawe azotemba, bose bahindikirane hamwe.

Kuk’ ukw ari k’Uhoraho ambariye, ati Nk’ukw intambge, cank’ umugunza w’intambge igwangwarira ku co yishe, iy’ abungere benshi batabajwe kurwana na yo, ntikangwe n’amajwi yabo, kandi ntiteshwe n’urwamo rwabo, uko ni k’ Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo azomanurwa no kurwanira ku musozi Siyoni no ku mutumba waho.
Nk’ukw inyoni zizengerera hejuru y’ivyari vyazo, ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo azorinda Yerusalemu; azoharinda ahakize, azohaca hejuru aharokore.
Yemwe Bisirayeli, ni muhindukirire uwo mwagararije ruhebga.
Maze kur’ uwo musi umuntu wese azoshibura ibigirwamana vyiwe vy’ifeza, n’ibigirwamana vyiwe vy’izahabu, ivyo mwacurishije intoke zanyu kubabera icaha.
Ni ho Abashuri bazokwicwa n’inkota itar’ iy’ abantu, kand’ inkota itar’ iy’ abantu izobarya: bazohunga iyo nkota, kand’ imisore yabo izohinduka abagurano.
Igitandara cabo kizokūrwaho no gucika ivutu, kand’ abaganwa babo bazokwihebeshwa n’ibendera, ni k’Uhoraho agize, afise umuriro wiwe i Siyoni, akagira itanure ryiwe i Yerusalemu.
Rāba, umwami azoganza mu bugororotsi, n’abaganwa bazotwaza imanza ziroranye.
Kandi mur’ abo, uw’ ari we wese azoba nk’aho kwikinga umuyaga, n’ubgugamo bg’ikirura; azoba nk’ inzūzi z’amazi ahantu hagadutse, kandi nk’igitūtu c’igitandara kinini mu gihugu kiruhisha.
Amaso y’ababona ntazoba agihwihwisha, kand’ amatwi y’abumva azokwumviriza neza.
Umutima w’ūhutikiranya uzomenya ubgenge, n’ururimi rw’abagigimiza ruzotobora neza ibirashe.
Igipfapfa ntibazoba bakimwita umupfasoni, kand’ uwigungirako ntibazoba bakimwita umunyabuntu.
Kukw igipfapfa kivuga ivy’ ubupfu, umutima wiwe ugakora ivy’ ukugabitanya, ngw akore ibihumanya, avuge ibigoramye k’ Uhoraho, akarekerana ūshonje inzara, n’ūfise inyota akamwima ico anywa.
Kand’ ibikoreshwa vy’uwigungirako ni bibi: agira akazikira k’ikibi ko kuzikiriza abagorwa n’amagambo y’ibinyoma, naho hoba umukene afise urubanza.
Arik’ umunyabuntu imigabo yiwe n’ukugira ubuntu, kand’ ukwo kugira ubuntu azogushishikara.
Yemwe bagore bidibamiye, ni muve hasi, mwumve ijwi ryanje; yemwe bakobga b’ibidage, ni mutegere amatwi amajambo yanje.
Muzomara imisi irenze umwaka muhagaritse imitima, yemwe mwa bidage mwe, kukw imyengo izobura, kandi nta kwimbura kuzobaho.
Hinda agashitsi, yemwe bagore bidibamiye; hagarika imitima, yemwe mwa bidage! Mwiyambure impuzu, mwīsige ubusa, mukenyere amagunira mu rukenyerero.
Bazokwishishitira bababajwe n’amatongo yabanezereza, n’imizabibu yaregeza.
Mu gihugu c’abantu banje hazomera amahwa n’imikēre; mbere bizomera no ku mazu yose banezererwamwo yo ku murwa w’umunezero;

kukw ingoro izohebga, umurwa bahora bayebanganako uzoba imisaka; umusozi n’umunara w’abateramyi bizohinduka amasenga gushitsa ibihe bidashira, bizoba aho guhimbara indogoba z’inyeshamba, hazoba ubgatsi bg’imikuku;
gushitsa aho Mpwemu azodusukirwako avuye hejuru, ubugaragwa bugacika itongo rimera cane, kand’ itongo ryamera cane rikitwa ishamba.
Maz’ ukuroranya kuzotsindaza mu bugaragwa, n’ubugororotsi buzoba mw itongo rimera cane.
Ubugororotsi buzovyara amahoro, kand’ ubugororotsi buzozana ugutekereza n’ivyizigiro gushitsa ibihe bidashira.
Kand’ abantu banje bazoba mu ngo z’amahoro, no mu mazu bahabe amarembe, no mu buruhukiro butagira inkomanzi.
Arik’ urubura ruzotsinda ikibira hasi, igisagara gisangangurwe rwose.
Murahiriwe, yemwe ababiba mu biyaya vy’ amazi yose, mukarekura inka n’ indogoba kugenda umwagambo.
Uzobona ibara, wewe unyaga kand’ utānyazwe, uryarukana kandi batākuryarutse! Ni waheza kunyaga, nawe uzonyagwa; kandi ni wamara kuryarukana, bazokuryaruka nawe.
Ewe Uhoraho, utugirire imbabazi; ni wewe twiteze; utubere amaboko uko bukeye, mber’ utubere agakiza mu gihe c’amagorwa.
Amoko ahungishijwe n’ijwi ryo guhūrīra; kubgo guhaguruka kwawe amahanga arasābagiye.
Bazovumbura iminyago mwanyaze nk’ukw inzige zivumbura, bazoyigwako nk’uk’ ubuyige bg’intōteza bugwa.
Uhoraho ashizwe hejuru nk’uko yibera iyo hejuru: yuzuza i Siyoni ibiroranye n’ubugororotsi.
Mu bihe vyawe hazobah’ umutēkāno, n’ agakiza k’umurengera, n’ubgenge no kumenya: kwubaha Uhoraho ni bgo butunzi bgawe.
Ehe, abahizi babo baraborogera hanze; intumwa zo gusaba impore ziriko zirarira cane.
Inzira z’iroro zirasivye, nta wuhita akiboneka; yishe isezerano, akēngēra ibisagara, kandi ntagira udusoni ku bantu.
Igihugu kiriganyira, kirahondobereye: Lebanoni haratēterewe, harakabiranye; Sharoni hameze nk’ ubugaragwa; Bashani na Karumeli hakoraguye amababi.
Uhoraho aravuga, ati Hinge mvyaguruke non’ ubu, non’ ubu ngira mpaguruke, non’ ubu ngira nishire hejuru.
Muzosama inda y’umuguruka, muvyare ishingwe; impwemu zanyu ni wo muriro uzobatongora.
Amahanga azoturirwa nk’uko baturira ishwagara; azomera nk’igiteme c’amahwa, kigaturirirwa mu muriro.
Yemwe abari kure, ni mwumve ivyo nkoze, namwe abari hafi, ni mwemere ubushobozi bganje.

Abanyavyaha b’i Siyoni baratinye; agatengo gafashe giturumbuka abatubaha Imana. Muri twebge ni nde yoshobora kubana n’umuriro utongora, kandi muri twebge ni nde yoshobora kubana n’ikibengebenge kidahengeshanya?

Ūgendera mu bugororotsi akavuga ibitunganye, akagaya inyungu ziva mu gahahazo, agahungisha amaboko ngo ntiyābīre ingurire, akīziba amatwi ngo ntiyumve inama yo kuvisha amaraso, agahumiriza amaso ngo ntarābe ibibi:
uwo ni we azoba ahataramutse hejuru, ahantu hiwe ho kwikinga hazoba igihome c’ amabuye; azohabga ivyo kurya bimutunga, kandi n’amazi ntazoyabura.
Amaso yawe azokwitegereza umwami afise ubgiza bgiwe: azorāba igihugu kigera kure.
Umutima wawe uzokwibuka ivyatera ubgoba; ukībaza, ut’ Uwaca ibitigiri vy’ ingorore ari hehe? Uwazākīra akarāba ko zishitse ari hehe? Uwaharūra iminara ari hehe?
Ntuzoba ukibona ihanga ry’ inkazi, ihanga ry’imvugo igoye udashobora kwumva, riri n’ururimi rw’urunyamahanga udashobora gutahura.

Ni witegereze i Siyoni, umurwa twagiriramw’ imisi mikuru yacu: amaso yawe azobona i Yerusalemu hasigaye hatsimbataye har’ amahoro, ar’ ihema ritazokūrwaho, imambo zaryo ata ho zizoshingūrwa, ata n’ umugozi waryo uzocika.
Arik’ Uhoraho azohabana natwe afise icubahiro, azotubera inzūzi zagutse n’imigezi, ah’ ata bgato buzosozwa, ata n’imasuba ihambaye izohaca.
Kuk’ Uhoraho ari we mucamanza wacu; Uhoraho ni we adushingira ivyagezwe; Uhoraho ni we Mwami wacu: azodukiza.
Imigozi yawe iradohotse, ntigishobora gukamvya epfo y’ umuringoti, ntigishobora kubamba igihuzu kigendesha ubgato: ico gihe bazogabangana isahu ry’ibitayega, mbere n’abacumbagira bazosahura isahu.
Kand’ uwaho ntazovuga, ati Ndarwaye: abantu bahaba bazoba bahariwe ukugabitanya kwabo.
Mwa mahanga, ni mwīgire hafi kugira ngo mwumve; mutege amatwi mwa moko mwe; isi ni yumve, bo n’ibiyuzuye; n’ivu n’ibirimeramwo.
Kuk’ Uhoraho ashangashiriwe amahanga yose, akaba arakiye ingabo zayo zose, arabagesheje rwose, arabagabuye ngo bicwe.
Abishwe babo bazoshiburirwa hirya, umunuko w’imivyimba yabo uzoduhuka, imisozi izojegeshwa n’ ibitenga vy’amaraso yabo.

Ingabo z’inyenyeri zo kw ijuru zose zizokamangana, kand’ amajuru azozingirwa hamwe nk’umuzingo w’igitabo, n’izo ngabo zayo zose zizokabirana, nk’ukw akaragarira kava ku muzabibu, kandi nk’ ukw akaragarira kava ku musukoni.
Kukw inkota yanje inyoye mw ijuru igahāga; non’ igira igwe ku Banyedomu, no ku bantu navumye, ngw ibahane.

Inkota y’Uhoraho yuzuyekw amaraso, ihāze ibinure, amaraso y’imyagazi y’intama n’impene, n’ibinure vyo ku mafyigo y’amasuguru y’intama; kuk’ Uhoraho yifitiye ikimazi i Bosira, n’ukugeseza gukomeye mu gihugu ca Edomu.
Imbogo zizogwa hamwe na vyo, amashūri hamwe n’amapfizi; igihugu cabo kizoborerwa amaraso, n’ivu ry’i wabo rizohāga ibinure.
Kuk’ uwo musi ari wo wo guhōra kw’ Uhoraho, n’umwaka wo kubasubiriza mu nkōko ku vyo bāgiriye Siyoni.
Imigezi yaho izohinduka kaburimbi, n’ivu ryaho rizohinduka amazuku; kand’ igihugu caho kizohinduka kaburimbi yaka.
Ntikizozimwa ku murango no mw ijoro, umwotsi waco uzopfunduka ibihe bidashira; kizohora ar’ amatongo uk’ urunganwe rwabo ruzogenda rukurikirana: kandi nta wuzogicamwo gushitsa ibihe bitazoshira.
Arikw inkongori n’ibinyogoto ni vyo bizocegukira, ibihuna n’ibikona na vyo bizokibamwo; azohageresha umugozi, ni wo bitongozi, na karisho, ni ko gusigara ubusa.
Bazohamagara abashingantahe b’ico gihugu ngo bimike umwami, ariko nta bazoba bariho; kand’ abaganwa baho bose bazoba bacitse ubusa.
Ingoro zaho zizomeramw’ amahwa, n’ibihome vyaho bizomeramw’ ibisuru n’ibitovu; hazoba ubgishinzo bg’ imbgebge n’inama y’ibisīga vyitwa imbuni.
Ibikōko vyo mu bugaragwa bizohūrirayo n’amabingira, n’igisigo c’impfizi y’impene kizohamagarana na mugenzi waco, mbere n’ikinyejoro kizohagerēra, kihibonere uburuhukiro.
Ni ho imvuvyi izokwigirira umwimba, ihatere amagi, ihamenagurire, ikumakumire musi y’igitūtu cayo: mber’ aho ni ho ibinyakabaka bizokoranira, ikigore cose kiri kumwe n’ikigabo caco.
Ni murondere mu gitabo c’Uhoraho musome: nta na kimwe co mur’ ivyo kizobura, nta kigore kizobura ikigabo caco, kukw akanwa kiwe ari ko kabigeze, kand’ impwemu ziwe akaba ari zo zibikoranije.
Yabipfindiye ubupfindo, kand’ ukuboko kwiwe ni kwo kwahabigaburiye n’umugozi; bizohegukira gushitsa ibihe vyose, bihabe ukw ibihe bihaye ibindi.
Ahagadutse n’ubgeranyange hazonezerwa, ubugaragwa buzohimbarwa, bushurike amashurwe nk’aya habaseleti.
Buzoshurika amashurwe menshi, buhimbaranwe umunezero n’indirimbo; buzohabga ubgiza bg’i Lebanoni, n’ugushaza kw’i Karumeli n’i Sharoni: bazobona ubgiza bg’Uhoraho, ugushaza kw’ Imana yacu.
Mukomeze amaboko areganutse, mugumishe amavi aregarega.
Mubgire abahagaritse imitima, muti Rema, nta co mutinya: rāba, Imana yanyu izozanana n’uguhōra, ni kwo kwitura kw’Imana; izoza ibakize.
Ni ho impumyi zizohumūka, n’ibipfamatwi bizozibūrwa.
Ico gihe ūcumbagira azosimba nk’ impongo, ururimi rw’ikiragi ruririmbe: kukw amazi azodudubiriza ahagadutse, imigezi itembere mu bugaragwa.
Kand’ umusenyi uhiye uburimbi uzohinduka ibidengeri, n’ahagataye hazocika amasōko: mu bgishinzo bg’imbgebge, aho zāgandagaza, hazemera ivyatsi n’amarenga n’ imibere.
Kandi hazobay’ inzira y’iroro, iyo nzira izokwitwa Inzira Yera. Abanduye imitima ntibazoyicamwo, arikw izoba iy’ abantu biwe. Abayicamwo, naho hobamw’ ibijuju, ntibazozimira.
Nta ntambge izohaba, nta gikōko na kimwe c’inkazi kizoyigeramwo, ntibizoyibonekamwo: arikw abācunguwe ni bo bazoyicamwo.
Abācunguwe n’ Uhoraho bazogaruka, bashike i Siyoni baririmba; umunezero udashira uzoba ku mitwe yabo: bazobona uguhimbarwa bo n’ umunezero, kand’ umubabaro n’ ugusuhuza umutima bizohunga.
Mu mwaka ugira icumi na kane umwami Hezekiya ari ku ngoma, Senakeribu umwami w’i Ashuri yaradūze, atera ibisagara vyose vyubakiwe inzitiro vy’i Buyuda, arabitsinda.

Bukeye umwami w’i Ashuri atuma Rabushake ava i Lakishi ajanye ingabo nyinshi, aja i Yerusalemu, ku mwami Hezekiya. Ashitseyo ahagarara ku mugende wo ku kidengeri co haruguru, ku nzira yo ku kibuga c’umumesuzi.
Maz’ umuzezwarugo Eliyakimu mwene Hilukiya, n’umukarani Shebuna, n’umwanditsi w’ivyaja biraba yitwa Yowa mwene Asafu, barenga irembo baramusanganira.
Rabushake arababarira, ati Ni mubarire Hezekiya, mut’ Uku ni k’umwami ahambaye, ni we mwami w’i Ashuri, agize: ngo Mbeg’ ivyo vyizigiro wizigiye n’ibiki?
Ngw Inama yawe n’ inkomezi zo kurwana, erega n’ amajambo y’impfagusa. Ngo Mbeg’ uwo wishimiye ni nde, yatumye umugarariza?
Ngw Erega wishimiye ya nkoni y’ irenga rivunitse, ni ryo Egiputa, umuntu yoryishimikiza ryomutobekeranya ikiganza. Ng’ Uko ni ko Farawo umwami wa Egiputa amerera abamwishimiye bose.
Naho mwomubarira ko mwishimiye Uhoraho Imana yanyu: none si yo Hezekiya yakūyeh’ ibitabo vyayo n’ibicaniro vyayo, akabarira Abayuda n’ab’ i Yerusalemu, ati Muze musengere imbere y’iki gicaniro?
Muti None rero, enda shinga na shebuja umwami w’i Ashuri, muti Na we Rabushake araguha amafarasi ibihumbi bibiri, namba nawe ubgawe woshobora kuronka abo uyūriza.

Muti None se woshobora ute gukora mu maso y’umugabisha n’umwe wo mu basavyi ba shebuja bo hanyuma y’abandi, mut’ Asangw’ ar’ ukwishimira Abanyegiputa kw ari bo bazoguha imikogote ikwegwa n’ amafarasi n’abo kuyagenderako?
Muti Mbega yadūze gutera iki gihugu no kukirandura, atari kubg’ Uhoraho? Mut’ Ereg’ Uhoraho ni we nyene yamubariye, ati Dūga utere ico gihugu, ukirandure.

Maze Eliyakimu na Shebuna na Yowa bishura Rabushake, bat’ Enda se turakwinginze, utubarire mu Gisiriya, kuko tucumva; ariko nta co utubaririra mu Kiyuda mu matwi y’aba bantu bari hejuru ku ruzitiro rw’amabuye.

Ariko Rabushake arabishura, ati Mbega mugira ngo databuja yantumye kuri shobuja namwe gusa kubabgira aya majambo? Ntiyantumye kur’ aba bagabo bicaranye namwe hejuru ku ruzitiro, kugira ngo barīre amavyi yabo hamwe n’ayo basōvye?
Maze Rabushake arahagarara, avuga n’ijwi rirenga mu rurimi rw’Ikiyuda, ati Ni mwumve amajambo y’umwami ahambaye, ni we mwami w’i Ashuri.
Uku ni k’umwami agize, ngo Hezekiya ntabahende; ngo Kukw atazoshobora kubakiza.
Ngo Kandi Hezekiya ntabizigize Uhoraho, ababarira, ng’ Uhoraho ntazobura kubakiza, kandi ng’ Uyu murwa ntuzotangwa ng’ukorokere mu maboko y’umwami w’i Ashuri.

Ntimwumvire Hezekiya: kuk’ ukw ari k’umwami w’i Ashuri agize, ngo Kunda mwuzure na we, musokoroke muje iy’ ari, umuntu wese ngw abone kurya ku muzabibu wiwe no ku musukoni wiwe, no kunywa ku mazi yo mw ivomo ryiwe,
ngo Gushitsa igihe azozira akabajana mu gihugu gihwanye n’icanyu, igihugu c’ingano na vino, igihugu c’indya n’inzabibu.
Ngo Mwiyubare, Hezekiya ntabahende, avuga ng’ Uhoraho azobakiza. Mbega mu mana z’ abanyamahanga hari n’imwe yigeze gukiza igihugu cayo ngo ntigikorokere mu maboko y’umwami w’i Ashuri?
Ngo Mbeg’ imana z’i Hamati n’izo muri Arupadi ziri hehe? Imana z’i Sefaravayimu ziri hehe? Ngo Mbega zarakijije Samariya ngo ntihakorokere mu maboko yiwe?
Ngo N’izihe mu mana zose zo mur’ ivyo bihugu zākijije igihugu cazo ngo ntigikorokere mu maboko yiwe, ng’ Uhoraho na we akize Yerusalemu ngo ntihakorokere mu maboko yiwe?
Maze barihorera, ntibamwishura ijambo na rimwe, kukw ijambo ry’umwami ryari ryavuze, ngo Ntimugire ico mumwishura.

Hanyuma wa muzezwarugo Eliyakimu mwene Hilukiya, n’ umukarani Shebuna, n’umwanditsi w’ivyaja biraba yitwa Yowa mwene Asafu, baza kuri Hezekiya bitantamuriyekw impuzu zabo, bamudondera amagambo ya Rabushake.
Maz’ umwami Hezekiya avyumvise, yitantamurirakw impuzu ziwe, yambara amagunira, yinjira mu ngoro y’Uhoraho.
Maz’ atuma Eliyakimu umuzezwarugo, na Shebuna umukarani, n’abakuru bo mu baherezi, bambaye amagunira, k’ūvugishwa n’Imana Yesaya mwene Amosi.
Baramubgira, bati Hezekiya aradutumye, ng’ Uyu musi n’umusi w’umubabaro n’ibihano n’ugushinyagurirwa, ngo Kukw abana bagomba kuvuka, kandi nta nkomezi zo kubavyara.

Ngo Kumbure Uhoraho Imana yawe yokwumva amagambo ya Rabushake, ayo shebuja umwami w’i Ashuri yamutumye gutuka Imana nzima, Uhoraho Imana yawe akamuhana kubg’ ayo magambo yumvise. Ngo Nuko rero, shirak’ usenge, usabire amasigarira agisigaye.
Nukw abantu b’umwami Hezekiya bashika kuri Yesaya.
Yesaya arababgira, at’ Uku abe ari ko mubgira shobuja, mut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ngo Ntutinye ayo magambo wumvise, abo baja b’umwami w’i Ashuri bamurogoseko.
Ngo Rāba, azomushiramw’ uwundi mutima, kand’ azokwumva impuha zitume asubira mu gihugu ciwe; kandi ngw Azomwicishiriza inkota mur’ ico gihugu ciwe nyene.
Nuko Rabushake asubira inyuma, asanga umwami w’i Ashuri ateye i Libuna; ajayo kuko yari yumvise ko yavuye i Lakishi.
Bukeye umwami w’i Ashuri yumva bavuga Tiruhaka umwami w’i Etiyopiya, bat’ Araje kugutera. Avyumvise, atuma intumwa kuri Hezekiya,
mut’ Uku abe ari ko muzobgira Hezekiya umwami w’i Buyuda, mut’ Iyo Mana wishimiye ntiz’ iguhende, ngw I Yerusalemu ntihazotangwa mu maboko y’umwami w’i Ashuri.
Muti Mbega ntiwumvise ukw abami b’i Ashuri bāgiriye ibihugu vyose, bakabirandura rwose? muti None wewe uzokira?
Muti Mbeg’ imana z’amahanga, ayo ba sekuru bāranduye, zarakijije ab’ i Gozani n’i Harani n’i Resefu n’Abanyedeni baba i Telasari?
Mut’ Umwami w’i Hamati ari hehe, cank’ umwami w’i Arupadi, n’umwami w’umurwa w’i Sefaravayimu, n’uw’ i Hena n’uw’ i Iva?
Bukeye Hezekiya ashikirizwa ico cete n’izo ntumwa, aragisoma; maz’ aradūga, aja mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho, arakigaranzura, agishira imbere y’Uhoraho.
Nuko Hezekiya asenga Uhoraho,
at’ Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, Mana y’Abisirayeli, uvyagiye ku bakerubi, ni wewe Mana wenyene y’ibihugu vy’abami bose bo mw isi, ni wewe waremye ijuru n’isi.
Tega ugutwi Uhoraho, wumve; tereza inyonga zawe, Uhoraho, witegereze; wumve amagambo yose ya Senakeribu yatumye ino kugutuka wewe Mana nzima.
Uhoraho, n’ivy’ ukuri abami b’i Ashuri bārahoneje ayo mahanga yose n’ibihugu vyayo,
bātereye imana zabo mu muriro; ariko ntizar’ imana nya mana, zar’ izakozwe n’intoke z’abantu mu biti no mu mabuye; ni co catumye bazihonnya.
Nuko none, Uhoraho Mana yacu, udukize, udukūre mu maboko yiwe, kugira ngw ibihugu vy’abami bose bo mw isi bamenye kw ari wewe Uhoraho wenyene.
Maze Yesaya mwene Amosi atuma kuri Hezekiya, ut’ Uku ni k’ Uhoraho, Imana y’Abisirayeli, agize, ngw Ivyo wamutakambiye ku vya Senakeribu umwami w’i Ashuri, yavyumvise.
Ut’ Iri ni ryo jambo Uhoraho yamuvuzeko, at’ Umukobga w’inkumi w’i Siyoni aragukēngereye, agutwengeye mw ijigo; umukobga w’i Yerusalemu akuzungurije umutwe.
Uwo watonganije ukamurogotako ni nde? Ni nde wirahiye akararamango ukamurābana agakēngērwe? Erega ni jewe Uwera w’Abisirayeli.

Watumye abantu bawe kuntuka, jewe Umwami Imana, uravuga, ng’ Udūganye igitero cinshi c’imikogote yawe y’intambara, ushitse mu mpinga z’imisozi, no mu dushōka tw’i Lebanoni; ngo Wiciye ibiti vy’amasederi vyaho birebire, n’ivy’ akajwari vyaho vyiza‐vyiza; ngo Wahanyuragiye ushika ku mpinga yaho hirya cane, no mu biti vyo mw itongo ryaho rimera cane.
Ngo Wimvye amazi urayanywa; wakamishije inzūzi zo muri Egiputa ubgōro bg’ ibirenge vyawe.
Mbega ntiwumvise uko nabigenjeje kera, mbigabiye mu bihe vyashize? None narabishikije, kugira ng’ uhonnye ibisagara vyubakiwe inzitiro, ubihindure ibirundo vy’amasakamburira.
Ni co catumye abābibamwo baba imburamaboko, bagacika ivutu, bakamāramāra; bagacika nk’ubgatsi bgo ku gahinga, nk’ubgatsi bg’urumerera, nk’ivyatsi vyimejeje ku nzu, nk’ingano zirumvye zikir’ ibironge.
Ariko ndazi imyicarire yawe, n’ amaja n’amaza yawe, n’ingene wanshangashiriwe.
None rero kubg’ ubushangashirwe wangiriye, n’uko numvise ivy’ agashamango kawe, nzogutūngīra umurinda wanje mu mazuru, n’umujiginya wanje mu kanwa, ngusubize mu nzira wazananye.

Ut’ Ariko weho Hezekiya, iki ni co kizokubera ikimenyamenya: uyu mwaka muzorya ivyimejeje ubgavyo, mu mwaka ugira kabiri muzorya utunagano twavyo, mu mwaka ugira gatatu muze mubibe, mwimbure, mutere inzabibu, muziryeko.
Kand’ amasigarira arokotse yo mu nzu ya Yuda bazokwongera gushōra imizi hasi, ahahera hejuru bahūrike ivyamye.
Kuko muri Yerusalemu hazosokoroka amasigarira, no ku musozi Siyoni have abārokotse: ishaka ry’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo rizoshitsa ivyo.

Uti Ni co gitumye Uhoraho avuga ivy’ umwami w’i Ashuri, ati Ntazoruha agera mur’ iki gisagara, canke ngw aharase n’umwampi, canke ngw ahatumbereze n’inkinzo, canke ngw aharunde ikirundo co kwūririrako.
Ut’ Inzira yazananye ni yo nyene izomusubizayo; ntazoruha agera mur’ iki gisagara, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Ut’ Arik’ Uhoraho ngw Azozigama uyu murwa kugira ngw awukize, abikoze kubgiwe no kubg’ umusavyi wiwe Dawidi.
Maz’ umumarayika w’Uhoraho arasohoka, atera mu nsago z’Abashuri, yicamw’ ingabo ibihumbi ijana na mirongumunani na bitanu: abantu bavyutse mu gatondo basanga ingabo zose ar’ imihindigiti y’imivyimba.
Nuko Senakeribu umwami w’i Ashuri aca arataha, asubira inyuma, aja kuba i Ninewe.

Umusi ur’ izina, arikw arasenga mu ngoro y’ikigirwamana ciwe citwa Nisiroki, Adurameleki na Sharezeri abana biwe bamwicisha inkota; baca bahungira mu gihugu c’i Ararati. Maz’ umuhungu wiwe Esarihadoni asubira ku ngoma yiwe.

Mur’ iyo misi Hezekiya ararwara agera hafi yo gupfa. Bukeye ūvugishwa n’Imana Yesaya mwene Amosi aza kuri we, aramubgira, at’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ngo Tunganya ivyo mu rugo rwawe, kuk’ ugira upfe, utagikira.
Maze Hezekiya ahindukiriza amaso ku rusika, asenga Uhoraho,
ati Tegēra, Uhoraho we, ni wibuke ingene nagendera mu vy’ukuri imbere yawe n’umutima utunganye, ngakora ivyo ubona kw ari vyiza. Hezekiya ararira cane.
Maz’ ijambo ry’Uhoraho rishika kuri Yesaya,
riti Genda ubarire Hezekiya, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho, Imana ya sogokuruza Dawidi, agize: uti Ngo yumvise ugusenga kwawe, abonye n’amosozi yawe; ut’ Ehe ku misi yawe yongeyekw imyaka cumi n’itanu.
Uti Kand’ azokurokorana n’iki gisagara, agukūre mu maboko y’ umwami w’i Ashuri; uti Kand’ azozigama iki gisagara.
Ut’ Iki ni co kimenyamenya aguhaye, cemeza yukw azoshitsa ico avuze:
eh’ agira ngw ahēre ah’ igitūtu kigeze ku ntambuko z’urugero rwashinzwe na Ahazi, agisubizanyeyo n’izuba intambuko cumi. Nukw izuba rigaruka intambuko cumi riva aho ryari rigeze kuri za ntambuko.
Ibi ni vyo Hezekiya umwami w’Abayuda yanditse, amaze gukira indwara yiwe yari yararwaye.
Naravuze, nti Ndakenyutse, ngiye guca mu marembo y’i kuzimu: Natswe imyaka yanje yar’ igisigaye.
Ndavuga, nti Sinzobona Uhoraho, Uhoraho mu gihugu c’abariho: Sinzokwongera kubona umuntu n’umwe wo mu baba mw isi.
Inzu yanje ikūweho, imvanyweko nk’ukw ihema ry’ umwungere ritaragama. Ubugingo bganje ndabuzinze nk’uk’ ūjisha azinga; agira ancācūre ku mambo: Umusi ugeze kwīra azoba amaze kumpeza.
Nariyumanganije nshitsa mu gatondo; arikw avunagura amagufa yanje yose nk’ ukw intambge igira: Umusi ugeze kwīra azoba amaze kumpeza.
Ndanihīra nk’intamba ijwigira, canke nk’inyanana yānāga, Nkaniha nk’inuma iguguza; amaso yanje yaheze hejuru; Uhoraho, ndegeranijwe: nyishinga.
Novuga ikindi ki kandi? Ni we yavuganye nanje, kandi ni we nyene yabikoze. Nuko nzogenda niyoroheje mu myaka yanje yose, nibuka umubabaro war’ umeze nk’umururazi mu mutima wanje.
Mwami, ivyo ni vyo bibeshah’ abantu, Kandi mur’ ivyo vyonyene ni ho umutima wanje ubonera ubugingo. Nuko nkiza, umbesheho.

Ereg’ icatumye ngira umubabaro w’umururazi mwinshi kwar’ ukugira ngo ndonke amahoro; Kand’ urukundo wakunze ubugingo bganje rwātumye ubukiza urwobo rw’ iborero, Kukw ivyaha vyanje vyose wabirengeje inyuma yawe.
Kukw i kuzimu hadashobora kuguhimbaza, n’urupfu ntirushobora kugutazira, Kand’ abamanuka baja muri rwa rwobo ntibashobora kwishimira ukuri kwawe.
Umuntu muzima, umuntu muzima ni we azoguhimbaza, nk’uko ndiko ndaguhimbaza uyu musi. Umuvyeyi azomenyesha abana biwe ingen’ ur’ uwo kwizigirwa.
Uhoraho, nkiza, Ni co kizotuma turirimba indirimbo zanje tuvugira inanga Turi mu ngoro y’Uhoraho imisi yose y’ukubaho kwacu.
Kandi Yesaya yari yaravuze, ati Ni bābīre intore ibumbabumbge mu nsukoni, bayomeke ku kivyimba, kand’ azokira.
Kandi na Hezekiya yari yarabajije, at’ Ikimenyamenya kizoba iki, cerekana ko nzodūga nkaja mu ngoro y’Uhoraho?
Ico gihe Merodaki‐Baladani mwene Baladani umwami w’i Babuloni arungikira Hezekiya ivyete n’ingemurano, kuko yari yumvise ko yarwaye agakira.

Maz’ abātumwe Hezekiya abākīra neza, abereka mu nzu ah’ abīka ibintu vyiwe vy’igiciro, amafeza n’amazahabu n’imibavu n’amavuta y’igiciro kinini, no mu nzu hose ah’ abīka ivyo kurwanisha, n’ikintu cose co mu vyo atunze cariho. Nta kintu na kimwe co mu ngoro yiwe canke co mu gihugu ciwe cose Hezekiya atāberetse.
Bukeye haza uwavugishwa n’Imana Yesaya ku mwami Hezekiya, aramubaza, at’ Abo bantu bavuze iki? Kandi baje i wawe bavuye hehe? Hezekiya aramwishura, ati Baje bavuye mu gihugu ca kure i Babuloni.
Arongera aramubaza, ati Babonye ibiki mu ngoro yawe? Hezekiya aramwishura, at’ Ibiri mu ngoro yanje vyose bābibonye: nta kintu na kimwe co mu vyo ntunze ntāberetse.
Maze Yesaya abarira Hezekiya, ati Ni wumve ijambo ry’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo.
Eh’ imisi izoza, ibiri mu ngoro yawe vyose, n’ivyo ba sogokuruza bābītse bigashitsa n’ubu, bizosahurwa bijanwe i Babuloni; nta kintu na kimwe kizosigara, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Kand’ abahungu bawe uzoba wīkūriye mu nda wavyaye bazobajana, bagirwe inkone zo kuba mu ngoro y’umwami w’i Babuloni.
Maze Hezekiya yishura Yesaya, at’ Ijambo ry’Uhoraho uvuze ni ryiza. Yongera kuvuga, ati Kazima hagiye kuba amahoro n’umutēkāno nkiriho.
Ni muhūmurize abantu banje, ni mubahūmurize, ni kw Imana yanyu igize.
Muremēshe imitima y’ab’i Yerusalemu, mubabgire musemerera yukw intambara zaho zabangurukanye, k’ umwenda w’igicumuro cabo ushize, kukw ivyaha vyabo vyose babihaniwe kabiri n’ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho.
Ijwi ry’ūsemerera, ati Ni mutegure inzira y’Uhoraho mu bugaragwa, musenere Imana yacu inzira y’iroro mu bgeranyange.
Umwonga wose uzokwuzuzwa, n’umusozi wose n’akarambi bizoringanizwa; ahār’ udutumba hazotega, uduhogoro ducike ikiyaya.
Maz’ ubgiza bg’Uhoraho buzohishurwa, kand’ abafise umubiri bose bazobubonera rimwe, kukw akanwa k’Uhoraho ari ko kabivuze.
Ijwi ry’ūvuga, ati Semerera. Uwundi ati Nsemerere iki? Ut’ Abafise umubiri bose n’ivyatsi gusa, n’ubgiza bgabo bgose bumeze nk’amashurwe yo ku musozi:
ivyatsi birūma, amashurwe agakabirana, kukw impwemu z’Uhoraho zībihūhako: n’ukuri abantu n’ivyatsi gusa.
Ivyatsi birūma, amashurwe agakabirana, arikw ijambo ry’Imana yacu rizohorah’ ibihe bidashira.
Yewe ubarira Siyoni ubutumwa bgiza, dūga umusozi muremure; yewe ubarira Yerusalemu ubutumwa bgiza, semerera cane ushimitse; semerera, ntutinye; ubgire ibisagara vy’i Buyuda, ut’ Eh’ Imana yanyu!
Eh’ Uhoraho Imana azoza afise ubushobozi, kand’ ukuboko kwiwe kuzomutwarira: rāba, azoza azanye impēra, kand’ inyishu yiwe ir’ imbere yiwe.
Azoragira umukuku wiwe nk’umwungere, azoterura imyagazi mu maboko, ayitware mu gikiriza, kand’ izonsa azoziyobora buhoro‐buhoro.
Ni nde yigeze kugera amazi y’ikiyaga ku rushi, akageresha ijuru itambge ry’intoke, akaronka ingero yokwirwamw’ umukungugu wo kw isi, akagera imisozi ku munzane, n’uturambi ku ngero?
Ni nde yigeze kurōngōra Mpwemu w’Uhoraho, akamwigisha nk’ah’ ar’ umujanama wiwe?
Ni nde Mpwemu yigeze kugīsha inama, kandi ni nde yigeze kumwigisha, akamwigisha kuroranya, akamwigisha ubgenge, akamwereka uburyo bgo gutahura?
Ereg’ amahanga ameze nk’ ima ry’amazi riri mu mubindi, agereranywa n’umukungugu ufashe ku munzane; rāba aterura ibizinga vyo mu kiyaga nk’ah’ ar’ akantu gato k’ubusa.
Kand’ i Lebanoni ntihoboneka inkwi zo gucana zirangije, kandi n’ibikōko vyaho ntivyorangiza kuba ikimazi co kwosa.
