Imbere yiwe amahanga yose ni nk’ubusa; kuri we agereranywa nk’ah’ ari hanyuma y’ubusa, nk’akarēre kagaragara.
None rer’ Imana mwoyigereranya na nde, canke mwoyishushanya n’ishusho ki?
Ikigirwamana, umuhinga arakiyaza, umucuzi w’izahabu akacomekakw izahabu, akagicurira imigufu y’ifeza.
Ūbaye mworo, atoshoboye ishikanwa ringana rirtyo, yironkera igiti kitazobora, maz’ akironderera umukozi w’umuhinga wo guhagarika ico kigirwamana, ngo kigume.
Ntimwaribgabimenye? Ntimwaribgavyumve? Ntimwaribgabibarirwe uhereye mbere na mbere? Ntimwaribgabitahure uhereye ah’ itanguriro ry’isi ryashiriweho?
Iyo ni yo ivyagiye ahihese hejuru y’isi, ababa mw isi bameze nk’uduhori; ni yo igaranzura amajuru nk’impuzu y’agakangayenzi, ikayāgānura nk’ihema ryo kubamwo;
ni yo ihindura abaganwa ubusa; ikamanganya abacamanza bo mw isi, bakaba nk’akarēre kagaragara.
Bābaye bagiteragirwa, bābaye bakibibga, igishitsi cabo cābaye kigishinga imizi hasi, irabahūha, barakabirana, agashururu kabazingazinga nk’ibishingwe.
None rero mwongereranya na nde twongana? ni k’Uwera abajije.

Ni mwunamure amaso yanyu murābe hejuru, murābe uwaremye izo nyenyeri uw’ ari we, asohora ingabo zazo mu bitigiri: azihamagara zose mu mazina; kubg’ ububasha bg’ubushobozi bgiwe, no kubg’ inkomezi ziwe nyinshi, nta n’imwe ihara.
N’iki gituma uvuga, yewe Yakobo, ukiganyira, yewe Isirayeli, ut’ Inzira yanje inyegejwe Uhoraho, kand’ ut’ Ivyanje Imana yanje iravyirengagiza?
Ntiwaribgabimenye? Nturavyumva? Uhoraho n’Imana ihoraho, Umuremyi w’impera z’isi; ntadendebukirwa, nta ho aruha; ubgenge bgiwe ntibuserangurika.
Ni we aha inkomezi abadendebukiwe, kand’ ūtagira intege amwongeramw’ inkomezi.
Imisore yonadendebukirwa, ikaruha, n’imisore y’imikangara yokwicakw igatemba,
arikw abīteze Uhoraho bazokwama biyubura mu nkomezi nsha; bazodūgisha amababa nk’ inkukuma, biruke ntibaruhe, bagende ntibadendebukirwe.
Ni mucereze munyumvirize, yemwe ababa ku kiyaga; amahanga ni yiyubure, asubire mu nkomezi nsha, bīgire hafi; maze bahēreko bavuge: twegerane, tubūrane.

Ni nde yavyukije ūva i burasirazuba, akāma anesha ukw ashingūye ikirenge? Amugomoreye amahanga, amuha kuganza abami, ayagomorera inkota yiwe iyahindura nk’umukungugu, n’umuheto wiwe uyahindura nk’ibishingwe bikubebga n’umuyaga.
Arabatōta, agenda aja imbere ata nkomanzi; mber’ ajana inzira ibirenge vyiwe bitigeze gucamwo.
Ni nde yabikoze akabishitsa, ahamagaye abantu uk’ urunganwe rwabo rwagenda rukurikirana uhereye kw itanguriro? Ni jewe Uhoraho, uwa mbere n’ uw’ iherezo, ni jewe nyene.
Ababa ku kiyaga barabibonye, baratinya; abo ku mpera z’isi bahinda agashitsi: bīgira hafi, baraza.
Umuntu wese yafashije umubanyi wiwe, akabarira mugenzi we, ati Gumya umutima.
Nuk’ umuhinga aremesha umucuzi w’izahabu, ūryohoza inyundo akaremesha ūcurira kw ibuye, akavuga, at’ Ivyuma twabiteranije neza; maz’ akagikomeresha imisumari ngo kigume.
Ariko weho Isirayeli musavyi wanje, Yakobo uwo natoranije, ruvyaro rwa Aburahamu umukunzi wanje:
wewe uwo natoye, nkagukūra ku mpera z’isi, nkaguhamagara ng’uve ku mfuruka zayo, nkakubgira, nt’ Ur’ umusavyi wanje, naragutoranije sinagutaye;
ntutinye, kuko ndi kumwe nawe; ntukihebure, kuko nd’ Imana yawe: nzogukomeza, nzogutabara, mbere nzokuramira n’ukuboko kw’i buryo kw’ukugororoka kwanje.
Eh’ abakurakiye bose bazotētērwa bamāramāre: abagutonganya bazocika ubusa, baranduke.
Abaguhāririza uzobarondera, ubabure, kand’ abakurwanya bazocika ubusa, bakamangane.
Kuko jewe Uhoraho Imana yawe nzogufata ukuboko kw’i buryo, nkubgire, nti Ntutinye, ndagutabara.
Ntutinye, musiba we Yakobo, namwe nkehwa z’ Abisirayeli; nzogutabara, ni k’ Uhoraho agize; kand’ Uwera w’ Abisirayeli ni we mucunguzi wawe.
Rāba nzoguhindura igisekuzo gisha, gikarishe gifise amenyo: uzohūragura imisozi uyinoze, uzohindura uturambi nk’ umuguruka.
Uzobigosora umuyaga ubitumure, agashururu kabishwiragize: nawe uzohimbarwa n’Uhoraho, wirate Uwera w’ Abisirayeli.
Impahazwa n’ abakene barondera amazi bakayabura, ururimi rwabo rukagwa umwumwa; jewe Uhoraho nzobishura, jewe Imana ya Isirayeli sinzobaheba.
Nzoziburura inzūzi mu mpinga z’imisozi y’uruharabuga, n’amasōko hagati mu myonga: ubugaragwa nzobuhindura ikidengeri c’amazi, n’igihugu cumye nzogihindura imbizi z’amazi.
Mu bugaragwa nzohatera ibiti vy’amasederi n’ivy’ imishita n’ivy’ imihadasi n’ivya elayo; kandi mu gahinga nzohashira ibiti vy’akajwari n’ivy’ imitidari n’ivy’ imiteyashuri bikurane;
kugira ngo barābe, bamenye, bitegereze, batahurire hamwe yuk’ ukuboko kw’Uhoraho ari kwo gukoze ivyo, kandi k’Uwera w’Abisirayeli ari we yabiremye.
Ni muzane imibūrano yanyu, ni k’Uhoraho agize; muserure inyanduruko zanyu zikomeye, ni k’Umwami wa Yakobo agize.
Ni babiserure, batubarire ibizoba: ni muvuge ivyabayeho ivy’ ari vyo, kugira ngo tuvyiyumvire, tumenye iherezo ryavyo; canke se mutwereke ibizoza.
Muvuge ibigiye kuzoza hanyuma kugira ngo tumenye ko mur’ imana: mupfe gukora iciza canke gukora ikibi, kugira ngo tukirābe twese, tujorerwe.
Rāba nta co murimwo, kandi n’igikorwa canyu n’ ubusa: ūbahitamwo aba abaye umuyobe.
Nahagurukije umuntu avuye i burārūko, kand’ araje; uwambaza izina ryanje avuye i burasirazuba: azokāta abaganza nk’ūkāta urwondo, canke nk’uk’ umubumvyi akāta ibumba.

Ni nde yabivuze uhereye ubga mbere ngo tubimenye, canke ni nde yabivuze kera kugira ngo tuvuge, tut’ Ivyo n’ivy’ ukuri? N’ukuri koko nta wabivuze, n’ukuri nta wavyerekanye, n’ukuri nta wumvise amajambo yanyu.
Ni jewe nabanje kubgira Siyoni, nti Ngabo baraje! I Yerusalemu mpatuma intumwa yo kubabgira ubutumwa bgiza.
Naritegereje, mbona ata wuriho; muri bo ubgabo nta n’ umujanama ariho yoshobora kunyishura n’ijambo na rimwe mbabajije.
Rāba bose ibikorwa vyabo nta co birimwo kandi n’ubusa gusa: ibishushanyo vyabo vyāvugutiwe mu nkero ni bga muyaga kandi n’ubusa.
Nguyu umushumba wanje, uwo nama nshigikiye, uwo natoranije, ahimbara umutima wanje: nashize Mpwemu wanje kuri we; azoshikana amateka mu banyamahanga.
Ntazoyogora, ntazosemerera, kandi ntazokwumvikanisha ijwi mu nzira.
Ntazohohosha irenga rivunitse, n’urumuri ruyenga ntazoruzimya: azoshikana amateka mu vy’ukuri.
Ntazodendebukirwa, ntazocika intege, gushitsa ah’ azoshingira amateka mw isi; ababa ku kiyaga bazokwitega ivyagezwe vyiwe.
Uku ni kw Imana Uhoraho agize, uwaremye amajuru akayāgānura, uwagaranzuye isi n’ivy’ imera, uwahaye abantu bo muri yo guhumeka, kand’ abayigendako akabaha ubugingo:
ati Jewe Uhoraho naguhamagaye mu bugororotsi: nzogufata nkuzigame, ngutange ng’ ubere abantu isezerano, n’abanyamahanga ubabere umuco;
ng’ uhumūre impumyi, ng’ usohore imbohe mw ibohero, n’abicaye mu mwiza ngo bave mu nzu y’imbohe.
Jewe nd’Uhoraho, iryo ni ryo zina ryanje; icubahiro canje sinzogiha uwundi, n’ishimwe ryanje sinzoriha ibigirwamana vy’ibibāzano.
Rāba ivya mbere birashitse, kandi ndabamenyesha n’ibisha; bitaraseruka ndabibabgira.
Ni muririmbire Uhoraho indirimbo nsha, n’ishimwe ryiwe uhereye ku mpera y’isi; muririmbe yemwe abagenda ku kiyaga, n’ibiri muri co vyose, namwe biyaya vyo kuri co, n’ababibamwo.
Ubugaragwa n’ibisagara vyabgo ni birangurure ijwi, n’imihana y’Abakedari; ababa i Sela baririmbe, basemerere bari ku mpinga z’imisozi.
Ivyo ni vyubahe Uhoraho, vyamamaze ishimwe ryiwe mu baba ku kiyaga.
Uhoraho azoja gutera nk’umuhizi, arwanane ishaka nk’intōre mu ntambara: azobīrahira, mber’ azobīvuga n’ijwi rirenga; abansi biwe azobagirira ibikomeye.
Eh’ aho nahoreye; naracereje, ndiyumanganya: noneho ndataka cane nk’umugore ari mu bise, nzohezagirika nsēmagiritse.
Nzotongora imisozi n’uturambi, numishe ivyatsi vyose vyaho; mu nzūzi nzohahindura i musozi, kandi nzokamya ibidengeri.
Nzozana impumyi mu nzira zitazi, ndazirōngōre mu ndari zitari zizi, nzohindura umwiza ube umuco imbere yazo, n’ahagoramye nzohagorora. Ivyo nzobishitsa, sinzobaheba.
Arikw abīshimira ibishushanyo vy’ibibāzano bazosubizwa inyuma, bazotētērwa cane, bo n’ababgira ibishushanyo vyāvugutiwe mu nkero, bati Mur’ imana zacu.
Mwa bipfamatwi ni mwumve; mwa mpumyi ni murābe kugira ngo mwitegereze.
Ni nde mpumyi atar’ umushumba wanje, canke gipfamatwi nk’intumwa yanje ntuma? Ni nde mpumyi nk’ umugendanyi wanje, kand’ ahumye nk’umushumba wanje, jewe Uhoraho?
Abona vyinshi yamara ntiyitegereza; amatwi yiwe arazibūtse, yamara ntiyumva.
Vyahimbaye Uhoraho kudūza ivyagezwe no kuvyubahiriza, kubg’ ukugororoka kwiwe.

Aba bantu n’abantu bāsahuwe, bānyazwe inkōkōre; bose bāratezwe, bagwa mu vyobo, kandi babanyegeje mu mabohero; n’abo gucika inyagano, ata wo kubakiza; n’abo gucika inyagano, ata wo kuvuga ati Barekure.
Ni nde muri mwebge yotegera ugutwi ivyo, agaca uruma akumva ivy’ igihe kizoza?
Ni nde yatanze aba Yakobo ngo banyagwe, kand’ Abisirayeli akabaha ababanyaga? Mbega s’Uhoraho, uwo twacumuyeko, kandi ntitwemeye kugendera mu nzira ziwe, ntitwumviye ivyagezwe vyiwe?
Ni co catumye aturekurirak’ uburake bgiwe bg’inkazi n’intambara zikomeye; bikaduturira impande zose, kandi ntitwabimenya, vyaraduturiye yamara ntitwabishirak’ umutima.
Ariko none, uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, uwakuremye, yewe Yakobo, kand’ akakubumba, yewe Isirayeli, ati Ntutinye, kuko nagucunguye, naguhamagaye izina, ur’ uwanje.
Ni waca mu mazi nzoba ndi kumwe nawe, no mu nzūzi ntizizokurengera; ni waca mu muriro ntuzosha, kandi n’urubeya ntiruzokubabura.
Kuko jewe nd’ Uhoraho Imana yawe, Uwera wa Isirayeli, Umukiza wawe. Nagutangiriye Egiputa kw incungu, Etiyopiya na Seba nahahevye kubgawe.
Kuko wabaye uw’ igiciro kinini mu nyonga zanje, n’umwubahwa, nanje nkagukunda, ni co gitumye nzoheba abantu kubgawe, n’amahanga kubg’ ubugingo bgawe.
Ntutinye, kuko ndi kumwe nawe; nzozana uruvyaro rwawe ndarukūye i burasirazuba, nzogukoraniriza hamwe ndagukūye i burengerazuba;
nzobgira i burārūko, nti Barekure, n’i bumanuko, nti Ntubīmane; zana abahungu banje ubakūye kure, n’abakobga banje ubakūye ku mpera y’isi;
n’umuntu wese yitirirwa izina ryanje, uwo naremeye icubahiro canje: naramubumvye, mbere naramuremye.
Sohora impumyi zifise amaso, n’ibipfamatwi bifise amatwi.

Amahanga yose n’akoranywe, amoko yose n’ahūrire hamwe: ni nde muri bo yoshobora kubimenyekanisha, akatwereka ivyabayeh’ ubga mbere? Ni bazane ivyabona vyabo batsindishirizwe; canke ni bumve bemere, bati N’ivy’ ukuri.

Ni mwebge vyabona vyanje, ni k’Uhoraho agize, n’abasavyi banje natoranije, kugira ngo mummenye kandi munyizere, kandi mutahure ko nd’ uwo ndi we: nta mana yigeze kubumbga hirya yanje, kandi nta yizonza mu nyuma.
Jewe, jewe nyene nd’ Uhoraho; kandi nta wundi Mukiza atari jewe.
Ni jewe nabitāngāje, ni jewe nakijije, ni jewe nabimenyekanishije, kandi nta yindi mana yariho muri mwebge: ni co gituma ari mwebge vyabona vyanje, ni k’Uhoraho agize, kandi ni jewe Mana.
Eka ndi yo, uhereye no ku musi w’itanguriro; kandi nta woshobora kugira ico arokora ngw agikūre mu kuboko kwanje. Jewe ico nkora, ni nde yokibuza?
Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, Umucunguzi wanyu, Uwera w’ Abisirayeli, ati Natumye i Babuloni kubganyu, nzomanura abaho bose ar’ impunzi, ni bo Bakaludaya, mu māto bishimira.
Ni jewe Uhoraho, Uwera wanyu, Umuremyi wa Isirayeli, Umwami wanyu.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ni we aca inzira mu kiyaga, n’indari mu mazi asuriranya,
agashikimura imikogote n’amafarasi, ingabo n’abahizi; birambaraye hamwe, ntibizovyuka ukundi; biradegeye, birazimye nk’ urutambi:
ati Mwoye kwibuka ivya mbere, kandi ntimwiyumvire ku vya kera.
Ehe ngira nkore ikintu gisha: ko kigira giseruke ubu, mbega ntimuzokimenya? Nzoca inzira no mu bugaragwa, ntembeshe inzūzi ahagadutse.
Ibikōko vyo mw ishamba bizonyubaha, bo n’imbgebge n’ibisīga vyitwa imbuni, kuko ntanze amazi mu bugaragwa, ngatembesha inzūzi ahagadutse, kugira ngo nnyweshe abantu banje, bamwe natoranije,
abantu niremeye kugira ngo bamenyekanishe ishimwe ryanje.
Ariko rero, Yakobo we, ntiwanyambaje; Isirayeli we, waramparurutse.
Ntiwanzaniye imyagazi y’ibimazi vyawe vyo kwosa, kandi ntiwanyubahishije ibimazi vyawe. Sinakugoje kunshikanira amashikanwa, sinakuruhishije imibavu.
Nta vyitwa kanehe imota neza wanguriye amahera, kandi ntiwampāgije ibinure vy’ibimazi vyawe; ariko ni wewe wangoje ivyaha vyawe, mbere wanduhishije ibigabitanyo vyawe.
Jewe, ni jewe nyene nsibanganya ibicumuro vyawe kubganje nyene, kand’ ivyaha vyawe sinzovyibuka ukundi.
Nyibutsa, tubūrane; shinga urubanza rwawe, kugira ng’utsindishirizwe.
Sogokuruza wa mbere yakoze icaha, n’abashikirwa bawe bancumuyeko.
Ni co kizotuma ntētereza abakuru b’ahēra, kandi Yakobo nzomuhindura ikivume, na Isirayeli igitutsi.
Yamara noneh’ umve, yewe Yakobo musavyi wanje, yewe Isirayeli uwo natoranije:
uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, uwakuremye akakubumba uhereye ukiri mu nda, kand’ ari we azogutabara: ati Ntutinye, yewe Yakobo musavyi wanje, yewe Yeshuruni uwo natoranije.
Kuko nzosuka amazi ku gihugu gifise inyota, n’imigezi kw isi yumye; nzosuka Mpwemu wanje ku ruvyaro rwawe, n’umugisha wanje ku buzukuruza bawe:
bazomera hagati mu vyatsi nk’ ibiti bimeze i ruhande y’inzūzi.
Umwe azovuga, ati Nd’ uw’ Uhoraho, uwundi azokwiyita izina rya Yakobo, uwundi azokwiyandikira n’ukuboko kwiwe kw ar’ uw’ Uhoraho, yiyita izina rya Isirayeli.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, Umwami wa Isirayeli, ari we Mucunguzi wiwe, Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo: ati Nd’ uwa mbere kandi nd’ uw’ iherezo, kandi nta yindi Mana atari jewe.
Ni nde ahwanye nanje? N’abiserure, abitāngāze, abishire ngaho imbere yanje! Uhereye kera hose ni nde yamenyekanishije ibizoba? Ibigira bize n’ibizobaho ni babivuge!
Mwoye gutinya canke guhagarika imitima: kera sinabibabariye nkabiserura? Namwe mur’ ivyabona vyo kunshingira intahe. Har’ iyindi Mana atari jewe? Mbere nta kindi gitandara kiriho: jewe nta co nzi.
Abaryohora ibishushanyo bibājwe bose n’ubusa; n’ ibintu vyabo vy’igikundiro nta co bizomara, n’ivyabona vyabo ubgavyo nta co bibona, nta co bimenya; kugira ngo bamāramāre.
Ni nde yaryohoye ikigirwamana, agacura igishushanyo kitagira ico kimaze?
Ereg’ abo bafatanije bose bazomāramāra; kand’ abo bahinga n’abantu buntu: bose ni bakoranire hamwe, baze ahabona; bazogira ubgoba, bamāramārire hamwe.
Umucuzi acura incabiti, akayivugutira mu makara, akayikubitisha inyundo, akayicurisha ukuboko kwiwe kw’ inkomezi: yamara yasonza, agacika intege; atanyoye amazi, agaheza akagwa umwumwa.
Umubāji arāmvura umugozi ku giti akahacisha ikaramu, akakibāza n’imbāzo, akakigera n’icuma kigera, akakibāza mw ishusho y’umuntu, kikagira akaranga nk’ak’ umuntu, kugira ngo kibe mu nzu.
Yīcīra ibiti vy’amasederi, akābīra ivy’ imizo n’ivy’ imyeloni, akīhitiramw’ igiti kimwe mu vyo mu kibira. Atera igiti c’umworeni, imvura ikakimeza.
Hanyuma kikazobera umuntu inkwi zo gucana, azozābīra azōte, mber’ arazicana agacumba umutsima: kand’ akakibāzamw’ ikigirwamana akagisenga, akibāzamw’ igishushanyo akacikubita imbere.
Igihimba caco agicanisha umuriro, ikindi gihimba kimuhishiriza inyama akarya; agatara izishinze agahāga; mber’ akōta, akavuga, ati Ha ha! nshize imbeho, mbonye umuriro!
Maz’ igisigaye akagihindura ikigirwamana, ar’ igishushanyo ciwe yabāje: akacikubita imbere akagisenga, akacambaza, ati Nkiza, kuk’ ur’ imana yanje.
Nta co bazi, kandi nta co biyumvira, kukw amaso yabo yahumye ngo ntibashobore kubona, n’imitima yabo ngo ntibashobore gutahura.

Erega nta wibuka, nta wumenya ngw atahure, ngw avuge at’ Igihimba caco nagicanishije umuriro, nacumvye umutsima ku makara yaco, ntarakw inyama ndazirya; mbeg’ igisigaye nogikorakw ikintu nk’ico c’ubuyobe? Mbega nokwikubita imbere y’ingiga y’igiti?
Ūshima umunyota gusa, umutima wibesha uba wamujimije, bituma adashobora gukiza ubugingo bgiwe, ngw aruhe yibaza, ati Mbeg’ ico mfise mu kuryo kwanje s’ikinyoma?
Wibuke ivyo, yewe Yakobo, yewe Isirayeli, kuk’ ur’ umusavyi wanje. Ni jewe nakubumvye, ur’ umusavyi wanje: yewe Isirayeli sinzokwibagira.
Neyuye ibicumuro vyawe nk’igicu gitwaye intunda, n’ivyaha vyawe nk’igicu: garuka kuri jewe, kuko nagucunguye.

Muririmbe, mwa majuru, kuk’ Uhoraho abikoze; wa bgina bg’isi usemerere; ni muturike muririmbe, mwa misozi mwe, nawe kibira, n’igiti cose kirimwo: kuk’ Uhoraho yacunguye Yakobo, kand’ azokwihesha icubahiro muri Isirayeli.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, Umucunguzi wawe, uwakubumvye uhereye ukiri mu nda, ati Ni jewe Uhoraho ndema vyose, nāguye ijuru nd’umwe, ngaranzura isi: har’ uwo twari kumwe?
Indagu z’abanyabinyoma ndazihindura ubusa, abapfumu nkabatēza ibisazi, nsubiza inyuma abanyabgenge, ubgenge bgabo nkabuhindura ubupfu.
Nkomeza ijambo ry’umusavyi wanje, ngashitsa inama z’intumwa zanje, mvuga ivya Yerusalemu, nti Hazokwongera gutūrika; n’ivy’ ibisagara vy’i Buyuda, nti Bizokwubakwa, kandi nzovyutsa ahāsenyutse haho.
Mbarira idamba, nti Kama, kandi nzokamya inzūzi zikujamwo;
mvuga ivya Kuro, nti N’umwungere wanje, azoshitsa ivyo ngomba vyose; nkavuga ivya Yerusalemu, nti Hazokwubakwa; nkabarira urusengero, nt’ Itanguriro ryawe rizoshirwaho.

Ibi ni vyo jewe Uhoraho mbgira uwo narobanuje amavuta, ni we Kuro, uwo mfashe ukuboko kw’i buryo, kugira ngo nsiribange amahanga imbere yiwe, kandi nzokenyurura inkindi z’abami, kugira ngo ndamwugururire inzugi imbere yiwe, kand’ amarembo ntazokwugarirwa:
nti Nzoja imbere yawe, kand’ ahar’ uduhogoro nzohasena; nzomenagura inzugi z’imiringa, nzovunagura ibihindizo vy’ivyuma:
kandi nzoguha itunga rihishijwe mu mwiza, n’ubutunzi bunyegejwe mu mpisho, kugira ng’ umenye kw ari jewe Uhoraho nguhamagaye mw izina, jewe nyene Imana y’Abisirayeli.
Kubga Yakobo umusavyi wanje, Isirayeli uwo natoranije, nguhamagaye mw izina, nakwise iry’ icubahiro, nah’ utaribgammenye.
Ni jewe Uhoraho, nta wundi; atari jewe nta yindi Mana iriho. Nzogukenyeza nah’ utigeze kummenya,
kugira ngo bamenye uhereye i burasirazuba ugashitsa i burengerazuba yukw ata yindi atari jewe: ni jewe Uhoraho, kandi nta wundi.
Ni jewe nkomoko y’umuco, nd’ umuremyi w’umwiza; nd’ isōko y’impore, nd’umuremyi w’ivyago: ni jewe Uhoraho nkora ivyo vyose.
Mwa majuru, murekure ukugororoka kuve mw ijuru, n’ikirēre kigucuncubure: isi yasame, itengengerekw agakiza, ikamezanye n’ukugororoka: ni jewe Uhoraho nabiremye.
Azobona ibara, ūhāririza uwamuremye, kand’ ar’ akajo mu tujo two kw isi! Mbeg’ ibumba ryobaza ūrikw araribumba, riti Har’ ico wobumba? Cank’ igikorwa ukora covuga kw ata maboko ufise?
Azobona ibara, ūbaza se, at’ Ubgo wotera inda? akabaza nyina, at’ Ubgo wotwara inda?
Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, Uwera wa Isirayeli, Umuremyi wiwe, ati Mbega murambaza ibizoza? Murangaba ku vy’abahungu banje n’ igikorwa c’amaboko yanje?
Ni jewe naremye isi, kandi ndayiremerakw abantu; ni jewe nibambiye amajuru n’amaboko yanje, kand’ ingabo z’inyenyeri zose zo kuri yo ndazigaba.

Ni jewe mpagurukije Kuro mu bugororotsi, kandi nzororanya inzira ziwe zose; ni we azokwubaka umurwa wanje, kandi ni we azorekura abantu banje bānyazwe, adahongewe cank’ adahērewe, ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize.

Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Abakozi ba Egiputa n’abadandaza ba Etiyopiya n’abagabo barebare b’i Sabe bazoza bagukomere amashi, bazoba abawe, bagukurikire, bazoza bari mu minyororo, bakwikubite imbere, bagutakambire, bati N’ukuri Imana iri muri wewe, kandi nta yindi iriho, nta yindi Mana.
N’ukuri ur’ Imana yihishije, wewe Mana y’ Abisirayeli, Umukiza.
Bazotētērwa, bamāramāre bose, bazomāramārira hamwe, abakora ibishushanyo vy’ibigirwamana.
Arikw Abisirayeli bazokizwa n’Uhoraho, abakirishe agakiza kadashira: ntimuzotētērwa, canke ngo mumāramāre, no gushitsa ibihe bitazoshira.

Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, uwaremye amajuru, ni we Mana; uwabumvye isi akayirema; yarayikomeje, ntiyayiremye ngw ibek’ ubusa gusa, ariko yayibumvye kugira ngw ibekw abantu: ati Ni jewe Uhoraho, kandi nta wundi.
Sinavugiye mu mpisho, ahantu ho mu gihugu c’umwiza; nta ho nabariye uruvyaro rwa Yakobo, nti Ni mundonderere ubusa. Jewe Uhoraho mvuga ibiroranye, nsigura ivy’ ukuri.
Ni mukorane, ni muze, mwīgirire hafi hamwe, mwebge abarokotse bo mu mahanga: abīkorera igiti c’ikigirwamana cabo c’ikibāzano, bagasenga imana idashobora gukiza, nta bgenge bagira.

Ni mubivuge, ni mubizane, mbere ni baje inama hamwe: ni nde yerekanye ivyo uhereye mu bihe vya kera? Ni nde yabimenyekanishije uhereye kera? Si jewe, Uhoraho? Kandi nta yindi Mana atari jewe, Imana igororotse kand’ Umukiza; nta yindi atari jewe.
Ni muntumbere mukizwe, mwa mpera zose z’isi: kukw ari jewe Mana, ata yindi.
Ndirahiye, ijambo ry’ukuri rivuye mu kanwa kanje ritazokwirahuruzwa, yukw amavi yose azompfukamira, n’indimi zose zizondahira.
Uhoraho, muri we honyene ni ho har’ ukugororoka n’inkomezi, ni ko bazomvuga; kuri we ni ho abantu bazoza; kand’ abamurakiye bose bazotētērwa.
Uhoraho, muri we ni ho uruvyaro rwose rwa Isirayeli ruzotsindanishiririzwa, rukamwirata.
Beli irarundutse, Nebo irubamye; ibishushanyo vyazo biremētswe ingamiya n’inka; bimwe mwarerura mushogamanga bicitse umutwaro ugenda uravuna inka.
Izo mana zirubamye zirundukiye hamwe; ntizashoboye kurokora uwo mutwaro, ariko na zo ubgazo zagiye ar’ inyagano.
Ni munyumve, yemwe ab’ inzu ya Yakobo, mwa masigarira yo mu nzu ya Isirayeli mwese, abo nateruye uhereye mukivuka, nkabaheka mukiva mu nda;
nzobageza no mu zabukuru ndi We, muzorinda musēsa imvi nkibaheka: ni jewe naremye, ni jewe nzoheka; mbere nzobaterura, mbarokore.
None rero mwongereranya na nde twongana? Kandi mwonshushanya na nde twosa?
Basukanura izahabu mu mupfuko, bagera ifeza ku munzane, bagaha umucuzi w’izahabu ingero, akabicuramw’ imana; bakayīkubita imbere bakayisenga.
Maze bakayishira ku bitugu bakayirerura, bakayishinga mu kibanza cayo, igahagararaho ntisegenye; mbere nah’ umuntu yoyitakambira, ntiyoshobora kumwishura, canke ngw imukize amagorwa yiwe.
Ni mwibuke ivyo, muvyiyumvire: mwongere muvyibuke, mwa bagarariji.
Mwibuke ivyabanje kubaho kera; kukw ari jewe Mana, ata yindi; ni jewe Mana, nta yindi duhwanye.
Mpēra kw itanguriro nkavuga ivy’ iherezo, ngahēra no mu bihe vya kera nkavuga ibitaraba; nkavuga nt’ Imigabo yanje izohama, kand’ ivyo nzogomba vyose nzobishitsa.
Nzohamagara igisīga caromoye kive i burasirazuba, ni co muntu afise imigabo yanje, ava mu gihugu ca kure. Narabivuze; no kubishitsa nzobishitsa; narabigabiye, no kubikora nzobikora.
Ni munyumve, yemwe ab’ imitima ikomantaye, abari kure y’ukugororoka:
nīgije hafi ukugororoka kwanje, ntikuzoba kure; n’agakiza kanje ntikazotebagana; kandi nzoshira ako gakiza i Siyoni kubga Isirayeli, ni we cubahiro canje.
Manuka wicare mu mukungugu, wa nkumi y’i Babuloni; wa mukobga w’Abakaludaya, icara hasi hatari ku ntebe y’ubgami, kuk’ utazokwongera kuvugwa k’udibamye canke ko wāmikaye.
Fata urusyo usye, utwikurure mu maso hawe; kūra imvune zawe, ukūre impuzu ushitse mu bibero, ujabuke inzūzi.
Ubgambure bgawe buzotwikururwa, mber’ ibiteye isoni vyawe bizoboneka; nzokwīhōra, kandi sinzogira akagongwe,
ni k’Umucunguzi wacu agize, izina ryiwe n’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, Uwera w’Abisirayeli.
Icara wumaniwe, wibembeteranye mu mwiza, wa mukobga w’ Abakaludaya we, kuk’ utazokwongera kwitwa Umugabekazi w’ibihugu.
Nari narakiye abantu banje, mpindura igihumane ishamvu yanje, ndabakugomorera; nawe nta kagongwe wabagiriye, abatāma wabatwaje amanyama birengeje.
Urīyāga, uti Nzoba umugabekazi ibihe bidashira. Ivyo ntiwarushe ubishirak’ umutima, canke ngo wibuke iherezo ryavyo.

Nuko rero ni wumve ibi, wewe wihaye ibihimbaro, ukicara ata co winona, ukīyāga mu mutima, uti Ni jewe ndiho, nta wundi atari jewe; sinzosigara nd’ umupfakazi, kandi sinzomenya kubura abana ic’ ari co.
Arikw ivyo vyompi bizokugwako umusi umwe, kubura abana no gupfakara: bizogushikako uko vyakabaye, nah’ ubupfumu bgawe bgoba bginshi bute, n’ amahezayo yawe akaba isinzi.
Kuko widibamiye mu bubi bgawe ata co wicura, ukavuga, uti Nta wumbona; ubgenge bgawe n’ukumenya kwawe ni vyo bikujimije; wīyāga mu mutima, uti Ni jewe ndiho, nta wundi atari jewe.
Ni co kizotuma ivyago bigushikako, ntumenye amahezayo yavyo; ibara rikugweko, ntushobore kuryīkūrako, kand’ ubugesera utazi buzokuzako giturumbuka.
Nuko hagararana amahezayo yawe, n’ivy’ ubupfumu bgawe uko bingana, ivyo wakobereje uhereye mu buto bgawe: namba kumbure vyogira ico bikumarira, namba kumbure vyogushoboza.
Wacumukujwe n’abakugīra inama benshi; abaragurisha ijuru, n’abaragurisha inyenyeri, na bamwe bahora bakumenyesha ibigira bikubeko, uk’ ukwezi kubonetse, ni baze bagukize.
Rāba bazoba nk’ibishingwe, umuriro uzobaturira; ntibazokwikiza inkomezi z’ imbeya zawo; ntuzoba amakara yo kwota, cank’ umuriro wo kwicarako.
Uko ni ko bizokubera, ivyo wakobereje; abādandaza nawe uhereye mu buto bgawe bazokwīgīra, umuntu wese yīgīre ahiwe; ntihazogira ūgukiza.

Ni mwumve ibi, yemwe nzu ya Yakobo, abitwa izina rya Isirayeli, bakanduruka mu rura rwa Yuda; abarahira izina ryanje Uhoraho, bakavuga Imana ya Isirayeli, ariko mu bitar’ ivy’ ukuri canke mu vy’ukugororoka.
Kuko biyita abo ku murwa wera, bakishingikiriza ku Mana ya Isirayeli; Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo ni ryo zina ryanje.
Kera navuze ibizoba bitaraza; ni koko vyavuye mu kanwa kanje, ndavyerekana: kandi nabikoze giturumbuka, birashika.
Nari nzi k’udakūrwa kw ijambo, kandi kw izosi ryawe ari nk’umutsi umeze nk’icuma, n’uruhanga rwawe ari nk’umuringa:

ni co catumye mbikubarira uhereye kera, bitaraba nkabikwereka; kugira ngo woye kuvuga, uti Ya mana yanje ni yo ibikoze, ni ca gishushanyo canje c’ikibāzano, ni ca gishushanyo canje cavugutiwe mu nkero, ni co cabigeze.
Waravyumvise, non’ ehe vyitegereze vyose: mbega ntuvyemera? Guhēra ubu ngira mbereke ibisha, vyari bihishijwe, utigeze kumenya.
Bigizwe ubu nyene, s’ivya kera: kugeza uyu musi ntiwigeze kuvyumva; kugira ngo woye kuvuga, ut’ Erega nari nsanzwe ndabizi.
N’ukuri koko ntiwaribgavyumve, ntiwaribgabimenye, mber’ uhereye kera ntivyaribgashike mu matwi yawe: kuko nari nzi k’ur’ umuryarukanyi w’agahebuza, kandi wiswe ikigāba uhereye ukiva mu nda.
Kubg’ izina ryanje reka ntenyenye kukurakira; kubg’ ishimwe ryanje reka nkwihanganire, noye kukurandura.
Ehe ndakuvugutiye, ariko si nk’ifeza; nkugeragereje mu ruganda rwo kubabazwa.
Kubganje, mbere kubganje nyene nzobikora; n’iki cotuma izina ryanje rikēngērwa? Kand’ icubahiro canje sinzogiha uwundi.
N’unyumve, yewe Yakobo, yewe Isirayeli nahamagaye; ndi We. Nd’ uwa mbere kandi nd’ uw’ iherezo.
Mber’ ukuboko kwanje ni kwo kwashizeh’ itanguriro ry’isi, n’ukuboko kwanje kw’i buryo ni kwo kwabamvye ijuru: iyo mbihamagaye bivira hasi rimwe.
Mwese ni mukorane mwumve. Ni nde wo muri bo yigeze kuvuga ivyo? Uwo jewe Uhoraho nkunda azogirira Babuloni uko ngomba, kand’ ukuboko kwiwe kuzotera Abakaludaya.
Ni jewe, jewe nyene nabivuze; mbere naramuhamagaye, ndamuzanye, kand’ urugendo rwiwe ruzogira amahirwe.
Ni mwīgire hafi mwumve ibi: uhereye mw itanguriro nta ho navugiye mu mpisho; uhereye aho vyabereyeho, nariho: kandi non’ Uhoraho Imana antumanye na Mpwemu wiwe.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho Umucunguzi wawe, Uwera w’ Abisirayeli agize, ati Ni jewe Uhoraho Imana yawe, nkwigisha ibikugirira ikimazi, nkakurōngōra mu nzira ukwiye gucamwo.
Iy’ uba warumviye ivyagezwe vyanje, uba waragize amahoro ameze nk’ uruzi, kand’ ukugororoka kwawe kuba kwarabaye nk’imipfunda y’ ikiyaga;
kand’ uruvyaro rwawe rwobaye nk’umusenyi, n’abava mu nda yawe bobaye nk’umuhekeheke wawo; izina ryawe ntiryorandutse canke ngo rizimangane imbere yanje.
Ni muve i Babuloni, muhunge muve mu Bakaludaya, muvuge ibi, mubikwize, muvyamamaze gushitsa ku mpera y’isi, mubivugishe ijwi ry’indirimbo, mut’ Uhoraho acunguye umusavyi wiwe Yakobo.
Kand’ aho yabarōngōra mu bugaragwa nta ho bishwe n’inyota; yabatembeshereje amazi ava mu gitandara; yasatuye igitandara, amazi arasendanisha.
Nta mahoro y’abanyavyaha, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Ni munyumve, yemwe ababa ku kiyaga; namwe mahanga ya kure, tega amatwi. Uhoraho yampamagaye ntaravuka; nkiri mu nda ya mama yamvuze izina:
akanwa kanje yakagize nk’inkota ikarishe, ampisha mu gitūtu c’ukuboko kwiwe; kandi yampinduye umwampi usennye, mu mutana wiwe ni ho anzigamira rwose.
Kandi yarambariye, ati Ni wewe musavyi wanje, Isirayeli, uwo nzoherwamw’ icubahiro.
Ariko ndavuga, nti Naruhijwe n’ubusa, inkomezi zanje zapfuye ubusa, nazikoresheje ibitagira ikimazi: yamara rer’ urubanza rwanje ruseguwe n’Uhoraho, kand’ Imana yanje ni yo izompēra.

None rero, uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ni we yambumvye nkiri mu nda ngo mbe umusavyi wiwe, ngo ndamugarukanire Yakobo, Abisirayeli bakoranirizwe kuri we; kuko nd’ umwubahwa mu nyonga z’Uhoraho, kand’ Imana yanje yambereye inkomezi;

aravuga, ati Kuba umushumba wanje, ugashira hejuru imiryango ya Yakobo, ukagarukana abarokotse b’Abisirayeli, ivyo ntibihāgije: ariko kandi ndagushizeho ng’ ube umuco wākira amahanga, kugira ngo n’ abo ku mpera y’isi ubashikirize agakiza kanje.

Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, Umucunguzi wa Isirayeli, Uwera wiwe, abgira umwe abantu bakēngēra, uwo ihanga ryanka urunuka, umushumba w’ abaganza, at’ Abami bazobirāba bahaguruke; bo n’abaganwa, bakome amashi; kubg’ Uhoraho umwizigirwa, ni we Wera wa Isirayeli yagutoranije.

Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Mu gihe co kwemererwamwo ndakwishuye, no ku musi wo gukirizwako ndagutabaye; kandi nzogukiza, ngushireho ube isezerano ry’abantu, kugira ng’ usibure igihugu, utume basubizwa mw ishamvu yabo yabaye imisaka.
Kand’ ubgire imbohe, uti Ni musohoke; n’ abari mu mwiza, uti Ni museruke ahabona. Bazogenda barisha umwagambo ku mayira, kand’ ahār’ uruharabuga hejuru ku misozi hazobabera ivyanya.
Ntibazokwicwa n’inzara canke n’inyota, kand’ indugumba ntizobahundagaza cank’ izuba: kuk’ uwabagiriye ikigongwe azobaja imbere, akabashikana no ku masōko y’amazi.
Imisozi yanje yose nzoyihindura inzira, n’amarango yanje nzoyashira hejuru.
Ehe bamwe bazova kure: eh’ abandi bazova i burārūko n’i burengerazuba, kand’ abandi bazova mu gihugu c’i Sinimu.
Ririmba, mwa majuru; nezerwa wa si we; turika muririmbe, mwa misozi miremire, kuk’ Uhoraho amaze umubabaro abantu biwe, kand’ atewe akagongwe n’abāhahajwe biwe.
Ariko Siyoni ho haravuga, hat’ Uhoraho yarampevye, Umwami Imana yaranyibagiye.
Mbeg’ umugore yokwibagira umwana akiri kw ibere, ngo yoye kugirira akagongwe ubura bgiwe? Ni koko, abo boshobora kwibagira, ariko jeho sinoshobora kukwibagira.
Ehe ngushushanije mu biganza vyanje; inzitiro zawe ndazihozakw amaso.
Abana bawe baza bihuta; abāguhoneje n’abāguhinduye amatongo bazokuvamwo bagende.
Unamura amaso urābe impande zose: ba bandi bose barakoranye, bariko baraza kuri wewe. Ndahiye ukubaho kwanje, ni k’Uhoraho agize, uzobīsakara nk’uwambaye utugenegene, uzobakenyera use n’umugeni.
Kukw amatongo yawe n’ imisaka yawe n’igihugu cawe cāgeshejwe, n’ukuri noneho hazokwagira abazohaba, kand’ abāri baragutsontsomeye bazoba kure.
Abana wari wānyazwe bazovugira mu matwi yawe, bat’ Aha hantu haratwagiye: segenya turonke aho tuba.
Maz’ uzokwibaza mu mutima, uti Mbeg’ aba nabavyariwe na nde? Ko nari naranyazwe abana banje, nkaba nd’ imbura n’igicibga n’inyererezi! Ko nari nsigaye nd’ inyakamwe, aba bo bamye hehe?
Uku ni k’Umwami Uhoraho agize, ati Nzorāmvurira amahanga ukuboko kwanje, nshingire amoko ibendera yanje; nuko bazozana abahungu bawe babakikiye mu gikiriza, n’abakobga bawe babateruye ku bitugu.

Kand’ abami bazokubera ba se babakurerera, n’abamikazi babo bazokubera ba nyina babakwonkereza; bazokwikubita imbere bubamye hasi, barigate umukungugu wo ku birenge vyawe; nawe uzomenya ko nd’ Uhoraho, kand’ abanyiteze ntibazomāramāra.
Mbeg’ abahizi bonyagwa iminyago, cank’ abagororotsi bajanywekw inyagano borokorwa?

Arik’ uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Abāfashwe mpiri n’abahizi, na bo bazobanyagwa, kand’ iminyago y’abantu b’agaterabgoba izorokorwa: kukw ari jewe nzokurwanira, nkarwanya ūkurwanya, kandi nzokiza abana bawe.

Kand’ abaguhahaza nzobagaburira inyama zabo ubgabo, bazoborerwa ayabo maraso nk’ūborewe vino novu; kand’ abantu bose bazomenya ko jewe Uhoraho nd’ Umukiza wawe, n’Umucunguzi wawe, Inyenkomezi ya Yakobo.

Uku ni k’Uhoraho abaza, at’ Icete c’uko tuvavanuye na nyoko, ico namwirukanishije, kiri hehe? Cank’ uwo narīriye umwenda ngatanga mwebge ngo mube inyishu, ari hehe? Ereg’ ukugabitanya kwanyu ni kwo kwatumye mutangwa, kand’ ibicumuro vyanyu ni vyo vyirukanishije nyoko.

Mbeg’ aho naza, n’iki catumye ntagira uwo ndahasanga, ngahamagara, ntihagire uwitaba? Mbeg’ ukuboko kwanje kwabaye kugufi ngo kunanirwe gucungura? Canke se nta bubasha mfise bgo kurokora? Ereg’ iyo nkankamiye ikiyaga ndagikamya, inzūzi ndazihindura ubugaragwa; amafi yari muri zo aranuka, kukw ata mazi ariho, yatikijwe n’inyota.
Nambika ijuru ukwirabura, ndaryorosa amagunira.
Umwami Uhoraho ampaye ururimi rw’abigishwa, kugira ngo mmenye uko nosindagirisha ūrushe amajambo; ankangura uko bukeye, akangurira ugutwi kwanje kwumva, nk’ukw abigishwa bumviriza.
Umwami Uhoraho anziburuye ugutwi, nanje sinabaye ikigāba, canke ngo mpindukire nsubire inyuma.
Abankubita nabategeye ibitugu, n’imisaya ndayitegera abammomora ubganwa; kandi mu maso hanje sinahakinjishije gutēterezwa no gucirwakw amate.
Arik’ Umwami Uhoraho arantabara, ni co gituma ntatētērwa: ni co gituma ndinduka, mu maso hanje hakamera nk’ibuye, kandi nzi yuko ntazomāramāra.
Ūntsindishiriza ari hafi; non’ uwombūranya ni nde? Ngo tuve hasi duhagararane: umubūranyi wanje ni nde? N’aze tubangikane.
Rāba Umwami Uhoraho ni we azompagarikira; non’ uwontsindisha ni nde? Ereg’ abo bose bazosāza nk’impuzu; inyenzi zizobarya zibamare.
Ni nde muri mwebge yubaha Uhoraho, akumvira ijwi ry’umushumba wiwe? Ūgendera mu mwiza, adafise umuco, ni yizigire izina ry’Uhoraho, kandi yisunge Imana yiwe.
Umve mwese abacana umuriro, bakīshira imuri impande zose: ni mugende mumurikiwe n’umuriro wanyu, bo n’imuri mwidomekeye. Ivyo muzoronka mu kuboko kwanje n’ibi: muzoryamana umubabaro.
Ni munyumve, yemwe abakurikirana ukugororoka, yemwe abarondera Uhoraho: mwitegereze igitandara mwasatuweko, n’inganzo mwimbgemwo.
Mwitegereze Aburahamu sogokuruza, na Sara yabavyaye; kuko hamwe Aburahamu yar’ akir’ umwe rudende namuhamagaye, nkamuha umugisha, nkamugwiza.

Kuko jewe Uhoraho namaze Siyoni umubabaro; namaze umubabaro imisaka yaho yose, kand’ ubugaragwa bgaho nabugize nka Edeni, n’ubgeranyange bgaho nabugize nk’itongo ryanje, jewe Uhoraho; hazobonekamw’ umunezero n’uguhimbarwa, bo n’ishimwe n’ijwi ry’inanga.
Bantu banje, ni munyumvirize; hanga ryanje, muntege ugutwi; kukw icagezwe kizova kuri jewe, kandi nzoshinga amateka yanje ngw abe umuco w’amahanga.
Ubugororotsi bganje buri hafi, agakiza kanje karaserutse, amaboko yanje azocira amahanga amateka; ababa ku kiyaga bazonyitega, kand’ ukuboko kwanje ni kwo bazokwizigira.

Ni mwunamurire amaso yanyu mw ijuru, mwitegereze no kw isi hasi: kukw ijuru rizokamangana nk’umwotsi, n’isi izosāza nk’umwambaro, n’abayibako bazopfa nk’isazi: arikw agakiza kanje kazokwamah’ ibihe bidashira, kand’ ukugororoka kwanje ntikuzogira iherezo.
Yemwe abazi ivy’ ukugororoka, ihanga rifise ivyagezwe vyanje mu mitima yanyu, ni munyumve: ntimugatinye ibitutsi vy’abantu, canke ngo murandurwe imitima n’ ugucokora kwabo.
Kukw inyenzi zizobarya nk’umwambaro, n’ ifukunyi izobarya nk’ubgoya bg’ intama: arik’ ukugororoka kwanje kuzokwamah’ ibihe bidashira, n’ agakiza kanje uk’ urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikirana.

Ikangure, ikangure, wambare inkomezi, ewe wa kuboko kw’ Uhoraho; ikangure nko mu misi ya kera, nko ku runganwe rw’ibihe vyashize, uko rwagenda rukurikirana. Mbega si wewe wahimbaguye Rahabu, ugasogota ca gisato c’amahēro?
Si wewe wakamije ikiyaga, amazi maremare yo mw idamba; ugahindura i bgina bgo mu kiyaga kuba inzira ngw abācunguwe bayicemwo?

Nukw abācunguwe n’Uhoraho bazogaruka, bashike i Siyoni baririmba; umunezero utazoshira uzohora ku mitwe yabo; bazoronka umunezero n’uguhimbarwa, kand’ umubabaro no gusuhuza umutima bizohunga vyambuke.
Ni jewe, ni jewe nyene mbahūmuriza; uri nde utinya umuntu, kand’ azopfa; n’umwana w’ umuntu, kand’ azohinduka nk’ivyatsi?
ukibagira Uhoraho Umuremyi wawe, ari we yagaranzuye amajuru, agashirah’ amatanguriro y’isi; maz’ ukīriza umusi utinya uburake bg’ūhahaza, iyo yiteguye guhonnya: non’ uburake bg’ūhahaza buri hehe?
Abāfashwe mpiri bakambukanwa bazorekurwa vuba; ntibazopfa ngo baje muri rwa rwobo, kand’ ivyo kurya vyabo ntibizobura.
Kuko jewe nd’ Uhoraho Imana yawe, ntera ikiyaga gusuriranya, imipfunda yaco ikabomborana: Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo ni ryo zina ryanje.
Kandi nshize amajambo yanje mu kanwa kawe, ngutwikirije igitūtu c’ukuboko kwanje, kugira ngo ngaranzure ijuru risha, nshireh’ amatanguriro y’isi nsha, mbarire ab’i Siyoni, nti Mur’ abantu banje.
Ikangure, ikangure, vyuka uve hasi, ewe Yerusalemu, uwo Uhoraho yasomesheje ku gikombe c’uburake bgiwe; wanyoye ku gakarabo ari ko gikombe c’ukudandabagiranya, uracīrāngūza.
Mu bana wavyaye bose ntiharih’ uwo kukurōngōra; kandi mu bo wareze bose nta wo kugufata ukuboko.
Ibi vyompi ko bigushitseko, ni nde azokuririra? Ko haje ibitongozi n’ugusangangurwa, bo n’inzara n’inkota, nokuremesha nte?
Abana bawe bararavye, bahindikiranye ku mayirabiri hose, nk’impongo iguye mu mutego; bamazwe n’uburake bg’Uhoraho, ni kwo guhana kw’ Imana yawe.
None rero ni wumve ibi, wa mpahazwa we, uborewe utanyoye vino:

uku ni k’Umwami wawe Uhoraho agize, ari we Mana yawe ibūranira abantu bayo, at’ Ehe nkūye ca gikombe c’ukudandabagiranya mu kuboko kwawe, ni ko ka gakarabo, ari ko gikombe c’uburake bganje; ntuzosubira kukinywak’ ukundi:
ngiteretse mu kiganza c’abaguhahaza, c’abākubarira, bat’ Ubika inda, tuguceko; nawe ugatega mu mugongo hawe nko hasi, canke nk’inzira, ngo bahahite.
Ikangure, ikangure, wambare inkomezi zawe, ewe Siyoni; ambara imyambaro yawe ishajije, ewe Yerusalemu wa murwa wera; kuk’ uhereye none muri wewe hatazoshika ūtākebge cank’ igihumane.
Haguruka wikunkumure umukungugu, uheze uze wicare ewe Yerusalemu: wibohore imvuto zo mw izosi ryawe, ewe mukobga w’i Siyoni wajanywekw inyagano.
Kuk’ ukw ari k’Uhoraho agize, ati Mwaguzwe ubusa: na none muzocungurwa ata mahera.
Kuk’ ukw ari k’Umwami Uhoraho agize, at’ Ubga mbere abantu banje bāramanutse baja muri Egiputa gusuhukirayo: Abashuri babahahaza ata nyanduruko.
None rero nkora iki hano? ni k’ Uhoraho agize; kw abantu banje bānyazwe ku busa! Ababaganza barayogora, ni k’Uhoraho agize, kandi bīriza umusi batuka izina ryanje.
Nuko rer’ abantu banje bazomenya izina ryanje; kur’ uwo musi bazomenya kw ari jewe mvuga: mbere ni jewe nyene.
Ereg’ ibirenge vy’ūzanye inkuru nziza ni vyiza ku misozi, akamamaza ivy’ amahoro, akazana inkuru nziza z’ivyiza, akamamaza ivy’ agakiza, akabarira Siyoni, at’ Imana yawe iri ku ngoma!
Ijwi ry’abashibamyi bawe! Bashize hejuru bavugiriza impundu hamwe; bazovyibonera imbonankubone aho Uhoraho azogaruka i Siyoni.
Ni muturike munezerwe, muririmbire hamwe, yemwe misaka y’i Yerusalemu: kuk’ Uhoraho aremesheje abantu biwe, acunguye Yerusalemu.
Uhoraho akumye impuzu ku kuboko kwiwe kwera mu maso y’amahanga yose, kand’ impera z’isi zose zizobona agakiza k’Imana yacu.
Ni mugende, ni mugende, muveyo; ntimugakore ku kintu gihumanya na kimwe; muve hagati yaho; mwitunganye, yemwe abashorezi b’imbombovu z’Uhoraho.
Kuko mutazovayo mwihuta, canke ngo mugende nk’abahunga: kuk’ Uhoraho azobaja imbere; Imana y’Abisirayeli izobīmiriza.
Rāba, umushumba wanje azoja imbere, azokuzwa ashirwe hejuru, asumbe abandi.
Nk’uko benshi yababereye akumiza — kuko mu maso hiwe hononekaye ntihase n’ah’ umuntu, n’ishusho yiwe yononekaye ntise n’iy’ abana b’abantu —
uko ni kw azojoreza amahanga menshi; abami bazozibira akanwa kabo imbere yiwe: kuko bazobona ico batābgiwe, n’ico batumvise bazocitegereza.
Ni nde yemeye inkuru zacu? Kand’ ukuboko kw’Uhoraho kwahishuriwe nde?
Kuko yakuriye imbere yiwe nk’ikironge, kandi nk’agashami kava mw ivu rigadutse. Ntiyar’ afise ishusho nziza cank’ igikundiro, kand’ aho twamubona ntiyar’ afise ubgiza bgotumye tumwifuza.
Yarakēngērwa, agahurwa n’abantu; yar’ umunyamibabaro, yar’ azi intimba ic’ ari co; yakēngērwa nk’umuntu abandi bahisha mu maso habo, natwe nta co twamwibajijeko.
N’ukuri n’izacu ntimba yishizeko, n’iyacu mibabaro yikoreye; ariko tweho twamwiyumviriye nk’ uwakubiswe, nk’uwacumiswe n’ Imana, akicurikirizwa n’akabonge.
Yamara yacumitiwe ivyacu bicumuro, yajanjaguriwe ivyacu bigabitanyo: igihano kituronkesha amahoro cabaye kuri we, kand’ imishishagu yiwe ni yo idukiza.
Twese twazimiye nk’intama, twese twagiye isābagire, umuntu wese mu nzira yiwe; Uhoraho amuremēka ukugabitanya kwacu twese.
Yaracuranguzwa, yamar’ akarendeka, ntiyakūrak’ umunwa; nk’ umwagazi w’intama ujanwa mw ibāgiro, canke nk’ukw intama itekerereza imbere y’abayikemura, ni kw atākūyek’ umunwa.
Yakūweho no kugirirwa nabi no gutsindishwa; mu bo mu runganwe rwiwe ni nde yabishizek’ umutima ko yakūwe mw isi y’abakiriho? Ibicumuro vy’abantu banje ni vyo yakubitiwe.
Bāgeze kw ahambga hamwe n’abanyavyaha, asangira imva n’umutunzi mu gupfa kwiwe; nah’ ata kibi yakoze, kand’ ata guhemana kwari mu kanwa kiwe.
Yamar’ Uhoraho yashimye kumujanjagura, yaramubabaje; ah’ azotanga ubugingo bgiwe kw ikimazi co gukūrah’ ivyaha, azobona uruvyaro rwiwe, azoramba, ivyo Uhoraho agomba bizoshitswa neza n’ukuboko kwiwe.
Abonye ibiva mu bise vy’ubugingo bgiwe, bizomuhāza; umushumba wanje agororoka azotuma benshi baheshwa ukugororoka no kumumenya; kand’ azokwishirak’ ukugabitanya kwabo.

Ni co gituma nzomugabanganya umugabane n’ abahambaye, kand’ azogabura iminyago n’abanyenkomezi; kuko yasutse ubugingo bgiwe, akageza ku gupfa, agaharūranwa n’abanyabicumuro: yamar’ ubgiwe yishizekw icaha ca benshi, kand’ asabira abanyabicumuro.
Ririmba, mugore w’ingumba utigeze kuvyara, turika uririmbe usemerere, wewe utigeze kuramukwa: kukw abana b’intābga ari benshi, baruta abana b’ūfise umugabo, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Tāzānura ikibanza c’ihema ryawe, ni bāgure amahema y’ah’ uba; ntugarukize hafi; wungure imigozi yaryo, ushimangire imambo zaryo.
Kuk’ uzogasara, uje i buryo n’i bumoso; kand’ uruvyaro rwawe ruzoganza amahanga, ruzotuma ibisagara vyabaye imisaka bisubira kugerērwa.
Nta co utinya, kuk’ utazotētērwa; ntumāramāre, kukw isoni zitazokwica; kuk’ uzokwibagira isoni wagize mu buto bgawe, n’umugayo wo mu bupfakazi bgawe ntuzowibuka ukundi.
Kuko jewe Umuremyi wawe ari jewe mugabo wawe; Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo ni ryo zina ryanje; Uwera w’Abisirayeli ni jewe Mucunguzi wawe; nzokwitwa Imana y’isi yose.
Kuko jewe Uhoraho nguhamagaye nk’umugore w’intābga afise intuntu mu mutima, ngucūye nk’umugore wo mu bucance yari yarirukanywe, ni jewe Imana yawe mbivuze.
Mbaye ndagutaye akanya gato, ariko nzokwiyegereza ngufitiye imbabazi nyinshi.
Uburake bgāraziririnze, nguhisha inyonga zanje akanya gato, ariko nzokugirira imbabazi z’urukundo rutazoshira, ni jewe Uhoraho Umucunguzi wawe mbivuze.
Ivyo bimmereye nk’ivy’ umwuzure wo mu gihe ca Nowa; nk’ uko narahiye k’umwuzure wo mu gihe ca Nowa utazokwongera kurengera isi, ni ko n’ubu ndahiye ko ntazokurakira ngo ndagutonganye.
Kukw imisozi izovaho, n’uturambi tuzokūrwaho, arik’ ubuntu bganje ntibuzokuvako, kandi n’isezerano ry’amahoro nagusezeraniye ntirizokūrwaho, ni jewe Uhoraho nkugirira ikigongwe mbivuze.
Ewe uhahazwa, ukazungagizwa n’inkūbi y’umuyaga, ntugire ikikuremesha, ehe nzokwubakisha amabuye yitwa simaragido, amatanguriro yawe nzoyubakisha ayitwa safiro.
Iminara yawe nzoyubakisha amabuye atukura, n’ ibirimba vyawe nzovyubakisha amabuye akayangana, kand’ uruzitiro rwawe rwose nzorwubakisha ay’ igiciro.
Abana bawe bose bazokwigishwa nanje, jewe Uhoraho, kand’ amahoro abana bawe bazogira azoba menshi.
Uzoshikamishwa n’ukugororoka; uguhahazwa kuzokuba kure, nta co uzotinya; bo n’ibitera ubgoba, kuko bitazokwēgēra.
Ni hagira abagutera, si jewe nzoba mbagomoye; abazogutera bose bazohindikirana imbere yawe.
Ehe ni jewe ndema umucuzi avuguta umuriro w’amakara, agakūramw’ ico kurwanisha kubg’ ubuhanga bgiwe; ariko kandi naremye umuranduzi wo kugeseza na we.

Nta co kurwanisha bācuriye kukurwanya kizogira ico kimara; kand’ ururimi rwose ruzoguhagurukira kukubūranya, uzorutsinda. Ivyo ni vyo mwandu w’abasavyi banje, jewe Uhoraho, kand’ ukwo ni kwo kugororoka kwabo kwanduruka kuri jewe; ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Yemwe abafise inyota, ni muze ku mazi, kandi n’ūdafise amahera na we n’aze; ni muze mugure, murye: ni mugure vino n’amata, mudatanze amahera cank’ ibiguzi.
N’iki gituma mutanga amahera kugura ibitar’ ivyo kurya nyakuri? N’iki gituma mukorera ibidahāza? Mugire umwete wo kunyumvira, ni ho muzorya ivyiza, ubugingo bganyu bunezererwe ibishashagira.
Mutege amatwi, muze kuri jewe; munyumve, ni ho ubugingo bganyu buzobaho; nanje nzosezerana namwe isezerano ritazoshira, ni ryo mbabazi Dawidi yasezeraniwe zitazovaho.
Rāba, ndamutanze ngw abe icabona co gushingira intahe amahanga, ngw abe n’umukuru na segaba w’amahanga.
Rāba, uzohamagara ihanga utazi, kandi n’iryari ritakuzi rizokwirukirako, kubg’ Uhoraho Imana yawe, no kubg’ Uwera w’Abisirayeli, kukw azoba aguhaye icubahiro.
Ni murondere Uhoraho bigishoboka kw abonwa, ni mumwambaze akiri hafi:
umunyavyaha n’areke inzira yiwe, ūgabitanya areke ivyiyumviro vyiwe: agaruke k’Uhoraho, na we aramugirira ikigongwe, agaruke ku Mana yacu, kukw ikunda guharira.
Kukw ivyiyumviro vyanje atari vyo vyiyumviro vyanyu, kand’ inzira zanyu atari zo nzira zanje, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Mbere nk’ukw ijuru ryītāngūye isi, ni kw inzira zanje zītāngūye inzira zanyu, n’ ivyiyumviro vyanje vyītāngūye ivyiyumviro vyanyu.
Nk’ukw imvura na shelegi bigwa bivuye mw ijuru, ntibisubireyo, ariko bigatosa isi, bigatuma imeza, ikēra, igaha umubivyi imbuto, n’ ūrya ikamuha ivyo kurya;
uko ni kw ijambo ryanje riva mu kanwa kanje rizomera: ntirizogaruka ubusa, ariko rizoshitsa ivyo ngomba, rizosozera ico naritumye.
Muzovayo muri n’umunezero, muzorōngōra amahoro muvayo: imisozi n’uturambi bizoturika biririmbire imbere yanyu, ibiti vyose vyo mw ishamba bizokoma amashi.
Mu gishingo c’umubambangwe hazomera igiti c’umuberoshi, mu c’umukēre hazomera ic’ umuhadasi: bizozanira Uhoraho izina ry’iritāzīrano, ikimenyetso kitazoshira, kitazokūrwaho.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Ni mwitondere ibiroranye, mukore ivy’ ukugororoka: kukw agakiza kanje kagira gashike, n’ ukugororoka kwanje kugira guhishurwe.
Hahirwa umuntu akora ivyo, n’umwana w’umuntu abibangiriza, akaziririza isabato ntayikēngēre, akarinda ukuboko kwiwe ntigukore icaha na kimwe.
Kand’ umunyamahanga yifatanije n’Uhoraho yoye kuvuga, at’ Uhoraho ntazobura kuntandukanya n’abantu biwe; canke n’inkone yoye kuvuga, it’ Erega nd’ igiti cumye.
Kuk’ ukw ari k’ Uhoraho agize ku vy’inkone ziziririza amasabato yiwe, zigahitamw’ ibimunezereza, zikabangiriza isezerano ryiwe,
ati Nzozishirira icibutso mu ngoro yanje no mu rugo rwanje, ndazihe n’izina riruta kugira abahungu n’abakobga; nzoziha izina ritazoshira, ritazokūrwaho.
Kandi n’abanyamahanga bīfatanya nanje Uhoraho kugira ngo bankorere, bakunde izina ryanje, babe abasavyi banje, umuntu wese aziririza isabato ntayikēngēre, akabangiriza isezerano ryanje,

abo na bo nzobashikana ku musozi wanje wera, mbanezereze mu ngoro yanje yo gusengeramwo; ibimazi vyabo vyo kwoswa n’ivyo gukererwa bizokwemerwa ku gicaniro canje: kukw ingoro yanje izokwitwa inzu yo gusengerwamwo n’amahanga yose.
Umwami Imana, umwe akoraniriza hamwe abāri birukanywe bo mu Bisirayeli, aravuze, ati Nzokwongera kumukoraniriza abandi, ukūye abiwe bāri bamaze gukoranywa.
Yemwe bikōko mwese vyo mw ishamba, ni muze mutabagure, namwe bikōko vyose vyo mu kibira.
Abashibamyi biwe n’impumyi, bose nta co bazi; bose ni nk’imbga z’ibiyingiyingi, zitazi gukuga; bararavūta, bararyama, bakunda gusinzira.
Mbere n’imbga z’ ibigunya, zitigera zihāga; kand’ abo bameze bartyo n’abungere! Nta co bashobora gutahura; bose bījaniye inzira zabo ubgabo, umuntu wese yironderera inyungu impande zose.
Bati Ni muze mbazanire vino, twinywere inturire duhimbe. N’ejo na ho bizomera nk’uku, bizonarushiriza.
Umugororotsi arikw araherengetera, kandi nta wubishirak’ umutima; abubaha Imana bariko barakūrwaho, kandi nta wubibabaye. Umugororotsi akūwe mu vyago,
ashitse mu mahoro; umuntu wese muri bo yagendera mu nzira igororotse ashitse mu buruhukiro bgiwe.
Ni mwīgire hino, mwa bana b’umurozikazi, mwa ruvyaro rw’ umusambanyi n’umusambanyikazi.
Uwo mutwenga akāmuhinya ni nde? Uwo muha ibinoko ni nde, mukamucira inyeri? Mbega ntimur’ abana b’ibicumuro, uruvyaro rw’ibinyoma,
abītera gushuha muri mu biti vy’ imyeloni no musi y’igiti cose gitotahaye, mukicira abana mu myonga, no mu bihoro vyo mu bitandara?
Mu nguru ziba mu mwonga ni ho har’ umugabane wawe; izo nyene ni zo mugabane wawe; izo ni zo wūhiye ishikanwa ry’ibiturire, ukaziterekēra. Mbeg’ ivyo novyiyumanganya?
Ku musozi muremure ni ho wubatse uburiri bgawe; kandi ni ho wadūga, ukaja gutanga ibimazi.

Kandi washize icibutso cawe inyuma y’inzugi n’ibishimaryango; kuko wampemukiye, ukiyambikira abandi ubusa; wūrira ku buriri bgawe, urabgagura, wemeranya na bo impēra; wanezererewe kuryamana na bo, ubona ubgambure bgabo.
Washengereye umwami ujanye amavuta atāmirana n’imbazi wagwijije; utuma intumwa zawe kure, urīmanura, urinda ushika i kuzimu.
Wagenze urugendo runini rurakunaniza, yamara ntiwisubiramwo, uti Nta kimazi; urahava uriyungunganya, ni co catumye utihebura.
Mbeg’ uwo watinya ukamugirira ubgoba ni nde, bigatuma ubesha, ntunyibuke, ng’ ubishirek’ umutima? Mbega simmaze igihe kinini ncereje, si co catumye utanyubaha?
Nzoserura ukugororoka kwawe n’ibikorwa vyawe; ariko ntibizogira ico bigufasha.

Ni watakamba, vya bigirwamana warundanije birakurokora! Yamara rer’ umuyaga uzobitwara, impwemu zihumetswe gusa zibikūreho vyose: arik’ ūnyizigira ni we azoganza igihugu, kandi ni we azoragwa umusozi wanje wera.
Kand’ azovuga, ati Ni muharure, ni muharure, mutunganye inzira, mukūre ibitsitaza mu nzira y’abantu banje.

Kuk’ ukw ari kw Imwe iri hejuru isumba vyose igize, iba ahatazoshira, izina ryayo n’Uwera; iti Mba hejuru ahantu hēra, kandi mbana n’ūfise umutima umenetse wicisha bugufi, kugira ngo mpēmbūre imitima y’abicisha bugufi, mpēmbūre n’abafise imitima imenetse.
Kuko ntotongana ibihe vyose, kandi sinokwama ndatse: kukw imitima n’ubugingo naremye vyodendebukirirwa imbere yanje.
Icaha ciwe c’igono ni co candakije ndamukubita, ndihisha, ndaraka: yamar’ ashishikara gukikamira mu nzira ikundwa n’umutima wiwe.
Inzira ziwe narazibonye, kandi nzomukiza; nzomurōngōra, nzoheruka kumwirurana n’abāmuborogera.
Ni jewe ndema ishimwe riva mu minwa. Amahoro, amahoro abe k’ūri kure no k’ūri hafi, nanje nzomukiza, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Arikw abanyakibi bameze nk’ikiyaga gisuriranya; kuko kidashobora guhwekera, kand’ amazi yaco azīkurura isūri n’imyanda.
Nta mahoro ku banyakibi, ni kw Imana yanje igize.
Semerera cane, woye kwigarura; rangurura ijwi ryawe nk’inzamba, ubarire abantu banje ibicumuro vyabo, n’inzu ya Yakobo ivyaha vyabo.

Mugabo bandondera uko bukeye, banezererwa kumenya inzira zanje; nk’ihanga ryakora ivy’ ukugororoka, ntirireke ivyagezwe vy’ Imana yabo, ni ko bansaba ivyagezwe vyo kugororoka, bakanezererwa kwēgēra Imana.

Barabaza, bati Mbeg’ igituma twisonzesha, nturuhe ubibona, ni ku ki? Igituma twibabaza, nawe ukavyirengagiza, ni ku ki? Erega mbiterwa n’uko ku musi wanyu wo kwisonzesha mupfa kwikorera ivyanyu, mugakoresha nabi abakozi banyu bose.
Rāba ico mwisonzeshereza n’amahāne n’ imitongano no gukubitana ibipfunsi vyo kugiriranira nabi; ereg’ ukwisonzesha kwanyu kwo mur’ iyi misi si kwo kwotuma ijwi ryanyu ryumvikana mw ijuru.

Non’ ukwisonzesha nshima, mugira ngo kumeze gurtyo? Mugira ngo n’umusi wo kwibabarizamwo, no kujondamika umutwe nk’urufunzo, no kwisasira amagunira n’umunyota? Mbeg’ ivyo ni vyo mwita kwisonzesha, n’ umusi jewe Uhoraho nnezererwa?

Mbeg’ uku si kwo kwisonzesha nshima? S’ukubohora abantu ingoyi z’ukugiriranira nabi, no guhamburura imigozi abatwazwa igitugu, no kurekura impahazwa ngo zīdegemvye, mukavuna ivy’ ugutwaza igitugu vyose?
Mbega s’ugutanga ivyo kurya vyawe ukagaburira abashonje, ukazana aboro birukanywe ukabashira mu nzu yawe? Wabona ūgenda gusa ukamwambika, ntiwirengagize mwene wanyu?
Maze rer’ umuco wawe uzoca utambika nk’umutwenzi, amagara yawe asubire atotahare vuba; ukugororoka kwawe kuzokuja imbere, kand’ ubgiza bganje buzoba bukwimirije.
Maze ni watabaza, jewe Uhoraho nzokwitaba; ni watakamba, nzovuga, nti Ndi hano. Ni wakūra ugutwaza igitugu hagati muri wewe, no gutūngira abandi urutoke, n’ibiyāgo bibi,
ugahebera umushonji ivyo wari kurya, ugahāza impahazwa: umuco wawe uzorasira mu mwiza, kand’ umwiza wawe uzohinduka nko ku murango w’amashōka;
kandi jewe Uhoraho nzokwama nkurōngōra, nzohāza ubugingo bgawe mu gihe c’ikigatwa, nguhe kunonoka mu magufa yawe; kand’ uzomera nk’indimiro ikwegewemw’ umwuzi, kand’ uzoba nk’isōko y’ amazi idakama.
Kand’ ahār’ imisaka kera hazosubira kwubakwa; bazokwubaka ku matanguriro yariho mu bindi bihe; kand’ uzokwitwa Uwica ibirengero, n’Ūsibūra inzira zija mu ngo.

Ni wakūra ikirenge cawe, ngo ntukandagire isabato, ukareka gukora ivyo wigombeye ku musi wanje wera, arik’ ukita isabato umusi w’umunezero, mber’ umusi wanje wera ukawita uw’ icubahiro, ukawubaha, ntukore ivyo ugomba ubgawe, ntiwironderere gukora ivyawe, ntiwirirwe mu bijandijandi vy’ubusa,

nuk’ uzonnezererwa jewe Uhoraho; nanje nzoguha kugenda ujandagira ku mpinga z’ imisozi yo mu gihugu; kandi nzogutungisha ishamvu ya sogokuruza Yakobo: kukw akanwa kanje, jewe Uhoraho, ari ko kabivuze.
Ehe, ukuboko kw’Uhoraho ntikubaye kugufi ngo kunanirwe gukiza, n’ugutwi kwiwe ntikwapfuye ngo kunanirwe kwumva:
arikw ibigabitanyo vyanyu ni vyo vyabatandukanije n’ Imana yanyu, kand’ ivyaha vyanyu ni vyo vyabakīngiriye mu nyonga hayo, bituma yanka no kwumva.
Kukw amaboko yanyu yandujwe n’amaraso, n’intoke zanyu zandujwe n’ibigabitanyo; iminwa yanyu yama ivuga ibinyoma, n’ururimi rwanyu ruvugira ibibi mu ntamatama.
Nta witwarira uwundi mu buryo buroranye, nta n’ūbūrana ivy’ ukuri; bizigira ibitagira ikimazi, bakavuga ibinyoma; basama inda z’ ukugira nabi, bakavyara ibigabitanyo.
Baberagura amagi y’ imvuvyi, bajisha butangurirwa: ūriye amagi yabo agapfa; wamena irigi, hagaturumbukamw’ imamba.
Ivyo bājishe butangurirwa ntibizovamw’ imyambaro, kandi ntibazoshobora kwipfuka ibikorwa vyabo; ibikorwa vyabo n’ ibikorwa vy’ubugāba, ibikorwa vy’ umuryano biri mu maboko yabo.
Ibirenge vyabo vyirukira gukora ikibi, kandi bihutira kuvisha amaraso y’abatācumuye; ivyiyumviro vyabo n’ivyiyumviro vy’ubugāba; kugeseza no guhonnya biri mu nzira zabo.
Inzira y’amahoro ntibayizi; mu ngendo zabo ntihabamw’ ibiroranye: bītoboreye inzira z’ibigoramange; ūzicamwo wese ntamenya amahoro.
Ni co gituma ibiroranye biri kure yacu, kandi n’ukugororoka ntikudushikīra; twitega umuco tukabona umwiza; twitega ahakemutse tukagenda mu muzitanya.
Dukabakaba ku nzu nk’impumyi, ni koko dukabakaba nk’abatagira amaso; ku murango w’amashōka dutsitara nko mu kajoro; mu bagikomeye tumeze nk’abapfuye.
Twese twivuga nk’igikōko citwa idubu, tukaniha nk’inuma iguguza; twitega ibiroranye, ariko nta vyo; twitega agakiza, ariko kakaba kure yacu.
Kukw ibicumuro vyacu vyagwiriranye imbere yawe, kand’ ivyaha vyacu ari vyo bitwagiriza: kukw ibicumuro vyacu turi kumwe, kandi n’ibigabitanyo vyacu na vyo turabizi;
turacumura kandi twihakana Uhoraho, duta inzira tukareka gukurikira Imana yacu, tukavuga ivy’ agahahazo n’ubugarariji; dusama inda y’ ibinyoma, tukabivuga biturutse mu mutima.
Ibiroranye vyashubijwe inyuma, n’ukugororoka guhagaze kure; kuk’ ukuri kwatemvye mu nzira, kand’ ubgeranda ntibushobora gushika.
Ni koko, ukuri kurakamanganye; kand’ ūhunze ibibi aba yinyagishije. Uhoraho yarabibonye, biramubabaza, kukw ata biroranye biriho.
Kand’ abona yukw ata muntu ariho, atangazwa n’ukw ata wo kubahagarikira; ni co catumye ukwiwe kuboko ari kwo yizanishirije agakiza, kand’ ukugororoka kwiwe ni kwo yishimikije.
Yambara ukugororoka nk’icuma gikīngira igikiriza, no ku mutwe inkofero y’agakiza; yambara impuzu zo guhōra ngo zimubere imyambaro, yiyambika ishaka nk’umutamana.
Azobasubiriza mu nkōko ibihwanye n’ ivyo bakoze; abarwanizi biwe abasubize uburake, n’abansi biwe abīhōre, kandi n’ababa ku kiyaga azobasubiza inyishu.
Ni ho bazokwubaha izina ry’Uhoraho, uhereye i burengerazuba, n’icubahiro ciwe uhereye iyo rirasira: kukw azoza nk’uruzi rusēnyerana, rukubebga n’impwemu z’Uhoraho.
Kand’ umucunguzi azoza i Siyoni, ku bo mu ba Yakobo bateye ibitugu ibicumuro, ni k’ Uhoraho agize.

Nanje ngiri isezerano nsezeranye na bo, ni k’Uhoraho agize: impwemu yanje iri kuri wewe, n’amajambo yanje nshize mu kanwa kawe, ntibizova mu kanwa kawe, canke mu kanwa k’abuzukuru bawe, canke mu kanwa k’abuzukuruza bawe, uhereye none ugashitsa ibihe bidashira, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Haguruka ukayangane, kuk’ umuco wawe ushitse, kand’ ubgiza bg’Uhoraho bukaba bukurasiye.
Kuko rāba, umwiza uzotwikira isi, umwiza w’umuzitanya uzotwikira amahanga: arik’ Uhoraho azokurasira, kand’ ubgiza bgiwe buzokubonekako.
Amahanga azoza ku muco wawe, n’abami bazoza ku gukayangana kwawe.
Unamura amaso yawe weraguze, urābe, bose bakoraniye hamwe baza kuri wewe; abahungu bawe bazoza baturutse kure, n’ abakobga bawe bazoza bateruwe mu kwaha.
Ni ho uzorāba, mu maso hawe hakeyuka, umutima wawe ukadidagizwa n’umunezero, ukāguka; kukw ibidandazwa vy’ibitayega bica mu kiyaga bizogaruka i wawe, n’ubutunzi bg’ amahanga buzokuzako.
Isinzi ry’ingamiya rizogutwikira, inyana z’ingamiya z’i Midiyani n’izo muri Efa. Abaturutse i Sheba bose bazoza, bazoba bazanye izahabu n’imibavu, bavuge inkuru nziza z’ishimwe ry’Uhoraho.
Imikuku yose y’i Kedari izokoranirizwa kuri wewe, amapfizi y’intama y’i Nebayoti azogukorera; azokwūrira igicaniro canje yemerwe, nzokwubahiriza inzu yanje y’icubahiro.
Aba ni ba nde baguruka nk’igicu, kandi nk’ inuma zisubira mu turyango tw’ ivyari vyazo?

N’ababa ku kiyaga banyiteze, amāto y’i Tarushishi ni yo abītangiye imbere, azanye abahungu bawe abakūye kure, bazanye ifeza zabo n’ izahabu kubg’ izina ryanje, jewe Uhoraho Imana yawe, Uwera w’Abisirayeli, kuko nakwubahirije.
Abanyamahanga bazokwubaka inzitiro zawe, n’abami babo bazogukorera; kuko nagukubise ndatse, ariko nkugiriye imbabazi ndagutunze.
Amarembo yawe azokwama yuguruye, ntazokwugarirwa ku murango canke mw ijoro, kugira ngw abantu bakuzanire ubutunzi bg’amahanga, bo n’abami bayo babashoreye.
Kukw ihanga n’ubgami bitazokwemera kugukorera bizohona; ni koko ayo mahanga azogesezwa rwose.
Ubgiza bg’i Lebanoni buzokuzako, ibiti vy’amasederi n’ ivy’ imitidari n’ivy’ imiteyashuri bizozira hamwe, kugira ngo bisharize ahēra hanje, kand’ aho nshira ibirenge vyanje nzohubahiriza:
abahungu b’abāguhahaza bazoza bakubite inkoro hasi imbere yawe, n’abāgukēngēra bīkubite imbere y’ibirenge vyawe, bakwite Umurwa w’Uhoraho, Siyoni h’Uwera w’Abisirayeli.
Naho wahebge, ukankwa, ntihabe hakigira ūhita muri wewe, nzoguhindura ubgiza bginshi butazoshira, ube umunezero uk’ urunganwe rwawe ruzogenda rukurikirana.
Kand’ uzokwonka amaberebere y’amahanga, uzokwonka amabere y’abami, kand’ uzomenya yuko jewe, Uhoraho, nd’ Umukiza wawe n’ Umucunguzi wawe, Inyenkomezi ya Yakobo.

Mu gishingo c’imiringa nzozana izahabu, no mu gishingo c’ivyuma nzozana ifeza; nzane imiringa mu gishingo c’ibiti, n’ ivyuma mu gishingo c’amabuye; nzokwimika amahoro abe ari yo akuganza, n’ukugororoka abe ari kwo kugutwara.
Umuryano ntuzokwumvikana ukundi mu gihugu cawe, bo n’ukugeseza n’ ugutikiza mu ngabano zawe; arikw inzitiro zawe uzozīta Gakiza, n’amarembo yawe uzoyīta Mpundu.
Izuba si ryo rizoba rikikubera umuco ku murango, cank’ ukwezi ngo kukuboneshereze: ariko jewe Uhoraho ni jewe nzokubera umuco utazoshira, kandi jewe Imana yawe ni jewe nzokubera icubahiro.
Izuba ryawe ntirizoba rikirenga, kand’ ukwezi kwawe ntikuzoba kugikeha, kuko jewe Uhoraho nzokubera umuco utazoshira, kand’ imisi y’ikigandaro cawe izoba ishize.
Abantu bawe bazoba abagororotsi bose, bazoba ben’ igihugu bgite gushitsa ibihe vyose; bazoba umuvyaro nitereye, igikorwa c’intoke zanje, kugira ngo bintere icubahiro.
Inkēngērwa izovamw’ igihumbi, kandi nyarucari azoba ihanga rikomeye. Jewe Uhoraho nzobishitsa n’ingoga, igihe cavyo kigeze.

Mpwemu w’Umwami Uhoraho ari kuri jewe, kuk’ Uhoraho yandobanuje amavuta ngo mbgire abaciye bugufi ubutumwa bgiza; yantumye gutubika imitima imenetse, no kumenyesha abarindwa ko barekuwe, n’imbohe ko zugururiwe;
ngo mmenyeshe abantu umwaka wo kwemererwamwo n’Uhoraho, n’ umusi wo kwīhōra w’Imana yacu; ngo nirure abagandaye bose,

ngo nshirireh’ abagandaye i Siyoni igitsibo mu gishingo c’umunyota, ndabahe n’amavuta y’akaneza mu gishingo c’ukugandara, n’umwambaro wo guhimbaza mu gishingo c’umutima uhondobereye; kugira ngo baze bitwe ibiti vy’ukugororoka, imyeloni yatewe n’ Uhoraho, ngo bimutere icubahiro.
Nuko bazokwubaka ahār’ imisaka kera, bahagarike ahāsanganguwe ubga mbere, kandi bazosubira kuvyura ibisagara vyāsenyutse, ivyāmaze ibihe vyinshi ar’ imisaka.
Abanyamahanga bazohagarara ngaho babaragirire imikuku, kand’ abanyamahanga ni bo bazokora mu mirima yanyu no mu nzabibu zanyu.
Ariko mweho muzokwitwa abaherezi b’Uhoraho, abantu bazobita abasavyi b’Imana yacu: muzorya itunga ry’abanyamahanga, ivyār’ icubahiro cabo ni mwebge muzovyirata.
Kubg’ ukumāramāra kwanyu muzoshumbushwa kabiri; mu gishingo co gutētērwa muzonezererwa umugabane wanyu: ni co gituma mu gihugu canyu muzoshumbushwa kabiri, mugire umunezero utazoshira.
Kuko jewe Uhoraho nkunda ibiroranye, nanka ubgambuzi n’ibigabitanyo; kandi nzobashumbusha ibikwiranye n’ukuri kwanje, nzosezerana namwe isezerano ritazoshira.
Abazobakomokako bazomenyekana mu mahanga, n’uruvyaro rwanyu mu bandi bantu: abazobabona bose bazobemera yukw ar’ ihanga jewe Uhoraho mpaye umugisha.

Nzonezererwa cane Uhoraho, umutima wanje uvugirize impundu Imana yanje; kuko yanyambitse imyambaro y’agakiza, akansēsa hejuru umutamana w’ubugororotsi, nk’uk’ umukwe ashazisha igitsibo, kandi nk’uk’ umugeni ashazisha utugenegene twiwe.
Nk’ukw isi ibaduka ibimeze, n’ indimiro imeza ivyayitewemwo, uko ni k’Umwami Uhoraho azomeza ukugororoka n’ishimwe imbere y’amahanga yose.
Kubga Siyoni sinzocereza, no kubga Yerusalemu sinzoruhuka, gushitsa ah’ ugutsinda kwaho kuzoserukira nk’umuco, n’ agakiza kaho kakamera nk’itara ryaka.
Nukw amahanga azobona ugutsinda kwawe, n’abami bose bazobona icubahiro cawe; maz’ uzokwitwa izina risha, wiswe n’akanwa k’Uhoraho.
Kand’ uzoba igitsibo c’ubgiza mu kuboko kw’Uhoraho, n’umugāra w’ ubgami mu kuboko kw’Imana yawe.
Ntuzosubira kwitwa Ntabga, n’igihugu cawe ntikizosubira kwitwa Misaka; arik’ uzokwitwa Nkundwakazi, n’igihugu cawe kizokwitwa Uwābiriwe; kuk’ Uhoraho agukundwakaje, kand’ igihugu cawe kizokwābīrwa.
Nk’uk’ umusore arongora inkumi, ni kw abakubamwo bazokurongora, ewe Yerusalemu; kandi nk’uk’ umukwe anezererwa umugeni, ni kw Imana yawe izokunezererwa.
Ewe Yerusalemu, nshize abashibamyi hejuru ku nzitiro zawe z’amabuye; nta ho bazocereza ku murango no mw ijoro; yemwe abibutsa Uhoraho ntimukaruhuke,
kandi na we ntimwemere kw aruhuka, gushitsa ah’ azovyurira Yerusalemu, akahahindura ishimwe mw isi.
Uhoraho yarahije ukuboko kwiwe kw’i buryo, ukuboko kw’inkomezi ziwe, ati N’ukuri sinzokwongera guha abansi bawe amasaka yawe ngo bayarye, kand’ abanyamahanga ntibazokunywera vino wacumukuriye;
arikw abazoyimbura ni bo bazoyarya, banshime jewe Uhoraho, kand’ abazoyamura ni bo bazoyinywa, mu ntangaro y’ ahēra hanje.
Ni murenge, ni murenge amarembo; mutunganirize abantu inzira; muharure, muharure inzira y’iroro, muyikūremw’ amabuye; mushingire amoko ibendera.
Rāba, Uhoraho yabariye abo ku mpera y’isi, ati Ni mubgire umukobga w’i Siyoni, muti Rāba, agakiza kawe karaje; rāba, araje azanye impēra, kand’ inyishu yiwe ir’imbere yiwe.
Kandi bazobita Ihanga ryera, Abācunguwe n’Uhoraho; kand’ uzokwitwa Ahārondewe, Umurwa utāhebge.
Uriya ni nde aturutse muri Edomu, i Bosira, yambaye imyambaro y’agahama, yambaye impuzu zikayangana, araramanga ari n’inkomezi nyinshi? Ni jewe mvuga mu bugororotsi, umunyabushobozi bgo gukiza.
N’iki gitumye impuzu zawe ziba agatuku, n’imyambaro yawe igasa n’iy’ ūganisha ibirenge vino mu bgato?

Nīganishije mu bgato nd’umwe; mu bantu bo mu mahanga yose nta n’umwe twari kumwe; n’ukuri nabaganishije ibirenge mu burake bganje, mbanyukuza ubushangashirwe bganje; kand’ amaraso yabo yatarukiye ku myambaro yanje, impuzu zanje zose zirayoberana.
Kuko nari narashinze mu mutima umusi wo kwīhōra, kand’ umwaka wo gucungura abantu banje urashitse.
Narēraguje, mbona nta wutabaye; ntangazwa n’ukw ata wo kundwanira; ni co catumye ukwanje kuboko ari kwo nitabarishije, kand’ ubushangashirwe bganje ni bgo bgampagarikiye.
Nanyukuje amahanga uburake bganje, mbamenaguza ubushangashirwe bganje, mpondoganiriza amaraso yabo kw isi.

Nzokwamamaza ukugira neza kw’Uhoraho n’ishimwe ryiwe, nk’ ukw ivyo Uhoraho yatugiriye vyose bingana; mvuge n’ivyiza vyinshi yagiriye inzu ya Isirayeli, nk’ukw imbabazi ziwe ziri, kandi nk’uk’ ukugira neza kwiwe kwinshi kungana.
Kuko yavuze, ati N’ukuri n’abantu banje, abana batogunga; nuko rer’ ababera Umukiza.

Yababaranye na bo mu mibabaro yabo yose, kand’ umumarayika yama ahagaze mu nyonga ziwe yarabakiza: urukundo rwiwe n’ikigongwe ciwe ni vyo vyamuteye kubacungura; yarabaterura akabaheka imisi yose ya kera.
Ariko baragarariza, bababaza Mpwemu wiwe yera; bituma ahinduka umwansi wabo, ubgiwe arwana na bo.
Maz’ abantu biwe bibuka ibihe vya kera n’ivya Mose, bat’ Uwabadūgananye n’umwungere w’intama ziwe abakūye mu kiyaga ari hehe? Uwashize Mpwemu wiwe yera hagati muri bo ari hehe?
Ni nde yatumye ukuboko kwiwe kw’ icubahiro kugendera ku ruhande rw’i buryo bga Mose? Ni nde yatandukanije amazi imbere yabo, akīhesha izina ritazoshira?
Ni nde yabacishije ahār’ i bgina, nk’ah’ ar’ ifarasi ica mu bugaragwa, ntibatsitare?
Nk’ ukw inka zishōka ku mwonga, ni ko Mpwemu w’Uhoraho yabaruhura; uko ni ko warōngōye abantu bawe, kugira ngo wiheshe izina ry’icubahiro.

Tereza inyonga hasi uri mw ijuru, witegereze ur’ i wawe, ah’ ukwera kwawe n’icubahiro cawe biri: rya shaka ryawe n’ibikorwa vyawe vy’ubushobozi biri hehe? Igishika n’imbabazi umfitiye ko bibujijwe kunshikīra!
Kuko wewe uri Data wa twese, naho Aburahamu atatuzi, kandi na Isirayeli ntatwemere: wewe ubgawe, Uhoraho, ni wewe Data; Umucunguzi wacu ni ryo zina ryawe uhereye kera hose.
Ewe Uhoraho, n’iki gituma utuzimiza inzira zawe, ugakomantaza imitima yacu ntitukwubahe? Garuka kubg’ abasavyi bawe, imiryango y’ishamvu yawe.
Abantu bawe bera bāhaganje igihe gito gusa; abarwanizi bacu bāsiribanze ahantu hawe hēra.
Twahindutse nk’abatigeze kuganzwa nawe, nk’abatigeze kwitirirwa izina ryawe.
Icompa ugasatura ijuru ukamanuka, imisozi igahindira agashitsi imbere yawe,
bikaba nk’uk’ umuriro ufata inyabara, kandi nk’uk’ umuriro ubiza amazi: kugira ngw izina ryawe rimenyekane mu bansi bawe, amahanga ahindire agashitsi imbere yawe.
Aho wakora ibiteye ubgoba tutīteze, waramanutse, imisozi ihindira agashitsi imbere yawe.
Kuk’ uhereye kera hose ata ho abantu bīgeze kwumva, canke ngo bibagwe mu matwi, canke ngo baboneshe amaso iyindi mana igira ico imarira abayīteze atari wewe.
Usanganira ūnezererwa gukora ivy’ ukugororoka, n’abagendera mu nzira zawe bakwibuka; ariko wararatse, kuko twakoze ivyaha, mbere tubimazemw’ igihe kirekire; mbega, none twoba tugikizwa?
Kuko twese twahindutse nk’ibihumane, kand’ ukugororoka kwacu kwose kumeze nk’impuzu yanduye; twese dukabiranye nk’ikibabi, kand’ ibigabitanyo vyacu bidukubeba nk’ umuyaga.
Kandi nta n’umwe yambaza izina ryawe, nta wuruha yinanata ngo yimatanye nawe; kuko waduhishije mu nyonga hawe, ukaduhebera mu bigabitanyo vyacu.
Ariko noneho, Uhoraho, uri Data wa twese; tur’ ibumba, nawe ur’ umubumvyi wacu; twese tur’ igikorwa c’ intoke zawe.
Uhoraho, reka kuraka cane birenze urugero, ntiwame wibuka ibigabitanyo vyacu ibihe vyose; ni witegereze se turakwinginze, twese tur’ abantu bawe.
Ibisagara vyawe vyera vyacitse ubugaragwa, i Siyoni hacitse ubugaragwa, i Yerusalemu hacitse amatongo.
Inzu yacu yera nziza, iyo ba sogokuruza bacu bāguhimbarizamwo, yaraturiwe; n’ ibintu vyacu vyose vyāduhimbara vyārononekaye.
Ewe Uhoraho, mbeg’ uzokwiyumanganya, kandi bimeze birtyo? Upfe kwiyumya, kand’ utubabaje birengeje urugero?
Nabaririkijwe n’abatānyibaza; nabonywe n’abatāndondeye; nabariye ihanga ritāmbaje izina ryanje, nt’ Ehe rāba, ndi hano.
Nirirwa ntegeye amaboko ihanga rigarariza, bagendera mu nzira zitari nziza, bakurikira ivyabo vyiyumviro.
N’abantu bahora banshinyaguriza imbonankubone, bagatangira ibimazi mu bigabiro, bakosereza imibavu ku bicaniro vyubakishijwe amatafari;
bakicara hagati y’imva, bakarāra mu bitabo ahihishije; bakarya inyama z’ingurube, kandi mu nzavya zabo hakabamw’ umufa w’inyama z’ibizira;
bakavuga, bati Hagarara ukwawe, ntunyegēre, kuko jewe nkurusha kuba uwejejwe. Ben’ abo bambera umwotsi wo mu mazuru, n’umuriro wīriza umusi waka.
Eh’ ivyo biranditswe imbere yanje, sinzohora, ariko nzobibasubizako, mbere nzobasubiriza mu nkōko.

Ibigabitanyo vyanyu ubganyu, ni k’ Uhoraho agize, nzobibasubirizakw icarimwe n’ibigabitanyo vya ba sogokuruza banyu, bosereza imibavu ku misozi, bakantukira ku turambi: ni co gituma nzobasubiriza mu nkōko ibikwiranye n’ ibikorwa vyabo.

Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Nk’ukw ihando ry’umuzabibu riboneka ko ririmw’ umutobe, bakavuga, bati Ntuwurandure, kuk’ ugifise ikimazi, uko ni ko nanje nzogira, kubg’ abasavyi banje, noye kubarandura bose.
Nzokwironkera uruvyaro muri Yakobo, n’ūzoragwa imisozi yanje muri Yuda; abo nitoranirije bazoharagwa, n’abasavyi banje bazohaba.
Maz’ i Sharoni hazoba icanya c’intama, kand’ ikiyaya c’i Akori kizoba ivyagiro ry’ inka, n’uburuhukiro bg’abantu banje bandondeye.
Ariko mwebge abantaye jewe Uhoraho, mukibagira umusozi wanje wera, mugatereka Gadi, mugaturiraniriza Meni;
nanje nzobashirirah’ inkota, mwese muzokwunamira kwicwa: kukw igihe nahamagara mutitavye, n’igihe navuga mutumvise; ariko mugakora ivyo mbona kw ari bibi, mukitoraniriza ibitannezera.

Nuko rero, uku ni k’Uhoraho Imana agize, ati Rāba, abasavyi banje bazorya, ariko mweho muzokwicwa n’inzara; abasavyi banje bazonywa, ariko mweho muzokwicwa n’inyota; abasavyi banje bazonezerwa, ariko mweho muzomāramāra:
rāba, abasavyi banje bazoririmbishwa n’ umunezero wo mu mitima, ariko mweho muzorizwa n’intuntu yo mu mitima, muborozwe n’ukw imitima yanyu isābijwe n’umubabaro.
Kand’ izina ryanyu muzorisigarana abo nitoranirije, barigire umuvumo, bat’ Urakicwa n’Uhoraho Imana! Maz’ abasavyi banje bazokwitwa irindi zina.
Nuk’ uwo mu gihugu yisabīra umugisha n’awusabe Imana y’ukuri, kand’ uwo mu gihugu arahira, n’arahire Imana y’ukuri; kukw amagorwa ya mbere yibagiranye, agahishwa inyonga zanje.
Kuko rāba, ndarema ijuru risha n’isi nsha; ivya mbere ntibizokwibukwa, kandi ntibizoruha vyiyumvirwa.
Ariko munezerwe, muze muhore muhimbawe n’ivyo ndema; kuko rāba, ndema Yerusalemu ngo mpagire umunezero, n’abantu baho ngo ndabagire akanyamuneza.
Kandi nzohimbarwa n’i Yerusalemu, nnezerwe n’abantu banje: kand’ ijwi ryo kurira ntirizohumvikana ukundi, cank’ ijwi ryo kuboroga.
Ntihazokwongera kubamw’ abapfa bakir’ inzoya, cank’ umutāma adasozereye imyaka yiwe; kuk’ umwana azopfa amaze imyaka ijana, kand’ ūkenyutse ntashitse ijana azoba yavumwe.
Bazokwubaka amazu bayīberemwo, kandi bazotera uruzabibu, bīrīre inzabibu zarwo.

Ntibazokwubaka ngw abandi binjire; ntibazorima ngw abandi babirye: kuko nk’ukw imyaka y’igiti ingana ari kw abantu banje bazoramba, kand’ abo nitoranirije bazoshitsa igihe kirekire banezererwa igikorwa c’amaboko yabo.
Ntibazoruhira ubusa, kandi ntibazovyara abo kugesezwa, kuko bazoba ar’ uruvyaro jewe Uhoraho nahezagiye, bo n’abazobakomokako.
Maze batarampamagara nzobitaba, kandi bakivuga nzokwumva.

Ibingira n’umwagazi w’intama bizorīshanya; intambge izorīsha ubgatsi nk’inka; kand’ umukungugu ni wo uzoba ivyo kurya vy’inzoka. Ntibizoryana canke ngo bigire ico vyica ku musozi wanje wera iy’ uva ukagera, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Ijuru ni ryo ntebe yanje y’ubgami, isi na yo n’indava y’ ibirenge vyanje: muzonyubakira inzu ki, kandi n’ahantu ki hombera uburuhukiro?

Kukw ivyo vyose intoke zanje ari zo zabiremye, bikabaho vyose, ni k’ Uhoraho agize; arik’ umuntu w’impahazwa afise umutima umenetse, agahindishwa agashitsi n’ ijambo ryanje, uwo ni we nzohozakw ijisho.

Ūkerera inka, ahwanye n’uwica umuntu; ūtanga umwagazi w’ intama kw ikimazi, ahwanye n’ ūvuna imbga izosi; ūshikana ishikanwa ry’amafu, ahwanye n’ ūzanye amaraso y’ingurube; uwosa imibavu, ahwanye n’ūhezagira ikigirwamana. N’ukuri koko bitoranirije inzira zabo ubgabo, imitima yabo ihimbarwa n’ ibizira vyabo vy’ubuyobe.
None nanje nzobatoraniriza amagorwa, mbatēze ibibatera ubgoba; kukw aho nahamagara ata witavye, aho navuga ntibumve, ariko bagakora ivyo mbona kw ari bibi, bagahitamw’ ivyo nanka.

Ni mwumve ijambo ry’Uhoraho, yemwe abahindishwa agashitsi n’ijambo ryiwe: ati Bene wanyu babanka, bakabaca babahoye izina ryanje, bāravuze ng’ Uhoraho n’agaragaze icubahiro ciwe, turābe umunezero wanyu! Ariko bo bazomāramāra.
Umve urwānāga rwumvikana ku murwa, ruturutse mu rusengero! N’Uhoraho asubiriza abansi biwe mu nkōko.
Siyoni hatararamukwa haravyara, ibise bitaraza havyara umwana w’umuhungu.
Ni nde yigeze kwumva ibimeze birtyo? Ni nde yigeze kubona ibisa birtyo? Mbeg’ igihugu covukira umusi umwe? Ihanga ryovyarirwa icarimwe? Ariko Siyoni ho habaye hakiramukwa haca havyara abana.
Mbega notuma baramukwa, sintume bavyara? ni k’Uhoraho abaza; kw ari jewe ntuma bavyara, nobaboheramw’ inda? ni kw Imana yawe ibaza.
Munezeranwe n’i Yerusalemu, muhimbarwe kubgaho, yemwe abahakunda mwese; munezeranwe na ho akanyamuneza, yemwe abāharirira mwese:
kugira ngo mwonke, muhāge amaberebere y’ibihahūmuriza, mugutanye munezererwe icubahiro caho c’umureto.

Kuk’ ukw ari k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Ehe nzohasendanishiriza amahoro ameze nk’uruzi, n’ubgiza bg’amahanga bumeze nk’umugezi usebereye; ivyo ni vyo muzokwonka, muzoshirwa mu kwaha, musimbagirizwe ku bibero.
Nk’uk’ umwana ahūmurizwa na nyina ni ko nzobahūmuriza; kandi muzohūmuririzwa i Yerusalemu.
Muzobibona, kand’ imitima yanyu izonezerwa, n’amagufa yanyu azototahara nk’ubgatsi bubisi, kand’ ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho kuzomenyekana mu basavyi biwe, kand’ azorakira abansi biwe.
Kuk’ Uhoraho azozanana n’ umuriro, kand’ imikogote yiwe izoba imeze nk’agashururu; kugira ngo yīmarishe ishavu uburake bg’inkazi, abahanishe imbeya z’ umuriro.
Kuk’ Uhoraho azocira abantu bose amateka, ayacishe umuriro n’inkota yiwe, kand’ abazokwicwa n’Uhoraho bazoba ari benshi.
Abiyeza bakiyuhagira kugira ngo baje mu bigabiro barōngōye, abarya inyama z’ ingurube n’iz’ ivyikwega hasi n’ imbeba, abo bose bazoshirira icarimwe, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Kuko nzi ibikorwa vyabo n’ ivyiyumviro vyabo. Igihe kigiye kuza nzokoranya amahanga yose n’ab’ indimi zose; bazoza babone ubgiza bganje.

Kandi nzoshira ikimenyetso muri bo, abarokotse muri bo nzobatuma mu mahanga, i Tarushishi n’i Puli n’i Ludi mu bafozi b’imiheto, n’i Tubali n’i Yavani, mu baba ku kiyaga kure, aho bataribgumve ko ndi rurangiranwa, ntibabone n’icubahiro canje; maze bazokwīgānira amahanga icubahiro canje.

Nuko bazozana bene wanyu bose babakūye mu mahanga yose kw ishikanwa ryanje Uhoraho, bazoza bagendera ku mafarasi no mu mikogote ikwegwa na yo, no mu nderuzo no ku nyumbu no ku ngamiya, bashike ku musozi wanje wera Yerusalemu, ni k’Uhoraho agize; bizoba nk’ ukw Abisirayeli bahora bazana amashikanwa yabo mu nzu yanje Uhoraho, bayazanye mu bintu bitunganye.
Kandi nzorobanuramwo bamwe mbagire abaherezi n’Abalewi, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Kuko nk’ukw ijuru risha n’isi nsha, ivyo nzorema, bizohorah’ imbere yanje, ni k’ uruvyaro rwawe n’izina ryawe bizohoraho, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Igihe kizoza uhereye mu mboneko z’ukwezi ukageza mu mboneko z’ukundi, no guhēra kw isabato ukageza ku yindi, abantu bose bazohora baza gusenga imbere yanje, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Nuko bazosohoka baje kwitegereza imivyimba y’abangararije; kukw inyo zabo zitazopfa, kandi n’umuriro wabo ntuzime; kandi bazotera abantu bose ishishi.
Amajambo ya Yeremiya mwene Hilukiya, wo mu baherezi bāba muri Anatoti mu ntāra ya Benyamini.
Ijambo ry’Uhoraho riza kuri we mu mwaka ugira icumi na gatatu Yosiya mwene Amoni, umwami w’i Buyuda, ari ku ngoma.

Kandi ryongera kuza no ku ngoma ya Yehoyakimu mwene Yosiya, umwami w’i Buyuda, gushitsa no kw iherezo ry’umwaka ugira icumi na rimwe Zedekiya mwene Yosiya, umwami w’i Buyuda, ari ku ngoma; rishitsa n’igihe ab’ i Yerusalemu bājanywe kw inyagano mu kwezi kwa gatanu.
Nukw ijambo ry’Uhoraho rinzako,
riti Ntarakubumbira mu nda nari ndakuzi, kand’ utarava muri yo nari narakurobanuye; nagushizeho kuba ūvugishwa nanje mu mahanga.
Maze ndavuga, nti Yō, erega Mwami Uhoraho, sinzi kuvuga, kuko nkiri muto.
Arik’ Uhoraho arambarira, ati Nta co uvuga, ngo Ndacari muto; kuk’ uwo nzogutumako wese ari we uzojako, kand’ ico nzokubarira cose akaba ari co ukwiye kuvuga.
Ntuz’ ugire ubgoba kubgabo, kuko nzoba ndi kumwe nawe ngo nkurokore, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Maz’ Uhoraho arāmvura ukuboko ankora ku munwa; Uhoraho arambarira, at’ Ehe nshize amajambo yanje mu kanwa kawe.
Rāba uyu musi ngushizeho kugira ubushobozi ku mahanga no ku bihugu vy’abami, bgo kurandura no gusangangura, guhonnya no gukomvomvora, bo n’ukwubaka no guteragira.
Maz’ ijambo ry’Uhoraho rinzako, rirambaza, rit’ Ubonye iki ga Yeremiya? Ndavuga, nti Mbona ishami ry’umurinzi.
Maz’ Uhoraho aranyishura, ati Witegereje neza: kuko ndinda ijambo ryanje kugira ngo ndarishitse.
Maz’ ijambo ry’Uhoraho rinzako ubugira kabiri, rit’ Ubonye iki? Ndavuga, nti Mbona inkono ibiragira; kand’ umuhuro w’imbere werekeye i burārūko.
Nuk’ Uhoraho arambarira, at’ I burārūko hazoturuka ivyago bizoza biziye ababa mu gihugu bose.

Kuko rāba, nzohamagara imiryango yose yo mu bihugu vy’abami b’i burārūko, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze; bazoza, umuntu wese ashinge intebe yiwe y’ubgami mw ishikiro ku marembo y’i Yerusalemu, ahaherereye ku nzitiro zaho zose zihazitiriye, n’ahaherereye ku bisagara vyose vy’i Buyuda.
Nanje nzokwātamīra amateka mbaciriye kubg’ ibibi vyabo vyose bākoze; kuko bāndetse, bakosereza imibavu izindi mana, bagasenga ivyakozwe n’intoke zabo.
None rero wewe va hasi ukenyere, ubabgire ivyo nkubarira vyose: ntuhindishwe agashitsi na bo, kugira ngo noye kuzoguhindishiriza agashitsi imbere yabo.

Kuko rāba, uyu musi nguhinduye igisagara cubakiwe inzitiro, nguhinduye n’inkingi y’icuma n’inzitiro z’imiringa, bitazotsindwa n’igihugu cose, canke n’abami b’i Buyuda, canke n’abaganwa baho, canke n’abaherezi baho, canke n’abantu bo mu gihugu.
Bazokurwanya, ariko ntibazokunesha, kuko nzoba ndi kumwe nawe ngo nkurokore, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Ijambo ry’Uhoraho rinzako,

riti Genda usemererere mu matwi y’ab’ i Yerusalemu, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Nibuka urukundo rwo mu buto bgawe, n’ukuntu wannogera ukir’ umugeni; ukuntu wankurikiye mu bugaragwa, no mu gihugu kitigeze kubibgamw’ imbuto.
Isirayeli yar’ uwo nirobanuriye, jewe Uhoraho, yar’ umushuzo mu bikikimvye vyanje. Abazomurya bose bazobakw igicumuro; ivyago bizobazako, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Ni mwumve ijambo ry’Uhoraho, mwebge nzu ya Yakobo, namwe miryango yose y’inzu ya Isirayeli;
uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati N’ibigabitanyo ki ba sogokuruza banyu bānsanganye, ko bāngiye kure, bagakurikira ibitagira ikimazi, na bo ubgabo bagahinduka imburakimazi?

Ko batārushe bībaza, bat’ Uhoraho ari hehe, yadukūye mu gihugu ca Egiputa, akaturōngōra mu bugaragwa, no mu gihugu c’ubgeranyange kirimw’ ivyobo, mu gihugu kigadutse c’igitūtu c’urupfu, mu gihugu kidacamw’ abantu, ata muntu n’umwe ahaba?
Ushime nabashikanye mu gihugu cama kirumbuka, ngo murye ivyo cera n’ivyiza vyaco; ariko mumaze kucinjira mwāhumanije igihugu canje, muhindura umwandu wanje ikizira.

Abaherezi ntibārushe bībaza, bat’ Uhoraho ari hehe? N’abafise ibango ry’ivyagezwe ntibāmmenye; abaragiye igihugu bārancumuyeko, kand’ abo nari kuvugisha basigaye bavugishwa na Bayali, bakurikira ibitagira ikimazi.
Ni co gitumye nzokomeza kubūrana namwe, kandi nzobūrana n’abuzukuru banyu, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Enda ni mujabuke ku bizinga vy’i Kitimu, murābe; mutume i Kedari, mwitegereze mushirutse umwete; murābe ko higeze kuboneka ikintu nk’iki.
Mbega harih’ ihanga ryigeze gukāba imana zaryo, nah’ atar’ imana nya mana? Arikw abantu banje bo, icubahiro cabo bāgikāvye ibitagira ikimazi.
Ni mwumirwe, mwa majuru mwe, muje mu gatengo, mujorerwe, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze;
kukw abantu banje bakoze ibibi bibiri: bataye jewe, isōko y’amazi y’ubugingo, bakīyimbira ivyobo vyo kubīka amazi, ivyobo vyatobotsemw’ imishwena, bidashobora kugumamw’ amazi.
Mbega Isirayeli n’umuja yaguzwe? Mbega yavukiye mu buja? None n’iki gitumye acika inyama z’ibisīga?
Imigunza y’intambge yamwivugiyeko irenza amajwi, yahinduye igihugu ciwe imisaka; ibisagara vyiwe vyaturiwe, bisigaye ata wukihaba.
Abantu b’i Nofu n’i Tahapanesi bākujonjanze agahanga.
