Mbega si wewe wavyihamagariye, kuko wataye Uhoraho Imana yawe akikurōngōra mu nzira?
None rero n’iki kikujanye mu nzira ija muri Egiputa, ukaja kunywa amazi ya Shihori? Canke n’iki kikujanye mu nzira ija muri Ashuri, ukaja kunywa amazi ya rwa Ruzi?

Ivyaha vyawe ni vyo bizogukubita, n’ubuhemu bgawe ni bgo buzoguhana: uzomenya rero kand’ uzobona yukw ar’ ikintu c’icago kandi c’umururazi, kunta jewe Uhoraho Imana yawe, no kutampa igitinyiro, ni jewe Umwami, Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, mbivuze.
Kuk’ uhereye kera wavunnye ingōgo yawe, ugacagagura imvuto, ukavuga, uti Sinkikugera inyuma! Mbere nta ho utāgiye uryama nka maraya ku musozi wose muremure no musi y’igiti cose gitōtahaye.
Yamara nari naguteye ur’ umuzabibu w’ubgoko, ur’ urugemwe rutōretse rwose: none se wabaye ute ko wampindukiye igiti c’umuzabibu w’ikijakija w’icaduka?
Naho wokwiyuhagiza ivyitwa amagadi, ukīyabīrira n’isabuni nyinshi, ukugabitanya kwawe kuzoba ubgome imbere yanje, ni jewe Umwami Uhoraho mbivuze.
Uvuga ute, uti Sinanduye, kand’ uti Sinakurikiye Bayali? Itegereze inzira zawe zo mu mwonga, umenye ico wakoze! Ur’ ingamiya y’iriza y’impehu, igenda iharātwa;
ur’ indogoba y’inyeshamba imenyereye ubugaragwa, ihemba umuyaga igihe igomba kwima; iyo irinze, ni nde yoyigarura? Iziyironderakw isumba zose ntizirinda kwigora; mu kwezi kwayo kugeze zizoyibona.
Enda ni wirinde, ibirenge vyawe ntibibure inkweto, n’imihogo yawe ntiyume; ariko waravuze, ut’ Oyaye, n’unyiziguruke; kuko jewe ngomwe imana z’inyamahanga, nkaba ari zo nkurikiye.
Nk’ukw igisuma kimāramāra iyo gifashwe, ni ko n’ab’ inzu ya Isirayeli bazomāramāra, bo n’abami babo n’abaganwa babo n’abaherezi babo na ba kamenyi babo;
ababgira ikigegene, bati Ni wewe data; bakabgira ibuye, bati Ni wewe wamvyaye: kuko banteye ibitugu, ntibabe bakinshirakw amaso; ariko mu gihe c’ivyago vyabo bazotakamba, bati Haguruka udukize.
None se za mana zawe wironkeye ziri hehe? Ni zihaguruke, namba zishobora kugukiza mu gihe c’ivyago vyawe: kuk’ ukw ibisagara vyawe bingana, ewe Buyuda, ari kw imana zawe zingana.
N’iki kibagombesha kubūrana nanje? Mwese mwarancumuyeko, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Nakubise abo mu gihugu canyu, ariko nigoreye ubusa; banse guhaha; inkota zanyu ubganyu zāriritse ba kamenyi banyu nk’intambge itikiza.

Yemwe runganwe rw’iki gihe, ni murābe ijambo ryanje, jewe Uhoraho. Mbeg’ Abisirayeli nababereye ubugaragwa? Canke se nababereye igihugu c’umwiza w’umuzitanya? N’iki gituma abantu banje bavuga, bati Turidohoye: ntitukigomba kukugarukako?
Mbeg’ umwigeme yoshobora kwibagira utugenegene twiwe? Cank’ umugeni yokwibagira umwitwikiro wiwe? Arikw abantu banje bānyibagiye imisi myinshi itoharūrwa.
Ewe kuntu ugira amīsīgiranzira kugira ngo bakugomwe! Bitayeko wahavuye wigisha n’abagore b’abanyavyaha ingeso zawe!
Mbere no ku mpuzu zawe haboneka amaraso y’abantu b’abakene wishe batagira igicumuro, kand’ utābafashe bamena inzu.
Ariko naho bimeze birtyo, uravuga, uti Nta gicumuro ndiko; kand’ uti N’ukuri n’uburake yar’ andakiye bgashize. Rāba nzobūrana nawe, kuk’ uvuga, uti Nta caha nakoze.
Ukubagiranira iki guhindura inzira yawe? Egiputa hazogutētereza, nk’uko Ashuri hagutētereje.
Na ho nyene uzovayo witwaye impungenge; jewe Uhoraho ko nagaye abo wishimiye, nta co bazokumarira.

Baravuga, bat’ Umuntu ni yirukana umugore wiwe bakavana, akābīrwa n’uwundi mugabo, mbeg’ uwo mugabo wiwe yosubira kumugarukana ukundi? Mbega n’igihugu nyene nticoba cononekaye? Nawe wīgize maraya ku būzure batari bake; non’ ugira ngo wongarukako? ni jewe Uhoraho mbibajije.

Unamurira amaso ku mpinga mu ruharabuga, witegereze: mbeg’ aho batāryamanye nawe ni hehe? Wabategeye ku mayira, nk’uk’ Umwarabo ategera mu bugaragwa; wononesheje igihugu ubusambanyi bgawe n’ivyaha vyawe.
Ni co gitumye imvura ibuzwa, ntigwe no mu gihe cobaye urushana; yamara na ho nyene wāraritse uruhanga nka maraya, ntiwaruha ugira n’udusoni.
Mbe ntiwoca uhēra ubu ukantakambira, uti Muvyeyi wanje, ni wewe wandōngōra mu buto bganje?
uti Mbeg’ uzohorana uburake imisi yose? Uzobgamana gushitsa kw iherezo? Mbega si wewe wavuze ibintu bibi, ugatak’ ukabikora, ukīgira uk’ ugomba?

Kandi ku ngoma y’umwami Yosiya, Uhoraho arambarira, ati Mbega wabonye ico Isirayeli Inamusubiranyuma yakoze? Yadūze umusozi wose muremure, akaja no musi y’igiti cose gitōtahaye, akīhindurirayo maraya.
Amaze gukora ivyo vyose, naravuze, nt’ Azongarukako; maze ntiyagaruka; kandi mwene nyina Yuda Inamuryarukanyi arabibona.

Mmaze kwirukana Isirayeli Inamusubiranyuma, no kumuha icete c’uko tuvāvānura, ku nyanduruko y’uko yasambanye, na ho nyene mbona mwene nyina Yuda Inamuryarukanyi ata kōba agize: na we n’uko, aragenda yihindura maraya.
Maz’ igihugu gica cononekara, kuko Isirayeli yabaye vyenywe mu busambanyi bgiwe, agasambana n’amabuye n’ibigegene.
Kandi nah’ ivyo bimeze birtyo, mwene nyina Yuda Inamuryarukanyi ntiyangarutseko n’umutima wose atar’ ukugaruka mu buryarya, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Maz’ Uhoraho arambarira, ati Isirayeli Inamusubiranyuma yiyerekanye kw ar’ umunyakuri kuruta Yuda Inamuryarukanyi.

Genda uvuge aya majambo werekeye i burārūko, uti Garuka, yewe Isirayeli Inamusubiranyuma, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze. Sinzokurābana ishavu, kuko nd’ umunyembabazi, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze; kandi sinzokwamana uburake imisi yose.

Pfa kwemera gusa ukugabitanya kwawe, ko wancumuyeko, jewe Uhoraho Imana yawe, ugakwiragira irya n’ino ku mana z’inyamahanga musi y’igiti cose gitōtahaye, ntiwumvire ijwi ryanje, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Garuka, mwa bantu basubiye inyuma, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, kuko jewe nd’ umugabo wanyu; kandi nzobagarukana i Siyoni, umwe ndamukūye mu gisagara kimwe, babiri mu muryango umwe;
mbahe abungere bameze nk’uk’ umutima wanje ugomba, bazobaragirana ubgenge no gutahura.

Maze mur’ iyo misi, ni mwamara kugwira no kurondoka mu gihugu, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, ntibazoba bakivuga isandugu y’isezerano ryanje, jewe Uhoraho, kandi ntibazoba bakiyiyumvira canke ngo bayibuke; ntibazoba bakiyikumbura, canke ngo babe bagisubira kubāza iyindi.

Ico gihe bazokwita Yerusalemu intebe y’ubgami bganje, jewe Uhoraho, kand’ amahanga yose azokoranirizwa i Yerusalemu mw izina ryanje, jewe Uhoraho: ntibazoba bakigendera ukundi mu budadarare bg’imitima yabo mibi.
Mur’ iyo misi ab’ inzu ya Yuda bazogendana n’ab’ inzu ya Isirayeli, bazanane bava mu gihugu c’i burārūko, baza mu gihugu nahaye ba sogokuruza banyu k’umwandu.

Ariko narībajije, nti Nogushira nte mu bana banje, nkaguha igihugu c’igikundiro, nkaguha umwandu mwiza uruta iy’ ayandi mahanga yose? Nari naravuze, nti Muzonyita umuvyeyi wanyu, kandi ntimuzokebanuka ngo mumve inyuma.
Ariko nk’uk’ umugore aryāruka umugabo wiwe akamuta, uko ni ko namwe mwandyārutse, mwebge ab’ inzu ya Isirayeli, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Ijwi rirumvikanira ku mpinga mu ruharabuga, ry’ukurira no kwinginga kw’Abisirayeli, kuko bāgoretse inzira yabo, bakanyibagira jewe Uhoraho Imana yabo.
Garuka, mwa bantu basubiye inyuma, nzoharira ugusubira inyuma kwanyu. Ehe tukugarutseko, kukw ari wewe Uhoraho Imana yacu.
N’ukuri kwishimira ugutabarwa kuva ku misozi n’ukw’ ubusa, bo n’akarūru ko ku misozi miremire: n’ukuri Uhoraho Imana yacu muri we ni ho har’ agakiza k’Abisirayeli.
Arik’ uhereye no mu buto bgacu, ivy’ akamāramāza ni vyo vyāmaze ivyāvuye mu butame bga ba sogokuruza; vyāmaze imikuku yabo n’amasho yabo, n’abahungu babo n’abakobga babo.

Ni turambarare hasi mu gatētereza kacu, twipfuke ubumāramāre bgacu; kuko twacumuye k’Uhoraho Imana yacu, twe na ba sogokuruza, kuva mu buto bgacu gushitsa no kur’ uyu musi, ntitwumvire Uhoraho Imana yacu.
Namb’ ugomba guhindukira, ewe Isirayeli, ni jewe ukwiye guhindukirira, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze; kandi ni wakūrah’ ivyo ukora vy’ubuyobe mu nyonga zanje, nuko nawe ntuzokūrwaho;
kand’ uzorahira uguhoraho kwanje Uhoraho mu vy’ukuri no mu biroranye no mu bugororotsi, maz’ amahanga azohezagiranira muri jewe, kandi ni jewe azokwirata.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho abarira abagabo b’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu, ati Ni mumene imishike yanyu, mureke kubiba mu mahwa.

Enda ni mukebge, munyiyegurire jewe Uhoraho, mukūreh’ ukudakebga kwo mu mitima yanyu, mwebge bagabo b’i Buyuda n’ababa i Yerusalemu; ubushangashirwe bganje bgoye kurabagiza nk’umuriro, bukarurumba ntihagire ūshobora kubuzimya, kubg’ ibibi mukora.
Musemererere i Buyuda, mwamamaze i Yerusalemu, muti Mutabarishe inzamba mu gihugu, musemereze ijwi rirenga, muti Ni mwēgerane, duhungire mu bisagara vyubakiwe inzitiro.
Mushinge ibendera aherekeye i Siyoni: muhunge mwikize, ntimutebagane: kukw ehe rāba, nzanye ivyago biturutse i burārūko, n’ukugeseza gukomeye.
Intambge isokorotse mu gisaka cayo, ni yo mugeseza w’amahanga; ifashe inzira, isokorotse ahantu hayo, kugira ngw itikize igihugu canyu, ibisagara vyanyu ngo bisigare ar’ imisaka, ata wukihaba.
Kubg’ ivyo mukenyere amagunira, mucure umunihiro, muboroge: kuk’ uburake bganje bg’inkazi, jewe Uhoraho, budasubiye inyuma ngo bubaveko.
Maze kur’ uwo musi, umutima w’umwami uzoranduka, n’imitima y’abaganwa, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze; kand’ abaherezi bazokwumirwa, ba kamenyi batangare.
Maze ndavuga, nt’ Ewe Mwami Uhoraho! Mbega ko wahenze rwose ubu bgoko n’i Yerusalemu, wavuze ngo Muzoba amahoro: kandi non’ inkota ikaba igeramiye amagara yabo!

Ico gihe hazobarirwa ubu bgoko n’i Yerusalemu, ng’ Umuyaga w’indugumba uturutse mu ruharabuga rwo ku mpinga z’imisozi yo mu bugaragwa uje utōmereye wa mukobga, ari bo bantu banje, kandi ntuzoba nk’uwo gutumura umuguruka cank’ uwo kugosora intete;
arik’ umuyaga uruta ben’ uyo uzovayo ari jewe ndawugomoye: mur’ aka kanya ngira mbacirekw amateka.
Eh’ azodūga aze nk’ibicu, n’imikogote yiwe izoza nk’agashururu; amafarasi yiwe azorusha inkukuma kunyaruka. Tubonye ibara! Turageseye!
Ewe Yerusalemu, ni wuhagire umutima wawe ivyaha, kugira ng’ ukizwe. Uzogeza ryari kwama usembereza ivyiyumviro vyawe bibi mu mutima?
Kuko humvikana ubutumwa buturutse i Dani, kandi buturutse no mu misozi ya Efurayimu bubūra ivyago,
buti Mubarire amahanga, mubūrire Yerusalemu, yukw abaje gutega ibico bariko baraza, bavuye mu gihugu ca kure, bīrahira ibisagara vy’i Buyuda n’amajwi arenga.
Bakikije Yerusalemu nk’abarinda ivyona umurima, kuko hangararije, ndabivuze jewe Uhoraho.
Ingeso zawe n’ibikorwa vyawe ni vyo bikuzaniye ibimeze birtyo; ivyo ni vyo nyishu y’ububi bgawe; ni koko n’ivy’ umubabaro, kandi bikora no ku mutima wawe.
Amara yanje, amara yanje aradobangana! Nseserewe mu mutima wanje; umutima wanje umpagazemwo, sinshobora kwiyumanganya; ewe mutima wanje, ni kuko wumvise ijwi ry’inzamba, n’akarūru k’intambara!
Habūwe ubugesera bugerekeranye n’ubundi; kukw igihugu cose kinyazwe, amahema yanje anyazwe giturumbuka, mber’ ayo nashinze anyazwe mu kanya isase.
Nzogeza ryari kubona ibendera, no kwumva ijwi ry’inzamba?
Ereg’ abantu banje n’ibipfu, ntibanzi; n’abana b’ibijuju, nta bgenge bagira: bagira ubgenge bgo gukora ibibi, ariko mu vyo gukora ivyiza nta co bazi.
Nararāvye, mbona isi, nsanga ar’ imisaka irik’ ubusa gusa; n’ijuru n’uko, ata n’umuco rigira.
Nararāvye, mbona imisozi, nsanga ihinda agashitsi, n’uturambi twose n’uko, turi mu gatengo.
Nararāvye, nsanga ata muntu n’umwe ariho, n’inyoni zose zo mu kirēre zarahunze.
Nararāvye, nsanga itongo ryamera rihindutse ubugaragwa, n’ibisagara vyaho vyose bisangangukiye imbere y’Uhoraho, n’imbere y’uburake bgiwe bg’inkazi.
Kuk’ ukw ari k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Igihugu cose kizoba imisaka; yamara sinzogiherengeteza rwose.
Kubg’ ivyo isi izogandara, n’ijuru ryiraburanirwe: kuko mbivuze, kandi mbimaramaje, sinzokwigarura canke ngo nihindukize.
Abo mu bisagara vyose bahungishijwe n’urwamo rw’abagendera ku mafarasi n’urw’ abanyamiheto; banyegera mu bisaka, būrira ku bitandara hejuru: igisagara cose gisigara ar’ umurara ata n’umwe akihaba.

None weho, ni wanyagwa, uzogira ute? Naho wokwambara impuzu zisa n’agahama, ukīsakara utugenegene tw’izahabu, ukīraba amarangi mu maso, uzoba washarije ubusa: abūzure bawe baragukēngēra, barondera ingene bokwica.

Kuko numvise ijwi nk’iry’ umugore aramutswe, ubusinzikare bg’ūrikw aravyara umwana w’uburiza, ijwi ry’umukobga w’i Siyoni ahuzagizwa, ata amaboko, at’ Ewe jewe ndagowe! Umutima wanje ugwiriye igihumura imbere y’abicanyi.
Ni mwiruke hirya no hino mu nzira z’i Yerusalemu, murondere mwitegereze, mucakare no mu hiyaguye haho, namba mwobona umuntu yoba umugororotsi arondera ivy’ ukuri, nanje nzohaharira.
Naho barahira uguhoraho kw’Uhoraho, n’ukuri barahira ibinyoma.
Mbeg’ Uhoraho, inyonga zawe ntizitegereza ivy’ ukuri? Warabakubise, ntibābibabara; warabatūbije, banka guhaha: bākomantaje mu maso habo gusumvya ibuye; banse kugaruka.
Maze ndavuga, nt’ Erega n’ukw ari ba nyarucari: n’ibijuju, kuko batazi inzira y’Uhoraho, ntibamenye n’ukuroranya kw’Imana yabo.
Reka nje ku bakuru, mvugane na bo; kuko bo bazi inzira y’Uhoraho, n’ukuroranya kw’Imana yabo. Ariko na bo nyene bāhūrije inama hamwe kuvuna ingōgo no gucagagura imvuto.

Ni co gituma intambge yo mu kibira izobica, n’ibingira rigendagenda uko buhwibiriye rizobasahura, n’ingwe izotegera ku bisagara vyabo, maz’ ūbisokorokamwo wese atabagurwe; kuk’ ukugabitanya kwabo ari kwinshi, n’ugusubira inyuma kwabo kukaba kurenze urugero.
Mbega noshobora nte kuguharira? Abana bawe barantaye, bīrahira izitar’ imana; mpejeje kubagaburira bagahāga, bāciye basambana, barema inteko i wabo w’abasambanyikazi.
Bameze nk’impfizi z’amafarasi ahimvye yiruka irya n’ino, umuntu wese akaroherana, arondera umugore wa mugenzi we.
Mbeg’ ivyo ntibizotuma nisidukira? ni k’Uhoraho abaza; mbeg’ ivyo umutima wanje ntuzobihōra ubgoko bumeze burtyo?
Ni mwūrire ku nzitiro zaho, muhonnye; yamara ntimuherengeteze rwose: mukūreh’ amashami yaho, kukw atar’ ay’ Uhoraho.
Kukw inzu ya Isirayeli n’inzu ya Yuda zandyarutse rwose, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Bīhakanye Uhoraho, ngo Nta we; kandi ngo Nta vyago bizotuzako, nta n’inkota tuzobona cank’ amapfa;
ngw Ivy’ abavugishwa n’Imana n’ibitwarwa n’umuyaga, kand’ ijambo ryayo ntiriri muri bo: ngw Ivyo babūra birakaba ari bo bigarukako.
Nuko rero, uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ni we Mana Nyen’ ingabo, ati Ko bavuga ben’ ayo magambo, ehe ngira mpindure amajambo yanje umuriro mu kanwa kawe, ubu bgoko na bgo ndabuhindure inkwi, ubatongore.

Ehe ngira mbazanire ihanga rivuye kure, yemwe ab’ inzu ya Isirayeli, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze; n’ihanga rihambaye, n’ihanga ryamyeho kera, n’ihanga rivuga ururimi mutazi, mutoshobora no kwumva ico rivuga.
Umutana wabo ni nk’imva irangaye, bose n’abantu b’abahizi.

Bazorya ivyimburwa vyanyu n’ivyo kurya vyanyu, ivyo abahungu banyu n’abakobga banyu boriye; bazorya imikuku yanyu n’amasho yanyu; bazorya imizabibu yanyu n’imisukoni yanyu; kand’ ibisagara vyanyu vyubakiwe inzitiro, ivyo mwishimira, bazobisanganguza inkota.
Yamara no mur’ iyo misi na ho sinzobaherengeteza rwose, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.

Maz’ igihe bazobaza, bati Mbeg’ Uhoraho Imana yacu ivyo vyose yabidukoreye ku ki? nawe ni ho uzobabarira, uti Nk’uko mwataye Imana, mugakorerera imana z’inyamahanga mu gihugu canyu, uko ni ko muzokorerera abanyamahanga mu gihugu kitar’ icanyu.
Mutāngāze ibi ku b’inzu ya Yakobo, muvyamamaze i Buyuda,
mut’ Enda ni mwumve ibi, mwa bantu b’ibipfu, batagira umutima, bafise amaso ntibabone, bafise n’amatwi ntibumve:

muti Mbega nta n’ukuruha mumutinya? ni k’Uhoraho abajije; muti Nta guhindira agashitsi imbere yiwe, kand’ ari we yashinze umusenyi ng’ ubere ikiyaga akarimbi, ni co cagezwe kizokwamaho, ngo ntikikarēngāne? Mbere nah’ imipfunda yaco yosuriranya, ntiyowutsinda; naho yobomborana, ntiyowurēngāna.
Yamar’ ubu bgoko bgo bufise umutima ugarariza, ugābagāba; bāragararije, baracika.
Nta ho bīvuganya mu mitima, bat’ Enda twubahe Uhoraho Imana yacu, ni yo iduha imvura y’agatāsi n’iy’ urushana, nk’ukw ibihe bihaye ibindi; ni yo itugerera amayinga yashinzwe yo kwimburiramwo.
Mut’ Ibigabitanyo vyanyu ni vyo bibujije ivyo, kand’ ivyaha vyanyu ni vyo bibīmishije ivyiza.
Muti Kuko mu bantu biwe habonekamw’ abantu b’abanyakibi: baratega nk’ukw abatezi b’inyoni batega; batega umutego, bagafata abantu.
Nk’ukw igisamba cokwuzuzwa izo nyoni, ni kw amazu yabo yuzuyemw’ ibigungano: ni co catumye bacika abahambaye, bakaba abatunzi.
Bacitse ibisēme, barayagayaga; bakora ibibi vy’akarenzarugero: ntibabūrana impfuvyi mu manza ngo zibone kuroranirwa; kand’ urubanza rw’aboro ntibaruca.
Mbeg’ ivyo ntibizotuma nisidukira? ni jewe Uhoraho mbibajije; mbeg’ umutima wanje ntuzohōra ubgoko bumeze burtyo?
Habonetse ikintu c’akumiza giteye ubgoba mu gihugu:
ba kamenyi bavuga ibinyoma, kandi n’abaherezi, uko baganza kwose bagukūra kuri bo; kand’ abantu banje ni co bakunda: mbega none muzokora iki kw iherezo ryavyo?

Muhunge mwikize, mwebge Babenyamini, muve hagati muri Yerusalemu; muvugirize inzamba i Tekowa, kand’ i Beti‐hakeremu muhashire inderetsi yo gutabaza; kukw ivyago bisēsetse i burārūko, n’ukugeseza gukomeye.
Umukobga w’i Siyoni mwiza yāmikaye, nzomurandura.
Abungere bazomūzira, bari n’imikuku yabo; bazoshinga amahema yabo, bamushagaje irya n’ino; bazomurisha, umuntu wese ah’ aherereye:
bati Mutonde urugamba tumurwanye; ni mukūre hasi tudūge ku murango w’amaminangohe. Bat’ Ewe turagowe, kuk’ umusi ukuze, kand’ ibitūtu vy’ubgīra bikaba bimaze ibihugu!
Bati Ni mukūre hasi, tudūge mw ijoro, dusangangure ingoro ziwe.
Kuk’ ukw ari k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ati Ni mwicire ibiti, murundire Yerusalemu ikigunguzi co kwūririrako: ico gisagara gikwiye kūzirwa; nta kindi kiri muri co atar’ agahahazo.
Nk’ukw iriba ridudubiza amazi yaryo, uko ni ko kidudubiza ibibi vyaco: humvikana umuryano n’ubunyazi muri co; ububabare n’inguma vyama imbere yanje na ntaryo.
Kunda wigishwe, Yerusalemu, umutima wanje woye guhubanwa nawe; noye kuzohava nguhindura amatongo, igihugu kitakirimw’ umuntu.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ati Bazohūmba bamaririkanye amasigarira y’Abisirayeli, nk’uko bahūmba umuzabibu: subira uje uratuma ukuboko nk’uwamurira inzabibu mu bisamba.
Nobarira nde ngw ambere icabona, kugira ngo bumve? Ereg’ amatwi yabo arazivye, ntibashobora kwumva: ijambo ry’Uhoraho ryahindutse agatukisha kuri bo; ntibakirinezererwa.

Ni co gituma nuzuye ubushangashirwe bg’Uhoraho: bingoye kubuzina; burekurire ku bana bari mu nzira, no ku misore ah’iganamye: kuk’ umugabo azonyaganwa n’umugore wiwe, n’umutāma azonyaganwa n’ūgeze mu zabukuru.
Ingo zabo zizogabirwa abandi, bo n’amatongo yabo n’abagore babo: kuko nzobangurira ukuboko kwanje ku baba mu gihugu, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Kuk’ uhereye kuri nyarucari muri bo ugashitsa no k’ūhambaye, umuntu wese yifuza inyungu mbi; kand’ uhereye kuri ba kamenyi ugashitsa no ku baherezi, umuntu wese aragunga.
Bāvūye igikomere c’abantu banje imirenzako, bavuga, bati N’amahoro, n’amahoro; kand’ ata mahoro ariho.
Mbega har’ isoni bāgize, bamaze gukora ibizira? Eka nta dusoni na mba, nta n’ukumāramāra. Ni co gituma bazotembana n’abari ku mutembo; igihe nzobāzira bazogwaho, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.

Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Muhagarare mu mayira, mwitegereze, mubaze inzira za kera, inzira nziza iy’ ari yo, abe ari yo mujana, maze muzoronka uburuhukiro bg’imitima yanyu: ariko bo baravuga, bat’ Eka ntituyijana.
Nabashiriyeh’ abashibamyi, nti Ni mwumvirize ijwi ry’inzamba; ariko bo baravuga, bat’ Eka ntituryumviriza.
None rero mwa mahanga, ni mwumve ibigira bibabeko; ubimenye, wa koraniro ry’amoko;
ni wumve, wa si we, ehe ngira nzane ivyago kur’ ubu bgoko, vyandurutse mu vyiyumviro vyabo, kuko batumviye amajambo yanje, kand’ ivyagezwe vyanje bakaba bārabikēngereye.
Bimaze iki kunkūrira ibintu bimoga i Sheba, na kanehe imota neza ivuye mu gihugu ca kure? Ibimazi vyanyu vyoswa simbishima, kand’ ivyo mukerera ntibimpimbara.
None rero ni mwumve ivyo mvuze jewe Uhoraho: Ehe ngira nshire ibitsitaza imbere y’ubu bgoko: abavyeyi n’abana babo bazobitsitarirakw icarimwe; ababanyi na bagenzi babo bazoranduka.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Eh’ ubgoko buraje buvuye mu gihugu c’i burārūko; ihanga rikomeye rizovyutswa rive ku mpera y’isi.

Bābiriye imiheto n’amacumu; ni ba ruburakigongwe, nta mbabazi bagira; ijwi ryabo ribomborana nk’ikiyaga, kandi bagendera ku mafarasi; bāzira mu rugamba icarimwe, nk’umuntu umwe, kugira ngo bagutere, ewe mukobga w’i Siyoni.
Twumvise inkuru zavyo, amaboko yacu arareganuka: uburibge buradufashe, nk’ibise vy’umugore aramutswe.
Ntimuruhe musohoka mu mirima, canke ngo mufate inzira: kuko hariy’ inkota y’umwansi, n’ibiteye ubgoba irya n’ino.

Ewe Yerusalemu, wa mukobga ari bo bantu banje, kenyera amagunira, wikumbagaze mu minyota: vuza induru nk’ūyivugiriza umwana wiwe w’ikinege, uborogane akabonge kenshi; kuk’ umugeseza agira adushikeko giturumbuka.
Nguhinduye nk’uruganda n’umucuzi hagati mu bantu banje; kugira ng’ umenye ingeso zabo uzigerageze.
Bose n’abagarariji bitovugwa, bagenda barementanya; bameze nk’imiringa n’ivyuma; bose bakora ivy’ ubugunge.
Imivuba ivugutana inkomezi, umuriro ugakūrah’ inkamba: bashishikarira ubusa kuvuguta, kukw abanyakibi batākūwemwo.
Abantu bazobīta ifeza z’ibihonwa, kuk’ Uhoraho abashibuye.
Ijambo rivuye k’Uhoraho riza kuri Yeremiya,
riti Hagarara mu kirimba kirora ku ngoro y’Uhoraho, uhatāngārize iri jambo, uti Ni mwumve ijambo ry’Uhoraho, mwebge mwese b’i Buyuda, abaca mur’ ibi birimba ngo musenge Uhoraho.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ati Mutunganye ingeso zanyu n’ibikorwa vyanyu, nanje nzobabesha aha hantu.
Ntimwizigire amagambo y’ibinyoma, avuga ngo Nguru urusengero rw’Uhoraho, nguru urusengero rw’Uhoraho, nguru urusengero rw’Uhoraho!
Erega ni mwatunganya ingeso zanyu n’ibikorwa vyanyu, ni mwaca imanza ziri hagati y’umuntu na mugenzi we,
ni mudahahaza ingenzi cank’ impfuvyi cank’ umupfakazi, ntimuvishirize amaraso y’ūtācumuye aha hantu, ntimugendanire izindi mana, bikababera icago:
nuko nanje nzobabesha aha hantu, mu gihugu nahaye ba sogokuruza, uhereye ubga mbere ugashitsa ibihe bidashira.
Mbega ko mwizigiye amagambo y’ibinyoma adafise ikimazi!
Mbega birashoboka ko mwiba, mukica, mugasambana, mukarahira ibinyoma, mukosereza Bayali imibavu, mukagendanira izindi mana mutigeze kumenya,
maze mukaza mugahagarara imbere yanje mur’ iyi ngoro yitirirwa izina ryanje, mukavuga, muti Turakijijwe: mwaheza mugakora ivyo bizira vyose?
Non’ iyi ngoro yitirirwa izina ryanje, mbeg’ ihindutse nk’isenga ry’abambuzi mu maso yanyu? Erega jewe ni jewe ubganje navyiboneye, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Enda ni mugende ha hantu hanje i Shilo, aho natanguye gushira izina ryanje ngo rihabe, mwitegereze ivyo nahagiriye kubg’ ivyaha vy’abantu banje b’Abisirayeli.
Kandi none, ko mwakoze ivyo bikorwa vyose, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, nkaba nari naravuganye namwe nzinduwe no kubabgira, ariko ntimwumve, nkabahamagara ariko ntimwitabe;
nuko rero, nk’uko nagiriye i Shilo, ni ko nzogirira iyi ngoro yitirirwa izina ryanje, iyo mwizigira, ni ho hantu nabahaye, mwe na ba sogokuruza banyu.
Kandi nzobahinda mbirukane mu nyonga zanje, nk’uko nahinze bene wanyu bose, ni bo ruvyaro rwose rwa Efurayimu.
None rero nta co usengera ubu bgoko, ntubītwarire canke ng’ubasengere, kandi ntubanyingingire: kuko ntazokwumva.
Mbega ntubona ivyo bakora mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda no mu nzira z’i Yerusalemu?
Abana batoragura udukwi, ba se bagacana umuriro, abagore bagacumba, ngo bahakurire imitsima umwamikazi wo mw ijuru, kandi ngo basukire ibiturire izindi mana, ngo bantere ishavu.
Mbega ni jewe baritera gusa? Si bo baryitera, ngo bibazanire ukumāramāra? ni jewe Uhoraho mbibajije.

Nuko rero, uku ni ko mbivuze, jewe Umwami Uhoraho, nt’ Eh’ uburake bganje n’ubushangashirwe bganje bizosukwa aha hantu, uhereye ku bantu no ku bitungwa no ku biti vyo ku misozi no ku bimera vyo mu mirima; buzotongora, nta kizobuzimya.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, at’ Ibimazi vyanyu vyo kwoswa, enda ni mubirundanye hamwe n’ivyo gukererwa, mwīrīre inyama!
Kukw ata co nabariye ba sogokuruza banyu, canke ngo ngire ico mbabgira ku musi nabakūriye mu gihugu ca Egiputa, ku vyo kwosa ibimazi canke kubikerera:
arikw ijambo nabageze ryar’ iri: nababgiye, nti Ni mwumvire ijwi ryanje, maze nanje nzoba Imana yanyu, namwe muzoba abantu banje; mugendere mu vyo mbagera vyose, kugira ngo bibagendere neza.
Ariko ntibāvyumvira, kandi ntibātega ugutwi kwabo, ariko bāgendera mu migabo yabo, no mu bukomantare bg’imitima yabo mibi, kandi bāsubira inyuma, ntibāja imbere.
Uhereye umusi ba sogokuruza banyu bāviriye mu gihugu ca Egiputa ugashitsa no kur’ uyu musi, nabatumyekw abasavyi banje bose, ari bo mvugisha, nama nzindurwa uko bukeye no kubatuma:
ariko na ho nyene ntibānyumvira, canke ngo batege ugutwi kwabo, ariko bagamika amazosi yabo; bagatako bagakora ibibi birengeye ivya ba sekuruza.
Nawe naho wobabgira ayo majambo yose ntibazokwumva; kandi naho wobahamagara ntibazokwitaba.
Ubabgire, ut’ Ubu ni bgo bgoko butumviye Uhoraho Imana yabo, ntibemere kwigishwa: ukuri kurapfuye, kurazimiriye mu kanwa kabo.
Ni wiharangure umushatsi, ewe Yerusalemu, uwushibure; uheze uturike uborogere ku mpinga mu ruharabuga; kuk’ Uhoraho yaciye ab’ uru runganwe yarakiye, akabaheba.
Kuk’ uruvyaro rwa Yuda bakoze ibibi mu nyonga zanje, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze; bashize ibintu vyabo vy’ubuyobe mu ngoro yitirirwa izina ryanje, ngo bayihumanye.
Batavye ibitabo i Tofeti, ahahanamiye umwonga wa mwene Hinomu, ngo bahosereze abahungu babo n’abakobga babo mu muriro, babatanze kw ibimazi; ar’ ikintu ntābageze, kitigeze no kuza mu mutima wanje.

None rer’ umve, imisi igira ize, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, ntihazoba hacitwa Tofeti, canke ngo hitwe Umwonga wa mwene Hinomu; ariko hazokwitwa Umwonga w’ Imihindigiti, kuko bazohamba i Tofeti gushitsa aho batazoba bagishigaje n’akanya k’aho bahamba.
Kand’ imivyimba y’ubu bgoko izoba inyama z’ibisīga vyo mu kirēre, n’iz’ ibikōko vyo kw isi, ata wo kuvyirukana ariho.
Maze mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda no mu nzira z’i Yerusalemu nzohaca ijwi ry’ibitwengo n’iry’ umunezero, bo n’ijwi ry’umukwe n’iry’ umugeni: kukw igihugu kizoba gicitse amatongo.
Ico gihe, ni k’Uhoraho agize, bazozura amagufa y’abami b’Abayuda, n’ay’ abaganwa babo, n’ay’ abaherezi, n’aya ba kamenyi, n’ay’ ababa i Yerusalemu, bayakūre mu mva zabo:

bazoyanikira musi y’izuba n’ukwezi n’ingabo zose z’inyenyeri zo kw ijuru, ivyo bākunda bakabisaba bakabigendanira bakabishishikarira bakabisenga: ntazosubira kwegeranywa ngw ahambge, arikw azoba nk’intabire yometse ku misozi.
Kand’ amasigarira yose azoba asigaye kur’ uyu muryango mubi azohitamw’ urupfu kuruta kubaho, ni bo bazoba basigaye ahantu hose aho nzoba narabirukaniye, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo mbivuze.
Kand’ ubabgire, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho abaza, ati Mbeg’ abantu iyo batemvye ntibasubira kuvyuka? Cank’ umuntu iy’ ahuvye inzira ntasubira kugaruka?
None rero n’iki cashubije inyuma aba bantu b’i Yerusalemu, bagasubira inyuma akagīrīre? Bakobereza ubugunge, bakanka kugaruka.

Narateze ugutwi ndumviriza, ariko nta ho bavuga ukuri: nta muntu yihannye ibibi vyiwe, ngo yibaze, ati Mbeg’ ico nakoze n’igiki? Umuntu wese apfa guhuruduka, akajana inzira yiwe, ameze nk’ifarasi igenda akabushungwe yirukira mu ntambara.
Mber’ igisīga sarumfune co mu kirēre kizi ibihe vyaco cāgerewe, kand’ intunguru n’intamba n’inyanāna bimenya ibihe vyavyo vyo kuziramwo; arikw abantu banje bo ntibazi ibgirizwa ryanje, jewe Uhoraho.
Muvugira iki, muti Tur’ abanyabgenge, kandi mut’ Ivyagezwe vy’Uhoraho bibana natwe? Ereg’ abanditsi banyu bandikishije ikaramu y’ibinyoma, banditse ibitar’ ivy’ ukuri.
Abanyabgenge baratēterewe, barajorewe, bafashwe mpiri: erega n’uko bāgaye ijambo ryanje Uhoraho; mbeg’ ubgenge buri muri bo n’ubuki?

Ni co gitumye abagore babo nzobaha abandi, n’amatongo yabo nkazoyaha abandi bakayegukira: kuk’ umuntu wese, uhereye kuri nyarucari muri bo ugashitsa no k’ūhambaye wo muri bo, yifuza inyungu mbi: kand’ uhereye kuri ba kamenyi ugashitsa no ku baherezi, umuntu wese aragunga.
Kandi bāvūye imirenzako igikomere ca wa mukobga ari bo bantu banje, bavuga, bati N’amahoro, n’amahoro; kand’ ata mahoro ariho.
Mbega har’ isoni bāgize, bamaze gukora ibizira? Eka nta dusoni na mba, nta n’ukumāramāra. Ni co gituma bazotembana n’abari ku mutembo; igihe nzobazira bazogwaho, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Nzobanzura rwose, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze: nta nzabibu zizoba zikiba ku muzabibu, cank’ insukoni ku musukoni, n’ibibabi bizokabirana; kand’ ibintu nabahaye bizobavako.
Mbega none n’iki kikitwicaritse? Enda ni mwegerane, tuje mu bisagara vyubakiwe inzitiro, twumireyo; kuk’ Uhoraho Imana yacu atwumije, aduhaye amazi y’ubumara ngo tuyanywe, kuko twacumuye k’Uhoraho.
Twiteze amahoro, ariko nta vyiza vyaje; twiteze igihe co kuvūrwa, ariko habah’ ibiteye ubgoba.

Gufuhagira kw’amafarasi yiwe kwumvikana i Dani; igihugu cose gihindishwa agashitsi no kwumva kuroherana kw’amafarasi yiwe y’intambara; kuko baje, kandi bākegese igihugu n’ibiri muri co vyose, bo n’igisagara n’ababa muri co bose.
Ehe ngira ndungike inzoka z’imvuvyi muri mwebge, zitazoshobora kugundwa, ariko zizobakomora, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Icompa nkabona uko nomarwa umubabaro! Umutima wanje undendebukiyemwo.

Umve, ijwi ry’ugutakamba kw’umukobga, ari we bgoko bgacu, rituruka hirya no hino mu gihugu, riti Mbeg’ Uhoraho ntakiba i Siyoni? Mbeg’ Umwami waho si ho akiri? Mbega na bo n’iki catumye bandakisha ibishushanyo vyabo bibājwe, n’ ivy’ imburakimazi vy’ivyaduka?
Bat’ Igihe c’iyimbura kirashize, ici rirahise, natwe ntituragakira.
Ereg’ ikibabaje wa mukobga ari bo bgoko bgacu, nanje kirambabaje: ndiraburaniwe, mfashwe n’agatengo.
Mbeg’ i Gileyadi ntihariy’ umuti wo gusomōra? Nta muvūzi abayo? None n’iki cabujije uruguma rwa wa mukobga ari bo bgoko bgacu ko rukira?
Icompa umutwe wanje ukuzuramw’ amazi, amaso yanje akaba isōko y’amosozi, kugira ngo name ndira ku murango no mw ijoro, ndirira abishwe ba wa mukobga, ari bo bgoko bgacu!
Icompa nkaja mu bugaragwa mu ndāro y’abahita, kugira ngo nte ubgoko bgacu, ndabuvemwo! Kuko bose ar’ abasambanyi, bakaba umuhari w’abagabo baryarukana.

Bafora ururimi rwabo nk’umuheto, kugira ngo barekure ibinyoma; bācitse abahambaye mu gihugu, ariko batabiheshejwe n’ukuri: kuko bava mu bibi bakaja mu bindi, kandi ntibammenye, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.

Mwiyubarane, umuntu wese yiyubare umubanyi wiwe, kandi ntihagire uwo muri mwebge yizigira mugenzi we: kuk’ umuntu wese agendanira ubugunge mugenzi we, kand’ umubanyi w’umuntu wese agenda amurementaniriza.
Kand’ umuntu wese ahenda umubanyi wiwe, ntibavugane ukuri: bātoje ururimi rwabo kuvuga ibinyoma; bīgōza gukora ivy’ ukugabitanya.
Ereg’ ah’ uba ni hagati mu binyoma; ibinyoma ni vyo bibankisha kummenya, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
None rero, uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, at’ Ehe nzobavugutira, mbagerageze; ikindi nogirira wa mukobga ari bo bantu banje n’iki?
Ururimi rwabo n’umwampi wica; ruvuga ibinyoma; umuntu wese avugana n’umubanyi wiwe ivy’ amahoro mu kanwa kiwe, ariko mu mutima wiwe aba amuryamiye.
Mbeg’ ivyo ntibizotuma nisidukira? ni jewe Uhoraho mbibajije; mbeg’ umutima wanje ntuzobihōra ubgoko bumeze burtyo?
Ngira ndirire imisozi ndayiborogere, ncurire akanihiro amātsi yo mu biyaya, kuko haturiwe, ata wukihaca, kand’ ata wucumva kwābagirana kw’amasho; inyoni zo mu kirēre bo n’ibikōko birahunze, biragiye.
Kand’ i Yerusalemu nzohahindura ibirundo vy’amasakamburira, n’i wabo w’imbgebge; kandi n’ibisagara vy’i Buyuda nzobihindura amatongo, ata wukihaba.
Ni nde munyabgenge yotahura ivyo? Kandi ni nde yabibariwe n’akanwa kanje, jewe Uhoraho, kugira ngw avyamamaze? N’iki gitumye igihugu cononekara kigasha uburimbi nk’ubugaragwa, ntihabe hakigira ūhaca?
Maz’ Uhoraho aravuga, ati Ko bātaye ivyagezwe vyanje nabashize imbere, ntibanyumvire, canke ngo babigenderemwo,
ariko bakagendera mu budadarare bg’imitima yabo, bagakurikira Bayali, nk’uko ba sekuruza bābigishije:
nuko rero, uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ati Rāba, aba bantu nzobagaburira ivy’ umururazi, mbahe amazi y’ubumara ngo bayanywe.
Kandi nzobasābagiriza mu mahanga batigeze kumenya canke ba sekuruza babo: kandi nzorungika inkota ndayibakurikize gushitsa mbamaze.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ati Mwitegereze ivyo, muhamagare abagore bazi kuvuza induru, mutume ku bagore babizi cane, kugira ngo baze:
banyaruke, batangure kuborogera ivyacu, kugira ngw amaso yacu acundugute amosozi, amazi yisuke ava mu bigohe vyacu.
Kukw ijwi ry’amaborogo yumvikana i Siyoni, rit’ Ewe kuntu tugeseye! Turatēterewe cane, kuko twirukanywe mu gihugu cacu, kandi bāsanganguye amazu yacu.
Yemwe bagore, ni mwumve ijambo ry’Uhoraho, amatwi yanyu yumvirize ijambo ryo mu kanwa kiwe; mwigishe abakobga banyu kuboroga, umugore wese yigishe mugenzi we gucura akanihiro.
Kuk’ urupfu rwūriye rugaca mu madirisha yacu, rukinjira n’i bukuru bgacu; rukaririka abana bari hanze, n’abasore bari mu mayira.
Vuga, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Imivyimba y’abantu izokwandagara nk’amase ku gasozi, izogwa nk’isasira inyuma y’umwimbuzi, ata wo kuyegeranya.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Umunyabgenge yoye kwirata ubgenge bgiwe, cank’ umunyenkomezi ngo yirate inkomezi ziwe, cank’ umutunzi ngo yirate ubutunzi bgiwe;
arik’ uwirata, ni yirate ibi, ko yammenye, akantahura, yuko nd’ Uhoraho nkunda kugira imbabazi no guca iziroranye n’izigororotse mw isi: kukw ivyo ari vyo bimpimbara, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Eh’ imisi igira ize, ni k’Uhoraho agize, ngo mpane abākebge ariko batākebge nyakuri;

ni bo Banyegiputa n’Abayuda n’Abanyedomu n’umuryango w’Abamoni n’Abanyamowabu, bose abica amasoso, n’ababa mu bugaragwa; kukw amahanga yose ar’ intakebga, kand’ umuryango wose w’Abisirayeli n’intakebga mu mitima.
Ni mwumve ijambo Uhoraho ababgira, yemwe ab’ inzu ya Isirayeli:
uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Ntimukige ingeso z’amahanga, ntimugahagarikwe imitima n’ivyitwa imbitsi ziboneka mw ijuru, kukw ari zo zihagarika amahanga imitima.
Kukw imigenzo y’amahanga ar’ iy’ ubusa: baca igiti co mu kibira, amaboko y’umuhumbizi akagitunganisha incabiti.
Bagisakara ifeza n’izahabu; bakagikomeresha imisumari n’inyundo, ngo coye kunyiganyiga.

Ben’ ivyo bishushanyo bisa n’ibikanganyoni bishinzwe mu mirima, bitazi kuvuga: bikwiye guterurwa kuko bidashobora kwijana. Ntimukabitinye; kuko bidashobora gukora ikibi, canke ngo bibashe gukora iciza.
Nta gihwanye nawe, Uhoraho, kuk’ uhambaye, kand’ izina ryawe rikaba irihambaye kubg’ ububasha bgawe.
Ni nde atogutinya ga Mwami w’amahanga? kuko bikubereye; kuko mu banyabgenge bose bo mu mahanga, uko bāgatsindaje kwose nk’abami, ata wuhwanye nawe.
Ariko bose uko bangana n’ibiyingiyingi n’ibipfu; ukwigisha kw’igishushanyo guhwanye n’igiti buti.

Bakoresha ifeza zātabatabge zavuye i Tarushishi, n’izahabu zavuye i Ufazi, ibikorwa vy’umuhinga, n’ivy’ amaboko y’umucuzi w’izahabu; bavyambika impuzu z’amasufe n’iz’ inyambarabami; vyose n’ibikorwa vy’abahinga.
Arik’ Uhoraho ni we Mana y’ukuri; ni we Mana nzima, n’Umwami yamaho ibihe bidashira: uburake bgiwe buhindisha isi agashitsi, kand’ amahanga ntashobora kwihanganira ubushangashirwe bgiwe.
Uk’ ukwiye kubabgira n’uku: ut’ Imana zitāremye ijuru n’isi, izo ni zo zizoherengetezwa mw isi no musi y’ijuru.
Rurema ni yo yaremesheje isi ubushobozi bgayo, ikayihamangirisha ubgenge bgayo, ikagaranzuza ijuru ukumenya kwayo;
iy’ ishize ijwi hejuru haba gusūma kw’amazi yo hejuru; irandisha ibipfungu bikava ku mpera y’isi; iremera imvura imiravyo, kand’ isokorora umuyaga mu bubīko bgayo.

Non’ umuntu wese kw ar’ ikiyingiyingi ata bgenge agira! Umucuzi w’izahabu wese azotēterezwa n’igishushanyo ciwe yasaruye, kukw igishushanyo ciwe yavugutiye mu nkero ar’ ic’ ibinyoma, kandi nta mpwemu ziba muri vyo.
N’ivy’ ubusa gusa, n’igikorwa c’uruhendo; igihe cabo co kūzirwa bizoherengetezwa.
Arik’ Umugabane w’ aba Yakobo we si kw ameze, kukw ari we Muremyi wa vyose; kand’ Abisirayeli ni bo muryango yagize ishamvu yiwe: Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo ni ryo zina ryiwe.
Andūra utuntu twawe, wewe wugarijwe impande zose.
Kuk’ ukw ari k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Eh’ ababa mu gihugu iki gihe nzobashiburira kure, nzobababaza kugira ngo bibonereko.
Ewe jewe ndagowe, ndatonekaye! Uruguma rwanje rurambabaje: maze ndavuga, nt’ Ereg’ aya n’amagorwa nyene, nkwiye gupfa kuyihanganira.
Ihema ryanje rirononekaye, imigozi yose iracitse; abana banje bamvuyeko, ntibakiriho: nta wugisigaye wo kwagura ihema ryanje, ngw abambe ibihuzu vyaryo.
Kukw abungere bācitse ibiyingiyingi, ntibagīsha Uhoraho inama: ni co cababujije kumererwa neza, kand’ imikuku yabo yose yarasābagiye.
Umve ijwi ry’impuha, ngw imivurungano ikomeye iraje, ivuye mu gihugu c’i burārūko, kugira ngw ibisagara vy’i Buyuda bigirwe imisaka, habe i wabo w’imbgebge.
Uhoraho, nzi yukw inzira umuntu yogenderamwo atari we ashobora kuyigaba; ntibiri mu muntu agenda kwitunganiriza intambuko ziwe.
Uhoraho, umpane, ariko bitarenze urugero: ntumpanane ishavu, ng’ uhave unzimiriza.
Rekurira uburake bgawe ku mahanga atakuzi, no ku miryango itambaza izina ryawe, kuko bātsontsomeye aba Yakobo, mbere barabatsontsomeye barabaherengeteza, bākomvomvoye aho bāba.
Ijambo rivuye k’Uhoraho riza kuri Yeremiya,
riti Ni mwumve amajambo y’iri sezerano, muvugane n’abagabo b’i Buyuda n’ababa i Yerusalemu;
ubabgire, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli agize, at’ Aravumwe umugabo atumva amajambo y’iri sezerano,

iryo nihanikirije ba sogokuruza ku musi nabakūriye mu gihugu ca Egiputa, muri rya tanure rivugutira ivyuma, nti Ni munyumvire, mukore vyose ivyo mbagera: uko ni ko muzoba abantu banje, nanje nzoba Imana yanyu;
kugira ngo mbone gushitsa indahiro narahiye ba sogokuruza, yuko nzobaha igihugu gitemba amata n’ubūki, nk’uko bimeze uyu musi. Nuko ndishura, nti Amen, Uhoraho.
Maz’ Uhoraho arambarira, ati Tāngāza aya majambo yose mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda, no mu nzira z’i Yerusalemu, uti Ni mwumve amajambo y’iri sezerano, muyitondere.
Kuko nihanikirije rwose ba sogokuruza banyu, mpereye umusi nabakūriye mu gihugu ca Egiputa ngashitsa no kur’ uyu musi, nzinduka mbihanikiriza, mvuga nti Ni munyumvire.

Yamara ntibānyumvira, canke ngo batege amatwi, ariko bāgendera mu budadarare bg’imitima yabo mibi: ni co catumye mbashitsakw ivyo nababūriye vyose vyo mur’ iryo sezerano, iryo nabageze kwitondera, ntibaryitondere.
Uhoraho arambarira, ati Har’ inama yagīwe mu bagabo b’i Buyuda no mu baba i Yerusalemu.

Bahindukiriye ibigabitanyo vya ba sekuruza bāhora banka kwumva amajambo yanje; bakurikiye izindi mana ngw abe ari zo basaba: ab’ inzu ya Isirayeli n’ab’ inzu ya Yuda bishe isezerano ryanje nasezeranye na ba sekuruza.
Nuko rero nzobazanakw ivyago batazoshobora gukira, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze; bazontakambira, ariko sinzobumva.
Maz’ ibisagara vy’i Buyuda n’ababa i Yerusalemu bazogenda gutakambira imana bāhora bosereza imibavu: ariko ntizizobakiza na gatoya mu gihe c’ivyago vyabo.

Kuk’ ukw ibisagara vyawe bingana, ewe Buyuda, ari kw izo mana zawe zingana: kandi nk’ukw inzira zo muri Yerusalemu zingana ni ko mwagiye mushirah’ ibicaniro mubishiriyeho bga buyobe bganyu, ni vyo bicaniro vyo kwoserezakw imibavu Bayali.
None rero ntusengere ubu bgoko, ntubītwarire canke ng’ ubasabire; kuko ntazobumva igihe bazontakambira babonye ivyago vyabo.
Mbeg’ inkundwakazi yanje igikora iki mu nzu yanje, ko yakoze ibiteye isoni? Mbeg’ amasezerano yawe n’inyama z’ibimazi ugira ngo vyogukiza? Canke ben’ ivyo ugira ngo vyokurokora?
Jewe Uhoraho nari nakwise igiti ca elayo kiremvye giteye igomwe, kirikw imyelayo myiza: noneho naragituriye, har’ urwamo rw’ akarūru kenshi, kand’ amashami yaco arahimbaguritse.

Kuko jewe Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo nari narakubaditse, ari jewe nyene nkugeneye ivyago, kubg’ ibibi vyakozwe n’ab’ inzu ya Isirayeli n’ab’ inzu ya Yuda, ivyo bakoze vyo kundatsa, mu kwosereza Bayali imibavu.
Maz’ Uhoraho, urabimmenyesha, ndabimenya: uca unyereka ibikorwa vyabo.

Ariko nari mmeze nk’umwagazi w’intama w’ikirīga ujanwa kubāgwa; sinari nzi yuko bampigiye imihigo, bat’ Enda turandurane igiti n’ivyo camye, tumukūre mw isi y’abakiriho, kugira ngw izina ryiwe ntiribe ricibukwa ukundi.
Ariko, Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, wewe uca iziroranye, ukagerageza imishaha n’imitima, umpe kwibonera ingen’ ubīhōra: kukw ari wewe nitwayeko.
None rero, uku ni k’Uhoraho agize ku vy’abagabo bo muri Anatoti barondera kukwica, bati Ntuz’ ugire ico uvuga mw izina ry’Uhoraho, twoye kuzokwica:
uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize rero, at’ Ehe nzobāzira: imisore yabo izokwicwa n’inkota; abahungu babo n’abakobga babo bazokwicwa n’inzara;
ntihazoba hakiri n’amasigarira muri bo, kuko nzozana ivyago ku bagabo bo muri Anatoti, ni wo mwaka wo kūzirwa kwabo.

Ewe Uhoraho, iyo nkubūranije uboneka k’ugororotse; yamara na ho nyene nogomvye ko dusiguzanya: mbeg’ igituma abanyakibi bagenda bagubga neza mu kubaho kwabo n’iki? N’iki gituma abaryarukanyi bose bidibamira ngaho?
Warababaditse, mbere bashinga imizi; barakura, mbere no kwama barāma: uhora hafi mu kanwa kabo, arik’ ukaba kure y’imishaha yabo.
Ariko wewe, Uhoraho, uranzi; urambona, ugerageza umutima wanje ng’ urābe uk’ ukumereye: ubakwegere kubāgwa nk’intama, ubategurire umusi wo kubāgirwako.
Igihugu kizogeza ryari kuboroga, n’ivyatsi vyo mu ntāra yose gukabirana? Kubg’ ibibi vy’abakibamwo ibikōko n’inyoni bikimazwemwo: kuko bavuga, bat’ Ivy’ iherezo ryacu nta ho azobibona.
Ko wirukanye n’abiruka ku maguru bakakuruhisha, none woshobora ute gusiganwa n’amafarasi? Namb’ ugira amahoro gusa igihugu gitēkānye, non’ uzomera ute Yorodani rwigize akagabo?
Kuko na bene wanyu n’inzu ya so ari bo nyene bakuryarutse; ni bo nyene bakuvuza induru inyuma: nawe ntuz’ ubemerere, naho bokubarira amajambo meza.
Nahevye inzu yanje, nataye ishamvu yanje; narekuriye inkundwakazi y’umutima wanje mu maboko y’abansi.
Ishamvu yanje yampindukiye nk’intambge yo mu kibira: irantontomeye, ni co gitumye ndayanka.
Mbeg’ ishamvu yanje ntiyampindukiye nk’ igisīga c’amabara y’uruyoberane? Mbeg’ ibindi bisīga ntivyagikonganije impande zose? Ni mugende mukoranye ibikōko vyo mw ishamba vyose, mubizane bikākagure.
Abungere benshi bāhanyaguye uruzabibu rwanje, bāsiribanze umugabane wanje, umugabane wanje w’igikundiro bāwuciye ubugaragwa bg’ibitongozi.
Bāhagize amatongo; haramborogera, kuko habaye ibitongozi; igihugu cose n’amatongo, kukw ata wigeze kubishirak’ umutima.
Abanyazi baserutse ku mpinga zose mu ruharabuga: kukw inkota y’Uhoraho iriritse, uhereye ku mpera y’igihugu ugashitsa ku yindi: nta muntu n’umwe afise amahoro.
Bābivye ingano, bimbura amahwa: bārīgōye, ntivyagira ico bibamarira; muzomāramāzwa n’ivyo mwejeje, kubg’ uburake bg’inkazi bg’Uhoraho.

Uku ni ko mvuze, jewe Uhoraho, ku vy’ababanyi banje bose babi, bīhaye ku manyama ishamvu neguriye abantu banje b’Abisirayeli, nt’ Ehe nzobashika mbakūre mu gihugu cabo, kand’ inzu ya Yuda nzoyibashikura.
Hanyuma mmaze kubashika nzohindukira mbagirire ikigongwe; kandi nzobagarukana, umuntu wese asubire mw ishamvu yiwe, umuntu wese asubire mu gihugu cabo.

Maze ni bigana umwete ingeso z’abantu banje, bakarahira izina ryanje, ni kwo guhoraho kwanje Uhoraho, nk’uko nyene bāri bārigishije abantu banje kurahira Bayali; ni ho bazokomezwa hagati y’abantu banje.
Ariko ni banka kwumva, ubgoko buzokwanka nzoburandura; ndaburandure ndabuhonnye, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho yambariye, ati Genda wigurire umukanda w’impuzu yera, uwukenyeze, ntuwukoze mu mazi.
Nuko ngura umukanda nk’ukw ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryambariye, ndawukenyeza.
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rinzako ubugira kabiri,
riti Jana wa mukanda wagura, umwe ukenyeye, uve hasi uje kuri Efurate, uwunyegezeyo mu mugāga wo mu gitandara.
Nuko ndagenda, ndawuhisha i ruhande ya Efurate, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yangeze.
Hanyuma hahise imisi myinshi, Uhoraho arambarira, ati Va hasi, uje kuri Efurate, ukūreyo wa mukanda, umwe nakubarira kunyegezayo.
Nuko ndagenda nja kuri Efurate, ndaseregeta nkūra wa mukanda ahantu nari narawunyegeje: nsanga wa mukanda warononekaye, ata co ukimaze.
Maz’ ijambo ry’Uhoraho rinzako,
rit’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Uko ni ko nzokwonona amanyama y’ Ubuyuda n’amanyama akomeye y’i Yerusalemu.

Aba bantu b’abanyakibi, uko bākanse kwumva amajambo yanje, bakagendera mu budadarare bg’imitima yabo, bagakurikira izindi mana ngw abe ari zo basaba, bazisenge, bazomera nk’uyu mukanda utakigira ico umaze.

Nk’uk’ umukanda uramata ubura bg’ umuntu, uko ni ko nari naratumye inzu yose ya Isirayeli indamatako, bo n’inzu yose ya Yuda, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze; kugira ngo bambere ubgoko niharije, bampeshe izina ry’iritazirano, n’icubahiro n’ubgiza: ariko banka kwumva.

None rer’ ubabgire iri jambo, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, at’ Umubindi wose uzokwuzuzwa vino. Na bo bazokwishura, bat’ Ugira ngo ntitwari tubizi yuk’ umubindi wose uzokwuzuzwa vino?

Ni ho uzoca ubabgira, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Ehe ngira nuzuze ababa mur’ iki gihugu bose ubudandahirwe, uhereye ku bami uko bakūranwa ku ngoma ya Dawidi, no ku baherezi, no kuri ba kamenyi, no ku baba i Yerusalemu bose.
Nzobasekanisha nk’impfizi z’intama, umwe n’uwundi, abana na ba se, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze: nta kagongwe nzogira, cank’ impuhwe, cank’ imbabazi, ngo bimbuze kubageseza.
Ni mwumve, mutege amatwi: nta co mugira ubgibone; kuk’ Uhoraho ari we avuze.
Muheshe Uhoraho Imana yanyu icubahiro, atarazana umwiza, ibirenge vyanyu bitaratsitarira ku misozi icuze umwiza; namwe muciteze umuco akawuhindura igitūtu c’urupfu, akawugira umwiza w’umuzitanya.
Ariko ni mwanka kuvyumva, umutima wanje uzoririra mu mpisho, urizwe n’ubgibone bganyu; amaso yanje azorira cane, acundugute amosozi, kuk’ umukuku w’intama z’Uhoraho unyazwe.
Barira umwami n’umugabekazi, uti Ni mwicishe bugufi, mwicare hasi, kukw ibitsibo vyanyu bishajije mwambaye mu mutwe biriko birakoroka.
Ibisagara vy’i bumanuko birugarijwe, nta wugicārūka: Abayuda bajanywe kw inyagano bose, ntihasigara n’uwa kirazira.
Ni wunamure amaso, urābe abaje baturutse i burārūko: mbeg’ umukuku wahawe uri hehe, wa mukuku wawe mwiza?
Abo wironkeyekw abagenzi ni yabashira hejuru yawe ngo bakuganze, uzovuga iki, kand’ ari wewe wabiyigishirije? Mbeg’ umubabaro ntuzogufata nk’uw’ umugore ari ku nda?
Kandi ni wibaza mu mutima, uti N’iki gitumye mbonye aya? Umurengera w’ibigabitanyo vyawe ni wo watumye impuzu zawe zigukūrwako, ibitsintsiri vyawe bigasigara ar’ inkobe.
Mbeg’ Umunyetiyopiya yoshobora guhindura urukoba rw’umubiri wiwe, cank’ ingwe yokwihindura amabara yayo? Ivyo bishobotse, namwe mwoshobora gukora ivyiza, mwebge abāmogoreye gukora ibibi.
Nuko rero nzobashwiragiza, nk’ibishingwe bitwawe n’umuyaga wo mu bugaragwa.
Ivyo ni vyo bizokubako, ni wo mugabane nkugereye, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, kuko wanyibagiye ukizigira ibinyoma.
Nuko rero nanje nzogukūrakw impuzu, mfate ku musozo ndenze ku mutwe wawe, ubgambure bgawe buboneke.

Nabonye ibizira vyawe, ni bgo busambanyi bgawe, n’ukuroherana kwawe, ni bgo bushakanyi bg’ubusambanyi bgawe, ku misozi no ku gahinga. Uzobona ibara, ewe Yerusalemu! Ko wanse kwezwa: mbeg’ uzogeza ryari?
Ijambo ry’Uhoraho riza kuri Yeremiya rivuga ivy’ uruzuba.
I Buyuda haraboroga, amarembo yaho arihebuye, bicara hasi biraburaniwe; gutaka kw’i Yerusalemu kugiye hejuru.
Abashingantahe babo barungika abana kuvoma, bashika ku mariba, basanga ata mazi; bagaruka imibindi yabo iri gusa: baramāramāra baratētērwa, bitwikira mu mutwe.
Kubg’ isi yāse imigāga, kukw ata mvura igikoroka mu gihugu, abarimyi baramāramāra, bitwikira mu mutwe.
Mber’ impongokazi yo mw ishamba iravyara, ita umwana wayo, kukw ata bgatsi.
Indogoba z’inyeshamba zihagarara ku mpinga mu ruharabuga, zisama umuyaga nk’ imbgebge; amaso yazo ahwerezwa no kubura ubgatsi.
Nah’ ibigabitanyo vyacu bitwagiriza, gira ico ukora kubg’ izina ryawe, Uhoraho we: kuko gusubira inyuma kwacu ari kwinshi, kandi twagucumuyeko.
Wewe vyizigiro vy’Abisirayeli, umukiza wabo mu gihe c’ivyago, n’iki cotuma utubako nk’umuntu w’akavantara ari mu gihugu, canke nk’impirahisi yaka indāro y’ijoro rimwe?
N’iki cotuma uba nk’ umuntu atamāriwe, nk’umuhizi ayobewe gukiza? Yamara wewe Uhoraho, uri hagati muri twebge, kandi twitiriwe izina ryawe: ntuduhebe.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho abarira ubu bgoko, at’ Ivyo bakunda n’ ukuyerera; ntibābujije ibirenge vyabo: ni co gituma Uhoraho atabemera; n’ubu yibuka ibigabitanyo vyabo, kand’ arabagīriye kubg’ ivyaha vyabo.
Maz’ Uhoraho arambarira, ati Nta co usabira ubu bgoko kugirirwa neza.
Iyo bisonzesha sinzoruha numva ugutakamba kwabo; iyo bosa ikimazi, bazanye n’ishikanwa ry’ifu, sinzobākīrira: ariko nzobaranduza inkota n’inzara n’ikīza.
Maze ndavuga, nti Yō! Erega Mwami Uhoraho, ba kamenyi bababgira, ngo nta ho bazobona inkota cank’ inzara, ariko ng’ uzobaha kugirira aha hantu amahoro y’ukuri.

Uhoraho aranyishura, at’ Abo ba kamenyi bavuga ibinyoma mw izina ryanje: sinabatumye, nta co nabageze, nta co nababariye: babarotorera ivyo beretswe vy’ibinyoma, n’ indagu, n’ibitagira ikimazi, n’ ubuhuhuta bgo mu mitima yabo.

None rero, uku ni ko mvuze, jewe Uhoraho, ku vya ba kamenyi bavuga mw izina ryanje, kandi ntābatumye, yamara bakavuga ngw Inkota n’inzara ntibizoba mur’ iki gihugu: mber’ inkota n’ inzara ni vyo bizorandura abo ba kamenyi.

Kandi n’abo bantu baragurira bazoshiburirwa hanze mu nzira z’i Yerusalemu bishwe n’inzara n’inkota; kandi ntibazogira uwo kubahamba, bo ubgabo, cank’ abagore babo, cank’ abahungu babo, cank’ abakobga babo: kuko nzobasubizakw ibibi vyabo.
Ubabgire rer’ iri jambo, ut’ Amaso yanje acunduguta amosozi ku murango no mw ijoro adahengeshanya; kuk’ umukobga w’inkumi, ari we bgoko bgacu, avunitse, ari n’imvune nini, ari n’uruguma rubi rwose.
Iyo nsohotse nkaja ku gahinga, nsanga abariritswe n’inkota; nashika mu gisagara, ngasanga abazingamitswe n’inzara! Kuko ba kamenyi n’abaherezi bagendagenda mu gihugu ata co bazi.

Mbega waciye Yuda ruhebga? Umutima wawe wanse Siyoni urunuka? N’iki gitumye udukubita, tukabura ikituvūra? Twari twiteze amahoro, ariko nta vyiza twabonye; twari twiteze igihe co kuvūrirwamwo, ariko tubona ibitugwisha igihūmura!
Ewe Uhoraho, twemeye ibibi vyacu, n’ibigabitanyo vya ba sogokuruza, kuko twagucumuyeko.
Kubg’ izina ryawe ntutwanke urunuka; ntutītūze ingoma y’icubahiro cawe: n’utwibuke, ntiwice isezerano wasezeranye natwe.

Mu bigirwamana vy’imburakimazi vy’ amahanga har’ ivyoshobora kurekura imvura? Cank’ ijuru ubgaryo ryoshobora kurekura iy’ umurindi? Mbeg’ ūbishobora si wewe Uhoraho Mana yacu? Ni co gituma tukwitega; kukw ari wewe waremye ivyo vyose.
Maz’ Uhoraho arambarira, ati Naho Mose na Samweli bohagarara imbere yanje, umutima wanje ntiwohangaza ubu bgoko: bahinde, bave mu nyonga zanje, bagende.

Maze ni bakubaza, bati Tuje hehe? ubabarire, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Abagerewe gupfa, baje mu rupfu; abagerewe inkota baje ku nkota; abagerewe kigoyi baje muri kigoyi; abagerewe gufatwa mpiri bafatwe mpiri.
Kandi ndabagereye ivyago bine, ni k’ Uhoraho agize: inkota yo kwica, n’imbga zo gutabagura, n’ibisīga vyo mu kirēre n’ibikōko vyo kw isi vyo gutsontsomera no gutikiza.
Kandi nzobagira akabarore mu bihugu vy’abami bose bo mw isi, kubga Manase mwene Hezekiya, umwami w’i Buyuda, kubg’ ivyo yakoreye i Yerusalemu.
Ni nde azokugirira akagongwe, ewe Yerusalemu? Ni nde azokuririra? Ni nde azokikama ngw abaze udukuru twawe?
Warantaye, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, wasubiye inyuma; ni co gitumye nagushōreyek’ ukuboko nkaguhonnya; kwigarura kurandambiye.
Nabagosoje urutaro ku marembo y’igihugu; nabakūyekw ibibondo, mponnya abantu banje: ariko ntibāhindukira ngo bave mu nzira zabo mbi.
Abapfakazi babo baragwiriye kurusha umusenyi wo ku kiyaga imbere yanje: nabagomoreye abanyazi ku murango w’amashōka, ngomoreye nyina w’abahungu; namusutseko giturumbuka umubabaro n’ ibiteye ubgoba.
Umugore yavyaye ndwi arahondobereye, aregutse; izuba ryiwe ryacokeye hakiri ku murango; aratēterewe, aramāramāye; amasigarira yabo nzoyagaburira inkota imbere y’ abansi babo, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.

Erega mama, mbonye ibara, kuko wamvyaye nd’ umutēzi w’ intambara, nd’ umutēzi w’amahane mw isi yose! Nta we nagurāniye kuzohabga ay’ inyungu, kandi nta bāngurānye ngo nze mbahe ay’ inyungu: arik’ umuntu wese muri bo aramvuma.
Uhoraho arambarira, ati N’ukuri nzogukomeza umere neza; n’ukuri nzotuma abansi bagukomera ibōbo mu gihe c’ivyago no mu gihe c’amagorwa.
Mbega har’ uwoshobora kuvuna icuma, kand’ ar’ icuma kivuye i burārūko, bo n’umuringa?
Ibintu vyawe n’itunga ryawe nzobigomorera binyagwe ata biguzi, kubg’ ivyaha vyawe vyose, bihereye ku mbibe zawe zose.
Kandi nzotuma bijanwa n’abansi bawe mu gihugu utazi: kuk’ umuriro ucanywe kubg’ uburake bganje, uzobatongora.
Ewe Uhoraho, ivyo urabizi: nyibuka, ungendere, umpōre abandendereza; ntunkūreho, kubg’ ukwihangana kwawe: menya kw ari kubgawe ntukwa.
Amajambo yawe yarabonetse, ndayarya; kand’ amajambo yawe yambereye akanyamuneza n’ibihimbaro vy’umutima wanje: kuko nitiriwe izina ryawe, Uhoraho Mana Nyen’ ingabo.
Sinicaranye n’abaremye akarwi bitwengera, bihimbarirwa: nicaye ukwanje jenyene kubg’ ukuboko kwawe; kuko wanyujuje umwikomo.
N’iki gituma uburibge bganje bgamaho, n’igisebe canje kikaba ikitavūrika, kikanka gukira? Mbega wombera nk’uruzi ruhendana, nk’amazi akamye?

None rero, uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Ni wahindukira nzokugarukana, ubone guhagarara imbere yanje; kandi ni warobanura ivy’ ingirakimazi ukabikūra mu vy’imburakimazi, uzoba nk’akanwa kanje: abandi baze baguhindukirire, ariko weho ntuz’ ubahindukirire.
Kandi mur’ ubu bgoko nzoguhindura uruzitiro rukomeye rw’imiringa; bazokurwanya, ariko ntibazokunesha, kuko nzoba ndi kumwe nawe ngo ngukize, nkurokore, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Nzokurokora ngukūre mu maboko y’ abanyakibi, kandi nzogucungura ngukūre mu maboko y’abantu b’agaterabgoba.
Ijambo ry’Uhoraho rinzak’ ukundi gusha,
riti Ntukābīre umugore, canke ng’ uvyarire abahungu n’abakobga aha hantu.
Kuk’ ukw ari k’Uhoraho agize ku vy’abahungu n’abakobga bavukira aha hantu, no ku vya ba nyina bābatwaye inda no ku vya ba se bābavyariye mur’ iki gihugu:

ati Bazopfa rubi: ntibazoborogerwa, ntibazohambga; bazoba nk’intabire yometse ku misozi: bazoba bamazwe n’inkota n’inzara; kand’ imivyimba yabo izoba inyama z’ibisiga vyo mu kirēre n’ibikōko vyo kw isi.

Kuk’ ukw ari k’Uhoraho agize, ati Nturuhe winjira mu nzu y’abagandaye, ntuje kubaborogera canke kubaririra; kuko nkūye amahoro yanje kur’ ubu bgoko, bo n’imbabazi no kugirirwa neza, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Abakuru n’abato bazopfira mur’ iki gihugu: ntibazohambga, kand’ abantu ntibazobaborogera, canke ngo bikebagure, canke ngo babīmwēre ibimwerere:
kandi nta bazosangira ibiryazagu vyabo; abābuze se canke nyina ntibazobazanira ikarabo ryo kubibagiza umubabaro.
Kandi ntuze winjire mu nzu y’amazimano ngo wicarane na bo, usangire na bo.
Kuk’ ukw ari ko ngize, jewe Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, Imana y’Abisirayeli, nti Rāba aha hantu nzohaca ijwi ry’ibitwengo n’iry’ umunezero, bo n’ijwi ry’umukwe n’iry’ umugeni, mbikore mukibona mukiriho.

Maze ni wamenyesha ubu bgoko ayo majambo yose, bazokubaza, bati N’iki gitumye Uhoraho atugenera ivyo vyago vyose bikomeye birtyo? Mbeg’ ukugabitanya kwacu n’iki? Cank’ icaha twakoze k’Uhoraho Imana yacu n’iki?
Uz’ uce ubabgira, uti N’uko ba sogokuruza banyu bāmutaye, ni k’Uhoraho agize, bakagendanira izindi mana, bakazisaba bakazisenga, na we bakamuta, ntibitondere ivyagezwe vyiwe;
kandi namwe mwakoze ibibi kurusha ba sogokuruza, kukw ehe rāba, umuntu wese muri mwebge agendera mu budadarare bg’umutima wiwe mubi, bigatuma mutamwumvira:

nuko rero ngw Azobirukana abakūre mur’ iki gihugu, muje mu gihugu mutigeze kumenya, mwebge canke ba sogokuruza banyu; muzohasabira izindi mana ku murango no mw ijoro; ngo Kukw atazobahangaza na gatoya.
Nuko rero, uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ngw Imisi izoza ntibazoba bakirahira uguhoraho kwanje jewe Uhoraho ko nakūye Abisirayeli mu gihugu ca Egiputa,
ariko bazorahira uguhoraho kwanje jewe Uhoraho ko nakūye Abisirayeli mu gihugu c’i burārūko, no mu bihugu vyose aho nzoba narabirukaniye: kandi nzobagarukana mu gihugu cabo nahaye ba sekuruza.
Ehe nzotuma ku barovyi benshi, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, bazobaroba; hanyuma nzotuma ku bahīgi benshi, na bo bazobahiga ku gisozi cose no ku karambi kose no mu vyobo vyo mu bitandara.
Kukw inyonga zanje ziri ku nzira zabo zose: ntizinyegejwe ngo sinzibone, kand’ ibigabitanyo vyabo ntibihishijwe inyonga zanje.
Ariko nzobanza kubahōra ibigabitanyo vyabo n’ivyaha vyabo ibihetangabo kabiri, kuko bāndurishije igihugu canje imivyimba y’ibimazi vyabo biteye ishishi, bakuzuza ishamvu yanje bga buyobe bgabo.

Ewe Uhoraho, nkomezi zanje, gihome canje, buhungiro bganje ku musi w’amagorwa, amahanga azoza kuri wewe avuye mw isi yose iy’ iva ikagera, bavuge, bati Ba sogokuruza bacu nta kindi bārazwe atar’ ibinyoma n’ivy’ ubusa n’ibitagira ikimazi.
Mbega kare ho har’ uwokwironkera izitwa imana, kandi zitari zo?
Kubg’ ivyo nzobatahuza, iri rimwe gusa nzobatahuza inganji yanje n’ubushobozi bganje; kandi bazomenya izina ryanje ko nd’ Uhoraho.
Icaha ca Yuda candikishijwe ikaramu y’icuma, n’ akabuye gasongoye kitwa alimasi: canditswe ku bisate, ari vyo mitima yabo, canditswe no ku mahembe y’ibicaniro vyabo;
abana babo bibuka ibicaniro vyabo, n’ibigirwamana vyabo vya Ashera vyashinzwe i ruhande y’ibiti bitotahaye ku misozi miremire.
Ewe musozi wanje wibonekeza mu gihugu, ibintu vyawe n’itunga ryawe ryose nzobigomorera binyagwe, bo n’ibitabo vyawe vyatabge ku mpinga z’imisozi, kubg’ ivyaha, bihereye ku mbibe zawe zose.
Kandi nawe uzohomba ishamvu yawe naguhaye, ari wewe uvyihamagariye; nzotuma ukorera abansi bawe uri mu gihugu utazi, kuko mwadometse umuriro w’uburake bganje uzokwaka gushitsa ibihe vyose.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Aravumwe umuntu yishimira abantu, akizigira inkomezi z’abari n’umubiri, umutima wiwe ukava k’Uhoraho.
Azoba nk’agasaka k’inkōkōre mu bugaragwa, kandi ntazobona ivyiza bimujeko; arikw azoba ahagadutse ahantu h’ ubgeranyange, igihugu c’umunyu kitabamw’ abantu.
Arahiriwe umuntu yizigira Uhoraho, Uhoraho akaba ivyizigiro vyiwe.

Kukw azoba nk’igiti gitewe i ruhande y’amazi, gishōrera imizi yaco i ruhande y’uruzi, kitumva izuba iyo ryatse, ariko kikāmana itōto; ntikizorinda kwiganyira mu mwaka w’uruzuba, kandi ntikizoharuruka kwama.
Umutima uribesha kuruta ibindi vyose, urwaye indwara itavūrwa: ni nde yowumenya?
Ni jewe Uhoraho nsesa umutima, nkagerageza umushaha, kugira ngo ngerere umuntu wese ibikwiranye n’ingeso ziwe, n’ibikwiranye n’ivy’ ibikorwa vyiwe vyeze.
Nk’ukw inkware ibundikira amagi itātaye, umuntu yironkera itunga mu buryo bubi ni kw amera: agicagatije imisi yo kubaho kwiwe rizomuvako, kw iherezo ryiwe azoboneka kw ar’ igipfu.
Ahantu h’ahēra hacu ni ho ntebe y’icubahiro, ishizwe hejuru uhereye mbere na mbere.
Ewe Uhoraho, vyizigiro vy’Abisirayeli, abagutaye bose bazorimarima; abakuvako bazokwandikwa mu mukungugu gusa, kuko bataye Uhoraho, ari we sōko y’amazi y’ ubugingo.
Mvūra, Uhoraho we, nanje ndakira; undokore, nanje ndarokoka: kukw ari wewe shimwe ryanje.
Erega barambaza, bat’ Ijambo ry’Uhoraho riri hehe? Ni rishike turābe!
Ariko jewe ubganje sinanse kuba umwungere nk’uk’ ugomba; sinifuje wa musi w’ivyago, nawe urabizi: ico navugishije akanwa cose car’ imbere yawe.
Ntumbere ikinca ivutu: ni wewe buhungiro bganje ku musi w’ivyago.
Abampīga ni bamāramāre, ariko jeho noye kumāramāra; ni bacike ivutu, ariko jeho noye kuricika: ubashitseko wa musi w’ivyago, ubageseze umurengera.
Maz’ Uhoraho arambarira, ati Genda uhagarare mu kirimba gihitamw’ abantu bose, ari co abami b’Abayuda bahora bacamw’ amaja n’amaza, uhagarare no ku birimba bindi vyose vy’i Yerusalemu,
ubabgire, uti Ni mwumve ijambo ry’Uhoraho, mwebge bami b’i Buyuda na Buyuda bgose, n’ababa i Yerusalemu mwese, abaca mur’ ibi birimba;
uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Ni mwirinde, ntimukagire ico mwiremēka na kimwe ku musi w’isabato, canke ngo mugicishe mu birimba vy’i Yerusalemu;
kandi ntimukagire icikorerwa musohokana mu nzu zanyu ku musi w’isabato, kandi ntimugire igikorwa na kimwe muwukorako: ariko muziririze umusi w’isabato, nk’uko nageze ba sogokuruza;
yamara bo ntibānyumvira, canke ngo batege amatwi, ariko bāgamika amazosi ngo boye kwumva, canke ngo bemere kwigishwa.

None rero mweho ni mwanyumvirana umwete, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, mukareka gucisha icikorerwa na kimwe mu birimba vy’iki gisagara ku musi w’isabato, ariko mukaziririza umusi w’isabato, ntimugire igikorwa na kimwe muwukorako;

ni ho mu birimba vy’iki gisagara hazoca abami n’abaganwa uko bakūranwa ku ngoma ya Dawidi, bagendera mu mikogote no ku mafarasi, bo ubgabo n’ abaganwa babo, n’abagabo b’i Buyuda, n’ababa i Yerusalemu: kand’ iki gisagara kizokwamah’ ibihe bidashira.

Kandi bazoza bavuye mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda, no mu bihugu bikikije i Yerusalemu, no mu gihugu c’Ababenyamini, no mu misozi iciye bugufi, na ruguru mu mugamba, no mu gihugu c’i bumanuko, bazana ibimazi vyo kwoswa n’ivyo gukererwa n’ivyo gushikana, n’imibavu, bazana n’ivy’ ishimwe, babizana mu ngoro yanje jewe Uhoraho.

Ariko ni mutanyumvira ngo muziririze umusi w’isabato, ngo mwoye kugira ico mwiremēka mugicana mu birimba vy’i Yerusalemu ku musi w’isabato, nuko nzodomeka umuriro mu birimba vyaho, uzotongora ingoro z’i Yerusalemu, kandi ntibazoruha bawuzimya.
Ijambo ry’Uhoraho rija kuri Yeremiya,
riti Va hasi, umanuke uje ku nzu y’umubumvyi, aho ni ho nzokwumvishiriza amajambo yanje.
Nuko ndamanuka, nja ku nzu y’umubumvyi, nsanga arikw arabumbira ku rujo.
Maz’ ikintu yarikw arabumba cononekarira mu ntoke z’uwo mubumvyi, nuko yongera kukibumbamw’ ikindi ukundi gusha, kimeze nk’ukw agomba.
Maz’ ijambo ry’Uhoraho rinzako,

riti Yemwe ab’ inzu ya Isirayeli, mbega jewe sinoshobora kubagira nk’uyu mubumvyi? ni k’Uhoraho abaza. Rāba nk’ukw ibumba riri mu kuboko kw’umubumvyi, namwe ni ko muri mu kuboko kwanje, yemwe ab’ inzu ya Isirayeli.
Igihe kimwe novuga ku vy’ihanga no ku vy’ ubgami ku vyo kuzorirandura no kuzorisangangura no kuzorihonnya:
maz’ iryo hanga navuzeko ryohindukira rikareka ibibi vyaryo, nanje nzokwigarura ndeke ibibi nari namaramaje kuzobakorera.
Ikindi gihe novuga ku vy’ihanga no ku vy’ubgami, ku vyo kuzoryubaka no kuzoritēragira:
maze ni ryakora ibibi mu nyonga zanje, ntiryumvire ijwi ryanje, nuko nanje nzogarwa, ndeke ivyiza nari namaramaje kuzobagirira neza.

Nuko rer’ ubarire abagabo b’i Buyuda n’ababa i Yerusalemu, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Ehe mbagereye ikibi, nīgīriye imigabo y’ivyo nzobagirira: enda ni mugaruke, umuntu wese ave mu nzira yiwe mbi, mutunganye inzira zanyu n’ ingeso zanyu.
Ariko bo baravuga, bati N’utwiziguruke, kuko twebge tugomba gukurikira imigabo yacu ubgacu, kand’ umuntu wese muri twebge agomba gukora nk’uk’ ubudadarare bg’umutima wiwe mubi bumeze.
Nuko rero, uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Enda ni mubaze mu mahanga ko hoba har’ uwumvise ibimeze birtyo; inkumi, ni yo Bisirayeli, yakoze ibibi vy’ubuyobe.
Mbega shelegi y’i Lebanoni yoreka kugwa kuri vya bitandara vyaho vyibonekeza mu gihugu? Cank’ amazi yayo atimvye atemba ava kure yokamuka?
Yamar’ abantu banje baranyibagiye, boshereje imibavu ibitagira ikimazi; vyatumye batsitara mu nzira zabo, ni zo nzira za kera, ngo bajane inzira zikikamye, inzira zitanoze,
bituma bahindura igihugu cabo akajoreza, n’ico kuvuzwakw agahwa ubudasība; umuntu wese azohaca azojorerwa, azunguze umutwe.
Nzobasābagiza imbere y’abansi nk’ūbasābagirishije umuyaga uvuye i burasirazuba; nzobatera ibitugu, mbime mu nyonga hanje, ku musi bazobonerakw ibara.

Maze baravuga, bat’ Enda ni muze, duhigire imihigo Yeremiya; kukw ahar’ umuherezi hatobura n’ivyagezwe, kand’ ahar’ umunyabgenge ntihobura n’inama, kand’ ahar’ ūvugishwa n’ Imana ntihobura ijambo ryayo. Enda ni muze, tumukubitishe intega y’ururimi, ntidushire umutima ku magambo yiwe, mwo na rimwe.
Nshirak’ umutima weho Uhoraho, wumvirize ijwi ry’abandwanya.
Mbeg’ iciza cokwishurwa ikibi? Ko banyimbiye icobo! Ibuka ingene nahagaze imbere yawe kugira ngo mbavugire neza, kugira ng’ uburake bgawe bubaveko!

Kubg’ ivyo tanga abana babo ubahe inzara, ubagaburire ubugi bg’inkota; abagore babo ni babure abana babo, bateko bapfakare; abagabo babo ni bicwe n’urupfu, imisore yabo ni yicwe n’inkota yo mu ntambara.
Induru ni zumvikane mu ngo zabo, igihe uzobashikanakw igitero giturumbuka, kuko banyimbiye icobo, bagatega ibirenge vyanje imitego.

Yamara wewe, Uhoraho, urazi imihigo bampigiye yose yo kunyica; ntuharire igicumuro cabo, ntusibanganye icaha cabo ngo kive mu nyonga zawe: ariko batsindwe imbere yawe; abe ari k’ubagirira mu gihe c’uburake bgawe.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho yagize, ati Genda ugure ikarabo ku mubumvyi, uheze ujane abashingantahe bo mur’ ubu bgoko, n’ abakuru b’abaherezi,
ugende ushike mu mwonga wa mwene Hinomu, aherekeye mw ishikiro ry’irembo ry’ababumvyi, uhavugire amajambo nkubarira:

uti Ni mwumve ijambo ry’Uhoraho, mwebge bami b’i Buyuda, namwe ababa i Yerusalemu; uku ni k’ Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, at’ Ehe nzozana ivyago aha hantu, kand’ ūzovyumva wese iminzerere izomuvuga mu matwi.
Kuko bāntaye, bagahumanya aha hantu, bakahoserereza imibavu izindi mana batigeze kumenya, bo na ba sekuruza n’abami b’i Buyuda; bakuzuza aha hantu ibitenga vy’ amaraso y’abatācumuye;
bagataba ibitabo vya Bayali, ngo bahosereze abahungu babo mu muriro, babe ibimazi vyosherejwe Bayali; ar’ ikintu ntābageze, ntāvuze, kitigeze no kuza mu mutima wanje.
Nuko rero, umve, imisi igira ize, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, aha hantu ntihazoba hacitwa Tofeti, canke ngo hitwe Umwonga wa mwene Hinomu; ariko hazokwitwa Umwonga w’Imihindigiti.

Kandi nzohindurira ubusa aha hantu inama z’i Buyuda n’iz’ i Yerusalemu; nzobahindikiranya n’inkota imbere y’abansi babo, bicwe n’amaboko y’ababahīga: kand’ imivyimba yabo nzoyigabura ibe inyama z’ibisīga vyo mu kirēre, n’iz’ ibikōko vyo kw isi.
Nzohindura iki gisagara akajoreza, n’ico kuvuzwakw agahwa; umuntu wese azohaca azojorerwa, avuze agahwa kubg’ ivyago vyaho vyose.
Nzotuma barya abahungu babo n’abakobga babo, umuntu wese aryekw inyama mugenzi we, kubgo kwugarizwa no gusugerezwa, basugerejwe n’abansi babo n’ababahīga ngo babice.
Uheze usābirize iryo karabo imbere y’abo bantu mwajanye,

ubabgire, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, at’ Uko ni ko nzosāvya ubu bgoko n’iki gisagara, nk’uk’ umuntu asāvya ikibumbano, kidashobora kwungwa ukundi: uti Maze bazohamba i Tofeti gushitsa aho batazoba bagishigaje n’akanya k’aho bahamba.
Uko ni ko nzogirira aha hantu, bo n’abahaba, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, mpindure iki gisagara kibe nk’i Tofeti:

ingo z’i Yerusalemu n’ingoro z’abami b’i Buyuda zizoba ibihumane, zimere nk’aha hantu i Tofeti, mbere n’amazu yose būriyeko hejuru ngo bosereze imibavu inyenyeri zose, ari zo ngabo zo kw ijuru, bagasukira ibiturire izindi mana.
Nuko Yeremiya aragaruka avuye i Tofeti, ah’ Uhoraho yari yamutumye kuvuga imbūri; maz’ ahagarara mu rugo rw’ingoro y’ Uhoraho, abarira abantu bose,

at’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, at’ Ehe nzozana kur’ iki gisagara, no ku bindi bisagara vyose vyo hafi yaco, ivyago vyose nakigeneye, kuko bāgamitse amazosi yabo, bakanka kwumva amajambo yanje.
Nuko Pashuri mwene Imeri umuherezi, yar’ umubgiriza mukuru wo mu ngoro y’Uhoraho, yumvise Yeremiya avuze izo mbūri,
aca aramukubita, amushira mu mpatane z’ibiti vyari ku kirimba gihera haruguru citwa ica Benyamini, kirora ku ngoro y’ Uhoraho.
Bukeye Pashuri akūra Yeremiya mur’ izo mpatane. Maze Yeremiya aramubgira, at’ Uhoraho ntiyakwise Pashuri, ariko yakwise Magori‐misabibu.

Kuk’ ukw ari k’Uhoraho agize, ati Nzotuma wikanga, ukange na bagenzi bawe bose; bazohindikiranywa n’inkota z’abansi babo, nawe amaso yawe azovyibonera. Nzotanga Ubuyuda bgose mu kuboko kw’umwami w’i Babuloni, kand’ azobajana ar’ inyagano i Babuloni, kand’ azobicisha inkota.

Ikigeretseko nzotanga itunga ryose ry’iki gisagara, n’ivyar’ inyungu zaco, n’ivy’ igiciro vyaco vyose, mbere n’ibitayega vyose vy’abami b’i Buyuda, mbitange mu maboko y’abansi babo bazoba babanyaze, babafashe, babajanye i Babuloni.
Kandi nawe, Pashuri, mwe n’abo mu rugo rwawe bose, muzojanwa kw inyagano: kand’ uzoshika i Babuloni, ni yo uzogwa, ni yo uzohambga, mwe na bagenzi bawe bose, abo warotoreye ivy’ ibinyoma.
Ewe Uhoraho, waranyoheje ndoha, wandushije inkomezi, uranjaniranya: mpindutse agatwengo kurenza umusi, umuntu wese arancokora.
Kukw iyo mvuze, mvugira hejuru; mvugira hejuru, nti Har’ umuryano n’ubunyazi! Mber’ ijambo ry’Uhoraho ryampinduye agatukisha n’agatwengo kurenza umusi.

Iyo mvuze, nti Sinzosubira kumuvuga, canke ngo ngire ico mvuga mw izina ryiwe, haca haba nk’umuriro uyingana mu mutima wanje, uhīshije uburimbi amagufa yanje, bikangora kwiyumanganya, nkaba ntobishobora.

Kuko numvise benshi bandementaniriza, ubgoba bukantera irya n’ino. Abakunzi banje pfampfe bose, ni bo barereka ko notsitara, bavuga, bati Mumurege, natwe tumurege, kumbure yogwa mu mutego, natwe tukamunesha, tukamwīhōra.

Ariko noneh’ Uhoraho ari kumwe nanje nk’umunyenkomezi n’uw’ igitinyiro; ni co kizotuma abampama batsitara, ntibaneshe: bazorimarima rwose kuko batākoze ivy’ ubgenge, bagire ibitētērwa bitazobavako, bitazoruha vyibagirana.
Ariko wewe, Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, wewe ugerageza abagororotsi, ukitegereza imishaha n’imitima, umpe kwibonera ingen’ ubīhōra, kukw ari wewe nitwayeko.
Muririmbire Uhoraho, muhimbaze Uhoraho: kuko yarokoye ubugingo bg’umukene, akabukūra mu maboko y’inkozi z’ibibi.
Umusi navukiyeko uravumwe! Umusi mama yamvyariyeko ntube ucitwa uw’ amahirwe.
Aravumwe umuntu yazaniye inkuru data, at’ Uvyaye umwana w’umuhungu; bikamunezereza cane.
Uwo muntu n’abe nka vya bisagara Uhoraho yasanganguye, ata kagongwe: ni yumve amaborogo mu gatondotondo, n’ akarūru ku murango;
kukw atānyishe nkiri mu nda ya mama; ni ko mama yombereye imva, akazokwama akuriwe.
N’iki cankūye mu nda, ngo nze mbone ubutame n’umubabaro, imisi yanje nkayimara mu bitētērwa?
Ijambo ryaje kuri Yeremiya rivuye k’Uhoraho, igihe umwami Zedekiya yamutumako Pashuri mwene Malakiya na Zefaniya mwene Mayaseya umuherezi,
muti Basigurize Uhoraho; kuko Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni ateye: kumbure Uhoraho yotugirira nk’ukw ibikorwa vyiwe vyose vy’igitangaza bimeze, agatuma asubira inyuma akatureka.
Maze Yeremiya arabishura, at’ Uku abe ari ko mubarira Zedekiya:

mut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, at’ Ehe nzobakubiranya hamwe n’ibirwanishwa biri mu maboko yanyu, ivyo murwanisha umwami w’i Babuloni n’Abakaludaya babugarije, muriko murabarwanisha inyuma y’inzitiro z’iki gisagara, mbakoranirize hamwe hagati muri co.
Kandi nanje ubganje nzobarwanya, mbarwanishe ukuboko kubānguye n’ukuboko kw’inkomezi, ndi n’ishavu n’ubushangashirwe n’uburake bg’inkazi.
Kandi nzokubita ababa mur’ iki gisagara, abantu n’ibitungwa: bazokwicwa n’ikīza gikomeye.

Kandi hanyuma y’ivyo, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, nzogabura Zedekiya umwami w’Abayuda, n’ abasavyi biwe, n’abantu bazoba bagisigaye mur’ iki gisagara, batishwe n’ikīza n’inkota n’inzara, mbashire mu kuboko kwa Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni, no mu maboko y’abansi babo, no mu maboko y’abarondera kubica: azobicisha ubugi bg’inkota; ntazobagirira impuhwe cank’ akagongwe cank’ imbabazi.
Maz’ aba bantu ubabarire, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Rāba mbashize imbere inzira y’ubugingo n’inzira y’urupfu.
Ūguma mur’ iki gisagara azokwicwa n’inkota n’inzara n’ikīza: arik’ ūsokoroka muri co, akīsaba Abakaludaya babugarije, azobaho, kand’ azoba akijije amagara yiwe.
Kuko ntungiriye igitsure iki gisagara ngo nkizanekw amagorwa, sinkizanekw amahirwe, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze; kizotangwa mu kuboko kw’umwami w’i Babuloni, kand’ azogitongoza umuriro.
Kandi ku vy’inzu y’umwami w’i Buyuda, ni mwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho:

Ewe nzu ya Dawidi, uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Ni muce imanza ziroranye uko bukeye, mukize ūnyazwe mumukūre mu kuboko kw’ūmuhahaza, uburake bganje bgoye kurabagiza nk’umuriro, bukarurumba ntihagire ūshobora kubuzimya, kubg’ ibibi mukora.

Rāba nzohigūra nawe, wewe gisagara cubatswe ku mushasha, ku gitandara co mu kiyaya, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze; yemwe abavuga, muti Ni nde yorinduka kumanuka ngw adutere? Canke ni nde yoshika mu ngo zacu?
Nzobahana nk’ukw ibikorwa vyanyu vyamuje, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze; kandi nzodomeka umuriro mu kibira caho uzotongora ibiri hirya no hino yaho vyose.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Manuka uje ku ngoro y’ umwami w’i Buyuda, uhavugire iri jambo,
uti Ni wumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho, yewe mwami w’i Buyuda, uri ku ngoma ya Dawidi, wewe n’abasavyi bawe, n’abaca mur’ aya marembo.

Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Ni muce imanza ziroranye n’izigororotse, mukize ūnyazwe, mumukūre mu kuboko kw’ ūmuhahaza; ntimugirire nabi canke ngo muhahaze ingenzi n’ impfuvyi n’umupfakazi, canke ngo muvishirize aha hantu amaraso y’ abatācumuye.
Kuko ni mwagenza murtyo koko, ni ho mu birimba vy’iki gisagara hazoca abami uko bakūranwa ku ngoma ya Dawidi, bagendera mu mikogote no ku mafarasi, umwami wese n’ abasavyi biwe n’abantu biwe.
Ariko ni mwanka kwumva ayo majambo, iyi ngoro izocika umusaka, ndirahiye ubganje, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Kuk’ ukw ari k’Uhoraho agize, ku vy’ingoro y’umwami w’i Buyuda, ati War’ umbereye nka Gileyadi, canke nk’ agatwe ka Lebanoni: n’ukuri nzoguhindura ubugaragwa, ube nk’ ibisagara bitakirimw’ umuntu.
Kandi nzogutegurira abo kugusangangura, umuntu wese muri bo afise ibirwanishwa; bazohimbagura inkingi zawe z’amasederi meza, baziterere mu muriro.
Kand’ amahanga menshi azoca i ruhande y’iki gisagara, bazobazanya, bati N’iki catumye Uhoraho agirira artyo iki gisagara gihambaye?
Maze bazobishura, bati Ni kuko bātaye isezerano bāsezeranye n’Uhoraho Imana yabo, bagasenga izindi mana bakazisaba.
Ntimukaririre uwamaze gupfa, canke ngo mumuborogere: ariko muririre uwagiye mazimayongo, kukw atazoba akigaruka ukundi, canke ngw asubire kubona igihugu yavukiyemwo.
Kuko ku vya Shalumu mwene Yosiya umwami w’i Buyuda, yasubiye ku ngoma ya se Yosiya, yavuye aha hantu akagenda mazimayongo: ntazosubira kugaruka ino ukundi, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze;
arikw iyo bāmushorereye ar’ inyagano ni yo azogwa, kandi ntazosubira kubona iki gihugu ukundi.
Azobona ibara uwubakisha inzu yiwe mu biva mu kugabitanya, akayitegurisha ibigungano; agakoresha mugenzi we ku kagōbēro, ntamuhe ingero yiwe;
akavuga, ati Hinge niyubakire inzu nini n’ivyumba vyagutse, akayicamw’ amadirisha; akayishiramw’ insenge z’amasederi, akazisīga irangi ritukura.
Mbeg’ ubeshejwe ku ngoma n’uk’ urushije abandi kwubakisha amasederi? Mbega so ntiyabonye gufungura no kwuhira? Yamara we yaciye iziroranye n’izibereye; maze yibereye amahoro.
Yaciriye urubanza umworo n’umukene; maze hakaba amahoro. Mbeg’ ivyo si kwo kummenya kw’ukuri? ni jewe Uhoraho mbibajije.
Ariko weho amaso yawe n’umutima wawe nta handi bitumbereye atar’ ukwifuza inyungu mbi, no kuvisha amaraso y’abatācumuye, no guhahaza, n’umuryano.

None rero, uku ni k’Uhoraho agize ku vya Yehoyakimu mwene Yosiya umwami w’i Buyuda, ati Ntibazomuborogera, bat’ Ewe musazanje! Ewe mwana wa mama! Ntibazomuborogera, bat’ Ewe mwami wanje! Ewe cubahiro ciwe!
Azotabga nk’uko bata indogoba, bamukweze bamushiburiye inyuma y’ibirimba vy’i Yerusalemu.
Dūga i Lebanoni, utake; shira ijwi hejuru ur’ i Bashani; taka uhagaze ahitwa Abarimu; kukw abūzure bawe bose bageseye.
Navuganye nawe igihe war’ umerewe neza, arik’ uravuga, uti Sinduha ndavyumva. Iyo ni yo ngeso yawe uhereye mu buto bgawe, yo kutanyumvira.
Umuyaga ni wo uzoragira abungere bākuragira bose, kand’ abūzure bawe bazoja mu mugozi: bibaye birtyo ntuzobura gutētērwa no kumāramāra kubg’ ibibi vyawe vyose.
Ewe uba kuri Lebanoni, ukārika icāri cawe mu masederi, es’ ukuntu uzoba uteye akagongwe igihe ibise bizoba bigufashe, nk’umubabaro w’umugore aramutswe!
Ndahiye ukubaho kwanje, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, yuko naho wewe Koniya mwene Yehoyakimu umwami w’i Buyuda woba impeta y’ikimenyetso ku kuboko kwanje kw’i buryo, na ho nyene nogushikura nkagukūraho;
kandi nzokugabura mu maboko y’abarondera kukwica, no mu maboko y’abo utinya, mbere no mu kuboko kwa Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni, no mu maboko y’Abakaludaya.
Kandi nzogushiburana na nyoko yakuvyaye, mbashiburire mu kindi gihugu, aho mutāvukiye; aho ni ho muzogwa.
Arikw igihugu imitima yabo yifuza kugarukamwo, ntibazokigarukamwo na mba.
Mbeg’ uyu Koniya n’urwavya rukēngērwa rusāvye? N’urwavya rudahimbaye? N’iki catumye bashiburwa, bashiburirwa mu gihugu batazi?
Ewe wa gihugu we, wa gihugu we, wa gihugu we, ni wumve ijambo ry’Uhoraho!

Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Ni mwandike uyu muntu kw abaye incike, umuntu atazopfa aroraniwe: kukw ata wo mu ruvyaro rwiwe azororanirwa, ngw asubire ku ngoma ya Dawidi, canke ngw az’ asubire kuganza i Buyuda.
Bazobona ibara, abungere batikiza intama zo mu canya canje, bakazishwiragiza! ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.

None rero, uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ku vyo ageneye abungere baragira abantu biwe: ati Mwashwiragije umukuku wanje, murawirukana, ntimwawurāba; nuko rero nanje nzobāzira, mbazanekw ivyago bihwanye n’ ukugira nabi kwanyu, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Kandi nzokoraniriza hamwe amasigarira y’ umukuku wanje, ndazikūre mu bihugu vyose aho nazirukaniye, ndazigarukane ukundi gusha mu mpongore zazo; zizorondoka zigwire.
Kandi nzoshira abungere kuri zo, baziragire: ntizizoba zikigira ubgoba ukundi, canke ngo zihagarike imitima, kandi ntihazotākara n’imwe muri zo, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Rāba imisi izoza, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, nzonagisha kuri Dawidi uwitwa Shami w’umugororotsi, kand’ azoganza nk’ umwami, agire ikiganza ciza, ace iziroranye n’izibereye mu gihugu.
Mu gihe ciwe Abayuda bazokizwa, Abisirayeli bibere amahoro: kand’ iri ni ryo zina azokwitwa, ng’ Uhoraho ni we kugororoka kwacu.
Nuko rero, mu misi izoza, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, ntibazoba bakirahira uguhoraho kwanje, jewe Uhoraho, ko nakūye Abisirayeli mu gihugu ca Egiputa,

ariko bazorahira uguhoraho kwanje Uhoraho, ko nakūye uruvyaro rw’ab’ inzu ya Isirayeli mu gihugu c’i burārūko, nkabarōngōra, nkabakūra mu bihugu vyose aho nzoba narabirukaniye; kandi bazokwibera mu gihugu cabo bgite.
Ku vya ba kamenyi. Umutima wanje unsābiye mu nda, amagufa yanje yose aratetemera; mmeze nk’imborerwa, nk’umuntu yaneshejwe na vino, kubg’ Uhoraho n’amajambo yiwe yera.
Kukw igihugu cuzuye abasambanyi; kubg’ umuvumo igihugu kiragandaye; imyīmīro yo ku mirāmbi irumye; ingeso zabo ni mbi, ububasha bgabo ni bubi.
Kuko ba kamenyi n’abaherezi ar’ ibihumane; mbere no mu ngoro yanje nabonye ivyaha vyabo, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Ni co gitumye inzira yabo izobabera nk’ahanyerera mu mwiza: bazokwirukanwa bahagwe, kuko nzobazanakw ivyago, ni wo mwaka wo kūzirwa kwabo, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Nabonye ubupfu bga ba kamenyi i Samariya; bāvugishijwe na Bayali, bakazimiza abantu banje b’Abisirayeli.

Mbonye ubuyobe muri ba kamenyi b’i Yerusalemu: barasambana, bagendera mu binyoma, baremesha inkozi z’ibibi, bigatuma ata wigarura ngw ave mu bibi vyiwe: bose bampindukiye nk’i Sodomu, n’ababayo bampindukiye nk’i Gomora.

Nuko rero, uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize ku vya ba kamenyi: at’ Ehe rāba, nzobagaburira ivy’ umururazi, nzobanywesha amazi y’ubumara: kukw ibihumanya vyasāvye igihugu cose, biturutse kuri ba kamenyi b’i Yerusalemu.

Nuk’ uku ni k’ Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ati Ntimwumvirize amagambo abo ba kamenyi bababarira; babigisha ibitagira ikimazi; barotora ivyo beretswe bivuye mu mitima yabo ubgabo, bitavuye mu kanwa kanje Uhoraho.
Ntibahengeshanya kubarira abakēngēra ijambo ryanje, bat’ Uhoraho yavuze ngo Muzoba amahoro; kand’ umuntu wese agendera mu budadarare bg’umutima wiwe, baramubgira, bati Nta cago kizobazako.
Ni nde yabaye mu nama yanje, jewe Uhoraho, canke ngw amenye ijambo ryanje, aryumve? Ni nde yategereye ijambo ryanje akaryumva?
Rāba ikirura canje, jewe Uhoraho, ni bgo burake bganje, kirahinze, mbere n’ikirura c’imvugusi: kizorindimukira ku mitwe y’abanyavyaha.
Uburake bganje jewe Uhoraho ntibuzokebanuka kugeza aho nzoba nshikije ivy’ umutima wanje wagabiye, mbiheraheje: mu misi yo hanyuma muzobitahura rwose.
Erega si jewe natumye abo ba kamenyi, yamara bārirukanze; jewe nta co navuganye na bo, yamara baravugishwa.
Iyaba bārabaye mu nama yanje baba bātumye abantu banje bumva amajambo yanje, kandi baba bārabahindukije bakava mu nzira yabo mbi, no mu bikorwa vyabo bibi.
Mbega nd’ Imana igarukira hafi gusa? ni jewe Uhoraho mbibajije; sind’ Imana ishika kure na ho?
Har’ uwoshobora kwinyegeza ahantu hihishije ngo nanje sindamubone? ni jewe Uhoraho mbibajije. Mbega sinkwiye ijuru n’isi? ni jewe Uhoraho mbibajije.
Numvise ivyo ba kamenyi bavuga, barotora ibinyoma mw izina ryanje; bati Narose, narose.
Ivyo bizogeza ryari kuba mu mitima ya ba kamenyi barotora ibinyoma, ni bo bavugishwa n’ubugunge bgo mu mitima yabo?
