Bibgira ko bokwibagiza abantu banje izina ryanje, babibagirisha inzozi zabo barotora, izo umuntu wese arotorera mugenzi we, nk’ uko ba sekuruza babo bibagijwe izina ryanje na Bayali.
Kamenyi ni yagira ico yarose, n’akirotore; kand’ ūfise ijambo ryanje n’ avuge iryo jambo adacishije i ruhande. Mbeg’ umuguruka uhwanye ute n’ingano? ni jewe Uhoraho mbibajije.
Mbeg’ ijambo ryanje si nk’umuriro? ni jewe Uhoraho mbibajije; canke si nk’inyundo imenagura igitandara?
Nuko rer’ ehe rāba, abo ba kamenyi tuzohigūra twe na bo, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, abība amajambo yanje, umuntu wese akayība uwundi.
Rāba, nzohigūra n’abo ba kamenyi, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, ababishira mu kanwa kabo, ngo ni ko nabivuze.

Rāba, nzohigūra n’abarotora inzozi z’ibinyoma, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, bakazisigura, bakazimirisha abantu banje ibinyoma vyabo n’ukwihayagiza kwabo kw’ ubusa: yamara jewe nta ho nabatumye, nta co nabageze; kandi nta co bazomarira ubu bgoko na gatoya, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Kand’ aba bantu canke kamenyi cank’ umuherezi, ni hagira ūkubaza, at’ Imbūri y’Uhoraho ivuga iki? uz’ umwishure, ut’ Ugize ngw imbūri n’iki? N’ukw agira ngw abate, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Kandi kamenyi cank’ umuherezi cank’ uwo mu bantu ni hagira ūpfa kuvuga ivy’ imbūri yanje jewe Uhoraho, uwo muntu nzomuhana, bo n’abo mu nzu yiwe.
Uku az’ abe ari k’umuntu wese abaza umubanyi wiwe, abaze na mugenzi we, ati Mbeg’ Uhoraho yishuye iki? Kand’ ati Mbeg’ Uhoraho yavuze iki?
Imbūri y’Uhoraho ntimuze muyivuge ukundi: kukw ijambo ry’umuntu wese ari ryo rizomubera imbūri; erega mwagoretse amajambo y’Imana nzima, ni yo y’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo Imana yacu.
Uz’ ubaze ūvugishwa, uti Mbeg’ Uhoraho yakwishuye iki? Cank’ ut’ Uhoraho yavuze iki?
Ariko ni mwavuga ivy’ imbūri y’Uhoraho, uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Ko muvuga iryo jambo ry’imbūri yanje Uhoraho, nanje nkaba nabatumyeko ndabibabuza, nti Ntimukavuge ivy’ imbūri yanje, jewe Uhoraho;
nuko rero nzobībagira rwose, nzobashiburana n’igisagara nabahānye na ba sogokuruza, ngo mumve imbere;
kandi nzobazanira umuvumo utazovaho, ibitētērwa bitazoshira, bitazoruha vyibagirana.

Uhoraho aranyereka, mbona ibisimbo bibiri vy’insukoni biteretse imbere y’urusengero rw’ Uhoraho, igihe Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni yar’ amaze kujana Yekoniya mwene Yehoyakimu, umwami w’i Buyuda, kw inyagano, bo n’abaganwa b’i Buyuda n’ababāji n’abacuzi, abakūra i Yerusalemu abashikana i Babuloni.
Igisimbo kimwe carimw’ insukoni nziza cane, zimeze nk’insukoni z’isega: ikindi gisimbo carimw’ insukoni ziboze rwose, zitoshoboka kuribga kubgo kubora.
Maz’ Uhoraho arambaza, at’ Ubonye iki ga Yeremiya? Ndamwishura, nti Mbonye insukoni; inziza ni nziza cane, iziboze ziraboze cane, zitoshoboka kuribga kubgo kubora.
Maz’ ijambo ry’Uhoraho rinzako,

rit’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ati Nk’uk’ umuntu yokwerekeza umutima kur’ izi nsukoni nziza, ni ko nzowerekeza ku Bayuda, kugira ngo mbagirire neza, abo narungitse ar’ inyagano, ngo bave aha hantu baje mu gihugu c’Abakaludaya.
Kuko nzobashirakw ijisho kugira ngo mbagirire neza, kandi nzosubira kubagarukana mur’ iki gihugu: nzobubaka, sinzobasambura; nzobatēragira, sinzobarandura.
Kandi nzobaha umutima wo kummenya yuko nd’ Uhoraho: bazoba abantu banje, nanje nzoba Imana yabo, kuko bazongarukanak’ umutima wabo wose.

Kandi nk’uko bata insukoni ziboze, zidashoboka kuribga kubgo kubora, ni ko nzota Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda, n’abaganwa biwe, n’amasigarira y’i Yerusalemu asigaye mur’ iki gihugu, n’abāgiye kuba mu gihugu ca Egiputa, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze;
mbere nzobatanga batererekanywe irya n’ino mu bihugu vy’abami bose bo mw isi, ngo mbagirire nabi; bazoba igitutsi n’iciro ry’imigani n’agatwengo n’ ibivume, ahantu hose aho nzobirukanira.
Kandi nzorungika inkota n’inzara n’ikīza muri bo, gushitsa aho bazoba baherengeteye mu gihugu nabahānye na ba sekuruza.

Ijambo ryaje kuri Yeremiya ku vy’abantu bose b’i Buyuda mu mwaka ugira kane Yehoyakimu mwene Yosiya, umwami w’i Buyuda, ari ku ngoma; ni wo war’ umwaka wa mbere wa Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni wo kuba ku ngoma.
Iryo ni ryo Yeremiya uwavugishwa n’Imana yabariye abantu bose b’i Buyuda, n’ababa i Yerusalemu bose,

at’ Uhereye mu mwaka ugira icumi na gatatu wa Yosiya mwene Amoni, umwami w’i Buyuda, gushitsa no kur’ uyu musi, iyo myaka ukw ari mirongwibiri n’itatu, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryama rinzako, nanje nkaribabgira, nkāma nzindurwa no kubabarira, namwe ntimwumve.
Kand’ Uhoraho yabatumyekw abasavyi biwe bose abo yavugisha, yama azindurwa no kubatuma, namwe ntimwumve, canke ngo mutege amatwi ngo mwumvirize;
at’ Enda ni mugaruke, umuntu wese ave mu nzira yiwe mbi, muve mu bubi bg’ibikorwa vyanyu, ni ho muzokwibera mu gihugu Uhoraho yabahānye na ba sogokuruza, uhereye kera ugashitsa ibihe bitazoshira.
Kandi ntimugakurikire izindi mana ngo muzisabe, muzisenge; ntimukamurakishe ibikorwa vy’intoke zanyu: na we ntazogira ivyago abatēza.
Ariko mwebge ntimwanyumviye, ni k’ Uhoraho agize, atar’ ukundakisha ibikorwa vy’intoke zanyu, mukikwegera ivyago.
None rero, uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ati Ko mutumviye amajambo yanje,

nzotuma kugomora imiryango yose y’i burārūko, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, kandi nzotuma no kuri Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni, umusavyi wanje, mbazane ngo barwanye iki gihugu n’abakibamwo, barwanye n’aya mahanga yose agikikije; kandi nzobageseza rwose, mbahindure akajoreza, n’abo kuvuzwakw agahwa, n’iciro ry’imigani ibihe bidashira.
Ikindi, nzobakūramw’ ijwi ry’ibitwengo n’iry’ umunezero, n’ijwi ry’umukwe n’iry’ umugeni, n’ukuvuga kw’urusyo n’ukubonesha kw’itara.
Kand’ iki gihugu cose kizoba amatongo n’akajoreza; kand’ ayo mahanga azokorera umwami w’i Babuloni imyaka mirongwirindwi.

Hanyuma y’ivyo, iyo myaka mirongwirindwi ishize, nzohana umwami w’i Babuloni bo n’iryo hanga, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, mbahōre ukugabitanya kwabo; nzohana n’igihugu c’Abakaludaya, ngihindure amatongo gushitsa ibihe vyose.
Kandi nzoshitsa kur’ ico gihugu amajambo yanje yose y’ivyo nakigeneye, ni vyo vyanditswe mur’ iki gitabo uko bingana, ivyo navugishije Yeremiya mbigeneye amahanga yose.
Kandi na bo ubgabo amahanga menshi n’abami bahambaye bazobahindura abaja; kandi nzoba mbashubirije mu nkōko ibihwanye n’ivyo bākoze, n’ibihwanye n’ ibikorwa vy’amaboko yabo.
Kuk’ ukw ari k’Uhoraho ambariye, ari we Mana y’Abisirayeli, at’ Enda abīra mu kuboko kwanje iki gikombe ca vino y’uburake bganje, ukiramize amahanga yose ngutumyeko, bakinywe.
Bazokinywa badandabagirane, bazimire ubgenge, kubg’ inkota nzorungika muri bo.
Nuko nābīra igikombe mu kuboko kw’ Uhoraho, ndakiramiza amahanga yose Uhoraho yantumyeko;
ni yo aya: Yerusalemu n’ibisagara vy’i Buyuda n’abami baho n’abaganwa baho, ngo hacike imisaka n’akajoreza n’aho kuvuzwakw agahwa n’ikivume, nk’uko nyene bimeze uyu musi;
nkiramiza Farawo, umwami wa Egiputa n’ abasavyi biwe n’abaganwa biwe n’ abantu biwe bose;
bo n’amahanga yose y’ikivange, n’abami bose bo mu gihugu ca Uzi, n’abami bose bo mu gihugu c’i Bufilisitiya, n’i Ashikeloni n’i Gaza n’i Ekuroni, n’amasigarira yo muri Ashidodi,
n’i Edomu n’i Mowabu n’ab’ umuryango wa Amoni,
nkiramiza n’abami bose b’i Tiro n’abami bose b’i Sidoni, n’ abami b’ikizinga co hirya mu kiyaga,
n’i Dedani n’i Tema n’i Buzi; n’abica amasoso bose;
n’ abami bose b’i Arabiya, n’abami bose b’amahanga y’ikivange baba mu bugaragwa,
n’abami bose b’i Zimuri, n’abami bose b’i Elamu, n’abami bose b’Abamedi,
n’abami bose b’i burārūko, abari kure n’abari hafi, bose hamwe; n’ibihugu vyose vy’abami bo mw isi, aho biri hose mw isi; kand’ umwami w’i Sheshaki ni we azobaherukira kunywa.

Kand’ uz’ ubabarire, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ati Ni munywe, muborerwe, mudahwe, mwubameho, ntimuze musubire kuvyuka ukundi, kubg’ inkota nzorungika muri mwebge.
Maze ni baramuka banse kwābīra igikombe mu kuboko kwawe ngo banywe, uz’ uheze ubabarire, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ati Ntimugenda mutakinyoye:

ko ntanguriye ku gisagara citiriwe izina ryanje kuhazana ivyago, none mwebge mwobura guhanwa? Eka ntimuzobura guhanwa na mba: kuko nzohamagara inkota ngw ize ku baba kw isi bose, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo mbivuze.

Nuko rero, ubabūrire ayo majambo yose, ubabgire, ut’ Uhoraho azokwivuga ari mw ijuru, avuge n’ijwi rirenga ar’ ahiwe hēra; umukuku wiwe azowutontomera; azovuza akāmo, nk’ak’ abakānya inzabibu, akavugirije ababa kw isi bose.
Ijwi ryavyo rizoshika no ku mpera y’isi; kuk’ Uhoraho afitaniye imibūrano n’amahanga, azobūrana n’abariho bose; kand’ abanyavyaha azobagaburira inkota, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, at’ Eh’ ivyago bizosimba‐simba biva kw ihanga bija ku rindi, kand’ ikirura gihambaye kizozingazinga kivuye ku mpera z’isi.
Abishwe n’Uhoraho bazohēra ku mpera y’isi bashike ku yindi, ntibazoririrwa, canke ngo begeranywe, canke ngo bahambge; bazoba nk’intabire yometse ku misozi.
Muboroge, mwa bungere, murire; mwitembagaze mu minyota, yemwe ba kizigenza mu mukuku: kukw igihe co kubāgwa kwanyu gishitse rwose; nzobasāvya, mukoroke nk’ikarabo riteye igomwe.
Abungere ntibazobona inzira yo guhunga, canke ba kizigenza mu mukuku ngo babone ingene bacika.
Umve ijwi ry’ ukurira kw’abungere, n’iry’ ukuboroga kwa ba kizigenza mu mukuku! Kuk’ Uhoraho yakomvoje ubgatsi bgazo.
Impongore zār’ amahoro zisigaye zumaniwe, kubg’ uburake bg’inkazi bg’Uhoraho.
Yahevye ahiwe nk’ukw intambge iheba ikibundo cayo; kukw igihugu cabo gihindutse akajoreza kubg’ ubukare bg’inkota itwaza igitugu, no kubg’ uburake bgiwe bg’inkazi.
Mu matangura yo kuba ku ngoma kwa Yehoyakimu mwene Yosiya umwami w’Abayuda, haza iri jambo rivuye k’ Uhoraho,

rit’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Hagarara mu nyubakwa y’ingoro yanje Uhoraho, ubarire ab’ibisagara vyose vy’i Buyuda baza gusenga mu ngoro yanje, amajambo yose nkubarira yo kubabgira: ntusige na rimwe.
Kumbure bohava bumva, umuntu wese agahindukira akareka inzira yiwe mbi, ngo nanje mbone kwigarura, ndeke ibibi mmaramaje kubakorera kubg’ ibibi vy’ibikorwa vyabo.
Kand’ ubabarire, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Ni mwanka kumutega amatwi, ngo mugendere mu vyagezwe vyiwe yabashize imbere,
ngo mwumvire amajambo y’ abasavyi biwe avugisha, abo abatumako, mber’ akāma azindurwa no kubatuma, mukanka kubumvira,
ngo Ni ho azohindura iyi ngoro kuba nk’i Shilo, kandi n’iki gisagara ngw Azogihindura ikivume ku mahanga yose yo mw isi.
Maz’ abaherezi na ba kamenyi n’ abantu bose bumva Yeremiya avugira ayo majambo yose mu ngoro y’Uhoraho.
Nuko Yeremiya aheraheje kuvuga vyose Uhoraho yamugeze kubarira abantu bose, abaherezi n’abo ba kamenyi n’ abantu bose baramufata, bati Ntugenda udapfuye.
N’iki kikuvugisha mw izina ry’Uhoraho ngw Iyi ngoro izomera nk’i Shilo, ngo N’iki gisagara kizoba amatongo, ata wukikibamwo? Nukw abantu bose bakoranira kuri Yeremiya mu ngoro y’Uhoraho.
Maz’ abaganwa b’i Buyuda bumvise ivyo, baradūga bavuye mu ngoro i bgami, baja ku ngoro y’ Uhoraho; bicara mw ishikiro ku kirimba gisha c’urugo rw’ Uhoraho.
Maz’ abaherezi na ba kamenyi babarira abaganwa n’abantu bose, bat’ Uyu muntu akwiye gupfa; kukw ataze ibibi kur’ iki gisagara, nk’uko mwiyumviye n’amatwi yanyu.
Maze Yeremiya abarira abaganwa bose n’abantu bose, at’ Uhoraho ni we yantumye kubūrira kur’ iyi ngoro no kur’ iki gisagara amajambo yose mwumvise.
None rero mutunganye ingeso zanyu n’ibikorwa vyanyu, mwumvire Uhoraho Imana yanyu; maz’ Uhoraho azokwigarura areke ibibi yar’ abageneye.
Ariko jeho ndi mu maboko yanyu: mungire nk’uko mubona ko bikwiye kandi bibereye mu maso yanyu.

Kimwe gusa, mumenye rwose ni mwanyica, ko muzoba mwizanyekw amaraso y’ ūtācumye, azoba kuri mwebge ubganyu no kur’ iki gisagara no ku bakibamwo: kuko vy’ukuri Uhoraho ni we yabantumyeko kuvugira ayo majambo yose mu matwi yanyu.
Maz’ abaganwa n’abantu bose babarira abaherezi n’abo ba kamenyi, bat’ Uyu muntu ntakwiye gupfa, kukw atubariye mw izina ry’Uhoraho Imana yacu.
Maze hava hasi bamwe bo mu bashingantahe b’igihugu, babarira ikoraniro ryose ry’abantu,

bati Mika w’i Moresheti yavugishwa n’Imana ku ngoma ya Hezekiya umwami w’i Buyuda; kandi yabariye abantu bose b’i Buyuda, at’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ati Siyoni hazosīzwa hahinduke nk’ubusīze, Yerusalemu hazohinduka ibirundo vy’ amasakamburira, n’umurwa wubatswekw iyi ngoro uzohinduka nk’ikibira kiri ku mpinga z’imisozi.

Mbega Hezekiya umwami w’i Buyuda n’Abayuda bose mugira ngo bāramwishe? Hezekiya ntiyaciye atinya Uhoraho, akamukomera ibobo, Uhoraho na we akīgarura akareka ivyago yari yabageneye? Twogira ico tumugira twoba dukwegeye ubugingo bgacu ivyago bihambaye.

Kandi hāri n’uwundi yavugishwa mw izina ry’Uhoraho, ni Uriya mwene Shemaya w’i Kiriyati‐yeyarimu; uyo yavugishijwe n’ Imana ku bizoba kur’ iki gisagara no kur’ iki gihugu bihwanye n’amajambo yose ya Yeremiya.
Maz’ umwami Yehoyakimu n’intōre ziwe zose n’abaganwa bose, bumvise amajambo yiwe, umwami ashaka kumwica; ariko Uriya avyumvise, agira ubgoba, arahunga, aja muri Egiputa;
nuk’ umwami Yehoyakimu atuma abantu muri Egiputa, ni bo Elunatani mwene Akabori n’abandi bagabo bamwe bajanye na we muri Egiputa;
bakwega Uriya bamukūra muri Egiputa, bamuzanira umwami Yehoyakimu: amwicisha inkota, ashiburira umuvyimba wiwe mu mva z’ abantu ba nyarucari.
Ariko Ahikamu mwene Shafani atabara Yeremiya, ngo ntātabge mu maboko y’abantu ngo bamwice.
Mu matangura yo kuba ku ngoma kwa Yehoyakimu mwene Yosiya umwami w’Abayuda, haza iri jambo kuri Yeremiya rivuye k’Uhoraho,
riti Rondera imvuto n’ingōgo, bimwe uvyiyambike mw izosi,

ibindi ubirungikire umwami w’i Edomu, n’umwami w’i Mowabu, n’ umwami w’Abamoni, n’umwami w’i Tiro, n’umwami w’i Sidoni, ubirungikane intumwa zaje i Yerusalemu zitumwe kuri Zedekiya, umwami w’i Buyuda;
ubatume amajambo bashīra ba shebuja, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, at’ Uku abe ari ko mubarira ba shobuja,
mut’ Uhoraho agize ngo Ni jewe naremye isi, n’abantu n’ibikōko biri kw isi, mbiremesha ubushobozi bganje bginshi n’ukuboko kwanje kurāmvuye; kand’ ivyo mbigabira uwo ngomba.
Kandi non’ ibi bihugu vyose mbishize mu kuboko kwa Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni, umusavyi wanje; ndamuhaye n’ibikōko vyo ku misozi kumukorera.
Kand’ amahanga yose azomusaba, asabe n’umwana wiwe n’umwuzukuru wiwe, gushitsa igihe co kūzirwa kw’igihugu ciwe kigeze; ni ho amahanga menshi n’abami bahambaye bazomuhindura umuja na we.

Maz’ ihanga ryose cank’ igihugu c’ umwami wese, ni habah’ abatemera gusaba Nebukadineza, uyo mwami w’i Babuloni, canke ngo bemere kugondera izosi ingōgo yiwe, iryo hanga nzorihana, ni k’ Uhoraho agize, ndarihanishe inkota n’inzara n’ikīza, gushitsa aho nzoba mperaheje kubaranduza ukuboko kwiwe.
None rero mwebge, ntimuruhe mwumvira ba kamenyi banyu, cank’ abapfumu banyu, cank’ inzozi zanyu, cank’ abamenyi banyu, cank’ abarozi banyu, bababarira, bati Ntimuzoruha musaba umwami w’i Babuloni:
kuko babaragurira ibinyoma, kugira ngo mwambukanwe kure y’igihugu canyu, no kugira ngo nanje ndakibirukanemwo, muhone.
Arikw ihanga rizogondera izosi umwami w’i Babuloni, rikamusaba, iryo nzoryemerera kuguma mu gihugu cabo bgite, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze; bazokirima, bakibemwo.
Nuko mbarira Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda nk’ukw ayo majambo yose ameze, nti Ni mugondere izosi ingōgo y’umwami w’i Babuloni, mumusabe, musabe n’abantu biwe, mubone kubaho.
Mugombera iki gupfa, wewe n’abantu bawe, ngo mwicishwe inkota n’inzara n’ikīza, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yavuze kw ihanga ritazokwemera gusaba umwami w’i Babuloni?
Ntimuruhe mwumvira amagambo ya ba kamenyi bababarira, bati Ntimuzoruha musaba umwami w’i Babuloni: kuko babaragurira ibinyoma.
Kuk’ Uhoraho avuze kw atari we yabatumye, ariko bavuga ibinyoma mw izina ryiwe; kugira ngw abirukane, muhone, mwe n’ abo ba kamenyi babaragurira.

Kandi mbarira n’abaherezi n’ ubgo bgoko bgose, nt’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Ntimuruhe mwumvira amagambo y’abo ba kamenyi banyu babaragurira, bat’ Ibintu vy’imbombovu vyo mu ngoro y’Uhoraho bizohava bigarukanwa bive i Babuloni: kuko babaragurira ibinyoma.
Ntimuruhe mubumvira: musabe umwami w’i Babuloni, mubone kubaho: n’iki cotuma iki gisagara gihinduka amatongo?

Namb’ ar’ abavugishwa n’Imana, kandi namb’ ijambo ry’Uhoraho riri muri bo, ni bashireko binginge Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo ngw ibintu vy’imbombovu bisigaye mu ngoro y’Uhoraho no mu ngoro y’umwami w’i Buyuda, n’i Yerusalemu, bireke kujanwa i Babuloni.
Kuk’ ukw ari k’ Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize ku vy’inkingi, no ku vya ca gikarabiro citwa ikiyaga, no ku vy’ibitereko, no ku vy’ibisigaye vy’imbombovu bigisigaye mur’ iki gisagara,

ivyo Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni atātwaye, igihe yajana Yekoniya mwene Yehoyakimu umwami w’i Buyuda ar’ inyagano, amukūye i Yerusalemu amujanye i Babuloni, bo n’abaganwa bose b’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu;
n’ukuri uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana ya Isirayeli, ku vy’ibintu vy’imbombovu bisigaye mu ngoro y’Uhoraho no mu ngoro y’umwami w’i Buyuda, n’i Yerusalemu:
ati Bizojanwa i Babuloni, bibeyo, gushitsa umusi azobagendera, akabidūgana, akabisubiza aha hantu; ni k’Uhoraho agize.

Maze mur’ uyo mwaka nyene, mu matangura yo kuba ku ngoma kwa Zedekiya, umwami w’i Buyuda, ni wo mwaka wa kane, mu kwezi kwa gatanu, Hananiya mwene Azuri, kamenyi w’i Gibeyoni, ambaririra mu ngoro y’Uhoraho, imbere y’abaherezi n’abantu bose,
at’ Uku ni k’ Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ati Mvunnye ingōgo mwambitswe n’ umwami w’i Babuloni.
Hasigaye imyaka ibiri yiramvuriye nkagarukana aha hantu ivy’ imbombovu vyo mu ngoro y’Uhoraho vyose, ivyo Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni yasahuye aha hantu, akabijana i Babuloni;
kandi nzogarukana aha hantu Yekoniya mwene Yehoyakimu umwami w’i Buyuda, bo n’abānyazwe bose b’i Buyuda bāgiye i Babuloni, ni k’Uhoraho agize, kuko nzovuna ingōgo mwambitswe n’umwami w’i Babuloni.
Maze Yeremiya ūvugishwa n’Imana yishurira Hananiya kamenyi imbere y’abaherezi n’imbere y’abantu bose bāri bahagaze mu ngoro y’Uhoraho;

Yeremiya ūvugishwa n’Imana aravuga, at’ Amen! Uhoraho n’ akore nk’uko! Uhoraho n’ashitse amajambo yawe uvugishijwe, agarukane ivy’ imbombovu vyo mu ngoro y’Uhoraho, n’abo bose bānyazwe, abakūre i Babuloni abazane aha hantu!
Yamara rero ni wumve iri jambo mvugira mu matwi yawe, no mu matwi y’abantu bose:
Abavugishwa n’Imana ba kera bānyitangiye imbere bakakwitangira imbere nawe, bāvugishijwe ivy’ intambara n’ivy’ ivyago n’ivy’ ikīza bizotera ibihugu vyinshi n’ibihugu vy’ abami bahambaye.
Ūvugishwa akavuga ivy’ amahoro, ijambo ry’ uwo muvugishwa ni ryashika, ni ho uyo muvugishwa azomenyekana yuk’ Uhoraho yamutumye koko.
Maze Hananiya uwo kamenyi akūra iyo ngōgo mw izosi ry’ūvugishwa n’Imana Yeremiya, arayivuna.

Hananiya avugira imbere y’abantu bose, at’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Imyaka ibiri yiramvuriye itarashira, uko ni ko nzovuna ingōgo Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni yambitse ku mazosi y’amahanga yose. Nuko Yeremiya uwo muvugishwa aca arīgīra.
Maz’ ijambo ry’ Uhoraho riza kur’ uwo muvugishwa Yeremiya, Hananiya kamenyi amaze kuvuna iyo ngōgo yari kw izosi ryiwe,
riti Genda ubarire Hananiya, ut’ Uku ni k’ Uhoraho agize, at’ Uvunnye ingōgo z’ibiti, arik’ ushubije iz’ ivyuma mu gishingo cazo.

Kuk’ ukw ari k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ati Nambitse ingōgo z’ivyuma ku mazosi y’aya mahanga yose, kugira ngo basabe Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni: kandi bazomusaba; kandi namuhaye ibikōko vyo ku misozi na vyo.
Nuk’ ūvugishwa n’Imana Yeremiya aca abarira Hananiya kamenyi, ati Ni wumve, Hananiya: Uhoraho ntiyagutumye, ariko wizigiza ubu bgoko ivy’ ibinyoma.
Nuko rero, uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Rāba ndagukūye kw isi: uyu mwaka urawupfamwo, kuko wavuze ivyo kungarariza jewe Uhoraho.
Nuko Hananiya kamenyi apfa mur’ uyo mwaka nyene mu kwezi kw’indwi.

Aya ni yo majambo y’icete ūvugishwa n’Imana Yeremiya yarungitse ar’ i Yerusalemu, akirungikira abāsigaye b’abashingantahe mu bambukanywe, n’ abaherezi n’abavugishwa n’abantu bose Nebukadineza yambukanye abakūye i Yerusalemu abajana i Babuloni.
Ico gihe umwami Yekoniya n’umugabekazi n’abantu b’inkone n’abaganwa b’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu n’ababāji n’abacuzi, bāri bamaze kuvanwa i Yerusalemu.
Akirungikana Elasa mwene Shafani na Gemariya mwene Hilukiya, abo Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda atumye i Babuloni kuri Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni, cāri canditse,
ng’ Uku ni k’ Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, abarira abānyazwe bose, abo yambukanishije ngo bakūrwe i Yerusalemu bajanwe i Babuloni,
ati Ni mwiyubakire amazu, muyabemwo; mwirimire amatongo murye ibiyezemwo;
mwiyabīrire abagore, muvyare abahungu n’abakobga; musabire abahungu banyu abageni, mushingire abakobga banyu, kugira ngo na bo bavyare abahungu n’abakobga; murondokereyo, ntimube inkehwa.
Mwifurize amahoro igisagara, ico natumye mwambukanirwamwo, mugisengere Uhoraho: kuko kibaye amahoro namwe muzoba amahoro.
Kuk’ ukw ari k’ Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ati Ba kamenyi banyu baba muri mwebge n’abapfumu banyu ntibabahende, kandi ntimukumvire inzozi babarotera.
Kuko babaragurira ibinyoma mw izina ryanje, nanje ntābatumye, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Kuk’ ukw ari k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Imyaka mirongwirindwi ni yarangira mur’ i Babuloni, nzobagendera, mbashitsekw ijambo ryanje ryiza, mbagarukane aha hantu.
Kuko nzi ivyiyumviro mbiyumvirako, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, kw ar’ ivyiyumviro vy’amahoro, atar’ ivy’ ivyago, kugira ngo mbahe ivyizigiro vyo mw iherezo ryanyu.
Kandi muzonyambaza, muzoza munsenge, nanje nzobumva.
Muzondondera kandi muzombona, ni mwandondeza umutima wanyu wose.

Nanje nzobabonekera, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, ntume muhindukira, muve mu kinyago, kandi nzobakoranya mbakūye mu mahanga yose n’ahantu hose aho nabirukaniye, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze; kandi nzobagarukana ahantu nabakūye igihe nabambukanisha.
Ko muvuga, mut’ Uhoraho yaduhagurukirije abavugishwa na we i Babuloni.
Uku ni k’ Uhoraho agize ku vy’umwami ari ku ngoma ya Dawidi, no ku vy’ abantu bose baba mur’ iki gisagara, ni bo bene wanyu mutājanye igihe mwambukanwa;
uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ati Rāba nzorungika inkota n’ inzara n’ikīza muri bo, mbahindure nk’insukoni ziteye ishishi, zidashoboka kuribga kubgo kubora.

Nzobirukanisha inkota n’inzara n’ikīza, mbatange batererekanywe irya n’ino mu bihugu vy’abami bose bo mw isi, ngo babe ibivume n’akajoreza n’ abo kuvuzwakw agahwa n’igitutsi mu mahanga yose aho nabirukaniye;
kuko batumviye amajambo yanje, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, ayo natumye abasavyi banje mvugisha, nama nzindurwa no kubatuma, ariko ntibaruha bumva, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
None rero ni mwumve ijambo ryanje, jewe Uhoraho, mwebge mwese abambukanywe, abo narungitse ngo muve i Yerusalemu muje i Babuloni.

Uku ni ko mvuze, jewe Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, Imana y’Abisirayeli, ku vya Ahabu mwene Kolaya no ku vya Zedekiya mwene Mayaseya, babaragurira ibinyoma mw izina ryanje, nt’ Ehe nzobatanga mu kuboko kwa Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni, na we azobicira imbere y’ amaso yanyu;
kandi bazohinduka umuvumo wo kuvumana w’abambukanywe bose b’i Buyuda bar’ i Babuloni, ng’ Uhoraho arakakugira nka Zedekiya na Ahabu, abo umwami w’i Babuloni yataze ku muriro babona;

kuko bākoze ivy’ ubupfu mu Bgisirayeli, bagasambana n’abagore ba bagenzi babo, bakavuga amagambo y’ibinyoma mw izina ryanje, ayo ntābageze; jewe ubganje ndabizi, kandi nd’icabona, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Kandi ku vya Shemaya w’i Nehelamu uvuge,

ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ati Ko warungitse ivyete mw izina ryawe, ukabirungikira ababa i Yerusalemu bose, na Zefaniya mwene Mayaseya umuherezi, n’abaherezi bose,

ukavuga, ut’ Uhoraho ko yaguhinduye umuherezi mu gishingo c’umuherezi Yehoyada, namwe kugira ngo mube ababgiriza mu ngoro y’Uhoraho, ngo mubuze umuntu wese w’ umusazi yīgira ūvugishwa n’Imana, ngo mumushire mu mpatane z’ibiti no mu minyororo;
none rero n’iki cakubujije guhana Yeremiya w’i Anatoti, yīgira ūvugishwa n’Imana ngo yabatumweko?
Kw adutumakw amajambo i Babuloni, avuga, ngo Turacasigaje igihe kirekire tur’ inyagano: ngo Ni twiyubakire amazu, tuyabemwo; ngo Ni twirimire amatongo turye ibiyezemwo.
Maze Zefaniya umuherezi asoma ico cete ūvugishwa n’ Imana Yeremiya yumva.
Nukw ijambo ry’Uhoraho riza kuri Yeremiya,
riti Tuma ku bājanywe kw inyagano bose, ubabgire, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize ku vya Shemaya w’i Nehelamu, ati Kw ababariye amagambo, nanje ntāmutumye, akabizigiza ibinyoma,

nuko rero, uku ni ko mvuze, jewe Uhoraho, nti Rāba, nzohana Shemaya w’i Nehelamu n’ uruvyaro rwiwe; ntazosigarana n’ umwe mu biwe azoba mur’ ubu bgoko, na we ntazoruha abona ivyiza nzogirira abantu banje, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze: kuko yavuze ivy’ ukungarariza jewe Uhoraho.
Ijambo ryaje kuri Yeremiya rivuye k’Uhoraho,
rit’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ati Wandike mu gitabo amajambo yose nakubariye.

Kukw imisi izoza, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, nzotuma abantu banje b’Abisirayeli n’Abayuda bahindukira, bave mu ngoyi zabo, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze; kandi nzotuma bagaruka mu gihugu nahaye ba sekuruza, baciganzire.
Aya ni yo majambo Uhoraho yavuze ku Bisirayeli n’Abayuda:
at’ Uku ni ko mbivuze, jewe Uhoraho, nti Twumvise ijwi ry’ abari mu gatengo no mu bgoba, atar’ iry’ abari mu mahoro.
Banza mubaze, murābe ko hogira umugabo aja ku nda ngw avyare: none n’iki gitumye mbona umugabo wese yifashe ku mafyinga nk’umugore aramutswe, mu maso ha bose hagahindurira?
Ew’ amagorwa ari hano! Kuk’ uwo musi uhambaye, nta wuhwanye na wo: n’igihe c’umubabaro wa ba Yakobo; yamara bazogikizwa.
Maze kur’ uwo musi, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo mbivuze, nzovuna ingōgo bambitswe, ndayikūre kw izosi ryabo, ncagagure imvuto baboheshejwe; kandi ntibazoba bakijakarira amahanga:
ariko bazosaba jewe, Uhoraho Imana yabo, na Dawidi umwami wabo, uwo nzobahagurukiriza.

None rero ntutinye, ewe Yakobo musavyi wanje, ni k’Uhoraho agize; nturanduke umutima, ewe Isirayeli: kuko rāba nzogukiza ngukūre kure, uruvyaro rwawe ndarukūre mu gihugu rwajanywemwo ar’ inyagano; Yakobo azogaruka, kand’ azoba amahoro ata nkomanzi, kandi nta wuzomutera ubgoba.

Kuko ndi kumwe nawe, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, kugira ngo ngukize; kuko nzoherengeteza amahanga yose, ayo nagushwiragirijemwo: ariko weho sinzoguherengeteza; mugabo nzogubana ibigeze, sinzokureka ntaguhannye.
Kuk’ ukw ari ko mvuze, jewe Uhoraho, nt’ Igikomere cawe ntikivūrika, n’igisebe cawe n’ ikigoye.
Nta wo kukwitsa ariho, kugira ng’ upfukwe igikomere: nta n’imiti ufise yo kukuvūra.

Abūzure bawe bose barakwibagiye; ntibakikubabaye; kuko ngukomerekeje nk’ūkomerekejwe n’umwansi, ngukubise bga ruburakigongwe; ni kubg’ ibigabitanyo vyawe vyinshi, kukw ivyaha vyawe vyari vyiyongeranije.
Non’ igikomere cawe kikuririza iki? K’uburibge bgawe butavūrika; ni kubg’ ibigabitanyo vyawe vyinshi, kukw ivyaha vyawe vyari vyiyongeranije, ivyo ni vyo vyatumye nkugira ntyo.
Yamar’ abo bose bakurya na bo bazoribga; abarwanizi bawe bose, umuntu wese muri bo, bazojanwa ar’ inyagano; abākugize umunyagwa na bo bazonyagwa, abākunyaga bose nzobagira inyagano.
Ariko nzosubira kugukomeza, nzogukiza ibikomere vyawe, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze; kuko bakwise uwirukanywe, bati Ni Siyoni, hatagifise ūkihababara.

Uku ni ko ndabivuze, jewe Uhoraho, nti Rāba nzotuma abo mu mahema ya Yakobo bahindukira, bave mu ngoyi zabo, ngirire ikigongwe amazu yabo; kand’ igisagara kizokwubakwa mu bitongozi vyaho, n’ ingoro isubire kumera nk’uko yahora.
Muri vyo hazoba gushima, n’ijwi ry’abanezerewe: kandi nzobagwiza, ntibazoba bake; nzobaha icubahiro, ntibazoba abo hasi.
Abana babo bazomera nk’uko bār’ ubga mbere, kand’ ikoraniro ryabo rizokomezwa imbere yanje, nanje nzohana abābahahaza bose.
Umwami wabo azoba uwo muri bo bgite, ūbaganza akomoke hagati muri bo: nanje nzomwiyegereza, kand’ azonshikīra: kuko ni nde yohangara kunshikīra? ni jewe Uhoraho mbibajije.
Kandi muzoba abantu banje, nanje nzoba Imana yanyu.
Rāba ikirura c’Uhoraho, ni bgo burake bgiwe, kirahinze, mbere n’ikirura c’inkubebe: kizorindimukira ku mitwe y’abanyavyaha.
Uburake bg’inkazi bg’Uhoraho ntibuzohwama kugeza ah’ azoba ashikije ivyo umutima wiwe wagabiye, abiheraheje: mu misi yo hanyuma muzobitahura.
Ico gihe, ni k’Uhoraho agize, nzoba Imana y’imiryango yose y’Abisirayeli, na bo bazoba abantu banje.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Abantu bāsigajwe n’inkota ni bo bāgiriwe ubuntu mu bugaragwa, ni bo Bisirayeli, abo nagiye mpa kuruhuka.
Uhoraho yanyiyeretse kera, ati N’ukuri naragukunze urukundo rudashira; ni co gituma nkwiyegerezanya imbabazi.
Nzosubira kukwubaka, nawe uzoba wubakitse, ewe nkumi, ni yo Bgisirayeli: uzosubira gushazisha udushako twawe tw’ingoma, usohoke uvyinane n’abanezerewe.
Uzosubira gutera inzabibu ku misozi y’i Samariya: abarimyi bazozitera, bazīyereze.
Kuko hazoza umusi abama bagavye ku misozi ya Efurayimu bazosemerera, bati Ni muve hasi tudūge i Siyoni, dushengerere Uhoraho Imana yacu.
Kuk’ ukw ari k’ Uhoraho agize, ati Muririmbane umunezero kubga Yakobo, musemerere kubg’ umukuru w’amahanga: mwamamaze mushima, mut’ Uhoraho, kiza abantu bawe, ni bo masigarira y’Abisirayeli.

Ehe nzobazana mbakūye mu gihugu c’i burārūko, mbakoranirize hamwe mbakūye ku mpera z’ isi; kandi bazozanana n’impumyi n’ūcumbagira, n’umugore akuriwe hamwe n’ūramutswe: bazogaruka ino ar’ ishengero rinini.
Bazoza barira, kandi nzobarōngōra banyinginga, nzobacisha i ruhande y’inzūzi zuzuye, mu nzira igororotse aho batazotsitara; kuko Isirayeli namubereye se, Efurayimu n’imfura yanje.
Ni mwumve ijambo ry’Uhoraho, mwa mahanga, muvyamamaze mu bizinga vya kure mu kiyaga: muvuge, mut’ Uwashwiragije Abisirayeli ni we azobatororokanya, abazigame, nk’uk’ umwungere agirira umukuku wiwe.
Kuk’ Uhoraho yagobotoye aba Yakobo, yabacunguye abakūra mu kuboko kw’uwabarusha inkomezi.

Bazoza baririmbire ku mpinga y’i Siyoni, bazohondogana bose hamwe, baja ku vyiza vy’Uhoraho, ni vyo ngano na vino n’amavuta n’imyagazi y’imikuku n’inyana z’amasho. Imitima yabo izomera nk’indimiro ikwegewemw’ umwuzi; nta ho bazogira umubabaro ukundi.
Ni ho inkumi izonezerezwa n’ imvyino, n’abasore n’abatāma bose hamwe: kukw ikigandaro cabo nzogihindura umunezero, nzobīrūra, mbanezereze mbakūye mu mubabaro wabo.
Imitima y’ abaherezi nzoyihāza ibinure, kand’ abantu banje bazohāzwa n’ ivyiza vyanje, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Induru yumvikana i Rama, amaborogo n’amarira menshi: Rakeli aririra abana biwe, yanka kwīrūrwa umubabaro w’abana, kuko batakiriho.

Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Buza ijwi ryawe ryoye kurira, n’amaso yawe yoye gukorora amosozi, kukw ibikorwa vyawe bizokwishurwa, ni k’Uhoraho agize; kandi bazosubira kugaruka bavuye mu gihugu c’abansi.
Kandi hazoba ivyizigiro vyo mw iherezo ryawe, ni k’Uhoraho agize; abana bawe bazosubira kugaruka mu gihugu cabo bgite.
N’ukuri numvise Efurayimu yiganyira, ati Warankubise, ndakubitika, mmera nk’inyana itamenyereye ingōgo: mpindukiza mbone guhindukira, kuko wewe ur’ Uhoraho Imana yanje.
N’ ukuri mmaze guhindukizwa narihannye; bimaze kunyigisha narishishitiye: nagize isoni, mbere ndatētērwa, kukw ibiteye isoni vyo mu buto bganje vyansubiyeko.

Mbega Efurayimu n’umwana wanje nkunda koko? N’umwana ateye igomwe? Kuk’ uko ndamukankamiye nama ndamwibukana igishika; ni co gituma ndamuhagarikira umutima: sinzobura kumugirira ikigongwe, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.

Wishingire ibimenyetso bikurangira inzira, wironkere ibiti vy’ivyapa: shira umutima ku nzira y’iroro, imwe wajana ukijayo: hindukira, ewe nkumi, ruvyaro rwa Isirayeli, hindukira ugaruke mur’ ibi bisagara vyawe.
Uzogeza ryari kwāngāra irya n’ino, ewe mukobga wasubiye inyuma? Kuk’ Uhoraho yaremye ikintu gisha mw isi, k’umugore azozigama umugabo.

Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ati Bazosubira ukundi gusha kuvugira aya majambo mu gihugu c’i Buyuda no mu bisagara vyaho, ni nasubira kubagarukana mbakūye mu kinyago, bat’ Uhoraho n’aguhezagire, wewe i wabo w’ubugororotsi, wewe musozi wera.
Maz’ ab’ i Buyuda n’ibisagara vyaho vyose bazohasāsagara; bo n’abarimyi n’abaragiye imikuku.
Kuko nashubije intege mu mutima urushe, n’umutima udendebukiwe nkawuhēmbūra.
Bishitse aho ndikangura, nsanga itiro ryari rindyoheye.
Eh’ imisi izoza, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, nzobiba imbibe, ni yo nzu ya Isirayeli n’inzu ya Yuda, ndayibibemw’ imbuto, ari zo bantu n’ibitungwa.
Maz’ ico gihe, nk’uko nabahozakw igitsure ngo mbarandure, mbahomvore, mbasangangure, mbahonnye, mbababaze, ni ko nzobahozakw ijisho ngo mbubake mbatēragire, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Mur’ iyo misi ntibazoba bakivuga, ngo Ba se barya inzabibu z’ibitumbge, amenyo y’abana akajiginyurwa.
Arik’ umuntu wese azopfa azize ivyiwe bigabitanyo nyene: ūriye inzabibu z’ibitumbge, ayiwe menyo nyene ni yo azojiginyurwa.
Eh’ imisi igira ize, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, aho nzosezerana isezerano risha n’umuryango wa Isirayeli n’umuryango wa Yuda:
ridahwanye n’isezerano nasezeranye na ba sekuruza, ku musi nabafata ukuboko nkabakūra mu gihugu ca Egiputa; kand’ iryo sezerano nyene bāraryishe, naho nari shebuja, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.

Arikw iri ni ryo sezerano nzosezerana n’umuryango w’Abisirayeli hanyuma y’ iyo misi, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze; nzoshira ivyagezwe vyanje imbere muri bo, no mu mitima yabo ni ho nzovyandika; nanje nzobabera Imana, na bo bazoba abantu banje.

Kandi ntibazoba bacigishanya, ng’ umuntu wese yigishe mugenzi we, canke ngo yigishe uwo bavukana, ati Menya Uhoraho; kuko bose bazonyimenyera, uhereye kuri nyarucari ugashitsa k’ūhambaye, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze; kuko nzoharira ukugabitanya kwabo, kand’ icaha cabo sinzocibuka ukundi.

Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, uwatanze izuba ngo ribe umuco w’ umurango, akagera ukwezi n’ inyenyeri ngo vyake mw ijoro, ni we azīkurura ikiyaga ngw imipfunda yaco ibomborane: Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo ni ryo zina ryiwe:
at’ Ivyo nageze ivyo ni vyava mu nyonga zanje, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, ni ho uruvyaro rwa Isirayeli na rwo ruzoreka kuba ihanga mu nyonga zanje ibihe bidashira.
Uku ni k’ Uhoraho agize, at’ Ijuru ryogerwa, amatanguriro y’isi agaserangurwa, ni ho nanje noca uruvyaro rwose rwa Isirayeli, mbahōye ivyo bakoze vyose, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Eh’ imisi izoza, ni k’Uhoraho agize, ca gisagara kizokwubakirwa Uhoraho, uhereye ku munara wa Hananeli, ugashitsa no kw irembo ryo ku mfuruka y’uruzitiro.
Kand’ umugozi bazogeresha uzovuduka aho hantu ugororwe ushike ku gatumba k’i Garebu, maz’ uzozenguka ushike i Gowa.

Kand’ umwonga wose uhambgamw’ imivyimba ugatābgamwo n’umunyota, n’indimiro zose ukarinda ushitsa ku mugezi Kidironi, ugashitsa no ku mfuruka y’irembo ry’amafarasi aherekeye i burasirazuba, hose hazoba ahēra h’ Uhoraho; ntihazokwongera guhomvorwa ngo hasangangurwe gushitsa ibihe bidashira.
Ijambo ryaje kuri Yeremiya rivuye k’Uhoraho mu mwaka ugira icumi Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda ari ku ngoma, ni wo wagira icumi n’umunani Nebukadineza ari ku ngoma.
Maz’ ico gihe ingabo z’uwo mwami w’i Babuloni zari zugarije i Yerusalemu: kand’ uwavugishwa n’ Imana Yeremiya yari yabohewe mu rugo rw’ibohero rwari rubangikanye n’ingoro y’umwami w’i Buyuda.
Kuko Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda yari yamuboshe, ati N’iki gituma uvuga ng’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Rāba nzotanga iki gisagara mu kuboko kw’umwami w’i Babuloni, kand’ azohatsinda?
Uti Na Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda ntazokira amaboko y’Abakaludaya, arik’ uti Ntazobura gutangwa mu kuboko kw’umwami w’i Babuloni, uti Bazokwivuganira barābana imbonankubone;
uti Kand’ azoshumika Zedekiya amujane i Babuloni, ngw Azobayo gushitsa aho nzomugendera, ngo Ni k’Uhoraho agize; ngo Naho mworwanya Abakaludaya ntimuzotsinda?
Yeremiya aravuga, at’ Ijambo ry’Uhoraho ryanjeko,
riti Hanameli mwene so wanyu Shalumu, agira aze kuri wewe, akubgire, ati Ni wigurire ishamvu yanje iri Anatoti: kukw ari wewe wo kuyicungura.

Nuko Hanameli mwene wacu aza kuri jewe aho ndi mu rugo rw’ibohero, nk’ukw ijambo ry’Uhoraho ryavuze, arambarira, ati Ndakwinginze, gura ishamvu yanje iri Anatoti, ho mu ntāra ya Benyamini: kuko na kare yar’ iyawe, kandi ni wewe wo kuyicungura: non’ uyigurire. Ni ho naciye mmenya yukw iryo jambo ar’ iry’ Uhoraho.
Nuko ngura na Hanameli mwene wacu iyo shamvu iri Anatoti, ndamugerera ifeza ku munzane, ziba shekeli cumi n’indwi.
Nandika icete c’uko tuguze, nkiyagirizakw ishashara ndomamw’ ikimenyetso, mpamagara ivyabona, ndamugerera za feza ku munzane.
Nuko nābīra ico cete c’uko tuguze, ikidomwekw ikimenyetso nk’ukw ivyagezwe n’imigenzo biri, bo n’ikindi kitamatanijwe,

maz’ ico cete c’uko tuguze ngihēra Baruki mwene Neriya wa Mahaseya imbere ya Hanameli mwene wacu, n’imbere y’ivyabona vyari vyanditse amazina yabo kur’ ico cete c’uko tuguze, n’imbere y’Abayuda bose bari bicaye mu rugo rw’ibohero.
Nihanikiririza Baruki imbere yabo,

nt’ Uku ni k’ Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ati Jana ibi vyete, iki cete c’uko tuguze kimatanishijwe ishashara, bo n’iki kitamatanijwe, ubibīke mw ikarabo, kugira ngo bize bimare igihe kinini.
Kuk’ ukw ari k’ Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, at’ Amazu n’amatongo n’imirima y’imizabibu bizokwongera kugurwa mur’ iki gihugu.
Nuko mpejeje gushīra Baruki mwene Neriya ico cete c’uko naguze, nca nsenga Uhoraho,
nt’ Ewe Mwami Uhoraho! Erega ni wewe waremye ijuru n’isi, ubiremesha ubushobozi bgawe buhambaye, n’ukuboko kwawe kurāmvuye: nta kintu na kimwe kikunanira.
Ni wewe ugirira imbabazi ibihumbi n’ibihumbi, ibigabitanyo vya ba se ubihōra n’abana babo babasubiriye mu gishingo: ni wewe ūhambaye, Imana y’ubushobozi, y’izina ryitwa Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo:

ur’ umujanama ahambaye, ur’ umunyenkomezi mu bikorwa; inyonga zawe zītegereza ingeso zose z’abana b’abantu, kugira ng’ ugerere umuntu wese ibikwiranye n’ ingeso ziwe, n’ibikwiranye n’ivy’ ibikorwa vyiwe vyamuje.
Ni wewe washizeh’ ibimenyetso n’ ibitangaza mu gihugu ca Egiputa, gushitsa no kur’ uyu musi, mu Bisirayeli no mu bandi bantu, ukīronkera izina rya rurangiranwa, nk’uko rimeze n’uyu musi;
ugakūza abantu bawe b’Abisirayeli mu gihugu ca Egiputa ibimenyetso n’ibitangaza, n’ukuboko gukomeye kandi kurāmvuye, n’ibiteye ubgoba bginshi;
ukabaha iki gihugu, ico warahiye ba sekuruza babo kuzobaha, ar’ igihugu gitemba amata n’ubūki;
baracinjira barakiganza; yamara banka kukwumvira, no kugendera mu vyagezwe vyawe; ntibakora na kimwe mu vyo wabageze vyose gukora: ico ni co catumye ubatēza ivyo vyago vyose.

Eh’ ibirundo barundiye kwūririrako ngo baneshe igisagara birashitse: igisagara gitanzwe mu maboko y’Abakaludaya bagiteye, kubg’ inkota n’inzara n’ikīza. Ivyo wavuze birashitse, nawe urik’ uravyibonera.
Yamara Mwami Uhoraho, wambariye ngo nigurire itongo amahera, ngo ni mpamagare ivyabona, kand’ iki gisagara gitanzwe mu maboko y’ Abakaludaya!
Maz’ ijambo ry’Uhoraho riza kuri Yeremiya,
rit’ Ehe nd’ Uhoraho, Imana y’abariho bose: mbega har’ ikintu na kimwe kinnanira?
Nuko rero, uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Ehe nzotanga iki gisagara mu maboko y’Abakaludaya, no mu kuboko kwa Nebukadineza, umwami w’i Babuloni, kand’ azogitsinda;
n’Abakaludaya bateye iki gisagara, bazogishikamwo bagiturire bagitongore, bo n’amazu būriyeko hejuru ngo bosereze imibavu Bayali, bagasukira ibiturire izindi mana, kugira ngo bantere ishavu.
Kukw Abisirayeli n’Abayuda bākoze ibibi gusa mu nyonga zanje uhereye mu buto bgabo, kuko ku Bisirayeli ata kindi atar’ ukuntera ishavu, barinteresha ibikorwa vy’amaboko yabo, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Kukw iki gisagara, guhēra ku musi bācubakiye gushitsa no kur’ uyu musi, cabaye ico kuntera ishavu n’ubushangashirwe, bituma ngira ngikūre mu nyonga zanje;
kubg’ ibibi vyose Abisirayeli n’Abayuda bakoze kugira ngo bantere ishavu, bo n’abami babo n’abaganwa babo n’abaherezi babo, na ba kamenyi babo n’abagabo b’i Buyuda n’ababa i Yerusalemu.
Banteye ibitugu mu gishingo co kuntumbera, naho nabahanūra nkāma nzindurwa no kubahanūra, yamara ntibanyumviye ngo babishire ku mutima.
Ariko bāshize ibizira vyabo vy’ ubuyobe mu ngoro yanje yitirirwa izina ryanje ngo bayihumanye.

Kandi bātabiye ibitabo Bayali, ni vyo biri mu mwonga wa mwene Hinomu, bagatanga abana babo b’abahungu n’abakobga kw ibimazi ngo boserezwe Moleki; ar’ ikintu ntābageze, kitigeze no kuza mu mutima wanje, ko bokora ivyo bizira, bagacumuza Abayuda.
None rero, uku ni ko mvuze, jewe Uhoraho, Imana y’Abisirayeli, ku vy’iki gisagara, ico muvuga ngo Gitanzwe mu kuboko kw’ umwami w’i Babuloni kubg’ inkota n’inzara n’ikīza:
nti Rāba nzobakoranya, mbakūre mu bihugu vyose aho nzoba narabirukaniye mfise ishavu n’ubushangashirwe n’ uburake bg’inkazi; kandi nzokwongera kubagarukana aha hantu, ndababesheh’ amahoro:
kandi bazoba abantu banje, nanje nzoba Imana yabo.
Nzobaha umutima umwe no kujana inzira imwe, kugira ngo bahore banyubaha gushitsa ibihe vyose; ngo bahave baroranirwe, bo n’ abana babo bazoba babasubiriye mu gishingo.
Kandi nzosezerana na bo isezerano ritazoshira, yuko ntazorora irya ngo mbahebe, ndeke kubagirira neza; kandi mu mitima yabo nzohashira kunyubaha, na bo boye kumvako.
Mbere nzobanezererwa mbagirire neza, kandi nzobatēragira mur’ iki gihugu vy’ukuri, bivuye mu mutima wanje wose no mu mushaha wanje wose.
Kuk’ ukw ari ko mvuze, jewe Uhoraho, nti Nk’uko nazaniye ubu bgoko ibi vyago vyose bikomeye, uko ni ko nzobazanakw ivyiza vyose nabasezeraniye.
Kand’ amatongo azogurwa mur’ iki gihugu, ico muririra, ngo Kirakomvomvowe, ata muntu agisigayemwo cank’ igitungwa; ngo Gitanzwe mu maboko y’Abakaludaya.

Abantu bazokwigurira amatongo amahera, bandike ivyete vy’uko baguze, babimatanishe ishashara bayidomemw’ ikimenyetso, bahamagare ivyabona; bizoba birtyo mu gihugu ca Benyamini, n’ahantu hahereranye n’i Yerusalemu, no mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda, no mu bisagara vyo mu mugamba waho, no mu bisagara vyo mu gihugu giciye bugufi, no mu bisagara vy’i bumanuko: kuko nzotuma bahindukira bave mu kinyago, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Ijambo ry’Uhoraho ryongera kuza kuri Yeremiya ubugira kabiri, acugaraniwe mu rugo rw’ibohero,
rit’ Uhoraho abikora, Uhoraho abirema akabikomeza, Uhoraho ni ryo zina ryiwe, uku ni kw agize,
ati Mpamagara, nanje ndakwitaba, nkwereke ibihambaye n’ivyikinze, ivy’ utaribgamenye.

Kuk’ ukw ari ko mvuze, jewe Uhoraho, Imana y’Abisirayeli, ku vy’amazu yo mur’ iki gisagara, no ku vy’ingoro z’umwami w’i Buyuda, vyasambuwe ngo bavyubakishe aho kwikingiriza ngo barwanye abitwaje inkota būrira ku birundo kubatera,
ni bo Bakaludaya bazokwuzuza ayo mazu imivyimba y’abantu nicishije uburake bganje n’ubushangashirwe bganje, kuko bātumye mpisha mu nyonga hanje iki gisagara kubg’ ivyaha vyabo vyose;
nti Rāba nzohazanira gukira no kuvūrwa, kandi nzobavūra; nzobahishurira amahoro bo n’ukuri vy’isinzi.
Kandi nzotuma Abayuda n’Abisirayeli bahindukira bave mu kinyago, nzosubira mbubake nk’uko vyari bir’ ubga mbere.
Nzobōza ibigabitanyo vyabo vyose, ivyo bangabitanijeko; nzobaharira ibigabitanyo vyabo vyose bangabitanijeko n’ivyo bancumuyeko.

Kand’ iki gisagara kizombera izina ry’umunezero, kimbere n’ishimwe n’icubahiro imbere y’amahanga yose yo mw isi, abazokwumva ivyiza vyose nabakoreye; bazotinya bahinde agashitsi kubg’ ivyiza vyose n’ amahoro yose ndahahaye.

Uku ni ko mvuze, jewe Uhoraho, nt’ Aha hantu aho muririra, ngo Harakomvomvowe, ata muntu agisigayeho cank’ igitungwa, ngo No mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda n’ uko, no mu miharuro y’i Yerusalemu, ngo Hasigaye ar’ imisaka, ata n’umuntu ata n’ūkihaba ata n’igitungwa;

aha hantu nyene hazosubira kwumvikana ijwi ry’umunezero n’iryo guhimbarwa, n’ijwi ry’umukwe n’iry’ umugeni, n’ijwi ry’abavuga, bati Ni mushime Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, kuk’ Uhoraho ari mwiza, kukw imbabazi ziwe zamaho ibihe bidashira; n’iry’ abazanye ibimazi vy’ishimwe mu ngoro yanje Uhoraho. Kuko nzotuma iki gihugu kiva mu kinyago, kikamera nk’ ubga mbere, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.

Kand’ uku ni ko mvuze, jewe Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, nt’ Aha hantu hakomvomvowe ata muntu agisigayeho cank’ igitungwa, no mu bisagara vyaho vyose ar’ uko, hazosubira kuboneka amarāro y’abungere bavyagiza imikuku yabo.

Imikuku izosubira gutaha itonze imirongo mu bisagara vyo mu mugamba waho, no mu bisagara vyo mu bihugu biciye bugufi, no mu bisagara vy’i bumanuko, no mu gihugu ca Benyamini n’ahantu hahereranye n’i Yerusalemu, no mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda, bayiharūre, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Eh’ imisi izoza, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, nzoshitsa rya jambo ryiza navuze ku nzu ya Isirayeli no ku nzu ya Yuda.
Mur’ iyo misi no mur’ ico gihe nzoshamikisha kuri Dawidi uwitwa Shami w’umugororotsi; azoca iziroranye n’izigororotse mu gihugu.
Mur’ iyo misi Abayuda bazokira, i Yerusalemu hazoba amahoro: kand’ iri ni ryo zina hazokwitwa, ng’ Uhoraho ni we kugororoka kwacu.
Kuk’ ukw ari ko mvuze, jewe Uhoraho, nti Dawidi ntazokwigera abura uwo kuzokwama ku ngoma yiwe, aganza ab’ inzu ya Isirayeli.
N’abaherezi b’Abalewi n’uko, ntibazokwigera babura uwo kuzokwama ahagarara imbere yanje ngw atange ibimazi avyose, ngo yose n’ibishikanywe, no kwama akerera ibimazi.
Maz’ ijambo ry’Uhoraho riza kuri Yeremiya,

rit’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Namba mwoshobora guhindura isezerano ryanje ryashinze umurango k’ubaho, n’isezerano ryanje ryashinze ijoro ko ribaho, ng’ umurango n’ijoro ntibikūranwe mu bihe vyavyo;
ni ho n’isezerano ryanje nasezeranye na Dawidi umusavyi wanje ryohindurwa, akabura umwana wo kumusubirira ku ngoma; bo n’iryo nasezeranye n’ Abalewi, abaherezi banje bankorera.
Nk’ukw ingabo zose z’inyenyeri zo kw ijuru zitoharūrika, n’umusenyi wo ku kiyaga utogereka, ni ko nzogwiza uruvyaro rwa Dawidi umusavyi wanje, n’urw’ Abalewi bankorera.
Ijambo ry’Uhoraho riza kuri Yeremiya,
riti Mbega ntiwiyumviriye ivyo aba bantu bavuga, ngw Imiryango yompi Uhoraho yatoranije yayicīye? Uko ni ko bakēngēra abantu banje, kuko bagira ngo ntibakir’ ihanga.
Uku ni ko mvuze, jewe Uhoraho, nti Namb’ isezerano ryanje ryāshinze umurango n’ijoro ritāhamye, namba ntāshinze ivyagezwe vy’ijuru n’isi,

nuko rero nzoca n’uruvyaro rwa Yakobo, n’urwa Dawidi umusavyi wanje, ngo noye gutora mu ruvyaro rwiwe abo kuganza uruvyaro rwa Aburahamu na Isaka na Yakobo; kuko nzotuma bahindukira bakava mu kinyago, kandi nzobagirira imbabazi.

Ijambo ryaje kuri Yeremiya rivuye k’Uhoraho, igihe Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni n’ingabo ziwe zose n’abami bo mw isi yose yaganzwa na we, n’ amahanga yose, bāriko bararwana n’i Yerusalemu n’ibisagara vyaho vyose,

rit’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ati Genda ubarire Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda, umubgire, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ngw Eh’ azotanga iki gisagara mu kuboko kw’ umwami w’i Babuloni, na we azogitongoza umuriro:
nawe ubgawe ntuzomukira, ntuzobura gufatwa ng’ utangwe mu kuboko kwiwe; uzomwibonera imbonankubone, na we muzokwivuganira; kand’ uzoja i Babuloni.
Uti Yamara ni wumve ijambo ryiwe Uhoraho, ewe Zedekiya mwami w’i Buyuda: ut’ Uku ni kw avuze ku vyawe, ati Ntuzokwicwa n’inkota,

arik’ uzokwipfira bupfe; nk’ uko boshereje imibavu ba sogokuruza, abami bākwitangiye imbere, ni ko bazoyikwosereza nawe; bazokuborogera, bati Yewe mwami wacu! uti Kukw ari we avuze iryo jambo, uti Ni kw agize.
Nuk’ ūvugishwa n’Imana Yeremiya abarira Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda ayo majambo yose ar’ i Yerusalemu,

igihe ingabo z’umwami w’i Babuloni zāriko zirarwana n’i Yerusalemu n’ibisagara vyose vy’i Buyuda vyari bigisigaye, n’i Lakishi n’i Azeka; kukw ivyo ari vyo vyari bigisigaye mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda bikizitiriwe inzitiro.
Ijambo ryaje kuri Yeremiya rivuye k’Uhoraho, igihe umwami Zedekiya yar’ amaze gusezerana isezerano n’abantu bose b’i Yerusalemu, ryo gutanga umwidegemvyo;
kugira ng’ umuntu wese arekure umuja wiwe, ar’ uwitwa umuhungu, cank’ umukobga, ar’ Umuheburayo cank’ Umuheburayokazi abe uwidegemvya; kugira ngo hoye kuba ūbagaba, ar’ Umuyuda ngw agabe mugenzi we.

Nukw abaganwa bose n’ abantu bose baramwumvira, abāri basezeranye iryo sezerano ry’uk’ umuntu wese akwiye kurekura umuja wiwe, ar’ uwitwa umuhungu cank’ umukobga, abe uwidegemvya, ngo hoye kuba ūkibagaba; baramwumvira, barabarekura;
ariko hanyuma barihindukiza, bagarukana abo baja b’abahungu n’abakobga, abo bāri barekuye ngo babe abidegemvya, babasubiza mu buja ukw ar’ abahungu n’abakobga.
Ico ni co catumye ijambo ry’Uhoraho riza kuri Yeremiya,
rit’ Uku ni k’ Uhoraho agize, ni we Mana y’ Abisirayeli, ati Nasezeranye isezerano na ba sogokuruza, umusi nabakūra mu gihugu ca Egiputa, no mu nzu y’ubuja,

nt’ Ukw imyaka ndwi igiye gushira, umuntu wese az’ arekure mugenzi we w’Umuheburayo, uwo yaguze akamukorera imyaka ndwi, amurekure amuveko, abe uwidegemvya: yamara ba sogokuruza ntibānyumvira, canke ngo bantege ugutwi.
Ariko mweho mwari mwigaruye, mukora igitunganye mu nyonga zanje, mutanga umwidegemvyo, umuntu wese arekura mugenzi we; kandi mwari musezeraniye isezerano imbere yanje mu ngoro yitirirwa izina ryanje;

maze murihindukiza, mutukisha izina ryanje, umuntu wese agarukana umuja wiwe ar’ umuhungu cank’ umukobga, abo mwari mwarekuye ngo babe abidegemvya uko bagomba; mubasubiza mu buja ukw ar’ abahungu n’abakobga.

Nuko rero, uku ni ko mvuze, jewe Uhoraho, nti Ntimwanyumviye, ngo mutange umwidegemvyo, ng’ umuntu wese arekure mwene wabo, umuntu wese arekure mugenzi we: nuko rero nanje ntanze umwidegemvyo kuri mwebge, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, w’inkota n’ikīza n’inzara; kandi nzotuma mutererekanywa irya n’ino mu bihugu vy’ abami bose bo mw isi.
Kandi nzotanga abantu bāciye mw isezerano ryanje, ntibashitse amajambo y’isezerano bāsezeraniye imbere yanje, hamwe bāhimburamwo kubiri imasa, bagaca hagati y’ibihimba vyayo;
ni bo baganwa b’i Buyuda n’abaganwa b’i Yerusalemu n’inkone n’abaherezi n’abantu bose bo mu gihugu, abāciye hagati ya vya bihimba vy’iyo masa:
nzobatanga mu maboko y’abansi babo, no mu maboko y’ababahiga ngo babice, kand’ imivyimba yabo izoba inyama z’ibisīga vyo mu kirēre n’iz’ ibikōko vyo kw isi.
Kandi Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda n’abaganwa biwe nzobatanga mu maboko y’abansi babo, no mu maboko y’ababahīga ngo babice, no mu maboko y’ingabo z’umwami w’i Babuloni zari zabaretse zikabavako.
Rāba nzobigera, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, mbagarukane kur’ iki gisagara; kandi bazokirwanya bagitsinde, bagitongoze umuriro: kand’ ibisagara vy’i Buyuda nzobigira imisaka, ata wukihaba.
Ijambo ryaje kuri Yeremiya rivuye k’Uhoraho mu gihe ca Yehoyakimu mwene Yosiya, umwami w’i Buyuda,
riti Genda ku b’inzu ya Rekabu, uvugane na bo, ubinjize mu ngoro y’Uhoraho, ubashikane muri kimwe mu vyumba vyubatswe kuri yo, ubahe vino banywe.
Nuko njana Yazaniya mwene Yeremiya, Yeremiya wa Habaziniya, n’abo bavukana, n’abana biwe bose, n’ab’ inzu ya Rekabu bose,
mbinjiza mu ngoro y’Uhoraho, mu cumba ca bene Hanani, Hanani wa Igidaliya umuntu w’Imana, gihereranye n’icumba c’abaganwa, cari hejuru y’icumba ca Mayaseya mwene Shalumu umushibamyi wo ku muryango.
Ntereka imibindi yuzuye vino, bo n’amakarabo, imbere y’ab’ inzu ya Rekabu, ndababgira, nti Ngiyo vino ni munywe.
Na bo baravuga, bati Nta vino tunywa: kuko Yonadabu mwene Rekabu sogokuruza wacu yatwihanikirije, ati Ntimuze mwigere munywa vino, mwebge cank’ abana banyu,

canke ngo muze mwigere mwubaka inzu, canke ngo murime, canke ngo mutere uruzabibu canke ngo hagire ūzorwitirirwa; at’ Arikw imisi muzomara yose muze mube mu mahema, kugira ngo mubone kuramba mu gihugu mubamwo.
Kandi twumviye Yonadabu mwene Rekabu sogokuruza mu vyo yatuziririje vyose, kutanywa vino imisi tuzomaraho yose, twebge n’abagore bacu n’abahungu bacu n’abakobga bacu;
no kutubaka amazu yo kubamwo, no kutagira uruzabibu cank’ itongo cank’ imbuto zo gutera;
ariko twibereye mu mahema, twumvira iragi rya vyose Yonadabu sogokuruza yadusigaranye.
Maze rero, Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni ateye iki gihugu, turavugana, tuti Ngo tuje i Yerusalemu, duhunge ingabo z’Abakaludaya, duhunge n’ingabo z’Abasiriya; ni kwo kuba i Yerusalemu.
Maz’ ijambo ry’Uhoraho riza kuri Yeremiya,

rit’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ati Genda ubarire abagabo b’i Buyuda n’ababa i Yerusalemu, uti Mbega ntimworuha mwemera indero yanje ngo mwumvire amajambo yanje? ni jewe Uhoraho mbibajije.

Amajambo ya Yonadabu mwene Rekabu, ayo yihanikirije abana biwe ngo ntibanywe vino, barayashitsa, no gushitsa kur’ uyu musi nta yo banywa, kuko bumviye iragi rya sekuruza; ariko jeho navuganye namwe, nama nzindurwa no kubabarira, namwe ntimwanyumvira.

Kandi nabatumyekw abasavyi banje bose abo navugisha, nama nzindurwa no kubatuma, nt’ Enda ni mugaruke, umuntu wese ave mu nzira yiwe mbi, mutunganye ibikorwa vyanyu, mwoye gukurikira izindi mana ngo muzigendanire; nti Ni ho muzobona kwibera mu gihugu nabahaye, mwe na ba sogokuruza: ariko ntimwateze ugutwi, canke ngo munyumvire.
Bene Yonadabu wa Rekabu ko bāshikije iragi rya sekuruza yabasigaranye, arik’ ubu bgoko bgo ntibgānyumviye;

nuko rero, uku ni ko mvuze, jewe Uhoraho, Imana Nyen’ ingabo, Imana y’Abisirayeli, nt’ Ehe nzozana ku Bayuda no ku baba i Yerusalemu bose ivyago vyose nabageneye, kuko nababūriye bakanka kwumva, nkabahamagara bakanka kwitaba.

Nuko Yeremiya abarira ab’ inzu ya Rekabu, at’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ati Ko mwumviye iragi rya sogokuruza Yonadabu, mukitondera amabgirizwa yiwe yose, mukagenza nk’uko yababariye muri vyose;
nuko rero, uku ni k’ Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ati Yonadabu mwene Rekabu ntazokwigera abura uwo kuzokwama ahagarara imbere yanje gushitsa ibihe vyose.
Mu mwaka ugira kane Yehoyakimu mwene Yosiya umwami w’i Buyuda ari ku ngoma, haza iri jambo kuri Yeremiya rivuye k’Uhoraho,
rit’ Abīra umuzingo w’igitabo, wandikemw’ amajambo yose nakubariye abūrira Abisirayeli n’Abayuda n’amahanga yose, utanguye umusi nakubaririye, uhereye ku ngoma ya Yosiya, ugashitsa no kur’ uyu musi.
Kumbure ab’ inzu ya Yuda bokwumva ivyago vyose nageneye kubatēza, bagahindukira, umuntu wese akava mu nzira yiwe mbi, kugira ngo mbone guharira ukugabitanya kwabo n’icaha cabo.
Nuko Yeremiya ahamagara Baruki mwene Neriya; maze Baruki yandika amajambo yose y’ Uhoraho mu muzingo w’igitabo, ayakūye mu kanwa ka Yeremiya, ukw ayamubgiye.
Nuko Yeremiya abarira Baruki, ati Jewe ndabujijwe kuja mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho:

nuko rero wewe genda usome mur’ uwo muzingo amajambo y’Uhoraho wanditse ukūye mu kanwa kanje, uyasomere abantu mu ngoro y’Uhoraho ku musi wo kwisonzesha: uyasomere n’Abayuda bose baza bavuye mu bisagara vyabo.
Kumbure bokwitwara k’Uhoraho, bagahindukira, umuntu wese akareka inzira yiwe mbi: kuk’ uburake n’ubushangashirwe, ivyo Uhoraho yabūye kur’ ubu bgoko, ar’ ibihambaye.
Nuko Baruki mwene Neriya akora vyose nk’uk’ ūvugishwa n’Imana Yeremiya yamubariye, asoma mur’ ico gitabo amajambo y’Uhoraho ahagaze mu ngoro y’Uhoraho.

Maze mu mwaka ugira gatanu Yehoyakimu mwene Yosiya umwami w’i Buyuda ari ku ngoma, mu kwezi kw’icenda, abantu bose b’i Yerusalemu n’abantu bose bavuye mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda baja i Yerusalemu, bashinga umusi wo kwisonzeshereza imbere y’Uhoraho.

Nuko Baruki asoma muri ca gitabo amajambo ya Yeremiya ahagaze mu ngoro y’Uhoraho, mu cumba ca Gemariya mwene Shafani umukarani, cari mu kigo ahahera haruguru, mw ishikiro ry’ikirimba gisha kija ku ngoro y’Uhoraho, ayasomera abantu bose.
Maze Mikaya mwene Gemariya, Gemariya wa Shafani, yumvise mur’ ico gitabo amajambo yose y’Uhoraho,

aramanuka aja mu ngoro y’umwami, ashika mu cumba c’umukarani: ahasanga abaganwa bose bicaye, ni bo aba: Elishama umukarani, na Delaya mwene Shemaya, na Elunatani mwene Akabori, na Gemariya mwene Shafani, na Zedekiya mwene Hananiya, n’ abandi baganwa bose.
Nuko Mikaya abatondera amajambo yose yumvise, igihe Baruki yasomera abantu ico gitabo.

Nukw abo baganwa bose batuma Yehudi mwene Netaniya, Netaniya wa Shelemiya, Shelemiya wa Kushi, kuri Baruki, bat’ Abīra uwo muzingo w’igitabo wasomeye abantu, uwuzane. Nuko Baruki mwene Neriya yābīra uwo muzingo, aja iyo bari.
Baramubgira, bat’ Enda icara, uwudusomere. Nuko Baruki arawubasomera.
Nuko bumvise amajambo yose, beraguzanya bafise ubgoba, babarira Baruki, bati Ntitwobura kubarira umwami ayo majambo yose.
Babaza Baruki, bati Tubarire, mbeg’ ayo majambo yose wayanditse ute? Wayakūye mu kanwa kiwe?
Nuko Baruki arabishura, ati Yambarira ayo majambo yose n’ akanwa kiwe, nanje nkayandikisha wino mur’ iki gitabo.
Maz’ abo baganwa babarira Baruki, bati Genda winyegeze, mwe na Yeremiya; ntihagire umuntu n’ umwe amenya aho muri.
Baja ah’ umwami ari mw irebe, basize uwo muzingo mu cumba ca Elishama umukarani; umwami bamudondera ayo majambo yose.
Nuk’ umwami atuma Yehudi kuzana uwo muzingo: awuzana awukūye mu cumba ca Elishama umukarani. Nuko Yehudi awusomera umwami n’abaganwa bose bāri bahagaze i ruhande yiwe.
Kand’ umwami yar’ avyagiye mu ngoro yabamwo mu gihe c’ imbeho; hāri mu kwezi kw’icenda. Imbere yiwe hār’ umuriro mu coto.
Nuko Yehudi amaze gusoma impapuro zitatu canke zine, umwami awucagaguza imbugita, awuterera mu muriro wari mu coto, gushitsa ah’ umuzingo wose watemukiye mu muriro wo mu coto.
Kandi nta bgoba bāgira, ngo bitantamurireko n’impuzu zabo, ar’ umwami canke n’umwe wo mu basavyi biwe bumvise ayo majambo yose.
Yamara Elunatani na Delaya na Gemariya bari binginze umwami ngo ntaturire uwo muzingo: yanka kubumva.
Maz’ umwami abarira Yerameyeli umwana w’umwami na Seraya mwene Aziriyeli, na Shelemiya mwene Abudeli ngo bafate Baruki umukarani n’uwavugishwa n’Imana Yeremiya: arik’ Uhoraho arabahisha.
Hanyuma ijambo ry’Uhoraho riza kuri Yeremiya, umwami amaze guturira wa muzingo warimwo ya majambo Baruki yari yanditse, ayakūye mu kanwa ka Yeremiya,
riti Subira wābīre uwundi muzingo, uwandikemw’ amajambo yose nk’aya mbere yari mu muzingo wa mbere, uwo Yehoyakimu umwami w’i Buyuda yaturiye.

Kandi ku vya Yehoyakimu umwami w’i Buyuda uvuge, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Waturiye uwo muzingo, uvuga ngo N’iki kiwukwandikishije ut’ Umwami w’i Babuloni ntazobura kuza ngw ahonnye iki gihugu, akimaremw’ abantu n’ibitungwa?

Nuko rero, uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ku vya Yehoyakimu umwami w’i Buyuda, ati Ntazokwigera agira n’umwe wo gusubira ku ngoma ya Dawidi; umuvyimba wiwe uzotererwa hanze ng’ ube mu ndugumba yo ku murango no mu gikonyozi co mw ijoro.
Kandi nzomuhanana n’uruvyaro rwiwe n’abasavyi biwe, mbahōye ukugabitanya kwabo; nshitse kuri bo, bo n’ababa i Yerusalemu n’abagabo b’i Buyuda, ivyago vyose nabageneye, kuko banse kwumva.

Nuko Yeremiya yābīra uwundi muzingo, awuha Baruki umukarani mwene Neriya, awandikamw’ amajambo yose ayakūra mu kanwa ka Yeremiya, yari muri ca gitabo Yehoyakimu umwami w’i Buyuda yaturiye: kandi hongerwakw ayandi majambo menshi asa na yo.
Zedekiya mwene Yosiya aja ku ngoma mu gishingo ca Koniya mwene Yehoyakimu, Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni ari we amwimitse mu gihugu c’i Buyuda.
Ariko ntiyumvira amajambo y’Uhoraho ayo yavugisha Yeremiya, ubgiwe cank’ abasavyi biwe cank’ abantu bo mu gihugu.
Maz’ umwami Zedekiya atuma Yehukali mwene Shelemiya na Zefaniya mwene Mayaseya umuherezi kuri Yeremiya uwavugishwa n’Imana, ati N’udusengere k’Uhoraho Imana yacu.
Kandi Yeremiya yar’ acigendagendera mu bandi bantu, kuko bataribgamushire mw ibohero.
Kand’ ingabo za Farawo zari zije zivuye muri Egiputa: maz’ Abakaludaya bari bugarije i Yerusalemu bumvise inkuru zavyo, bata i Yerusalemu barakimirana.
Maz’ ijambo ry’Uhoraho riza kur’ uwo yavugisha Yeremiya,

rit’ Uku ni k’ Uhoraho agize, ni we Mana y’ Abisirayeli, at’ Uku abe ari ko mubarira umwami w’i Buyuda yabantumyeko kunsiguza, muti Rāba ingabo za Farawo zije kubatabara zizosubira muri Egiputa mu gihugu cabo.
Kand’ Abakaludaya bazogaruka, batere iki gisagara; bazogitsinda bagitongoze umuriro.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Ntimwihende, mut’ Abakaludaya bazotuvako nta kabuza: kuko batazobavako.
Kuko naho mwotikiza ingabo zose z’Abakaludaya babarwanya, hagasigaramw’ abakomeretse basa, na ho nyene bova hasi, umuntu wese aho yar’ ari mw ihema ryiwe, bagatongoza iki gisagara umuriro.
Nukw ingabo z’Abakaludaya zimaze gukimirana zitaye i Yerusalemu kubgo kugirira ubgoba ingabo za Farawo,
Yeremiya asokoroka i Yerusalemu ngw aje mu ntāra ya Benyamini, gushikiririzway’ umugabane wiwe hagati mu bantu.
Agishika mw irembo ryitwa irya Benyamini, umukuru w’ abashibamyi yitwa Iriya mwene Shelemiya, Shelemiya wa Hananiya, ni ho yar’ ahagaze: afata uwo muvugishwa Yeremiya, at’ Uroye kwisaba Abakaludaya.
Yeremiya ati S’ivy’ ukuri; singiye kwisaba Abakaludaya. Ariko yanka kuvyumva: nuko Iriya afata Yeremiya, amushīra abaganwa.
Abaganwa bashavurira Yeremiya, baramukubita, bamushira mw ibohero mu nzu ya Yonatani umukarani, kuko bāri bayigize ibohero.
Nuko Yeremiya amaze gushika mw ibohero, mu kazu ko mu kuzimu, ahamaze imisi myinshi,
umwami Zedekiya atuma kumuzana; nuk’ umwami amubariza mu mpisho mu ngoro yiwe, ati Mbega nta jambo ryoba rivuye k’Uhoraho? Yeremiya ati Ririho; at’ Uzotangwa mu kuboko kw’umwami w’i Babuloni.
Ikindi, Yeremiya abaza umwami Zedekiya, ati Mbega nagucumuyekw iki, cank’ abantu bawe, cank’ ubu bgoko, ko mwanshize mw ibohero?
Ba kamenyi banyu bābabarira, ng’ Umwami w’i Babuloni ntazobatera canke ngw atere iki gihugu, bari hehe?
Non’ urazirikanye, mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma, tegēra ivyo ngusavye ndakwinginze; ntunsubize mu nzu ya Yonatani umukarani, simpfireyo.

Nuk’ umwami Zedekiya aravuga, bashira Yeremiya mu rugo rw’ibohero, bamugaburira umutsima uko bukeye, bawuguriye ku nzira y’abacumvyi, gushitsa ah’ imitsima yose yahebūriwe mu gisagara. Nuko Yeremiya aguma ngaho mu rugo rw’ibohero.
Shefatiya mwene Matani, na Gedaliya mwene Pashuri, na Yukali mwene Shelemiya, na Pashuri mwene Malakiya, bumva amajambo Yeremiya abarira abantu bose,
ng’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Ūguma mur’ iki gisagara azokwicwa n’inkota n’inzara n’ ikīza: arik’ ūsokoroka muri co, akaja ku Bakaludaya, azobaho, kand’ azoba akijije amagara yiwe, abeho.
At’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Iki gisagara ntikizobura gutangwa mu maboko y’ ingabo z’umwami w’i Babuloni, na we azogitsinda.

Maz’ abaganwa babgira umwami, bat’ Uyu muntu akwiye gupfa: kukw adendebura amaboko y’abahizi bagisigaye mur’ iki gisagara n’ay’ abantu bose, ababarira amajambo asa artyo: kuk’ uyu mugabo atifuriza amahoro ubu bgoko, atar’ ivyago.
Nuk’ umwami Zedekiya at’ Eh’ ari mu maboko yanyu: kuko jewe umwami ntoshobora gukora ikintu na kimwe co kubabuza.

Maze bafata Yeremiya, bamushira mu cobo cimbiwe kubīka amazi ca Malakiya umwana w’ umwami, cari mu rugo rw’ibohero: bamwururukirizayo n’imigozi. Mur’ ico cobo nta mazi yarimwo, atar’ ikivurugu c’ivyondo: kandi Yeremiya adibira muri nya vyondo.
Maze Ebedumeleki, Umunyetiyopiya w’inkone, yasukūra mu ngoro y’ umwami, yumva ko bashize Yeremiya mur’ ico cobo; ico gihe umwami yar’ avyagiye ku kirimba citwa ica Benyamini.
Ebedumeleki asohoka mu ngoro i bgami, abarira umwami,

ati Mwami wanje nyen’ ingoma, abo bantu bakoze nabi muri vyose bagiriye Yeremiya umuvugishwa, uwo batereye mu cobo; kand’ ari mu gupfira aho hantu ari, kubg’ inzara; kukw ata mutsima ugisigaye mu gisagara.
Maz’ umwami abarira Ebedumeleki Umunyetiyopiya, ati Kūra hano abagabo mirongwitatu, ubajane, ukūre uwo muvugishwa Yeremiya mur’ ico cobo, ntagweyo.
Nuko Ebedumeleki ajana abo bagabo, yinjira mu ngoro y’umwami, aja musi y’ubushinguro, akūray’ impuzu z’imikūra n’ibishambara, abirungikisha imigozi mu cobo abiha Yeremiya.
Maze Ebedumeleki Umunyetiyopiya abarira Yeremiya, at’ Enda shira izo mpuzu z’imikūra n’ibishambara mu maha imbere y’imigozi. Yeremiya agira kuno.
Nuko bakwegesha Yeremiya imigozi, bamukūra mur’ ico cobo; Yeremiya aguma mu rugo rw’ibohero.
Maz’ umwami Zedekiya aratuma, bamuzanira Yeremiya umuvugishwa, bamumusanza imbere mw irebe rya gatatu ryo mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho: maz’ umwami abarira Yeremiya, ati Har’ ico nkubaza: ntugire ico umpisha.
Maze Yeremiya abarira Zedekiya, ati Ni nakikubarira, wobura kunyica? Kandi ni nakugīra inama, na ho nyene ntiwonyumva.
Nuk’ umwami Zedekiya arahirira Yeremiya mu mpisho, ati Nk’uk’ Uhoraho ahoraho, ari we yandemeye uyu mutima, sinkwica, kandi singutanga mu maboko y’abo bantu barondera kukwica.

Maze Yeremiya abarira Zedekiya, at’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ni we Mana Nyen’ ingabo, Imana y’Abisirayeli, ati Ni wagenda ukīsaba abaganwa b’umwami w’i Babuloni, uzokwikiza, kand’ iki gisagara ntikizotongozwa umuriro; nawe uzobona kubaho, n’abo mu nzu yawe.
Ariko n’utemera kwīsaba abaganwa b’umwami w’i Babuloni, iki gisagara kizotangwa mu maboko y’Abakaludaya, kandi bazogitongoza umuriro, nawe ntuzokwikiza ng’ uve mu maboko yabo.
Maz’ umwami Zedekiya yishura Yeremiya, ati Ntinya Abayuda bāmaze kwisaba Abakaludaya, kuko bobampa bakanshinyagurira.
Yeremiya aramwishura, ati Ntibazobaguha. Ndakwinginze, wumvire Uhoraho mur’ ivyo nkubariye: ni ho uzomererwa neza, ukikiza.
Ariko ni wanka kugenda, iri ni ryo jambo Uhoraho yanyeretse:

ati Rāba abagore bose basigaye mu rugo rw’umwami w’i Buyuda, bazokūrwayo bahabge abaganwa b’umwami w’i Babuloni, kand’ abo bagore bazovuga, bat’ Abakunzi bawe pfampfe bāraguhenze, uja na rwo: arikw ibirenge vyawe bimaze gushaya mu kivurugu c’ivyondo, barakimirana.

Kandi bazosohora abamikazi bawe bose n’abana bawe babahe Abakaludaya: nawe ntuzokwikiza ng’ uve mu maboko yabo, arik’ uzofatwa n’ukuboko kw’umwami w’i Babuloni: kandi ni wewe uzoba uzaniye iki gisagara gutongozwa umuriro.
Maze Zedekiya abarira Yeremiya, ati Ntihakagire umuntu agira ico amenya kur’ ayo majambo; ni ho utopfa.
Arikw abaganwa ni baramuka bumvise ko twavuganye, bakaza bakakubarira, bati Twīgānire ivyo wabariye umwami, ntuduhishe, natwe ntitukwica, bati Tubgire n’ivyo umwami yakwishuye:
uz’ ubabgire, uti Nari kwinginga umwami ngo yoye kunsubiza mu nzu kwa Yonatani, ngo ngweyo.
Maz’ abaganwa bose baza kuri Yeremiya, barabimubaza: na we abishura amajambo yose nk’uk’ umwami yamubariye. Baca baramureka, barīgīra, kukw ayo majambo yabaye akabanga.
Nuko Yeremiya aba mu rugo rw’ibohero, gushitsa umusi Yerusalemu hatsinzwe.

Nuko Yerusalemu haratsindwa. Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni, n’ingabo ziwe zose, yaje gutera Yerusalemu arahugariza, mu mwaka ugira icenda Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda ari ku ngoma, mu kwezi kw’icumi;
maze mu mwaka ugira icumi na rimwe Zedekiya ari ku ngoma, mu kwezi kwa kane, ku musi wakwo w’icenda, basatura uruzitiro rw’ico gisagara.

Hatsinzwe, abaganwa bose b’umwami w’i Babuloni baraza basagaza mu kirimba co hagati, ni bo aba: Nerugali‐sharezeri, na Samugari‐nebo, na Sarusekimu, na Rabu‐sarisi, na Nerugali‐sharezeri, na Rabu‐magu, bo n’abandi baganwa bose b’umwami w’i Babuloni.

Maze Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda n’ingabo zose bababonye, barahunga, bahenga mw ijoro bava mu gisagara, baciye mu ndimiro y’umwami no mu kirimba kiri hagati y’inzitiro zibiri: umwami ajana inzira ica mu kiyaya Araba.

Maz’ ingabo z’Abakaludaya zibōma inyuma, zihambiriza Zedekiya mu kiyaya c’i Yeriko: bamaze kumufata, baramudūgana, bamuzanira Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni bamumusanza i Ribula mu ntāra y’i Hamati: amucirakw iteka.
Nuk’ uwo mwami w’i Babuloni yicira abahungu ba Zedekiya imbere y’amaso yiwe nyene i Ribula; kand’ uwo mwami w’i Babuloni yica n’abaganwa bose b’i Buyuda.
Ikigeretseko anogora amaso Zedekiya, amwambika umunyororo kugira ngo bamujane i Babuloni.
Abakaludaya banda umuriro ingoro y’umwami n’ amazu y’abantu, basangangura n’ inzitiro zikikije i Yerusalemu.
Maze Nebuzaradani, umukuru w’abashibamyi, ajana i Babuloni amasigarira y’abantu bāri bagisigaye mu gisagara, n’abāri bāragiye kumwisaba, n’amasigarira y’abantu bāri bagisigaye, abajana ar’ inyagano.
Ariko Nebuzaradani uwo mukuru w’abashibamyi, asiga mu gihugu c’i Buyuda abantu ba nyarucari batagira ico batunze, abaha imirima y’inzabibu n’amatongo ico gihe.
Maze Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni agera Nebuzaradani uwo mukuru w’abashibamyi ku vya Yeremiya,
ati Mujane, umuzigame neza, ntugire ico umugira; kand’ ukw azogomba abe ari k’uzomugirira.
Nuko Nebuzaradani uwo mukuru w’abashibamyi aratuma, bo na Nebushazabani na Rabu‐sarisi na Nerugali‐sharezeri na Rabu‐magu, n’abakuru bose b’umwami w’i Babuloni,
baratuma, bakūra Yeremiya mu rugo rw’ibohero, bamuha Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu, Ahikamu wa Shafani, ngw amujane i we: nuko yibera ngaho mu bandi bantu.
Kand’ ijambo ry’Uhoraho ryari ryaje kuri Yeremiya, igihe yar’ acugaraniwe mu rugo rw’ ibohero,

riti Genda ubarire Ebedumeleki Umunyetiyopiya, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ati Rāba ngira nshitse kur’ iki gisagara ayo nakivuzeko y’ivyago, atar’ ay’ ivyiza; kandi bizoshika uvyibonera kuri nya musi.
Ariko weho nzokurokora kur’ uwo musi, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze: kandi ntuzotangwa mu maboko y’abo utinya.
Kuko ntazobura kugukiza; ntuzokwicwa n’inkota, arikw amagara yawe uzoba uyakijije, kuko wanyizigiye, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.

Ijambo ryaje kuri Yeremiya rivuye k’Uhoraho, Nebuzaradani umukuru w’abashibamyi amaze kumubohorera i Rama, iyo yari yaramujanye ari mu munyororo, hamwe n’imbohe zose zavuye i Yerusalemu, izo bājana i Babuloni ar’ inyagano.
Nuk’ uwo mukuru w’abashibamyi akūramwo Yeremiya, aramubarira, at’ Uhoraho Imana yawe yari yarageneye ivyago aha hantu:
kand’ Uhoraho arabishikanye, agize nk’ uko yavuze; ko mwacumuye k’ Uhoraho, ntimumwumvire, ivyo ni vyo vyatumye ivyo bibashikako.

Kandi non’ uyu musi ndakubohoye iminyororo iri ku maboko yawe. Ni washima kujana nanje i Babuloni, n’uze, nanje nzokugirira neza; ariko n’udashima kujana nanje i Babuloni, usigeho: eh’ igihugu cose kir’ imbere yawe; aho wumva ushima ko hakubereye kujayo, abe ari ho uja.

Agitebaganye kumwishura, aramubgira, ati Subirayo, uje kuri Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu, Ahikamu wa Shafani, umwe umwami w’i Babuloni yashizeho kuganza ibisagara vy’i Buyuda, wibanire na we hagati mu bandi bantu: cank’ aho wumva ko hakubereye kugenda hose, abe ari ho uja. Nuko wa mukuru w’abashibamyi amuha impamba n’ingabire, aramurekura.
Nuko Yeremiya aja kuri Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu i Mizipa, yibanira na we hagati mu bandi bantu bari barasigaye mu gihugu.

Nukw abagabisha bose b’ingabo bari bakwiragiye mu misozi, bo n’ingabo zabo, bumvise yuk’ umwami w’i Babuloni yashizeho Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu kuganza igihugu, kandi ko yamuragije abagabo n’abagore n’abana, n’abo muri ba nyarucari batambukanywe kw inyagano i Babuloni;

baza kuri Gedaliya i Mizipa. Ni bo aba: Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya, na Yohanani na Yonatani bene Kareya, na Seraya mwene Tanehumeti, na bene Efayi w’i Netofati, na Yezaniya umwana w’Umunyamayakati, bo n’ingabo zabo.
Maze Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu, Ahikamu wa Shafani, ababarira abarahira, bo n’ingabo zabo, ati Ntimutinye gusaba Abakaludaya: mwibere mu gihugu, musabe umwami w’i Babuloni, kandi bizobaroranira.

Nanje rāba ngerereye i Mizipa, kugira ngo nshikirweko n’Abakaludaya mu vyo bazombarira vyose, ni baza ino: ariko mweho, mwamure inzabibu za vino n’ivyo ibiti vyama na elayo z’amavuta, mubishire mu mibindi yanyu, mwibere mu bisagara vyanyu mwegukiye.

N’ Abayuda bose n’uko, abār’ i Mowabu no mu Bamoni no muri Edomu, n’abāri mu bihugu vyose, bumvise yuk’ umwami w’i Babuloni yaretse amasigarira yo mu Bayuda, kandi ko yashizeho Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu, Ahikamu wa Shafani, kubaganza,
nukw Abayuda bose baragaruka, bavuye ahantu hose aho bari barirukaniwe, bashika mu gihugu c’i Buyuda, baza kuri Gedaliya i Mizipa, bamura inzabibu za vino n’ivyo ibiti vyama vyinshi cane.
Maze Yohanani mwene Kareya, n’abagabisha bose b’ingabo bāri bakwiragiye mu misozi, baza kuri Gedaliya i Mizipa,
baramubgira, bati Mbeg’ urazi yuko Bayalisi umwami w’Abamoni yatumye Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya kukwica? Ariko Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu ntiyavyemera.

Maze Yohanani mwene Kareya abaririra Gedaliya mu mpisho i Mizipa, ati Ndekura ndakwinginze, nje kwica Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya; nta muntu azobimenya: mbega yokwicira iki, Abayuda bose batororokaniye kuri wewe bagasubira gusanzara, amasigarira y’i Buyuda agahona?
Ariko Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu abarira Yohanani mwene Kareya, ati Ntuz’ ukore ikintu kimeze girtyo: kuk’ ubeshera Ishimayeli.

Maze mu kwezi kw’indwi, Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya, Netaniya wa Elishama, wo mu nda y’ingoma, ari we umwe mu babgiriza bakuru b’umwami, azanana n’abantu cumi, aja kuri Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu i Mizipa; nuko basangirira na we aho nyene i Mizipa.

Maze Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya avana hasi n’abo bagabo cumi bāri kumwe na we, bacumita inkota Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu, Ahikamu wa Shafani, baramwica, kand’ ari we umwami w’i Babuloni yashizeho kuganza igihugu.
Ishimayeli yica kandi n’ Abayuda bāri kumwe na Gedaliya i Mizipa, bo n’abasoda b’Abakaludaya bāri basanzweyo.
Bukeye ku musi ugira kabiri amaze kwica Gedaliya, kand’ ata wurabimenya,

haza bamwe bavuye i Shekemu n’i Shilo n’i Samariya, abagabo mirongumunani, bāri bimosheje ubganwa bgabo inkomvorera, bitantamuriyekw impuzu zabo, bikebaguye ku mibiri, bazanye amashikanwa n’imibavu mu minwe, ngo babizane mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho.
Nuko Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya ava i Mizipa ngw aje kubasanganira, agenda arira ingenda: abasanganiye, arababarira, ati Ni muze kuri Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu.
Nuko bamaze gushika hagati mu gisagara, Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya arabica, afatanije n’abagabo bāri kumwe na we, abashiburira mu cobo co kubīka amazi.

Ariko haboneka abagabo cumi muri bo bīsaba Ishimayeli, bati Ntutwice, kuko dufise ivyo twaziganije, twānyegeje mu misozi, ingano na sayiri n’amavuta ya elayo n’ubūki. Nukw arigarura, ntiyabicana na bagenzi babo.

Nukw ico cobo Ishimayeli yashiburiyemw’ imivyimba yose y’abo yishe, ikahasanga uwa Gedaliya, ni co cari cimbishije umwami Asa kubgo gutinya Bayasha umwami w’Abisirayeli. Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya acuzuza abishwe.

Maze Ishimayeli ajana kw inyagano amasigarira yose y’abantu bār’ i Mizipa, ni bo bakobga b’umwami n’abantu bose bāri bagisigaye i Mizipa, abo Nebuzaradani umukuru w’abashibamyi yari yaragije Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu. Nuko Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya abajana kw inyagano, avayo ngw aje mu Bamoni.
Maze Yohanani mwene Kareya, n’abagabisha bose b’ingabo bāri kumwe na we, bumvise ivyo bibi vyose Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya yakoze,
bajana n’ ingabo zose, baja kurwanya Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya, bamusanga hafi y’ikidengeri kinini c’i Gibeyoni.
Nukw abantu bose bāri kumwe na Ishimayeli babonye Yohanani mwene Kareya n’abagabisha b’ingabo bose bāri kumwe na we, baranezerwa.
Nukw abantu bose Ishimayeli yarajanye kw inyagano abakūye i Mizipa, barahindukira, baherēra kuri Yohanani mwene Kareya.
Ariko Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya, bo n’abagabo munani, bacikana Yohanani, baja mu Bamoni.

Nuko Yohanani mwene Kareya, n’abagabisha b’ingabo bose bāri kumwe na we, ajana amasigarira y’abantu yari yatse Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya, yarakūye i Mizipa amaze kwica Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu, abagabo n’abagore n’abana n’ inkone, abagarukaniye i Gibeyoni,
baragenda baba barifashije i Geruti‐Cimuhamu hahereranye n’i Betelehemu, ngo baje muri Egiputa,
kubg’ Abakaludaya: kuko bābatinya, kuko Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya yari yishe Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu, uwo umwami w’i Babuloni yari yarashizeho kuganza igihugu.
Maz’ abagabisha b’ingabo bose, na Yohanani mwene Kareya, na Yezaniya mwene Hoshaya, n’abantu bose uhereye ku boroshe ugashitsa ku bahambaye,

bēgēra uwavugishwa n’Imana Yeremiya, bati Turakwinginze, emera ico tugusaba, udusengere k’Uhoraho Imana yawe, twebge aya masigarira twese; kuko dusigaye turi bake twahora turi benshi, nk’uko nawe utwibonera:
kugira ng’ Uhoraho Imana yawe atwereke uko dukwiye kugenza n’ico dukwiye gukora.
Nuk’ uwavugishwa n’Imana Yeremiya arabishura, at’ Ego ndumvise; ngiye kubasengera k’Uhoraho Imana yanyu nk’uko muvuze: maz’ ico Uhoraho azonyishura cose nzokibabarira; sinzogira ico mbahisha.
Bishura Yeremiya, bat’ Uhoraho n’atubere icabona c’ ukuri c’ukwizigirwa, ni tutākora nk’ukw ijambo ryose rimeze, iryo Uhoraho Imana yawe azokudutumako.
Ar’ ivyiza ar’ ibibi, ntituzobura kwumvira Uhoraho Imana yacu, uwo tugutumyeko; kugira ngo tuze tubone kuroranirwa ni twumvira Uhoraho Imana yacu.
Nukw imisi cumi ihise, ijambo ry’Uhoraho riza kuri Yeremiya.
Ahamagara Yohanani mwene Kareya, n’abagabisha b’ingabo bose bāri kumwe na we, n’abantu bose uhereye ku boroshe ugashitsa ku bahambaye,
arababarira, at’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, uwo mwantumyeko kumushikiriza ivyo mwasavye:
ati Ni mwakomeza kuguma mur’ iki gihugu, azobubaka, ntazobasambura; azobatēragira, ntazobarandura: ngo Kuko yigaruye mu vyago yabateje.
Ngo Reka gutinya umwami w’i Babuloni, uwo mutinya uwo; ntimumutinye, ni k’Uhoraho agize; ngo Kukw ari kumwe namwe ngw abakize, abarokore abakūre mu kuboko kwiwe.
Ngw Azobaha kumutera akagongwe, kugira ngw abagirire imbabazi, abasubize mu gihugu canyu bgite.
Ngw Ariko ni mwavuga, muti Ntitukigomba kuba mur’ iki gihugu; bigatuma mutamwumvira, ari we Uhoraho Imana yanyu,
mukavuga, mut’ Oya, ariko tugomba kuja mu gihugu ca Egiputa, aho tutazobona intambara, canke ngo twumve ijwi ry’inzamba, canke ngo tubure indya; abe ari ho tuba:

none rero gira mwumve ijambo ry’Uhoraho, mwebge amasigarira y’i Buyuda: uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ati Ni mwerekeza amaso rwose muri Egiputa, ngw abe ari yo muja kuba;
nukw inkota mutinya izobahamvyayo, mu gihugu ca Egiputa, n’inzara mutinya izobakurikirana no muri Egiputa; kandi ni yo muzogwa.
Ni ko bizomerera abantu bose berekeza amaso kuja muri Egiputa ngo babeyo; bazokwicwa n’inkota n’inzara n’ikīza; ngo Kandi nta n’umwe muri bo azosigara canke ngo yikize ivyago azobatēza.

Kuk’ ukw ari k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ngo Nk’uk’ uburake bgiwe n’ubushangashirwe bgiwe vyasutswe ku baba i Yerusalemu, ni k’ubushangashirwe bgiwe buzosukwa kuri mwebge ni mwaja muri Egiputa; ngo Muzoba igitutsi n’ akajoreza n’ikivume n’iciro ry’ imigani: ngo Kandi ntimuzosubira kubona aha hantu.
Uhoraho yavuze kuri mwebge, mwa masigarira y’i Buyuda, ngo Ntimukaje muri Egiputa: mumenye mudakekeranya yuko mbibashingiye intahe uyu musi.

Erega mwāhenze imitima yanyu ubganyu, kuko mwantumye k’Uhoraho Imana yanyu, ngo Ni mbasengere k’Uhoraho Imana yanyu, ngw Ivyo Uhoraho Imana yanyu azovuga vyose ngo Ndabibabarire, ngo Namwe muzobikora:
non’ uyu musi ndabibabariye, ariko mwebge ntimwumviye Uhoraho Imana yanyu mu kintu na kimwe mu vyo yabantumyeko.
None rero ni mumenye mudakekeranya yuko muzokwicirwa n’inkota n’ inzara n’ikīza, aho hantu aho mwifuza kuja kuba.
Maze Yeremiya ahejeje kubarira abantu bose amajambo yose y’Uhoraho Imana yabo, ayo Uhoraho Imana yabo yamubatumyeko, ni yo ya majambo yose,
Azariya mwene Hoshaya, na Yohanani mwene Kareya, n’abagabo b’abibone bose, babarira Yeremiya, bat’ Uvuze ibinyoma: Uhoraho Imana yacu ntiyagutumye kuvuga, ngo Ntituje muri Egiputa kubayo;
ariko Baruki mwene Neriya ni we akuduteranijeko, kugira ngo dutangwe mu maboko y’Abakaludaya, ngo batwice, canke batujane i Babuloni tur’ inyagano.
Nuko Yohanani mwene Kareya n’abagabisha b’ ingabo bose, n’abantu bose, ntibumvira Uhoraho, ngo babe mu gihugu c’i Buyuda.
Ariko Yohanani mwene Kareya n’abagabisha b’ingabo bose, bajana amasigarira yose y’Abayuda, abāri bagarutse kuba mu gihugu c’i Buyuda bavuye mu mahanga yose aho bāri barirukaniwe;

abagabo n’abagore n’abana, n’abakobga b’ umwami, n’umuntu wese Nebuzaradani umukuru w’abashibamyi yari yararagije Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu, Ahikamu wa Shafani, bo n’ūvugishwa n’Imana Yeremiya, na Baruki mwene Neriya;
baja mu gihugu ca Egiputa, kuko batumviye Uhoraho: nuko bashika i Tahapanesi.
Maz’ ijambo ry’Uhoraho riza kuri Yeremiya i Tahapanesi,
rit’ Abīra amabuye manini, uyahishe mw ivu musi y’amatafari ari mw ishikiro ry’irebe ry’ingoro ya Farawo i Tahapanesi, abagabo b’ Abayuda barorēra;

ubabarire, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ngw Eh’ azotuma kuzana Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni umusavyi wiwe, na we azotereka intebe yiwe y’ubgami kur’ aya mabuye mpishije; kand’ azoshinga ihema ryiwe ry’ubgami kuri yo.
Kand’ azoza atere igihugu ca Egiputa; abagerewe kwicwa bazoja kwicwa, abagerewe umugozi bazoja mu mugozi, abagerewe inkota bazoja ku nkota.

Kand’ azokwanda umuriro amazu y’ibigirwamana vy’Abanyegiputa; azoyaturira, abijane kw inyagano: kand’ azokwirenza igihugu ca Egiputa nk’uk’ umwungere yirenza umutamana wiwe; kand’ azovayo ar’ amahoro.
Kand’ azohomvagura inkingi ziri mu rusengero rw’izuba, ruri mu gihugu ca Egiputa; kand’ amazu y’ibigirwamana vy’Abanyegiputa azoyatongoza umuriro.
Ijambo ryaje kuri Yeremiya ku vy’ Abayuda bose bāba mu gihugu ca Egiputa, bāba i Migidoli, n’i Tahapanesi ni Nofu no mu ntāra y’i Patirosi,
