rit’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ati Mwabonye ivyago vyose nateje i Yerusalemu, n’ibisagara vyose vy’i Buyuda; kandi none rāba, uyu musi hasigaye ar’ imisaka, ata muntu akihaba;
kubg’ ivyaha vyabo bākoze ngo banshavuze, kuko boshereje imibavu izindi mana bakazisaba, izo batigeze bamenya, bo ubgabo, canke mwebge, canke ba sogokuruza banyu.
Yamara nabatumyekw abasavyi banje bose, ni bo bavugishwa nanje, nama nzindurwa no kubatuma, nti Ntimugakore ico kizira c’ubuyobe nanka urunuka.
Ariko na ho nyene ntibāvyumva, canke ngo batege ugutwi kwabo, ngo bahindukire bareke ibibi vyabo, ntibosereze imibavu izindi mana.
Ni co catumye ubushangashirwe bganje n’uburake bganje bisukwa bikadomekwa mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda no mu nzira z’i Yerusalemu; none har’ imisaka n’amatongo, nk’uko bir’ uyu musi.

Nuko rer’ uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ni we Mana Nyen’ ingabo, Imana y’Abisirayeli, ati N’iki gituma mukora ikibi kingana girtyo, mugacumurira ubugingo bganyu, mukamarisha mu Bayuda umugabo n’umugore, umwana n’ uwonka, ntimugire ico musigaza?

Kandi n’iki gituma mundakisha ibikorwa vy’amaboko yanyu, mu kwosereza imibavu izindi mana mu gihugu ca Egiputa, aho mwaroye kuba, bikabakwegera guherengetezwa, mugahinduka ibivume n’iciro ry’imigani mu mahanga yose yo mw isi?

Mbega mwibagiye ivyaha vya ba sogokuruza banyu, n’ivyaha vy’abami b’i Buyuda, n’ivyaha vy’abamikazi babo, n’ivyaha vyanyu ubganyu, n’ivyaha vy’abagore banyu, ivyo bākoreye mu gihugu c’i Buyuda, no mu nzira z’i Yerusalemu?
Ntibarīcīsha bugufi gushitsa no kur’ uyu musi, ntibaratinya, ntibaragendera mu vyagezwe vyanje, canke mu mabgirizwa yanje, ivyo nashize imbere yanyu n’imbere ya ba sogokuruza.
Nuko rero, uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, at’ Ehe rāba, mbatungiriye igitsure ngo mbazanekw ivyago, ngo mperengeteze i Buyuda hose.

Kandi nzofata amasigarira y’i Buyuda, aberekeje amaso kuja mu gihugu ca Egiputa ngo babeyo, bazotikizwa bose; kandi mur’ ico gihugu ca Egiputa nyene ni yo bazogwa. Bazoririkwa n’inkota n’inzara; kandi bazopfa, uhereye ku woroshe ugashitsa k’ūhambaye, bishwe n’ inkota n’inzara; kandi bazoba igitutsi n’akajoreza n’ibivume n’ iciro ry’imigani.
Kuko nzohana ababa mu gihugu ca Egiputa nk’uko nahannye i Yerusalemu, mbahanishe inkota n’inzara n’ikīza,

ngo mu masigarira y’i Buyuda, abāgiye mu gihugu ca Egiputa kubayo, hoye kugira ūzocika cank’ ūzosigara bagasubira mu gihugu c’i Buyuda, aho bifuza kuzosubira kubayo: kukw ata wuzosubirayo atar’ abazocika.

Maz’ abagabo bose bāri bazi yukw abagore babo bosereza imibavu izindi mana, bo n’abagore bose bahagararanye aho, ar’ ishengero rinini, ni bo bantu bose bagiye kuba mu gihugu ca Egiputa i Patirosi, bishura Yeremiya,
bati Ku vy’ijambo utubariye mw izina ry’Uhoraho ntitukwumvira.

Ariko ntituzobura gushitsa ijambo ryose rivuye mu kanwa kacu, ngo twosereze imibavu umwamikazi wo mw ijuru, tumusukire n’ibiturire, nk’uko twahora dukora, twe na ba sogokuruza n’abami bacu n’abaganwa bacu, mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda no mu nzira z’i Yerusalemu: kukw ico gihe twagira indya nyinshi, tukibera amahoro, nta vyago twabona.
Arik’ uhereye igihe twarekeye kwosereza imibavu umwamikazi wo mw ijuru, no kumusukira ibiturire, ni ho twaciye duhīndāna, tukamarwa n’inkota n’inzara.
Kandi hamwe twosereza imibavu umwamikazi wo mw ijuru, tukamusukira ibiturire, ugira ngo twamucumbiye imitsima y’ibiterekerwa tumusukira n’ibiturire, abagabo bacu batabizi?
Maze Yeremiya abarira abantu bose, abagabo n’abagore, ni bo abo bose bāmwishuye bartyo,

at’ Imibavu mwoshereje mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda no mu nzira z’i Yerusalemu, mwe na ba sogokuruza n’abami banyu n’abaganwa banyu n’abantu bo mu gihugu, mbeg’ Uhoraho ntiyayibutse, ntivyinjiye mu mutima wiwe?

Bigatuma Uhoraho atagishobora kuvyihanganira, kubg’ ibibi vy’ibikorwa vyanyu, no kubg’ ibizira vy’ ubuyobe mwakoze; ivyo ni vyo vyatumye igihugu canyu gihinduka imisaka n’akajoreza n’ikivume, ata wukikibamwo, nk’uko bimeze n’ uyu musi.

Ko mwosheje imibavu, mugacumura k’Uhoraho, ntimwumvire Uhoraho, ngo mugendere mu vyagezwe vyiwe, no mu vyo yashinze no mu vyo yihanikirije, ivyo ni vyo vyatumye ibi vyago bibashikako, nk’uko bimeze n’uyu musi.
Vyongeye Yeremiya abarira abantu bose, n’abo bagore bose, ati Ni mwumve ijambo ry’Uhoraho, mwebge mwese Abayuda muri mu gihugu ca Egiputa:

uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ati Mwebge n’abagore banyu mwavugishije akanwa kanyu, mubishikisha amaboko yanyu, muti Ntituzobura gushitsa amasezerano twasezeranye yo kwosereza imibavu umwamikazi wo mw ijuru, no kumusukira ibiturire: enda rero ni mukomeze amasezerano yanyu! Enda ayo masezerano yanyu muyashitse!

Nuko rero ni mwumve ijambo ry’Uhoraho, mwebge mwese Abayuda muri mu gihugu ca Egiputa: at’ Ehe rāba, ndahiye izina ryanje rihambaye, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, yukw izina ryanje ritazosubira kuvugwa n’akanwa k’umuntu n’umwe wo mu Bayuda bari mu gihugu cose ca Egiputa, ngo bavuge bati Nk’ uk’ Umwami Uhoraho ahoraho.
Rāba mbahozakw igitsure, ngo mbazanekw ivyago atar’ ivyiza; kand’ abagabo bose b’Abayuda bari mu gihugu ca Egiputa bazoririkwa n’inkota n’inzara, gushitsa baherengeteye.

Kand’ abazokira inkota bagasubira mu gihugu c’i Buyuda bavuye mu gihugu ca Egiputa, bazoba ar’ imparūrwa; kand’ amasigarira yose y’i Buyuda, abāgiye mu gihugu ca Egiputa kubayo, bazomenya ijambo rihamye iry’ ari ryo, kw ar’ iryanje cank’ iryabo.
Kand’ iki ni co kimenyamenya canyu, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, kizobamenyesha yuko nzobahanira aha hantu, ngo mumenye yukw amajambo yanje atazobura guhama ngw abazanire ivyago:

uku ni ko ngize, jewe Uhoraho, nti Nzotanga Farawo‐Hofura umwami wa Egiputa mu maboko y’abansi biwe, no mu maboko y’abarondera kumwica, nk’uko natanze Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda mu kuboko kwa Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni umwansi wiwe, yarondera kumwica.

Ijambo uwavugishwa n’Imana Yeremiya yabariye Baruki mwene Neriya, igihe yandika ya majambo mu gitabo, ayakūye mu kanwa ka Yeremiya, mu mwaka ugira kane Yehoyakimu mwene Yosiya umwami w’Abayuda ari ku ngoma,
at’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho akubariye, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, wewe Baruki:
ati Wavuze, uti Mbonye ibara, kuk’ Uhoraho yongereje intuntu ku mubabaro wanje! Kuniha kurandambiye, simbona akaruhuko.
Uku abe ari k’umubarira, ut’ Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ngo Rāba, ico yubatse azogisambura, kand’ ico yatēragiye azokirandura: azokora artyo mu gihugu cose.
Ngo Mbega nawe wironderera ubukuru? Ntuburondere. Kuko rāba, ngw Azozana ivyago ku bafise umubiri bose, ni k’Uhoraho agize; ariko weho ngw Azoguha gukirira ah’ uzoba ugiye hose.
Ijambo ry’Uhoraho ryaje kuri Yeremiya uwavugishwa na we ku vy’amahanga.

Ku vya Egiputa: amajambo yo ku vy’ingabo za Farawo‐Neko umwami wa Egiputa, zari ku nkengera y’uruzi Efurate i Karukemeshi, izo Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni yanesheje mu mwaka ugira kane Yehoyakimu mwene Yosiya umwami w’i Buyuda ari ku ngoma.
Mutegure inkinzo nto‐nto na nini‐nini, mutonde urugamba murwane.
Mushire amatandiko ku mafarasi, muheze mwūrire, mwebge abayagenderako, mutonde mwambaye inkofero z’ivyuma; murtyorore amacumu, mwambare ivyuma vyo gukīngira imibiri.
N’iki gitumye bacika ivutu bagakimirana? Abahizi babo batsinzwe hasi, barahunga baratemesha, batarinze no gukebuka: haba ibibateye ubgoba irya n’ino, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Ntihagira impayamaguru icīka, cank’ umuhizi ngo hagire uwikiza; i burārūko ku nkengera y’uruzi Efurate ni ho batsitaye baratemba.
Uyu ni nde asendanisha nka Nili, amazi yiwe agatera imipfunda nk’inzūzi?
Ni Egiputa hasendanisha nka Nili, n’amazi yaho atera imipfunda nk’inzūzi: havuga, hati Hinge nsendanishe, ndenge isi yose; nze ngeseze ibisagara n’ ababibamwo.
Mudūge, mwa mafarasi, mugende akabushungwe, mwa mikogote! Abahizi ni barumikeko, ni bo Banyetiyopiya n’ Abaputi batwara inkinzo, n’Abaludimu batwara imiheto bazi kuyifora.

Kuk’ uwo musi ar’ uw’ Umwami, ni we Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, ar’ umusi wo kwīhōrako, kugira ngo yīhōre abarwanizi biwe: inkota izorya ihāge, izonywa amaraso yabo ihīmbe: kuk’ Umwami, ari we Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, acumitira ibimazi mu gihugu c’i burārūko ku nkengera y’uruzi Efurate.
Dūga upfe kwizenza i Gileyadi, wābīrey’ umuti, wewe mukobga w’inkumi ari we Egiputa: nta kimazi kunywa imiti myinshi: nta wo kuzogukiza uriho.
Amahanga yumvise ibitētērwa vyawe, isi yuzuye amaborogo yawe: kuk’ umuhizi atsitaye ku wundi, bompi bagatemba hamwe.
Ijambo Uhoraho yabariye Yeremiya ūvugishwa na we, ry’ ingene Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni azoza gutera igihugu ca Egiputa.
Muvugire muri Egiputa, muvyamamaze i Migidoli, muvyamamaze n’i Nofu n’i Tahapanesi, muti Mutonde, mwitegure, kukw inkota yariritse impande zose zigukikije.
N’iki gituma abahizi bawe bahunga? Ntibāshinze ikirenge, kuk’ Uhoraho yabirukanye.
Yatumye benshi batsitara, mbere bātsitaranyeko: bati Ngo tuvyuke twisubirire mu b’i wacu, no mu gihugu twavukiyemwo, duhunge inkota iririka.
Aho hantu ni ho basemerereye, bati Farawo umwami wa Egiputa n’ukureremesha akarūru gusa! Yazangazanze mu gihe cashinzwe.
Nk’uko ndiho, ni k’Umwami agize, ari we yitwa Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, n’ukuri nk’uko Tabora umeze ku yindi misozi, kandi nk’ uko Karumeli umeze ku kiyaga, ni k’ūgiye kuza azoza ameze.
Ewe wa mukobga wibereye muri Egiputa, witegure kujanwa kw inyagano; kukw i Nofu hazohinduka amatongo, hazotongorwa, hasigare ata wukihaba.
Egiputa n’inka y’iriza iteye igomwe rwose; ariko haje ikibugu kivuye i burārūko, kirashitse.

Kand’ ingabo zaho z’abacangero ziri hagati yaho, zimeze nk’inyana zo mu ruhongore: kuko na zo zakimiranye, zahungiye icarimwe, ntizashinga ikirenge: kuk’ umusi w’ ivyago vyabo ubashitseko, ni co gihe co kūzirwa kwabo.
Akariri kabo kazokwumvikana nk’ ugukakamba kw’inzoka; kuko bazobāzira bari n’ingabo, babatere bari n’amacabiti, nk’abaje kwicira ibiti.
Bazokwicira ikibira caho, ni k’Uhoraho agize, naho kizitanye gite; kuko barusha inzige ubginshi, kandi badaharūrika.
Umukobga, ni we Egiputa, azokorwa n’isoni; azotangwa mu maboko y’abantu b’i burārūko.
Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, aravuga, ati Nzohana Amona ikigirwamana c’ ahitwa No, na Farawo na Egiputa n’imana zaho n’abami baho; mbere Farawo nzomuhanana n’abamwizigira.

Nzobatanga mu maboko y’abashaka kubica, no mu kuboko kwa Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni, no mu maboko y’ abasavyi biwe; ariko hanyuma y’ivyo muri Egiputa hazosubira kubamw’ abantu, nk’uko hamye mu misi ya kera, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.

Ariko weho ntutinye, ewe Yakobo musavyi wanje, nturanduke umutima, ewe Isirayeli: kuko rāba nzogukiza ngukūre kure, uruvyaro rwawe ndarukūre mu gihugu rwajanywemwo ar’ inyagano; Yakobo azogaruka, kand’ azokwibera amahoro ata nkomanzi, kandi nta wuzomutera ubgoba.

Ntutinye, ewe Yakobo musavyi wanje, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, kuko ndi kumwe nawe: kuko nzoherengeteza amahanga yose, ayo nagushwiragirijemwo: ariko weho sinzoguherengeteza; mugabo nzoguhana ibigeze, sinzokureka ntaguhannye.
Ijambo ry’Uhoraho ryaje kuri Yeremiya ūvugishwa n’ Imana ku vy’Abafilisitiya, Farawo ataratera i Gaza.

Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Eh’ amazi azodudubiza avuye i burārūko ahinduke uruzi rudengereye, ruzodengera rurenge ku gihugu no ku birimwo vyose, rurenge ku gisagara no ku bakibamwo bose: abantu bazotaka, n’ ababa mu gihugu bose bazoboroga.
Bumvise kudida imigere kw’amafarasi yiwe ahambaye, n’ukugenda akabushungwe kw’ imikogote yiwe, n’uguhinda kw’ amakurudumu, bituma abavyeyi batanakebuka ngo barābe abana babo kubgo gucika inkokora;

kuk’ umusi ugira uze wo kuzonyagwako kw’Abafilisitiya bose, wo kuzorandura umutabazi wese azoba agisigaye muri Tiro n’i Sidoni: kuk’ Uhoraho azonyaga Abafilisitiya, n’amasigarira yo ku kizinga co mu kiyaga citwa Kafutori.
I Gaza hasigaye ar’ uruharabuga; Ashikeloni harakomvomvowe, bo n’amasigarira yo mu kiyaya caho: uzokwikebagura ushitse ryari?
Weho wa nkota y’Uhoraho, uzogeza ryari kutaruhuka? Enda ni wisubize mu rwubati rwawe, utekereze, ugume hamwe.
Yamara se woruhuka ute, kand’ Uhoraho ari we yagutumye? Yayigeze kurwanya Ashikeloni n’abo kw isēsero ry’ikiyaga.

Ku vya Mowabu. Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli: at’ I Nebo habonye ibara! Kuko hakomvomvowe: i Kiriyatayimu haratēterewe, haratsinzwe: i Misigabu haratēterewe, harasanganguwe.
Icubahiro c’i Mowabu kiraheze; bahahigiye imihigo bar’ i Heshiboni, bat’ Enda ni muze tuhageseze, ntihabe hakiba ihanga. Nawe Madumeni, uzozibizwa; inkota izogukurikirana.
Ijwi ry’amaborogo rituruka i Horonayimu: har’ ukunyaga n’ ugutikiza gukomeye.
I Mowabu haratikiye; abana baho bumvikanisha urwānāga.
Kuko bazodūga ku kadūgo k’i Luhiti barira ingenda badahengeshanya; ku kamanuko k’i Horonayimu bumvise umunihiro w’umuborogo w’ abagesezwa.
Muhunge, mwunzūre amagara, mube nk’agasaka k’inkōkōre mu bugaragwa.
Ko wishimiye ibikorwa vyawe n’ubutunzi bgawe, nawe nyene uzotsindwa: kand’ ikigirwamana Kemoshi kizojanwa ar’ inyagano, bo n’abaherezi baco n’abaganwa baco.
Kand’ umunyazi azoshika ku gisagara cose, nta gisagara na kimwe kizomukira: ababa mu mwonga bazohona, n’ababa mu kiyaya bazogesezwa, nk’uk’ Uhoraho yabivuze.
Muhe Mowabu amababa, kugira ngo haguruke hīgīre: ibisagara vyaho bizocika amatongo, ata wukiriho wo kuhaba.
Aravumwe uwanjanjwa ku gikorwa c’Uhoraho; aravumwe ūbuza inkota yiwe kuvisha amaraso.

Mowabu hamye hidibamiye uhereye mu buto bgaho, hireretse ku mvūzo, ntihāsukanuwe ngo have mu mubindi haje mu wundi, ntihājanywe kw inyagano; ni co gituma uburyohe bgaho bukiri muri ho, n’ubumote bgaho ntibutītūke.
Nuko rāba, imisi igira ize, ni k’Uhoraho agize, nzoharungikira abacuranguza, bazohacuranguza, barangūze imibindi yaho, bamenagure amakarabo yaho.
Abanyamowabu bazomāramāzwa na Kemoshi, nk’ ukw ab’ inzu ya Isirayeli bāmāramājwe n’ivy’ i Beteli bāri bishimiye.
Muvuga ngw iki ngo Mur’ abahizi, kandi ngo Mur’ intōre zo kuja mu ntambara?
Mowabu hacitse imisaka, badūze gutera ibisagara vyaho, kand’ imisore yaho y’intōre imanutse gukekagurwa, ni k’Umwami agize, yitwa Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo.
Ukugesezwa kw’i Mowabu kuri hafi gushika, ivyago vyaho bije akabushungwe.
Mwebge abahakikije mwese muharirire, namwe mwese abazi izina ryaho, muvuge, mut’ Es’ ukuntu ubuhiri bukomeye buvunitse, ya nkoni ishajije!
Yewe wa mukobga uba i Diboni, manuka uve mu cubahiro cawe, wicare ahagadutse; kuk’ umunyazi w’i Mowabu adūze kukurwanya, yasanganguye ibihome vyawe bikomeye.
Ewe uba i Aroweri, hagarara i ruhande y’ inzira, wirābire indore: baza umugabo ahunze n’umugore yiyunzūra, uti Bibaye bite?
Mowabu haratēterewe; kuko hasanganguwe; muboroge, murire; muvuge inkuru kuri Arunoni kw i Mowabu hageseye.
Iteka haciriweko rishitse mu ntāra yo hasi mu kiyaya, no kuri Holoni, no kuri Yahaza, no kuri Mefata,
no kuri Diboni, no kuri Nebo, no kuri Beti‐dibulatayimu,
no kuri Kiriyatayimu, no kuri Beti‐gamuli, no kuri Beti‐meyoni,
no kuri Keriyoti, no kuri Bosira, no ku bisagara vyose vyo mu gihugu c’i Mowabu, ibiri kure n’ibiri hafi.
Ihembe ry’i Mowabu rirakondowe, n’ukuboko kwaho kuravunitse, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Muhaboreze, kuko hinantaje k’ Uhoraho; nuko Mowabu hazokwivurunga mu bidashwe vyaho, hacike agatwengo.
None Isirayeli ntiwamugize agatwengo? Mbega yabonetsek’ ubusuma? Kuk’ uk’ umuvuga kwose uzunza umutwe.
Yemwe ababa i Mowabu, ni muve mu bisagara, muje kuba mu masenga; mube nk’ inuma yārika icāri cayo mu mbavu z’umuryango w’isenga.
Twumvise ivy’ ubgibone bg’i Mowabu, yuko hafise ubgibone bginshi; ivy’ ukwishira hejuru kwaho, n’ivy’ ubgibone bgaho, n’ivy’ amanyama yaho, n’ivy’ ukwigira hanini kwo mu mutima waho.
Nzi uburake bgaho, ni k’Uhoraho agize, yukw ata co bumaze; ukwihayagiza kwaho nta co kwakoze.
Ni co kizotuma mborogera Mowabu; mbere nzotakira i Mowabu hose: bazovugiriza amarūru abagabo b’i Kiri‐heresi.
Ewe ruzabibu rw’ i Sibuma, nzokuririra kurusha kurira kw’i Yazeri; amashami yawe aca hejuru y’ikiyaga, agashika no ku kiyaga c’i Yazeri: umunyazi afashe ku vyo weze no ku vyo wimbuweko vya vino.

Umunezero n’uguhimbarwa bikūweho, bikūwe mu ndimiro imera no mu gihugu c’i Mowabu; natumye vino ibura mu mato akanyirwamwo: nta wuzoganisha ibirenge n’akāmo k’umunezero: akāmo kazobaho kazoba ar’ ak’ intambara, ntikazoba ar’ ak’ umunezero.

Gutaka kw’i Heshiboni kwumvikana gushitsa n’i Eleyale; mber’ amajwi yabo ashika n’i Yahazi, kand’ ahēra i Sowari agashitsa n’i Horonayimu bo n’i Egilati‐shelishiya: kuko n’amazi y’i Nimurimu azocika iyondoyondo.
Ikigeretseko nzoherengeteza i Mowabu ūtangira ikimazi mu gitabo, n’uwosereza imibavu imana ziwe, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Ni co gitumye Mowabu umutima wanje uhacurira intimba mu mwironge, abagabo b’i Kiri‐heresi ubacurira intimba mu mwironge: kukw ivy’ ibitayega hāronse bihonnye.
Kukw imitwe yabo yose imowe inkomvorera, n’ ubganwa bgose bumowe; ku maboko yose har’ ibikebagure, no mu rukenyerero hose hakenyeye amagunira.
Hejuru ku nzu zose z’i Mowabu no mu nzira zaho, hose hose har’ amaborogo: kuko nasābije Mowabu nk’urujo rudashimwa, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Ewe kuntu hasābijwe! Ewe kuntu baboroga! Ewe kuntu ab’ i Mowabu baroye irya bomotse batēterewe! Uko ni ko Mowabu hazohinduka agatwengo n’akumiza ku bahakikije bose.
Kuk’ ukw ari k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Eh’ umwansi azoza aguruka nk’inkukuma, azosanza amababa i Mowabu.
I Keriyoti haratsinzwe, ibihome bineshejwe giturumbuka; kur’ uwo musi imitima y’abahizi b’i Mowabu izomera nk’umutima w’ umugore ari mu bise.
Kandi Mowabu hazogesezwa ngo ntihabe hakiba ihanga, kuko hinantaje k’Uhoraho.
Wewe uba i Mowabu, ibiteye ubgoba n’urusumanyenzi n’umutego bigushitseko, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Ūhunga ibiteye ubgoba azogwa mu rusumanyenzi; uwūrira ngw ave mu rusumanyenzi umutego uzomufata: kukw i Mowabu nzohashitsako umwaka wo kūzirwa kwabo, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Abāhunze basigaye ata nkomezi mu gitūtu c’i Heshiboni: arik’ umuriro uturutse i Heshiboni, urubeya ruturutse hagati y’i Sihoni, rutongoye impande z’i Mowabu, n’igitwariro c’abanyamuvurungano.
Ubonye ibara, Mowabu! Abantu ba Kemoshi baragowe! Kukw abahungu bawe bajanywe ar’ inyagano, n’abakobga bawe mu ngoyi.
Yamara nzotuma ab’i Mowabu bahindukira bave mu kinyago mu misi yo hanyuma, ni k’Uhoraho agize. Ivy’ iteka Mowabu haciriwe bigarukiye aho.
Ku vy’Abamoni. Uku ni k’ Uhoraho agize, ati Mbega Isirayeli nta bahungu afise? Nta samuragwa agira? None n’iki gituma ikigirwamana Malukamu ari co cegukiye Gadi, n’abantu baco baba mu bisagara vyaho?

None rero, ehe rāba imisi igira ize, ni k’Uhoraho agize, nzokwumvikanisha akarūru k’intambara i Raba h’Abamoni; kandi hazohinduka ibirundo vy’amasakamburira, n’ abakobga baho bazoyigizwa n’ umuriro: ni ho Isirayeli azokwiguranura, akegukira abāmwegukiye, ni k’Uhoraho agize.

Boroga, Heshiboni we, kuko Hayi hanyazwe; murire, mwa bakobga b’i Raba, mukenyere amagunira: mwivugirize amarūru, mwiruke mujarajare hirya no hino mu nzitiro; kuko Malukamu kizojanwa ar’ inyagano, bo n’abaherezi baco n’abaganwa baco.
N’iki gitumye wirata imyonga? Umwonga wawe uratwarwa, ewe mukobga usubiye inyuma, wishimiye ubutunzi bgawe, uti Ni nde azonshikīra?

Ehe nzogushitsakw ibiteye ubgoba, ni k’Umwami agize, ni we Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, biturutse mu bagukikije bose; muzokwirukanwa, umuntu wese atūmūke, kandi ntihazoboneka uwo gukoraniriza hamwe abazimiye.
Ariko hanyuma nzotuma Abamoni bahindukira bave mu kinyago, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Ku vya Edomu. Uku ni k’ Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ati Mbeg’ ubgenge nta bukiriho i Temani? Mbeg’ inama yabuze mu bahanga? Mbeg’ ubgenge bgabo bgakamanganye?
Muhunge, musubire inyuma, muje kuba ahigobetse, yemwe ababa i Dedani; kuko nzoshitsa ivyago kuri Esau, mu gihe nzomūzira.
Abamura inzabibu bogushikako, mbega hari n’uduhumbga tw’ inzabibu bogusigariza? Cank’ ibisuma vyogutahako mw ijoro ntivyokwoza uko bishaka?
Ni ko nanje Esau namusize amēnya, natwikuruye ahinyegeje hiwe ngo ntāshobore kwinyegeza: uruvyaro rwiwe n’abo bavukana n’ababanyi biwe barageseye, na we ubgiwe ntakiriho.
Siga abana bawe b’ impfuvyi, nzobazigama mbabesheho; abapfakazi bawe ni banyizigire.
Kuk’ ukw ari k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Abāri batabereye kunywa kur’ ico gikombe ko batazobura kukinywa, none weho uzogenda udahanwe na gatoya? Eka ntuzogenda udahanwe, arik’ uzonywa nta kabuza.
Kuko nirahiye ubganje, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, yukw i Bosira hazohinduka akajoreza n’igitutsi n’ ibitongozi n’ikivume; kand’ ibisagara vyaho vyose bizoba ibitongozi gushitsa ibihe bidashira.
Numvise inkuru zivuye k’ Uhoraho, kandi har’ intumwa itumwe ku mahanga, ngo Mwikoranye muhatere, muhaguruke muje mu ntambara.
Kuko rāba, nakugize ritoya ku yandi mahanga, n’inkēngērwa mu bantu.

Gutera ubgoba kwawe n’ubgibone bgo mu mutima wawe vyaraguhenze, wewe uba mu bihoro vyo mu bitandara, wihase ku mpinga y’ umusozi: naho wokwārika icāri cawe hejuru iyo bigwa nk’inkukuma, nzokumanura ngukūreyo, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Kandi Edomu hazohinduka akajoreza: ūzohaca wese azojorerwa, azovuza agahwa kubg’ ivyago vyaho vyose.
Nk’ukw i Sodomu n’i Gomora vyabaye, igihe hākomvomvorwa, bo n’ibisagara bihereranye na ho, ni kw ata muntu azobayo, canke ngo hagire umwana w’umuntu azoba akihaba, ni k’Uhoraho agize.

Eh’ azodūga nk’intambge ivuye kuri Yorodani iyo rwigize akagabo, ngw atere ahantu h’itsitsi hakomeye: ariko nzotuma ahahunga giturumbuka, kand’ uwo nzotoranya ni we nzoshinga ngw ahaganze: none ni nde ahwanye nanje? Kandi ni nde azonshingira igihe? Kandi ni nde mwungere yohangara guhagarara imbere yanje?
Nuko rero ni mwumve inama Uhoraho yarunduye kuri Edomu, n’imigabo yagabiye y’ivyo azogirira ababa i Temani: ati N’ukuri bazobakwega nk’imyagazi yo mu mukuku; n’ukuri azobagesezanya n’aho baba.
Isi ihindishwa agashitsi no kwumva ugusenyerana kwabo; amarūru yabo yumvikana gushitsa ku Kiyaga Gitukura.
Eh’ azodūga aguruke nk’inkukuma, asānze amababa i Bosira: kand’ umutima w’abahizi b’i Edomu kur’ uwo musi uzohinduka nk’umutima w’ umugore ari ku bise.
Ivy’ i Damasiko. I Hamati haratēterewe, bo n’i Arupadi; kuko humvise inkuru mbi, harashonga: ku kiyaga hahagaritse umutima, ntihashobora gutēkāna.
I Damasiko haradendebukiwe, harakimiranye ngo hiruke, hafashwe n’agatengo: uburibge n’ umubabaro vyahafashe nk’umugore aramutswe.
Mbega n’ iki catumye igisagara c’ishimwe kitāzigurijwe, ca gisagara cannezereza?
Ni co gitumye imisore yaho izohindikirana mu nzira zaho, n’abahizi bose bazozibizwa kur’ uwo musi, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo mbivuze.
Nzokwanda umuriro uruzitiro rw’i Damasiko, kand’ uzotongora ingoro za Beni‐hadadi.
Ivy’ i Kedari, n’ivy’ ibihugu vy’abami b’i Hazori, ivyo Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni yahavuye atsinda. Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, ati Ni muhaguruke mudūge i Kedari, munyage abantu b’i burasirazuba.
Bazonyaga amahema yabo n’ imikuku yabo, bazokwinyagira impuzu z’imikingo yabo n’ivy’ imbombovu vyabo vyose n’ingamiya zabo: kandi bazobabarira basemerera, bati Har’ ibiteye ubgoba irya n’ino.
Muhunge, mukwiragire kure, muje kuba ahigobetse, yemwe ababa i Hazori, ni k’Uhoraho agize; kuko Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni yabahigiye imihigo, yarunduye imigabo y’ivy’ azobagirira.
Ni muhaguruke mudūge, muje kw ihanga ryidibamiye, ryibereye aho ata co ryinona, ritagira imyugariro cank’ ibihindizo, ryibera aho ukwaryo, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Ingamiya zabo zizoba iminyago, n’isinzi ry’ibitungwa vyabo rizoba inyagano: kandi nzoshwiragiriza mu birēre vyose abīca amasoso; nzobazanakw ivyago biturutse impande zose, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Kand’ i Hazori hazoba i wabo w’imbgebge, n’ibitongozi vy’ibihe bidashira: nta muntu azobayo, cank’ umwana w’umuntu azoba akihaba.
Ijambo ry’Uhoraho ryaje kuri Yeremiya uwavugishwa na we, ku vya Elamu, igihe Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda yar’ agiye ku ngoma,
rit’ Uku ni k’ Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, at’ Ehe nzovuna umuheto w’i Elamu, ni wo binunu vy’ubuhizi bgaho.
Kandi nzohuruza kuri Elamu imiyaga ine iturutse ku mpande zine z’ijuru, mbashwiragirize mur’ ivyo birēre vyose; abirukanywe b’i Elamu nta hanga batazoshikamwo.

Nzotera Abelamu agatengo imbere y’abansi babo, n’imbere y’abarondera kubica: kandi nzobazanakw ivyago, ni vyo burake bganje bg’inkazi, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze; kandi nzorungika inkota ibakurikirane, gushitsa mbamaze.
Nzoshinga intebe yanje y’ubgami i Elamu, kandi nzohagesereza umwami n’ abaganwa baho, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Yamara mu misi yo hanyuma nzotuma Abelamu bahindukira bave mu kinyago, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Ijambo Uhoraho yavuze ku vy’i Babuloni, no ku vy’igihugu c’Abakaludaya, arivugishije Yeremiya.

Mubitāngāze mu mahanga, muvyamamaze, mushinge ibendera; muvyamamaze, ntimubihishe, mut’ I Babuloni haratsinzwe, ikigirwamana Beli kiratēterewe, Merodaki kiravunaguritse; ibishushanyo vyaho biratēterewe, ibigirwamana vyaho biravunaguritse.
Kukw i burārūko hazoturuka ihanga rije kuhatera, rizohindura igihugu caho amatongo, kandi nta wuzoba akihaba; abantu bo n’ibitungwa bizohunga bigende.
Kuko mur’ iyo misi no mur’ ico gihe, ni k’Uhoraho agize, Abisirayeli bazoza, bazananye n’ Abayuda; bazogenda barira ingenda, barondera Uhoraho Imana yabo.
Bazobaza ivy’ i Siyoni bahērekeje amaso, bat’ Enda ni muze mwifatanye n’Uhoraho musezerane isezerano ritazoshira ritazokwibagirana.
Abantu banje bābaye intama zizimiye; abungere babo bārabajimije, bābahubirije ku misozi: bāva ku musozi baja ku wundi, bibagiye uburuhukiro bgabo.
Abābabonye bose bāgiye babatsontsomera; abarwanizi babo bāvuze, bati Nta caha dukoze, kuko bācumuye k’Uhoraho, ari we i wabo w’ubugororotsi, k’Uhoraho, ari we vyizigiro vya ba sekuruza.
Muhunge muve hagati y’i Babuloni, muve mu gihugu c’ Abakaludaya, mube ba kizigenza nk’impfizi z’impene mu mukuku.

Kuko rāba, nzoyagamvya ikoraniro ry’amahanga ahambaye aturutse i burārūko, ngw adūge atere i Babuloni: kandi bazotonda urugamba kuharwanya; bazohatsinda bahereye kur’ urwo ruhande: imyampi yabo izoba nk’iy’ umuhizi w’umuhanga: nta wuzogwa hasi.
I Bukaludaya hazohinduka isahu: abahasahura bose bazohāga, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Kuko vyabanezereye, bikabahimbara, mwebge abanyaga ishamvu yanje; kuko mwikirigita nk’inka y’iriza yo mu magarama, mukaroherana nk’amafarasi y’inkomezi;
nuko rero nyoko azogira ibitētērwa vyinshi, uwabavyaye azomāramāra: rāba, azosigara ar’ uw’ inyuma y’ayandi mahanga, abe ubugaragwa, igihugu kigadutse, n’ubgeranyange.
Kubg’ uburake bg’ Uhoraho ntihazosubira kugerērwa, ariko hazohebga rwose: umuntu wese azohita kuri Babuloni azojorerwa, azovuza agahwa kubg’ ivyago vyaho vyose.
Mwebge mwese abarashi, mutondere urugamba Babuloni irya n’ino; muharase, ntimuzigurize imyampi: kuko hācumuye k’Uhoraho.
Muhīrahire mur’ irya n’ino; hazokoma amashi, ibihome bihakingiye bizotemba, inzitiro zaho zisangangurwe: kukw ar’ uguhōra kw’ Uhoraho; namwe muhīhōre; nk’ uko hakoze abe ari ko muhasubiriza mu nkōko.
Murandure i Babuloni umubivyi, bo n’ūtemesha umuhoro mu gihe c’iyimbura. Kubgo gutinya inkota iririka, bazohunga, umuntu wese asubire mu bgoko bgabo, umuntu wese asubire mu gihugu cabo.
Abisirayeli n’intama zisābagiye; intambge zarabasanzaje: umwami w’i Ashuri ni we yabanje kubarotsa, ubuheruka Nebukadineza uyo, umwami w’i Babuloni, yabajanjaguye amagufa.
Nuko rero, uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, ati Rāba nzohana umwami w’i Babuloni n’igihugu ciwe, nk’uko nahannye umwami w’i Ashuri.
Kandi nzogarukana Abisirayeli mu canya cabo, na bo bazorīsha i Karumeli n’i Bashani, bafore amabondo bari ku misozi y’i Efurayimu n’i Gileyadi.
Mur’ iyo misi no mur’ ico gihe, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, ibigabitanyo vy’Abisirayeli bizoronderwa, bibure; n’ivyaha vy’Abayuda na vyo ntibizoboneka: kuko nzoharira abo nashigaje kuba amasigarira.
Dūga utere igihugu c’i Meratayimu, uhatere, utere n’ababa i Pekodi: ubakurikirane, ubice, ubatotore rwose, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, ubagirire nk’ivyo nkubariye vyose.
Akarūru k’ intambara kari mu gihugu, bo n’ ak’ ukugeseza gukomeye.
Ewe kuntu ya nyundo yar’ igeramiye isi yose ivunitse, imenaguritse! Ewe kuntu i Babuloni hahindutse ibitongozi hagati mu mahanga!
Naguteze umutego, nawe uca urafatwa ata co winona, ewe Babuloni: wararushe uraboneka, utak’ urafatwa, kuko warwanije Uhoraho.
Uhoraho yuguruye ububīko bg’ibirwanishwa vyiwe, asohoye ibirwanishwa vy’ubushangashirwe bgiwe: kuk’ Umwami, ari we Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, afise igikorwa co gukora mu gihugu c’ Abakaludaya.
Ni muze muhatere, muturutse impande zose, mwugurure ibigega vyaho: muhace nk’ibirundo vy’amasakamburira, muhatotore rwose, ntihagire ikihasigara.
Ni mwice amakombe yaho yose; n’amanuke aje kubāgwa. Babonye ibara! Kuk’ umusi wabo washitse, ni wo gihe co kūzirwa kwabo.
Ni mwumve ingene bahunga, bacika bava mu gihugu c’i Babuloni, ngo bamamaze i Siyoni uguhōra kw’Uhoraho Imana yacu, uguhōra yahōye urusengero rwiwe!

Ni muhamagare abarashi bakoranire kurwanya Babuloni, abazi gufora imiheto bose; musagaze hirya no hino yaho; ntihagire uwaho acika: muhīhōre ibikwiranye n’ibikorwa vyaho, muhasubirize mu nkōko ibikwiranye n’ivyo hākoze; kuko hinantaje k’Uhoraho, k’Uwera w’ Abisirayeli.
Ni co gitumye imisore yaho izohindikirana mu nzira zaho, n’abahizi bose bazozibizwa kur’ uwo musi, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Ehe tuzohigūra twe nawe, wa munyabgibone we, ni jewe Umwami Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo mbivuze; kuk’ umusi wawe ushitse, ni wo gihe nkūziye.
Umunyabgibone azotsitara atembe, ntihagire ūmuvyutsa: kandi nzokwanda umuriro ibisagara vyiwe, uzotongora abamukikije bose.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, at’ Abisirayeli n’Abayuda bāhaharijwe hamwe; ababajanye kw inyagano bārabagumije, banse kubarekura.
Arik’ Umucunguzi wabo arakomeye: Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo ni ryo zina ryiwe; azobītsa mu manza zabo, kugira ngw ahe isi kuruhuka, arikw atere ababa i Babuloni imitima ihagaze.
Inkota iri ku Bakaludaya, ni k’Uhoraho agize, no ku baba i Babuloni, no ku baganwa baho, no ku banyabgenge baho.
Inkota iri ku birata, kandi bazoyinga; inkota iri ku bahizi baho, kandi bazoranduka imitima.
Inkota iri ku mafarasi yabo, no ku mikogote yabo, no ku b’ikivange c’amoko bari hagati muri ho, kandi bazohinduka nk’ abagore; inkota iri ku butunzi bgaho, kandi bazobunyagwa.
Ikigatwa kizoba ku mazi yaho, kand’ azogaduka; kukw ar’ igihugu c’ibishushanyo bibājwe, bāciwe ntema n’ibigirwamana.

Ni co kizotuma ibikōko vyo mu bugaragwa bizobanayo n’amabingira, n’ibisīga vyitwa imbuni na vyo bizohaba: ntihazosubira kugerērwa gushitsa ibihe vyose, kandi nta wuzoba akihaba uk’ urunganwe rwabo ruzogenda rukurikirana.
Nk’uko vyabaye hamwe Imana yakomvomvora i Sodomu n’i Gomora, bo n’ibisagara bihereranye na ho, ni kw ata muntu azobayo, canke ngo hagire umwana w’umuntu azoba akihaba, ni k’Uhoraho agize.
Eh’ ubgoko buraje buvuye i burārūko; ihanga rikomeye n’ abami benshi bazovyutswa bave ku mpera y’isi.

Bābiriye imiheto n’amacumu; ni ba ruburakigongwe, nta mbabazi bagira; ijwi ryabo ribomborana nk’ikiyaga, kandi bagendera ku mafarasi; bāzira mu rugamba icarimwe, nk’ umuntu umwe, kugira ngo bagutere, ewe mukobga Babuloni.
Umwami w’i Babuloni yumvise inkuru zavyo, amaboko yiwe arareganuka: uburibge buramufashe, nk’ibise vy’umugore aramutswe.

Eh’ azodūga nk’intambge ivuye kuri Yorodani iyo rwigize akagabo, ngw atere ahantu h’itsitsi hakomeye: ariko nzotuma bahunga bahave giturumbuka, kand’ uwo nzotoranya ni we nzoshinga ngw ahaganze: none ni nde ahwanye nanje? Kandi ni nde azonshingira igihe? Kandi ni nde mwungere yohangara guhagarara imbere yanje?

Nuko rero ni mwumve inama Uhoraho yarunduye kuri Babuloni, n’imigabo yagabiye y’ ivyo azogirira igihugu c’Abakaludaya: ati N’ukuri bazobakwega nk’imyagazi yo mu mukuku; n’ ukuri azobagesezanya n’aho baba.
Isi ihindishwa agashitsi no kwumva gutsindwa kw’i Babuloni: amarūru yaho yumvikana mu mahanga.
Uku ni k’Uhoraho agize, at’ Ehe nzovyutsa igihuhuta c’umuyaga kigeseza, ngitēze i Babuloni n’ababa i Lebu‐kamayi.
Kandi nzorungika i Babuloni abagosozi bazohagosora, kand’ igihugu caho bazogicacura, gisēswe: kuko ku musi w’ivyago bazohakikiza impande zose.
Umurashi ntaz’ aruhe afora umuheto wiwe, n’uwambaye ivyuma bimukīngira ntaz’ aruhe yirwanira. Ntimuzigurize imisore yaho; mutotore rwose ingabo zaho zose.
Bazokwicwa bahindikirane aho nyene i Bukaludaya, batobekeranirizwe mu nzira zaho.
Kukw Abisirayeli atar’ intābga, cank’ Abayuda, ku Mana yabo, ni we Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo, nah’ igihugu cabo cuzuye ivyo bācumuye k’Uwera w’Abisirayeli.
Ni muhunge muve hagati muri Babuloni, umuntu wese yunzūre amagara yiwe; ntimuranduranwe na ho, muzira ibigabitanyo vyaho, kukw ar’ igihe c’uguhōra kw’Uhoraho, agira ahasubirize mu nkōko.
Babuloni cār’ igikombe c’izahabu mu kuboko kw’Uhoraho, cāboreje isi yose: amahanga yanyoye kuri vino yaco, ni co catumye azimira ubgenge.
I Babuloni harakomvomvowe giturumbuka, harageseye: muhaborogere; mwābīre umuti wo kuvūra uburibge bgaho, namba kumbure hokira.
Twagerageje kuvūra Babuloni, ariko ntihakize: reka tuhahebe, umuntu wese ni yisubirire mu gihugu cabo: kukw iteka haciriweko rishitse no kw ijuru, rigiye hejuru gushitsa no mu bicu.
Uhoraho yerekanye ukugororoka kwacu; enda ni muze twamamaze i Siyoni igikorwa c’Uhoraho Imana yacu.
Mukarishe imyampi, mubangirize inkinzo: Uhoraho yagayambije imitima y’abami b’Abamedi; kukw imigabo yagīriye i Babuloni n’ukuhageseza: kukw ar’ uguhōra kw’Uhoraho, uguhōra yahōye urusengero rwiwe.
Mushinge ibendera mwerekeye inzitiro z’i Babuloni, mugwize abashibamyi, mushireh’ abateramyi, mugere abaja kuhaca ibico: kuk’ Uhoraho yahagīriye imigabo, agashitsa ivyo yavuze ku baba i Babuloni.
Ewe uba ku materaniro y’amazi menshi, ukaba mu bihinda vy’ubutunzi, umuhero wawe urashitse, ipfa ryo kudahāga kwawe riraherewe.
Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo yirahiye ubgiwe, ati N’ukuri i wawe nzohuzuza abansi bagutere nk’inzige: bazokureremesherezakw akarūru.
Rurema ni yo yaremesheje isi ubushobozi bgayo, ikayihamangirisha ubgenge bgayo, ikagaranzuza ijuru ukumenya kwayo:
iy’ ishize ijwi hejuru haba gusūma kw’ amazi yo hejuru; irandisha ibipfungu bikava ku mpera y’isi; iremera imvura imiravyo, kand’ isokorora umuyaga mu bubīko bgayo.

Non’ umuntu wese kw ar’ ikiyingiyingi ata bgenge agira! Umucuzi w’izahabu wese azotēterezwa n’igishushanyo ciwe yasaruye, kukw igishushanyo ciwe yavugutiye mu nkero ar’ ic’ ibinyoma, kandi nta mpwemu ziba muri vyo.
N’ivy’ ubusa gusa, n’igikorwa c’uruhendo; igihe cabo co kūzirwa bizoherengetezwa.
Arik’ umugabane wa Yakobo we si kw ameze, kukw ari we Muremyi wa vyose; kandi Isirayeli ni we muryango yagize ishamvu yiwe: Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo ni ryo zina ryiwe.
Ni wewe nyundo yanje, n’ ibirwanishwa vyanje: ni wewe nzomenaguza amahanga; ni wewe nzogeseresha abami b’ibihugu;
ni wewe nzomenaguza ifarasi n’ūyigenderako;
ni wewe nzomenaguza umukogote n’ūwugenderamwo; ni wewe nzomenaguza umugabo n’umugore; ni wewe nzomenaguza umutāma n’umusore; ni wewe nzomenaguza umuhungu n’umukobga;
ni wewe nzomenaguza umwungere n’umukuku wiwe; ni wewe nzomenaguza umurimyi n’inka arimisha; ni wewe nzomenaguza abagabisha n’abaganza.
Kand’ ab’ i Babuloni, bo n’ababa i Bukaludaya bose, nzobasubiriza mu nkōko ibibi vyabo vyose bākoreye i Siyoni mubona, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Ehe tuzohigūra twe nawe, wa musozi ugeseza we, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, wagesheje isi yose: nzokubangurirak’ ukuboko kwanje, ngucuranguze ngukūre ku rutare, nguhindure umusozi uhiye inkomvorera.
Ntibazoba bakigukūrako n’ibuye ryo kugumya imfuruka, cank’ ibuye ry’itanguriro; arik’ uzoba ibitongozi gushitsa ibihe bidashira, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.

Mushinge ibendera mu gihugu, muvuze inzamba zitabaza mu mahanga, mwiteguze amahanga arwane na ho, mukoranirize hamwe abami b’i Ararati n’i Mini n’i Ashikenazi kuharwanya; mushinge umugabisha wo kuhagomorera; mudūze amafarasi nk’inzige zishinze urwoya.
Mwiteguze amahanga kurwana na ho, bo n’abami b’i Bumedi, n’abagabisha baho, n’ abaganza baho bose, n’ibihugu vyose biganzwa na ho.
Isi ihinze agashitsi, irasambagirika: kukw imigabo Uhoraho yagīriye i Babuloni igihamye, ngw ahindure igihugu c’i Babuloni ibitongozi, ata wukihaba.
Abahizi b’i Babuloni bahevye kurwana, bigungiye mu bihome vyabo, ubutōre bgabo buraheze, bacitse bga bagore: amazu yaho yanzwe umuriro; ibihindizo vyaho biravunaguritse.
Intabaza imwe izohūra n’iyindi, n’intumwa imwe ihūre n’iyindi, ngo bamenyeshe umwami w’i Babuloni yukw igisagara ciwe gitsinzwe impande zose:
kandi ko bazitiye ivyambu giturumbuka, baturiye n’ urufunzo, kandi kw abahizi bacitse ivutu.
Kuk’ ukw ari k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, ni we Mana y’Abisirayeli, at’ Umukobga ari we Babuloni ameze nk’imbuga iy’ ikubita rigeze; hasigaye igihe gito igihe co kwimburwa kikahashikako.
Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni yaramfyonderanije, arandotsa, angira urwavya rusigaye ubusa, yaranyongobeje nk’igisato c’amahēro, yagemereje inda yiwe ivyar’ ivyiza vyanje; yaranyirukanye.
Ivyo nagiriwe nabi bikaba no ku mubiri wanje ni bisubire kuri Babuloni, ni k’ ūzoba ar’ i Siyoni azovuga; amaraso yanje arakora ababa i Bukaludaya, ni ko Yerusalemu hazovuga.
None rero, uku ni k’ Uhoraho agize, at’ Ehe nzokwitsa mu manza zawe, ndaguhōre; nzokamya ikiyaga caho, n’isōko yaho nzoyimīmūra.
Kand’ i Babuloni hazocika ibirundo vy’amasakamburira, n’i wabo w’imbgebge, n’akajoreza, n’ico kuvuzwakw agahwa, ata wukihaba.
Bazokwivuga nk’imigunza y’intambge bose icarimwe, bagwangware nk’ ivyana vy’intambge.
Bamaze kuborerwa nzobategurira amazimano, kandi nzobaboreza kugira ngo banezerwe, basinzire itiro ry’intashira, batazokwikangura ukundi, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Nzobamanukana nk’ imyagazi y’intama ija kubāgwa, nk’amapfizi y’intama n’ay’ impene.
Ewe kuntu i Sheshaki hatsinzwe! Ahār’ ibihimbaro vy’isi yose ukuntu hazirimukiwe! Ewe kuntu i Babuloni hahindutse ibitongozi hagati mu yandi mahanga!
Ikiyaga kiradūze kīziye i Babuloni: harengewe n’isinzi ry’ imipfunda yaco.
Ibisagara vyaho bihindutse ibitongozi, igihugu cumye c’ubugaragwa, igihugu ata muntu akikibamwo, ata n’umuntu akigihitamwo.
Kandi nzohanira ca kigirwamana Beli i Babuloni, nzokijiginyura mu menyo ivyo catsontsomeye; kand’ amahanga ntazosubira gusendanisha aja kuri co: mber’ uruzitiro rw’i Babuloni ruzotemba.
Yemwe bantu banje, ni muve hagati muri ho, mwikize mwese uburake bganje bg’inkazi, jewe Uhoraho.

Imitima yanyu ntidendebukirwe, ntimuterwe ubgoba n’impuha zumvikana mu gihugu; kukw impuha zizoza mu mwaka umwe, maze mu wundi mwaka hakaza izindi, umuryano ukaba mu gihugu, abaganza bakarwanya abandi.
Nuko rero, rāba imisi igira ize, nzohana ibishushanyo bibājwe vy’i Babuloni, igihugu caho cose kizotētērwa; abishwe baho bose bazohindikirana hagati muri ho.
Ni ho ijuru n’isi n’ibirimwo vyose bizoririmbishwa n’umunezero wo kwitamba kuri Babuloni; kukw abanyazi bazohāzira bavuye i burārūko, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Nk’uko Babuloni hāhindikiranije abishwe b’Abisirayeli, ni kw i Babuloni hazohindikirana abishwe b’igihugu caho.
Yemwe abakize inkota, mugende, ntimuhagarare; munyibuke, jewe Uhoraho, mukiri kure, i Yerusalemu hagaruke mu mitima yanyu.
Turatēterewe, kuko twumvise ibitutsi; mu maso hacu haje ibimāramāre: kukw abanyamahanga binjiye mu myanya yera yo mu ngoro y’Uhoraho.
Nuko rero, rāba imisi igira ize, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze, nzohana ibishushanyo bibājwe vyaho; kandi mu gihugu caho cose abakomeretse bazocura umuniho.
Naho Babuloni hodūga hagashika kw ijuru, kandi nah’ ibihome vyaho birebire vyoba uruhatane, na ho nyene abanyazi bohashika bavuye kuri jewe, ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Ijwi ry’amarūru riturutse i Babuloni, n’iry’ ukugesera gukomeye riturutse mu gihugu c’Abakaludaya!
Kuk’ Uhoraho ahoneje i Babuloni, ajibije amajwi yaho ahūrīra; kukw imipfunda y’abanyazi ibomborana nk’amazi menshi, urwamo rw’ijwi ryabo rwumvikana;
mber’ abanyazi barahashitse, bashitse i Babuloni nyene, abahizi baho barafashwe, imiheto yabo iravunaguritse. Kuk’ Uhoraho ar’ Imana yīhōra, ntazobura kwīhōra.

Kandi nzoboreza abaganwa baho n’abanyabgenge baho, bo n’abagabisha baho, n’abahaganza n’abahizi baho; bazosinzira itiro ry’intashira, ntibikangure ukundi, ni jewe Umwami mbivuze, izina ryanje nd’ Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo.

Uku ni k’Uhoraho Nyen’ ingabo agize, at’ Inzitiro zagutse z’i Babuloni zizosangangurwa rwose, n’amarembo yaho maremare atongozwe umuriro; kand’ amahanga azoba yar’ atamijwe n’ubusa, n’amoko azoba yar’ aruhijwe n’ibizoja mu muriro.

Ivyo uwavugishwa n’Imana Yeremiya yageze Seraya mwene Neriya, Neriya wa Mahaseya, igihe yajana na Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda, aja i Babuloni, mu mwaka ugira kane wo kuba ku ngoma kwiwe. Kandi Seraya yar’ umukuru w’abagaranzurira umwami.
Nuko Yeremiya yari yanditse mu gitabo ivyago vyose bizotera i Babuloni, ni vyo ayo majambo yose yanditswe avuga ivya Babuloni.
Maze Yeremiya abarira Seraya, ati Ni washika i Babuloni, ntubure gusoma aya majambo yose,
kand’ ut’ Ewe Uhoraho, wavuze ku vy’aha hantu k’uzohahonnya, ngo ntihaze hagire ūzoba akihaba, ar’ umuntu cank’ igitungwa, ariko ko hazoba ibitongozi gushitsa ibihe bidashira.
Urangije rero gusoma iki gitabo, uz’ uheze ugihambirane n’ibuye, ugiterere hagati mu ruzi Efurate:
kand’ uz’ uvuge, ut’ Uku ni ko Babuloni hazodobera, ntihasubire kwiburuka ukundi, kubg’ ivyago Uhoraho azohatēza: kandi bazoba badendebukiwe. Amajambo ya Yeremiya agarukiye aho.
Zedekiya yagiye ku ngoma amaze imyaka mirongwibiri n’umwe; ayimarakw imyaka cumi n’umwe i Yerusalemu. Nyina yitwa Hamutali, umukobga wa Yeremiya w’i Libuna.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona kw ari bibi, nk’ivyo Yehoyakimu yakoze vyose.
Kukw ivyabaye i Yerusalemu n’i Buyuda vyavuye ku burake bg’Uhoraho, gushitsa ah’ amaramarije kubirukana imbere yiwe. Hanyuma Zedekiya agarariza umwami w’i Babuloni.

Mu mwaka ugira icenda Zedekiya ari ku ngoma, mu kwezi kw’icumi, ku musi wakwo ugira icumi nyene, Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni araza, bo n’ingabo ziwe zose, batera Yerusalemu, basagaza inyuma yaho; bubaka n’ ibihome vyo kuhatera hirya no hino.
Nuko bakomeza kwugariza ico gisagara gushitsa ku mwaka ugira icumi na rimwe umwami Zedekiya ari ku ngoma.
Mu kwezi kwa kane, ku musi wakwo ugira icenda, inzara yar’ imaze guhūma mur’ ico gisagara, bituma abantu b’abanyagihugu babura ico barya.

Abakaludaya baraheza basatura uruzitiro rw’ ico gisagara; maz’ ingabo zose zirahunga, zihenga mw ijoro ziva mu gisagara, ziciye mu kirimba kiri hagati y’inzitiro zibiri cari hafi y’indimiro y’umwami; kand’ Abakaludaya bāri bakikije igisagara impande zose; nuko zijana inzira ica mu kiyaya Araba.
Maz’ ingabo z’Abakaludaya zōma inyuma y’umwami Zedekiya, zimuhambiriza mu kiyaya c’i Yeriko: ingabo ziwe zirasābagira ziramuta.
Maze bafata umwami, baramudūgana, bamuzanira umwami w’i Babuloni bamumusanza i Ribula, mu ntāra y’i Hamati: amucirakw iteka.
Nuk’ umwami w’i Babuloni yicira abahungu ba Zedekiya imbere y’amaso yiwe nyene; yicira n’ abaganwa bose b’i Buyuda i Ribula.
Anogora amaso Zedekiya; maz’ uwo mwami w’i Babuloni amwambika umunyororo, amujana i Babuloni, amushira mw ibohero, arinda ashitsa umusi yapfiriye.

Maze mu kwezi kwa gatanu, ku musi wakwo ugira icumi, mur’ uwo mwaka ugira icumi n’icenda umwami Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babuloni ari ku ngoma, Nebuzaradani umukuru w’abashibamyi, yahora ahagarara imbere y’umwami w’i Babuloni, yinjira i Yerusalemu.
Araheza yanda umuriro ingoro y’Uhoraho n’ingoro y’ umwami, n’amazu yose y’i Yerusalemu, mber’ amazu yose y’ abahambaye ayatongoza umuriro.
Maz’ ingabo zose z’Abakaludaya zari kumwe n’uwo mukuru w’abashibamyi, zisangangura inzitiro zose z’i Yerusalemu impande zose.

Maze Nebuzaradani, uwo mukuru w’abashibamyi, ajana bamwe bo muri ba nyarucari ar’ inyagano, bo n’amasigarira y’ abantu bāri bagisigaye mur’ ico gisagara, n’abāri baragiye kwisaba umwami w’i Babuloni, n’amasigarira y’abafundi.
Ariko Nebuzaradani, uwo mukuru w’abashibamyi, asiga abandi bo muri ba nyarucari bo mur’ ico gihugu ngo batunganye imizabibu, barime.

Kand’ inkingi z’imiringa zari mu ngoro y’Uhoraho, n’ibitereko, na ca gikarabiro citwa ikiyaga cācuzwe mu miringa cāri mu ngoro y’Uhoraho, Abakaludaya barabijanjagura, bajana bino bimeneke vyose vy’imiringa i Babuloni.
Bajana n’imibindi, n’ ivyuma biyōra umunyota, n’imakasi, n’inzavya, n’udukombe, n’ ibintu vyacuzwe mu miringa vyose bākoresha mu vyo guhēreza;
kandi n’ibikombe, n’ivyotero, n’inzavya, n’imibindi, n’ibiterekwakw amatara, n’udukombe, n’ ubgavya, uwo mukuru w’abashibamyi arabijana, ivyacuzwe mw izahabu ukwavyo, n’ivyacuzwe mw ifeza ukwavyo.

Ku vya za nkingi zompi, na ca kiyaga, na vya bishushanyo vy’amapfizi cumi n’ abiri bicuzwe mu miringa vyari biteretsweko ca kiyaga, na vya bitereko, ivyo umwami Salomo yari yaracurishirije ingoro y’Uhoraho: imiringa ivyo bintu vyose vyacuzwemwo ntiyagira akagero.

Ku vy’inkingi, inkingi imweimwe uburebure bgayo bgar’ amatambge cumi n’umunani y’ ukuboko uciriye mu nkokora; ubunini bgo mu nda yayo bgagerwa n’umugozi w’amatambge cumi n’abiri; intimba yayo yagerwa n’intoke zine: imbere yar’ umuheha.

Yarik’ umwashi w’umuringa; uburebure bg’umwashi umwe‐umwe bgar’ amatambge atanu, kandi ku mwashi hārikw ibimeze nk’urusenga n’ibimeze nk’ amakomamanga impande zose, vyose vyācuzwe mu miringa: kandi n’inkingi ya kabiri yarikw ibisa n’ivyo, bo n’amakomamanga.
Ibisa n’amakomamanga vyari mirongwicenda na bitandatu ku mpande zine; amakomamanga yose na yose yar’ ijana kur’ urwo rusenga hirya no hino.
Nuko wa mukuru w’abashibamyi afata Seraya umuherezi mukuru, na Zefaniya umuherezi wa kabiri, n’abashibama ku rugi ukw ari batatu:

kandi mu gisagara ahafatira uwaganza ivy’ abahizi b’ intambara, n’abashingantahe ndwi b’abanyejambo b’umwami, abo yasanze mu gisagara; n’umukarani w’umugabisha w’ingabo yakoranya ingabo zo mur’ ico gihugu; afata n’abagabo mirongwitandatu bo mu banyagihugu yasanze hagati mur’ ico gisagara nyene.
Maze Nebuzaradani, wa mukuru w’abashibamyi, arabajana, abasanza umwami w’i Babuloni i Ribula.
Umwami w’i Babuloni arabazibagura, abatsinda ngaho nyene i Ribula, mu ntāra y’i Hamati. Uko ni kw Abayuda bajanywe kw inyagano, bakūrwa mu gihugu cabo.
Aba ni bo bantu Nebukadineza yajanye ar’ inyagano: mu mwaka w’indwi yajanye Abayuda ibihumbi bitatu na mirongwibiri na batatu;
mu mwaka ugira icumi n’umunani Nebukadineza ari ku ngoma, yajanye ab’ inyagano amajana munani na mirongwitatu na babiri, abakūye i Yerusalemu;

mu mwaka ugira mirongwibiri na gatatu Nebukadineza ari ku ngoma, Nebuzaradani umukuru w’ abashibamyi yajanye ab’ inyagano b’Abayuda abantu amajana ndwi na mirongwine na batanu: abantu bose na bose bār’ ibihumbi bine n’amajana atandatu.

Maze mu mwaka ugira mirongwitatu n’indwi Yehoyakina umwami w’i Buyuda ari mu mugozi, mu kwezi kw’icumi na kabiri, ku musi wakwo wa mirongwibiri na gatanu, Evili‐merodaki umwami w’i Babuloni abohora Yehoyakina umwami w’i Buyuda, amukūra mw ibohero: hāri mu mwaka yimyemwo.
Amuyāgīsha neza, yubahiriza intebe yiwe kuyirutisha iz’ abandi bami bāri kuri we i Babuloni.
Amunyuranurira impuzu zo mw ibohero amwambika izindi, amuha kwama asangira na we na ntaryo, imisi yose yamaze akiriho.
Kandi ku bimutunga, agererwa ivyo kumutunga n’umwami w’i Babuloni vy’intasība, ingaburo y’uko bukeye imisi yose yamaze akiriho, gushitsa ku musi yapfiriye.
Ewe kuntu igisagara cari cuzuye abantu gisigaye cicaye ubusa! Ukuntu cahindutse nk’umupfakazi! Icar’ agakomeye mu mahanga, kikaba umwamikazi mu ntāra, Ukuntu gisigaye gishikanira abandi!
Kirāra kirarira mw ijoro, amosozi agacunduguta ku matama; Mu bakunzi baho bose ntihafise uwo kuhirura: Abagenzi baho bose bāraharyarutse, Bahindutse abansi baho.
Abayuda bajanywe ar’ inyagano, bitewe n’agahahazo no kuja mu buja bukomeye; Baba mu banyamahanga, ntibahabona uburuhukiro: Ababadendereza bose bābahambirije ahantu h’inkōnywa.
Inzira z’i Siyoni ziraboroga, kukw ata wukiruha aza mu misi mikuru yashinzwe; Amarembo yaho yose arasivye, abaherezi baho baraniha: Inkumi zaho zifise umubabaro, na ho ubgaho hari n’ intuntu.
Abarwanizi baho bahagiye hejuru, abansi baho bararoraniwe; Kuk’ Uhoraho yahababaje ahahōye ibicumuro vyaho vy’isinzi: Abana baho bashorewe ar’ inyagano imbere y’abarwanizi.
Icubahiro cose c’umukobga ari we Siyoni camuvuyeko: Abaganwa baho bahindutse nk’impongo zibuze ubgatsi, Bānyavūse batagifise intege imbere y’ababirukana.

Mu gihe c’umubabaro waho n’ivyago, Yerusalemu hibutse Ibihimbaro vyaho vyose hāhoranye uhereye kuva kera. Hamwe abantu baho bākorokeye mu maboko y’umurwanizi, ntihabone ūhatabara, Abarwanizi bārahabona, bakahatwengera mw ijigo ko habaye imisaka.
Yerusalemu hakoze ivyaha birengereje; ni co catumye hahinduka nk’ikintu giteye iseseme: Abāhora bahubaha bose basigaye bahakēngēra, kuko babonye ubgambure bgaho: N’ukuri haraniha, hakarora irya.

Ibiteye isoni vyaho vyashitse no ku myambaro yaho; ntihāri hārībajije ivy’ amaherezo yaho; Ni co catumye hacishwa bugufi bitangaje; ntihagira ūhahūmuriza. Uhoraho we, itegereze umubabaro wanje; kuk’ umwansi yishize hejuru.
Umurwanizi yashingirije ukuboko kwiwe ibintu vyaho vyose bihimbara: Kandi hitegereje ingen’ abanyamahanga binjiye ahantu haho hēra, Abo wari warahakaniye ko badakwiye kwinjira mw ikoraniro ryawe.
Abantu baho bose baraniha, bayerera utwo kurya; Ibintu vyabo vyābahimbara bābitanze ku two kurya ngo basame amagara yabo: Uhoraho we, rāba witegereze: nahindutse ikigawa.
Yemwe mwese abīhitira, mbega nta co murushe muvyibazako? Enda ni mwitegereze, murābe ko hoba umubabaro uhwanye n’uyu wanje wanshitseko, Uwo Uhoraho yambabarishije ku musi w’uburake bgiwe bg’inkazi.
Yarungitse umuriro mu magufa yanje uvuye iyo hejuru, urayayigiza: Yateze ibirenge vyanje umutego, ansubiza inyuma; Yangize inkōkōre, anca intege umusi urīra.
Ukuboko kwiwe kwamboheyekw ingōgo y’ibicumuro vyanje; Vyarasobekeranye, binshika mw izosi; yacobogoje inkomezi zanje: Umwami Imana yangabuye mu maboko y’abo ntashoboye kurindana na bo.

Umwami Imana yatītūye abahizi banje bose bāba i wanje; Yarungitse abaza kungirirak’ umusi mukuru ngo bafyonyagure imisore yanje: Umwami Imana yahonyanze umukobga w’inkumi w’i Buyuda, nk’ūganira vino mu bgato.
Ivyo ni vyo bindiza; amaso yanje, amaso yanje yisuka amosozi; Kuk’ uwompūmurije akandemesha umutima ambaye kure: Abana banje barapfapfanye, kuk’ umwansi yanyigamvye.
Siyoni hata amaboko, ntihabona uwohahūmuriza; Uhoraho yashinze ivya Yakobo, kw abamukikije bose bamubera abarwanizi: Yerusalemu habamereye nk’ ikintu giteye iseseme hagati muri bo.
Uhoraho aragororotse, ariko jeho nagararije ivyagezwe vyiwe: Ni mwumve ndabinginze, mwebge mwa mahanga yose, mwitegereze umubabaro wanje: Abakobga banje n’abahungu banje bagiye ar’ inyagano.
Natabaje abūzure banje, ariko barampemukira: Abaherezi banje n’abashingantahe banje bahwerereye mu gisagara, Bakiriko barayerera utwo kurya two gusama amagara yabo.
Uhoraho we, ni witegereze, kuko ndi mu magorwa; amara yanje aradobangana; Umutima wanje urandida mu nda; kuko nagararije birengereje: Hanze inkota iraririka, no mu nzu na ho har’ urupfu.
Ni wumve ingene nniha; nta wo kumpūmuriza ngira; Abansi banje bose bumvise ivyago mbonye; baranezerwa kukw ari wewe wabikoze: Uzotuma umusi washinze ushika, na bo bamere nkanje.
Ububi bgabo bgose ni bushike imbere yawe; Ubagirire nk’uko wangiriye umpōra ibicumuro vyanje vyose: Kuko kuniha kwanje ari kwinshi, kand’ umutima wanje ukaba udendebutse.

Ewe kuntu Umwami Imana yaratse, akūbikiza igicu ku mukobga w’i Siyoni! Yatsinze hasi ubgiza bg’ Abisirayeli abuhanuye kw ijuru, Kandi ntiyibutse indava y’ ibirenge vyiwe kur’ uwo musi w’uburake bgiwe.
Umwami Imana asanganguye amazu yose ya Yakobo ata kagongwe; Yahenuranye uburake ibihome vy’umukobga w’i Buyuda; Arabitsinda gushitsa hasi: Abami n’abaganwa babo yabahinduye ibihumane.

Kubg’ uburake bgiwe bg’inkazi yakondoye ihembe ryose ry’Abisirayeli; Yapfunye ukuboko kwiwe kw’i buryo imbere y’abansi: Kandi yaturiye Yakobo, amumerera nk’umuriro w’ikibengebenge utongora impande zose.
Yamufōreye umuheto nk’ umwansi, yahagaze abanguye ukuboko kw’i buryo nk’umurwanizi, Yishe abanyagikundiro bose: Yasutse ubushangashirwe bgiwe mw ihema ry’umukobga w’i Siyoni nk’umuriro.
Umwami Imana yahindukiye i Bgisirayeli nk’umwansi, arahayongobeza; Yayongobeje ingoro zaho zose, yasanganguye ibihome vyaho: Yongerekanije akabonge n’ ugucura intimba vy’umukobga w’i Buyuda.

Yashikuye ihema ryiwe nk’ ah’ ar’ umutara wo mu murima; Yasanganguye ahantu hiwe h’ikoraniro: Uhoraho yatumye imisi mikuru n’amasabato vyibagirana i Siyoni, Kand’ ubushangashirwe bgiwe bg’inkazi bgatumye atītūra umwami n’umuherezi wese.
Umwami Imana yashibuye igicaniro ciwe, yazinutswe ahēra hiwe, Yagabuye mu maboko y’ abansi ibigo vy’ingoro z’i Siyoni: Bāyogoreye mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho, nko ku musi mukuru washinzwe.
Uhoraho yagabiye gusangangura uruzitiro rw’umukobga w’i Siyoni: Yahageresheje umugozi, ntararuha apfunya ukuboko ngw areke guhonnya; Yateye igihome n’uruzitiro kuboroga; vyiheburiye hamwe.

Amarembo yaho anyikiye mu kuzimu; ibihindizo vyaho yaravyononye, arabivunagura: Umwami waho n’abaganwa baho bari mu mahanga; nta vyagezwe bikiriho: Mber’ abavugishwa n’Uhoraho ntibakigira ivyo beretswe na we.
Abashingantahe b’umukobga w’i Siyoni bicaye hasi, baguye mu gahwi; Biyoreye imikungugu ku mitwe; bakenyeye amagunira; Abakobga b’i Yerusalemu bajondamitse imitwe hasi.
Amaso yanje yakobowe n’ amosozi, amara yanje aradobangana, Umutima wanje usanzariye hasi kubgo kugesezwa kw’ umukobga w’ubgoko bgacu; Kukw abana bato n’abonka barabiraniye mu nzira zo mu gisagara.
Babaza ba nyina, bati Nta duheke na vino vyobaho? Bagaca barabiranira mu nzira zo mu gisagara nk’abakomeretse, Imitima yabo igahondoberera mu bikiriza vya ba nyina.
Nokubarira iki? Nokugereranya n’iki, ga mukobga Yerusalemu we? Noguhwanya n’iki kugira ngo nguhūmurize ga nkumi Siyoni we? Kuk’ uruguma rwawe ari runini nk’ikiyaga: ni nde yoshobora kukuvūra?
Ba kamenyi bawe bākurotoreye ivy’ ubusa n’ivy’ ubupfu; Kandi ntibāguseruriye ibigabitanyo vyawe, ngo ntuje mu kinyago: Ariko bākurotoreye imbūri z’ubusa, n’ibikuzanira gucibga.

Abahita bose bakwitamba ku muvyimba bakubita amashi ku yandi; Bakavuza agahwa, bakazunguriza imitwe umukobga w’i Yerusalemu, Bati Mbeg’ iki ni ca gisagara abantu bāhora batazira, ngo Ni Nyamwiza w’agahore, ngo Ni Munezero w’isi yose?
Abansi bawe bose barakwasamiye cane, Bavuza agahwa, bagahekenya imisaya, bati Twarahayongobeje; Bati N’ukuri uyu ni wo musi twari twiteze; none turawushitseko, turawiboneye.
Uhoraho yakoze ico yagabiye; Yashikije ijambo ryiwe yashinze mu misi ya kera; Yagukubise hasi ata kagongwe; Yahaye umwansi kukwitamba hejuru, Yashize hejuru ihembe ry’ abarwanizi bawe.

Umutima w’ab’ i Yerusalemu watakambiye Uhoraho; Bat’ Ewe wa ruzitiro rw’umukobga w’i Siyoni, reka amosozi asendanishe nk’ uruzi ku murango no mw ijoro; Nturuhe uruhuka na gatoya; imbone y’ijisho ryawe ntitenzekanye.

Va hasi uboroge mw ijoro, uhereye igihe amaterama atanguye; Usuke umutima wawe nk’ amazi imbere y’Umwami Imana: Tega ibiganza umusabire ubugingo bg’abana bawe, Barambitswe n’inzara mu mayirabiri yose.
Uhoraho we, rāba witegereze uwo wagiriye ivyo! Mbeg’ abagore borya abo bāvyaye, utwana bākuyakuya mu maboko yabo? Mbeg’ umuherezi n’ūvugishwa n’Imana bokwicirwa ahantu hēra h’Umwami Imana?
Umusore n’umutāma barambaraye hasi mu nzira; Abigeme banje n’imisore yanje bahindikiranijwe n’ inkota; Wabatikije ku musi w’uburake bgawe; warabariritse ata kagongwe.

Wampamagariye ibinteye ubgoba irya n’ino, nk’uko wahamagara ikoraniro ku musi mukuru washinzwe, Kandi nta warokotse canke ngw asigare kur’ uwo musi w’uburake bg’Uhoraho; Abo nakuyakuya nkabarera, umwansi wanje yarabampēkūye.
Nd’ umuntu yabonye umubabaro uzanywe n’inkoni y’uburake bgayo.
Yaranjanye ancisha mu mwiza, atari mu muco.
N’ukuri yashishikaye kumbangurira ukuboko vuba na vuba burinda bgira.
Yasāzishije inyama zanje n’ urukoba rwanje; yavunaguye amagufa yanje.
Yaranziguje, ankikiza indurwe n’umubabaro.
Yangerereye ahantu h’umwiza nk’abapfuye kera.
Yankubakuvye impande zose ngo sincārūke; yatumye umunyororo wanje undemēra.
Mber’ iyo ndamutakambiye ndamutabaza, ugusenga kwanje akwugaranira hanze.
Yajibije inzira zanje ibibuye bibājwe; yagoretse inzira zanje.
Ammereye nk’igikōko citwa idubu kibundiye kwica, nk’ intambge itegeye mu bibundo.
Yakikamitse inzira zanje, kandi yarantabaguye; yangize inkōkōre.
Yamfōreyek’ umuheto, anshinga nk’uruti rw’icumu, antimbisha imyampi yiwe.
Imyampi yo mu mutana wiwe ayintobekeranije mu mafyigo.
Nahindutse ak’ amenyo mu bgoko bgacu bgose, n’ akavyino kabo umusi ukīra.
Yanyujuje ibamba, ampāza umururazi.
Amenyo yanje yayahongoje urusekebuye, yanyubitse mu munyota.
Kand’ ubugingo bganje bgatandukanijwe n’amahoro, ukuroranirwa narakwibagiye.
Maze ndavuga, nt’ Inkomezi zanje zirashize, n’ivyizigiro nari mfise k’Uhoraho na vyo biraheze.
Ibuka umubabaro wanje n’ intuntu yanje, umururazi n’ indurwe.
Umutima wanje wama uvyibuka, ugenda wicurikiriye muri jewe.
Ibi ni vyo nibuka, bikantera ivyizigiro:
N’ukw imbabazi z’Uhoraho ari zo zatumye tudaherengetezwa, kukw ikigongwe ciwe kidahera:
Cama ari gisha uko bukeye; ingen’ ar’ umwizigirwa bīratangaje.
Uhoraho ni we mugabane wanje, ni k’umutima wanje wama uvuga; ni co gituma nzohora mmwizigira.
Uhoraho agirira neza abamwiteze, n’imitima imurondera.
Ni vyiza k’umuntu yizigira, akitega agakiza k’Uhoraho atekereje.
Ni vyiza k’umuntu amenyerezwa ingōgo yo kuganzwa akiri muto.
Ni yicare wenyene, acereze, kukw ar’ Uhoraho yayimwambitse.
N’ashikane umunwa wiwe mu mukungugu, namba kumbure harih’ ivyizigiro.
N’ategere umusaya ūmukubita; bamuhāze ibitutsi.
Kuk’ Umwami Imana ata ho azota umuntu ruhebga.
Naho yomubabaza, arikw azomugirira ikigongwe, nk’ ukw isinzi ry’imbabazi ziwe riri.
Kukw atababaza abantu abigomba, canke kubatera intuntu.
Gusiribanga imbohe zose zo mw isi,
Canke kugoreka urubanza rw’ umuntu mu nyonga z’Īsumba vyose,
Canke kurya urubanza rw’ umuntu, Umwami Imana ntabishima.
Ni nde yovuga ikintu, kikaboneka, kand’ Umwami Imana atari we yabigeze?
Mbega mu kanwa k’Īsumba vyose ntihavamw’ ivyago n’ivyiza?
Umuntu akiriho, iy’ ahaniwe ivyaha vyiwe, yokwidogera iki?
Enda ni dusesangure ingeso zacu, tuzisuzume, tugaruke k’Uhoraho.
Ducurūrire imitima yacu Imana yo mw ijuru, tuyitarikiye amaboko,
Tuti Twaracumuye, turagarariza; ntiwaduharira.
Wadutwikiriye uburake, uradutōta; waratwishe, nta mbabazi watugirira.
Witwikiriye igicu, kugira ng’ ugusenga kwacu ntikumenēre ngo kugushikīre.
Waduhinduye nk’udukokorwa n’umwavu hagati y’amahanga.
Abansi bacu bose baratwasamiye.
Ibiteye ubgoba n’urusumanyenzi bidushitseko, bo n’ ubugesera no kuranduka.
Amaso yanje atemberanamw’ inzūzi z’amosozi, kubgo kuririra ukuranduka kw’ umukobga w’ubgoko bgacu.
Amaso yanje aracunduguta, ntasigaho, ntahengeshanya,
Gushitsa igihe Uhoraho azokwitegereza, akarāba hasi ari mw ijuru.
Amaso yanje aransābije kubgo kuririra abakobga bose bo mu gisagara cacu.
Abanyankira ubusa bampīze cane nk’inyoni,
Batsinze ubugingo bganje mw ibohero i bgina, banyubikakw ibuye.
Amazi yarandenze ku mutwe; maze ndavuga, nti Ndapfuye.
Natakambiye izina ryawe, ewe Uhoraho, nd’ i bgina kure mw ibohero.
Wumva ijwi ryanje; ntukinge ugutwi kwawe ngo ntiwumve kuniha kwanje n’ugutaka kwanje.
Umusi nagutakambira waranyegereye; uravuga, uti Nta co utinya.
Mwami, wabūranye urubanza rw’umutima wanje; wacunguye ubugingo bganje.
Uhoraho, wabonye ukuntu ngiriwe nabi: n’uncire urubanza.
Wabonye guhōra kwabo kwose n’imigabo bangīra yose.
Wumvise ibitutsi vyabo, Uhoraho we, n’imigabo bangīra yose,
N’amagambo y’abahagurutswa no kuntera, n’inama zabo zose bangīra umusi ukīra.
Ni witegereze iyicara ryabo n’īva hasi ryabo: mbaye akavyino kabo.
Uhoraho we, uzobasubiriza mu nkōko ibihwanye n’ibikorwa vy’amaboko yabo.
Uzobaha umutima ukomantaye, umuvumo wawe ushike kuri bo.
Uzobirukana uri n’uburake, uzobaherengeteza musi y’ ijuru ryawe, ewe Uhoraho.
Ewe kuntu izahabu yafyirifyitiye! Ukuntu izahabu nziza yahindutse ukundi! Amabuye y’ahēra h’urusengero yasābagijwe mu mayirabiri yose.
Abahungu b’igikundiro b’i Siyoni, abāri bameze nk’ izahabu nziza, Ewe kuntu bagereranywa n’ imibindi y’imibumbano, igikorwa c’amaboko y’umubumvyi!
Imbgebge zo ziha ivyana vyazo amabgabga, zikavyonsa; Umukobga w’ubgoko bgacu we agira icīra, nk’ibisīga vyo mu bugaragwa vyitwa imbuni.
Ururimi rw’umwana yonka rufatanye n’uruhekenyero, ruguye ubukagashi: Abana bato basaba utwo kurya, ariko nta wubaha.
Abāri bamenyereye gufungura ibigemānije basigaye bagwira isari mu nzira; Abārerewe mu mpuzu z’ inyambarabami basigaye barambarara ku macukiro.
Kukw ibigabitanyo vy’umukobga w’ubgoko bgacu bikomeye gusumba icaha c’i Sodomu, Ari ho hākomvomvowe mu kanya isase, ata kuboko kuhakozeko.
Abaganwa biwe bāhora bakayangana kurusha shelegi, bakarusha n’amata kwera, Imibiri yabo yabonerana kurusha utubuyenge twitwa marijani, bāri basēnnye nk’ utwitwa safiro.
Noneho mu maso habo hasigaye harusha imivyiro kwirabura; ntibakimenyekana mu nzira: Urukoba rwabo rumatanye n’ amagufa; rwārūmye nk’igiti.
Abicwa n’inkota ni bo bapfa rwiza kuruta abicwa n’ inzara; Kukw abo bo bagenda bashirira hejuru, bakicwa no kubura utwo bokweza mu mirima.
Abagore bāri bafise ikigongwe basigaye bafata abana bīvyariye, bakabateka, Bakaba ivyo kurya vyabo, igihe umukobga w’ubgoko bgacu yagesezwa.
Uhoraho yashikije ubushangashirwe bgiwe, yarekuye uburake bgiwe bg’inkazi; Kandi yadometse umuriro muri Siyoni, utongora n’ amatanguriro yaho.
Abami bo mw isi, bo n’ababa kw isi bose, nta ho bokwemeye Kw abarwanizi n’abansi bofyutse mu marembo y’i Yerusalemu.
Vyatewe n’ivyaha vya ba kamenyi baho, n’ibigabitanyo vy’abaherezi baho, Bāvishirije amaraso y’abagororotsi hagati muri ho.
Badandabagirana mu nzira zaho nk’impumyi, bihumanishije amaraso, Bituma abantu batagishobora gukora ku myambaro yabo.
Barabahāniranwa, bati Ni mwīgireyo, mwa bihumane mwe! Ni mwīgireyo, ni mwīgireyo, ntimugire ico mukorako! Igihe bāhunga bayerera, abantu bo mu mahanga baravuga, bati Ntibabe bakiba hano.
Igitsure c’Uhoraho carabashwiragije; ntagisubira kubashirak’ umutima: Na bo ntibubashe abaherezi, ntibāsoneye abatāma.
Amaso yacu yakobowe no kurereka ugutabarwa kwacu, kand’ ata co bitumariye: Mu kurereka kwacu twiteze ihanga ridashobora gukiza.
Baraturyamiye, bituma tudashobora guca mu nzira zacu: Iherezo ryacu riri hafi, imisi yacu irashize; ni koko iherezo ryacu rirashitse.
Abaduhīga barusha inkukuma zo mu kirēre kunyaruka: Badukinagiza ku misozi miremire, bakaducira ibico mu bugaragwa.
Uwar’ atubereye nk’impwemu duhumeka, uwari yararobanujwe amavuta n’Uhoraho, yakorokeye mu vyobo vyabo, Kand’ ari we twari twishimiye, ngo mu gitūtu ciwe ni ho tuzoba, uko turi hagati mu mahanga.
Ni winezererwe, uhimbarwe, ewe mukobga, Edomu we, wibereye mu gihugu c’i Uzi! Nawe igikombe kizodōbēra kiruhe kigushikeko; uzoborerwa, ute agahuzu.
Igihano c’ukugabitanya kwawe kirarangiye, weho mukobga, Siyoni we; Ntazokwongera kukujana kure ur’ inyagano: Ariko wewe mukobga, Edomu we, azoguhanira ibigabitanyo vyawe; Azogaragaza ivyaha vyawe.
Uhoraho we, ibuka ivyatubayeko: Itegereze urābe ukuntu dutukwa.
Ishamvu yacu yegukiwe n’ abanyamahanga, N’amazu yacu yegukiwe n’ab’ akavantara,
Tur’ impfuvyi ntitukigira ba data, Ba mama bameze nk’abapfakazi.
Tunywa amazi tuyaguze; Inkwi tuzironka ku biguzi.
Abaduhīga batuguye ku gakanu: Turarushe, ntitugira akito ko kuruhuka.
Twakomeye amashi Abanyegiputa, N’Abashuri kugira ngo turonke utwo kurya two kwisama.
Ba data bakoze ivyaha, kandi ntibakiriho; Natwe twasubiweko n’ibigabitanyo vyabo.
Abagurano ni bo basigaye batuganza: Nta wuriho wo kuturokora ngw atugobotore mu maboko yabo.
Ivyo kurya tubironka duhevye amagara, Kubg’ inkota itegeye mu bugaragwa.
Urukoba rwacu rusigaye rwirabura nk’inkono, Bitewe n’umuriro w’inzara.
Bafata abagore bo muri Siyoni ku kagōbēro, N’inkumi zo mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda.
Abaganwa bāmanitswe babasungaje ukuboko kumwe: N’abatāma ntibābagirira udusoni.
Imisore isigaye ikorerwa insyo, N’abana banyikizwa n’imbambo z’inkwi.
Abatāma bāhevye kwicara ku nama, N’imisore ntikiruha icuraranga.
Umunezero wo mu mitima yacu urashize; Imvyino zacu zahindutse amaborogo.
Ibitsibo vyo ku mitwe yacu birakorotse: Tubonye ibara, kuko twakoze ivyaha.
Ni co gituma imitima yacu ihondobera, Ivyo ni vyo bituma duhwera mu kajisho;
Bitewe n’uk’ umusozi Siyoni ucitse amatongo: Imbgebge zisigaye zihatambatamba.
Weho, Uhoraho, wamah’ ibihe bidashira; Intebe yawe ihoraho uk’ urunganwe rugenda rukurikirana.
N’iki catumye utwibagira ibihe vyose, Kand’ ukaduheba kumara igihe kirekire kingana girtyo?
N’utwigarukanire, Uhoraho we, natwe turakugarukira; Dukomōrere imisi yacu nk’ iyo twahoranye ubga mbere,
Shiti waradutaye ruhebga, Ukaturakira birenze urugero.
Mu mwaka wa mirongwitatu, mu kwezi kwa kane, ku musi ugira gatanu w’ukwo kwezi, nari kumwe n’abājanywe ar’ inyagano turi ku ruzi Kebari; ijuru riruguruka, maze mbona ivyo neretswe bivuye ku Mana.
Kur’ uwo musi ugira gatanu w’ukwo kwezi, hāri mu mwaka ugira gatanu umwami Yehoyakina yambukanywe ar’ inyagano,
ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryanjeko jewe umuherezi Ezekiyeli mwene Buzi, ndi mu gihugu c’Abakaludaya ku ruzi Kebari; kand’ aho hantu nyene ni ho ukuboko kw’Uhoraho kwaziye kuri jewe.

Ngize ntya, mbona umuyaga w’ikirura uje uturutse i burārūko, igicu kininiya kirabagizamw’ umuriro, gikikijwe n’ibibatsi bituruka hagati muri wo, biboneka nk’ umuringa w’umujumbu, bituruka hagati mur’ uwo muriro.
Kandi muri wo hagati havamw’ ishusho y’ibinyabugingo bine. Kand’ uku ni ko vyasa: vyari bifise ishusho y’umuntu.
Kimwe‐kimwe cari gifise mu maso hane, kandi kimwe‐kimwe nyene cari gifise amababa ane.
Kand’ ibirenge vyavyo vyar’ inambi; mu bgōro bg’ ibirenge vyavyo hari hameze nk’ imbere mu nzāra z’inyana: kandi vyakayangana nk’umuringa w’ umwakaka.
Kandi vyari bifise amaboko nk’ay’ umuntu musi y’amababa yavyo mu mpande zavyo ukw ari zine; ivyo ukw ari bine, uku ni ko mu maso havyo n’ amababa yavyo vyari bimeze:
amababa yavyo yar’ asomanye; nta ho vyahindukira iyo bigenda; vyose vyagenda bibanze.

Mu maso havyo uko hāsa, vyari bifise mu maso nk’ah’ umuntu; kand’ ukw ari bine, vyari bifise mu maso nk’ah’ intambge mu ruhande rw’i buryo; kand’ ukw ari bine, vyari bifise mu maso nk’ah’ inka mu ruhande rw’i bumoso; kand’ ukw ari bine, vyari bifise mu maso nk’ ah’ inkukuma.
Kandi mu maso havyo n’amababa yavyo vyari bihānye inta ahahera hejuru; amababa abiri ya kimwe‐kimwe yasomana n’ay’ ikindi, yandi abiri agatwikira umubiri waco.
Kandi vyose vyagenda bibanze; aho Mpwemu yerekeje ni ho vyaja; nta ho vyahindukira iyo bigenda.

Kandi ku vy’ishusho y’ivyo binyabugingo uko yar’ imeze, vyasa n’amakara y’umuriro yaka, kandi vyasa n’imuri; uwo muriro waca hirya no hino hagati y’ivyo binyabugingo: uwo muriro wakayangana cane, kandi muri wo havamw’ imiravyo.
Ivyo binyabugingo vyariruka bigakimirana, bisa n’imiravyo irabagiza.
Nuko ncitegereza ivyo binyabugingo, mbona amakurudumu ahagaze hasi, imwe‐imwe i ruhande y’ivyo binyabugingo, imbere mu maso yavyo ukw ari bine.

Ayo makurudumu, ishusho yayo n’ uburyo yakozwe vyari bimeze nk’ akabuyenge kitwa tarushishi; kandi yose ukw ar’ ane yarasa: ishusho yayo n’uburyo yakozwe, vyasa n’ah’ umenga n’ikurudumu isobekeranye n’iyindi.
Iy’ agiye, yagenda yerekeye mu mpande zayo ukw ari zine: nta ho yahindukira iy’ agenda.
Ahihese hayo hāshika hejuru biteye ubgoba; kandi yose ukw ar’ ane, ahihese hayo hāri huzuyekw amaso impande zose.
Kand’ ivyo binyabugingo iyo bigiye, ya makurudumu yagendera i ruhande yavyo: kand’ iy’ ivyo binyabugingo biteruwe ngo bive kw isi, na ya makurudumu yaraterurwa.
Aho Mpwemu yerekeje hose ni ho vyaja, ari ho nyene Mpwemu yerekeje kugenda: ya makurudumu akagenda ateruwe i ruhande yavyo, kukw impwemu y’ikinyabugingo cose yari mu makurudumu.
Iyo bigiye na yo yaragenda; vyahagarara agahagarara; vyaterurwa ngo bive kw isi, na ya makurudumu agaterurwa i ruhande yavyo, kukw impwemu y’ ikinyabugingo cose yari mu makurudumu.
Hejuru y’imitwe y’ ivyo binyabugingo hār’ ikimeze nk’itāzānure ry’ijuru, gisa n’urubona ruca mu jisho, kibamvye hejuru y’imitwe yavyo.
Kandi musi y’iryo tāzānure, amababa yavyo yaranambikiriye, rimwe ryerekeye irindi: kimwe‐kimwe cari gifise abiri atwikiriye umubiri.
Kand’ iyo bigiye, numva guhinda kw’amababa yavyo, ni nko guhinda kw’amazi menshi, nk’ ijwi ry’Īshobora vyose, nk’uguhinda kw’ingabo: iyo bihagaze vyabumba amababa yavyo.
Kandi hirya y’itāzānure ry’ijuru ryo hejuru y’imitwe yavyo hār’ ijwi: nuko vyarahagarara bikabumba amababa yavyo.
Hirya y’iryo tāzānure ryo hejuru y’imitwe yavyo hār’ igisa n’intebe y’ubgami imeze nk’akabuyenge kitwa safiro; kandi hejuru kur’ ico kintu casa n’intebe y’ubgami hār’ igisa n’umuntu.

Uhereye ahobaye mu rukenyerero rwiwe ugasubiza ahahera haruguru, mbona ibiboneka nk’ umuringa w’umujumbu, n’igisa n’ umuriro umuziguje impande zose; kand’ uhereye ahobaye mu rukenyerero rwiwe ugasubiza ahahera hepfo, mbona umenga har’ ibisa n’umuriro, kand’ ibibatsi vyamukikiza hirya no hino.

Nk’uk’ umunywamazi wo ku gicu usa ku musi w’imvura, ni k’ugukayangana kwari kumukikije hirya no hino kwasa. Ivyo vyari bimeze nk’ibisa n’ubgiza bg’Uhoraho. Mbibonye, nikubita hasi nubamye, numva ijwi ry’ūvuga.
Arambarira, ati Mwana w’ umuntu, vyuka uhagarare n’ ibirenge vyawe, mbone kugira ico nkubarira.
Akivugana nanje Mpwemu anyinjiramwo, ampagarika n’ibirenge vyanje; maze numva uyo avugana nanje.
Arambarira, ati Mwana w’umuntu, ngutumye ku Bisirayeli, kw ihanga ry’abagarariji bāngararije. Bāncumuyeko, bo na ba sekuruza, gushitsa no kur’ uyu musi nyene.
N’abana b’inshinyaguza b’imitima ikomantaye: abo ni bo ngutumyeko. Uz’ ubabarire, ut’ Uku ni k’Umwami Uhoraho agize.
Na bo bazokwumva canke batazokwumva, (kukw ar’ inzu y’ abagarariji), ariko rero bazomenya yuk’ ūvugishwa n’Imana yabaye muri bo.

Kandi nawe, mwana w’umuntu, ntuz’ ubatinye, ntuz’ utinye n’amagambo yabo, n’iyo woba mu mikere no mu mahwa, ukabana na za sikorupiyo: ntuz’ utinye amagambo yabo, canke ng’urandurwe umutima n’igitsure cabo, nah’ ar’ inzu y’abagarariji.
Nuk’ uz’ ubabarire amajambo yanje, bovyumva batovyumva; kukw ar’ abagarariji.
Ariko weho, mwana w’umuntu, ni wumve ico nkubgira; ntube umugarariji nk’ iyo nzu y’abagarariji: asamika akanwa kawe, maz’ ico nguha ukirye.
Ngize ntya, mbona ukuboko kuramvuye kuza iyo ndi; maze mbona gufise umuzingo w’ igitabo;
akizingururira imbere yanje: kandi cari canditswe imbere n’inyuma; canditswemw’ intimba n’amaborogo n’amahano.
Nukw arambarira, ati Mwana w’umuntu, ico ubonye ukirye; urye uwo muzingo, uheze ugende, ubarire inzu ya Isirayeli.
Nuko nasamika akanwa, angaburira uwo muzingo.
Arambarira, ati Mwana w’umuntu, hāza inda yawe, n’amara yawe uyuzuze uyu muzingo nguhaye. Nuko ndawurya; mu kanwa unsosera nk’ubūki.
Maz’ arambgira, ati Genda, ushikīre ab’ inzu ya Isirayeli, ubabarire amajambo yanje.
Kuko ntagutumye kw ihanga ry’abavuga imvugo itumvikana n’ururimi rugoye, ariko ni ku b’inzu ya Isirayeli;
si ku mahanga menshi avuga imvugo zitumvikana n’indimi zigoye, abo mudashobora kwumvikana mu majambo. N’ukuri, iyaba ari bo ngutumyeko, bo bokwumviye.
Arikw inzu ya Isirayeli ntizokwumvira, kuko nanje banse kunyumvira: kukw ab’ inzu ya Isirayeli bose mu ruhanga rwabo ar’abanyakadāda, bikomantaje imitima.
Ehe mpinduye mu maso hawe ngo hakomere hahangare mu maso habo, n’uruhanga rwawe ngo rukomere ruhangare impanga zabo.
Uruhanga rwawe ndaruhaye gukomera nk’intosho rurushe isare: ntuz’ ubatinye canke ng’ urandurwe umutima n’igitsure cabo, nah’ ar’ inzu y’abagarariji.
Maz’ arongera arambarira, ati Mwana w’umuntu, amajambo yanje yose nzogenda nkubarira uz’ uyākīre mu mutima wawe, uyumvishe n’amatwi yawe.
Uheze ugende, ushikīre abo mu bgoko bganyu b’abanyagano, uvugane na bo ubabgire, bovyumva, batovyumva, ut’ Uku ni k’Umwami Uhoraho agize.
Maze Mpwemu aranterura, numva inyuma yanje ijwi rihinda cane, rivuga, ng’ Ubgiza bg’ Uhoraho bushemagirizwe ahantu hiwe.
Kandi numva uguhinda kw’amababa ya vya binyabugingo yagenda arakomanako, n’uguhinda kwa ya makurudumu yar’ i ruhande yavyo, mbere kwar’ uguhinda kw’ugusūma gukomeye.
Nuko Mpwemu aranterura, aranjana; ngenda nshavuye, nitonganya; arik’ ukuboko kw’Uhoraho kwari kunshikamiye.
Maze nshikīra ba banyagano i Telabibu, bāba ku ruzi Kebari, nshika aho hantu bāba; mpamara imisi ndwi numiwe nicaye hagati yabo.
Nukw iyo misi ndwi ishize, ijambo ry’Uhoraho rinzako,
riti Mwana w’umuntu, nkugize umushibamyi w’inzu ya Isirayeli; nuko wumve ijambo riva mu kanwa kanje, ubammenyeshereze ivyo mbabūrira.

Ni nabgira umunyakibi, nti Ntuzobura gupfa: nawe ugaheza ntumubūrire, canke ng’ ugire ico uvuga co kubūrira umunyakibi ngw ave mu nzira yiwe mbi, ng’ ukize ubugingo bgiwe, uwo munyakibi azopfira mu bigabitanyo vyiwe; arikw amaraso yiwe nzoyakuronderako.
Ariko ni wabūrira umunyakibi, ntahindukire ngw areke ibibi vyiwe, canke ngw ave mu nzira yiwe mbi, azopfira mu bigabitanyo vyiwe; ariko weho uzoba urokoye ubugingo bgawe.

Ikindi, umugororotsi ni yahindukira akareka ubugororotsi bgiwe, agakora ivy’ ukugabitanya, nanje ngashira igitsitaza imbere yiwe, azopfa: kuk’ utāmubūriye, azopfira mu caha ciwe; kand’ ibikorwa vyiwe bigororotse yakoze ntazobiharūrwako, arikw amaraso yiwe nzoyakuronderako.
Yamara ni wabūrira umugororotsi, uwo mugororotsi ngo yoye gukora icaha, na we ntagikore nyene, ntazobura kubaho, kuko yemeye kubūrirwa; kandi nawe uzoba urokoye ubugingo bgawe.
Aho hantu nyene ni ho ukuboko kw’Uhoraho kwanziyeko; arambarira, ati Va hasi, uje mu kiyaya, iyo ni ho nja kubonanira nawe.
Nca mva hasi nja mu kiyaya; mbona ubgiza bg’Uhoraho buhahagaraye, bumeze nk’ubgiza naboneye ku ruzi Kebari: maze nikubita hasi nubamye.
Nuko Mpwemu anyinjiramwo, ampagarika n’ibirenge vyanje; avugana nanje, arambarira, ati Genda wiyugaranire mu nzu yawe.
Ariko rero, mwana w’umuntu, bazoguta mu migozi, bayikuboheshe, nawe ntuzobona uk’ usohoka ng’ uje muri bo.
Nzotuma ururimi rwawe rufatana n’uruhekenyero, ugobge ururimi, woye kubabera imbūri; kukw ar’inzu y’ abagarariji.
Arikw igihe nzovugana nawe, nzogobotora akanwa kawe, nawe uz’ uheze ubabarire, ut’ Uku ni k’Umwami Uhoraho agize, ng’ Ūgomba kwumva ni yumve, ūtabigomba n’areke: kukw ar’ inzu y’abagarariji.
Nuko nawe, mwana w’umuntu, wiyabīrire itafari, urirambike imbere yawe, urishushanyekw igisagara, ari co Yerusalemu:
maz’ ukiziguze, wubake ibihome vyo kuhatera, ukirundire ibigunguzi vyo kwūririrako, ugisagazeko n’ insago, ugikikizeko hirya no hino ibiti vy’imigogo vyo kugihomvora.

Kandi wiyabīrire umubehe w’ icuma, uwukike ng’ukubere uruzitiro rw’icuma hagati yawe n’ igisagara: ugishinge ijisho ngo kiziguzwe, wewe ubgawe ukiziguze. Ivyo bizoba ikimenyamenya c’inzu ya Isirayeli.
Utek’ uryamire urubavu rwawe rw’i bumoso, ururemeke ibigabitanyo vy’inzu ya Isirayeli: ukw igitigiri c’imisi uzoruryamira kingana, ni k’uzokwishirakw ibigabitanyo vyabo.
Kuk’ ukw imyaka yo guhanirwa ibigabitanyo vyabo ingana, nguciriye igitigiri c’ imisi kingana na yo, n’imisi amajana atatu na mirongwicenda: uko ni k’uzokwishirakw ibigabitanyo vy’inzu ya Isirayeli.
Maz’ urangije ivyo, uz’ uheze uryamire urubavu rw’i buryo, wishirekw ibigabitanyo vy’inzu ya Yuda: nguciriye imisi mirongwine, umusi‐umusi uhwana n’umwaka.
Kand’ uz’ ushinge ijisho kuri Yerusalemu hajigujwe, ukumye impuzu ku kuboko kwawe; uhabūrire ibizoba.
Kandi rāba, ngushize mu ngoyi, nta ho uzohindukirira urundi rubavu, gushitsa ah’ imisi yo kuhaziguza kwawe izoba irangiye.

Kandi wironderere ingano na sayiri n’ibiharage n’inkōre n’amasaka n’uburo, maz’ ubishire mu nkono imwe, ubicemw’ uturobe tw’udutsima; nk’ukw igitigiri c’imisi kiri uzoryamira urubavu, ukw ar’ amajana atatu na mirongwicenda, ivyo ni vyo bizogutunga.
Kand’ ivyo kurya vyawe uze wame ubirya ku rugero, ari rwo shekeli mirongwibiri mu musi mu musi: uzokwama urya rimwe ku musi.
Kandi n’ amazi uzokwama uyanywa ku rugero, ari rwo gihimba ca gatandatu c’ingero yitwa hini: na yo uzokwama uyanywa rimwe ku musi.
Uzokwama ubirya nk’ udutsima twa sayiri, kand’ uzokwama uducaniriza amavyi y’ abantu imbere yabo.
Kand’ Uhoraho aravuga, at’ Uko ni kw Abisirayeli bazorīra ivyo kurya vyabo vyandavuye mu mahanga nzobashwiragirizamwo.

Maze ndavuga, nti Yo! Ewe Mwami Uhoraho! Erega kuva aho nakabereye nta ho nigeze mpumana: kuk’ uhereye mu buto bganje ugashitsa n’ubu ata ho nigeze kurya icipfiriye, cank’ icātabaguwe n’ igikōko; kandi nta ho inyama zihumanye zigeze kuja mu kanwa kanje.
Maz’ arambarira, ati Rāba, nguhaye ibisheshe vy’amase y’inka mu gishingo c’amavyi y’ abantu: ivyo ni vyo uzocaniriza ukora utwo dutsima twawe.

Arongera arambarira, ati Mwana w’umuntu, ehe ngira mvune inkoni ab’ i Yerusalemu bishimikije, ari wo mutsima; kandi bazosigara barya umutsima ku rugero, bahagaritse umutima; n’amazi bazoyanywa ku rugero bihebuye:
uko ni ko bazokena ivyo kurya n’amazi, bazazanirwe iyo bava bakagera, bashire umunywera kubg’ ibigabitanyo vyabo.
Nuko mwana w’umuntu, wiyabīrire inkota y’ubuhwe, uyābīre bga rupfuhe, uyicīshe ku mutwe wawe no ku bganwa bgawe: uheze wiyabīrire umunzane wo kugeresha, ugabanye iyo mishatsi wimoye.

Ikigira gatatu cayo uz’ ugituririre hagati mu gisagara, igihe imisi yo gutabga hagati kwaho izoba ihereye; ikindi kigira gatatu cayo ugicagagurize inkota hirya no hino yaho; kand’ ikindi kigira gatatu cayo ukirekurire mu muyaga ng’ugishwiragize, nanje nzosokora inkota icirukane.
Kand’ iyo mishatsi uz’ uyigabanyeko mukeya, uwutekere mu mutwe w’impuzu yawe.
Kandi kur’ uwo nyene uwukūrekw akandi gakeya, ugaterere mu muriro, ugaturire; aho ni ho hazova umuriro uzoshika ku nzu yose ya Isirayeli.
Uku ni k’Umwami Uhoraho agize, at’ Ehe ngaha i Yerusalemu, aho natabitse hagati y’amahanga n’ibihugu bihakikije!
Ariko hāgararije amabgirizwa yanje, hakora ibibi kurusha abanyamahanga; hāgararije ivyagezwe vyanje kurusha ibihugu bihakikije; bāshibuye amabgirizwa yanje, n’ ivyagezwe vyanje ntibābigenderamwo.

Nuko rero, uku ni k’ Umwami Uhoraho agize, ati Kuko mur’ abanyamivurungano kurusha amahanga abakikije, kandi mukaba mutāgendeye mu vyagezwe vyanje, ntimwitondere n’amabgirizwa yanje, canke ngo mukore n’ivyo amabgirizwa y’amahanga abakikije yashinze:
nuko rero, uku ni k’ Umwami Uhoraho agize, ati Rāba jewe ubganje nyene nzohigūra nawe: kandi nzocira amateka hagati muri wewe, amahanga abirorēra.
Kandi nzokorera muri wewe ico ntigeze gukora, mbere ntazokwongera gukora ukundi, nguhōye ibizira vyawe vyose.
Ni co gituma ba se b’abana bazobarīra hagati muri wewe, n’ abana bazorya ba se; kandi nzocira amateka muri wewe, n’amasigarira yawe yose nzoyashwiragiriza mu birēre vyose.

Ni co gituma ndahiye ukubaho kwanje, ni k’Umwami Uhoraho agize, kuko wahumanishije ahēra hanje ibintu vyawe vyankwa urunuka, n’ibizira vyawe vyose, ni co gituma nanje ntazobura kugutūvya; ijisho ryanje ntirizogira ico riziguriza, kandi nta n’akagongwe nzogira.

Ikigira gatatu cawe kizokwicwa n’ikīza, na kigoyi kizobamarira hagati muri wewe; ikindi kigira gatatu kizoririkirwa n’inkota impande zawe zose; n’ikindi kigira gatatu nzogishwiragiriza mu birēre vyose, kandi nzosokōra inkota ibirukane.
Uko ni ko nzoba nimaze ishavu, n’ubushangashirwe nabagiriye nzoba ndabutuye, kandi nzoba nshizwe: nuko bazomenya yuko jewe, Uhoraho, nabivuganye agatsi, ni naheza kwimara uburake mbafitiye.
Kand’ ikindi nzoguhindura umusaka n’igitutsi mu mahanga agukikije, no mu maso y’abahita bose.
Maz’ uzoba igitutsi n’agatwengo n’akabarore n’akajoreza mu mahanga agukikije, ni nagucirakw iteka mfise uburake n’ubushangashirwe, nguhambariranye ishavu: ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze;
kandi nkabarasa imyampi mibi ya kigoyi yo kubageseza, iyo nzorungika kubatikiza; kandi nzobagwizamw’ amapfa, mvune inkoni yanyu mwishimikije, ni wo mutsima;
kandi nzobatēza kigoyi n’ibikōko vy’inkazi, bikugire nyakamara; ikīza n’ibitenga vy’amaraso bizoca muri wewe, kandi nzogutērēra inkota: ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Maz’ ijambo ry’Uhoraho rinzako,
riti Mwana w’umuntu, tungīra ijisho ryawe imisozi y’i Bgisirayeli, uyibūrire,

uti Yemwe misozi y’i Bgisirayeli, ni mwumve ijambo ry’Umwami Uhoraho: Uku ni k’Umwami Uhoraho abgira imisozi n’uturambi, imigezi n’ imyonga, at’ Ehe jewe ubganje nyene nzobatērēra inkota, nkomvomvore ibitabo vyanyu vyo ku mpinga z’imisozi.
Kand’ ibicaniro vyanyu bizosigara bitamāriwe, n’ibishushanyo vyanyu vy’izuba bizomenagurwa: kand’ abishwe banyu nzobashiburira hasi imbere y’ibigirwamana vyanyu.
Nzorambika imivyimba y’Abisirayeli imbere y’ibigirwamana vyabo; kand’ amagufa yanyu nzoyatāgaguza impande zose z’ibicaniro vyanyu.

Aho muba hose ibisagara bizogesezwa, n’ibitabo bitamārirwe, kugira ngw ibicaniro vyanyu bisangangurwe, bitamārirwe, n’ibigirwamana vyanyu bimenagurwe, biherengetezwe, n’ ibishushanyo vyanyu vy’izuba bicibge bitsindwe hasi, n’ibikorwa vyanyu bizimangane.
