Abayuda baramubgira, bati Noneho turamenye k’urimwo dayimoni. Aburahamu yarapfuye, n’abāvugishwa n’Imana n’uko, ariko wewe uvuze, uti Ni hagira uwitondera ijambo ryanje, nta ho azokwumviriza ku rupfu.
Mbeg’ uruta sogokuruza wacu Aburahamu? We ko yapfuye, n’abāvugishwa n’Imana na bo bakaba bārapfuye: wiyita nde?
Yesu arabishura, ati Ni naba niha icubahiro, icubahiro canje kizoba ar’ ic’ ubusa: ūmpa icubahiro ni Data, uwo muvuga ngo n’Imana yanyu,
yamara ntimumuzi, ariko jewe ndamuzi. Kandi ni navuga ngo sindamuzi, nzoba mbaye umunyabinyoma nkamwe: ariko ndamuzi, kandi nitondera ijambo ryiwe.
Aburahamu sogokuruza wanyu yari yarahahamiye kubona umusi wanje, kandi yarawubonye, aranezerwa.
Nuko rer’ Abayuda baramubgira, bat’ Ube utaramara imyaka mirongwitanu, ngo warabonye Aburahamu?
Yesu arababgira, ati N’ukuri, n’ukuri ndababgire: Aburahamu ataravuka, jewe namye ndiho.
Baca batora amabuye yo kumutera, maze Yesu arihisha, ava mu rusengero.
Arikw arahita, abona umuntu yavutse ar’ impumyi.
Abigishwa biwe baramubaza, bati Mwigisha, ni nde yakoze icaha, n’uyo, canke n’abavyeyi biwe, ko yavutse ar’ impumyi?
Yesu arabishura, at’ Uyu ntiyakoze icaha, kandi s’abavyeyi biwe, ariko n’ukugira ngw ibikorwa vy’Imana bibonekere kuri we.
Twebge dukwiye gukora ibikorwa vy’uwantumye hakibona; buhava bgira, ata wugishobora gukora.
Nkiri mw isi, nd’ umuco w’isi.
Avuze ivyo, acira amate hasi, avurungisha amate utwondo, araheza amusīga utwo twondo ku maso;
aramubarira, ati Genda wiyuhagire mu kidengeri Silowamu; (Silowamu risobanurwa ngo Mutumwa). Nukw aragenda ariyuhagira, agaruka abona.
Nukw ababanyi biwe, n’abāhora bamubona kw ar’ umusēzi, barabazanya, bati Mbeg’ uyu si we yahora yicaye asēgerereza?
Abandi bati Ni we; abandi bat’ Oya, n’uwo basa. Na we arababgira, ati Ni jewe.
Nuko baramubaza, bati Mbega non’ amaso yawe yahumūtse ate?
Na we arabishura, ati Wa muntu yitwa Yesu yavurunze utwondo, atunsīga ku maso, arambgira, ati Ja kuri Silowamu wiyuhagire; nuko ndagenda, ndiyuhagira, ndahumūka.
Baramubaza, bat’ Ari hehe? Ati Sindahazi.
Umwe yahora ar’impumyi bamujana ku Bafarisayo.
Kand’ uwo musi war’ isabato, Yesu yavurunzek’ utwondo, agahumūra amaso yiwe.
Abafarisayo basubira kumubaza ingene yahumūtse, na we arababgira, ati Yansīze utwondo ku maso, ndiyuhagira, ndahumūka.
Bamwe mu Bafarisayo baravuga, bat’ Uwo muntu ntava ku Mana, kukw ataziririza isabato. Abandi bati Mbeg’ umuntu w’umunyavyaha yoshobora ate gukora ibimenyetso bingana birtyo? Baramupfa.
Basubira kubaza umwe yahora ar’ impumyi, bati Weho uvuga kw ar’ iki, kuko yaguhumūye amaso? Na we ati N’ūvugishwa n’Imana.
Maz’ Abayuda ntibemera ivy’ uwo, yuko yamye ar’impumyi, agaheza agahumūka, kugeza aho bāhamagariye abavyeyi b’uwahumūtse,
barababaza, bati Mbeg’ uyu n’umwana wanyu, mwebge muvuga ko yavutse ar’ impumyi? None yahumūtse ate?
Abavyeyi biwe barabishura, bat’ Uyu turazi kw ar’ umwana wacu, kandi ko yavutse ar’ impumyi;
arikw icatumye abona ubu, ntitukizi, kandi n’uwamuhumūye, tweho ntitumuzi. Mumwibarize, n’umugabo, arivugira.
Abavyeyi biwe bāvugiye ivyo, kuko bātinya Abayuda, kukw Abayuda bāri bamaze kuja ingingo, ng’umuntu wese azokwatura Yesu kw ari Kristo acibge mw isinagogi.
Ni co catumye abavyeyi biwe bavuga, bati N’umugabo, ni mumwibarize.
Maze bahamagara ubugira kabiri wa muntu yahora ar’ impumyi, baramubgira, bati Ni wubahe Imana, twebge tuzi yuk’ uwo muntu ar’ umunyavyaha.
Na we arabishura, ati Namb’ ar’ umunyavyaha sindabizi: ico nzi ni kimwe, n’uko nar’ impumyi, none nkaba mbona.
Baramubaza, bati Yakugiriye ate? Yahumūye amaso yawe ate?
Arabishura, ati Namaze kubibabgira, ko mutavyumvise? Mugombera iki gusubira kuvyumva? Mbega namwe mugomba kuba abigishwa biwe?
Baramutuka, bati Ni wewe mwigishwa wiwe, natwe tweho tur’ abigishwa ba Mose.
Twebge tuzi yukw Imana yavuganye na Mose, arik’ uwo ntituzi ah’ aturuka.
Wa muntu arabishura, at’ Erega n’igitangaza ko mutazi ah’ aturuka, kand’ ari we yahumūye amaso yanje.
Turazi kw Imana itumviriza abanyavyaha, arik’ ūyubaha, agakora ivyo igomba, uwo ni we yumviriza.
Uhereye kera hose ntihumvikanye ko har’ umuntu yahumūye amaso y’uwavutse ar’ impumyi.
Iyaba uyo atāvuye ku Mana, nta co yoshoboye gukora.
Baramwishura, bati Wewe wavukiye mu vyaha gusa gusa, ni wewe utwigisha? Bamuhindira hanze.
Yesu yumvise ko bamuhindiye hanze, aja kumurāba, aramubaza, ati Mbega wizeye Umwana w’Imana?
Na we aramwishura, ati Ni nde ga Mugenzi, nkamwizera?
Yesu aramubgira, ati Wamubonye, kandi ni we muriko muravugana.
Na we ati Ndizeye, Mwami. Araheza aramupfukamira.
Yesu aravuga, ati Naje mur’ iyi si kuba agahinyuza, ngw abatabona babone, n’ababona babe impumyi.
Bamwe mu Bafarisayo bāri kumwe na we bumvise ivyo, bati Mbega natwe tur’ impumyi?
Yesu arababgira, at’ Iyo muba mwar’ impumyi, nta caha muba mufise, ariko noneho muvuga muti Turabona: icaha canyu camaho.
N’ukuri, n’ukuri ndababgire: Ūdaca mw irembo ry’urugo rw’intama, arikw akūririra ahandi, uwo aba ar’ igisuma n’umwambuzi.
Arik’ ūca mw irembo ni we mwungere w’intama.
Umuteramyi w’irembo aramwugururira, kand’ intama zumva ijwi ryiwe; ahamagara iziwe ntama mu mazina yazo, akaziturutsa.
Kand’ iy’ amaze guturutsa iziwe zose, azija imbere, zikamukurikira kuko zizi ijwi ryiwe.
Arik’ uwo zitazi ntizomukurikira na mba, zomuhunga, kuko zitazi amajwi y’abandi.
Yesu abacira uwo mugani, ariko bo ntibatahura ivyo ababgira ivy’ ari vyo.
Nuko Yesu yongera kubabgira, ati N’ukuri, n’ukuri ndababgire: Ni jewe rembo ry’intama.
Abanyītangiye imbere bose bār’ ibisuma n’abambuzi, arikw intama ntizabumviye.
Ni jewe rembo, kand’ ūshika mu rugo wese aciye muri jewe arakizwa; agataha, agaturuka, akaronka icanya.
Igisuma ntikizanwa n’ikindi, atar’ ukwiba, n’ukwica, n’ugutikiza; nanje jeho nazanywe no kugira ngo zironke ubugingo, kandi ngo ziburonke busāgutse.
Ni jewe mwungere mwiza; umwungere mwiza yigura intama ziwe.
Arik’ umucangero, atar’ umwungere bgite, kand’ intama atar’ iziwe, iy’ abonye ibingira rije, ata intama, agahunga: ibingira rikazisahura, rikazishwiragiza.
Arahunga, kukw ar’ umucangero, atababaye intama.
Ni jewe mwungere mwiza, ndazi izanje, n’izanje ziranzi,
nk’uko Data anzi, nanje nkamumenya; kandi ndigura intama zanje.
Kandi mfise n’izindi ntama zitar’ izo mur’ uru rugo, na zo nyene birankwiye kuzija imbere, zizokwumva ijwi ryanje, hazoba umukuku umwe n’umwungere umwe.
Igituma Data ankunda, n’uko ndekura ubugingo bganje, ngo mpeze nsubire kubgābīra.
Nta n’umwe abunyaka, kuko mburekura kubganje: mfise ububasha bgo kuburekura, mfise n’ububasha bgo gusubira kubgābīra. Ico ni co cagezwe nahawe na Data.
Abayuda bongera kumupfa kubg’ ayo majambo;
benshi muri bo bat’ Arimwo dayimoni, kandi yāsaze: mumwumviririza iki?
Abandi bat’ Ereg’ ayo majambo si nk’ay’ ūhagazweko na dayimoni: mbega dayimoni arashobora guhumūra amaso y’impumyi?
Maze haza imisi mikuru yo kwibuka uguhumanurwa kw’ urusengero i Yerusalemu: hāri mu rushana.
Yesu agendagenda mu rusengero mw ibaraza rya Salomo.
Abayuda baramukikiza, baramubaza, bat’ Uzogeza ryari gutera imitima yacu kujuragira? Asangw’ uri Kristo bidufoborere.
Yesu arabishura, ati Narababgiye, ariko ntimwizera: ibikorwa nkora mw izina rya Data, ni vyo binshingira intahe.
Ariko ntimwizera, kuko mutar’ abo mu ntama zanje.
Abābaye intama zanje bumva ijwi ryanje, nanje ndabazi, na bo barankurikira,
kandi nanje mbaha ubugingo budashira, nta ho bazokwigera bapfa rubi gushitsa ibihe bidashira, kandi nta wushobora kubanshikura mu kuboko kwanje.
Data yabampaye ni we aruta bose; nta wushobora kubashikura mu kuboko kwa Data.
Jewe na Data tur’ umwe.
Bun’ Abayuda bongera gutora amabuye, ngo bayamutere.
Yesu arababgira, ati Naberetse ibikorwa vyiza vyinshi bivuye kuri Data, ikibanteresha amabuye mur’ ivyo bikorwa n’ikihe?
Abayuda baramwishura, bati Ntituguterera amabuye kubg’ igikorwa ciza, ariko n’uko warogose; kuko wewe ur’ umuntu ukīgira Imana.
Yesu arabishura, ati Mbega ntihanditswe mu vyagezwe vyanyu, ngo Navuze nti Mur’ imana?
None ko yabise imana, bamwe ijambo ry’Imana ryashitseko (kand’ ivyanditswe ntibishobora guhinduka),
mwebge mubgira mute uwo Data yejeje, akamutuma mw isi, ng’ Urarogose, kuko navuze nti Nd’ Umwana w’Imana?
Asangwa ntakora ibikorwa vya Data, ntimunyemere;
ariko ni nabikora, naho jewe mutanyemera, mupfe kwemera ibikorwa, kugira ngo mumenye, mutahure, yuko Data ari muri jewe, nanje nkaba muri Data.
Nuko bongera kurondera ingene bomufata, abava mu maboko.
Avayo, yongera kuja hakurya ya Yorodani, ha hantu Yohana yabatiriza ubga mbere, agumayo.
Benshi baza kuri we; baravuga, bati Yohana nta kimenyetso yakoze, arikw ivyo Yohana yavuze vyose kur’ uyu vyar’ ivy’ ukuri.
Kandi benshi bamwizererayo.
Hārih’ uwar’ arwaye, ni Lazaro w’i Betaniya, ni wa musozi Mariya na mwene nyina Marita bābako.
Uwo Mariya ni we yasīze Umwami Yesu amavuta atāmirana ku birenge, amuhanaguza umushatsi wiwe; uyo Lazaro yar’ arwaye ni we musaza we.
Bashiki biwe batuma kuri Yesu, bati Mugenzi, wa wundi ukunda ararwaye.
Yesu avyumvise aravuga, at’ Iyo ndwara s’iyo kumwica, ariko n’iyo gushimagirisha Imana, kugira ngo n’Umwana w’Imana imushimagirishe.
Kandi Yesu yarakunda Marita na mwene nyina na Lazaro.
Nuko yumvise kw arwaye, asībira aho hantu yar’ ari imisi ibiri.
Hanyuma y’ivyo abgira abigishwa biwe, ati Dusubire i Yudaya.
Abigishwa baramubgira, bati Mwigisha, Abayuda baheruka gushaka kugutera amabuye, non’ usubireyo?
Yesu arabishura, ati Non’ isaha z’umurango s’icumi na zibiri? Ūgenda ku murango ntatsitara, kukw abona umuco w’iyi si.
Arik’ ūgenda mw ijoro aratsitara, kuk’ umuco utari muri we.
Amaze kuvuga ivyo, arababgira, ati Lazaro, umukunzi wacu, arasinziriye, nanje ndagiye kumukangura.
Nukw abigishwa baramubgira, bati Mugenzi, asangw’ asinziriye, azokira.
Yamara Yesu yavuga urupfu rwiwe, ariko bo bagira ngw avuga kuruhuka kwo gusinzira.
Buno Yesu avuga abifoboye, ati Lazaro yahwereye;
ariko kubganyu ndanezerewe ko ntāriyo, kugira ngo muze mwizere; noneho ni muze tuje iy’ ari.
Toma ari we Hasa abgira abigishwa bagenzi biwe, ati Ngo tugende, dupfane na Yesu.
Nuko Yesu ashitse asanga amaze imisi ine mu mva.
I Betaniya hāri hafi y’i Yerusalemu nka stadiyo cumi na zitanu.
Nukw Abayuda benshi bāri baje kwa Marita na Mariya kubirura kubga musaza wabo.
Nuko Marita yumvise ko Yesu aje, aragenda aramusanganira; ariko Mariya asigara yicaye mu nzu.
Marita abgira Yesu, ati Mugenzi, iy’ uba wari hano, musazanje ntaba yāhwereye.
Kandi n’ubu ndazi kw ivyo wosaba Imana vyose, Imana yobiguha.
Yesu aramubgira, ati Musazawe azozuka.
Marita aramwishura, ati Ndazi kw azozuka mw izuka ryo ku musi w’iherezo.
Yesu aramubgira, ati Ni jewe kuzuka n’ubugingo. Ūnyizera n’iyo yoba yarapfuye, azobaho;
kand’ ūriho wese anyizera, nta ho azokwigera apfa gushitsa ibihe bidashira. Urizeye ivyo?
Na we at’ Ego me Mugenzi, nizeye k’uri Kristo, Umwana w’Imana, umwe wo kuza mw isi.
Avuze ivyo, asubira inyuma, yonjorora Mariya, mwene nyina, at’ Umwigisha ari hano, araguhamagaje.
Na we avyumvise, ava hasi n’ingoga, aja ah’ ari.
Yesu ntiyaribgashike mur’ iyo mihana, ariko yar’ akiri ha handi aho Marita yamusanganiriye.
Bun’ Abayuda bāri kumwe na Mariya mu nzu bamwirura, babonye avuye hasi n’ingoga, asohotse, baramukurikira, bagira ngw agiye kuririra ku mva.
Mariya ashitse aho Yesu ari, amubonye, yikubita imbere y’ibirenge vyiwe, ati Mugenzi, iy’ uba wari hano, musazanje ntaba yāhwereye.
Yesu abonye kw arira, n’Abayuda bāri kumwe na we barira, agira ikigumbagumba mu mutima, arawuhagarika,
arababaza, ati Mwamutaye hehe? Bati Mugenzi, ngwino urābe.
Yesu ararira.
Abayuda baravuga, bat’ Eh’ ingene yamukunda.
Ariko bamwe muri bo baravuga, bati Mbeg’ uyo yahumūye amaso y’impumyi, ntiyoshoboye kubuza uyo ngo ntapfe?
Yesu yongera kugira ikigumbagumba mu mutima, ashika ku mva; kandi yar’ isenga yugajwe ikibuye.
Yesu aravuga, ati Ni mukūreh’ iryo buye. Marita mushiki w’uwapfuye, aramubgira, ati Mugenzi, ereg’ ubu aramaze kunuka, kw amaze imisi ine.
Yesu aramubgira, ati Sinakubgiye nti Ni wizera urabona ubgiza bg’Imana?
Nuko bakūrah’ ikibuye. Buno Yesu ararangamiza, ati Data, ndagushima ko wanyumvirije.
Jewe nari nsanzwe nzi k’unyumviriza ubudasība, ariko mbivugishijwe n’ishengero rihagaze ngaha, kugira ngo bizere kw ari wewe wantumye.
Amaze kuvuga ivyo, asemerera n’ijwi rirenga, ati Lazaro, ngwino, sohoka.
Uwari yāpfuye arasohoka, azingiriwekw impuzu ku maguru no ku maboko, n’igitambara gipfutse mu maso hiwe. Yesu arababgira, ati Ni mumuhamburure, mumureke, agende.
Nuko benshi mur’ abo Bayuda bari baje kwa Mariya, babonye ico Yesu akoze, baramwizera,
ariko bamwe muri bo baja ku Bafarisayo, bababgira ivyo Yesu akoze.
Nukw abaherezi bakuru n’Abafarisayo bakoranya abanyekombe, barababaza, bati Mbega, tugire dute? K’uyu muntu akora ibimenyetso vyinshi.
Ni twamurekeraho durtyo, bose bazohava bamwizera, kand’ Abaroma bazoza batikize igisagara cacu n’ubgoko bgacu.
Arik’ umwe muri bo, ni Kayafa, yar’ umuherezi mukuru mur’ uwo mwaka, arababgira, ati Mwebge nta co muzi na mba,
kandi nta co mwiyumvira yukw ar’ ibibereye kubganyu k’umuntu umwe apfira abantu, hak’ ubgoko bgose buhona.
Ivyo ntiyabivuze avyigeneye, ariko, kuko yar’ umuherezi mukuru mur’ uwo mwaka, yavugishijwe ko Yesu agira apfire ubgo bgoko;
kandi s’ubgo bgoko bgonyene, ariko ngw abana b’Imana bose bari basanzaye, abakoranirize hamwe.
Nuko bahēra uwo musi baja inama yo kumwica.
Maze Yesu ntiyaba akigenda yibonekeza mu Bayuda, arikw avayo, aja mu gihugu kiri hafi y’ubugaragwa mu gisagara citwa Efurayimu, agumanayo n’abigishwa.
Maze Pasika y’Abayuda yarikw irashika, benshi bava mu misozi, badūga i Yerusalemu, Pasika itarashika, ngo bihumanure.
Maze barondera Yesu, babazanya bahagaze mu rusengero, bati Mbega, mugira ngw iki? Ubgo ntazoza mur’ iyi misi mikuru?
Kand’ abaherezi bakuru n’Abafarisayo bāri bashinze ng’ uwomenya ah’ ari aharange, ngo bamufate.
Nuko hasigaye imisi itandatu Pasika igashika, Yesu aja i Betaniya, ni ho Lazaro yaba, umwe Yesu yazuye mu bapfuye.
Barahamuzimanira; Marita yarahereza, kandi na Lazaro yar’ umwe wo mu bicaranye na we basangira.
Maze Mariya yābīra ingero y’amavuta atāmirana y’igiciro kinini cane, y’agati kitwa narada, ayasīga ku birenge vya Yesu, abihanaguza umushatsi wiwe, kand’ inzu yose itāmiranamw’ ayo mavuta.
Ariko Yuda Isikaryota, umwe mu bigishwa biwe, uwagira az’ amugure, aravuga,
ati N’iki catumye ayo mavuta ataguzwe idenariyo amajana atatu, ngo zihabge aboro?
Arikw ivyo ntiyabivugishijwe no kubabara aboro, n’uko yar’ umwivyi, agendana umupfuko, agasotōra ku bibītswemwo.
Yesu aramubgira, ati N’umureke, kukw ivyo yabibīkiye umusi wo guhambga kwanje.
Aboro murāmana imisi yose, ariko jeho ntituja kwamana imisi yose.
Ishengero ryinshi ry’Abayuda rimenye kw ari ho ari, baraza, mugabo ntihāri kubga Yesu gusa, ariko kwār’ ukugira ngo barābe na Lazaro yazuye mu bapfuye.
Arikw abaherezi bakuru baja inama yo kwica Lazaro na we,
kuko kubgiwe Abayuda benshi bābavako bakizera Yesu.
Bukeye bg’aho, ishengero ryinshi ryari ryaje i Yerusalemu mur’ iyo misi mikuru, bumvise ko Yesu azayo,
bābīra amashami y’ibigazi, baja kumusanganira, barasemerera, bati Hoziyana: hashemezwe ūje mw izina ry’Uhoraho, ni we Mwami w’Abisirayeli.
Kandi Yesu abonye inyana y’indogoba, ayicarako, nk’uko handitswe,
ngo Nta co utinya, mukobga w’i Siyoni, rāba, Umwami wawe araje, ari ku nyana y’indogoba.
Ivyo abigishwa ntibabitahuye ubga mbere, ariko Yesu amaze guhabga ubgiza bgiwe, ni ho bibutse kw ivyo yavyandikiwe, kandi kw ari vyo bāmugiriye.
Nuko rya shengero rimushingira intahe, rimwe ryari kumwe na we hamwe yahamagara Lazaro ngw ave mu mva, akamuzura mu bapfuye.
Kandi ni co catumye ishengero rimusanganira, kuko bumvise ko yakoze ico kimenyetso.
Arikw Abafarisayo bavugana muri bo, bati Murabona kw ata co mumaze: rāba isi yose yamukondoreye inyuma.
Hār’ Abagiriki bamwe, mu bādūze gusenga mu misi mikuru,
bashikīra Filipo w’i Betsayida i Galilaya, baramwinginga, bati Mugenzi, turagomba kurāba Yesu.
Filipo araza abibarira Andereya; Andereya na Filipo baraza babibarira Yesu.
Yesu arabishura, at’ Igihe kirageze c’uk’ Umwana w’umuntu ahabga ubgiza bgiwe.
N’ukuri, n’ukuri ndababgire: Iy’ agatete k’ingano kataguye mw ivu ngo gapfe, kaguma uko kari konyene; arikw iyo gapfuye, gahunda impeke nyinshi.
Ūkunda ubugingo bgiwe azobubura, arik’ uwanka ubugingo bgiwe mur’ iyi si azobuzigama gushitsa ku bugingo budashira.
Ni hagira ūnkorera, n’ankurikire, kand’ aho nzoba ndi, umukozi wanje ni ho azoba: ni hagira ūnkorera, Data azomuha icubahiro.
Umushaha wanje urahagaze: none mvuge iki? Ngire nti Data, n’unkize iki gihe? Yamara ni co canzanye ngo nshike mur’ iki gihe.
Data, shimagiza izina ryawe. Maz’ ijwi riva mw ijuru, riti Ndarishimagije, kandi nzokwongera kurishimagiza.
Ishengero rihagazeho rivyumvise, riti N’umuturagaro. Abandi bati N’umumarayika avuganye na we.
Yesu arabishura, at’ Iryo jwi ntirije kubganje, ariko rije kubganyu.
Non’ ubu iyi si iciriwekw iteka, non’ ubu umutware w’iyi si agira ahindirwe hanze.
Nanje ni namanikwa hejuru y’isi, nzokwikwegerako bose.
Avuga ivyo ar’ukubamenyesha urupfu agira apfe.
Ishengero riramwishura, riti Twebge twumvise mu vyagezwe ko Kristo azohorah’ ibihe bidashira. Non’ uvuze ute ng’ Umwana w’umuntu akwiye kumanikwa? Mbeg’ uwo Mwana w’umuntu ni nde?
Yesu arababgira, ati Hasigaye igihe gito umuco ukiri muri mwebge: ni mugende mugifise umuco, umwiza woye kubīriranirako. Ūgenda mu mwiza ntamenya iy’ aja.
Mugifise umuco, mwizere umuco, ngo mube abana b’umuco. Yesu amaze kuvuga ivyo, arīgīra, arabīhisha.
Ariko naho yakoreye ibimenyetso bingaho imbere yabo, ntibārushe bamwizera,
ngw ijambo ry’uwavugishwa n’Imana Yesaya rishike, ngo, Mwami, ni nde yizeye ico twumvise? Kand’ ukuboko kw’Uhoraho kwahishuriwe nde?
Ni co catumye badashobora kwizera, kuko Yesaya yongeye kuvuga,
ati Yabahumye amaso, yabakomantaje imitima, Kugira ngo boye kubonesha amaso, no gutahurisha imitima, No guhindukira, Ngo mbakize.
Ivyo Yesaya yabivuze, kuko yabonye ubgiza bgiwe, kandi ni we yavuzeko.
Yamara no mu bakuru, benshi baramwizeye; ariko kubg’ Abafarisayo ntibāvyatura, kugira ngo boye gucibga mw isinagogi,
kuko bākunda icubahiro c’abantu kukirutisha icubahiro c’Imana.
Yesu arasemerera, at’ Ūnyizera, si jewe yizeye, ariko yizeye uwantumye:
ūmbonye aba abonye uwantumye.
Naje mw isi nd’ umuco, kugira ng’ ūnyizera wese ntaz’ agume mu mwiza.
Ariko ni hagira uwumva amajambo yanje, ntayazigame, si jewe ndamucirakw iteka; kuko ntāzanywe no gucirakw iteka isi, ariko nazanywe no gukiza isi.
Arik’ ūngaya, ntiyemere amajambo yanje, ari n’ikizomutsindisha: ijambo navuze ni ryo rizomutsindisha ku musi w’umuhero.
Kukw ivyo ntabivuze mvyigeneye, ariko Data yantumye, ni we yangeze ivyo nkwiye kuvuga n’ivyo nkwiye gusigura.
Kandi ndazi yukw ivyo yageze ar’ ubugingo budashira. Nukw ivyo mvuga, mbivuga nk’uko Data yambariye.
Umusi wa Pasika utarashika, Yesu amenye kw igihe ciwe gishitse co kuva mw isi ngw aje kwa Se, uko yakunda abiwe bari mw isi, ni ko yabakunze gushitsa ku muhero.
Bakiriko bararya ku mugoroba, wa Murwanizi amaze kwinjiza ubuguranyi mu mutima wa Yuda Isikaryota, mwene Simoni,
Yesu yar’ azi ko Se yamuhaye vyose yabishize mu maboko yiwe, kandi ko yavuye ku Mana, kandi kw agira asubire ku Mana,
ava hasi mw irīro, akūra umutamana, yābīra icambazo, arakenyera;
araheza asuka amazi mu mubehe, atangura kwoza ibirenge vy’abigishwa, no kubihanaguza icambazo akenyeje.
Nukw ashika kuri Simoni Petero, na we aramubaza, ati Mugenzi, ni wewe unyoza ibirenge?
Yesu aramwishura, at’ Ico jewe ndiko ndakora, wewe nturibukimenye ubu: arik’ uzokimenya hanyuma.
Petero aramubgira, ati Nta ho uzokwigera unyoza ibirenge gushitsa ibihe vyose. Yesu aramwishura, ati Ni ntakwoza, nta ho tuzoba duhūriye.
Simoni Petero aramubgira, ati Mugenzi, ntugarukize ku birenge gusa, arik’ ushikane ku maboko no ku mutwe.
Yesu aramubgira, at’ Uwari yiyuhagiye nta kindi agomba, atar’ ukwoga ibirenge, kukw aba akeye umubiri wose: namwe murakeye, ariko si mwese.
Kuko yar’ azi ūzomugura uw’ ari we; ni co catumye avuga, ati Ntimukeye mwese.
Nukw ahejeje kubōza ibirenge, yābīra umutamana wiwe, yongera kwicara; arababaza, ati Mbega muramenye ico mbagiriye?
Munyita Mwigisha na Shobuja, kandi mubivuga ko, kukw ari ko ndi.
Nuko rero, ko jewe mbogeje ibirenge, ndi Shobuja n’Umwigisha, namwe mukwiye kwozanya ibirenge.
Kuko mbahaye akarorero, kugira ngo nk’uko jewe mbagiriye, abe ari ko namwe mugira.
N’ukuri, n’ukuri ndababgire: Umushumba ntaruta shebuja, kandi n’intumwa ntiruta uwayitumye.
Ni mwamenya ivyo, muzoba muhiriwe ni mwabikora.
Simvuze mwese, kuko nzi abo natoranije, ariko n’ukugira ngw ivyanditswe bishike, ng’ Ūrya ivyo kurya vyanje ni we ambanguriye umugere.
Uhereye ubu ndabibabariye bitaraba, kugira ngw aho bizobera, muze mwizere ko ndi we.
N’ukuri, n’ukuri ndababgire: Uwākīra uwo nzotuma azoba anyakiriye, kand’ ūnyakīra aba yākiriye uwantumye.
Yesu avuze ivyo, ahagarika umutima, abivuga avyataguye, ati N’ukuri, n’ukuri ndababgire: Umwe muri mwebge agira angure.
Abigishwa bararābana, bazazaniwe uwo avuze uw’ ari we.
Hārih’ umwe mu bigishwa biwe yari yegamiye mu gikiriza ca Yesu bariko bararya, umwe Yesu yakunda.
Simoni Petero amuvunira akagohe, ati Tubgire uwo avuze uw’ ari we.
Uyo rero ahengamira inyuma, uko yari hano nyene mu gikiriza ca Yesu, aramubaza, ati Ni nde ga Mugenzi?
Yesu aramwishura, at’ Uwo nkorezamw’ intore, nkayimuha, azoba ari we. Akojejemw’ intore, arayikūramwo, ayihereza Yuda, mwene Simoni Isikaryota.
Hanyuma y’iyo ntore, Satani aca yinjira muri we. Nuko Yesu aramubarira, at’ Ico ukora, gikore n’ingoga.
Ariko mur’ abo bicaranye nta n’umwe yamenye ico abimubgiriye.
Ariko kuko Yuda ari we yar’ afise umupfuko, bamwe bāgize ngo Yesu yamubgiye, ngo Gura ibizodukwira ku musi mukuru, canke ngw agire ico aha aboro.
Na we amaze kwābīra intore, aca asohoka ako kanya: kandi hāri mw ijoro.
Nukw amaze gusohoka, Yesu aravuga, ati Noneh’ Umwana w’umuntu arashimagijwe, kand’ Imana ishimagirijwe muri we.
Kand’ Imana, kw ishimagirijwe muri we, na yo izomushimagiriza muri yo, kand’ izomushimagiza vuba.
Bana bato, ndacari kumwe namwe akanya gato. Muzondondera, ariko, nk’uko nabgiye Abayuda, nt’ Aho nja ntimushobora gushikayo, ni ko none ndababgira namwe.
Ndabaha icagezwe gisha: ni mukundane; nk’uko nabakunze, abe ari ko namwe mukundana.
Ni mwagiriranira urukundo, ni ho bose bazomenya ko mur’ abigishwa banje.
Simoni Petero aramubaza, ati Mugenzi, uja hehe? Yesu aramwishura, at’ Aho nja ntushobora kunkurikira ubu, arik’ uzonkurikira hanyuma.
Petero aramubaza, ati Mugenzi, n’iki kimbuza kugukurikira n’ubu? Erega nzonakwigura.
Yesu aramwishura, at’ Ugize ng’ uzonyigura? N’ukuri, n’ukuri ndakubgire: Inkoko itarabika, uhava unyihakana gatatu.
Ntimuhagarike imitima yanyu, mwizere Imana, nanje munyizere.
I muhira kwa Data har’ amazu menshi, iy’ aba atariho, mba ndabibabgiye, kuko ngiye kubategurira ahanyu.
Kandi ko ngiye kubategurira ahanyu, nzogaruka kubajana i wanje, ngw aho ndi namwe abe ari ho muba.
Kand’ iyo nja murazi inzira ijayo.
Toma aramubgira, ati Mugenzi, ntituzi iy’ uja, dushobora dute kumenya inzira?
Yesu aramubgira, ati Ni jewe nzira n’ukuri n’ubugingo: nta wushika kuri Data ntamujanye.
Iyo muba mwarammenye, na Data muba mumuzi. Uhereye ubu muramuzi, kandi mwamubonye.
Filipo aramubgira, ati Mugenzi, twereke So, bizoba bihaye.
Yesu aramubaza, ati Mbega ko nabanye namwe igihe kingana girtyo, nturakaruha ummenya ga Filipo? Ūbonye jewe aba abonye Data: non’ uvuga ute ngo Twereke So?
Ntiwizeye ko jewe ndi muri Data, na Data ari muri jewe? Amajambo mbabgira s’ayo nigeneye, ariko Data aba muri jewe ni we akora ibikorwa vyiwe.
Ni munyizere ko ndi muri Data, na Data ari muri jewe, bibuze, mupfe kwizera kubg’ ibikorwa ubgavyo.
N’ukuri, n’ukuri ndababgire: Ūnyizera, ibikorwa jewe nkora na we azobikora: kand’ azokora ibibiruta, kuko jewe ngiye kwa Data.
Kand’ ico muzosaba cose mw izina ryanje nzogikora, kugira ngo Se ashimagizwe mu Mwana.
Ni mwagira ico musaba mw izina ryanje, nzogikora.
Ni mwankunda, muzokwitondera ivyagezwe vyanje,
nanje nzosaba Data, na we azobaha uwundi Mwitsa, ngw az’ abane namwe ibihe bidashira,
ni we Mpwemu w’ukuri, uwo ab’ isi badashobora kwākīra, kuko batamubona, kandi batamuzi; mweho muramuzi, kukw abana namwe kand’ azoba muri mwebge.
Sinzobasiga nk’impfuvyi, nzoza kuri mwebge.
Hasigaye igihe gito, ab’ isi ntibabe bakimbona, ariko mweho muzombona; kuko ndiho, namwe muzobaho.
Uwo musi muzomenya ko ndi muri Data, namwe muri muri jewe, nanje ndi muri mwebge.
Ūri n’ivyagezwe vyanje akavyitondera, uwo ni we ankunda, kand’ ūnkunda azokundwa na Data, nanje nzomukunda, kandi nzomwihishurira.
Yuda (atari Isikaryota), aramubaza, ati Mugenzi, bibaye bite, k’ugira wihishurire twebge, ntiwihishurire ab’ isi?
Yesu aramwishura, ati Ni hagira ūnkunda, azokwitondera ijambo ryanje, kandi Data azomukunda, maze tuzoza kuri we, tubane na we.
Ūtankunda ntiyitondera amajambo yanje, kand’ ijambo mwumva s’iryanje, ariko n’irya Data yantumye.
Ivyo ndabibabariye nkiri kumwe namwe,
arik’ Umwitsa, ari we Mpwemu Yera, uwo Data azorungika mw izina ryanje, ni we azobigisha vyose, kand’ azobibutsa ivyo nababariye vyose.
Amahoro ndayabasigaranye, amahoro yanje ndayabagabiye. Jeho simbagabira nk’ukw ab’ isi bagaba. Imitima yanyu ntihagarare, kandi ntitinye.
Mwumvise ko nababgiye, nti Ndagiye, ariko nzobagarukako. Iyo muba munkunda, muba munezerejwe n’uko ngiye kwa Data, kuko Data ari we anduta.
Nuko none ndabibabgiye bitaraba, ngw aho bizobera muze mwizere.
Sinkivugana namwe vyinshi, kuk’ umwami w’isi ari mu kuza, yamara muri jewe nta kintu ahafise;
ariko n’ukugira ngw ab’ isi bamenye ko nkunda Data, kand’ uko Data yangeze kw ari ko nkora. Ve hasi, tuve hano tugende.
Jewe nd’umuzabibu w’ukuri, kandi Data ni nyene wo.
Ishami ryose ryo muri jewe ritāma, arikūraho; kand’ iryama ryose araritūtūrira, ngo rirushirize kwama.
N’ubu mwebge mumaze kwezwa kubg’ ijambo nababgiye.
Ni mugume muri jewe, nanje ngume muri mwebge. Nk’ukw ishami ritabasha kwama ubgaryo, ritagumye mu muzabibu, ni ko namwe mutabibasha, mutagumye muri jewe.
Ni jewe muzabibu, namwe mur’ amashami: ūguma muri jewe, nanje nkaguma muri we, uwo ni we yama cane, kukw ata co mubasha gukora mutamfise.
Umuntu n’ataguma muri jewe atabga nk’ukw’ ishami ritererwa inyuma y’uruzabibu, akuma; maze bakayatororokanya, bakayaterera mu muriro, agasha.
Ni mwaguma muri jewe, amajambo yanje akaguma muri mwebge, musabe ico mugomba cose, kizobabera kuno.
Mur’ ivyo Data arashimagizwa, ni mwama cane, kandi mukaba abigishwa banje.
Nk’uko Data yankunze, ni ko nanje nabakunze: ni mugume mu rukundo rwanje.
Ni mwitondera ivyagezwe vyanje, muzoguma mu rukundo rwanje, nk’uko nanje nitondeye ivyagezwe vya Data, nkaguma mu rukundo rwiwe.
Ivyo mbibabgiye, kugira ng’umunezero wanje ube muri mwebge, kandi n’umunezero wanyu wuzuzwe.
Ngiki icagezwe canje: ni mukundane, nk’uko nabakunze.
Nta wogira urukundo ruruta urw’ uk’ umuntu yigura abakunzi biwe.
Mur’ abakunzi banje, ni mwakora ivyo mbagera.
Sinkibita abashumba, kuk’ umushumba atamenya ico shebuja akora; ariko mweho nabise abakunzi, kukw ivyo numvanye Data vyose nabibamenyesheje.
Si mwebge mwantoranije, ariko ni jewe nabatoranije, nabashizeho kugira ngo mugende murāma imbuto, kandi ngw imbuto zanyu zigumeho, kugira ngw ico muzosaba Data cose mw izina ryanje, akibahe.
Ivyo ndabibageze kugira ngo mukundane.
Isi ni yabanka, mumenye ko jewe yabanje kunyanka, itarabanka.
Iyo muba ab’ isi, isi iba ikunze icayo, maze kuko mutar’ ab’ isi, ariko nabatoranije mu b’isi, ni co gituma isi ibanka.
Mwibuke rya jambo nababgiye, nt’ Umushumba ntaruta shebuja; namba bārampamye, namwe bazobahama; namba bāritondeye ijambo ryanje, n’iryanyu bazoryitondera.
Arikw ivyo vyose bazobibagirira babahōra izina ryanje, kuko batazi uwantumye.
Iyo ntaba naraje ngo ngire ico mbabarira, nta caha baba bafise, ariko none ntibari n’ico bireguza icaha cabo.
Ūnyanka aba yanka na Data.
Iyo ntaba narakoreye ibikorwa muri bo bitigeze gukorwa n’uwundi, nta caha baba bafise, ariko noneho twe na Data baratubonye, baraheza baratwanka.
Ariko vyabaye birtyo kugira ngw ijambo ryanditswe mu vyagezwe vyabo rishike, ngo Bānyankiye ubusa.
Arik’ Umwitsa ah’ azozira, uwo nzobarungikira ava kuri Data, ni we Mpwemu w’ukuri akomoka kuri Data, uwo ni we azonshingira intahe,
kandi namwe nyene muranshingira intahe, kuko mwari kumwe nanje uhereye mbere na mbere.
Ico mbabaririye ivyo, n’ukugira ngo ntimuze mutsitazwe.
Bazobaca mu masinagogi, kand’ igihe kigiye kuza, ūzobīca wese azogira ngw agiriye Imana ikimazi.
Kand’ ivyo bazobikora kuko batamenye Data, nanje ntibāmmenye.
Ico mbabaririye ivyo, n’ukugira ngw igihe cavyo ni cashika, muze muvyibuke ko nanje nabibabgiye. Uhereye ubga mbere sinaribgabibabgire, kuko nari nkiri kumwe namwe.
None ngira ngende ku wantumye, kandi nta n’umwe muri mwebge arushe ambaza at’ Uja hehe?
Ariko kuko mbabariye ivyo, umubabaro waciye wuzura mu mitima yanyu.
Ariko jewe ndababgira ukuri: Ikizogira ico kibamarira, n’uko jewe ngenda; kuko ni ntagenda, Umwitsa ntazoza kuri mwebge: ariko ni nagenda nzomubarungikira.
Uwo ni yaza, azohinyuza ab’ isi, abemeze ivy’ icaha, n’ivy’ ukugororoka, n’ivy’ amateka;
ivy’ icaha, kuko batānyizeye,
ivy’ ukugororoka, kuko nja kwa Data, kandi namwe muzoba mutakimbona,
ivy’ amateka, kuk’ umwami w’iyi si yaciriwekw iteka.
Nari ngifise vyinshi vyo kubabgira, ariko ntimushobora kuvyihanganira ubu.
Arik’ uwo Mpwemu w’ukuri ni yaza, azobarōngōra abashitse ku kuri kwose, kukw atazovuga ivyo yigeneye, arikw ivy’ azokwumva vyose ni vyo azovuga, kand’ azobamenyesha ibigira bize.
Uwo azoshimagiza jewe, kukw azokwābīra ku vyanje, akabibamenyesha.
Ivyo Data afise vyose n’ivyanje, ni co gitumye mvuga, nti Yābīra ku vyanje, akabibamenyesha.
Hasigaye igihe gito ntimube mukimbona, maze hazoca ikindi gihe gito musubire kumbona.
Bamwe mu bigishwa biwe barabazanya, bati Mbeg’ ivyo atubgiye n’ibiki ngo Hasigaye igihe gito ntimube mukimbona, ngo Maze hazoca ikindi gihe gito musubire kumbona, kandi ngo Kuko nja kwa Data?
Kandi bat’ Ivyo atubgiye n’ibiki, ngw Igihe gito? Ntitumenye ico avuze ic’ ari co.
Yesu amenya ko bagomba kumubaza, arababaza, ati Mbega mubazanya ic’ ari co, ko mbabariye nti Hasigaye igihe gito ntimube mukimbona, nti Maze hazoca ikindi gihe gito musubire kumbona?
N’ukuri, n’ukuri ndababgire: Mweho muzorira muboroge, arikw ab’ isi bo bazonezerwa; mweho muzobabara, arik’ umubabaro wanyu uzocika umunezero.
Umugore iy’ aramutswe, aja mu mubabaro, kukw igihe ciwe kigeze, arikw iy’ umwana amaze kuvuka ntaba acibuka kugorwa kwiwe, kukw anezerejwe n’uk’ umuntu avutse mw isi.
Ni ko namwe muri mu mubabaro, ariko nzosubira kubabona, kand’ imitima yanyu izonezerwa, umunezero wanyu nta n’umwe azowubanyaga.
Kur’ uwo musi nta na kimwe muzombaza. N’ukuri, n’ukuri ndababgire: Ni hagira ico musaba Data cose azokibaha mw izina ryanje.
Kugeza ubu nta co mwasavye mw izina ryanje; musabe muzohabga, ng’umunezero wanyu wuzuzwe.
Ivyo mbibabgiriye mu migani, arikw igihe kizoza sinzoba ngisubira kuvuganira namwe mu migani, mugabo nzobabgira ivya Data mbifoboye.
Kur’ uwo musi muzosaba mw izina ryanje, kandi simbabgira ngo nzobasabira Data.
Kuko Data na we ubgiwe abakunda, kuko mwankunze kandi mwizeye ko naturutse ku Mana.
Navuye kwa Data, nza mw isi; ikindi, isi ndiko ndayivamwo, nje kwa Data.
Abigishwa biwe baravuga, bat’ Ubuho urabifoboye, nta mugani uduciriye.
Ubuho tumenye k’uzi vyose, kandi ko kubgawe utarinda ko hogira ūkubaza; ni co gituma twizera ko waturutse ku Mana.
Yesu arabishura, ati Mbega noneho murizeye?
Igihe kigira kize, mbere kirashitse, aho muhava musābagira, umuntu wese aje mu vyiwe, munte jenyene, ariko sindi jenyene, kuko Data ari kumwe nanje.
Ivyo mbibabgiye, kugira ngo mugire amahoro muri jewe. Mw isi muri n’amarushwa, ariko ni muhūmure, jewe naranesheje isi.
Yesu avuze ivyo, arangamiza mw ijuru, ati Data, igihe kirashitse: shimagiza Umwana wawe, ng’ Umwana agushimagize;
nk’uko wamuhaye ububasha ku bafise umubiri bose, ngw abo wamuhaye bose abahe ubugingo budashira.
Ubu ni bgo bugingo budashira, ko bamenya wewe, Imana yonyene y’ukuri, n’uwo watumye, Yesu Kristo.
Nagushimagije mw isi, nnonosoye igikorwa wampaye gukora.
Na none Data, unshimagizanye nawe, unshimagirishije bga bgiza nahoranye ndi kumwe nawe, isi itararemwa.
Nahishuriye izina ryawe abantu wampaye mu b’isi; bar’ abawe, urabampa, kandi bitondeye ijambo ryawe.
None bamenye yukw ivyo wampaye vyose biva kuri wewe:
kukw amajambo wampaye nayabahaye, na bo bakayākīra, bakamenya vy’ukuri ko naturutse kuri wewe; bakizera kw ari wewe wantumye.
Ndabasabira; sinsabira ab’ isi, ariko nsabira abo wampaye, kukw ar’ abawe;
kand’ ivyanje vyose n’ivyawe, n’ivyawe na vyo n’ivyanje, kandi nashimagijwe muri bo.
Sinkiri mw isi, ariko bo bari mw isi, nanje ndaje kuri wewe. Data wera, ubazigamire mw izina ryawe wampaye, ngo babe umwe nk’uko natwe turi.
Nkiri kumwe na bo, nabazigamiye mw izina ryawe wampaye. Narabashibamyeko, kandi nta n’umwe muri bo yapfuye rubi, atari wa mwana wo gupfa rubi, kugira ngw ivyanditswe bishike.
Ariko none ndaje kuri wewe, kand’ ibi mbivuga ndi mw isi, kugira ngo bagire umunezero wanje wuzure muri bo.
Nabahaye ijambo ryawe; kand’ ab’ isi barabanka, kukw atar’ ab’ isi, nk’uko nanje ntar’ uw’ isi.
Singusaba ng’ ubakūre mw isi, ariko ng’ ubarinde wa Mubi.
S’ab’ isi, nk’uko nanje ntar’ uw’ isi.
Ubeze mu kuri: ijambo ryawe ni ryo kuri.
Nk’uko wantumye mw isi, ni ko nanje nabatumye mw isi:
kandi nanje niyeza kubgabo, kugira ngo na bo babe bejejwe mu kuri.
Sinsabira aba gusa, ariko ndasabira n’abo bazonyizera kubg’ ijambo ry’aba,
kugira ngo bose babe umwe, nk’uko wewe, Data, uri muri jewe, nanje nkaba muri wewe, ngo na bo abe ari ko baba muri twebge, ngw isi yizere kw ari wewe wantumye.
Nanje nabahaye ubgiza wampaye, ngo babe umwe, nk’uko natwe tur’ umwe.
Jewe mbe muri bo, nawe ube muri jewe, ngo bahīngūrwe babe umwe, kugira ngw isi imenye kw ari wewe wantumye, ukabakunda, nk’uko wankunze.
Data, abo wampaye ndagomba kw aho ndi na bo bahabana nanje, ngo barābe ubgiza bganje wampaye, kuko wankunze itanguriro ry’isi ritarashirwaho.
Data ugororotse, isi ntiyakumenye, ariko jewe narakumenye, n’aba na bo bamenye kw ari wewe wantumye.
Nabamenyesheje izina ryawe, kandi nzoribamenyesha, ng’ urukundo wankunze rube muri bo, nanje mbe muri bo.
Yesu avuze ivyo, avanayo n’abigishwa biwe afata hakurya y’umugezi witwa Kidironi; aho hār’ itongo: ashikaho, bo n’abigishwa biwe.
Kandi na Yuda amugura yar’ azi aho hantu, kuko Yesu yahora ajanayo n’abigishwa biwe kenshi.
Nuko Yuda amaze guhabga n’abaherezi bakuru n’Abafarisayo ingabo z’abasoda, bo n’abagendanyi, ajayo, bari n’amatara n’ibimuri n’ibirwanishwa.
Nuko Yesu amenye ibigira bimubeko vyose, arabasanganira, arababaza, ati Murondera nde?
Na bo baramwishura, bati Yesu Umunyanazareti. Arababgira, ati Ni jewe. Kandi Yuda, amugura, yar’ ahagararanye na bo.
Amaze kubabarira, ati Ni jewe, bagenza imigongo, bagwa hasi.
Na we asubira kubabaza, ati Murondera nde? Na bo bati Yesu Umunyanazareti.
Yesu arabishura, ati Mbabgiye kw ari jewe: asangw’ ari jewe murondera, mureke aba, bīgīre.
Ukwo kwar’ ukugira ngo rya jambo yavuze rishike, ngo Mu bo wampaye nta n’umwe najimije.
Simoni Petero yari n’inkota, arayisokōra, aca ugutwi kw’i buryo kw’umuntu w’umuherezi mukuru: uwo muntu yitwa Malikusi.
Maze Yesu abarira Petero, ati Subiza inkota mu rwubati: mbeg’ igikombe Data yampaye ndeke kukinywa?
Nukw abasoda n’umukuru w’abagabisha babo n’abagendanyi b’Abayuda bafata Yesu, baramuboha,
babanza kumujana kwa Anasi, kuko yari sebukwe wa Kayafa umuherezi mukuru wo mur’ uwo mwaka.
Kandi Kayafa ni we yari yagīriye inama Abayuda, yukw ar’ ibibereye k’umuntu umwe apfira ubgo bgoko.
Simoni Petero akurikira Yesu, bo n’uwundi mwigishwa. Uwo mwigishwa yar’ azinanyi n’umuherezi mukuru, ashikana na Yesu mu rugo rw’uwo muherezi mukuru,
ariko Petero asigara ahagaze kw irembo. Wa wundi mwigishwa yar’ azinanyi n’umuherezi mukuru, ashika kw irembo, avugana n’umukumirizi, araheza ashikana Petero imbere.
Maz’ iyo ncoreke ikumīra ibaza Petero, iti Mbega nawe uri mu bigishwa b’uyo muntu? Petero at’ Oya, sindimwo.
Abashumba n’abagendanyi bāri bahagaze bacanye umuriro w’amakara, kuko hār’ imbeho, bariko barōta; kandi Petero na we yari kumwe na bo, ahagaze yōta.
Nuk’ umuherezi mukuru asiguza Yesu ivy’ abigishwa biwe n’inyigisho ziwe.
Yesu aramwishura, ati Nabarira ab’ isi mvyeruye, nahora nigishiriza mu masinagogi no mu rusengero ah’ Abayuda bose bakoranira, nta co navugiye mu mpisho.
Umbarije iki? Baza abāhora bavyumva ico nababariye: erega ni bo bazi ivyo navuze.
Avuze artyo, umwe mu bagendanyi ahagazeho akubita Yesu urushi, at’ Uko ni ko wishura umuherezi mukuru?
Yesu aramubaza, ati Namba mvuze nabi, nyagiriza ico kibi; ariko namb’ ari neza, unkubitiye iki?
Nuko Anasi amurungika aboshwe kwa Kayafa umuherezi mukuru.
Simoni Petero yar’ ahagaze yōta; nuko baramubaza, bati Mbega nawe uri mu bigishwa biwe? Na we arahakana, at’ Oya, sindimwo.
Umwe mu bashumba b’umuherezi mukuru, yar’ incuti y’umwe Petero yaciye ugutwi, aramubaza, ati Sinakubonye uri kumwe na we muri rya tongo?
Maze Petero yongera kubihakana, ako kanya inkoko ica irabika.
Bakūra Yesu kwa Kayafa, bamujana mw iboma: hāri mu mutwenzi. Arik’ ubgabo ntibinjira mw iboma, ngo boye kwihumanya, kugira ngo babone ingene barya Pasika.
Kubg’ ivyo Pilato arasohoka aja aho bari, arababaza, at’ Ikirego mufise kur’ uyu muntu n’igiki?
Baramwishura, bat’ Ugira ng’ uyu, iyaba atākoze ibibi tuba tumukuzaniye?
Nuko Pilato arababgira, ati Ni mumujane mwebge, mumucire urubanza nk’ukw ivyagezwe vyanyu bivuga. Abayuda baramwishura, bat’ Erega twebge ntitwemererwa kwica umuntu.
Ngw ijambo rya Yesu rishike, iryo yavuze abamenyesha urupfu azopfa urw’ ari rwo.
Nuko Pilato asubira mw iboma, ahamagaza Yesu, aramubaza, ati Ni wewe Mwami w’Abayuda?
Yesu ati Mbeg’ ivyo ubibajije kubgawe, canke n’abandi bakubariye ivyanje?
Pilato ati Mbega nanje nd’ Umuyuda? Ab’ ubgoko bganyu n’abaherezi bakuru ni bo bakunzaniye. Wakoze iki?
Yesu aramwishura, at’ Ubgami bganje s’ubgo mur’ iyi si; iyaba ubgami bganje bgar’ ubgo mur’ iyi si, abagendanyi banje baba bārwanye, ngo simpabge Abayuda. Ariko noneh’ ubgami bganje s’ubg’ ino.

Nuko Pilato aramubaza, at’ Ubgo wewe ur’ umwami? Yesu ati Ni wewe uvyivugiye ko nd’ umwami. Iki ni co navukiye, kand’ iki ni co canzanye mw isi, n’ukugira ngo nshingire intahe ukuri. Uw’ ukuri wese yumva ijwi ryanje.
Pilato aramubaza, ati Mbeg’ ukuri n’iki? Amaze kuvuga ivyo, asubira gusohoka, aja ah’ Abayuda bari, arababgira, ati Jewe nta gicumuro mbonye kuri we.
Ariko musanganywe umugenzo ko mbarekurira umwe mu misi ya Pasika: none muragomba ko mbarekurira umwami w’Abayuda?
Nuko basubira gusemerera, bati S’uyo, ariko turekurire Baraba. Yamara Baraba yar’ umwambuzi.
Maze Pilato afata Yesu, aramukubitisha.
Abasoda na bo batsiba igitsibo c’amahwa bakimwambika mu mutwe, baraheza bamwambika impuzu y’inyambarabami.
Baramwēgēra, bati Ndagize bgakeye, Mwami w’Abayuda. Maze baramubīngūra.
Maze Pilato asubira gusohoka, arababgira, at’ Ehe ndamusohokanye aho muri, ngo mumenye kw ata gicumuro mbonye kuri we.
Nuko Yesu asohoka yambaye ico gitsibo c’amahwa na ya mpuzu y’inyambarabami. Pilato arababgira, at’ Ehe rāba uwo muntu!
Maz’ abaherezi bakuru n’abagendanyi bamubonye, barasemerera, bati Mubambe, mubambe. Pilato arababgira, ati Ni mube ari mwebge mumwishorerera, mumubambe, kuko jewe ata gicumuro mbonye kuri we.
Abayuda baramwishura, bati Twebge dufise icagezwe, kandi kubg’ ico cagezwe akwiye gupfa, kuko yigize Umwana w’Imana.
Nuko Pilato yumvise iryo jambo, arushiriza gutinya;
asubira kwinjira mw iboma, abaza Yesu, at’ Ur’ uwa hehe? Ariko Yesu ntiyamwishura na rimwe.
Nuko Pilato aramubaza, ati Nta co umbarira? Ntuzi yuko mfise ububasha bgo kukurekura, kandi mfise ububasha bgo kukubamba?
Yesu aramwishura, ati Nta bubasha war’ ufise kuri jewe, shit’ ubuhawe buvuye hejuru, ni co gituma uwakunshikirije afise icaha kirengeje.
Uhereye aho Pilato arondera uburyo bg’uko yomurekura, arikw Abayuda barasemerera, bati Ni warekura uyo, ntuzoba ucuzura na Kayisari, kuk’ uwīgira umwami wese aba agararije Kayisari.
Nuko Pilato yumvise ayo magambo, asohora Yesu, yicara ku ntebe y’imanza, yar’ ahantu hitwa Musezero w’amabuye, mu Giheburayo hitwa Gabata.
War’ umusi wo kwitegurira Pasika, hari nk’isaha zitandatu. Abgira Abayuda, at’ Ehe rāba umwami wanyu.
Na bo barasemerera, bati Mukūreho, mukūreho, umubambe. Pilato arababaza, ati Mbambe umwami wanyu? Abaherezi bakuru bati Nta mwami dufise, atari Kayisari.
Araheza aramubahereza, ngw abambge. Nuko basūmira Yesu.
Avayo, yiyikorereye umusaraba, ashika ahantu hitwa Nyagihanga, mu Giheburayo hitwa Gologota;
bamubambaho, hamwe n’abandi babiri, umwe hirya, uwundi hino, Yesu yari hagati.
Pilato yandika icandiko, agishira ku musaraba; canditswe ngo YESU UMUNYANAZARETI UMWAMI W’ABAYUDA.
Benshi mu Bayuda bāsoma ico candiko, kukw aho hantu Yesu yabambge hari hafi y’igisagara; kandi cari canditswe mu Giheburayo no mu Kiroma no mu Kigiriki.
Nukw Abaherezi bakuru b’Abayuda babgira Pilato, bati Nta co wandika ng’ Umwami w’Abayuda, arik’ uti Yivuze ngo Ni jewe Mwami w’Abayuda.
Pilato arabishura, at’ Ico nanditse, nacanditse.

Nukw abasoda, bamaze kubamba Yesu, bābīra impuzu ziwe, bazigaburamw’ imigabane ine, umusoda wese umugabane wiwe; hasigara umwinjiro. Kand’ uwo mwinjiro ntiwar’ ufise umubarīro, war’ ujishwe kumwe, uhereye hejuru kugeza hasi.
Nuko baravugana, bati Twoye kuwutabura, tuwupfindire, ugire ūwegukiye. Kwar’ ukugira ngw ivyanditswe bishike, ngo Bagabuye impuzu zanje, Bapfindira umwambaro wanje. Ivyo ni kw abasoda babikoze.
Arikw i ruhande y’umusaraba wa Yesu hāri hahagaze nyina na nyinabo na Mariya muka Kilopa na Mariya Magadalene.
Yesu abonye nyina na wa mwigishwa yakunda ahagazeho, abarira nyina, ati Nyina wanje, nguyo umwana wawe.
Maz’ abarira wa mwigishwa, ati Nguyo nyoko. Uhereye ako kanya uwo mwigishwa amujana i we.
Hanyuma y’ivyo Yesu amenye yuko noneho vyose birangiye, kugira ngw icanditswe gishike, aravuga, ati Mfise inyota.
Aho hantu hari hateretse inkono yuzuye inkarisha, nuko bashira sipongo yuzuyemw’ inkarisha kw irenga, bayirungika ku munwa wiwe.
Yesu amaze kuyihabga, aravuga, ati Birarangiye. Araheza ajondamika umutwe, umutima uraca.

Uwo musi war’ uwo kwitegurira Pasika; nuko kugira ngw abābambge ntibagume ku misaraba kw isabato, kuk’ uwo musi w’isabato wari mukuru, Abayuda basaba Pilato ngw amaguru yabo avunwe, kandi ngo babambūrwe.
Maz’ abasoda baraza, bavuna amaguru y’uwa mbere n’ay’ uwundi yabambanywe na we.
Ariko bashitse kuri Yesu, babonye amaze gupfa, ntibāba bakimuvuna amaguru,
arik’ umwe mu basoda amucumita icumu mu rubavu; ako kanya hava amaraso n’amazi.
Uwabibonye ni we yabishingiye intahe kand’ intahe yiwe n’iy’ ukuri, kand’ arazi kw avuga ukuri, kugira ngo namwe mwizere.
Kukw ivyo vyabayeho kugira ngw icanditswe gishike, ngo Nta n’igufa ryiwe rizovunwa.
Kandi har’ ikindi canditswe, kivuga ngo Bazobona uwo bācumise.
Hanyuma y’ivyo Yosefu Umunyarimataya, yar’ umwigishwa wa Yesu, ariko mu mpisho, kubgo gutinya Abayuda, yaka Pilato ikiziga ca Yesu ngw akijane: Pilato aremera; nukw araza ajana ikiziga ciwe.
Kandi haza na Nikodemo, umwe yaza kuri Yesu mw ijoro ubga mbere, azana ikivange c’isenga n’imbazi nk’ibilo mirongwitanu.
Nuko bābīra ikiziga ca Yesu, bakizingira mu mpuzu zera derere, hamwe n’ivyo bimota neza, nk’uk’ umugenzo w’Abayuda wo guhamba war’ uri.
Kand’ aho hantu yabambge hār’ itongo; kandi mur’ iryo tongo hār’ imva nsha itarahambgamw’ umuntu;
aho ni ho bāhamvye Yesu, kuko war’ umusi wo kwitegura kw’ Abayuda, kand’ iyo mva ikaba hafi.
Ku wa mbere w’imisi ndwi mu gahuru, hatarabona, Mariya Magadalene aja ku mva, abona ikibuye gikūwe ku mva;
agenda ariruka ashikīra Simoni Petero na wa mwigishwa wundi Yesu yakunda, arababgira, ati Bākūye Umwami Yesu mu mva, kandi ntituzi aho bāmushize.
Nuko Petero arasohoka, na wa mwigishwa wundi, baja ku mva.
Bompi birukira icarimwe, kandi wa mwigishwa wundi asiga Petero, amutanga ku mva.
Yunamye, arungurutseyo, abona za mpuzu zera derere zirambitseho, ariko ntiyinjira.
Maze Simoni Petero arashika amukurikiye, yinjira mu mva, abona za mpuzu zirambitseho,
n’igitambara cari mu mutwe wiwe, kitarambitse hamwe na za mpuzu, ariko kizinze kir’ ahaco ukwa conyene.
Ni ho hinjiye wa mwigishwa wundi na we, umwe yabanje gushika ku mva, abibonye arizera.
Kuko bataribgamenye ivyanditswe yukw akwiye kuzozuka mu bapfuye.
Maz’ abo bigishwa bavayo basubira i wabo.
Mariya yar’ ahagaze ku mva arira. Akirikw ararira, arunama, arunguruka mu mva,
abona abamarayika babiri bambaye impuzu zera, bicaye umwe ku mutwe, uwundi mu mirambizo y’ah’ ikiziga ca Yesu cari kiryamye.
Baramubaza, bati Mbega nyina wanje, urizwa n’iki? Na we ati N’uko bakūyeh’ Umwami wanje, nanje nkaba ntazi aho bamushize.
Avuze ivyo, arakebuka, abona Yesu ahagaze, ariko ntiyamenya kw ari Yesu.
Yesu aramubaza, ati Mbega nyina wanje, urizwa n’iki? Urondera nde? Na we yiyumvira kw ar’ umurimyi waho, aramubgira, ati Mugenzi, namb’ ari wewe wamukūye hano, ndangira aho wamushize, ndamukūreyo.
Yesu aramuhamagara, ati Mariya. Na we arahindukira, amwitaba mu Giheburayo, ati Rabuni (risobanurwa ngo Mwigisha).
Yesu aramubgira, ati Ntunkoreko, kuko ntaradūga kwa Data; ariko genda kwa bene Data, ubabarire, ut’ Agira adūge kwa Se ari we So, uti Ku Mana yiwe ari yo Mana yanyu.
Mariya Magadalene aragenda, abarira abigishwa inkuru, ati Nabonye Umwami; abadondera ivyo yamubariye.
Nuko kur’ uwo musi buhwibiriye, ni wo musi wa mbere w’imisi ndwi, inzugi zāri zugaye ah’ abigishwa bari, kubgo gutinya Abayuda, Yesu araza abahagarara hagati, arababgira, at’ Amahoro abe muri mwebge.
Amaze kuvuga artyo, abereka ibiganza vyiwe no mu rubavu. Maz’ abigishwa baranezerwa, babonye Umwami.
Yesu yongera kubabgira, at’ Amahoro abe muri mwebge. Nk’uko Data yantumye ni ko nanje mbatumye.
Avuze ivyo, abahumekerako, ati Ni mwākīre Mpwemu Yera.
Kand’ abo muzoharira ivyaha bose, bazoba babihariwe; arikw abo mutazobiharira bose, ntibazoba babihariwe.
Ariko Toma ari we Hasa, umwe wo muri bamwe cumi na babiri, ntiyari kumwe na bo aho Yesu yaza.

Abandi bigishwa baramubgira, bati Twabonye Umwami. Na we arabishura, ati Ni ntabona inkovu z’imambo mu biganza vyiwe, ngo nkoze urutoke rwanje mu nkovu z’imambo, ngo nshire urushi mu rubavu rwiwe, sinemera.
Maz’ imisi munani ishize abigishwa bāri mu nzu ukundi gusha, na Toma bāri kumwe. Yesu araza, inzugi zari zugaye, abahagarara hagati, at’ Amahoro abe muri mwebge.
Maz’ abgira Toma, ati Zana hano urutoke rwawe, urābe ibiganza vyanje; zana n’urushi, urushire mu rubavu rwanje, nta co uba ūtizera, arik’ ube uwizeye.
Toma aramwishura, ati Mwami wanje, kandi Mana yanje.
Yesu aramubgira, ati Wijejwe n’uk’ umbonye. Hahirwa abatarinze kubona, yamara bakizera.
Hariho n’ibindi bimenyetso vyinshi Yesu yakoreye imbere y’abigishwa, bitanditswe mur’ iki gitabo.
Arikw ibi vyandikiwe kugira ngo mwizere yuko Yesu ari we Kristo, Umwana w’Imana, no kugira ngo mwizeye mugire ubugingo mw izina ryiwe.
Hanyuma y’ivyo Yesu yiyereka abigishwa ukundi gusha, ari ku kiyaga c’i Tiberiya, kand’ uburyo yiyerekanye n’ubu:
Simoni Petero na Toma ari we Hasa bāri kumwe na Natanayeli w’i Kana i Galilaya, na bene Zebedayo, n’abandi bigishwa babiri.
Simoni Petero arababgira, ati Ndagiye kuroba. Na bo bati Natwe turajana nawe. Barīkora, batambukira mu bgato. Mur’ iryo joro ntibāgira ico bafata.
Umutwenzi ugitambika, Yesu ahagarara ku musenyi, arikw abigishwa ntibāmenya kw ari Yesu.
Nuko Yesu arababaza, ati Bana, har’ ico kurya mufise? Bat’ Oya.
Arababgira, ati Ni muterere urusenga i buryo bg’ubgato, muraronka. Nuko baraterera, ntibāba bakibasha kurukwega, kukw ifi zar’ isinzi.
Wa mwigishwa Yesu yakunda abgira Petero, ati N’Umwami Yesu. Simoni Petero yumvise kw ar’ Umwami, akenyera impuzu, kuko yari gusa, araheza yikubita mu kiyaga.
Arikw abandi bigishwa baza mu bgato, kuko bari hafi y’umusenyi, hāri nk’intambuko ijana, bakwega urusenga rurimw’ ifi.
Bafashe i musozi, babonah’ umuriro w’amakara n’ifi zigeretseko, n’umutsima.
Yesu arababgira, ati Ni muzane ifi ku zo muhejeje kuroba.
Simoni Petero aja mu bgato, akwegera urusenga i musozi rwuzuye ifi nini‐nini ijana na mirongwitanu na zitatu: kandi naho zari zingaho zirtyo, urusenga ntirwacitse.
Yesu arababarira, ati Ni muze murye. Ariko mu bigishwa ntihāgira ūtinyuka kumubaza, at’ Uri nde? Kuko bāri bamenye kw’ ar’ Umwami Yesu.
Yesu araza, yābīra umutsima, arawubaha, n’ifi n’uko.
Ubgo bgar’ ubugira gatatu Yesu yiyereka abigishwa, amaze kuzuka mu bapfuye.
Nuko barangije kurya, Yesu abaza Simoni Petero, ati Simoni, mwene Yohana, mbeg’ urankunda kurusha aba? Na we at’ Ego, Mugenzi, wewe urazi ko nkunogera. Aramubgira, at’ Ahura imyagazi y’intama zanje.
Yongera kumubaza ubugira kabiri, ati Simoni, mwene Yohana, mbeg’ urankunda? Na we at’ Ego, Mugenzi, wewe urazi ko nkunogera. Aramubgira, ati Ragira intama zanje.

Amubaza ubugira gatatu, ati Simoni, mwene Yohana, mbeg’ urannogera? Petero arababara, kuko yamubajije ubugira gatatu ngo Mbeg’ urannogera? Aramwishura, ati Mugenzi, weho urazi vyose, urazi ko nkunogera. Yesu aramubgira, at’ Ahura intama zanje.
N’ukuri, n’ukuri ndakubgire: Ukir’ umusore, warikenyeza, ukaja ah’ ugomba; arikw ah’ uzosāzira, uzoramvura amaboko, uwundi agukenyeze, akujane ah’ utagomba.
Icatumye avuga artyo, kwar’ ukwerekana urupfu azopfa, ashimagirisha Imana. Amaze kuvuga artyo, aramubarira, ati Nkurikira.
Petero arakebuka, abona wa mwigishwa Yesu yakunda abakurikiye, umwe yari yegamiye mu gikiriza ca Yesu hamwe bāsangira, akamubaza, ati Mugenzi, ni nde azokugura?
Nuko Petero amubonye, abaza Yesu, ati Mugenzi, uyu we bizoba bite?
Yesu aramwishura, ati Namba ngomba kw azogumaho kugeza aho nzozira, upfa iki? Wewe nkurikira.
Ni co catumye iri jambo rikwira muri bene Data, ng’ uwo mwigishwa ntazopfa. Ariko Yesu ntiyamubgiye kw atazopfa, ariko yavuze, ati Namba ngomba kw agumaho kugeza aho nzozira, upfa iki?
Uwo ni wa mwigishwa yashingiye intahe ivyo, kandi ni we yavyanditse, kandi natwe tuzi yukw intahe yiwe ar’ iy’ ukuri.
Ariko hariho n’ibindi vyinshi Yesu yakoze, vyokwandikwa bidondowe kimwe‐kimwe, ngira ngo n’isi na yo ntiyokwirwamw’ ibitabo vyokwanditswe.
Ca gitabo ca mbere nanditse ga Teyofilo we, kivuga ivyo Yesu yatanguye gukora no kwigisha vyose,
gushitsa ku musi yadūgijwe mw ijuru, ahejeje kugerera intumwa muri Mpwemu Yera, zimwe yatoranije.
Kand’ amaze kubabazwa, abiyereka ari muzima atanga ibimenyetso vyinshi, ababonekera imisi mirongwine, avuga ivy’ ubgami bg’Imana.
Maz’ akoranye na bo, arabihanikiriza ngo ntibave i Yerusalemu, at’ Ariko murorēre isezerano rya Data, iryo mwanyumvanye.
Kuko Yohana yabatirisha amazi, ariko mweho, mu misi itari myinshi, muzobatizwa na Mpwemu Yera.
Nuko bakoranye, baramubaza, bati Mwami, iki gihe ni co ugira ugarukane ingoma y’Abisirayeli?
Arabishura, ati S’ivyanyu kumenya imisi cank’ ibihe Data yashinze n’ububasha bgiwe wenyene;
ariko muzohabga ubushobozi, Mpwemu Yera ni yabazako, muzoba ivyabona vyo kunshingira intahe i Yerusalemu, n’i Yudaya hose, n’i Samariya, no gushitsa ku mpera y’isi.
Amaze kuvuga artyo, adūzwa babona, igicu kimukūra mu maso yabo.
Bagihanze amaso mw ijuru akigenda, abagabo babiri bambaye impuzu zera bahagarara i ruhande yabo;
barababaza, bati Yemwe bagabo b’i Galilaya, n’iki gitumye muhagaze murāba mw ijuru? Uyo Yesu, abakūwemwo, akadūzwa mw ijuru, azoza artyo, nk’uko mumubonye aja mw ijuru.
Buno basubira i Yerusalemu, bavuye ku musozi witwa Elayono, uri hafi y’i Yerusalemu nk’urugendo rwemewe kugendwa kw’ isabato.

Bashitseyo, barūrira baja mu nzu yo hejuru, aho bāri basembereye, ari Petero, na Yohana, na Yakobo, na Andereya, na Filipo, na Toma, na Barutolomayo, na Matayo, na Yakobo mwene Alufayo, na Simoni Zelote, na Yuda mwene Yakobo.
Abo bose bāsenga badahumeka n’umutima uhūye, hamwe n’abagore, na Mariya nyina wa Yesu, na bene nyina.
Mur’ iyo misi Petero ava hasi ahagarara hagati ya bene Data, (hāri hakoraniye ishengero ry’abantu nk’ijana na mirongwibiri), aravuga,
ati Bagabo bene Data, ivyanditswe ntivyobuze gushika, ivyo Mpwemu Yera yari yaravugiye mu kanwa ka Dawidi kuri Yuda, yarōngōye abaja gufata Yesu,
kuko yari yaharūwe muri twebge, agahabga umugabane w’iki gikorwa.
(Kand’ uwo muntu amaze kugura ubgatsi ku vyo yahawekw ibiguzi vyo kugabitanya kwiwe, agwa yubamye, araturika, amara yiwe yose arasēseka.
Bimenyekana mu baba i Yerusalemu bose, ni co catumye ubgo bgatsi mu rurimi rwabo babgita Akeludama, risobanurwa ng’ Ubgatsi bg’amaraso.)
Kuko mu gitabo ca Zaburi handitswe, ngw I we hasigare umusaka, Kandi ntihakagire uwundi ahaba, kandi ng’ Ububgiriza bgiwe busubiremw’ uwundi.
Nuko mur’ abo bagabo twahora tugendana igihe cose Umwami Yesu yar’ akiri muri twebge amaja n’amaza,
utanguriye ku kubatiza kwa Yohana ukageza ku musi yadukūriwemwo, adūganywe, umwe muri bo akwiye kuba icabona hamwe natwe co gushingira intahe ukuzuka kwiwe.
Bahagarika babiri, umwe ni Yosefu ari we Barusaba, irindi ni Yusito, uwundi na we ni Matiya.
Barasenga, bati Mwami, ni wewe uzi imitima y’abantu bose, none werekane uwo utoranije mur’ aba bompi
gusubira mu kirenge ca Yuda mur’ iki gikorwa no kuba intumwa, ivyo yataye akaja ahiwe.
Barabapfindira, ubupfindo bgerekana Matiya, nukw aharūranwa n’intumwa cumi n’imwe.
Umusi wa Pentekote ushitse, bose bāri bakoraniye ahantu hamwe;
haza igihinda kivuye mw ijuru giturumbuka, nk’uguhuhuta kw’umuyaga w’inkomezi, gikwira hose mu nzu bicayemwo.
Hababonekera ibirimi vyigabanije, nk’ivy’ umuriro; bibajak’ umwe‐umwe.
Bose buzuzwa Mpwemu Yera, batangura kuvuga izindi ndimi, uko Mpwemu abahaye kuzivuga.
I Yerusalemu hār’ Abayuda bamyeho, abagabo bubaha Imana, bāri bāravuye mu mahanga yose yo musi y’ijuru.
Ico gihinda cumvikanye, hakorana abantu benshi, barajorerwa, kuk’ umuntu wese yumvise ururimi rw’i wabo baruvuga.
Barumirwa bose, baratangara, bati Mbeg’ aba bose bavuga s’Abanyagalilaya?
Kandi n’iki gitumye twese tubumva bavuga indimi z’i wacu izo twavukanye?
Tur’ Abapariti, n’Abamedi, n’Abelamiti, n’abamye i Mesopotamiya, n’i Yudaya, n’i Kapadokiya, n’i Ponto, no muri Asiya,
n’i Furugiya, n’i Pamfiliya, no muri Egiputa, no mu bihugu vy’i Libuwa bihereranye n’i Kureni, n’ab’ i Roma bāgerereye ino, Abayuda, bo n’abātoye idini yabo,
Abakirete, n’Abarabo, tukabumva bavuga mu ndimi zacu ibitangaza vy’Imana.
Bose barumirwa barazazanirwa, barabazanya, bat’ Ibi n’ibiki?
Arikw abandi barabanegura, bati Baborewe igisāma.
Ariko Petero ahagararana na bamwe cumi n’umwe, ababariza ijwi rirenga, ati Yemwe Bayuda n’ababa i Yerusalemu mwese, ibi ni mubimenye, kandi ni mwumvirize amajambo yanje.
Aba ntibaborewe nk’uko mwiyumvira, kuk’ ubu ar’ isaha zitatu z’umusi,
arikw ivyo n’ivyavuzwe n’uwavugishwa n’Imana Yoweli,

ati Bizoba mu misi y’iherezo, ni kw Imana yagize, Nzosuka Mpwemu wanje ku bari n’umubiri bose: Kand’ abahungu n’abakobga banyu bazovugishwa nanje, N’imisore yanyu izobona ivyo yeretswe, N’abatāma banyu bazorota inzozi.
Mbere n’abagurano banje b’abahungu n’abakobga mur’ iyo misi Nzobasukako Mpwemu wanje, bavugishwe nanje.
Nzoshira utwumiza hejuru mw ijuru, N’ibimenyetso hasi kw isi, Amaraso n’umuriro no gupfūndūka kw’umwotsi.
Izuba rizocura umwiza, N’ukwezi guhinduke amaraso, Hataraza uwo musi mukuru rurangiranwa w’Uhoraho:
Kand’ umuntu wese azokwambaza izina ry’Uhoraho azokizwa.

Yemwe bagabo b’Abisirayeli, ni mwumve aya majambo: Yesu Umunyanazareti, umuntu Imana yashimagirishije kuri mwebge ibitangaza n’utwumiza n’ibimenyetso, ivyo Imana yamukoresheje hagati yanyu, nk’uko mubizi ubganyu;
uwo muntu amaze gutangwa nk’ukw Imana yabigabiye yikomvomvoye, ibimenye bitaribgabe, mumubambisha amaboko y’abagarariji, muramwica.
Arikw Imana yaramuzuye, ibohōye ibise vy’urupfu, kuko bitāshobotse ko rumugumya.
Kuko Dawidi yavuze ivy’ uwo, ati Nabonye Uhoraho imbere yanje imisi yose, Kukw ar’ i buryo bganje, ngo sinnyiganyige.
Ni co gituma umutima wanje uhimbarwa, ururimi rwanje rukanezerwa, Kandi n’umubiri wanje uzoba nko mu gikāri, wizigiye ibizoba.
Kuk’ utazoreka ubugingo bganje ngo buje i kuzimu, Kandi ntuzotanga Uwera wawe ngw az’ abore.
Wammenyesheje inzira z’ubugingo, Mu nyonga hawe uzohanyuzurisha akanyamuneza.
Bagabo bene Data, s’ikingora kubabarira mvyeruye ivya sogokuruza mukuru Dawidi, yuko yapfuye, agahambga, n’imva yiwe iri ngaha ino muri twebge na bugingo n’ubu.
Nuko, kuko yar’ uwavugishwa n’Imana, akamenya kw Imana yamurahiye indahiro, kw izoshira ku ngoma yiwe uwamutse mu bura bgiwe,
yavuze ivy’ ukuzuka kwa Kristo abibonye bitaribgabe, yukw atārekewe mu kuzimu, kandi n’umubiri wiwe ata ho wigeze ubora.
Uwo Yesu Imana yaramuzuye, natwe twese tur’ ivyabona vyo gushingira intahe ivyo.
Nukw amaze gushirwa hejuru n’ukuboko kw’i buryo kw’Imana, kand’ ashikirijwe na Se isezerano, ari ryo Mpwemu Yera, non’ asutse ico muriko murabona kandi mwumva.
Kandi Dawidi ntiyadūze mw ijuru, arik’ ubgiwe yaravuze, at’ Uhoraho yabariye Umwami wanje, At’ Icara i buryo bganje,
Ushitse aho nzohindurira abansi bawe indava yo musi y’ibirenge vyawe.
Nukw abo mu muryango wa Isirayeli bose, ni bamenye badakekeranya yukw Imana yamugize Umwami na Kristo, Yesu umwe mwābamba.
Bumvise ivyo, bibacumita mu mitima, babaza Petero n’izindi ntumwa, bati Bagabo bene Data, mbega tugire dute?
Petero arabishura, ati Ni mwihane, umuntu wese muri mwebge abatizwe mw izina rya Yesu Kristo, mubone guharirwa ivyaha vyanyu, kandi muzohabga ingabire, ari yo Mpwemu Yera.
Kukw isezerano ar’ iryanyu kand’ ar’ iry’ abana banyu, n’abari kure bose, abazohamagarwa bose n’Umwami Imana yacu.
Kand’ ashingisha intahe ayandi majambo menshi, arabahanūra, ati Ni mwikize ab’ iki gihe kigoramye.
Nukw abemeye amajambo yiwe barabatizwa: abongewe kur’ uwo musi ku bāri basanzweho bāri nk’ibihumbi bitatu.
Bashishikara cane mu vyo intumwa zigisha, no kugira ubumwe, no kumanyagura umutsima no gusenga.
Umuntu wese aterwa n’ubgoba: kand’ utwumiza n’ibimenyetso vyinshi vyakorwa n’intumwa.
Abizeye bose bāba hamwe, basangira ivyabo vyose:
amatongo yabo n’ibintu vyabo bārabigura, bakabibagabanganya bose, nk’uk’ umuntu wese akennye.
Kand’ imisi yose bāshishikara kuja mu rusengero n’umutima uhūye, kand’ i wabo bāmanyagura umutsima, bakarya banezerewe n’imitima itagira akarohe,
bahimbaza Imana, kandi na bo bāshimwa n’abantu bose. Umwami Imana akabongera imisi yose abama barakizwa.
Petero na Yohana bāriko baradūga baja mu rusengero mu gihe co gusenga, ni co saha cenda.
Hār’ umuntu yaremaye ibirenge uhereye kuva mu nda ya nyina, yama aterurwa, bakamushira kw irembo ry’urusengero ryitwa Ryiza uko bukeye, kugira ngw asēge abinjira mu rusengero.
Uyo abonye Petero na Yohana bagira binjire mu rusengero, arabasēga ngo bamuhe.
Petero amuhanga amaso, bo na Yohana, aramubarira, ati N’uturābe.
Abashirak’ umutima agira ngo har’ ico bamuha.
Petero aramubarira, at’ Ifeza n’izahabu nta vyo mfise, arikw ico mfise ndakiguha: mw izina rya Yesu Kristo Umunyanazareti, va hasi utambuke.
Maz’ amufata ukuboko kw’i buryo, amukūra hasi: ako kanya ibirenge vyiwe n’ingingo zavyo bica birakomera,
arabaduka arahagarara, atangura gutambuka, yinjirana na bo mu rusengero, atambuka yitera hejuru, ahimbaza Imana:
abantu bose babona atambuka ahimbaza Imana,
bamenya kw ari we yahora yicara kw irembo ry’urusengero ryitwa Ryiza asēgerereza; barumirwa cane, batangazwa n’ibimubayeko.
Agifashe Petero na Yohana, abantu bose birukira kuri bo, bakoranira kw ibaraza ryitwa irya Salomo, batangaye cane.

Petero abibonye, abaza abo bantu, ati Yemwe bagabo b’Abisirayeli, n’iki gitumye mutangazwa n’ibi, muduhangiye amaso iki, nk’ah’ ubushobozi bgacu cank’ ukwubaha Imana kwacu ari vyo vyaduhaye kumugendesha?
Imana ya Aburahamu na Isaka na Yakobo, ari yo Mana ya ba sogokuruza, yashimagije Umushumba wayo Yesu, umwe mwebge mwatanze mukamwihakanira mu maso ya Pilato, amaze kwahukanya urubanza rwo kumurekura.
Ariko mweho mwihakana Uwera kand’ Umugororotsi, musaba ko babarekurira umwicanyi,
wa Mukuru w’ubugingo muramwica; arikw Imana muzura mu bapfuye, natwe tur’ ivyabona vyo gushingira intahe ivyo.
Kand’ uyu, uwo mubona kandi muzi, kuko yizeye izina ry’uwo, iryo zina ryamuhaye inkomezi: mber’ ukwizera ahawe na we ni kwo kumukirije rwose imbere yanyu mwese.
Kandi none, bene Data, ndazi yuko mwabikoze mutabizi, n’ababaganza na bo n’uko.
Arikw ivyo Imana yavugiye mu kanwa k’abāvugishwa na yo bose bitaribgabe, yuko Kristo wayo azobabazwa, ivyo yabishikije irtyo.
Nuko mwihane, muhindukire, ivyaha vyanyu bihanagurwe, ibihe vyo guhēmbūka bibone ingene biza, bivuye mu nyonga z’Umwami Imana,
kugira ngo na yo iz’ itume Kristo yabatoranirijwe kera, ni we Yesu.
Arikw ijuru rikwiye kumwākīra, gushitsa ku bihe vyo gusubira guhindura ibintu vyose bisha, nk’ukw Imana yavuze mu kanwa k’abera bayo yavugisha bose, uhereye ubga mbere na mbere.
Mose koko yaravuze, at’ Uhoraho Imana azobahagurukiriza ūvugishwa na we mu b’i wanyu ameze nkanje; uwo muze mumwumvire mu vy’ azobabarira vyose.
Kand’ umuntu wese atazokwumvira uno avugishwa n’Imana, azorandurwa mu bantu.
Mber’ abāvugishwa n’Imana bose, uhereye kuri Samweli n’abāmukurikiye, abāvuze bose bāramenyekanishije ivy’ iyi misi.
Namwe mur’ abana b’abāvugishwa n’Imana, kandi mur’ ab’ isezerano Imana yasezeranye na ba sogokuruza banyu, ibarira Aburahamu, iti Mu ruvyaro rwawe ni ho imiryango yose yo mw isi izohērwa umugisha.
Ni mwebge Imana yatanguye gutumak’ Umushumba wayo imaze kumuzura, kugira ngw abahe umugisha, abahindure, umuntu wese ave mu bibi vyiwe.
Bakivugana n’abantu, abaherezi bazanana aho bari n’umukuru w’abashibamyi b’urusengero, n’Abasadukayo,
bababajwe cane n’uko bigisha abantu, bababarira yuk’ ukuzuka kw’abapfuye kwabonetse kuri Yesu.
Babashōrerakw amaboko, babashira mw ibohero gushitsa mu gitondo, kuko bgari bugorovye.
Ariko benshi mu bumvise iryo jambo barizera, igitigiri c’abagabo gishika nk’ibihumbi bitanu.
Bukeye bg’aho, abashingantahe babo bo n’abakuru n’abanyabgenge b’ivyanditswe bakoranira i Yerusalemu,
na Anasi umuherezi mukuru, na Kayafa na Yohana na Alekisandero, n’ab’ umuryango bose w’abaherezi bakuru.
Babashize hagati, barababaza, bati N’ubushobozi ki, canke n’izina ki, vyabateye gukora ivyo?
Nuko Petero, yuzuye Mpwemu Yera, arababarira, ati Yemwe bashingantahe b’abantu n’abakuru,
uyu musi ko ducunaguzwa ivyo twagiriye neza umuntu yanyogomba, kandi n’icamukijije,

ni mumenye mwese, n’ubgoko bgose bg’Abisirayeli, yukw ari mw izina rya Yesu Kristo, Umunyanazareti, uwo mwebge mwabamvye, Imana ikamuzura mu bapfuye, kw ari ho hatumye uyu muntu ahagarara imbere yanyu, akomeye.
Uwo ni we buye mwebge abubatsi mwātītūye, kandi ryahindutse irigumya imfuruka.
Kandi nta wundi agakiza kabonerwamwo, kukw ata rindi zina musi y’ijuru ryāhawe abantu dukwiye gukirizwamwo.
Babonye ugushira amanga kwa Petero na Yohana, kandi babona ko batigishijwe, atar’ abanyabgenge, baratangara; maze bamenya ko bābana na Yesu;
kandi babonye uwo muntu yakijijwe ahagararanye na bo, babura ico bavuga.
Barabataramura, maze baja inama,
bati Mbeg’ aba bantu tubagire dute? Ko vyamenyekanye mu baba i Yerusalemu bose yuko bakoze ikimenyetso kibaye rurangiranwa, natwe ntidushobora kubihakana;
ariko vyoye kurushiriza kwamamara mu bantu, tubahahirize, ntibongere kugira umuntu n’umwe babarira mur’ iryo zina.
Babahamagaje, barabihanikiriza ngo ntibazirukanye ngo bavuge canke bigishe mw izina rya Yesu.
Petero na Yohana barabishura, bati Namb’ ari vyiza mu nyonga z’Imana kubumvira kubarutisha Imana, ni mubitandukanye:
kuko tweho tudashobora kureka kuvuga ivyo twabonye n’ivyo twumvise.
Na bo bongeye kubahahiriza, barabarekura, babuze uko bobahana kubg’ abantu, kuko bose bāhimbaza Imana ku vyābaye.
Kuk’ uwo muntu yar’ arengeje imyaka mirongwine avutse, uwakozwekw ico kimenyetso co kumukiza.
Nuko barekuwe basubira muri bagenzi babo, babīgānira ivyo abaherezi bakuru n’abakuru bababgiye vyose.
Na bo bavyumvise bavuga n’ijwi rirenga, babgira Imana n’umutima uhūye, bati Databuja, ni wewe waremye ijuru n’isi, n’ikiyaga n’ibirimwo vyose,
kandi wavugiye mu kanwa ka sogokuruza Dawidi, umusavyi wawe, ubivugisha Mpwemu Yera, ut’ Abanyamahanga n’iki kibateye umuvurungano, N’amoko yagīriye ingingo iki ivy’ ubusa?
Abami bo mw isi batonze urugamba, N’abakuru bakoraniye hamwe, Kurwanya Uhoraho n’Uwo yarobanuje amavuta.
Kandi vy’ukuri mur’ iki gisagara, Herode, bo na Pontiyo Pilato hamwe n’abanyamahanga n’imiryango ya Isirayeli, bākoraniye kurwanya Umushumba wawe yera Yesu, uwo warobanuje amavuta,
ngo bashitse ivy’ ukuboko kwawe n’inama yawe vyari vyaragabiye vyose ko bizoba.
Kandi none, Mwami, rāba agahahirizo kabo, uhe abasavyi bawe kuvuga ijambo ryawe bashize amanga rwose:
ukiramvuye ukuboko kwawe gukiza indwara, ibimenyetso n’ibitangaza bikorwe mw izina ry’Umushumba wawe yera Yesu.
Bahejeje gusenga, aho bakoraniye haratigita, bose buzuzwa Mpwemu Yera, bavuga ijambo ry’Imana bashize amanga.
Kand’ abizeye b’akavuvu bari bahūje umutima n’inama, kandi nta n’umwe yakīmbūkira ikintu cose atunze ngo n’iciwe, ariko vyose bārabisangira.
Kand’ intumwa zāshingira intahe ukuzuka kw’Umwami Yesu ziri n’ubushobozi bginshi, kand’ ubuntu bg’Imana bginshi buba kuri bo bose.
Nta mukene yari muri bo, kukw abāri bafise amashamvu bose cank’ amazu bābigura, bakazana ibiguzi vy’ivyo baguze,
bakabishira imbere y’ibirenge vy’intumwa; maze bakabigabanganya abantu, umuntu wese ukw akennye.
Na Yosefu, uwo intumwa zise Barunaba, risobanurwa ng’Umwana wo guhanūra, Umulewi yavukiye i Kupuro,
yar’afise itongo ararigura, azana ibiguzi vyaryo, abishira imbere y’ibirenge vy’intumwa.
Kandi hār’ umugabo yitwa Ananiya, agura ishamvu afatanije n’umugore wiwe Safira,
yisigariza ku biguzi vyayo, umugore wiwe abizi, azana ikigabane, agishira imbere y’ibirenge vy’intumwa.
Petero aramubaza, ati Ananiya, n’iki gitumye Satani yuzuza umutima wawe guhenda Mpwemu Yera, ukīsigariza ku biguzi vy’ishamvu?
Ukiyifise ntiyar’ iyawe? Kand’ umaze kuyigura, ibiguzi vyayo ntuba warabikoze uk’ ugomba? N’iki catumye wīgīra ingingo mu mutima wawe gukora urtyo? S’abantu uhenze, Imana ni yo uhenze.
Ananiya yumvise ayo majambo agwa bukumbi: abavyumvise bose baterwa n’ubgoba bginshi.
Imisore iva hasi, iramutekera, iramujana, iramuhamba.
Hahise nk’isaha zitatu, umugore wiwe arinjira, atazi ivyabaye;
Petero aramubaza, ati Mbarira: mbeg’ ishamvu mwayiguze ayo nyene? Aramwishura, at’ Ego me, n’ayo.
Petero aramubaza, ati N’iki gitumye muhūza inama kugerageza Mpwemu w’Umwami Imana? Ehe ibirenge vy’abahejeje guhamba umugabo wawe biri ku rugi, nawe barakujana.
Uwo mwanya agwa imbere y’ibirenge vyiwe bukumbi. Ya misore yinjiye isanga amaze guhwera, iramujana, imuhamba i ruhande y’umugabo wiwe.
Ishengero ryose n’abavyumvise bose baterwa n’ubgoba bginshi.
Ibimenyetso n’ibitangaza vyinshi bikorwa mu bantu n’amaboko y’intumwa: kandi bose bākoranira mw ibaraza rya Salomo n’umutima uhūye:
ariko mu bandi nta muntu yatinyuka kwifatanya na bo, yamar’ abantu bose bārabashimagiza,
bārushiriza kwongerwakw abizeye Umwami Yesu, ishengero ryinshi ry’abagabo n’abagore;
bituma banaterurira abarwaye ku nzira, babashira mu nderuzo no ku birago, kugira ngo Petero ni yahaca, naho coba igitūtu ciwe gishike kuri bamwe.
Hakoranira ishengero rivuye no mu bisagara bihereranye n’i Yerusalemu, bazana abarwaye n’abababazwa n’impwemu zihumanye: bakizwa uko bangana.
Maz’ umuherezi mukuru ahagurukana n’abāri kumwe na we bose, ni bo muce witwa uw’ Abasadukayo, buzura ishari,
bashōrera amaboko ku ntumwa, bazishira mu nzu y’ibohero rya bose.
Maz’ umumarayika w’Umwami Imana ahenga mw ijoro yugurura inzugi z’ibohero, abakūrayo, arababgira,
ati Ni mugende, muhagarare mu rusengero, mubarire abantu amajambo yose ya bga Bugingo.

Bavyumvise, binjira mu rusengero hāri nko mu mutwenzi, barigisha. Maz’ umuherezi mukuru azanana n’abāri kumwe na we, bahamagaza abanyekombe, n’abakuru bose b’Abisirayeli, maze batuma mu nzu y’abanyororo kubazana.
Abagendanyi bagiye ntibabasanga mw ibohero: baragaruka barababgira,
bat’ Inzu y’abanyororo dusanze yugaye ata nkomanzi iriho na mba, n’abarinzi bahagaze ku nzugi, maze twuguruye ntitwasangamw’ umuntu.
Bumvise ayo majambo umukuru w’abashibamyi b’urusengero n’abaherezi bakuru bazazanirwa n’ivyabo, ikizovamwo.
Haza umuntu arababarira, at’ Erega ba bagabo mwashira mw ibohero bari mu rusengero bahagaze bigisha abantu.
Maz’ uwo mukuru w’abashibamyi ajana n’abagendanyi, babazana ku neza, kuko bātinya abantu, ngo ntibabatere amabuye.
Bamaze kubazana babashira mw ikombe: umuherezi mukuru arababaza,
ati Mbega ntitwabīhanije cane kutigisha muri rya zina? None rāba mwujuje Yerusalemu inyigisho zanyu; ico murondera n’ukudushirakw amaraso ya wa muntu.
Maze Petero n’intumwa barabishura, bat’ Igikwiye n’ukwumvira Imana kuyirutisha abantu.
Imana ya ba sogokuruza yazuye Yesu, uwo mwebge mwishe mumumanitse ku giti.
Uyo Imana yaramushize hejuru n’ukuboko kwayo kw’i buryo, ngw abe Umukuru n’Umukiza, ngw ahe Abisirayeli kwihana no guharirwa ivyaha.
Natwe tur’ ivyabona vyo gushingira intahe ivyo, na Mpwemu Yera na we n’uko, uwo Imana yahaye abayumvira.
Ariko bo bavyumvise baribga mu mitima, bashaka kubica.
Maze hahaguruka umwe mw ikombe, w’Umufarisayo yitwa Gamaliyeli, umwigisha w’ivyagezwe, yubahwa n’abantu bose, avuga ko bataramura abo bantu akanya gato.
Maz’ arababarira, ati Yemwe bagabo b’Abisirayeli, ni mwirinde mumenye uko mugirira aba bantu:
kuko mu misi ishize Teyuda yādutse yiyita agakomeye, igitigiri c’abantu gishika nk’amajana ane gikondōrera inyuma yiwe: maz’ aricwa, abāmwumvira bose barasābagira, bacika ubusa.
Hanyuma yiwe hāduka Yuda Umunyagalilaya, mu misi yo kwandikwa, yikwegera abantu inyuma; na we apfa rubi, n’abāmwumvira bose uko bangana barasābagira.
Kandi none ndababgire: Ni muzibukire aba bantu, mubarekure: kukw iyi nama n’iki gikorwa ni vyaba biturutse mu bantu, bizosendwa:
ariko ni vyaba biturutse ku Mana, ntimuzoshobora kubatsinda, mwoye kuzosanga murwanya Imana.
Baramwemerera, maze bahamagaje intumwa, barazitonagura, barazīhanikiriza ngo ntizize zigishe mw izina rya Yesu, maze barazirekura.
Nuko bava mu maso y’abanyekombe, banezerejwe n’uko bemerewe gutētererezwa iryo zina.
Kand’ imisi yose mu rusengero no mu mihana ntibahorereza kwigisha no kuvuga ubutumwa bgiza bga Yesu, kw ari we Kristo.
Kandi mur’ iyo misi, abigishwa bāriko baragwira, Abayuda bavuye i Bugiriki bidodombera Abaheburayo b’inyamo, kukw abapfakazi babo bīrengagizwa ku ngaburo y’imisi yose.
Bamwe cumi na babiri bakoranya ishengero ry’abigishwa, bati Ntibibereye yuko twebge turekera ijambo ry’Imana kugaburisha ivyo ku meza.
Nuko, bene Data, ni murābe muri mwebge abantu ndwi bashimwa, buzuye Mpwemu Yera n’ubgenge, tubashire kur’ iki gikorwa.
Ariko tweho tuzoshishikara gusenga no kugabura ijambo ry’Imana.

Ayo majambo ishengero ryose rirayashima, batoranya Stefano, umuntu yuzuye ukwizera na Mpwemu Yera, na Filipo, na Purokoro, na Nikanori, na Timoni, na Parumena, na Nikolayo, Umunyantiyokiya yatoye idini y’Abayuda,
babashira imbere y’intumwa, kandi bamaze gusenga zibarambikakw ibiganza.
Nukw ijambo ry’Imana riragwira; abigishwa barōndōka cane i Yerusalemu, abaherezi b’akavuvu bumvira ukwizera.
Stefano yari yuzuye ubuntu bg’Imana n’ubushobozi, yakora mu bantu ibitangaza n’ibimenyetso bikomeye.
Ariko hava hasi abantu bamwe bo mw isinagogi y’Abaliberutino, n’iy’ Abanyakurene n’iy’ Abanyalekisanderiya, n’iy’ Abanyakilikiya, n’iy’ Abanyasiya, baja impāri na Stefano,
ariko ntibashobora gutsinda ubgenge na Mpwemu bimuvugisha.
Nuko bahēra abagabo bo kuvuga, bati Twumvise avuga amagambo y’amarogotano kuri Mose no ku Mana.
Bosha abantu n’abakuru n’abanyabgenge b’ivyanditswe baramugīra, baramufata, bamujana mw ikombe.
Bahagarika ivyabona vy’ibinyoma, baravuga, bat’ Uyu muntu nta ho ahumeka gutuka aha hantu hēra n’ivyagezwe:
kuko twumvise avuga, ati Yesu Umunyanazareti azokombora aha hantu, kandi ngw azohindura imigenzo twahawe na Mose.
Abicaye mw ikombe bose bamuhanze amaso babona mu maso hiwe, hasa n’ah’ umumarayika.
Umuherezi mukuru aramubaza, ati Mbeg’ ivyo ni ko biri?
Na we aramwishura, ati Yemwe bene Data kandi ba data, ni mwumve: Imana y’icubahiro yiyeretse sogokuruza Aburahamu, ar’ i Mesopotamiya, ataraja kugerēra i Harani,
iramubarira, iti Va mu gihugu canyu no mu muryango wanyu, uje mu gihugu nzokwereka.
Maz’ ava mu gihugu c’i Bukaludaya, agerēra i Harani. Se amaze gupfa, iramwimura, imuzana mur’ iki gihugu mubamwo none.
Ariko ntiyakimuhayemw’ umwandu, naho hoba aho gushinga ikirenge; isezerana kuzokimuha ngo kibe ishamvu yiwe n’iy’ uruvyaro rwiwe, kand’ ataragira umwana.
Kand’ Imana ivuga irtya, it’ Uruvyaro rwawe ruzoba inyambukira mu kindi gihugu, bazobagira abaja, babagirire nabi imyaka amajana ane.
Kand’ ihanga rizobagira abaja ni jewe nzoricirakw iteka, Imana ni ko yagize, it’ Arikw amaherezo bazovayo, bansengere aha hantu.
Maz’ imuha isezerano ryo gukebga. Nukw avyara Isaka, amukeba ku musi ugira umunani: Isaka avyara Yakobo, Yakobo avyara ba sogokuruza bakuru cumi na babiri.
Ba sogokuruza bagirira Yosefu ishari, baramugura ngw ajanwe muri Egiputa. Imana ibana na we,
imukiza mu marushwa yiwe yose, imuha ubutoni n’ubgenge kuri Farawo, umwami wo muri Egiputa, amugira icēgēra ciwe ngw aganze muri Egiputa, amuzēza n’urugo rwiwe rwose.
Ikigoyi gitera muri Egiputa hose n’i Kanani, hatera n’amarushwa menshi, kandi ba sogokuruza babura ivyo kurya.
Maze Yakobo yumvise yuko muri Egiputa har’ amasumo, atuma ba sogokuruza ubga mbere.
Kand’ ubugira kabiri Yosefu yibarira bene se, umuryango wa Yosefu umenywa na Farawo.
Yosefu atumiza se Yakobo n’abo mu nzu yabo bose, ukw ari mirongwirindwi na batanu.
Yakobo aramanuka, aja muri Egiputa; agwayo, bo na ba sogokuruza:
babajana i Shekemu, babahamba mw isenga Aburahamu yaguze igiciro c’ifeza na bene Hamori i Shekemu.
Arikw igihe c’isezerano kigira gishike, iry’ Imana yasezeraniye Aburahamu, abantu baragwira, baba benshi muri Egiputa,
gushitsa ah’ uwundi mwami yīmiye muri Egiputa atigeze kumenya ivya Yosefu.
Uwo mwami agirira ubugunge ubgoko bgacu, agirira ba sogokuruza nabi, abateshereza abana babo b’inzoya kugira ngo ntibabeho.
Mur’ ico gihe Mose aravuka, yari mwiza cane, bamurerera mu nzu kwa se amezi atatu;
amaze gutābga, umukobga wa Farawo aramutora, amurerera kuba umwana wiwe.
Mose yigishwa ubgenge bgose bg’Abanyegiputa, agira ubushobozi mu majambo yiwe no mu bikorwa vyiwe.
Maz’ arikw aramara imyaka mirongwine avutse, haza iciyumviro mu mutima wiwe co kugendera bene wabo b’Abisirayeli.
Abonye umuntu agirirwa nabi, aramutabara, ahōra iyo mpahazwa, yica wa Munyegiputa.
Yibgira yukw ab’i wabo botahura kw Imana ibakirisha ukuboko kwiwe: ariko ntibabimenya.
Bukeye bg’aho, asanga abarwana, ageza kubatātūra, ati Yemwe bagabo, mur’ umuryango umwe, n’iki gitumye mugiriranira nabi?
Arik’ uwagirira mugenzi we nabi aramusunika, aramubaza, ati Ni nde yakugize umukuru cank’ umucamanza wacu?
Mbeg’ ugomba kunyica, nk’ukw ejo wishe wa Munyegiputa?
Mose yumvise iryo jambo, arahunga, aba umwambukīra mu gihugu c’i Midiyani, avyariray’ abahungu babiri.
Imyaka mirongwine ishize, umumarayika amubonekerera mu rubeya rw’umuriro waka mu gisaka c’amahwa mu bugaragwa bgo ku musozi Sinayi.
Mose abonye ivyo biramutangaza: akivyēgēra ngw avyihweze, havuga ijwi ry’Uhoraho,
ati Ni jewe Mana ya ba sogokuruza bawe, Imana ya Aburahamu, Imana ya Isaka, Imana ya Yakobo. Mose ahinda agashitsi, ntiyatinyuka kwihweza.
Uhoraho aramubarira, ati Kūra inkweto mu birenge vyawe, kukw aho hantu uhagaze ar’ ahēra.
N’ukuri abantu banje bari muri Egiputa nabonye amarushwa barimwo, numvise umuniho wabo, none mmanukanywe no kubarokora: kandi none n’uze ndagutume muri Egiputa.
Mose uyo, umwe banka, bati Ni nde yakugize umukuru cank’ umucamanza? ni we Imana yatumye kuba umukuru n’umucunguzi, abihawe n’ukuboko kw’umumarayika yamubonekereye muri ca gisaka.
Uwo abakūrayo, amaze gukora ibitangaza n’ibimenyetso mu gihugu ca Egiputa, no ku Kiyaga Gitukura no mu bugaragwa, imyaka mirongwine.
Uwo Mose ni we yabgiye Abisirayeli, at’ Imana izobahagurukiriza ūvugishwa na yo mu b’i wanyu, ameze nkanje.
Kand’ uwo Mose ni we yari mw ishengero ryo mu bugaragwa, ari kumwe n’umumarayika yavuganiye na we ku musozi Sinayi, kand’ ari kumwe na ba sogokuruza; kandi yaherejwe amajambo y’ubugingo ngw aduhe.
Ba sogokuruza banse kumwumvira, baramwikunkumura, basubira muri Egiputa mu mitima yabo,
babgira Aroni, bati N’uturonkere imana zo kutuja imbere; kuk’ umwe Mose yaturōngōye adukūra mu gihugu ca Egiputa, tutazi ico yabaye.
Bironkera igishushanyo c’imasa mur’ iyo misi, ico kigirwamana bakizanira ibimazi, bahimbarwa n’ibikorwa vy’intoke zabo.

Arikw Imana irora irya, irabaheba ngo basenge ingabo zo kw ijuru: nk’uko vyanditswe mu gitabo c’abavugishwa n’Imana, ngo Mbega har’ ibitungwa bibāzwe cank’ ibimazi mwanshikaniye, Ya myaka ukw ari mirongwine yo mu bugaragwa, yemwe ab’ inzu ya Isirayeli?
Mwareruye ihema rya Moloki, N’inyenyeri y’ikigirwamana Refani, Ar’ ibishushanyo mwironkeye ngo mubisenge: Nanje nzobambukana hirya y’i Babuloni.
Ba sogokuruza bāri bafise ihema ry’Ibishinga intahe, hamwe bāri mu bugaragwa, nk’ukw iyavuganye na Mose yabigeze, yamubgiye kurigereranya n’ikigereranyo yabonye.
Iryo, ba sogokuruza barihawe na ba sekuru babo, barishikana ino, Yosuwa ari kumwe na bo, hamwe bātsinda amahanga, Imana iyirukana imbere ya ba sogokuruza, gushitsa ku gihe ca Dawidi.
Kandi Dawidi aronka ubutoni mu nyonga z’Imana, asaba kwubakira Imana ya Yakobo aho kuba.
Ariko Salomo ni we yayubakiye ingoro.
Yamar’ Īsumba vyose ntiba mu zubakishijwe amaboko: nk’uk’ uwavugishijwe n’Imana yavuze,
at’ Ijuru ni ryo ntebe yanje y’ubgami, Isi na yo n’indava y’ibirenge vyanje; Muzonyubakira inzu ki? ni k’Uhoraho abajije, Canke nzoruhukira ahantu ki?
Mbeg’ intoke zanje si zo zaremye ivyo vyose?
Yemwe abatagonda izosi, mwa ntakebga mu mitima no mu matwi, na ntaryo murwanya Mpwemu Yera. Uko ba sogokuruza banyu bākora, ni ko namwe mukora.
Ni nde mu bavugishijwe n’Imana ba sogokuruza banyu batāhamye? Bishe abābanje kumenyekanisha ivyo kuza kwa wa Mugororotsi, none namwe mwaramuguze muramwica:
ari mwebge mwāhawe ivyagezwe bizanywe n’abamarayika, ntimwavyitondera.
Bavyumvise baribga mu mitima, bamuhekenyera imisaya.
Ariko Stefano yuzuye Mpwemu Yera, ahanga amaso mw ijuru, abona ubgiza bg’Imana, na Yesu ahagaze i buryo bg’Imana:
aravuga, at’ Ehe mbonye ijuru rikingurutse, n’Umwana w’umuntu ahagaze i buryo bg’Imana.
Barayogora n’amajwi arenga, bīziba amatwi, bamugwirakw icarimwe,
bamuhindira inyuma y’igisagara, bamwicisha amabuye; kand’ abāmwagirije bāri bafashije hasi imitamana yabo imbere y’ibirenge vy’umusore yitwa Sauli.
Maze bakiriko baratera Stefano amabuye, arambaza, aravuga, ati Mwami Yesu, akīra ubugingo bganje.
Araheza arapfukama, asemerera n’ijwi rirenga, ati Mwami, ntubaharūrekw iki caha. Amaze kuvuga artyo, aca aracīkāna. Kandi Sauli na we yarabishimye ko yicwa.
Bahēra kur’ uwo musi bahama cane ishengero ry’i Yerusalemu: bose basābagirira mu bihugu vy’i Yudaya n’i Samariya, ukūyemw’ intumwa gusa.
Abantu bubaha Imana bahamba Stefano, baramuborogera cane.
Ariko Sauli yatikiza ishengero; yinjira mu mazu yose, agakūramw’ abagabo n’abagore, akabashira mw ibohero.
Arikw abāsābagiye bagendagenda bavuga ijambo ry’Imana.
Na Filipo aramanuka, aja mu gisagara c’i Samariya, abamenyesha ivya Kristo.
Abantu benshi bashira umutima ku vyo Filipo avuga bashize hamwe, bumvise kandi babonye ibimenyetso akora.
Kuko benshi muri bo bāri binjiwemwo n’impwemu zihumanye zābavamwo, ziboroga n’amajwi arenga; kandi n’abāri bamugaye n’abacumbagira benshi barakizwa.
Haba umunezero mwinshi mur’ ico gisagara.
Kandi hāriy’ umuntu yitwa Simoni, yahora akora ivy’ amarēba mur’ico gisagara, akūmiza ubgoko bg’Abasamariya, akīyita agakomeye.
Bama bamushizek’ umutima bose, uhereye ku boroshe ugashitsa ku bahambaye, bat’ Uyu ni we bga bushobozi bg’Imana bgitwa Ubuhambaye.
Arikw icatuma bamushirak’ umutima n’uk’ uhereye kera yabūmiza n’amarēba yiwe.
Ariko bizeye ubutumwa bgiza Filipo ababgiye bg’ubgami bg’Imana, n’ubg’ izina rya Yesu Kristo, barabatizwa, abagabo n’abagore.
Na Simoni na we arizera, kand’ amaze kubatizwa yāmana na Filipo: abonye ibimenyetso n’ibitangaza bihambaye vyakorwa, arūmirwa.
Maz’ intumwa zir’i Yerusalemu zumvise yukw Abasamariya bemeye ijambo ry’Imana, zirungikayo Petero na Yohana,
na bo bamanutseyo barabasengera ngo bahabge Mpwemu Yera;
kuko Mpwemu ataribgamanuke ngw aje no kur’ umwe muri bo, bāri babatijwe gusa mw izina ry’Umwami Yesu.
Maze babarambikakw ibiganza, bahabga Mpwemu Yera.
