Ariko Simoni, abonye yukw abarambitswekw ibiganza vy’intumwa bahabga Mpwemu Yera, azizanira amahera,
ati Nanje ni mumpe ubgo bushobozi, kugira ng’uwo nzorambikakw ibiganza az’ ahabge Mpwemu Yera.
Petero aramubgira, at’ Ifeza zawe ziragapfana nawe, kuk’ ugira ngw ingabire y’Imana woyironkesha amahera.
Nta n’agahimba ufise, nta n’akagabane kavyo, kuk’ umutima wawe udatunganye imbere y’Imana.
Nuko wihane ubgo bubi bgawe, usenge Umwami Imana, namba kumbure ivyo wiyumviriye mu mutima wawe wobiharirwa.
Kuko mbona yuk’ uri mw ibamba ry’umururazi no mu ngoyi zo kugabitanya.
Simoni aramwishura, ati Munsengere Umwami Imana, ivyo muvuze hoye kugira ikimbako.
Na bo bamaze gushinga intahe, no kuvuga ijambo ry’Umwami Yesu, basubira i Yerusalemu, bagenda baravuga ubutumwa bgiza mu mihana myinshi y’Abasamariya.
Maz’ umumarayika w’Umwami Imana abarira Filipo, ati Va hasi uje i bumanuko, ushike ku nzira imanuka iva i Yerusalemu ikaja i Gaza: imwe yo mu bugaragwa.
Ava hasi, aragenda. Haza Umunyetiyopiya, inkone y’ububasha bginshi yakorera Kanidake, umugabekazi w’Abanyetiyopiya, ni yo yazezwa itunga ryiwe ryose, yari yagiye i Yerusalemu gusenga.
Yahindukiye yicaye mu mukogote wiwe ukwegwa n’amafarasi, asoma muri Yesaya yavugishwa n’Imana.
Mpwemu abarira Filipo, ati Ni wēgēre uriya mukogote, ugendane na wo.
Filipo yirukirayo, yumva asoma muri Yesaya yavugishwa n’Imana; aramubaza, at’ Ivyo usoma urabitahuye?
Na we ati Nobishobora nte, ntabonye ūbindōngōramwo? Yinginga Filipo ngo yūrire bicarane.
Igihimba co mu vyanditswe yasoma cār’ iki, ngo Yajanywe nk’intama bajana mw ibāgiro, Nk’uk’ umwagazi w’intama utekerereza imbere y’uwukemura Ni kw atākūyek’ umunwa.
Hamwe yacishwa bugufi barēngānye urubanza rwiwe, Ab’ urunganwe rwiwe ni nde azoshobora kubadondora? Kuk’ ubugingo bgiwe bukūwe mw isi.
Iyo nkone ibaza Filipo, iti Ndakubaza: uwavugishwa n’Imana yavuze ayo majambo kuri nde? Ni we yayīvuzeko, canke yayavuze ku wundi?
Filipo ateranura akanwa, atangurira kur’ ivyo vyanditswe, amubgira ubutumwa bgiza bga Yesu.
Bakigenda mu nzira, bashika ah’ ar’ amazi, iyo nkone iramubaza, it’ Ehe amazi: ikimbuza kubatizwa n’iki? [
Filipo arayishura, ati Namba wizeye mu mutima wawe wose birashoboka. Na yo iti Nizeye Yesu Kristo kw ar’ Umwana w’Imana.]
Ivuga ko bahagarika umukogote, baramanukana baja mu mazi bompi, Filipo n’iyo nkone, arayibatiza.
Bavuye mu mazi, Mpwemu w’Umwami Imana ajana Filipo, inkone ntiyasubira kumubona, kuko yashishikaye kugenda inezerewe.
Ariko Filipo abonekera muri Azoto, ahahita avuga ubutumwa bgiza mu bisagara vyose, kugeza aho yashikiye i Kayisariya.
Ariko Sauli, akigenda afuhagira, afitiye abigishwa b’Umwami imihigo n’ubgicanyi, aja ku muherezi mukuru,
amusaba ivyete vyo guha ab’ amasinagogi y’i Damasiko, kugira ngo ni yabona abantu bakurikira Inzira ya Yesu, ar’ abagabo cank’ abagore, abajane i Yerusalemu mu ngoyi.
Maz’ arikw aragenda, agira ashike i Damasiko, haza umuco giturumbuka, uvuye mw ijuru, umukayanganira irya n’ino.
Yikubita hasi, yumva ijwi rimubaza, riti Sauli, Sauli, umpīgira iki?
Aramubaza, at’ Uri nde ga Mwami? Na we ati Ni jewe Yesu, uwo urik’ urahīga;
ariko va hasi, ushike mu gisagara, uzobarirwa ivy’ ukwiye gukora.
Abagabo bajanye na we bahagarara badakoma, kuko bumvise ijwi, ata muntu babona.
Sauli aravyuka, ava hasi, maz’ akanuye amaso ntiyagira ic’ abona: bamufata ukuboko, bamushikana i Damasiko.
Amarayo gatatu, atabona, ata co arya, ata co anywa.
I Damasiko hār’ umwigishwa yitwa Ananiya: Umwami Yesu aramwiyereka, aramuhamagara, ati Ananiya. Na we ati Sabge, Mwami.
Umwami aramubarira, ati Va hasi, uje mu nzira yitwa Igororotse, ubarizeyo mu rugo kwa Yuda umuntu yitwa Sauli w’i Taruso, kukw arikw arasenga.
Kandi yabonye umuntu yitwa Ananiya yinjira ah’ ari, amurambikakw ibiganza, kugira ngw ahumūke.
Ananiya aramwishura, ati Mwami, uwo mugabo ko numvise benshi bavuga ivyiwe, vy’inabi nyinshi yagirira abera bawe i Yerusalemu:
kandi n’ino ahafise ububasha abuhāwe n’abaherezi bakuru, bgo kuboha abambaza izina ryawe bose.
Umwami aramwishura, ati Pfa kugenda, kuk’ uwo muntu ar’ ikintu nītoranirije, ngw ajane izina ryanje imbere y’abanyamahanga n’abami n’Abisirayeli:
nanje nzomwereka imibabaro ukw ingana azoba akwiye kubabazwa ahōrwa izina ryanje.
Ananiya aragenda, yinjira mu nzu, amurambikakw ibiganza, aramubgira, ati Sauli, mwene Data, Umwami arantumye, ni we Yesu yakubonekereye mu nzira wazananye, ng’uhumūke, wuzuzwe Mpwemu Yera.
Uwo mwanya ibisa n’ibikaragashi bimuva ku maso, arahumūka, ava hasi, arabatizwa:
maz’ ararya, intege ziragaruka. Amarana imisi n’abigishwa b’i Damasiko;
aca ahērakw avuga mu masinagogi ivya Yesu, yukw ar’ Umwana w’Imana.
Abamwumvise bose barūmirwa, bati Mbeg’ uyu si we yatikije abambaza iryo zina i Yerusalemu? Kandi ni co cari kimuzanye n’ino, kugira ngw abashīre abaherezi bakuru bari mu ngoyi.
Ariko Sauli arushiriza kugira ubushobozi, atsinda Abayuda baba i Damasiko, abereka yuko Yesu ari we Kristo.
Hashize imisi myinshi, Abayuda baja inama yo kumwica:
maze Sauli amenya inama yabo. Bamutegera ku marembo ku murango no mw ijoro kugira ngo bamwice.
Maz’ abigishwa biwe bamujana mw ijoro, bamucisha mu ruzitiro rw’amabuye, bamwururukirije mu gisangaza.
Ashitse i Yerusalemu, agerageza kwifatanya n’abigishwa: bose baramutinya, ntibemera kw ar’ umwigishwa.
Maze Barunaba aramwākīra, amushīra intumwa, azīgānira ingene yaboneye Umwami Yesu mu nzira, n’ingene yavuganye na we, kandi n’ingene yavuze ashize amanga mw izina rya Yesu i Damasiko.
Aba kumwe na bo amaja n’amaza i Yerusalemu,
avuga ashize amanga mw izina ry’Umwami Yesu; yaravuga ahārīra n’Abayuda bāvuye i Bugiriki: na bo barondera ingene bomwica.
Ariko bene Data babimenye, bamumanukana i Kayisariya, bamurungika i Taruso.
Nukw ishengero ryose ryari hose i Yudaya n’i Galilaya n’i Samariya rigira amahoro, rirahangama: kandi rigenda ryubaha Umwami Yesu, rihagarikiwe na Mpwemu Yera, riragwira.
Nuko Petero agendagenda hose, amanuka no ku bera baba i Luda,
asangay’ umuntu yitwa Ayineya, yar’ amaze imyaka munani avunda mu buriri, kuko yari yaramugaye.
Petero aramubgira, ati Ayineya, Yesu Kristo aragukijije: vyuka, wizingire ikirago. Aca avyuka ako kanya.
Ababa i Luda n’i Saroni bose bamubonye bahindukirira Umwami Yesu.
Kand’ i Yopa hār’ umwigishwa yitwa Tabita, risobanurwa ngo Doruka: uwo mugore yari n’ibikorwa vyiza vyinshi, n’ubuntu bginshi yagira.
Mur’ iyo misi ararwara, arapfa: bamaze kwuhagira ikiziga, bagishira mu nzu yo hejuru.
Kandi kukw i Luda hāri hafi y’i Yopa, abigishwa, bumvise ko Petero ari yo ari, bamutumakw abantu babiri, bamwinginga, bati Ntutebe kudushikīra.
Petero arikora, ajana na bo: ashitseyo bamujana muri ya nzu yo hejuru, abapfakazi bose bahagarara i ruhande yiwe barira, berekana amapfundo n’imitamana Doruka yapfunditse akiri muri bo.
Petero arabataramura bose, arapfukama, arasenga; maz’ ahindukirira umuvyimba, ati Tabita, vyuka. Arakanura; maz’ abonye Petero, aravyuka, aricara.
Amufata ukuboko, aramuhagarika. Maz’ ahamagara abera n’abapfakazi, amubaha ari muzima.
Bimenyekana i Yopa hose, benshi bizera Umwami Yesu.
Maz’ amara imisi myinshi i Yopa, kwa Simoni umuhazi w’insāto.
I Kayisariya hār’ umuntu yitwa Koruneliyo, umugabisha w’abasoda ijana wo mu ngabo zitwa Abanyetaliya.
Yar’ umuntu yubaha Imana akayitinyana n’abo mu nzu yiwe bose, yagirira abantu ubuntu bginshi, agasenga Imana ubudasība.
Abona yeretswe imbonankubone umumarayika w’Imana yinjiye i we hāri nk’isaha cenda z’umusi: aramuhamagara, ati Koruneliyo.
Na we amukanurira amaso, afise ubgoba, aramubaza, ati N’iki ga Mwami? Aramwishura, ati Gusenga kwawe n’ubuntu bgawe vyadūze biba icibutso imbere y’Imana.
None rero tuma abantu i Yopa, utumek’ umuntu yitwa Simoni, ari we Petero;
asembereye kwa Simoni umuhazi w’insāto, urugo rwiwe rur’i ruhande y’ikiyaga.
Umumarayika yavuganye na we amaze kugenda, ahamagara babiri bo mu basuku biwe, n’umusoda yubaha Imana wo mu bamugendanira:
ahejeje kubīgānira vyose, abatuma i Yopa.
Bukeye bg’aho, bakigenda, bari hafi gushika mu gisagara, Petero yūrira hejuru ku nzu gusenga, hāri nk’isaha zitandatu.
Yumva arashonje, agomba kurya: bakibirondera, amera nk’ūrota,
abona ijuru ryugurutse, maze hamanuka ikintu kimeze nk’uruhuzu runiniya, rufashwe ku mitwe ine, kija hasi,
hārimw’ ubgoko bgose bg’ibigenza amaguru ane, n’ibikwega inda hasi vyo kw isi, n’ibiguruka vyo mu kirēre.
Haza ijwi, riramubarira, riti Va hasi, Petero, ubāge, urye.
Petero at’ Oyaye, Mwami, kuko ntigeze ndya ikizira cank’ igihumanya.
Iryo jwi risubira kuza ubugira kabiri, riramubarira, rit’ Ivy’ Imana ihumanuye, reka kuvyita ibizira.
Biba birtyo gatatu, ico kintu gica gisubizwa mw ijuru.
Petero akizazaniwe mu mutima n’ivyo abonye yeretswe ivy’ ari vyo, abantu batumwe na Koruneliyo, bahejeje kubaza urugo rwa Simoni, bahagarara kw irembo,
barahamagara, babaza yuko Simoni ari we Petero ari ho asembereye.
Petero aciyumvira ivyo yeretswe, Mpwemu aramubarira, ati Har’ abantu batatu bariko barakurondera.
None va hasi, wururuke ujane na bo ata co ukekeranya, kukw ari jewe mbatumye.
Petero arururuka, asanga abo bantu aho bari, arababarira, ati Ni jewe uwo murondera: mbega mugenzwa n’iki?
Baramwishura, bati Koruneliyo, umugabisha w’abasoda ijana, umuntu agororoka yubaha Imana, ashimwa n’ubgoko bgose bg’Abayuda, yabariwe n’umumarayika yera kugutumako, ng’ uze i we, yumve amajambo yawe.
Maz’ arabinjiza, abaha indāro. Bukeye bg’aho, Petero arīkora, avanayo na bo, na bene Data bamwe b’i Yopa bajana na we.
Bukeye bg’aho bashika i Kayisariya, Koruneliyo yar’ abīteze, yākoranije incuti ziwe n’abakunzi bo ku mutima.
Petero agira yinjire, Koruneliyo aramusanganira, yikubita imbere y’ibirenge vyiwe, aramupfukamira.
Maze Petero amukūra hasi, ati Va hasi, nanje nd’umuntu nkawe.
Bakivugana, arinjira asanga abakoraniyeho benshi,
arababgira, at’ Ubganyu murazi yuko kizira k’umuntu w’Umuyuda yifatanya n’uw’ ubundi bgoko, canke kw amugendera: ariko jeho, Imana yanyeretse yuko hatogira umuntu nita ikizira cank’ igihumanya.
Ni co catumye nza, ntarinze guhakana, ntumweko. None rero ndabaza ico mwantumiyeko ic’ ari co.
Koruneliyo ati Hashize imisi ine, nka bugingo ubu, nariko ndasenga ar’ isaha cenda, ndi mu nzu yanje; maz’ umuntu ahagarara imbere yanje, yambaye impuzu ikayangana,
arambgira, ati Koruneliyo, ugusenga kwawe kwarumviswe, n’ubuntu bgawe bgibutswe imbere y’Imana.
Nuko tuma i Yopa, utumeko Simoni ari we Petero: asembereye mu rugo kwa Simoni umuhazi w’insāto, i ruhande y’ikiyaga.
Uwo mwanya nca ndagutumako rero, nawe urayobotse k’uje. None rero twese turi hano imbere y’Imana, kwumva ivy’ Umwami Imana yakugeze kutubgira vyose.
Petero yanzika kuvuga, ati N’ukuri ni ho nkimenya yukw Imana itarobanura abantu ku butoni,
ariko mu mahanga yose ūyubaha, agakora ivy’ ukugororoka, iramwemera.
Ijambo Imana yatumye ku Bisirayeli, ivugisha Yesu Kristo ubutumwa bgiza bg’amahoro, ni we Mwami wa bose;
iryo jambo mwebge murarizi, ryāmāmaye i Yudaya hose, ritanguriye i Galilaya, hanyuma y’umubatizo uwo Yohana yigishije:
rivuga ivya Yesu Umunyanazareti, ingen’ Imana yamusutseko Mpwemu Yera n’ubushobozi, akagenda agirira abantu neza, agakiza abo bose wa Murwanizi atwaza amanyama, kukw Imana yari kumwe na we.
Natwe tur’ ivyabona vyo gushingira intahe ivyo yakoze vyose mu gihugu c’Abayuda, bo n’i Yerusalemu, umwe bishe, bamumanitse ku giti.
Uyo, Imana iramuzura ku musi ugira gatatu, imuha guserurwa ahibonekeza,
s’imbere y’abantu bose, arikw imbere y’ivyabona vyatoranijwe n’Imana ivyo bitarabaho, ni twebge, abāsangira na we, turya kandi tunywa, amaze kuzuka mu bapfuye.
Atugera kumenyesha abantu no gushinga intahe kw ari we Imana yashinze kuba Umucamateka w’abariho n’abapfuye.
Abāvugishwa n’Imana bose bāmushingiye intahe, bavuga yuk’ ūmwizera wese azoharirwa ivyaha kubg’ izina ryiwe.
Petero akivuga ayo majambo, Mpwemu Yera aramanuka, aja ku bariko barumva iryo jambo bose.
Abizeye bo mu bākebge barūmirwa, abāzananye na Petero uko bangana, kuko n’abanyamahanga na bo basutswekw ingabire, ari yo Mpwemu Yera.
Kuko bumvise bavuga izindi ndimi, bahimbaza Imana. Maze Petero arababaza,
ati Mbega har’ uwoshobora kwima amazi abahawe Mpwemu Yera nkatwe, ngo ntibabatizwe?
Avuga ko babatizwa mw izina rya Yesu Kristo. Baca baramwinginga ngw amarey’ imisi.
Intumwa na bene Data bar’i Yudaya bumva yukw abanyamahanga na bo bemeye ijambo ry’Imana.
Maze Petero adūze i Yerusalemu, abo mu bākebge baramutonganya,
bati Ko winjiriye abatākebge, ugasangira na bo!
Maze Petero aratangura, abibasobanurira uko bikurikirana,
ati Nari mu gisagara c’i Yopa, ndiko ndasenga, mbona neretswe nko mu nzozi ikintu kimanuka kivuye mw ijuru, kimeze nk’uruhuzu runiniya rufashwe ku mitwe ine, kiza aho ndi.
Ngihanga amaso, ndacitegereza, mbonamw’ ibigenza amaguru ane vyo kw isi, n’ibikōko vyo mw ishamba, n’ibikwega inda hasi, n’ibiguruka vyo mu kirēre.
Kandi numva ijwi rimbarira, riti Va hasi, Petero, ubāge urye.
Nanje nt’ Oyaye, Mwami, kukw ata kizira cank’ igihumanya cigeze kija mu kanwa kanje.
Maz’ ijwi rimbarira ubugira kabiri rivuye mw ijuru, rit’ Ivy’ Imana ihumanuye, reka kuvyita ibizira.
Biba birtyo gatatu, biradūzwa vyose, bisubizwa mw ijuru.
Uwo mwanya abagabo batatu bavuye i Kayisariya, bantumweko, bahagarara imbere y’inzu turimwo.
Mpwemu ambarira kujana na bo, ata tandukaniro. Kandi na bene Data aba, ukw ari batandatu, turajana, twinjira mu nzu y’uwo mugabo.
Atwīgānira ingene yabonye umumarayika mu nzu yiwe, ahagaze amubarira, ati Tuma i Yopa, utumeko Simoni ari we Petero,
azokubarira amajambo yo kugukizanya n’abo mu nzu yawe bose.
Ngitanguye kuvuga, Mpwemu Yera arabamanukira, nk’uko yamanukiye kuri twebge ubga mbere.
Nibuka rya jambo ry’Umwami Yesu, uko yavuze, ati Yohana yabatirishije amazi, ariko mweho muzobatizwa na Mpwemu Yera.
None kw Imana yabahaye ingabire imwe n’iyo natwe twahawe hamwe twizera Umwami Yesu Kristo, jewe nd’ iki gishobora gutāngīra Imana?
Bumvise ivyo barīhorera, bahimbaza Imana, bati Noneho rer’ Imana ihaye n’abanyamahanga kwihana ngo baronke ubugingo.
Nukw abāsābagijwe n’amarushwa yabaye kubg’ ivya Stefano baragenda, bashika n’i Foyinike n’i Kupuro no muri Antiyokiya, ata bandi babarira ijambo ry’Imana atar’ Abayuda bonyene.
Ariko hāri bamwe muri bo b’abagabo bavuye i Kupuro n’i Kurene bashitse muri Antiyokiya babarira n’Abagiriki na bo, bababgira ubutumwa bgiza bg’Umwami Yesu.
Ukuboko kw’Umwami kwari kumwe na bo, abantu benshi barizera, bahindukirira Umwami.
Inkuru yabo ishika mu matwi y’ishengero ry’i Yerusalemu, batuma Barunaba ngw ashirwe ashitse muri Antiyokiya.
Na we amaze gushikayo, abonye ubuntu bg’Imana, biramunezereza, arabahanūra bose ngo bamaramaze mu mitima kwifatanya akaramata n’Umwami Yesu.
Kuko yar’ imico myiza, yuzuye Mpwemu Yera n’ukwizera. Abantu benshi bagwirirana ku Mwami Yesu.
Avayo, aja i Taruso kurondera Sauli,
amubonye, amujana muri Antiyokiya. Bamaray’ umwaka wose, bakorana n’ishengero, bigisha abantu benshi, kandi muri Antiyokiya ni ho abigishwa bātanguriye kwitwa Abakristo.
Mur’ iyo misi, abavugishwa n’Imana bava i Yerusalemu baja muri Antiyokiya.
Hava hasi umwe muri bo yitwa Agabo, abamenyesha avugishijwe na Mpwemu yukw ikigoyi cinshi kizotera mw isi yose. Ico yavuga ni kimwe cātera ku ngoma ya Kilawudiyo.
Maz’ abigishwa, umuntu wese nk’ukw atunze, bashinga kurungikira bene Data baba i Yudaya ivyo kubatabara.
Babigenza bartyo, babirungikira abakuru, bijanye Barunaba na Sauli.
Maze nko mur’ ico gihe umwami Herode ata mu maboko bamwe bo mw ishengero ngw abagirire nabi.
Yicisha inkota Yakobo mwene nyina wa Yohana.
Maz’ abonye ko bihimbaye Abayuda, ariyongeza, afata na Petero. Hāri mu misi y’imitsima itambiwe.
Amaze kumufata, amushira mw ibohero, amuha abasoda cumi na batandatu kumurinda ari bane‐bane, agira ngw az’ amushikirize abantu, Pasika ishize.
Nuko Petero arindirwa mw ibohero: arikw ab’ishengero baramusengera, batakambira Imana bakobeje.
Ku musi Herode bgāca amubashikiriza, mur’ iryo joro Petero yar’ asinziriye hagati y’abasoda babiri, aboheshejwe iminyororo ibiri, abateramyi bāri ku rugi barinda inzu y’ibohero.
Maz’ umumarayika w’Umwami Imana amuhagarara i ruhande, umuco ubonesha mu nzu. Akoma Petero mu mbavu, aramukangura, ati Vyuka n’ingoga. Iminyororo imuva ku maboko, irakoroka.
Umumarayika aramubarira, ati Kenyera, wambare inkweto zawe. Abigenza artyo. Kand’ aramubarira, at’ Ikubirek’ umutamana wawe, unkurikire.
Arasohoka, aramukurikira, yamara ntiyamenya ivyo umumarayika akoze kw ar’ ivy’ ukuri, arikw agira ngw abonye ivyo yeretswe nko mu nzozi.

Baciye ku bateramyi ba mbere no ku ba kabiri, bashika kw irembo ryugarije urugi rw’icuma, rija mu gisagara. Rurabīyugururira ubgarwo, barenga irembo baca mu nzira imwe, uwo mwanya umumarayika aca amusiga hano.
Akenge kagarutse, Petero aribgira, ati Noneho mmenye vy’ukuri yuk’ Umwami yatumye umumarayika wiwe, akankiza ukuboko kwa Herode, bo n’ivyo ubgoko bg’Abayuda bgāri bushamāje vyose.
Amaze kuvyiyumvira, aja kwa Mariya, nyina wa Yohana ari we Mariko, aho bāri bakoraniye benshi, bariko barasenga.
Petero akomanga ku rugi rw’irembo, umukobga w’umugurano yitwa Rode aja kwumvīra.
Amenye ijwi rya Petero akanyamuneza kamubuza kwugurura, arirukanga arinjira, ababarira yuko Petero ahagaze kw irembo.
Baramwishura, bat’ Urasara. Na we avuga ashimitse kw ar’ivy’ ukuri. Bati N’umumarayika wiwe.
Ariko Petero ashishikara gukomanga: buguruye baramubona, barūmirwa.
Arabamama, abīgānira uk’Umwami Imana yamukūye mw ibohero, arababgira, at’ Ivyo mubibarire Yakobo na bene Data bandi. Arahava, aja ahandi.
Ijoro rikeye, havyuka imivurungano itari mike mu basoda, kuko bazazaniwe ukuntu Petero yabaye.
Herode amurondeye amubuze, acunaguza abateramyi, avuga ko babajana kubica: maz’ ava i Yudaya amanuka i Kayisariya, agumayo.
Maz’ ashāmira abo muri Tiro n’i Sidoni, na bo bahūza inama, baja kuri we, bahongera Bulasito, umukuru w’abagaranzurira umwami, basaba impore, kukw igihugu cabo casuma mu gihugu c’uwo mwami.
Nuko ku musi washinzwe, Herode yambara impuzu z’ubgami, avyagira ku ntebe y’icubahiro, abacūrira amajambo.
Abantu barasemerera, bati N’ijwi ry’imana, s’iry’ umuntu.
Uwo mwanya umumarayika w’Umwami Imana aramukubita, kukw adahaye Imana Rurema icubahiro, aturika inyo, aracīkāna.
Arikw ijambo ry’Imana riragwira, riramamara.
Kandi Barunaba na Sauli bava i Yerusalemu, basubira inyuma, bashikirije ivyāgabuwe, bajana Yohana, ari we Mariko.

Kandi muri Antiyokiya, mw ishengero ryaho, hār’ abavugishwa n’Imana n’abigisha; umwe ni Barunaba na Simeyoni ari we Nigeru, na Lukiyosi Umunyakurene, na Manayeni yarerewe hamwe n’umwami Herode, hāriho na Sauli.
Bariko barasenga Umwami Imana bisonzesheje, Mpwemu Yera aravuga, ati Ni mundobanurire Barunaba na Sauli bankorere igikorwa nabahamagariye.
Nuko bisonzesheje, basenze, babarambitsekw ibiganza, barabarungika.
Nuko bavuyeyo batumwe na Mpwemu Yera bamanuka i Seleyukiya. Bavudukayo bari mu bgato bafata i Kupuro.
Maze bashitse i Salamini, bavuga ijambo ry’Imana mu masinagogi y’Abayuda: kandi bāri bafise Yohana agenda arabakorera.
Bararamiriza baca mur’ ico kizinga cose, bashika i Pafo, basangay’ umugabo w’umunyamarēba, umuraguzi w’ibinyoma, yar’ Umuyuda, izina ryiwe ni Bari‐Yesu;
yagendanira Serugiyo Paulo, icēgēra ca Kayisari, umuntu w’ubgenge. Uyo ahamagaza Barunaba na Sauli, ashaka kwumva ijambo ry’Imana.
Ariko Eluma, uwo munyamarēba (izina ryiwe ni ko risobanurwa), arabahāririza, ashaka guhuvya ico cēgēra ngo nticizere.
Ariko Sauli ari we Paulo, yuzuye Mpwemu Yera, amuhanga amaso,
ati Wewe wuzuye ubugunge bgose n’ububi bgose, wa mwana w’Umurwanizi we, wa mwansi w’ivyo kugororoka vyose, ntuzoreka kugoreka inzira z’Umwami Imana zigororotse?
Nuko rāba, ukuboko kw’Umwami Imana kuraguhanamiye, ugira uhume, umare imisi utabona izuba. Ako kanya igipfungu n’umwiza bimwubikizako, agenda azimagirika arondera uwo kumufata ukuboko.
Ico cēgēra kibonye ibibaye kirizera, gitangajwe n’ivyo cigishijwe vy’Umwami Yesu.
Maze Paulo n’abāri kumwe na we bavuduka i Pafo bari mu bgato, bafata i Peruga h’i Pamfiliya: Yohana abasigayo, asubira i Yerusalemu.
Ariko bo bavuduka i Peruga, bararamiriza, bashika muri Antiyokiya h’i Pisidiya; ku musi w’isabato binjira mw isinagogi, baricara.
Isomwa ry’ivyagezwe n’ivy’ abāvugishwa n’Imana riheze, abakuru b’isinagogi batuma kuri bo, bati Bene Data, ni mwaba mufise ijambo ryo guhanūra abantu, ni murivuge.
Paulo ava hasi, arabamama, arababarira, ati Yemwe bagabo b’Abisirayeli, namwe abubaha Imana, ni mwumve.
Imana y’ubu bgoko bg’Abisirayeli yatoranije ba sogokuruza, kand’ ishira abantu hejuru hamwe bār’ abambukīra mu gihugu ca Egiputa, ikabakūzay’ ukuboko gukomeye.
Yihanganira ingeso zabo nk’imyaka mirongwine mu bugaragwa.
Imaze guhonnya amahanga ndwi mu gihugu c’i Kanani, ibēgurira ico gihugu cabo kuba ishamvu yabo. Maze nk’imyaka amajana ane na mirongwitanu ishize,
ibaha abacamanza, gushitsa ku wavugishwa n’Imana Samweli.
Hanyuma bayisaba umwami, Imana ibaha Sauli mwene Kishi, umugabo wo mu muryango wa Benyamini, amara ku ngoma imyaka mirongwine.
Imukūye, ibahagurukiriza Dawidi kuba umwami wabo, imushingira intahe, iti Mbonye Dawidi mwene Isayi umuntu ameze nk’uk’ umutima wanje ugomba, azokora ivyo ngomba vyose.
Mu ruvyaro rw’uwo, nk’ukw Imana yasezeranye, yazaniye Abisirayeli Umukiza, ni we Yesu.
Ataraza, Yohana yari yigishije ubgoko bgose bg’Abisirayeli ukubatizwa kwo kwihana.

Ariko Yohana arikw arasozera urugendo rwiwe, arababaza, ati Mbega mwiyumvira ko ndi nde? Jewe sindi we. Mugabo har’ ūzoza mu nyuma yanje, kandi jewe ntibimbereye no gupfundurura inkweto zo mu birenge vyiwe.
Bagabo bene Data, bana bo mu muryango wa Aburahamu, namwe abubaha Imana, ijambo ry’ako gakiza ni twebge ryatumweko.
Kukw ababa i Yerusalemu n’abakuru babo batāmumenye, cank’ amajambo y’abavugishwa n’Imana asomwa ukw isabato itashe, ni co catumye bashitsa ivyo bāvugishijwe, hamwe bāmutsindisha:
kandi naho bābuze inyanduruko yo kumwicisha, basaba Pilato kw amwica.
Bamaze gushitsa ivyo yandikiwe vyose, bamumanura ku giti, bamushira mu mva.
Arikw Imana iramuzura mu bapfuye.
Imisi myinshi abonekera abāri baradūganye na we ava i Galilaya aja i Yerusalemu, abo ni bo bamushingira intahe ubu imbere y’abantu.
Natwe turababgira ubutumwa bgiza bg’ivyasezeraniwe ba sogokuruza,
yukw Imana yabishikije kuri twebge abana babo, hamwe yazura Yesu. Kandi ni ko vyanditswe muri Zaburi ya kabiri, ng’ Ur’ Ubura bganje, uyu musi ndakuvyaye.
Kandi kuko yamuzuye mu bapfuye atazosubira mw iborero, yavuze irtya, iti Nzobaha imigisha yera ya Dawidi itazovaho.
No muri Zaburi yindi yavuze, ngo Ntuzotanga Uwera wawe ngw az’ abore.
Yamara Dawidi mu gihe ciwe amaze gukora ivy’ Imana igomba, arasinzira, ahamvya ba sekuruza, arabora.
Arik’ uwo Imana yazuye nta ho yigeze abora.
Nuko bagabo bene Data, ni mumenye ko mur’ uwo ari ho mubgirirwa ivy’ uguharirwa ivyaha:
kandi ni we atsindanishiriza ūmwizera wese kuri vyose, ivyo mutāshoboye gutsindanishirizwa n’ivyagezwe vya Mose.
Nuko mwiyubare, ivyavuzwe n’abavugishwa n’Imana vyoye kubashikako,
ngo Rāba mwa banyagakēngērwe, mutangare, muyongayonge, Kuko ngira nkore igikorwa mu gihe canyu, Igikorwa mutazoruha mwemera, nah’ umuntu yokibasobanurira.
Bariko barasohoka, barabinginga ngw ayo majambo az’ avugwe no kw isabato izoza.

Abāri mw isinagogi bamaze gusābagira, benshi mu Bayuda bo n’abātoye idini yabo bakubaha Imana, bakurikira Paulo na Barunaba; na bo bayāga na bo, barabahanūra ngo bashishikare kuguma mu buntu bg’Imana.
Kw isabato ikurikira iyo, hakorana nk’abo mu gisagara bose kwumva ijambo ry’Imana.
Arikw Abayuda babonye ishengero ryinshi, buzura ishari, bahakanya ivyo Paulo avuze, barabicokora.

Paulo na Barunaba bavuga bashize amanga, bati Vyari bibereye kw ijambo ry’Imana ribanza kubgirwa mwebge; none ko murishibuye, mukībūra ko mutabereye ubugingo budashira, ehe‐e duhindukiriye abanyamahanga.
Kuk’ Umwami Imana ari ko yatubariye, ati Ndagushizeho ng’ ube umuco w’amahanga, Kugira ngo n’abo ku mpera y’isi ubashikirize agakiza.
Abanyamahanga bavyumvise baranezerwa, bashimagiza ijambo ry’Imana; abāri baragerewe ubugingo budashira bose barizera.
Ijambo ry’Umwami Yesu rikwira mur’ ico gihugu cose.
Arikw Abayuda bosha abagore b’icubahiro bubaha Imana, n’abakuru bo mur’ ico gisagara, bavyurira akadenderezo Paulo na Barunaba, babirukana mu ntāra yabo.
Na bo babakunkumurira umukungugu wo mu birenge vyabo, baja muri Ikoniyo.
Abigishwa buzuzwa umunezero na Mpwemu Yera.
Maze bari muri Ikoniyo bompi binjira mw isinagogi y’Abayuda, bavuga amajambo atuma Abayuda n’Abagiriki benshi cane bizera.
Arikw Abayuda banse kwumvira ivyo, bavyura urwanko mu mitima y’abanyamahanga ngo bagirire inabi bene Data.
Bamara imisi myinshi bavuga batabobotereza kubg’ Umwami Yesu, ashingira intahe ijambo ry’ubuntu bgiwe, abaha gukora ibimenyetso n’ibitangaza n’amaboko yabo.
Arikw abantu bo mur’ ico gisagara bīrema ibice, bamwe baherēra ku Bayuda, abandi ku ntumwa.
Kand’ abanyamahanga, bo n’Abayuda n’abashingantahe babo baja kubatera ngo babagirire nabi babicishe amabuye;
barabimenya, bahungira i Lusitira n’i Derube, ibisagara vy’i Lukawoniya, no mu gihugu gihereranye na ho:
bagumayo bavuga ubutumwa bgiza.
I Lusitira hār’ umugabo yar’ aremaye ibirenge uhereye aho yakaviriye mu nda ya nyina, nta ho yari yarigeze gutambuka.
Uwo yumva Paulo avuga, na we amuhanze amaso abona kw afise ukwizera kwo gukizwa.
Avuga n’ijwi rirenga, ati Hagarara n’ibirenge vyawe, weme. Arabaduka, aratambuka.
Maz’ ishengero ribonye ico Paulo akoze, bavuga n’ijwi rirenga mu Kinyalukawoniya, bat’ Imana zitumanukiyemwo zīshushanije n’abantu.
Barunaba bamwita Zeyu, Paulo na we bamwita Herume, kukw ari we yar’ imvuzi.
Maz’ umuherezi wa Zeyu, ingoro y’igitabo cayo yar’ imbere y’igisagara, azana amapfizi n’imyīshwa, agira acumite ikimazi, we n’ishengero.
Arikw intumwa, Barunaba na Paulo, bavyumvise, bītantamurirakw impuzu zabo, bītera mu bantu, basemerera,

bati Yemwe bagabo, n’iki gitumye mugira murtyo? Natwe tur’ abantu buntu, tumeze nkamwe, kandi tubabgira ubutumwa bgiza, ngo mureke ivyo bitagira ikimazi, muhindukirire Imana nzima, yaremye ijuru n’isi n’ikiyaga n’ibirimwo vyose,
ni yo yaretse amahanga yose mu bihe vyahise ngo bagendere mu nzira zabo.
Ariko ntiyabirekeye ngaho, itagira ico kuyishingira intahe, kuko yama ibagirira neza, ibaha imvura iva mw ijuru, n’ibihe vy’ivyimburo vyiza, ibahāza ivyo kurya, yuzuza imitima yanyu umunezero.
Aho bāvuga ayo majambo, hāri hasigaye gatoya ntibabe bakibuza ishengero kubacumitira ikimazi.
Maze haza Abayuda bavuye muri Antiyokiya no muri Ikoniyo; bamaze kwosha ishengero, batera Paulo amabuye, bamukwegera inyuma y’igisagara, bagira ngo yāpfuye.
Arikw abigishwa bahagaze bamukikije, aravyuka, aja mu gisagara; bukeye bg’aho avanayo na Barunaba, aja i Derube.
Bamaze kuvuga ubutumwa bgiza mur’ ico gisagara no guhindura benshi abigishwa, basubira i Lusitira no muri Ikoniyo no muri Antiyokiya,
baremesha imitima y’abigishwa, babahanūra ngo bagume mu kwizera: kandi yuko dukwiye guca mu marushwa menshi mu kwinjira mu bgami bg’Imana.
Kandi bamaze kubatorera abakuru mu mashengero yose, no gusenga bisonzesha, babaragiza Umwami Yesu, uwo bizeye.
Baca i Pisidiya, bashika i Pamfiliya.
Bamaze kuvuga ijambo ry’Imana i Peruga baramanuka baja muri Ataliya;
bavudukayo bari mu bgato bafata muri Antiyokiya, aho bāri barazigamishirijwe ubuntu bg’Imana ubga mbere ku gikorwa baheraheje.
Bashitseyo bakoranya ishengero, babīgānira ivy’ Imana yakoranye na bo vyose, n’ingene yugururiye abanyamahanga urugi rwo kwizera.
Bamarana n’abigishwa igihe kitari gito.
Maze haza abantu bamwe bavuye i Yudaya bigisha bene Data, bati Ni mutākebga, nk’uk’ umugenzo wa Mose uri, ntimuzoruha mukizwa.

Maze Paulo na Barunaba bamaze kugira ibihāri n’imibūrano itari mike n’abo bantu, abaho bahūza inama gutuma Paulo na Barunaba n’abandi bamwe bo muri bo, ngo baje i Yerusalemu ku ntumwa n’abakuru kubg’ iyo mibūrano.
Nukw abo, ishengero rimaze kubaherekeza, baca i Foyinike bo n’i Samariya, babamenyesha ingen’ abanyamahanga bāhindukiriye Imana, batera bene Data bose akanyamuneza kenshi.
Bashitse i Yerusalemu, ishengero n’intumwa n’abakuru barabākīra, na bo babīgānira ivy’ Imana yakoranye na bo vyose.
Maze hava hasi bamwe bo mu muce w’Abafarisayo bizeye, baravuga, bat’ Abanyamahanga birakwiye ko bakebga, no kubabgiriza kwitondera ivyagezwe vya Mose.
Nukw intumwa n’abakuru bakoranira hamwe kuja inama y’iryo jambo.

Habaye imibūrano myinshi, Petero ava hasi, arababgira, ati Bagabo bene Data, murazi yuko kera Imana yantoranije muri mwebge kugira ngo mu kanwa kanje abe ari ho abanyamahanga bumva ijambo ry’ubutumwa bgiza, bizere.
Kand’ Imana izi imitima, yarabashingiye intahe, hamwe yabaha Mpwemu Yera, nk’uko yamuduhaye natwe;
ntiyashirah’ itandukaniro hagati yacu na bo, yogesheje imitima yabo ukwizera.
None rero n’iki gitumye mugerageza Imana, mwikoreza abigishwa imitwaro ba sogokuruza batāshoboye kwikorera canke twebge?
Ariko twizeye yuko tuzokizwa n’ubuntu bg’Umwami Yesu nka bo.
Maz’ ishengero ryose riracereza, bumviriza Barunaba na Paulo babīgānira ibimenyetso n’ibitangaza vyose Imana yabahaye gukora mu banyamahanga.
Barangije kuvuga, Yakobo aravuga, ati Bagabo bene Data, ni munyumvirize.
Simoni yabīgāniye ingen’ Imana yatanguye kugendera abanyamahanga ngw ibarobanuremw’ ubgoko bg’izina ryayo.
Amajambo y’abavugishwa na yo ahūye n’ivyo, nk’uko handitswe,
ngo Hanyuma y’ivyo nzogaruka, Nongere nubake urusago rwa Dawidi rwatemvye, Nongere nsanasane ahāshize harwo, ndaruhagarike,
Kugira ngw amasigarira y’abantu baronderane Uhoraho N’amahanga yose yitirirwa izina ryanje,
Ni k’Uhoraho agize, akora ivyo vyose, yabimenye uhereye ku kuremwa kw’isi.
Nuko rer’ inama yanje n’uko tureka kugora abo mu banyamahanga bahindukirira Imana,
ariko tubandikire ngo bareke ibihumanya vy’ibigirwamana, no gusambana, no kurya ibinizwe, bo n’amaraso.
Kuk’ uhereye kera hose Mose afise mu bisagara vyose abigisha ivyiwe, bisomwa mu masinagogi ukw isabato itashe.
Maz’ intumwa n’abakuru, bo n’ishengero ryose, bashima gutoranya abagabo muri bo, ni Yuda ari we Barusaba, na Sila, abantu bakuru muri bene Data, no kubatumana muri Antiyokiya na Paulo na Barunaba:
bandika icete, barakibarungikana, canditswe girtya, ngw Intumwa na bene Data bakuru turabatasha mwebge bene Data bo mu banyamahanga bari muri Antiyokiya n’i Siriya n’i Kilikiya.
Kuko twumvise yuko bamwe bāvuye muri twebge bābahagarikishije imitima amajambo, bakayisangangura, kandi tutābibageze;
duhūje inama dushimye gutoranya abo bantu no kubatumana kuri mwebge n’abo dukunda Barunaba na Paulo,
abantu bāhevye amagara yabo kubg’ izina ry’Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo.
Nukw abo dutumye ni Yuda na Sila, na bo ubgabo bazobabarira mu rurimi bimwe n’ibi.
Kuko Mpwemu Yera bimubereye vyiza, natwe n’uko, kutabīkoreza uwundi mutwaro urenze ibi bikwiye:
mureke kurya ivyaterekerejwe ibigirwamana, n’amaraso, n’ibinizwe, mureke no gusambana; ivyo ni mwavyirinda, muzomera neza. Nuko muganūke.
Nukw abo basezewe bamanuka muri Antiyokiya; bamaze gukoraniriza hamwe ishengero, babashikiriza kino cete.
Bamaze kugisoma banezererwa iyo mpanūro.
Na Yuda na Sila, kuko na bo bār’ abavugishwa n’Imana, bahanūra bene Data mu majambo menshi, barabaremesha.
Bahamaze imisi, bene Data babasezera amahoro, ngo basubire ku bābatumye. [
Mugabo Sila bimubera vyiza kugumayo.]
Kandi Paulo na Barunaba baguma muri Antiyokiya bigisha abantu, bababgira ijambo ry’Umwami Yesu, bafatanije n’abandi benshi.
Hashize imisi, Paulo abgira Barunaba, at’ Ingo dusubire ha handi tugendere bene Data mu gisagara cose aho twāvuze ijambo ry’Umwami Yesu, tumenye uko bameze.
Barunaba agomba ko bajana na Yohana na we, ari we Mariko.
Ariko Paulo ntivyamubera vyiza kujana uwabataye i Pamfiliya, ntajane na bo mur’ ico gikorwa.
Havyuka imitongano ibatera gutandukana, Barunaba ajana Mariko, avudukayo ari mu bgato, afata i Kupuro;
Paulo na we atoranya Sila, avayo, bene Data bamaze kumuragiza ubuntu bg’Umwami Yesu.
Aca i Siriya n’i Kilikiya, aremesha amashengero.
Nukw ashika i Derube n’i Lusitira; hāriy’ umwigishwa yitwa Timoteyo, umwana w’Umuyudakazi umugore yizeye, ariko se yar’ Umugiriki:
yashimwa na bene Data b’i Lusitira no muri Ikoniyo.
Uyo, Paulo agomba ko bajana, aramwābīra aramukeba, kubg’ Abayuda bo mur’ izo ntāra, kuko bose bāri bazi yuko se yar’ Umugiriki.
Bariko baraca mu bisagara, bagenda bababgira ivyo intumwa n’abakuru b’i Yerusalemu bāshinze, ngo bavyitondere.
Nukw amashengero akomerezwa mu kwizera, agenda yunguka ibitigiri imisi yose.
Baca mu gihugu c’i Furugiya n’i Galatiya, babuzwa na Mpwemu Yera kuvuga ijambo ry’Imana muri Asiya.
Bashitse ahabangikanye n’i Musiya, bagerageza kuja i Bituniya, Mpwemu wa Yesu ntiyabakundira:
baca i Musiya baramanuka, bashika i Tirowa.
Maze Paulo mw ijoro arota inzozi, abona umugabo w’i Makedoniya ahagaze amwinginga, ati Jabuka uze i Makedoniya, udutabare.
Amaze kurota izo nzozi, duca turondera ingene tuja i Makedoniya, kuko tumenye yukw Imana iduhamagariye kubabgira ubutumwa bgiza.
Nuko tuvuduka i Tirowa mu bgato, turaramiriza tuja i Samotirake, bukeye bg’aho dushika i Neyapoli,
tuvuyeyo dushika i Filipi, igisagara c’i Makedoniya gikuru mur’ iyo ntāra, cubatswe n’Abaroma. Tumara imisi mur’ ico gisagara.
Ku musi w’isabato turenga irembo ry’igisagara, tuja ku ruzi, dukēka ko hobay’ ahahora hasengerwa. Turicara, tuyāga n’abagore bahakoraniye.
Umugore umwe yitwa Ludiya, umudandaza w’impuzu z’inyambarabami, wo mu gisagara citwa Tuwatira, yubaha Imana, aratwumviriza. Umwami Yesu amwugurura umutima, kugira ngw awushire ku vyo Paulo yavuga.
Amaze kubatizanywa n’abo mu nzu yiwe, aratwinginga, at’ Asangwa mubonye nd’uwizeye Umwami Yesu, ni muze i wanje, musembereho. Aratugōbēra.
Bukeye tugiye aho basengera, duhūra n’umwigeme arimwo dayimoni aragura, yar’ atungishije ba shebuja cane kubg’ iyo ndagu.
Uyo aradukurikira twebge na Paulo, asemerera, at’ Aba bantu n’abasavyi b’Imana isumba vyose, kandi bababarira inzira y’agakiza.
Amara imisi myinshi agenza artyo. Ariko Paulo adundumiwe, arahindukira, abarira dayimoni, ati Ndakubariye mw izina rya Yesu Kristo, muvemwo. Amuvamwo mur’ ako kanya.
Maze ba shebuja babonye yukw ico bazigakw inyungu kivuyeho, bafata Paulo na Sila, barabakwega babajana mu kaguriro imbere y’abashingantahe,
babashīra abacamanza, bat’ Aba bantu bahagarika imitima y’abo mu gisagara cacu, kand’ ar’ Abayuda;
batuzanira imigenzo tuzira kwemera canke kuyikora, twebge tur’ Abaroma.
Ishengero ribahagurukira icarimwe, abacamanza babakākagurirakw impuzu, bagera ko babakubita.
Bamaze kubakubita inkoni nyinshi, babashira mw ibohero, babarira umurinzi kubarinda cane.
Na we abariwe artyo abashira mu nzu yo hagati, arobeza amaguru yabo mu mpatane z’ibiti.
Maze nko mu gicugu Paulo na Sila bariko barasenga baririmbira Imana, izindi mbohe zibumva,
isi ica inyiganyiga cane giturumbuka, bituma amatanguriro y’inzu y’ibohero anyiganyiga, ako kanya inzugi zose ziruguruka, iminyororo ya bose iradohoka.
Uwo murinzi yikanguye, abonye inzugi z’ibohero zuguruye, asokora inkota agira yiyahure, kuko yagira ngw imbohe zācitse.
Ariko Paulo asemerera n’ijwi rirenga, ati Ntiwigirire nabi, twese turi hano.
Ahamagaza imuri, yitera mu nzu, ari mu gatengo k’ubgoba, yikubita imbere ya Paulo na Sila,
arabasohokana, arababaza, ati Bagenzi, nkwiye gukora iki ngo nkire?
Baramwishura, bat’ Izere Umwami Yesu, urakira, mwe n’abo mu nzu yawe.
Bamubarira ijambo ry’Umwami Yesu, n’abo mu nzu yiwe bose.
Mur’ ico gihe nyene c’ijoro arabajana, abuhagira inguma z’inkoni, aca arabatizwa, bo n’abiwe bose.
Arabadūgana, abajana i we, arabagaburira, anezeranwa cane n’abo mu nzu yiwe bose, kuko yizeye Imana.
Ijoro rikeye, abacamanza batuma abagendanyi, bati Rekura abo bantu.
Umurinzi w’imbohe abarira Paulo ayo majambo, at’ Abacamanza baratumye ngo murekurwe, nuko rero ni musohoke, mwīgīre amahoro.

Ariko Paulo arabishura, ati Ko bādukubitiye imbere y’ishengero, ata kidutsinze, kandi tur’ Abaroma, bakadushira mw ibohero: none bagomba kuduhinda mu mpisho? Ekaye, ni babe ari bo biyizira ubgabo badusohore.
Abo bagendanyi babarira abacamanza ayo majambo: na bo baratinya, bumvise kw ar’ Abaroma,
baraza, babakomera ibōbo, barabasohora, babinginga kuva mur’ ico gisagara.
Bavuye mw ibohero, baja kwa Ludiya, barinjira; bamaze kubona bene Data, barabahanūra, bavayo.
Bamaze guca muri Amfipoli no muri Apoloniya, bashika i Tesalonike, hārih’ isinagogi y’Abayuda.
Nuko Paulo, nk’uko yamenyereye, yinjira muri bo, amara amasabato atatu avugana na bo ivyo mu vyanditswe,
abibasobanurira, amenyekanisha yuko Kristo yar’ uwo kubabazwa, no kuzuka mu bāpfuye: kand’ ati Yesu, uwo mbabgira, ni we Kristo.
Bamwe muri bo birabemeza, bīfatanya na Paulo na Sila, n’ishengero ryinshi ryo mu Bagiriki bubaha Imana n’uko, no mu bagore b’icubahiro batari bake.

Arikw Abayuda bagize ishari, bajana abagabo b’imburakimazi bo mu bigaramangira, bakoranya abantu benshi, bavyura imigūmūko mu gisagara, batera inzu ya Yasona, bashaka gukūramwo Paulo na Sila, ngo babashikirize abantu.
Bababuze, bakwegera Yasona na bene Data bamwe imbere y’abaganza igisagara, barasemerera, bat’ Abāteye isi yose umugūmūko bashitse n’ino,
kandi Yasona yabashembereje: abo bose barenze ivyagezwe vya Kayisari, bavuga yuko harih’ uwundi mwami, ngo ni Yesu.
Bahagarika imitima y’ishengero rihakoraniye n’iy’ abaganza igisagara, bumvise ivyo,
nuko bāka Yasona n’abandi ingwati, barabarekura.
Nuko bene Data baca banyuruza Paulo na Sila mw ijoro baja i Beroya; maze bashitseyo binjira mw isinagogi y’Abayuda.
Arikw abo bo bār’ imico myiza kuruta ab’i Tesalonike, kuko bākiriye ijambo ry’Imana n’umutima ukunze, basesa mu vyanditswe uko bukeye, ngo bamenye yukw ivyo ar’ivy’ ukuri.
Nuko benshi muri bo barizera, n’abagore b’icubahiro b’Abagirikikazi n’abagabo batari bake.
Arikw Abayuda b’i Tesalonike bamenye yukw ijambo ry’Imana rivugwa na Paulo i Beroya kandi, bajayo na ho, bavyura imivurungano mu bantu, babahagarika imitima.
Uwo mwanya bene Data banyuruza Paulo ngw ahave, aje ku kiyaga; ariko Sila na Timoteyo basigarayo.
Kand’ abaherekeje Paulo bamugeza muri Atenayi; maze babariwe kubgira Sila na Timoteyo ngo bamusangeyo n’ingoga, basubira inyuma.
Ariko Paulo akibarindīriye muri Atenayi, umutima wiwe utunturira muri we abonye ingen’ ico gisagara cuzuye ibigirwamana.
Nukw ahārīrira n’Abayuda n’abubaha Imana mw isinagogi, no mu kaguriro imisi yose ahārīra n’abāmusangaho.

Maze bamwe mu banyabgenge bitwa Abepikureyo, n’abandi bitwa Abasitoyiko bahūra na we. Bamwe muri bo barabazanya, bati Mbeg’ uyu adedemba agomba kuvuga ibiki? Abandi bat’ Umenga n’ūzanye imana z’ivyaduka: kuko yavuga ubutumwa bgiza bga Yesu n’ubg’ ukuzuka.
Baramufata bamujana ahitwa Areyopago, baramubaza, bati Mbeg’ ubona twoshobora kumenya ukwo kwigisha gusha uvuga ukw ari kwo?
Kuk’ utuzanye mu matwi ibintu vy’ivyaduka: none rero turagomba kumenya ivy’ ari vyo.
Kukw Abanyatenayi bose n’ab’ akavantara bāriho, batāgira ikindi bakora, atar’ ukwumva canke kudonda amakuru mashāsha.
Paulo ahagarara hagati muri Areyopago, aravuga, ati Bagabo bo muri Atenayi, mbonye muri vyose ko mukabije kwubaha imana zanyu.
Kukw aho nagendagenda nitegereza ivyo musenga, nasanze hari n’igicaniro canditsweko, ngw IC’ IMANA ITAZWI. Nukw iyo musenga mutayizi, ni yo mbabarira.
Imana Rurema, yaremye isi n’ibirimwo vyose, iyo, kukw ari yo Mwami w’ijuru n’isi, ntiba mu nsengero zubatswe n’amaboko,
kandi ntikorerwa n’amaboko y’abantu, nk’ūri n’ic’ akennye: kukw ari yo yahaye bose ubugingo, no guhumeka, n’ibindi vyose.
Kandi yaremye amahanga yose y’abantu, ibakūye mu muntu umwe, ngo basagaze mw isi yose, yashinze ibihe vy’imyaka ko bikūranwa uko yageze, icira abantu imbibe z’aho baba,
kugira ngo barondere Imana, ngo namba kumbure bakabakavye boyibona, nah’ itari kure y’umuntu n’umwe muri twebge.
Kuko muri yo ari ho tubeshejweho, tugenda, turi n’ubugingo; nk’uko na bamwe bo mu bigeneye indirimbo banyu bāvuze, bati Kuko natwe, tur’ uruvyaro rwayo.
Nuko rero, ko tur’ uruvyaro rw’Imana, ntidukwiye kwiyumvira yukw Imana isa n’izahabu, cank’ ifeza, cank’ amabuye, ivyābājwe n’ubuhinga n’ubgenge bg’abantu.
Nukw iyo misi y’ubutamenya, Imana yarayīrengagije, ariko noneho, igera kw abantu bose bari hose bihana,
kuko yashinze umusi wo gucirakw isi yose amateka y’ukuri, izoyacisha umuntu yatoranije, kandi yahaye bose ikimenyamenya c’ivyo, mu kumuzura imukūye mu bapfuye.
Maze bumvise ivy’ ukuzuka mu bapfuye, bamwe barishinyira, abandi bati Tuzoba turumva ukundi ivy’ utubarira kur’ ivyo.
Nuko Paulo ava muri bo.
Arikw abagabo bamwe bīfatanya na we barizera; muri bo umwe ni Diyonisiyo wo mu Bareyopago, kandi n’umugore yitwa Damari, n’abandi hamwe na bo.
Hanyuma y’ivyo Paulo ava muri Atenayi, aja i Korinto.
Abonye Umuyuda yitwa Akwila, amamo yiwe n’i Ponto, yar’ avuye muri Italiya mur’ iyo misi, bo n’umugore wiwe Purisikila, kuko Kilawudiyo yari yageze kw Abayuda bose bava i Roma, aja aho bari.
Kandi kuko bāri bahūje ubuhinga, abana na bo, barabungirana, kuk’ ubuhinga bgabo bgar’ ubgo kujisha amahema.
Ahārīrira n’abaho mw isinagogi amasabato yose, ngo yemeze Abayuda n’Abagiriki.
Maze Sila na Timoteyo bamanutse, bavuye i Makedoniya, Paulo agōbērwa n’ijambo ry’Imana, ashingira intahe Abayuda yuko Yesu ari we Kristo.
Na bo babihāririje barogose, akunkumura impuzu ziwe, arababarira, at’ Amaraso yanyu araba ari mwebge akora! Jeho ndacuna; guhēra ubu ndaja ku banyamahanga.
Avaho, yinjira mu nzu y’umuntu yitwa Tito Yusito, yubaha Imana, inzu yiwe yar’ ihereranye n’isinagogi.
Ariko Krisipo, umukuru w’isinagogi, yizerana Umwami Yesu n’abo mu nzu yiwe bose; n’Abakorinto benshi bumvise barizera, barabatizwa.
Maz’ Umwami Yesu abarira Paulo mw ijoro nko mu nzozi, ati Ntutinye, arik’ uvuge, woye gucereza,
kuko ndi kumwe nawe, kandi nta muntu azogutera ngw akugirire nabi, kuko mfise abantu benshi mur’ iki gisagara.
Amaray’ umwaka n’amezi atandatu, yigisha ijambo ry’Imana muri bo.
Maze Galiyo abaye icēgēra ca Kayisari muri Akaya, Abayuda bahūza inama bakūrira hasi Paulo, bamujana imbere y’intebe y’imanza,
bat’ Uyu muntu yemeza abantu gusenga Imana uburyo bunyuranye n’ivyagezwe.
Paulo arikw arahaga amatama, Galiyo abgira Abayuda, at’ Iyo haba hāri habonetse ibirego vy’icaha, cank’ igicumuro kigoye, yemwe Bayuda, hari kuboneka inyanduruko yuko mbihanganira kubumva:
ariko kw ar’ibihāri vy’amajambo n’ivy’ amazina n’ivy’ ivyagezwe vyanyu ubganyu, ni mubimare ubganyu: jeho singomba guca urubanza rwa ben’ ivyo.
Abirukana imbere y’intebe y’imanza.
Abagiriki bose basūmira Sositene, umukuru w’isinagogi, bamukubitira imbere y’intebe y’imanza. Ariko Galiyo, ivyo vyose ntiyabibabara.

Paulo amaray’ iyindi misi myinshi hanyuma y’ivyo, maz’ asezera bene Data, avudukayo ari mu bgato ngw aje i Siriya, Purisikila na Akwila bajana na we, amaze kwikemuriza i Kenkireya: kuko yari mw isezerano.
Bashitse muri Efeso, abasiga ngaho; ariko we aragenda yinjira mw isinagogi, ahārīra n’Abayuda.
Bamwinginze ngw amarey’ iyindi misi ntiyabakundira.
Arikw asezerana na bo, ati Nzogaruka ikindi gihe, Imana ni yabigomba. Avuduka muri Efeso ari mu bgato.
Afashe i Kayisariya, aradūga aja i Yerusalemu, aramutsa ishengero, aramanuka, aja muri Antiyokiya.
Amazey’ imisi avayo, aca mu gihugu c’i Galatiya n’i Furugiya, aja mu bisagara uko bikurikirana, aremesha abigishwa bose.
Maz’ Umuyuda yitwa Apolo, amamo yiwe ni muri Alekisanderiya, yar’ umuntu w’ubgenge, ashika muri Efeso; yar’ umunyabushobozi mu vyanditswe.
Uwo yari yigishijwe inzira y’Umwami wacu, acānīrwa mu mutima n’umwete, yavuga yigisha ivya Yesu avyitondeye, yar’ azi umubatizo wa Yohana gusa.
Atangura kuvugira mw isinagogi ashize amanga. Maze Purisikila na Akwila bamwumvise, bamujana i wabo, barushiriza kumutahuza inzira y’Imana.
Agomvye kujabuka ngw aje muri Akaya, bene Data baramuremesha, bandikira abigishwa ngo bamwākīre. Na we ashitseyo, ubuntu bg’Imana bumutera gufasha cane abizeye:
kuko yatururuza Abayuda abatsindira imbere y’abantu, yerekana mu vyanditswe yuko Yesu ari we Kristo.
Maze Apolo akir’ i Korinto, Paulo aca mu bihugu vyo haruguru, ashika muri Efeso, asangay’ abigishwa bamwe.
Arababaza, ati Mbega mwarahawe Mpwemu Yera igihe mwizera? Baramwishura, bati Ntitwaribganavyumve yuko Mpwemu Yera yatanzwe.
Arababaza, ati None mwabatijwe umubatizo ki? Bat’ Umubatizo wa Yohana.
Paulo ati Yohana yabatije umubatizo wo kwihana, abarira abantu ko bakwiye kwizera ūzoza hanyuma yiwe, ni Yesu.
Bavyumvise babatizwa mw izina ry’Umwami Yesu.
Paulo amaze kubarambikakw ibiganza, Mpwemu Yera abazako, bavuga izindi ndimi, bavugishwa n’Imana.
Abo bose bār’ abagabo nk’icumi na babiri.
Yinjira mw isinagogi, amara amezi atatu avuga ashize amanga: akīranira ivy’ ubgami bg’Imana abibemeza.
Ariko bamwe bikomantaje imitima, b’intumva, batukira Inzira ya Yesu imbere y’abantu, ava muri bo, arobanura abigishwa, uko bukeye ahārīrira mu nzu yo kwigishirizamwo ya Turano.
Bimara imyaka ibiri bimeze birtyo: nukw ababa muri Asiya bose bumva ijambo ry’Umwami wacu, Abayuda n’Abagiriki.
Kand’ Imana ikoresha amaboko ya Paulo ibitangaza vy’agaheta:
vyatuma bashīra abarwaye ibitambara n’ivyambazo bivuye ku mubiri wiwe, bagakira indwara zabo, impwemu zihumanye zikabavamwo.
Arikw inyererezi zimwe zo mu Bayuda zāsenda impwemu zihumanye zīgerera kuvugira izina ry’Umwami Yesu hejuru y’abatewe n’impwemu zihumanye, ziti Tubarahiye Yesu, uwo Paulo avuga.
Kandi hārih’ abahungu ndwi b’Umuyuda yitwa Sikewa, umwe mu baherezi bakuru, bāgenza bartyo.
Impwemu ihumanye irabishura, iti Yesu ndamuzi, na Paulo ndamuzi, ariko mweho muri ba nde?
Umuntu arimw’ impwemu ihumanye abagurukirako bompi, arabanesha, arababirika, bahunga mur’ iyo nzu bambaye ubusa bakomeretse.
Ivyo bimenyekana mu Bayuda no mu Bagiriki bose baba muri Efeso, bose baterwa n’ubgoba, izina ry’Umwami Yesu rishirwa hejuru.
Kandi benshi mu bari barizeye baraza, bātura ivyo bākoze, barabiserura.
Benshi no mu bakora ivy’ ubupfumu bakoranya ibitabo vyabo vy’ubupfumu, babituririra mu maso ya bose: baharūra igiciro cavyo, basanga gishitse ku ntete z’ifeza ibihumbi mirongwitanu.
Uko ni kw ijambo ry’Umwami Yesu ryagwiriye cane, rigira ububasha.
Ivyo bishize Paulo agabira mu mutima wiwe guca i Makedoniya no muri Akaya aja i Yerusalemu, ati Ni namara gushikayo, nkwiye kuja kurāba n’i Roma na ho.
Atuma abāgenda bamukorera babiri, Timoteyo na Erasito, ngo baje i Makedoniya; ariko we, atebera muri Asiya imisi.
Nko mur’ ico gihe havyuka imivurungano itari mike kubg’ Inzira ya Yesu.
Hār’ umuntu yitwa Demetiriyo, umucuzi w’ifeza, yacura utunyabugoro twa Arutemi mw ifeza, akaronkesha abacuzi biwe inyungu nyinshi.
Nukw abakoraniriza hamwe n’abandi bākora ibikorwa ben’ ivyo, arababgira, ati Yemwe bagabo, murazi yuk’ ubutunzi bgacu buva mur’ iki gikorwa.
Murabona kandi murumva yukw atari muri Efeso honyene, ariko nko muri Asiya hose, umwe Paulo yoheje abantu benshi akabahindura, at’ Imana zākozwe n’intoke si zo mana.

S’ukw igikorwa cacu kiri mw irinde kigiye gukēngērwa gusa, ariko kandi n’ingoro y’igitabo c’imanakazi ihambaye Arutemi yotītūrwa, mbere yonakūrwakw icubahiro cayo gikomeye, ari yo abo muri Asiya bose n’isi yose basenga.
Bavyumvise barasugurirwa, barasemerera, bati Arutemi y’Abanyefeso irahambaye.
Maz’ igisagara cose kiravurungana, bashwabadukira icarimwe baja ku kibuga c’ibirori, bashika Gayo na Arisitariko Abanyamakedoniya, bāgendana na Paulo.
Maze Paulo agomvye kuja mur’ iryo gugu ry’abantu, abigishwa baramutesha.
Kandi bamwe mu bakuru bo muri Asiya, kuko bār’ abagenzi, bamutumako bamwinginga ngo yoye kwiroha mu kibuga c’ibirori.
Nuko barayogora, bamwe ukwabo abandi ukwabo, kukw iryo shengero ryavurunganye, abenshi batāri bazi icatumye bakorana.
Maze basokorora Alekisandero mu bantu, Abayuda bamwīgiza imbere. Maze Alekisandero arabamama, agira yiregure ku bantu.
Ariko bamumenye kw ar’ Umuyuda, bose basemererera icarimwe, bamara nk’amasaha abiri, bati Arutemi y’Abanyefeso irahambaye.

Umwanditsi (ari we mukuru w’igisagara) amaze guhoza ishengero, arababarira, ati Bagabo b’Abanyefeso, mbega harih’ umuntu atazi yukw igisagara c’Abanyefeso ari co kizigama ingoro y’igitabo c’imanakazi ihambaye Arutemi, ari co gishushanyo cākorotse kiva mw ijuru?
None kw ata woshobora guhakana ivyo, mukwiye guhora, no kutagira ico mukora mutitonze.
Kuko muzanye aba bagabo, bativye ivyo mu ngoro z’imana kandi batārogose ku manakazi yacu.
Nuko Demetiriyo n’abacuzi bari kumwe na we, namba bafise uwo barega, imisi y’imanza iriho, kandi hariho n’ivyēgēra vya Kayisari, ni baregane.
Ariko ni mwaba mufise ibindi murondera, bizomarirwa mu rukinja rusanzweho.
Mbere turi mw irinde, kumbure ibibaye uyu musi vyotuma turegwa ubugarariji, kukw ata nyanduruko; kandi ntituzoshobora gusobanura icakoranije iri shengero rivurunganye.
Avuze ivyo, acūra ikoraniro.
Umugūmūko umaze gushira, Paulo atumakw abigishwa, arabahanūra, arabasezera, avayo ngw aje i Makedoniya.
Amaze guca mur’ ivyo bihugu, abahanūra mu majambo menshi, aja i Bugiriki.
Amaray’ amezi atatu; maz’ Abayuda bamugīriye inama yo kumutega agira atambukire mu bgato aja i Siriya, agabira gusubira inyuma aciye i Makedoniya.
Abājana na we bashikana no muri Asiya ni Sopatero mwene Puro w’i Beroya, n’ab’i Tesalonike ni Arisitariko na Sekondo, bo na Gayo w’i Derube, na Timoteyo, n’abo muri Asiya ni Tukiko na Tirofimo.
Abo bāri bitangiye imbere, baturorērera i Tirowa.
Natwe tuvuduka i Filipi turi mu bgato hanyuma y’imisi y’imitsima itambiwe, tubasanga i Tirowa ku musi ugira gatanu, tumaray’ imisi ndwi.
Ku wa mbere w’imisi ndwi, dukoranira kumanyagura imitsima, Paulo ayāga na bo, agira ngo buce agenda, atevya mu majambo ashitsa mu gicugu.
Maze hār’ amatara menshi mu cumba co mu nzu yo hejuru aho twari dukoraniye.

Kandi mw idirisha hari hicaye umusore yitwa Eyutuko, aremērwa n’itiro ryinshi; maze Paulo arushirije gutevya mu majambo, itiro riramuremēra, arakoroka avuye mu nzu yo hejuru ya gatatu, bamuyora ahwereye.
Paulo arururuka, amwubama hejuru, aramugumbira, ati Mureke gukoma induru, kuk’ ubugingo bgiwe bukiri muri we.
Asubira kwūrira, amanyagura umutsima, ararya, ayāga na bo igihe kirekire, ashitsa no mu macaca, maz’ aragenda.
Bazana uwo muhungu ari muzima, imitima yabo iraruhuka.
Ariko tweho tumwitangira imbere dutambukira mu bgato, turajabuka dufata muri Aso, aho twari tugabiye guhitana Paulo: kuko yari yabishinze artyo, kugira ngo we ace i musozi.
Adusanze muri Aso turamujana, turajabuka dufata i Mitulene.
Tuvuyeyo, bukeye bg’aho dushika imbere y’i Kiyo, ku musi ugira gatatu dufata i Samo, bukeye dufata i Mileto.
Kuko Paulo yari yagabiye guca i ruhande ya Efeso, kugira ngo ntatebe muri Asiya: kuko yihuta, ngo ni vyashoboka umusi wa Pentekote uz’ ushike ar’i Yerusalemu.
Ar’i Mileto atuma muri Efeso, atumakw abakuru b’ishengero.
Na bo bashitse ah’ ari, arababgira, at’ Ubganyu murazi ingene nabana namwe na ntaryo, uhereye umusi natanguriye gushika muri Asiya,
nkorera Umwami wacu n’umutima wicishije bugufi, kandi ndira, nterwa n’ibingerageza kubg’ inama z’Abayuda.
Kandi murazi yukw ata jambo ribereye nacishije i ruhande kubabgira canke kubigishiriza imbere y’abantu mu nzu no mu yindi.
Nashinze intahe mu Bayuda no mu Bagiriki y’ukwihana mu nyonga z’Imana, n’ukwizera Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo.
None rāba, ngiye i Yerusalemu mboshwe mu mutima, ntazi ibizombako nshitseyo;
atar’ uko Mpwemu Yera anshingira intahe mu gisagara cose yukw ingoyi n’ivyago bintegeyeyo.
Ariko simbabaye ubugingo bganje nk’ah’ ar’ubg’ igiciro, kugira ngo ndangize urugendo rwanje, n’igikorwa nahawe n’Umwami Yesu, co gushingira intahe ubutumwa bgiza bg’ubuntu bg’Imana.
Kandi none rāba, ndazi yuko mutazosubira kubona mu maso hanje, abo naciyemwo mwese mbabgira ivy’ ubgami bg’Imana.
Ni co gituma mbashingira intahe uyu musi ncuna, yukw amaraso ya bose atazonkora,
kuko ntacishije i ruhande mbabgira ivy’ Imana yagabiye vyose.
Mwirinde ubganyu, muzigame n’ubusho bgose Mpwemu Yera yabashizemwo, ngo mube abo kubuzēzwa, kugira ngo muragire ishengero ry’Imana, iryo yaguze amaraso yayo.
Ndazi yuko ni namara kuhava, amabingira y’inkazi azobinjiramwo atababaye umukuku.
Kandi no muri mwebge ubganyu hazokwadukamw’ abantu bavuga ibigoramye kugira ngo bakwegere abigishwa inyuma yabo.
Nuko mwame mugavye, mwibuke yuko namaze imyaka itatu ntasība guhanūra umuntu wese ndira, ku murango no mw ijoro.
Kandi none mbaragije Imana n’ijambo ry’ubuntu bgayo, rishobora kububaka no kubahēra ibiragwa hamwe n’abejejwe bose.
Nta co nifuje, ar’ ifeza ar’ izahabu ar’ ivyambarwa vy’umuntu n’umwe.
Ubganyu murazi kw aya maboko yanje yankenurana ivyo nkennye n’abo turi kumwe.
Nabahaye akarorero muri vyose, yuko mu butame nk’ubgo, ari ko mukwiye gufasha abadakomeye, no kwibuka amajambo y’Umwami Yesu, ingen’ ubgiwe yavuze, ati Gutanga kuzana umugisha, kuruta guhabga.
Amaze kuvuga artyo, arapfukama, asengera hamwe na bo bose.
Bose bararira cane, bagwa Paulo mw izosi, baramugumbira:
cane‐cane bababajwe n’ijambo yababgiye ngo ntibazosubira kumubona mu maso. Maze baramuherekeza, bamugeza ku bgato.
Tumaze gutandukana na bo, no gutambukira mu bgato, turaramiriza tuja i Kosi: bukeye bg’aho dufata i Rodo, tuvayo dufata i Patara.
Dusanze ubgato bugira bujabuke buja i Foyinike, tubutambukiramwo turagenda.
Tubonye i Kupuro tuhasiga i bumoso, tuja i Siriya, dufata muri Tiro: kukw ari ho bari bagabiye gukūrira ibintu mu bgato.
Tuhasanze abigishwa, dusībiray’ imisi ndwi: na bo bavugishijwe na Mpwemu babarira Paulo ngo yoye kuja i Yerusalemu.
Turangije iyo misi, tuvayo turagenda, bose baduherekezanya n’abagore n’abana, baturenza igisagara, dupfukama ku musenyi, turasenga.
Tumaze gusezerana dutambukira mu bgato, na bo basubira i wabo.
Natwe turangije urugendo rwo kuva muri Tiro, dufata i Putolemayi, turamutsa bene Data, tumarana na bo umusi umwe.
Bukeye bg’aho tuvayo, dushika i Kayisariya, twinjira mu nzu ya Filipo umuvuzi w’ubutumwa bgiza, n’umwe muri ba bandi ndwi, twaka indāro i we.
Uwo yar’ afise abakobga bane b’inkumi, bāvugishwa n’Imana.
Tugitevyey’ imisi myinshi, haza ūvugishwa n’Imana yitwa Agabo, yar’ amanutse avuye i Yudaya.

Aza aho turi, yābīra umukanda wa Paulo, awibohesha amaguru n’amaboko, aravuga, at’ Uku ni ko Mpwemu Yera agize: Nyen’ uyu mukanda, uku ni kw Abayuda bazomubohera i Yerusalemu, bazomushira mu maboko y’abanyamahanga.
Maze twumvise ivyo, twebge n’abantu baho turamwinginga ngo ntadūge i Yerusalemu.
Maze Paulo aratubaza, ati Mukora ibiki, kurira mundandura umutima? Siniteguye kuboherwa gusa i Yerusalemu, ariko no gupfirayo, kubg’ izina ry’Umwami Yesu.
Yanse kubicungūrako, turīhorera, tut’ Ivyo Umwami agomba ni bibeho!
Hanyuma y’iyo misi dutekera ibintu vyacu, turadūga tuja i Yerusalemu.
Bamwe mu bigishwa bavuye i Kayisariya turajana, bazana Umunyakupuro yitwa Munasona, yar’ umwigishwa wa kera, tuba ari we dusemberako.
Dushitse i Yerusalemu bene Data batwākīrana umunezero.
Bukeye bg’aho Paulo yinjirana natwe kwa Yakobo, abakuru bose ni ho bāri bari.
Amaze kubaramutsa, ababarira ivy’ Imana yakoze mu banyamahanga imukoresheje, abidonze kimwe‐kimwe.
Na bo bavyumvise bahimbaza Imana; maze baramubgira, bat’ Urabona, mwene Data, ingen’ Abayuda bizeye ar’ ibihumbi vyinshi; kandi bose bagira ishaka ry’ivyagezwe.
Kandi bābariwe ivyawe, yuko wigisha Abayuda bose bari mu banyamahanga guheba ivya Mose, ukavuga ngo ntibakwiye gukeba abana babo canke kugendera mu migenzo yacu.
Non’ icobimara n’iki? Ntibazobura kwumva ko waje.
Nuko genza urtya, uko tukubgira. Dufise abagabo bane bari n’ico bāsezeranye.
Ubajane, wihumanurane na bo, ubatērēre, ngo babone kwimosha. Maze bose bazomenya yukw ivyo bāguteranije kuri bo ata kuri kurimwo, kandi ko nawe ubgawe ugenda witonze, witondera n’ivyagezwe.
Yamar’ ivy’ abizeye bo mu banyamahanga, twanditse dushinze ko birinda kurya ivyaterekerejwe ibigirwamana, bo n’amaraso, bo n’ibinizwe, birinde no gusambana.

Nuko Paulo ajana abo bagabo, bukeye bg’aho yihumanurana na bo, yinjirana na bo mu rusengero, avuga igihe imisi yo guhumanurwa izoshirira, agenza artyo gushitsa ah’ ikimazi c’umuntu wese muri bo catangiwe.
Nukw iyo misi ndwi igira ishire, Abayuda bāvuye muri Asiya bamubonye mu rusengero, bavurunga ishengero ryose, bamushōrerakw amaboko,

baratabaza, bati Bagabo b’Abisirayeli, mudutabare! Nguyu wa muntu yigisha hose abantu bose, akēngereza ubu bgoko n’ivyagezwe n’aha hantu: ikigeretseko yazanye n’Abagiriki mu rusengero, yahumanije aha hantu hēra.
Kuko bāri babonye Tirofimo w’Umunyefeso ari kumwe na we mu gisagara, bagira ngo Paulo yamujanye mu rusengero.
Igisagara cose kiravurungana, abantu barashwabaduka: basūmira Paulo, baramukwega bamukūra mu rusengero; ako kanya bugara inzugi.
Bakirondera ingene bamwica, inkuru ishika ku mukuru w’abagabisha b’abasoda yukw abo muri Yerusalemu bose bavurunganye.
Aca ajana abasoda n’abagabisha babo, abamanukira yiruka. Na bo babonye uwo mukuru w’abagabisha n’abasoda, basigaho gukubita Paulo.
Maz’ uwo mukuru w’abagabisha arabashikīra, aramufata, avuga ko bamufatisha iminyororo ibiri, abaza uw’ ari we, n’ic’ akoze ic’ ari co.
Abo mw ishengero barayogora, bamwe ukwabo abandi ukwabo: abujijwe n’uruyogoyogo kumenya ukuri, avuga ko bamujana mw iboma.
Ashitse ku ngazi y’amabuye abasoda baramuterura kubg’ ubusugurirwe bg’abantu,
kukw ishengero ry’abantu ryābaja inyuma, basemerera, bati Kūrah’ uyo.
Bagira bamushikane mw iboma, Paulo abaza uwo mukuru w’abagabisha, ati Wonkundira ijambo nkubarira? Na we aramubaza, at’ Urazi Ikigiriki?
Si wewe wa Munyegiputa yateye umugararizo mu gihe gishize, akajana mu bugaragwa abantu b’abicanyi ibihumbi bine?
Paulo aramwishura, ati Nd’ Umuyuda, umuntu w’i Taruso, igisagara c’i Kilikiya kitayoberanye: none ndakwinginze unkundire ico mbarira abantu.
Amukundiye, Paulo ahagarara ku ngazi y’amabuye, amama abantu: hamaze kuba agacerere rwose, ababarira mu Giheburayo,
Ati Yemwe bagabo bene Data kandi ba data, ni mwumvirize ivyo nireguza muri mwebge.
Bumvise ababariye mu Giheburayo, barushiriza gucereza. Aravuga,

ati Nd’ Umuyuda, navukiye i Taruso h’i Kilikiya, ariko nakuriye mur’ iki gisagara, nigishirizwa imbere y’ibirenge vya Gamaliyeli nk’uk’ uruhande rugoye rw’ivyagezwe vya ba sogokuruza ruri, ngira ishaka ry’Imana, nk’uko namwe mwese murifise uyu musi.
Kandi nahama abakurikira Inzira ya Yesu gushitsa bapfuye, nkababoha nkabashira mu mabohero abagabo n’abagore.

Kandi n’umuherezi mukuru na we aranshingira intahe y’ivyo, bo n’abanyekombe bose. Ni bo bāmpaye ivyete vyandikiwe bene Data b’i Damasiko, ikinjanyeyo ar’ ukuzana i Yerusalemu abaho na bo bari mu ngoyi, ngo bishure.
Nuko nkigenda, nshitse hafi y’i Damasiko, hāri nko mu mashōka, umuco uhambaye uza giturumbuka uvuye mw ijuru, unkayanganira irya n’ino.
Nikubita hasi numva ijwi rimbaza, riti Sauli, Sauli, umpīgira iki?
Nanje ndabaza, nt’ Uri nde ga Mwami? Aranyishura, ati Ndi Yesu Umunyanazareti, uwo urik’ urahīga.
Kandi n’abo twāri kumwe umuco bārawubonye, ariko ntibumva ijwi ry’uwo tuvugana.
Ndamubaza, nti Ngire nte ga Mwami? Umwami aranyishura, ati Va hasi, ushike i Damasiko, ni ho uzobaririrwa ivyashinzwe k’uzokora.
Maz’ ubgiza bg’uwo muco bumpumishije, abo twāri kumwe bamfata ukuboko, nshika i Damasiko.
Umugabo yitwa Ananiya, yubaha Imana mu kwumvira ivyagezwe, yashimwa n’Abayuda bose babayo,
aza aho ndi, ampagarara hejuru, arambarira, ati Sauli, mwene Data, humūka. Ako kanya ndahumūka, ndamurāba.
Aravuga, at’ Imana ya ba sogokuruza yagutoranirije kumenya ivy’ igomba, no kubona wa Mugororotsi, no kwumva ijwi riva mu kanwa kiwe:
kuk’ uzomubera icabona ku bantu bose ku vyo wabonye kandi wumvise.
Non’ ikigutevya n’iki? Va hasi, ubatizwe, wiyuhagire ivyaha vyawe, wambaze izina ryiwe.
Maze ngarutse i Yerusalemu, nariko ndasenga mu rusengero, mmera nk’ūrota,
ndamubona ambgira, ati Tebuka, uve i Yerusalemu vuba, kuko batazokwemera ivy’ unshingira intahe.
Nanje nti Mwami, na bo ubgabo barazi yuko nashira abakwizeye mw ibohero, nkabatonagurira mu masinagogi yose.
Kandi hamwe amaraso y’uwagushingira intahe Stefano yava, nanje ni ho nari mpagaze, mbishimye, nsanze impuzu z’abāmwica.
Aranyishura, ati Genda, kuko nzogutuma kure ku banyamahanga.
Baramwumviriza gushitsa kur’ iryo jambo: maze basemerera n’ijwi rirenga, bati Kūra ūmeze artyo mw isi, na kare ntiyar’ abereye kubaho.
Bakiyogora, bata impuzu zabo, basūrira umukungugu hejuru,
umukuru w’abagabisha b’abasoda avuga ko bamwinjiza mw iboma, ababarira kumucacisha ibimoko, kugira ngw amenye icatumye bamuvugiriza uruhōgo bartyo.
Bamaze kumubohesha imigozi, Paulo abaza umugabisha w’abasoda ijana ahagaze aho, ati Mbega biremerwa ko mukubita umuntu w’Umuroma, kand’ ata rubanza rwamutsinze?
Uwo mugabisha avyumvise, aja ku mukuru w’abagabisha, arabimumenyesha, at’ Ugira ukore iki? Erega wa muntu n’Umuroma.
Uwo mukuru w’abagabisha araza, aramubaza, ati Mbarira: mbeg’ ur’ Umuroma? Na we at’ Ego me.
Uwo mukuru aramubarira, ati Jewe naguze ubgo buroma amahera menshi. Paulo at’ Ariko jeho nabuvukiyemwo.
Nukw abāri bagiye kumucaca baca baramureka; umukuru w’abagabisha na we aratinya, amenye kw ar’ Umuroma, kandi yamuboshe.
Ariko bukeye bg’aho, agomvye kumenya neza ic’ Abayuda bamurega ic’ ari co, aramubohora, agera kw abaherezi bakuru bakorana n’abanyekombe bose, amanukana Paulo, amuhagarika imbere yabo.
Paulo ahanga amaso abanyekombe, arababgira, ati Bagabo bene Data, nāmanye umutima utarimw’ ijwi rinyagiriza ikibi na kimwe imbere y’Imana gushitsa kur’ uyu musi.
Ananiya umuherezi mukuru abarira abamuhagaze i ruhande kumukubita ku munwa.
Maze Paulo aramubgira, at’ Imana izogukubita, wa rusika rukuyengejekw ingwa: mbega wewe ko wicaritswe no kuncira urubanza nk’ukw ivyagezwe biri, ugatako ukavuga ko bankubita ukanyuranya n’ivyagezwe?
Abāri bahagazeho, bati Mbeg’ uratuka umuherezi mukuru w’Imana?
Paulo, ati Sinari ndamuzi, bene Data, kw ar’ umuherezi mukuru; kuko handitswe ngo Ntukavuge nabi umukuru wo mu bgoko bganyu.

Maze Paulo amenye yuk’ umuce umwe ar’uw’ Abasadukayo, uwundi ar’uw’ Abafarisayo, ashira ijwi hejuru mu banyekombe, ati Bagabo bene Data, nd’ Umufarisayo, nd’ umwana w’Abafarisayo: ivy’ ivyizigiro vy’ibizoba n’ukuzuka kw’abapfuye ni vyo bimpagaritse mur’ izi manza.
Avuze artyo, havyuka ibihāri mu Bafarisayo n’Abasadukayo, abanyarukinja birema ibice.
Kukw Abasadukayo bāhakana yukw ata kuzuka kuriho, cank’ umumarayika n’impwemu; arikw Abafarisayo bāvyemera vyompi.
Habah’ urwamo rwinshi; bamwe mu banyabgenge b’ivyanditswe bo mu muce w’Abafarisayo bava hasi barahārīra, bati Nta kibi twabonye kur’ uyu muntu. Kumbure impwemu cank’ umumarayika yoba yavuganye na we.
Habah’ ibihāri vyinshi, umukuru w’abagabisha b’abasoda atinye ko bogabangana Paulo, abarira ingabo ngo zimanuke zimubashikure, zimujane mw iboma.
Ijoro ry’uwo musi, Umwami Yesu amuhagarara hejuru, ati Hūmura; nk’uko wanshingiye intahe i Yerusalemu, ni k’ukwiye kuzonshingira intahe i Roma.
Iryo joro rikeye, Abayuda barakorana, barahira bīsiba yuko batazorya ntibanywe batarica Paulo.
Abāhize bartyo bāsāga mirongwine.
Baja ku baherezi bakuru n’abakuru, bati Twarahiye twisivye bikomeye yukw ata co tuzotamira tutarica Paulo.
Nuko rero mwebge n’abanyekombe, ni mubgire umukuru w’abagabisha b’abasoda amubamanukanire, nk’abarondera kurushiriza gutahura ivyiwe neza. Natwe, atarabashikīra, twiteguye kumwica.
Mwishwa wa Paulo yumva uwo mutego, araza ashika mw iboma, abibarira Paulo.
Paulo ahamagara umwe mu bagabisha b’abasoda ijana, ati Jana uyu muhungu ku mukuru w’abagabisha b’abasoda; afise ijambo amubarira.
Na we aramujana amushīra uwo mukuru w’abagabisha, ati Ya mbohe Paulo yampamagaye aranyinginga, ngo nkuzanire uyu muhungu, afise ic’ akubarira.
Uwo mukuru amufata ukuboko, aramwikebanya aramubaza biherereye, at’ Ic’ ufise kumbarira n’iki?
Aramwishura, at’ Abayuda bahūje inama yo kukwinginga ngw ejo uz’ umanukane Paulo mw ikombe, nk’ūgomba kubaza ivyiwe ng’ urushirize kubimenya neza.
None rero ntuje kubumvira, kukw abantu babo basāga mirongwine bamuryamiye, barahiye bīsivye ko batazorya ntibanywe bataramwica; kandi none bariteguye, barorereye ic’ uribubemerere.
Uwo mukuru arungika uwo muhungu, amaze kumwihanikiriza, ati Ntugire umuntu ubarira yuk’ ummenyesheje ivyo.

Ahamagara babiri bo mu bagabisha b’abasoda ijana, arababarira, ati Ni mwitegure abasoda amajana abiri bo kuja i Kayisariya, n’abagendera ku mafarasi mirongwirindwi, n’ab’ amacumu amajana abiri, bahenge mw ijoro isaha zitatu bagende.
Kandi bazane n’amafarasi kugira ngo bayashireko Paulo, bamushikane kwa Feliki icēgēra ca Kayisari akiri muzima.
Yandika icete nka ben’ iki:
ati Jewe Kilawudiyo Lusiya ndakuganūtsa wewe Feliki umwubahwa, icēgēra ca Kayisari.
Non’ uyo mugabo Abayuda bāri bamaze kumuta mu maboko bagira bamwice, nanje mmenye kw ar’ Umuroma nzanana n’ingabo ndamubakiza.
Kandi nshatse kumenya ico bamurega, ndamumanukana mw ikombe ryabo.
Mbona yuko bamurega amajambo y’ivyagezwe vyabo, ariko kw ata co yarezwe gikwiye kumwicisha canke kumubohesha.
Maze mbariwe yuko bahigiye uwo mugabo, nca ndamukurungikira, mbarira abarezi ko bamuregera imbere yawe. Ndakwikebanuye.
Nukw abasoda bābīra Paulo uko babariwe, bahenga mw ijoro bamujana muri Antipatiri.
Bumaze guca basigay’ abagendera ku mafarasi, ngw abe ari bo bajana na we, na bo basubira iyo bavuye kw iboma.
Abo bashitse i Kayisariya bashīra icēgēra ca Kayisari ca cete, bamushikiriza na Paulo.
Amaze kugisoma abaza intāra y’i wabo iy’ ari yo; amenye kw ar’uw’ i Kilikiya,
aravuga, ati Nzokwumva ivyawe abarezi bawe ni bamara kuza. Agera ko bamurindira mw iboma ya Herode.
Imisi itanu ishize, umuherezi mukuru Ananiya amanukana n’abakuru bamwe n’uwo kubavuganira yitwa Teritulo, barega Paulo ku cēgēra ca Kayisari.
Amaze guhamagazwa, Teritulo atangura kumurega, ati Ni kubgawe igituma tugazagaza mu mahoro menshi, n’ibindi vyaroranirijwe ubu bgoko kubg’ imigabo yawe:
nuko turavyemera uburyo bgose ahantu hose, Feliki umwubahwa, tugukengurukiye cane.
Reka noye guhava nkurambira, ndakwinginze zirikana tuvuge amajambo make, kubg’ ubugwaneza bgawe.
Twabonye uyu muntu ar’ ikīza, atera umugararizo Abayuda bose bari mu bihugu vyose; ni we remezo ry’igice c’Abanazareti.
Kandi yagejeje no guhumanya urusengero, turamufata, [twāri tugomvye kumucira urubanza nk’ukw ivyagezwe vyacu bivuga.
Arik’ umukuru w’abagabisha b’abasoda Lusiya araza, amudushikura mu maboko,
abarira abarezi biwe kuza imbere yawe.] Nawe ni wamwibariza ubgawe urashobora kumenya ivyo tumureze vyose.
Abayuda na bo bafatanya na we mur’ ico kirego, bavuga kw ivyo ari ko biri.
Icēgēra ca Kayisari kimaze kumukebura ngw avuge, Paulo aramwishura, ati Ndazi k’umaze imyaka myinshi ur’ umucamanza w’ubu bgoko, ni co gitumye niregura ivyanje ndemye;
kuk’ ushobora kumenya yukw imisi itarasāga icumi n’ibiri, uhereye aho nadūgiye i Yerusalemu gusengerayo.
Kandi ntibāsanze mpārīra n’umuntu n’umwe, canke nkoraniriza abantu kubakikiza, naho hoba mu rusengero canke mu masinagogi canke mu gisagara.
Kandi ku vyo bandeze ubu, ntibashobora kuronka ikinyagiriza imbere yawe.
Arikw iki ni co nkwemerera: n’uk’ ukw iyo Nzira iri, iyo abo bita igice, ari ko nkorera Imana ya ba sogokuruza bacu, nemera vyose bifatanije n’ivyagezwe kandi vyanditswe mu vy’abāvugishwa n’Imana;
mfise ivyizigiro ku Mana bimwe n’ivyo aba na bo biteze, yuko hazoba ukuzuka kw’abagororotsi n’abagabitanya.
Ni co gituma na ntaryo nkobereza kugira umutima utanyagiriza ikibi ku Mana canke ku bantu.
Maz’ imyaka myinshi ishize, njanwayo no gushīra ubgoko bgacu ivy’ubuntu, no gutanga ibimazi.
Nkiri muri vyo bansanga mu rusengero nihumanuye, ata bantu nkoranije, ata n’uruhōgo ruriho. Ariko hār’ Abayuda bamwe bavuye muri Asiya,
ni bo bāri bakwiye kuza hano imbere yawe no kundega, iyaba bafise ico bangaya.
Canke na bano na bo ni bavuge icaha bambonyeko, aho nari mpagaze imbere y’abanyekombe,
shiti ryoba rya jambo rimwe navuze n’ijwi rirenga mpagaze muri bo, nt’ Ukuzuka kw’ abapfuye ni kwo kumpagaritse mur’ izi manza imbere yanyu uyu musi.
Ariko Feliki, kuko yar’ azi neza ivy’ Iyo Nzira ivy’ ari vyo, arabibīka, ati Lusiya umukuru w’abagabisha b’abasoda ni yaza, nzoca urubanza rw’amajambo yanyu.
Abarira umugabisha w’abasoda ijana kumurinda urw’ amaso, no kutabuza n’umwe mu bagenzi kumukorera.
Imisi mike ishize, Feliki azanana n’umugore wiwe Durusila w’Umuyudakazi, ahamagaza Paulo, yumviriza ivyo avuga ku vy’ukwizera Kristo Yesu.
Akirikw aravuga ivy’ ukugororoka n’ivy’ ukwirinda n’ivy’ amateka azocibga, Feliki aranduka umutima, aramubarira, at’ Ubu ni wīgīre, ni naronka uburyo bgiza nzogutumako.
Kandi yanaziga ko Paulo yomuhēra amahera; ico ni co camutera kwama amuhamagaza ngo bayāge.
Imyaka ibiri ishize, Porukiyo Fesito akūra Feliki. Maze Feliki agomvye kwikundisha Abayuda asiga Paulo akiboshwe.
Nuko Fesito ashikiriye intāra amara gatatu, araheza ava i Kayisariya adūga i Yerusalemu.
Abaherezi bakuru n’abahambaye bo mu Bayuda bamuregako Paulo, baramwinginga,
bamusaba kubagirira neza kur’ uyo, ngw amutumeko, aze i Yerusalemu, na bo baze bamuryamire bamutsinde mu nzira.
Ariko Fesito abishura yuko Paulo arindirwa i Kayisariya, kand’ ubgiwe kw agiye kujayo vuba.
Arababgira, ati Nukw abakuru bo muri mwebge ni bamanuke tujane, maze namba kur’ uyo mugabo har’ ikidakwiye, bakimurege.
Amaze muri bo imisi itarenga umunani cank’ icumi, aramanuka aja i Kayisariya; bukeye bg’aho yicara ku ntebe y’imanza avuga ko bazana Paulo.
Na we ashitse, Abayuda bamanutse bavuye i Yerusalemu baramukikiza, bamurega ibirego vyinshi bikomeye, ivyo badashobora kuronkera icagiriza.
Paulo ariregura, ati Nta caha nakoze, ari ku vyagezwe vy’Abayuda, canke ku rusengero, canke kuri Kayisari.
Fesito agomvye kwikundiriza Abayuda, abaza Paulo, ati Wokwemera kudūga i Yerusalemu gucirirway’ urubanza rw’ivyo mu maso yanje?
Ariko Paulo aramwishura, ati Mpagaze aha imbere y’intebe y’imanza ishinzwe na Kayisari, ni ho nkwiye gucirwa urubanza. Nta kibi nagiriye Abayuda, kandi nawe urabizi neza.
Nuko namba naragabitanije, canke narakoze ibikwiye kunyicisha, sinanka gupfa: ariko namb’ ivyo aba bandega atari ko biri, nta muntu ashobora kubampa. Nzokwitwara kuri Kayisari.
Fesito amaze kuja inama n’abanyekombe, aramwishura, ati K’ugomvye kwitwara kuri Kayisari, imbere ya Kayisari ni ho uzoja.
Hashize imisi, umwami Agiripa na Berenike bashika i Kayisariya, baja kuramutsa Fesito.
Bamazey’ imisi myinshi, Fesito ashira imbere y’umwami ivya Paulo, ati Harih’ umuntu Feliki yasize ar’ imbohe.
Aho nar’i Yerusalemu abaherezi bakuru n’abakuru b’Abayuda bambariye ivyiwe, basaba ko ndamucira urubanza.
Ndabishura, nti S’umugenzo w’Abaroma gutanga umuntu uw’ ari we wese, umuregwa atabanje kuba kumwe n’abāmureze imbonankubone, no kubona uburyo bgo kwiregura ibirego bāmureze.
Nuko bakoraniye hano, sinarinze guteba, ariko bukeye bg’aho nicara ku ntebe y’imanza, mpamagaza uwo muntu.
Abarezi bavuye hasi, ntibāmurega ikirego na kimwe co mu bibi nakēka;
ariko bāmurega ibihāri vyo mw idini yabo, n’ivy’ umuntu yitwa Yesu, yapfuye, uwo Paulo yavuga ashimitse kw ari muzima.
Nanje nzazaniwe ingene nobaza ivy’ ivyo, ndamubaza yukw agomba kuja i Yerusalemu, gucirirway’ urubanza rw’ivyo.
Ariko Paulo asavye kurindwa kugira ngw az’ acirwe urubanza na Augusito, mvuga kw arindwa gushitsa aho nzomurungikira Kayisari.
Agiripa yishura Fesito, ati Nanje nagomba kwumva uwo muntu. Na we at’ Ejo uzomwumva.
Bukeye bg’aho, Agiripa na Berenike bazanana icubahiro cinshi, binjirana mw ikombe n’abakuru b’abagabisha b’abasoda n’abahambaye bo mur’ ico gisagara; maze Fesito avuga ko bazana Paulo.
Nuko Fesito aravuga, ati Mwami Agiripa, namwe mwese abo turi kumwe hano, murabona uyu, uwo ishengero ry’Abayuda bose bānsabira i Yerusalemu bo n’ino, basemerera ngo ntagikwiye kubaho.
Ariko nsanga ntiyakoze igikwiye kumwicisha, kand’ ubgiwe agomvye kwitwara kuri Augusito, ngabira kumumurungikira.

None mbuze ijambo rimenyekanisha ivyiwe ryo kwandikira umwami wanje, ni co gitumye ndamuzana imbere yanyu, kandi cane‐cane imbere yawe, mwami Agiripa, kugira ngo ni twamara kumusiguza, mbone ico kwandika.
Kuko ngira ngo n’ic’ ubgenge buke kurungika imbohe, sinerekane ibirego vyayo.
Agiripa abarira Paulo, at’ Uremerewe kwiregura. Maze Paulo aramvura ukuboko, ariregura,
at’ Ivyo narezwe n’Abayuda vyose, mwami Agiripa, numva nnezerewe kw ari wewe ngira mvyiregureko uyu musi:
kandi cane‐cane kuk’ uzi imigenzo n’impāri vyo mu Bayuda vyose: ni co gitumye nkwinginga ngo wihangane, unyumvirize.
Ingeso zanje, uhereye mu buto bganje, izo nārukanye mu bgoko bgacu n’i Yerusalemu, Abayuda bose barazizi.
Kandi bokwemera kubishingira intahe, baranzi, uhereye mbere na mbere, yuko nar’ Umufarisayo wo mu muce urusha iyindi yo mw idini yacu gushimikira imigenzo.
None mpagaze ngo ncirwe urubanza, kuko nizigira kuzobona ivy’ Imana yasezeraniye ba sogokuruza:
ivyo imiryango yacu cumi n’ibiri yizigira kuzobona, ikorera Imana ishizek’ umwete mwinshi ku murango no mw ijoro. Kandi ni kubg’ ivyo vyizigiro ndezwe n’Abayuda, mugenzi!
N’iki gituma mugira ngo n’ikintu kitoruha cemerwa kw Imana izura abapfuye?
Nanje ubganje nahora niyumvira muri jewe yuko nkwiye gukora vyinshi birwanya izina rya Yesu Umunyanazareti.
Kand’ ivyo narabikora nyene nd’i Yerusalemu, ngashira abera benshi mu mabohero, mpawe ubushobozi n’abaherezi bakuru, kand’ aho bābica, nanje nishira mu bemera ko bicwa.
No mu masinagogi yose nābahana kenshi, nkagerageza cane kubatukisha Yesu; kandi kuko nasazwa cane mbazira, narabatuza no gushitsa mu bisagara vy’abanyamahanga.
Ngikora ivyo, nja i Damasiko mpawe ubushobozi ndungitswe n’abaherezi bakuru.
Nuko mugenzi, nkigenda mu mashōka, mbona umuco uvuye mw ijuru, urusha ukw izuba rica ibibatsi, unkayanganira irya n’ino, twe n’abo tugendanye.
Twese twikubise hasi, numva ijwi rimbgira mu rurimi rw’Igiheburayo, riti Sauli, Sauli, umpīgira iki? Erega birakugoye gutera imigere ku mihunda.
Nanje ndabaza, nt’ Uri nde ga Mwami? Umwami aranyishura, ati Ndi Yesu, uwo urik’ urahīga.
Ariko va hasi, hagarara n’ibirenge vyawe: kukw igitumye nkwiyereka, ar’ukugira ngo ngutoranye nkugire umukozi wanje n’icabona co gushingira intahe ivy’ umbonanye, n’ivyo nzokwiyerekeramwo;
ndagukize abo mur’ ubu bgoko bo n’abanyamahanga, ni bo ngutumyeko,
kubahumūra amaso kugira ngo bahindukire bave mu mwiza baje mu muco, bave no mu bubasha bga Satani baje ku Mana, bateko baharirwe ivyaha vyabo, baraganwe n’abejejwe n’ukunyizera.
Nuko, mwami Agiripa, sinanka kwumvira ivyo neretswe vyavuye mw ijuru.

Ariko nabanje kubgira ab’i Damasiko hanyuma ab’i Yerusalemu, n’abo mu gihugu cose c’i Yudaya, n’abanyamahanga na bo, yuko bakwiye kwihana, no guhindukirira Imana, bakore ibikorwa bikwiranye n’ukwihana.
Ni co catumye Abayuda bamfatira mu rusengero, bakageza kunyica.
None nabonye gutabarwa kwavuye ku Mana, ndacahagaze kugeza n’ubu, nshingira intahe aboroshe n’abahambaye, nta kindi mvuga atar’ ivy’ abāvugishwa n’Imana na Mose bāvuze ko bizoba,
yuko Kristo atazobura kubabazwa, kandi kw ari we azobanza kuzuka mu bapfuye, no kubgira ubgoko bgacu n’abanyamahanga ubutumwa bg’umuco.
Aciregura artyo, Fesito avuga n’ijwi rirenga, at’ Erega Paulo urasaze; ubgenge bgawe bginshi buragushajije.
Paulo aramwishura, ati Sinsaze, Fesito umwubahwa, ariko mvuga amajambo y’ukuri kand’ aroranye.
Umwami arazi ivyo neza, kandi ndamubarira nshize amanga; kuko nzi yukw ata na kimwe mur’ ivyo ahishijwe, kukw ivyo bitākorewe mu mfuruka.
Mwami Agiripa, uremeye ivy’ abāvugishwa n’Imana? Ndazi yuk’ uvyemeye.
Agiripa yishura Paulo, at’ Unkwegesha ivyo bike ng’ umpindure Umukristo?
Paulo, ati Ndasaba Imana ari bike ari vyinshi, yukw atoba wewe wenyene, ariko n’abanyumva uyu musi mwese, ko vyobahindura nkanje, ukūye iyi minyororo.
Umwami ahagurukana n’icēgēra ca Kayisari na Berenike, n’abāri bicaranye na we;
maze basohotse baravugana, bati Nta co uyu muntu yakoze gikwiye kumwicisha canke kumubohesha.
Agiripa abarira Fesito, at’ Uyu muntu aba arekuwe, iy’ ataba yar’ agomvye kuzokwitwara kuri Kayisari.
Bamaze gushinga ngo tujabuke tuje muri Italiya, Paulo n’izindi mbohe babaha umugabisha w’abasoda ijana yitwa Yuliyo, wo mu ngabo za Augusito.
Dutambukira mu bgato bgāvuye muri Aduramutiyo, bugira bugende bujabukiranya ahantu ho muri Asiya haherereye ku kiyaga, tuvudukayo turi kumwe na Arisitariko Umunyamakedoniya w’i Tesalonike.
Bukeye bg’aho dufata i Sidoni, Yuliyo agirira Paulo neza, amukundira kugendera abagenzi ngo bamuzimane.
Tuvudukayo, duca musi y’i Kupuro ngo tuhīkinge umuyaga, kuko war’ uduturutse imbere.
Tujabutse ikiyaga gihereranye n’i Kilikiya n’i Pamfiliya, dufata mu gisagara c’i Lukiya citwa Mura.
Uwo mugabisha w’abasoda ijana ahasanga ubgato buvuye muri Alekisanderiya buja muri Italiya, adushiramwo.
Tumaze imisi myinshi tugenda buhoro, dushika hafi y’i Kinido bitugoye cane, maz’ umuyaga utubujije duca musi y’i Kirete, imbere y’i Salumone, ngo tuhikinge umuyaga.
Tuhakikira bitugoye cane, dushika ahantu hitwa Vyambuvyiza, hafi y’igisagara citwa Laseya.
Hashize igihe kirekire, kandi kujabuka kubaye irinde, kukw igihe co kwisonzesha cari gishize, Paulo arabahanūra,
arababarira, ati Yemwe bagabo, mbonye yuk’ uru rugendo rugira rubemw’ ivyago n’ubuhombe bginshi, s’ivy’ ubgato n’ibirimwo gusa, ariko n’ivy’ amagara yacu na yo.
Ariko, umugabisha w’abasoda yumvira ūtumbereza ubgato na nyene bgo kurusha ivyo Paulo avuze.

Kandi kukw icambu atari ciza co kugumamwo kuhamara urushana, abenshi babagīra inama yo kuvayo, ngo bishobotse bashike i Foyinike, kuba ari ho bamara urushana, hār’ icambu c’i Kirete, cerekeye hagati y’i burārūko n’i burasirazuba, kandi hagati y’i burasirazuba n’i bumanuko.
Maz’ umuyaga uturutse i bumanuko uheheye buhoro, bibgiye ko baronse ico bāgomba, bazitura ubgato, bagenda bakikira hafi cane y’i Kirete.
Arikw igihe kitari kinini gishize, hatera umuyaga w’igihuhuta citwa Ewurakulo, uturutse kur’ ico kizinga.
Ubgato bumaze guhehwa, butagishobora gutumbera umuyaga, turabureka burakubebga.
Duca musi y’akazinga kitwa Kilawuda, tuhīkinga umuyaga, tubona uko tuboha akāto k’inyuma bitugoye cane;

bamaze kugaterura, bābīra ibitsibo vy’integakiba, babicisha musi y’ubgato, barabuboha: kandi kuko batinya gusukwa ku musenyi ushaya witwa Suriti, bamanura igihuzu kigendesha ubgato, bagenda bartyo bakubebga.
Tuzungagizwa cane n’igihuhuta, bukeye bg’aho bata imitwaro mu kiyaga.
Ku musi ugira gatatu batesha amaboko yabo ibikoreshwa mu bgato.
Kand’ izuba n’inyenyeri bimaze imisi myinshi bitaboneka, turi mu gihuhuta cinshi girtyo, twihebura rwose kw ata wuzokira.
Bamaze igihe kirekire batakirya, Paulo ahagarara hagati muri bo, arababarira, ati Yemwe bagabo, mwāri mukwiye kunyumvira, ntimuve i Kirete, ngo mugire ibi vyago n’ubuhombe.
Kandi none ndabaremesha, ni muhūmure, kuko muri mwebge hatazopfa n’umwe, atar’ ubgato.
Kuko mur’ iri joro umumarayika w’Imana, nd’ uwayo, kandi ni yo nkorera, yahagaze i ruhande yanje,
arambgira, ati Nta co utinya, Paulo; ukwiye guhagarara imbere ya Kayisari, kand’ ehe Imana ikwemereye n’abo mugendanye bose.
Nuko ni muhūmure, yemwe bagabo, kuko nizeye Imana, yuko bizoba nk’uko nabariwe.
Ariko har’ ikizinga dukwiye gusukwako.
Ijoro ry’icumi na kane rishitse, dukūbēbga irya n’ino mu kiyaga ca Adiriya; maze nko mu gicugu abagendesha ubgato bakēka ko har’ igihugu bēgereye.
Bagera uburebure bg’amazi yo hasi, babona ingero mirongwibiri; hashize umwanya muto bongera kugera, babona ingero cumi na zitanu.
Kandi kuko batinya gusukwa ahantu h’amabuye baterera mu mazi ivyuma bine vyo kuzirika ubgato babicishije mu mutwe w’inyuma; bifuza ko buca.
Maz’ abagendesha ubgato barondeye ingene bobuhungamwo, bururukiriza ka kāto mu kiyaga, biyenzereza nk’abagomba kuzirikisha ivyuma umutwe w’imbere.
Paulo abarira wa mugabisha w’abasoda ijana, hamwe n’abasoda na bo, at’ Aba ni bataguma mu bgato ntimushobora gukira.
Maz’ abasoda baca imigozi ifashe akāto, ngo bakareke gakoroke.
Bugira buce Paulo arabinginga bose ngo barye, ati Non’ uyu musi n’ūgira icumi na kane mukirorereye mutarya, ata co mutamira.
Nuko ndabinginze, ni murābe utwo murya: kukw ari vyo vyobakiza, kandi ntihazohara agashatsi na kamwe ko ku mitwe yanyu.
Amaze kuvuga ivyo, yābīra umutsima, ashimira Imana imbere yabo bose, arawumanyagura, atangura kurya.
Bose basubiza umutima mu nda, na bo bararya.
Kandi twese abāri mu bgato twar’ abantu amajana abiri na mirongwirindwi na batandatu.
Bamaze guhāga, baremurura ubgato, bata ingano mu kiyaga.
Ijoro rikeye, ntibāmenya ico gihugu, ariko babonye ikigobe kirimw’ umusenyi, baja inama yuko boshobora gushikanah’ ubgato.

Bazitura imigozi ifashe ivyuma biziritse ubgato, babirekera i bgina; bariko barabikora, batenzūra imigozi yar’ igumije ingafe zihindukiza ubgato, badūza igihuzu c’imbere kibugendesha ngo gihēhwe n’umuyaga, batumbereza ku musenyi.
